courses.title: 長江三峽大壩工程
courses.summary: 以三峽大型複合工程為背景，進一步追蹤預報偏差如何耗用防洪空間、長庫區流量如何轉成不均勻水位，以及泥砂和溫度如何改變調度判斷。學員把船閘用水、機組淨水頭及電力爬坡列成可核對帳本，避免只用總裝機容量代表每個時段的可供電力。
courses.summaryEn: Using Three Gorges as context, trace how forecast bias consumes flood space, how flow produces spatially varying levels, and how sediment and temperature affect decisions. Build auditable accounts of lock water, turbine net head and electrical ramping, recognizing that installed capacity cannot describe deliverable power in every interval.
courses.focus: 長庫區洪水預報與航運發電耦合
courses.focusEn: Flood forecasting and navigation generation coupling in a long reservoir
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 世界水壩與水庫
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「洪峰預報偏差帳」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「分段庫容積分」及「泥砂質量與淤積」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3；第二組為 A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Flood forecast bias account, then compare the controlling variables in Piecewise storage integration and Sediment mass and deposition. The first calculation is dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3; the second is A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

newStages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「洪峰預報偏差帳」與「分段庫容積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flood forecast bias account" and "Piecewise storage integration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪峰預報偏差帳」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flood forecast bias account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。入流偏差會隨時間積分成庫容偏差，即使瞬時流量差看似不大，也可能持續耗用預留空間。模型必須以相同時間窗對齊雨量預報、支流到達與下游限制，不能把更新前後的預報當成兩股來水。 逐時正負誤差可能在期末抵消，但最大累積偏差仍決定需要保留的暫時空間，應同時報告兩種量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪峰預報偏差帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release. Inflow bias integrates over time into storage error, so a modest flow discrepancy can consume reserved space when it persists. Rainfall predictions, tributary arrival and downstream restrictions must share a time window; forecast revisions are alternative estimates, not additional streams of water. Positive and negative hourly errors may cancel at the endpoint, while the maximum cumulative error still determines temporary space requirements; report both quantities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flood forecast bias account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪峰預報偏差帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flood forecast bias account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳
knowledge.text: 大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。入流偏差會隨時間積分成庫容偏差，即使瞬時流量差看似不大，也可能持續耗用預留空間。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release. Inflow bias integrates over time into storage error, so a modest flow discrepancy can consume reserved space when it persists.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪峰預報偏差帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood forecast bias account" is correct?
options: 每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水
大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。
相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容
optionsEn: Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow.
Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release.
Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage.
quiz.explanation: 大型水庫調度先把預報入流與可控制出流分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir scheduling separates forecast inflow from controllable release. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洪峰預報偏差帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flood forecast bias account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。模型邊界：偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3. Model boundary: constant bias throughout the interval, omitting surface rainfall, evaporation and withdrawals; this is forecast error volume only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。模型邊界：偏差在整段期間固定，忽略水面雨量蒸發及取水；只計預報誤差體積。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3. Model boundary: constant bias throughout the interval, omitting surface rainfall, evaporation and withdrawals; this is forecast error volume only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪峰預報偏差帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Flood forecast bias account", which statement holds?
options: 出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度
大船入槽一定等量增加升降總重
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。
optionsEn: The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.
A heavier floating vessel always adds its full weight to the lifted total.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=1500 m3/s; dt=6 h; dS=dQ*dt*3600=32400000 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洪峰預報偏差帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flood forecast bias account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。另查出流儀表是否延遲，若流量偏差與水位變化不閉合，先排除時間戳及曲線版本不同，不直接調整防洪限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Check release-meter delay separately. If flow imbalance and level change disagree, investigate timestamps and curve versions before interpreting the discrepancy as lost flood space. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立六小時誤差帳，再把偏差改成前半正值、後半負值，分別比較最大暫存量與期末淨增量，說明兩者對預留空間的意義不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a six-hour error account, then reverse the bias sign halfway through. Compare maximum temporary storage with the final net increment and explain why they imply different space requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。另查出流儀表是否延遲，若流量偏差與水位變化不閉合，先排除時間戳及曲線版本不同，不直接調整防洪限制。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Check release-meter delay separately. If flow imbalance and level change disagree, investigate timestamps and curve versions before interpreting the discrepancy as lost flood space.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立六小時誤差帳，再把偏差改成前半正值、後半負值，分別比較最大暫存量與期末淨增量，說明兩者對預留空間的意義不同。
knowledge.textEn: Build a six-hour error account, then reverse the bias sign halfway through. Compare maximum temporary storage with the final net increment and explain why they imply different space requirements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「洪峰預報偏差帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flood forecast bias account"?
options: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同
optionsEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.
quiz.explanation: 將逐時預報與事後入流各列一欄，以相同起訖時間積分並核對水位庫容表推算的增量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate hourly forecasts beside reconstructed inflow, integrate over identical limits and compare the increment with the stage-storage relation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 洪峰預報偏差帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood forecast bias account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洪峰預報偏差帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flood forecast bias account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. An unusual level can also reflect backwater or datum drift, so a second water-balance observation is needed before assigning the discrepancy to forecast failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：逐時正負誤差可能在期末抵消，但最大累積偏差仍決定需要保留的暫時空間，應同時報告兩種量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Positive and negative hourly errors may cancel at the endpoint, while the maximum cumulative error still determines temporary space requirements; report both quantities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每次預報更新都應另加一筆來水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 預報低估若與出流受限同時發生，庫容偏差會持續累積；但水位異常也可能來自回水或量測基準漂移，必須以第二種水量證據區分，不能只憑單站水位判斷預報失準。
knowledge.textEn: Underprediction combined with constrained release accumulates storage error. An unusual level can also reflect backwater or datum drift, so a second water-balance observation is needed before assigning the discrepancy to forecast failure.

steps.title: 分段庫容積分：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piecewise storage integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位與庫容通常不是固定面積的線性關係，山谷展寬會讓同一水位增量對應不同體積。用相鄰高程的水面面積做梯形積分，是資料稀疏時可檢查的近似；但支流庫灣及回水的空間差異仍須另外處理，不能把單站水位當成全庫水平面的證明。 若測深採用的水位基準與岸線高程不同，整張容量曲線會偏移，因此測量基準屬於模型輸入的一部分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分段庫容積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area. A widening valley gives different volumes for equal level increments. Trapezoidal integration between surveyed areas provides a transparent approximation when data are sparse, but tributary bays and backwater remain spatial effects that a single gauge cannot resolve. A mismatch between bathymetric water-level datum and shoreline elevations shifts the capacity curve; reference control is therefore part of the model input. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piecewise storage integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分段庫容積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piecewise storage integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area. A widening valley gives different volumes for equal level increments.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分段庫容積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage.
Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density.
Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area.
quiz.explanation: 水位與庫容通常不是固定面積的線性關係，山谷展寬會讓同一水位增量對應不同體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water level and storage are rarely related by one constant surface area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分段庫容積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piecewise storage integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分段庫容積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piecewise storage integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3。模型邊界：相鄰斷面的面積隨高程線性變化且假設靜水面；不是完整庫容曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: A1=380 km2; A2=420 km2; dz=2 m; dV=(A1+A2)/2*1e6*dz=800000000 m3. Model boundary: area changes linearly with elevation between observations and the surface is level; this is not a complete capacity curve. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以相同垂直基準疊合兩次測量輪廓，檢查支流庫灣是否被遺漏，再把高程間距減半比較積分變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Overlay survey contours in one vertical datum and check missing tributary bays.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 分段庫容積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piecewise storage integration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分段庫容積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piecewise storage integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同垂直基準疊合兩次測量輪廓，檢查支流庫灣是否被遺漏，再把高程間距減半比較積分變化。若細分結果差異集中在一段高程，應補查地形轉折，而非以整庫平均面積掩蓋局部誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Overlay survey contours in one vertical datum and check missing tributary bays. Halve the elevation interval and compare integrated volumes. If the change concentrates in one elevation band, investigate a terrain transition rather than hiding local error behind a reservoir-wide mean area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出三個高程的面積曲線，加入中間面積與端點線性值不同的情境，計算粗細兩種積分差並提出最值得補測的高程區間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot areas at three elevations and make the middle area differ from linear interpolation. Calculate coarse and refined volumes, then identify the elevation band where another survey would be most valuable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岸線插值錯誤會讓可用庫容被高估，尤其在淹沒平台突然展寬的位置；這類幾何誤差與蒸發損失的時間特徵不同，可用靜水測量及多次水量閉合分辨。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect shoreline interpolation can overstate usable storage, especially where a submerged terrace widens abruptly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and deposition: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥砂質量與淤積」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment mass and deposition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 懸浮泥砂先以乾質量守恆，沉積後再透過乾容重轉成體積，兩個步驟不可混用水的密度。流量、濃度與攔砂比例共同控制入庫及留庫質量；細粒壓密會隨時間改變體積，因此一次估算的體積不能直接當成永久損失曲線。 乾容重包含沉積孔隙的體積效應，壓密後即使乾質量不變，對應占據庫容仍可能減少，需明示測量齡期。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥砂質量與淤積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Suspended sediment is first conserved as dry mass and then converted to deposited volume using dry bulk density, not water density. Discharge, concentration and trapping fraction jointly control incoming and retained mass. Fine material consolidates over time, so one volume estimate does not establish a permanent capacity-loss curve. Dry bulk density includes pore-volume effects, so consolidation can reduce occupied storage without changing dry mass; specify the age of the surveyed deposit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment mass and deposition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泥砂質量與淤積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment mass and deposition”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 泥砂質量與淤積
knowledge.text: 懸浮泥砂先以乾質量守恆，沉積後再透過乾容重轉成體積，兩個步驟不可混用水的密度。流量、濃度與攔砂比例共同控制入庫及留庫質量；細粒壓密會隨時間改變體積，因此一次估算的體積不能直接當成永久損失曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Suspended sediment is first conserved as dry mass and then converted to deposited volume using dry bulk density, not water density. Discharge, concentration and trapping fraction jointly control incoming and retained mass.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算

optionsEn: Suspended sediment is first conserved as dry mass and then converted to deposited volume using dry bulk density, not water density.
Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density.
The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.
quiz.explanation: 懸浮泥砂先以乾質量守恆，沉積後再透過乾容重轉成體積，兩個步驟不可混用水的密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Suspended sediment is first conserved as dry mass and then converted to deposited volume using dry bulk density, not water density. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與淤積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and deposition: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泥砂質量與淤積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment mass and deposition” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3。模型邊界：流量濃度及截留比例皆固定；不含床載、再懸浮及後續壓密。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=2000 m3/s; C=0.30 kg/m3; t=86400 s; f=0.60 (dimensionless); rhoDry=1200 kg/m3; V=Q*C*t*f/rhoDry=25920 m3. Model boundary: constant flow, concentration and trapping fraction; excludes bed load, resuspension and subsequent consolidation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時採集不同水深的濃度樣本，核對濁度換算是否跨越粒徑改變，再用沉積岩心乾重與體積估算容重。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample concentration at several depths, check whether turbidity calibration spans changing grain sizes, and obtain dry bulk density from cores.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泥砂質量與淤積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and deposition: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥砂質量與淤積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment mass and deposition” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時採集不同水深的濃度樣本，核對濁度換算是否跨越粒徑改變，再用沉積岩心乾重與體積估算容重。將質量帳與測深體積比較時必須採相同期間，否則洪水後壓密會被誤認為泥砂離庫。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Sample concentration at several depths, check whether turbidity calibration spans changing grain sizes, and obtain dry bulk density from cores. Compare mass and bathymetric volume over the same period; otherwise consolidation after a flood may be mistaken for sediment leaving the reservoir. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩種乾容重重算同一留庫質量，再令洪水濃度隨流量先升後降，繪出質量輸入曲線，說明單一平均濃度會遺失哪些時序資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate one retained mass using two dry bulk densities, then make concentration rise and fall around the flood peak. Plot incoming mass and identify timing information lost by one average concentration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用表層濃度容易漏掉近底高濃度流，低估留庫質量；若直接用顆粒實體密度換算，還會忽略孔隙而低估沉積體積，兩項誤差可能同向疊加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface samples can miss concentrated near-bed flow and understate retained mass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Sample concentration at several depths, check whether turbidity calibration spans changing grain sizes, and obtain dry bulk density from cores. Compare mass and bathymetric volume over the same period; otherwise consolidation after a flood may be mistaken for sediment leaving the reservoir.

knowledge.text: 以兩種乾容重重算同一留庫質量，再令洪水濃度隨流量先升後降，繪出質量輸入曲線，說明單一平均濃度會遺失哪些時序資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate one retained mass using two dry bulk densities, then make concentration rise and fall around the flood peak. Plot incoming mass and identify timing information lost by one average concentration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「泥砂質量與淤積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sediment mass and deposition"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.title: 泥砂質量與淤積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sediment mass and deposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「泥砂質量與淤積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sediment mass and deposition” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用表層濃度容易漏掉近底高濃度流，低估留庫質量；若直接用顆粒實體密度換算，還會忽略孔隙而低估沉積體積，兩項誤差可能同向疊加。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface samples can miss concentrated near-bed flow and understate retained mass. Converting with particle density also ignores pore space and understates deposited volume, allowing both errors to reinforce one another. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：乾容重包含沉積孔隙的體積效應，壓密後即使乾質量不變，對應占據庫容仍可能減少，需明示測量齡期。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dry bulk density includes pore-volume effects, so consolidation can reduce occupied storage without changing dry mass; specify the age of the surveyed deposit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用表層濃度容易漏掉近底高濃度流，低估留庫質量；若直接用顆粒實體密度換算，還會忽略孔隙而低估沉積體積，兩項誤差可能同向疊加。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「泥砂質量與淤積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sediment mass and deposition" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只用表層濃度容易漏掉近底高濃度流，低估留庫質量；若直接用顆粒實體密度換算，還會忽略孔隙而低估沉積體積，兩項誤差可能同向疊加。

optionsEn: Surface samples can miss concentrated near-bed flow and understate retained mass.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.

steps.title: 分層取水混溫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered withdrawal temperature mixing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層取水混溫」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered withdrawal temperature mixing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深庫水溫分層會讓相同總流量具有不同下游熱負荷。理想混合先以各支流質量流率乘比熱與溫度作能量守恆，再求共同出口溫度；開口所在高程不等於實際吸入水層，因取水流束可能跨越密度界面，必須量測垂向剖面。 熱量帳應明示共同參考溫度；在相同比熱近似下參考值會相消，但水流的實際來源與交換路徑不能省略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層取水混溫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thermal stratification allows equal total releases to carry different downstream heat loads. Ideal mixing conserves each stream mass flow multiplied by heat capacity and temperature. The elevation of an opening does not uniquely identify the withdrawn layer, because the intake flow can entrain water across a density interface. The heat account needs a common reference temperature; it cancels under equal heat capacities, while stream origins and exchange paths still require explicit identification. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered withdrawal temperature mixing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層取水混溫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layered withdrawal temperature mixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層取水混溫
knowledge.text: 深庫水溫分層會讓相同總流量具有不同下游熱負荷。理想混合先以各支流質量流率乘比熱與溫度作能量守恆，再求共同出口溫度；開口所在高程不等於實際吸入水層，因取水流束可能跨越密度界面，必須量測垂向剖面。
knowledge.textEn: Thermal stratification allows equal total releases to carry different downstream heat loads. Ideal mixing conserves each stream mass flow multiplied by heat capacity and temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層取水混溫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

通船艘數就是獨立升降循環數
optionsEn: The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.
Thermal stratification allows equal total releases to carry different downstream heat loads.
Vessel count is the same as the number of independent lockage cycles.
quiz.explanation: 深庫水溫分層會讓相同總流量具有不同下游熱負荷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC。模型邊界：兩水流密度比熱相同、完全混合且無外界熱交換；不代表生態合格溫度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qwarm=120 m3/s; Twarm=22 degC; Qcold=80 m3/s; Tcold=12 degC; Tout=(Qwarm*Twarm+Qcold*Tcold)/(Qwarm+Qcold)=18 degC. Model boundary: equal density and heat capacity, complete mixing and no external heat exchange; not an ecological compliance temperature. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 分層取水混溫：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層取水混溫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Layered withdrawal temperature mixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在取水口上游布設垂向溫度剖面，並量測混合後斷面的橫向差異。以總流量與熱量殘差檢查混合是否完成；若出口單點溫度符合算值而橫向差異仍大，不能宣稱整個河段具有同一熱環境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure an upstream vertical temperature profile and lateral differences after mixing. Check total flow and heat residuals. If one outlet sensor matches the calculation while lateral differences remain large, the entire receiving reach cannot be described by that single temperature. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定總出流，求得另一目標溫度所需冷暖流量比例，再列出若冷水層厚度不足時模型失效的證據，以及需補充的剖面量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold total release constant and solve the warm-to-cold flow ratio for another target temperature. List observations showing that insufficient cold-layer thickness invalidates the assumption and specify additional profile measurements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水躍或分層流可能使冷水沿底部延伸，表面測值會掩蓋底層熱衝擊；感測器反應慢也可能削弱短時變化，應將空間不均與儀器滯後分別辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stratified release can carry cold water along the bed while surface readings hide the thermal change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分層取水混溫：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層取水混溫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Layered withdrawal temperature mixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水躍或分層流可能使冷水沿底部延伸，表面測值會掩蓋底層熱衝擊；感測器反應慢也可能削弱短時變化，應將空間不均與儀器滯後分別辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stratified release can carry cold water along the bed while surface readings hide the thermal change. Slow sensor response can also suppress short events, so spatial nonuniformity and instrument lag require separate diagnosis. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱量帳應明示共同參考溫度；在相同比熱近似下參考值會相消，但水流的實際來源與交換路徑不能省略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The heat account needs a common reference temperature; it cancels under equal heat capacities, while stream origins and exchange paths still require explicit identification.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 船閘用水時序：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lockage water timing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船閘升降依靠閘室水位變化，船隻排水量在同船進出且水位轉換完整時不應重複計入。教材先用閘室平面積乘水位差建立一個升降階段的幾何水量，再把循環次數放到時段帳中；多級閘室之間的共享水及回收系統必須另建連接關係。 每個閘室都應有控制體，級間移轉在整體帳內會互相抵消，只有跨越外部邊界的水量才形成淨耗用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船閘用水時序」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A lock changes chamber level to move vessels. Vessel displacement must not be counted repeatedly when the same vessel enters and leaves a complete level-change cycle. Chamber area times lift gives one stage geometric volume; the number and timing of cycles then enter the water account. Shared water between stages requires an explicit connection model. Each chamber needs a control volume; interstage transfers cancel in the overall account, and only flow crossing its external boundary contributes to net use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lockage water timing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：A=4200 m2; dh=18 m; N=12 cycles/day; V=A*dh*N=907200 m3/day。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「通船艘數就是獨立升降循環數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lockage water timing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用閘室水位曲線識別充水與排水開始時間，核對閥門流量積分與幾何體積，再追蹤水究竟來自上游庫區或鄰室。若只記錄通船艘數而未記實際升降循環，共閘通行會使估計耗水失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify filling and emptying from chamber level traces, compare integrated valve flow with geometric volume, and track whether water comes from the reservoir or a neighboring chamber. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Valve leakage transfers water during waiting periods and prevents geometric closure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 閥門漏水會使停等期間仍有水量移轉，幾何升降帳因而不能閉合；但多艘共閘與級間調水也會造成表面差異，應先辨認流程再指認設備洩漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 水槽式升船裝置的理想平衡取決於槽內總重量，而非只看船重。浮船進槽時通常排出相應水量，若槽內水位維持不變，載船前後總重近似不變。教材把殘餘不平衡質量與摩擦分開，藉此辨認驅動功率、制動及結構載重是不同問題。 船仍漂浮時排水質量與船重相等，若船體接觸槽底則浮力條件改變，不能再使用原先重量替代關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「升船機平衡偏差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 以槽水位、排出水量和稱重記錄核對浮力替代關係，再比較空槽與載船的同速電流。若差值隨運動方向改變，應檢查摩擦與導向偏載；若與水位偏差一致，才支持殘餘重量解釋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare trough level, displaced water and weighing records, then compare empty and occupied trough current at equal speed. Direction-dependent differences suggest friction or guide loading, whereas a consistent relation with level error supports an imbalance-weight explanation for the extra demand. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水位誤差換算成新增水重，與給定不平衡質量比較，再列出加速度與導向摩擦所需額外資料，繪製完整功率帳而不把缺項設成零。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert a level error into added water mass and compare it with the stated imbalance. List additional data needed for acceleration and guide friction, and build a complete power account without silently setting missing terms to zero.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Direction-dependent differences suggest friction or guide loading, whereas a consistent relation with level error supports an imbalance-weight explanation for the extra demand.

quiz.question: 要驗證「升船機平衡偏差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ship lift balance imbalance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算
以槽水位、排出水量和稱重記錄核對浮力替代關係，再比較空槽與載船的同速電流。

Deposited volume can be calculated directly using particle density.
Compare trough level, displaced water and weighing records, then compare empty and occupied trough current at equal speed.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare trough level, displaced water and weighing records, then compare empty and occupied trough current at equal speed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 升船機平衡偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ship lift balance imbalance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「升船機平衡偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ship lift balance imbalance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. A binding guide also raises current without the same static weight change, allowing weighing and direction tests to distinguish the two mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：船仍漂浮時排水質量與船重相等，若船體接觸槽底則浮力條件改變，不能再使用原先重量替代關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Displaced water mass equals vessel mass while the vessel floats; grounding changes that buoyancy condition and invalidates the original weight-substitution relationship for the trough.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「大船入槽一定等量增加升降總重」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heavier floating vessel always adds its full weight to the lifted total." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。
knowledge.textEn: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. A binding guide also raises current without the same static weight change, allowing weighing and direction tests to distinguish the two mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「升船機平衡偏差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ship lift balance imbalance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭
optionsEn: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head.
quiz.explanation: 水位控制失準會改變槽內總重，造成原先平衡假設不成立；導輪卡阻也會提高電流，但不會以相同方式改變靜態重量，兩者需靠停機稱重與方向試驗區分。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incorrect level control changes total trough weight and invalidates the balance assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「淨水頭功率帳」與「電力爬坡能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Net head power account" and "Electrical ramp energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淨水頭功率帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Net head power account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淨水頭功率帳」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net head power account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。尾水抬升與攔污柵阻塞都會降低淨水頭，卻有不同的量測位置及維修責任。把水力功率、軸功率與電功率依效率串接，才能避免在不同儀表邊界間重複扣損。 速度水頭必須和壓力水頭使用相容斷面，若兩端斷面差異很大，僅以靜水位差代替能量差會有偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淨水頭功率帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation. Tailwater rise and trash-rack blockage both reduce net head but have different measurement locations and maintenance implications. Distinguish hydraulic, shaft and electrical power when applying efficiencies so that losses are not deducted twice across instrument boundaries. Velocity and pressure heads require compatible sections; markedly different inlet and outlet sections make a simple static-level difference an incomplete estimate of energy difference. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net head power account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淨水頭功率帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net head power account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淨水頭功率帳
knowledge.text: 發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。尾水抬升與攔污柵阻塞都會降低淨水頭，卻有不同的量測位置及維修責任。
knowledge.textEn: Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation. Tailwater rise and trash-rack blockage both reduce net head but have different measurement locations and maintenance implications.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淨水頭功率帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Net head power account" is correct?
options: 壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭
發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。
總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同
optionsEn: Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head.
Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation.
Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.
quiz.explanation: 發電水頭是能量高程差扣除引水系統損失，不是壩高或水庫高程的同義詞。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Generating head is the energy-level difference after conveyance losses, not dam height or reservoir elevation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淨水頭功率帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Net head power account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淨水頭功率帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net head power account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，效率為水力輸入至電端總效率；未計暫態及可用率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW. Model boundary: steady incompressible flow with overall hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency; transients and availability are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮流，效率為水力輸入至電端總效率；未計暫態及可用率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW. Model boundary: steady incompressible flow with overall hydraulic-to-electrical efficiency; transients and availability are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淨水頭功率帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Net head power account", which statement holds?
options: 標準化殘差可直接當通用安全評分
相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容

optionsEn: A standardized residual directly provides a universal safety score.
Equal level increments always add equal reservoir storage.
Original hypothetical example.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Q=650 m3/s; Hg=92 m; hL=4 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.91 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(Hg-hL)*eta/1e6=510.63012 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淨水頭功率帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Net head power account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淨水頭功率帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Net head power account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。若損失隨流量平方增加而機組效率曲線正常，先查引水阻力，不把全部差值歸因於轉輪劣化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections. If loss grows approximately with flow squared while the turbine efficiency trend remains normal, investigate conveyance resistance before assigning the entire discrepancy to runner deterioration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別增加尾水高程及柵損失，保持其他輸入不變重算功率，再畫出兩個情境所需量測位置，說明相同功率下降為何需要不同處理。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase tailwater level and rack loss in separate scenarios while holding other inputs constant. Recalculate power and locate the measurements needed to explain why equal power reductions require different responses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尾水資料延遲會造成虛假的效率升降，尤其在快速增載後；堵塞柵前後的壓差才是局部損失證據，不能僅由電力降低推定必須更換機組。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Delayed tailwater data create artificial efficiency changes after load increases. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。若損失隨流量平方增加而機組效率曲線正常，先查引水阻力，不把全部差值歸因於轉輪劣化。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections. If loss grows approximately with flow squared while the turbine efficiency trend remains normal, investigate conveyance resistance before assigning the entire discrepancy to runner deterioration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別增加尾水高程及柵損失，保持其他輸入不變重算功率，再畫出兩個情境所需量測位置，說明相同功率下降為何需要不同處理。
knowledge.textEn: Increase tailwater level and rack loss in separate scenarios while holding other inputs constant. Recalculate power and locate the measurements needed to explain why equal power reductions require different responses.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淨水頭功率帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Net head power account"?
options: 同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
出口平均溫度就是整段河川溫度
optionsEn: Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The average outlet temperature represents the entire receiving river reach.
quiz.explanation: 同步讀取進出口能量高程、流量與電端功率，以同一時段計算效率，並核對壓力計高程補償。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize inlet and outlet energy levels, discharge and terminal power, including pressure-tap elevation corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淨水頭功率帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Net head power account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淨水頭功率帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net head power account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尾水資料延遲會造成虛假的效率升降，尤其在快速增載後；堵塞柵前後的壓差才是局部損失證據，不能僅由電力降低推定必須更換機組。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Delayed tailwater data create artificial efficiency changes after load increases. Differential pressure across a blocked rack is evidence of local loss; reduced electrical output alone does not establish that the generating unit needs replacement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：速度水頭必須和壓力水頭使用相容斷面，若兩端斷面差異很大，僅以靜水位差代替能量差會有偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Velocity and pressure heads require compatible sections; markedly different inlet and outlet sections make a simple static-level difference an incomplete estimate of energy difference.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩高可直接當作機組淨水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dam height can be used directly as turbine net head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淨水頭功率帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Delayed tailwater data create artificial efficiency changes after load increases.
Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.

steps.title: 電力爬坡能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Electrical ramp energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電力爬坡能量」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electrical ramp energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電網要求的功率爬坡會沿水力傳動鏈改變流量及壓力，但功率斜率與累計能量是不同維度。先以功率時間曲線求能量，再檢查水量及暫態約束是否容許該曲線；額外能量只是相對基線的面積，不能將爬坡末值乘全時段而忽略初值。 功率曲線下面積的單位是能量，曲線斜率則是功率每時間，將兩者分開才能對照不同調度合約要求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電力爬坡能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A grid power ramp changes flow and pressure through the hydraulic chain, but ramp rate and accumulated energy have different dimensions. Integrate the power-time curve first, then check water and transient constraints. Additional energy is the area above a baseline, not the final power multiplied by the whole ramp duration. Area under a power curve is energy, whereas its slope is power per time; separating them permits comparison with different dispatch requirements and limits. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Electrical ramp energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電力爬坡能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Electrical ramp energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電力爬坡能量

knowledge.textEn: A grid power ramp changes flow and pressure through the hydraulic chain, but ramp rate and accumulated energy have different dimensions. Integrate the power-time curve first, then check water and transient constraints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電力爬坡能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electrical ramp energy" is correct?
options: 總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同
水庫水面在任何流量下皆為水平
電網要求的功率爬坡會沿水力傳動鏈改變流量及壓力，但功率斜率與累計能量是不同維度。
optionsEn: Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects.
A reservoir surface is level at every discharge.
A grid power ramp changes flow and pressure through the hydraulic chain, but ramp rate and accumulated energy have different dimensions.
quiz.explanation: 電網要求的功率爬坡會沿水力傳動鏈改變流量及壓力，但功率斜率與累計能量是不同維度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A grid power ramp changes flow and pressure through the hydraulic chain, but ramp rate and accumulated energy have different dimensions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電力爬坡能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electrical ramp energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電力爬坡能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electrical ramp energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh。模型邊界：假設電端功率線性爬坡，不表示水力暫態或電網限制已獲滿足。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh. Model boundary: linear electrical power ramp only; hydraulic transient and grid constraints are not thereby satisfied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以秒級電功率積分核對時段電表，再將調度命令、導葉位置與壓力峰值按時間對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate second-scale terminal power and compare the interval meter, then align dispatch commands, guide-vane position and pressure peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh。模型邊界：假設電端功率線性爬坡，不表示水力暫態或電網限制已獲滿足。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh. Model boundary: linear electrical power ramp only; hydraulic transient and grid constraints are not thereby satisfied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電力爬坡能量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electrical ramp energy", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P0=400 MW; P1=700 MW; dt=0.25 h; E=(P0+P1)/2*dt=137.5 MWh。

沉積體積可以直接用顆粒密度換算

Every forecast revision should be counted as an additional inflow.

steps.title: 電力爬坡能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electrical ramp energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電力爬坡能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Electrical ramp energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以秒級電功率積分核對時段電表，再將調度命令、導葉位置與壓力峰值按時間對齊。若總電量正確但壓力有尖峰，問題屬爬坡形狀而非能量帳；應保留原始波形，不只保存十五分鐘平均值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate second-scale terminal power and compare the interval meter, then align dispatch commands, guide-vane position and pressure peaks. Correct total energy with a pressure spike indicates a ramp-shape problem, so retain raw waveforms instead of only fifteen-minute averages for the diagnosis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較線性爬坡與先快後慢的兩段曲線，使兩者總電量相同，再指出哪幾個水力與電氣量必須高頻記錄才能判斷各自限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare a linear ramp with a two-stage fast-then-slow ramp having equal energy. Identify the hydraulic and electrical variables requiring rapid recording to determine the different constraints on each trajectory.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只核對時段電量會漏掉短時壓力超越或機組振動，因正負功率偏差可能互相抵消；若時間戳錯位，也會把先前的壓力事件錯配到後續命令。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking interval energy alone can miss brief pressure or vibration excursions because positive and negative power errors cancel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Correct total energy with a pressure spike indicates a ramp-shape problem, so retain raw waveforms instead of only fifteen-minute averages for the diagnosis.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總電量相同就代表爬坡影響相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total energy means that ramp trajectories have equivalent effects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只核對時段電量會漏掉短時壓力超越或機組振動，因正負功率偏差可能互相抵消；若時間戳錯位，也會把先前的壓力事件錯配到後續命令。
knowledge.textEn: Checking interval energy alone can miss brief pressure or vibration excursions because positive and negative power errors cancel. Timestamp misalignment can additionally attach an earlier pressure event to a later dispatch command.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 長庫區回水高差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long reservoir backwater difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長庫區回水高差」如何影響長江三峽大壩工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long reservoir backwater difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges Dam Engineering”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有持續流量通過的長庫區並非處處靜水面，水面坡度同時受斷面、摩阻與下游控制影響。教材先以已量測平均坡度換算兩站高差，建立空間尺度感；真正回水分析仍需能量方程及各斷面資料，不能用一條坡線外推所有支流。 水面坡度與能量坡度並不總相等，流速水頭沿程改變時需要補入能量方程，尤其在斷面突變附近。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長庫區回水高差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long reservoir carrying flow does not have a level surface everywhere. Section geometry, friction and downstream control jointly influence the water-surface slope. A measured mean slope can estimate the difference between two stations, but actual backwater analysis requires energy equations and cross sections rather than one line extrapolated through every tributary. Water-surface slope and energy slope are not always equal; changing velocity head requires an energy correction, particularly near abrupt changes in cross-sectional geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long reservoir backwater difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫水面在任何流量下皆為水平」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A reservoir surface is level at every discharge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長庫區回水高差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long reservoir backwater difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A long reservoir carrying flow does not have a level surface everywhere. Section geometry, friction and downstream control jointly influence the water-surface slope.

knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫水面在任何流量下皆為水平 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A reservoir surface is level at every discharge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 長庫區回水高差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long reservoir backwater difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長庫區回水高差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long reservoir backwater difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m。模型邊界：坡度為無因次且只代表該時段兩站平均水面坡度；不是摩阻坡度定律。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m. Model boundary: dimensionless slope represents the observed mean water-surface gradient between two stations in one interval, not a friction-slope law. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先統一兩站水準基準並校正訊號時間，再比較低流量與洪水時的高差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Unify gauge datums and synchronize signals before comparing low-flow and flood differences.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Sw=0.000012 (dimensionless); L=80000 m; dh=Sw*L=0.96 m。模型邊界：坡度為無因次且只代表該時段兩站平均水面坡度；不是摩阻坡度定律。

Model boundary: dimensionless slope represents the observed mean water-surface gradient between two stations in one interval, not a friction-slope law.
