knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

options: 相同水位增量必定增加相同庫容

steps.title: 長庫區回水高差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long reservoir backwater difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長庫區回水高差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long reservoir backwater difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先統一兩站水準基準並校正訊號時間，再比較低流量與洪水時的高差。若高差會隨流量改變而基準點穩定，支持水力回水解釋；若所有流量下都出現固定偏移，應先檢查測站基準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Unify gauge datums and synchronize signals before comparing low-flow and flood differences. A flow-dependent difference with stable benchmarks supports a hydraulic explanation. A fixed offset across all flow conditions instead calls for checking the reference elevations and calibration of the gauges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一長度下試算兩倍坡度的高差，並畫出支流匯入口前後應設的測站，說明哪些資料可檢查平均坡度假設，哪些需一維或二維模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the slope over the same length, then locate gauges around a tributary junction. Explain which observations test the mean-slope assumption and which questions require a one- or two-dimensional hydraulic model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把上游洪水抬升全歸因於壩前水位，會漏掉沿程壅水及支流匯入作用；反之，基準錯差也可能偽裝成坡度，必須用獨立水準測量拆解。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attributing all upstream flood rise to the dam-front level overlooks reach backwater and tributary inputs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：y=7.2 mm; yhat=5.4 mm; sigma=0.6 mm; z=(y-yhat)/sigma=3。模型邊界：正常基線的標準差固定；數值僅示範殘差，並非本壩警報或安全判準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 多感測殘差判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Multiple sensor residual diagnosis: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多感測殘差判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multiple sensor residual diagnosis” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時檢查溫度、庫水位、量測基準及維修紀錄，將殘差與附近不同原理儀器比較。若僅單一通道偏離而獨立測量穩定，先查儀器；若多種原理同時偏離，再追查共同結構或水力原因。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review temperature, reservoir level, reference control and maintenance records together, then compare residuals with nearby instruments using different physical principles. An isolated channel suggests an instrument issue; coherent changes across independent methods justify investigating a shared structural or hydraulic mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立包含季節項的假想量測序列，分別加入感測器跳值與緩慢結構位移，畫出原始值和殘差，提出可區分兩種原因的獨立觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a hypothetical seasonal series and separately insert a sensor jump and slow structural movement. Plot observations and residuals, then propose an independent measurement that can distinguish the two underlying causes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基線若含長期漂移，標準差會被放大而掩蓋新異常；若校準資料只涵蓋低水位，外推至高水位也會產生假殘差，不能直接宣告壩體劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A drifting baseline inflates the standard deviation and can conceal new changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 多感測殘差判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Multiple sensor residual diagnosis: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多感測殘差判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Multiple sensor residual diagnosis” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基線若含長期漂移，標準差會被放大而掩蓋新異常；若校準資料只涵蓋低水位，外推至高水位也會產生假殘差，不能直接宣告壩體劣化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A drifting baseline inflates the standard deviation and can conceal new changes. A model trained only at low reservoir levels can also create false residuals at high levels, which do not alone demonstrate dam deterioration. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「標準化殘差可直接當通用安全評分」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A standardized residual directly provides a universal safety score." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 胡佛壩
courses.summary: 以胡佛壩為背景，區分自重抗滑與拱向傳力、裂縫連通與揚壓，以及冷卻收縮與接縫閉合。後半部把壓力瞬變、低水頭出力、排砂與量測溫漂連結，讓學員用相互獨立的證據判斷異常原因。所有試算都明示幾何與材料是假想值，不替代既有壩評估。
courses.summaryEn: Using Hoover as context, distinguish gravity resistance from arch transfer, crack connectivity from uplift, and cooling contraction from joint closure. Later units connect pressure transients, low-head output, sediment and measurement drift, requiring independent evidence to distinguish causes. Every calculation uses declared hypothetical geometry or material data and cannot replace assessment of the existing dam.
courses.focus: 拱重力壩熱力水力與監測交互診斷
courses.focusEn: Arch gravity dam thermal hydraulic and monitoring diagnosis
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「拱座相容與分力」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「裂縫連通與揚壓」及「混凝土冷卻熱量」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN；第二組為 pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Abutment compatibility and load sharing, then compare the controlling variables in Crack connectivity and uplift and Concrete cooling heat account. The first calculation is ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN; the second is pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

newStages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「拱座相容與分力」與「裂縫連通與揚壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment compatibility and load sharing" and "Crack connectivity and uplift": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拱座相容與分力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment compatibility and load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱座相容與分力」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment compatibility and load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱重力壩把一部分水平荷載沿拱圈送到兩岸，也把一部分荷載透過壩底傳入基礎。教材以同位移的平行彈簧理解剛度與分力，不把它當成真實拱壩公式。岩體節理、施工縫及溫度會改變相容條件，所以增加某路徑剛度也會改變其他路徑分擔。 平行彈簧共同位移來自相容條件，若兩岸支承本身移動，需把支承位移加入，分力比例就不再只由剛度決定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱座相容與分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An arch-gravity dam transfers some horizontal load toward the abutments and some through its base. Parallel springs with equal displacement illustrate stiffness-controlled sharing, not a real arch-dam design equation. Rock joints, construction joints and temperature alter compatibility, so stiffening one path changes the load carried by the other path as well. Equal spring displacement follows compatibility; moving supports introduce imposed displacements, after which stiffness ratios alone no longer determine the force shares between the paths. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment compatibility and load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height alone determines the arch load share." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱座相容與分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment compatibility and load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱座相容與分力

knowledge.textEn: An arch-gravity dam transfers some horizontal load toward the abutments and some through its base. Parallel springs with equal displacement illustrate stiffness-controlled sharing, not a real arch-dam design equation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dam height alone determines the arch load share. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱座相容與分力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment compatibility and load sharing" is correct?
options: 只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力
拱重力壩把一部分水平荷載沿拱圈送到兩岸，也把一部分荷載透過壩底傳入基礎。
只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓
optionsEn: Dam height alone determines the arch load share.
An arch-gravity dam transfers some horizontal load toward the abutments and some through its base.
Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution.
quiz.explanation: 拱重力壩把一部分水平荷載沿拱圈送到兩岸，也把一部分荷載透過壩底傳入基礎。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An arch-gravity dam transfers some horizontal load toward the abutments and some through its base. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱座相容與分力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment compatibility and load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱座相容與分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment compatibility and load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN。模型邊界：線彈性且兩路徑同位移；未模擬三維拱殼、開裂或接觸滑移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN. Model boundary: linear elasticity and equal displacement in both paths; excludes three-dimensional shell action, cracking and contact slip. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一水位下比較壩體位移、拱座變形及溫度，避免用不同季節的位移直接反推剛度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare dam displacement, abutment deformation and temperature at the same reservoir level before inferring stiffness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN。模型邊界：線彈性且兩路徑同位移；未模擬三維拱殼、開裂或接觸滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN. Model boundary: linear elasticity and equal displacement in both paths; excludes three-dimensional shell action, cracking and contact slip.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱座相容與分力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abutment compatibility and load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 自由熱伸長就是受約束接縫閉合量
所有表面可採同一汽蝕數界線
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN。
optionsEn: Free thermal extension equals closure of a restrained joint.
One cavitation-number threshold applies to every spillway surface.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ka=8 GN/m; kg=12 GN/m; F=100 MN; Fa=F*ka/(ka+kg)=40 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱座相容與分力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment compatibility and load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱座相容與分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Abutment compatibility and load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一水位下比較壩體位移、拱座變形及溫度，避免用不同季節的位移直接反推剛度。以改變一個路徑剛度的敏感度分析檢查分力總和是否保持外力，並用多點量測辨認左右岸反應不對稱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare dam displacement, abutment deformation and temperature at the same reservoir level before inferring stiffness. Change one path stiffness and confirm that load shares still sum to the applied force. Use several observations to distinguish an asymmetric abutment response from a uniform translation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把拱座路徑剛度減半，重算兩種分力與共同位移，畫出每個路徑的自由體圖，列出需要岩體試驗才能確認的模型參數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the abutment-path stiffness and recalculate both load shares and common displacement. Draw a free-body diagram for each path and identify the parameters that require rock-mass testing before interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一水位下比較壩體位移、拱座變形及溫度，避免用不同季節的位移直接反推剛度。以改變一個路徑剛度的敏感度分析檢查分力總和是否保持外力，並用多點量測辨認左右岸反應不對稱。
knowledge.textEn: Compare dam displacement, abutment deformation and temperature at the same reservoir level before inferring stiffness. Change one path stiffness and confirm that load shares still sum to the applied force. Use several observations to distinguish an asymmetric abutment response from a uniform translation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把拱座路徑剛度減半，重算兩種分力與共同位移，畫出每個路徑的自由體圖，列出需要岩體試驗才能確認的模型參數。
knowledge.textEn: Halve the abutment-path stiffness and recalculate both load shares and common displacement. Draw a free-body diagram for each path and identify the parameters that require rock-mass testing before interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱座相容與分力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abutment compatibility and load sharing"?
options: 在同一水位下比較壩體位移、拱座變形及溫度，避免用不同季節的位移直接反推剛度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
岸線移動距離就是沉積前緣移動距離
optionsEn: Compare dam displacement, abutment deformation and temperature at the same reservoir level before inferring stiffness.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Shoreline movement equals the movement of the sediment front.
quiz.explanation: 在同一水位下比較壩體位移、拱座變形及溫度，避免用不同季節的位移直接反推剛度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare dam displacement, abutment deformation and temperature at the same reservoir level before inferring stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱座相容與分力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abutment compatibility and load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱座相容與分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abutment compatibility and load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere. Calibrating only one crest displacement may reproduce overall stiffness while completely misrepresenting local stress concentrations and the distribution of support reactions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平行彈簧共同位移來自相容條件，若兩岸支承本身移動，需把支承位移加入，分力比例就不再只由剛度決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal spring displacement follows compatibility; moving supports introduce imposed displacements, after which stiffness ratios alone no longer determine the force shares between the paths.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dam height alone determines the arch load share." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。
knowledge.textEn: Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere. Calibrating only one crest displacement may reproduce overall stiffness while completely misrepresenting local stress concentrations and the distribution of support reactions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱座相容與分力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abutment compatibility and load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。
只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere.
Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution.
quiz.explanation: 拱座節理張開會使承載路徑變軟並把荷載移向其他部位；若只校準壩頂單點位移，可能得到看似正確的總剛度，卻完全錯判局部應力集中。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening abutment joints soften one load path and transfer force elsewhere. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack connectivity and uplift: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫連通與揚壓」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack connectivity and uplift” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 基礎裂縫是否與上游水連通，會改變揚壓分布而不只是減少受壓面積。教材把已假設的壓力分布積分成向上合力，再討論裂縫開口與排水能力對分布的影響。裂縫長度不能獨立決定壓力，因流動阻力、下游水位與排水孔都參與控制。 排水點可能讓壓力圖出現折線，積分時應按各段面積相加，作用點也必須用各段力矩求得。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫連通與揚壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Whether a foundation crack connects to upstream water changes uplift distribution as well as contact area. Integrating an explicitly assumed pressure diagram gives the upward resultant; crack aperture and drainage then explain possible changes to that diagram. Crack length alone cannot determine pressure because flow resistance, tailwater and drains also control it. A drain may introduce a breakpoint in the pressure diagram; sum segment areas for force and segment moments for the resultant location on the base. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack connectivity and uplift” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂縫連通與揚壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crack connectivity and uplift”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓
knowledge.text: 基礎裂縫是否與上游水連通，會改變揚壓分布而不只是減少受壓面積。教材把已假設的壓力分布積分成向上合力，再討論裂縫開口與排水能力對分布的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Whether a foundation crack connects to upstream water changes uplift distribution as well as contact area. Integrating an explicitly assumed pressure diagram gives the upward resultant; crack aperture and drainage then explain possible changes to that diagram.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂縫連通與揚壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crack connectivity and uplift" is correct?
options: 只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓
平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險
基礎裂縫是否與上游水連通，會改變揚壓分布而不只是減少受壓面積。
optionsEn: Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution.
Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk.
Whether a foundation crack connects to upstream water changes uplift distribution as well as contact area.
quiz.explanation: 基礎裂縫是否與上游水連通，會改變揚壓分布而不只是減少受壓面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Whether a foundation crack connects to upstream water changes uplift distribution as well as contact area. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack connectivity and uplift: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂縫連通與揚壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack connectivity and uplift” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。模型邊界：沿基底壓力線性且以一米壩長計算；不代表裂縫內實際壓力分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN. Model boundary: linear basal pressure over a one-metre dam strip; not the measured distribution within an actual crack. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各測壓孔換算至共同基準的壓力水頭，再檢查高低庫水位期間的反應與時間差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert piezometer readings to pressure heads on one datum and compare their response and lag at different reservoir levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。模型邊界：沿基底壓力線性且以一米壩長計算；不代表裂縫內實際壓力分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN. Model boundary: linear basal pressure over a one-metre dam strip; not the measured distribution within an actual crack.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂縫連通與揚壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Crack connectivity and uplift", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。
首波壓升必定是所有暫態最大壓力
低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN.
The first pressure rise is always the maximum of the whole transient.
Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pu=900 kPa; pd=100 kPa; B=60 m; w=1 m; U=(pu+pd)/2*B*w=30000 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crack connectivity and uplift: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂縫連通與揚壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crack connectivity and uplift” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各測壓孔換算至共同基準的壓力水頭，再檢查高低庫水位期間的反應與時間差。以排水流量配對判讀：壓力上升但流量下降支持堵塞假說，壓力與流量同升則須追查新增連通路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert piezometer readings to pressure heads on one datum and compare their response and lag at different reservoir levels. Pair pressure with drainage flow: rising pressure with falling flow supports blockage, while simultaneous increases require investigation of a newly connected seepage path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較線性分布與上游半段保持高壓的分段分布，分別求合力及作用點，說明相同上游水位下為何抗滑與傾覆判斷都會改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare the linear diagram with a piecewise diagram retaining high pressure over the upstream half. Find each resultant and its location, then explain changes in both sliding and overturning interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未辨認堵塞仍沿用原先低揚壓分布，會高估有效壩重與抗滑餘量；但測管氣泡或堵管也能產生假訊號，需以沖洗紀錄及鄰孔讀值交叉確認。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using an old low-uplift diagram after drainage blockage overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將各測壓孔換算至共同基準的壓力水頭，再檢查高低庫水位期間的反應與時間差。以排水流量配對判讀：壓力上升但流量下降支持堵塞假說，壓力與流量同升則須追查新增連通路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Convert piezometer readings to pressure heads on one datum and compare their response and lag at different reservoir levels. Pair pressure with drainage flow: rising pressure with falling flow supports blockage, while simultaneous increases require investigation of a newly connected seepage path.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較線性分布與上游半段保持高壓的分段分布，分別求合力及作用點，說明相同上游水位下為何抗滑與傾覆判斷都會改變。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the linear diagram with a piecewise diagram retaining high pressure over the upstream half. Find each resultant and its location, then explain changes in both sliding and overturning interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂縫連通與揚壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crack connectivity and uplift"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將各測壓孔換算至共同基準的壓力水頭，再檢查高低庫水位期間的反應與時間差。
溫漂校正應消除所有壩體季節位移
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Convert piezometer readings to pressure heads on one datum and compare their response and lag at different reservoir levels.
Thermal drift correction should remove all seasonal movement of the dam.
quiz.explanation: 將各測壓孔換算至共同基準的壓力水頭，再檢查高低庫水位期間的反應與時間差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert piezometer readings to pressure heads on one datum and compare their response and lag at different reservoir levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂縫連通與揚壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crack connectivity and uplift: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂縫連通與揚壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crack connectivity and uplift” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未辨認堵塞仍沿用原先低揚壓分布，會高估有效壩重與抗滑餘量；但測管氣泡或堵管也能產生假訊號，需以沖洗紀錄及鄰孔讀值交叉確認。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using an old low-uplift diagram after drainage blockage overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. Air or blockage in the measuring tube can also create false signals, so maintenance records and neighboring readings must corroborate the interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：排水點可能讓壓力圖出現折線，積分時應按各段面積相加，作用點也必須用各段力矩求得。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A drain may introduce a breakpoint in the pressure diagram; sum segment areas for force and segment moments for the resultant location on the base.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未辨認堵塞仍沿用原先低揚壓分布，會高估有效壩重與抗滑餘量；但測管氣泡或堵管也能產生假訊號，需以沖洗紀錄及鄰孔讀值交叉確認。
knowledge.textEn: Using an old low-uplift diagram after drainage blockage overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. Air or blockage in the measuring tube can also create false signals, so maintenance records and neighboring readings must corroborate the interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂縫連通與揚壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crack connectivity and uplift" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險
未辨認堵塞仍沿用原先低揚壓分布，會高估有效壩重與抗滑餘量；但測管氣泡或堵管也能產生假訊號，需以沖洗紀錄及鄰孔讀值交叉確認。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk.
Using an old low-uplift diagram after drainage blockage overstates effective weight and sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 未辨認堵塞仍沿用原先低揚壓分布，會高估有效壩重與抗滑餘量；但測管氣泡或堵管也能產生假訊號，需以沖洗紀錄及鄰孔讀值交叉確認。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using an old low-uplift diagram after drainage blockage overstates effective weight and sliding resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「混凝土冷卻熱量」與「接縫閉合與溫度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concrete cooling heat account" and "Joint closure and temperature": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete cooling heat account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土冷卻熱量」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete cooling heat account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大體積混凝土降溫同時涉及熱量移除與空間溫差，兩者不可互相代替。比熱模型能估算均勻降溫所需移除的顯熱，但表面冷得過快可能提高內外約束應力。需把水化熱產生、冷卻水帶走熱量與周邊散熱分列，才能判斷熱量帳是否閉合。 熱擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，縮小試件的冷卻曲線不能直接按時間等比例搬到大體積壩塊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土冷卻熱量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling mass concrete involves both heat removal and spatial gradients, which are not interchangeable. Heat capacity estimates sensible energy for uniform cooling, while rapid surface cooling can increase restraint stresses. Separate hydration heat, heat carried by cooling water and environmental exchange to establish whether the thermal account actually closes. Thermal diffusion time scales with characteristic length squared, so cooling observations from small specimens cannot be transferred to massive blocks by simple linear time scaling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete cooling heat account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：V=5000 m3; rho=2400 kg/m3; c=900 J/(kg*K); dT=8 K; E=V*rho*c*dT/1e9=86.4 GJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: V=5000 m3; rho=2400 kg/m3; c=900 J/(kg*K); dT=8 K; E=V*rho*c*dT/1e9=86.4 GJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混凝土冷卻熱量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concrete cooling heat account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量
knowledge.text: 大體積混凝土降溫同時涉及熱量移除與空間溫差，兩者不可互相代替。比熱模型能估算均勻降溫所需移除的顯熱，但表面冷得過快可能提高內外約束應力。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling mass concrete involves both heat removal and spatial gradients, which are not interchangeable. Heat capacity estimates sensible energy for uniform cooling, while rapid surface cooling can increase restraint stresses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土冷卻熱量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete cooling heat account" is correct?
options: 大體積混凝土降溫同時涉及熱量移除與空間溫差，兩者不可互相代替。
平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險
自由熱伸長就是受約束接縫閉合量
optionsEn: Cooling mass concrete involves both heat removal and spatial gradients, which are not interchangeable.
Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk.
Free thermal extension equals closure of a restrained joint.
quiz.explanation: 大體積混凝土降溫同時涉及熱量移除與空間溫差，兩者不可互相代替。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling mass concrete involves both heat removal and spatial gradients, which are not interchangeable. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete cooling heat account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土冷卻熱量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete cooling heat account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：V=5000 m3; rho=2400 kg/m3; c=900 J/(kg*K); dT=8 K; E=V*rho*c*dT/1e9=86.4 GJ。模型邊界：常數比熱與均勻溫降；未計持續水化熱及熱應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: V=5000 m3; rho=2400 kg/m3; c=900 J/(kg*K); dT=8 K; E=V*rho*c*dT/1e9=86.4 GJ. Model boundary: constant heat capacity and uniform cooling; continuing hydration heat and thermal stress are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以核心、中間和表面溫度檢查均勻假設，再用冷卻水流量乘進出口溫差積分熱量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the uniform-temperature assumption using core, intermediate and surface readings, then integrate cooling-water flow times temperature rise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete cooling heat account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土冷卻熱量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete cooling heat account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以核心、中間和表面溫度檢查均勻假設，再用冷卻水流量乘進出口溫差積分熱量。若水側移熱量大於混凝土顯熱減少，應查水化熱與邊界交換，不可立即認定溫度儀表故障。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the uniform-temperature assumption using core, intermediate and surface readings, then integrate cooling-water flow times temperature rise. If water-side heat removal exceeds the concrete sensible-energy decrease, investigate hydration and boundary exchange before assuming the temperature instruments are defective. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對同一熱量設計均勻與偏側冷卻兩個假想溫度剖面，指出哪些測點能區分兩者，再估算多移除一開爾文顯熱所需的額外能量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct uniform and one-sided cooling profiles with the same total heat removal. Identify sensors that distinguish them, then calculate the additional sensible energy associated with one more kelvin of cooling.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：冷卻太集中會造成局部溫度梯度及裂縫，即使平均溫度下降符合目標也可能出現問題；裂縫又改變水密與局部傳熱，因此不能只以總移熱量驗收冷卻品質。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Concentrated cooling can create local gradients and cracking even when average temperature meets its target. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

If water-side heat removal exceeds the concrete sensible-energy decrease, investigate hydration and boundary exchange before assuming the temperature instruments are defective.

knowledge.text: 對同一熱量設計均勻與偏側冷卻兩個假想溫度剖面，指出哪些測點能區分兩者，再估算多移除一開爾文顯熱所需的額外能量。

quiz.question: 要驗證「混凝土冷卻熱量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete cooling heat account"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每增加一台備用設備就多一個獨立備援
以核心、中間和表面溫度檢查均勻假設，再用冷卻水流量乘進出口溫差積分熱量。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every additional spare device provides another fully independent backup.
Check the uniform-temperature assumption using core, intermediate and surface readings, then integrate cooling-water flow times temperature rise.
quiz.explanation: 以核心、中間和表面溫度檢查均勻假設，再用冷卻水流量乘進出口溫差積分熱量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the uniform-temperature assumption using core, intermediate and surface readings, then integrate cooling-water flow times temperature rise. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土冷卻熱量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete cooling heat account: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土冷卻熱量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete cooling heat account” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 冷卻太集中會造成局部溫度梯度及裂縫，即使平均溫度下降符合目標也可能出現問題；裂縫又改變水密與局部傳熱，因此不能只以總移熱量驗收冷卻品質。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated cooling can create local gradients and cracking even when average temperature meets its target. Cracks subsequently alter watertightness and heat transfer, so total extracted energy alone cannot establish the quality of the cooling process. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱擴散時間隨特徵長度平方變化，縮小試件的冷卻曲線不能直接按時間等比例搬到大體積壩塊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Thermal diffusion time scales with characteristic length squared, so cooling observations from small specimens cannot be transferred to massive blocks by simple linear time scaling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土冷卻熱量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete cooling heat account" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 冷卻太集中會造成局部溫度梯度及裂縫，即使平均溫度下降符合目標也可能出現問題；裂縫又改變水密與局部傳熱，因此不能只以總移熱量驗收冷卻品質。

steps.title: 接縫閉合與溫度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint closure and temperature: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫閉合與溫度」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint closure and temperature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分塊澆置留下的接縫，其開合取決於塊體自由熱變形、相鄰約束與水壓。線膨脹模型只描述未受約束的長度變化，接縫灌漿後的應力則需用實際約束分析。不能把某溫度下的縫寬直接解讀為永久缺陷，也不能把所有縫寬變化都歸於氣溫。 接縫量測方向若與縫面法線不一致，需將位移投影分解，否則剪切位移也可能混入開合讀值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫閉合與溫度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A joint between concrete blocks opens or closes through thermal strain, neighboring restraint and water loading. Linear expansion describes free length change only; stress after grouting depends on actual restraint. Joint width at one temperature is not automatically a permanent defect, and not every width change can be attributed to air temperature. A gauge not aligned with the joint normal requires displacement projection; otherwise tangential movement can contaminate the apparent opening or closure of the joint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint closure and temperature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=18 m; dT=12 K; dL=alpha*L*dT*1000=2.16 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=18 m; dT=12 K; dL=alpha*L*dT*1000=2.16 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由熱伸長就是受約束接縫閉合量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free thermal extension equals closure of a restrained joint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫閉合與溫度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint closure and temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 接縫閉合與溫度：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Joint closure and temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將接縫計讀值與塊體內部溫度及庫水位同步繪圖，查看升溫與降溫路徑是否重合。若有遲滯，再查接觸摩擦與裂縫連通；量測基座本身的熱伸縮也必須先校正，避免誤判壩體變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot joint readings with internal block temperature and reservoir level, checking whether warming and cooling paths coincide. Hysteresis calls for investigating contact friction or crack connectivity. Correct thermal movement of the instrument mounting itself before assigning the observed change to the dam. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：灌漿溫度與後續運轉溫度不相容時，可能造成過高接觸壓力或縫面重新張開；但單支接縫計也可能因固定端鬆動而跳值，需以附近位移證據區分。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incompatible grouting and service-temperature range can produce excessive contact pressure or reopening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 灌漿溫度與後續運轉溫度不相容時，可能造成過高接觸壓力或縫面重新張開；但單支接縫計也可能因固定端鬆動而跳值，需以附近位移證據區分。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incompatible grouting and service-temperature range can produce excessive contact pressure or reopening. A loose gauge anchor can also cause a sudden reading change, requiring neighboring displacement evidence to distinguish the instrument fault from physical joint behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由熱伸長就是受約束接縫閉合量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Penstock water hammer" and "Spillway cavitation indicator": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓力鋼管水錘：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Penstock water hammer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力鋼管水錘」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Penstock water hammer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導葉或閥門快速變動使水流動量轉為壓力波，波速同時受水的可壓縮性與管壁彈性影響。焦科夫斯基關係適合估計快速速度改變的首波幅度；反射、分岔與調壓設施會改變後續波形，因此單一首波不能取代整段管路的暫態包絡。 反射的符號取決於邊界阻抗，水庫端與封閉閥端可能產生不同反射，因此應在時空圖標明每個邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力鋼管水錘」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rapid guide-vane or valve movement converts flow momentum into a pressure wave whose speed depends on water compressibility and pipe elasticity. The Joukowsky relation estimates the first wave from a rapid velocity change. Reflections, branches and surge facilities alter later waves, so one first-wave estimate is not a full transient envelope. Reflection sign depends on boundary impedance; reservoir and closed-valve ends can reflect differently, so every boundary must be identified on the space-time diagram. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Penstock water hammer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=0.7 m/s; dp=rho*a*dv/1e6=0.63 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=0.7 m/s; dp=rho*a*dv/1e6=0.63 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「首波壓升必定是所有暫態最大壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The first pressure rise is always the maximum of the whole transient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力鋼管水錘」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 高速溢洪流在不平整表面附近會產生局部低壓，是否形成汽穴要比較局部絕對壓力與水的蒸氣壓。汽蝕數把可用壓力差除以動壓，便於比較流況，但臨界值仍依表面幾何、含氣與尺度而異。以平均壓力計算只能作初步篩查。 蒸氣壓取決於水溫，而局部絕對壓也受大氣壓影響，兩者均應使用與事件同時的條件比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溢洪面汽蝕指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: High-speed spillway flow can create local low pressure near surface irregularities. Vapor formation depends on absolute pressure relative to vapor pressure. A cavitation number normalizes available pressure by dynamic pressure, but its critical value depends on geometry, aeration and scale. A value based on mean pressure is therefore a preliminary indicator only. Vapor pressure depends on water temperature and absolute local pressure depends on atmospheric conditions; both should represent the same event rather than unrelated reference conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spillway cavitation indicator” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One cavitation-number threshold applies to every spillway surface." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

Frequent low-pressure excursions require analysis of the lower distribution tail even if the mean cavitation number appears steady.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在固定壓力下把流速提高兩成，重算指標並說明平方效應，再列出判斷實際損傷還需的粗糙度、含氣與壓力波動證據。
knowledge.textEn: Increase velocity by twenty percent at fixed pressure and recompute the indicator, explaining the squared effect. List roughness, aeration and pressure-fluctuation evidence still needed before assessing actual surface damage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溢洪面汽蝕指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Spillway cavitation indicator"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險
核對壓力感測器是表壓還是絕對壓，並量測水溫以選取蒸氣壓。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Meeting an average cooling target proves there is no gradient risk.
Confirm whether the sensor reports gauge or absolute pressure and measure water temperature for vapor pressure.
quiz.explanation: 核對壓力感測器是表壓還是絕對壓，並量測水溫以選取蒸氣壓。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm whether the sensor reports gauge or absolute pressure and measure water temperature for vapor pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 溢洪面汽蝕指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spillway cavitation indicator: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溢洪面汽蝕指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spillway cavitation indicator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把表壓當絕對壓會嚴重改變指標，表面錯台又可能使局部最低壓遠低於平均值；若只看總流量，就無法區分幾何缺陷與通氣不足的來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing gauge with absolute pressure distorts the indicator, while a surface offset can make minimum pressure much lower than its mean. Total discharge alone cannot distinguish a geometric defect from inadequate air supply as the cause of damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：蒸氣壓取決於水溫，而局部絕對壓也受大氣壓影響，兩者均應使用與事件同時的條件比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Vapor pressure depends on water temperature and absolute local pressure depends on atmospheric conditions; both should represent the same event rather than unrelated reference conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有表面可採同一汽蝕數界線」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One cavitation-number threshold applies to every spillway surface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 錯把表壓當絕對壓會嚴重改變指標，表面錯台又可能使局部最低壓遠低於平均值；若只看總流量，就無法區分幾何缺陷與通氣不足的來源。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing gauge with absolute pressure distorts the indicator, while a surface offset can make minimum pressure much lower than its mean. Total discharge alone cannot distinguish a geometric defect from inadequate air supply as the cause of damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「溢洪面汽蝕指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spillway cavitation indicator" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 錯把表壓當絕對壓會嚴重改變指標，表面錯台又可能使局部最低壓遠低於平均值；若只看總流量，就無法區分幾何缺陷與通氣不足的來源。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償
optionsEn: Confusing gauge with absolute pressure distorts the indicator, while a surface offset can make minimum pressure much lower than its mean.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge.
quiz.explanation: 錯把表壓當絕對壓會嚴重改變指標，表面錯台又可能使局部最低壓遠低於平均值；若只看總流量，就無法區分幾何缺陷與通氣不足的來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing gauge with absolute pressure distorts the indicator, while a surface offset can make minimum pressure much lower than its mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「低水頭機組出力」與「沉積三角洲前移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Low head generating output" and "Sediment delta advance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 低水頭機組出力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low head generating output: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低水頭機組出力」如何影響胡佛壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low head generating output” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 庫水位下降使可用水頭改變，維持同一功率可能需要增加流量，但管路損失和機組運轉範圍限制這種補償。教材先固定流量與效率比較水頭對出力的直接作用，再要求用機組特性曲線檢查效率假設，不能線性外推至所有低水位。 導葉開度與流量的關係隨水頭改變，固定開度不等於固定流量，比較模型時必須明確哪一項受到控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低水頭機組出力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Falling reservoir level changes available head, and maintaining power may require more discharge. Conveyance losses and the machine operating range limit that compensation. First hold flow and efficiency constant to isolate the direct head effect, then consult machine characteristics; the assumed efficiency cannot be extrapolated to every low-water condition. The relation between guide-vane opening and discharge changes with head; fixed opening is not fixed flow, so the controlled quantity must be stated explicitly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low head generating output” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低水頭機組出力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low head generating output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低水頭機組出力
knowledge.text: 庫水位下降使可用水頭改變，維持同一功率可能需要增加流量，但管路損失和機組運轉範圍限制這種補償。教材先固定流量與效率比較水頭對出力的直接作用，再要求用機組特性曲線檢查效率假設，不能線性外推至所有低水位。
knowledge.textEn: Falling reservoir level changes available head, and maintaining power may require more discharge. Conveyance losses and the machine operating range limit that compensation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低水頭機組出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low head generating output" is correct?
options: 低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償
庫水位下降使可用水頭改變，維持同一功率可能需要增加流量，但管路損失和機組運轉範圍限制這種補償。
岸線移動距離就是沉積前緣移動距離
optionsEn: Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge.
Falling reservoir level changes available head, and maintaining power may require more discharge.
Shoreline movement equals the movement of the sediment front.
quiz.explanation: 庫水位下降使可用水頭改變，維持同一功率可能需要增加流量，但管路損失和機組運轉範圍限制這種補償。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Falling reservoir level changes available head, and maintaining power may require more discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低水頭機組出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low head generating output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低水頭機組出力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low head generating output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW。模型邊界：淨水頭已扣引水損失且效率固定；未保證機組在該工況允許運行。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW. Model boundary: net head already excludes conveyance loss and efficiency is fixed; operation at this point is not thereby authorized. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將同步流量、淨水頭與電功率換算成效率，並按導葉開度分類比較，避免把不同工況混成一條趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate efficiency from synchronized discharge, net head and terminal power, grouping observations by guide-vane position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW。模型邊界：淨水頭已扣引水損失且效率固定；未保證機組在該工況允許運行。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW. Model boundary: net head already excludes conveyance loss and efficiency is fixed; operation at this point is not thereby authorized.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「低水頭機組出力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low head generating output", which statement holds?
options: 每增加一台備用設備就多一個獨立備援
只要量得裂縫長度就知道全部揚壓
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW。
optionsEn: Every additional spare device provides another fully independent backup.
Crack length alone determines the complete uplift pressure distribution.
Original hypothetical example.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=180 m3/s; H=70 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*H*eta/1e6=111.2454 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低水頭機組出力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low head generating output: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低水頭機組出力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low head generating output” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將同步流量、淨水頭與電功率換算成效率，並按導葉開度分類比較，避免把不同工況混成一條趨勢。另查振動與壓力脈動，若功率模型符合而脈動增大，仍須研究運轉區域限制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calculate efficiency from synchronized discharge, net head and terminal power, grouping observations by guide-vane position. Check vibration and pressure pulsation separately. Agreement with the power equation does not resolve an increasing pulsation level or establish suitability of that operating region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以相同效率計算恢復原功率所需流量，再加入與流量平方相關的損失重算，繪出補償效果遞減的原因並列出機組曲線的必要資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate the discharge needed to restore original power at fixed efficiency, then introduce flow-squared losses. Show why compensation diminishes and list the machine-curve data required to assess the revised point.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：為補償低水頭而增加流量，可能提高損失與不穩定流動，使預期增益落空；若流量計受流態改變影響，也會出現虛假的效率提升，需用獨立量測核對。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing flow to compensate for low head may raise losses and unstable-flow effects enough to defeat the expected gain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將同步流量、淨水頭與電功率換算成效率，並按導葉開度分類比較，避免把不同工況混成一條趨勢。另查振動與壓力脈動，若功率模型符合而脈動增大，仍須研究運轉區域限制。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate efficiency from synchronized discharge, net head and terminal power, grouping observations by guide-vane position. Check vibration and pressure pulsation separately. Agreement with the power equation does not resolve an increasing pulsation level or establish suitability of that operating region.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以相同效率計算恢復原功率所需流量，再加入與流量平方相關的損失重算，繪出補償效果遞減的原因並列出機組曲線的必要資料。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate the discharge needed to restore original power at fixed efficiency, then introduce flow-squared losses. Show why compensation diminishes and list the machine-curve data required to assess the revised point.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低水頭機組出力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low head generating output"?
options: 將同步流量、淨水頭與電功率換算成效率，並按導葉開度分類比較，避免把不同工況混成一條趨勢。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自由熱伸長就是受約束接縫閉合量
optionsEn: Calculate efficiency from synchronized discharge, net head and terminal power, grouping observations by guide-vane position.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Free thermal extension equals closure of a restrained joint.
quiz.explanation: 將同步流量、淨水頭與電功率換算成效率，並按導葉開度分類比較，避免把不同工況混成一條趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calculate efficiency from synchronized discharge, net head and terminal power, grouping observations by guide-vane position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低水頭機組出力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low head generating output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低水頭機組出力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low head generating output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 為補償低水頭而增加流量，可能提高損失與不穩定流動，使預期增益落空；若流量計受流態改變影響，也會出現虛假的效率提升，需用獨立量測核對。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing flow to compensate for low head may raise losses and unstable-flow effects enough to defeat the expected gain. A meter affected by altered flow patterns can also indicate a false efficiency improvement, requiring independent verification. steps.title: 沉積三角洲前移：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment delta advance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hoover Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 入庫流速降低使較粗顆粒優先沉降，三角洲前緣位置影響取水與通道幾何。簡化的體積除以橫截面積只能估算平均前移距離，不能描述底坡、粒徑分選及潛流。應把泥砂供給與可容納空間分開，避免把局部淤高等同全庫均勻填滿。 沉積前緣可能沿舊河槽形成狹長分支，使用全庫平均寬度會稀釋這種集中前移，需要保留局部地形。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉積三角洲前移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deceleration at reservoir entry deposits coarse material preferentially, and delta position affects intake and channel geometry. Deposited volume divided by a representative cross-sectional area estimates mean advance only; it omits bed slope, sorting and density currents. Sediment supply and accommodation space must be distinguished from uniform filling of the reservoir. A depositional front may advance as a narrow lobe along the old channel; reservoir-average width conceals that concentration and should not replace local geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment delta advance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：V=240000 m3; B=600 m; h=8 m; dx=V/(B*h)=50 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: V=240000 m3; B=600 m; h=8 m; dx=V/(B*h)=50 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岸線移動距離就是沉積前緣移動距離」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Shoreline movement equals the movement of the sediment front." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉積三角洲前移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 沉積三角洲前移

Thermal drift correction should remove all seasonal movement of the dam.

steps.title: 沉積三角洲前移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment delta advance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉積三角洲前移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment delta advance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：V=240000 m3; B=600 m; h=8 m; dx=V/(B*h)=50 m。模型邊界：假設矩形沉積前緣且全數體積推進前緣；不含壓密及側向擴展。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: V=240000 m3; B=600 m; h=8 m; dx=V/(B*h)=50 m. Model boundary: rectangular depositional front with all volume advancing that front; excludes consolidation and lateral spreading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重複測量同一基準的縱剖面及橫斷面，將前緣位置、頂積層厚度與粒徑一起比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat longitudinal and cross-sectional surveys on one datum, comparing front position, topset thickness and grain size.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 重複測量同一基準的縱剖面及橫斷面，將前緣位置、頂積層厚度與粒徑一起比較。若測得體積增加但前緣未動，應查垂向加積或側向展寬，不能因簡式預測前移便宣稱測量錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat longitudinal and cross-sectional surveys on one datum, comparing front position, topset thickness and grain size. If volume rises without front advance, investigate vertical aggradation or lateral widening rather than rejecting measurements because the simple translation model predicted movement. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep deposited volume fixed and separately double front width and thickness. Calculate advance distances, then plan three repeat survey lines that distinguish frontal translation from vertical accumulation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追蹤表面岸線可能漏掉水下前緣逼近取水區；反之，水位變化造成的岸線位移也可能被誤作淤積，應以固定高程下的水下地形辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tracking only the visible shoreline can miss an underwater front approaching an intake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
