備援只有在失效機制足夠獨立時才能降低同時失效機率。
只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力
optionsEn: Every additional spare device provides another fully independent backup.
Redundancy reduces simultaneous failure only when failure mechanisms are sufficiently independent.
Dam height alone determines the arch load share.
quiz.explanation: 備援只有在失效機制足夠獨立時才能降低同時失效機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Redundancy reduces simultaneous failure only when failure mechanisms are sufficiently independent. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水備援共同原因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage redundancy common causes: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水備援共同原因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage redundancy common causes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：pA=0.03 (dimensionless); pB=0.04 (dimensionless); pBoth=pA*pB=0.0012。模型邊界：兩泵同一需求期間的失效事件假設獨立；不是現場可靠度或年失效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pA=0.03 (dimensionless); pB=0.04 (dimensionless); pBoth=pA*pB=0.0012. Model boundary: independent failure events over the same demand interval; not field reliability or an annual failure rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用設備接線圖與管線圖找出共同電源、閥件與吸入口，逐項核對測試是否真正涵蓋切換。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace shared power, valves and suction paths on electrical and hydraulic diagrams, then check whether tests actually exercise transfer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: pA=0.03 (dimensionless); pB=0.04 (dimensionless); pBoth=pA*pB=0.0012. Model boundary: independent failure events over the same demand interval; not field reliability or an annual failure rate.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage redundancy common causes", which statement holds?
options: 平均降溫達標就表示沒有梯度風險
首波壓升必定是所有暫態最大壓力

steps.title: 排水備援共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage redundancy common causes: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水備援共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage redundancy common causes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用設備接線圖與管線圖找出共同電源、閥件與吸入口，逐項核對測試是否真正涵蓋切換。把無需求時停機與有需求時失效分開統計；若兩泵常在同一事件失效，就不能保留獨立假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace shared power, valves and suction paths on electrical and hydraulic diagrams, then check whether tests actually exercise transfer. Distinguish planned idle states from failures on demand. Repeated simultaneous failures during one event invalidate the independence assumption used by the simple probability product. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一個共同電源失效事件，畫故障樹並計算條件機率，指出何種改造可切斷共同原因，以及需要哪些需求紀錄才能更新估計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a common power-failure event, draw a fault tree and calculate conditional probabilities. Identify a modification that removes the shared cause and the demand records needed to update the estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：淹水可能同時淹沒兩部泵的控制設備，使機械備援失去作用；只測馬達空載啟動不會揭露共同吸入口堵塞，需驗證實際抽排路徑與電力隔離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flooding can disable controls for both pumps and defeat mechanical redundancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用設備接線圖與管線圖找出共同電源、閥件與吸入口，逐項核對測試是否真正涵蓋切換。把無需求時停機與有需求時失效分開統計；若兩泵常在同一事件失效，就不能保留獨立假設。
knowledge.textEn: Trace shared power, valves and suction paths on electrical and hydraulic diagrams, then check whether tests actually exercise transfer. Distinguish planned idle states from failures on demand. Repeated simultaneous failures during one event invalidate the independence assumption used by the simple probability product.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入一個共同電源失效事件，畫故障樹並計算條件機率，指出何種改造可切斷共同原因，以及需要哪些需求紀錄才能更新估計。
knowledge.textEn: Add a common power-failure event, draw a fault tree and calculate conditional probabilities. Identify a modification that removes the shared cause and the demand records needed to update the estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水備援共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage redundancy common causes"?
options: 用設備接線圖與管線圖找出共同電源、閥件與吸入口，逐項核對測試是否真正涵蓋切換。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
低水頭可藉無限增加流量完全補償
optionsEn: Trace shared power, valves and suction paths on electrical and hydraulic diagrams, then check whether tests actually exercise transfer.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Any low head can be fully compensated by unlimited discharge.
quiz.explanation: 用設備接線圖與管線圖找出共同電源、閥件與吸入口，逐項核對測試是否真正涵蓋切換。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace shared power, valves and suction paths on electrical and hydraulic diagrams, then check whether tests actually exercise transfer. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水備援共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage redundancy common causes: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水備援共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage redundancy common causes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 淹水可能同時淹沒兩部泵的控制設備，使機械備援失去作用；只測馬達空載啟動不會揭露共同吸入口堵塞，需驗證實際抽排路徑與電力隔離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flooding can disable controls for both pumps and defeat mechanical redundancy. Testing unloaded motor starts does not reveal a blocked common intake, so the actual drainage path and electrical separation must be verified together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：故障機率須附需求期間與成功功能定義，短時啟動成功與長時持續抽水成功是兩個不同的事件。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A probability needs a demand interval and a defined success function; successful starting and sustained pumping throughout a long event are different reliability questions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每增加一台備用設備就多一個獨立備援」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every additional spare device provides another fully independent backup." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 淹水可能同時淹沒兩部泵的控制設備，使機械備援失去作用；只測馬達空載啟動不會揭露共同吸入口堵塞，需驗證實際抽排路徑與電力隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Flooding can disable controls for both pumps and defeat mechanical redundancy. Testing unloaded motor starts does not reveal a blocked common intake, so the actual drainage path and electrical separation must be verified together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水備援共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drainage redundancy common causes" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
淹水可能同時淹沒兩部泵的控制設備，使機械備援失去作用；只測馬達空載啟動不會揭露共同吸入口堵塞，需驗證實際抽排路徑與電力隔離。
只知道壩高就能決定拱向分力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Flooding can disable controls for both pumps and defeat mechanical redundancy.
Dam height alone determines the arch load share.
quiz.explanation: 淹水可能同時淹沒兩部泵的控制設備，使機械備援失去作用；只測馬達空載啟動不會揭露共同吸入口堵塞，需驗證實際抽排路徑與電力隔離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flooding can disable controls for both pumps and defeat mechanical redundancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大古力水壩
courses.summary: 大古力案例將發電與灌溉抽水放入同一能量和水量帳，並追蹤前池水位、管路阻力與機組停機如何相互影響。課程接續混凝土分塊、基礎排水與量測基準，再以灌溉回歸流及更新後效率驗證收束；學員須解釋不同時間尺度的資料為何不能直接相減。
courses.summaryEn: The Grand Coulee case places generation and irrigation pumping in one water and energy account and follows interactions among forebay level, pipe resistance and outages. Concrete blocks, foundation drainage and survey reference control lead into irrigation return flows and post-renewal efficiency verification. Learners explain why observations from different time scales cannot simply be subtracted.
courses.focus: 水電灌溉抽水與大型機組更新介面
courses.focusEn: Hydropower irrigation pumping and major unit renewal interfaces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 世界水壩與水庫
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「灌溉抽水能量帳」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「發電抽水淨交換」及「前池水位緩衝」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW；第二組為 Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Irrigation pumping energy account, then compare the controlling variables in Generation pumping net exchange and Forebay level buffering. The first calculation is rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW; the second is Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌溉抽水能量帳」與「發電抽水淨交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Irrigation pumping energy account" and "Generation pumping net exchange": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Irrigation pumping energy account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=45 m3/s; H=95 m; eta=0.86 (dimensionless); Pin=rho*g*Q*H/eta/1e6=48.76482558 MW。模型邊界：揚程含全部假定水力損失，效率為電端至水力總效率；穩態計算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 灌溉抽水能量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Irrigation pumping energy account: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌溉抽水能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Irrigation pumping energy account” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測流量、上下游壓力與高程及電端功率，先確認揚程是總揚程而非單一壓差。將實測耗電按每立方米水量表示，若隨水位降低而升高，須區分靜揚程增加與設備效率下降。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize flow, pressure, elevations and terminal power, confirming that head is total head rather than one pressure difference. Express consumption per cubic metre. If it rises as the source level falls, distinguish increased static lift from deterioration of equipment efficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定輸送體積，分別比較高水位短時抽水與低水位長時抽水的總耗電，列出效率及管路阻力資料，避免只用尖峰功率選方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: For a fixed delivered volume, compare short pumping at a high source level with longer pumping at a low level. List efficiency and resistance data needed before choosing a schedule from peak power alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：進水柵堵塞會提高損失且可能降低吸入壓力，單靠增加馬達功率不一定恢復流量；電表和流量計時間窗不同也會偽造效率變化，需先檢查資料對齊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An obstructed intake raises losses and may reduce suction pressure, so increasing motor input need not restore discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 說明「發電抽水淨交換」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generation pumping net exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電站邊界的淨外送是發電、抽水及輔機耗電的代數和，卻不能代表各設備內部效率。不同設備的電表可能位於變壓器前後，必須統一計量邊界再作加減。水量帳也需另列，因取水到灌區的時間延遲不等於電力交換時段。 輔機可能由外部電網供電而非機組母線供電，淨外送與自用電帳必須依實際接線拓撲定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電抽水淨交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary. Maintain a separate water account because delivery time to irrigation areas differs from the electrical exchange interval. Auxiliaries may draw from an external grid rather than the generating bus, so net export and internal consumption depend on the actual electrical connection topology. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generation pumping net exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Net export at the station boundary is the algebraic sum of generation, pumping and auxiliary demand, but it does not describe internal equipment efficiency. Meters may sit on different sides of transformers, requiring a common boundary.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「發電抽水淨交換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Generation pumping net exchange” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW。模型邊界：所有功率同一時間與電端邊界，不另重扣已含於電表的損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pgen=620 MW; Ppump=180 MW; Paux=12 MW; Pnet=Pgen-Ppump-Paux=428 MW. Model boundary: all powers use the same interval and electrical boundary; losses already included in readings are not deducted again. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Generation pumping net exchange: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「發電抽水淨交換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Generation pumping net exchange” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出每只電表相對母線及變壓器的位置，逐項核對輔機是否已含於淨電表，再比較各分表積分與外送總表。若殘差隨抽水啟停改變，應追查漏列負載或不同量測邊界，不先假設發電機效率跳變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map each meter relative to buses and transformers, check whether auxiliaries are already included, and compare integrated submeters with export metering. A residual that changes with pump switching suggests a missing load or inconsistent boundary before it suggests a sudden generator-efficiency change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為三種抽水時程計算日淨外送電量，並讓總抽水量相同，說明電價時序、灌溉需求與設備效率各需何種附加資料才能比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate daily net export for three pumping schedules with equal delivered water. Explain the additional price timing, irrigation-demand and equipment-efficiency information needed to compare their practical consequences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把抽水耗電同時列為輔機與獨立項目會重複扣除，造成虛假的低外送；若時間平均方式不同，短時啟動尖峰也可能被錯配到另一設備的時段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 發電抽水淨交換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Generation pumping net exchange: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「發電抽水淨交換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Generation pumping net exchange” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把抽水耗電同時列為輔機與獨立項目會重複扣除，造成虛假的低外送；若時間平均方式不同，短時啟動尖峰也可能被錯配到另一設備的時段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting pump demand both as an auxiliary and a separate item double-deducts energy and understates export. Different averaging windows can also assign a brief starting peak to the wrong equipment interval, producing an apparent unexplained loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：輔機可能由外部電網供電而非機組母線供電，淨外送與自用電帳必須依實際接線拓撲定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Auxiliaries may draw from an external grid rather than the generating bus, so net export and internal consumption depend on the actual electrical connection topology.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 前池水位緩衝：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「前池水位緩衝」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Forebay level buffering” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前池可緩衝短時間的入出流不平衡，但水位變化會反過來影響泵揚程與進水條件。矩形水池的面積模型適合建立短時反應尺度；若池形變化大、波浪明顯或連接渠道長，則需把儲存與傳播分開，不能把所有測點當成同時同高。 渠道水面振盪能使局部水位先升後降而總儲量近乎不變，多站平均與流量積分提供不同但互補的資訊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「前池水位緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A forebay buffers brief inflow-outflow imbalances, while changing level feeds back into pump head and intake conditions. A constant-area model establishes a short-term response scale. Strongly varying geometry, waves or long connecting canals require separate treatment of storage and propagation instead of assuming every gauge changes simultaneously. Surface oscillation can raise and lower a local level with little total storage change; multi-gauge averages and flow integration provide distinct complementary information. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Forebay level buffering” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qin=80 m3/s; Qout=95 m3/s; dt=600 s; A=300000 m2; dz=(Qin-Qout)*dt/A=-0.03 m.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「前池水位緩衝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction scaling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輸水管摩阻尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conveyance friction scaling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測兩斷面壓力並補正高程及速度水頭，再把剩餘能量差與摩阻式比較。改變流量時查看損失與流速平方是否一致；若僅某閥位下突增，應分列局部損失而非把全部效應塞進管壁粗糙度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss. Vary discharge to examine velocity-squared behavior. A jump associated with one valve position should be treated as local loss rather than absorbed entirely into inferred wall roughness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把流量提高兩成，在直徑不變下重算流速與摩阻，再增加一個已知局部損失係數，分別列出兩種損失對總揚程的貢獻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase flow by twenty percent at unchanged diameter and recalculate velocity and friction. Add one known local-loss coefficient and separately account for each contribution to the total pumping head.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss. Vary discharge to examine velocity-squared behavior. A jump associated with one valve position should be treated as local loss rather than absorbed entirely into inferred wall roughness.

knowledge.textEn: Increase flow by twenty percent at unchanged diameter and recalculate velocity and friction. Add one known local-loss coefficient and separately account for each contribution to the total pumping head.

quiz.question: 要驗證「輸水管摩阻尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conveyance friction scaling"?
options: 量測兩斷面壓力並補正高程及速度水頭，再把剩餘能量差與摩阻式比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
optionsEn: Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 量測兩斷面壓力並補正高程及速度水頭，再把剩餘能量差與摩阻式比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure pressure at two sections and correct elevation and velocity heads before comparing energy loss. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 輸水管摩阻尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conveyance friction scaling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輸水管摩阻尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conveyance friction scaling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. Trapped air or partially full flow also violates the equation assumptions and should be investigated through pressure fluctuations and air-release records. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：截面直徑改變也會改變速度水頭，壓力差不全是耗散，必須先扣除可逆的動能與高程變化。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A diameter change also changes velocity head, so pressure difference is not entirely dissipation; first account for reversible kinetic and elevation-energy changes between sections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. Trapped air or partially full flow also violates the equation assumptions and should be investigated through pressure fluctuations and air-release records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「輸水管摩阻尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Conveyance friction scaling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。
水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness.
Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use.
quiz.explanation: 混用范寧與達西因子會造成四倍誤差，粗糙度反算因而失真；管內空氣或未滿管流也會破壞原式假設，需要從壓力波動及排氣記錄辨識。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a fourfold error and corrupts inferred roughness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「灌溉回歸流水帳」與「混凝土分塊溫差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Irrigation return flow accounting" and "Concrete block temperature mismatch": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Irrigation return flow accounting: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「灌溉回歸流水帳」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Irrigation return flow accounting” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。課程把取水、作物蒸散、渠道蒸發、地下儲存與回歸流分開，先建立明確邊界的日帳。回歸水水質與到達時間也可能限制再利用，不能只靠體積差評價灌溉效益。 回歸水若跨越原先劃定邊界，需改列外部輸出而非區內儲存，控制體選擇會改變各項名稱但不改守恆。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌溉回歸流水帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location. Separate withdrawal, crop evapotranspiration, canal evaporation, subsurface storage and return flow within a declared daily boundary. Return-water quality and arrival time can constrain reuse even when the volume account closes. Return water crossing the chosen boundary is an external output rather than internal storage; control-volume choice changes labels while preserving the conservation requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Irrigation return flow accounting” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「灌溉回歸流水帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Irrigation return flow accounting”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳
knowledge.text: 從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。課程把取水、作物蒸散、渠道蒸發、地下儲存與回歸流分開，先建立明確邊界的日帳。
knowledge.textEn: Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location. Separate withdrawal, crop evapotranspiration, canal evaporation, subsurface storage and return flow within a declared daily boundary.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「灌溉回歸流水帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Irrigation return flow accounting" is correct?
options: 水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量
兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度
從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。
optionsEn: Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use.
The free-strain difference of two blocks equals the joint crack width.
Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location.
quiz.explanation: 從水庫取出的水不全等於流域消耗，部分可能在不同時間和位置回到河道。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water withdrawn from a reservoir is not identical to basin consumption because some returns at another time and location. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Irrigation return flow accounting: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「灌溉回歸流水帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Irrigation return flow accounting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day。模型邊界：所有項目同一灌區邊界與日尺度，正儲存表示留在區內。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day. Model boundary: all terms share one irrigation-area boundary and daily interval; positive storage remains within the area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將渠道進出流、土壤含水與作物蒸散估計對齊到同一天，另核對回歸水在下游的延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day。模型邊界：所有項目同一灌區邊界與日尺度，正儲存表示留在區內。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day. Model boundary: all terms share one irrigation-area boundary and daily interval; positive storage remains within the area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「灌溉回歸流水帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Irrigation return flow accounting", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：W=1200000 m3/day; ET=650000 m3/day; E=50000 m3/day; dS=100000 m3/day; R=W-ET-E-dS=400000 m3/day。

steps.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Irrigation return flow accounting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「灌溉回歸流水帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Irrigation return flow accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將渠道進出流、土壤含水與作物蒸散估計對齊到同一天，另核對回歸水在下游的延遲。若日帳不閉合而多日累計閉合，可能是地下儲存及到達時間問題，不宜直接指認未計量取水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately. Daily imbalance that closes over several days may reflect subsurface storage and travel time rather than an unmetered withdrawal from the irrigation system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一日延遲的回歸流，建立連續三日水量表，再比較單日與三日淨消耗，提出一項能檢查地下儲存變化的現地觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a one-day delay to return flow and construct a three-day balance. Compare daily and cumulative consumption, then propose a field observation that can test the inferred change in subsurface storage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將渠道進出流、土壤含水與作物蒸散估計對齊到同一天，另核對回歸水在下游的延遲。若日帳不閉合而多日累計閉合，可能是地下儲存及到達時間問題，不宜直接指認未計量取水。
knowledge.textEn: Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately. Daily imbalance that closes over several days may reflect subsurface storage and travel time rather than an unmetered withdrawal from the irrigation system.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入一日延遲的回歸流，建立連續三日水量表，再比較單日與三日淨消耗，提出一項能檢查地下儲存變化的現地觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Add a one-day delay to return flow and construct a three-day balance. Compare daily and cumulative consumption, then propose a field observation that can test the inferred change in subsurface storage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「灌溉回歸流水帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Align canal flows, soil-water observations and evapotranspiration estimates to the same day, checking downstream return-flow delay separately.
Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.

steps.title: 灌溉回歸流水帳：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「灌溉回歸流水帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Irrigation return flow accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將深層滲漏一律稱為浪費，可能忽略可回收地下水；但把所有滲漏都視為可利用回歸流也會高估供水，因水質、流向與時間均可能不符合需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling all deep percolation waste can ignore recoverable groundwater. Treating it all as usable return flow can equally overstate supply because water quality, direction and arrival time may fail to match the downstream demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Return water crossing the chosen boundary is an external output rather than internal storage; control-volume choice changes labels while preserving the conservation requirement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫取水量就是流域總消耗量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reservoir withdrawal volume equals total basin consumptive use." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 混凝土分塊溫差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「混凝土分塊溫差」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete block temperature mismatch” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰壩塊不同的溫度歷程會造成相容變形差，而不是每塊都在相同溫度下同步收縮。教材比較兩塊的自由熱應變差，作為接縫運動的來源之一；澆置齡期、徐變與約束會改變實際應力，因此應變差不能直接乘一個彈性模數就宣告開裂。 兩塊混凝土即使最終溫度相同，也可能因不同齡期的約束與徐變而留下不同殘餘應力，不能只比較終值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土分塊溫差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neighboring blocks can have different thermal histories and therefore different free strains rather than cooling together. Their free thermal-strain difference is one source of joint movement. Placement age, creep and restraint alter actual stress, so multiplying this difference by one elastic modulus does not by itself establish cracking. Two blocks reaching the same final temperature may retain different stresses because restraint and creep developed at different ages; matching endpoints does not establish equivalent histories. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete block temperature mismatch” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩塊自由應變差就是接縫裂縫寬度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 混凝土分塊溫差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete block temperature mismatch: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土分塊溫差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete block temperature mismatch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain。模型邊界：兩塊熱膨脹係數相同且只算自由應變差，不計徐變與約束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: alpha=0.00001 1/K; dTA=10 K; dTB=4 K; deps=alpha*(dTA-dTB)*1e6=60 microstrain. Model boundary: equal thermal expansion coefficients and free-strain difference only, excluding creep and restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct core temperature histories from embedded sensors and pair them with joint gauges and placement dates.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以埋入式溫度量測還原各塊核心歷程，配對接縫計及澆置日期，避免用外氣溫代表內部。若應變差預測與接縫方向相反，先核對正負號、感測軸向及塊體約束，再研究材料異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.text: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. A sensor too close to a cooling pipe can also represent a local temperature rather than the block average and distort the inferred compatibility difference.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土分塊溫差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete block temperature mismatch" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
optionsEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
quiz.explanation: 只按相同日曆時間比較不同齡期混凝土，會忽略剛度及徐變發展；量測點離冷卻管太近也可能把局部溫度當成整塊平均，導致錯估相容差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing blocks only by calendar time ignores age-dependent stiffness and creep. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基礎排水阻力」與「停機容量與水量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Foundation drainage resistance" and "Outage capacity and water allocation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基礎排水阻力」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Foundation drainage resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。壓力與流量必須成對觀察，才可區分堵塞及新增滲流。 導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基礎排水阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure. Pressure and flow must be observed together to distinguish blockage from newly connected seepage. Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foundation drainage resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基礎排水阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Foundation drainage resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基礎排水阻力
knowledge.text: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。簡化的導水率乘水頭差模型可描述一段線性滲流路徑，但岩體裂隙網絡可能隨壓力改變。
knowledge.textEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. Conductance times head difference describes one linear seepage path, while a fractured-rock network may change with pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基礎排水阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Foundation drainage resistance" is correct?
options: 排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善
排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。
可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載
optionsEn: A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control.
Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief.
Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.
quiz.explanation: 排水孔降低基礎孔隙水壓的能力取決於連通路徑及排水阻力，流量大並不必然表示排水效果較好。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drain effectiveness depends on hydraulic connectivity and resistance, so a larger discharge does not automatically mean better pressure relief. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基礎排水阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foundation drainage resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。模型邊界：線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Model boundary: linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。模型邊界：線性等效導水率且水頭差固定，並非單孔允許流量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Model boundary: linear equivalent hydraulic conductance at fixed head difference, not an allowable drain discharge.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基礎排水阻力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Foundation drainage resistance", which statement holds?
options: 更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高
淨外送減少必定表示發電效率下降
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。
optionsEn: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
Reduced net export always demonstrates lower generating efficiency.
Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: C=0.00025 m2/s; dh=32 m; Q=C*dh=0.008 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基礎排水阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foundation drainage resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。若清孔後流量增加而孔壓下降，與恢復排水一致；若孔壓同升，須追查上游連通變化，不把所有增流都稱為維修成功。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Increased flow with lower pressure supports restored drainage. If pressure also rises, investigate changed upstream connectivity rather than describing every increase in discharge as a successful repair. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對清孔前後兩組水頭和流量反算導水率，加入一組上游水位改變的資料，說明如何避免把水頭變化誤作排水能力改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Infer conductance from two pressure-flow pairs before and after cleaning, then add a pair with changed reservoir level. Explain how to avoid confusing changed driving head with changed drainage capability.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。若清孔後流量增加而孔壓下降，與恢復排水一致；若孔壓同升，須追查上游連通變化，不把所有增流都稱為維修成功。
knowledge.textEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Increased flow with lower pressure supports restored drainage. If pressure also rises, investigate changed upstream connectivity rather than describing every increase in discharge as a successful repair.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對清孔前後兩組水頭和流量反算導水率，加入一組上游水位改變的資料，說明如何避免把水頭變化誤作排水能力改變。
knowledge.textEn: Infer conductance from two pressure-flow pairs before and after cleaning, then add a pair with changed reservoir level. Explain how to avoid confusing changed driving head with changed drainage capability.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基礎排水阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Foundation drainage resistance"?
options: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
不同定義的摩阻因子可以直接互換
optionsEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Friction factors using different conventions can be interchanged directly.
quiz.explanation: 在相近庫水位下配對測壓與排水量，將清孔前後的導水率反算並比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair pressure and drainage at similar reservoir levels and infer conductance before and after cleaning. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基礎排水阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation drainage resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基礎排水阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation drainage resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. Blockage in the measuring tube instead produces a delayed response and needs an independent response test to identify. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導水率的單位是面積每時間，與材料滲透係數的長度每時間不同，兩者還差流路幾何因子。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic conductance has area-per-time units, unlike conductivity in length per time; a flow-path geometry factor is required before one can be converted into the other.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水量下降必定證明滲漏改善」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A decrease in drain flow always proves improved seepage control." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「基礎排水阻力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foundation drainage resistance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
排水出口淤塞會讓孔壓上升而流量下降，單看低流量可能誤以為滲漏改善；測壓管自身堵塞則會使反應遲緩，需要獨立水位變化試驗辨識。
可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness.
Available unit count alone guarantees simultaneous full-load operation.

quiz.explanationEn: An obstructed outlet raises pressure while reducing discharge, so low flow alone may be mistaken for improved tightness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage capacity and water allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機容量與水量」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outage capacity and water allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型機組檢修會降低可用發電通道，但不一定同比例降低河道總出流，因其他機組及放流設施可能分擔水量。教材先用可用機組數乘假定單機出力估算容量，再把水頭、流量與共同輸電限制另列。設備容量是上限條件之一，不能單獨預測實際電量。 未被發電利用的水可能仍履行必要河道放流，因此旁通量應記入水量帳，而非自動視為可避免的浪費。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機容量與水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints. Equipment capacity is only one limit and cannot independently predict energy production. Water bypassing turbines may still satisfy required river release; account for its volume without automatically treating all bypass as an avoidable operational waste. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outage capacity and water allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 停機容量與水量
knowledge.text: 大型機組檢修會降低可用發電通道，但不一定同比例降低河道總出流，因其他機組及放流設施可能分擔水量。教材先用可用機組數乘假定單機出力估算容量，再把水頭、流量與共同輸電限制另列。
knowledge.textEn: A major-unit outage reduces available generating paths without necessarily reducing total river release proportionally, because other units and outlets may carry water. Count available units at an assumed unit output first, then consider head, discharge and shared transmission constraints.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outage capacity and water allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW。模型邊界：所有剩餘機組相同出力且無共同限制，只算假想機組容量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=8 units; nout=2 units; Pu=120 MW/unit; Pav=(N-nout)*Pu=720 MW. Model boundary: equal output for remaining units and no shared constraints; hypothetical unit capacity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機容量與水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outage capacity and water allocation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將停機時程與水頭、可用流量和輸電限制放在同一張表，核對未停機機組是否真的可同時滿載。比較實際放流與發電流量，若差額經旁通排放，應在能量帳列明而非把它視為流量量測錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Combine outage timing with head, available discharge and transmission limits, checking whether the remaining units can actually reach full output simultaneously. Compare total release with turbine flow and account explicitly for bypassed water instead of treating the difference as a metering error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：排列兩種檢修重疊方案，加入一項共同變壓器容量限制，逐時求可用容量並比較旁通水量，說明選擇方案還需哪些河道限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Arrange two overlapping-maintenance schedules, add a shared transformer limit and calculate hourly available capacity. Compare bypassed water and explain the downstream constraints still needed before selecting a maintenance plan.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同時檢修共用變壓器可能讓更多機組失去外送能力，機組台數法因而高估容量；洪水時可用水量增加也不會解除電氣或機械共同限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 停機容量與水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage capacity and water allocation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停機容量與水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outage capacity and water allocation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同時檢修共用變壓器可能讓更多機組失去外送能力，機組台數法因而高估容量；洪水時可用水量增加也不會解除電氣或機械共同限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance of a shared transformer may remove export capability from additional units, making unit counting overstate capacity. Greater water availability during a flood does not remove a shared electrical or mechanical limit on the remaining machines. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：未被發電利用的水可能仍履行必要河道放流，因此旁通量應記入水量帳，而非自動視為可避免的浪費。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「可用機組台數足以保證同時滿載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水準基準閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level reference closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留往返觀測、尺溫與儀器整平紀錄，先重測異常測段再決定是否配賦。將閉合差與外部穩定點連測結果分開呈現；若內部閉合良好但外部連測變動，應研究共同基準移動而非強行歸零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain forward and backward observations, staff temperature and leveling checks. Remeasure an anomalous leg before adjustment. Present loop closure separately from the external-control tie; good internal closure with a changing external tie calls for investigating common benchmark movement rather than forcing zero displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作一組單段粗差及一組所有基準共同移動的觀測，分別計算閉合差，說明哪一組需外部控制才能發現，並設計復測路線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create observations with a single-leg blunder and another set with common benchmark movement. Compute closure for each, identify which requires external control to detect, and design the confirming survey route.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水準基準閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level reference closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水準基準閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level reference closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 自動把閉合差平均分配，可能掩蓋單一測段粗差；若基準點位於會隨庫水位變形的區域，所有相對高程都可能受影響而仍表面自洽。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatically distributing closure equally can hide a blunder in one leg. If the reference benchmark itself responds to reservoir loading, all relative elevations can shift together while remaining internally consistent and apparently precise. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：觀測線長度與視距不平衡會影響誤差來源，配賦方式應依量測品質而非僅按測段數平均處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Line length and unequal sight distances affect survey errors; adjustment weights should reflect observation quality rather than distributing every closure equally by number of legs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水準閉合良好就證明所有基準穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Good level-loop closure proves every benchmark is stable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.

steps.title: 更新效率比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「更新效率比較」如何影響大古力水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post renewal efficiency comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Grand Coulee Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機組更新的效益必須在相近水頭、流量與量測邊界下比較，否則水文條件改變會被誤認成設備改善。先以同一水力輸入估算效率增加帶來的功率差，再討論不確定度與測試重複性。額定出力提高與日常效率提高是不同主張，需要不同驗證資料。 全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「更新效率比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement. Estimate the power difference for one hydraulic input, then examine uncertainty and repeatability. Increased rated output and improved routine efficiency are distinct claims requiring different supporting observations. Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post renewal efficiency comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=220 m3/s; H=80 m; etaOld=0.88 (dimensionless); etaNew=0.92 (dimensionless); dP=rho*g*Q*H*(etaNew-etaOld)/1e6=6.90624 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「更新效率比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post renewal efficiency comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「更新效率比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高

抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
optionsEn: Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement.
A renewal benefit must be compared at similar head, flow and metering boundaries or hydrologic change can masquerade as equipment improvement.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
