steps.title: 更新效率比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「更新效率比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post renewal efficiency comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在更新前後選取可比工況，校驗流量與功率儀表並重複測試，將不確定度與效率差並列。若差值小於量測解析能力，應報告未能辨識改善，而非把四捨五入後的正值當成確定收益。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Report uncertainty beside the efficiency difference. If the difference is below measurement resolution, state that improvement was not resolved rather than presenting a rounded positive value as a demonstrated gain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以三組水頭流量建立更新前後比較表，先計算同工況功率差，再加入流量偏差，討論何種精度才能辨識假定的效率增益。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build before-and-after comparisons at three head-flow combinations. Calculate matched-condition power differences, then introduce flow bias and determine what measurement precision is needed to resolve the assumed efficiency gain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Select comparable conditions before and after renewal, calibrate discharge and power instruments, and repeat measurements. Report uncertainty beside the efficiency difference. If the difference is below measurement resolution, state that improvement was not resolved rather than presenting a rounded positive value as a demonstrated gain.

knowledge.textEn: Build before-and-after comparisons at three head-flow combinations. Calculate matched-condition power differences, then introduce flow bias and determine what measurement precision is needed to resolve the assumed efficiency gain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「更新效率比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

steps.title: 更新效率比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post renewal efficiency comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「更新效率比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post renewal efficiency comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Recalibrating a flow meter can also change calculated efficiency, so original calibration records and a consistent comparison boundary are needed to avoid crediting measurement changes to the equipment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：全年收益需以各工況停留時間加權，單一最佳效率點的改善不能代表全年不同水頭流量下的平均成效。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annual benefit requires weighting operating points by their duration; improvement at one best-efficiency point does not represent average performance across a year of varying conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「更新後功率增加必定證明效率提高」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher output after renewal always proves an efficiency improvement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。
knowledge.textEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Recalibrating a flow meter can also change calculated efficiency, so original calibration records and a consistent comparison boundary are needed to avoid crediting measurement changes to the equipment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「更新效率比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post renewal efficiency comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。
抽水電端功率等於水力功率乘效率
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain.
Pump electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 更新後恰逢較高水頭會讓功率增加，即使效率不變；流量儀表重新校正也可能改變計算效率，需保留原始校準與一致的比較邊界，避免把量測變動列為設備成效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher head after renewal can increase power without any efficiency gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 伊泰普水壩
courses.summary: 伊泰普提供同一水力系統連結不同電網頻率的案例。學員從同步轉速、換流損失及無功容量出發，再追蹤尾水耦合、洩洪動量、冷卻與振動，最後建立跨時區資料帳。課程把電力份額與水量分配分開處理，避免將制度安排誤認為固定物理分流比例。
courses.summaryEn: Itaipu illustrates one hydraulic development linked to grids with different frequencies. Learners examine synchronous speed, converter loss and reactive capacity before tailwater coupling, spillway momentum, cooling, vibration and time-aligned records. Electrical allocation and water distribution are handled separately, preventing institutional arrangements from being mistaken for a fixed physical flow split.
courses.focus: 雙頻率水電系統與跨境能量協調
courses.focusEn: Dual frequency hydropower and cross border energy coordination
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「頻率極數與轉速」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「異頻換流能量」及「無功與視在容量」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm；第二組為 Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Frequency poles and speed, then compare the controlling variables in Asynchronous conversion energy and Reactive power and apparent capacity. The first calculation is f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm; the second is Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頻率極數與轉速」與「異頻換流能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Frequency poles and speed" and "Asynchronous conversion energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻率極數與轉速」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency poles and speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。比較兩種頻率時應先寫清楚總極數而非極對數，再檢查轉輪水力設計所允許的轉速。電網頻率不同不表示兩台機組的轉輪幾何可以不經分析直接互換。 磁極數選擇也影響發電機幾何與轉輪匹配，因此頻率介面應由機械與電氣團隊共同確認，不能只改控制設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率極數與轉速」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. State total poles rather than pole pairs when comparing frequencies, then check the speed allowed by the hydraulic design. Different grid frequencies do not make runner geometries interchangeable without analysis. Pole selection also affects generator geometry and runner matching, so mechanical and electrical teams must jointly verify a frequency interface rather than merely changing control settings. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency poles and speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻率極數與轉速」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Frequency poles and speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻率極數與轉速
knowledge.text: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。比較兩種頻率時應先寫清楚總極數而非極對數，再檢查轉輪水力設計所允許的轉速。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. State total poles rather than pole pairs when comparing frequencies, then check the speed allowed by the hydraulic design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻率極數與轉速」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Frequency poles and speed" is correct?
options: 只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯
同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。
不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失
optionsEn: Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.
Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster.
Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss.
quiz.explanation: 同步發電機的電氣頻率由機械轉速與磁極數共同決定，並非只靠水輪機轉得更快。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronous electrical frequency depends on mechanical speed and magnetic pole count, rather than simply making a turbine rotate faster. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency poles and speed: quantitative estimate

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f=50 Hz; poles=60; n=120*f/poles=100 rpm。模型邊界：理想同步轉速，極數為總磁極數；不是伊泰普實際機組銘牌。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 頻率極數與轉速：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻率極數與轉速」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency poles and speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將電氣頻率、軸轉速與銘牌極數互相核對，並檢查轉速感測器每轉脈衝設定。若頻率正確但顯示轉速倍增，先查極對數與脈衝換算，不要由儀表顯示直接推定水輪機發生超速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check electrical frequency, shaft speed and nameplate pole count, including pulses per revolution in the tachometer. If frequency is correct but displayed speed doubles, investigate pole-pair conventions and pulse conversion before interpreting the display as physical turbine overspeed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同總極數計算另一頻率的轉速，並畫出轉速與頻率關係，再說明若維持原轉速，所需極數為何必須是可製造的整數配置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate speed at another frequency using the same total poles. Plot the relationship and explain why retaining the original speed requires an integer pole arrangement that can actually be constructed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 總極數與極對數混用會產生兩倍轉速誤差，影響後續轉矩及離心力估算；同步關係只適用已同步狀態，啟動或解列後的暫態不能照此強制代入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing poles with pole pairs creates a factor-of-two speed error that propagates into torque and centrifugal calculations. The synchronous relation applies after synchronization; startup and disconnected transients cannot be forced to follow it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：磁極數選擇也影響發電機幾何與轉輪匹配，因此頻率介面應由機械與電氣團隊共同確認，不能只改控制設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pole selection also affects generator geometry and runner matching, so mechanical and electrical teams must jointly verify a frequency interface rather than merely changing control settings.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「異頻換流能量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Asynchronous conversion energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同頻率的交流系統可藉電力電子換流傳輸能量，但換流站會產生損失並受控制及設備限制。教材以輸入電量乘總效率求接收電量，只描述能量帳，不把它當成電壓穩定或故障穿越分析。每個效率都要附邊界，避免把線路損失同時算入兩次。 換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異頻換流能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power-electronic conversion can transfer energy between AC systems of different frequencies, with losses and equipment constraints. Multiplying input energy by overall efficiency describes the energy account only, not voltage stability or fault behavior. Each efficiency needs a boundary so that line losses are not included twice in the same transfer estimate. Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Asynchronous conversion energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pin=900 MW; t=4 h; eta=0.965 (dimensionless); Eout=Pin*t*eta=3474 MWh。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「異頻換流能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「異頻換流能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Asynchronous conversion energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較送端與受端同一時窗的電表，先校正時鐘並明確列出換流及線路邊界。把損失與功率、環境溫度及設備狀態作圖，若差額只在切換時段出現，應先查積分時間與計量路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare sending and receiving meters over one synchronized interval and define converter and line boundaries. Plot loss against power, ambient temperature and equipment state. A discrepancy confined to switching intervals calls for checking integration windows and meter paths before assigning a physical efficiency change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持送端電量相同，設定兩種負載效率曲線比較受端電量，再列出換流站與線路應分設哪些電表才能驗證各項損失。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold sending energy fixed and compare received energy under two load-dependent efficiency curves. Identify the converter and line meters needed to verify the individual loss components rather than only the final balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 異頻換流能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Asynchronous conversion energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「異頻換流能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Asynchronous conversion energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏列換流輔機會使受端電量預測偏高，重複扣線損則使預測偏低；兩種帳務錯誤可能互相抵消，因此總數吻合仍需逐項核對計量邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting converter auxiliaries overpredicts received energy, while deducting line losses twice underpredicts it. These accounting errors can cancel, so agreement in the final total still requires checking the physical boundary of every metered term. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：換流損失可包含固定輔助耗電及隨負載改變的部分，低負載效率因此未必與額定點相同，需保留負載曲線。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conversion losses can include fixed auxiliaries and load-dependent components, making low-load efficiency differ from the rated point; retain the load curve in comparisons.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不同頻率換流後必定沒有能量損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Conversion between different frequencies necessarily has no energy loss." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reactive power and apparent capacity" and "Tailwater rise coupling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 無功與視在容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reactive power and apparent capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無功與視在容量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reactive power and apparent capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電機與變壓器的電流負擔同時受實功與無功影響，因此兆伏安額定值不能直接改寫成兆瓦。功率三角形可在平衡正弦穩態下關聯三者，但熱限制與勵磁限制形成的實際能力曲線更複雜。教材先分清量綱，再討論何者是真正限制。 視在功率描述電壓電流乘積，實功才對應平均能量轉移，無功方向則需明示供應或吸收的符號慣例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無功與視在容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generator and transformer current loading depends on both active and reactive power, so an MVA rating cannot simply be relabeled as MW. The power triangle connects the quantities for balanced sinusoidal steady operation, while thermal and excitation limits make the actual capability curve more complex. Identify quantities before deciding which limit controls. Apparent power describes the voltage-current product, active power represents mean energy transfer, and reactive direction needs an explicit convention for supply versus absorption. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reactive power and apparent capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An MVA rating can directly be treated as the same numerical MW rating." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無功與視在容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reactive power and apparent capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Generator and transformer current loading depends on both active and reactive power, so an MVA rating cannot simply be relabeled as MW. The power triangle connects the quantities for balanced sinusoidal steady operation, while thermal and excitation limits make the actual capability curve more complex.

knowledge.text: 誤解：兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 無功與視在容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reactive power and apparent capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無功與視在容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reactive power and apparent capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW。模型邊界：平衡正弦穩態且功率因數為實功除視在功率，不表示完整能力曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW. Model boundary: balanced sinusoidal steady state with power factor defined as active divided by apparent power, not a complete capability curve. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時讀取三相電壓電流、實功與無功，核對功率因數是否依同一基波定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Read three-phase voltage, current, active and reactive power together, checking the definition of power factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW。模型邊界：平衡正弦穩態且功率因數為實功除視在功率，不表示完整能力曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=750 MVA; pf=0.92 (dimensionless); P=S*pf=690 MW. Model boundary: balanced sinusoidal steady state with power factor defined as active divided by apparent power, not a complete capability curve.

steps.instruction: 同時讀取三相電壓電流、實功與無功，核對功率因數是否依同一基波定義。若總電流增加而實功不變，應查無功及諧波，不立即把它解讀成水輪機提供更多有用機械功率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Read three-phase voltage, current, active and reactive power together, checking the definition of power factor. If current increases without greater active power, investigate reactive flow and harmonics rather than assuming that the turbine is delivering additional useful mechanical power. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：將視在額定值全部當實功，會忽略供應無功時的電流負擔；即使實功低於名目值，過勵磁或冷卻不足仍可能形成限制，需要核對能力曲線與溫度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the apparent rating entirely as active power ignores current loading while supplying reactive power. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

If current increases without greater active power, investigate reactive flow and harmonics rather than assuming that the turbine is delivering additional useful mechanical power.

steps.instruction: 將視在額定值全部當實功，會忽略供應無功時的電流負擔；即使實功低於名目值，過勵磁或冷卻不足仍可能形成限制，需要核對能力曲線與溫度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the apparent rating entirely as active power ignores current loading while supplying reactive power. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兆伏安額定值可直接當成同數字兆瓦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tailwater rise coupling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多台機組向共同尾水河段排放時，增加總流量可能抬高尾水並降低每台機組淨水頭。單機功率因此不一定能線性相加到任意總流量。教材以量測的局部尾水敏感度估算水頭損失，提醒學員同一河段的各機組不是完全獨立的水力設備。 共同尾水河段形成水力耦合，即使電氣母線分開仍會互相影響；模型拓撲應同時保留水路與電路的差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尾水抬升耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units releasing into a common tailwater reach can raise its level as total discharge increases, reducing net head for each machine. Individual outputs therefore cannot be added linearly at arbitrary aggregate flow. A measured local tailwater sensitivity estimates the head effect and illustrates why machines sharing a reach are not hydraulically independent. A shared tailwater creates hydraulic coupling even with separate electrical buses; model topology should preserve the different connections of the water and electrical systems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tailwater rise coupling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tailwater rise coupling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m。模型邊界：局部線性尾水評價，係數僅為假設且不含洪水回水遲滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: dQ=500 m3/s; k=0.0012 s/m2; dH=k*dQ=0.6 m. Model boundary: local linear tailwater relation with an assumed coefficient, excluding flood backwater hysteresis. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步總出流與尾水位建立上升及下降兩條散點路徑，並檢查下游來水是否另有影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot rising and falling total-flow paths against synchronized tailwater level and check downstream influences.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 溢洪水舌動量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「溢洪水舌動量」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spillway jet momentum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洩洪水舌轉向時，其動量改變需要由導流構造與水體承受反力。教材只取一個水平分量，以質量流率乘速度差建立尺度；實際衝擊力還受壓力、重力及含氣影響。把動量通量與水舌動能分開，才能避免用能量單位直接當載重。 控制體出口角度決定速度分量，速度大小相同而方向改變仍有動量差，應先做向量解析再計算反力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溢洪水舌動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change. One horizontal component is estimated from mass flow times velocity difference, while real impact also involves pressure, gravity and entrained air. Distinguish momentum flux from kinetic energy so that energy units are not incorrectly treated as structural force. Outlet direction determines velocity components; unchanged speed with a changed direction still produces momentum change, requiring vector resolution before calculating the associated reaction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spillway jet momentum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The numerical jet kinetic energy can directly be used as structural reaction force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溢洪水舌動量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Turning a spillway jet requires a reaction associated with momentum change. One horizontal component is estimated from mass flow times velocity difference, while real impact also involves pressure, gravity and entrained air.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水舌動能數值可以直接當結構反力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 溢洪水舌動量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spillway jet momentum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溢洪水舌動量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spillway jet momentum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN。模型邊界：穩態單一水平動量分量，控制面壓力另假設抵消；非完整消能池載重。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=300 m3/s; vxIn=20 m/s; vxOut=5 m/s; Fx=rho*Q*(vxIn-vxOut)/1e6=4.5 MN. Model boundary: steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先畫控制體標出流入流出方向，量測斷面平均速度而非表面最高速度，再比較壓力與水位所帶來的額外作用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the control volume and flow directions, use section-average rather than peak surface velocity, and assess additional pressure and level forces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: steady single horizontal momentum component with boundary pressures assumed to cancel; not a complete stilling-basin load.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 溢洪水舌動量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溢洪水舌動量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spillway jet momentum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先畫控制體標出流入流出方向，量測斷面平均速度而非表面最高速度，再比較壓力與水位所帶來的額外作用。若動量估算與支承反力不同，先檢查遺漏的壓力項，不直接調整流量使兩者吻合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the control volume and flow directions, use section-average rather than peak surface velocity, and assess additional pressure and level forces. If the momentum estimate differs from measured reaction, examine omitted pressure terms before altering discharge merely to force agreement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變出口水舌方向而保持速率，計算水平與垂直動量改變，畫出反力方向，再列出含氣模型試驗需要保持的相似條件。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：水舌偏流會把反力集中在局部邊牆，總水平力不變也可能增加局部損傷；含氣及脈動又會改變瞬時峰值，因此平均動量不能代替動態載重評估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A skewed jet concentrates reaction on a sidewall even when total horizontal force is unchanged. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 水舌偏流會把反力集中在局部邊牆，總水平力不變也可能增加局部損傷；含氣及脈動又會改變瞬時峰值，因此平均動量不能代替動態載重評估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 機組冷卻水熱升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit cooling water temperature rise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「機組冷卻水熱升」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit cooling water temperature rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電機及軸承損失最終多以熱形式排出，冷卻水流量和溫升共同決定帶走的熱量。教材由已知熱負荷反求理想混合溫升，並區分換熱器端差與水的熱容量。增加冷卻流量不一定解除所有熱點，因接觸熱阻或局部流道堵塞仍可能控制溫度。 量測水溫差通常遠小於絕對溫度，因此成對感測器的差值校準可能比各自絕對精度更影響熱量帳。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「機組冷卻水熱升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generator and bearing losses largely leave as heat, and cooling-water flow together with temperature rise determines heat removal. Infer an ideal mixed temperature rise from a stated thermal load, distinguishing exchanger approach temperature from water heat capacity. More cooling flow may not remove a hotspot controlled by contact resistance or a blocked local passage. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=8000000 W; mdot=400 kg/s; cp=4180 J/(kg*K); dT=Qheat/(mdot*cp)=4.784688995 K。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且熱負荷全由水帶走，不含對環境散熱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 機組冷卻水熱升：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 校驗進出口溫度差及水流量，檢查感測器是否位於已混合斷面，再將水側熱量與電機損失估計比較。若總熱量符合而局部繞組升溫，應檢查流道分配與接觸熱阻，而非只增加總流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate inlet-outlet temperature difference and water flow, locating sensors at mixed sections. Compare water-side heat with estimated machine loss. If total heat removal agrees while one winding heats up, investigate flow distribution and contact resistance rather than simply increasing total cooling flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Let part of the water bypass the exchanger. Calculate active-channel and mixed-outlet temperature rises, explain how total-outlet measurements can conceal overheating, and design additional sensing locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：換熱管結垢可能提高設備溫度卻不明顯改變總水量，僅監看流量會漏報；溫度感測器安裝在旁通流也會顯示偏低溫升，掩蓋實際熱負荷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Exchanger fouling can raise equipment temperature without much change in total water flow, escaping flow-only monitoring. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 轉子激振頻率：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 同步取得轉速訊號與多方向振動，製作階次圖以區分隨轉速移動的峰值及固定結構頻率。若峰值只在特定水頭增強，應結合壓力脈動判讀，不能單憑頻率相等就確定是機械失衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Acquire speed and multidirectional vibration together and create an order map separating speed-dependent peaks from fixed structural frequencies. A peak strengthening only at certain heads calls for pressure-pulsation evidence, rather than identifying mechanical imbalance solely from a frequency match. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate blade-passing frequency at two speeds and mark crossings with a fixed mode. Select a sufficient sampling rate and identify amplitude and phase evidence still needed to diagnose resonance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測取樣率不足會把高頻折返成低頻峰，導致錯誤維修方向；只有單軸量測也可能漏掉主要模態，因此需先核對防混疊與測點方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Insufficient sampling can alias a high frequency into a low-frequency peak and misdirect maintenance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 感測取樣率不足會把高頻折返成低頻峰，導致錯誤維修方向；只有單軸量測也可能漏掉主要模態，因此需先核對防混疊與測點方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sampling can alias a high frequency into a low-frequency peak and misdirect maintenance. A single measurement axis may miss the dominant mode, so anti-alias filtering and sensor orientation must be checked before interpreting the spectrum. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「頻率接近就足以證明發生共振」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Frequency proximity alone is enough to prove resonance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 跨境資料時間對齊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cross border data time alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「跨境資料時間對齊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cross border data time alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一測站的原始記錄和匯總記錄核對時間戳定義，使用明確時區轉成統一時間後再積分。把尖峰事件作為對齊檢查，若總日量相同但時段殘差很大，先查時間位移而非創造額外水源項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check timestamp definitions against raw and aggregated records from one station, convert explicit time zones to a common basis, and then integrate. Use identifiable peaks for alignment. Equal daily totals with large interval residuals suggest a time shift before an additional physical water source. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一條洪水尖峰曲線並將另一份資料錯移十五分鐘，比較日量與時段殘差，再寫出可重現的時間欄位規格與缺測旗標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create a flood-peak series and shift a second copy by fifteen minutes. Compare daily volume and interval residuals, then specify reproducible timestamp fields and flags for missing or reconstructed values.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：系統自動套用錯誤夏令時間規則會讓資料跳一小時，且日總量可能仍看似合理；缺測補值若未加旗標，也會讓跨境比較誤判為真實調度差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect automatic daylight-saving rule can shift data by an hour while daily totals still look plausible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 跨境資料時間對齊：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cross border data time alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨境資料時間對齊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cross border data time alignment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 系統自動套用錯誤夏令時間規則會讓資料跳一小時，且日總量可能仍看似合理；缺測補值若未加旗標，也會讓跨境比較誤判為真實調度差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect automatic daylight-saving rule can shift data by an hour while daily totals still look plausible. Unflagged imputation can likewise make a cross-border comparison mistake reconstructed values for a real difference in dispatch behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：區間平均與瞬時樣本不可混用積分規則，時間戳相同仍可能代表不同觀測語義，必須保留欄位定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Interval averages and instantaneous samples require different integration treatment; matching timestamps can still represent different observation meanings, so field definitions must accompany the data.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「日總量吻合就保證每小時資料對齊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching daily totals guarantees that hourly records are aligned." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「機組輪替可用時數」與「閘門驅動功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unit rotation available hours" and "Gate drive power requirement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 機組輪替可用時數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit rotation available hours: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「機組輪替可用時數」如何影響伊泰普水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit rotation available hours” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定期檢修以台時表示能區分停機數量與時間，卻不能直接等同失去的發電量。機組輪替可能在水量不足期間安排，部分停機因而不減少實際出力；相反地，共同設備停機可能影響所有機組。先算可用台時，再與逐時可用水量和輸電能力配對。 計畫停機與強迫停機可有不同管理目的，但在某時段都會限制可用設備；比較前應把分類與物理狀態分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「機組輪替可用時數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unit-hours distinguish outage count from duration but do not directly equal lost energy. Maintenance during water-limited periods may leave actual output unchanged, whereas shared-equipment outages can affect every unit. Calculate available unit-hours first and then pair them with hourly water availability and transmission capability. Planned and forced outages have different management meanings but both constrain equipment in an interval; separate classification from physical availability before comparing schedules. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit rotation available hours” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「可用台時減少一定等比例減少發電量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced available unit-hours always reduce generation by the same proportion." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「機組輪替可用時數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit rotation available hours”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Unit-hours distinguish outage count from duration but do not directly equal lost energy. Maintenance during water-limited periods may leave actual output unchanged, whereas shared-equipment outages can affect every unit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：可用台時減少一定等比例減少發電量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced available unit-hours always reduce generation by the same proportion. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 機組輪替可用時數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit rotation available hours: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「機組輪替可用時數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit rotation available hours” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h。模型邊界：只計假想設備可用台時，不計功率或水量限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: N=10 units; T=24 h; nout=2 units; tout=6 h; A=N*T-nout*tout=228 unit*h. Model boundary: hypothetical equipment availability hours only, excluding power and water constraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用事件紀錄核對每部機組停機開始與恢復時間，區分計畫檢修、故障及外部限制。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 機組輪替可用時數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit rotation available hours: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「機組輪替可用時數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unit rotation available hours” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用事件紀錄核對每部機組停機開始與恢復時間，區分計畫檢修、故障及外部限制。再與逐時發電和來水比較，若可用台時減少而能量不變，需檢查原本是否受水量限制，而非假定紀錄錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile each unit outage and restoration with event logs, distinguishing maintenance, failures and external restrictions. Compare hourly generation and inflow. Reduced available unit-hours with unchanged energy may indicate water-limited operation rather than an error in the equipment records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較同樣損失十二台時但安排在高流量與低流量時段的情境，建立簡化發電表，指出哪種條件下兩者實際能量損失不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare two schedules losing twelve unit-hours during high-flow and low-flow periods. Build a simplified generation table and identify conditions under which the schedules produce different actual energy losses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把待命未發電記為設備故障會低估可用率，反之只看機械可動也會漏掉電氣外送限制；不同可用率定義不能在未說明邊界時直接排名。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating idle standby as equipment failure understates availability, while mechanical readiness alone overlooks electrical export restrictions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 用事件紀錄核對每部機組停機開始與恢復時間，區分計畫檢修、故障及外部限制。再與逐時發電和來水比較，若可用台時減少而能量不變，需檢查原本是否受水量限制，而非假定紀錄錯誤。

steps.title: 機組輪替可用時數：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 把待命未發電記為設備故障會低估可用率，反之只看機械可動也會漏掉電氣外送限制；不同可用率定義不能在未說明邊界時直接排名。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating idle standby as equipment failure understates availability, while mechanical readiness alone overlooks electrical export restrictions. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gate drive power requirement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Itaipu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘門驅動需要克服水力作用、門重及摩擦，但水流通過閘孔的水力功率並不全由啟閉機提供。教材使用已知提升力與速度估算電端需求，並把啟動峰值、制動和結構反力另列。力的取得應來自明確載重組合，不能由總洩洪量任意換算。 提升力可能隨門位改變，完整動作能量需沿行程積分力，固定力乘行程只適用於明示的簡化情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閘門驅動功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gate drive overcomes hydraulic effects, weight and friction, but it does not supply all hydraulic power passing through the opening. Estimate electrical demand from a stated lifting force and speed, separating startup peaks, braking and structural reaction. The force must come from a defined load combination rather than an arbitrary conversion of spill discharge. Lifting force can vary with position, so complete travel energy integrates force along displacement; constant force times travel applies only to the declared simplified case. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gate drive power requirement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「啟閉機需提供通過閘孔的全部水力功率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The gate drive must supply all hydraulic power flowing through the opening." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 閘門驅動功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gate drive power requirement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閘門驅動功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gate drive power requirement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W。模型邊界：已知恆定提升力與速度，不含啟動峰值及不平衡吊點。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: F=1600000 N; v=0.015 m/s; eta=0.75 (dimensionless); P=F*v/eta=32000 W. Model boundary: known constant lifting force and speed, excluding startup peaks and unequal lifting points. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較啟閉電流、位移速度與兩側吊點力，檢查門體是否偏斜及摩擦是否隨方向改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare drive current, movement speed and forces at both lifting points, checking skew and direction-dependent friction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 同步比較啟閉電流、位移速度與兩側吊點力，檢查門體是否偏斜及摩擦是否隨方向改變。若功率高而位移低，應查卡阻與制動未釋放；不能只靠額定馬達容量推定閘門能正常動作。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Lubrication cannot correct geometric misalignment, so the source of unequal loading must be identified before choosing a maintenance response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：提升力可能隨門位改變，完整動作能量需沿行程積分力，固定力乘行程只適用於明示的簡化情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lifting force can vary with position, so complete travel energy integrates force along displacement; constant force times travel applies only to the declared simplified case.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「啟閉機需提供通過閘孔的全部水力功率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The gate drive must supply all hydraulic power flowing through the opening." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Lubrication cannot correct geometric misalignment, so the source of unequal loading must be identified before choosing a maintenance response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閘門驅動功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gate drive power requirement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。
只要電壓相同就能忽略頻率直接並聯
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force.
Equal voltage permits direct paralleling regardless of frequency.
quiz.explanation: 一側傳動不同步可能讓門體扭斜並提高局部摩擦，即使總提升力仍低於名目值也會卡住；潤滑改善不能解決幾何錯位，需先辨識偏載來源。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized drives can skew the gate and increase local friction even below nominal total lifting force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 古里水壩
courses.summary: 古里案例以供應商公開的機組更新紀錄為起點，研究汽蝕、效率試驗、轉矩與對心、冷卻及停機順序。課程要求每項改善主張都有對應量測與比較工況，並把轉輪最大出力、名目出力和全廠供電可靠度分開。學員以故障假說表統整水力與機械證據。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from a supplier record of Guri modernization, study cavitation, efficiency testing, torque, alignment, cooling and outage sequence. Each claimed improvement requires matching measurements and comparable operating conditions. Runner maximum power, nominal output and plant supply reliability remain separate concepts, brought together through a table of hydraulic and mechanical fault hypotheses.
courses.focus: 大型法蘭西斯轉輪更新與證據鏈
courses.focusEn: Large Francis runner renewal and evidence chains
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 世界水壩與水庫
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「效率試驗不確定度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「汽蝕可用水頭」及「低速巨型轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981；第二組為 Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Efficiency test uncertainty, then compare the controlling variables in Available cavitation head and Large torque at low speed. The first calculation is uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981; the second is Hatm=9.8 m; Hvap=0.3 m; Hs=1.1 m; H=70 m; sigmaA=(Hatm-Hvap-Hs)/H=0.12. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「效率試驗不確定度」與「汽蝕可用水頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Efficiency test uncertainty" and "Available cavitation head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「效率試驗不確定度」如何影響古里水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Efficiency test uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Guri Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。流量、水頭與功率誤差會共同傳到效率；獨立小誤差可用平方和開根近似，但共用校準或同一基準造成的相關誤差必須保留協方差，不能假裝會互相抵消。 標準不確定度與擴充不確定度不能直接相混，若資料給涵蓋因子，應先換成同一層級再進行傳播。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「效率試驗不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. Flow, head and power errors all propagate into efficiency. Independent small errors permit a root-sum-square approximation, while shared calibration or reference errors require covariance and cannot be assumed to cancel. Standard and expanded uncertainties cannot be mixed directly; when a coverage factor is supplied, convert every input to the same uncertainty level before propagation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Efficiency test uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「效率試驗不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Efficiency test uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 效率試驗不確定度
knowledge.text: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。流量、水頭與功率誤差會共同傳到效率；獨立小誤差可用平方和開根近似，但共用校準或同一基準造成的相關誤差必須保留協方差，不能假裝會互相抵消。
knowledge.textEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. Flow, head and power errors all propagate into efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「效率試驗不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Efficiency test uncertainty" is correct?
options: 重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差
更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。
相同淨水頭必定具有相同汽蝕餘量
optionsEn: Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias.
Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty.
Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
quiz.explanation: 更新驗收先定義電端輸出與水力輸入的量測邊界，再討論效率差是否大於量測不確定度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Renewal acceptance first defines electrical-output and hydraulic-input boundaries, then asks whether an efficiency change exceeds measurement uncertainty. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「效率試驗不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Efficiency test uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。模型邊界：各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Model boundary: dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。模型邊界：各輸入為無因次相對標準不確定度，互相獨立且誤差小；不是擴充信賴區間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Model boundary: dimensionless relative standard uncertainties, mutually independent and small; not an expanded confidence interval.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「效率試驗不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Efficiency test uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 出現轉頻振動就一定是轉子不平衡
總冷卻流量正常就代表局部熱阻正常
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。
optionsEn: A vibration at rotational frequency always proves rotor unbalance.
Normal total cooling flow proves that local thermal resistance is normal.
Original hypothetical example.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: uP=0.004 (dimensionless); uQ=0.008 (dimensionless); uH=0.003 (dimensionless); uEta=(uP*uP+uQ*uQ+uH*uH)**0.5=0.009433981. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「效率試驗不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Efficiency test uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。若改善幅度與不確定度相近，應報告分辨能力不足，再研究增加樣本能否降低隨機項，而非期待它消除系統偏差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. If the claimed improvement is comparable to uncertainty, report limited resolution and assess whether more samples reduce random components rather than expecting them to remove systematic bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為三個量測項建立不確定度表，再加入流量與水頭正相關情境，重算效率不確定度，指出改善哪一項儀表最能提高辨識能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build an uncertainty budget for the three measurements, add positive correlation between head and flow, and recompute efficiency uncertainty. Identify the instrument improvement that most increases the ability to resolve a performance change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 查閱各儀表校準的標準不確定度及共同來源，將不同工況的重複試驗分開統計。若改善幅度與不確定度相近，應報告分辨能力不足，再研究增加樣本能否降低隨機項，而非期待它消除系統偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Review standard calibration uncertainties and shared causes, keeping repeated tests at different operating points separate. If the claimed improvement is comparable to uncertainty, report limited resolution and assess whether more samples reduce random components rather than expecting them to remove systematic bias.

quiz.question: 要驗證「效率試驗不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 效率試驗不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Efficiency test uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「效率試驗不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Efficiency test uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares. Changing instrument ranges between tests may also create an apparent efficiency improvement that is actually a calibration difference. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：標準不確定度與擴充不確定度不能直接相混，若資料給涵蓋因子，應先換成同一層級再進行傳播。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Standard and expanded uncertainties cannot be mixed directly; when a coverage factor is supplied, convert every input to the same uncertainty level before propagation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重複測試足夠多次就能消除所有偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Enough repeated tests eliminate every systematic measurement bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

水頭與流量共用錯誤時間窗會造成相關偏差，直接平方和會低估或高估結果；更新前後若換了儀表量程，也可能製造看似效率改善的校準差。

Head and discharge using the same incorrect time window can have correlated errors, invalidating a simple sum of squares.
Equal net head always provides equal cavitation margin.
