steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調蓄水的能量尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stored water energy scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh。模型邊界：固定淨水頭效率且假設全量經機組，不含其他用途與時序限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=20000000 m3; H=180 m; eta=0.90 (dimensionless); E=rho*g*V*H*eta/3.6e12=8.829 GWh. Model boundary: fixed net head and efficiency with all water passing through turbines, excluding other uses and timing constraints. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調蓄水的能量尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stored water energy scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分段放水量與各段平均淨水頭積分，對照固定水頭結果，再核對旁通及其他取水。若庫水位下降明顯，應縮小分段以檢查收斂，不把最初最高水頭用於全部水量來高估能量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate incremental releases using each segment mean net head and compare the fixed-head estimate, accounting for bypass and other withdrawals. When level changes substantially, refine the segments and check convergence rather than applying the initial maximum head to every unit of water. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水量分成兩段並給不同淨水頭，重算總電能，與固定平均及初始水頭兩種近似比較，再列出水庫用途約束對可用量的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Split release into two volumes with different net heads and calculate total energy. Compare fixed-average and initial-head approximations, then explain how water-use constraints alter the volume available for generation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尾水隨出流上升會進一步降低淨水頭，僅考慮庫水位下降仍可能高估能量；若用總庫容替代可調節庫容，也會把不能利用的水列入電量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

When level changes substantially, refine the segments and check convergence rather than applying the initial maximum head to every unit of water.

knowledge.textEn: Split release into two volumes with different net heads and calculate total energy. Compare fixed-average and initial-head approximations, then explain how water-use constraints alter the volume available for generation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調蓄水的能量尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stored water energy scale"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

Maximum pressures from all sensors can always be added as simultaneous loads.

steps.title: 調蓄水的能量尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stored water energy scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調蓄水的能量尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stored water energy scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尾水隨出流上升會進一步降低淨水頭，僅考慮庫水位下降仍可能高估能量；若用總庫容替代可調節庫容，也會把不能利用的水列入電量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tailwater rising with release further reduces head, so accounting only for falling reservoir level may still overstate energy. Using total rather than usable storage can also include water that cannot be allocated to the assumed generating sequence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量換算需從焦耳轉為瓦時再轉為吉瓦時，忽略每小時秒數會造成巨大單位錯誤，應逐級檢查。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同庫容在任何水頭下都代表相同電能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal storage volume represents equal electrical energy at every head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「相關監測聯合殘差」如何影響錦屏一級水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Correlated monitoring residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Jinping-I Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體相鄰量測常因同一水位或溫度作用而相關，不能把每個偏離都當成獨立證據。教材以兩個標準化殘差與相關係數建立聯合距離，說明共同變動與相反變動具有不同意義。統計距離仍須依有效基線與物理機制解讀，不能直接當成安全分數。 相關係數接近一時矩陣可能病態，小量測差異會被大幅放大，應檢查基線品質與數值穩定性再解讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相關監測聯合殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nearby dam observations often correlate through shared level or temperature effects and cannot each be counted as independent evidence. A two-residual distance with correlation distinguishes common movement from opposing movement. Its interpretation still depends on a valid baseline and physical mechanism; the statistical distance is not a direct safety score. A correlation near one makes the covariance matrix ill-conditioned and can amplify small differences; assess baseline quality and numerical stability before interpreting the joint distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Correlated monitoring residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: z1=2 (dimensionless); z2=2 (dimensionless); r=0.8 (dimensionless); D2=(z1*z1-2*r*z1*z2+z2*z2)/(1-r*r)=4.444444444.

knowledge.title: 相關監測聯合殘差
knowledge.text: 壩體相鄰量測常因同一水位或溫度作用而相關，不能把每個偏離都當成獨立證據。教材以兩個標準化殘差與相關係數建立聯合距離，說明共同變動與相反變動具有不同意義。
knowledge.textEn: Nearby dam observations often correlate through shared level or temperature effects and cannot each be counted as independent evidence. A two-residual distance with correlation distinguishes common movement from opposing movement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相關監測聯合殘差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Correlated monitoring residuals" is correct?
options: 兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據
壩體相鄰量測常因同一水位或溫度作用而相關，不能把每個偏離都當成獨立證據。
壩頂海拔可直接代替壓力積分水深
optionsEn: Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly.
Nearby dam observations often correlate through shared level or temperature effects and cannot each be counted as independent evidence.
Crest elevation above sea level can directly replace water depth in pressure integration.
quiz.explanation: 壩體相鄰量測常因同一水位或溫度作用而相關，不能把每個偏離都當成獨立證據。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nearby dam observations often correlate through shared level or temperature effects and cannot each be counted as independent evidence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相關監測聯合殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Correlated monitoring residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：z1=2 (dimensionless); z2=2 (dimensionless); r=0.8 (dimensionless); D2=(z1*z1-2*r*z1*z2+z2*z2)/(1-r*r)=4.444444444。模型邊界：兩個無因次標準化殘差及固定相關係數；只示範平方距離，未給警報門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: z1=2 (dimensionless); z2=2 (dimensionless); r=0.8 (dimensionless); D2=(z1*z1-2*r*z1*z2+z2*z2)/(1-r*r)=4.444444444. Model boundary: two dimensionless standardized residuals with fixed correlation; squared-distance illustration without an alarm threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Model boundary: two dimensionless standardized residuals with fixed correlation; squared-distance illustration without an alarm threshold.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相關監測聯合殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Correlated monitoring residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。若相關結構本身改變，應重查共同水力或溫度原因，而不是沿用舊矩陣把新反應自動判成正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles. A changing correlation structure requires examining shared hydraulic or thermal causes rather than automatically classifying new behavior with an outdated covariance model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持兩個殘差大小但反轉其中一個符號，重算聯合距離並比較，提出一項可區分共同基準漂移與相反結構變形的獨立觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep residual magnitudes fixed but reverse one sign, recompute the joint distance and compare. Propose an independent observation that distinguishes common reference drift from opposing structural movements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。若相關結構本身改變，應重查共同水力或溫度原因，而不是沿用舊矩陣把新反應自動判成正常。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles. A changing correlation structure requires examining shared hydraulic or thermal causes rather than automatically classifying new behavior with an outdated covariance model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持兩個殘差大小但反轉其中一個符號，重算聯合距離並比較，提出一項可區分共同基準漂移與相反結構變形的獨立觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Keep residual magnitudes fixed but reverse one sign, recompute the joint distance and compare. Propose an independent observation that distinguishes common reference drift from opposing structural movements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相關監測聯合殘差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Correlated monitoring residuals"?
options: 用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
單側位移可以直接當成相鄰接縫開度
optionsEn: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Displacement on one side directly equals the adjacent joint opening.
quiz.explanation: 用未含已知異常的基線估計相關，檢查不同季節是否穩定，並與不同原理儀器比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate correlation from a baseline excluding known anomalies, test seasonal stability and compare instruments using different principles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 相關監測聯合殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Correlated monitoring residuals: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相關監測聯合殘差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Correlated monitoring residuals” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. A drifting shared reference can also create high correlation between instruments without providing evidence of consistent structural behavior across the monitored locations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相關係數接近一時矩陣可能病態，小量測差異會被大幅放大，應檢查基線品質與數值穩定性再解讀。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A correlation near one makes the covariance matrix ill-conditioned and can amplify small differences; assess baseline quality and numerical stability before interpreting the joint distance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個相關感測器就是兩份獨立異常證據」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two correlated sensors provide two independent confirmations of an anomaly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. A drifting shared reference can also create high correlation between instruments without providing evidence of consistent structural behavior across the monitored locations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相關監測聯合殘差」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Correlated monitoring residuals" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。
壩頂海拔可直接代替壓力積分水深
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization.
Crest elevation above sea level can directly replace water depth in pressure integration.
quiz.explanation: 基線中混入長期變形會放大變異與相關，讓真正新異常被標準化後縮小；兩感測器共用漂移基準也可能製造高度相關，並非結構反應一致的證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term movement within the baseline inflates variance and correlation, shrinking new anomalies after standardization. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 白鶴灘水壩
courses.summary: 白鶴灘案例連結柱狀節理岩體、低熱混凝土與大型水輪發電機，從局部剛度及熱量一路推到轉矩、視在功率、冷卻和調速介面。課程刻意分開實際裝機規模與假想材料參數，並要求學員對每個簡化模型提出可驗證觀察及升級分析條件。
courses.summaryEn: The Baihetan case connects jointed rock, low-heat concrete and large turbine-generators, moving from local stiffness and thermal energy to torque, apparent power, cooling and governor interfaces. Actual installed scale is separated from assumed material parameters. Each simplified model requires an observable verification method and a stated condition for more advanced analysis.
courses.focus: 百萬千瓦機組與高拱壩多尺度
courses.focusEn: Gigawatt units and multiple scales of a high arch dam
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 世界水壩與水庫
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」及「巨型機組軸轉矩」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m；第二組為 binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Columnar joint series compliance, then compare the controlling variables in Low heat cement adiabatic rise and Gigawatt unit shaft torque. The first calculation is kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m; the second is binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「柱狀節理串聯柔度」與「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Columnar joint series compliance" and "Low heat cement adiabatic rise": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Columnar joint series compliance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。這種尺度分析幫助理解很薄的弱介面為何可能主導整體變形，但不代表真實三維節理網絡。 串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「柱狀節理串聯柔度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness. A thin weak interface can dominate deformation, though the model does not represent a three-dimensional joint network. Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Columnar joint series compliance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Columnar joint series compliance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度
knowledge.text: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。當載重路徑依序通過岩塊及節理，兩者變形可在簡化一維模型中相加，等效剛度由柔度相加求得。
knowledge.textEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. A load path passing sequentially through rock and an interface permits additive displacements in a simplified one-dimensional model, with compliances added to obtain equivalent stiffness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「柱狀節理串聯柔度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Columnar joint series compliance" is correct?
options: 串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
optionsEn: Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip.
Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.
quiz.explanation: 柱狀節理岩體的變形不只來自完整岩塊，也包含節理壓縮與滑移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Columnar-jointed rock deforms through intact blocks and joint compression or slip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Columnar joint series compliance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。模型邊界：單一串聯線彈性載重路徑，兩元件同力且不滑移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m. Model boundary: one linear elastic series path with equal force in both elements and no sliding. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m。模型邊界：單一串聯線彈性載重路徑，兩元件同力且不滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: kb=120 GN/m; kj=30 GN/m; keq=1/(1/kb+1/kj)=24 GN/m. Model boundary: one linear elastic series path with equal force in both elements and no sliding.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Columnar joint series compliance", which statement holds?

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Columnar joint series compliance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。若主要變形集中在界面，應優先辨認節理閉合；若卸載後殘留位移大，串聯彈簧需改為非線性接觸模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Interface-dominated movement points toward joint closure, while substantial residual movement after unloading requires nonlinear contact behavior rather than two purely elastic series springs. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將節理剛度提高一倍重算等效剛度，再比較只提高岩塊剛度的效果，指出試驗與處理資源應優先釐清哪一個變形來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double joint stiffness and recompute the equivalent value, then compare doubling only block stiffness. Identify which deformation source should receive priority in testing and in evaluating a proposed treatment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。若主要變形集中在界面，應優先辨認節理閉合；若卸載後殘留位移大，串聯彈簧需改為非線性接觸模型。
knowledge.textEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Interface-dominated movement points toward joint closure, while substantial residual movement after unloading requires nonlinear contact behavior rather than two purely elastic series springs.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將節理剛度提高一倍重算等效剛度，再比較只提高岩塊剛度的效果，指出試驗與處理資源應優先釐清哪一個變形來源。
knowledge.textEn: Double joint stiffness and recompute the equivalent value, then compare doubling only block stiffness. Identify which deformation source should receive priority in testing and in evaluating a proposed treatment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「柱狀節理串聯柔度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Columnar joint series compliance"?
options: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
入口空氣分率就是底板局部空隙率
optionsEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The inlet air-flow fraction equals the local void fraction at the floor.
quiz.explanation: 用不同載重級的現地位移檢查線性與回復性，分別量測岩塊內與跨節理的變形。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check linearity and recovery over several field load levels, measuring within blocks and across joints separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 柱狀節理串聯柔度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Columnar joint series compliance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「柱狀節理串聯柔度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Columnar joint series compliance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：串聯元件承受相同力，平行元件則共享位移，先確認物理連接才能決定應加剛度還是加柔度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Elements in series carry equal force, whereas parallel elements share displacement; the physical connection determines whether stiffnesses or compliances should be added in the model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
knowledge.textEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Opening or sliding can change the path itself, so one reduced constant stiffness cannot describe every loading stage and contact condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「柱狀節理串聯柔度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Columnar joint series compliance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。
使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness.
Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature.
quiz.explanation: 將兩剛度直接相加會誤用平行路徑而高估承載系統剛度；節理張開或滑移還會改變路徑本身，不能只以較小的常數剛度描述所有受力階段。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding the two stiffnesses directly mistakes a series path for parallel paths and overstates system stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低熱水泥減少或延緩水化放熱，但大體積混凝土仍可能累積顯著溫升。教材以膠結料用量乘單位放熱量，再除混凝土體積熱容量估算絕熱上升尺度。放熱隨齡期改變，骨材與摻料也影響熱容量，因此材料名稱本身不能替代實測溫升曲線。 單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Low-heat cement reduces or delays hydration heat, but mass concrete can still accumulate a substantial temperature rise. Binder content times specific heat release divided by concrete volumetric heat capacity estimates an adiabatic scale. Age-dependent hydration, aggregates and supplementary materials alter the response, so a material name cannot replace a measured temperature-rise curve. Specific binder heat release requires an age; mixing early and final heat values erases the delayed-release behavior that matters when comparing low-heat materials. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K。模型邊界：假定指定齡期放熱全被保留的絕熱估算，不含散熱及水化動力學。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: binder=180 kg/m3; q=200 kJ/kg; rho=2400 kg/m3; cp=0.9 kJ/(kg*K); dT=binder*q/(rho*cp)=16.66666667 K. Model boundary: adiabatic estimate retaining all stated age-specific heat, excluding heat loss and hydration kinetics. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test the actual mix adiabatically or semi-adiabatically, matching age, starting temperature and supplementary materials, then compare core temperatures and cooling accounts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對實際配比做絕熱或半絕熱試驗，核對試件齡期、初溫與摻料比例，再與現場核心溫度及冷卻帳比較。若現場峰值較低，應查散熱與放熱時間，而非直接宣稱水泥單位放熱量不同。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test the actual mix adiabatically or semi-adiabatically, matching age, starting temperature and supplementary materials, then compare core temperatures and cooling accounts. A lower field peak calls for examining heat exchange and timing before concluding that the cement specific heat release has changed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：改變膠結料用量與比熱各一成，分別重算溫升，建立敏感度表，再列出要從絕熱尺度轉成現地溫度歷程所需的邊界條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change binder content and heat capacity by ten percent separately, recalculate rise and build a sensitivity table. List boundary conditions needed to convert the adiabatic scale into a field temperature history.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 低熱水泥絕熱溫升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low heat cement adiabatic rise: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低熱水泥絕熱溫升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low heat cement adiabatic rise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低熱不等於無熱，若忽略保溫邊界仍可能低估核心溫升；過快表面降溫又可能提高梯度，所以降低總熱量不能單獨保證沒有溫度裂縫。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low heat is not zero heat, and an insulating boundary can still permit a high core temperature. Rapid surface cooling can increase gradients, so a reduced total heat release alone cannot guarantee the absence of thermal cracking. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：單位膠結料放熱量必須附齡期，早期與最終放熱不能混用，否則低熱材料延遲放熱的特徵會被抹平。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Specific binder heat release requires an age; mixing early and final heat values erases the delayed-release behavior that matters when comparing low-heat materials.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用低熱水泥就不需要量測核心溫度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Using low-heat cement eliminates the need to measure core temperature." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「巨型機組軸轉矩」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 百萬千瓦級機組的低速軸系需傳遞很大的轉矩，機械功率與電端功率要先分清楚。教材把指定軸功率除以角速度，得到平均扭矩，再討論法蘭、軸承與轉輪連接的載重路徑。平均扭矩不能表示扭振峰值，也不能由單機容量推論材料應力。 若功率以兆瓦輸入而角速度以每秒計，所得扭矩自然是兆牛頓米，但弧度的無因次慣例仍需說明。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「巨型機組軸轉矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-speed gigawatt-class shaft transmits large torque, and mechanical power must be distinguished from terminal electrical power. Divide specified shaft power by angular speed for mean torque, then trace loads through flanges, bearings and runner connections. Mean torque does not describe torsional peaks or determine material stress from unit capacity alone. With megawatts and angular speed per second, torque is naturally in meganewton-metres; the dimensionless-radian convention should still be understood when checking the units. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「巨型機組軸轉矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m。模型邊界：假想恆速軸端功率，未含載重拒絕與扭振。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Pshaft=1000 MW; n=120 rpm; omega=2*pi*n/60; T=Pshaft/omega=79.57747155 MN*m. Model boundary: hypothetical constant-speed shaft power, excluding load rejection and torsional oscillation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照軸速、電端功率及損失估計，先確認功率邊界一致，再把扭振頻譜與平均轉矩分開報告。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align shaft speed, terminal power and loss estimates to a common boundary, reporting torsional spectra separately from mean torque.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「巨型機組軸轉矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照軸速、電端功率及損失估計，先確認功率邊界一致，再把扭振頻譜與平均轉矩分開報告。若接頭局部應變偏高而平均功率正常，應研究偏心、載重分配及應力集中，不用總功率排除機械問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align shaft speed, terminal power and loss estimates to a common boundary, reporting torsional spectra separately from mean torque. High local connection strain at normal mean power calls for examining eccentricity, load distribution and stress concentration rather than using total power to dismiss a mechanical problem. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持軸功率並改變轉速，計算平均轉矩曲線，再畫接頭傳力圖，指出還需哪些幾何與動態資料才能評估局部螺栓或法蘭應力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold shaft power fixed while varying speed and plot mean torque. Draw the connection load path and identify geometric and dynamic information needed to assess local bolt or flange stress.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 巨型機組軸轉矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gigawatt unit shaft torque: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「巨型機組軸轉矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gigawatt unit shaft torque” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. Confusing revolutions per minute with per second introduces a unit error into every subsequent torque and stress estimate based on that speed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若功率以兆瓦輸入而角速度以每秒計，所得扭矩自然是兆牛頓米，但弧度的無因次慣例仍需說明。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With megawatts and angular speed per second, torque is naturally in meganewton-metres; the dimensionless-radian convention should still be understood when checking the units.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. Confusing revolutions per minute with per second introduces a unit error into every subsequent torque and stress estimate based on that speed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「巨型機組軸轉矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gigawatt unit shaft torque" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流
optionsEn: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed.
quiz.explanation: 軸系接頭鬆動可能造成週期滑移與局部峰值，平均扭矩帳仍會閉合；若錯把轉速每分鐘當每秒，則會把所有後續扭矩與應力估算帶入單位錯誤。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A loose shaft connection can produce cyclic slip and local peaks while the mean torque account still closes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發電端電流尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Generator terminal current scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「發電端電流尺度」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Generator terminal current scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。教材在平衡正弦條件下計算線電流，並辨認線電壓與相電壓的差異。導體溫升、短路力及局部放電需另行驗證。 每相電流與線電流是否相等取決於接線方式，本例使用平衡系統的線量關係，不可未確認就套入繞組損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電端電流尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-generator current depends on three-phase active power, line voltage and power factor. Raising voltage lowers current at fixed power but introduces insulation and fault considerations. Calculate line current for balanced sinusoidal operation while distinguishing line from phase voltage; conductor heating, short-circuit forces and partial discharge remain separate assessments. Whether phase and line current match depends on connection; this example uses balanced-system line quantities and cannot enter winding-loss calculations without checking that distinction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Generator terminal current scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P=1000000000 W; Vline=24000 V; pf=0.90 (dimensionless); I=P/(sqrt(3)*Vline*pf)/1000=26.72917913 kA.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電端電流尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Generator terminal current scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發電端電流尺度
knowledge.text: 大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。教材在平衡正弦條件下計算線電流，並辨認線電壓與相電壓的差異。
knowledge.textEn: Large-generator current depends on three-phase active power, line voltage and power factor. Raising voltage lowers current at fixed power but introduces insulation and fault considerations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發電端電流尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Generator terminal current scale" is correct?
options: 實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流
大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。
相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力
optionsEn: Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed.
Large-generator current depends on three-phase active power, line voltage and power factor.
Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
quiz.explanation: 大型發電機電流由三相實功、線電壓及功率因數共同決定，電壓提高會降低同功率電流，但不能因此忽略絕緣與故障需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

Model boundary: balanced sinusoidal three-phase steady state using line voltage for line current, not fault current.

steps.title: 發電端電流尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Generator terminal current scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「發電端電流尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Generator terminal current scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 校驗三相電壓電流相量與功率因數定義，核對電流互感器比值及相序，再比較總實功與三相分量。若某相電流異常但總功率近似不變，應查不平衡與量測問題，不只用平均電流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify three-phase phasors, power-factor convention, current-transformer ratio and phase sequence, then compare total power with individual phases. An unusual phase current at similar total power requires checking imbalance and instrumentation rather than relying on one average current for the machine. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定電壓和實功，對三種功率因數計算電流及電流平方比例，再說明為何銅損比較仍需導體溫度下的電阻資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed voltage and active power, calculate current and current-squared ratios for three power factors. Explain why comparing copper loss still requires resistance measured at the relevant conductor temperature.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 發電端電流尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Generator terminal current scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「發電端電流尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Generator terminal current scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 線電壓誤作相電壓會造成根號三倍誤差，低功率因數又可能在實功未增加時提高電流；忽略這兩項會低估導體與冷卻系統負擔。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing line and phase voltage introduces a square-root-of-three error, while reduced power factor can raise current without increasing active power. Ignoring these effects understates conductor loading and cooling demand even at an unchanged generating output. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每相電流與線電流是否相等取決於接線方式，本例使用平衡系統的線量關係，不可未確認就套入繞組損失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Whether phase and line current match depends on connection; this example uses balanced-system line quantities and cannot enter winding-loss calculations without checking that distinction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「實功固定時功率因數不會影響電流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Power factor cannot affect current when active power is fixed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱體積流」與「調速下垂靜態尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling volume flow" and "Governor droop static scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風散熱體積流」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling volume flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。海拔、溫度和壓力會改變密度，因此相同風量不一定帶走相同熱量。教材求理想需求流量後，還要檢查風路分配、壓降與局部熱點，不能只看風機銘牌。 空氣密度應對應量測斷面的壓力與溫度，標準風量和實際風量需要換算後才能放進同一熱量帳。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱體積流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. Altitude, temperature and pressure change density, so equal volume flow may remove different heat. After estimating ideal demand, examine distribution, pressure drop and hotspots rather than relying on a fan nameplate alone. Air density must match pressure and temperature at the measurement section; standard and actual volume flows require conversion before they belong in one thermal account. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling volume flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風散熱體積流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation cooling volume flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風散熱體積流
knowledge.text: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。海拔、溫度和壓力會改變密度，因此相同風量不一定帶走相同熱量。
knowledge.textEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. Altitude, temperature and pressure change density, so equal volume flow may remove different heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風散熱體積流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation cooling volume flow" is correct?
options: 相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力
下垂公式算出的增功率會瞬間全部到位

optionsEn: Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously.
Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise.
quiz.explanation: 以空氣帶走發電機熱量時，體積流量須先乘密度轉成質量流率，再乘比熱與溫升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Air cooling requires converting volume flow to mass flow with density before applying heat capacity and temperature rise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling volume flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風散熱體積流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling volume flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s。模型邊界：穩態完全混合且全部熱由此氣流帶走，不含旁通與漏風。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Qheat=5000000 W; rhoAir=1.15 kg/m3; cpAir=1005 J/(kg*K); dT=15 K; Vdot=Qheat/(rhoAir*cpAir*dT)=288.4130074 m3/s. Model boundary: steady complete mixing with all heat carried by this airflow, excluding bypass and leakage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 在進出口量測溫度、密度條件與風速分布，使用斷面積分而非單點最高風速。若總熱量帳吻合但局部繞組過熱，應查分流及死區；若風機功率增加而有效風量不增，則查阻力及漏風。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet-outlet temperature, density conditions and velocity distribution, integrating the section rather than using its peak velocity. A closing total heat account with hot windings indicates flow maldistribution. Greater fan power without more effective flow calls for checking resistance and leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將空氣密度降低一成重算需求風量，再加入兩條不均等風路，說明哪些測點能確認熱源真正得到冷卻，而非只看到總風量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower air density by ten percent and recalculate required volume flow. Add two unequal airflow paths and identify measurements that verify cooling at the heat source rather than only total delivered airflow.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：風道旁通可讓量測總風量正常卻繞過熱源，局部堵塞也可能在平均溫升不高時形成熱點；若沿用標準密度，則會把高溫空氣的熱容量估高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bypass can preserve measured total airflow while avoiding the heat source, and local blockage can create hotspots despite modest mean temperature rise. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 通風散熱體積流：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風散熱體積流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation cooling volume flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 風道旁通可讓量測總風量正常卻繞過熱源，局部堵塞也可能在平均溫升不高時形成熱點；若沿用標準密度，則會把高溫空氣的熱容量估高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A bypass can preserve measured total airflow while avoiding the heat source, and local blockage can create hotspots despite modest mean temperature rise. Using standard density for hot air also overestimates its heat-carrying capacity at the stated volume flow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：空氣密度應對應量測斷面的壓力與溫度，標準風量和實際風量需要換算後才能放進同一熱量帳。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Air density must match pressure and temperature at the measurement section; standard and actual volume flows require conversion before they belong in one thermal account.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 調速下垂靜態尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Governor droop static scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調速下垂靜態尺度」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Governor droop static scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 調速下垂使頻率降低時機組增加功率，但其靜態斜率不等於瞬時能提供的響應。導葉速度、水錘、轉動慣量及保護限制決定暫態過程。教材以無因次下垂和頻率偏差估算理想增功率，要求另查機組餘裕，避免在已滿載時仍假設無限調節能力。 下垂係數的百分比是頻率相對變化與額定功率相對變化之比，若把赫茲直接除百分數會失去量綱一致性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調速下垂靜態尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Governor droop increases requested power as frequency falls, but the static slope is not instantaneous delivered response. Guide-vane speed, water hammer, inertia and protection shape the transient. Use dimensionless droop and frequency deviation to estimate an ideal increment, then check headroom rather than assuming unlimited response from a fully loaded machine. Droop relates relative frequency change to relative rated-power change; dividing raw hertz directly by a percentage loses the dimensional consistency of the normalized relation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Governor droop static scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下垂公式算出的增功率會瞬間全部到位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「調速下垂靜態尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Governor droop static scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Governor droop increases requested power as frequency falls, but the static slope is not instantaneous delivered response. Guide-vane speed, water hammer, inertia and protection shape the transient.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Governor droop static scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW。模型邊界：無死區及飽和的靜態下垂關係，未含水力暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: f0=50 Hz; df=-0.25 Hz; R=0.05 (dimensionless); Prated=1000 MW; dP=-(df/f0)/R*Prated=100 MW. Model boundary: static droop without deadband or saturation, excluding hydraulic transients. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。若指令增加但出力受限，應檢查餘裕和水力限制；若頻率量測有濾波延遲，不能把全部延遲歸因於機械執行器。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay. A rising request with limited output requires checking headroom and hydraulic constraints. Frequency-filter delay must not be attributed entirely to the mechanical actuator in the response diagnosis. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set two headroom limits, clip the ideal response and compare them. Sketch a delayed actuator response and identify tests that distinguish static droop from the dynamic parameters of the hydraulic-machine system.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing governor gain can interact with hydraulic delay and create oscillation, improving the static formula while degrading dynamic behavior. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。若指令增加但出力受限，應檢查餘裕和水力限制；若頻率量測有濾波延遲，不能把全部延遲歸因於機械執行器。
knowledge.textEn: Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay. A rising request with limited output requires checking headroom and hydraulic constraints. Frequency-filter delay must not be attributed entirely to the mechanical actuator in the response diagnosis.

knowledge.text: 設定兩種可用功率餘裕，將理想響應截限後比較，再畫出有執行器延遲的概念曲線，指出哪些測試才能辨識靜態與動態參數。
knowledge.textEn: Set two headroom limits, clip the ideal response and compare them. Sketch a delayed actuator response and identify tests that distinguish static droop from the dynamic parameters of the hydraulic-machine system.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調速下垂靜態尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Governor droop static scale"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常
對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal.
Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay.
quiz.explanation: 對齊頻率、功率指令、導葉開度與電端出力，分別估計靜態增益及動態延遲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align frequency, power request, guide-vane position and terminal output, separating static gain from dynamic delay. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調速下垂靜態尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Governor droop static scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調速下垂靜態尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Governor droop static scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接提高調速增益可能與水力延遲形成振盪，靜態公式看似增強支援卻降低動態穩定；忽略功率上限則會高估事故期間可提供的頻率響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing governor gain can interact with hydraulic delay and create oscillation, improving the static formula while degrading dynamic behavior. Ignoring the power ceiling also overstates the frequency response available during a disturbance in the interconnected system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下垂係數的百分比是頻率相對變化與額定功率相對變化之比，若把赫茲直接除百分數會失去量綱一致性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Droop relates relative frequency change to relative rated-power change; dividing raw hertz directly by a percentage loses the dimensional consistency of the normalized relation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下垂公式算出的增功率會瞬間全部到位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The power increment from the droop formula is delivered completely and instantaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
