stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高頻訊號混疊」與「摻氣體積分率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "High frequency signal aliasing" and "Aeration volume fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高頻訊號混疊」如何影響白鶴灘水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High frequency signal aliasing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Baihetan Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型機組監測若取樣頻率不足，高頻壓力或振動會折返到較低頻段，形成不存在的故障特徵。取樣理論需與類比防混疊濾波共同考慮，單純增加資料點顯示密度不會恢復已遺失資訊。教材計算一個折返頻率，再要求用原始取樣與濾波規格驗證。 取樣前的類比濾波與取樣後數位濾波作用不同，前者防止折返進入資料，後者只能處理已記錄頻帶。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高頻訊號混疊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient sampling folds high-frequency pressure or vibration into lower bands and creates misleading fault signatures. Sampling must be considered with analog anti-alias filtering; plotting more interpolated points cannot restore lost information. Calculate one alias frequency and verify it against the original acquisition and filtering specifications before diagnosing machinery. Analog filtering before sampling and digital filtering afterward serve different roles: the former prevents folding, while the latter only processes frequencies already represented in the record. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High frequency signal aliasing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高頻訊號混疊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High frequency signal aliasing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高頻訊號混疊」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：定量估算
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高頻訊號混疊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “High frequency signal aliasing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。模型邊界：此頻率位於第一個折返區間且無有效防混疊濾波，非一般多區間公式。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz. Model boundary: this signal lies in the first folding interval without effective anti-alias filtering; not a general multi-band formula. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：ftrue=360 Hz; fs=500 Hz; falias=abs(ftrue-fs)=140 Hz。模型邊界：此頻率位於第一個折返區間且無有效防混疊濾波，非一般多區間公式。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 高頻訊號混疊：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High frequency signal aliasing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高頻訊號混疊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High frequency signal aliasing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查原始取樣率、類比濾波截止及感測器頻寬，再以較高取樣率重測同一工況。若低頻峰隨取樣率改變而移動，支持混疊而非機械模態；若峰保持物理頻率，仍需結合轉速與相位判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check original sampling rate, analog cutoff and sensor bandwidth, then repeat the operating point at a higher rate. A low-frequency peak moving with sample rate supports aliasing rather than a mechanical mode; a stable physical frequency still needs speed and phase evidence for interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩個取樣率計算同一真實頻率的顯示位置，畫出頻譜折返，再提出類比濾波與取樣設定，說明為何僅改圖表解析度無效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate the apparent frequency of one real signal at two sampling rates and sketch folding. Propose analog filtering and acquisition settings and explain why changing chart resolution alone cannot correct the data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：軟體後處理低通無法移除已折返而混入有效頻帶的訊號，插值也不會創造新資訊；若據此調整機組，可能處理根本不存在的低頻激振。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A digital low-pass applied afterward cannot remove a folded signal already overlapping the useful band, and interpolation creates no new information. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 先核對幾何縮尺與所有測具位置，再用速度、水深及流量三種尺度互相驗算。比較不同模型尺寸的含氣與表面現象，若結果隨尺寸改變，應辨認尺度效應，不把較細緻照片當作更準確的原型預測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify geometric scale and sensor positions, then cross-check velocity, depth and discharge scaling. Compare aeration and surface behavior in different model sizes. Size-dependent results require identifying scale effects rather than treating more detailed photographs as inherently more accurate prototype predictions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 關於「獨立量測加權估計」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent measurement weighted estimate" is correct?
options: 加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差
多種儀器觀察同一位移時，可在誤差獨立且無偏的條件下依變異倒數加權，但精度高不代表沒有共同基準偏差。
串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
optionsEn: Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias.
Measurements of one displacement can be weighted by inverse variance when errors are independent and unbiased, but precision does not exclude shared reference bias.
Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
quiz.explanation: 多種儀器觀察同一位移時，可在誤差獨立且無偏的條件下依變異倒數加權，但精度高不代表沒有共同基準偏差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements of one displacement can be weighted by inverse variance when errors are independent and unbiased, but precision does not exclude shared reference bias. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 獨立量測加權估計：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent measurement weighted estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立量測加權估計」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Independent measurement weighted estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm。模型邊界：獨立無偏高斯量測的加權平均，未處理共同漂移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm. Model boundary: weighted mean for independent unbiased Gaussian observations, excluding shared drift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm。模型邊界：獨立無偏高斯量測的加權平均，未處理共同漂移。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm. Model boundary: weighted mean for independent unbiased Gaussian observations, excluding shared drift.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「獨立量測加權估計」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Independent measurement weighted estimate", which statement holds?
options: 機組平均功率正常就代表接頭局部應力正常
相同體積風量必定提供相同散熱能力
原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm。
optionsEn: Normal mean unit power proves that local connection stresses are normal.
Equal volumetric airflow always provides equal heat-removal capability.
Original hypothetical example.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: x1=5 mm; s1=0.5 mm; x2=6 mm; s2=1 mm; xhat=(x1/s1**2+x2/s2**2)/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2)=5.2 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 獨立量測加權估計：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent measurement weighted estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立量測加權估計」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent measurement weighted estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩筆量測同時加入相同偏差，重算融合值並比較差值是否改變，再提出可揭露共同漂移的第三種獨立觀測與基準設計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。若兩者一起偏移但差值不變，需要外部基準；加權平均無法從兩份共同錯誤中恢復真值。
knowledge.textEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. If both drift together while their difference remains constant, an external reference is required; weighted averaging cannot recover truth from two observations with the same bias.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對兩筆量測同時加入相同偏差，重算融合值並比較差值是否改變，再提出可揭露共同漂移的第三種獨立觀測與基準設計。
knowledge.textEn: Add the same bias to both observations, recompute the fused estimate and check whether their difference changes. Propose a third independent observation and reference arrangement capable of exposing the shared drift.

quiz.question: 要驗證「獨立量測加權估計」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent measurement weighted estimate"?
options: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
取樣後插值增加點數就能消除混疊
optionsEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding interpolated points after sampling eliminates aliasing.
quiz.explanation: 查校準資料與量測基準是否共用，將兩儀器差值與時間、溫度作圖，再檢查權重是否穩定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check calibration and shared references, plot the instrument difference against time and temperature, and test weight stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 獨立量測加權估計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent measurement weighted estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立量測加權估計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent measurement weighted estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Unsynchronized observations can also turn a genuine reservoir-response change into an apparent disagreement between instruments observing the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：權重由標準差平方的倒數取得，而非標準差本身的倒數；兩者混用會讓低精度資料取得過大影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weights use inverse variance, not inverse standard deviation; confusing the two gives the less precise observation too much influence in the combined displacement estimate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加權平均一定能消除所有共同基準偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Weighted averaging always removes every shared reference bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。
knowledge.textEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Unsynchronized observations can also turn a genuine reservoir-response change into an apparent disagreement between instruments observing the structure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「獨立量測加權估計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent measurement weighted estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。
串聯岩塊與節理的剛度可直接相加
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate.
Stiffnesses of rock and joint elements in series can be added directly.
quiz.explanation: 過度相信精度標示會讓有偏的儀器取得過大權重，融合值看似平滑卻偏離真實位移；若兩儀器不同步，水位變化也可能偽裝成量測差異。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An overtrusted precision specification gives a biased instrument excessive weight, producing a smooth but wrong estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 溪洛渡水壩
courses.summary: 溪洛渡案例從發電機視在功率與實功區分開始，接續冷卻、轉速、轉矩與振動，再回到拱壩變形、水力消能及梯級調度。學員須追蹤每筆資料的量測邊界，說明同一數值在設備銘牌、瞬時測試和年度電量中具有不同意義，避免由規模推定性能。
courses.summaryEn: The Xiluodu case starts by distinguishing apparent and active generator power, then studies cooling, speed, torque and vibration before returning to arch deformation, dissipation and cascade scheduling. Learners track measurement boundaries and explain why a number on a rating plate, during a test and in annual energy accounting means different things.
courses.focus: 高拱壩與發電機額定量的辨識
courses.focusEn: High arch dam and generator rating interpretation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為本課原創情境串接，所有數值是假設，不能視為業主設計圖或操作許可。先完成「視在容量與無功」的守恆與邊界檢核，再比較「轉子旋轉儲能」及「風機轉速與耗能」的不同控制量。第一組計算為 S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar；第二組為 J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。學員須保留量綱、資料時間與量測位置，討論誤差如何傳到結果，將第三單元的限制寫入同一張決策表。任何未納入的結構、河道或機組耦合都列為下一階段工作，不由單一得數推論全工程安全。
workedExample.textEn: This original sequence connects the first three units using assumed inputs; none is an owner drawing or an operating authorization. First establish conservation and boundaries for Apparent capacity and reactive power, then compare the controlling variables in Rotor rotational stored energy and Fan speed and power. The first calculation is S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar; the second is J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Preserve dimensions, observation times, and measurement locations in the working sheet. Explain how input uncertainty changes each conclusion and include the third unit limitations in the same decision table. Structural, river, and machine interactions omitted by a model remain subsequent work; a single numerical answer cannot demonstrate safety of the complete project.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「視在容量與無功」與「轉子旋轉儲能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Apparent capacity and reactive power" and "Rotor rotational stored energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Apparent capacity and reactive power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「視在容量與無功」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Apparent capacity and reactive power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar。模型邊界：平衡正弦條件的功率三角形，未區分超前滯後無功符號。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: S=800 MVA; P=640 MW; Qreactive=(S*S-P*P)**0.5=480 Mvar. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 視在容量與無功：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「視在容量與無功」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Apparent capacity and reactive power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對功率表的無功正負定義與三相電流，再把實功無功工作點放到設備能力圖上。若低實功時電流仍高，應檢查無功輸出與諧波，而不能只憑發電兆瓦較低判斷設備熱負擔較低。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the meter reactive-sign convention and phase currents, then place active-reactive operating points on the machine capability diagram. High current at low active power calls for checking reactive output and harmonics rather than assuming that lower generated megawatts imply lower thermal loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定視在容量並增加實功，計算剩餘無功尺度，畫出兩個工作點，再說明為何真正可用無功仍可能受勵磁或冷卻限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase active power at fixed apparent capacity and calculate the remaining reactive scale. Plot both operating points and explain why actual reactive capability may still be constrained by excitation or cooling.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting active from apparent power violates the vector relationship and misstates capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Apparent capacity and reactive power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以視在減實功估算無功會破壞向量關係，造成錯誤容量判斷；若系統含顯著諧波，簡單三角形本身也可能不足，需明確區分基波及總功率定義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objective: 說明「轉子旋轉儲能」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotor rotational stored energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水輪發電機轉子儲存的旋轉動能可在短時間功率不平衡時交換，但不是可持續供電的水庫能量。轉動慣量乘角速度平方的一半給出動能，若轉速變化小，能量變化仍與初始速度有關。教材用整體等效慣量建立尺度，不推定實際機組慣量常數。 可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉子旋轉儲能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rotor kinetic energy can exchange during brief power imbalance but is not sustained reservoir generation. Half the inertia times angular speed squared gives stored energy, with small energy changes still dependent on initial speed. An assumed equivalent inertia establishes scale without claiming the actual machine inertia constant or allowable speed excursion. Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotor rotational stored energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉子旋轉儲能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotor rotational stored energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ。模型邊界：剛性等效轉子且慣量固定，未計水柱動能與控制作用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: J=40000000 kg*m2; n=125 rpm; E=0.5*J*(2*pi*n/60)**2/1e9=3.426945973 GJ. Model boundary: rigid equivalent rotor with fixed inertia, excluding water-column energy and controls. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉子旋轉儲能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotor rotational stored energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。若動能差不閉合，應查水力轉矩、控制延遲及損失，不任意調慣量使每次事件都符合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. If kinetic-energy change does not close, investigate hydraulic torque, control delay and losses rather than retuning inertia separately to fit every event recorded by the system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將轉速降低百分之一，計算可釋出的動能而非總動能，再除以假想功率缺口估算短時尺度，列出此估算忽略的控制作用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce speed by one percent and calculate released rather than total kinetic energy. Divide it by an assumed power deficit to estimate a short time scale and list the control actions omitted by that estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉子旋轉儲能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotor rotational stored energy"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
查慣量定義及是否包含水輪機與發電機全部旋轉件，將轉速變化與瞬時功率不平衡積分比較。
同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance.
Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.

quiz.explanationEn: Check which rotating components the inertia includes and compare speed change with integrated instantaneous power imbalance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉子旋轉儲能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotor rotational stored energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉子旋轉儲能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotor rotational stored energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A flexible shaft can also distribute energy into torsional modes, making mean rotational speed insufficient to describe local dynamics during an electrical or hydraulic disturbance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：可釋放動能是兩個轉速狀態的能量差，若只用總動能估算支援時間，就等於假設轉子可停轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Available kinetic release is the energy difference between two speeds; using total stored energy for support duration implicitly assumes that the rotor can stop completely.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。
knowledge.textEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. A flexible shaft can also distribute energy into torsional modes, making mean rotational speed insufficient to describe local dynamics during an electrical or hydraulic disturbance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉子旋轉儲能」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotor rotational stored energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能
把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase.
Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range.
quiz.explanation: 把轉子總動能全當成可用支援，會忽略允許轉速範圍；柔性軸系還可能把能量分配到扭振模態，使平均轉速不足以描述局部動態。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating all rotor kinetic energy as available support ignores the permitted speed range. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「風機轉速與耗能」與「定子銅損邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fan speed and power" and "Stator copper loss boundary": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 風機轉速與耗能：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「風機轉速與耗能」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fan speed and power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 發電機通風增加時，風機相似律可估算相同幾何及相似工況下的流量、壓升和軸功率變化。功率對轉速約呈三次方，因此小幅提速可能增加顯著輔機耗能。相似律需配合系統阻力曲線，風道變更、失速或密度改變都可能破壞簡化比例。 風機功率相似通常指軸端，變頻器與馬達損失要另列，才能與電端輔機耗電建立一致比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「風機轉速與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fan affinity laws estimate changes in flow, pressure and shaft power for unchanged geometry and similar conditions. Power varies approximately with the cube of speed, so a modest increase can raise auxiliary demand substantially. System resistance must also be considered; duct changes, stall and density variation can invalidate the simplified ratio. Fan power similarity usually refers to shaft power; converter and motor losses need separate terms before comparison with electrical auxiliary demand is physically consistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fan speed and power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: P1=1 MW; ratioN=1.10 (dimensionless); P2=P1*ratioN**3=1.331 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機轉速增加一成只會增加一成耗能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「風機轉速與耗能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fan speed and power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent fan speed increase causes only a ten-percent power increase. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fan speed and power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測風機轉速、壓差、有效風量及電功率，將工作點放到風機與系統曲線交會處。若提速後壓差升高但風量變化很小，應查阻塞或工作區域，不能只靠三次方律推定冷卻改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure speed, pressure difference, effective airflow and electrical power together, locating the operating point on fan and system curves. If speed raises pressure with little added flow, investigate obstruction or operating region rather than inferring improved cooling solely from the affinity-law estimate. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate power and ideal airflow ratios for three speed ratios and plot the demand increase. Identify the operating point that must be remeasured if system resistance changes after maintenance or duct modification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：在失速區增加轉速可能提高噪音與耗能卻不改善均勻通風；若馬達效率隨負載變化，軸功率相似也不會直接等於電端功率比例，需要分別量測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing speed in a stalled region can raise noise and demand without improving uniform ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 在失速區增加轉速可能提高噪音與耗能卻不改善均勻通風；若馬達效率隨負載變化，軸功率相似也不會直接等於電端功率比例，需要分別量測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing speed in a stalled region can raise noise and demand without improving uniform ventilation. Changing motor efficiency also means shaft-power similarity does not directly establish the electrical-input ratio, which requires a separate measurement boundary. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stator copper loss boundary: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「定子銅損邊界」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stator copper loss boundary” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定子繞組的電阻損失與電流平方成正比，且電阻會隨溫度上升。教材以每相有效電阻與相電流計算三相損失，必須先辨認接法及所給電流定義。交流附加損失、鐵損與機械損失不在此式中，不能將三相銅損誤當成發電機全部損失。 每相有效電阻需和電流頻率及溫度相符，直流電阻只提供部分基礎，不能自動涵蓋所有交流附加效應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定子銅損邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stator resistive loss scales with current squared and resistance increases with temperature. Calculate three-phase loss using effective per-phase resistance and phase current, first identifying winding connection and current definition. Additional AC, iron and mechanical losses remain outside this equation, so copper loss is not the entire generator loss account. Effective per-phase resistance must match temperature and frequency; a DC resistance measurement supplies only part of the basis and does not automatically include all AC effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stator copper loss boundary” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「定子銅損邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stator copper loss boundary”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW。模型邊界：三相相同相電流與每相運轉溫度電阻，未含其他損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: Iphase=24000 A; Rphase=0.0007 ohm; Pcu=3*Iphase*Iphase*Rphase/1e6=1.2096 MW. Model boundary: equal phase currents and per-phase resistance at operating temperature, excluding other losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 量測繞組電阻時記錄溫度並轉換到比較條件，核對相電流及接線方式，再將銅損估算與冷卻熱量比較。若總熱量高於銅損，應補列鐵損及其他熱源，而非把差額全歸於電阻量錯。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record winding temperature during resistance measurement and convert to comparable conditions, checking phase current and connection. steps.observation: 現場實務：固定電阻把電流提高兩成，重算銅損，再增加熱態電阻比例，分別比較兩項效應並列出現地熱量帳還缺少的損失來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase current by twenty percent at fixed resistance and recalculate copper loss. Then increase hot resistance, compare both effects separately and list the remaining loss sources required by a field heat account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 量測繞組電阻時記錄溫度並轉換到比較條件，核對相電流及接線方式，再將銅損估算與冷卻熱量比較。若總熱量高於銅損，應補列鐵損及其他熱源，而非把差額全歸於電阻量錯。
knowledge.textEn: Record winding temperature during resistance measurement and convert to comparable conditions, checking phase current and connection. Compare copper-loss estimates with cooling heat. Heat greater than calculated copper loss requires other loss terms rather than assigning the entire difference to an incorrect resistance measurement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「定子銅損邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 定子銅損邊界：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stator copper loss boundary: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定子銅損邊界」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stator copper loss boundary” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. A high-resistance local joint can concentrate heat even when the mean per-phase value appears reasonable for the winding as a whole. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：每相有效電阻需和電流頻率及溫度相符，直流電阻只提供部分基礎，不能自動涵蓋所有交流附加效應。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Effective per-phase resistance must match temperature and frequency; a DC resistance measurement supplies only part of the basis and does not automatically include all AC effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「定子銅損邊界」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stator copper loss boundary" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用冷態電阻計算熱態損失會偏低，將線電流直接套到不相容接法也會造成比例錯誤；局部接頭高電阻可能集中發熱，平均每相值不能排除熱點。
油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error.
Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot.

quiz.explanationEn: Cold resistance understates hot-state loss, and using line current with an incompatible winding connection creates another ratio error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「軸承油熱容量」與「谷幅變形基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bearing oil thermal storage" and "Valley closure reference geometry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸承油熱容量」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bearing oil thermal storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。以油量、比熱與溫升估算顯熱可幫助檢查短時能量帳，但循環中的熱交換器、軸承金屬及管路也會儲熱。單一混合槽模型只代表平均油溫，不能推定軸瓦接觸面的最高溫度。 熱容量只改變升溫時間尺度，長時間穩態仍需足夠散熱能力，增加油量不能永久抵消持續熱負荷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承油熱容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. Oil mass, heat capacity and rise estimate sensible storage, while exchangers, bearing metal and piping also store heat. A mixed-tank model describes mean oil temperature rather than the maximum temperature at the bearing contact. Heat capacity changes the heating time scale, while long-term steady operation still needs adequate heat removal; adding oil cannot indefinitely offset a continuous thermal load. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing oil thermal storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸承油熱容量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bearing oil thermal storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 軸承油熱容量
knowledge.text: 潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。以油量、比熱與溫升估算顯熱可幫助檢查短時能量帳，但循環中的熱交換器、軸承金屬及管路也會儲熱。
knowledge.textEn: Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. Oil mass, heat capacity and rise estimate sensible storage, while exchangers, bearing metal and piping also store heat.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「軸承油熱容量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bearing oil thermal storage" is correct?
options: 油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點
谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔
潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。
optionsEn: Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot.
Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change.
quiz.explanation: 潤滑油除了傳熱也暫存熱量，因此負載突變後的油溫會有延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lubricating oil transports and temporarily stores heat, producing a delayed temperature response after a load change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軸承油熱容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bearing oil thermal storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。模型邊界：固定油量比熱的均勻溫升，不含金屬熱容量及散熱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ. Model boundary: uniform rise of a fixed oil mass with constant heat capacity, excluding metal storage and heat loss. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。模型邊界：固定油量比熱的均勻溫升，不含金屬熱容量及散熱。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ. Model boundary: uniform rise of a fixed oil mass with constant heat capacity, excluding metal storage and heat loss.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「軸承油熱容量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bearing oil thermal storage", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ。
單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升
平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率
optionsEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: mOil=800 kg; cp=2000 J/(kg*K); dT=20 K; E=mOil*cp*dT/1e6=32 MJ.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軸承油熱容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bearing oil thermal storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。若槽溫反應慢而軸瓦溫度迅速上升，應查局部供油與接觸熱點，不能用油槽平均溫度證明潤滑正常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state. Rapid bearing-metal heating despite a slowly changing tank temperature calls for local supply and contact checks rather than declaring lubrication normal from the tank average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在相同熱輸入下比較兩種油量的初期升溫速率，再加入金屬熱容量，說明需哪些溫度測點才能區分儲熱與散熱不足。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare initial heating rates for two oil inventories under equal heat input, then add metal heat capacity. Identify temperature measurements that distinguish thermal storage from inadequate heat removal in the system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state. Rapid bearing-metal heating despite a slowly changing tank temperature calls for local supply and contact checks rather than declaring lubrication normal from the tank average.

knowledge.text: 在相同熱輸入下比較兩種油量的初期升溫速率，再加入金屬熱容量，說明需哪些溫度測點才能區分儲熱與散熱不足。
knowledge.textEn: Compare initial heating rates for two oil inventories under equal heat input, then add metal heat capacity. Identify temperature measurements that distinguish thermal storage from inadequate heat removal in the system.

options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以進出口油溫、槽內多點溫度與流量檢查混合假設，將負載變化與冷卻器狀態對齊。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.

quiz.explanationEn: Use inlet-outlet and multiple tank temperatures with flow to test mixing, aligning load changes and cooler state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 軸承油熱容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bearing oil thermal storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軸承油熱容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bearing oil thermal storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 油槽分層或旁通會使單點溫度低估高溫油區，油量不足又會縮短熱緩衝時間；如果只按穩態溫差分析，就可能漏掉短時供油中斷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. A steady-state temperature difference alone may therefore miss a brief interruption of supply to the bearing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱容量只改變升溫時間尺度，長時間穩態仍需足夠散熱能力，增加油量不能永久抵消持續熱負荷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Heat capacity changes the heating time scale, while long-term steady operation still needs adequate heat removal; adding oil cannot indefinitely offset a continuous thermal load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油槽平均溫度正常就保證軸瓦沒有熱點」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal average oil-tank temperature guarantees no bearing hotspot." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.explanationEn: Stratification or bypass can make one tank sensor understate a hot region, while low oil inventory reduces thermal buffering time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「谷幅變形基準」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Valley closure reference geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蓄水後兩岸變形會改變谷幅，但距離縮短可能來自一岸、兩岸或測量基準移動。教材把兩點間距變化除初始距離表示平均幾何應變尺度，不把它當成岩體各處的局部應變。需保留左右岸絕對位移與方向，才能把谷幅反應連結到拱座相容條件。 兩點距離只提供沿連線方向的投影，垂直於連線的共同位移可能幾乎看不到，需要完整三維控制網。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「谷幅變形基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. Distance change divided by initial separation gives a mean geometric strain scale, not local strain everywhere in the rock. Absolute movement and direction on each side are needed to connect closure to abutment compatibility. Two-point distance supplies a projection along the line; shared movement perpendicular to it can remain almost invisible, requiring a complete three-dimensional control network. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Valley closure reference geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「谷幅縮短必定由左右岸平均分擔」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「谷幅變形基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Valley closure reference geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 谷幅變形基準

knowledge.textEn: Reservoir filling can change valley width through movement of either bank, both banks or the measurement reference. Distance change divided by initial separation gives a mean geometric strain scale, not local strain everywhere in the rock.

quiz.question: 關於「谷幅變形基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Valley closure is always shared equally by the two banks.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Valley closure reference geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「谷幅變形基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Valley closure reference geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。模型邊界：正值表示兩點距離縮短的平均尺度，不代表均勻岩體應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain. Model boundary: positive value denotes a mean two-point closure scale, not uniform rock strain. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain。模型邊界：正值表示兩點距離縮短的平均尺度，不代表均勻岩體應變。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: closure=0.012 m; width=500 m; e=closure/width*1e6=24 microstrain. Model boundary: positive value denotes a mean two-point closure scale, not uniform rock strain.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 谷幅變形基準：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「谷幅變形基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Valley closure reference geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以外部穩定控制網分別追蹤兩岸點位，校正大氣折射與距離儀溫度，再比對庫水位及地下水變化。若谷幅縮短但單側位移占多數，模型應保留不對稱，不把一半變形平均分配給兩岸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track both banks against an external stable network, correcting atmospheric refraction and instrument temperature, then compare reservoir and groundwater changes. Closure dominated by one bank requires an asymmetric model rather than allocating half the measured distance change to each side by assumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作相同谷幅變化但左右岸位移分配不同的兩個情境，畫位移向量，說明對拱座相容的影響，以及需哪些外部控制點才能辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create two cases with equal closure but different bank displacement shares. Draw their vectors, explain effects on abutment compatibility and identify external controls needed to distinguish the cases.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
