options: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準位移可能不改變谷幅卻改變整體位置，單純距離量測因而漏掉剛體運動；大氣折射的季節變化也可能偽裝成與庫水位相關的地形變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared reference motion can change absolute position without changing width, so distance alone misses rigid-body movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂隙開度與滲流」與「通風局部阻力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fracture aperture and flow" and "Ventilation local resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂隙開度與滲流」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fracture aperture and flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。教材使用光滑固定開度及牛頓流體，將壓差、黏度與流路長度列明；天然裂隙粗糙、接觸及網絡分岔會改變此關係，不能用流量唯一反推幾何。 流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂隙開度與滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length. Roughness, contacts and network branching alter natural fractures, so measured flow does not uniquely determine the physical aperture of a real seepage path. Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fracture aperture and flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂隙開度與滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fracture aperture and flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂隙開度與滲流
knowledge.text: 理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。教材使用光滑固定開度及牛頓流體，將壓差、黏度與流路長度列明；天然裂隙粗糙、接觸及網絡分岔會改變此關係，不能用流量唯一反推幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. State smooth fixed aperture, Newtonian viscosity, pressure difference and path length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂隙開度與滲流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fracture aperture and flow" is correct?
options: 滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。
單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升
optionsEn: An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
quiz.explanation: 理想平行板裂隙的層流導水能力與開度三次方成正比，因此很小的開度變化也可能明顯改變流量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Laminar conductance of an ideal parallel-plate fracture varies with aperture cubed, making small opening changes important. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂隙開度與滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fracture aperture and flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。模型邊界：光滑平行板穩態層流且開度固定，不含裂隙網絡與紊流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s. Model boundary: steady laminar flow between smooth parallel plates at fixed aperture, excluding networks and turbulence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。模型邊界：光滑平行板穩態層流且開度固定，不含裂隙網絡與紊流。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s. Model boundary: steady laminar flow between smooth parallel plates at fixed aperture, excluding networks and turbulence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「裂隙開度與滲流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fracture aperture and flow", which statement holds?
options: 平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率
轉子全部動能都可在不改變轉速下輸出
optionsEn: Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow.
All rotor kinetic energy can be delivered without changing rotational speed.
Original hypothetical example.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: b=1 m; a=0.0002 m; dp=1000000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; L=10 m; Q=b*a**3*dp/(12*mu*L)=0.00006666666667 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裂隙開度與滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fracture aperture and flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。若流量與壓差非線性，應先辨識變形或流況，不直接以三次方律推算裂縫已增加多少。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability. Nonlinearity requires investigating deformation or flow regime before using the cubic law to claim a particular increase in physical crack opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將開度提高兩成重算流量，再只降低黏度作比較，展示兩種增流原因，並設計能區分幾何變化與流體性質變化的量測組合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase aperture by twenty percent and recompute flow, then compare a change in viscosity alone. Show the two causes of increased discharge and design measurements that distinguish geometry from fluid-property changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。若流量與壓差非線性，應先辨識變形或流況，不直接以三次方律推算裂縫已增加多少。
knowledge.textEn: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability. Nonlinearity requires investigating deformation or flow regime before using the cubic law to claim a particular increase in physical crack opening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將開度提高兩成重算流量，再只降低黏度作比較，展示兩種增流原因，並設計能區分幾何變化與流體性質變化的量測組合。
knowledge.textEn: Increase aperture by twenty percent and recompute flow, then compare a change in viscosity alone. Show the two causes of increased discharge and design measurements that distinguish geometry from fluid-property changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裂隙開度與滲流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fracture aperture and flow"?
options: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
三相銅損就是發電機全部能量損失
optionsEn: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Three-phase copper loss is the complete energy loss of the generator.
quiz.explanation: 在受控壓差下量測流量與溫度以修正黏度，重複升降壓檢查開度是否隨壓力改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure flow and temperature under controlled pressure difference to account for viscosity, repeating pressure increase and decrease to test aperture stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裂隙開度與滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fracture aperture and flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裂隙開度與滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fracture aperture and flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Warming can also lower viscosity and increase flow, so every rise in seepage cannot be assigned to fracture enlargement without temperature and pressure evidence. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：流路長度與開度可能互相補償產生相同流量，反算參數具有非唯一性，需要獨立幾何或示蹤資料縮小範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Path length and aperture can compensate to produce the same flow, making inverse estimates nonunique; independent geometry or tracer evidence is needed to constrain them.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。
knowledge.textEn: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Warming can also lower viscosity and increase flow, so every rise in seepage cannot be assigned to fracture enlargement without temperature and pressure evidence.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「裂隙開度與滲流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fracture aperture and flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。
單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture.
The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system.
quiz.explanation: 接觸點閉合與局部堵塞會使有效水力開度不同於量得的平均幾何開度；若溫度變化降低黏度，流量也會增加，不能把所有增流都認定為裂隙擴張。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Contact closure and local blockage make hydraulic aperture differ from mean geometric aperture. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風局部阻力」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation local resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地下廠房及廊道通風包含彎頭、格柵和分支等局部阻力，壓損與動壓及阻力係數相關。教材以一個已知係數估算局部壓損，提醒學員係數的參考速度必須明確。這只是正常通風能量帳，不代表火災煙控、逃生條件或所有分支風量均已驗證。 阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風局部阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underground powerhouse ventilation includes local losses at bends, screens and branches, related to dynamic pressure and a loss coefficient. One assumed coefficient estimates local pressure loss, with its reference velocity explicitly stated. This normal-ventilation account does not verify smoke control, escape conditions or flow distribution through every branch of the network. Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation local resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 通風局部阻力
knowledge.text: 地下廠房及廊道通風包含彎頭、格柵和分支等局部阻力，壓損與動壓及阻力係數相關。教材以一個已知係數估算局部壓損，提醒學員係數的參考速度必須明確。
knowledge.textEn: Underground powerhouse ventilation includes local losses at bends, screens and branches, related to dynamic pressure and a loss coefficient. One assumed coefficient estimates local pressure loss, with its reference velocity explicitly stated.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風局部阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風局部阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation local resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：K=2.5 (dimensionless); rho=1.2 kg/m3; v=12 m/s; dp=K*0.5*rho*v*v=216 Pa。模型邊界：穩態不可壓縮近似及已指定參考斷面速度，未含沿程阻力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: K=2.5 (dimensionless); rho=1.2 kg/m3; v=12 m/s; dp=K*0.5*rho*v*v=216 Pa. Model boundary: steady approximately incompressible air with a specified reference-section velocity, excluding distributed friction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在構件前後設壓力測點，避開強烈旋流區並量測截面速度分布，再核對所用係數的參考面積。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通風局部阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ventilation local resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在構件前後設壓力測點，避開強烈旋流區並量測截面速度分布，再核對所用係數的參考面積。若多個支路同時調整，須重算風網，不能把一支路壓損直接當整個風機所需壓升。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure before and after the fitting away from strong swirl, map section velocity and verify the coefficient reference area. Simultaneous branch changes require a network recalculation; one branch loss cannot simply be treated as the pressure rise required from the entire fan system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定風道面積提高風量兩成，重算局部壓損，再加入一個並聯支路，說明為何分支流量必須由共同壓差及各自阻力一起求解。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase flow by twenty percent at fixed duct area and recalculate local loss. Add a parallel branch and explain why branch flows must be solved from the shared pressure difference and their individual resistances.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：格柵堵塞或風門位置偏差會改變係數，舊調試值未必適用；若壓力測點位於回流區，也可能產生非代表讀值，導致錯判風機能力不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 通風局部阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ventilation local resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「通風局部阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ventilation local resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 格柵堵塞或風門位置偏差會改變係數，舊調試值未必適用；若壓力測點位於回流區，也可能產生非代表讀值，導致錯判風機能力不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked screen or changed damper position alters the coefficient and can invalidate commissioning values. A tap inside a recirculation zone can also give an unrepresentative reading and falsely suggest inadequate fan capability in the ventilation network. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：阻力係數使用的參考速度可能位於不同斷面，串接多構件時應換成一致能量帳，不能直接加不相容的係數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loss coefficients may use velocities at different sections; connecting several fittings requires a consistent energy account rather than directly adding coefficients with incompatible reference velocities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單一構件壓損就是整座風機所需壓升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The loss across one fitting equals the pressure rise required for the whole fan system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「梯級重複用水發電」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cascade reuse of release water” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一水量通過上下游兩座電站，可利用兩段不同的落差，並非創造新的水量或把同一位能重複計算。教材以同一流量乘各段淨水頭效率相加求總功率，先確認兩段高程落差不重疊。實際河道傳播、支流與水庫儲存會使兩站瞬時流量不同。 上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「梯級重複用水發電」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same water can generate through two successive drops without creating water or counting one potential-energy drop twice. Sum each net-head and efficiency contribution at a common assumed discharge, confirming that the elevation intervals do not overlap. Routing, tributaries and storage can make actual instantaneous discharges differ between plants. Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cascade reuse of release water” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「梯級重複用水發電」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cascade reuse of release water” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW。模型邊界：相同穩態流量與不重疊淨水頭，忽略中間取水及儲量變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=500 m3/s; H1=90 m; eta1=0.91 (dimensionless); H2=70 m; eta2=0.90 (dimensionless); P=rho*g*Q*(H1*eta1+H2*eta2)/1e6=710.7345 MW. Model boundary: equal steady flow through nonoverlapping net heads, omitting intermediate withdrawals and storage changes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以河段高程圖標明兩段淨水頭及尾水控制，再核對上下游流量時間對齊與中間儲量。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梯級重複用水發電」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cascade reuse of release water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以河段高程圖標明兩段淨水頭及尾水控制，再核對上下游流量時間對齊與中間儲量。若同時流量不同，先做河段水量帳與傳播分析，不把差值直接列為漏水或發電效率損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark both net heads and tailwater controls on an elevation profile and reconcile flow timing and intermediate storage. Different simultaneous discharges require reach water accounting and routing before the difference is labeled leakage or a generating-efficiency loss between the two plants. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將總落差固定而改變兩站分配及效率，計算總功率差，再加入一段中間取水，說明何時相同流量假設失效及應如何修正。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold total drop fixed while changing its allocation and the two efficiencies, then calculate total power. Introduce an intermediate withdrawal and explain when the equal-flow assumption fails and how the account must change.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將上游總落差再次列入下游水頭會重複計算位能，忽略流量延遲又會使逐時能量帳不閉合；兩者可能在月平均下被掩蓋，需保留分段基準。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including the upstream drop again in downstream head double-counts potential energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 梯級重複用水發電：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cascade reuse of release water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梯級重複用水發電」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cascade reuse of release water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將上游總落差再次列入下游水頭會重複計算位能，忽略流量延遲又會使逐時能量帳不閉合；兩者可能在月平均下被掩蓋，需保留分段基準。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including the upstream drop again in downstream head double-counts potential energy. Ignoring travel delay also disrupts hourly energy closure. Monthly averages can conceal both errors, so elevation references and interval boundaries must be retained for each stage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：上下游兩段效率各自作用於各段位能，不應把效率連乘套在總落差，因第一段損失不會消滅下游全部落差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Each efficiency acts on its own potential-energy drop; multiplying efficiencies over total head misrepresents the stages, because losses upstream do not eliminate the downstream drop.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一水量二次發電就是重複創造水的位能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Generating twice with the same water creates the same potential energy twice." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「增流邊際功率」如何影響溪洛渡水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Marginal power from added flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Xiluodu Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加機組流量會提高水力輸入，也可能增加與流量平方相關的引水損失，因此每增加一單位流量得到的功率不是固定值。教材對含損失的功率式微分，區分平均功率除流量與邊際增益。這個局部分析仍需效率及運轉區域限制，不能作無約束最佳化命令。 損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「增流邊際功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing turbine flow raises hydraulic input while also increasing conveyance losses that may scale with flow squared. Marginal power is therefore not constant. Differentiate a loss-inclusive power equation and distinguish its derivative from average power divided by discharge. Efficiency variation and operating-region limits remain necessary before any optimization interpretation. Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Marginal power from added flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入均非本工程操作參數：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical example; inputs are not operating parameters of this project: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; eta=0.9 (dimensionless); Hs=100 m; k=0.00002 s2/m5; Q=300 m3/s; dPdQ=rho*g*eta*(Hs-3*k*Q*Q)/1e6=0.8352234 MW/(m3/s).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「增流邊際功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 誤解：平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.observation: 如何核對：以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Model boundary: local derivative for net head Hs-kQ² at constant efficiency, excluding nonlinear tailwater and machine limits.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「增流邊際功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Marginal power from added flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。若大增量與局部預測不同，應縮小區間或更新模型，不把導數當成全域線性關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verify approximately constant loss coefficient over that interval. A large-increment disagreement calls for a smaller interval or revised model rather than treating a local derivative as a global linear law. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以一個很小及一個較大流量增量比較有限差分與導數，畫出誤差隨步長變化，再加入效率下降情境指出原導數缺少的項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare finite differences using a small and a larger flow increment with the derivative, plot error against step size, and introduce declining efficiency to identify the additional derivative term missing from the original model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。若大增量與局部預測不同，應縮小區間或更新模型，不把導數當成全域線性關係。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verify approximately constant loss coefficient over that interval. A large-increment disagreement calls for a smaller interval or revised model rather than treating a local derivative as a global linear law.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以一個很小及一個較大流量增量比較有限差分與導數，畫出誤差隨步長變化，再加入效率下降情境指出原導數缺少的項目。
knowledge.textEn: Compare finite differences using a small and a larger flow increment with the derivative, plot error against step size, and introduce declining efficiency to identify the additional derivative term missing from the original model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「增流邊際功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Marginal power from added flow"?
options: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
滲流量增加就唯一證明裂隙開度增加
optionsEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
An increase in seepage uniquely proves an increase in fracture aperture.
quiz.explanation: 以小幅流量增量重算原功率式，用有限差分檢查導數，再以量測曲線驗證損失係數在該區間是否近似固定。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Recompute the original power equation with a small flow increment and compare its finite difference with the derivative. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 增流邊際功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Marginal power from added flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「增流邊際功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Marginal power from added flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A mathematical power maximum may also lie beyond cavitation, vibration or electrical limits and does not establish an authorized operating point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：損失項隨流量平方增加，功率中的該項則隨流量三次方，因此微分後會出現三倍係數，不能漏算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Head loss grows with flow squared, but its contribution within power grows with flow cubed; differentiation therefore introduces a factor of three that must be retained.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均功率除流量必定等於增流邊際功率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Average power divided by flow always equals marginal power from added flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. A mathematical power maximum may also lie beyond cavitation, vibration or electrical limits and does not establish an authorized operating point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「增流邊際功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Marginal power from added flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。
無功等於視在功率直接減去實功
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge.
Reactive power equals apparent power minus active power.
quiz.explanation: 忽略損失導數會高估增流收益，效率若在高流量區下降則偏差更大；把局部最大功率當成允許運轉點，也可能越過汽蝕、振動或電氣限制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring the derivative of head loss overstates added-flow benefit, especially if efficiency falls at higher discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 阿斯旺高壩
courses.summary: 本課以以阿斯旺長期蓄水調節串連土石壩與尼羅河水量為主線，先用跨季庫容水量帳與大湖蒸發與面積界定水力與構造條件，再將核心沉陷與接觸、淤積量與乾密度連結到監測基線與異常。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops connecting Aswan long-term storage with embankment behavior and Nile water accounting through Seasonal reservoir water balance and Lake evaporation and surface area, then connects Core settlement and interfaces and Sediment storage and dry density to Monitoring baseline and anomaly. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以阿斯旺長期蓄水調節串連土石壩與尼羅河水量
courses.focusEn: Connecting Aswan long-term storage with embankment behavior and Nile water accounting
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查跨季庫容水量帳：InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3；再獨立檢查大湖蒸發與面積：HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year。敏感度：同面積500km2下年蒸發深度由1.8增至2.1m，水量損失由0.90增至1.05km3，增加0.15km3；實際湖面積會隨水位變化，故需逐時或逐月積分。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。公開工程事實與假想算例分開；下列尺寸水量及材料參數均不是阿斯旺設計或操作資料。 將核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Seasonal reservoir water balance: InitialStorage=8 km3; seasonalInflow=5 km3; releases=4 km3; netLoss=0.6 km3; finalStorage=8+5-4-0.6=8.4 km3. Independently examine Lake evaporation and surface area: HypotheticalArea=500 km2; evaporationDepth=1.8 m/year; lossVolume=500e6*1.8/1e9=0.90 km3/year. Sensitivity: over a fixed500km2 surface, annual evaporation increasing from1.8 to2.1m changes loss from0.90 to1.05km3, an increase of0.15km3. Real surface area varies with stage and requires time integration. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Public project facts are separate from hypothetical calculations; dimensions flows and material parameters below are not Aswan design or operating data. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

steps.title: 跨季庫容水量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seasonal reservoir water balance: mechanism and system paths

knowledge.text: 乾燥地區的大湖蒸發涉及水面面積與能量交換，蒸發深度不能直接當成水庫降深。湖面積隨水位變動，風場與氣象站代表性也會影響估算；固定面積算例只能說明單位換算，長期水量帳需用一致時間解析度積分。
knowledge.textEn: Large-lake evaporation in an arid setting depends on surface area and energy exchange. Evaporation depth is not automatically reservoir stage decline.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 大型土石壩的不同土區可形成串聯與並聯流路，不能將各層滲透係數直接算術平均。等面積一維串聯模型以厚度除導水率形成阻力，可顯示低滲層控制作用；裂縫或接觸繞流則可能讓此理想串聯失效。 驗證時應以分層孔壓分配核對主要水頭損失是否位於低滲區，並辨識以下失效情境：沿接觸面繞流可避開原本控制流量的低滲核心。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防滲核心串聯阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different embankment zones create series and parallel paths, so arithmetic averaging of conductivity is generally inappropriate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use layered piezometric heads to locate the dominant head loss. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Contact bypass can avoid the low-permeability core that controls the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core seepage resistance in series” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 濕土含水增加可能掩蓋乾密度不足。診斷時應採取以下查核：將現地密度與同期含水樣品配對並核對分層位置，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「核心沉陷與接觸」與「發電淨水頭與出力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core settlement and interfaces" and "Net head and power output": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Core settlement and interfaces: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「核心沉陷與接觸」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core settlement and interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 核心與壩殼的壓縮性差異會造成相對變形，剛性穿越構造附近尤其需要檢查接觸與反濾連續。相鄰沉陷差只能描述幾何需求，不能直接預測裂縫寬度；施工時序、材料非線性與三維約束會改變實際應變分布。 驗證時應比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，並辨識以下失效情境：差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「核心沉陷與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Different compressibility in core and shell creates relative movement, especially near rigid penetrations. Settlement difference describes geometric demand but does not directly predict crack aperture. Construction sequence, nonlinear material response and three-dimensional restraint govern the actual strain distribution and filter continuity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core settlement and interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: coreSettlement=0.32 m; shellSettlement=0.20 m; relativeSettlement=0.32-0.20=0.12 m.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 核心沉陷與接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Core settlement and interfaces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「核心沉陷與接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Core settlement and interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較跨土區沉陷測點與剛性構造接觸觀測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare settlement markers across zones with observations at rigid interfaces. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相鄰沉陷差就必定等於核心裂縫寬度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Settlement difference necessarily equals the width of a core crack" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「核心沉陷與接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
差異沉陷集中於接觸面可能形成優先滲流路徑。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage.

quiz.explanationEn: Concentrated differential settlement at an interface can create preferential seepage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「發電淨水頭與出力」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Net head and power output” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。尾水上升與水路損失會降低淨落差，裝置容量也不等於任何時刻能達到的出力；應以一致工況的量測核對能量轉換。 驗證時應同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，並辨識以下失效情境：只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電淨水頭與出力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. Reservoir level is only one upstream contribution; tailwater and conveyance losses reduce usable head. Installed capacity is not guaranteed output at every stage, so compare energy conversion using measurements from the same operating condition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Net head and power output” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「發電淨水頭與出力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Net head and power output”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 發電淨水頭與出力
knowledge.text: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。尾水上升與水路損失會降低淨落差，裝置容量也不等於任何時刻能達到的出力；應以一致工況的量測核對能量轉換。
knowledge.textEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. Reservoir level is only one upstream contribution; tailwater and conveyance losses reduce usable head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「發電淨水頭與出力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Net head and power output" is correct?
options: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積
optionsEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency.
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume
quiz.explanation: 大型蓄水壩的發電能力由流量、淨水頭與效率共同控制，庫水位只是上游水頭的一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Power depends on flow, net head and efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Net head and power output: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「發電淨水頭與出力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Net head and power output” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「發電淨水頭與出力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Net head and power output", which statement holds?
options: 平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺
原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW。
只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度
optionsEn: Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence
Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=180 m3/s; netHead=55 m; efficiency=0.90; power=1000*9.81*180*55*0.90/1e6=87.4071 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 發電淨水頭與出力：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Net head and power output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用壩高當發電水頭會高估可用能量。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步記錄上下游水位流量與機組功率並列水路損失，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using dam height as generating head overstates usable energy. Diagnose it by the following check: Record upstream and downstream levels, flow and unit power and itemize waterway losses. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「淤積量與乾密度」與「放流輸配與需水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment storage and dry density" and "Release conveyance and demand": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淤積量與乾密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment storage and dry density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淤積量與乾密度」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment storage and dry density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫截留泥砂會改變容量與入流三角洲，乾砂質量轉體積需考慮壓密和粒徑分區。相同質量在不同乾密度下佔據不同庫容，不能把水樣固體體積直接當沉積總體積；需要重複測深與分層取樣建立長期變化。 驗證時應以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淤積量與乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trapped sediment changes storage and delta geometry. Converting dry mass to deposit volume requires compaction and grain-size zoning. Equal mass occupies different bulk volume at different dry densities; repeat bathymetry and layered samples rather than treating grain volume as total deposited volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment storage and dry density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淤積量與乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment storage and dry density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淤積量與乾密度
knowledge.text: 水庫截留泥砂會改變容量與入流三角洲，乾砂質量轉體積需考慮壓密和粒徑分區。相同質量在不同乾密度下佔據不同庫容，不能把水樣固體體積直接當沉積總體積；需要重複測深與分層取樣建立長期變化。
knowledge.textEn: Trapped sediment changes storage and delta geometry. Converting dry mass to deposit volume requires compaction and grain-size zoning.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淤積量與乾密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積

optionsEn: Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume
Trapped sediment changes storage and delta geometry.

steps.title: 淤積量與乾密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment storage and dry density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淤積量與乾密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment storage and dry density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：AnnualTrappedDryMass=1.2e6 t; depositDryDensity=1.3 t/m3; depositedBulkVolume=1.2e6/1.3=923077 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

steps.instruction: 以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Sediment storage and dry density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淤積量與乾密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sediment storage and dry density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減。診斷時應採取以下查核：以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. Diagnose it by the following check: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dry grain volume equals the total bulk deposit volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略壓密會把容量變化誤讀成同量泥砂增減。診斷時應採取以下查核：以測深差與分層乾密度交叉核算沉積質量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. Diagnose it by the following check: Cross-check bathymetric change and layered dry density against sediment mass. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「淤積量與乾密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sediment storage and dry density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。

所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass.
Every conveyance loss equals permanent basin water consumption

quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring consolidation confuses storage change with an equal change in sediment mass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 放流輸配與需水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Release conveyance and demand: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「放流輸配與需水」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Release conveyance and demand” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫放流經輸配系統到達用水端，取水量與有效供水之間有蒸散、滲漏與回歸水等差異。簡化效率只定義特定邊界的比值，不能把所有損失都視為流域消耗；應先界定取用點與回歸路徑，再計算放流需求。 驗證時應核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳，並辨識以下失效情境：把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「放流輸配與需水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Released water passes through a conveyance system before reaching demand. A simplified efficiency belongs to a defined boundary and does not classify every loss as basin consumption; seepage or drainage may return elsewhere. Define delivery points and return paths before converting a service demand into release volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Release conveyance and demand” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every conveyance loss equals permanent basin water consumption" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「放流輸配與需水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Release conveyance and demand”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 放流輸配與需水

knowledge.textEn: Released water passes through a conveyance system before reaching demand. A simplified efficiency belongs to a defined boundary and does not classify every loss as basin consumption; seepage or drainage may return elsewhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every conveyance loss equals permanent basin water consumption Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「放流輸配與需水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 所有輸配損失都等於流域永久耗水

Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence

steps.title: 放流輸配與需水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Release conveyance and demand: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「放流輸配與需水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Release conveyance and demand” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「放流輸配與需水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Release conveyance and demand", which statement holds?

只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度

optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: TargetDeliveredVolume=60 million m3; definedConveyanceEfficiency=0.75; requiredRelease=60/0.75=80 million m3.
Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
Conductivities of layers in series can be averaged arithmetically

steps.title: 放流輸配與需水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Release conveyance and demand: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「放流輸配與需水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Release conveyance and demand” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對水庫出口用水端與回歸水的同時水量帳作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile simultaneous volumes at release, delivery and return-flow boundaries. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把回歸水全當消耗會高估流域淨需水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all return water as consumption overstates basin net demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
