stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「枯水連續與備援」與「監測基線與異常」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drought sequence and reserve" and "Monitoring baseline and anomaly": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「枯水連續與備援」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drought sequence and reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。以累積短缺估算備援容量可展示序列效應，但假設需求、損失和初始庫容均已界定；實際可靠度還需多種水文序列、操作限制與不確定度分析。 驗證時應比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設，並辨識以下失效情境：只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「枯水連續與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. Cumulative deficits illustrate reserve demand for defined demand, losses and initial storage. Reliability still requires multiple hydrological sequences, operating constraints and uncertainty rather than treating one synthetic drought as universal. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drought sequence and reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「枯水連續與備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drought sequence and reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 枯水連續與備援
knowledge.text: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。以累積短缺估算備援容量可展示序列效應，但假設需求、損失和初始庫容均已界定；實際可靠度還需多種水文序列、操作限制與不確定度分析。
knowledge.textEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. Cumulative deficits illustrate reserve demand for defined demand, losses and initial storage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「枯水連續與備援」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drought sequence and reserve" is correct?
options: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。
平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺
基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效
optionsEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance.
Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence
Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing
quiz.explanation: 長期蓄水需要面對連續低入流，而非只看平均年供需。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Carryover storage responds to sequences of low inflow, not just average annual balance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「枯水連續與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drought sequence and reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「枯水連續與備援」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drought sequence and reserve", which statement holds?
options: 蒸發一公尺就表示水庫水位必定下降一公尺
原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。
濕密度較高就必定代表壓實骨架更密
optionsEn: One metre of evaporation necessarily lowers reservoir level by one metre
Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3.
Higher wet density always proves a denser compacted skeleton
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Three annual deficits=0.4,0.7,0.3 km3; no intervening refill; cumulativeReserveDemand=0.4+0.7+0.3=1.4 km3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「枯水連續與備援」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drought sequence and reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「枯水連續與備援」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drought sequence and reserve"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
壩體高度就是所有水位下的機組淨水頭
比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Dam height equals turbine net head at every reservoir level
Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions.
quiz.explanation: 比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 枯水連續與備援：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drought sequence and reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「枯水連續與備援」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drought sequence and reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均年入流足夠就保證任何乾旱序列都供水無缺」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate mean inflow guarantees supply through every drought sequence" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較不同乾旱排列下的最低庫容並保留需求假設，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare minimum storage under different drought sequences and retain demand assumptions. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「枯水連續與備援」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drought sequence and reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效
optionsEn: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing
quiz.explanation: 只用平均入流會忽略連年不足的累積效應。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean inflow alone hides cumulative deficits over consecutive dry years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 監測基線與異常：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Monitoring baseline and anomaly: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「監測基線與異常」如何影響阿斯旺高壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring baseline and anomaly” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aswan High Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型壩監測應將庫水位與季節溫度造成的可逆反應和持續變化分開。基線殘差能提示不同於歷史關係的訊號，但資料漂移與工況外插也可能造成異常；應用獨立儀器與現場檢查確認，不以重新擬合消除警訊。 驗證時應比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監測基線與異常」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring separates reversible stage and seasonal effects from persistent change. A baseline residual flags departures from historical relations, but sensor drift and extrapolation also create anomalies. Confirm using independent measurements and inspection rather than erasing a new signal by refitting the baseline to it. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Monitoring baseline and anomaly” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「監測基線與異常」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Monitoring baseline and anomaly”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 監測基線與異常
knowledge.text: 大型壩監測應將庫水位與季節溫度造成的可逆反應和持續變化分開。基線殘差能提示不同於歷史關係的訊號，但資料漂移與工況外插也可能造成異常；應用獨立儀器與現場檢查確認，不以重新擬合消除警訊。
knowledge.textEn: Monitoring separates reversible stage and seasonal effects from persistent change. A baseline residual flags departures from historical relations, but sensor drift and extrapolation also create anomalies.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「監測基線與異常」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring baseline and anomaly" is correct?
options: 基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效
大型壩監測應將庫水位與季節溫度造成的可逆反應和持續變化分開。
只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度
optionsEn: Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing
Monitoring separates reversible stage and seasonal effects from persistent change.
Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
quiz.explanation: 大型壩監測應將庫水位與季節溫度造成的可逆反應和持續變化分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Monitoring separates reversible stage and seasonal effects from persistent change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 監測基線與異常：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring baseline and anomaly: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測基線與異常」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring baseline and anomaly” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredMovement=14 mm; baselinePrediction=9 mm for same state; residual=14-9=5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 監測基線與異常：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring baseline and anomaly: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測基線與異常」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring baseline and anomaly” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. quiz.question: 要驗證「監測基線與異常」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring baseline and anomaly"?
options: 比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍。

乾砂顆粒體積就是整層沉積物的總體積
optionsEn: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanation: 比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測基線與異常：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring baseline and anomaly: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測基線與異常」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring baseline and anomaly” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基線殘差不為零就必定代表壩體正在失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any nonzero baseline residual proves the dam is failing" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較鄰近獨立儀器與人工測量並核對基線適用水位範圍，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare independent instruments and manual surveys and check the baseline stage range. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測基線與異常」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring baseline and anomaly" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。
只知道洪峰流量就能判定跨季供水可靠度
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration.
Peak flood discharge alone determines seasonal supply reliability
quiz.explanation: 超出歷史水位範圍的外插可能被誤當結構劣化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolation beyond historical stages can be mistaken for structural deterioration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 塔貝拉水壩
courses.summary: 本課以以塔貝拉深厚地基防滲及既有水路擴建界面學習為主線，先用大體積填築物流與鋪蓋延伸與流路界定水力與構造條件，再將蓄水分期與孔壓、進水口餘隙與淤積連結到出口消能與修復證據。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops studying Tarbela foundation seepage control and existing-waterway expansion interfaces through Bulk placement logistics and Blanket extension and seepage paths, then connects Impoundment stages and pore pressure and Intake clearance and deposition to Outlet dissipation and repair evidence. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以塔貝拉深厚地基防滲及既有水路擴建界面學習
courses.focusEn: Studying Tarbela foundation seepage control and existing-waterway expansion interfaces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.subcategoryTitleEn: World dams and reservoirs

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查大體積填築物流：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day；再獨立檢查鋪蓋延伸與流路：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。敏感度：同滲透係數與面積下，示意水路長度由400增至600m，達西流量減至三分之二；鋪蓋延長的真實效果需二維或三維流網，不能用此比例直接估算實際壩基改善。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。合成土石壩與水路模型不重現塔貝拉現況，實際地層、設備與調度須以業主資料另行建立。 將比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Bulk placement logistics: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. Independently examine Blanket extension and seepage paths: k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s. Sensitivity: at fixed conductivity and area, increasing an illustrative seepage path from400 to600m reduces Darcy flow to two-thirds. Real blanket extension requires a two- or three-dimensional flow model rather than direct use of this ratio. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic embankment and waterway models do not reconstruct Tarbela conditions; owner data must establish actual geology equipment and operations. Use the following independent check: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「大體積填築物流」與「鋪蓋延伸與流路」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bulk placement logistics" and "Blanket extension and seepage paths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「大體積填築物流」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bulk placement logistics” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。理想車隊算例假設供料與攤鋪不成瓶頸，實際還需檢查材料分區、道路干擾與品質驗收速度，不能只加車就宣稱產能增加。 驗證時應核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，並辨識以下失效情境：把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「大體積填築物流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. Truck payload, cycle time and productive hours limit output. An ideal fleet estimate assumes loading and spreading are unconstrained; material zoning, road interference and acceptance capacity can become bottlenecks, so adding vehicles alone does not guarantee more placement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bulk placement logistics” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「大體積填築物流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bulk placement logistics”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 大體積填築物流
knowledge.text: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。理想車隊算例假設供料與攤鋪不成瓶頸，實際還需檢查材料分區、道路干擾與品質驗收速度，不能只加車就宣稱產能增加。
knowledge.textEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. Truck payload, cycle time and productive hours limit output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「大體積填築物流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bulk placement logistics" is correct?
options: 增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加
塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。
鋪蓋越長就可不必檢查局部破損與邊緣效應
optionsEn: More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement
Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics.
A longer blanket removes the need to inspect defects and edge effects
quiz.explanation: 塔貝拉的土石壩型式提供大量填築物流的學習背景，車輛載量、循環時間與有效工時共同限制日產量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tarbela provides context for large embankment placement logistics. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「大體積填築物流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bulk placement logistics” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「大體積填築物流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bulk placement logistics", which statement holds?
options: 低於理想浮起梯度就排除所有內部沖蝕
三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積
原創教學假設：trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day。

Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume
Original teaching assumptions: trucks=20; payload=18 m3; cyclesPerHour=2; productiveHours=8; looseVolume=20*18*2*8=5760 m3/day.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「大體積填築物流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bulk placement logistics” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「大體積填築物流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bulk placement logistics"?
options: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
原有隧道直徑足夠就不必檢查改接水頭損失
optionsEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate existing diameter removes the need to check conversion head losses
quiz.explanation: 核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 大體積填築物流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bulk placement logistics: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「大體積填築物流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bulk placement logistics” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加運輸車數就保證攤鋪完成量同比增加」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More haul trucks guarantee a proportional increase in accepted placement" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對過磅循環時間與攤鋪驗收紀錄並分別列鬆方實方，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile haul cycles with placement acceptance and distinguish loose from compacted volume. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「大體積填築物流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bulk placement logistics" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。
鋪蓋越長就可不必檢查局部破損與邊緣效應
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress.
A longer blanket removes the need to inspect defects and edge effects
quiz.explanation: 把鬆方直接當完成實方會高估填築進度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting loose volume as completed compacted volume overstates progress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Blanket extension and seepage paths: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋪蓋延伸與流路」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Blanket extension and seepage paths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上游防滲鋪蓋可改變進入地基的水頭分布與流路長度，不能只看壩體核心而忽略深部地基。均質一維達西式只是方向性示意，鋪蓋邊緣、分層及局部穿透會產生二維效應；需以孔壓分布和分區流量檢驗。 驗證時應用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，並辨識以下失效情境：鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋪蓋延伸與流路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：k=0.0001 m/s; effectiveArea=2000 m2; headDifference=60 m; pathLength=400 m; Q=0.0001*2000*60/400=0.030 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 鋪蓋延伸與流路：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Blanket extension and seepage paths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 鋪蓋局部缺口可能形成短流路而削弱整體效果。診斷時應採取以下查核：用鋪蓋前後及壩基孔壓剖面檢查實際水頭分配，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層導水與各向異性」與「出口梯度與有效重量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Layered conductivity and anisotropy" and "Exit gradient and submerged weight": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層導水與各向異性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered conductivity and anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層導水與各向異性」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沖積地基中水平連續砂礫層與低滲夾層可使水平及垂直導水率不同，單一等向係數可能誤判孔壓。平行層等厚加權只適用層內流向，跨層方向需用阻力式；應以鑽探和試驗建立層序與連通性。 驗證時應比較不同方向的試驗與孔壓反應並繪製連續高滲層，並辨識以下失效情境：把水平平均導水率用於垂直流會扭曲滲流分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層導水與各向異性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Continuous granular layers and low-permeability seams create directional conductivity. One isotropic value can misrepresent pressures. Thickness-weighted averaging applies to flow parallel to layers, whereas cross-layer flow uses resistance weighting. Boreholes and testing must establish both layer sequence and hydraulic connectivity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare directional tests and pressure response and map connected high-permeability layers. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using horizontal averaged conductivity for vertical flow distorts the seepage field. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered conductivity and anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Parallel flow through equal-thickness layers: k1=1e-3 m/s;k2=1e-5 m/s; horizontalK=(1e-3+1e-5)/2=0.000505 m/s。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口梯度與有效重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exit gradient and submerged weight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：grainSpecificGravity=2.65; voidRatio=0.65; idealHeaveGradient=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: grainSpecificGravity=2.65; voidRatio=0.65; idealHeaveGradient=(2.65-1)/(1+0.65)=1.00 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 出口梯度與有效重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exit gradient and submerged weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口梯度與有效重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exit gradient and submerged weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 出口梯度與有效重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exit gradient and submerged weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出口梯度與有效重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exit gradient and submerged weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「低於理想浮起梯度就排除所有內部沖蝕」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A gradient below ideal heave excludes every internal-erosion mechanism" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：以出口附近密集孔壓量測核對局部梯度並觀察顆粒流失，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure local exit gradients with closely spaced piezometers and observe particle loss. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出口梯度與有效重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exit gradient and submerged weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。
淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects.
Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium
quiz.explanation: 用平均全壩梯度代替局部出口梯度會漏掉集中作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An average whole-dam gradient can conceal concentrated exit effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「蓄水分期與孔壓」與「三角洲推進與測深」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Impoundment stages and pore pressure" and "Delta advance and bathymetry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Impoundment stages and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「蓄水分期與孔壓」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。單一升水步的平均速率不代表可接受操作速度；應按核准程序及失效模式判讀，並辨識尚未達平衡的深層測點。 驗證時應對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，並辨識以下失效情境：只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「蓄水分期與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. Observation periods must fit material and instrument response times. A mean rise rate is descriptive, not an authorized rate; interpret it through approved procedures and failure modes and identify deep points still out of equilibrium. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HypotheticalStageIncrease=4.5 m; observationInterval=9 days; meanRiseRate=4.5/9=0.50 m/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「蓄水分期與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Impoundment stages and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蓄水分期與孔壓
knowledge.text: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。單一升水步的平均速率不代表可接受操作速度；應按核准程序及失效模式判讀，並辨識尚未達平衡的深層測點。
knowledge.textEn: Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses. Observation periods must fit material and instrument response times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蓄水分期與孔壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 淺層孔壓穩定就表示整個地基都已達平衡
三角洲前緣前進距離本身就是淤積體積
分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。
optionsEn: Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium
Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume
Staged impoundment enables comparison of stage changes with pressure and deformation responses.
quiz.explanation: 分期蓄水使工程師能比較庫水位改變與地基孔壓及變形反應，觀察時間需符合材料和儀器的反應尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.instruction: 對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Impoundment stages and pore pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看淺層孔壓穩定會漏掉深層尚未消散的變化。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照分期水位與深淺孔壓的延遲及穩定趨勢，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stable shallow pressures can hide continuing deep pressure changes. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare staged levels with shallow and deep pressure lags and stabilization trends. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 三角洲推進與測深：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「三角洲推進與測深」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Delta advance and bathymetry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫泥砂三角洲推進會改變有效庫容與進水口周邊地形，前緣位移不等於沉積體積。用平均剖面積乘推進距離僅作稜柱近似，沿寬變化和壓密需另處理；應把斷面追蹤、粒徑與輸砂帳連結。 驗證時應沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，並辨識以下失效情境：用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三角洲推進與測深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Delta advance changes storage and intake surroundings, but front movement alone is not deposit volume. Mean cross-sectional area times advance is a prism approximation that omits lateral changes and consolidation. Link repeated sections, grain-size observations and sediment budgets before interpreting long-term progression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track front and section changes along several transects and check deposit dry density. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using one centerline advance for the full width misestimates deposit volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Delta advance and bathymetry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: MeanDepositionalCrossSection=2500 m2; frontAdvance=120 m; prismDepositVolume=2500*120=300000 m3.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Delta-front advance distance itself equals deposited volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「三角洲推進與測深」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 用單一中心線推進代表全庫寬會誤估沉積體積。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿多條測線追蹤前緣及斷面變化並核對沉積乾密度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 進水口餘隙與淤積：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「進水口餘隙與淤積」如何影響塔貝拉水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Intake clearance and deposition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 既有進水口的底部餘隙會隨沉積與庫水位變化，幾何淨距不足可能提高吸砂與堵塞風險。標高差只提供空間盤點，不預測局部三維取水或再懸浮；需同時觀測底床地形、流速與取水濃度。 驗證時應重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，並辨識以下失效情境：只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「進水口餘隙與淤積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intake clearance changes with deposition and stage, potentially increasing sediment ingestion or blockage. An elevation difference describes geometry, not three-dimensional withdrawal or resuspension. Combine bed surveys, approach velocities and intake concentration to interpret whether the remaining space is hydraulically adequate. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Resurvey the intake bed and compare sediment ingestion with local velocity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A distant mean bed level misses a local mound in front of the intake. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Intake clearance and deposition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：IntakeLowerLipElevation=300 m; localSedimentElevation=292 m; verticalClearance=300-292=8 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: IntakeLowerLipElevation=300 m; localSedimentElevation=292 m; verticalClearance=300-292=8 m.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「進水口餘隙與淤積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 只量遠處平均庫底會漏掉進水口前局部淤丘。診斷時應採取以下查核：重測進水口前底床並比較取水含砂與局部流速，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 既有隧道擴建損失：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Existing tunnel conversion losses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tarbela Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把既有放水隧道接入新增機組時，流量與壓力邊界改變會影響摩阻和暫態，不能只查隧道直徑是否足夠。局部損失係數乘速度水頭可盤點轉接件作用，還需核對接頭、分岔與下游調節對整體系統的影響。 驗證時應比較改接前後能量線與接頭壓力並核對實際構形，並辨識以下失效情境：新增轉接損失會降低機組可用淨水頭。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「既有隧道擴建損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connecting new generation to an existing release tunnel changes flow and pressure boundaries, affecting friction and transients. Diameter alone is insufficient. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare energy lines and joint pressures before and after connection and verify geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Added connection losses reduce net head available to the generating unit. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.instructionEn: Large low outlets convert head into jets, requiring linked assessment of tunnel pressure, dissipation and the receiving bed. Hydraulic power is an energy rate rather than a scour-depth law. quiz.question: 關於「出口消能與修復證據」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 出口消能與修復證據：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outlet dissipation and repair evidence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口消能與修復證據」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outlet dissipation and repair evidence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=150 m3/s; dissipatedHead=70 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; hydraulicPower=1000*9.81*150*70/1e6=103.005 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=150 m3/s; dissipatedHead=70 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; hydraulicPower=1000*9.81*150*70/1e6=103.005 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match discharge and tailwater before and after repair and compare pool pressure and scour surveys.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Q=150 m3/s; dissipatedHead=70 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; hydraulicPower=1000*9.81*150*70/1e6=103.005 MW。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=150 m3/s; dissipatedHead=70 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; hydraulicPower=1000*9.81*150*70/1e6=103.005 MW. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出口消能與修復證據」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Stable shallow pressure means the entire foundation is at equilibrium

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=150 m3/s; dissipatedHead=70 m; rho=1000 kg/m3; hydraulicPower=1000*9.81*150*70/1e6=103.005 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出口消能與修復證據：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outlet dissipation and repair evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口消能與修復證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outlet dissipation and repair evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match discharge and tailwater before and after repair and compare pool pressure and scour surveys. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Less damage after a smaller flood does not by itself prove a better repair. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Match discharge and tailwater before and after repair and compare pool pressure and scour surveys. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Less damage after a smaller flood does not by itself prove a better repair. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Less damage after a smaller flood does not by itself prove a better repair. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Match discharge and tailwater before and after repair and compare pool pressure and scour surveys. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Less damage after a smaller flood does not by itself prove a better repair. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以對齊修復前後流量尾水並比較水墊壓力及沖坑測深作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對較小洪水後損傷減少不一定證明修復構造更有效，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
