workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想融雪流入為每秒二十立方公尺、放流每秒十二立方公尺，六小時內增加十七萬二千八百立方公尺蓄量；這只是水量帳，尚未求出水位。另一假想拱圈以壓力零點八兆帕、半徑一百二十公尺、厚度十公尺求得平均膜壓應力九點六兆帕，不能取代三維壩體分析。把厚度增加百分之二十至十二公尺，應力降至八兆帕；比較結果時仍需考慮岩盤變形與溫度拘束。 核驗：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。
workedExample.textEn: For an assumed snowmelt inflow of 20 m3/s and release of 12 m3/s, six hours adds 172800 m3 of storage; a storage curve is still needed to infer water level. A separate ideal arch strip with pressure 0.8 MPa, radius 120 m and thickness 10 m has mean membrane compression of 9.6 MPa. Increasing thickness by twenty percent to 12 m gives 8 MPa. This sensitivity does not replace three dimensional dam analysis, because foundation movement, bending and thermal restraint remain outside the strip model. Verification: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」與「理想拱圈膜壓應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Snowmelt pulses and storage" and "Ideal arch membrane compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Snowmelt pulses and storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。 融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change. Snow water equivalent and temporary soil storage also control melt runoff. Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Snowmelt pulses and storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Snowmelt pulses and storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳
knowledge.text: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。黑部背景的水量帳必須將庫區當作控制體，分別列出入流、放流與時段，蓄量增加後還需面積高程曲線才能換成水位。
knowledge.textEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. A reservoir control volume separates inflow, release and duration; storage change still needs an area-elevation relationship before it becomes a level change.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Snowmelt pulses and storage" is correct?
options: 蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升
高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。
只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
optionsEn: Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion
Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain.
Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
quiz.explanation: 高山積雪把降水暫存到融化季節，入庫峰值可能落後氣溫而非跟隨當日降雨。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mountain snow delays runoff until melting, so an inflow peak can lag temperature rather than follow daily rain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。適用邊界：假設六小時流量固定，蒸發與側向入流已忽略，不外推融雪預報。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Applicable boundary: Flows are constant for six hours; evaporation and lateral inflows are omitted, and no snowmelt forecast is implied.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Snowmelt pulses and storage", which statement holds?
options: 每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。
optionsEn: Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=20 m3/s; Qout=12 m3/s; dt=21600 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=172800 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Snowmelt pulses and storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將入流峰值改成前兩小時三十、後四小時十五立方公尺每秒，分段求蓄量並與平均法比較，說明兩者何時相同、何時因出口變化而不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Replace constant inflow with thirty cubic metres per second for two hours and fifteen for four hours. Integrate segments and explain when averaging preserves volume and when a varying outlet invalidates the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。標出量測間隔與缺值補法，若洪峰期間差額變大，先查時間錯位與未入帳支流，不能立刻把殘差判為漏水。
knowledge.textEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Record sampling gaps explicitly. If the mismatch grows near a peak, investigate timing and uncounted tributaries before interpreting the residual as leakage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將入流峰值改成前兩小時三十、後四小時十五立方公尺每秒，分段求蓄量並與平均法比較，說明兩者何時相同、何時因出口變化而不同。
knowledge.textEn: Replace constant inflow with thirty cubic metres per second for two hours and fifteen for four hours. Integrate segments and explain when averaging preserves volume and when a varying outlet invalidates the comparison.

quiz.question: 要驗證「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Snowmelt pulses and storage"?
options: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率
optionsEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
quiz.explanation: 以同一時鐘對齊入流與出口流量，再逐時積分比較庫容曲線反推的蓄量差。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align inlet and outlet records to one clock, integrate each hourly interval and compare with storage inferred from a capacity curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 融雪脈衝與蓄量帳：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Snowmelt pulses and storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Snowmelt pulses and storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把日平均流量與六小時洪峰混用，會把尖峰放流錯配到整日；即使總水量看似相符，短時最高水位仍可能被平滑掉，失去檢查蓄洪空間的意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Even an apparently correct daily volume can conceal the short-term level maximum that matters to storage checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：融雪產流還受積雪含水量與土壤暫存控制，同一氣溫未必產生同一入流；庫內水量平衡只核算已到達的水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identical air temperatures need not produce identical inflows; this reservoir balance accounts only for water that has already arrived.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every storage increase raises level in a fixed proportion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「融雪脈衝與蓄量帳」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

quiz.explanationEn: Mixing a daily mean with a six-hour pulse assigns peak release to the wrong duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ideal arch membrane compression” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲線壩體可把水壓轉成沿拱圈傳到兩岸的壓縮力。把一條水平窄帶理想化為等厚圓環，只保留膜作用，可從局部力平衡看見半徑與厚度如何改變平均壓應力；實際雙曲率壩仍有懸臂及彎曲。 薄膜模型的壓力乘半徑是每單位高度的環向內力，再除厚度才成為平均應力；這兩個量的單位與用途應分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「理想拱圈膜壓應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects. Pressure times radius is circumferential force per unit height; division by thickness converts it to mean stress. Distinguishing force resultant from stress makes the approximation and its units explicit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ideal arch membrane compression” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ideal arch membrane compression”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力

knowledge.textEn: Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides. An ideal constant-thickness circular strip retains membrane action and reveals radius and thickness sensitivity, while the real double-curvature body also carries cantilever and bending effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「理想拱圈膜壓應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度

optionsEn: Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Curvature transfers water loading into compression delivered toward the valley sides.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ideal arch membrane compression” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Uniform normal pressure on a continuous ideal arch strip; joints, foundation compliance and three-dimensional bending are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。適用邊界：均勻法向壓力與連續理想拱圈，忽略接縫、基岩順應及三維彎矩。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「理想拱圈膜壓應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ideal arch membrane compression", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa。

一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力

Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=0.8 MPa; R=120 m; t=10 m; sigma=pR/t=9.6 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 理想拱圈膜壓應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ideal arch membrane compression: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ideal arch membrane compression” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在紙上切出微小圓弧並畫兩端壓力與外水壓，檢查徑向平衡是否得到同一式子。再改變厚度與曲率而保持水壓不變，確認所得應力趨勢合理，並列出必須由三維模型補回的支承條件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a small arc with compression at both ends and external pressure, then recover the equation from radial equilibrium. Change thickness and radius separately at fixed pressure, check the trends and identify support conditions that must return in a three-dimensional model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持水壓與半徑不變，將厚度增加到十二公尺後重算，畫出厚度與應力的反比曲線，並說明為何材料用量與整體變形不會只由此曲線決定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase thickness to twelve metres at fixed pressure and radius, recalculate and plot the inverse relationship. Explain why this curve alone cannot determine material quantity, foundation response or the complete deformation field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「理想拱圈膜壓應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

quiz.explanation: 將平均膜壓應力當作所有位置的最大應力，會忽略壩踵、接縫與岩盤轉角附近的彎曲集中；一個看似低的平均值不能證明局部拉裂不會發生。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating mean membrane compression as the maximum everywhere hides bending near heel regions, joints and foundation transitions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岩盤順應與推力位移」與「混凝土受拘束溫降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment compliance under thrust" and "Restrained concrete cooling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩盤順應與推力位移」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment compliance under thrust” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。 同一模數配上不同受力面積或岩盤有效深度，會形成不同支承剛度，因而需要先說明彈簧代表的幾何尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩盤順應與推力位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample. The same modulus combined with different loaded areas or effective rock depths produces different support stiffnesses. The equivalent spring therefore needs a declared geometric scale before its displacement has physical meaning. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment compliance under thrust” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩盤順應與推力位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment compliance under thrust”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移
knowledge.text: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。以一個等效彈簧表示局部岩盤，可把推力與位移連起來，但剛度應包含受力範圍，不能只拿完整岩芯彈性模數直接代入。
knowledge.textEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. A local equivalent spring relates force to displacement, but its stiffness includes geometry and cannot simply be replaced by the elastic modulus of an intact core sample.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩盤順應與推力位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment compliance under thrust" is correct?
options: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。
岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度
每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變
optionsEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement.
Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
quiz.explanation: 拱圈推力到達岩盤後，支承不會絕對不動；節理與岩體剛度決定反力下的位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arch thrust reaches a deformable rock support whose joints and loaded extent affect movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩盤順應與推力位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment compliance under thrust” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。適用邊界：單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Applicable boundary: One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。適用邊界：單一線彈性反力方向，剛度屬假想整體支承，不表示岩盤試驗值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Applicable boundary: One linear reaction direction; stiffness represents a hypothetical support assembly rather than a measured rock property.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岩盤順應與推力位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abutment compliance under thrust", which statement holds?
options: 機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。
抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率
optionsEn: Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m.
Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: F=90 MN; k=18000 MN/m; u=F/k=0.005 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩盤順應與推力位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Abutment compliance under thrust” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。使用載入與卸載兩段斜率比較等效剛度，若回程無法閉合，應另外檢查節理滑移與儀器基座變動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Estimate stiffness from both loading and unloading slopes. If the loop does not close, investigate joint slip and movement of the instrument base separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：另設左岸剛度為一萬二千兆牛頓每公尺，在相同反力下比較兩岸位移，討論差異位移可能如何改變拱圈變形，並指出仍缺少哪些三維平衡條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assign the left support a stiffness of twelve thousand meganewtons per metre and compare movements under equal reactions. Discuss possible arch distortion and identify the missing equilibrium conditions needed before predicting redistribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。使用載入與卸載兩段斜率比較等效剛度，若回程無法閉合，應另外檢查節理滑移與儀器基座變動。
knowledge.textEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Estimate stiffness from both loading and unloading slopes. If the loop does not close, investigate joint slip and movement of the instrument base separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 另設左岸剛度為一萬二千兆牛頓每公尺，在相同反力下比較兩岸位移，討論差異位移可能如何改變拱圈變形，並指出仍缺少哪些三維平衡條件。
knowledge.textEn: Assign the left support a stiffness of twelve thousand meganewtons per metre and compare movements under equal reactions. Discuss possible arch distortion and identify the missing equilibrium conditions needed before predicting redistribution.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩盤順應與推力位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abutment compliance under thrust"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量
把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone.
quiz.explanation: 把同一水位區間的岩盤位移與壩體位移並列，確認基準點位在受影響區之外。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare rock and dam displacement over matching reservoir-level intervals using a reference outside the affected zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岩盤順應與推力位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abutment compliance under thrust: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩盤順應與推力位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abutment compliance under thrust” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. Attributing every observed displacement to weak rock is equally misleading because thermal expansion and reference drift can create reversible changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同一模數配上不同受力面積或岩盤有效深度，會形成不同支承剛度，因而需要先說明彈簧代表的幾何尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The equivalent spring therefore needs a declared geometric scale before its displacement has physical meaning.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岩石彈性模數可直接當成支承彈簧剛度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。
knowledge.textEn: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. Attributing every observed displacement to weak rock is equally misleading because thermal expansion and reference drift can create reversible changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩盤順應與推力位移」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abutment compliance under thrust" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變
optionsEn: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
quiz.explanation: 把岩盤設成無限剛會低估支承移動造成的內力重分配；反過來把所有位移都歸因於軟岩，也會漏掉溫度造成的可逆壩體伸縮及基準漂移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An infinitely rigid support suppresses load redistribution caused by rock movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 混凝土受拘束溫降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Restrained concrete cooling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土受拘束溫降」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Restrained concrete cooling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土冷卻本來會縮短，但岩盤或相鄰塊體若限制收縮，就可能產生拉應力。高山環境的季節溫度與壩內溫度不會同步，完全拘束模型只能用來辨識熱應變的量級，不能忽略徐變及接縫開合。 熱應變本身沒有力的單位，只有與彈性模數及拘束條件結合才形成應力；自由收縮與完全拘束提供兩個理想端點。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土受拘束溫降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling concrete tends to contract, while restraint by rock or adjoining blocks can create tension. Mountain air and internal concrete temperatures respond on different schedules, so full restraint indicates a thermal strain scale without representing creep or joint opening. Thermal strain has no force unit. Stress emerges only when stiffness and restraint are supplied, making free contraction and full restraint distinct ideal endpoints for interpreting a temperature change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Restrained concrete cooling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「混凝土受拘束溫降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 混凝土受拘束溫降
knowledge.text: 混凝土冷卻本來會縮短，但岩盤或相鄰塊體若限制收縮，就可能產生拉應力。高山環境的季節溫度與壩內溫度不會同步，完全拘束模型只能用來辨識熱應變的量級，不能忽略徐變及接縫開合。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling concrete tends to contract, while restraint by rock or adjoining blocks can create tension. Mountain air and internal concrete temperatures respond on different schedules, so full restraint indicates a thermal strain scale without representing creep or joint opening.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土受拘束溫降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

混凝土冷卻本來會縮短，但岩盤或相鄰塊體若限制收縮，就可能產生拉應力。
沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例
optionsEn: Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
Cooling concrete tends to contract, while restraint by rock or adjoining blocks can create tension.
Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa。適用邊界：完全軸向拘束、線彈性且忽略徐變；正值表示冷卻所致拉應力量級。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: E=30000 MPa; alpha=0.00001 1/K; dT=12 K; sigma=E alpha dT=3.6 MPa. Applicable boundary: Full axial restraint, linear elasticity and no creep; the positive value is the tensile stress scale from cooling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 混凝土受拘束溫降：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土受拘束溫降」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Restrained concrete cooling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較表面與內部溫度計的相位差，先決定哪個溫度代表受拘束體積。另以自由試件量得熱膨脹係數，核對應變計零點與季節基準，避免把儀器自身溫漂誤當混凝土拉伸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare phase lag between surface and internal thermometers before selecting a representative restrained-volume temperature. Measure thermal expansion on an unrestrained specimen and check strain-gauge zero and seasonal reference so instrument temperature drift is not mistaken for concrete tension. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把拘束比例改為零點四並重算拉應力量級，另畫自由收縮與完全拘束兩個極端，說明實際接縫開合與徐變會如何移動答案的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate with a restraint fraction of zero point four and sketch free contraction and full restraint as limiting cases. Explain how joint opening and creep can move the actual response between or beyond those simple bounds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接以每日氣溫降幅代替整塊混凝土溫降，通常誇大深部瞬時應力；若忽略長期徐變的鬆弛，也可能把彈性上限誤讀成持續存在的實際應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using daily air cooling as the temperature change of an entire block exaggerates immediate interior response. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 混凝土受拘束溫降：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restrained concrete cooling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土受拘束溫降」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained concrete cooling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接以每日氣溫降幅代替整塊混凝土溫降，通常誇大深部瞬時應力；若忽略長期徐變的鬆弛，也可能把彈性上限誤讀成持續存在的實際應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using daily air cooling as the temperature change of an entire block exaggerates immediate interior response. Ignoring long-term creep relaxation can also turn an elastic bound into an incorrect estimate of sustained stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：熱應變本身沒有力的單位，只有與彈性模數及拘束條件結合才形成應力；自由收縮與完全拘束提供兩個理想端點。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Stress emerges only when stiffness and restraint are supplied, making free contraction and full restraint distinct ideal endpoints for interpreting a temperature change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Friction in a long conduit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高水頭發電的毛落差不會全部到達機組，長輸水通道把部分機械能耗散成熱。達西摩擦式將長徑比與速度平方連結，黑部背景下可用來比較增大管徑與增加流量的代價，但粗糙度與局部損失仍需另計。 能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長引水管的沿程損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gross mountain head does not all reach a generating unit because a long waterway dissipates mechanical energy. Darcy friction connects length-to-diameter ratio with velocity squared, allowing comparison of diameter and discharge choices while roughness and local losses remain separate inputs. The energy line falls along the conduit, while the pressure line also depends on elevation and velocity. Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Friction in a long conduit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長引水管的沿程損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Friction in a long conduit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用兩個壓力測點及高程差建立總水頭線，校核壓力單位與流量換算速度是否一致。選取穩定流量時段擬合摩擦因子，再檢查不同流量是否維持合理趨勢，避免把閥件損失全塞入沿程係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Construct the total-head line from two pressure taps and elevations, checking pressure units and velocity inferred from discharge. Fit the friction factor during steady periods and examine its trend across flows rather than absorbing every valve loss into distributed friction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持管徑與粗糙度不變，把速度提高百分之二十，重算水頭損失及增加比例，再列出摩擦因子可能隨雷諾數改變而使簡化比較失準的情況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise velocity by twenty percent at fixed diameter and roughness, recalculate head loss and its percentage increase, then identify circumstances where a changing Reynolds number alters the friction factor and weakens the simple comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 長引水管的沿程損失：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Friction in a long conduit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長引水管的沿程損失」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Friction in a long conduit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把范寧係數誤作達西係數會造成四倍差異；只注意高落差而忽略流速平方項，則會低估增流後的能量損失，甚至錯算可供機組使用的淨水頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量線沿流向下降，而壓力線還受高程和速度影響；把兩者分開可避免看到局部低壓便誤判全部水頭耗失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separating them prevents local low pressure from being mistaken for total head dissipation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Ignoring the velocity-squared term because gross head is large understates added losses at higher flow and miscalculates the net head available to equipment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長引水管的沿程損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error.

quiz.explanationEn: Confusing Fanning and Darcy factors creates a factor-of-four error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高水頭水能轉換」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “High head energy conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水的位能通量由密度、重力、流量與淨水頭決定，發電效率只是把這股能量轉為電力的比例。黑部案例應先把水路損失從毛水頭扣掉，再談電功率，否則同一耗能會被遺漏或重複扣除。 控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高水頭水能轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included. The conversion boundary must identify whether generator, transformer and auxiliary consumption are included. Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “High head energy conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高水頭水能轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “High head energy conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Potential-energy flux depends on density, gravity, discharge and net head; efficiency converts that flux into electric output. In a high-head case, waterway losses must be separated from gross head before applying an efficiency boundary that clearly identifies which equipment is included.

knowledge.text: 誤解：機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=18 m3/s; Hnet=420 m; eta=0.9; P=rho g Q Hnet eta/1e6=66.74724 MW. Applicable boundary: Constant head and discharge; assumed electromechanical efficiency excludes waterway losses already removed from net head.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

蓄量增加必然讓水位以固定比例上升

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高水頭水能轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “High head energy conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別核對上游能量、尾水基準與電表邊界，將功率和同一時段流量相配。若估算效率超過一，先查毛淨水頭混淆及千瓦兆瓦換算，再比較壓力與流量儀表的校正紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. An efficiency above unity requires checking gross versus net head and power-unit conversions before investigating calibration of pressure and discharge instruments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用六小時等功率運行求兆瓦小時，再把淨水頭降低十公尺重算差值，註明效率保持不變是敏感度假設，不是實際機組效率曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate megawatt-hours for six hours at constant output, then reduce net head by ten metres and compare energy. State explicitly that unchanged efficiency is a sensitivity assumption rather than a measured turbine performance curve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow. An efficiency above unity requires checking gross versus net head and power-unit conversions before investigating calibration of pressure and discharge instruments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用六小時等功率運行求兆瓦小時，再把淨水頭降低十公尺重算差值，註明效率保持不變是敏感度假設，不是實際機組效率曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate megawatt-hours for six hours at constant output, then reduce net head by ten metres and compare energy. State explicitly that unchanged efficiency is a sensitivity assumption rather than a measured turbine performance curve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高水頭水能轉換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "High head energy conversion"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。

Rock elastic modulus can directly substitute for support spring stiffness
Check upstream energy, the tailwater reference and electrical-meter boundary separately, pairing output with simultaneous flow.

steps.title: 高水頭水能轉換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: High head energy conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高水頭水能轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “High head energy conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. An efficiency that already includes waterway losses, followed by another friction deduction, counts the same energy loss twice. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制體邊界必須說明是否包含發電機、變壓器與輔機用電，否則兩個看似相同效率可能其實分母分子範圍不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Otherwise two apparently comparable efficiencies can refer to different energy inputs and different reported electrical outputs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。
knowledge.textEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. An efficiency that already includes waterway losses, followed by another friction deduction, counts the same energy loss twice.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高水頭水能轉換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "High head energy conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力
optionsEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location
quiz.explanation: 把額定功率當作每小時都能提供的實際功率，會忽略水頭與流量變動；把效率同時包含輸水損失又再扣摩擦，則會把同一能量損失計入兩次。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating rated power as continuous achievable output ignores changing head and discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快速流速變化與水錘」與「施工湧水的抽排功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rapid velocity change and water hammer" and "Pumping energy for tunnel inflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快速流速變化與水錘：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and water hammer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快速流速變化與水錘」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。焦科夫斯基關係給出理想快速變化的壓力尺度，與穩流摩擦屬不同物理過程，必須先比較變化時間與波的往返時間。 波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速流速變化與水錘」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The Joukowsky relation gives an ideal rapid-change pressure scale, which differs from steady friction and requires comparison of change duration with the wave round-trip time. Wave speed reflects the combined compressibility of water and wall, not mean flow velocity. A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快速流速變化與水錘」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rapid velocity change and water hammer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快速流速變化與水錘
knowledge.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and water hammer
knowledge.text: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。焦科夫斯基關係給出理想快速變化的壓力尺度，與穩流摩擦屬不同物理過程，必須先比較變化時間與波的往返時間。
knowledge.textEn: Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The Joukowsky relation gives an ideal rapid-change pressure scale, which differs from steady friction and requires comparison of change duration with the wave round-trip time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快速流速變化與水錘」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rapid velocity change and water hammer" is correct?
options: 一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力
管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。
抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率
optionsEn: One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location
Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly.
Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency
quiz.explanation: 管中水與管壁都具有彈性，快速改變速度會形成沿管傳播的壓力波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Elastic water and pipe walls support a travelling pressure wave when velocity changes rapidly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快速流速變化與水錘：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and water hammer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速流速變化與水錘」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa。適用邊界：單相滿管、快速變化且不發生液柱分離；不是實際閥門操作指令。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; a=900 m/s; dv=1.5 m/s; dp=rho a dv/1e6=1.35 MPa. Applicable boundary: Single-phase full-pipe rapid change without column separation; this is not an actual valve operating instruction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知管長與波速估算壓力波往返時間，再確認壓力記錄取樣足以解析波峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate round-trip travel time from pipe length and wave speed, then confirm that pressure sampling resolves the peak.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 以已知管長與波速估算壓力波往返時間，再確認壓力記錄取樣足以解析波峰。對照上下游波形的到達時間與反射極性，並檢查感測器量程是否把峰值截平而低估瞬變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate round-trip travel time from pipe length and wave speed, then confirm that pressure sampling resolves the peak. Compare arrival times and reflection signs at different locations and check whether sensor saturation clips the recorded maximum. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在紙上比較波速七百與一千公尺每秒的壓力增量，說明管壁柔度如何影響結果，再列出需要瞬變模擬才能回答的反射與負壓問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare pressure increments for wave speeds of seven hundred and one thousand metres per second. Explain the role of wall flexibility and identify reflection and sub-atmospheric-pressure questions that require a transient model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若局部壓力降到汽化條件，液柱分離及再結合可能改變峰值，簡單線性式不再完整；只把平均壓力加上算得增量也會忽略反射與高程分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If local pressure reaches vapor conditions, column separation and rejoining can alter peaks beyond the simple linear model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 快速流速變化與水錘：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity change and water hammer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「快速流速變化與水錘」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rapid velocity change and water hammer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若局部壓力降到汽化條件，液柱分離及再結合可能改變峰值，簡單線性式不再完整；只把平均壓力加上算得增量也會忽略反射與高程分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If local pressure reaches vapor conditions, column separation and rejoining can alter peaks beyond the simple linear model. Adding one increment to an average pressure also neglects reflections and the elevation-dependent pressure distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波速由水與管壁的合成可壓縮性決定，並非水流平均速度；壓力訊息能快速往返，而水體本身位移相對較小。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A pressure signal can travel rapidly back and forth while the water itself moves a comparatively short distance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次水錘增量就是整條管線所有位置的最大壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One water-hammer increment is the maximum pressure at every pipeline location" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy for tunnel inflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工湧水的抽排功率」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 黑四施工歷史中的地下水困難提醒工程師，排水是水量、揚程與能源的聯合問題。假想隧道集水坑把來水提升到出口時，所需電功率須除以泵組效率；進水量估計不能只靠某一次乾天觀察。 總揚程包含出口與集水坑的位能差及流動損失，泵的工作點由供能曲線與管路需求曲線交會決定而非單看銘牌。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工湧水的抽排功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The historical groundwater difficulty highlights dewatering as a coupled flow, lift and energy problem. A hypothetical tunnel sump must lift inflow to an outlet, so electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump efficiency rather than multiplying by it. Total head contains elevation difference and flow losses. The operating point follows the intersection of pump supply and system demand curves, rather than being fixed by the nameplate flow alone. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工湧水的抽排功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: The historical groundwater difficulty highlights dewatering as a coupled flow, lift and energy problem. A hypothetical tunnel sump must lift inflow to an outlet, so electrical input divides hydraulic power by pump efficiency rather than multiplying by it.

knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy for tunnel inflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工湧水的抽排功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW。適用邊界：穩定清水與總揚程，未計堵塞、含砂磨耗及備援需求，不是現場抽水計畫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; H=35 m; eta=0.7; Pin=rho g Q H/eta/1000=122.625 kW. Applicable boundary: Steady clean-water flow and total head; blockage, abrasion and standby requirements are excluded, so this is not a site dewatering plan. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：試驗與驗證
