steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工湧水的抽排功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。以多個來水時段建立範圍，並檢查集水坑儲量變化，避免把坑內暫存水誤當穩定地下水補注。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge. Examine several inflow periods and sump storage changes so temporarily stored water is not mistaken for sustained groundwater recharge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把效率降到零點五五，計算相同排水量所需輸入功率，再另列水位上升時總揚程改變的方向，說明不能只用電費判斷抽排能力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce efficiency to zero point five five and recalculate input power at the same flow. Separately determine how changing sump level alters head and explain why electricity consumption alone cannot demonstrate dewatering capacity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。以多個來水時段建立範圍，並檢查集水坑儲量變化，避免把坑內暫存水誤當穩定地下水補注。
knowledge.textEn: Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge. Examine several inflow periods and sump storage changes so temporarily stored water is not mistaken for sustained groundwater recharge.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把效率降到零點五五，計算相同排水量所需輸入功率，再另列水位上升時總揚程改變的方向，說明不能只用電費判斷抽排能力。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce efficiency to zero point five five and recalculate input power at the same flow. Separately determine how changing sump level alters head and explain why electricity consumption alone cannot demonstrate dewatering capacity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工湧水的抽排功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pumping energy for tunnel inflow"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。
沿程水頭損失只與流速一次方成比例
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge.
Friction head loss is proportional only to the first power of velocity
quiz.explanation: 核對出口高程、管路摩擦與水位變化後再定總揚程，將電表輸入與實測排水量對照。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Establish total head from outlet elevation, friction and water-level variation, then compare electrical input with measured discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工湧水的抽排功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy for tunnel inflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工湧水的抽排功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pumping energy for tunnel inflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Abrasion or blockage can reduce efficiency, so rising electrical current may accompany falling water delivery and a continuing increase in sump level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總揚程包含出口與集水坑的位能差及流動損失，泵的工作點由供能曲線與管路需求曲線交會決定而非單看銘牌。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The operating point follows the intersection of pump supply and system demand curves, rather than being fixed by the nameplate flow alone.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抽水電功率應將水力功率乘上效率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pumping electrical input equals hydraulic power multiplied by efficiency" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。
knowledge.textEn: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Abrasion or blockage can reduce efficiency, so rising electrical current may accompany falling water delivery and a continuing increase in sump level.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工湧水的抽排功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping energy for tunnel inflow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全
把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety
Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head.
quiz.explanation: 把泵額定流量直接視為實際排水能力會忽略揚程工作點；含砂或堵塞造成效率下降時，即使電流升高也不代表排水量增加，水位仍可能持續上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rated pump flow does not establish discharge at the actual head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水位溫度與位移殘差」與「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Level temperature and displacement residuals" and "Downstream buffer storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位溫度與位移殘差」如何影響黑部水壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level temperature and displacement residuals” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Kurobe Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。假想回歸模型先用水位及內部溫度預測位移，再看觀測殘差，但殘差只能提示進一步檢查，不能自行判定損傷。 係數描述既有資料中的統計關聯，不保證每一項都是獨立因果；水位與季節高度相關時，係數可變得難以辨識。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位溫度與位移殘差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature. A hypothetical regression predicts movement from level and internal temperature before examining residuals, separating explanatory variables while leaving damage diagnosis to additional evidence and appropriate model validation. Coefficients describe associations in the calibration record rather than independent causal mechanisms. Strong correlation between reservoir level and season can make individual parameter estimates difficult to identify even when overall fit is good. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level temperature and displacement residuals” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位溫度與位移殘差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level temperature and displacement residuals”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差
knowledge.text: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。假想回歸模型先用水位及內部溫度預測位移，再看觀測殘差，但殘差只能提示進一步檢查，不能自行判定損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature. A hypothetical regression predicts movement from level and internal temperature before examining residuals, separating explanatory variables while leaving damage diagnosis to additional evidence and appropriate model validation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位溫度與位移殘差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Level temperature and displacement residuals" is correct?
options: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。
監測回歸殘差很小即可證明結構完全安全
每個放流脈衝都能重新使用緩衝池的全部容量
optionsEn: Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature.
A small monitoring regression residual proves complete structural safety
Every release pulse can reuse the entire buffer capacity from scratch
quiz.explanation: 拱壩位移常同時回應庫水壓與季節溫度，因此單看位移大小可能混淆可逆變形與異常。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arch displacement can respond to both reservoir loading and seasonal temperature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位溫度與位移殘差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level temperature and displacement residuals” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。適用邊界：線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. Applicable boundary: Coefficients are hypothetical calibrations restricted to the training range, with time lag omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。適用邊界：線性係數是假想校準值，變量範圍限於訓練資料，未計時間延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. Applicable boundary: Coefficients are hypothetical calibrations restricted to the training range, with time lag omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水位溫度與位移殘差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Level temperature and displacement residuals", which statement holds?
options: 只靠圓環平均壓應力就足以完成整座拱壩設計
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。
每日氣溫變化就是整座壩體的平均溫變
optionsEn: Mean ring compression alone is sufficient for complete arch-dam design
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m.
Daily air-temperature change equals the mean temperature change of the entire dam
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: bH=0.12 mm/m; dH=15 m; bT=0.25 mm/K; dT=-4 K; yobs=1.6 mm; r=yobs-(bH dH+bT dT)=0.8 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位溫度與位移殘差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level temperature and displacement residuals” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。對同時段的獨立儀器及基準點做交叉比對，若殘差突然跳變，先查換機、零點重設與缺值插補紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level. Cross-check independent instruments and references over matching periods, investigating replacement, zero resets and interpolation records before interpreting an abrupt residual jump. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入一個一毫米的儀器零點偏移後重新求殘差，說明如何用鄰近儀器區分共同結構位移與單一測點故障，並列出不能只靠回歸辨識的因素。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a one-millimetre zero shift and recalculate the residual. Explain how nearby instruments could distinguish common structural movement from a single-point fault and identify causes that regression alone cannot resolve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以同一組資料擬合又驗證會掩蓋過度擬合；把未曾出現的高水位輸入線性模型，可能得到看似精確卻無外推根據的預測，延誤必要的人工判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fitting and validating on identical records conceals overfitting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。對同時段的獨立儀器及基準點做交叉比對，若殘差突然跳變，先查換機、零點重設與缺值插補紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level. Cross-check independent instruments and references over matching periods, investigating replacement, zero resets and interpolation records before interpreting an abrupt residual jump.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入一個一毫米的儀器零點偏移後重新求殘差，說明如何用鄰近儀器區分共同結構位移與單一測點故障，並列出不能只靠回歸辨識的因素。
knowledge.textEn: Add a one-millimetre zero shift and recalculate the residual. Explain how nearby instruments could distinguish common structural movement from a single-point fault and identify causes that regression alone cannot resolve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水位溫度與位移殘差」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level temperature and displacement residuals"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
機組功率乘秒仍可直接標成兆瓦小時
把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Power multiplied by seconds can directly be labelled megawatt-hours
Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level.
quiz.explanation: 把校準與驗證年份分開，檢查殘差是否仍跟溫度、季節或水位相關。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate calibration and validation years and test whether residuals still correlate with season, temperature or level. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水位溫度與位移殘差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Level temperature and displacement residuals: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 發電放流可能在短時間變動，而下游希望較平順的水量。假想緩衝池以暫時蓄水吸收入出流差額，所需容積由整個時段積分決定，不能只用最大流量相減而忽略持續時間與初始水位。 緩衝所需容積是累積差額曲線的最大與最小之差，若脈衝並非矩形，必須先積分完整歷線才能辨認容量需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游緩衝池的時段蓄量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Generating releases can change faster than desired downstream delivery. A hypothetical buffer stores the time integral of the inlet-outlet difference; required volume depends on duration and initial storage, not merely the difference between two peak discharge values. For a repeating cycle, required active storage is the range of the cumulative imbalance curve. Nonrectangular pulses require integration of the complete hydrograph before the relevant volume can be identified. steps.title: 下游緩衝池的時段蓄量：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downstream buffer storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3。適用邊界：半小時矩形入流脈衝、出口固定且無溢流，未指定實際下游運用。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qin=24 m3/s; Qout=16 m3/s; dt=1800 s; dV=(Qin-Qout)dt=14400 m3. Applicable boundary: A thirty-minute rectangular inflow pulse with fixed outlet and no overflow, without specifying real downstream operation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 將入流與出流歷線畫在同一時間軸，用曲線間面積核對蓄量增加，再檢查下一時段是否有足夠差額排回初始狀態。加入可用庫容上限時，要同時保留初始蓄量，不可從零開始假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot inlet and outlet hydrographs on one time axis and verify storage from the area between them. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Repeated pulses without recovery accumulate storage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

courses.summary: 翡翠案例結合拱壩的水平傳力與垂直懸臂、基岩層面有效應力、溫度接縫和水庫分層取水。課程將防洪蓄量、溢流消能及原水混合分開建模，避免把水位、濁度和結構安全視為同一指標。每個推導均要求確認幾何、量測基準與不能外推的條件。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想有效水量二千萬立方公尺、平均取水每秒四立方公尺，以體積除流量得名目停留時間五百萬秒，約五十七點八七日；實際水齡仍受密度流與短路影響。另設水平拱剛度三千、垂直懸臂剛度二千兆牛頓每公尺，在總力五十兆牛頓下，拱分擔三十兆牛頓。若拱剛度下降百分之二十，拱分力成二十七點二七三兆牛頓。這是共同位移的雙彈簧模型，不應拿分力直接宣布壩體安全。 核驗：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。
workedExample.textEn: Assume 20 million m3 of active water and mean withdrawal of 4 m3/s. Volume divided by flow gives a nominal residence time of five million seconds, or 57.87 days; actual water age still depends on density currents and short circuiting. Separately, arch and cantilever stiffnesses of 3000 and 2000 MN/m share a 50 MN force, giving the arch 30 MN. Reducing arch stiffness by twenty percent changes that share to 27.273 MN. This common-displacement spring analogy identifies redistribution, not a verified stress field or a dam safety conclusion. Verification: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「名目停留時間與水齡」與「曲面水平投影的水推力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nominal residence and water age" and "Hydrostatic horizontal projected force": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「名目停留時間與水齡」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal residence and water age” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。 名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「名目停留時間與水齡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel. A nominal time contains only one averaged flow. Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal residence and water age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「名目停留時間與水齡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal residence and water age”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 名目停留時間與水齡
knowledge.text: 供水水庫的體積除以平均取水率得到名目周轉時間，適合比較儲水量與需求尺度。翡翠背景下的真實水齡還取決於密度分層、入流短路及死水區，所以這個商不能代表每滴水都在庫內停留相同天數。
knowledge.textEn: Stored volume divided by mean withdrawal gives a nominal turnover scale useful for comparing storage and demand. Actual water age also depends on stratification, short-circuit inflows and stagnant zones, so the quotient does not describe the travel time of every parcel.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「名目停留時間與水齡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal residence and water age” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。適用邊界：穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Applicable boundary: A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day。適用邊界：穩態體積與平均流量的尺度估算，沒有假設真實水庫完全混合。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: V=20000000 m3; Q=4 m3/s; tau=V/Q/86400=57.87037 day. Applicable boundary: A steady-volume and mean-flow scale estimate, without asserting complete mixing in the actual reservoir.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal residence and water age", which statement holds?

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「名目停留時間與水齡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Nominal residence and water age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。用水溫或保守示蹤物的深度剖面辨識隔離水層，再比較不同取水高程的到達時間，檢查名目周轉是否掩蓋短路。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將有效交換體積減為原值七成，計算名目停留時間，再畫完全混合與短路兩種概念流路，說明單一平均數無法分辨何者。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the actively exchanging volume to seventy percent, recalculate turnover and sketch complete mixing and short-circuit pathways. Explain why the same nominal mean cannot distinguish their very different age distributions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Use temperature or conservative-tracer depth profiles to identify isolated layers, then compare arrival times at withdrawal elevations to assess possible short circuiting.

knowledge.textEn: Reduce the actively exchanging volume to seventy percent, recalculate turnover and sketch complete mixing and short-circuit pathways. Explain why the same nominal mean cannot distinguish their very different age distributions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「名目停留時間與水齡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Nominal residence and water age"?
options: 核對體積是有效交換區還是總庫容，將流量平均時段寫清楚。

quiz.explanationEn: Check whether volume represents active exchange or total storage and state the averaging period for discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 名目停留時間與水齡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal residence and water age: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「名目停留時間與水齡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal residence and water age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以整座水庫體積計算後宣稱污染會在該天數全部消失，忽略長尾水齡與沉積再釋出；短路可能讓部分新入流水更早抵達取水口，兩種偏差可同時存在。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming that contamination disappears after one nominal residence time ignores long age tails and sediment release. Short circuiting can simultaneously deliver some newly arrived water much earlier to the intake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：名目時間只包含一個平均流率，若入流沿某深度快速通過，水庫可同時存在很年輕的水團與多年未交換的深層水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Rapid passage along one depth can coexist with young water parcels and deep water that exchanges much more slowly, creating a broad age distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic horizontal projected force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面水平投影的水推力」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲面上的水壓始終沿表面法線，水平分力可用垂直投影面積積分取得。翡翠拱壩背景的示範只計一塊假想投影條帶，不把合力直接當作壩基剪力，也不忽略曲面另外可能承受的垂直分量。 積分可用水平分力逐點相加，也可先投影再積分，兩種路徑在靜水條件下應一致，這提供幾何模型的獨立檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面水平投影的水推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure acts normally to a curved surface, while its horizontal component follows integration over the vertical projection. This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body. The horizontal force may be integrated from local components or calculated after projection. Under hydrostatic conditions these routes must agree, providing an independent geometric check without assuming a structural load path. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面水平投影的水推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

This exercise treats a hypothetical projected strip rather than equating the result to foundation shear or discarding other force components on the curved body.

steps.title: 曲面水平投影的水推力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面水平投影的水推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN。適用邊界：頂端位於自由液面的垂直矩形投影，靜水且尾水壓未計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; b=10 m; H=40 m; F=rho g b H2/2/1e6=78.48 MN. Applicable boundary: A vertical rectangular projection starting at the free surface, with hydrostatic water and no downstream pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出隨深度線性增加的壓力三角形，用底壓乘面積再除二重算合力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw the triangular pressure distribution and independently recover force from half the base pressure times projected area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydrostatic horizontal projected force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出隨深度線性增加的壓力三角形，用底壓乘面積再除二重算合力。核對作用點在水深下方三分之二位置，並列出曲面法線方向與水平投影之間的轉換，避免面積重複計入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the triangular pressure distribution and independently recover force from half the base pressure times projected area. Check that the resultant acts two thirds of the depth below the surface, then distinguish actual curved area from its horizontal-force projection. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水深從四十公尺增至四十八公尺，計算合力倍率並比較壓力倍率，解釋為何總推力增加快於底壓，以及投影寬度假設有何影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase depth from forty to forty-eight metres, compare force and bottom-pressure multipliers, and explain why resultant force grows faster. State how the assumed projected width limits the interpretation of the comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant.
quiz.explanation: 把平均水壓誤設為底部最大水壓會使合力加倍；又若把投影條帶的合力直接均分給所有拱圈，便忽略深度變化與三維承載分配，產生錯誤應力圖。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using bottom pressure as average pressure doubles the resultant. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拱與懸臂剛度分力」與「岩盤層面有效正向力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arch and cantilever load sharing" and "Effective force on rock bedding": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱與懸臂剛度分力」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch and cantilever load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。 總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱與懸臂剛度分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam. Adding stiffnesses follows from common displacement, unlike the common force of series springs. The force ratio equals the stiffness ratio only within this linear parallel model, not as a universal dam property. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch and cantilever load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch and cantilever load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力
knowledge.text: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。用同位移的兩個並聯彈簧表示這兩條力路，可看出較硬路徑分擔更多荷載，但這只是相容變形概念，不能把兩彈簧視為互不影響的真實壩塊。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. Parallel springs with a common displacement illustrate why the stiffer load path attracts more force, while remaining an analogy rather than two independent physical blocks of a real double-curvature dam.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱與懸臂剛度分力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch and cantilever load sharing" is correct?
options: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。
一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力
不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
optionsEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure.
Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged
Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
quiz.explanation: 雙曲率壩的水平拱作用與垂直懸臂作用共同抵抗水壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal arch and vertical cantilever action jointly resist pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。適用邊界：線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Applicable boundary: Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。適用邊界：線性並聯與共同位移，只示範力路分配，不提供局部應力。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Applicable boundary: Linear parallel paths with shared displacement illustrate force distribution without predicting local stresses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch and cantilever load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。
水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變
optionsEn: Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN.
A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: ka=3000 MN/m; kc=2000 MN/m; F=50 MN; Fa=F ka/(ka+kc)=30 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱與懸臂剛度分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch and cantilever load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。改變其中一條路徑剛度時，同時記錄另一條分力如何增加，並說明真實壩體需要何種接縫及基礎資料。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Change one path stiffness while tracking the other force, then identify joint and foundation information required to move beyond this simple compatibility analogy. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。改變其中一條路徑剛度時，同時記錄另一條分力如何增加，並說明真實壩體需要何種接縫及基礎資料。
knowledge.textEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Change one path stiffness while tracking the other force, then identify joint and foundation information required to move beyond this simple compatibility analogy.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把拱剛度降至二千四百兆牛頓每公尺，重新求兩條分力及共同位移，畫出荷載轉移方向，指出這項結果仍不能判定局部裂縫是否擴展。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce arch stiffness to twenty-four hundred meganewtons per metre, recalculate both forces and displacement, and draw redistribution. Explain why these results alone cannot determine whether a local crack will propagate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱與懸臂剛度分力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch and cantilever load sharing"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均
分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ
Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium.
quiz.explanation: 分別用總剛度求位移，再以兩個剛度乘位移重建分力，確認分力相加等於外力。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Find displacement from total stiffness, recover each force from stiffness times displacement and verify equilibrium. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂剛度分力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱與懸臂剛度分力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Keeping old force shares with new stiffnesses creates incompatible displacements and violates the model's central assumption. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總剛度相加來自同位移條件，與串聯彈簧的同力條件不同；分力比恰為剛度比，只在這個線性並聯模型成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The force ratio equals the stiffness ratio only within this linear parallel model, not as a universal dam property.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Softening one load path leaves force in the other path unchanged" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。
knowledge.textEn: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Keeping old force shares with new stiffnesses creates incompatible displacements and violates the model's central assumption.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱與懸臂剛度分力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arch and cantilever load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
optionsEn: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
quiz.explanation: 認為一條力路變軟只會減少整體受力，漏掉荷載向另一力路轉移；若仍保留原分力卻改用新剛度，則位移不相容，模型已失去共同變形的基本前提。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Softening one path does not simply remove load; it redirects force into the other path. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岩盤層面有效正向力」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective force on rock bedding” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。假想單一平面模型把水壓作用面積明列出來，讓學員看見排水如何改變有效力，而不是把總壓力全部當成可用摩擦來源。 孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩盤層面有效正向力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted. A single-plane model explicitly includes pressurized area, showing how drainage changes effective force rather than treating total compression as entirely available for friction. Pore pressure acts normal to the bedding plane, so it must use a compatible sign convention with total normal force. Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective force on rock bedding” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岩盤層面有效正向力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective force on rock bedding”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力
knowledge.text: 拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。假想單一平面模型把水壓作用面積明列出來，讓學員看見排水如何改變有效力，而不是把總壓力全部當成可用摩擦來源。
knowledge.textEn: Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted. A single-plane model explicitly includes pressurized area, showing how drainage changes effective force rather than treating total compression as entirely available for friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岩盤層面有效正向力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
Thrust entering bedded rock mobilizes friction according to normal force remaining after water pressure is deducted.
Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
quiz.explanation: 拱推力進入有層面的岩盤時，抗滑摩擦取決於扣除孔隙水壓後的有效正向力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岩盤層面有效正向力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective force on rock bedding” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN。適用邊界：不計黏聚與側向約束，孔壓均勻；只算摩擦抗力不是安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=80 MN; u=0.3 MPa; A=100 m2; phi=30 deg; R=(N-uA)tan(phi)=28.86751 MN. Applicable boundary: No cohesion or lateral confinement, with uniform pore pressure; the result is frictional resistance, not a safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先核對兆帕乘平方公尺等於兆牛頓，再以測壓管代表範圍估算壓力分布。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify that megapascals times square metres produce meganewtons, then examine how piezometers represent the pressure field.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岩盤層面有效正向力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective force on rock bedding” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對兆帕乘平方公尺等於兆牛頓，再以測壓管代表範圍估算壓力分布。比較排水前後孔壓與位移趨勢，注意單一測點不能代表整條層面，並另列未知的剪力需求與力矩。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify that megapascals times square metres produce meganewtons, then examine how piezometers represent the pressure field. Compare pressure and movement before and after drainage, noting that one point cannot characterize the entire plane and that shear demand remains unspecified. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把均勻孔壓提高到零點四兆帕，重算摩擦抗力並畫孔壓與抗力關係，再討論何時有效正向力趨近零會使簡化接觸假設失效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise uniform pore pressure to zero point four megapascals, recalculate resistance and plot its pressure dependence. Discuss why the contact assumption breaks down as effective normal force approaches zero.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岩盤層面有效正向力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 岩盤層面有效正向力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective force on rock bedding: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岩盤層面有效正向力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective force on rock bedding” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A sensor beside a local drain may miss a remote high-pressure zone, so an apparently reasonable average can conceal reduced effective contact force. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔壓作用的方向垂直層面，水壓與總正向力使用相同符號約定才能相減；孔壓上升不是直接增加摩擦的壓緊力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increasing water pressure is not additional clamping force available to mobilize friction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. A sensor beside a local drain may miss a remote high-pressure zone, so an apparently reasonable average can conceal reduced effective contact force.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岩盤層面有效正向力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective force on rock bedding" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。
單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance.
Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening
quiz.explanation: 把總正向力直接乘摩擦係數會高估抗力；若測壓點位在局部低壓排水孔旁，可能漏掉遠處高壓區，使看似合理的平均孔壓掩蓋層面有效力不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying total normal force by friction coefficient overestimates resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度變形與接縫開度」與「密度分層與取水慣性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal movement and joint gap" and "Stratification and withdrawal inertia": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and joint gap: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度變形與接縫開度」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal movement and joint gap” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩接縫的相對開合會受到塊體溫度、拘束及水壓共同影響。自由熱伸縮長度可以當作幾何尺度，但不能直接等同實際縫寬；縫面接觸後可能傳力，張開後傳力條件又會改變，形成非線性問題。 若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度變形與接縫開度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative joint movement responds to block temperature, restraint and hydraulic loading. Free thermal movement provides a geometric scale rather than the actual gap, because contact can transmit force while opening changes the load path and introduces nonlinearity. When both blocks expand toward a joint, relative closure can exceed one block expansion. Common translation leaves gap unchanged, demonstrating why absolute movement and relative aperture are different observables. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and joint gap” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: alpha=0.00001 1/K; L=24 m; dT=15 K; dL=alpha L dT*1000=3.6 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度變形與接縫開度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度變形與接縫開度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal movement and joint gap” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將縫計與附近溫度計同步繪圖，核對量測方向與正負號，再分別辨識日週期與季節週期。以兩側塊體的相對運動重建縫寬，不能把單側絕對位移直接當成開度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot joint and temperature measurements synchronously, checking sensor direction and sign before distinguishing daily from seasonal cycles. Reconstruct gap from the relative motion of both sides rather than treating one block's absolute displacement as joint opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫兩側等長塊體同時升溫的幾何圖，指定固定端位置後求相對位移，再與單側伸長比較，說明接縫初始間隙對是否接觸的影響。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Sketch two equal blocks warming together, specify their fixed ends and derive relative movement. Compare it with single-block expansion and explain how the initial gap determines whether contact develops.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把自由伸長全數加到縫寬而不考慮方向，可能把閉合預測成張開；若縫面已接觸仍用同一直線關係外推，就會忽略接觸壓力與剛度突然改變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 溫度變形與接縫開度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and joint gap: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫度變形與接縫開度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal movement and joint gap” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把自由伸長全數加到縫寬而不考慮方向，可能把閉合預測成張開；若縫面已接觸仍用同一直線關係外推，就會忽略接觸壓力與剛度突然改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs. Continuing the same linear relation after contact ignores the resulting contact pressure and abrupt change in stiffness. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若接縫兩側都朝縫面伸長，相對閉合量可能大於單塊伸長；若一起平移則縫寬不變，顯示絕對與相對位移不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Common translation leaves gap unchanged, demonstrating why absolute movement and relative aperture are different observables.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Adding all free expansion to gap without checking direction can predict opening where closure occurs.

steps.title: 密度分層與取水慣性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stratification and withdrawal inertia: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度分層與取水慣性」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫冷暖水層的密度差提供恢復浮力，取水流速則會拉動界面。以約化重力及密度福祿數比較慣性與浮力，可討論選擇性取水是否容易擾動水層，但實際取水形狀、界面厚度與三維流場仍不可省略。 約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度分層與取水慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Density contrast between warm and cool layers supplies restoring buoyancy while withdrawal velocity disturbs the interface. Reduced gravity and a densimetric Froude number compare inertia with buoyancy, without resolving intake geometry, interface thickness or the three-dimensional withdrawal field. Reduced gravity retains the buoyancy associated with density difference and cannot be replaced by full gravitational acceleration. Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：g=9.81 m/s2; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=8 m; v=0.2 m/s; Fr=v/sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.50482。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: g=9.81 m/s2; drho=2 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=8 m; v=0.2 m/s; Fr=v/sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.50482.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度分層與取水慣性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Reduced gravity and a densimetric Froude number compare inertia with buoyancy, without resolving intake geometry, interface thickness or the three-dimensional withdrawal field.

knowledge.text: 誤解：密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 密度分層與取水慣性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stratification and withdrawal inertia: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度分層與取水慣性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿深度量測溫度與密度，確認界面存在並記錄測點時間，再用流量與有效進水面積估算局部速度。比較不同取水時段的剖面變化，留意風混合也可能造成界面移動而非全部由取水引起。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure depth profiles of temperature and density to establish an interface and record sampling times. Estimate local velocity from flow and effective intake area, then compare profiles across withdrawal periods while accounting for wind-driven mixing as an alternative cause. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將密度差減半而保持速度不變，重算無因次數並描述浮力恢復變弱的意義，再列出需用水槽或數值模型確認的取水口幾何效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the density difference at unchanged velocity, recalculate the dimensionless number and explain weaker buoyant restoration. Identify intake-geometry effects requiring physical experiments or a resolved flow model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全庫平均流速代替取水口附近速度可能嚴重低估慣性；直接把無因次數當成固定允許值，也會忽略幾何、分層厚度與入流條件，使比較失去物理依據。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reservoir-wide mean velocity can greatly understate inertia near an intake. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 密度分層與取水慣性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stratification and withdrawal inertia: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度分層與取水慣性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stratification and withdrawal inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全庫平均流速代替取水口附近速度可能嚴重低估慣性；直接把無因次數當成固定允許值，也會忽略幾何、分層厚度與入流條件，使比較失去物理依據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir-wide mean velocity can greatly understate inertia near an intake. Treating the dimensionless number as a universal permitted value ignores geometry, interface thickness and inflow conditions that control its interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：約化重力只保留密度差造成的浮力尺度，不能用完整重力取代；其平方根與水深共同形成可與流速比較的特徵速度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combined with depth under a square root, it produces a characteristic velocity comparable with withdrawal speed.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
