stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「颱風入流與短時水位」與「水躍共軛水深」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Storm inflow and short term level" and "Hydraulic jump conjugate depths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 颱風入流與短時水位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storm inflow and short term level: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「颱風入流與短時水位」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storm inflow and short term level” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 颱風期間水量累積取決於入流減放流的時程，水面積把蓄量差轉成水位差。以局部固定面積作近似可快速估計量級，但翡翠的真實地形曲線與隨水位變動的出口能力會使線性估算偏離實況。 局部面積就是庫容對水位的導數，因此固定面積近似只適合變動不大的一段高程；跨越地形突變時應分段處理。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「颱風入流與短時水位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During a storm, storage accumulates from the time history of inflow minus release. Local water area converts volume change into level change as a first approximation, while real geometry and level-dependent outlet behavior can depart from that linear estimate. Local surface area is the derivative of storage with respect to elevation. Constant area is therefore a local approximation, and a level change spanning abrupt topographic variation should be integrated in segments. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Storm inflow and short term level” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Knowing only level increment establishes remaining flood-storage capacity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「颱風入流與短時水位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Storm inflow and short term level”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：只知道水位增量就能判斷剩餘蓄洪空間 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「颱風入流與短時水位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Storm inflow and short term level” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m。適用邊界：三小時淨入流與水面積固定，沒有指定實際蓄洪空間或放流規則。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Qnet=140 m3/s; dt=10800 s; A=8000000 m2; dH=Qnet dt/A=0.189 m. Applicable boundary: Constant net inflow and surface area for three hours, without specifying real flood space or release rules. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用逐時入出流積分先求體積，再以相鄰高程面積曲線求水位並比較固定面積結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate hourly inlet and outlet flows for volume, then use neighboring elevation-area data to estimate level and compare with the fixed-area result.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 用逐時入出流積分先求體積，再以相鄰高程面積曲線求水位並比較固定面積結果。保留初始水位及面積資料年代，查明降雨、側流和量測時間差是否已納入水量平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate hourly inlet and outlet flows for volume, then use neighboring elevation-area data to estimate level and compare with the fixed-area result. steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溢流後的高速淺水若轉成低速深水，可透過水躍耗散能量。矩形渠道的動量平衡給出上下游共軛水深，這不代表任意尾水都能穩住水躍；實際消能池還受床面、空氣摻混及側向流動影響。 躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水躍共軛水深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hydraulic jump converts fast shallow flow into slower deeper flow while dissipating energy. Rectangular-channel momentum gives conjugate depths, but arbitrary tailwater will not necessarily hold the jump in place, and actual basins involve aeration, bed details and lateral effects. Discharge is conserved across the jump while depth and velocity change. Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 水躍共軛水深：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic jump conjugate depths: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水躍共軛水深」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic jump conjugate depths” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Treating dissipated energy as local pressure also obscures distinct mechanisms of fluctuating loads, cavitation and scour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：躍前與躍後流量相同但速度與水深改變，動量函數相等不代表比能相等，兩斷面的比能差才是耗散的量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal momentum functions do not imply equal specific energies; their specific-energy difference quantifies the mechanical energy dissipated in the transition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水躍同時保持動量函數與機械比能不變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A hydraulic jump conserves both momentum function and mechanical specific energy" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。
knowledge.textEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Treating dissipated energy as local pressure also obscures distinct mechanisms of fluctuating loads, cavitation and scour.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水躍共軛水深」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic jump conjugate depths" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數
把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre
A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur.
quiz.explanation: 把共軛水深當成保證穩定水躍的尾水設定，可能忽略掃出或淹沒；若又把耗能量當作局部壓力，將無法辨識床面脈動、氣蝕與沖刷的不同機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A conjugate depth does not guarantee a stable jump; sweep-out or submergence may occur. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含砂濃度與固體負荷」與「原水保守溶質混合」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment concentration and mass load" and "Conservative raw water mixing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含砂濃度與固體負荷」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment concentration and mass load” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。 質量率積分得到的是運輸量，轉成沉積體積還要知道留下比例與乾容重，因而輸砂與庫容測量應分開設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含砂濃度與固體負荷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty. Integrating mass flux gives transported solids. Conversion to deposited volume additionally requires retention and dry bulk density, so sediment transport measurements and reservoir-capacity surveys address related but distinct quantities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment concentration and mass load” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment concentration and mass load”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷
knowledge.text: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。濁度是光學反應而非質量濃度，翡翠背景的教學不能不經現地校準就把濁度單位直接乘流量。
knowledge.textEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. Turbidity is an optical response rather than mass concentration, so it cannot be multiplied directly by flow without a site-specific conversion and its uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含砂濃度與固體負荷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sediment concentration and mass load" is correct?
options: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。
濁度數值可以直接當作每立方公尺固體公斤數
兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均
optionsEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage.
A turbidity value directly equals kilograms of solids per cubic metre
Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ
quiz.explanation: 流量與懸浮固體質量濃度相乘得到輸入固體的質量率，可把集水區侵蝕與水庫占容問題串連。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Discharge times suspended-solids mass concentration gives a solids delivery rate linking catchment erosion to reservoir storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment concentration and mass load” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。適用邊界：兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Applicable boundary: Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。適用邊界：兩小時代表濃度與流量固定，僅懸浮輸砂，不含推移質與庫內沉降。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Applicable boundary: Constant representative concentration and flow for two hours; suspended load only, excluding bed load and reservoir deposition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含砂濃度與固體負荷」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sediment concentration and mass load", which statement holds?
options: 曲面水平水推力可直接用底壓乘全部曲面面積
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。
不必扣除孔隙水壓即可用總正向力算摩擦
optionsEn: Horizontal hydrostatic force equals bottom pressure times the entire curved area
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg.
Friction can use total normal force without deducting pore pressure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=12 m3/s; C=0.35 kg/m3; dt=7200 s; M=Q C dt=30240 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含砂濃度與固體負荷：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment concentration and mass load: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含砂濃度與固體負荷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment concentration and mass load” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。檢查洪峰前後是否有遲滯，避免只採清水期而漏掉主要固體負荷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Check rising and falling limbs for hysteresis so clear-water sampling does not miss the dominant solids load. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設濃度在第一小時加倍而第二小時減半，分段求質量並比較原值，再說明若流量同步變動，使用兩個平均值相乘會有何偏差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double concentration in the first hour and halve it in the second, integrate mass and compare with the original case. Explain the bias from multiplying separate averages when discharge varies simultaneously.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以單一岸邊樣本代表全斷面會漏掉垂向與橫向濃度梯度；把輸入固體全當作永久沉積，也會忽略排出、再懸浮與密度壓密，使庫容損失估算偏離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One bank sample may miss vertical and lateral gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。檢查洪峰前後是否有遲滯，避免只採清水期而漏掉主要固體負荷。
knowledge.textEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Check rising and falling limbs for hysteresis so clear-water sampling does not miss the dominant solids load.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 假設濃度在第一小時加倍而第二小時減半，分段求質量並比較原值，再說明若流量同步變動，使用兩個平均值相乘會有何偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Double concentration in the first hour and halve it in the second, integrate mass and compare with the original case. Explain the bias from multiplying separate averages when discharge varies simultaneously.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含砂濃度與固體負荷」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sediment concentration and mass load"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
密度福祿數有適用所有取水口的固定允許值
同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Densimetric Froude number has one fixed permitted value for all intakes
Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration.
quiz.explanation: 同時採集斷面流量與混合代表水樣，以過濾乾燥法取得質量濃度，再用濁度建立有誤差範圍的輔助關係。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair cross-section discharge with representative composite samples, determine mass concentration by filtration and drying, and use turbidity only through an uncertain calibration. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

knowledge.textEn: One bank sample may miss vertical and lateral gradients. Treating all incoming solids as permanent deposition ignores passage, resuspension and compaction, so transported mass cannot directly establish lost reservoir volume.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Sediment concentration and mass load" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「原水保守溶質混合」如何影響翡翠水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conservative raw water mixing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Feitsui Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。這個概念能教導取水來源比例的重要性，但濁度、藻類與會反應的物質不一定線性混合，不能把保守示蹤物公式套到所有水質指標。 質量守恆以溶質通量為基礎，濃度本身不能直接相加；每股流量權重的總和必須等於一，混合濃度應介於兩來源之間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「原水保守溶質混合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator. Mass conservation applies to solute flux rather than concentration alone. Flow weights must sum to unity, and a conservative two-source blend should lie between the source concentrations when both flows are positive. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conservative raw water mixing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「原水保守溶質混合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conservative raw water mixing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 原水保守溶質混合
knowledge.text: 不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。這個概念能教導取水來源比例的重要性，但濁度、藻類與會反應的物質不一定線性混合，不能把保守示蹤物公式套到所有水質指標。
knowledge.textEn: A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. Turbidity, algae and reactive substances need not mix linearly, so the tracer equation is not a universal relationship for every water-quality indicator.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「原水保守溶質混合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conservative raw water mixing" is correct?
options: 兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均
不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。
名目停留時間就是每滴水完全相同的水齡
optionsEn: Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ
A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions.
Nominal residence time is the identical age of every water parcel
quiz.explanation: 不同深度原水混合後，保守溶質濃度由流量加權質量守恆求得。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A conservative dissolved constituent mixes according to flow-weighted mass balance, illustrating the importance of source proportions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「原水保守溶質混合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conservative raw water mixing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。適用邊界：充分混合、無反應的假想溶質，不表示濁度或飲用水合格限值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L. Applicable boundary: Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。適用邊界：充分混合、無反應的假想溶質，不表示濁度或飲用水合格限值。

Applicable boundary: Complete mixing of a hypothetical nonreactive solute, not turbidity or a drinking-water acceptance limit.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「原水保守溶質混合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conservative raw water mixing", which statement holds?
options: 一條力路變軟不會改變另一條力路的分力
單塊自由伸長必然等於接縫實際開口增量
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。

Free expansion of one block necessarily equals actual joint opening

quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q1=3 m3/s; C1=20 mg/L; Q2=2 m3/s; C2=50 mg/L; Cm=(Q1C1+Q2C2)/(Q1+Q2)=32 mg/L. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「原水保守溶質混合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conservative raw water mixing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。將預測值與出口樣本比較時，先補上停留時間，避免把不同水團的濃度直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance. Account for travel time before comparing predicted and measured concentrations so different water parcels are not subtracted as if simultaneous. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：維持總流量五立方公尺每秒，把較高濃度來源減至一立方公尺每秒，重算混合濃度並畫比例曲線，註明這只是保守溶質的教材。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep total flow at five cubic metres per second, reduce the higher-concentration source to one and recalculate the blend. Plot concentration against source fraction and label the conservative-solute assumption explicitly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying conservative mixing to turbidity can fail because particles flocculate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。將預測值與出口樣本比較時，先補上停留時間，避免把不同水團的濃度直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Use simultaneous source flows and concentrations to calculate input mass rate and confirm that the outlet sample follows sufficient mixing distance. Account for travel time before comparing predicted and measured concentrations so different water parcels are not subtracted as if simultaneous.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 維持總流量五立方公尺每秒，把較高濃度來源減至一立方公尺每秒，重算混合濃度並畫比例曲線，註明這只是保守溶質的教材。
knowledge.textEn: Keep total flow at five cubic metres per second, reduce the higher-concentration source to one and recalculate the blend. Plot concentration against source fraction and label the conservative-solute assumption explicitly.

quiz.question: 要驗證「原水保守溶質混合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conservative raw water mixing"?
options: 以相同時段的兩股來源流量及濃度求輸入質量率，核對混合後取樣位置已有足夠混合距離。

steps.title: 原水保守溶質混合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conservative raw water mixing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「原水保守溶質混合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conservative raw water mixing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 拿濁度直接做保守濃度混合可能因顆粒絮凝而失準；若取樣位置尚未混勻，單點量值會偏向某股來源，即使整體質量守恆正確仍看似不符合公式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying conservative mixing to turbidity can fail because particles flocculate. Before complete mixing, a single sample may favor one source, appearing to violate the equation even when the overall mass balance is correct. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：質量守恆以溶質通量為基礎，濃度本身不能直接相加；每股流量權重的總和必須等於一，混合濃度應介於兩來源之間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Flow weights must sum to unity, and a conservative two-source blend should lie between the source concentrations when both flows are positive.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩股流量不同時仍可把濃度直接取算術平均」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two concentrations can be averaged arithmetically even when source flows differ" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 石門水庫大壩
courses.summary: 石門課程從中央心層、濾層、壓實與孔隙水壓開始，再把排砂、分層取水及後池調節納入水量與固體質量帳。學生練習區分土的乾密度與濕密度、濁度與含砂質量濃度，以及排水量上升與內部侵蝕證據。假想地震水平力只用於理解受力，不能替代滑動面或動力分析。
courses.summaryEn: The Shihmen course begins with core zoning, filters, compaction and pore pressure, then brings sediment outlets, selective withdrawal and afterbay buffering into water and solids balances. Learners separate dry from wet density, turbidity from sediment mass concentration, and rising drainage from evidence of erosion. Hypothetical seismic inertia illustrates force bookkeeping without replacing slip-surface or dynamic analysis.
courses.focus: 中央心層土石壩與排砂取水協作
courses.focusEn: Central core embankments with sediment and withdrawal functions

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想兩層心層厚度各十公尺，滲透係數分別為一乘十的負七次方及五乘十的負八次方公尺每秒，串聯等效係數為六點六六七乘十的負八次方公尺每秒。水頭差三十公尺、截面一千平方公尺時，流量為零點零零零一立方公尺每秒；若低滲透層係數加倍，流量增至零點零零零一五。另以濕密度每立方公尺二千一百公斤及含水率百分之十二得乾密度一千八百七十五公斤每立方公尺，兩個計算不能替代現地壓實曲線與排水觀測。 核驗：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
workedExample.textEn: Assume two core layers, each 10 m thick, with permeability values of 1e-7 and 5e-8 m/s. Series resistance gives an equivalent permeability of 6.667e-8 m/s. Across 30 m of head and 1000 m2 of area, flow is 0.0001 m3/s. Doubling the less permeable layer value raises flow to 0.00015 m3/s. Separately, wet density 2100 kg/m3 and gravimetric water content 0.12 imply dry density 1875 kg/m3. These results illustrate different material properties and cannot replace a compaction curve, zoning checks or drainage observations. Verification: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分層心層的串聯滲流」與「濾層粒徑比例篩查」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Series seepage through core layers" and "Filter gradation ratio screening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層心層的串聯滲流」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Series seepage through core layers” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。這與平行流路的算術平均不同，也不能把分層公式套到裂縫形成的集中流，因為後者改變流路與有效截面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層心層的串聯滲流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability. The least permeable layer can dominate resistance. This differs from parallel-path averaging and does not describe a crack carrying concentrated flow, because that feature changes both geometry and the effective flow area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Series seepage through core layers” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分層心層的串聯滲流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Series seepage through core layers”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流
knowledge.text: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。等效滲透係數因此是厚度加權的調和平均，較不透水的一層可能支配阻力。
knowledge.textEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. Layers arranged along the flow direction carry the same discharge but consume different head losses, giving a thickness-weighted harmonic equivalent permeability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Series seepage through core layers" is correct?
options: 沿流向串聯材料的係數應直接取算術平均
中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。
只要一個粒徑比值很小就可保證濾層合格
optionsEn: Permeabilities of layers in series should simply be averaged arithmetically
A central core limits flow with low-permeability material.
A sufficiently small single grain-size ratio guarantees filter acceptance
quiz.explanation: 中央心層靠低滲透材料限制穿壩水量，不同材料沿流向排列時，每層通過相同流量但消耗不同水頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A central core limits flow with low-permeability material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分層心層的串聯滲流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Series seepage through core layers” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和一維達西流、材料均勻無裂縫，截面固定且無側向逸流。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated one-dimensional Darcy flow through uniform uncracked materials with constant area and no lateral escape.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分層心層的串聯滲流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Series seepage through core layers", which statement holds?
options: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。
optionsEn: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L1=10 m; k1=1e-7 m/s; L2=10 m; k2=5e-8 m/s; A=1000 m2; dh=30 m; Q=A dh/(L1/k1+L2/k2)=0.0001 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Series seepage through core layers” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩層係數直接平均會低估低滲透層的控制作用；但若低滲透層已有裂縫，仍堅持完整材料模型又會低估集中流量，兩種錯誤方向並不相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Arithmetic averaging underestimates control by the less permeable layer. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。核對室內試體方向與現地壓實方向是否一致，保留溫度與飽和程度，並以排水量獨立檢查總流量而非只信等效係數。
knowledge.textEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Match laboratory specimen orientation to field compaction, retain temperature and saturation information, and use measured drainage as an independent check on total flow.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把第二層滲透係數加倍，重新求流量與兩層水頭分配，再將層厚互換比較，說明為何幾何與材料阻力必須一起記錄而不能只報一個平均係數。
knowledge.textEn: Double the second permeability, recalculate discharge and head distribution, then interchange layer thicknesses. Explain why geometry and material resistance must be reported together rather than reduced to an unexplained average coefficient.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層心層的串聯滲流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Series seepage through core layers"?
options: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多
optionsEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
quiz.explanation: 以分層測壓點比較各層水頭損失，再用同一流量反算阻力比例。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare head losses across layers using piezometers and infer their resistance ratio from a common discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分層心層的串聯滲流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Series seepage through core layers: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分層心層的串聯滲流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Series seepage through core layers” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.instruction: 心層旁的濾層既要容許水排出，也要阻止細料隨流失去。粒徑分位數比例可作初步相容性討論，但其物理目的與材料分布形狀都要清楚。單一比例沒有描述間斷級配、塑性細料或施工離析，因此本課只計算幾何比值，不提供通用驗收門檻或取代專門濾層試驗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾層粒徑比例篩查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 濾層粒徑比例篩查：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter gradation ratio screening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8。適用邊界：粒徑均為重量通過百分比的同單位數據，只作比值計算，不宣告材料合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: D15filter=0.7 mm; d85base=0.25 mm; ratio=D15filter/d85base=2.8. Applicable boundary: Both percentiles use the same size unit and mass-passing convention; this is a ratio calculation, not material acceptance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：繪完整粒徑曲線並標明取樣位置，確認百分之十五與八十五是通過率而非留置率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Plot the complete gradation and sampling locations, confirming that fifteen and eighty-five percent denote passing rather than retained mass. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.explanation: 把通過率與留置率顛倒會選錯粒徑；以一個看似漂亮的比值掩蓋施工離析，可能讓局部濾層過粗而失去保土功能，即使整體樣本仍維持原級配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reversing passing and retained percentages selects the wrong sizes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含水率與壓實乾密度」與「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water content and compacted density" and "Drawdown and pore pressure lag": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水率與壓實乾密度」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water content and compacted density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水率與壓實乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. Gravimetric water content, defined relative to dry solids, converts wet density to dry density for comparing the solid skeleton. Even equal dry density does not ensure equal permeability, since composition, moisture condition, compactive effort and particle arrangement may still differ substantially between specimens or placed layers. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water content and compacted density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水率與壓實乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water content and compacted density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度
knowledge.text: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。以水重除乾土重定義的含水率可將濕密度換成乾密度，才便於比較固體骨架壓實程度。
knowledge.textEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. Gravimetric water content, defined relative to dry solids, converts wet density to dry density for comparing the solid skeleton.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水率與壓實乾密度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water content and compacted density" is correct?
options: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。
含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式
庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
optionsEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water.
Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion
Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
quiz.explanation: 土石壩施工控制不能只看每立方公尺濕土多重，因為其中一部分是水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wet bulk density alone cannot describe embankment compaction because part of the measured mass is water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水率與壓實乾密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water content and compacted density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。適用邊界：含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Applicable boundary: Water content uses dry-solid mass and density uses the original wet specimen volume, without oversize correction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。適用邊界：含水率以乾土質量為分母，體積為原濕試體體積，無超粒徑修正。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Applicable boundary: Water content uses dry-solid mass and density uses the original wet specimen volume, without oversize correction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水率與壓實乾密度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water content and compacted density", which statement holds?
options: 入庫泥砂總質量全部等於當期永久庫容損失
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。
只要放流水量大就能保證排出的泥砂很多
optionsEn: All incoming sediment mass equals permanent capacity loss in that period
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3.
A large water release guarantees a large exported sediment mass
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rhoWet=2100 kg/m3; w=0.12 kg/kg; rhoDry=rhoWet/(1+w)=1875 kg/m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水率與壓實乾密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water content and compacted density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。以重複試體檢查體積量測偏差，並把現地乾密度與相同材料、相同試驗能量的壓實曲線比較，避免跨材料誤比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Use replicate specimens to assess volume error and compare field dry density with a compaction curve for the same material and test effort rather than a different soil. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定濕密度，分別用含水率百分之八與十六計算乾密度，畫出關係並說明這條換算曲線為何不是實際材料的壓實最佳含水率曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed wet density, calculate dry density for eight and sixteen percent water contents. Plot the conversion and explain why it is not the material's experimental optimum-moisture compaction curve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。以重複試體檢查體積量測偏差，並把現地乾密度與相同材料、相同試驗能量的壓實曲線比較，避免跨材料誤比。
knowledge.textEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Use replicate specimens to assess volume error and compare field dry density with a compaction curve for the same material and test effort rather than a different soil.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定濕密度，分別用含水率百分之八與十六計算乾密度，畫出關係並說明這條換算曲線為何不是實際材料的壓實最佳含水率曲線。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed wet density, calculate dry density for eight and sixteen percent water contents. Plot the conversion and explain why it is not the material's experimental optimum-moisture compaction curve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水率與壓實乾密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water content and compacted density"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
排水量降低一定表示壩內滲流風險下降
核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Lower measured drainage always means reduced internal seepage risk
Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation.
quiz.explanation: 核對濕樣、乾樣與容器重量紀錄，將百分率轉成無因次小數後再換算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check wet, dry and container masses, converting percentage to a dimensionless fraction before calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水率與壓實乾密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water content and compacted density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水率與壓實乾密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water content and compacted density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Using wet mass as the water-content denominator while retaining this equation creates a systematic definition error in otherwise precise-looking records. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相同乾密度也不代表相同滲透性，因為土的組成、含水狀態、壓實能量與顆粒排列仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Even equal dry density does not ensure equal permeability, since composition, moisture condition, compactive effort and particle arrangement may still differ substantially between specimens or placed layers.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「含水率百分之十二可直接以十二代入換算式」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Twelve percent water content can be entered as twelve in the conversion" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Using wet mass as the water-content denominator while retaining this equation creates a systematic definition error in otherwise precise-looking records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水率與壓實乾密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water content and compacted density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把百分之十二直接代入十二會得到不合理低密度；若以濕土質量當含水率分母卻仍用此式，也會系統性偏差，使壓實紀錄看似精確但定義不一致。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
optionsEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.

quiz.explanationEn: Entering twelve instead of zero point one two produces an implausible low density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」如何影響石門水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shihmen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. Effective normal force illustrates how retained pressure changes the source of friction. A true rapid-drawdown assessment also requires drainage timescale, appropriate soil strength and slip geometry; a single force calculation cannot establish stability or represent the entire upstream slope during rapidly changing hydraulic and drainage conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drawdown and pore pressure lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後
knowledge.text: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。有效正向力計算能展示孔壓滯後對摩擦來源的影響；真正快速降水位問題還需土體不排水強度、滲流時程及滑動幾何，不能僅用一個力值定安全。
knowledge.textEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. Effective normal force illustrates how retained pressure changes the source of friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawdown and pore pressure lag" is correct?
options: 庫水位下降時土內孔壓一定立即等幅下降
水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。
等效水平力計算完成就能排除地震永久變形
optionsEn: Internal pore pressure always falls immediately by the same amount as reservoir level
Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly.
Calculating equivalent horizontal force rules out permanent seismic deformation
quiz.explanation: 水庫水位下降會減少上游坡面外側水壓，但心層與土體內孔壓未必同速消散，造成內外支撐條件改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Falling reservoir level reduces external water support while pore pressure within embankment material may dissipate more slowly. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 快速降水位與孔壓滯後：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown and pore pressure lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown and pore pressure lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。適用邊界：假想單一面上總法向力與均勻孔壓，未計滑動面需求或外水力矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步繪製庫水位與坡內測壓管歷線，比較峰值及回落的時間差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot reservoir level and slope piezometer histories together to compare peak and recession timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN. Applicable boundary: A hypothetical plane with total normal force and uniform pore pressure; slip demand and external-water moments are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「快速降水位與孔壓滯後」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawdown and pore pressure lag", which statement holds?
options: 孔口流量與水頭成正比而不是平方根關係
每次脈衝都可以重新使用整座後池總容量
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN。
optionsEn: Orifice discharge is proportional to head rather than its square root
Every new pulse can reuse the entire gross afterbay capacity
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: N=900 kN; u=45 kPa; A=12 m2; Neff=N-uA=360 kN.
