steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「梯級發電的能量相加」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy addition across a cascade” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。以各級電表與同時段流量比對，將中間蓄水變化另外入帳，再核對總電能沒有超過共同水流的可用位能。
knowledge.textEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Compare stage electrical meters with synchronized flow, account separately for intermediate storage and verify that total energy stays below the water's available potential.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將第二級效率降至零點八，重算總功率與差額，再設中間暫存使第二級流量少三立方公尺每秒，分開求能量與蓄量變化而不混算。
knowledge.textEn: Lower second-stage efficiency to zero point eight and recalculate total power. Then reduce its flow by three cubic metres per second through intermediate storage, calculating energy and storage changes in separate accounts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「梯級發電的能量相加」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy addition across a cascade"?
options: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速
optionsEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe
quiz.explanation: 分別畫每級進出口能量線，檢查中間尾水是否也是下一級上游基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw inlet and outlet energy lines for each stage and check how intermediate tailwater connects to the next inlet. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 梯級發電的能量相加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy addition across a cascade: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「梯級發電的能量相加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy addition across a cascade” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若中間有旁通、蓄水或取水，各級流量也未必相同，能量帳必須跟著水量控制體分段，並保留尾水與上游基準高程。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bypass, storage and withdrawals can also make stage flows differ, requiring separate water accounts and explicit upstream and tailwater elevation references.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Assuming immediate equal flow while an intermediate reservoir is storing water also shifts generation to the wrong time and breaks hourly accounting.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「梯級發電的能量相加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy addition across a cascade" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。
壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice.
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
quiz.explanation: 把兩級流量相加後再乘總水頭會重複計入同一水體；若中間水庫正在蓄水卻仍假設流量立即一致，則會錯配發電時間，讓逐時能量帳失去守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding serial discharges and multiplying by combined head counts the same water twice. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高壩底壓與水推力」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Base pressure and water resultant” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高壩底壓與水推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared. Pressure is force per area, whereas the resultant enters overall equilibrium. Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Base pressure and water resultant” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高壩底壓與水推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Base pressure and water resultant”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高壩底壓與水推力
knowledge.text: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。壓力的單位是力除面積，而合力才可進入整體受力平衡。
knowledge.textEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. Bottom hydrostatic pressure increases linearly with depth, while force on a fixed-width projection grows with depth squared.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Base pressure and water resultant" is correct?
options: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。
optionsEn: Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force.
quiz.explanation: 德基高拱壩背景可用來區分局部壓力與整體水推力：底部靜水壓隨水深一次增加，但固定寬度投影上的合力隨深度平方增加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A high arch dam illustrates the difference between local pressure and integrated water force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高壩底壓與水推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Base pressure and water resultant” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。適用邊界：靜止淡水的表壓，水深為假想值而非公開壩高或當前水位。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Applicable boundary: Gauge pressure in still fresh water, with hypothetical depth rather than dam height or current reservoir level.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高壩底壓與水推力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Base pressure and water resultant", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。
跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa.
Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; H=140 m; pbase=rho g H/1e6=1.3734 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Base pressure and water resultant” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。核對壓力感測器是絕對壓還是表壓，並將安裝高程與水面高程分開記錄，避免基準錯置。
knowledge.textEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Identify absolute versus gauge pressure sensors and record installation and water-surface elevations separately to prevent datum errors.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把假想水深降至一百二十公尺，分別求底壓倍率與同寬合力倍率，再說明為何不能以壓力變化百分比直接代表整體水推力變化。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce hypothetical depth to one hundred twenty metres, calculate bottom-pressure and fixed-width force ratios, and explain why the percentage pressure change cannot directly represent the change in total water thrust.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高壩底壓與水推力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Base pressure and water resultant"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。
只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units.
A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation
quiz.explanation: 用壓力三角形區分底壓與平均壓，再選一個投影寬度求合力以確認單位不同。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a pressure triangle to separate bottom and mean pressures, then select a projected width to obtain force and check units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高壩底壓與水推力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Base pressure and water resultant: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高壩底壓與水推力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Base pressure and water resultant” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：水深應由自由水面量到計算點，不能直接把壩高當成每一時刻的有效水深，也不能忽略尾水反壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Depth is measured from the free surface to the point, not automatically equated with structural height, and downstream counterpressure must be considered when relevant.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Treating a megapascal value as meganewtons omits area and confuses quantities that may look numerically similar but have different physical meanings.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.questionEn: When "Base pressure and water resultant" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
直接拿一百八十公尺壩高代入每次水壓計算會忽略實際水位；把兆帕數字當作兆牛頓則漏掉面積，讓看似相近的數字實際代表完全不同的物理量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.

Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level.

quiz.explanationEn: Substituting structural height for every pressure calculation ignores changing water level. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」與「濃密入流的底流尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential abutment movement scale" and "Density underflow velocity scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential abutment movement scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential abutment movement scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱壩兩岸共同平移與兩岸相對位移有不同結構意義，後者才會改變跨距或扭曲形狀。以相對位移除基準長度可得到平均幾何應變，便於比較監測量級；這不是局部混凝土應變，也沒有包含支承轉角。儀器的共同基準若一起移動，可能掩蓋絕對運動卻仍保留部分相對量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「兩岸差異位移的應變尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Common translation of both abutments differs from relative movement, which can change span or distort the arch. Relative displacement divided by reference length gives an average geometric strain useful for comparing measurement scales, not local concrete strain and not support rotation. Movement of a shared instrument reference may hide absolute motion while leaving some relative measurements intact, so reference geometry belongs in the interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential abutment movement scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 拱壩兩岸共同平移與兩岸相對位移有不同結構意義，後者才會改變跨距或扭曲形狀。以相對位移除基準長度可得到平均幾何應變，便於比較監測量級；這不是局部混凝土應變，也沒有包含支承轉角。
knowledge.textEn: Common translation of both abutments differs from relative movement, which can change span or distort the arch. Relative displacement divided by reference length gives an average geometric strain useful for comparing measurement scales, not local concrete strain and not support rotation.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002。適用邊界：兩位移為沿原跨距連線方向的軸向投影，採小變形及同一穩定基準，只求跨距平均正應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: uR=5 mm; uL=1 mm; L=200 m; eps=(uR-uL)/1000/L=0.00002. Applicable boundary: Both movements are axial projections along the original span line, using small deformation and one stable datum; only span-average normal strain is calculated. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 兩岸差異位移的應變尺度：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 先將左右岸位移投影到原跨距連線軸線並確認小變形假設，再扣除共同平移量，確認毫米與公尺已轉換。以外部穩定測點閉合測量網，另記旋轉與垂直位移，避免一個水平差值被誤認為完整岩盤變形。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Project both movements onto the original span axis and verify the small-deformation assumption, remove common translation and convert millimetres to metres. Close the survey network against external stable points while separately recording rotation and vertical motion, so one horizontal difference is not treated as complete rock deformation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add three millimetres of common translation to both sides and compare relative strain with absolute movement. Then introduce support rotation and explain why one span-average strain cannot describe the added deformation mode.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把左右岸位移絕對值相加而不看方向，可能把共同平移誤認為跨距改變；若基準點位於同一移動岩塊上，則可能得到很小差值而漏掉整體位移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding absolute movement magnitudes without direction can turn common translation into apparent span change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density underflow velocity scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 含砂較多的入流水可能比庫水密度大，沿底部向前推進形成密度流。以密度差定義約化重力，再與流層厚度組合可估算浮力控制的速度尺度。這個尺度不是底流實際速度，因為坡度、摩擦、混合與顆粒沉降都會改變流體密度及厚度，沿途不一定維持同一狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濃密入流的底流尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s。適用邊界：小密度差的特徵速度，未選經驗福祿係數或推定真實底流到達時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: g=9.81 m/s2; drho=4 kg/m3; rho=1000 kg/m3; h=3 m; U=sqrt(g drho h/rho)=0.34310 m/s. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 濃密入流的底流尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Density underflow velocity scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濃密入流的底流尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density underflow velocity scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測入口與庫內不同深度的密度或含砂剖面，將溫度造成的密度差也分開。以多個測站到達時間估算傳播，對照流層厚度變化，檢查沿途混合是否讓原先密度差逐漸減弱。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure density or sediment profiles at the inlet and several reservoir depths while separating temperature contributions. Estimate propagation from arrival times at multiple stations and compare changing current thickness to determine whether entrainment weakens the original density contrast. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把流層厚度加倍而密度差減半，重算速度尺度並解釋為何數值可能不變，但兩個流場的混合、沉降與幾何條件仍然不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double thickness while halving density contrast, recalculate the velocity scale and explain why its value may stay unchanged even though mixing, settling and geometric conditions differ between the two currents.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Holding inlet density contrast constant throughout the reservoir neglects entrainment and settling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 濃密入流的底流尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density underflow velocity scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濃密入流的底流尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density underflow velocity scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把入口密度差維持到整個水庫會忽略摻混與沉降；若直接用特徵速度除距離宣告準確到達時間，則把未包含的地形與阻力誤當不存在，造成錯誤預報信心。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Holding inlet density contrast constant throughout the reservoir neglects entrainment and settling. Turning a velocity scale into a precise arrival forecast also treats omitted topography and resistance as absent rather than unresolved. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這個尺度不是底流實際速度，因為坡度、摩擦、混合與顆粒沉降都會改變流體密度及厚度，沿途不一定維持同一狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not the actual underflow speed, because slope, friction, entrainment and particle settling alter density and thickness as the current advances, so conditions need not remain constant along the irregular reservoir floor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮力速度尺度就是可直接預報的真實底流速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The buoyancy velocity scale directly predicts the actual underflow speed" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.instructionEn: Interbasin diversion adds water that actually crosses a boundary, not all rainfall over the source catchment. steps.title: 越域引水的獨立水量帳：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「越域引水的獨立水量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Separate diversion water accounting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將引水兩端資料依旅行時間對齊，核對水表累積值的起迄時刻，並把中間暫存單獨列出。對來源河川保留未引走流量，目的水庫只入帳實際收到的水，避免用設計流量代替量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align diversion endpoint records for travel time, check cumulative-meter interval boundaries and account for intermediate storage. Retain undiverted flow in the source-river balance and credit the destination only with water received, not nominal design discharge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把引入水量減半，重新求日蓄量變化，再列出源頭及目的地兩本水量帳，證明對整個系統而言內部轉水應相互抵銷而不是創造新水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve imported water and recalculate daily storage change. Write separate source and destination accounts and show that an internal transfer cancels in the combined system instead of creating additional water.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：來源流量、引水量與目的地入流同時相加會把轉送水重複計算；用設計輸水能力乘整日時間也可能高估實際供水，因為水源不足或停機會改變可送水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding source flow, diversion flow and destination inflow together duplicates transferred water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Separate diversion water accounting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 來源流量、引水量與目的地入流同時相加會把轉送水重複計算；用設計輸水能力乘整日時間也可能高估實際供水，因為水源不足或停機會改變可送水量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding source flow, diversion flow and destination inflow together duplicates transferred water. Multiplying design capacity by a whole day can overstate delivery when source scarcity or outages limit the quantity actually conveyed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若隧道或中間池有暫存，兩端同時刻流量也可能不一致，需在更小控制體補上蓄量項。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Storage in a tunnel or intermediate pool can make simultaneous endpoint flows differ, requiring an additional storage term in the smaller control volume rather than an unexplained balance error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 局部低壓與汽化裕度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「局部低壓與汽化裕度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local pressure and cavitation index” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高速出流區的壓力若接近該水溫的蒸氣壓，可能產生汽化空穴，後續在高壓區潰滅造成侵蝕。氣蝕指數把絕對壓力超過蒸氣壓的差額除以動壓，提供相對尺度；各種幾何具有不同臨界條件，指數本身不能直接宣告安全，更不能把表壓與絕對蒸氣壓混用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部低壓與汽化裕度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: If local pressure approaches vapor pressure at the water temperature, cavities can form and later collapse in a higher-pressure region. A cavitation index divides the absolute-pressure margin above vapor pressure by dynamic pressure. It provides a relative scale, not a universal safe threshold, because critical behavior depends on geometry. Gauge pressure must not be mixed with absolute vapor pressure in the numerator. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local pressure and cavitation index” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gauge pressure can directly subtract absolute vapor pressure in a cavitation index" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部低壓與汽化裕度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 核對壓力儀表是否已加大氣壓，並記錄水溫以選對蒸氣壓。以局部速度而非管道平均值估算動壓，對照表面形狀與脈動資料，將氣蝕、磨蝕及化學侵蝕的證據分開檢查。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm whether atmospheric pressure has been included and record water temperature for vapor pressure. Use local rather than blindly averaged velocity, compare geometry and pressure fluctuations, and distinguish evidence of cavitation from abrasion and chemical deterioration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持局部壓力不變，把速度提高百分之十，重算指數並說明平方速度的影響，再列出真實流場中壓力也可能同步改變的原因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold local pressure fixed, increase velocity ten percent and recalculate the index. Explain the squared-velocity effect and identify reasons why pressure itself may change simultaneously in a real flow field.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部低壓與汽化裕度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local pressure and cavitation index"?

steps.title: 局部低壓與汽化裕度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local pressure and cavitation index: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部低壓與汽化裕度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local pressure and cavitation index” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Equal average indices can still accompany different local accelerations and pressure fluctuations around surface irregularities, so one mean value cannot exclude local cavitation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣蝕指數把絕對壓力超過蒸氣壓的差額除以動壓，提供相對尺度；各種幾何具有不同臨界條件，指數本身不能直接宣告安全，更不能把表壓與絕對蒸氣壓混用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gauge pressure must not be mixed with absolute vapor pressure in the numerator.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表壓可以直接減去絕對蒸氣壓來算氣蝕指數」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gauge pressure can directly subtract absolute vapor pressure in a cavitation index" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Equal average indices can still accompany different local accelerations and pressure fluctuations around surface irregularities, so one mean value cannot exclude local cavitation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部低壓與汽化裕度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local pressure and cavitation index" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 把表壓代替絕對壓力會嚴重改變裕度；即使平均指數相同，表面突起引起的局部加速與壓力脈動仍可能不同，因此不能用單一平均數排除局部氣蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Substituting gauge for absolute pressure substantially changes the margin. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼管環向拉應力」與「壓力波往返時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel pipe hoop tension" and "Pressure wave round trip time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管環向拉應力」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel pipe hoop tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。薄壁圓管可由切開半圓截面的平衡推得壓力乘半徑除壁厚的平均環向應力。壁厚相對半徑必須小，且此式不包含焊縫缺陷、腐蝕減薄、支承彎曲或壓力循環疲勞。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼管環向拉應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. Cutting a thin circular pipe into halves gives mean hoop stress as pressure times radius divided by wall thickness. Thickness must be small relative to radius, and the relation excludes weld defects, corrosion loss, support bending and fatigue caused by repeated pressure cycles. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel pipe hoop tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼管環向拉應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steel pipe hoop tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼管環向拉應力
knowledge.text: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。薄壁圓管可由切開半圓截面的平衡推得壓力乘半徑除壁厚的平均環向應力。
knowledge.textEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. Cutting a thin circular pipe into halves gives mean hoop stress as pressure times radius divided by wall thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼管環向拉應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel pipe hoop tension" is correct?
options: 受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。
壓力波傳播速度就是管內水的平均流速
optionsEn: A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch.
Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe
quiz.explanation: 高水頭輸水鋼管承受內壓而產生環向拉力，與拱壩把外水壓轉為壓縮的受力方向不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal pressure creates hoop tension in a steel water conduit, unlike the compression associated with external loading on an arch. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼管環向拉應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel pipe hoop tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。適用邊界：薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Applicable boundary: Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Independently derive the relation from pressure on a half-pipe projection balanced by two tensile sections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。適用邊界：薄壁圓管膜拉應力，厚半徑比為零點零一六七，不含軸力與局部缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Applicable boundary: Thin circular pipe membrane tension with thickness-radius ratio about 0.0167, excluding axial force and local defects.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼管環向拉應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel pipe hoop tension", which statement holds?
options: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失
壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。
optionsEn: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently
Structural dam height is the hydrostatic depth at every reservoir level
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: p=2 MPa; r=1.2 m; t=0.02 m; sigmaHoop=p r/t=120 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 鋼管環向拉應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel pipe hoop tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管環向拉應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel pipe hoop tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。檢查量測位置、焊縫與支承附近是否需局部分析，並把壓力最高值與疲勞循環範圍分開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Independently derive the relation from pressure on a half-pipe projection balanced by two tensile sections. Compare using measured minimum rather than nominal thickness, identify weld and support regions needing local analysis, and separate peak pressure from fatigue-cycle range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把有效壁厚降到十六毫米，重算環向應力並求增加百分比，再討論局部點蝕為何不能只用平均厚度減少量代表其應力集中。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce effective thickness to sixteen millimetres, recalculate hoop stress and percentage increase, then explain why localized pitting cannot be represented solely by a uniform reduction in average wall thickness.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用名目厚度而忽略局部腐蝕會低估應力；把這個受拉管壁公式解讀成拱壩受壓驗證，雖形式相似卻混淆不同邊界與失效機制，不能互相替代。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring local corrosion while using nominal thickness understates stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用半圓管兩側拉力平衡投影水壓獨立推導，再以實測最小壁厚而非名目厚度比較。檢查量測位置、焊縫與支承附近是否需局部分析，並把壓力最高值與疲勞循環範圍分開。

steps.title: 壓力波往返時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure wave round trip time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 瞬變分析先要知道壓力訊息在水路中的傳播尺度，往返時間由兩倍管長除波速得到。它不是水粒子通過管線所需時間，也不是機組旋轉週期。把假想流量變化時間與往返時間比較，可判斷反射是否會在變化過程中返回，但多分支、調壓室及氣穴會使單管圖像需要擴充。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力波往返時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Transient interpretation starts with the time for a pressure signal to travel through the waterway and return, equal to twice length divided by wave speed. This is neither water-particle travel time nor machine rotation period. Comparing a hypothetical flow-change duration with this scale reveals whether reflections return during the change, while branches, surge chambers and cavities require more than the single-pipe picture. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure wave round trip time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure-wave speed equals the mean velocity of water in the pipe" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 壓力波往返時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure wave round trip time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力波往返時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure wave round trip time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s。適用邊界：單一均勻管段且波速固定，只計傳播時間而非瞬變壓力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: L=1200 m; a=800 m/s; tr=2L/a=3 s. Applicable boundary: A single uniform pipe segment with constant wave speed; propagation time only, not transient pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從兩支壓力感測器波峰的時間差估算波速，確認取樣時鐘同步並保留量測距離。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate wave speed from peak arrival differences at two synchronized pressure sensors with a known separation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均流速代替波速會把秒級訊息傳播誤算成很長的旅行時間；只因變化時間大於往返時間就宣告沒有水錘，也忽略反射疊加及邊界條件可能仍產生瞬變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「地震記錄的取樣尺度」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling scale for seismic records” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 地震感測器輸出若以離散時間記錄，取樣率決定可辨識的頻率上限。理想奈奎斯特條件要求取樣頻率超過最高訊號頻率兩倍，但實務還要抗混疊濾波及保留相位精度。高取樣率不能補救飽和、感測器安裝鬆動或時鐘不同步，所以監測鏈須從物理感測到資料處理一起檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地震記錄的取樣尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete earthquake records can resolve only a limited frequency range set by sampling rate. The ideal Nyquist condition requires sampling above twice the highest signal frequency, while practical systems also need anti-alias filtering and adequate phase accuracy. High sampling alone cannot repair sensor saturation, loose mounting or unsynchronized clocks, so the full chain from physical sensing to data processing must be examined as one measurement system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling scale for seismic records” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A high sampling rate can recover peaks already clipped by sensor saturation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling scale for seismic records”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要取樣率高就可以恢復感測器已飽和的峰值 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「地震記錄的取樣尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling scale for seismic records: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling scale for seismic records” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。適用邊界：理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz. Applicable boundary: Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知頻率訊號做桌上資料實驗，逐步降取樣觀察假頻率，保留抗混疊濾波前後紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a known-frequency signal in a desktop experiment, downsample progressively and observe apparent frequencies while preserving before-and-after filter records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz。適用邊界：理想均勻取樣的奈奎斯特上限，實用通帶需低於此值並配濾波。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz. Applicable boundary: Nyquist limit for ideal uniform sampling; practical passband must lie below it with suitable filtering.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地震記錄的取樣尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 壩高就是任何水位下都應使用的靜水深度

Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: fs=200 sample/s; fNyquist=fs/2=100 Hz.

steps.title: 地震記錄的取樣尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling scale for seismic records: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地震記錄的取樣尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling scale for seismic records” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知頻率訊號做桌上資料實驗，逐步降取樣觀察假頻率，保留抗混疊濾波前後紀錄。同步檢查滿量程、安裝方向與時鐘漂移，不能只看檔案每秒筆數就判定地震資料品質。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a known-frequency signal in a desktop experiment, downsample progressively and observe apparent frequencies while preserving before-and-after filter records. Check full scale, mounting orientation and clock drift rather than judging earthquake data quality solely by samples per second. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：產生一個七十赫茲正弦波，分別以二百與一百赫茲取樣並比較表觀頻率，說明抗混疊濾波需在何時介入，以及這個實驗不代表實際壩體頻率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Generate a seventy-hertz sinusoid, sample at two hundred and one hundred hertz and compare apparent frequencies. Explain when anti-alias filtering must intervene and why this experiment does not identify a real dam vibration frequency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未濾掉高頻就降取樣會把高頻折返成假低頻，可能誤認壩體出現新的振動模態；若感測器早已飽和，即使取樣率很高也無法重建被削平的真實峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Downsampling without removing high frequencies aliases them into false lower frequencies that may resemble a new vibration mode. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停機發電量與留存水量」如何影響德基水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outage energy and retained water” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deji Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。德基梯級背景的停機帳應同時追蹤水量，避免把短期延後發電誤稱永久損失。若水位因留存上升，後續淨水頭也可能變動，使固定功率估計只是一階比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停機發電量與留存水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. A cascade outage account must therefore follow water as well as electricity, distinguishing delayed generation from permanent loss. Retained water may change level and subsequent net head, making constant-power multiplication only a first-order comparison. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outage energy and retained water” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停機發電量與留存水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Outage energy and retained water”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停機發電量與留存水量
knowledge.text: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。德基梯級背景的停機帳應同時追蹤水量，避免把短期延後發電誤稱永久損失。
knowledge.textEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. A cascade outage account must therefore follow water as well as electricity, distinguishing delayed generation from permanent loss.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「停機發電量與留存水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage energy and retained water" is correct?
options: 停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失
機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。
串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭
optionsEn: All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently
Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later.
Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
quiz.explanation: 機組停機少發的電能可以用原可用功率乘時段估算，但水不會因此消失，可能留在水庫、改道或後續使用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Energy not generated during an outage can be estimated from otherwise available power times duration, but the water remains in storage, is bypassed or is used later. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停機發電量與留存水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outage energy and retained water” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。適用邊界：固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Applicable boundary: Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。適用邊界：固定假想可用功率，僅計停機時段少發電量，不宣稱全部永遠損失。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Applicable boundary: Constant hypothetical available power; energy absent during the outage only, not necessarily permanently lost.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「停機發電量與留存水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage energy and retained water", which statement holds?
options: 兩岸同向等量平移必然造成跨距增加
跨流域水量可在來源與目的地總帳各算一次供水
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。
optionsEn: Equal translation of both abutments in one direction necessarily increases span
Transferred water may count as new system supply at both source and destination
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Pavailable=36 MW; dt=5 h; Edeferred=Pavailable dt=180 MWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停機發電量與留存水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outage energy and retained water” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。對後續補發只計實際新增能量，避免把原本就會發出的基線電量重複列為恢復。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Count only genuinely additional later generation as recovery, avoiding credit for baseline energy that would have been produced anyway. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設一半留水能於後續以相同淨水頭利用，求可補回能量，再改變後續效率做敏感度分析，清楚區分延後電量、旁通損失與未知部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Assume half the retained water is later used at the same net head, calculate recoverable energy and vary subsequent efficiency. Distinguish deferred generation, bypass loss and unresolved quantities in the final account.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。對後續補發只計實際新增能量，避免把原本就會發出的基線電量重複列為恢復。
knowledge.textEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Count only genuinely additional later generation as recovery, avoiding credit for baseline energy that would have been produced anyway.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 假設一半留水能於後續以相同淨水頭利用，求可補回能量，再改變後續效率做敏感度分析，清楚區分延後電量、旁通損失與未知部分。
knowledge.textEn: Assume half the retained water is later used at the same net head, calculate recoverable energy and vary subsequent efficiency. Distinguish deferred generation, bypass loss and unresolved quantities in the final account.

quiz.question: 要驗證「停機發電量與留存水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage energy and retained water"?
options: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
受拉薄壁管公式可直接證明受壓拱壩安全
optionsEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A tensile thin-pipe equation directly proves the safety of a compressed arch dam
quiz.explanation: 把停機前預期功率曲線與實際電表逐時比較，再用同一時段水量帳辨認水是否留下或旁通。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare expected and metered hourly power, then use the matching water balance to identify storage or bypass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停機發電量與留存水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage energy and retained water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停機發電量與留存水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outage energy and retained water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Claiming complete recovery can instead ignore spill, timing constraints and downstream demand; both extremes fail to close the multi-period water-energy account. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若水位因留存上升，後續淨水頭也可能變動，使固定功率估計只是一階比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retained water may change level and subsequent net head, making constant-power multiplication only a first-order comparison.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停機時段少發的電能必然全部永久損失」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All generation absent during an outage is necessarily lost permanently" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。
knowledge.textEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Claiming complete recovery can instead ignore spill, timing constraints and downstream demand; both extremes fail to close the multi-period water-energy account.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「停機發電量與留存水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage energy and retained water" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。
串聯兩級流量應先相加再乘上總水頭
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water.
Serial stage discharges should be added before multiplying by total head
quiz.explanation: 將少發電量全部當永久損失會忽略留水後補發；反之宣稱所有水都可補發又可能忽略溢流、時間限制與下游需求，兩種極端都沒有完成跨時段水能守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calling all missing generation permanent loss ignores later use of retained water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 曾文水庫大壩
courses.summary: 曾文案例將土石壩內的有效應力及排水，連到下游串聯水庫、灌溉渠道與水能利用。學生把閘門出流、消能功率與泥砂質量分開記帳，再核對渠道容量、田間需水及壩頂沉陷趨勢。全課以假想資料檢驗物理關係，避免把容量相加當成可以任意調度的同一水池。
courses.summaryEn: The Tsengwen case links effective stress and drainage inside an embankment to downstream serial storage, irrigation canals and energy recovery. Learners keep gate discharge, dissipated power and sediment mass in separate accounts before checking canal capacity, field demand and settlement trends. Hypothetical data test physical relationships without treating two reservoir capacities as one freely interchangeable pool.
courses.focus: 串聯灌溉調蓄與土石壩滲排水
courses.focusEn: Serial irrigation storage and embankment drainage
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 假想曾文上游水池每天流入一百二十萬立方公尺，輸往下游八十萬、其他損失十萬，蓄量增加三十萬立方公尺。下游接收八十萬，灌溉取走七十萬、損失五萬，增加五萬；全系統增加三十五萬，內部轉水應互相抵銷。若下游需求增百分之二十到八十四萬，下游轉成減少九萬而全系統只增二十一萬。另以六百毫米淨灌溉水深、兩百公頃及效率零點七五求得毛需水一百六十萬立方公尺，不可把效率損失重複扣算。 核驗：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。
workedExample.textEn: Assume the upper reservoir receives 1.2 million m3 per day, transfers 0.8 million and loses 0.1 million; storage rises by 0.3 million m3. The lower pool receives that transfer, supplies 0.7 million and loses 0.05 million, gaining 0.05 million. System storage therefore rises by 0.35 million, with the internal transfer cancelling. Raising lower demand twenty percent to 0.84 million makes its change negative 0.09 million and the system gain 0.21 million. Separately, a 600 mm net depth over 200 ha at efficiency 0.75 requires 1.6 million m3 gross supply. Verification: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.
