stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「串聯水庫的內部轉水」與「壩體孔壓與有效應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs" and "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「串聯水庫的內部轉水」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。分池蓄量仍很重要，因為下游需求不能無視輸水能力與旅行時間。兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「串聯水庫的內部轉水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. Individual storage still matters because downstream demand is constrained by conveyance capacity and travel time. A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水
knowledge.text: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。分池蓄量仍很重要，因為下游需求不能無視輸水能力與旅行時間。
knowledge.textEn: Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. Individual storage still matters because downstream demand is constrained by conveyance capacity and travel time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「串聯水庫的內部轉水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs" is correct?
options: 上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源
曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。
孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
optionsEn: Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources
Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system.
Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
quiz.explanation: 曾文與烏山頭的串聯背景提醒水量帳必須選好邊界：對上游水庫而言轉送是流出，對下游是流入，但對合併系統而言它只是內部交換。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Serial storage requires explicit boundaries: a transfer leaves the upper reservoir and enters the lower one, but cancels within the combined system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日封閉雙池系統，內部轉水抵銷，沒有額外下游天然入流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: A two-pool daily system with internal transfers cancelling and no additional natural inflow to the lower pool. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。適用邊界：同一日封閉雙池系統，內部轉水抵銷，沒有額外下游天然入流。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day. Applicable boundary: A two-pool daily system with internal transfers cancelling and no additional natural inflow to the lower pool.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs", which statement holds?
options: 不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式
原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。
optionsEn: The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level
Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Vin=1200000 m3/day; demand=700000 m3/day; lossUpper=100000 m3/day; lossLower=50000 m3/day; dVsystem=Vin-demand-lossUpper-lossLower=350000 m3/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「串聯水庫的內部轉水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將下游需求增加百分之二十，重新求系統與各池蓄量差，再指定內部轉水八十萬立方公尺每天，證明總帳不因轉水名稱而改變。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。以兩池水位庫容變化獨立核對，避免只因合計帳平衡就忽略某一池資料錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. If travel crosses the daily boundary, include storage in the conveyance segment. Independently compare both pool level-volume changes so a balanced total does not conceal an error in one reservoir.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將下游需求增加百分之二十，重新求系統與各池蓄量差，再指定內部轉水八十萬立方公尺每天，證明總帳不因轉水名稱而改變。
knowledge.textEn: Increase downstream demand twenty percent and calculate system and individual changes using a transfer of eight hundred thousand cubic metres per day. Show that relabeling internal transfer cannot alter the combined balance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「串聯水庫的內部轉水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs"?
options: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深
optionsEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth
quiz.explanation: 先各寫一份水量表，再把上游轉出與下游收到配對相消；若旅行時間跨日，需在輸水段另列暫存。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Write separate balances and cancel matched upper exports and lower receipts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 串聯水庫的內部轉水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Internal transfers in serial reservoirs: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「串聯水庫的內部轉水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Internal transfers in serial reservoirs” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：兩池總量增加不代表每池都增加，更不表示水可以立即任意調往任何位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A rise in combined storage does not imply that both pools rise, nor that water can move instantly and freely to any location where demand occurs.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「上下游間轉水會增加兩池合計的新水資源」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Transfer between the two reservoirs creates additional combined water resources" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。
knowledge.textEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Checking only combined storage can hide a lower-pool shortage while water remains upstream but cannot be conveyed quickly enough to meet demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「串聯水庫的內部轉水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Internal transfers in serial reservoirs" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。
孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources.
Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
quiz.explanation: 把內部轉水當成系統新供水會虛增資源；只檢查總蓄量而忽略分池庫存，可能掩蓋下游已接近不足、上游卻有水但無法及時輸送的空間限制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting an internal transfer as new system supply inflates resources. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壩體孔壓與有效應力」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壩體孔壓與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance. Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力
knowledge.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
knowledge.text: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。以總應力減孔壓可說明排水與蓄水變化如何影響骨架受力，但這是單點應力關係，不直接等於整體抗滑能力。
knowledge.textEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. Subtracting pore pressure illustrates how drainage and reservoir changes affect skeleton loading, but this point relation does not establish whole-slope resistance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壩體孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" is correct?
options: 孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。
optionsEn: Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress.
quiz.explanation: 土石壩顆粒骨架承擔有效應力，水的孔隙壓力則分擔總法向應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The soil skeleton carries effective stress while pore water contributes to total normal stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。適用邊界：飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Applicable boundary: One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。適用邊界：飽和土單一法向分量，壓應力為正，未計剪應力或安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Applicable boundary: One normal component in saturated soil with compression positive, excluding shear stress and a safety factor.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。
每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力
發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa.
Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure
Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: sigmaTotal=420 kPa; u=170 kPa; sigmaEff=sigmaTotal-u=250 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壩體孔壓與有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。將量測高程與水壓基準寫清楚，並以多點剖面辨識局部孔壓，避免把一個平均值套到整個壩坡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Record elevation and pressure datum and use multiple points to identify local conditions rather than assigning one average to an entire slope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。將量測高程與水壓基準寫清楚，並以多點剖面辨識局部孔壓，避免把一個平均值套到整個壩坡。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Record elevation and pressure datum and use multiple points to identify local conditions rather than assigning one average to an entire slope.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定總應力，把孔壓提高五十千帕後重算，再畫總應力、孔壓與有效應力三條示意線，說明若總應力也變動時為何不能只看水壓。
knowledge.textEn: Hold total stress fixed and raise pore pressure fifty kilopascals, then sketch total, pore and effective stress. Explain why pressure alone is insufficient when total stress changes at the same time.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壩體孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。
兩次量測求出的平均沉陷速率必定可永久線性外推
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles.
An average settlement rate from two surveys can always be extrapolated indefinitely
quiz.explanation: 核對土壓計與測壓管是否代表同一位置、方向與時段，再比較水位升降時兩者變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm that earth-pressure and pore-pressure measurements represent matching location, direction and time, then compare their changes during level cycles. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壩體孔壓與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壩體孔壓與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. During drainage blockage, total stress may stay almost unchanged while skeleton stress falls, so total-pressure observations alone can miss the important change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若土未飽和或有明顯各向異性，還需要更適當的有效應力描述與材料參數，不能把飽和模型無條件外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unsaturated conditions or pronounced anisotropy require additional constitutive description and material parameters, so the saturated model cannot be extended indiscriminately to every location or stage of embankment response.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。
knowledge.textEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. During drainage blockage, total stress may stay almost unchanged while skeleton stress falls, so total-pressure observations alone can miss the important change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壩體孔壓與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation.
quiz.explanation: 把孔壓當作額外壓緊土粒的力而相加，會把有效應力方向算反；排水堵塞時總應力可能近似不變而骨架有效應力下降，僅看總壓力會漏掉變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding pore pressure as extra particle clamping reverses the effective-stress relation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水層的導水阻力」與「假想閘下出流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer" and "Hypothetical gated underflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水層的導水阻力」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。達西式可由流量反推所需水頭損失，顯示濾料堵塞或有效面積縮小會提高上游水頭。導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水層的導水阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. Rearranging Darcy's relation gives the head loss required to pass a flow, showing why clogging or reduced effective area increases upstream head. Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水層的導水阻力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水層的導水阻力
knowledge.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer
knowledge.text: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。達西式可由流量反推所需水頭損失，顯示濾料堵塞或有效面積縮小會提高上游水頭。
knowledge.textEn: A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. Rearranging Darcy's relation gives the head loss required to pass a flow, showing why clogging or reduced effective area increases upstream head.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水層的導水阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer" is correct?
options: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式
optionsEn: A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure.
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level
quiz.explanation: 下游排水層提供較低阻力通路，讓穿過心層的水離開並降低孔壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A downstream drain offers a lower-resistance path for seepage and helps limit pore pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水層的導水阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m。適用邊界：均勻飽和達西流、固定有效截面，不代表現地排水層能力驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Q=0.006 m3/s; L=12 m; k=0.003 m/s; A=24 m2; dh=Q L/(k A)=1 m. Applicable boundary: Uniform saturated Darcy flow through fixed effective area, not a field drain-capacity acceptance test. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水層的導水阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。將維護清理、細料出現與降雨時段一起標記，再檢查水頭升高是來水增加還是阻力增加，不能只看流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence. Mark cleaning, observed fines and rainfall periods, then determine whether rising head reflects increased inflow or increased resistance rather than interpreting discharge alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把滲透係數減半並保持流量不變，重算所需水頭差，再把截面也減少四分之一，比較兩種劣化疊加的效果與量測所需證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve permeability at fixed flow and recalculate required head difference, then also reduce area by one quarter. Compare the combined effects and identify measurements needed to distinguish the two deterioration mechanisms.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。將維護清理、細料出現與降雨時段一起標記，再檢查水頭升高是來水增加還是阻力增加，不能只看流量。
knowledge.textEn: Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence. Mark cleaning, observed fines and rainfall periods, then determine whether rising head reflects increased inflow or increased resistance rather than interpreting discharge alone.

knowledge.text: 把滲透係數減半並保持流量不變，重算所需水頭差，再把截面也減少四分之一，比較兩種劣化疊加的效果與量測所需證據。
knowledge.textEn: Halve permeability at fixed flow and recalculate required head difference, then also reduce area by one quarter. Compare the combined effects and identify measurements needed to distinguish the two deterioration mechanisms.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水層的導水阻力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率
以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency
Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence.
quiz.explanation: 以排水層前後的測壓差與總排水量反算導水能力，確認出口未被回水淹沒。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Infer conductance from head difference and total drainage while checking for outlet submergence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水層的導水阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水層的導水阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Local blockage can redirect flow through bypasses, leaving total drainage similar while changing the internal pore-pressure distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：導水良好與保土功能是兩個要求，材料粗化雖能降低阻力，卻不一定維持對細料的截留，不能只追求最大流量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic capacity and soil retention are separate requirements: coarser material may reduce resistance without retaining fines, so maximizing flow alone does not define a satisfactory filter-drain system.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。
knowledge.textEn: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Local blockage can redirect flow through bypasses, leaving total drainage similar while changing the internal pore-pressure distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排水層的導水阻力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic resistance of a drain layer" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式
optionsEn: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level
quiz.explanation: 出口回水會改變水頭邊界，若仍把出口當零壓就錯估阻力；局部堵塞也可能讓水改走旁路，使總排水量近似不變卻在壩內形成不同孔壓分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Outlet backwater changes the hydraulic boundary, so assuming zero outlet pressure misestimates resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 假想閘下出流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hypothetical gated underflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「假想閘下出流量」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hypothetical gated underflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘下出流把上游水頭轉成高速水流，開口面積與局部收縮共同控制通量。用孔口形式可作量級比較，但真實閘門出流還要分自由與淹沒狀態，並知道上游能量與尾水。曾文案例的教學參數完全是假想，不是現地閘門開度表，計算目的是理解水頭平方根與開口面積的一次關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「假想閘下出流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gated underflow converts upstream head into high-speed flow, with opening area and contraction controlling discharge. An orifice-style relation supports scale comparison, but actual gates require distinction between free and submerged conditions and knowledge of upstream energy and tailwater. All parameters here are hypothetical rather than a Tsengwen gate schedule; the purpose is to distinguish square-root head dependence from linear dependence on opening area. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hypothetical gated underflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: Cd=0.65; b=4 m; opening=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; H=9 m; Q=Cd b opening sqrt(2gH)=27.63975 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「假想閘下出流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hypothetical gated underflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

An orifice-style relation supports scale comparison, but actual gates require distinction between free and submerged conditions and knowledge of upstream energy and tailwater.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「假想閘下出流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.title: 假想閘下出流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hypothetical gated underflow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「假想閘下出流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hypothetical gated underflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出開口中心與自由水面，核對水頭定義後用量水設施求實際係數。比較不同開度的係數是否穩定，記錄尾水變化和水面波動，再決定簡單孔口式是否足以描述該測試區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw opening center and free surface, verify the head definition and infer discharge coefficient from measurements. Compare coefficients across openings while recording tailwater and surface fluctuations before deciding whether a simple orifice relation describes the tested range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將假想開口高度減半但暫維持中心水頭，求流量變化，再重新加入中心位置改變，說明分步比較有助於分辨面積與水頭兩種效應。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve opening height while temporarily holding center head fixed, then account for the changed center elevation. Explain how the two-step comparison separates area effects from the effect of altered hydraulic head.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把開口高度改變造成的中心高程變化完全忽略，會使大幅開度比較不一致；尾水淹沒後仍使用自由出流式，則可能高估通量並錯配下游水量帳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring the changing opening-center elevation can make comparisons inconsistent over large opening changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 假想閘下出流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hypothetical gated underflow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「假想閘下出流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hypothetical gated underflow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把開口高度改變造成的中心高程變化完全忽略，會使大幅開度比較不一致；尾水淹沒後仍使用自由出流式，則可能高估通量並錯配下游水量帳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the changing opening-center elevation can make comparisons inconsistent over large opening changes. Retaining a free-discharge equation after submergence can overstate flow and distort the downstream water balance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：曾文案例的教學參數完全是假想，不是現地閘門開度表，計算目的是理解水頭平方根與開口面積的一次關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: All parameters here are hypothetical rather than a Tsengwen gate schedule; the purpose is to distinguish square-root head dependence from linear dependence on opening area.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「不論尾水多高都可以使用相同自由出流公式」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same free-discharge equation applies regardless of tailwater level" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「消能區的功率通量」與「近底取水的輸砂效率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Power flux in a dissipating reach" and "Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 消能區的功率通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Power flux in a dissipating reach: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「消能區的功率通量」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Power flux in a dissipating reach” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 溢流水失去的水頭代表機械能轉為紊流、熱與聲等形式，流量乘水頭損失可求耗散功率。把功率除以示意面積得到平均面功率通量，有助比較能量集中程度，但單位不是壓力，不能直接當作混凝土或岩盤承受的力。局部沖刷還取決於流向、脈動、材料與持續時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「消能區的功率通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head lost by spill flow represents mechanical energy converted to turbulence, heat and sound. Discharge times head loss gives dissipated power, and dividing by an illustrative area gives mean areal power flux. This compares energy concentration but is not pressure or a structural force. Local scour additionally depends on flow direction, fluctuations, material resistance and duration, so equal mean flux does not imply equal damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Power flux in a dissipating reach” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dissipated power per area is the same numerical local pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「消能區的功率通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Power flux in a dissipating reach”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「消能區的功率通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 每平方公尺耗散功率就是同數值的局部壓力

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「消能區的功率通量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Power flux in a dissipating reach” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=35 m3/s; dH=18 m; A=140 m2; flux=rho g Q dH/A/1000=44.145 kW/m2。適用邊界：耗散能量在假想面積上的平均分配，不是局部衝擊壓力或沖刷深度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Applicable boundary: Mean dissipated power over a hypothetical area, not local impact pressure or scour depth. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check total power from flow and head loss, then retain the energy-per-time unit after division by area.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 靠近底部的取水可能攜帶較濃泥砂，但輸砂效果應用乾固體質量與放流水量共同衡量，而非只說水看起來很濁。質量濃度本身就是每單位水混合物體積攜帶的固體，乘流量才變成質量率。沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「近底取水的輸砂效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Withdrawal near the bottom may carry more concentrated sediment, but performance requires both dry-solids mass and released water volume rather than visual darkness. Concentration measures solids per mixture volume, and multiplication by flow gives mass rate. Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將代表水樣乾燥後求固體濃度，核對採樣口是否避開粗粒沉降而偏低。同步積分放流水量，再以取水前後庫底測量檢查材料來源，區分新入流通過與既有沉積再搬運。
knowledge.textEn: Dry representative samples to determine solids concentration and check whether sampler placement misses settling coarse grains. Integrate released water simultaneously and compare bed surveys to distinguish passage of new incoming sediment from remobilization of previously deposited material.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 設另一時段流量加倍但濃度降為三分之一，計算等長時段的輸出質量和用水量，分別比較總輸砂與每單位水的輸砂，不混為同一效率。
knowledge.textEn: Double flow while reducing concentration to one third for an equal duration. Compare total solids, water volume and solids per unit water, keeping those performance measures distinct rather than combining them into one undefined efficiency.

quiz.question: 要驗證「近底取水的輸砂效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總排水量不變就能證明排水層各處都沒有堵塞
將代表水樣乾燥後求固體濃度，核對採樣口是否避開粗粒沉降而偏低。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Unchanged total drainage proves that no part of the drain is blocked
Dry representative samples to determine solids concentration and check whether sampler placement misses settling coarse grains.
quiz.explanation: 將代表水樣乾燥後求固體濃度，核對採樣口是否避開粗粒沉降而偏低。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry representative samples to determine solids concentration and check whether sampler placement misses settling coarse grains. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 近底取水的輸砂效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「近底取水的輸砂效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. A large dilute release may consume much water while carrying few solids; both cases require consistent mass and water boundaries for comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉積物是否能被帶到入口，還取決於地形與流場，計算輸出不等於證明整個庫底被清除。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Whether deposits reach the inlet depends on bed geometry and flow, so a calculated export does not demonstrate clearance of the entire reservoir floor or uniform sediment removal.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原水越濁就一定代表該時段排出總泥砂越多」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Darker water necessarily means more total sediment was exported during the interval" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。
knowledge.textEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. A large dilute release may consume much water while carrying few solids; both cases require consistent mass and water boundaries for comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「近底取水的輸砂效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Solids concentration in bottom withdrawal" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗
optionsEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
quiz.explanation: 只以高濃度宣稱效率高可能忽略放流水量很小，總輸出仍有限；反之大量低濃度放流可能耗水多而帶走固體少，兩者需要同一質量與水量邊界才可比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High concentration alone may accompany little water and limited total export. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共同放流的發電與灌溉」與「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Energy and irrigation from one release" and "Manning scale for an irrigation canal": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共同放流的發電與灌溉」如何影響曾文水庫大壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy and irrigation from one release” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。帳目應把通過機組的水列為同一次放流，避免再加成第二份供水；實際是否可共用仍受渠道高程、時間和取水位置限制。發電效率影響能量轉換，不直接把相同比例水量變成不可用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同放流的發電與灌溉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The turbine flow therefore remains a single water transfer rather than a second supply allocation. Actual reuse depends on canal elevation, timing and withdrawal location. Conversion efficiency changes electrical output, not the fraction of water physically remaining, so energy and water ledgers must use different units and boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy and irrigation from one release” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy and irrigation from one release”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉
knowledge.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release
knowledge.text: 同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。帳目應把通過機組的水列為同一次放流，避免再加成第二份供水；實際是否可共用仍受渠道高程、時間和取水位置限制。
knowledge.textEn: One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The turbine flow therefore remains a single water transfer rather than a second supply allocation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共同放流的發電與灌溉」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Energy and irrigation from one release" is correct?
options: 發電效率八成就表示兩成水量已被機組消耗
同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。
矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深
optionsEn: Eighty percent generation efficiency means the unit consumes twenty percent of the water
One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself.
Hydraulic radius of a rectangular canal always equals its depth
quiz.explanation: 同一股水可以先經發電再用於灌溉，利用位能不等於把水體消耗掉，因此能源與水量可提供不同服務。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: One release may generate electricity before serving irrigation; extracting potential energy does not consume the water itself. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Energy and irrigation from one release” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。適用邊界：同一放流先經假想機組再到下游，未計渠道損失或真實取水配置。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW. Applicable boundary: One release passes a hypothetical unit before downstream use, excluding canal losses and actual withdrawal configuration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。適用邊界：同一放流先經假想機組再到下游，未計渠道損失或真實取水配置。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW. Applicable boundary: One release passes a hypothetical unit before downstream use, excluding canal losses and actual withdrawal configuration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共同放流的發電與灌溉」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy and irrigation from one release", which statement holds?
options: 毛取水量應把田間淨需水乘上輸配效率
孔隙水壓越高就一定讓土粒骨架承受更大壓應力
原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。
optionsEn: Gross withdrawal equals net field requirement multiplied by delivery efficiency
Higher pore pressure necessarily increases compression carried by the soil skeleton
Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，以下數值不是本工程實測或設備設定：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=8 m3/s; H=60 m; eta=0.86; P=rho g Q H eta/1e6=4.049568 MW. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「共同放流的發電與灌溉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy and irrigation from one release” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。比較機組出口及渠道入口累積流量，將中間損失或暫存另外列帳，確認沒有因兩種用途而重複計水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units. Compare cumulative turbine-outlet and canal-inlet flows, accounting for intermediate losses or storage so two services do not create duplicate water allocations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一流量求一日通過水量，再計一日發電量，將兩者以各自單位並列。若渠道另損失百分之五，只修改下游水量帳並說明是否改變已發出的電。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate daily water throughput and energy at the same flow, displaying their distinct units. Apply a separate five-percent canal loss only to downstream water and explain whether it changes electricity already generated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Interpreting efficiency below unity as an equal loss of water misstates downstream availability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units. Compare cumulative turbine-outlet and canal-inlet flows, accounting for intermediate losses or storage so two services do not create duplicate water allocations.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy and irrigation from one release"?
options: 在流程圖上用一條水線連接發電與灌溉，另畫能量輸出箭頭，核對單位不混用。

quiz.explanationEn: Draw one water path through generation to irrigation with a separate energy-output arrow, checking units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共同放流的發電與灌溉：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy and irrigation from one release: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 把機組效率低於一解讀成同樣比例水被消耗，會錯估下游可用水；把發電用水與灌溉用水相加成總需求，又可能對同一串聯放流重複扣帳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Tsengwen Dam”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 開放渠道的平均流速受斷面形狀、濕周、坡度及粗糙阻力共同控制。矩形斷面水力半徑是面積除濕周，不等於水深，尤其窄渠道差異顯著。曼寧式可估算均勻流通水量，但回水、閘門控制或急變流會破壞水面坡與底坡近似相同的條件，需要另作水面線分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「灌溉明渠的曼寧尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean open-channel velocity depends on geometry, wetted perimeter, slope and roughness. For a rectangular section, hydraulic radius is area divided by wetted perimeter, not simply depth, especially in a narrow canal. Manning's relation estimates uniform-flow capacity, while backwater, gates or rapidly varied flow can invalidate the approximation that energy slope follows bed slope and require a water-surface-profile calculation instead. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Manning scale for an irrigation canal” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「矩形渠道的水力半徑永遠等於水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not project measurements or equipment settings: b=5 m; y=1.2 m; n=0.025 s/m^(1/3); S=0.0004; A=by=6 m2; R=A/(b+2y); Q=A R^(2/3)sqrt(S)/n=4.173697 m3/s. Applicable boundary: SI Manning relation for uniform flow in a prismatic rectangular canal, with assumed roughness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由實測斷面計算面積與濕周，確認側壁也納入濕周；以沿程水面高程檢查是否近似均勻流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Calculate area and wetted perimeter from a surveyed section including both sidewalls, and inspect longitudinal water levels for near-uniform flow. steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接把水深當水力半徑會高估窄渠通量；若下游閘門回水卻仍採底坡為能量坡，則可能得到不符合現地水面線的流量，連帶錯估供水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing hydraulic radius with depth overstates narrow-channel flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
