steps.title: 預報偏差與時間裕度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forecast bias and time margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預報偏差與時間裕度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Forecast bias and time margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均完成時間足以代表任何風暴中的最差時間裕度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Average completion time adequately represents the worst margin in every storm." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 通訊中斷、供電擾動與人員確認可能同受一場風暴影響，直接相加獨立平均值會高估裕度。時間戳不一致也可能把資料延遲誤認為機械遲緩。
knowledge.textEn: Communications, power and confirmation can be impaired by the same storm, making independent average delays optimistic. Inconsistent timestamps can also make data latency appear to be slow machinery.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds.

steps.title: 腐蝕餘厚與疲勞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion allowance and fatigue: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」如何影響荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion allowance and fatigue” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽水環境的板件減薄降低截面能力，但焊趾疲勞又取決於局部應力範圍與循環數。均勻腐蝕速率只做餘厚預測，不能替代點蝕量測或裂紋檢查；維護判讀要把材料損失和疲勞機制分列。 假設初厚20 mm、均勻腐蝕0.08 mm/year、經過15 years，餘厚18.8 mm；若截面寬不變，面積損失6%，不據此推定疲勞壽命。 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Saline exposure reduces plate section, while weld fatigue depends on local stress range and cycle count. Uniform corrosion rate predicts remaining thickness but cannot replace pitting surveys or crack inspection. Maintenance interpretation must separate material loss from cyclic damage. Assume initial thickness 20 mm and uniform corrosion 0.08 mm/year over 15 years. Remaining thickness is 18.8 mm and area loss is six percent at constant width; fatigue life is not inferred. Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion allowance and fatigue” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume initial thickness 20 mm and uniform corrosion 0.08 mm/year over 15 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Saline exposure reduces plate section, while weld fatigue depends on local stress range and cycle count.
Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour.

steps.title: 腐蝕餘厚與疲勞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion allowance and fatigue: quantitative estimate

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion allowance and fatigue” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要板件餘厚足夠，焊縫就不可能存在疲勞裂紋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate remaining plate thickness rules out fatigue cracks at welds." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。焊趾裂紋可在餘厚足夠時擴展。
knowledge.textEn: Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Weld-toe cracks may continue growing even where remaining gross thickness appears adequate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「腐蝕餘厚與疲勞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corrosion allowance and fatigue" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。
開口平均流速相同就能保證閘緣沖刷完全相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning.
Equal opening-average velocity guarantees identical gate-edge scour.
quiz.explanation: 以平均厚度遮蔽單個深坑會高估局部承載能力；反過來把表面粗糙造成的回波誤差當真減薄也會誤導維護。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Average thickness can conceal a deep local pit and overstate resistance, while roughness-related echo error can imitate thinning. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘
courses.summary: 本課以荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘為入口，深入浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Maeslant storm-surge barrier as its entry point, this course examines joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析
courses.focusEn: Joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 單參數敏感度：固定水線面積1200 m²及外水密度1025 kg/m³，只把新增質量由600 t降至300 t。ΔT=m/(ρA)由0.4878 m降至0.2439 m，恰為一半；此比例限小吃水變化與固定水線面積，不適用浸沒後水線形狀明顯改變的狀態。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For a one-parameter sensitivity comparison, hold waterplane area at 1200 m² and external density at 1025 kg/m³, reducing only added mass from 600 t to 300 t. ΔT=m/(ρA) falls from 0.4878 m to 0.2439 m, exactly half. This scaling assumes small draft changes and a constant waterplane, not substantially changed submerged geometry.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 官方兩座門體各寬210 m、高22 m。
官方球接頭直徑10 m，課堂不據此推定容許反力。
教學600 t壓載使固定水線面平均吃水增加0.4878 m。
教學8 MN力乘60 m力臂為480 MN·m。
教學共同原因模型失效機率為0.005398。
教學資料延遲4 min乘水位速率0.12 m/min為0.48 m。
factsEn: The two official gate structures are each 210 m wide and 22 m high.
Official spherical-joint diameter is 10 m, without inferring allowable reactions.
Teaching ballast of 600 t increases mean draft by 0.4878 m at fixed waterplane area.
Teaching force 8 MN times lever arm 60 m gives 480 MN·m.
The teaching common-cause model gives failure probability 0.005398.
Teaching latency 4 min times rise rate 0.12 m/min gives 0.48 m.
timeline: 1991　馬仕朗防潮閘開始建設，保留主要航道平時開放。
1997　馬仕朗防潮閘建設完成，成為歐洲港防線的一部分。
2007　官方記載馬仕朗防潮閘首次因風暴而關閉防護。
timelineEn: 1991 — Construction begins on the Maeslant Barrier while preserving an open main navigation route.
1997 — The Maeslant Barrier is completed as part of the Europoort defence system.
2007 — The owner records the first storm-protection closure of the Maeslant Barrier.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮運吃水與壓載」與「球鉸支臂力矩」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floating draft and ballast" and "Spherical-joint arm moment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮運吃水與壓載」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floating draft and ballast” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。 假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 艙內自由液面會削弱穩定性，即使總浮力平衡也可能出現傾斜。若一側進水較快，剛體平均吃水模型便漏掉扭轉與局部碰撞的危險。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮運吃水與壓載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height. Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Internal free surfaces reduce stability even when total buoyancy balances weight. Unequal filling creates tilt, so a mean-draft model misses twisting and local collision hazards during the transition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floating draft and ballast” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮運吃水與壓載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Floating draft and ballast”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮運吃水與壓載
knowledge.text: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。水線面積決定增加重量所造成的吃水變化，不能用門高直接換算沉降。
knowledge.textEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. Waterplane area controls the draft change caused by added mass, rather than the overall gate height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮運吃水與壓載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Floating draft and ballast" is correct?
options: 浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。
球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
optionsEn: Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy.
A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
quiz.explanation: 中空閘門靠排水體積承受自重，注水後有效浮力減少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hollow gate floats by displacement; ballast changes its net buoyancy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮運吃水與壓載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floating draft and ballast” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮運吃水與壓載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Floating draft and ballast", which statement holds?
options: 曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³。
optionsEn: Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水線面積1200 m²、加入淡水質量600 t，外水密度1025 kg/m³；ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m，限小吃水與固定水線面積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume waterplane area 1200 m², added mass 600 t and external density 1025 kg/m³. ΔT=m/(ρA)=0.4878 m, for small changes and constant waterplane area. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮運吃水與壓載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floating draft and ballast: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮運吃水與壓載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floating draft and ballast” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步比較左右吃水、艙內水量與門體傾角，檢查壓載質量是否與排水增量一致；把鹽度引起的外水密度變化另外列出。利用各艙液位推算重心移動，核對觀測傾斜方向是否符合新增壓載的位置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare port and starboard drafts, ballast volume and tilt synchronously. Check added mass against displaced volume and record salinity-related external density changes separately. Infer center-of-gravity movement from individual tank levels and check that observed heel matches the added ballast location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spherical-joint arm moment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 球接頭容許多方向轉動，卻仍需把巨大門體荷載傳入陸側基礎。支臂幾何控制力矩和軸力分配，轉動自由不代表沒有反力。 假設水平合力8 MN、對基礎有效力臂60 m，外力矩M=Fr=480 MN·m；這是整體平衡量，非球鉸直接承受的純彎矩。 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「球鉸支臂力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A spherical joint permits rotation in several directions while transmitting gate loads into shore foundations. Arm geometry controls moment and axial-force distribution; rotational freedom does not eliminate reaction forces. Assume horizontal resultant 8 MN and effective foundation lever arm 60 m. External moment M=Fr=480 MN·m is a global equilibrium quantity, not a pure moment carried directly by the ball joint. Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spherical-joint arm moment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanation: 繪出門體、支臂和球鉸分別的自由體圖，再用應變與位移方向核對內力路徑；確認力臂量的是垂直距離而非桁架長度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw separate free-body diagrams for gate, arm and joint. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 球鉸支臂力矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Spherical-joint arm moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「球鉸支臂力矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Spherical-joint arm moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。若基礎轉動未列入，量測變形可能被錯誤解讀為鋼材損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Excluding foundation rotation can make measured movement appear to be steel damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「球鉸支臂力矩」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Spherical-joint arm moment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint.
quiz.explanation: 將球鉸錯當固定端會扭曲桁架內力，忽略支承摩擦又會低估局部拘束。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the ball joint as fixed distorts truss forces, while omitting friction understates local restraint. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支臂壓桿穩定」與「曲面門水壓分解」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arm compression-member stability" and "Resolving pressure on curved gates": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支臂壓桿穩定：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arm compression-member stability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支臂壓桿穩定」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm compression-member stability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細長支臂桿件可能先失穩再達材料降伏，端部拘束決定有效長度。理想歐拉式只說明幾何敏感性，實際彎曲與殘餘應力需另外處理。 假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。若只檢查材料強度，便可能漏掉受壓桿件突然出現的側向失穩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支臂壓桿穩定」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A slender arm member can buckle before yielding, and end restraint sets effective length. Euler theory illustrates geometric sensitivity but leaves initial curvature and residual stresses to separate assessment. Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions. Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arm compression-member stability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支臂壓桿穩定」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arm compression-member stability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「支臂壓桿穩定」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arm compression-member stability" is correct?

鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
optionsEn: A slender arm member can buckle before yielding, and end restraint sets effective length.
A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.

steps.title: 支臂壓桿穩定：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Arm compression-member stability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支臂壓桿穩定」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Arm compression-member stability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以測量所得桿件初彎曲建立幾何模型，核對節點轉動和側向支撐位置；比較不同有效長度的敏感性，不直接把理論臨界力當容許荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Model measured initial curvature, joint rotation and lateral bracing locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN；理想直桿彈性屈曲，未含缺陷或設計折減。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m. Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN, for an ideal straight elastic member without imperfections or design reductions.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「支臂壓桿穩定」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arm compression-member stability", which statement holds?
options: 總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=200 GPa、I=0.08 m⁴、鉸支長40 m，Pcr=π²EI/L²=98.696 MN。
設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。
optionsEn: Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=200 GPa, I=0.08 m⁴ and pinned length 40 m.
Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability.

steps.title: 支臂壓桿穩定：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arm compression-member stability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支臂壓桿穩定」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arm compression-member stability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以測量所得桿件初彎曲建立幾何模型，核對節點轉動和側向支撐位置；比較不同有效長度的敏感性，不直接把理論臨界力當容許荷載。比較支點轉角和壓桿側向位移的關係，以辨認實際端部是否近似鉸接或有拘束。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Model measured initial curvature, joint rotation and lateral bracing locations. Compare sensitivity to effective length instead of treating the theoretical critical force as an allowable load. Compare support rotation with member lateral displacement to identify whether real ends approximate pins or restrained connections. steps.failure: 注意干擾：節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

knowledge.textEn: Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Checking material strength alone can miss sudden lateral instability in an otherwise apparently adequate compression member.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「支臂壓桿穩定」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arm compression-member stability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
optionsEn: Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
quiz.explanation: 節點腐蝕或鬆動會改變端部拘束，讓先前的有效長度假設失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint corrosion or looseness changes end restraint and invalidates an earlier effective length. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 曲面門水壓分解：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resolving pressure on curved gates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面門水壓分解」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resolving pressure on curved gates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。曲面面積不能直接乘最大壓力。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面門水壓分解」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. Its horizontal component follows the vertical projection, while its vertical component relates to an imaginary overlying water volume; surface area times maximum pressure is inappropriate. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate. Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resolving pressure on curved gates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面門水壓分解」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resolving pressure on curved gates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲面門水壓分解
knowledge.text: 曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。曲面面積不能直接乘最大壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. Its horizontal component follows the vertical projection, while its vertical component relates to an imaginary overlying water volume; surface area times maximum pressure is inappropriate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面門水壓分解」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resolving pressure on curved gates" is correct?
options: 曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
optionsEn: Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
Pressure acts normal to a curved surface.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
quiz.explanation: 曲面水壓應按法向分布積分，水平分量可由垂直投影求得，垂直分量則與上覆假想水體有關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure acts normal to a curved surface. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面門水壓分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolving pressure on curved gates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面門水壓分解」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resolving pressure on curved gates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設垂直投影寬20 m、水深5 m、單側靜水密度1025 kg/m³；水平分量ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN，未求曲面垂直分量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vertical projection width 20 m, one-sided depth 5 m and water density 1025 kg/m³. Horizontal force ρgbh²/2=2.514 MN; the curved-surface vertical component remains separate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「曲面門水壓分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resolving pressure on curved gates", which statement holds?
options: 漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。
多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.
Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 曲面門水壓分解：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolving pressure on curved gates: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面門水壓分解」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resolving pressure on curved gates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。以相同水位的獨立積分重算垂直分量，確認水平投影沒有被當成全部濕潤面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions. Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides. Independently integrate the vertical component at matching levels and verify that projected area is not mistaken for wetted area. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以曲面門水壓分解編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分別畫水平與垂直投影，對照多點壓力計積分與結構反力；若潮水淹過門頂或兩側皆有水，須更新濕潤邊界再計算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for resolving pressure on curved gates, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Draw separate horizontal and vertical projections, comparing integrated pressure measurements with reactions. Revise wetted boundaries whenever water overtops the gate or occupies both sides.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲面門水壓分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 曲面門水壓分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolving pressure on curved gates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面門水壓分解」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resolving pressure on curved gates” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把水壓視為全水平會漏掉浮沉方向荷載，影響壓載與接觸判斷。波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all pressure as horizontal misses vertical loading that affects ballast and contact. Waves vary pressure in time and space, so the hydrostatic component cannot represent the maximum transient resultant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波浪使壓力隨時間和位置改變，靜水分量不能代表瞬間最大合力。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由液面穩定修正」與「沉放前底隙流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-surface stability correction" and "Under-gate flow before seating": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由液面穩定修正：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-surface stability correction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由液面穩定修正」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-surface stability correction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未滿的壓載艙在傾斜時移動液體重心，降低初始復原能力。相同水量分裝在窄艙或集中於寬艙，穩定效果可以不同。 假設艙液密度1000 kg/m³、自由液面慣性矩8000 m⁴、總排水質量20 million kg，虛擬重心升高ρI/m=0.4 m，限小傾角。 部分充水的過渡階段可能比空艙或滿艙更不利。若把隔板當成密閉分艙而實際有大開孔，計算會低估液體轉移和動態晃蕩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由液面穩定修正」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Partially filled ballast tanks move the liquid center of gravity during heel and reduce initial stability. Equal water volumes distributed among narrow tanks or one wide tank can have different effects. Assume tank-liquid density 1000 kg/m³, free-surface second moment 8000 m⁴ and displacement mass 20 million kg. Virtual center-of-gravity rise ρI/m=0.4 m, for small heel. An intermediate filling stage may be less stable than empty or full tanks. Treating perforated baffles as sealed subdivisions understates liquid transfer and dynamic sloshing across the available free surface. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設狹縫寬30 m、高0.2 m、壓差水頭1 m、Cd=0.65；Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s，僅為穩定孔口近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume slot width 30 m, height 0.2 m, head difference 1 m and Cd=0.65. Q=CdA√(2gΔh)=17.27 m³/s, a steady-orifice approximation only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照底隙幾何、上下游水位與局部聲學流速，檢查孔口係數是否隨門位改變；把渦動頻率與門體振動頻譜比較而非只看流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare gap geometry, head and local acoustic velocities, checking how the discharge coefficient varies with position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 沉放前底隙流量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉放前底隙流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Under-gate flow before seating” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照底隙幾何、上下游水位與局部聲學流速，檢查孔口係數是否隨門位改變；把渦動頻率與門體振動頻譜比較而非只看流量。比較底隙各位置的流速分布，確認縮小開口後高流速區是否移到未保護的邊緣。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare gap geometry, head and local acoustic velocities, checking how the discharge coefficient varies with position. Compare vortex frequencies with gate vibration spectra rather than examining flow rate alone. Compare velocity distributions along the gap and determine whether narrowing shifts fast jets toward unprotected edges. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以沉放前底隙流量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照底隙幾何、上下游水位與局部聲學流速，檢查孔口係數是否隨門位改變；把渦動頻率與門體振動頻譜比較而非只看流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for under-gate flow before seating, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare gap geometry, head and local acoustic velocities, checking how the discharge coefficient varies with position. Compare vortex frequencies with gate vibration spectra rather than examining flow rate alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 沉放前底隙流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-gate flow before seating: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉放前底隙流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Under-gate flow before seating” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 底床殘留砂石會使間隙不均，形成集中噴流與不對稱支承。若把單一水位差當作整條狹縫的條件，可能漏判局部氣蝕或振動區域。
knowledge.textEn: Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Assigning one head difference uniformly along the slot may miss localized cavitation or vibration zones near changing sill geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉放前底隙流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference.

quiz.explanationEn: Debris creates uneven gaps, concentrated jets and asymmetric contact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 止水縫漏流診斷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seal leakage diagnosis: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「止水縫漏流診斷」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal leakage diagnosis” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水縫的漏流同時受縫寬、壓差和變形控制，漏水量增大不一定是橡膠老化。以同水頭比較流量，可先排除水位改變造成的表面趨勢。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設長10 m、縫寬2 mm、Cd=0.6、Δh=3 m；Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s，均勻縫且無黏性修正。 小縫中的黏性流可能不遵守孔口平方根關係，不能把正規化曲線偏移全歸於磨耗。雜物卡縫與門體歪斜也會產生相似漏水訊號。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「止水縫漏流診斷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seal leakage depends on gap, head and deformation, so increased flow does not necessarily indicate rubber ageing. Comparing at equal head first removes water-level changes that can imitate deterioration. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume length 10 m, gap 2 mm, Cd=0.6 and head 3 m. Q=0.6×0.02√(2×9.81×3)=0.09206 m³/s, for a uniform slot without viscous correction. Viscous flow through a very narrow gap may not follow the orifice square-root law. Debris and gate misalignment can imitate wear, so normalized curve changes do not uniquely identify material deterioration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal leakage diagnosis” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing leakage proves seal ageing without checking the head difference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「止水縫漏流診斷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seal leakage diagnosis”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：漏流增加就足以證明止水橡膠老化，無須檢查水頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「止水縫漏流診斷」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.objective: 說明「共同原因與備援」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Common cause and redundancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩套備援設備若共用電源、機房或感測來源，就不是完全獨立。風暴可能同時破壞多條功能鏈，可靠度計算必須把共同原因與單機失效分開。 假設兩單元各獨立失效機率0.02，共同原因機率0.005；簡化總失效q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398，非本站實測可靠度。 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共同原因與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Redundant equipment sharing power, rooms or sensing is not fully independent. One storm may damage several functional chains, requiring common-cause events to be separated from individual equipment failures. Assume independent unit-failure probabilities 0.02 and common-cause probability 0.005. Simplified total q=0.005+0.995×0.02²=0.005398, not a measured site reliability. Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Common cause and redundancy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以共同原因與備援編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for common cause and redundancy, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。追查演練中兩套設備同時失去功能的事件，確認共同原因沒有被拆成兩件獨立故障。
knowledge.textEn: Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree. Trace exercise events that disabled both units and ensure one common cause was not counted as two independent failures.
