knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for common cause and redundancy, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Use exercise events to verify actual separation and document the justification for each independence assumption in the fault tree.

quiz.question: 要驗證「共同原因與備援」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Common cause and redundancy"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
quiz.explanation: 逐項追蹤電源、冷卻、網路、感測和維修狀態的共用節點，用演練事件核對是否真正隔離；將假設獨立的理由寫入失效樹。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace shared power, cooling, network, sensing and maintenance dependencies. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 共同原因與備援：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Common cause and redundancy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「共同原因與備援」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Common cause and redundancy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備數量加倍就能直接把整體失效機率平方。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling equipment automatically squares the complete system failure probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。備援設備即使定期空載測試合格，也未必能在淹水、斷電和高荷載同時出現時接替。
knowledge.textEn: Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Successful unloaded backup tests do not prove takeover during simultaneous flooding, power loss and high mechanical demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「共同原因與備援」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Common cause and redundancy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。
將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.
Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure.
quiz.explanation: 將共用電纜路徑的兩套系統視為獨立會大幅低估失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating two systems in one cable route as independent understates failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「資料延遲與判斷鏈」與「荷載循環與疲勞累積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Data latency in decisions" and "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「資料延遲與判斷鏈」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Data latency in decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。 假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「資料延遲與判斷鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain. Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Data latency in decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Data latency in decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈
knowledge.text: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。將取樣延遲和運算時間分開，才能定位錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. A plausible displayed water level may be stale, so sampling latency must be separated from computation time to diagnose the chain.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「資料延遲與判斷鏈」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Data latency in decisions" is correct?
options: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。
多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。
累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
optionsEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags.
Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale.
A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
quiz.explanation: 自動判斷取決於資料的新鮮度、時鐘與品質旗標，畫面顯示合理水位仍可能是舊值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Automated decisions depend on data age, synchronized clocks and quality flags. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Data latency in decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Uncompensated difference is 0.48 m, a short-term linear illustration rather than a storm-surge forecast.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Data latency in decisions", which statement holds?
options: 球鉸能自由轉動，所以不會傳遞巨大的支承反力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。
曲面門體的靜水壓合力永遠只有水平方向分量。
optionsEn: A freely rotating spherical joint cannot transmit large support reactions.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min.
Hydrostatic loading on a curved gate always has only a horizontal component.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水位線性上升0.12 m/min、資料延遲4 min，未補償的水位差0.48 m；只示範短時線性估算，不外推真實暴潮。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume level rises linearly at 0.12 m/min and data latency is 4 min. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「資料延遲與判斷鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Data latency in decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。以原始量測時間重排事件，核對資料更新旗標能否辨識通訊恢復後抵達的過期讀數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors. Reorder events by measurement time and verify that freshness flags identify stale readings arriving after communications recover. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以資料延遲與判斷鏈編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for data latency in decisions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。以原始量測時間重排事件，核對資料更新旗標能否辨識通訊恢復後抵達的過期讀數。
knowledge.textEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors. Reorder events by measurement time and verify that freshness flags identify stale readings arriving after communications recover.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以資料延遲與判斷鏈編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for data latency in decisions, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verify traceable quality flags and distinguish transmission errors from estimation errors.

quiz.question: 要驗證「資料延遲與判斷鏈」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Data latency in decisions"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
總漏流減小就表示所有閘底局部流速都同時減小。
在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Reduced total leakage means every local under-gate velocity also decreases.
In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records.
quiz.explanation: 在離線回放中保留量測時刻與接收時刻，注入舊資料、跳值及缺測，確認品質旗標可追溯；把錯誤定位到傳輸或推估階段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: In offline replay, preserve measurement and receipt times and inject stale, discontinuous or missing records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 資料延遲與判斷鏈：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Data latency in decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「資料延遲與判斷鏈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Data latency in decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多個測站讀數一致就能證明資料沒有過時問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Agreement among several stations proves that none of their data is stale." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。多站同時延遲不能被誤當成一致的高品質證據。
knowledge.textEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Replacing measurement time with arrival time conceals this defect, and several equally delayed stations do not constitute independent high-quality confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「資料延遲與判斷鏈」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Data latency in decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
optionsEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
quiz.explanation: 重傳機制可能讓資料最後到達卻已失去時效；以接收時刻覆蓋原始時間戳會掩蓋問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Retransmission may deliver data too late for its purpose. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「荷載循環與疲勞累積」如何影響荷蘭馬仕朗防潮閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Maeslant storm-surge barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。 假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「荷載循環與疲勞累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations. Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積
knowledge.text: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。疲勞累積依應力範圍分組，小幅循環數量多也可能有影響，但線性損傷和忽略序列只是近似。
knowledge.textEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. Fatigue accumulation groups stress ranges; many smaller cycles may matter, but linear damage and sequence independence remain approximations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「荷載循環與疲勞累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation" is correct?
options: 累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。
大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。
浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
optionsEn: A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety.
Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms.
Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
quiz.explanation: 大型活動結構除風暴荷載外也承受測試與維修循環。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving structures experience test and maintenance cycles as well as storms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Miner sum D=0.02+0.03=0.05. Assumed capacities do not predict remaining calendar life.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 鋼材尚未降伏時，細長受壓桿件就不可能屈曲。
壓載艙半滿一定比空艙或全滿時更穩定。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05。
optionsEn: A slender compression member cannot buckle before its steel yields.
A half-full ballast tank is always more stable than an empty or full tank.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩組循環n1=2000、N1=100000與n2=300、N2=10000，Miner和D=0.02+0.03=0.05；N值為假設，不作剩餘年限預測。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle groups n1=2000, N1=100000 and n2=300, N2=10000. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 荷載循環與疲勞累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「荷載循環與疲勞累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。以局部應變循環重新分箱計數，將雨流計數所得範圍與所用疲勞細節曲線一致對應。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail. Rebin local strain cycles and consistently match rainflow stress ranges to the selected fatigue-detail curve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以荷載循環與疲勞累積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for load cycles and fatigue accumulation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify stress cycles from local strain histories and check weld detail and corrosion condition. Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。以局部應變循環重新分箱計數，將雨流計數所得範圍與所用疲勞細節曲線一致對應。

Count movement modes separately and use crack inspection to challenge the calculation assumption of an intact detail. Rebin local strain cycles and consistently match rainflow stress ranges to the selected fatigue-detail curve.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation"?
options: 從局部應變時間史辨認循環範圍，核對焊縫細節和腐蝕狀態；將不同運動模式分開計數，並以裂紋檢查挑戰無損傷的計算假設。

steps.titleEn: Load cycles and fatigue accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「荷載循環與疲勞累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Load cycles and fatigue accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「累積疲勞損傷小於一就能保證構件永久安全無裂紋。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fatigue damage sum below one guarantees permanent crack-free safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。若只記錄關閘次數而未量應力範圍，也無法建立可靠疲勞譜。
knowledge.textEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Closure counts alone cannot establish a fatigue spectrum without stress ranges.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「荷載循環與疲勞累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Load cycles and fatigue accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。
浮力與重量平衡就能保證門體漂浮姿態穩定。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life.
Balanced buoyancy and weight guarantee a stable floating attitude.
quiz.explanation: 小於一的損傷和不是無裂紋證明，初始缺陷、應力集中與腐蝕會改變壽命。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A damage sum below one does not prove absence of cracks; initial defects, stress concentration and corrosion alter life. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 泰晤士河防洪閘
courses.summary: 本課以泰晤士河防洪閘為入口，深入旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Thames Barrier as its entry point, this course examines rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 旋轉閘門力矩、河潮聯合作用與長期調適
courses.focusEn: Rotating-gate torque, combined river and tidal effects, and long-term adaptation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 另作固定姿態的敏感度比較：力臂維持1.5 m、淨重量與浮力矩−2 MN·m、摩擦矩0.5 MN·m，只把水壓合力4 MN改為5 MN。需求轉矩F×1.5−2+0.5由4.5增至6.0 MN·m，增加33.33%；這是獨立力擾動，不把它當作水位變動時力臂也固定的真實閘門預測。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. At the same posture, keep the lever arm at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment at −2 MN·m and friction moment at 0.5 MN·m, changing only water resultant from 4 MN to 5 MN. Required torque F×1.5−2+0.5 rises from 4.5 to 6.0 MN·m, or 33.33%. This isolated force perturbation does not predict a real stage change, which may also shift the lever arm.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「旋轉門體驅動力矩」與「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rotating-gate drive torque" and "Surge phase and tidal superposition": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rotating-gate drive torque” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。 假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 密封摩擦、沉積物與軸承偏心會讓負載峰值偏離理想曲線。若只以平均馬達功率檢查能力，短暫的起動高扭矩和局部拘束可能被完全掩蓋。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋轉門體驅動力矩」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque. At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Seal friction, sediment and bearing eccentricity shift peaks away from ideal curves. Average motor power can conceal brief breakaway torque demands and local restraint that govern actual motion capability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rotating-gate drive torque” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rotating-gate drive torque”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩
knowledge.text: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。各力臂隨角度改變，最大水壓不一定對應最大驅動需求。
knowledge.textEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. Lever arms vary with angle, so maximum water pressure need not coincide with maximum required drive torque.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旋轉門體驅動力矩」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rotating-gate drive torque" is correct?
options: 最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。
兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
optionsEn: Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction.
Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
quiz.explanation: 旋轉閘門的驅動需求來自重量、浮力、水壓與摩擦的合成力矩。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Drive demand combines moments from weight, buoyancy, water pressure and friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rotating-gate drive torque” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Required torque is 4.5 MN·m for that static posture only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「旋轉門體驅動力矩」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rotating-gate drive torque", which statement holds?
options: 只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。
油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m。
optionsEn: Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設某角度水壓合力4 MN、力臂1.5 m，重量與浮力淨力矩−2 MN·m，摩擦0.5 MN·m；需求4.5 MN·m，僅該姿態靜力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: At one assumed angle, water force 4 MN acts at 1.5 m, net weight-buoyancy moment is −2 MN·m and friction is 0.5 MN·m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 旋轉門體驅動力矩：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rotating-gate drive torque: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「旋轉門體驅動力矩」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rotating-gate drive torque” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿轉角建立分項力矩曲線，對照油壓、位置與轉速資料；分開啟動摩擦和持續轉動阻力，避免只用終點水位解釋整段動作。比較起轉前後扭矩殘差，確認峰值是外載改變還是靜摩擦釋放造成的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build component moment curves against angle and compare pressure, position and speed. Separate breakaway friction from running resistance instead of explaining an entire movement by the final water level. Compare torque residuals before and after breakaway to separate changed external load from the release of static friction. steps.title: 暴潮相位與潮汐疊加：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Surge phase and tidal superposition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 天文潮與氣象暴潮的峰值可能不同時到達。簡單線性相加可說明相位重要性，真實河口中摩擦與水深又使交互作用非線性。 假設潮位2cosθ m、暴潮1cos(θ+60°) m，合成振幅√(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m，非兩峰直接相加3 m。 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Astronomical tide and meteorological surge can peak at different times. Linear addition illustrates phase effects, while friction and changing depth make real estuarine interaction nonlinear. Assume tide 2cosθ m and surge 1cos(θ+60°) m. Combined amplitude is √(2²+1²+2×2×1cos60°)=2.646 m, rather than the direct peak sum of 3 m. Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Surge phase and tidal superposition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把不同來源水位換到同一時間與高程基準，檢查預報相位誤差；比較水深不同期間的殘差，以辨識線性疊加何時不再適用。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Convert water levels to common time and elevation references and examine phase errors.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
quiz.explanation: 把不同來源水位換到同一時間與高程基準，檢查預報相位誤差；比較水深不同期間的殘差，以辨識線性疊加何時不再適用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert water levels to common time and elevation references and examine phase errors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 暴潮相位與潮汐疊加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Surge phase and tidal superposition: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Surge phase and tidal superposition” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。模型驗證若只比最高水位，會漏掉危險持續時間。
knowledge.textEn: Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Validation limited to peak level overlooks the duration of hazardous conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「暴潮相位與潮汐疊加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Surge phase and tidal superposition" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation.
quiz.explanation: 取兩個不同時刻的最大值相加可能過度保守，也可能忽略風暴改變潮波傳播後的新峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding maxima from separate times can be overly conservative yet still miss peaks created by changed tidal propagation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「關閉期間河水蓄積」與「通航窗口與排程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "River storage during closure" and "Navigation windows and scheduling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 關閉期間河水蓄積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: River storage during closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「關閉期間河水蓄積」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “River storage during closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。 假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉期間河水蓄積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. Available storage depends on bank elevations and tributaries, not only the level beside the barrier. Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “River storage during closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「關閉期間河水蓄積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “River storage during closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 關閉期間河水蓄積
knowledge.text: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。可用庫容取決於沿岸高程與支流，不能只看閘前水位。
knowledge.textEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. Available storage depends on bank elevations and tributaries, not only the level beside the barrier.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關閉期間河水蓄積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "River storage during closure" is correct?
options: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。
關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。
optionsEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
quiz.explanation: 阻隔海潮時，上游河流仍持續入流，受保護河段因此變成暫時蓄水體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When sea levels are excluded, river inflow continues and the protected reach temporarily stores water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 關閉期間河水蓄積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: River storage during closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「關閉期間河水蓄積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “River storage during closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「關閉期間河水蓄積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "River storage during closure", which statement holds?
options: 油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m。
一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
optionsEn: Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage.
One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設關閉期間淨入流300 m³/s持續2 h、有效水面20 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m；忽略側向溢流與面積隨水位變化。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 300 m³/s for two hours over effective area 20 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.108 m, excluding lateral spill and changes of area with stage. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 關閉期間河水蓄積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: River storage during closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「關閉期間河水蓄積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “River storage during closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。檢查各支流入流與儲水增量之和，量化忽略側向入流對上游水位估算的影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately. Close tributary inflows against storage increase and quantify how omitted lateral inflow changes the upstream level estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以關閉期間河水蓄積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for river storage during closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。檢查各支流入流與儲水增量之和，量化忽略側向入流對上游水位估算的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately. Close tributary inflows against storage increase and quantify how omitted lateral inflow changes the upstream level estimate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以關閉期間河水蓄積編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for river storage during closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Test whether one storage area still represents the water-surface slope and estimate unmeasured lateral inflow separately.

quiz.question: 要驗證「關閉期間河水蓄積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "River storage during closure"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations.
quiz.explanation: 用上游流量、支流雨量與多站水位建立同期水量平衡，檢查水面坡度是否仍可用單一儲水面積描述；另計未量測的側向流入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a synchronized balance from river flow, tributary rainfall and multiple water-level stations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。以平坦水面替代長河段水力坡降，還會低估某些支流交會處的局部水位。
knowledge.textEn: Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Replacing a long river gradient with a flat surface can underestimate levels near particular tributary junctions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關閉期間河水蓄積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "River storage during closure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。
optionsEn: Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
quiz.explanation: 只防海側高水位而忽略河流洪峰，可能把洪水留在防線內側。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excluding the sea while overlooking a river flood can retain water inside the defence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通航窗口與排程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Navigation windows and scheduling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。 假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。把通過閘區的時間與完整航段時間混用，則會錯算容量並掩蓋航道瓶頸。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通航窗口與排程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure. Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. Mixing barrier-crossing time with complete-route time miscalculates capacity and conceals bottlenecks elsewhere in the navigation channel. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Navigation windows and scheduling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通航窗口與排程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Navigation windows and scheduling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通航窗口與排程
knowledge.text: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。平均船舶到達率無法描述尖峰排隊與關閉後的復原時間。
knowledge.textEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. Windows depend on level, clearance and availability; average vessel arrivals do not describe peak queues or recovery after a closure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通航窗口與排程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Navigation windows and scheduling" is correct?

活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。
清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
optionsEn: Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
A movable flood defence is also a navigation route.
Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
quiz.explanation: 活動防洪結構同時是航運通道，通航窗口受水位、橋下空間與設備可用性約束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A movable flood defence is also a navigation route. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通航窗口與排程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Navigation windows and scheduling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. After reopening, service six and arrivals four per hour require 12/(6−4)=6 hours to clear. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通航窗口與排程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Navigation windows and scheduling", which statement holds?

一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels。
optionsEn: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.

quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設停航3 h、到達率4 vessels/h，累積12 vessels；重開後處理6 vessels/h且仍到達4 vessels/h，清空需12/(6−4)=6 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume closure three hours with arrival rate four vessels per hour, accumulating twelve vessels. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 通航窗口與排程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Navigation windows and scheduling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通航窗口與排程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Navigation windows and scheduling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名化船舶到達與通過時間畫累積曲線，核對服務率是否受船型和潮向影響；將安全間隔和商業需求分列，避免把理論容量當保證。從累積到達與離開曲線的垂直距離求隊列，並核對復原斜率是否真正大於到達率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput. Derive queue size from cumulative arrival-departure separation and verify that recovery service genuinely exceeds arrivals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Plot cumulative anonymous arrival and transit records, checking vessel-type and tidal effects on service rate. Separate safety spacing from commercial demand instead of presenting theoretical capacity as guaranteed throughput.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若重開後服務率只等於到達率，既有隊列永遠無法消散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If reopened service merely matches arrivals, the existing queue never clears. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門槽沉積與淨空」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。平均淤積厚度不能代表單個硬物或高點，幾何檢查必須覆蓋整段掃掠體積。 假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門槽沉積與淨空」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A recessed gate requires a defined swept space. Sediment changes clearance and local flow, while average deposit thickness cannot represent isolated hard objects or high spots across that volume. Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 門槽沉積與淨空

quiz.question: 關於「門槽沉積與淨空」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。
optionsEn: Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
A recessed gate requires a defined swept space.
quiz.explanation: 下沉式門體需要特定運動空間，門槽沉積改變淨空與局部水流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「門槽沉積與淨空」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設槽底面積400 m²、均勻淤積厚0.08 m，沉積體積32 m³；若濕容重16 kN/m³，重量512 kN，不代表驅動附加力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume recess area 400 m² with uniform deposit 0.08 m thick: volume 32 m³. At wet unit weight 16 kN/m³, weight is 512 kN, not the added drive force. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「門槽沉積與淨空」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。逐格比較測深不確定度與門體幾何裕度，對最接近掃掠包絡的高點安排獨立複測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes. Compare sounding uncertainty with geometric allowance cell by cell and independently resurvey high spots nearest the swept envelope. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以門槽沉積與淨空編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gate-recess sediment and clearance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Use repeatable bathymetry and imagery to identify high spots and distinguish loose sediment from hard debris. Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Overlay the gate swept volume on surveyed surfaces and preserve before-and-after changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「門槽沉積與淨空」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gate-recess sediment and clearance"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用可重複定位的測深與影像核對槽底高點，區分鬆散泥砂和硬質異物；把門體掃掠幾何疊合測量面，保存清理前後差異。

Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.

steps.title: 門槽沉積與淨空：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gate-recess sediment and clearance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「門槽沉積與淨空」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gate-recess sediment and clearance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uniform deposits underestimate jamming from isolated blocks, and removal can expose existing sill damage. Excavated volume alone cannot establish that the entire required swept space has been restored. steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。若只用挖除體積驗收，不能證明全部運動空間已恢復。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「門槽沉積與淨空」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gate-recess sediment and clearance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
均勻沉積假設會低估孤立塊體造成的卡阻，移除沉積也可能暴露既有底板損傷。

Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
