steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「液壓功率與效率」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic power and efficiency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。相同壓力下流量不足會降低速度，不能只憑壓力表判斷動作能力。 假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「液壓功率與效率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. Insufficient flow reduces speed even at normal pressure, so a gauge alone cannot establish movement capability. Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients. Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic power and efficiency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic power and efficiency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 液壓功率與效率
knowledge.text: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。相同壓力下流量不足會降低速度，不能只憑壓力表判斷動作能力。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. Insufficient flow reduces speed even at normal pressure, so a gauge alone cannot establish movement capability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「液壓功率與效率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic power and efficiency" is correct?
options: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。
油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
optionsEn: Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
quiz.explanation: 液壓驅動把流體壓力與流量轉成機械功率，泵的電功率還包含損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic drives convert pressure and flow into mechanical power, while electrical input also covers losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「液壓功率與效率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic power and efficiency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Input ΔpQ/η=300 kW, for steady flow without acceleration or accumulator transients.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「液壓功率與效率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic power and efficiency", which statement holds?
options: 一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設壓差12 MPa、流量0.02 m³/s、總效率0.8，輸入功率ΔpQ/η=300 kW；穩定流量，未含加速與儲能器瞬態。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pressure difference 12 MPa, flow 0.02 m³/s and overall efficiency 0.8. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「液壓功率與效率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic power and efficiency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。將能量差換算成熱產生量並核對油溫趨勢，確認內漏推論符合能量守恆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses. Convert the power difference into heat generation and compare temperature trends to test the leakage interpretation against energy conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以液壓功率與效率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic power and efficiency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses. Convert the power difference into heat generation and compare temperature trends to test the leakage interpretation against energy conservation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以液壓功率與效率編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic power and efficiency, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Identify pump-side versus cylinder-side measurements to avoid double-counting line losses.

quiz.question: 要驗證「液壓功率與效率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic power and efficiency"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測油壓、流量、溫度和門位速率，比較液壓輸入與機械輸出；確認量測位置是在泵側或缸側，避免把管路損失重複計入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure pressure, flow, temperature and gate speed together, comparing hydraulic input with mechanical output. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 液壓功率與效率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic power and efficiency: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「液壓功率與效率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic power and efficiency” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。只檢查電流或單點壓力，可能把效率惡化誤認為正常的負載變動。
knowledge.textEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Current or pressure alone may make declining efficiency look like an ordinary change in external loading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「液壓功率與效率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic power and efficiency" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
optionsEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
quiz.explanation: 內漏使壓力維持但有效行程流量減少，油溫上升又改變黏度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal leakage can preserve pressure while reducing useful cylinder flow, and heating changes viscosity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「防線接續高程」與「波浪脈衝與反力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Continuous defence elevations" and "Wave impulse and reaction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防線接續高程」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Continuous defence elevations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。 假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防線接續高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height. Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Continuous defence elevations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防線接續高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Continuous defence elevations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防線接續高程
knowledge.text: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。水位基準、沉降與門檻高程的差異往往比平均牆高更重要。
knowledge.textEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. Local low points bypass strong main structures, making datum consistency, settlement and sill elevation more important than average wall height.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防線接續高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Continuous defence elevations" is correct?
options: 主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。
一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
optionsEn: Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line.
One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
quiz.explanation: 防洪閘與兩岸堤牆必須形成連續高程線，局部低點會繞過強大的主結構。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Barrier and bank defences must form a continuous elevation line. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防線接續高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Continuous defence elevations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Remaining geometric freeboard is 0.58 m, excluding wave runup and probabilistic margins. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防線接續高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Continuous defence elevations", which statement holds?
options: 長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設牆頂高程5.8 m、評估水位5.1 m、沉降0.12 m，剩餘幾何超高0.58 m；不含波浪上衝或統計安全裕度。
optionsEn: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume crest elevation 5.8 m, assessed water level 5.1 m and settlement 0.12 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防線接續高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Continuous defence elevations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。對最低接續點進行反向水準複測，將量測閉合差納入幾何超高的不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys. Repeat leveling in reverse at the lowest connection and include survey closure error in the freeboard uncertainty. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以防線接續高程編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for continuous defence elevations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Retain settlement rates and map versions to prevent mixing elevations from different surveys.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防線接續高程」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Continuous defence elevations"?
options: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
quiz.explanation: 沿整條防線進行共同基準閉合水準測量，標出接頭、道路與管線穿越低點；將最新沉降速率與地圖版本一起保存，避免混用不同年代高程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Run closed leveling on a common datum along the full defence, marking joints, roads and utility crossings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防線接續高程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Continuous defence elevations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防線接續高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Continuous defence elevations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。以地圖等高線代替接縫精密測量，會把繞流通道藏在資料解析度之下。
knowledge.textEn: A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Coarse map contours can hide bypass routes that require detailed joint and crossing surveys.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防線接續高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Continuous defence elevations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。
一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue.
One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
quiz.explanation: 主閘設計再強也不能彌補遠端牆頂低點，局部沉降又可能持續發展。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A strong main barrier cannot compensate for a distant low crest, and settlement may continue. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 波浪脈衝與反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave impulse and reaction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波浪脈衝與反力」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave impulse and reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。靜水壓力不能替代瞬態結構反應。 假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波浪脈衝與反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave impact depends on both peak and duration. A short impulse affects a flexible member differently from a sustained load of equal peak, so hydrostatics cannot substitute for transient structural response. Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Impulse J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s; displacement and fatigue are not obtained from this alone. Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave impulse and reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波浪脈衝與反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave impulse and reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 波浪脈衝與反力

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「波浪脈衝與反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wave impulse and reaction" is correct?
options: 一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。
optionsEn: One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Wave impact depends on both peak and duration.
quiz.explanation: 波浪撞擊的峰值和持續時間共同決定脈衝，短脈衝對柔性構件的作用不同於同峰值的長載重。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「波浪脈衝與反力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wave impulse and reaction", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形力脈衝峰值2 MN、歷時0.4 s，衝量J=FmaxΔt/2=0.4 MN·s；未由此直接求位移或疲勞。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a triangular force pulse with peak 2 MN and duration 0.4 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 波浪脈衝與反力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wave impulse and reaction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波浪脈衝與反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wave impulse and reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。用原始高頻資料重新積分衝量，檢查不同感測器峰值是否在同一時間真正重疊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model. Reintegrate impulse from raw high-frequency data and check whether peaks at separate sensors actually coincide in time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以波浪脈衝與反力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wave impulse and reaction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。用原始高頻資料重新積分衝量，檢查不同感測器峰值是否在同一時間真正重疊。
knowledge.textEn: Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model. Reintegrate impulse from raw high-frequency data and check whether peaks at separate sensors actually coincide in time.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以波浪脈衝與反力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for wave impulse and reaction, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Compare duration with structural natural period to choose an appropriate dynamic model.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波浪脈衝與反力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wave impulse and reaction"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。
清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks.
Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
quiz.explanation: 用足夠取樣率的壓力和加速度訊號核對脈衝形狀，查濾波是否削掉短峰；再比較脈衝歷時與結構自振週期，決定動力模型層級。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check pulse shape with sufficiently sampled pressure and acceleration records, examining whether filtering removes brief peaks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波浪脈衝與反力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wave impulse and reaction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波浪脈衝與反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wave impulse and reaction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一個壓力計的瞬間峰值能直接代表整門瞬時合力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One sensor pressure peak directly represents the instantaneous whole-gate resultant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。氣泡含量及局部接觸使相鄰壓力計不一定同步到峰。
knowledge.textEn: Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Air content and local contact mean adjacent sensors need not peak simultaneously.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波浪脈衝與反力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wave impulse and reaction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force.
quiz.explanation: 低取樣率可能完全漏掉撞擊峰值，過度放大峰值而忽略面積與相位也會誤判總力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low sampling may miss impact peaks, while multiplying one peak over the entire area misstates total force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「檢測覆蓋與可用度」與「海平面情境與調適」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Test coverage and availability" and "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢測覆蓋與可用度」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Test coverage and availability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。 假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測覆蓋與可用度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model. Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Test coverage and availability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Test coverage and availability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度
knowledge.text: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。檢測間隔與潛伏失效機率相關，但獨立恆定失效率只是基礎模型。
knowledge.textEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. Test interval influences latent unavailability, but constant independent failure rate is only a basic model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「檢測覆蓋與可用度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Test coverage and availability" is correct?
options: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。
一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
optionsEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads.
One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
quiz.explanation: 定期測試只能發現被測功能的故障，無法保證未施加的環境與荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Periodic tests reveal only exercised failures, not untested environments and loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Test coverage and availability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Mean unavailability is approximately λT/2=0.003, for small λT and complete detection.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Test coverage and availability", which statement holds?
options: 兩個不同時刻的水位峰值相加就是實際聯合峰值。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003。
只要航道重新開放，等待船舶隊列就會立即消失。
optionsEn: Adding water-level peaks from different times gives the actual combined peak.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days.
Reopening the navigation route immediately eliminates every waiting vessel queue.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設潛伏失效率λ=0.0002/day、完全檢測間隔30 days，平均不可用度近似λT/2=0.003；限λT很小及完美檢測。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume latent failure rate λ=0.0002/day and perfect-test interval 30 days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢測覆蓋與可用度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Test coverage and availability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。將未覆蓋的故障模式逐一對應替代證據，確認停機維修時間沒有從可用度分母中刪除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately. Map uncovered failure modes to alternative evidence and verify that maintenance downtime remains in the availability denominator. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以檢測覆蓋與可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for test coverage and availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Record discovery time, repair time and outage cause separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢測覆蓋與可用度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Test coverage and availability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
油壓讀數正常就能保證有足夠流量完成預定動作。
列出每項演練涵蓋的感測、傳動與負載條件，將未涵蓋功能保留在分析中；把檢出時間、修復時間和停機原因分別記錄。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Normal hydraulic pressure guarantees enough flow for the planned movement.
List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment.

quiz.explanationEn: List sensors, transmission paths and loading conditions covered by each exercise, retaining uncovered functions in the assessment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋與可用度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Test coverage and availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測覆蓋與可用度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Test coverage and availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次測試成功就代表所有設備失效模式均已受測。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One successful test means every equipment failure mode has been exercised." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。維修造成的暫時停用也屬可用度問題，不能因主設備故障率低就忽略。
knowledge.textEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Maintenance outages also reduce availability and cannot be ignored merely because the main equipment has a low failure rate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢測覆蓋與可用度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Test coverage and availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
optionsEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
quiz.explanation: 若測試只能檢出部分故障，延續使用完美檢測公式會低估風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using perfect-test formulas when only some failures are detectable understates risk. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「海平面情境與調適」如何影響泰晤士河防洪閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Thames Barrier”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。 假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「海平面情境與調適」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend. Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「海平面情境與調適」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 海平面情境與調適
knowledge.text: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。情境外推用來比較方案，並非保證未來趨勢。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. Scenario extrapolation compares options rather than guaranteeing a future trend.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「海平面情境與調適」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation" is correct?
options: 長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。
長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions.
Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 長期海平面變化會改變關閉頻率、河流排水窗口和維護時間，而不只提高一道設計水位。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term sea-level change affects closure frequency, drainage windows and maintenance time, not only a design level. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「海平面情境與調適」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. An assumed acceleration 0.05 mm/year² adds 0.5at²=0.04 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「海平面情境與調適」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation", which statement holds?
options: 關閘排除海水後，上游水位就不可能繼續上升。
清出預定泥砂總量就能證明所有門槽淨空足夠。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m。
optionsEn: Upstream water level cannot keep rising after the sea is excluded.
Removing the planned sediment volume proves sufficient clearance throughout the recess.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設線性相對海平面上升5 mm/year持續40 years，增量0.20 m；另假設加速項0.05 mm/year²，額外0.5at²=0.04 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume linear relative sea-level rise 5 mm/year over 40 years, giving 0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

Compare scenario effects on drainage windows and closure cycles, stating which changes first trigger reassessment of system function.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以海平面情境與調適編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sea-level scenarios and adaptation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Separate observed trends from planning assumptions and compare freeboard, drainage duration and equipment-cycle sensitivity across scenarios.

quiz.question: 要驗證「海平面情境與調適」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation"?
options: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
主閘高度足夠就表示整條沿岸防洪牆都同樣足夠。
optionsEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate main-barrier height proves sufficient elevation along every shoreline defence.
quiz.explanation: 把潮位站、地面沉降與情境模型的基準年份對齊，分列觀測趨勢和規劃假設；比較超高、排水時間及設備使用次數對不同情境的敏感性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align baseline years for tide gauges, land movement and scenarios. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 海平面情境與調適：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sea-level scenarios and adaptation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「海平面情境與調適」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sea-level scenarios and adaptation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「長期調適只需把海平面增量加到牆頂，其他功能不受影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Long-term adaptation only adds sea-level rise to crest height without affecting other functions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。若只加高牆體而不評估關閉增加，設備疲勞和內河排水需求仍可能失配。
knowledge.textEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Raising walls without examining more frequent closures can leave equipment fatigue and inland drainage demands poorly matched.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「海平面情境與調適」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sea-level scenarios and adaptation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。
最大水壓時刻必定同時是最大驅動力矩時刻。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change.
Maximum water pressure always coincides with maximum drive torque.
quiz.explanation: 以單一線性速率規劃全部壽命，可能忽略加速、區域沉降與潮汐改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One linear rate may miss acceleration, local subsidence and tidal change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統
courses.summary: 本課以威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統為入口，深入浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Venice MOSE flood barriers as its entry point, this course examines coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合
courses.focusEn: Coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 靜水壓敏感度固定ρ=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²及大氣壓101.3 kPa，只將水深8 m增為10 m。表壓ρgh由80.442增至100.5525 kPa，增加25%；絕壓則由181.742增至201.8525 kPa，其增幅不是25%。比較只包含靜水柱，不推定送氣管損、閘門浮力或動態壓力同步變化。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For hydrostatic sensitivity, hold ρ=1025 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s² and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa fixed, increasing only depth from 8 m to 10 m. Gauge pressure ρgh rises from 80.442 to 100.5525 kPa, or 25%; absolute pressure rises from 181.742 to 201.8525 kPa, not by 25%. This column calculation does not infer pipe losses, gate buoyancy or dynamic pressures.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮力翻轉與重心」與「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Buoyant rotation and centroids" and "Air pressure and absolute pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮力翻轉與重心：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Buoyant rotation and centroids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮力翻轉與重心」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Buoyant rotation and centroids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 翻板內水被空氣置換後，浮力和自重對鉸軸的力矩改變，門體才會轉動。上浮不是氣壓直接把整片門推出水面，還必須考慮外部水壓和重心位置。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。 氣室進水不均會移動重心，改變各鉸座受力。若把完全浸沒的浮力公式沿用到出水後，排水體積與力臂都會錯，進而誤判平衡角度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮力翻轉與重心」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing internal water with air changes buoyancy and weight moments about the hinge. Rotation is not simply air pressure pushing the entire gate upward; external pressure and centroid positions also matter. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Unequal flooding shifts the center of gravity and hinge reactions. Reusing fully submerged buoyancy after emergence gives incorrect displacement and lever arms, leading to a false equilibrium angle. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Buoyant rotation and centroids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總浮力大於自重就能直接決定翻板的唯一平衡角。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Buoyancy exceeding weight directly determines the unique flap equilibrium angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮力翻轉與重心」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Buoyant rotation and centroids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮力翻轉與重心
knowledge.text: 翻板內水被空氣置換後，浮力和自重對鉸軸的力矩改變，門體才會轉動。上浮不是氣壓直接把整片門推出水面，還必須考慮外部水壓和重心位置。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing internal water with air changes buoyancy and weight moments about the hinge. Rotation is not simply air pressure pushing the entire gate upward; external pressure and centroid positions also matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總浮力大於自重就能直接決定翻板的唯一平衡角。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Buoyancy exceeding weight directly determines the unique flap equilibrium angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮力翻轉與重心」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Buoyant rotation and centroids" is correct?
options: 總浮力大於自重就能直接決定翻板的唯一平衡角。
翻板內水被空氣置換後，浮力和自重對鉸軸的力矩改變，門體才會轉動。
氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。
optionsEn: Buoyancy exceeding weight directly determines the unique flap equilibrium angle.
Replacing internal water with air changes buoyancy and weight moments about the hinge.
Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure.
quiz.explanation: 翻板內水被空氣置換後，浮力和自重對鉸軸的力矩改變，門體才會轉動。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing internal water with air changes buoyancy and weight moments about the hinge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮力翻轉與重心：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Buoyant rotation and centroids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮力翻轉與重心」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Buoyant rotation and centroids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以門角、內外水位與艙氣壓同步重建排水體積，將浮心與重心分開定位；檢查力矩符號是否隨角度改變，避免只比較總浮力與重量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconstruct displacement from synchronized angle, internal and external levels and air pressure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設有效排水體積500 m³、海水密度1025 kg/m³、浮力臂3 m，自重3 MN、重心臂4 m；淨復原矩為3.083 MN·m，限靜水姿態。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume displaced volume 500 m³, seawater density 1025 kg/m³, buoyancy arm 3 m, weight 3 MN and weight arm 4 m. Net restoring moment is 3.083 MN·m for that hydrostatic posture.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮力翻轉與重心」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instruction: 氣室進水不均會移動重心，改變各鉸座受力。若把完全浸沒的浮力公式沿用到出水後，排水體積與力臂都會錯，進而誤判平衡角度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unequal flooding shifts the center of gravity and hinge reactions. Reusing fully submerged buoyancy after emergence gives incorrect displacement and lever arms, leading to a false equilibrium angle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air pressure and absolute pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 排水用空氣必須克服水深造成的外壓，壓縮氣體的狀態方程則使用絕對壓力。把表壓帶入氣體體積換算，會造成系統性的質量估算錯誤。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設海水深8 m、密度1025 kg/m³、大氣壓101.3 kPa，靜水表壓80.442 kPa、絕壓181.742 kPa；不含管損與動態壓差。 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Displacement air must overcome external water pressure, while gas state relations require absolute pressure. Inserting gauge pressure into volume conversion systematically miscalculates air mass. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume seawater depth 8 m, density 1025 kg/m³ and atmospheric pressure 101.3 kPa. Gauge pressure is 80.442 kPa and absolute pressure 181.742 kPa, excluding piping losses and dynamics. Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air pressure and absolute pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
