steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。用靜止水柱核驗表壓轉換，檢查導壓管高差是否被正確加回水深推估。
knowledge.textEn: Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements. Verify gauge conversion with a stationary water column and check that impulse-line elevation is correctly included in depth inference.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以氣壓水深與絕對壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air pressure and absolute pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Cross-check the water-column height inferred from air pressure against independent level measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air pressure and absolute pressure"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。
壓力感測器讀數一致就證明共同取壓管沒有問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure.
Matching pressure readings prove the shared impulse connection has no defect.
quiz.explanation: 標明每支壓力計為表壓或絕壓，核對取壓點高程和當時大氣壓；利用獨立水位量測交叉檢查氣壓所推得的水柱高度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify each gauge as relative or absolute, checking tapping elevation and atmospheric pressure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 氣壓水深與絕對壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air pressure and absolute pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air pressure and absolute pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。若只用壓力上升判斷門位，可能把管路堵塞或熱效應當成正常浮升。
knowledge.textEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Pressure rise alone can therefore mistake blockage or thermal effects for the expected gate movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「氣壓水深與絕對壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air pressure and absolute pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。
導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume.
Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air.
quiz.explanation: 導壓管積水會改變零點，溫度變動也會使封閉氣體壓力改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Water in impulse lines changes zero, and temperature changes pressure in confined air. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「空氣供應與壓縮功」與「鉸座荷載分配」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Air supply and compression work" and "Hinge reaction distribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air supply and compression work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「空氣供應與壓縮功」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air supply and compression work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。理想等溫模型提供能耗下界，不能代表真實機組效率。 假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。 壓縮熱若未散去，等溫假設會低估功率；漏氣又使供氣量不等於有效排水量。把氣量和門體位移直接一對一換算，會漏掉可壓縮儲能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「空氣供應與壓縮功」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency. Delivered volume is not free-air volume at the same pressure. Ideal isothermal work is a lower-bound model, not an actual machine rating. Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa. Ideal isothermal power p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW, excluding mechanical and thermal losses. Incomplete heat rejection makes the isothermal estimate optimistic, and leakage separates supplied air from effective displacement. Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air supply and compression work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「空氣供應與壓縮功」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Air supply and compression work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功
knowledge.text: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。理想等溫模型提供能耗下界，不能代表真實機組效率。
knowledge.textEn: Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency. Delivered volume is not free-air volume at the same pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「空氣供應與壓縮功」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Air supply and compression work" is correct?
options: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。
供氣量增加一定等比例增加浮門的排水體積。
只要有兩座鉸鏈，每座就永遠承受一半荷載。
optionsEn: Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency.
Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume.
With two hinges each always carries exactly half the applied load.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮機功率取決於壓比、流量、熱交換和效率，注入體積不是同壓力下的自由空氣體積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressor power depends on pressure ratio, flow, heat exchange and efficiency. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Air supply and compression work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「空氣供應與壓縮功」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Air supply and compression work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-air flow 2 m³/s, inlet absolute pressure 100 kPa and outlet 200 kPa. Ideal isothermal power p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW, excluding mechanical and thermal losses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄流量換算的參考溫壓，對照壓縮機入口出口狀態和電功率；用儲氣壓力變化核對總氣量平衡，避免把瞬時充氣量當長期平均。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record flow reference temperature and pressure, comparing compressor inlet and outlet states with electrical power.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設自由空氣流量2 m³/s、入口絕壓100 kPa、出口200 kPa，等溫理想功率p1Q1ln(p2/p1)=138.63 kW；未含機械與熱損失。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「空氣供應與壓縮功」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Air supply and compression work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄流量換算的參考溫壓，對照壓縮機入口出口狀態和電功率；用儲氣壓力變化核對總氣量平衡，避免把瞬時充氣量當長期平均。用入口質量流率與儲氣質量增量閉合空氣平衡，另列溫升和漏氣造成的差額。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.title: 空氣供應與壓縮功：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 壓縮熱若未散去，等溫假設會低估功率；漏氣又使供氣量不等於有效排水量。把氣量和門體位移直接一對一換算，會漏掉可壓縮儲能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incomplete heat rejection makes the isothermal estimate optimistic, and leakage separates supplied air from effective displacement. Equating air volume directly with gate movement ignores compressible energy stored in the system. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing supplied air always proportionally increases the gates displaced water volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 鉸座荷載分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hinge reaction distribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鉸座荷載分配」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hinge reaction distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多鉸座承受門體合力時，構件剛度與安裝高差控制分配，均分只適用對稱理想情況。局部接觸與變形會讓一個鉸座先承載。 假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鉸座荷載分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When several hinges share a gate resultant, stiffness and installation offsets govern distribution. Equal sharing is an ideal symmetric case; local contact and deformation may load one support first. Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m. Reactions are R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN and R2=2.25 MN, for a rigid gate under planar loading. Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hinge reaction distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有兩座鉸鏈，每座就永遠承受一半荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 鉸座荷載分配：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hinge reaction distribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩鉸座間距8 m、合力6 MN偏心1 m，靜力反力R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN、R2=2.25 MN；限剛性門體與平面荷載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume hinge spacing 8 m and resultant 6 MN offset 1 m. Reactions are R1=3+6/8=3.75 MN and R2=2.25 MN, for a rigid gate under planar loading. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare hinge geometry, bearing clearance and strain, checking that reactions sum to applied load and balance its moment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。只有總合力監測，無法辨識單個連接件的局部超載。
knowledge.textEn: Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Monitoring total resultant alone cannot identify overload in one individual connection or bearing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鉸座荷載分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hinge reaction distribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。
浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load.
A dry gate natural period can directly represent its wet natural period.
quiz.explanation: 把兩鉸座固定均分會低估偏心側承載，腐蝕或間隙改變又可能造成重新分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fixed equal sharing underestimates the eccentric side, while corrosion and clearance changes redistribute load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波浪激振與自振」與「相鄰門片相對位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 波浪激振與自振：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「波浪激振與自振」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave excitation and natural period” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮動門體具有轉動慣性、復原剛度與水體附加慣性，波浪頻率接近自振時可能放大運動。乾態模態不能直接替代濕態動力特性。 假設含附加水慣性的I=8×10⁸ kg·m²、線性轉動剛度K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad，T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s；限小擾動。 大角度運動會改變浮力剛度，破壞線性週期假設；相鄰門片的流體耦合也會產生集體模態。以單片門的小振幅結果代表整列，可能漏掉相對運動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波浪激振與自振」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A buoyant gate has rotational inertia, restoring stiffness and added hydrodynamic inertia. Excitation near its natural frequency can amplify motion, so dry structural modes cannot replace wet dynamic properties. Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances. Large angles alter restoring stiffness and invalidate a linear period. Hydrodynamic coupling produces collective modes, so a single-gate small-motion result can miss relative movement across the full barrier. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave excitation and natural period” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮門乾態自振週期可以直接當成水中的自振週期。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Two gates with equal amplitudes have no relative motion between them.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume inertia including added water I=8×10⁸ kg·m² and linear rotational stiffness K=2×10⁸ N·m/rad. T=2π√(I/K)=12.566 s, for small disturbances. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「波浪激振與自振」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 比較門角和波面頻譜，辨認相位及阻尼而非只找相同頻率；在不同水深重估附加慣性，確認觀測峰值不是感測器安裝共振。以相位跨越與衰減包絡交叉確認共振，而非只用頻譜上單一尖峰作判定。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare angle and wave spectra, examining phase and damping rather than frequency coincidence alone. Reassess added inertia at different depths and rule out resonance of sensor mountings. Confirm resonance through phase transition and decay envelopes rather than relying on one isolated spectral peak. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。水面面積使水位對體積敏感度不同，內部風致增水又會打破均勻水位假設。 假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「關閉潟湖降雨收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. Surface area controls stage sensitivity to volume, while wind setup can invalidate a uniform water level assumption. Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage. Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支
knowledge.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon
knowledge.text: 防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。水面面積使水位對體積敏感度不同，內部風致增水又會打破均勻水位假設。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. Surface area controls stage sensitivity to volume, while wind setup can invalidate a uniform water level assumption.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「關閉潟湖降雨收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon" is correct?
options: 海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。
防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。
平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。
optionsEn: Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.
Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon.
Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 防潮時海口交換減少，但潟湖降雨和陸域排水仍在加入水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reducing inlet exchange does not stop rainfall or land drainage into the lagoon. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「關閉潟湖降雨收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Added volume is 2 million m³ and mean rise 0.02 m, excluding land runoff, evaporation and leakage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「關閉潟湖降雨收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon", which statement holds?
options: 備援壓縮機能啟動就保證末端閥件取得足夠供氣。
氣體狀態換算可以直接用表壓取代絕對壓力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m。
optionsEn: A starting standby compressor guarantees sufficient air delivery at terminal valves.
Gas-state calculations can directly substitute gauge pressure for absolute pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設封閉水面100 km²、降雨20 mm且全部直接入水，增量2 million m³、水位上升0.02 m；未含陸域逕流、蒸發或漏流。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume isolated surface area 100 km² and direct rainfall 20 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「關閉潟湖降雨收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。將潟湖不同岸邊水位相減辨識風致坡度，再以全域平均驗算降雨增加的總庫容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance. Use stations on different shores to identify wind setup instead of attributing all local rise to rainfall. Difference shoreline levels to identify wind setup, then use the domain average to check rainfall-related storage increase. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以關閉潟湖降雨收支編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance. Use stations on different shores to identify wind setup instead of attributing all local rise to rainfall.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「關閉潟湖降雨收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon"?
options: 對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要有兩座鉸鏈，每座就永遠承受一半荷載。
optionsEn: Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
With two hinges each always carries exactly half the applied load.
quiz.explanation: 對照雨量雷達、雨量站和內外潮位，建立分時水量平衡；用不同方位水位站辨識風致傾斜，避免把單站升高全歸因於降雨。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare radar, rain gauges and internal and external levels in a time-resolved balance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 關閉潟湖降雨收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「關閉潟湖降雨收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。只看封閉後平均水位，可能漏掉城市沿岸的局部高水位。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Mean lagoon level can miss locally higher levels along urban shores.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「關閉潟湖降雨收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。
平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed.
Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 將整個流域雨量直接乘潟湖面積會混淆陸地與水面貢獻，地下水和支流也有延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying catchment rain by lagoon area confuses land and open-water contributions, while groundwater and tributaries are delayed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 鹽分混合與交換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Salinity mixing and exchange: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鹽分混合與交換」如何影響威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Salinity mixing and exchange” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Venice MOSE flood barriers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽分守恆可追蹤海水與淡水比例，但潟湖並非瞬間完全混合。底層密度流和局部滯水會讓平均鹽度掩蓋生態差異。 假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。 底層高鹽水可在表面變淡時仍滯留，造成密度分層並限制氧氣交換。把所有鹽度變化都歸因於門片動作，會漏掉河流、風和蒸發影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鹽分混合與交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salt conservation tracks seawater and freshwater fractions, but a lagoon does not mix instantly. Bottom density currents and stagnant regions allow a mean salinity to conceal ecological variation. Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing. New salinity is 30×100/105=28.571 g/kg, without evaporation. Saline bottom water can remain after surface freshening, maintaining stratification and limiting oxygen exchange. Attributing every salinity change to gate movement overlooks river, wind and evaporation effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Salinity mixing and exchange” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設初始100 million m³水體鹽度30 g/kg，加入5 million m³淡水，同密度完全混合；新鹽度30×100/105=28.571 g/kg，無蒸發。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume 100 million m³ at 30 g/kg plus 5 million m³ freshwater, equal densities and complete mixing.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均鹽度降低就證明底層高鹽水已完全排出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower mean salinity proves that all saline bottom water has been removed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鹽分混合與交換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 以可追溯壓力基準校正量測鏈，檢查零點和跨度，再與獨立水位及溫鹽資料比較；把隨機不確定度和共同基準偏差分開列帳。另以密度不確定度傳播計算水深影響，對共同基準偏差採獨立外部測量核驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 供氣系統由壓縮、儲存、分配與閥件共同構成，備援壓縮機無法補償所有共用管路故障。可靠度必須先定義功能成功條件再計算。 假設兩台獨立壓縮機可用度各0.98、任一足夠，並串聯共同分配系統0.99；A=(1−0.02²)×0.99=0.989604，忽略修復動態。 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「供氣網路可用度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air supply comprises compression, storage, distribution and valves. A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。以末端壓力和流量證明功能交付，檢查共用分配管故障是否仍能使備機失去作用。
knowledge.textEn: Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections. Verify that a spare truly provides required flow and use historical failure categories to test independence assumptions. Demonstrate terminal pressure and flow delivery and test whether shared distribution faults still defeat the standby unit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以供氣網路可用度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for air-network availability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections. Verify that a spare truly provides required flow and use historical failure categories to test independence assumptions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「供氣網路可用度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Air-network availability"?
options: 從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
海口關閉後，潟湖內水量就必定保持固定。
optionsEn: Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once the inlets close the lagoon water volume must remain constant.
quiz.explanation: 從供氣需求追蹤至末端閥件，標出共用電源和管段，核對備機是否真能滿足所需流量；用歷史故障分類檢查獨立性假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace supply demand to terminal valves, marking common power and pipe sections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 供氣網路可用度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air-network availability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「供氣網路可用度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air-network availability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「備援壓縮機能啟動就保證末端閥件取得足夠供氣。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A starting standby compressor guarantees sufficient air delivery at terminal valves." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。將設備啟動成功當作末端功能成功，會高估整體可用度。
knowledge.textEn: A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Equating successful equipment start with successful terminal delivery overstates availability of the complete functional supply chain.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「供氣網路可用度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air-network availability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。
總浮力大於自重就能直接決定翻板的唯一平衡角。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors.
Buoyancy exceeding weight directly determines the unique flap equilibrium angle.
quiz.explanation: 共用閥卡住或管道淹水會使兩台壓縮機同時無法供氣，即使各自運轉正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A stuck shared valve or flooded pipe can defeat both running compressors. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 新加坡濱海堤壩
courses.summary: 本課以新加坡濱海堤壩為入口，深入都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Marina Barrage as its entry point, this course examines urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質
courses.focusEn: Urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 降雨敏感度固定集水區A=2 km²與逕流係數C=0.75，只將雨強i由60改為90 mm/h；兩情境都假設降雨歷時超過集流時間。沿用同一單位換算式Q=0.278CiA，流量由25.02增至37.53 m³/s，增加50%。此線性比較未納入C隨飽和改變或渠道滯蓄，也不是泵站所需容量的直接決定。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Hold catchment area A=2 km² and runoff coefficient C=0.75 fixed, changing only rainfall intensity i from 60 to 90 mm/h; both storms last beyond concentration time. With the same unit-converted relation Q=0.278CiA, flow increases from 25.02 to 37.53 m³/s, or 50%. This linear comparison excludes saturation-related changes in C and channel storage and does not directly determine pumping capacity.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水區逕流峰值」與「庫容與淨入流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment runoff peak" and "Storage and net inflow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水區逕流峰值」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment runoff peak” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。合理化公式適合指定的小型集水區條件，不能直接代表整個大型水庫入流歷線。 假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水區逕流峰值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The rational method applies to specified small-catchment conditions, not a complete large-reservoir inflow hydrograph. Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment runoff peak” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水區逕流峰值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Catchment runoff peak”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水區逕流峰值
knowledge.text: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。合理化公式適合指定的小型集水區條件，不能直接代表整個大型水庫入流歷線。
knowledge.textEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The rational method applies to specified small-catchment conditions, not a complete large-reservoir inflow hydrograph.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水區逕流峰值」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Catchment runoff peak" is correct?
options: 各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。
都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。
水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
optionsEn: Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak.
An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
quiz.explanation: 都市不透水面提高快速逕流比例，但降雨空間與集流時間控制峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Impervious surfaces increase rapid runoff, while rainfall distribution and concentration time control the peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水區逕流峰值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment runoff peak” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間；Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s，未含渠道滯蓄。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Q=0.278CiA=25.02 m³/s, excluding channel storage.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水區逕流峰值」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Catchment runoff peak", which statement holds?
options: 抽水機已經運轉就表示一定達到額定排水流量。
沒有明顯噪音就足以證明吸水條件有足夠餘裕。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設集水區2 km²、C=0.75、雨強60 mm/h且歷時超過集流時間。
optionsEn: A running pump necessarily delivers its rated drainage flow.
Absence of obvious noise proves sufficient suction-head margin.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume area 2 km², C=0.75 and intensity 60 mm/h lasting beyond concentration time. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水區逕流峰值」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment runoff peak” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。對雨量歷時與集流時間的比值作檢查，確認峰值公式沒有用在尚未全區貢獻的短雨。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record. Compare storm duration with concentration time to ensure the peak formula is not applied before the full catchment contributes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以集水區逕流峰值編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for catchment runoff peak, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Attach land-use changes, drainage boundaries and chosen concentration time to the calculation record.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare storm duration with concentration time to ensure the peak formula is not applied before the full catchment contributes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水區逕流峰值」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Catchment runoff peak"?
options: 用雨量站與雷達核對雨強是否覆蓋集水區，再比較出口流量和延遲；將土地利用變更、排水分區和所選集流時間附在計算表。

quiz.explanationEn: Check rain-gauge and radar coverage, then compare outlet flow and lag. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集水區逕流峰值：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment runoff peak: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水區逕流峰值」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment runoff peak” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。把每個分區峰值直接相加，可能錯估各峰不同時到達的真實入流。
knowledge.textEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Adding every subcatchment peak directly can misrepresent the actual combined inflow when peaks arrive at different times.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水區逕流峰值」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Catchment runoff peak" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。
水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing.
An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
quiz.explanation: 短時局部暴雨可能不符合均勻降雨假設，排水瓶頸也會改變峰值時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Brief localized storms violate uniform rainfall assumptions, and drainage bottlenecks alter peak timing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「庫容與淨入流」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Storage and net inflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。庫面不是永遠固定，低窪岸帶開始淹沒時，水位與庫容的關係會改變。 假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 抽水流量若採額定值而非當時揚程下的實際值，會產生虛假的未量測入流。時間步太長又可能把短時高峰平滑掉，低估岸邊淹水機會。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「庫容與淨入流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. Surface area is not always constant; inundating low banks changes the stage-storage relation. Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Using rated pump discharge instead of flow at actual head creates false unexplained inflow. Long time steps smooth brief peaks and can underestimate opportunities for flooding along the reservoir edge. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Storage and net inflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「庫容與淨入流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Storage and net inflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 庫容與淨入流
knowledge.text: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。庫面不是永遠固定，低窪岸帶開始淹沒時，水位與庫容的關係會改變。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. Surface area is not always constant; inundating low banks changes the stage-storage relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「庫容與淨入流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Storage and net inflow" is correct?
options: 水庫水位不變就表示沒有大量水量流入與流出。
平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。
水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。
optionsEn: An unchanged reservoir level means there is no substantial inflow or outflow.
A higher mean reservoir level guarantees outward flow at every instant.
Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses.
quiz.explanation: 水庫水位變化由入流減去閘排、抽水及其他出流決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir level changes with inflow minus gravity discharge, pumping and other losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 庫容與淨入流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Storage and net inflow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「庫容與淨入流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Storage and net inflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設淨入流80 m³/s持續30 min、有效水面3 km²，Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m；只作固定面積短時估算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume net inflow 80 m³/s over thirty minutes and effective area 3 km². Δh=Qt/A=0.048 m, a short-duration constant-area estimate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「庫容與淨入流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

並聯兩台相同泵的總流量必定是單台的兩倍。
平均鹽度很低就表示所有深度的水質完全相同。

Two identical parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow.
Low mean salinity means water quality is identical at every depth.
