quiz.explanationEn: Compare upstream and downstream levels, flow and visible blockage against a clean baseline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 攔污柵損失與堵塞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screen losses and blockage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「攔污柵損失與堵塞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screen losses and blockage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「差壓增加只可能來自攔污柵堵塞，與流量無關。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher screen differential head only indicates blockage and is unrelated to flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。差壓增加也可能來自流量增大，因此未正規化的趨勢不能直接當作堵塞程度。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Increased differential head can also reflect increased flow, so an unnormalized trend does not directly measure blockage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「攔污柵損失與堵塞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Screen losses and blockage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。
optionsEn: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking.
quiz.explanation: 堵塞不均會把水流集中到少數開口，引發局部振動與吸氣。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven blockage concentrates flow through a few openings, promoting vibration and air entrainment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 複合事件與失效組合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compound events and failure combinations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「複合事件與失效組合」如何影響新加坡濱海堤壩的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compound events and failure combinations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Marina Barrage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。把各事件單獨罕見當成組合必定極罕見，會忽略共同氣象原因。 假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「複合事件與失效組合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence. Individually rare events do not necessarily make their combination extremely rare when weather drives several conditions together. Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01. Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compound events and failure combinations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「複合事件與失效組合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compound events and failure combinations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 複合事件與失效組合
knowledge.text: 暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。把各事件單獨罕見當成組合必定極罕見，會忽略共同氣象原因。
knowledge.textEn: Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence. Individually rare events do not necessarily make their combination extremely rare when weather drives several conditions together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「複合事件與失效組合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compound events and failure combinations" is correct?
options: 罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。
暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。
各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。
optionsEn: Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking.
Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence.
Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
quiz.explanation: 暴雨、高海潮與電力限制可能同時發生，聯合機率取決於相關性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Heavy rain, high tide and power constraints can coincide, with joint probability depending on dependence. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 複合事件與失效組合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compound events and failure combinations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「複合事件與失效組合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compound events and failure combinations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一年高海潮事件機率0.1，且該條件下強降雨機率0.3，聯合機率0.03；若誤用無條件雨率0.1獨立相乘會得到0.01。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual high-tide event probability 0.1 and conditional heavy-rain probability 0.3. Joint probability is 0.03; incorrectly multiplying an unconditional rain probability 0.1 gives 0.01. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「複合事件與失效組合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 平均庫位高於海面就保證所有瞬間都向海排水。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。用相同事件時間窗口重算條件機率，並報告小樣本區間及相關性假設的敏感度。
knowledge.textEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix. Recalculate conditional probabilities with a consistent event window and report small-sample ranges and sensitivity to dependence assumptions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以複合事件與失效組合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compound events and failure combinations, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Link storage, pump availability and power condition in a scenario matrix.

quiz.question: 要驗證「複合事件與失效組合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compound events and failure combinations"?
options: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均鹽度很低就表示所有深度的水質完全相同。
optionsEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Low mean salinity means water quality is identical at every depth.
quiz.explanation: 明確定義事件窗口、雨量門檻與潮位基準，核對歷史事件是否同時而非僅同年；用情境矩陣連結庫容、泵可用度與供電狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define event window, rainfall threshold and tidal datum, checking coincidence rather than merely the same calendar year. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 複合事件與失效組合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compound events and failure combinations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「複合事件與失效組合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compound events and failure combinations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「罕見暴雨和罕見高潮可以不經檢查直接視為獨立。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Rare rainfall and rare high tides can be assumed independent without checking." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。只列一個年機率而不說事件窗口，容易把短時設備容量與長期風險混為一談。
knowledge.textEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Reporting one annual probability without its event window confuses short-term capacity with long-term risk.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「複合事件與失效組合」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compound events and failure combinations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。
各分區最大流量無須考慮時序就能直接相加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions.
Subcatchment peak discharges can be added directly without considering their timing.
quiz.explanation: 樣本很少時條件機率不穩定，氣候變化又會改變共同分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Conditional probabilities are unstable with sparse samples, and climate changes alter joint distributions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
courses.summary: 本課以巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘為入口，深入節水池耦合、非恆定充洩水與滾動閘門的定量深化。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Panama Canal expansion locks as its entry point, this course examines quantitative extension of basin coupling, unsteady filling and rolling-gate mechanics. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 節水池耦合、非恆定充洩水與滾動閘門的定量深化
courses.focusEn: Quantitative extension of basin coupling, unsteady filling and rolling-gate mechanics
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形充水歷線峰值300 m³/s、總歷時1200 s，水量0.5Qt=180000 m³；閘面積22500 m²則升8 m，非本站運轉歷線。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 均衡水位的單參數比較固定閘室面積20000 m²、初始水位10 m及池面積10000 m²，只將池初始水位由4升至6 m。同基準下最終水位由8 m升為(20000×10+10000×6)/30000=8.6667 m；池升2 m只令共同水位升0.6667 m。這是兩固定面積水體的封閉體積平衡，未計船舶移動、漏水或外部補水。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas. Equalized level is (20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular filling hydrograph with peak 300 m³/s over 1200 s. Volume is 180000 m³ and rise over 22500 m² is 8 m, not a site operating hydrograph. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For equalization sensitivity, keep chamber area 20000 m², initial chamber level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² fixed, raising only initial basin level from 4 m to 6 m. On the common datum, final level rises from 8 m to (20000×10+10000×6)/30000=8.6667 m. A 2 m basin change raises the common level only 0.6667 m. This closed-volume comparison excludes vessel movement, leakage and external supply.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 官方新閘室尺寸為427 m長、55 m寬、18.3 m深。
官方回用說明為每次通行水量的60%，需保留原分母。
教學有限水池均衡水位為8 m。
教學50000 t船舶在0.0002坡度下推力98.1 kN。
教學快速水錘壓力增量240 kPa。
教學交換量與損失假設得到85000 m³補水。
factsEn: Official new chambers measure 427 m long, 55 m wide and 18.3 m deep.
The official reuse statement is 60 percent per transit and requires its original denominator.
The teaching finite-pool equilibrium level is 8 m.
A teaching 50000 t vessel on slope 0.0002 experiences force 98.1 kN.
The teaching rapid-waterhammer increment is 240 kPa.
The teaching exchange and loss assumptions give makeup 85000 m³.
timeline: 2016-02　二月首座阿瓜克拉拉節水池充水，進入系統測試階段。

timelineEn: 2016-02 — The first Agua Clara saving basin is filled in February for system testing.
2016-06 — The expanded canal officially opens on June twenty-six, beginning new-lock service.
2025 — Mechanical-electrical guidance provides comparison context; this is a publication milestone, not a canal reconstruction.

newStages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙池水位均衡」與「充水歷線與慣性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Equalization between two pools" and "Filling hydrograph and inertia": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙池水位均衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Equalization between two pools: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙池水位均衡」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Equalization between two pools” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個有限面積水體連通時，兩邊水位都會改變，不能把節水池當無限水源。守恆終點只由初始體積與面積決定，達到終點的時間則另受管路控制。 假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。 把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。若兩水位計基準不同，甚至會虛構無法解釋的水量損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙池水位均衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connecting two finite pools changes both levels, so a saving basin is not an infinite reservoir. Conservation determines the equilibrium endpoint from initial storage and areas, while conduits separately determine how quickly it is approached. Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas. Equalized level is (20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m. Treating the smaller basin as fixed head overstates recoverable water. Conduit storage, leakage and mismatched gauge datums can also break the apparent balance and create fictitious unexplained water losses. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equalization between two pools” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙池水位均衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Equalization between two pools”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙池水位均衡
knowledge.text: 兩個有限面積水體連通時，兩邊水位都會改變，不能把節水池當無限水源。守恆終點只由初始體積與面積決定，達到終點的時間則另受管路控制。
knowledge.textEn: Connecting two finite pools changes both levels, so a saving basin is not an infinite reservoir. Conservation determines the equilibrium endpoint from initial storage and areas, while conduits separately determine how quickly it is approached.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙池水位均衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Equalization between two pools" is correct?
options: 節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。
兩個有限面積水體連通時，兩邊水位都會改變，不能把節水池當無限水源。
充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。
optionsEn: A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water.
Connecting two finite pools changes both levels, so a saving basin is not an infinite reservoir.
Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads.
quiz.explanation: 兩個有限面積水體連通時，兩邊水位都會改變，不能把節水池當無限水源。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Connecting two finite pools changes both levels, so a saving basin is not an infinite reservoir. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙池水位均衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Equalization between two pools: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙池水位均衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Equalization between two pools” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas. Equalized level is (20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：各自積分水位變化乘面積，檢查兩側交換體積是否相反相等；再用閥位和流量時序辨識接近均衡時變慢的原因，不能只比較終點。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate area times level change on each side and check equal opposite exchange volumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas. Equalized level is (20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙池水位均衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Equalization between two pools", which statement holds?
options: 兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。
慢速改變流量也必須產生完整的快速水錘壓峰。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定。
optionsEn: Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal.
A slow flow change must generate the full rapid-waterhammer pressure peak.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設閘室面積20000 m²、水位10 m，池面積10000 m²、水位4 m，同基準且斷面固定；均衡水位(20000×10+10000×4)/30000=8 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume chamber area 20000 m² at level 10 m and basin area 10000 m² at 4 m, common datum and fixed areas. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙池水位均衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Equalization between two pools: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙池水位均衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Equalization between two pools” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 各自積分水位變化乘面積，檢查兩側交換體積是否相反相等；再用閥位和流量時序辨識接近均衡時變慢的原因，不能只比較終點。另算閘室下降水量與池體上升水量，核對共同終點能同時滿足兩個控制體的守恆。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate area times level change on each side and check equal opposite exchange volumes. Use valve and flow histories to diagnose slowing near equilibrium instead of comparing endpoints alone. Separately calculate chamber loss and basin gain and verify that the shared endpoint closes both control-volume balances. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以雙池水位均衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。各自積分水位變化乘面積，檢查兩側交換體積是否相反相等；再用閥位和流量時序辨識接近均衡時變慢的原因，不能只比較終點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for equalization between two pools, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate area times level change on each side and check equal opposite exchange volumes. Use valve and flow histories to diagnose slowing near equilibrium instead of comparing endpoints alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the smaller basin as fixed head overstates recoverable water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙池水位均衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Equalization between two pools"?

steps.title: 雙池水位均衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Equalization between two pools: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙池水位均衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equalization between two pools” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。若兩水位計基準不同，甚至會虛構無法解釋的水量損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the smaller basin as fixed head overstates recoverable water. Conduit storage, leakage and mismatched gauge datums can also break the apparent balance and create fictitious unexplained water losses. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若兩水位計基準不同，甚至會虛構無法解釋的水量損失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Conduit storage, leakage and mismatched gauge datums can also break the apparent balance and create fictitious unexplained water losses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。若兩水位計基準不同，甚至會虛構無法解釋的水量損失。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙池水位均衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Equalization between two pools" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。
充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating the smaller basin as fixed head overstates recoverable water.
Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads.
quiz.explanation: 把較小池當固定水頭會高估可回用水量，忽略連通管容積和漏流也會破壞守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the smaller basin as fixed head overstates recoverable water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 充水歷線與慣性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filling hydrograph and inertia: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「充水歷線與慣性」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filling hydrograph and inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船閘水位上升速度取決於當時淨流量，初期加速和末期減速產生的水面坡度又影響船舶受力。平均充水時間無法表示瞬時最大流量。 假設三角形充水歷線峰值300 m³/s、總歷時1200 s，水量0.5Qt=180000 m³；閘面積22500 m²則升8 m，非本站運轉歷線。 同一總水量可以由溫和或尖峰歷線達成，船舶受力卻不同。若僅用完成時間驗收，可能漏掉局部流速、壓力振盪和繫纜張力峰值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「充水歷線與慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lock level rises with instantaneous net flow. Early acceleration and late deceleration also create surface slopes affecting vessels, so average filling time cannot represent peak discharge. Assume triangular filling hydrograph with peak 300 m³/s over 1200 s. Volume is 180000 m³ and rise over 22500 m² is 8 m, not a site operating hydrograph. Equal total volumes can arise from gentle or peaked hydrographs with different vessel loads. Completion time alone misses local velocities, pressure oscillations and maximum mooring tensions during the filling cycle. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filling hydrograph and inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三角形充水歷線峰值300 m³/s、總歷時1200 s，水量0.5Qt=180000 m³；閘面積22500 m²則升8 m，非本站運轉歷線。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular filling hydrograph with peak 300 m³/s over 1200 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「充水歷線與慣性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filling hydrograph and inertia”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 充水歷線與慣性
knowledge.text: 船閘水位上升速度取決於當時淨流量，初期加速和末期減速產生的水面坡度又影響船舶受力。平均充水時間無法表示瞬時最大流量。
knowledge.textEn: Lock level rises with instantaneous net flow. Early acceleration and late deceleration also create surface slopes affecting vessels, so average filling time cannot represent peak discharge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「充水歷線與慣性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filling hydrograph and inertia" is correct?
options: 充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。
閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。
船閘水位上升速度取決於當時淨流量，初期加速和末期減速產生的水面坡度又影響船舶受力。
optionsEn: Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads.
A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference.
Lock level rises with instantaneous net flow.
quiz.explanation: 船閘水位上升速度取決於當時淨流量，初期加速和末期減速產生的水面坡度又影響船舶受力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lock level rises with instantaneous net flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Filling hydrograph and inertia: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「充水歷線與慣性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume triangular filling hydrograph with peak 300 m³/s over 1200 s. Volume is 180000 m³ and rise over 22500 m² is 8 m, not a site operating hydrograph. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare integrated flow with level rise and relate longitudinal level differences to mooring loads.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「充水歷線與慣性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filling hydrograph and inertia” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用流量積分對照水位升幅，並比較室內前後水位差與船舶繫纜負荷；保留流量上升段解析度，避免用整段平均掩蓋慣性效應。把高頻流量歷線重新取樣後積分，檢查峰值保存程度與總水量的數值收斂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare integrated flow with level rise and relate longitudinal level differences to mooring loads. Preserve the rising limb resolution instead of smoothing inertial effects into a full-cycle average. steps.title: 充水歷線與慣性：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「充水歷線與慣性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 同一總水量可以由溫和或尖峰歷線達成，船舶受力卻不同。若僅用完成時間驗收，可能漏掉局部流速、壓力振盪和繫纜張力峰值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal total volumes can arise from gentle or peaked hydrographs with different vessel loads. Completion time alone misses local velocities, pressure oscillations and maximum mooring tensions during the filling cycle. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若僅用完成時間驗收，可能漏掉局部流速、壓力振盪和繫纜張力峰值。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Equal total volumes can arise from gentle or peaked hydrographs with different vessel loads.

newStages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「縱向水面坡度推力」與「密度交換前緣」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Longitudinal water-slope force" and "Density-exchange front": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 縱向水面坡度推力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Longitudinal water-slope force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「縱向水面坡度推力」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Longitudinal water-slope force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 充水不均會使閘室水面形成坡度，船體承受對應的長向壓力差。以排水重量乘小坡度可估算準靜態推力，但需另外處理流速阻力和繫纜動力。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設船舶排水質量50000 t、閘內坡度0.0002，長向力約mgS=98.1 kN；小坡度準靜態，不含阻力與加速度。 單一水位站無法辨認室內坡度，繫纜伸長也會造成船體動態放大。若將全部張力歸於水面坡度，可能掩蓋局部射流或不對稱流入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「縱向水面坡度推力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven filling creates a longitudinal surface slope and pressure imbalance on a vessel. Displacement weight times small slope estimates quasi-static force, with current drag and mooring dynamics treated separately. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vessel displacement mass 50000 t and longitudinal slope 0.0002. Approximate force mgS=98.1 kN, for a small quasi-static slope without drag or acceleration. A single gauge cannot resolve chamber slope, and elastic mooring lines can amplify motion. Attributing all tension to slope may conceal a local jet or asymmetric inflow acting on the hull. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Longitudinal water-slope force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「縱向水面坡度推力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Longitudinal water-slope force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 充水不均會使閘室水面形成坡度，船體承受對應的長向壓力差。以排水重量乘小坡度可估算準靜態推力，但需另外處理流速阻力和繫纜動力。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven filling creates a longitudinal surface slope and pressure imbalance on a vessel. Displacement weight times small slope estimates quasi-static force, with current drag and mooring dynamics treated separately.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「縱向水面坡度推力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Longitudinal water-slope force" is correct?
options: 充水不均會使閘室水面形成坡度，船體承受對應的長向壓力差。
閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。
兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。
optionsEn: Uneven filling creates a longitudinal surface slope and pressure imbalance on a vessel.
A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference.
Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal.
quiz.explanation: 充水不均會使閘室水面形成坡度，船體承受對應的長向壓力差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven filling creates a longitudinal surface slope and pressure imbalance on a vessel. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縱向水面坡度推力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設船舶排水質量50000 t、閘內坡度0.0002，長向力約mgS=98.1 kN；小坡度準靜態，不含阻力與加速度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume vessel displacement mass 50000 t and longitudinal slope 0.0002. Approximate force mgS=98.1 kN, for a small quasi-static slope without drag or acceleration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「縱向水面坡度推力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 縱向水面坡度推力：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Longitudinal water-slope force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一水位站無法辨認室內坡度，繫纜伸長也會造成船體動態放大。若將全部張力歸於水面坡度，可能掩蓋局部射流或不對稱流入。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A single gauge cannot resolve chamber slope, and elastic mooring lines can amplify motion. Attributing all tension to slope may conceal a local jet or asymmetric inflow acting on the hull. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若將全部張力歸於水面坡度，可能掩蓋局部射流或不對稱流入。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 密度交換前緣：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density-exchange front: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度交換前緣」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density-exchange front” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海水與淡水連通時，即使兩側表面水位相同，密度差仍可驅動底層鹽水前進和上層淡水返回。這種交換不能用零淨流量判定不存在。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設密度差25 kg/m³、基準1000 kg/m³、水深5 m，約化重力g′=0.24525 m/s²，速度尺度√(g′h)=1.107 m/s；非精確前緣速度。 表層看似沒有入流時底層仍可向內輸送鹽分，傳感器只設單一深度會漏判。強紊流又會改變界面厚度，使理想兩層模型失效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度交換前緣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Connected salt and fresh water can exchange through bottom and surface currents even at equal surface elevations. Zero net discharge therefore does not establish absence of density-driven exchange. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume density difference 25 kg/m³, reference density 1000 kg/m³ and depth 5 m. Reduced gravity is 0.24525 m/s² and √(g′h)=1.107 m/s, a scale rather than an exact front speed. Salt can enter along the bed while the surface appears still, making one-depth sensing inadequate. Strong turbulence thickens the interface and can invalidate an ideal two-layer description of exchange. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density-exchange front” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度交換前緣」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density-exchange front”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度交換前緣
knowledge.text: 海水與淡水連通時，即使兩側表面水位相同，密度差仍可驅動底層鹽水前進和上層淡水返回。這種交換不能用零淨流量判定不存在。
knowledge.textEn: Connected salt and fresh water can exchange through bottom and surface currents even at equal surface elevations. Zero net discharge therefore does not establish absence of density-driven exchange.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度交換前緣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density-exchange front" is correct?
options: 兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。
海水與淡水連通時，即使兩側表面水位相同，密度差仍可驅動底層鹽水前進和上層淡水返回。
平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。
optionsEn: Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal.
Connected salt and fresh water can exchange through bottom and surface currents even at equal surface elevations.
Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group.
quiz.explanation: 海水與淡水連通時，即使兩側表面水位相同，密度差仍可驅動底層鹽水前進和上層淡水返回。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Connected salt and fresh water can exchange through bottom and surface currents even at equal surface elevations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度交換前緣：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度交換前緣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density-exchange front” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設密度差25 kg/m³、基準1000 kg/m³、水深5 m，約化重力g′=0.24525 m/s²，速度尺度√(g′h)=1.107 m/s；非精確前緣速度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume density difference 25 kg/m³, reference density 1000 kg/m³ and depth 5 m. Reduced gravity is 0.24525 m/s² and √(g′h)=1.107 m/s, a scale rather than an exact front speed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量測上下層流向及鹽度，計算鹽通量而非只積分總流量；追蹤前緣與船舶排水的交互作用，避免把短時混濁當作鹽分證據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure upper and lower currents and salinity together, calculating salt flux rather than total discharge alone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度交換前緣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density-exchange front” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測上下層流向及鹽度，計算鹽通量而非只積分總流量；追蹤前緣與船舶排水的交互作用，避免把短時混濁當作鹽分證據。以分層流量乘鹽度積分鹽通量，確認正負體積流量抵銷時仍可能輸送淨鹽量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 表層看似沒有入流時底層仍可向內輸送鹽分，傳感器只設單一深度會漏判。強紊流又會改變界面厚度，使理想兩層模型失效。
knowledge.textEn: Salt can enter along the bed while the surface appears still, making one-depth sensing inadequate. Strong turbulence thickens the interface and can invalidate an ideal two-layer description of exchange.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度交換前緣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Density-exchange front" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
表層看似沒有入流時底層仍可向內輸送鹽分，傳感器只設單一深度會漏判。
平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Salt can enter along the bed while the surface appears still, making one-depth sensing inadequate.
Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group.
quiz.explanation: 表層看似沒有入流時底層仍可向內輸送鹽分，傳感器只設單一深度會漏判。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Salt can enter along the bed while the surface appears still, making one-depth sensing inadequate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「閘門浮力與輪載」與「管路快速減速壓峰」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gate buoyancy and wheel loads" and "Rapid conduit deceleration pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閘門浮力與輪載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gate buoyancy and wheel loads: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閘門浮力與輪載」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gate buoyancy and wheel loads” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滾動門靠輪組與浮力共同承受重量，水位改變會重新分配輪載。減輕平均輪載有利移動，但偏心、軌道沉降和門體變形仍可能使個別輪子受力集中。 假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。 某輪懸空會把荷載轉給其他輪，平均公式仍可能看似正常。浮力艙漏水也可能增加荷載而不立即停止運動，所以移動成功不能代替承載檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閘門浮力與輪載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rolling gates share weight between buoyancy and wheel groups, with levels changing wheel loads. Lower mean loading aids movement, but eccentricity, rail settlement and deformation can still concentrate reactions on individual wheels. Assume gate weight 40 MN, buoyancy 28 MN and eight equally sharing wheels. Mean wheel load is (40−28)/8=1.5 MN, excluding eccentricity, dynamics and rail-level differences. A lifted wheel transfers load to others while the average formula still appears normal. A leaking buoyancy compartment can increase loading without stopping motion, so movement success cannot replace bearing assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gate buoyancy and wheel loads” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume gate weight 40 MN, buoyancy 28 MN and eight equally sharing wheels.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閘門浮力與輪載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gate buoyancy and wheel loads”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閘門浮力與輪載
knowledge.text: 滾動門靠輪組與浮力共同承受重量，水位改變會重新分配輪載。減輕平均輪載有利移動，但偏心、軌道沉降和門體變形仍可能使個別輪子受力集中。
knowledge.textEn: Rolling gates share weight between buoyancy and wheel groups, with levels changing wheel loads. Lower mean loading aids movement, but eccentricity, rail settlement and deformation can still concentrate reactions on individual wheels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閘門浮力與輪載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gate buoyancy and wheel loads" is correct?
options: 平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。
慢速改變流量也必須產生完整的快速水錘壓峰。
滾動門靠輪組與浮力共同承受重量，水位改變會重新分配輪載。
optionsEn: Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group.
A slow flow change must generate the full rapid-waterhammer pressure peak.
Rolling gates share weight between buoyancy and wheel groups, with levels changing wheel loads.
quiz.explanation: 滾動門靠輪組與浮力共同承受重量，水位改變會重新分配輪載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rolling gates share weight between buoyancy and wheel groups, with levels changing wheel loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閘門浮力與輪載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gate buoyancy and wheel loads: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閘門浮力與輪載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gate buoyancy and wheel loads” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume gate weight 40 MN, buoyancy 28 MN and eight equally sharing wheels. Mean wheel load is (40−28)/8=1.5 MN, excluding eccentricity, dynamics and rail-level differences. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將輪載或軸承應變與水位、門位一起比對，檢查軌道高程和各輪接觸；以總反力守恆確認量測，再評估最大輪載而非平均值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare wheel loads or bearing strains with water level and position, checking rail elevation and wheel contact.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。
平均水深足夠就能保證整條船底通道都有足夠淨空。
設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume gate weight 40 MN, buoyancy 28 MN and eight equally sharing wheels.
Adequate mean depth guarantees clearance along the entire hull route.
After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設門重40 MN、浮力28 MN、8輪理想均分，平均輪載(40−28)/8=1.5 MN；不含偏心、動力或軌道高差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume gate weight 40 MN, buoyancy 28 MN and eight equally sharing wheels. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閘門浮力與輪載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gate buoyancy and wheel loads: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閘門浮力與輪載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gate buoyancy and wheel loads” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將輪載或軸承應變與水位、門位一起比對，檢查軌道高程和各輪接觸；以總反力守恆確認量測，再評估最大輪載而非平均值。比較各輪反力總和與扣除浮力後的重量，另檢查最大輪載是否隨軌道高點移動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare wheel loads or bearing strains with water level and position, checking rail elevation and wheel contact. Verify total reaction equilibrium before evaluating maximum individual loads rather than averages. Compare summed reactions with weight minus buoyancy and check whether maximum wheel load follows rail high spots. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以閘門浮力與輪載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將輪載或軸承應變與水位、門位一起比對，檢查軌道高程和各輪接觸；以總反力守恆確認量測，再評估最大輪載而非平均值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for gate buoyancy and wheel loads, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare wheel loads or bearing strains with water level and position, checking rail elevation and wheel contact. Verify total reaction equilibrium before evaluating maximum individual loads rather than averages.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某輪懸空會把荷載轉給其他輪，平均公式仍可能看似正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A lifted wheel transfers load to others while the average formula still appears normal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verify total reaction equilibrium before evaluating maximum individual loads rather than averages. Compare summed reactions with weight minus buoyancy and check whether maximum wheel load follows rail high spots.

knowledge.text: 以閘門浮力與輪載編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將輪載或軸承應變與水位、門位一起比對，檢查軌道高程和各輪接觸；以總反力守恆確認量測，再評估最大輪載而非平均值。

steps.title: 管路快速減速壓峰：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 充洩水管路的速度改變會形成壓力波，反射邊界和含氣量決定波速與衰減。Joukowsky式適合快速改變的初估，慢速閥動作須用歷時模型。 假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、波速800 m/s、速度減少0.3 m/s且變化快於2L/a，Δp=ρaΔv=240 kPa；非閥門操作設定。 若壓力降至汽化壓以下，水柱分離後再碰撞可能產生不同峰值，單次線性式失效。把壓力計阻尼造成的平滑當成真實衰減也會低估荷載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管路快速減速壓峰」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity changes in filling conduits create pressure waves whose speed and decay depend on boundaries and air content. Δp=ρaΔv=240 kPa, not a valve operating setting. Column separation below vapor pressure and subsequent recombination can create different peaks, invalidating a single linear estimate. Sensor damping mistaken for physical decay can also underestimate the actual transient load. steps.title: 管路快速減速壓峰：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、波速800 m/s、速度減少0.3 m/s且變化快於2L/a，Δp=ρaΔv=240 kPa；非閥門操作設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume density 1000 kg/m³, wave speed 800 m/s and velocity change 0.3 m/s occurring faster than 2L/a. Δp=ρaΔv=240 kPa, not a valve operating setting. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 管路快速減速壓峰：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管路快速減速壓峰」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rapid conduit deceleration pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對管長、波速和動作歷時，再比較多點壓力到達時間與反射；檢查記錄取樣率足以看到波峰，並辨識氣穴與單相彈性模型的差別。以壓波往返時間核對閥動作快慢分類，並用多站到達時差反算有效波速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check pipe length, wave speed and movement duration, comparing pressure arrival and reflection at several locations. Compare valve movement time with wave round-trip time and infer effective wave speed from multi-station arrival differences. Verify adequate sampling and distinguish vapor cavities from the single-phase elastic model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若壓力降至汽化壓以下，水柱分離後再碰撞可能產生不同峰值，單次線性式失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.title: 混凝土溫差拘束：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concrete thermal restraint: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「混凝土溫差拘束」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concrete thermal restraint” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型閘室牆體的溫度收縮受底板與相鄰澆塊拘束，裂縫風險取決於拘束和早齡強度發展。只看最高溫度會漏掉冷卻過程的拉應力。 假設E=25 GPa、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫15 K、有效拘束0.4，σ=REαΔT=1.5 MPa；彈性近似，未含徐變鬆弛。 表面快速冷卻會造成局部裂縫，即使整體平均溫降不大；徐變雖降低短時應力，也不能保證止水接縫保持完整。以成熟度單值代替拉伸能力容易誤判。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土溫差拘束」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large lock walls contract against foundations and adjoining blocks. Crack risk depends on restraint and developing early-age strength, so peak temperature alone misses tensile demand during cooling. Assume E=25 GPa, thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K, cooling 15 K and effective restraint 0.4. Stress REαΔT=1.5 MPa, an elastic estimate without creep relaxation. Rapid surface cooling can crack concrete despite a small mean drop. Creep reduces some stresses but does not guarantee watertight joints, and one maturity value cannot substitute for tensile capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concrete thermal restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設E=25 GPa、熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、降溫15 K、有效拘束0.4，σ=REαΔT=1.5 MPa；彈性近似，未含徐變鬆弛。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume E=25 GPa, thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K, cooling 15 K and effective restraint 0.4. Stress REαΔT=1.5 MPa, an elastic estimate without creep relaxation. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 船底餘裕與沉降量：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 船底淨空由水深減吃水和動態變化決定，載重、鹽度和航速都會影響結果。幾何餘裕不是可直接使用的航行餘裕，須分列波動與量測不確定度。 假設水深16 m、吃水14.5 m、動態下沉0.25 m、其他保留0.35 m，可用餘裕16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m；全部為假設。 沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。若把固定吃水值用於所有載重與水質，會產生不實的可用餘裕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船底餘裕與沉降量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under-keel clearance subtracts draft and dynamic effects from depth, with loading, salinity and speed all relevant. Available margin is 16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m, with all values assumed. A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft. Fixed draft across different loads and water conditions creates a misleading available margin. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Under-keel clearance and squat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「船底餘裕與沉降量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Under-keel clearance and squat" is correct?
options: 平均水深足夠就能保證整條船底通道都有足夠淨空。
百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。
船底淨空由水深減吃水和動態變化決定，載重、鹽度和航速都會影響結果。
optionsEn: Adequate mean depth guarantees clearance along the entire hull route.
Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent.
Under-keel clearance subtracts draft and dynamic effects from depth, with loading, salinity and speed all relevant.
quiz.explanation: 船底淨空由水深減吃水和動態變化決定，載重、鹽度和航速都會影響結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Under-keel clearance subtracts draft and dynamic effects from depth, with loading, salinity and speed all relevant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 船底餘裕與沉降量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Under-keel clearance and squat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「船底餘裕與沉降量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Under-keel clearance and squat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水深16 m、吃水14.5 m、動態下沉0.25 m、其他保留0.35 m，可用餘裕16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m；全部為假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume depth 16 m, draft 14.5 m, squat 0.25 m and other allowance 0.35 m. Available margin is 16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m, with all values assumed. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水深16 m、吃水14.5 m、動態下沉0.25 m、其他保留0.35 m，可用餘裕16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m；全部為假設。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume depth 16 m, draft 14.5 m, squat 0.25 m and other allowance 0.35 m. Available margin is 16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m, with all values assumed.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「船底餘裕與沉降量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Under-keel clearance and squat", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水深16 m、吃水14.5 m、動態下沉0.25 m、其他保留0.35 m，可用餘裕16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m。
節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。
閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume depth 16 m, draft 14.5 m, squat 0.25 m and other allowance 0.35 m.
A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water.
A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設水深16 m、吃水14.5 m、動態下沉0.25 m、其他保留0.35 m，可用餘裕16−14.5−0.25−0.35=0.90 m；全部為假設。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume depth 16 m, draft 14.5 m, squat 0.25 m and other allowance 0.35 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 船底餘裕與沉降量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Under-keel clearance and squat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船底餘裕與沉降量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Under-keel clearance and squat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。對測深誤差和吃水變化分別作敏感度分析，核對最不利位置而非只有代表斷面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth. Retain trim, motion and sounding uncertainty separately to avoid duplicated or omitted deductions. Test sounding-error and draft sensitivities separately and assess the controlling location rather than one representative section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以船底餘裕與沉降量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for under-keel clearance and squat, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth. Retain trim, motion and sounding uncertainty separately to avoid duplicated or omitted deductions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。對測深誤差和吃水變化分別作敏感度分析，核對最不利位置而非只有代表斷面。
knowledge.textEn: Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth. Retain trim, motion and sounding uncertainty separately to avoid duplicated or omitted deductions. Test sounding-error and draft sensitivities separately and assess the controlling location rather than one representative section.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以船底餘裕與沉降量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。
