Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth. Retain trim, motion and sounding uncertainty separately to avoid duplicated or omitted deductions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「船底餘裕與沉降量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Under-keel clearance and squat"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。
平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth.
Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group.
quiz.explanation: 統一水深、吃水和潮位的基準與時刻，查底床最高點而非平均深度；將船體縱傾、波動和測深誤差分別保存，避免重複或遺漏扣減。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align depth, draft and tide references and times, checking highest bed points rather than mean depth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 船底餘裕與沉降量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-keel clearance and squat: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船底餘裕與沉降量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Under-keel clearance and squat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。若把固定吃水值用於所有載重與水質，會產生不實的可用餘裕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft. Fixed draft across different loads and water conditions creates a misleading available margin. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把固定吃水值用於所有載重與水質，會產生不實的可用餘裕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Fixed draft across different loads and water conditions creates a misleading available margin.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均水深足夠就能保證整條船底通道都有足夠淨空。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate mean depth guarantees clearance along the entire hull route." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。若把固定吃水值用於所有載重與水質，會產生不實的可用餘裕。
knowledge.textEn: A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft. Fixed draft across different loads and water conditions creates a misleading available margin.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船底餘裕與沉降量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Under-keel clearance and squat" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。
沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent.
A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft.
quiz.explanation: 沉積高點可能在水深平均值仍足夠時造成局部淺區，密度改變亦會增加吃水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A deposit high spot can create a shallow patch despite adequate mean depth, and density changes alter draft. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

newStages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
newStages.description: 本階段聚焦「回用率與淨淡水耗用」與「故障停航與水源緩衝」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
newStages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reuse ratio and net freshwater use" and "Outage backlog and water reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回用率與淨淡水耗用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reuse ratio and net freshwater use: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回用率與淨淡水耗用」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reuse ratio and net freshwater use” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 回用百分比必須有明確分母，閘室交換量、從湖取水量與全年水源消耗並不相同。漏流、蒸發與鹽分管理可能改變系統邊界內的淨耗用。 假設一次交換量200000 m³、回用率0.6、另有損失5000 m³，淡水補充=(1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³；非官方每次用水量。 只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。閘次船型差異和不完整循環又可能造成看似改善卻不可比較的績效數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回用率與淨淡水耗用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A reuse percentage requires an explicit denominator. Chamber exchange, lake withdrawal and annual water-resource consumption differ, while leakage, evaporation and salinity management can change net use within the chosen boundary. Assume cycle exchange 200000 m³, reuse fraction 0.6 and other losses 5000 m³. Freshwater makeup is (1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³, not an official lockage demand. Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings. Vessel differences and incomplete cycles can produce apparently improved performance values that are not comparable across the measurement period. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reuse ratio and net freshwater use” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一次交換量200000 m³、回用率0.6、另有損失5000 m³，淡水補充=(1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³；非官方每次用水量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle exchange 200000 m³, reuse fraction 0.6 and other losses 5000 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回用率與淨淡水耗用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reuse ratio and net freshwater use”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回用率與淨淡水耗用
knowledge.titleEn: Reuse ratio and net freshwater use
knowledge.text: 回用百分比必須有明確分母，閘室交換量、從湖取水量與全年水源消耗並不相同。漏流、蒸發與鹽分管理可能改變系統邊界內的淨耗用。
knowledge.textEn: A reuse percentage requires an explicit denominator. Chamber exchange, lake withdrawal and annual water-resource consumption differ, while leakage, evaporation and salinity management can change net use within the chosen boundary.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回用率與淨淡水耗用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reuse ratio and net freshwater use" is correct?
options: 回用百分比必須有明確分母，閘室交換量、從湖取水量與全年水源消耗並不相同。
百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。
設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。
optionsEn: A reuse percentage requires an explicit denominator.
Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent.
After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput.
quiz.explanation: 回用百分比必須有明確分母，閘室交換量、從湖取水量與全年水源消耗並不相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A reuse percentage requires an explicit denominator. The other options are common misconceptions.

Freshwater makeup is (1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³, not an official lockage demand. steps.observation: 如何核對：為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一次交換量200000 m³、回用率0.6、另有損失5000 m³，淡水補充=(1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³；非官方每次用水量。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle exchange 200000 m³, reuse fraction 0.6 and other losses 5000 m³. Freshwater makeup is (1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³, not an official lockage demand.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回用率與淨淡水耗用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reuse ratio and net freshwater use", which statement holds?
options: 充水量和總時間相同就表示所有瞬時水力荷載相同。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一次交換量200000 m³、回用率0.6、另有損失5000 m³，淡水補充=(1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³。
兩側水面相同時，不同密度水體就不會互相交換。
optionsEn: Equal filling volume and total duration imply identical transient hydraulic loads.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle exchange 200000 m³, reuse fraction 0.6 and other losses 5000 m³.
Different-density waters stop exchanging when their surface elevations are equal.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設一次交換量200000 m³、回用率0.6、另有損失5000 m³，淡水補充=(1−0.6)200000+5000=85000 m³；非官方每次用水量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume cycle exchange 200000 m³, reuse fraction 0.6 and other losses 5000 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 回用率與淨淡水耗用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reuse ratio and net freshwater use: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回用率與淨淡水耗用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reuse ratio and net freshwater use” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。以完整週期的池位回復確認沒有借用下一循環庫容，將蒸發漏流另列為水源負擔。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes. Cover a complete cycle and state whether vessel displacement is included in the metering boundary. Confirm basin-level recovery over a complete cycle to exclude borrowing future storage and list evaporation and leakage separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以回用率與淨淡水耗用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for reuse ratio and net freshwater use, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes. Cover a complete cycle and state whether vessel displacement is included in the metering boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。以完整週期的池位回復確認沒有借用下一循環庫容，將蒸發漏流另列為水源負擔。
knowledge.textEn: Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes. Cover a complete cycle and state whether vessel displacement is included in the metering boundary. Confirm basin-level recovery over a complete cycle to exclude borrowing future storage and list evaporation and leakage separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以回用率與淨淡水耗用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for reuse ratio and net freshwater use, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes. Cover a complete cycle and state whether vessel displacement is included in the metering boundary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回用率與淨淡水耗用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reuse ratio and net freshwater use"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
慢速改變流量也必須產生完整的快速水錘壓峰。
為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A slow flow change must generate the full rapid-waterhammer pressure peak.
Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes.
quiz.explanation: 為每個水量畫清楚來源與去向，將暫存池、外海與淡水湖分成控制體；確認計量時間覆蓋完整循環，並說明船舶排水體積是否納入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map every water source and destination, separating basins, sea and freshwater lake into control volumes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 回用率與淨淡水耗用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reuse ratio and net freshwater use: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回用率與淨淡水耗用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reuse ratio and net freshwater use” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。閘次船型差異和不完整循環又可能造成看似改善卻不可比較的績效數字。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings. Vessel differences and incomplete cycles can produce apparently improved performance values that are not comparable across the measurement period. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：閘次船型差異和不完整循環又可能造成看似改善卻不可比較的績效數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Vessel differences and incomplete cycles can produce apparently improved performance values that are not comparable across the measurement period.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「百分之六十回用一定讓全年淡水需求直接減少六成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sixty percent reuse necessarily reduces annual freshwater demand by sixty percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。閘次船型差異和不完整循環又可能造成看似改善卻不可比較的績效數字。
knowledge.textEn: Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings. Vessel differences and incomplete cycles can produce apparently improved performance values that are not comparable across the measurement period.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回用率與淨淡水耗用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reuse ratio and net freshwater use" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。
optionsEn: Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput.
quiz.explanation: 只引用回用率而省略其他損失，會把單次水力效率誤當流域節水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Quoting reuse alone confuses cycle hydraulics with watershed savings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 故障停航與水源緩衝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outage backlog and water reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「故障停航與水源緩衝」如何影響巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outage backlog and water reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Panama Canal expansion locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 容量與水源限制可能交互作用，故障後即使機械恢復，也需要足夠淡水與航道時間清理隊列。系統復原應同時盤點通行和水量資源。 假設積壓8次通行、每次教學補水85000 m³，額外需求680000 m³；若可分配水量每日170000 m³，至少需4 days，不含新增需求。 機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。若水位下降又增加抽水或通航限制，簡單固定單次需求亦會改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「故障停航與水源緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Capacity and water availability interact: after mechanical restoration, clearing a backlog also needs freshwater and navigation time. Recovery therefore requires both transit and water-resource accounting. Assume eight queued transits each needing teaching makeup 85000 m³. Extra demand is 680000 m³; allocation 170000 m³/day requires at least four days, excluding new arrivals. Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible. Falling levels can introduce further pumping or navigation constraints and change the assumed fixed water demand per transit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outage backlog and water reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設積壓8次通行、每次教學補水85000 m³，額外需求680000 m³；若可分配水量每日170000 m³，至少需4 days，不含新增需求。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume eight queued transits each needing teaching makeup 85000 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「故障停航與水源緩衝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Outage backlog and water reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 故障停航與水源緩衝
knowledge.text: 容量與水源限制可能交互作用，故障後即使機械恢復，也需要足夠淡水與航道時間清理隊列。系統復原應同時盤點通行和水量資源。
knowledge.textEn: Capacity and water availability interact: after mechanical restoration, clearing a backlog also needs freshwater and navigation time. Recovery therefore requires both transit and water-resource accounting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「故障停航與水源緩衝」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Outage backlog and water reserve" is correct?
options: 設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。
容量與水源限制可能交互作用，故障後即使機械恢復，也需要足夠淡水與航道時間清理隊列。

optionsEn: After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput.

A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water.

quiz.explanationEn: Capacity and water availability interact: after mechanical restoration, clearing a backlog also needs freshwater and navigation time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Outage backlog and water reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設積壓8次通行、每次教學補水85000 m³，額外需求680000 m³；若可分配水量每日170000 m³，至少需4 days，不含新增需求。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「故障停航與水源緩衝」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Outage backlog and water reserve", which statement holds?
options: 閘室平均水位平穩就表示船首船尾沒有壓力差。
平均輪載足夠低就能排除任何個別輪組超載。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設積壓8次通行、每次教學補水85000 m³，額外需求680000 m³。
optionsEn: A steady mean chamber level means there is no bow-to-stern pressure difference.
Low mean wheel load rules out overload in every individual wheel group.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume eight queued transits each needing teaching makeup 85000 m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設積壓8次通行、每次教學補水85000 m³，額外需求680000 m³；若可分配水量每日170000 m³，至少需4 days，不含新增需求。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume eight queued transits each needing teaching makeup 85000 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 故障停航與水源緩衝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outage backlog and water reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「故障停航與水源緩衝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outage backlog and water reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名化通行隊列、可分配水量與其他取水用途建立共同日曆；將已確認的供水約束和可調整排程分開，核對每項需求是否重複計列。將每天新增通行需求加入排程重算，檢查水源可分配量是否仍足以逐日減少積壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a common calendar of anonymous transit queues, available water and other withdrawals. Separate confirmed supply constraints from adjustable schedules and check that demands are not counted twice. Add newly arriving demand to the daily schedule and check whether allocated water still reduces the backlog each day. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以故障停航與水源緩衝編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用匿名化通行隊列、可分配水量與其他取水用途建立共同日曆；將已確認的供水約束和可調整排程分開，核對每項需求是否重複計列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for outage backlog and water reserve, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a common calendar of anonymous transit queues, available water and other withdrawals. Separate confirmed supply constraints from adjustable schedules and check that demands are not counted twice.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separate confirmed supply constraints from adjustable schedules and check that demands are not counted twice. Add newly arriving demand to the daily schedule and check whether allocated water still reduces the backlog each day.

quiz.question: 要驗證「故障停航與水源緩衝」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outage backlog and water reserve"?

steps.title: 故障停航與水源緩衝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outage backlog and water reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「故障停航與水源緩衝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outage backlog and water reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。若水位下降又增加抽水或通航限制，簡單固定單次需求亦會改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible. Falling levels can introduce further pumping or navigation constraints and change the assumed fixed water demand per transit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若水位下降又增加抽水或通航限制，簡單固定單次需求亦會改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Falling levels can introduce further pumping or navigation constraints and change the assumed fixed water demand per transit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備修復後，積壓通行一定能按機械最大吞吐量完成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After repair the backlog can always clear at maximum mechanical throughput." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。若水位下降又增加抽水或通航限制，簡單固定單次需求亦會改變。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible. Falling levels can introduce further pumping or navigation constraints and change the assumed fixed water demand per transit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「故障停航與水源緩衝」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outage backlog and water reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。
節水池即使面積有限，交換水量時水位仍保持不變。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible.
A finite saving basin maintains constant level while exchanging water.
quiz.explanation: 機械最大吞吐量可能遠高於水源允許速率，忽略這點會提出無法實現的復原計畫。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mechanical throughput can exceed water-limited capacity, making a recovery plan infeasible. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 三峽升船機
courses.summary: 本課以三峽升船機為入口，深入高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Three Gorges ship lift as its entry point, this course examines counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界
courses.focusEn: Counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 提升功率敏感度固定速度0.2 m/s與g=9.81 m/s²，只將不平衡質量由100 t降至50 t。純重力功率Δmgv由196.2降至98.1 kW，減少50%；這只是相同速度下需克服的重力項。摩擦、啟停加速度、再生回送和傳動效率仍須另計，不能因此宣稱整機耗電也減半。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume imbalance mass 100 t and speed 0.2 m/s. Gravity-only power Δmgv=196.2 kW, before friction and efficiency losses and distinct from machine-rated power. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For lifting-power sensitivity, hold speed at 0.2 m/s and g at 9.81 m/s², reducing only imbalance mass from 100 t to 50 t. Gravity-only power Δmgv falls from 196.2 to 98.1 kW, a 50% reduction in that component. Friction, starting acceleration, regeneration and drive efficiency remain separate, so total machine electricity consumption need not halve.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「船舶排水與船廂質量」與「配重不平衡功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vessel displacement and caisson mass" and "Counterweight imbalance power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 船舶排水與船廂質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vessel displacement and caisson mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「船舶排水與船廂質量」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vessel displacement and caisson mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮船進入保持固定水位的船廂時，會排出等重的水，因此船加水總重近似不變。這個平衡依賴船舶自由浮動及水量能夠交換，不能套用坐底或封閉增水情況。 假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。 船舶坐底後不再完整由浮力支承，水位改變也會破壞固定總重假設。若混淆載貨重量和船舶總排水質量，平衡重判讀將出現大幅偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船舶排水與船廂質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floating vessel entering a fixed-level caisson displaces water of equal weight, keeping vessel-plus-water mass approximately constant. This requires free flotation and water exchange, and does not apply to grounding or added water in a sealed chamber. Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³. It displaces 2000 m³; maintaining level removes 2000 t of water, giving ideal total mass change zero tonnes. Grounding removes full buoyant support, while changing level breaks constant total mass. Confusing cargo weight with total vessel displacement can cause a large error in interpreting counterweight balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vessel displacement and caisson mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設船舶質量2000 t、淡水密度1000 kg/m³，排水2000 m³；若維持水位，移出水質量2000 t，理想船廂總質量變化0 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume vessel mass 2000 t and freshwater density 1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「船舶排水與船廂質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vessel displacement and caisson mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 船舶排水與船廂質量
knowledge.text: 浮船進入保持固定水位的船廂時，會排出等重的水，因此船加水總重近似不變。這個平衡依賴船舶自由浮動及水量能夠交換，不能套用坐底或封閉增水情況。
knowledge.textEn: A floating vessel entering a fixed-level caisson displaces water of equal weight, keeping vessel-plus-water mass approximately constant. This requires free flotation and water exchange, and does not apply to grounding or added water in a sealed chamber.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「船舶排水與船廂質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vessel displacement and caisson mass" is correct?
options: 船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。
浮船進入保持固定水位的船廂時，會排出等重的水，因此船加水總重近似不變。
有配重就能完全消除所有重力差所需的驅動功率。
optionsEn: A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass.
A floating vessel entering a fixed-level caisson displaces water of equal weight, keeping vessel-plus-water mass approximately constant.
Counterweights completely eliminate drive power required by every gravitational imbalance.

steps.instruction: 配重抵銷大部分重力，但驅動仍需克服不平衡、摩擦與加速度。把整個提升重量乘高度當成電力耗用，會忽略下降配重釋放的位能。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設不平衡質量100 t、速度0.2 m/s，純重力功率Δmgv=196.2 kW；另有摩擦與效率損失，非整機額定功率。 配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「配重不平衡功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 配重不平衡功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Counterweight imbalance power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「配重不平衡功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 同步比較電功率、速度和船廂水位，區分恆速段與加減速段；在相反方向相同條件下比較損失，避免將回生電力誤記為負摩擦。將上升與下降的功率差分離為重力項，核對摩擦估計是否維持合理的非負耗能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare power, speed and water level synchronously, separating steady motion from acceleration. Separate gravitational demand from opposite-direction power differences and check that inferred friction remains a plausible nonnegative loss. steps.instruction: 配重失配可能由漏水或水位偏差引起，單靠驅動電流無法辨認來源。若效率和摩擦隨溫度變動仍視為固定，剩餘荷載的推估便會偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counterweight mismatch may arise from leakage or level error, which current alone cannot distinguish. Temperature-dependent efficiency and friction shift the inferred residual load if incorrectly treated as constant. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「齒條切向力分配」與「四角同步與船廂傾斜」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rack tangential-force sharing" and "Corner synchronization and caisson tilt": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 齒條切向力分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rack tangential-force sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「齒條切向力分配」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rack tangential-force sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 齒輪齒條把轉矩轉成豎向力，多驅動點必須協調分擔。平均轉矩相同不保證齒面接觸相同，幾何誤差和傳動剛度會造成局部偏載。 假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。 一個驅動點遲滯會使其他點先承載，扭矩平均值可能仍正常。齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「齒條切向力分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points. Equal mean torque does not ensure equal tooth contact because geometric error and drivetrain stiffness create local unequal loading. Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m. Tangential force T/r=400 kN, an ideal contact resultant excluding tooth-root stress concentration. A lagging drive shifts load to other points despite an apparently normal mean torque. Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rack tangential-force sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單齒輪轉矩200 kN·m、節圓半徑0.5 m，切向力T/r=400 kN；只算理想接觸合力，不含齒形應力集中。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume pinion torque 200 kN·m and pitch radius 0.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「齒條切向力分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rack tangential-force sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points. Equal mean torque does not ensure equal tooth contact because geometric error and drivetrain stiffness create local unequal loading.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均轉矩相同就能保證每個齒面接觸荷載相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean drive torque guarantees equal contact load on every tooth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Rack-and-pinion drives convert torque to vertical force and must coordinate several lifting points.

Tangential force T/r=400 kN, an ideal contact resultant excluding tooth-root stress concentration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 齒條切向力分配：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 一個驅動點遲滯會使其他點先承載，扭矩平均值可能仍正常。齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A lagging drive shifts load to other points despite an apparently normal mean torque. Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：齒根疲勞、潤滑不足與齒面點蝕是不同機制，不能僅由總提升力判定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Root fatigue, poor lubrication and contact pitting differ, and total lifting force cannot distinguish these mechanisms.

steps.title: 四角同步與船廂傾斜：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corner synchronization and caisson tilt: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「四角同步與船廂傾斜」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corner synchronization and caisson tilt” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型船廂由多點支承，位置差會轉成傾斜與扭曲，進而改變導向和對接條件。同步控制須比較同基準位置，不能只比較各馬達轉速。 假設橫向支承跨20 m、兩側高差4 mm，小角度θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad，即0.01146°；剛體近似不含扭曲。 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「四角同步與船廂傾斜」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A caisson supported at several points converts position differences into tilt and distortion, affecting guidance and docking. Synchronization requires common-reference positions rather than motor speeds alone. Assume transverse support spacing 20 m and level difference 4 mm. Small-angle θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad, or 0.01146 degrees, for rigid motion without distortion. Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corner synchronization and caisson tilt” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設橫向支承跨20 m、兩側高差4 mm，小角度θ=0.004/20=0.0002 rad，即0.01146°；剛體近似不含扭曲。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume transverse support spacing 20 m and level difference 4 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「四角同步與船廂傾斜」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corner synchronization and caisson tilt”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 四角同步與船廂傾斜
knowledge.text: 大型船廂由多點支承，位置差會轉成傾斜與扭曲，進而改變導向和對接條件。同步控制須比較同基準位置，不能只比較各馬達轉速。
knowledge.textEn: A caisson supported at several points converts position differences into tilt and distortion, affecting guidance and docking. Synchronization requires common-reference positions rather than motor speeds alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「四角同步與船廂傾斜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized.
A caisson supported at several points converts position differences into tilt and distortion, affecting guidance and docking.
A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corner synchronization and caisson tilt"?
options: 用獨立測量基準核對多點編碼器與傾角計，分離剛體傾斜和船廂撓曲；記錄同步誤差隨高度與方向的變化，找出重複性模式。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
船舶越重，保持水位且自由浮動的船廂總重必定越大。
optionsEn: Check encoders and inclinometers against independent survey references, separating rigid tilt from caisson bending.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A heavier freely floating vessel always increases a constant-level caisson total mass.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立測量基準核對多點編碼器與傾角計，分離剛體傾斜和船廂撓曲；記錄同步誤差隨高度與方向的變化，找出重複性模式。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check encoders and inclinometers against independent survey references, separating rigid tilt from caisson bending. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 四角同步與船廂傾斜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corner synchronization and caisson tilt: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「四角同步與船廂傾斜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corner synchronization and caisson tilt” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。只比較速度不能發現先前累積的位置差，也不能排除導向件局部卡阻。
knowledge.textEn: Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Speed comparison misses accumulated position error and does not exclude localized binding in guidance components.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「四角同步與船廂傾斜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Corner synchronization and caisson tilt" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。
鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization.
A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
quiz.explanation: 兩側編碼器共同零點漂移會讓同步數字好看卻整體偏離對接高程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Common encoder drift can hide an incorrect docking elevation despite good relative synchronization. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼索彈伸與溫度」與「螺旋機構自鎖判讀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rope extension and temperature" and "Self-locking of screw mechanisms": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rope extension and temperature: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼索彈伸與溫度」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rope extension and temperature” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鋼索受力會伸長，等長索因有效剛度和溫度差也可能產生不同位移。鋼索等效模數與實心鋼棒不同，必須使用實測或供應者資料。 假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。 端接滑移可能表現為長度增加卻不符合索力變化，斷絲也會降低有效剛度。若把所有延伸都視為可逆彈性，便會漏掉需獨立檢查的損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼索彈伸與溫度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature. Rope effective modulus differs from a solid steel bar and requires measured or supplier-supported values. Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Anchorage slip produces extension inconsistent with tension, and broken wires reduce effective stiffness. Treating all elongation as reversible elasticity misses damage that requires an independent physical inspection. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rope extension and temperature” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼索彈伸與溫度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rope extension and temperature”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature. Rope effective modulus differs from a solid steel bar and requires measured or supplier-supported values.

knowledge.text: 誤解：鋼索的等效彈性模數可以直接取為實心鋼棒模數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼索彈伸與溫度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rope extension and temperature" is correct?

螺旋機構具有靜態自鎖就保證所有動態情況安全。
鋼索受力會伸長，等長索因有效剛度和溫度差也可能產生不同位移。
optionsEn: A rope effective modulus can directly be taken as the solid-steel modulus.
Static screw self-locking guarantees safety under every dynamic condition.
Loaded ropes extend, and equal initial lengths can move differently because of stiffness and temperature.

steps.title: 鋼索彈伸與溫度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rope extension and temperature: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼索彈伸與溫度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rope extension and temperature” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record tension, reference length and temperature together, separating elastic from permanent extension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m；忽略構造伸長與蠕變。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼索彈伸與溫度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rope extension and temperature", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單索力1 MN、長100 m、有效面積0.005 m²、等效E=100 GPa，ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m。

提升速度最快的設備必定具有最大的全年通航量。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep.
Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
The fastest lifting equipment necessarily has the greatest annual throughput.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume rope force 1 MN, length 100 m, effective area 0.005 m² and equivalent E=100 GPa. ΔL=FL/EA=0.20 m, excluding constructional stretch and creep. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Rope extension and temperature: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼索彈伸與溫度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rope extension and temperature” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。在相似索力與溫度下比較長期長度，檢查不可回復部分是否集中於特定端接。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record tension, reference length and temperature together, separating elastic from permanent extension. Check strand construction, anchorage slip and modulus definition instead of using nominal solid-steel elasticity. Compare long-term lengths at matched tension and temperature and identify whether irreversible extension concentrates at particular terminations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rope extension and temperature, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record tension, reference length and temperature together, separating elastic from permanent extension. Check strand construction, anchorage slip and modulus definition instead of using nominal solid-steel elasticity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：端接滑移可能表現為長度增加卻不符合索力變化，斷絲也會降低有效剛度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Anchorage slip produces extension inconsistent with tension, and broken wires reduce effective stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare long-term lengths at matched tension and temperature and identify whether irreversible extension concentrates at particular terminations.

knowledge.text: 以鋼索彈伸與溫度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同時記錄索力、長度基準與溫度，分離載重彈伸和永久伸長；核對繩股結構、端接滑移及模數定義，避免誤用鋼材名義彈性模數。

肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。
optionsEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
quiz.explanation: 潤滑使摩擦降低可能改變反驅條件，動態衝擊也不服從單純靜摩擦比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lubrication can lower friction enough to change back-driving behavior, and impacts do not follow a simple static comparison. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「對接水位差作用」與「啟停加速度與慣性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Docking head-difference force" and "Start-stop acceleration and inertia": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對接水位差作用」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Docking head-difference force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。對接荷載需區分平衡水位、間隙充水和結構鎖定，不可只憑水面看似齊平。 取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對接水位差作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. Docking assessment separates equalized levels, gap filling and structural restraint instead of relying on water surfaces that merely appear aligned. Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area. Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Docking head-difference force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對接水位差作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Docking head-difference force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對接水位差作用
knowledge.text: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。對接荷載需區分平衡水位、間隙充水和結構鎖定，不可只憑水面看似齊平。
knowledge.textEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. Docking assessment separates equalized levels, gap filling and structural restraint instead of relying on water surfaces that merely appear aligned.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「對接水位差作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Docking head-difference force" is correct?
options: 肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。
船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。
配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。
optionsEn: Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces.
Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces.
Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
quiz.explanation: 船廂與航道對接前後，微小水位差也可能在大面積上形成顯著合力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Small level differences across a large docking area can create substantial forces. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對接水位差作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Docking head-difference force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。假設兩側平均壓差來自0.10 m淡水頭、有效面積100 m²，F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN；均勻壓差只適用共同浸沒區近似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Assume mean pressure difference from 0.10 m freshwater head over 100 m². F=ρgΔhA=98.1 kN, using a uniform difference over a commonly submerged area.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「對接水位差作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Docking head-difference force", which statement holds?
options: 提升速度最快的設備必定具有最大的全年通航量。
有配重就能完全消除所有重力差所需的驅動功率。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: The fastest lifting equipment necessarily has the greatest annual throughput.
Counterweights completely eliminate drive power required by every gravitational imbalance.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取淡水密度ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對接水位差作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Docking head-difference force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。將兩側水位差直接換算壓差，核對間隙充水過程的荷載峰值是否符合量測。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value. Convert the two-sided level difference directly to pressure and check whether measured peaks match the gap-filling stage. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以對接水位差作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking head-difference force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。將兩側水位差直接換算壓差，核對間隙充水過程的荷載峰值是否符合量測。
knowledge.textEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value. Convert the two-sided level difference directly to pressure and check whether measured peaks match the gap-filling stage.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以對接水位差作用編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for docking head-difference force, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Examine whether waves and vessel movement hide transient peaks behind an average value.

quiz.question: 要驗證「對接水位差作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Docking head-difference force"?
options: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
所有馬達轉速一致就能證明支承點位置已完全同步。
optionsEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal motor speeds prove that all support positions are fully synchronized.
quiz.explanation: 以同基準水位計和對接位移量測核對壓差，將間隙水量與密封受力一起記錄；檢查波浪和船舶移動是否使平均值掩蓋瞬時峰值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check head with common-datum gauges and docking displacement, recording gap volume and seal forces together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 對接水位差作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Docking head-difference force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對接水位差作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Docking head-difference force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「肉眼看到兩側水面齊平就能排除顯著對接荷載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Visually aligned water surfaces rule out substantial docking forces." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。若只測一側水位，無法區分船廂升沉和航道自身水位變動。
knowledge.textEn: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. One-sided level sensing cannot separate caisson movement from changes in the navigation reach itself.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「對接水位差作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Docking head-difference force" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。
配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact.
Counterbalancing weight also eliminates caisson and counterweight inertia.
quiz.explanation: 波動水面可能在平均齊平時仍產生交變荷載，鎖定件間隙又會造成撞擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fluctuating surfaces create alternating loads even when means match, while locking clearance can cause impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 啟停加速度與慣性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Start-stop acceleration and inertia: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「啟停加速度與慣性」如何影響三峽升船機的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Three Gorges ship lift”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。加速時兩者動能同時增加，不能將淨重量小誤當總慣性小。 假設兩側總移動質量30 million kg、加速度0.005 m/s²，慣性力ma=150 kN；簡化等效平動質量，未含旋轉件慣量。 直接二次微分雜訊會產生假的加速度峰值，過度平滑又會漏掉衝擊。若不計配重慣性，模型會把正常加速需求誤認為摩擦突然變大。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「啟停加速度與慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. Both gain kinetic energy during acceleration, so small net weight does not imply small total inertial demand. Assume total moving mass 30 million kg and acceleration 0.005 m/s². Inertial force ma=150 kN, using equivalent translation and excluding rotating-component inertia. Differentiating noise twice creates false acceleration peaks, while excessive smoothing hides impacts. Omitting counterweight inertia can make ordinary acceleration demand appear to be a sudden increase in friction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Start-stop acceleration and inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 啟停加速度與慣性
knowledge.text: 即使重量被配重抵銷，船廂和配重的慣性仍需要驅動與制動。加速時兩者動能同時增加，不能將淨重量小誤當總慣性小。
knowledge.textEn: Counterbalancing weight does not remove caisson and counterweight inertia. Both gain kinetic energy during acceleration, so small net weight does not imply small total inertial demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：配重抵銷重量後，船廂與配重的運動慣性也消失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tower temperature and alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效塔高120 m、混凝土熱膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻升溫10 K，伸長αLΔT=12 mm；不含溫差彎曲與徐變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume effective tower height 120 m, concrete thermal expansion 10⁻⁵/K and uniform warming 10 K. Extension αLΔT=12 mm, excluding thermal curvature and creep. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把塔柱不同方位溫度、測量基準和導軌位置同步，分離日循環與長期沉降；在相似溫度條件下比較年度幾何，而非直接比較任意兩天。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

Separate daily cycles from long-term settlement and compare annual geometry at similar thermal conditions rather than arbitrary dates.
