quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rotational inertia and acceleration"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
按實際質量分布建立慣量清單，核對槽、輪臂、傳動與附加設備；以加速段轉矩扣除重力和摩擦後比較，檢查是否遺漏旋轉件。
質量差固定時，整個旋轉過程的重力轉矩也固定。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Create an inertia inventory from actual mass distribution, including gondolas, arms, drivetrain and additions.
A fixed mass imbalance creates constant gravity torque throughout rotation.
quiz.explanation: 按實際質量分布建立慣量清單，核對槽、輪臂、傳動與附加設備；以加速段轉矩扣除重力和摩擦後比較，檢查是否遺漏旋轉件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Create an inertia inventory from actual mass distribution, including gondolas, arms, drivetrain and additions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉動慣量與加速：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rotational inertia and acceleration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉動慣量與加速」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rotational inertia and acceleration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。若用靜態平衡證明馬達能力，便完全漏掉啟停時的動力需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter. Static balance alone cannot establish motor capability because it omits starting and stopping demand. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若用靜態平衡證明馬達能力，便完全漏掉啟停時的動力需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Static balance alone cannot establish motor capability because it omits starting and stopping demand.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。若用靜態平衡證明馬達能力，便完全漏掉啟停時的動力需求。
knowledge.textEn: A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter. Static balance alone cannot establish motor capability because it omits starting and stopping demand.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉動慣量與加速」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rotational inertia and acceleration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。
把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle.
A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter.
quiz.explanation: 把全部質量放在單一半徑只是簡化，輪臂分布和傳動反射慣量可能不可忽略。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A single-radius mass representation is approximate; distributed arms and reflected drivetrain inertia may matter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 整循環能量與損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle energy and losses: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「整循環能量與損失」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Full-cycle energy and losses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 理想成對升降可互相交換位能，實際電力主要補足損失和不平衡。整循環比較須包括正負功率與輔助設備，不能用某一瞬間功率乘任意時間。 假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。宣傳用水壺類比缺乏共同容量時，不能替代電表紀錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「整循環能量與損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ideal paired motion exchanges potential energy, while electricity covers losses and imbalance. A cycle balance includes positive and negative power and auxiliaries rather than multiplying one instantaneous reading by an arbitrary duration. Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Total energy is (18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh, not official energy use. Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. Kettle analogies without common capacity and duration cannot replace metered energy records. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Full-cycle energy and losses” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「整循環能量與損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Full-cycle energy and losses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 整循環能量與損失
knowledge.text: 理想成對升降可互相交換位能，實際電力主要補足損失和不平衡。整循環比較須包括正負功率與輔助設備，不能用某一瞬間功率乘任意時間。
knowledge.textEn: Ideal paired motion exchanges potential energy, while electricity covers losses and imbalance. A cycle balance includes positive and negative power and auxiliaries rather than multiplying one instantaneous reading by an arbitrary duration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「整循環能量與損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Full-cycle energy and losses" is correct?
options: 理想成對升降可互相交換位能，實際電力主要補足損失和不平衡。
設備保持重力平衡就保證整個服務循環完全不耗電。
預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。
optionsEn: Ideal paired motion exchanges potential energy, while electricity covers losses and imbalance.
Gravitational balance guarantees zero electrical use over the complete service cycle.
All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
quiz.explanation: 理想成對升降可互相交換位能，實際電力主要補足損失和不平衡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ideal paired motion exchanges potential energy, while electricity covers losses and imbalance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 整循環能量與損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle energy and losses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「整循環能量與損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Full-cycle energy and losses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Total energy is (18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh, not official energy use. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Total energy is (18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh, not official energy use.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「整循環能量與損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Full-cycle energy and losses", which statement holds?
options: 只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh。
兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。
optionsEn: A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s.
With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設平均主驅動功率18 kW持續300 s，另輔助4 kW持續600 s，總能量=(18×300+4×600)/3600=2.1667 kWh；非官方耗能。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume main drive averages 18 kW for 300 s and auxiliaries 4 kW for 600 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 整循環能量與損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Full-cycle energy and losses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「整循環能量與損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Full-cycle energy and losses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。核對循環起點與終點是否具有相同儲能狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries. Check that cycle start and finish have equivalent stored-energy states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以整循環能量與損失編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle energy and losses, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。核對循環起點與終點是否具有相同儲能狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries. Check that cycle start and finish have equivalent stored-energy states.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以整循環能量與損失編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for full-cycle energy and losses, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Compare cycles at matched levels, weather and vessel conditions rather than ranking values with different energy boundaries.

quiz.question: 要驗證「整循環能量與損失」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Full-cycle energy and losses"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage.
quiz.explanation: 積分完整循環的雙向電功率，清楚標示電表是否包含輔機和待機；比較相同水位、天候與船型條件的循環，避免不同邊界的數值相互排名。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Integrate bidirectional power over a complete cycle and identify auxiliary and standby coverage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。宣傳用水壺類比缺乏共同容量時，不能替代電表紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. Kettle analogies without common capacity and duration cannot replace metered energy records.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「整循環能量與損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Full-cycle energy and losses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。
optionsEn: Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
quiz.explanation: 忽略待機與門控能耗會低估每次服務能源，將回生能量在不同邊界重複扣除也會失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting standby and gate-control loads understates service energy, while subtracting regeneration twice distorts the balance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「螺栓預拉與接觸」與「管形輪臂局部剛度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bolt pretension and joint contact" and "Tubular-arm section stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 螺栓預拉與接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bolt pretension and joint contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「螺栓預拉與接觸」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bolt pretension and joint contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輪臂連接的螺栓預拉力保持接觸並影響疲勞應力範圍，外力並非全部直接加到螺栓上。接頭剛度決定螺栓與被夾件的載荷分配。 假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。 表面嵌入和鬆弛可能降低夾緊力而扭矩標記仍在，接頭分離後線性分配失效。若把全部外力忽略或全部加到螺栓，都會誤判疲勞需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「螺栓預拉與接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pretension maintains contact and affects bolt fatigue range. Applied load does not all go directly into the bolt because relative bolt and clamped-part stiffness controls sharing. Assume bolt pretension 300 kN, stiffness fraction 0.2 and applied tension 100 kN. Before separation bolt force becomes 320 kN and clamping force falls by 80 kN. Embedment and relaxation can reduce clamp force despite intact torque marks, and separation invalidates linear sharing. Either ignoring applied load or adding it entirely to bolts misstates fatigue demand. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bolt pretension and joint contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume bolt pretension 300 kN, stiffness fraction 0.2 and applied tension 100 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「螺栓預拉與接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bolt pretension and joint contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 螺栓預拉與接觸
knowledge.text: 輪臂連接的螺栓預拉力保持接觸並影響疲勞應力範圍，外力並非全部直接加到螺栓上。接頭剛度決定螺栓與被夾件的載荷分配。
knowledge.textEn: Pretension maintains contact and affects bolt fatigue range. Applied load does not all go directly into the bolt because relative bolt and clamped-part stiffness controls sharing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「螺栓預拉與接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bolt pretension and joint contact" is correct?
options: 預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。
輪臂連接的螺栓預拉力保持接觸並影響疲勞應力範圍，外力並非全部直接加到螺栓上。
管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。
optionsEn: All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
Pretension maintains contact and affects bolt fatigue range.
Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling.
quiz.explanation: 輪臂連接的螺栓預拉力保持接觸並影響疲勞應力範圍，外力並非全部直接加到螺栓上。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 螺栓預拉與接觸：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume bolt pretension 300 kN, stiffness fraction 0.2 and applied tension 100 kN. Before separation bolt force becomes 320 kN and clamping force falls by 80 kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用校準方法核對預拉而非只讀扳手扭矩，查接觸面是否分離或滑移；將外載循環造成的螺栓應變幅與剛度分配模型交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify pretension with a calibrated method rather than torque alone, checking separation and slip.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單螺栓預拉300 kN、接頭剛度分配係數0.2、外拉力100 kN，未分離時螺栓力320 kN、夾緊力減少80 kN。

steps.title: 螺栓預拉與接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bolt pretension and joint contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「螺栓預拉與接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bolt pretension and joint contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用校準方法核對預拉而非只讀扳手扭矩，查接觸面是否分離或滑移；將外載循環造成的螺栓應變幅與剛度分配模型交叉比較。將預拉損失與表面壓陷量作獨立相關比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Compare cyclic bolt strain with the predicted stiffness sharing under the applied loading cycle. Independently compare pretension loss with measured embedment of the contact surfaces. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for bolt pretension and joint contact, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面嵌入和鬆弛可能降低夾緊力而扭矩標記仍在，接頭分離後線性分配失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Embedment and relaxation can reduce clamp force despite intact torque marks, and separation invalidates linear sharing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Tubular-arm section stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管形輪臂局部剛度」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tubular-arm section stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管形截面把材料移到外側提高彎曲剛度，但薄壁局部屈曲和焊接細節仍可能控制。截面慣性矩只描述整體彎曲，不能取代局部板件分析。 假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「管形輪臂局部剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Tubular sections place material outward to increase bending stiffness, but local shell buckling and welded details can govern. Section inertia describes overall bending rather than local wall behavior. Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴, for an intact uniform tube without openings or local thinning. A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tubular-arm section stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管形輪臂局部剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tubular-arm section stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 管形輪臂局部剛度
knowledge.text: 管形截面把材料移到外側提高彎曲剛度，但薄壁局部屈曲和焊接細節仍可能控制。截面慣性矩只描述整體彎曲，不能取代局部板件分析。
knowledge.textEn: Tubular sections place material outward to increase bending stiffness, but local shell buckling and welded details can govern. Section inertia describes overall bending rather than local wall behavior.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「管形輪臂局部剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tubular-arm section stiffness" is correct?
options: 管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。
只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。
管形截面把材料移到外側提高彎曲剛度，但薄壁局部屈曲和焊接細節仍可能控制。
optionsEn: Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling.
A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.
Tubular sections place material outward to increase bending stiffness, but local shell buckling and welded details can govern.
quiz.explanation: 管形截面把材料移到外側提高彎曲剛度，但薄壁局部屈曲和焊接細節仍可能控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Tubular sections place material outward to increase bending stiffness, but local shell buckling and welded details can govern. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 管形輪臂局部剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tubular-arm section stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「管形輪臂局部剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tubular-arm section stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴, for an intact uniform tube without openings or local thinning. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴, for an intact uniform tube without openings or local thinning.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「管形輪臂局部剛度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tubular-arm section stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。
兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。
只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m.
With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設圓管外徑1 m、內徑0.9 m，I=π(D⁴−d⁴)/64=0.01688 m⁴；均勻完整圓管，不含開孔和局部薄化。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume circular tube outer diameter 1 m and inner diameter 0.9 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 管形輪臂局部剛度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tubular-arm section stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管形輪臂局部剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tubular-arm section stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。對最薄壁段另行檢查局部曲率與凹陷深度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature. Inspect local curvature and dent depth separately in the thinnest wall regions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以管形輪臂局部剛度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tubular-arm section stiffness, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。對最薄壁段另行檢查局部曲率與凹陷深度。
knowledge.textEn: Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature. Inspect local curvature and dent depth separately in the thinnest wall regions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以管形輪臂局部剛度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for tubular-arm section stiffness, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Use multiple strains to test linear bending assumptions and inspect local dents separately from overall member curvature.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管形輪臂局部剛度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tubular-arm section stiffness"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。
兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations.
Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero.
quiz.explanation: 核對截面幾何與測厚分布，將開孔、加勁和焊縫位置納入模型；用多點應變檢查線性彎曲分布是否足夠，另查局部凹陷。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check geometry and thickness distribution, including openings, stiffeners and weld locations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 管形輪臂局部剛度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tubular-arm section stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管形輪臂局部剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tubular-arm section stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管形截面整體慣性矩足夠就能排除所有局部屈曲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate tubular section inertia rules out every form of local buckling." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。平均厚度無法代表腐蝕坑或焊趾附近的局部承載，不能只以整體撓度驗收。
knowledge.textEn: A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Mean thickness misses pits and local weld-toe demands, so global deflection alone cannot establish local adequacy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管形輪臂局部剛度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tubular-arm section stiffness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。
局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response.
A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia.
quiz.explanation: 局部凹陷可能觸發薄壁失穩，即使全截面慣性矩幾乎不變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A local dent can trigger shell instability with little change in overall inertia. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水面晃蕩時間尺度」與「運河高差與分段提升」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free-surface sloshing time scale" and "Canal elevation and staged lifting": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水面晃蕩時間尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free-surface sloshing time scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水面晃蕩時間尺度」如何影響福爾柯克水輪的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free-surface sloshing time scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Falkirk Wheel”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 船槽加速度會激起自由液面晃蕩，運動頻率與水深、槽長共同決定反應。小振幅理論可比較尺度，實際船體和隔板會改變流場。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設矩形槽長20 m、水深2 m，k=π/L，ω²=gk tanh(kh)，第一模態T=2π/ω=9.177 s；無船且小振幅。 船體遮擋會分割水面並改變模態，大幅晃蕩與撞壁亦超出線性理論。若只取槽中央測站，可能恰好位於節點而錯認沒有晃蕩。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水面晃蕩時間尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gondola acceleration excites free-surface sloshing whose response depends on motion frequency, water depth and tank length. Small-amplitude theory compares scales, while vessels and baffles modify the real flow. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume rectangular tank length 20 m and depth 2 m, with k=π/L and ω²=gk tanh(kh). First-mode T=2π/ω=9.177 s, for small motion without a vessel. A hull subdivides the free surface and changes modes, while large sloshing and wall impact exceed linear theory. A central sensor may sit near a node and falsely suggest no motion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free-surface sloshing time scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只量船槽中央水位就能可靠捕捉所有晃蕩最大值。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A central level sensor reliably captures every maximum sloshing response." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設矩形槽長20 m、水深2 m，k=π/L，ω²=gk tanh(kh)，第一模態T=2π/ω=9.177 s；無船且小振幅。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume rectangular tank length 20 m and depth 2 m, with k=π/L and ω²=gk tanh(kh). First-mode T=2π/ω=9.177 s, for small motion without a vessel. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較槽內不同位置水位相位與船槽加速度頻譜，辨認駐波節點；用有船和無船資料分開驗證，並保留感測器飽和或濺水段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare level phase at several positions with gondola-acceleration spectra and identify standing-wave nodes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 整個運河連接高差可以由水輪與其他船閘共同完成，不能把整體高差全歸給單一設備。分段能量與水量盤點需要明確界定每個控制體。 假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「運河高差與分段提升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運河高差與分段提升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Canal elevation and staged lifting” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities. Only 35 m is official canal context; 24 m is a teaching assumption. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities. Only 35 m is official canal context; 24 m is a teaching assumption.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「運河高差與分段提升」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Canal elevation and staged lifting", which statement holds?
options: 只要船槽自由懸吊，任何摩擦下都會完全保持水平。
兩端質量完全平衡就代表旋轉慣量等於零。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。
optionsEn: A freely suspended gondola stays perfectly level under any amount of friction.
Perfectly balanced end masses make rotational inertia equal to zero.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設全線高差35 m、水輪部分24 m，其他設施需補11 m；這是分段算例，僅35 m採官方運河背景，24 m為教學假設。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume total route difference 35 m and wheel portion 24 m, leaving 11 m for other facilities. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 運河高差與分段提升：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Canal elevation and staged lifting: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運河高差與分段提升」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Canal elevation and staged lifting” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。逐段核對高程差總和是否回到兩運河實測差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably. Check that the sum of stage differences closes against the measured canal-level difference. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以運河高差與分段提升編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for canal elevation and staged lifting, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。逐段核對高程差總和是否回到兩運河實測差。
knowledge.textEn: Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably. Check that the sum of stage differences closes against the measured canal-level difference.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以運河高差與分段提升編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for canal elevation and staged lifting, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Check definitions of advertised height, structural height and actual lift before using them interchangeably.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運河高差與分段提升」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Canal elevation and staged lifting"?
options: 沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
預拉螺栓承受外拉力時，外力必定全部加到螺栓上。
optionsEn: Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All external tension must be added directly to every preloaded bolt.
quiz.explanation: 沿完整航路建立同基準縱剖面，逐一標出水輪、船閘與渠道水面；檢查宣傳高度、結構高度和實際提升高度的定義，避免相互替代。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a common-datum profile along the complete route, marking wheel, locks and reach levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運河高差與分段提升：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Canal elevation and staged lifting: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運河高差與分段提升」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Canal elevation and staged lifting” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. A functioning wheel does not establish availability of the whole route. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A functioning wheel does not establish availability of the whole route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「官方運河總高差就是水輪單獨完成的精確提升高度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The official total canal difference is precisely the lift performed by the wheel alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。即使單一設備運轉正常，全航路仍可能受到其他節點限制。
knowledge.textEn: Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. A functioning wheel does not establish availability of the whole route.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運河高差與分段提升」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Canal elevation and staged lifting" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。
兩端都有浮船時，不論水位如何都必定完全平衡。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use.
With floating boats on both ends the wheel is perfectly balanced at any levels.
quiz.explanation: 把景觀總高度當提升高度會誇大能量需求，漏掉上游船閘又會低估通行時間與用水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using overall architectural height as lift exaggerates energy demand, while omitting upper locks understates transit time and water use. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 荷蘭三角洲工程
courses.summary: 本課以荷蘭三角洲工程為入口，深入區域防洪網路、環境取捨與分期調適決策。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Delta Works as its entry point, this course examines regional flood-defence networks, environmental tradeoffs and staged adaptation. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 區域防洪網路、環境取捨與分期調適決策
courses.focusEn: Regional flood-defence networks, environmental tradeoffs and staged adaptation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設三個必須全成功的區段年失效機率各0.001且獨立，系統失效1−0.999³=0.002997；不是把機率相乘成10⁻⁹。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 風險敏感度保留50年期限與各年獨立、平穩假設，只將年超越機率p由0.001改為0.002。由100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰]計算，累積機率由4.8794%增為9.5253%，並非精確翻倍。此比較說明非線性的期間換算，不假定氣候、暴露或防護性能在真實未來50年必然不變。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume three essential segments each fail annually with probability 0.001 independently. System failure is 1−0.999³=0.002997, not the product 10⁻⁹. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. Retain the fifty-year horizon and independent stationary years, changing only annual exceedance probability p from 0.001 to 0.002. The relation 100[1−(1−p)⁵⁰] changes cumulative probability from 4.8794% to 9.5253%, not exactly double. This illustrates nonlinear horizon conversion without asserting that climate, exposure or protection performance will actually remain stationary for fifty years.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 官方三角洲工程包含13項主要工程。
首項荷蘭艾瑟爾防潮閘於1958年啟用。
教學年機率0.001的50年累積超越機率4.879%。
教學三段串聯失效機率0.002997。
教學內河暫存需求7.2 million m³。
教學調適提前量分析要求第25年以前啟動。
factsEn: The official Delta Works comprise 13 major works.
The first Hollandsche IJssel Barrier enters service in 1958.
Teaching annual probability 0.001 gives fifty-year exceedance probability 4.879 percent.
The teaching three-segment essential-chain failure probability is 0.002997.
The teaching inland temporary-storage demand is 7.2 million m³.
The teaching adaptation lead-time analysis requires initiation by year 25.
timeline: 1953　北海洪災促使荷蘭推動區域尺度的三角洲防洪工程。
1958　十月二十二日荷蘭艾瑟爾防潮閘啟用，成為首項完成工程。
2018　官方記錄多座防潮閘首次同時關閉，顯示系統共同面對海象。
timelineEn: 1953 — The North Sea flood prompts a regional Dutch Delta Works protection programme.
1958 — The Hollandsche IJssel Barrier opens on October twenty-two as the first completed work.
2018 — The owner records barriers closing simultaneously for the first time, illustrating shared storm exposure.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重現期與壽命風險」與「串聯防線薄弱節點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Return period and lifetime risk" and "Weak links along a defence line": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重現期與壽命風險」如何影響荷蘭三角洲工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return period and lifetime risk” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Delta Works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。跨年累積需說明平穩與獨立假設，氣候及暴露變化可能使它們失效。 假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重現期與壽命風險」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. Multi-year accumulation requires stationary and independent years, assumptions that climate and exposure changes can invalidate. Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. Treating historical climate as fixed future probability makes lifetime risk appear more certain than the evidence supports. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return period and lifetime risk” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重現期與壽命風險」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Return period and lifetime risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重現期與壽命風險
knowledge.text: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。跨年累積需說明平穩與獨立假設，氣候及暴露變化可能使它們失效。
knowledge.textEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. Multi-year accumulation requires stationary and independent years, assumptions that climate and exposure changes can invalidate.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重現期與壽命風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Return period and lifetime risk" is correct?
options: 千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。
年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。
同一保護圈的多段堤防可以當成完全平行備援。
optionsEn: A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years.
Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods.
Several segments of one protection ring act as fully parallel backups.
quiz.explanation: 年度超越機率描述每年的事件風險，不代表兩次洪水必須相隔固定年數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Annual exceedance probability does not impose a fixed interval between floods. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重現期與壽命風險」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return period and lifetime risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. At least one event in fifty years has probability 1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879, or 4.879 percent, not a Dutch standard.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重現期與壽命風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Return period and lifetime risk", which statement holds?
options: 保留相同潮灘面積就一定保留相同生態功能。
只需關閉歷時乘船數就能精確得到全部經濟損失。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%。
optionsEn: Preserving equal tidal-flat area necessarily preserves identical ecological function.
Closure duration times vessel count precisely gives all economic losses.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設年超越機率p=0.001且各年獨立平穩，50年內至少一次為1−(1−p)⁵⁰=0.04879，約4.879%；非荷蘭現行標準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume annual exceedance p=0.001 with independent stationary years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重現期與壽命風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Return period and lifetime risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。另外說明年度超越事件和災損事件並非同義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation. Explain separately why annual load exceedance and a damaging failure are not equivalent events. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以重現期與壽命風險編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for return period and lifetime risk, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。另外說明年度超越事件和災損事件並非同義。
knowledge.textEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation. Explain separately why annual load exceedance and a damaging failure are not equivalent events.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for return period and lifetime risk, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. For changing probabilities use the product of annual survival probabilities and compare the stationary approximation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重現期與壽命風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Return period and lifetime risk"?
options: 將事件定義和記錄年份寫清楚，核對統計是否把超越荷載與結構失效混淆；對變動年機率改用逐年生存機率乘積，再比較平穩近似偏差。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
地圖上所有低窪面積都能立即提供相同蓄洪能力。
optionsEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All low ground on a map immediately provides equal usable flood storage.

quiz.explanationEn: Define events and observation years, checking whether load exceedance is confused with structural failure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重現期與壽命風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Return period and lifetime risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重現期與壽命風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Return period and lifetime risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Return period is not a warranty, and several high-water events can occur within one year. Treating historical climate as fixed future probability makes lifetime risk appear more certain than the evidence supports. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating historical climate as fixed future probability makes lifetime risk appear more certain than the evidence supports.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「千年重現期代表一次洪水後至少一千年不會再發生。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A thousand-year return period prevents another flood for at least one thousand years." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 重現期不是保固年限，同一年也可能出現多次高水事件。若把歷史氣候外推成固定未來機率，會讓長壽命設施的累積風險看似比實際更確定。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
