quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a simplified reaction rate doubling per ten kelvin above 20°C. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 層間黏結與有效齡期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interlift bond and exposure age: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「層間黏結與有效齡期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interlift bond and exposure age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。在相同表面處理下分別比較不同溫度歷程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range. Compare different temperature histories while holding interface preparation conditions constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以層間黏結與有效齡期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for interlift bond and exposure age, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。在相同表面處理下分別比較不同溫度歷程。
knowledge.textEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range. Compare different temperature histories while holding interface preparation conditions constant.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以層間黏結與有效齡期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for interlift bond and exposure age, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Compare preparation conditions and verify that the Q10 approximation remains within its calibrated temperature range.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層間黏結與有效齡期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interlift bond and exposure age"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。
將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens.
quiz.explanation: 將表面溫度、覆蓋時間和乾燥程度逐區記錄，用同條件層面試件量測黏結；比較表面處理前後結果，並檢查Q10近似是否超出校正溫度範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record surface temperature, covering time and drying by area and test bond using matched interface specimens. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 層間黏結與有效齡期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interlift bond and exposure age: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「層間黏結與有效齡期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interlift bond and exposure age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「等效齡期相同就能保證不同表面條件的層面黏結相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal equivalent age guarantees equal bond despite different interface conditions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。把化學反應速度直接當作力學強度，會忽略粗糙度、乾燥和界面缺漿的作用。
knowledge.textEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Equating reaction speed with mechanical strength ignores roughness, drying and local mortar deficiency at the interface.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「層間黏結與有效齡期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interlift bond and exposure age" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
optionsEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 相同等效齡期下，受雨沖刷或污染的層面仍可能有不同黏結。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: At equal equivalent age, washed or contaminated interfaces can still bond differently. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「層狀滲透異向性」與「上下游面層協調」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Layered permeability anisotropy" and "Facing and RCC compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「層狀滲透異向性」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layered permeability anisotropy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。層狀介質的等效滲透率須依平行或垂直流向計算。 假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「層狀滲透異向性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. Equivalent permeability of layers differs for flow parallel and perpendicular to them. Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s. A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. Directly extrapolating intact small specimens to the dam understates scale and interface effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layered permeability anisotropy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「層狀滲透異向性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layered permeability anisotropy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 層狀滲透異向性
knowledge.text: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。層狀介質的等效滲透率須依平行或垂直流向計算。
knowledge.textEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. Equivalent permeability of layers differs for flow parallel and perpendicular to them.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「層狀滲透異向性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layered permeability anisotropy" is correct?
options: 垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。
面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。
optionsEn: Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy.
Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface.
quiz.explanation: 薄層界面可能沿水平方向形成較易滲流的通道，垂直試體低滲透不代表整壩各方向相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lift interfaces can create easier horizontal seepage paths, so low vertical specimen permeability does not establish isotropy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「層狀滲透異向性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Layered permeability anisotropy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設等厚兩層k1=10⁻⁸、k2=10⁻⁶ m/s，平行ke=(k1+k2)/2=5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s，垂直調和平均1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal layers with k1=10⁻⁸ and k2=10⁻⁶ m/s. Parallel permeability is 5.05×10⁻⁷ m/s and perpendicular harmonic mean is 1.9802×10⁻⁸ m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「層狀滲透異向性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 層狀滲透異向性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Layered permeability anisotropy: testing and verification

steps.instruction: 按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。把芯樣中實際穿越的層面數量清楚列出。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head. Overlay drain locations with interfaces and determine whether fracture flow has exceeded the assumptions of a homogeneous Darcy model. State clearly how many actual lift interfaces each tested core crosses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以層狀滲透異向性編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for layered permeability anisotropy, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Test specimens parallel and perpendicular to lifts, checking saturation and applied head. Overlay drain locations with interfaces and determine whether fracture flow has exceeded the assumptions of a homogeneous Darcy model.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A specimen orientation may miss continuous weak layers, and low head may not reveal post-cracking paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「層狀滲透異向性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Layered permeability anisotropy"?
options: 按層面平行和垂直方向取樣試驗，核對飽和程度和試驗水頭；把排水出流位置與層面分布疊合，並檢查裂縫流是否已超出均質達西模型。

steps.instruction: 單一方向芯樣可能避開連續弱層，低試驗水頭也未必揭露開裂後通道。若把實驗室完整小試體結果直接代表整壩，會低估尺度與界面影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 上下游面層協調：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上下游面層協調」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Facing and RCC compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面層和內部RCC可能具有不同彈性、收縮與溫度歷程，接合區需傳遞相對變形。外表平整不能證明內部相容，尤其在澆置時間錯開時。 假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上下游面層協調」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement. A smooth exterior does not establish compatibility, especially with different placement times. Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution. An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Facing and RCC compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.question: 關於「上下游面層協調」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

quiz.explanation: 面層和內部RCC可能具有不同彈性、收縮與溫度歷程，接合區需傳遞相對變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Facing and interior RCC can differ in stiffness, shrinkage and temperature history, requiring their interface to accommodate relative movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上下游面層協調：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上下游面層協調」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Facing and RCC compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Differential movement is 1.5 mm, excluding restraint stress and crack distribution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「上下游面層協調」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Facing and RCC compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm。
拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。
只記錄外加水就足以準確得到混凝土有效水膠比。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m.
Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
Added water alone accurately determines the concrete effective water-binder ratio.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩材料自由收縮差150 microstrain、接合長10 m，差異位移1.5 mm；自由變形估算，不含拘束應力與裂縫分配。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume free-shrinkage difference 150 microstrain across bonded length 10 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 上下游面層協調：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上下游面層協調」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Facing and RCC compatibility” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。將兩側應變轉成相對位移檢查接合相容。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Use interface cores and crack patterns to assess compatibility, comparing free-shrinkage specimens separately from restrained field behavior. Convert strains on both sides into relative movement to check interface compatibility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以上下游面層協調編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for facing and rcc compatibility, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Use interface cores and crack patterns to assess compatibility, comparing free-shrinkage specimens separately from restrained field behavior.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上下游面層協調」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Facing and RCC compatibility"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步量測面層與內部溫度和應變，核對澆置齡期及養護差異；利用界面取芯和裂縫分布檢查相容性，將自由收縮資料與受拘束現場資料分開比較。
總砂漿體積足夠就能保證每個局部空隙都被填滿。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences.
Sufficient total mortar volume guarantees every local void is filled.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure facing and interior temperature and strain together, checking age and curing differences. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上下游面層協調：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Facing and RCC compatibility: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上下游面層協調」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Facing and RCC compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面層和內部材料各自強度合格就代表接合區必然可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Separate strength compliance of facing and RCC guarantees a reliable interface." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。若只要求兩種材料各自強度達標，仍無法證明接合區能共同工作。
knowledge.textEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Separate strength compliance of both materials does not establish that their interface acts compatibly under service conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上下游面層協調」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Facing and RCC compatibility" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths.
quiz.explanation: 面層過早變硬可能拘束後續RCC收縮，缺乏黏結則可能形成漏流路徑。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An early-stiffening facing can restrain later RCC shrinkage, while poor bond creates leakage paths. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「邊緣壓實與死角」與「強度抽樣與空間變異」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Edge compaction and restricted zones" and "Strength sampling and spatial variability": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 邊緣壓實與死角：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Edge compaction and restricted zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「邊緣壓實與死角」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Edge compaction and restricted zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。中部試驗成果不能直接代表受限空間，幾何可達性是品質控制的一部分。 假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。 體積占比小但若沿上游形成連續通道，可能主導滲流而非平均強度。以隨機中部取樣代表全部工程，會系統性漏掉可達性不足造成的缺陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「邊緣壓實與死角」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. Central trial results do not represent these areas, making geometric access part of quality control. Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick. Volume is 12 m³, or 0.8 percent of a 1500 m³ lift, not necessarily negligible. A small-volume band can dominate seepage if continuous near the upstream face. Random sampling confined to central areas systematically misses defects caused by restricted equipment access along the structure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Edge compaction and restricted zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設長100 m的邊緣未充分覆蓋帶寬0.4 m、層厚0.3 m，受影響體積12 m³；占1500 m³一層的0.8%，不代表可忽略。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume a poorly covered edge band 100 m long, 0.4 m wide and 0.3 m thick.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「邊緣壓實與死角」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Edge compaction and restricted zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 邊緣壓實與死角
knowledge.text: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。中部試驗成果不能直接代表受限空間，幾何可達性是品質控制的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods. Central trial results do not represent these areas, making geometric access part of quality control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「邊緣壓實與死角」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Edge compaction and restricted zones" is correct?
options: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。
邊緣弱帶占總體積很小就不可能影響整壩防滲功能。
平均強度相同就代表兩個施工區具有完全相同品質穩定性。
optionsEn: Large rollers cannot fully approach forms, galleries and embedded items, so restricted zones need different equipment or methods.
A small-volume weak edge band cannot affect the dams overall seepage performance.
Equal mean strength means two construction zones have identical quality consistency.
quiz.explanation: 大型碾輪難以接近模板、廊道和埋件，邊緣區可能需要不同設備與工法。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 強度抽樣與空間變異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Strength sampling and spatial variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「強度抽樣與空間變異」如何影響碾壓混凝土壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Strength sampling and spatial variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Roller-compacted-concrete dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 試體平均強度描述中心趨勢，離散程度和空間分布決定是否存在局部弱區。相同平均值可能對應完全不同品質穩定性，取樣須與施工批次對應。 假設強度平均20 MPa、標準差3 MPa，變異係數15%；採教學常態近似，第五百分位20−1.645×3=15.065 MPa，非規範設計值。 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「強度抽樣與空間變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean specimen strength describes central tendency, while variability and location reveal weak zones. Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Strength sampling and spatial variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 強度抽樣與空間變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Strength sampling and spatial variability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「強度抽樣與空間變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Strength sampling and spatial variability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。核對低強度樣本是否集中於相同材料批次。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum. Check whether low-strength specimens cluster within the same material batch. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以強度抽樣與空間變異編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for strength sampling and spatial variability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum. Check whether low-strength specimens cluster within the same material batch.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以強度抽樣與空間變異編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for strength sampling and spatial variability, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Check sample size and normality, then challenge specimen representativeness with field cores rather than reporting only mean and maximum.

quiz.question: 要驗證「強度抽樣與空間變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Strength sampling and spatial variability"?
options: 保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
垂直芯樣滲透率很低就證明水平層面也同樣不透水。
optionsEn: Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Low vertical-core permeability proves equally low permeability along horizontal lift interfaces.
quiz.explanation: 保留每支試體位置、齡期與養護條件，畫批次和空間分布；檢查常態近似與樣本數是否合理，再以現場芯樣挑戰試體代表性，避免只報平均和最大值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain specimen location, age and curing and plot batch and spatial distributions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 強度抽樣與空間變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Strength sampling and spatial variability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「強度抽樣與空間變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Strength sampling and spatial variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均強度相同就代表兩個施工區具有完全相同品質穩定性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal mean strength means two construction zones have identical quality consistency." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。若忽略相鄰樣本相關性，統計信心可能被高估而無法代表整個澆築範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Ignoring correlation between neighboring samples overstates statistical confidence and the extent represented by the testing programme.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「強度抽樣與空間變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Strength sampling and spatial variability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。
拌合廠額定產能就是每個澆築位置可持續取得的供料率。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones.
Rated batching capacity equals sustainable delivery at every placement location.
quiz.explanation: 不同齡期混在一起會製造假離散，選擇性刪除低值又會掩蓋真正弱區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing ages creates false variability, while selectively deleting low results hides weak zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析
courses.titleEn: Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
courses.summary: 本課以雙曲拱壩拱座分析為入口，深入拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams as its entry point, this course examines three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 拱推力、岸坡楔體與壩岩相容的三維判讀
courses.focusEn: Three-dimensional interpretation of arch thrust, abutment wedges and dam-rock compatibility
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 防潮、航運與大壩施工
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Tidal barriers, navigation and dam construction

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 薄拱公式的局部敏感度固定均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa和半徑80 m，只將厚度由8增加至10 m。理想壓應力σ=pR/t由5降至4 MPa，減少20%。比較保持無彎曲的連續圓拱假設；真實加厚會改變三維剛度、溫度與拱梁分載，不能把此倒數關係視為完整拱壩設計結論。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For local sensitivity of the thin-arch relation, hold uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa and radius 80 m fixed, increasing only thickness from 8 m to 10 m. Ideal compression σ=pR/t falls from 5 to 4 MPa, a 20% reduction. The comparison retains a continuous circular arch without bending; actual thickening changes three-dimensional stiffness, temperature and arch-cantilever sharing, so the inverse relation is not a complete dam-design conclusion.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

Teaching parallel stiffness sharing gives common displacement 2 mm.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「薄拱膜力初估」與「拱與懸臂分擔」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thin-arch membrane estimate" and "Arch and cantilever load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄拱膜力初估」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin-arch membrane estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。 假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄拱膜力初估」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry. Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thin-arch membrane estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄拱膜力初估」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thin-arch membrane estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄拱膜力初估
knowledge.text: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。真實壩體同時有懸臂彎曲、變厚與非圓形幾何，不能只用單一半徑設計。
knowledge.textEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. Thin circular-arch membrane action gives an initial scale, while real dams also have cantilever bending, variable thickness and noncircular geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thin-arch membrane estimate" is correct?
options: 薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。
雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam.
A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 雙曲拱壩把水壓經曲率傳向兩岸，薄圓拱膜力能提供第一個量級估算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A double-curvature arch dam transfers pressure toward the banks through curvature. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄拱膜力初估」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Thin-arch compressive stress pR/t=5 MPa, for a continuous circular arch without bending.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄拱膜力初估」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thin-arch membrane estimate", which statement holds?
options: 岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。
optionsEn: High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設均勻徑向壓力0.5 MPa、半徑80 m、厚8 m，薄拱壓應力pR/t=5 MPa；無彎曲且理想連續圓拱。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume uniform radial pressure 0.5 MPa, radius 80 m and thickness 8 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄拱膜力初估」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thin-arch membrane estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以薄拱膜力初估編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。分開報告拱冠與拱座附近的彎曲應力。
knowledge.textEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions. Report bending stresses near the crown and abutments as separate quantities.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for thin-arch membrane estimate, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Contrast the membrane estimate with a model including cantilever action, locating deviations near abutments or geometric transitions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「薄拱膜力初估」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thin-arch membrane estimate"?
options: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 從各高程截面量取曲率與厚度，對照壓力分布和應變方向；將薄拱估算與含懸臂作用模型比較，查最大的偏差位置是否接近岸坡或幾何轉折。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure curvature and thickness at several elevations and compare pressure and strain directions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 薄拱膜力初估：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thin-arch membrane estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「薄拱膜力初估」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thin-arch membrane estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「薄拱平均壓應力足夠低就證明整座雙曲拱壩沒有拉應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low mean thin-arch compression proves there is no tensile stress anywhere in the dam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。若只看整體平均壓力，會錯過岸坡傳力不均與彎曲集中。
knowledge.textEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Overall average stress can therefore conceal uneven abutment transfer and concentrated bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄拱膜力初估」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thin-arch membrane estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。
拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression.
Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
quiz.explanation: 薄拱公式不反映接縫張開或基礎變形，局部拉應力可能在平均壓應力下仍出現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The thin-arch relation omits joint opening and foundation deformation, allowing local tension despite mean compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拱與懸臂分擔」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arch and cantilever load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。 假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拱與懸臂分擔」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller. Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only. Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arch and cantilever load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拱與懸臂分擔」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arch and cantilever load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拱與懸臂分擔
knowledge.text: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。分擔比例由剛度與邊界形成，不是可任意指定以降低應力的設計選項。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. Relative stiffness and boundaries determine sharing; the proportions cannot be arbitrarily chosen to make stresses smaller.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Arch and cantilever load sharing" is correct?
options: 拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。
optionsEn: Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement.
quiz.explanation: 壩體可由水平拱與豎向懸臂共同分擔水壓，兩者變形必須相容。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal arches and vertical cantilevers share pressure while maintaining compatible movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Displacement is 2 mm, with arch share 6 MN and cantilever share 4 MN, a spring analogy only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「拱與懸臂分擔」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Arch and cantilever load sharing", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN。
裂隙出水很少就能證明整個岸坡節理水壓很低。
接縫灌漿溫度只影響施工方便，不影響後續拱壩受力。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN.
Small joint discharge proves low water pressure throughout all abutment discontinuities.
Joint-grouting temperature affects convenience only and not later arch-dam structural behavior.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩平行線性路徑剛度ka=3 GN/m、kc=2 GN/m，共受10 MN，位移2 mm，拱分6 MN、懸臂分4 MN；僅教學彈簧類比。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume parallel linear paths ka=3 GN/m and kc=2 GN/m under total 10 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Arch and cantilever load sharing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。確認兩路徑分擔總和仍等於原始水壓荷載。
knowledge.textEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone. Verify that the sum of both load paths still equals applied water loading.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以拱與懸臂分擔編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for arch and cantilever load sharing, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Compare simplified sharing with three-dimensional displacement and strain, rather than accepting a correct total reaction alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「拱與懸臂分擔」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Arch and cantilever load sharing"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。
把峰值地面加速度乘壩重就能完整代表三維地震反應。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness.
Peak ground acceleration times dam weight completely represents three-dimensional earthquake response.
quiz.explanation: 核對兩路徑在交點的位移相容及合力平衡，改變壩岩剛度做敏感度；將簡化分擔與三維位移和應變結果比較，避免只追求總反力正確。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check displacement compatibility and force balance at shared points and vary dam-rock stiffness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 拱與懸臂分擔：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Arch and cantilever load sharing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「拱與懸臂分擔」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Arch and cantilever load sharing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「拱和懸臂的荷載比例可以任意指定而不影響位移相容。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Arch and cantilever shares can be chosen arbitrarily without affecting displacement compatibility." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。只校準壩頂位移而忽略局部應變，可能得到錯誤卻看似吻合的內力分配。
knowledge.textEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Calibrating only crest displacement can produce a misleadingly good fit with incorrect local force distribution.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「拱與懸臂分擔」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Arch and cantilever load sharing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds.
quiz.explanation: 一條路徑剛度被高估會把荷載過度導向該路徑，整體平衡仍可能成立。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Overstated stiffness attracts too much load to one path even while global equilibrium holds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岸坡推力方向」與「楔體滑動抗力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Abutment thrust direction" and "Wedge sliding resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岸坡推力方向」如何影響雙曲拱壩拱座分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Abutment thrust direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。大壓力若指向易滑節理組合，仍可能形成不利楔體受力。 假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 角度定義混淆會交換法向與剪向分量，直接改變摩擦判讀。若把整個岸坡用單一平面代表，可能漏掉由兩組節理交線控制的三維運動方向。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸坡推力方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. Large compression can still destabilize a wedge when directed unfavorably relative to joints. Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system. Confusing angle definitions swaps normal and tangential components and changes friction assessment. Representing the whole abutment by one plane can miss three-dimensional movement controlled by intersecting joint sets. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Abutment thrust direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岸坡推力方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Abutment thrust direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岸坡推力方向
knowledge.text: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。大壓力若指向易滑節理組合，仍可能形成不利楔體受力。
knowledge.textEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. Large compression can still destabilize a wedge when directed unfavorably relative to joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岸坡推力方向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Abutment thrust direction" is correct?
options: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。
岸坡承受的總推力越大就必定越穩定，方向不重要。
岩石單軸強度很高就能排除沿節理滑動的岸坡失穩。
optionsEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude.
Greater total abutment thrust always improves stability regardless of its direction.
High intact-rock compressive strength rules out abutment failure by joint sliding.
quiz.explanation: 拱推力到達岸坡時需要分解到岩面法向與剪向，方向與大小同樣重要。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arch thrust must be resolved normal and tangential to abutment surfaces, making direction as important as magnitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岸坡推力方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Abutment thrust direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把節理法向和推力向量放到同一座標系，核對角度是相對法向還是面本身；用測繪和模型反力交叉確認，並保留各高程推力方向變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Put joint normals and thrust in a common coordinate system and verify whether angles reference normals or surfaces.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Normal component is 17.3205 MN and tangential component 10 MN, a planar illustration rather than a complete wedge force system.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岸坡推力方向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Abutment thrust direction", which statement holds?
options: 完整岩芯彈性模數可以無條件等同整個節理岩體模數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。
壩頂位移收斂就能證明所有局部最大應力都已收斂。
optionsEn: Intact-core elastic modulus can unconditionally represent the entire jointed rock mass.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal.
Converged crest displacement proves convergence of every local maximum stress.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設推力20 MN與岩面法向夾角30°，法向17.3205 MN、剪向10 MN；平面向量示例，不代表三維楔體完整力系。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume thrust 20 MN at thirty degrees to the rock-surface normal. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岸坡推力方向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Abutment thrust direction: testing and verification
