stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「堆石孔隙與密實」與「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rockfill voids and density" and "Layer compression and crest settlement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堆石孔隙與密實」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rockfill voids and density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。顆粒尺寸遠大於一般試體時，尺寸效應必須獨立處理。 假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堆石孔隙與密實」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. Dry density indicates bulk voids but does not directly give compressibility, and particles larger than normal specimens require separate treatment of scale effects. Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rockfill voids and density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堆石孔隙與密實」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rockfill voids and density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堆石孔隙與密實
knowledge.text: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。顆粒尺寸遠大於一般試體時，尺寸效應必須獨立處理。
knowledge.textEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. Dry density indicates bulk voids but does not directly give compressibility, and particles larger than normal specimens require separate treatment of scale effects.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堆石孔隙與密實」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rockfill voids and density" is correct?
options: 堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。
壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
optionsEn: Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage.
Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
quiz.explanation: 堆石透過顆粒重排和局部破碎變密，現場乾密度反映總孔隙但不直接給出壓縮模數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rockfill densifies by particle rearrangement and breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「堆石孔隙與密實」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rockfill voids and density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Porosity n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222, excluding intraparticle pores and moisture-correction error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堆石孔隙與密實」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rockfill voids and density", which statement holds?
options: 只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222。
optionsEn: Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設顆粒密度2700 kg/m³、乾密度2100 kg/m³，孔隙率n=1−ρd/ρs=0.2222；忽略顆粒內孔隙和含水修正誤差。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume particle density 2700 kg/m³ and dry density 2100 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「堆石孔隙與密實」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rockfill voids and density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。比較濕化前後的壓縮試驗以檢查密度代表性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines. Compare compression before and after wetting to test density representativeness. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以堆石孔隙與密實編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rockfill voids and density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。比較濕化前後的壓縮試驗以檢查密度代表性。
knowledge.textEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines. Compare compression before and after wetting to test density representativeness.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以堆石孔隙與密實編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for rockfill voids and density, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Compare density, settlement and grading changes to ensure apparent densification is not an artifact of losing fines.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堆石孔隙與密實」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rockfill voids and density"?
options: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。
optionsEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement.
quiz.explanation: 在代表性試填區量測鋪層前後體積與乾質量，核對大粒徑取樣方法；將密度、沉降與級配破碎變化一起比較，確認結果不是細料流失造成的假密實。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure trial-fill volume and dry mass before and after compaction and check large-particle sampling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堆石孔隙與密實：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rockfill voids and density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「堆石孔隙與密實」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rockfill voids and density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。若把料場小樣性質直接外推大粒徑填築，會漏掉尺度差異。
knowledge.textEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. High density need not imply small long-term movement, and small quarry samples can miss full-scale particle effects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堆石孔隙與密實」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rockfill voids and density" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。
壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression.
Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
quiz.explanation: 孔隙率相同的不同岩性可能有不同破碎和濕化壓縮，密度高也不必然代表長期變形小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different rock types at equal porosity can have different breakage and wetting compression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Layer compression and crest settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Layer compression and crest settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。分層量測能辨認填築、蓄水與長期作用各自造成的位移。 假設兩填築層厚30及50 m、豎向應變0.003及0.002，總壓縮30×0.003+50×0.002=0.19 m；一維分層近似。 只看壩頂總沉降可能把某一薄層的大應變平均掉，面板卻對局部曲率敏感。若基礎基準也沉降，所有相對儀器可能低估絕對位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. Layered measurements distinguish placement, impoundment and long-term contributions to movement. Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002. Total compression is 0.19 m, a one-dimensional layered approximation. Crest settlement can average out severe strain in a thin layer, while the face responds to local curvature. A settling reference foundation can make relative instruments understate absolute movement throughout the section. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Layer compression and crest settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume layers 30 and 50 m thick with vertical strains 0.003 and 0.002.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Layer compression and crest settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降
knowledge.text: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。分層量測能辨認填築、蓄水與長期作用各自造成的位移。
knowledge.textEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. Layered measurements distinguish placement, impoundment and long-term contributions to movement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Layer compression and crest settlement" is correct?
options: 壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。
optionsEn: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest.
quiz.explanation: 堆石壩沉降是不同高程層壓縮的累積，局部大應變不一定出現在壩頂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Crest settlement accumulates compression across layers, while the largest local strain need not occur at the crest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分層壓縮與壩頂沉降：定量估算

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

quiz.question: 要驗證「分層壓縮與壩頂沉降」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 面板曲率與拉應變：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Face curvature and tensile strain: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「面板曲率與拉應變」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Face curvature and tensile strain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土面板隨堆石支承變形彎曲，曲率比整體平移更直接影響表面拉應變。面板厚度與支承接觸條件共同控制反應，不能只檢查混凝土抗壓強度。 假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。 支承局部脫空可能使彎曲集中，即使整體沉降平滑仍可裂縫。用過長測距平均曲率會漏掉短波變形，單側應變也難分膜力與彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板曲率與拉應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation. Thickness and support contact govern response, so compressive strength alone is insufficient. Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending. Surface strain κt/2=200 microstrain, excluding membrane strain. Local support loss concentrates bending despite smooth overall settlement. Long gauge spacing averages away short-wavelength curvature, while one-sided strain alone cannot distinguish membrane action from flexural response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Face curvature and tensile strain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume face thickness 0.4 m, curvature 0.001 m⁻¹ and centered neutral axis under linear bending.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Face curvature and tensile strain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Concrete facing bends with its rockfill support, and curvature influences tensile strain more directly than rigid translation. Thickness and support contact govern response, so compressive strength alone is insufficient.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設面板厚0.4 m、曲率0.001 m⁻¹，中性軸居中且線彈性，表面應變κt/2=0.0002，即200 microstrain；未含膜應變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 面板與趾板交界會發生張開、沉降和剪移，止水需對應三方向變形。單一合位移大小相同，不表示止水受力和漏水風險相同。 假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周邊接縫位移分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Perimeter-joint movement components” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume opening 8 mm and along-joint shear 6 mm. Planar resultant is 10 mm, but components remain necessary and this is not an equivalent allowable opening.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「周邊接縫位移分量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Perimeter-joint movement components", which statement holds?

排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。
optionsEn: Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume opening 8 mm and along-joint shear 6 mm.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫張開8 mm、沿縫剪移6 mm，平面合位移√(8²+6²)=10 mm；分量仍須保留，不能當成等效容許張開。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume opening 8 mm and along-joint shear 6 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 周邊接縫位移分量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Perimeter-joint movement components: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周邊接縫位移分量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Perimeter-joint movement components” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多方向接縫計保存分量和符號，對照庫位、溫度與堆石沉降；檢查量測軸線是否隨面板轉動，並比較接頭試驗採用的變形路徑而非單一合量。對照止水試驗是否採用了同方向循環路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement. Check whether measuring axes rotate with the face and compare the tested deformation path rather than one resultant magnitude. Check whether waterstop tests used the same directional cyclic movement path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以周邊接縫位移分量編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以多方向接縫計保存分量和符號，對照庫位、溫度與堆石沉降；檢查量測軸線是否隨面板轉動，並比較接頭試驗採用的變形路徑而非單一合量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for perimeter-joint movement components, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement. Check whether measuring axes rotate with the face and compare the tested deformation path rather than one resultant magnitude.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「周邊接縫位移分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Perimeter-joint movement components"?
options: 以多方向接縫計保存分量和符號，對照庫位、溫度與堆石沉降；檢查量測軸線是否隨面板轉動，並比較接頭試驗採用的變形路徑而非單一合量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.

quiz.explanationEn: Retain signed components from multi-axis joint meters and compare reservoir level, temperature and settlement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 周邊接縫位移分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Perimeter-joint movement components: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「周邊接縫位移分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Perimeter-joint movement components” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。若只記錄合位移，可能把危險張開誤當較可容受的滑移。
knowledge.textEn: Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Recording only a resultant can disguise critical opening as a more tolerable sliding movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周邊接縫位移分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Perimeter-joint movement components" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。
趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage.
A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
quiz.explanation: 法向張開與剪向錯動對銅片或橡膠止水的影響不同，反覆循環也會累積疲勞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Opening and shear act differently on metal or elastomeric waterstops, and cycles accumulate damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「趾板基礎接觸」與「墊層反濾相容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Plinth foundation contact" and "Cushion-filter compatibility": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 趾板基礎接觸：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Plinth foundation contact: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「趾板基礎接觸」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plinth foundation contact” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。它不是只靠混凝土重量阻水，岩面弱帶和接縫繞流也必須追蹤。 假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「趾板基礎接觸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. Concrete weight alone does not block seepage through weak seams or bypass joints. Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment. Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plinth foundation contact” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「趾板基礎接觸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Plinth foundation contact”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 趾板基礎接觸
knowledge.text: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。它不是只靠混凝土重量阻水，岩面弱帶和接縫繞流也必須追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. Concrete weight alone does not block seepage through weak seams or bypass joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「趾板基礎接觸」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Plinth foundation contact" is correct?
options: 趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。
optionsEn: A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance.
quiz.explanation: 趾板把面板防滲系統接到基岩，接觸連續性與基礎水壓共同影響功能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The plinth connects the face sealing system to bedrock, with contact continuity and foundation pressure controlling performance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 趾板基礎接觸：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plinth foundation contact: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「趾板基礎接觸」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plinth foundation contact” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa；均勻接觸且不含彎矩。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Mean effective pressure is 0.15 MPa, for uniform contact without moment.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「趾板基礎接觸」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Plinth foundation contact", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設趾板接觸面積60 m²、總正力12 MN、上浮3 MN，有效平均壓力(12−3)/60=0.15 MPa。
教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN.

quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume plinth contact area 60 m², normal force 12 MN and uplift 3 MN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 趾板基礎接觸：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Plinth foundation contact: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「趾板基礎接觸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Plinth foundation contact” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。將趾板合力位置與實際接觸區域互相核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams. Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth. Cross-check the plinth resultant location against the actually contacting region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以趾板基礎接觸編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。查驗岩面清理、地質素描和接觸取芯資料，將孔壓測點對應到弱帶；比較接縫位移與分區滲流，確認平均接觸假設沒有掩蓋局部脫開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for plinth foundation contact, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Review cleaned-rock mapping and contact cores and relate pressure points to weak seams. Compare joint movement with zoned seepage to ensure a mean-contact assumption is not concealing local separation along the plinth.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 趾板基礎接觸：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plinth foundation contact: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「趾板基礎接觸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plinth foundation contact” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只用總重量除面積判斷完整接觸，會低估上浮和面板傳來偏心力的影響。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dividing gross weight by area can understate uplift and eccentric actions transferred from the facing, giving a false impression of continuous contact.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「趾板基礎接觸」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plinth foundation contact" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow.
quiz.explanation: 局部岩面凸起會造成接觸集中，弱帶沖蝕則可能形成繞流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Rock high points concentrate contact while weak-seam erosion creates bypass flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 墊層反濾相容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cushion-filter compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「墊層反濾相容」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cushion-filter compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。支承剛度和反濾能力是不同要求，級配必須與相鄰材料及施工離析一起檢查。 假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。 墊層缺口可能同時造成漏流和面板脫空，局部細料流失未必立刻反映在總漏水量。只確認粒徑比合格，仍不能排除施工接頭或厚度不足。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「墊層反濾相容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. Support stiffness and filtration are separate requirements, so grading must be checked with adjacent materials and placement segregation. Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests. A cushion gap can create leakage and support loss together, while local fines migration may not immediately change total leakage. Passing one grading ratio does not exclude construction discontinuities or insufficient layer thickness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cushion-filter compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「墊層反濾相容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cushion-filter compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 墊層反濾相容
knowledge.text: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。支承剛度和反濾能力是不同要求，級配必須與相鄰材料及施工離析一起檢查。
knowledge.textEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. Support stiffness and filtration are separate requirements, so grading must be checked with adjacent materials and placement segregation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「墊層反濾相容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cushion-filter compatibility" is correct?
options: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。
反濾粒徑比合格就能不再檢查墊層厚度和連續性。
斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。
optionsEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill.
A passing filter-size ratio removes the need to check cushion thickness and continuity.
Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
quiz.explanation: 面板墊層既提供平整支承，也需防止細料向粗堆石遷移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The face cushion supplies even support and prevents fines migrating into coarse rockfill. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 墊層反濾相容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cushion-filter compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「墊層反濾相容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cushion-filter compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從面板下實際鋪設材料取樣，對照料場級配及含泥量；以方向相符的滲流試驗觀察細料流失，並核對支承平整度是否因離析或沖刷而降低。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample placed material beneath the face and compare stockpile grading and fines.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three. This screens retention geometry without replacing soil-specific applicability or seepage tests.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「墊層反濾相容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cushion-filter compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基料d85=0.8 mm、相鄰反濾料D15=2.4 mm，比值3；只是粒徑保持篩選，不取代土類適用性與滲流試驗。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.8 mm and adjacent filter D15=2.4 mm, giving ratio three.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.

steps.title: 斜面水壓與合力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斜面水壓與合力」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靜水壓垂直作用在面板表面，合力依垂直水深分布而非沿坡距離直接計算。法向力再由堆石支承和趾板系統傳遞，須保留方向。 取淡水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³。假設每米寬面板斜長50 m、坡角對水平30°，底部垂深25 m，合力γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m；平面靜水且頂部在水面。 以斜長當水深會高估壓力，忽略法向分量又會誤判支承需求。若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斜面水壓與合力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the face and varies with vertical depth rather than slope distance alone. Rockfill support and plinth transfer the normal resultant, whose direction must be retained. Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Assume face slope length 50 m per metre width at thirty degrees to horizontal, giving bottom depth 25 m. Resultant γw hL/2=6131.25 kN/m, with the top at the surface. Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use freshwater unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

quiz.explanationEn: Convert surveyed slope coordinates to vertical depth and integrate normal force and toe moment separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 斜面水壓與合力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜面水壓與合力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydrostatic resultant on an inclined face” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以斜長當水深會高估壓力，忽略法向分量又會誤判支承需求。若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若面板部分失去接觸，水壓將引起局部彎曲，不能仍假定全部均勻傳入堆石。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Using slope length as depth overstates pressure, while ignoring direction misstates support demand. Loss of contact causes local bending under water load and invalidates uniformly transferred pressure into the rockfill.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Staged filling and wetting settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Staged filling and wetting settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蓄水會讓堆石受水壓並發生濕化變形，沉降速率可能落後水位。分期觀測的目的在辨認反應，不是用固定等待天數保證所有材料已穩定。 假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impoundment adds water loading and wetting deformation, with settlement potentially lagging stage. Staged observation identifies response rather than guaranteeing stabilization after a universal waiting duration. Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days. At twenty days S=86.47 mm, a fitted model rather than a material law. Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Staged filling and wetting settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Staged filling and wetting settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降
knowledge.text: 蓄水會讓堆石受水壓並發生濕化變形，沉降速率可能落後水位。分期觀測的目的在辨認反應，不是用固定等待天數保證所有材料已穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Impoundment adds water loading and wetting deformation, with settlement potentially lagging stage. Staged observation identifies response rather than guaranteeing stabilization after a universal waiting duration.

quiz.question: 關於「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Impoundment adds water loading and wetting deformation, with settlement potentially lagging stage.

steps.title: 分期蓄水與濕化沉降：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Staged filling and wetting settlement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Staged filling and wetting settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設教學一階沉降S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ))，S∞=0.1 m、τ=10 days，20 days達86.47 mm；僅擬合模型，非真實材料定律。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume teaching settlement S(t)=S∞(1−e^(−t/τ)), S∞=0.1 m and τ=10 days. At twenty days S=86.47 mm, a fitted model rather than a material law. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot reservoir stages, layer settlement and face joints together and check whether each stage has a different time constant.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 將水位階段、分層沉降和面板接縫同步作圖，檢查每次階段是否有不同時間常數；用後續資料驗證預測區間，不能只以早期擬合度宣稱趨勢可靠。保留每階段預測與後續實測的差異紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「教學沉降曲線擬合良好就能保證最終沉降不再增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A good fit to the teaching settlement curve guarantees no further ultimate settlement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。若把擬合漸近值當實際最終值，可能低估後續接縫位移。
knowledge.textEn: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Treating a fitted asymptote as a final value can understate later joint displacement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分期蓄水與濕化沉降」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Staged filling and wetting settlement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load.
quiz.explanation: 材料破碎和應力重分配可能使長期趨勢偏離指數衰減，水位繼續變化也破壞單步載入假設。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Particle breakage and redistribution can depart from exponential decay, while changing water level violates a single-step load. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏流與水量閉合」與「長期蠕變與變形預留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leakage and water-balance closure" and "Long-term creep and movement allowance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏流與水量閉合」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leakage and water-balance closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。分區量測與水質示蹤可區分壩體、基礎和外部集水。 假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。未校正外部雨水便比較兩次蓄水，會把不同環境條件誤當面板性能改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏流與水量閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. Total change alone cannot locate face cracks; sectional measurement and water-quality tracing distinguish embankment, foundation and external collection. Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag. An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Comparing impoundments without rainfall correction confuses environmental differences with changes in face performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leakage and water-balance closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏流與水量閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leakage and water-balance closure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏流與水量閉合
knowledge.text: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。分區量測與水質示蹤可區分壩體、基礎和外部集水。
knowledge.textEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. Total change alone cannot locate face cracks; sectional measurement and water-quality tracing distinguish embankment, foundation and external collection.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏流與水量閉合」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leakage and water-balance closure" is correct?
options: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。
排水量減少必定表示面板防水性能改善而無其他可能。
壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
optionsEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage.
Reduced drain discharge necessarily means improved face watertightness with no other explanation.
Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
quiz.explanation: 漏水量需與庫位、降雨和排水系統一起判讀，總量增減不能單獨定位面板裂縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Leakage must be interpreted with reservoir level, rain and drainage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏流與水量閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leakage and water-balance closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Corrected seepage is 85 L/s, with steady additive sources and no storage lag.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漏流與水量閉合」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Leakage and water-balance closure", which statement holds?
options: 壩頂沉降量很小就能排除任何局部填築層的大變形。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s。
只要接縫合位移相同，止水承受的變形模式就完全相同。
optionsEn: Small crest settlement rules out large deformation in every individual fill layer.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s.
Equal resultant joint displacement means an identical deformation mode for the waterstop.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設量測出水120 L/s、可辨識降雨集水30 L/s、儀器零偏5 L/s，校正滲流85 L/s；各來源穩定且可相加，未含儲水延遲。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume measured outflow 120 L/s, identified rain collection 30 L/s and instrument offset 5 L/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漏流與水量閉合：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leakage and water-balance closure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏流與水量閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leakage and water-balance closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。將清通排水管的時間與流量跳變逐項對照。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty. Compare drain-clearing times individually against observed jumps in measured flow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以漏流與水量閉合編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for leakage and water-balance closure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate sectional flow measurements and retain rain and level histories, using temperature or conductivity to distinguish sources. Compare joint events with leakage lag and test closure residuals against measurement uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分區校核量水設施並保存雨量和庫位時序，以溫度或電導差辨認來源；將接縫開度事件與漏流延遲對照，再檢查水量閉合殘差是否超過量測不確定度。將清通排水管的時間與流量跳變逐項對照。

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏流與水量閉合」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
