壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
optionsEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
quiz.explanation: 突增可能來自排水管清通而非新增裂縫，減少也可能是堵塞。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An increase may follow drain clearing rather than a new crack, and a decrease may mean blockage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長期蠕變與變形預留」如何影響混凝土面板堆石壩施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long-term creep and movement allowance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Concrete-face rockfill dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。短期壓實完成不表示服役期變形停止，接縫預留需檢查情境。 假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長期蠕變與變形預留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. Log-time relations are empirical descriptions; completed compaction does not end service movement, so joint allowance must be checked across scenarios. Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure. A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long-term creep and movement allowance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長期蠕變與變形預留」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long-term creep and movement allowance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留
knowledge.text: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。短期壓實完成不表示服役期變形停止，接縫預留需檢查情境。
knowledge.textEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. Log-time relations are empirical descriptions; completed compaction does not end service movement, so joint allowance must be checked across scenarios.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長期蠕變與變形預留」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long-term creep and movement allowance" is correct?
options: 壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。
堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep.
Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
quiz.explanation: 堆石長期變形受到應力、含水與顆粒破碎影響，常用對數時間關係只是經驗描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Long-term rockfill deformation depends on stress, moisture and breakage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長期蠕變與變形預留」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long-term creep and movement allowance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Increment is 11.513 mm, a stable-stress fit not extrapolated to failure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「長期蠕變與變形預留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Long-term creep and movement allowance", which statement holds?
options: 面板抗壓強度高就能保證不會因支承曲率產生拉裂。
趾板混凝土足夠重就能自動封閉所有岩面裂隙。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm。
optionsEn: High face compressive strength guarantees no tensile cracking from support curvature.
A sufficiently heavy concrete plinth automatically seals every bedrock fracture.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設經驗增量ΔS=C ln(t2/t1)，C=5 mm，t1=1 year、t2=10 years，增量11.513 mm；僅穩定應力下擬合，不外推破壞。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume empirical increment ΔS=C ln(t2/t1), C=5 mm, t1=1 year and t2=10 years. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長期蠕變與變形預留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long-term creep and movement allowance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。檢查新增載重後是否應重新定義時間起點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes. Check whether a new load requires redefining the empirical time origin. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以長期蠕變與變形預留編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for long-term creep and movement allowance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。檢查新增載重後是否應重新定義時間起點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes. Check whether a new load requires redefining the empirical time origin.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以長期蠕變與變形預留編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for long-term creep and movement allowance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Present fits from different time windows with prediction ranges and test whether additional settlement accompanies breakage or pore-pressure changes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「長期蠕變與變形預留」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Long-term creep and movement allowance"?
options: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
斜面上任一點水壓應依沿坡距離而非垂直水深計算。
optionsEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Pressure at an inclined-face point depends on slope distance rather than vertical depth.
quiz.explanation: 使用相同庫位與季節條件比較長期變形，核對測量基準的穩定性；將不同時間窗擬合結果及預測範圍並列，查新增沉降是否伴隨粒料破碎或孔壓變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare long-term movement at matched level and season, checking reference stability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 長期蠕變與變形預留：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long-term creep and movement allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長期蠕變與變形預留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long-term creep and movement allowance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓實驗收完成就代表堆石壩服役期間不再發生蠕變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Completed compaction acceptance means a rockfill dam experiences no service-life creep." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。若用短期數據推算數十年而不檢查條件變化，會低估模型不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Extrapolating decades from short records without checking changed conditions understates model uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「長期蠕變與變形預留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Long-term creep and movement allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。
堆石孔隙率相同就代表其壓縮模數和濕化變形完全相同。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history.
Equal rockfill porosity means identical stiffness and wetting deformation.
quiz.explanation: 對數式在接近零時間時沒有合理施工含義，新增載重也會重設變形歷程。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A logarithmic fit has no meaningful construction interpretation near zero time, and new loading changes the history. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 心牆土石壩分區填築
courses.titleEn: Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams
courses.summary: 本課以心牆土石壩分區填築為入口，深入心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams as its entry point, this course examines compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 心牆阻水、反濾排水與分區填築的相容
courses.focusEn: Compatibility of core sealing, filter drainage and zoned embankment placement
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 達西敏感度固定平均水力坡降5與通流面積1000 m²，只將k由10⁻⁹增至2×10⁻⁹ m/s。Q=kiA由5×10⁻⁶增至10⁻⁵ m³/s，即0.005增至0.010 L/s，恰為兩倍。這要求同一均質、無裂縫材料內仍可用線性達西流；若提高流量是裂縫或繞流造成，就不能只用調整均質k來解釋。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For Darcy sensitivity, hold gradient five and flow area 1000 m² fixed, changing only k from 10⁻⁹ to 2×10⁻⁹ m/s. Q=kiA doubles from 5×10⁻⁶ to 10⁻⁵ m³/s, or 0.005 to 0.010 L/s. This assumes linear Darcy flow in the same homogeneous uncracked medium; increased flow from cracking or bypass cannot be explained solely by adjusting homogeneous k.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

教學排水帶達西能力1 L/s，未含出口損失。
教學施工總應力增100 kPa而有效應力僅增30 kPa。
factsEn: Teaching homogeneous intact-core Darcy flow is 0.005 L/s.
Teaching moisture adjustment for dry soil 1000 t needs 40 t water.
Teaching void ratio 0.5 and water content 0.15 give saturation 0.81.
Teaching reduced local stress-pressure difference is −20 kPa, a screening result only.
Teaching drain Darcy capacity is 1 L/s, excluding outlet losses.
Teaching total stress rises 100 kPa while effective stress rises only 30 kPa.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分區滲透功能」與「含水調整與乾土質量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Hydraulic functions of zones" and "Moisture adjustment on dry mass": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區滲透功能」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic functions of zones” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。把所有區域都做得不透水，可能反而讓下游孔壓無法消散。 假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。若排水層被細料污染，孔壓會增加而不是變得更安全，必須依各區功能解讀性能。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區滲透功能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. Their functions differ, and making every zone impermeable can prevent downstream pore pressures from dissipating. Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. Fines-contaminated drains can raise pressure rather than improve safety, requiring performance to be interpreted according to each zones intended function. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic functions of zones” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區滲透功能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic functions of zones”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區滲透功能
knowledge.text: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。把所有區域都做得不透水，可能反而讓下游孔壓無法消散。
knowledge.textEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. Their functions differ, and making every zone impermeable can prevent downstream pore pressures from dissipating.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區滲透功能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic functions of zones" is correct?
options: 所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。
用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。
optionsEn: Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water.
Wet total soil mass times the moisture difference always gives the correct water addition.
quiz.explanation: 心牆降低滲流，反濾層保持細土，排水層把水安全導出；三者功能不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The core limits flow, filters retain fines and drains safely release water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區滲透功能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic functions of zones” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Darcy Q=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s, for homogeneous uncracked material.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區滲透功能」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic functions of zones", which statement holds?
options: 只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s。
optionsEn: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設心牆k=10⁻⁹ m/s、平均水力坡降5、通流面積1000 m²，達西Q=kiA=5×10⁻⁶ m³/s=0.005 L/s；均質無裂縫。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume core k=10⁻⁹ m/s, gradient five and flow area 1000 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區滲透功能」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic functions of zones” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。分別列出完整心牆流與缺陷集中流的證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate. List intact-core flow evidence separately from concentrated flow through defects. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分區滲透功能編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic functions of zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小範圍裂縫可能主導總流量，即使心牆材料滲透率很低。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small crack can dominate flow despite low intact-core permeability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。分別列出完整心牆流與缺陷集中流的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate. List intact-core flow evidence separately from concentrated flow through defects.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以分區滲透功能編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic functions of zones, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Compare pressure contours and discharge, using crack scenarios to identify paths omitted by the intact-soil Darcy estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區滲透功能」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic functions of zones"?
options: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。
optionsEn: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
quiz.explanation: 將心牆、反濾和排水的粒徑與滲透資料分區保存，核對模型控制體；比較孔壓等值線和排水量，並用裂縫情境檢查完整土體達西估算會漏掉哪些流路。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Keep core, filter and drain grading and permeability separately and verify model control volumes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區滲透功能：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic functions of zones: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區滲透功能」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic functions of zones” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆含水量以水重除乾土重定義，施工加水須先區分乾土與濕土基準。含水量影響壓實、滲透和施工孔壓，不能只追求最大乾密度。 假設乾土1000 t、初始含水率12%、目標16%，需加水(0.16−0.12)×1000=40 t；未含蒸發和混合損失，不是工地配方。 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。材料濕側施工也可能提高短期孔壓，需與穩定需求共同評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水調整與乾土質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Core water content is water mass divided by dry-soil mass, so water addition requires a clear dry versus wet basis. Moisture affects compaction, permeability and construction pore pressure rather than density alone. Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent. Added water is forty tonnes, excluding evaporation and mixing losses and not a field recipe. Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Using wet mass miscalculates additions, and wetter placement can raise short-term pore pressure, requiring evaluation with stability needs. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture adjustment on dry mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume dry soil 1000 t, initial water content twelve percent and target sixteen percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用濕土總重量乘含水率差就一定得到正確補水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水調整與乾土質量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture adjustment on dry mass" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean.
quiz.explanation: 表面灑水可能使上濕下乾，平均含水正確仍有弱層；誤用濕土重量會算錯補水量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface wetting can leave wet tops and dry bottoms despite a correct mean. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度孔隙與飽和度」與「水力劈裂與小主應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Density void ratio and saturation" and "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度孔隙與飽和度」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density void ratio and saturation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。這些相態關係能抓出不合理數據，但不能取代強度與滲透試驗。 此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度孔隙與飽和度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. Phase relations detect inconsistent data without replacing strength or permeability testing. Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81. Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density void ratio and saturation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度孔隙與飽和度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density void ratio and saturation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度
knowledge.text: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。這些相態關係能抓出不合理數據，但不能取代強度與滲透試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. Phase relations detect inconsistent data without replacing strength or permeability testing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度孔隙與飽和度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Density void ratio and saturation" is correct?
options: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。
乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。
只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
optionsEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation.
Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids.
Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 乾密度與顆粒比重決定孔隙比，再結合含水量可估飽和度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry density and particle specific gravity determine void ratio, which combines with water content to estimate saturation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度孔隙與飽和度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Density void ratio and saturation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。假設Gs=2.7、ρd=1800 kg/m³、ρw=1000，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.5；含水率0.15時Sr=wGs/e=0.81。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Assume Gs=2.7, dry density 1800 kg/m³ and water density 1000. Void ratio is 0.5; at water content 0.15, saturation Sr=wGs/e=0.81.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密度孔隙與飽和度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Density void ratio and saturation", which statement holds?
options: 反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。
各分區材料總重量正確就能證明所有分區位置與厚度正確。
optionsEn: A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³.
Correct total material mass proves every zone is correctly located and dimensioned.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：此處水密度為1000 kg/m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Water density here is 1000 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度孔隙與飽和度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Density void ratio and saturation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。以體積和質量閉合檢查取樣體積是否失真。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation. Use volume-mass closure to check whether the sampling volume is distorted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以密度孔隙與飽和度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for density void ratio and saturation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。以體積和質量閉合檢查取樣體積是否失真。
knowledge.textEn: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation. Use volume-mass closure to check whether the sampling volume is distorted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以密度孔隙與飽和度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for density void ratio and saturation, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Investigate units, coarse-particle corrections and sample volume before interpreting spatial variation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密度孔隙與飽和度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Density void ratio and saturation"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
水庫退到低水位時，壩內所有孔壓必定已同步降到最低。
同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
At low reservoir level every internal pore pressure has necessarily fallen to its minimum.
Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one.
quiz.explanation: 同批樣品核對比重、乾密度和含水量，檢查計算飽和度是否介於零與一；若不合理，回查單位、粗粒修正和取樣體積，再評估不同位置的變異。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check specific gravity, dry density and moisture on matched samples and ensure computed saturation lies between zero and one. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度孔隙與飽和度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density void ratio and saturation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度孔隙與飽和度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density void ratio and saturation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾密度達標就能直接證明土體已完全飽和且沒有大孔隙。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable dry density directly proves full saturation and absence of large voids." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。若比重取自不同土源，飽和度估算也會產生系統性偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Specific gravity from a different borrow source also creates systematic error in inferred saturation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度孔隙與飽和度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Density void ratio and saturation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
optionsEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
quiz.explanation: 相態閉合正常仍不保證土體結構均勻，團塊間大孔隙可能與團塊內高密度共存。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Consistent phase relations do not prove uniform fabric: dense clods can coexist with large interclod voids. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic fracture and minor stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水力劈裂與小主應力」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。簡單總應力比較只能提示敏感性，實際起裂還取決於抗拉、缺陷和應力路徑。 假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水力劈裂與小主應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. A simple total-stress comparison indicates sensitivity; initiation also depends on tension resistance, defects and stress history. Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only. Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水力劈裂與小主應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力
knowledge.text: 心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。簡單總應力比較只能提示敏感性，實際起裂還取決於抗拉、缺陷和應力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. A simple total-stress comparison indicates sensitivity; initiation also depends on tension resistance, defects and stress history.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水力劈裂與小主應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress" is correct?
options: 只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。
心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
optionsEn: Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress.
Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
quiz.explanation: 心牆若因拱效應使小主壓應力降低，蓄水壓力可能沿弱面推開土體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Arching can reduce the core minor compressive stress, allowing reservoir pressure to open weak planes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic fracture and minor stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水力劈裂與小主應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa. Reducing total stress by 50 kPa gives −20 kPa, a zero-tension screening comparison only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa；若拱效應降低總應力50 kPa，差變−20 kPa，僅無抗拉篩選。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水力劈裂與小主應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress", which statement holds?

新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設局部總小主壓應力250 kPa、水壓220 kPa，差30 kPa。
optionsEn: High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume local total minor compression 250 kPa and water pressure 220 kPa, leaving 30 kPa.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic fracture and minor stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水力劈裂與小主應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。檢查最小主應力方向是否與假設裂縫面相符。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer. Compare pre- and post-filling stress paths and interpret sensitive zones using cracks, seepage and filter protection together. Check whether the minor-principal-stress direction matches the assumed fracture plane. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以水力劈裂與小主應力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for hydraulic fracture and minor stress, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Identify total versus effective stress and colocate pressure and earth-pressure observations by layer. Compare pre- and post-filling stress paths and interpret sensitive zones using cracks, seepage and filter protection together.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水力劈裂與小主應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress"?
options: 核對量測的是總應力還是有效應力，將孔壓和土壓計布置到同層位；比較蓄水前後應力路徑，並用裂縫、漏流與反濾保護證據一起判讀敏感區。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.

steps.title: 水力劈裂與小主應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Hydraulic fracture and minor stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水力劈裂與小主應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Hydraulic fracture and minor stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要水壓小於豎向覆土壓力，就不可能發生心牆水力劈裂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydraulic fracture is impossible whenever water pressure is below vertical overburden stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。只比單一水壓數字，不能確定劈裂位置或後續內部侵蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. A single pressure comparison cannot locate fracture or establish subsequent internal erosion.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水力劈裂與小主應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic fracture and minor stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。
心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings.
Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
quiz.explanation: 以豎向覆土壓力代替最小主應力會漏掉橫向低應力區，儀器局部剛度也可能干擾讀值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Replacing minor principal stress with vertical overburden misses low lateral-stress zones, while instrument stiffness disturbs readings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「心牆拱效應與沉降差」與「反濾保持與排水能力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Core arching and differential settlement" and "Filter retention and drainage capacity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Core arching and differential settlement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「心牆拱效應與沉降差」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Core arching and differential settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。這有時降低心牆壓應力，不能把荷載轉移一律視為有利。 假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。若只以心牆壓力降低當作減載好處，會忽略裂縫與水力劈裂敏感性提高。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「心牆拱效應與沉降差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. Reduced core compression can be unfavorable, so load transfer is not automatically beneficial. Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient. Narrow valleys and steep abutments create three-dimensional arching beyond one two-dimensional coefficient. Viewing reduced core stress only as beneficial unloading overlooks increased sensitivity to cracking and hydraulic fracture. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Core arching and differential settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。

knowledge.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差
knowledge.text: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。這有時降低心牆壓應力，不能把荷載轉移一律視為有利。
knowledge.textEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. Reduced core compression can be unfavorable, so load transfer is not automatically beneficial.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「心牆拱效應與沉降差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Core arching and differential settlement" is correct?
options: 心牆拱效應降低壓應力，因此在所有情況下都提高安全。
反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。
較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。
optionsEn: Core arching lowers compression and therefore improves safety in every circumstance.
A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways.
quiz.explanation: 較軟心牆與較硬壩殼變形不同，界面剪力可把部分豎向荷載轉移到兩側。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A softer core and stiffer shells settle differently, allowing interface shear to transfer vertical load sideways. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 心牆拱效應與沉降差：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設原豎向應力600 kPa、側向界面轉移比例0.25，剩餘450 kPa；此為量化荷載分配假設，不是普遍拱效應係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume original vertical stress 600 kPa and side-interface transfer fraction 0.25. Remaining stress is 450 kPa, an assumed load split rather than a universal arching coefficient. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 比較心牆和壩殼分層沉降、土壓與孔壓，檢查荷載是否按界面方向轉移；用不同剛度比模型測試局部低應力區，並核對施工高差的時間歷程。比較陡岸與谷底區域的應力轉移差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences. Compare stress-transfer behavior near steep abutments with the valley-center region. Compare layer settlement, total stress and pore pressure in core and shells, checking interface load-transfer direction. Test low-stress zones across stiffness ratios and retain the history of construction elevation differences.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：窄谷或陡峭岸坡容易形成複雜三維拱效應，單一二維係數可能不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾保持與排水能力」如何影響心牆土石壩分區填築的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter retention and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。粒徑比只是初步條件，分散性土與間斷級配需要專門試驗。 假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。只用料場平均曲線可能同時漏掉這兩種相反缺陷，不能代替鋪設連續性和界面驗證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾保持與排水能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. Grain-size ratios are preliminary checks, while dispersive soils and gap grading require dedicated testing. Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion. Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A stockpile-average curve can miss both opposing defects and cannot replace checks of placement continuity and zone interfaces. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter retention and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「反濾料粒徑保持比合格就能自動推得其滲透係數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

A passing particle-retention ratio automatically determines the filter permeability coefficient.
High drain permeability guarantees sufficient drainage under every outlet condition.
quiz.explanation: 反濾材料要保持心牆細粒又提供足夠通水性，兩條要求需同時滿足。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must retain core particles while providing adequate flow capacity, requiring both conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反濾保持與排水能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter retention and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. A separate assumed k=10⁻⁴ m/s is not derived from that ratio or an acceptance criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反濾保持與排水能力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter retention and drainage capacity", which statement holds?
options: 新增填土重量造成的總應力一定全部立即轉成有效應力。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3。
所有填築分區都越不透水，整座土石壩就一定越安全。
optionsEn: All total stress added by new fill immediately becomes effective stress.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three.
Making every embankment zone less permeable necessarily makes the whole dam safer.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設基土d85=0.2 mm、反濾D15=0.6 mm，保持比3；另假設反濾k=10⁻⁴ m/s，不能由比值直接推得此k或接受標準。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume base d85=0.2 mm and filter D15=0.6 mm, giving retention ratio three. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反濾保持與排水能力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反濾保持與排水能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter retention and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。用出水細料量判斷是否出現持續顆粒遷移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records. Use discharged-fines mass to determine whether particle migration continues over time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以反濾保持與排水能力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for filter retention and drainage capacity, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Check full grading for the relevant soil class and sample placed filters for contamination. Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：施工離析會在局部形成過粗窗口，細料污染則降低排水性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Segregation creates locally coarse windows while fines contamination reduces drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按適用土類檢查完整級配，取施工後樣品確認細料未污染；以缺陷集中滲流試驗核對保持能力和堵塞反應，保留出水顆粒量、時間和水頭差資料。用出水細料量判斷是否出現持續顆粒遷移。

Test retention and clogging under concentrated defect flow, preserving particle discharge, time and head-difference records. Use discharged-fines mass to determine whether particle migration continues over time.
