steps.title: 集水井的暫態平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sump transient balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水井的暫態平衡」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sump transient balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。水量平衡應追蹤啟停延遲與共同排出管的限制，而非只把泵銘牌流量相加。 假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水井的暫態平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak. Storage balance must track start delay and common-discharge restrictions rather than merely summing pump nameplate capacities. Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes. Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sump transient balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水井的暫態平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sump transient balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水井的暫態平衡
knowledge.text: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。水量平衡應追蹤啟停延遲與共同排出管的限制，而非只把泵銘牌流量相加。
knowledge.textEn: A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak. Storage balance must track start delay and common-discharge restrictions rather than merely summing pump nameplate capacities.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水井的暫態平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sump transient balance" is correct?
options: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。
多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。
只要顯熱通風計算合格，就不必再評估廊道氣體與濕度。
optionsEn: A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak.
Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows.
Passing the sensible-heat ventilation calculation removes any need to assess gallery gases or humidity.
quiz.explanation: 廊道集水井具有有限儲水量，平均抽排能力足夠仍可能在短時入流尖峰溢流。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gallery sump has finite storage, so adequate average pumping can still fail during an inflow peak. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水井的暫態平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sump transient balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水井的暫態平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sump transient balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Constant net inflow 0.01 m³/s fills the initially empty sump in 1200 seconds, or twenty minutes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水井的暫態平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sump transient balance", which statement holds?
options: 出水溶解物濃度比進水低，就能確定全部差值都沉積在排水孔內。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min。
只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。
optionsEn: Lower outlet concentration proves that the entire dissolved-mass difference deposited inside the drain.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s.
Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設有效容積12 m³，入流0.03 m³/s而可用排流0.02 m³/s，淨增加0.01 m³/s，從空井填滿需1200 s即20 min；流量恆定、無額外容積。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume usable storage 12 m³, inflow 0.03 m³/s and available discharge 0.02 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水井的暫態平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sump transient balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水井的暫態平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sump transient balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。核對止回閥是否造成倒流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance. Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以集水井的暫態平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。核對止回閥是否造成倒流。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sump transient balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance. Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。核對止回閥是否造成倒流。
knowledge.textEn: Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance. Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以集水井的暫態平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。核對止回閥是否造成倒流。
knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for sump transient balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance. Use equipment test evidence to check start delay and shared-line backpressure, calculating available storage separately during power interruption. Check reverse flow through the discharge check valve.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水井的暫態平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sump transient balance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。
把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance.
quiz.explanation: 把液位記錄換算成容積，對照實測入流與泵出量檢查水量閉合；用設備測試資料核對啟動延遲及共同管路背壓，並把電源中斷期間的可用儲水獨立計算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert level records to volume and compare measured inflow and pumping to close the balance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集水井的暫態平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sump transient balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水井的暫態平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sump transient balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「多台泵的銘牌流量總和大於平均入流，就能保證集水井永不溢流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total nameplate pump capacity above average inflow guarantees that a sump never overflows." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。若把全部幾何容積當有效容積，便會高估可用緩衝時間。
knowledge.textEn: Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Counting total geometric volume as usable storage overestimates buffering time and conceals the effect of activation thresholds.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水井的暫態平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sump transient balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要顯熱通風計算合格，就不必再評估廊道氣體與濕度。
optionsEn: Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing the sensible-heat ventilation calculation removes any need to assess gallery gases or humidity.
quiz.explanation: 液位計被泡沫或沉積干擾會延遲啟動判讀，共同排管堵塞可能同時降低多台泵能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Foam or sediment interferes with level sensing, while a blocked shared line can reduce several pumps simultaneously. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「廊道熱量與通風尺度」與「廊道開孔的應力集中」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gallery heat and ventilation scale" and "Gallery opening stress concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 廊道熱量與通風尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gallery heat and ventilation scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「廊道熱量與通風尺度」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gallery heat and ventilation scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 設備散熱、濕空氣與岩體熱交換共同影響廊道環境。簡單顯熱平衡只能估通風尺度，不能取代氣體、濕度與局部氣流評估，也不能作為人員進入許可依據。 假設設備顯熱12 kW、空氣密度1.2 kg/m³、比熱1005 J/(kg·K)、容許教學溫升5 K，Q=12000/(1.2×1005×5)=1.990 m³/s；忽略潛熱與岩體交換。 總風量符合估算仍可能有局部停滯區，濕氣凝結會影響設備與表面耐久。只用平均溫度判斷環境充分性，會漏掉獨立的氣體風險和人員活動需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「廊道熱量與通風尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equipment heat, moisture and rock heat exchange shape gallery conditions. A sensible-heat balance estimates ventilation scale but cannot replace gas, humidity or local-airflow assessment and does not establish personnel-entry authorization. Assume sensible heat 12 kW, air density 1.2 kg/m³, heat capacity 1005 J/(kg·K) and teaching rise 5 K. Flow is 1.990 m³/s, excluding latent heat and rock exchange. Adequate total airflow can coexist with stagnant zones, and condensation affects equipment and surface durability. Average temperature alone overlooks separate gas hazards and occupancy requirements, so the heat calculation cannot establish overall environmental suitability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gallery heat and ventilation scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設設備顯熱12 kW、空氣密度1.2 kg/m³、比熱1005 J/(kg·K)、容許教學溫升5 K，Q=12000/(1.2×1005×5)=1.990 m³/s；忽略潛熱與岩體交換。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume sensible heat 12 kW, air density 1.2 kg/m³, heat capacity 1005 J/(kg·K) and teaching rise 5 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要顯熱通風計算合格，就不必再評估廊道氣體與濕度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing the sensible-heat ventilation calculation removes any need to assess gallery gases or humidity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「廊道熱量與通風尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gallery heat and ventilation scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 廊道熱量與通風尺度：定量估算

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 廊道是壩體或岩體中的開孔，周圍應力會重分布，局部峰值取決於形狀、遠場荷載與襯砌接觸。圓孔彈性解可用作數值模型的基準，但不代表矩形廊道真實角隅。 假設無內壓圓孔位於無限均質等向線彈性體，遠場單軸壓應力4 MPa，孔邊最大環向壓應力3σ=12 MPa；忽略節理與有限邊界。 尖角的數值應力峰值可能是理想幾何奇異而非可直接使用的材料應力，節理滑移又可能改變受力路徑。只比較最大值而不查平均區域和變形，會誤判損傷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「廊道開孔的應力集中」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gallery opening redistributes stress in concrete or rock, with local peaks controlled by geometry, far-field loading and lining contact. A circular elastic solution benchmarks numerical models but does not represent the corners of a rectangular gallery. Assume an unpressurized circular hole in an infinite homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic medium under uniaxial compression 4 MPa. Maximum boundary hoop compression is 12 MPa, excluding joints and finite boundaries. A sharp-corner peak can be a geometric singularity rather than directly usable material stress, while joint slip changes load paths. Comparing maxima without averaging-region and deformation checks can therefore misidentify damage or apparent numerical improvement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gallery opening stress concentration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an unpressurized circular hole in an infinite homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic medium under uniaxial compression 4 MPa.

steps.title: 廊道開孔的應力集中：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gallery opening stress concentration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「廊道開孔的應力集中」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設無內壓圓孔位於無限均質等向線彈性體，遠場單軸壓應力4 MPa，孔邊最大環向壓應力3σ=12 MPa；忽略節理與有限邊界。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume an unpressurized circular hole in an infinite homogeneous isotropic linear-elastic medium under uniaxial compression 4 MPa. Maximum boundary hoop compression is 12 MPa, excluding joints and finite boundaries. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instructionEn: Drain deposits can arise from chemical precipitation or transported particles with similar appearance but different causes. Concentration difference times flow estimates potential deposition only after accounting for sampling locations, mixing and alternative reaction paths. Assume flow 2 L/s and dissolved-mass decrease 20 mg/L, entirely retained as deposits. Daily mass is 3.456 kg/day, without specifying mineral composition and excluding bypass or redissolution. Mixing different waters lowers concentration without deposition, and reactions inside sample bottles alter results. Even small total deposit mass can dominate hydraulic resistance when concentrated at a narrow section rather than distributed uniformly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Precipitation deposits and mass balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Compare predicted accumulation with measured deposits and diameter change, testing whether dilution rather than precipitation explains the concentration difference.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同比例水源混合會造成濃度降低而沒有沉積，採樣瓶內反應也會改變結果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing different waters lowers concentration without deposition, and reactions inside sample bottles alter results. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 不同比例水源混合會造成濃度降低而沒有沉積，採樣瓶內反應也會改變結果。即使總質量小，局部狹窄處的沉積仍可能主導水力阻力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing different waters lowers concentration without deposition, and reactions inside sample bottles alter results. Even small total deposit mass can dominate hydraulic resistance when concentrated at a narrow section rather than distributed uniformly. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「析出沉積與質量收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation.

steps.title: 壓力差的不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-difference uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力差的不確定度」如何影響壩基排水廊道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-difference uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam-foundation drainage galleries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 判斷壓差趨勢需要把儀器隨機不確定度與共同系統偏差分開。兩個讀值的差可能抵消同源零點，也可能共享溫度誤差；是否相關決定合成規則。 假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa；若相關係數0.5則為sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa。 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力差的不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interpreting pressure differences requires separating random uncertainty from shared systematic bias. A common zero may cancel while temperature errors remain correlated, so covariance determines how the uncertainties of two readings combine. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa. Difference uncertainty is 3.606 kPa; correlation 0.5 changes it to sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa, with systematic bias assessed separately. Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-difference uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個壓力感測器的誤差不論是否相關都可以一律平方和開根號。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力差的不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure-difference uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 排水孔口等距排列就能保證深部各處具有相同的排水效果。
量水堰水頭偏差百分之二，計算流量也一定只偏差百分之二。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa。
optionsEn: Equally spaced drain collars guarantee equal drainage effectiveness throughout the foundation.
A two-percent weir-head error always produces exactly a two-percent discharge error.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設兩壓力讀值的獨立零均值標準不確定度為2與3 kPa，壓差標準不確定度sqrt(2²+3²)=3.606 kPa；若相關係數0.5則為sqrt(13−6)=2.646 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties 2 and 3 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力差的不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-difference uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力差的不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-difference uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。比較共同零點校正前後差值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation. Add uncertainty bands to trend plots and list uncorrected biases separately rather than treating resolution as accuracy. Compare differences before and after common-zero correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以壓力差的不確定度編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。比較共同零點校正前後差值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for pressure-difference uncertainty, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation. Add uncertainty bands to trend plots and list uncorrected biases separately rather than treating resolution as accuracy. Compare differences before and after common-zero correction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力差的不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure-difference uncertainty"?
options: 以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要顯熱通風計算合格，就不必再評估廊道氣體與濕度。
optionsEn: Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing the sensible-heat ventilation calculation removes any need to assess gallery gases or humidity.
quiz.explanation: 以共同壓力源校正兩儀器並記錄殘差協方差，追查纜線與溫度補償是否共享；對每個趨勢圖加上不確定度帶，另列未校正偏差，避免把解析度當作準確度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate both instruments against a common pressure source and record residual covariance, checking shared cabling and temperature compensation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力差的不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure-difference uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力差的不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-difference uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個壓力感測器的誤差不論是否相關都可以一律平方和開根號。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Errors of two pressure sensors can always be root-sum-squared regardless of correlation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。小幅變化若低於量測可辨識尺度，不能逕自解讀成性能改善。
knowledge.textEn: Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Changes below measurement resolution and uncertainty cannot automatically be interpreted as improved hydraulic performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力差的不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-difference uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。
只要設置排水孔，壩基所有位置的孔隙水壓都會變成零。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty.
Installing drain holes makes pore pressure zero at every foundation location.
quiz.explanation: 把實際觀測偏差直接平方和開根號不是合成標準不確定度，忽略相關性也會高估或低估壓差誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Root-summing observed offsets is not uncertainty propagation, and ignoring correlation can overstate or understate difference uncertainty. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大壩接縫灌漿
courses.summary: 本課以大壩接縫灌漿為入口，深入接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證。十個單元各自對應不同的荷載路徑、能量交換或監測問題，從守恆式建立量化估算，再檢查量測配置是否能辨認真正失效原因。工程史實只採用列明範圍的公開一手資料；所有模型輸入另標為教學假設，成果是可追溯的工程判讀紀錄。
courses.summaryEn: Using Dam contraction-joint grouting as its entry point, this course examines joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification. Ten units address different load paths, energy exchanges or monitoring questions, starting with conservation-based estimates and testing whether observations distinguish failure causes. Historical statements use scoped primary evidence. Numerical model inputs are separately identified as teaching assumptions, producing a traceable engineering interpretation record.
courses.focus: 接縫封拱、灌漿體積與荷載傳遞驗證
courses.focusEn: Joint closure grouting, volume accounting and load-transfer verification
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課原創比較練習分兩個相互獨立的物理模型。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。先逐一圈出公式內的控制體、力方向或時間尺度，再把每項輸入的量綱換成一致單位。第二人只根據輸入重算結果，不抄第一人的中間數字。最後指出這兩個估算尚未包含的空間變化、非線性及量測誤差；若將結果用於另一座工程，必須重建其幾何、材料與邊界條件，不能挪用本練習的假設。 自由熱收縮敏感度固定單塊長24 m與α=10⁻⁵/K，只將均勻降溫量由12增至18 K。ΔL=αLΔT由2.88增至4.32 mm，增加50%。比較保持自由收縮邊界；若塊體受到拘束，額外冷卻可能轉化為應力而非相同的位移，兩塊之間的接縫實際開度還取決於各自運動和接觸狀態。
workedExample.textEn: This original comparison exercise uses two independent physical models. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. First identify the control volume, force direction or time scale in each relation, then convert every input to consistent units. A second reviewer recalculates from the inputs without copying intermediate numbers. Finally identify spatial variability, nonlinear effects and measurement errors omitted by both estimates. Transfer to another structure requires rebuilding its geometry, material description and boundary conditions; the assumed classroom inputs are not transferable design or operating parameters. For free-contraction sensitivity, hold block length at 24 m and α=10⁻⁵/K fixed, increasing only uniform cooling from 12 K to 18 K. ΔL=αLΔT rises from 2.88 to 4.32 mm, or 50%. The comparison retains free contraction; restraint may turn added cooling into stress rather than the same displacement, while actual joint aperture depends on both blocks and their contact state.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」與「分區接縫的體積平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" and "Compartment grout-volume balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。自由收縮估算只給幾何尺度，實際開縫還受基礎約束、相鄰塊體與非均勻溫度控制。 假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. Free contraction provides a geometric scale, while foundation restraint, neighboring blocks and nonuniform temperature determine actual aperture and its spatial distribution. Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度
knowledge.text: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。自由收縮估算只給幾何尺度，實際開縫還受基礎約束、相鄰塊體與非均勻溫度控制。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. Free contraction provides a geometric scale, while foundation restraint, neighboring blocks and nonuniform temperature determine actual aperture and its spatial distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cooling contraction and joint aperture" is correct?
options: 用當日外氣溫度就能直接推定整塊混凝土的接縫開度。
分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。
供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
optionsEn: Daily air temperature directly determines the aperture throughout an entire concrete-block joint.
Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact.
Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
quiz.explanation: 分塊混凝土冷卻會收縮，接縫灌漿時的溫度決定後續可用的接觸狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling contracts concrete, and the thermal state at joint grouting influences later contact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設單塊長24 m、線膨脹係數10⁻⁵/K、均勻降溫12 K，自由收縮αLΔT=2.88 mm；不把它當兩塊接縫的直接實測開度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume block length 24 m, expansion coefficient 10⁻⁵/K and uniform cooling 12 K. Free contraction is 2.88 mm, not directly the measured aperture between two restrained blocks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for cooling contraction and joint aperture, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare embedded temperatures and joint meters at several elevations, separating uniform cooling from local gradients. Check instrument zeros independently and compare observed aperture against free-contraction scale to identify the effect of restraint and differential block movement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cooling contraction and joint aperture"?
options: 對照埋設溫度計與多高程縫寬計的時序，先分辨均勻冷卻及局部梯度；以獨立基準檢查儀器零點，再將實測開度與自由收縮界限比較，查明約束造成的差異。

steps.title: 冷卻收縮與接縫開度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cooling contraction and joint aperture: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cooling contraction and joint aperture” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 表面冷卻不代表塊體內部已達同溫，若僅依外氣溫度判讀封拱時機，會低估後續收縮。接縫閉合也可能只是局部接觸，並非全高同時形成傳力面。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface cooling does not establish uniform internal temperature, so air temperature alone underestimates later contraction. Local joint closure can also occur before full-height contact, leaving an incomplete load-transfer surface despite a closed reading at one elevation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「冷卻收縮與接縫開度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分區接縫的體積平衡」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compartment grout-volume balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。平均開度乘面積只是初估，止漿邊界、鍵槽和局部接觸會造成體積分布不均。 假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區接縫的體積平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. Mean aperture times area is only an estimate because seals, shear keys and localized contact create uneven available volume. Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compartment grout-volume balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分區接縫的體積平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compartment grout-volume balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡
knowledge.text: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。平均開度乘面積只是初估，止漿邊界、鍵槽和局部接觸會造成體積分布不均。
knowledge.textEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. Mean aperture times area is only an estimate because seals, shear keys and localized contact create uneven available volume.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分區接縫的體積平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compartment grout-volume balance" is correct?
options: 供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。
optionsEn: Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account.
quiz.explanation: 接縫灌漿應以分區幾何、管路容積和實際回流建立收支。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joint grouting requires compartment geometry, line storage and measured returns in its volume account. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分區接縫的體積平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compartment grout-volume balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Supply 2.8 minus return 0.2 and line storage 0.1 gives apparent retention 2.5 m³, requiring explanation of the difference.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分區接縫的體積平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compartment grout-volume balance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³。
只要新拌漿液充滿接縫，硬化後就不可能再形成任何空隙。
漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³.
Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.
Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設接縫面60×20 m、等效平均開度2 mm，幾何空隙2.4 m³；供漿2.8 m³扣回流0.2與管存0.1 m³，表觀留存2.5 m³，差0.1 m³需解釋。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume joint area 60×20 m and mean aperture 2 mm, giving 2.4 m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分區接縫的體積平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compartment grout-volume balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以分區接縫的體積平衡編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compartment grout-volume balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。以獨立秤重交叉查供漿量。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.

knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for compartment grout-volume balance, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Compare high-take regions with aperture maps and boundary-seal records to distinguish geometry, escape and metering discrepancies. Cross-check delivered volume by independent weighing.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分區接縫的體積平衡」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Compartment grout-volume balance"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
quiz.explanation: 逐分區核對流量積分、回漿容器和管路存量，將量測不確定度換成體積範圍；把高耗量區對照開度圖與邊界密封紀錄，查明差異來自幾何、逸漿還是儀表。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile integrated supply, collected returns and line storage by compartment, converting measurement uncertainty to volume bounds. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分區接縫的體積平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compartment grout-volume balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分區接縫的體積平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compartment grout-volume balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「供漿體積與理論接縫體積相同，就能證明接縫每處都填滿。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal supplied and theoretical joint volumes prove that every part of the joint is filled." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。只用總量相近宣告充填完成，會掩蓋上部空洞或局部連通缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Agreement in total volume alone hides upper voids and local connected gaps rather than establishing uniform filling.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分區接縫的體積平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compartment grout-volume balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage.
quiz.explanation: 耗量超過理論空隙可能是外漏或鄰區串通，少於理論量也可能是入口濾堵。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Excess take can indicate escape or communication with another compartment, while low take can reflect entrance blockage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殘留通道與立方敏感性」與「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Residual channels and cubic sensitivity" and "Grout-column head and compartment pressure": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual channels and cubic sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「殘留通道與立方敏感性」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam contraction-joint grouting”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。封堵體積百分比與水力改善百分比沒有固定對應，連通路徑比平均孔隙更重要。 假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「殘留通道與立方敏感性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. Filled-volume percentage does not have a fixed relationship to hydraulic improvement; connectivity matters more than average void fraction. Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm. Ideal flow ratio is 0.03704, a 96.296-percent reduction for Newtonian laminar flow without bypass. Turbulence, roughness and pressure-induced opening violate the cubic idealization, while bypasses avoid treated regions. Treating the ideal reduction as a material guarantee misses the weakest connected segment that actually governs leakage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「殘留通道與立方敏感性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性
knowledge.text: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。封堵體積百分比與水力改善百分比沒有固定對應，連通路徑比平均孔隙更重要。
knowledge.textEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. Filled-volume percentage does not have a fixed relationship to hydraulic improvement; connectivity matters more than average void fraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘留通道與立方敏感性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual channels and cubic sensitivity" is correct?
options: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。
填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。
位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
optionsEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed.
Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent.
Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
quiz.explanation: 少量未填通道可能控制整個接縫的滲漏，因薄縫層流對開度呈立方敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A small unfilled channel can control joint leakage because laminar thin-gap flow scales with aperture cubed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殘留通道與立方敏感性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual channels and cubic sensitivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殘留通道與立方敏感性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual channels and cubic sensitivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設相同寬度、長度和壓差的平行縫，開度0.3降至0.1 mm，理想水流比(0.1/0.3)³=0.03704，減少96.296%；牛頓層流且無旁通。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume equal width, length and pressure difference with aperture reduced from 0.3 to 0.1 mm. Ideal flow ratio is 0.03704, a 96.296-percent reduction for Newtonian laminar flow without bypass. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Turbulence, roughness and pressure-induced opening violate the cubic idealization, while bypasses avoid treated regions. Treating the ideal reduction as a material guarantee misses the weakest connected segment that actually governs leakage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「填滿接縫體積百分之九十，就一定能把滲漏流量降低百分之九十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Filling ninety percent of joint volume necessarily reduces leakage by ninety percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 局部裂縫紊流、粗糙與壓力張開都會偏離立方律，旁路還可能繞過已填區。若把理想降幅當成材料保證，會漏掉真正控制滲漏的最薄弱連通段。

quiz.question: 在「殘留通道與立方敏感性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.

steps.title: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grout-column head and compartment pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」如何影響大壩接縫灌漿的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 同一接縫內不同高程的漿壓不相同，密度與靜水頭必須和管損分開。儀表位置高於分區時，下部壓力可能大於表壓，不能把單一讀值當整片接縫受壓。 取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設靜止漿體密度1800 kg/m³、高差10 m，壓力差ρgΔz=176.58 kPa；若有流動、屈服或堵塞，不再等同單純靜水分布。 高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。若僅提高泵端壓力追求讀值一致，可能在未量測區造成不預期的開縫與串漿。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grout pressure varies with elevation inside a joint, and hydrostatic head must be separated from line losses. A gauge above a compartment can underrepresent pressure lower down, so one reading cannot describe loading over the whole interface. Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume stationary grout density 1800 kg/m³ over ten metres. Hydrostatic difference is 176.58 kPa; flow, yield behavior or blockage can invalidate the simple hydrostatic distribution. Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. Increasing pump pressure merely to equalize readings can create unexpected joint opening or cross-compartment flow in unmonitored regions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grout-column head and compartment pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grout-column head and compartment pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 位於不同高程的接縫灌漿壓力計應該不經修正讀到完全相同壓力。
同一接縫內不同高程的漿壓不相同，密度與靜水頭必須和管損分開。

optionsEn: Joint-grout gauges at different elevations should read identical pressure without correction.
Grout pressure varies with elevation inside a joint, and hydrostatic head must be separated from line losses.
Once fresh grout fills a joint, no void can develop during hardening.

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。假設靜止漿體密度1800 kg/m³、高差10 m，壓力差ρgΔz=176.58 kPa；若有流動、屈服或堵塞，不再等同單純靜水分布。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Assume stationary grout density 1800 kg/m³ over ten metres. Hydrostatic difference is 176.58 kPa; flow, yield behavior or blockage can invalidate the simple hydrostatic distribution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grout-column head and compartment pressure", which statement holds?
options: 漿材抗壓強度相同就代表不同厚度接縫具有相同法向剛度。
只量到一個壓力半衰時間，就能唯一算出接縫的滲漏導度。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Equal grout compressive strength means joints of different thickness have identical normal stiffness.
One measured pressure half-life uniquely determines the leakage conductance of a joint.
Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：取重力加速度g=9.81 m/s²。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Use gravitational acceleration g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 漿柱水頭與分區壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grout-column head and compartment pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漿柱水頭與分區壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Grout-column head and compartment pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以漿柱水頭與分區壓力編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for grout-column head and compartment pressure, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高黏度或正在凝結的漿體可形成非靜水壓差，分區堵塞又會隔離儀器。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Viscous or setting grout can develop nonhydrostatic pressure differences, and obstruction isolates instruments. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 把壓力計與各區頂底高程列在同一剖面，核對漿密度與流動狀態；用相鄰量測點檢查梯度，將短時脈動、管阻與靜態高程修正分開，避免重複加減水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Plot gauge and compartment elevations on one section and verify grout density and flow state. Check gradients between instruments, separating transients, line resistance and static elevation correction so head is neither omitted nor counted twice.
