knowledge.textEn: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for excavation dewatering and seepage supply, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge. Account separately for rainfall, process water and groundwater, recording turbidity to identify possible particle transport. Check surface-runoff entry into the collection system.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基坑降水與滲流供給」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個河道的弗勞德數相同，就能保證最終沖刷深度完全相同。
以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal Froude numbers in two channels guarantee identical final scour depth.
Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge.
quiz.explanation: 以抽水量、坑外孔壓和河水位同步反算等效供水，檢查停抽回復曲線辨認儲水與補注；分開雨水、施工用水及地下水收支，並記錄濁度以追查是否帶出細料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pumping, outside piezometers and river stage to infer supply, using recovery curves to distinguish storage from recharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基坑降水與滲流供給：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Excavation dewatering and seepage supply: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基坑降水與滲流供給」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Excavation dewatering and seepage supply” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「基坑抽水量增加必定代表整片地基的透水係數同步增加。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing excavation pumping always means permeability increased uniformly throughout the foundation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。若只提高抽排量而不查孔壓與細料，可能掩蓋基底有效應力或侵蝕條件的改變。
knowledge.textEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Focusing on discharge without pressures and transported fines can conceal changes in base effective stress or internal-erosion conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基坑降水與滲流供給」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Excavation dewatering and seepage supply" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。
optionsEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints.
quiz.explanation: 抽水流量增加可能來自裂隙被開挖接通或施工水混入，未必是整體k變大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Higher pumping can reflect newly exposed fractures or process water rather than increased bulk permeability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion transitions and critical duration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導流切換與關鍵工期」如何影響大壩施工導流的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion transitions and critical duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River diversion during dam construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。關鍵路徑需表示真正的前置關係，並與可回復狀態和監測交接共同審查。 假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導流切換與關鍵工期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. Critical paths must represent actual dependencies and be reviewed with recoverable states and monitoring handover requirements. Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days. Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion transitions and critical duration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導流切換與關鍵工期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion transitions and critical duration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期
knowledge.text: 導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。關鍵路徑需表示真正的前置關係，並與可回復狀態和監測交接共同審查。
knowledge.textEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. Critical paths must represent actual dependencies and be reviewed with recoverable states and monitoring handover requirements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「導流切換與關鍵工期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion transitions and critical duration" is correct?
options: 兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。
導流切換把水工能力和施工排程連在一起，某項延誤會讓高暴露階段跨入不同水文季節。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。

quiz.explanationEn: Diversion transitions couple hydraulic capacity with scheduling, and delays can carry vulnerable stages into a different hydrologic season. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導流切換與關鍵工期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion transitions and critical duration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Duration is 26 days; four-day entrance delay increases it to thirty days.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導流切換與關鍵工期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diversion transitions and critical duration", which statement holds?
options: 導流隧洞的摩阻係數不分Darcy或Fanning定義都能直接代入同一公式。
圍堰只是臨時構造，所以抗滑計算可以不扣除基底揚壓。
教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days。
optionsEn: Darcy and Fanning friction factors can be used interchangeably in the same tunnel formula.
Because a cofferdam is temporary, uplift can be omitted from its sliding calculation.

Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非地標實測值或操作設定：假設入口工程18 days、隧洞檢查12 days可平行，兩者完成後切換5 days，再驗證3 days，總期max(18,12)+5+3=26 days；入口延誤4 days使總期30 days。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not landmark measurements or operating settings: Assume entrance work eighteen days and tunnel checks twelve days run in parallel, followed by transition five days and verification three days. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diversion transitions and critical duration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導流切換與關鍵工期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion transitions and critical duration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。把共用設備占用列入排程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work. Overlay duration on seasonal exposure and examine how delays change available diversion states, recording update responsibility and hydrologically triggered review decisions. Include shared-equipment occupancy explicitly in the schedule. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以導流切換與關鍵工期編製可交接的證據頁，註明資料時間、單位、模型適用範圍與審查者。用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。把共用設備占用列入排程。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Prepare a reviewable evidence sheet for diversion transitions and critical duration, recording data time, units, model applicability and reviewer. Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work. Overlay duration on seasonal exposure and examine how delays change available diversion states, recording update responsibility and hydrologically triggered review decisions. Include shared-equipment occupancy explicitly in the schedule.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

Overlay duration on seasonal exposure and examine how delays change available diversion states, recording update responsibility and hydrologically triggered review decisions. Include shared-equipment occupancy explicitly in the schedule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「導流切換與關鍵工期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diversion transitions and critical duration"?
options: 用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
截流缺口縮小時，河道流量分配和水深必定保持原值不變。
optionsEn: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
During gap closure, discharge partition and water depth necessarily remain unchanged.
quiz.explanation: 用每項實際完成條件建立前置網路，核對檢查簽認是否真能與施工平行；將總期疊上季節洪水暴露，演練延誤如何改變可用導流狀態，保留更新責任與水文觸發的審查紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build dependencies from actual completion criteria and verify whether inspections can truly run in parallel with work. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導流切換與關鍵工期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diversion transitions and critical duration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導流切換與關鍵工期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion transitions and critical duration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩項工作只要畫在平行排程列，就一定能完全同時完成而不受共享資源限制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tasks drawn in parallel schedule rows can always finish concurrently without shared-resource constraints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。若把驗證當成可壓縮空檔，可能在尚未證明新通道能力時就失去原來的導流冗餘。
knowledge.textEn: Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Treating verification as expendable slack can remove previous diversion redundancy before the new route has demonstrated capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「導流切換與關鍵工期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Diversion transitions and critical duration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。
二十年重現期洪水表示施工開始後前十九年都不可能發生。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically.
A twenty-year return period means that flood cannot occur during the first nineteen years.
quiz.explanation: 名義平行的工作可能共享設備或通道，隱藏資源限制會使計算工期過短。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Nominally parallel tasks may share equipment or access, so hidden resource constraints shorten calculated duration unrealistically. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 壩體滲流監測
courses.summary: 本課以以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變為主線，先用總水頭與共同基準與達西流量與梯度界定水力與構造條件，再將孔壓響應與延遲、含砂濃度與輸砂連結到基線殘差與不確定度。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence through Total head and common datum and Darcy discharge and gradient, then connects Piezometer response and lag and Suspended concentration and sediment flux to Baseline residual and uncertainty. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變
courses.focusEn: Diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查總水頭與共同基準：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m；再獨立檢查達西流量與梯度：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。敏感度：相同幾何與滲透係數下，水頭差由12m增為15m，達西流量由0.0024增為0.0030m3/s，即增加25%；水頭降低仍流量上升才需另查通道變化。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 將比較同季節不同水位的導水指標並核對下游水頭實測作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Total head and common datum: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Independently examine Darcy discharge and gradient: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. Sensitivity: with unchanged geometry and conductivity, increasing head difference from12 to15m raises Darcy discharge from0.0024 to0.0030m3/s, or25 percent; rising flow despite falling head calls for a separate pathway investigation. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. Use the following independent check: Compare conductance across stage bands in one season and verify measured downstream head. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總水頭與共同基準」與「達西流量與梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total head and common datum" and "Darcy discharge and gradient": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總水頭與共同基準」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total head and common datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。 驗證時應將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，並辨識以下失效情境：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總水頭與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient. Identify gauge versus absolute pressure and atmospheric compensation, then inspect trapped air and zero offsets; low total head does not necessarily mean low local pore pressure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total head and common datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總水頭與共同基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total head and common datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總水頭與共同基準
knowledge.text: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。先辨認壓力是否為表壓並扣除大氣補償，再確認管線氣泡與感測器零點，低水頭不必然代表低孔隙壓力。
knowledge.textEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. Mixing vertical datums creates a false gradient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total head and common datum" is correct?
options: 孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比
孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation
A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計讀到的是量測位置的壓力，必須加上測點高程才能與庫水位比較；換用不同高程基準會製造假的水力坡降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A piezometer measures pressure at its own elevation; add elevation head before comparing it with reservoir stage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總水頭與共同基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total head and common datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總水頭與共同基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Total head and common datum", which statement holds?
options: 所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。
optionsEn: Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: z=142 m; gaugePressure=196.2 kPa; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; totalHead=142+196.2/9.81=162 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總水頭與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total head and common datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「總水頭與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Total head and common datum"?
options: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
整體導水指標就是土樣本身的滲透係數
optionsEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Bulk hydraulic conductance equals the conductivity of a soil specimen
quiz.explanation: 將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 總水頭與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Total head and common datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「總水頭與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Total head and common datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure values can be compared directly with water level at any elevation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。診斷時應採取以下查核：將測點水準成果與同日人工水位管讀值交叉比較，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surveyed sensor elevations against same-day manual standpipe readings. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「總水頭與共同基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Total head and common datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。
流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series.
Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
quiz.explanation: 壓力基準或高程更新未同步會使整組水頭產生固定偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized pressure or elevation references produce a persistent offset across the head series. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Darcy discharge and gradient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「達西流量與梯度」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Darcy discharge and gradient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。應先建立同水位工況的比較，再檢查非線性及地下邊界。 驗證時應以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，並辨識以下失效情境：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「達西流量與梯度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion. Changing pathway area or drain interception also changes measured flow; compare like stages before interpreting nonlinearity or subsurface boundaries. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Darcy discharge and gradient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s.

knowledge.title: 達西流量與梯度
knowledge.text: 穩定飽和滲流的流量同時受導水截面、滲透係數與水力坡降控制。排水量增加可能只是庫水頭提高，不能單憑流量認定內部沖蝕；反之通道面積改變或排水截流也會改變量測。
knowledge.textEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. Higher drainage may merely reflect higher reservoir head and does not by itself prove internal erosion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量上升就足以證明壩體正在遭到侵蝕 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「達西流量與梯度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: Rising flow alone proves active erosion within the dam
A free-flow rating remains valid regardless of tailwater elevation
Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient.

quiz.explanationEn: Steady saturated flow depends jointly on conducting area, hydraulic conductivity and gradient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: k=0.00002 m/s; A=500 m2; deltaHead=12 m; L=50 m; Q=k*A*deltaHead/L=0.0024 m3/s. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Plot simultaneous head difference and collected discharge in separate reservoir-stage bands. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 達西流量與梯度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「達西流量與梯度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 把降雨旁流併入滲流會誇大推估導水能力。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同時水頭差與集水流量建立分水位區間的散點圖，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including rainfall bypass in seepage exaggerates inferred hydraulic conductance. steps.title: 三角堰率定水深：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 量水堰藉控制斷面把上游水頭轉成流量，三角堰指數使小水頭誤差被放大。堰尖沉積、未通氣水舌及尾水淹沒都會破壞既有率定；水深必須在適當上游位置量取，不能以貼近堰口的抽降水面代替。 驗證時應以容積計時法抽驗率定曲線並攝錄水舌與尾水高度，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水淹沒時繼續套自由溢流曲線將造成系統流量誤差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三角堰率定水深」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三角堰率定水深」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “V-notch weir calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Calibrated free-flow rating Q=1.40*H**2.5 m3/s with H in m; H=0.10 m; Q=0.00442719 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Calibrated free-flow rating Q=1.40*H**2.5 m3/s with H in m; H=0.10 m; Q=0.00442719 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以容積計時法抽驗率定曲線並攝錄水舌與尾水高度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the rating by timed-volume collection and record nappe ventilation and tailwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三角堰率定水深」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instructionEn: Check the rating by timed-volume collection and record nappe ventilation and tailwater. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Applying a free-flow rating during submergence creates systematic discharge error. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尾水淹沒時繼續套自由溢流曲線將造成系統流量誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “V-notch weir calibration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尾水淹沒時繼續套自由溢流曲線將造成系統流量誤差。診斷時應採取以下查核：以容積計時法抽驗率定曲線並攝錄水舌與尾水高度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying a free-flow rating during submergence creates systematic discharge error. Diagnose it by the following check: Check the rating by timed-volume collection and record nappe ventilation and tailwater. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「自由溢流率定可以不管尾水高度直接套用」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A free-flow rating remains valid regardless of tailwater elevation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 集水分區水量平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Zoned drainage water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水分區水量平衡」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zoned drainage water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 量測槽可同時接收壩體滲水、地表逕流與維護排水，只有辨認來源才能推估穿越壩體的部分。用相同時間窗做分區平衡並檢查儲水變化；若集水坑水位持續上升，出流並不等於入流，短時事件更需保留集水系統的滯留量。 驗證時應獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，並辨識以下失效情境：省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水分區水量平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A collection channel may receive embankment seepage, surface runoff and maintenance water. Separate these sources within a common observation window and include storage change. When sump level rises, discharge is not equal to inflow; transient events require the collection system retention term rather than a simple subtraction of unmatched readings. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Zoned drainage water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Steady sump: measured=18 L/s; rainfallRunoff=5 L/s; maintenance=2 L/s; inferredSeepage=18-5-2=11 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Steady sump: measured=18 L/s; rainfallRunoff=5 L/s; maintenance=2 L/s; inferredSeepage=18-5-2=11 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水分區水量平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Zoned drainage water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Steady sump: measured=18 L/s; rainfallRunoff=5 L/s; maintenance=2 L/s; inferredSeepage=18-5-2=11 L/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 集水分區水量平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Zoned drainage water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水分區水量平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Zoned drainage water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

steps.title: 集水分區水量平衡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Zoned drainage water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水分區水量平衡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Zoned drainage water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。診斷時應採取以下查核：獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. Diagnose it by the following check: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有集水槽流量都是穿越壩體的地下水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every collected drainage flow is groundwater passing through the dam" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。診斷時應採取以下查核：獨立量測地表截水溝與維護排放並核對集水坑水位穩定，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. Diagnose it by the following check: Meter surface interception and maintenance releases independently and verify steady sump level. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水分區水量平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Zoned drainage water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。
儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse.
A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly
quiz.explanation: 省略集水坑蓄水變化會把抽水週期誤讀為壩體滲流脈動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring sump storage turns pump cycling into an apparent seepage pulse. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔壓響應與延遲」與「水溫黏度與流量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Piezometer response and lag" and "Temperature viscosity and discharge": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔壓響應與延遲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Piezometer response and lag: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓響應與延遲」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Piezometer response and lag” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。簡化一階響應能解釋量測滯後，但不能把傳感器時間常數當成地層擴散參數。應將儀器試驗與庫水位事件分開分析，避免錯置因果時序。 驗證時應對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓響應與延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay. A first-order response illustrates instrument lag but its time constant is not automatically a ground diffusivity. Separate sensor response testing from reservoir events before assigning a causal order to observed changes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Piezometer response and lag” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓響應與延遲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Piezometer response and lag”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓響應與延遲
knowledge.text: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。簡化一階響應能解釋量測滯後，但不能把傳感器時間常數當成地層擴散參數。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay. A first-order response illustrates instrument lag but its time constant is not automatically a ground diffusivity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓響應與延遲」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Piezometer response and lag" is correct?
options: 儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。
optionsEn: A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay.
quiz.explanation: 感測器與地層的水力連通性決定水位變化多久能被量到；低滲透層或堵塞濾頭會增加延遲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic connection between the sensor and ground determines response time; low permeability or a clogged tip increases delay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓響應與延遲：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Piezometer response and lag: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓響應與延遲」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Piezometer response and lag” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: First-order step: deltaHead=4 m; tau=6 h; elapsed=12 h; observedRise=4*(1-exp(-12/6))=3.45866 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 孔壓響應與延遲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Piezometer response and lag: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓響應與延遲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Piezometer response and lag” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 孔壓響應與延遲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Piezometer response and lag: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓響應與延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Piezometer response and lag” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照獨立孔壓計與已知水位階躍並檢查濾頭復原試驗，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare an independent piezometer during a known stage change and inspect tip recovery tests. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「儀器反應慢就證明地層孔壓一定變化慢」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A slow sensor response proves that ground pressure changes slowly" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓響應與延遲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Piezometer response and lag" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure.
quiz.explanation: 堵塞造成慢響應可能被誤判成穩定低孔壓。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clogging-induced slow response can be mistaken for stable low pore pressure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水溫黏度與流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Temperature viscosity and discharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水溫黏度與流量」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Temperature viscosity and discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。以固定密度近似時導水率與動力黏度成反比；若介質不飽和、裂隙開度改變或水化反應發生，單一溫度修正不能恢復可比性。 驗證時應同步量測出水溫度並將同水頭的流量按黏度比正規化，並辨識以下失效情境：未補償水溫就提高警戒線可能掩蓋真正導水通道增長。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水溫黏度與流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration. At approximately fixed density, conductivity varies inversely with dynamic viscosity. Temperature normalization cannot restore comparability if saturation, fracture aperture or chemical alteration has also changed; those require separate observations. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure outlet temperature simultaneously and normalize like-head discharge by the viscosity ratio. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Raising triggers without temperature correction can conceal genuine pathway growth. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Temperature viscosity and discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水溫黏度與流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Temperature viscosity and discharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水溫黏度與流量
knowledge.text: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。以固定密度近似時導水率與動力黏度成反比；若介質不飽和、裂隙開度改變或水化反應發生，單一溫度修正不能恢復可比性。
knowledge.textEn: Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration. At approximately fixed density, conductivity varies inversely with dynamic viscosity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水溫黏度與流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Temperature viscosity and discharge" is correct?
options: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。
季節流量增加就表示孔隙已被沖大
濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量
optionsEn: Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration.
Seasonal flow growth proves that soil pores have enlarged
The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre
quiz.explanation: 水的動黏度變化會影響同一孔隙結構的水力傳導，季節流量漂移不全代表材料劣化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water viscosity changes hydraulic conductivity even when pore geometry remains unchanged, so seasonal drift need not indicate deterioration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水溫黏度與流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Temperature viscosity and discharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水溫黏度與流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Temperature viscosity and discharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測出水溫度並將同水頭的流量按黏度比正規化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure outlet temperature simultaneously and normalize like-head discharge by the viscosity ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Same head and geometry; Qcold=8 L/s; muCold=1.30 mPa*s; muWarm=1.00 mPa*s; Qwarm=8*1.30/1.00=10.4 L/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水溫黏度與流量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Temperature viscosity and discharge", which statement holds?
options: 兩支共用電源感測器已經具備獨立備援

孔壓數值可以直接與不同高程的水位相比

steps.title: 含砂濃度與輸砂：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「含砂濃度與輸砂」如何影響壩體滲流監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suspended concentration and sediment flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seepage monitoring in dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濁度是光學訊號而不是直接泥砂質量，顆粒粒徑、色澤與氣泡皆會改變率定關係。要估算輸砂需採水樣測懸浮固體濃度，再與同時流量相乘；清澈水也不能排除早期內部沖蝕，因顆粒可能在下游反濾中被攔住。 驗證時應同步採取重量法水樣與濁度訊號並記錄粒徑及流量，並辨識以下失效情境：氣泡提高濁度但沒有增加固體質量會引發錯誤輸砂警報。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含砂濃度與輸砂」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration. Estimate sediment flux from sampled suspended concentration multiplied by simultaneous discharge. Clear water does not exclude early internal erosion because mobilized grains may remain trapped in downstream filters instead of reaching the outlet. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Pair gravimetric water samples with turbidity readings and document grain size and discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Bubbles raise turbidity without adding solid mass and can trigger false sediment alarms. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suspended concentration and sediment flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=0.012 m3/s; sampledSSC=80 mg/L=0.080 kg/m3; massFlux=0.012*0.080*3600=3.456 kg/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The turbidity number directly equals sediment mass per litre" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含砂濃度與輸砂」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suspended concentration and sediment flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含砂濃度與輸砂

knowledge.textEn: Turbidity is an optical signal rather than sediment mass; grain size, color and bubbles affect its calibration. Estimate sediment flux from sampled suspended concentration multiplied by simultaneous discharge.

knowledge.text: 誤解：濁度數字可以直接當作每公升泥砂重量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
