stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裂縫流量與留土試驗」與「變形相容與連續性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crack discharge and retention testing" and "Deformation compatibility and continuity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 裂縫流量與留土試驗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crack discharge and retention testing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「裂縫流量與留土試驗」如何影響土石壩反濾層設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crack discharge and retention testing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filter-zone design for embankment dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾應能在基土裂縫供水下阻止持續侵蝕，但裂縫幾何與壓力集中不能由均質達西模型代表。矩形水槽式流量只是給定平均速度的連續方程，不預測裂縫速度；試驗需觀察侵蝕是否停止及流量是否穩定，而非只看最初清水外觀。 驗證時應在指定試驗壓差下同步量測出流與流失乾土質量直到趨勢可判讀，並辨識以下失效情境：只在低壓差做短時試驗可能漏掉後續持續侵蝕。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「裂縫流量與留土試驗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must arrest continuing erosion when a base-soil crack supplies water, a concentrated condition poorly represented by uniform Darcy flow. A rectangular opening calculation applies continuity at a prescribed mean velocity and does not predict crack velocity. Test whether erosion arrests and flow stabilizes rather than judging initial water clarity. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure discharge and lost dry-soil mass together under the specified pressure difference. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A short low-head test may miss continuing erosion at later conditions. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crack discharge and retention testing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed crack opening=0.004 m; height=0.50 m; measuredMeanVelocity=0.30 m/s; Q=0.004*0.50*0.30=0.00060 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed crack opening=0.004 m; height=0.50 m; measuredMeanVelocity=0.30 m/s; Q=0.004*0.50*0.30=0.00060 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初期出水清澈就證明持續侵蝕已經停止」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Initially clear discharge proves that continuing erosion has stopped" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「裂縫流量與留土試驗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crack discharge and retention testing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 裂縫流量與留土試驗
knowledge.text: 反濾應能在基土裂縫供水下阻止持續侵蝕，但裂縫幾何與壓力集中不能由均質達西模型代表。矩形水槽式流量只是給定平均速度的連續方程，不預測裂縫速度；試驗需觀察侵蝕是否停止及流量是否穩定，而非只看最初清水外觀。
knowledge.textEn: Filters must arrest continuing erosion when a base-soil crack supplies water, a concentrated condition poorly represented by uniform Darcy flow. A rectangular opening calculation applies continuity at a prescribed mean velocity and does not predict crack velocity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初期出水清澈就證明持續侵蝕已經停止 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Initially clear discharge proves that continuing erosion has stopped Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「裂縫流量與留土試驗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crack discharge and retention testing" is correct?
options: 反濾應能在基土裂縫供水下阻止持續侵蝕，但裂縫幾何與壓力集中不能由均質達西模型代表。
初期出水清澈就證明持續侵蝕已經停止
顆粒可以重排就保證任何變形後仍連續
optionsEn: Filters must arrest continuing erosion when a base-soil crack supplies water, a concentrated condition poorly represented by uniform Darcy flow.
Initially clear discharge proves that continuing erosion has stopped
Particle rearrangement guarantees continuity after any amount of deformation
quiz.explanation: 反濾應能在基土裂縫供水下阻止持續侵蝕，但裂縫幾何與壓力集中不能由均質達西模型代表。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must arrest continuing erosion when a base-soil crack supplies water, a concentrated condition poorly represented by uniform Darcy flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裂縫流量與留土試驗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crack discharge and retention testing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裂縫流量與留土試驗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crack discharge and retention testing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed crack opening=0.004 m; height=0.50 m; measuredMeanVelocity=0.30 m/s; Q=0.004*0.50*0.30=0.00060 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed crack opening=0.004 m; height=0.50 m; measuredMeanVelocity=0.30 m/s; Q=0.004*0.50*0.30=0.00060 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在指定試驗壓差下同步量測出流與流失乾土質量直到趨勢可判讀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure discharge and lost dry-soil mass together under the specified pressure difference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Assumed crack opening=0.004 m; height=0.50 m; measuredMeanVelocity=0.30 m/s; Q=0.004*0.50*0.30=0.00060 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instructionEn: Dam settlement can bend or shear a filter zone and separate it from rigid structures. Granular rearrangement does not guarantee continuity after arbitrary deformation. knowledge.text: 交接時以比較相鄰沉陷測點與接觸面開口並檢查變形後材料連續性作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對與剛性牆面脫離會形成繞過反濾的集中水路，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare neighboring settlement points and interface openings and examine post-deformation material continuity. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Separation from a rigid wall creates a concentrated path around the filter. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「變形相容與連續性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deformation compatibility and continuity"?
options: 比較相鄰沉陷測點與接觸面開口並檢查變形後材料連續性。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
留土功能正常就表示排水出口一定暢通
optionsEn: Compare neighboring settlement points and interface openings and examine post-deformation material continuity.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Successful soil retention guarantees an unobstructed drainage outlet
quiz.explanation: 比較相鄰沉陷測點與接觸面開口並檢查變形後材料連續性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare neighboring settlement points and interface openings and examine post-deformation material continuity. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 變形相容與連續性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deformation compatibility and continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「變形相容與連續性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deformation compatibility and continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 與剛性牆面脫離會形成繞過反濾的集中水路。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較相鄰沉陷測點與接觸面開口並檢查變形後材料連續性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Separation from a rigid wall creates a concentrated path around the filter. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare neighboring settlement points and interface openings and examine post-deformation material continuity. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「顆粒可以重排就保證任何變形後仍連續」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Particle rearrangement guarantees continuity after any amount of deformation" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 與剛性牆面脫離會形成繞過反濾的集中水路。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較相鄰沉陷測點與接觸面開口並檢查變形後材料連續性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Separation from a rigid wall creates a concentrated path around the filter. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare neighboring settlement points and interface openings and examine post-deformation material continuity. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「變形相容與連續性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Deformation compatibility and continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
與剛性牆面脫離會形成繞過反濾的集中水路。
單一粒徑比可以批准所有不同土類反濾
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Separation from a rigid wall creates a concentrated path around the filter.
One grain-size ratio can approve filters for every soil class
quiz.explanation: 與剛性牆面脫離會形成繞過反濾的集中水路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Separation from a rigid wall creates a concentrated path around the filter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 水庫邊坡穩定監測
courses.summary: 本課以整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡為主線，先用有效應力與孔壓與無限邊坡力學示意界定水力與構造條件，再將衛星定位共同誤差、位移速率與加速度連結到監測不確定與應變。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement through Effective stress and pore pressure and Infinite slope force illustration, then connects GNSS common-mode errors and Displacement rate and acceleration to Monitoring uncertainty and response. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 整合庫水位降雨孔壓與三維位移判讀邊坡
courses.focusEn: Integrating reservoir stage rainfall pore pressure and three-dimensional slope displacement
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查有效應力與孔壓：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa；再獨立檢查無限邊坡力學示意：Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348。敏感度：相同總正應力150kPa下，孔壓由60增為90kPa，有效正應力由90降為60kPa；固定摩擦角30度時摩擦抗力由51.96降為34.64kPa，減少三分之一。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以合成邊坡作機制識別，無法由單一位移序列預測崩塌時間或湧浪。 將對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Effective stress and pore pressure: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. Independently examine Infinite slope force illustration: Dry cohesionless slope: phi=32 degrees; beta=24 degrees; FS=tan(32 degrees)/tan(24 degrees)=1.40348. Sensitivity: at total normal stress150kPa, raising pore pressure from60 to90kPa reduces effective normal stress from90 to60kPa. With a fixed30-degree friction angle, frictional resistance decreases from51.96 to34.64kPa, a one-third reduction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Synthetic slopes illustrate mechanisms; a single displacement series cannot predict failure time or impulse waves. Use the following independent check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效應力與孔壓」與「無限邊坡力學示意」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective stress and pore pressure" and "Infinite slope force illustration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效應力與孔壓」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress and pore pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。必須將坡內孔壓與滑面總應力分開估計，不能只用庫水位替代；簡化摩擦式也忽略了吸力、軟化與漸進破壞。 驗證時應將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較，並辨識以下失效情境：孔壓消散慢於外水位下降可降低有效抗剪能力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效應力與孔壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress. Falling reservoir stage may remove external support before internal pressure dissipates. Estimate total stress and slip-surface pore pressure separately rather than replacing internal head with reservoir level; the simple friction law also omits suction, softening and progressive failure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Pore pressure lagging external drawdown can reduce available shear resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress and pore pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效應力與孔壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress and pore pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效應力與孔壓
knowledge.text: 水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。必須將坡內孔壓與滑面總應力分開估計，不能只用庫水位替代；簡化摩擦式也忽略了吸力、軟化與漸進破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress. Falling reservoir stage may remove external support before internal pressure dissipates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效應力與孔壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress and pore pressure" is correct?
options: 庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低
水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。
示意安全係數足以核准複雜邊坡安全
optionsEn: Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction
Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress.
An illustrative factor of safety approves a complex slope
quiz.explanation: 水庫邊坡的抗剪能力受滑面有效正應力控制，外部水位下降可能移除坡腳水壓支撐，內部孔壓卻尚未消散。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Slope resistance depends on effective normal stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效應力與孔壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress and pore pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效應力與孔壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress and pore pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將滑面附近孔壓時序與庫水位下降段對齊比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align pore pressures near the potential slip surface with reservoir drawdown intervals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: sigmaNormal=150 kPa; u=60 kPa; phi=30 degrees; friction=(150-60)*tan(30 degrees)=51.9615 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效應力與孔壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress and pore pressure", which statement holds?
options: 測斜孔底只要夠深就一定是固定基準

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Infinite slope force illustration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻無限邊坡把重量分解為沿坡驅動與垂直坡面的正力，適合展示厚度、坡角與孔壓的作用，不能代表複雜旋轉滑動。所用深度須明定為垂直深度，否則三角函數形式不同；有側向約束與分層時應改用合適的分析模型。 驗證時應以剖面地形確認平行滑面假設並對摩擦角做獨立試驗，並辨識以下失效情境：把乾燥簡式套在高孔壓層會高估抗滑比。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無限邊坡力學示意」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An infinite-slope idealization resolves weight into driving and normal components, illustrating depth, angle and pore-pressure effects without representing rotational slides. Specify vertical depth because slope-normal thickness produces different geometry. Lateral confinement, layering and curved slip surfaces require a different analysis rather than hidden adjustments to this equation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the parallel-plane assumption against cross-sections and test friction angle independently. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using the dry expression in a high-pressure layer overstates resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.title: 水文傳遞時間尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hydrological diffusion time scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水文傳遞時間尺度」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hydrological diffusion time scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 降雨與庫水位會透過不同通道影響孔壓，擴散時間約隨距離平方增加，因此深層反應可能晚於地表事件。特徵時間只給量級，裂縫對流、非飽和入滲與變動邊界均會偏離均質擴散；應用多深度觀測區分傳遞機制。 驗證時應比較不同深度孔壓峰值時差並保留降雨強度與庫水位紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：把相關時差直接當因果證明可能漏掉共同季節驅動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水文傳遞時間尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rainfall and reservoir stage influence pressures through different pathways. A diffusion time scale grows with distance squared, so deep response may lag surface forcing. This is an order-of-magnitude estimate; fracture advection, unsaturated infiltration and moving boundaries depart from uniform diffusion and require observations at several depths. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare pressure-peak delays by depth alongside rainfall intensity and reservoir-stage records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating correlation lag as causation can overlook a common seasonal driver. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hydrological diffusion time scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 水位降速與內水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown rate and internal head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位降速與內水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown rate and internal head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把庫水位當全坡內水頭會忽略快速洩降的不利滯後。診斷時應採取以下查核：對照庫水位與滑面孔壓下降量並檢查停降後是否繼續消散，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Substituting reservoir stage for all internal heads ignores adverse rapid-drawdown lag. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare reservoir and slip-surface head reductions and observe continued dissipation during a hold. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均洩降速率就是每一土層的排水速率」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean reservoir drawdown rate equals drainage rate in every layer" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「潛在滑體與影響範圍」與「監測不確定與應變」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Potential slide volume and consequences" and "Monitoring uncertainty and response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 潛在滑體與影響範圍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Potential slide volume and consequences: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潛在滑體與影響範圍」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Potential slide volume and consequences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滑體幾何是後果分析的起點，但體積本身不能決定湧浪高度；入水速度、深度、滑體形狀與水庫幾何也重要。用簡化稜柱估體積應清楚標示平均厚度假設，再以地質界面、地形與鑽探檢驗範圍，避免把包絡體積當精確崩塌量。 驗證時應用鑽孔與地表裂縫約束滑面深度並對厚度範圍做敏感度，並辨識以下失效情境：把最大厚度套用整個面積會系統高估稜柱體積。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潛在滑體與影響範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Slide geometry begins consequence assessment, but volume alone does not determine wave height. Entry velocity, depth, shape and reservoir geometry also matter. A prism estimate must state its average-thickness assumption and be checked against geology, terrain and boreholes rather than presented as an exact failure volume. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Constrain slip depth with boreholes and surface cracks and vary the thickness range. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Applying maximum thickness over the entire area systematically overestimates prism volume. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Potential slide volume and consequences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：PlanArea=18000 m2; assumedMeanThickness=12 m; prismVolume=18000*12=216000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: PlanArea=18000 m2; assumedMeanThickness=12 m; prismVolume=18000*12=216000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只知道滑體體積就能決定入庫湧浪高度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Slide volume alone determines reservoir impulse-wave height" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潛在滑體與影響範圍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Potential slide volume and consequences”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 監測不確定與應變：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「監測不確定與應變」如何影響水庫邊坡穩定監測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring uncertainty and response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-slope stability monitoring”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儀器雜訊、基準誤差與空間代表性共同影響警戒解釋；兩個獨立時點差值的誤差不是單次精度。以合成標準不確定度可判斷訊號相對雜訊，但工程應變還需失效模式、資料可用率與既定責任鏈，不能僅依統計倍數自動停工。 驗證時應將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，並辨識以下失效情境：沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監測不確定與應變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Noise, reference errors and spatial representativeness influence alerts. The uncertainty of a difference between independent epochs is not one-epoch precision. Combined standard uncertainty describes signal relative to noise, while response also depends on failure modes, data availability and assigned responsibilities rather than an automatic statistical multiplier. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Monitoring uncertainty and response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Independent epoch standard uncertainties=2 and2 mm; displacementChangeU=sqrt(2**2+2**2)=2.82843 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提升量測精密度就不需要工程應變程序」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監測不確定與應變」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring uncertainty and response"?
options: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
短期加速足以決定精確的邊坡失穩時刻
optionsEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Short-term acceleration determines the exact time of slope failure
quiz.explanation: 將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測不確定與應變：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測不確定與應變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring uncertainty and response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。診斷時應採取以下查核：將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Diagnose it by the following check: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「提升量測精密度就不需要工程應變程序」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher measurement precision removes the need for response procedures" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。診斷時應採取以下查核：將共同基準偏差另列並以演練檢查警報到現場回報的流程，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Diagnose it by the following check: Separate shared reference bias and exercise the process from alarm to field confirmation. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測不確定與應變」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring uncertainty and response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。
庫水位降低就保證坡內孔壓同時降低
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action.
Falling reservoir stage guarantees simultaneous internal pore-pressure reduction
quiz.explanation: 沒有現場回報閉環的警報可能持續失去實際處置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An alarm without field-confirmation feedback can remain disconnected from action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 溢洪道消能池
courses.summary: 本課以由水躍共軛水深連結尾水底板與消能驗證為主線，先用單寬流量與入流與福祿數與流態界定水力與構造條件，再將尾水餘量與跳躍、墩塊動量作用連結到模型比例與尺度。只採矩形明渠及局部穩態示意；消能池型式與尺寸須依完整水理及結構試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops connecting hydraulic-jump depths tailwater slabs and energy-dissipation verification through Unit discharge and approach flow and Froude number and regime, then connects Tailwater margin and jump position and Baffle-block momentum action to Model ratios and scale effects. Rectangular-channel and locally steady examples do not select basin type or replace hydraulic and structural testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 由水躍共軛水深連結尾水底板與消能驗證
courses.focusEn: Connecting hydraulic-jump depths tailwater slabs and energy-dissipation verification
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查單寬流量與入流：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s；再獨立檢查福祿數與流態：V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless。敏感度：流速由12增為15m/s且入流水深維持1m，福祿數由3.831增為4.789，共軛水深由4.941增為6.291m；尾水需求不隨速度線性增加。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。只採矩形明渠及局部穩態示意；消能池型式與尺寸須依完整水理及結構試驗。 將核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Unit discharge and approach flow: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. Independently examine Froude number and regime: V=12 m/s; y=1 m; g=9.81 m/s2; Fr=12/sqrt(9.81*1)=3.83131 dimensionless. Sensitivity: increasing velocity from12 to15m/s at1m incoming depth changes Froude number from3.831 to4.789 and conjugate depth from4.941 to6.291m. Tailwater demand therefore does not scale linearly with velocity. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Rectangular-channel and locally steady examples do not select basin type or replace hydraulic and structural testing. Use the following independent check: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「單寬流量與入流」與「福祿數與流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Unit discharge and approach flow" and "Froude number and regime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「單寬流量與入流」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit discharge and approach flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。槽末彎道、墩柱與收縮會讓局部速度高於平均，進而改變水躍位置與底板壓力。先核對有效過水寬及水深定義，再把全寬分布與整體流量相互核算。 驗證時應以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略局部高速帶會低估局部水躍與底板荷載。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單寬流量與入流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. Bends, piers and contraction can create local velocities above the mean and shift the jump and slab pressures. Check effective width and depth definitions, then reconcile cross-sectional distributions with total discharge. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring high-velocity strips underestimates local jump behavior and slab loading. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit discharge and approach flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「單寬流量與入流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit discharge and approach flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 單寬流量與入流
knowledge.text: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。槽末彎道、墩柱與收縮會讓局部速度高於平均，進而改變水躍位置與底板壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. Bends, piers and contraction can create local velocities above the mean and shift the jump and slab pressures.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單寬流量與入流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unit discharge and approach flow" is correct?
options: 平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速
消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。
福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同
optionsEn: Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin
Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure.
Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere
quiz.explanation: 消能池入流可能沿寬度不均，平均單寬流量只能作第一輪水力整理。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Basin inflow may vary across the width, so mean unit discharge is an initial bookkeeping measure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單寬流量與入流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit discharge and approach flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單寬流量與入流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit discharge and approach flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=240 m3/s; width=20 m; depth=1 m; meanVelocity=240/(20*1)=12 m/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以橫向多點速度與水深積分核對總流量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Integrate transverse velocity and depth measurements to check total discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 福祿數比較慣性與重力作用，矩形斷面以水深作水力深度。超臨界入流需要透過水躍或其他機制轉換，但福祿數本身不能選定消能池完整構造；相同數值下，入流水層厚度、含氣量與尾水變動仍可能產生不同壓力波動。 驗證時應比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀，並辨識以下失效情境：非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「福祿數與流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Froude number compares inertia with gravity, using water depth as hydraulic depth in a rectangular section. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.instructionEn: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. steps.titleEn: Froude number and regime: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「福祿數與流態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Froude number and regime” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 非矩形槽誤用總水深會算錯控制流態的水力深度。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較表面波傳播與實測水深速度並標示斷面形狀，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total depth in a nonrectangular channel misstates the hydraulic depth. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare surface-wave behavior with measured depth and velocity and identify section geometry. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「福祿數相同就保證全部局部壓力相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal Froude numbers guarantee equal local pressures everywhere" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「共軛水深與動量」與「水躍能量損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conjugate depth and momentum" and "Hydraulic jump energy loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 共軛水深與動量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conjugate depth and momentum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「共軛水深與動量」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conjugate depth and momentum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。這不是能量守恆問題，因渦流會耗散機械能；若有強烈坡度、墩塊或淹沒效應，需將外力與邊界納入，而不能硬套水平矩形公式。 驗證時應在滾流區外量測上下游水深並核對尾水是否控制跳躍，並辨識以下失效情境：在紊亂滾流內取水深會破壞靜水壓斷面的假設。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「共軛水深與動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. Mechanical energy is dissipated, so energy conservation cannot replace momentum. Strong slope, appurtenance forces or submergence require additional boundary terms instead of unconditional use of the horizontal rectangular formula. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure depths outside the roller and check whether tailwater controls jump position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Sampling depth inside the turbulent roller violates the hydrostatic-section assumption. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conjugate depth and momentum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「共軛水深與動量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conjugate depth and momentum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 共軛水深與動量
knowledge.text: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。這不是能量守恆問題，因渦流會耗散機械能；若有強烈坡度、墩塊或淹沒效應，需將外力與邊界納入，而不能硬套水平矩形公式。
knowledge.textEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. Mechanical energy is dissipated, so energy conservation cannot replace momentum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「共軛水深與動量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conjugate depth and momentum" is correct?
options: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。
水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深

optionsEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected.
Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump
Dissipated mechanical energy automatically becomes usable electrical power
quiz.explanation: 短水躍可在忽略床面摩阻且壓力近靜水的前後斷面使用動量平衡，得到共軛水深。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Across a short jump, momentum balance between approximately hydrostatic sections gives conjugate depths when bed friction is neglected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 共軛水深與動量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conjugate depth and momentum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「共軛水深與動量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conjugate depth and momentum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在滾流區外量測上下游水深並核對尾水是否控制跳躍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure depths outside the roller and check whether tailwater controls jump position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「共軛水深與動量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conjugate depth and momentum", which statement holds?
options: 平均揚壓合格就排除了瞬時掀板風險
壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力
optionsEn: Acceptable mean uplift eliminates transient slab-lifting risk
Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m.
Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: y1=1 m; Fr1=12/sqrt(9.81); y2=0.5*y1*(sqrt(1+8*Fr1**2)-1)=4.94130 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 把量測壓力波動當靜水深可能造成假能量增益。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較上下游比能與流量並確認斷面遠離滾流區，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating fluctuating pressure as hydrostatic depth can create an apparent energy gain. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare upstream and downstream specific energy and discharge outside the roller. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Dissipated mechanical energy automatically becomes usable electrical power" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水躍能量損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hydraulic jump energy loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。

最大洪水必定是水躍位置最不利工況
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating fluctuating pressure as hydrostatic depth can create an apparent energy gain.

quiz.explanation: 把量測壓力波動當靜水深可能造成假能量增益。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating fluctuating pressure as hydrostatic depth can create an apparent energy gain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「尾水餘量與跳躍」與「底板揚壓與排水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tailwater margin and jump position" and "Slab uplift and drainage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 尾水餘量與跳躍：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tailwater margin and jump position: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「尾水餘量與跳躍」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tailwater margin and jump position” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 尾水不足會使水躍向下游移動甚至掃出池外，過高尾水則可能造成淹沒與不同壓力型態。比較尾水和所需共軛水深的差值有助整理工況，但不構成單一安全準則；應對洪水歷線、河床變動及下游控制進行組合試驗。 驗證時應逐一比較流量與尾水配對下的水躍位置和出池流速，並辨識以下失效情境：只測最高洪水可能漏掉中流量尾水不足的工況。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「尾水餘量與跳躍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Insufficient tailwater can move the jump downstream or sweep it out of the basin; excessive tailwater can submerge it and change pressures. The depth difference organizes operating cases but is not a universal safety criterion. Test flood hydrographs, bed changes and downstream controls in relevant combinations. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare jump location and exit velocity for paired discharge and tailwater conditions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Testing only the largest flood can miss inadequate tailwater at intermediate discharge. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tailwater margin and jump position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：ObservedTailwater=5.4 m; requiredConjugateDepth=5.0 m; depthMargin=5.4-5.0=0.40 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: ObservedTailwater=5.4 m; requiredConjugateDepth=5.0 m; depthMargin=5.4-5.0=0.40 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大洪水必定是水躍位置最不利工況」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The largest flood is always the worst jump-location condition" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「尾水餘量與跳躍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tailwater margin and jump position”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 尾水餘量與跳躍

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大洪水必定是水躍位置最不利工況 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The largest flood is always the worst jump-location condition Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「尾水餘量與跳躍」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Acceptable mean uplift eliminates transient slab-lifting risk

steps.title: 尾水餘量與跳躍：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tailwater margin and jump position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「尾水餘量與跳躍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tailwater margin and jump position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：ObservedTailwater=5.4 m; requiredConjugateDepth=5.0 m; depthMargin=5.4-5.0=0.40 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: ObservedTailwater=5.4 m; requiredConjugateDepth=5.0 m; depthMargin=5.4-5.0=0.40 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一比較流量與尾水配對下的水躍位置和出池流速。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare jump location and exit velocity for paired discharge and tailwater conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：ObservedTailwater=5.4 m; requiredConjugateDepth=5.0 m; depthMargin=5.4-5.0=0.40 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「尾水餘量與跳躍」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Testing only the largest flood can miss inadequate tailwater at intermediate discharge. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the largest flood can miss inadequate tailwater at intermediate discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 底板揚壓與排水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slab uplift and drainage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底板揚壓與排水」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slab uplift and drainage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底板下滲透壓與板面脈動壓力共同決定淨向上作用，排水有效性可隨堵塞改變。以平均水頭差估揚力只處理靜態部分；接縫入壓、錨筋分配及板塊動態反應需另分析，不能用自重平衡取代完整疲勞與掀板評估。 驗證時應同步量測板面與板底壓力並檢查排水孔通暢與接縫狀態，並辨識以下失效情境：接縫高速入水可瞬間增加局部底板下壓力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底板揚壓與排水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subslab pressure and fluctuating surface pressure determine net uplift, while drain effectiveness can deteriorate through blockage. An average head difference estimates only a static component. Joint pressurization, anchor load distribution and slab dynamics require separate checks; simple deadweight balance does not replace fatigue or hydraulic-jacking assessment. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures above and below the slab simultaneously and inspect drains and joints. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: High-speed flow entering a joint can rapidly increase local subslab pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slab uplift and drainage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 底板揚壓與排水：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; netHead=2 m; slabArea=30 m2; uplift=1000*9.81*2*30/1000=588.6 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; netHead=2 m; slabArea=30 m2; uplift=1000*9.81*2*30/1000=588.6 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 底板揚壓與排水：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「底板揚壓與排水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Slab uplift and drainage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測板面與板底壓力並檢查排水孔通暢與接縫狀態。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「接縫高速入水可瞬間增加局部底板下壓力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure pressures above and below the slab simultaneously and inspect drains and joints. steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure pressures above and below the slab simultaneously and inspect drains and joints. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: High-speed flow entering a joint can rapidly increase local subslab pressure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接縫高速入水可瞬間增加局部底板下壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

One sensor does not define the resultant on a whole slab. Use synchronized arrays to distinguish excitation near structural resonance from broader turbulence and preserve the observation duration used for statistics. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜
knowledge.text: 紊流壓力的均方根反映波動強度，但極值與持續時間還依頻譜、空間相關與採樣率而異。單點量測不能直接代表整塊底板合力；應建立多點同步紀錄，分辨結構共振附近的頻率與一般寬頻湍流。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure RMS describes fluctuation intensity, while extremes and duration depend on spectrum, spatial correlation and sampling. One sensor does not define the resultant on a whole slab.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「脈動壓力與頻譜」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fluctuating pressure and spectrum" is correct?
options: 壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力
池內殘留砂礫少就表示磨耗可以忽略
紊流壓力的均方根反映波動強度，但極值與持續時間還依頻譜、空間相關與採樣率而異。
optionsEn: Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure
Little retained sediment means abrasion can be ignored
Pressure RMS describes fluctuation intensity, while extremes and duration depend on spectrum, spatial correlation and sampling.
quiz.explanation: 紊流壓力的均方根反映波動強度，但極值與持續時間還依頻譜、空間相關與採樣率而異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure RMS describes fluctuation intensity, while extremes and duration depend on spectrum, spatial correlation and sampling. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fluctuating pressure and spectrum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「脈動壓力與頻譜」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「脈動壓力與頻譜」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fluctuating pressure and spectrum", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。
平均流速可以當作整個消能池最大流速
水躍前後可用機械能相等直接求水深
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa.
Mean velocity represents the maximum velocity throughout the basin
Equal mechanical energy determines depths across a hydraulic jump
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Zero-mean samples=-6,0,6 kPa; RMS=sqrt((36+0+36)/3)=4.89898 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fluctuating pressure and spectrum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「脈動壓力與頻譜」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
