quiz.question: 要驗證「脈動壓力與頻譜」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fluctuating pressure and spectrum"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性。
最大洪水必定是水躍位置最不利工況
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors.
The largest flood is always the worst jump-location condition
quiz.explanation: 核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 脈動壓力與頻譜：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fluctuating pressure and spectrum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「脈動壓力與頻譜」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fluctuating pressure and spectrum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. Diagnose it by the following check: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力均方根就是底板最大設計壓力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Root-mean-square pressure equals the maximum slab design pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對採樣頻率與抗混疊設定並比較相鄰壓力感測器的相干性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. Diagnose it by the following check: Check sample rate and anti-alias filtering and compare coherence between adjacent pressure sensors. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「脈動壓力與頻譜」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fluctuating pressure and spectrum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
池內殘留砂礫少就表示磨耗可以忽略
採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Little retained sediment means abrasion can be ignored
Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance.
quiz.explanation: 採樣過慢可把高頻壓力錯折成假的低頻共振。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slow sampling can alias high-frequency pressure into false low-frequency resonance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「滯留砂礫與磨耗」與「模型比例與尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Retained sediment and abrasion" and "Model ratios and scale effects": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 滯留砂礫與磨耗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Retained sediment and abrasion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滯留砂礫與磨耗」如何影響溢洪道消能池的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Retained sediment and abrasion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stilling basins for spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 池內回流可反覆搬運砂礫，使磨耗集中於底板與角隅，即使總體能量消散良好也會損傷表面。質量盤點能辨認材料是否滯留，但磨耗速率還受硬度、粒徑與接觸速度控制；需將清淤前後地形與實際磨耗深度聯合分析。 驗證時應重測池底高程與砂礫粒徑並核對清淤稱重紀錄，並辨識以下失效情境：反覆滾動的少量硬礫也可能造成嚴重局部磨坑。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滯留砂礫與磨耗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Recirculation can repeatedly move gravel against slabs and corners even when overall dissipation is effective. A mass balance identifies retention but does not determine abrasion rate, which also depends on hardness, size and contact velocity. Compare precleaning and postcleaning bathymetry with measured surface loss. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Resurvey basin elevations and sediment sizes and reconcile weighed cleaning records. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A small quantity of repeatedly circulating hard gravel can excavate deep local pits. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Retained sediment and abrasion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：IncomingSediment=18 t; outgoingSediment=11 t; removedByCleaning=2 t; retainedIncrease=18-11-2=5 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: IncomingSediment=18 t; outgoingSediment=11 t; removedByCleaning=2 t; retainedIncrease=18-11-2=5 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「池內殘留砂礫少就表示磨耗可以忽略」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Little retained sediment means abrasion can be ignored" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滯留砂礫與磨耗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Retained sediment and abrasion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 核對模型雷諾數與表面張力影響並以不同尺度重複關鍵工況。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 模型比例與尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model ratios and scale effects: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型比例與尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model ratios and scale effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過小模型可能壓低含氣量並扭曲壓力波動。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對模型雷諾數與表面張力影響並以不同尺度重複關鍵工況，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An excessively small model can suppress aeration and distort pressure fluctuations. Diagnose it by the following check: Check model Reynolds and surface-tension effects and repeat critical cases at another scale. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「福祿相似保證所有物理效應完全相似」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Froude similarity guarantees similarity of every physical effect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 滑雪跳台式消能工
courses.summary: 本課以追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界為主線，先用挑流彈道與落點與落差與飛行時間界定水力與構造條件，再將射流功率與承受區、入水動量與方向連結到福祿尺度與表面張力。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries through Jet trajectory and landing point and Drop height and flight time, then connects Jet power and receiving zone and Impact momentum and direction to Froude scaling and surface tension. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 追蹤挑流軌跡入水動量與岩床沖蝕邊界
courses.focusEn: Tracing flip-bucket trajectories impact momentum and rock-scour boundaries
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查挑流彈道與落點：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m；再獨立檢查落差與飛行時間：UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s。敏感度：同高起落且挑角30度時，出口速度由20增至25m/s，理想射程由35.31增至55.17m，增加56.25%；射程隨速度平方變化但不代表沖刷深度同倍增加。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。彈道忽略空氣阻力且以自由射流示意，水墊與岩床反應須另外驗證。 將以多點同步壓力量測比較面積平均與局部峰值作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Jet trajectory and landing point: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m. Independently examine Drop height and flight time: UpwardVelocity=10 m/s; drop=8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; flightTime=(10+sqrt(10**2+2*9.81*8))/9.81=2.65341 s. Sensitivity: at equal launch and landing elevation and a30-degree angle, increasing exit velocity from20 to25m/s raises ideal range from35.31 to55.17m, a56.25 percent increase. Range scales with velocity squared, whereas scour depth does not follow the same rule. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Ballistic examples neglect air resistance and describe free jets; plunge-pool and rock responses require separate verification. Use the following independent check: Compare spatially averaged pressure with local peaks using synchronized pressure arrays. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「挑流彈道與落點」與「落差與飛行時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet trajectory and landing point" and "Drop height and flight time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 挑流彈道與落點：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet trajectory and landing point: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「挑流彈道與落點」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet trajectory and landing point” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 挑流鼻坎把高速水舌拋向下游水墊，落點受出口速度、角度與落差控制。忽略阻力的質點彈道只估中心線，實際水舌會展寬、破碎與含氣；必須確認使用的是水舌離坎速度而非上游平均速度，且不能把單一落點當成整個沖擊區。 驗證時應由高速攝影追蹤水舌邊界並核對出口速度與實際尾水高程，並辨識以下失效情境：把高水位尾水仍當同高落點會誤判沖擊位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「挑流彈道與落點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flip bucket throws a high-speed jet toward a downstream pool. Velocity, angle and elevation difference determine the ideal trajectory. A drag-free particle model estimates a centerline, while real jets spread, fragment and aerate; use launch velocity and distinguish the landing point from the entire impact footprint. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track jet boundaries with high-speed imaging and verify launch velocity and actual tailwater elevation. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Assuming equal elevations despite high tailwater misplaces the impact region. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet trajectory and landing point” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Equal launch/landing elevation; V=20 m/s; angle=30 degrees; range=20**2*sin(60 degrees)/9.81=35.3119 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「挑流彈道與落點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Bucket curvature and pressure" and "Velocity head and jet energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鼻坎曲率與壓力：機制與系統路徑

steps.instructionEn: Turning flow upward requires centripetal acceleration, so bucket pressure is not purely hydrostatic. A thin-layer approximation estimates added curvature pressure, but depth and velocity vary along the surface. Abrupt curvature transitions can produce separation; examine the pressure distribution instead of checking only the launch angle. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure pressures along the bucket and compare low-pressure regions with curvature transitions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Abrupt curvature transitions can cause separation and local cavitation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bucket curvature and pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; V=22 m/s; flowDepth=0.8 m; radius=18 m; curvaturePressure=rho*V**2*flowDepth/radius/1000=21.5111 kPa (SI pressure in Pa divided by1000)。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; V=22 m/s; flowDepth=0.8 m; radius=18 m; curvaturePressure=rho*V**2*flowDepth/radius/1000=21.5111 kPa (SI pressure in Pa divided by1000).
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「鼻坎壓力只要用靜水深就能完整計算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydrostatic depth alone completely determines bucket pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鼻坎曲率與壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Abrupt curvature transitions can cause separation and local cavitation. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 速度水頭與能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Velocity head and jet energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「速度水頭與能量」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity head and jet energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離坎水流的速度水頭代表每單位重量所帶動能，挑流只是把能量移到下游空間消散，並未在鼻坎自動消除。出口高程、沿程損失與速度分布共同決定可用能量；要區分水頭、能量與功率，避免量綱混淆。 驗證時應核對入口至離坎的能量線並分別列出高程與速度水頭，並辨識以下失效情境：將射流離開混凝土視為已完全消能會漏掉下游沖擊。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度水頭與能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Velocity head represents kinetic energy per unit weight. A flip bucket relocates dissipation downstream rather than eliminating energy at the lip. Elevation, approach losses and velocity distribution determine available energy; distinguish head from energy and power so that apparent dissipation is not a dimensional bookkeeping mistake. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check the energy line to the lip and list elevation and velocity heads separately. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating departure from concrete as complete dissipation ignores downstream impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Velocity head and jet energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：V=24 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; velocityHead=24**2/(2*9.81)=29.3578 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: V=24 m/s; g=9.81 m/s2; velocityHead=24**2/(2*9.81)=29.3578 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水舌一離開鼻坎就已經失去全部動能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A jet loses all kinetic energy as soon as it leaves the bucket" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度水頭與能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「射流功率與承受區」與「含氣展寬與截面」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet power and receiving zone" and "Aeration spreading and jet area": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 射流功率與承受區：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet power and receiving zone: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「射流功率與承受區」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet power and receiving zone” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。相同功率可由不同流量與速度組合造成，而沖擊、含氣與岩塊拔出機制不同；因此功率只能作系統尺度指標，不能單獨轉成固定的水墊深度。 驗證時應以流量量測與能量線核對功率並繪製沖擊區分布，並辨識以下失效情境：把總功率均勻攤到全河床會低估集中沖擊強度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「射流功率與承受區」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic power combines discharge and dissipatable head into an energy rate. Equal power can arise from different discharge and velocity combinations with different impact, aeration and rock-block removal behavior. Use power as a system-level indicator rather than converting it directly into a prescribed pool depth. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Verify power from measured discharge and energy head and map the receiving footprint. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Spreading total power uniformly over the whole bed understates concentrated impact. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet power and receiving zone” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=80 m3/s; H=40 m; power=1000*9.81*80*40/1e6=31.392 MW.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「射流功率與承受區」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet power and receiving zone”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 水力功率將流量與可耗散水頭結合，描述下游需要處理的能量速率。相同功率可由不同流量與速度組合造成，而沖擊、含氣與岩塊拔出機制不同；因此功率只能作系統尺度指標，不能單獨轉成固定的水墊深度。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total hydraulic power alone determines required plunge-pool depth Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

options: 總水力功率可以單獨決定所需水墊深度

A thicker visible jet guarantees increased liquid discharge

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 含氣展寬與截面：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「含氣展寬與截面」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aeration spreading and jet area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 空氣捲入會增加水舌混合體積並改變外觀厚度，水量守恆應採液相體積而非混合總體積。均勻含氣率的示意只表達相分率，實際氣泡有滑移與非均勻分布；應同時量測水相流量、混合速度與含氣剖面。 驗證時應以含氣探針與影像量測展寬並核對液相流量守恆，並辨識以下失效情境：將混合截面全當水會高估液相質量與動量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含氣展寬與截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Entrained air expands the apparent jet thickness. Liquid continuity uses water volume, not total mixture volume. A uniform void-fraction model illustrates phase accounting, while real bubbles slip and concentrations vary across the jet. Measure liquid flow, mixture velocity and air profiles together before interpreting the visible envelope. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure spreading with air probes and imaging and check liquid-phase continuity. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Treating the entire mixture area as water overstates liquid mass and momentum. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aeration spreading and jet area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A thicker visible jet guarantees increased liquid discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含氣展寬與截面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: LiquidQ=40 m3/s; uniformAirVoidFraction=0.20; equal phase velocity=20 m/s; mixtureArea=40/((1-0.20)*20)=2.50 m2. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 入水動量與方向：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「入水動量與方向」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Impact momentum and direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射流入水時的作用取決於速度向量變化，垂直與水平分量對池底與側壁的影響不同。只估完全消除一個分量的平均動量力，不含壓力回授與脈動放大；實際射流可能在水墊中轉向而保留部分動量。 驗證時應以速度剖面與池底壓力積分檢查垂直動量平衡，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略射流轉向後的流出動量會算錯合力方向。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入水動量與方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Impact depends on vector velocity change, with vertical and horizontal components loading the pool bed and walls differently. A mean force for arresting one component omits pressure feedback and dynamic amplification. A real jet may turn within the pool and retain momentum rather than stopping completely. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check vertical momentum using velocity profiles and integrated bed pressures. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring outgoing momentum after deflection misstates the resultant force direction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Impact momentum and direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; Q=30 m3/s; removedVerticalVelocity=18 m/s; meanVerticalForce=1000*30*18/1000=540 kN.

steps.title: 岩節理揚力與抗力：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「岩節理揚力與抗力」如何影響滑雪跳台式消能工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint uplift and rock resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ski-jump spillway energy dissipation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 射流脈壓可沿節理傳入岩塊底面，使岩塊自重、浮力與節理抗力之間的平衡改變。簡化水下自重只提供一項抗力，不包含咬合與剪阻；需調查節理連通、開口與塊體尺寸，不能僅用完整岩石抗壓強度預測沖蝕。 驗證時應繪製節理網與塊體尺寸並同步量測節理內外壓差，並辨識以下失效情境：連通節理將脈壓送至塊底可能降低有效抗拔餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岩節理揚力與抗力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Jet pressure can enter joints beneath rock blocks and alter the balance of weight, buoyancy and joint resistance. Submerged weight is only one resisting component and excludes interlock and shear. Investigate joint connectivity, aperture and block geometry; intact compressive strength alone cannot predict plucking or scour. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Map joints and block sizes and measure pressure differences across connected joints. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Connected joints transmit pulses beneath blocks and can reduce uplift resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint uplift and rock resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: rockDensity=2650 kg/m3; waterDensity=1000 kg/m3; volume=2 m3; submergedWeight=(2650-1000)*9.81*2/1000=32.373 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完整岩石強度高就保證節理岩床不沖蝕」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Strong intact rock guarantees a scour-proof jointed bed" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

knowledge.text: 射流脈壓可沿節理傳入岩塊底面，使岩塊自重、浮力與節理抗力之間的平衡改變。簡化水下自重只提供一項抗力，不包含咬合與剪阻；需調查節理連通、開口與塊體尺寸，不能僅用完整岩石抗壓強度預測沖蝕。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; modelV=2 m/s; modelThickness=0.020 m; surfaceTension=0.072 N/m; Weber=1000*2**2*0.020/0.072=1111.11。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: rho=1000 kg/m3; modelV=2 m/s; modelThickness=0.020 m; surfaceTension=0.072 N/m; Weber=1000*2**2*0.020/0.072=1111.11. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 福祿尺度與表面張力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling and surface tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「福祿尺度與表面張力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Froude scaling and surface tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「福祿尺度與表面張力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 福祿尺度與表面張力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling and surface tension: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「福祿尺度與表面張力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Froude scaling and surface tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「彈道相似就代表破碎與含氣完全相似」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Similar trajectories guarantee similar breakup and aeration" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較不同模型尺度的水舌破碎長度與無因次落點，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare breakup length and dimensionless landing position between model scales. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「福祿尺度與表面張力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Froude scaling and surface tension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。
理想中心線落點就是完整水舌沖擊範圍
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration.
The ideal centerline landing point defines the complete jet footprint
quiz.explanation: 過細模型水舌受表面張力控制會偏離原型含氣機制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An overly thin model jet becomes surface-tension controlled and misrepresents prototype aeration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 階梯式溢洪道
courses.summary: 本課以以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能為主線，先用臨界水深與單寬流量與階高與相對尺度界定水力與構造條件，再將自含氣起點判讀、近壁低壓與氣蝕連結到縮尺黏性與可比性。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy through Critical depth and unit discharge and Step height and relative scale, then connects Self-aeration inception identification and Near-wall pressure and cavitation to Scale viscosity and comparability. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以階梯流態含氣與剩餘能量驗證陡槽性能
courses.focusEn: Verifying stepped-chute regimes aeration and residual energy
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查臨界水深與單寬流量：q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m；再獨立檢查階高與相對尺度：criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless。敏感度：單寬流量由4增至6m2/s時，臨界水深由1.177增為1.542m，增加31.0%；若階高不變，水深階高比隨之提高，但不能用此一比值作通用流態界線。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。以矩形斷面及均勻混合近似作示意，流態分界與氣蝕風險須依專案試驗。 將比較槽末清水等效比能與消能池入流工況表作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Critical depth and unit discharge: q=4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; criticalDepth=(4**2/9.81)**(1/3)=1.17711 m. Independently examine Step height and relative scale: criticalDepth=1.2 m; stepHeight=0.6 m; relativeDepth=1.2/0.6=2 dimensionless. Sensitivity: raising unit discharge from4 to6m2/s increases critical depth from1.177 to1.542m, about31.0 percent. At fixed step height the relative depth rises, but this ratio alone is not a universal regime boundary. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Rectangular sections and uniform-mixture approximations illustrate behavior; regime boundaries and cavitation require project testing. Use the following independent check: Compare terminal clear-water equivalent energy with basin approach-condition tables. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Critical depth and unit discharge" and "Step height and relative scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 臨界水深與單寬流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and unit discharge: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical depth and unit discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階梯流態與流量相對階高有關，先以單寬流量求矩形明渠的臨界水深可建立尺度。此水深不是階面實際平均水深，也不是含氣混合水深；橫向不均流與入口曲率會改變局部條件，需另外量測入口過渡區。 驗證時應以全寬流量積分核對單寬值並標記階高與入口幾何，並辨識以下失效情境：把含氣厚度當臨界水深會混淆流態尺度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「臨界水深與單寬流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Critical depth based on unit discharge supplies a reference scale for stepped-flow behavior. It is neither the actual mean depth above a step nor the aerated mixture depth. Transverse nonuniformity and entrance curvature alter local conditions and require measurements through the crest transition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check unit discharge by full-width integration and record step height and entrance geometry. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using aerated thickness as critical depth confuses the regime scale. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical depth and unit discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 只測單一流量會漏掉過渡流態的不規則噴濺。診斷時應採取以下查核：在連續變流量試驗中記錄水舌是否撞擊階面及流態轉換，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing one discharge can miss irregular splashing in transitional flow. steps.instruction: 階梯由水平踏面與垂直階面組成，整體坡角影響重力沿坡分量、回流穴與施工模板。幾何閉合需核對總落差與總水平長度；局部突出或階尖錯台可能破壞原本流場，不能只驗收平均坡度而忽略局部平整性。 驗證時應逐階測量高程與踏面長度並與整體坡線閉合，並辨識以下失效情境：局部突出階尖可能增加低壓與磨耗集中。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「階梯坡度與建造」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal treads and vertical risers define the overall slope, influencing gravity components and recirculation cavities. Check total rise and horizontal run together. Local protrusions or displaced edges disturb the intended flow field, so average slope acceptance does not replace local surface and alignment surveys. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey every riser and tread and close them against the overall slope line. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A projecting step edge can concentrate low pressure and abrasion. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Step geometry and construction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 把每階耗能當固定常數會忽略沿程流態演變。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較階穴速度場與界面剪應力並檢查沿程剩餘比能，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning constant dissipation to every step ignores evolving flow conditions. stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自含氣起點判讀」與「混合水深與牆高」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Self-aeration inception identification" and "Mixture depth and wall height": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自含氣起點判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Self-aeration inception identification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自含氣起點判讀」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Self-aeration inception identification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。以觀測座標描述起點位置並不預測其隨流量變化；應結合壓力、含氣與邊界層量測，不能只看表面是否呈白色。 驗證時應沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較，並辨識以下失效情境：表面含氣但近壁仍清水可能留下局部氣蝕風險。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自含氣起點判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. An observed inception coordinate does not predict its discharge dependence. Combine pressure, concentration and boundary-layer measurements rather than relying on a white surface appearance alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: An aerated surface with clear water near the wall leaves local cavitation risk. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Self-aeration inception identification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A white surface guarantees adequate air protection at the bed" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自含氣起點判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Self-aeration inception identification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自含氣起點判讀
knowledge.text: 湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。以觀測座標描述起點位置並不預測其隨流量變化；應結合壓力、含氣與邊界層量測，不能只看表面是否呈白色。
knowledge.textEn: Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. An observed inception coordinate does not predict its discharge dependence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A white surface guarantees adequate air protection at the bed Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自含氣起點判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Self-aeration inception identification" is correct?
options: 表面變白就保證底部已獲充分含氣保護
混合層厚度與清水等效深度永遠相同
湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。
optionsEn: A white surface guarantees adequate air protection at the bed
Mixture thickness always equals clear-water equivalent depth
Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation.
quiz.explanation: 湍流邊界層向自由水面發展後可開始大量捲氣，起點之前的近壁清水區可能更易受氣蝕影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Air entrainment develops when turbulence reaches the free surface, leaving an upstream clear-water region potentially more vulnerable to cavitation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿槽測量近壁含氣率並將其與表面白化起點比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure near-wall air concentration along the chute and compare surface whitening onset.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Measured inceptionDistance=18 m; totalChuteLength=60 m; clearRegionFraction=18/60=0.30 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「自含氣起點判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.instructionEn: Entrained air thickens the mixture, so wall assessment cannot rely only on clear-water equivalent depth. steps.instruction: 只用平均混合深度配置牆高會漏掉波峰越流。診斷時應採取以下查核：以含氣剖面積分核對等效水深並記錄波峰高度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sizing walls to mean mixture depth alone overlooks wave overtopping. Diagnose it by the following check: Integrate air profiles to check equivalent water depth and record wave crests. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混合層厚度與清水等效深度永遠相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mixture thickness always equals clear-water equivalent depth" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混合水深與牆高」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Sizing walls to mean mixture depth alone overlooks wave overtopping.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「近壁低壓與氣蝕」與「下游剩餘能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Near-wall pressure and cavitation" and "Downstream residual energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 近壁低壓與氣蝕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Near-wall pressure and cavitation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「近壁低壓與氣蝕」如何影響階梯式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Near-wall pressure and cavitation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stepped spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 階尖後方流動分離可產生低壓，局部壓力與蒸氣壓的距離比表面含氣外觀更直接。氣蝕指標需用一致的絕對壓力與參考速度；同一指標下表面缺陷與氣核不同仍會改變起始，因此需對實際階面品質驗證。 驗證時應同步量測階尖後低壓與近壁含氣率並記錄表面缺陷，並辨識以下失效情境：把表壓直接代入會錯估距蒸氣壓的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「近壁低壓與氣蝕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Separation behind step edges creates low pressure. Compare local absolute pressure with vapor pressure using a consistent velocity reference. Surface defects and nuclei affect inception even at similar indices; visible aeration does not replace verification of wall conditions and actual near-wall protection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure downstream-edge pressure and near-wall air together and document surface defects. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Inserting gauge pressure directly misstates the margin above vapor pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Near-wall pressure and cavitation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：pAbsolute=80 kPa; vaporPressure=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=18 m/s; sigma=(80000-2300)/(0.5*1000*18**2)=0.479630。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: pAbsolute=80 kPa; vaporPressure=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=18 m/s; sigma=(80000-2300)/(0.5*1000*18**2)=0.479630.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表壓可直接與絕對蒸氣壓相減」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gauge pressure can be subtracted directly from absolute vapor pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「近壁低壓與氣蝕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Near-wall pressure and cavitation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Separation behind step edges creates low pressure. Compare local absolute pressure with vapor pressure using a consistent velocity reference.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表壓可直接與絕對蒸氣壓相減 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gauge pressure can be subtracted directly from absolute vapor pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「近壁低壓與氣蝕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Near-wall pressure and cavitation" is correct?
options: 表壓可直接與絕對蒸氣壓相減
階尖後方流動分離可產生低壓，局部壓力與蒸氣壓的距離比表面含氣外觀更直接。

optionsEn: Gauge pressure can be subtracted directly from absolute vapor pressure
Separation behind step edges creates low pressure.

steps.title: 近壁低壓與氣蝕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Near-wall pressure and cavitation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「近壁低壓與氣蝕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Near-wall pressure and cavitation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：pAbsolute=80 kPa; vaporPressure=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=18 m/s; sigma=(80000-2300)/(0.5*1000*18**2)=0.479630。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: pAbsolute=80 kPa; vaporPressure=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=18 m/s; sigma=(80000-2300)/(0.5*1000*18**2)=0.479630. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測階尖後低壓與近壁含氣率並記錄表面缺陷。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure downstream-edge pressure and near-wall air together and document surface defects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：pAbsolute=80 kPa; vaporPressure=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=18 m/s; sigma=(80000-2300)/(0.5*1000*18**2)=0.479630。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 近壁低壓與氣蝕：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「近壁低壓與氣蝕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 同步量測階尖後低壓與近壁含氣率並記錄表面缺陷。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把表壓直接代入會錯估距蒸氣壓的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure downstream-edge pressure and near-wall air together and document surface defects. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Inserting gauge pressure directly misstates the margin above vapor pressure. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把表壓直接代入會錯估距蒸氣壓的餘量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.title: 縮尺黏性與可比性
knowledge.text: 同水質福祿模型的速度隨長度平方根縮小，使雷諾數比按長度比的二分之三次方改變。小模型可能改變階穴紊流與含氣，結果需附尺度限制；應分開驗證整體水面線與細部氣泡機制，不能用單一相似準則涵蓋所有現象。
knowledge.textEn: In a same-fluid Froude model, velocity scales with square root of length, making the Reynolds-number ratio length to the three-halves power. Small models may change cavity turbulence and aeration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同福祿數也保證雷諾數自動相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal Froude numbers also guarantee equal Reynolds numbers Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Equal Froude numbers also guarantee equal Reynolds numbers
In a same-fluid Froude model, velocity scales with square root of length, making the Reynolds-number ratio length to the three-halves power.
Critical depth equals actual flow depth on every step

quiz.explanationEn: In a same-fluid Froude model, velocity scales with square root of length, making the Reynolds-number ratio length to the three-halves power. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 縮尺黏性與可比性：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「縮尺黏性與可比性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Prototype/model lengthRatio=20; same kinematicViscosity; ReynoldsRatio=20**1.5=89.4427 dimensionless。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Prototype/model lengthRatio=20; same kinematicViscosity; ReynoldsRatio=20**1.5=89.4427 dimensionless. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 縮尺黏性與可比性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale viscosity and comparability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「縮尺黏性與可比性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale viscosity and comparability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List prototype and model Reynolds numbers and compare aeration at two model scales. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: List prototype and model Reynolds numbers and compare aeration at two model scales. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 縮尺黏性與可比性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale viscosity and comparability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「縮尺黏性與可比性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale viscosity and comparability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型黏性過強會改變階穴交換與表面擾動。診斷時應採取以下查核：列出原型與模型雷諾數並比較兩種模型尺度的含氣結果，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excessive model viscosity changes cavity exchange and surface disturbance. Diagnose it by the following check: List prototype and model Reynolds numbers and compare aeration at two model scales. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同福祿數也保證雷諾數自動相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal Froude numbers also guarantee equal Reynolds numbers" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

courses.title: 側槽式溢洪道
courses.summary: 本課以以側向入流動量及沿程水面控制側槽為主線，先用沿程入流與累積與長堰流量與水頭界定水力與構造條件，再將出口臨界控制、波峰餘高與牆頂連結到模型守恆與驗證。側槽具有空間變流，示意分段平均不代替完整三維模型與沿程動量求解。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops controlling side channels through lateral inflow momentum and profiles through Lateral inflow accumulation and Long crest discharge and head, then connects Critical outlet control and Wave allowance and wall crest to Model conservation and validation. Side channels have spatially varied flow; segmented averages do not replace three-dimensional modeling and longitudinal momentum analysis. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以側向入流動量及沿程水面控制側槽
courses.focusEn: Controlling side channels through lateral inflow momentum and profiles
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查沿程入流與累積：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s；再獨立檢查長堰流量與水頭：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。敏感度：均勻側入流由每公尺2增至3m2/s且側槽長40m時，總流量由80增至120m3/s；若出口面積維持20m2，平均速度由4增為6m/s，動量與能量需求不只增加50%。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。側槽具有空間變流，示意分段平均不代替完整三維模型與沿程動量求解。 將同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Lateral inflow accumulation: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. Independently examine Long crest discharge and head: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s. Sensitivity: increasing uniform lateral inflow from2 to3m2/s along40m raises discharge from80 to120m3/s. At a fixed20m2 outlet area, velocity rises from4 to6m/s; momentum and energy demands grow faster than the50-percent discharge increase. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Side channels have spatially varied flow; segmented averages do not replace three-dimensional modeling and longitudinal momentum analysis. Use the following independent check: Measure heads above and below the floor together and identify outlet submergence periods. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
