stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿程入流與累積」與「長堰流量與水頭」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Lateral inflow accumulation" and "Long crest discharge and head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沿程入流與累積」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral inflow accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。先把側入流分布積分，再檢查各段斷面與出口控制；堰上水頭不均或局部淹沒會破壞均勻入流假設。 驗證時應分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對，並辨識以下失效情境：局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沿程入流與累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. Integrate the inflow distribution before checking sections and outlet control rather than applying one discharge everywhere. Unequal crest heads or local submergence invalidate the uniform-inflow approximation and require segmented measurements. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral inflow accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沿程入流與累積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Lateral inflow accumulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沿程入流與累積
knowledge.text: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。先把側入流分布積分，再檢查各段斷面與出口控制；堰上水頭不均或局部淹沒會破壞均勻入流假設。
knowledge.textEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. Integrate the inflow distribution before checking sections and outlet control rather than applying one discharge everywhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沿程入流與累積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Lateral inflow accumulation" is correct?
options: 側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同
側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。
堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量
optionsEn: Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel
A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream.
Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
quiz.explanation: 側槽接收沿堰長分布的側向水流，流量沿下游增加，因此不能用一個固定流量套全槽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A side channel accumulates distributed lateral inflow, so discharge increases downstream. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沿程入流與累積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral inflow accumulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沿程入流與累積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral inflow accumulation", which statement holds?
options: 連續方程單獨就能求出整條側槽水面線
側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。
optionsEn: Continuity alone determines the complete side-channel water profile
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section
Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Uniform lateral input=2 m2/s; channelLength=40 m; upstreamQ=0; outletQ=2*40=80 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沿程入流與累積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral inflow accumulation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沿程入流與累積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral inflow accumulation"?
options: 分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水孔存在就保證底板下沒有揚壓
optionsEn: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The presence of drains guarantees no pressure beneath the floor
quiz.explanation: 分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沿程入流與累積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral inflow accumulation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沿程入流與累積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral inflow accumulation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。診斷時應採取以下查核：分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。診斷時應採取以下查核：分段量測堰上水頭並將側入流累積量與出口流量比對，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure crest head by segment and compare accumulated inflow with outlet discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沿程入流與累積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral inflow accumulation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。
堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution.
Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
quiz.explanation: 局部堰頂淹沒會改變沿程入流分配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local crest submergence changes the longitudinal inflow distribution. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Long crest discharge and head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「長堰流量與水頭」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Long crest discharge and head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。自由堰公式只適用所假設的係數與單位；堰長增加不保證出口通道有足夠容量，應聯合分析槽內回水。 驗證時應比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況，並辨識以下失效情境：只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「長堰流量與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. A free-weir equation applies only to its stated geometry and units. More crest length does not guarantee outlet capacity because channel backwater may suppress the intended inflow. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Long crest discharge and head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「長堰流量與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Long crest discharge and head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 長堰流量與水頭
knowledge.text: 側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。自由堰公式只適用所假設的係數與單位；堰長增加不保證出口通道有足夠容量，應聯合分析槽內回水。
knowledge.textEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. A free-weir equation applies only to its stated geometry and units.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「長堰流量與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Long crest discharge and head" is correct?

側向入流可當作早已沿槽流動的水量
側槽可提供較長堰頂以降低特定流量所需水頭，但係數仍受入口形狀、接近流與淹沒控制。
optionsEn: Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit
Lateral inflow can be treated as water already moving along the channel
A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important.

quiz.explanationEn: A long crest can reduce the head needed for discharge, but coefficient, approach flow and submergence remain important. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Long crest discharge and head: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「長堰流量與水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Long crest discharge and head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed coefficient C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestLength=30 m; head=1.2 m; Q=1.7*30*1.2**1.5=67.0412 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「長堰流量與水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Long crest discharge and head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 長堰流量與水頭：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Long crest discharge and head: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「長堰流量與水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Long crest discharge and head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Increasing crest length without channel checks can submerge the crest through backwater. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堰頂加長就一定可無限制增加整體洩量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lengthening the crest increases total system discharge without limit" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只增加堰長但不檢查側槽容量可能使堰頂回水淹沒。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較各堰段水頭與實測流量並標示淹沒工況，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Compare head and measured discharge for each crest segment and identify submergence. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

quiz.question: 在「長堰流量與水頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 側入動量與轉向：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「側入動量與轉向」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Lateral momentum and turning” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 垂直於槽軸的側入流需轉向後才沿槽輸送，其軸向初始動量可能很小，不能使用只含能量損失的普通渠道公式忽略混合作用。控制體應包含各入口速度向量、壁面反力與壓力力，簡化動量差只展示其中一項。 驗證時應以三維速度量測確認側入方向並核對控制體各面動量，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略側向混合會誤判沿程水深與壁面反力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側入動量與轉向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lateral inflow must turn into the channel axis and may carry little initial axial momentum. Ordinary channel calculations that only add an energy-loss coefficient can miss mixing forces. A control volume needs inlet velocity vectors, wall reactions and pressure forces; a simplified momentum difference illustrates only one contribution. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure three-dimensional velocity and reconcile momentum across every control-volume face. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring lateral mixing misstates channel depth and wall reactions. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Lateral momentum and turning” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：rho=1000 kg/m3; axialOutflow=80 m3/s at4 m/s; lateral axial velocity=0; outgoingAxialMomentum=1000*80*4/1000=320 kN。

steps.title: 斷面速度與水深：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「斷面速度與水深」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section velocity and depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用分層流速剖面檢查平均速度及回流面積。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「把回流區算成有效順流面積會低估主流速度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use layered velocity profiles to check mean speed and recirculating area. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Counting recirculation as effective downstream area understates main-stream velocity. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section velocity and depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把回流區算成有效順流面積會低估主流速度。診斷時應採取以下查核：用分層流速剖面檢查平均速度及回流面積，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting recirculation as effective downstream area understates main-stream velocity. Diagnose it by the following check: Use layered velocity profiles to check mean speed and recirculating area. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出口臨界控制」與「橫向水位與彎流」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Critical outlet control" and "Transverse level and curved flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出口臨界控制」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical outlet control” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。矩形臨界深度只對指定單寬流量成立；若有含氣、斜交或非矩形斷面，需用適用水力深度及完整模型。 驗證時應量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移，並辨識以下失效情境：漏掉出口控制會低估側槽上游水位。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出口臨界控制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest. Evaluate the outlet and side weir jointly. Rectangular critical depth applies to a specified unit discharge; aeration, oblique approach or different geometry requires a more suitable formulation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Missing outlet control underestimates upstream channel level. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical outlet control” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出口臨界控制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Critical outlet control”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出口臨界控制
knowledge.text: 出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。矩形臨界深度只對指定單寬流量成立；若有含氣、斜交或非矩形斷面，需用適用水力深度及完整模型。
knowledge.textEn: An outlet contraction or drop may impose critical control and send backwater upstream toward the lateral crest. Evaluate the outlet and side weir jointly.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出口臨界控制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical outlet control" is correct?
options: 出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游
側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平
出口收縮或跌水可能建立臨界控制並把回水影響傳回側槽，需將出口與側向堰頂聯合評估。
optionsEn: Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel
The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section

steps.title: 出口臨界控制：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical outlet control: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口臨界控制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical outlet control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測出口附近水面線並檢查控制斷面是否隨流量遷移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure the outlet profile and determine whether the control section shifts with discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Q=80 m3/s; outletWidth=8 m; q=10 m2/s; criticalDepth=(10**2/9.81)**(1/3)=2.16825 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

steps.instruction: 只在內側設水位計會漏掉外側越流。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測內外側水位與波峰並對照轉彎速度場，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A gauge only at the inner wall can miss outer-wall overtopping. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure levels and crests at both walls simultaneously alongside turning velocities. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「側槽同一斷面的水面必定完全水平」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The water surface must be perfectly level across every side-channel section" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「波峰餘高與牆頂」與「底板排水與回水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Wave allowance and wall crest" and "Floor drainage and backwater": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 波峰餘高與牆頂：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wave allowance and wall crest: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「波峰餘高與牆頂」如何影響側槽式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave allowance and wall crest” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側入水舌的碰撞會產生交叉波與噴濺，牆頂核對需區分平均水深、波幅與測量不確定度。簡單加總只整理已選定工況的幾何餘量，不會自動提供完整可靠度；洪水歷線與短暫浪峰仍要在試驗中覆蓋。 驗證時應以高頻水位與影像核對最大浪峰是否集中於局部牆段，並辨識以下失效情境：時間平均水深會掩蓋短暫越頂噴流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波峰餘高與牆頂」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Colliding lateral jets generate cross-waves and splash. Separate mean depth, wave amplitude and measurement uncertainty when checking a wall crest. A simple sum organizes geometry for an assumed case rather than establishing reliability; test hydrographs and short-lived crests as part of the boundary coverage. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use rapid level records and imagery to locate concentrated wave crests along walls. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Time-averaged depth conceals brief overtopping jets. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave allowance and wall crest” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：wallHeight=5 m; meanDepth=3.6 m; waveCrestAboveMean=0.8 m; geometricClearance=5-3.6-0.8=0.60 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: wallHeight=5 m; meanDepth=3.6 m; waveCrestAboveMean=0.8 m; geometricClearance=5-3.6-0.8=0.60 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均水面低於牆頂就保證不會越流」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A mean water surface below the wall guarantees no overtopping" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「波峰餘高與牆頂」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wave allowance and wall crest”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wave allowance and wall crest” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：wallHeight=5 m; meanDepth=3.6 m; waveCrestAboveMean=0.8 m; geometricClearance=5-3.6-0.8=0.60 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: wallHeight=5 m; meanDepth=3.6 m; waveCrestAboveMean=0.8 m; geometricClearance=5-3.6-0.8=0.60 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以高頻水位與影像核對最大浪峰是否集中於局部牆段。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rapid level records and imagery to locate concentrated wave crests along walls.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：wallHeight=5 m; meanDepth=3.6 m; waveCrestAboveMean=0.8 m; geometricClearance=5-3.6-0.8=0.60 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

steps.title: 底板排水與回水：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floor drainage and backwater” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Side-channel spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側槽底板可能同時受地下水與表面變動壓力作用，排水出口若被下游水淹沒，原本自由排水條件會改變。淨水頭差應使用同時工況而非把不同洪水時刻的極值拼接；排水失效需與結構抗浮共同檢查。 驗證時應同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段，並辨識以下失效情境：下游回水使排水反灌可升高底板下壓力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底板排水與回水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Groundwater and fluctuating surface pressure act on the floor together. A submerged drainage outlet changes the original free-drainage boundary. Use simultaneous states for differential head rather than combining incompatible extremes from different times, and evaluate drainage failure alongside structural uplift resistance. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure heads above and below the floor together and identify outlet submergence periods. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Downstream backwater can reverse drainage and raise subfloor pressure. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floor drainage and backwater” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：underFloorHead=108 m; surfaceHead=105 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; netPressure=(108-105)*9.81=29.43 kPa。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水孔存在就保證底板下沒有揚壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 同步量測底板上下水頭並檢查排水出口淹沒時段。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「下游回水使排水反灌可升高底板下壓力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

knowledge.text: 誤解：水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模型守恆與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Model conservation and validation" is correct?
options: 水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確
三維側槽試驗或數值模型需同時通過水量平衡與水面線比較，單一出口流量吻合不代表流場正確。
側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同
optionsEn: Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct
A three-dimensional side-channel model needs both mass balance and profile validation.
Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel
quiz.explanation: 三維側槽試驗或數值模型需同時通過水量平衡與水面線比較，單一出口流量吻合不代表流場正確。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A three-dimensional side-channel model needs both mass balance and profile validation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模型守恆與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Model conservation and validation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模型守恆與驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Model conservation and validation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模型守恆與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Model conservation and validation", which statement holds?
options: 側向入流可當作早已沿槽流動的水量
出口控制只影響出口不會影響側槽上游
原創教學假設：MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent。
optionsEn: Lateral inflow can be treated as water already moving along the channel
Outlet control affects only the outlet and never the upstream side channel
Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: MeasuredInflow=100 m3/s; measuredOutflow=98 m3/s; steady residual=(100-98)/100*100=2 percent. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模型守恆與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Model conservation and validation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模型守恆與驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Model conservation and validation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模型守恆與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Model conservation and validation"?
options: 核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均水面低於牆頂就保證不會越流
optionsEn: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A mean water surface below the wall guarantees no overtopping
quiz.explanation: 核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模型守恆與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model conservation and validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型守恆與驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model conservation and validation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水量守恆通過就證明整個三維模型完全正確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing mass balance proves that the entire three-dimensional model is correct" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對各入口總量與出口量並比較獨立水位測線，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile all inlet and outlet flows and compare independent water-level transects. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模型守恆與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Model conservation and validation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。
側槽上游與下游的流量永遠完全相同
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions.
Discharge is always identical upstream and downstream in a side channel
quiz.explanation: 只調參至流量守恆可能保留錯誤水面與流速分布。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tuning only for mass balance can preserve incorrect water-level and velocity distributions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 豎井式溢洪道
courses.summary: 本課以辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換為主線，先用環形堰頂自由流與喉部孔口控制界定水力與構造條件，再將旋渦環流與水頭、下游管流摩阻連結到瞬變量測與取樣。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions through Circular crest free flow and Throat orifice control, then connects Swirl circulation and head and Downstream conduit friction to Transient measurement and sampling. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換
courses.focusEn: Distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查環形堰頂自由流：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s；再獨立檢查喉部孔口控制：Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s。敏感度：自由堰流近似下水頭由1增至1.5m，流量比為1.5的1.5次方即1.837；若轉為孔口控制且面積不變，同樣水頭比的流量比只有平方根1.225，因此需要確認控制轉換。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 將用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Circular crest free flow: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. Independently examine Throat orifice control: Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s. Sensitivity: under free-weir control, increasing head from1 to1.5m gives a discharge ratio of1.837. Under fixed-area orifice control the same head ratio gives only1.225. A rating must therefore identify the change in control. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. Use the following independent check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環形堰頂自由流」與「喉部孔口控制」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circular crest free flow" and "Throat orifice control": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環形堰頂自由流」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circular crest free flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。水頭增加後控制可能移往喉部與隧道，應避免以同一冪次延伸整條率定曲線。 驗證時應沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，並辨識以下失效情境：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環形堰頂自由流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity. An illustrative coefficient cannot transfer across geometries, and higher heads may move control to the throat or tunnel rather than preserve one power law. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circular crest free flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環形堰頂自由流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circular crest free flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環形堰頂自由流
knowledge.text: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。接近流旋轉、墩柱與局部淹沒會降低均勻性；示意係數不能跨幾何直接沿用。
knowledge.textEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. Swirl, piers and submergence reduce uniformity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環形堰頂自由流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circular crest free flow" is correct?
options: 環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。
孔口控制的流量仍必定與水頭一點五次方成正比
optionsEn: A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length.
Orifice discharge must remain proportional to head to the three-halves power
quiz.explanation: 鐘口入口在低水頭下可近似環形堰流，周長提供有效堰長。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: At low head a bellmouth can behave approximately as a circular weir, with circumference supplying crest length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環形堰頂自由流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circular crest free flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環形堰頂自由流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circular crest free flow", which statement holds?
options: 通氣管存在就保證任何流量下都能充分補氣
動量變化單項就是井底彎道全部荷載
原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。
optionsEn: A vent pipe guarantees adequate air supply at every water discharge
Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load
Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed C=1.7 m0.5/s; crestDiameter=10 m; H=1 m; Q=1.7*pi*10*1**1.5=53.4071 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環形堰頂自由流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circular crest free flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環形堰頂自由流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Circular crest free flow"?
options: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算
optionsEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood
quiz.explanation: 沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環形堰頂自由流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circular crest free flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環形堰頂自由流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circular crest free flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿環形堰頂量測水頭並觀察各方位水舌是否對稱，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure head around the circular crest and observe whether nappes are symmetric. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環形堰頂自由流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Circular crest free flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。
孔口控制的流量仍必定與水頭一點五次方成正比
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating.
Orifice discharge must remain proportional to head to the three-halves power
quiz.explanation: 偏心接近流會形成非均勻溢流並改變率定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric approach flow creates nonuniform overflow and changes the rating. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 喉部孔口控制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Throat orifice control: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「喉部孔口控制」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Throat orifice control” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 喉部淹沒後可能由有效孔口面積與水頭差控制流量，流量對水頭的反應比自由堰流緩。排氣、下游壓力與流量係數都會影響此關係；孔口公式並不描述控制轉換期間的劇烈波動，需以連續升降流量試驗辨認。 驗證時應在升流與降流過程比較喉部壓力和水位流量曲線，並辨識以下失效情境：控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「喉部孔口控制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Once submerged, the throat may act as an orifice governed by effective area and head difference. Discharge then responds less strongly to head than free-weir flow. Venting, downstream pressure and coefficient matter, and the equation does not describe unstable transitions between these regimes. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare throat pressure and stage-discharge curves during increasing and decreasing flow. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Throat orifice control” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Cd=0.75; throatArea=12 m2; effectiveHead=8 m; Q=0.75*12*sqrt(2*9.81*8)=112.755 m3/s。

knowledge.title: 喉部孔口控制
knowledge.text: 喉部淹沒後可能由有效孔口面積與水頭差控制流量，流量對水頭的反應比自由堰流緩。排氣、下游壓力與流量係數都會影響此關係；孔口公式並不描述控制轉換期間的劇烈波動，需以連續升降流量試驗辨認。
knowledge.textEn: Once submerged, the throat may act as an orifice governed by effective area and head difference. Discharge then responds less strongly to head than free-weir flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口控制的流量仍必定與水頭一點五次方成正比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Orifice discharge must remain proportional to head to the three-halves power Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

The entire shaft section contains liquid water in every operating regime

steps.instruction: 在升流與降流過程比較喉部壓力和水位流量曲線。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Transition hysteresis may produce different discharges at the same stage. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：控制轉換滯回可能使同水位出現不同流量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 豎井中沿壁水膜與中央空氣芯可能並存，水量連續應只用液相過水面積。簡化環狀截面忽略含氣與非均勻流速，仍可提醒學生不能將整個井徑都算成水流面積；空芯縮小也會改變通氣和壓力邊界。 驗證時應以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量，並辨識以下失效情境：空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「豎井通水與空芯」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 空芯收縮可能使原本開放通氣轉成受限流動。診斷時應採取以下查核：以影像或含氣探針確認空芯尺寸並核對液相流量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Air-core contraction can turn open ventilation into restricted flow. Diagnose it by the following check: Use imaging or air probes to establish air-core size and check liquid discharge. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The entire shaft section contains liquid water in every operating regime" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
