stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「旋渦環流與水頭」與「豎井底彎轉動量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Swirl circulation and head" and "Bottom bend momentum change": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 旋渦環流與水頭：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Swirl circulation and head: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「旋渦環流與水頭」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Swirl circulation and head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。 驗證時應以表面追蹤與速度量測辨識環流方向和渦核範圍，並辨識以下失效情境：只降低平均入流速度可能仍保留強烈環流。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「旋渦環流與水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity. A free-vortex model applies only outside a specified core and cannot be extrapolated to infinite center velocity; test antivortex devices for both flow guidance and obstruction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Track the surface and measure velocities to identify circulation and core extent. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Reducing mean approach speed alone may leave strong circulation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Swirl circulation and head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「旋渦環流與水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Swirl circulation and head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 旋渦環流與水頭
knowledge.text: 不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。自由渦近似僅在指定半徑之外有效，靠近渦核不能任意外推至無限速度；抗渦構件應以模型驗證其阻水與導流作用。
knowledge.textEn: Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex. Tangential velocity affects central pressure and inlet capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均入流速度低就不可能形成進水旋渦 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「旋渦環流與水頭」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

不對稱接近流可能產生環流與空氣渦，局部旋轉速度會降低中心壓力並影響進流容量。

Momentum change alone equals the entire bottom-bend load
Asymmetric approach flow can create circulation and an air-core vortex.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Circulation=20 m2/s; radius=2 m; tangentialV=20/(2*pi*2)=1.59155 m/s。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom bend momentum change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 落水在井底彎轉為水平流時，方向改變形成明顯作用力，壓力與速度沿彎道分布不均。簡化等速直角轉彎的向量差只計動量項，實際支承作用還含壓力力與水重；不可直接把此單項當成彎道完整設計荷載。 驗證時應以彎道壓力積分及入口出口速度向量核對受力方向，並辨識以下失效情境：漏列壓力力會使支承反力估算不完整。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「豎井底彎轉動量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At the shaft bottom, flow turns from vertical to horizontal and generates substantial reaction. An equal-speed right-angle vector difference estimates only momentum change. Real support loads also include pressure forces and water weight, so that single component is not the complete bend design load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check force direction using bend-pressure integration and inlet-outlet velocity vectors. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting pressure forces leaves the support-reaction estimate incomplete. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bottom bend momentum change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: Omitting pressure forces leaves the support-reaction estimate incomplete. stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「下游管流摩阻」與「控制轉換與庫容」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Downstream conduit friction" and "Control transition and reservoir storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 下游管流摩阻：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Downstream conduit friction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下游管流摩阻」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream conduit friction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 當下游通道滿流時，沿程摩阻消耗水頭並可能回控豎井容量；自由水面流則需不同計算架構。達西摩阻係數與管長徑比必須配套使用，接頭、彎道與出入口損失另列，不能因管徑大就忽略整段水頭需求。 驗證時應以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流，並辨識以下失效情境：在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游管流摩阻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A full downstream conduit loses head to friction and may control shaft capacity; free-surface operation needs another framework. Use Darcy friction factor consistently with length-to-diameter ratio and list local losses separately. A large diameter does not eliminate the head demand along a long conduit. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream conduit friction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Full pipe: DarcyF=0.018; L=300 m; D=4 m; V=8 m/s; headLoss=0.018*(300/4)*8**2/(2*9.81)=4.40367 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Full pipe: DarcyF=0.018; L=300 m; D=4 m; V=8 m/s; headLoss=0.018*(300/4)*8**2/(2*9.81)=4.40367 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下游管徑夠大就可以忽略全部摩阻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sufficiently large downstream pipe permits ignoring all friction losses" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游管流摩阻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A sufficiently large downstream pipe permits ignoring all friction losses Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 下游管流摩阻：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downstream conduit friction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Full pipe: DarcyF=0.018; L=300 m; D=4 m; V=8 m/s; headLoss=0.018*(300/4)*8**2/(2*9.81)=4.40367 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Full pipe: DarcyF=0.018; L=300 m; D=4 m; V=8 m/s; headLoss=0.018*(300/4)*8**2/(2*9.81)=4.40367 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以沿管壓力測點核對摩阻坡降並辨認是否滿流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use pressure taps to check friction gradient and establish whether the conduit is full.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「下游管流摩阻」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Downstream conduit friction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。
靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow.
One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood
quiz.explanation: 在明滿流交替時套單一穩態管流式會漏掉壓力跳動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One steady pipe-flow formula misses pressure changes during mixed free-surface and full flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「控制轉換與庫容」如何影響豎井式溢洪道的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control transition and reservoir storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Shaft spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。 驗證時應用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，並辨識以下失效情境：延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「控制轉換與庫容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation. A constant-area short-interval estimate illustrates imbalance but omits changing storage geometry and time-dependent outflow; one static rating point cannot route a flood. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Control transition and reservoir storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「控制轉換與庫容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Control transition and reservoir storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 控制轉換與庫容
knowledge.text: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。定面積短時近似只表示水量差，不含變動庫容曲線與時間相依洩量；完整洪水演算不能靠單一靜態率定點。
knowledge.textEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. Couple continuity to the spillway control relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「控制轉換與庫容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control transition and reservoir storage" is correct?
options: 靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算
堵塞面積減少三成就保證洩量只減三成
豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。
optionsEn: One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood
A thirty-percent area blockage guarantees exactly thirty-percent discharge loss
When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage.
quiz.explanation: 豎井洩量率定的斜率變小時，新增入流可能更多轉為庫水位上升，應把水庫蓄水方程與溢洪道控制連接。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When the discharge-rating slope decreases, more incoming water may become reservoir storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「控制轉換與庫容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control transition and reservoir storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「控制轉換與庫容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control transition and reservoir storage", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。
環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
整個豎井截面在所有工況都充滿液態水
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m.
A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
The entire shaft section contains liquid water in every operating regime
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Inflow=150 m3/s; outflow=110 m3/s; interval=600 s; reservoirArea=2000000 m2; stageRise=(150-110)*600/2000000=0.012 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「控制轉換與庫容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Control transition and reservoir storage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「控制轉換與庫容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control transition and reservoir storage"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope.
Low mean approach speed makes inlet vortices impossible
quiz.explanation: 用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 控制轉換與庫容：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control transition and reservoir storage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「控制轉換與庫容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Control transition and reservoir storage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。診斷時應採取以下查核：用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靜態單點洩量足以完成任何洪水演算」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One static discharge point is sufficient to route every flood" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。診斷時應採取以下查核：用同時入出流與水位量測核對庫容變化並檢查率定斜率，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. Diagnose it by the following check: Reconcile simultaneous inflow, outflow and stage change and inspect rating-curve slope. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「控制轉換與庫容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control transition and reservoir storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
堵塞面積減少三成就保證洩量只減三成
延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A thirty-percent area blockage guarantees exactly thirty-percent discharge loss
Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes.
quiz.explanation: 延用自由堰流高斜率會低估轉換後水位上升。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extending the steep free-weir rating understates stage rise after control changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漂流物與局部堵塞」與「瞬變量測與取樣」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floating debris and local blockage" and "Transient measurement and sampling": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漂流物與局部堵塞：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floating debris and local blockage: mechanism and system paths

knowledge.text: 誤解：只達兩倍頻率就保證所有壓力尖峰量測準確 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sampling at twice the frequency guarantees accurate measurement of every pressure peak Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「瞬變量測與取樣」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transient measurement and sampling" is correct?
options: 只達兩倍頻率就保證所有壓力尖峰量測準確
控制轉換伴隨的壓力振盪可能比水位平均變化快，量測系統需足夠採樣率並處理抗混疊。
環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
optionsEn: Sampling at twice the frequency guarantees accurate measurement of every pressure peak
Pressure oscillations during control transitions may be faster than mean stage changes.
A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition

quiz.explanationEn: Pressure oscillations during control transitions may be faster than mean stage changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 瞬變量測與取樣：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transient measurement and sampling: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「瞬變量測與取樣」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transient measurement and sampling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HighestIllustrativeFrequency=8 Hz; theoreticalNyquistRate=2*8=16 samples/s; actual acquisition requires additional margin。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HighestIllustrativeFrequency=8 Hz; theoreticalNyquistRate=2*8=16 samples/s; actual acquisition requires additional margin. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 瞬變量測與取樣：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transient measurement and sampling: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「瞬變量測與取樣」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transient measurement and sampling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「瞬變量測與取樣」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transient measurement and sampling"?
options: 以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應。

optionsEn: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

quiz.explanation: 以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 瞬變量測與取樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transient measurement and sampling: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「瞬變量測與取樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transient measurement and sampling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。診斷時應採取以下查核：以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只達兩倍頻率就保證所有壓力尖峰量測準確」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sampling at twice the frequency guarantees accurate measurement of every pressure peak" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。診斷時應採取以下查核：以較高採樣率對照頻譜並測試感測器動態響應，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare spectra at a higher rate and test the pressure sensor dynamic response. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「瞬變量測與取樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transient measurement and sampling" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。
環形堰率定可以延伸到任何高水頭工況
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle.
A circular-weir rating remains valid at every high-head condition
quiz.explanation: 未濾波的高頻振動可能折疊成假低頻壓力週期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unfiltered high-frequency vibration can alias into a false low-frequency pressure cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 溢洪道氣蝕防治
courses.summary: 本課以由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治為主線，先用絕對壓力與蒸氣壓與氣蝕指標與速度界定水力與構造條件，再將摻氣量與相分率、拋離空腔與再附著連結到運轉曝露與追蹤。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair through Absolute pressure and vapor pressure and Cavitation index and velocity, then connects Air supply and phase fraction and Jet cavity and reattachment to Operating exposure and follow-up. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 由絕對壓力缺陷含氣與修補驗證氣蝕防治
courses.focusEn: Verifying cavitation mitigation through absolute pressure defects aeration and repair
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa；再獨立檢查氣蝕指標與速度：pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885。敏感度：絕對壓力100kPa與蒸氣壓2.3kPa不變，速度由20增至30m/s，氣蝕指標由0.4885降至0.2171；速度增加50%使動壓增加125%，但不能由指標直接預報破壞速率。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。氣蝕指標與含氣算例只作機制比較，起蝕門檻依表面幾何水質與流況而變。 將用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. Independently examine Cavitation index and velocity: pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885. Sensitivity: holding absolute pressure at100kPa and vapor pressure at2.3kPa, increasing speed from20 to30m/s lowers the index from0.4885 to0.2171. Dynamic pressure increases125 percent, but the index alone does not predict damage rate. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Cavitation indices and aeration examples compare mechanisms; inception thresholds depend on surface geometry water quality and flow conditions. Use the following independent check: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」與「氣蝕指標與速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure" and "Cavitation index and velocity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。高程與天氣會改變大氣壓，水溫則改變蒸氣壓；把表壓直接相減會嚴重錯估餘量。量測時須記錄壓力校正與溫度，而非只報單一負壓數值。 驗證時應將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，並辨識以下失效情境：混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. Altitude and weather affect atmospheric pressure while temperature affects vapor pressure. Subtracting gauge pressure directly gives the wrong margin; record pressure calibration and temperature instead of reporting only one negative gauge value. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓
knowledge.text: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。高程與天氣會改變大氣壓，水溫則改變蒸氣壓；把表壓直接相減會嚴重錯估餘量。
knowledge.textEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. Altitude and weather affect atmospheric pressure while temperature affects vapor pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure" is correct?
options: 表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓
氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。
氣蝕指標數值可直接換算成混凝土磨損速率
optionsEn: Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis.
The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate
quiz.explanation: 氣蝕涉及局部壓力接近液體蒸氣壓，兩者必須使用相同絕對壓力基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cavitation concerns local pressure approaching vapor pressure, both on an absolute basis. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure", which statement holds?
options: 平均壓力高於蒸氣壓就排除所有瞬間氣蝕
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。
optionsEn: Mean pressure above vapor pressure excludes every transient cavitation event
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: atmosphericPressure=90 kPa; gaugePressure=-35 kPa; absolutePressure=90-35=55 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure"?
options: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
一次損傷體積可直接預報未來每年的固定損失
optionsEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
One damage-volume survey predicts a fixed annual future loss
quiz.explanation: 將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 絕對壓力與蒸氣壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Absolute pressure and vapor pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Absolute pressure and vapor pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Diagnose it by the following check: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。診斷時應採取以下查核：將氣壓計與壓力感測器零點校正對齊並記錄水溫，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Diagnose it by the following check: Align barometer and pressure-sensor zero checks and record water temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「絕對壓力與蒸氣壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Absolute pressure and vapor pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。
氣蝕指標數值可直接換算成混凝土磨損速率
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation.
The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate
quiz.explanation: 混用表壓與絕對壓會錯估距離氣化條件的餘量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing gauge and absolute pressure misstates the margin to vapor formation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 氣蝕指標與速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cavitation index and velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「氣蝕指標與速度」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cavitation index and velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 氣蝕指標把高於蒸氣壓的壓力餘量除以參考動壓，可比較局部低壓對高速水流的相對程度。分母速度必須與起蝕資料使用相同定義；指標不是破壞速率，表面不平整、氣核與含氣保護仍會改變實際結果。 驗證時應同步量測參考速度與局部壓力並標明指標定義，並辨識以下失效情境：採不同位置速度比較門檻會造成不一致判讀。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「氣蝕指標與速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The cavitation index normalizes pressure margin above vapor pressure by a reference dynamic pressure. Its velocity definition must match the inception data used for comparison. The index is not a damage-rate law; surface irregularities, nuclei and protective aeration still affect the physical outcome. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure reference velocity and local pressure together and state the index definition. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. knowledge.title: 氣蝕指標與速度
knowledge.text: 氣蝕指標把高於蒸氣壓的壓力餘量除以參考動壓，可比較局部低壓對高速水流的相對程度。分母速度必須與起蝕資料使用相同定義；指標不是破壞速率，表面不平整、氣核與含氣保護仍會改變實際結果。
knowledge.textEn: The cavitation index normalizes pressure margin above vapor pressure by a reference dynamic pressure. Its velocity definition must match the inception data used for comparison.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：氣蝕指標數值可直接換算成混凝土磨損速率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「氣蝕指標與速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: The cavitation index directly converts into a concrete damage rate
Equal offset heights have identical cavitation effects in every orientation
The cavitation index normalizes pressure margin above vapor pressure by a reference dynamic pressure.

quiz.explanationEn: The cavitation index normalizes pressure margin above vapor pressure by a reference dynamic pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：pAbsolute=100 kPa; pVapor=2.3 kPa; rho=1000 kg/m3; V=20 m/s; sigma=(100000-2300)/(0.5*1000*20**2)=0.4885。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 氣蝕指標與速度：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 同步量測參考速度與局部壓力並標明指標定義。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「採不同位置速度比較門檻會造成不一致判讀」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure reference velocity and local pressure together and state the index definition. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：採不同位置速度比較門檻會造成不一致判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 氣蝕指標與速度：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「氣蝕指標與速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cavitation index and velocity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 採不同位置速度比較門檻會造成不一致判讀。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測參考速度與局部壓力並標明指標定義，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using velocities from different reference locations makes threshold comparisons inconsistent. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Air supply and phase fraction" and "Vent losses and suction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 摻氣量與相分率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Air supply and phase fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「摻氣量與相分率」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Air supply and phase fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 供氣可緩和氣泡潰滅附近的局部壓力衝擊，但入口總氣量不等於近壁保護濃度。水氣體積比需以相同壓力溫度定義，並區分氣水比與混合物空隙率；氣泡滑移與沿程脫氣使兩者的空間分布更複雜。 驗證時應同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「摻氣量與相分率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air supply can cushion local collapse pressures, but total supplied air is not near-wall protective concentration. Use consistent pressure and temperature and distinguish air-to-water volume ratio from mixture void fraction. Bubble slip and downstream detrainment complicate the spatial distribution further. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Air supply and phase fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Qa=6 m3/s andQw=54 m3/s at common conditions; bulkVoidFraction=6/(6+54)=0.10.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate total air supply guarantees adequate aeration at every wall" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. steps.title: 摻氣量與相分率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Air supply and phase fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「摻氣量與相分率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Air supply and phase fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測供氣管流量與底部含氣剖面並標記壓力溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure vent supply and near-bed air profiles together with pressure and temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總供氣量足夠就保證每個壁面都有足夠含氣」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate total air supply guarantees adequate aeration at every wall" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「摻氣量與相分率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Air supply and phase fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed.
quiz.explanation: 總供氣量正常但氣泡浮離底部仍可能缺乏保護。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal total supply can coexist with poor protection when bubbles leave the bed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 通氣管損失與負壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vent losses and suction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通氣管損失與負壓」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vent losses and suction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。低馬赫數近似可用局部損失估壓差；若壓差大或接近可壓縮限制，必須改用適當氣體流模型，不可直接照搬不可壓縮公式。 驗證時應量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力，並辨識以下失效情境：通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通氣管損失與負壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. At low Mach number, a local-loss relation estimates pressure drop. Large pressure differences or compressibility limits require a gas-flow model instead of unconditional use of an incompressible expression. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vent losses and suction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通氣管損失與負壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vent losses and suction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通氣管損失與負壓
knowledge.text: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。低馬赫數近似可用局部損失估壓差；若壓差大或接近可壓縮限制，必須改用適當氣體流模型，不可直接照搬不可壓縮公式。
knowledge.textEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. At low Mach number, a local-loss relation estimates pressure drop.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通氣管損失與負壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vent losses and suction" is correct?
options: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。
空腔越負壓就表示摻氣保護一定越好
只要有摻氣坎就不可能發生空腔淹沒
optionsEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape.
Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection
The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible
quiz.explanation: 摻氣槽形成的空腔需透過通氣管補氣，管路阻力會降低空腔壓力並影響射流軌跡。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Aerator cavities draw air through ducts whose resistance changes cavity pressure and jet shape. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通氣管損失與負壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vent losses and suction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通氣管損失與負壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vent losses and suction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「通氣管損失與負壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vent losses and suction", which statement holds?
options: 一個拉拔試點合格就證明整片修補完全黏結
原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。
表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓
optionsEn: One passing pull-off test proves complete bond over the entire repair
Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa.
Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: Low-Mach air: rhoAir=1.2 kg/m3; lossK=3; airV=20 m/s; pressureLoss=3*0.5*1.2*20**2=720 Pa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vent losses and suction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 通氣入口堵塞可降低供氣並加深空腔負壓。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測通氣口與空腔壓差並檢查網罩和轉彎阻力，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A blocked vent inlet reduces supply and deepens cavity suction. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure inlet-to-cavity pressure drop and inspect screens and bends. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stronger cavity suction always means better aeration protection" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「拋離空腔與再附著」與「損傷盤點與體積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Jet cavity and reattachment" and "Damage mapping and volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 拋離空腔與再附著：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Jet cavity and reattachment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「拋離空腔與再附著」如何影響溢洪道氣蝕防治的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Jet cavity and reattachment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Cavitation mitigation in spillways”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 摻氣坎讓水流暫時離開底板並在下方形成供氣空腔，水舌再附著位置影響近壁含氣與局部壓力。水平拋射簡式只估無阻力的中心線，不代表含氣分布；設計需同時檢查空腔是否淹沒與再附著後的保護長度。 驗證時應以影像量測空腔長度並檢查再附著後近壁含氣，並辨識以下失效情境：尾水或水深增大可能淹沒空腔並切斷補氣。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「拋離空腔與再附著」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An aerator ramp lifts flow from the floor and forms an air cavity. Reattachment affects near-wall air and pressure. A horizontal ballistic estimate gives only a drag-free centerline, not concentration. Check cavity drowning and protection downstream of reattachment as separate performance questions. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure cavity length optically and inspect near-wall air downstream of reattachment. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Higher water depth can drown the cavity and interrupt air supply. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Jet cavity and reattachment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要有摻氣坎就不可能發生空腔淹沒」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「拋離空腔與再附著」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Jet cavity and reattachment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 拋離空腔與再附著
knowledge.text: 摻氣坎讓水流暫時離開底板並在下方形成供氣空腔，水舌再附著位置影響近壁含氣與局部壓力。水平拋射簡式只估無阻力的中心線，不代表含氣分布；設計需同時檢查空腔是否淹沒與再附著後的保護長度。
knowledge.textEn: An aerator ramp lifts flow from the floor and forms an air cavity. Reattachment affects near-wall air and pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要有摻氣坎就不可能發生空腔淹沒 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: HorizontalLaunchV=15 m/s; drop=0.20 m; flightTime=sqrt(2*0.20/9.81); range=15*sqrt(0.4/9.81)=3.02891 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 尾水或水深增大可能淹沒空腔並切斷補氣。診斷時應採取以下查核：以影像量測空腔長度並檢查再附著後近壁含氣，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Higher water depth can drown the cavity and interrupt air supply. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure cavity length optically and inspect near-wall air downstream of reattachment. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The presence of an aerator ramp makes cavity drowning impossible" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instructionEn: Cavitation pits can grow and alter subsequent flow. Establish a repeatable surface datum before repair. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: damagedArea=12 m2; meanLossDepth=0.025 m; lostVolume=12*0.025=0.30 m3.

knowledge.text: 以單次平均損傷量線性外推可能漏掉幾何惡化的加速效應。診斷時應採取以下查核：用重複三維掃描比較凹坑位置體積並保留運轉流量紀錄，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。

Diagnose it by the following check: Compare repeated three-dimensional pit maps and volumes against operating discharge records. steps.title: 修補黏結與平整：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 修補材料需與基材共同承受水力脈壓及溫度變形，表面平順與黏結完整同樣重要。拉拔試驗只檢查局部黏結樣本，不能證明整片無空鼓；施工記錄應包含基面處理、養護與沿流接縫輪廓，避免修補本身形成新缺陷。 驗證時應結合拉拔位置圖敲測或適用非破壞檢查與表面剖面，並辨識以下失效情境：局部拉拔合格仍可能存在未取樣的空鼓帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「修補黏結與平整」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repairs must transfer hydraulic pulses and thermal deformation to the substrate. Smoothness and bond continuity both matter. Pull-off tests sample local adhesion and cannot prove an entire patch void-free; document preparation, curing and flowwise joint profiles so the repair does not create another initiating defect. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Combine mapped pull-off locations, suitable void detection and surface profiles. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: PullOffLoad=9 kN; testArea=0.003 m2; nominalBondStress=9/0.003/1000=3 MPa.
