steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 氣蝕損傷與高風險工況的持續時間有關，但不同流速與壓力不能以相同小時數直接等價。曝露時數可建立追蹤帳，仍須按流量、水位、含氣與缺陷狀態分組；修補後對照試驗應保持工況可比，才能辨識改善。 驗證時應按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，並辨識以下失效情境：只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「運轉曝露與追蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.text: 氣蝕損傷與高風險工況的持續時間有關，但不同流速與壓力不能以相同小時數直接等價。曝露時數可建立追蹤帳，仍須按流量、水位、含氣與缺陷狀態分組；修補後對照試驗應保持工況可比，才能辨識改善。

steps.title: 運轉曝露與追蹤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Operating exposure and follow-up: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運轉曝露與追蹤」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Operating exposure and follow-up” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Three identified operating intervals=2.5,1.0,3.5 h; totalRecordedExposure=2.5+1.0+3.5=7 h; no linear damage law。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Three identified operating intervals=2.5,1.0,3.5 h; totalRecordedExposure=2.5+1.0+3.5=7 h; no linear damage law. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 運轉曝露與追蹤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Operating exposure and follow-up: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運轉曝露與追蹤」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Operating exposure and follow-up” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 交接時以按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 運轉曝露與追蹤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Operating exposure and follow-up: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運轉曝露與追蹤」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Operating exposure and follow-up” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Diagnose it by the following check: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有運轉一小時造成的氣蝕損傷必定相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every operating hour necessarily causes the same cavitation damage" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。診斷時應採取以下查核：按流量水位與含氣狀態分組比較修補前後檢測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Diagnose it by the following check: Group inspections by discharge, stage and aeration when comparing before and after repair. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運轉曝露與追蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Operating exposure and follow-up" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。
表壓負值就表示液體一定已達蒸氣壓
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation.
Any negative gauge pressure proves that liquid has reached vapor pressure
quiz.explanation: 只比較總時數會掩蓋高速度短時工況的不同作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing total hours alone hides the different effects of brief high-speed operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大型弧形閘門安裝
courses.summary: 本課以以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門為主線，先用曲面水壓與水平力與曲面垂直分量界定水力與構造條件，再將吊索角度與張力、支臂長細與屈曲連結到同步行程與試運轉。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning through Curved pressure and horizontal force and Vertical pressure component, then connects Sling angle and tension and Arm slenderness and buckling to Synchronized travel and commissioning. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以鉸軸幾何受力傳遞與同步試運轉安裝弧門
courses.focusEn: Installing radial gates through trunnion geometry load paths and synchronized commissioning
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查曲面水壓與水平力：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN；再獨立檢查曲面垂直分量：Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body。敏感度：相同矩形投影寬度8m下，水深由6增至7m時水平靜水力由1412.64增至1922.76kN，增加36.11%；荷載按水深平方成長，不能用水位增加百分比直接放大全部構件反力。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。算例為準靜態簡化構件，起吊與蓄水驗收仍須核准吊裝計畫、結構分析及現場量測。 將核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Curved pressure and horizontal force: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. Independently examine Vertical pressure component: Specified imaginary waterVolume=45 m3; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; verticalMagnitude=45*9.81=441.45 kN; direction from free body. Sensitivity: for an8m-wide rectangular projection, raising depth from6 to7m increases horizontal hydrostatic force from1412.64 to1922.76kN, or36.11 percent. This quadratic change does not imply the same factor for every component reaction. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Examples idealize quasi-static components; lifting and impoundment acceptance require approved plans structural analysis and field measurements. Use the following independent check: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「曲面水壓與水平力」與「曲面垂直分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Curved pressure and horizontal force" and "Vertical pressure component": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「曲面水壓與水平力」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Curved pressure and horizontal force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。 驗證時應核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，並辨識以下失效情境：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「曲面水壓與水平力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components. The horizontal component follows the vertical projection, but weight, friction and eccentricity still create moments that depend on installed geometry. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Curved pressure and horizontal force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「曲面水壓與水平力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Curved pressure and horizontal force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 曲面水壓與水平力
knowledge.text: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。水平分量可用垂直投影面計算；此便利不表示閘門沒有重量、摩擦或偏心力矩，安裝幾何與受力必須共同核對。
knowledge.textEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. Resolve the resultant into horizontal and vertical components.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「曲面水壓與水平力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Curved pressure and horizontal force" is correct?
options: 理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩
弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。
曲面面積乘平均壓力必然就是垂直水壓力
optionsEn: Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment
Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion.
Curved area times mean pressure always equals vertical hydrostatic force
quiz.explanation: 弧門曲面上的靜水壓沿表面法線作用，理想同心圓弧的壓力線通過鉸軸，但合力仍須分解成水平與垂直分量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydrostatic pressure acts normal to the curved skin, and ideal concentric normals pass through the trunnion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「曲面水壓與水平力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: Vertical rectangular projection from free surface: width=8 m; depth=6 m; horizontalForce=0.5*9.81*8*6**2=1412.64 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Curved pressure and horizontal force", which statement holds?

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「曲面水壓與水平力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Curved pressure and horizontal force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「曲面水壓與水平力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Curved pressure and horizontal force"?
options: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力
optionsEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Total tension divided by anchor count equals every anchor maximum
quiz.explanation: 核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 曲面水壓與水平力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Curved pressure and horizontal force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「曲面水壓與水平力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Curved pressure and horizontal force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 圓弧中心偏離鉸軸會增加原本理想模型沒有的水壓力矩。診斷時應採取以下查核：核對水位與曲面垂直投影尺寸並確認鉸軸位置，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A curvature center offset from the trunnion adds hydrostatic moment absent from the ideal model. Diagnose it by the following check: Check water level and projected dimensions and survey the trunnion position. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙鉸軸同軸量測」與「軸承摩擦與啟閉」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Trunnion coaxiality surveying" and "Bearing friction and operation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Trunnion coaxiality surveying: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙鉸軸同軸量測」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 左右鉸軸需要符合設計同軸與高程條件，偏差會使支臂扭曲並增加軸承摩擦。兩端高差除跨度只是小角度幾何示意，不代表完整三維同軸誤差；還需量測軸線方向、支座位置與溫度變化後的相對移動。 驗證時應以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙鉸軸同軸量測」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Both trunnions must satisfy alignment and elevation requirements. Misalignment twists arms and raises bearing friction. End-height difference divided by span illustrates one small-angle component, not full three-dimensional coaxiality; also survey axis orientation, support positions and temperature-dependent relative movement. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙鉸軸同軸量測」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Trunnion coaxiality surveying”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測
knowledge.text: 左右鉸軸需要符合設計同軸與高程條件，偏差會使支臂扭曲並增加軸承摩擦。兩端高差除跨度只是小角度幾何示意，不代表完整三維同軸誤差；還需量測軸線方向、支座位置與溫度變化後的相對移動。
knowledge.textEn: Both trunnions must satisfy alignment and elevation requirements. Misalignment twists arms and raises bearing friction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Trunnion coaxiality surveying: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙鉸軸同軸量測」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：endElevationDifference=3 mm; span=10000 mm; smallAngle=3/10000=0.000300 rad。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。

steps.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Trunnion coaxiality surveying: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙鉸軸同軸量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。

Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.text: 交接時以以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。

Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙鉸軸同軸量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Trunnion coaxiality surveying"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Equal side-position readings guarantee equal loads on both sides
Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙鉸軸同軸量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Trunnion coaxiality surveying: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙鉸軸同軸量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Trunnion coaxiality surveying” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。診斷時應採取以下查核：以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. Diagnose it by the following check: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩鉸中心同高就保證三維軸線完全同軸」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal trunnion-center elevations guarantee complete three-dimensional coaxiality" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只核對中心高程會漏掉軸線方向偏斜。診斷時應採取以下查核：以獨立控制網量測兩鉸軸中心與方向並核對溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Checking center elevations alone misses angular axis misalignment. Diagnose it by the following check: Survey both trunnion centers and directions from an independent network and record temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙鉸軸同軸量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Trunnion coaxiality surveying" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Constant bearing reaction guarantees constant friction torque

steps.title: 軸承摩擦與啟閉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bearing friction and operation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「軸承摩擦與啟閉」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bearing friction and operation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鉸軸摩擦把支承反力轉成阻力矩，潤滑不足、鏽蝕與偏心會改變摩擦係數。簡化庫侖摩擦式只估給定接觸狀態的量級，不能保證啟動與運轉摩擦相同；驗證應比較鉸反力、啟動力及運轉後溫升趨勢。 驗證時應比較啟動與穩定運轉的馬達電流及軸承溫升，並辨識以下失效情境：摩擦上升可能把額外彎矩傳入原本主要受壓支臂。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軸承摩擦與啟閉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trunnion friction converts bearing reaction into resisting torque. Lubrication, corrosion and misalignment change the coefficient. A Coulomb estimate describes a specified contact state and does not make breakaway and running friction identical; compare reaction, starting demand and subsequent temperature trends. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare motor current at breakaway and steady travel with bearing temperature rise. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Rising friction can introduce additional bending into primarily compressed arms. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bearing friction and operation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：bearingReaction=1800 kN; frictionCoefficient=0.08; effectiveRadius=0.20 m; frictionTorque=1800*0.08*0.20=28.8 kN*m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: bearingReaction=1800 kN; frictionCoefficient=0.08; effectiveRadius=0.20 m; frictionTorque=1800*0.08*0.20=28.8 kN*m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「軸承反力不變就表示摩擦力矩永遠不變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Constant bearing reaction guarantees constant friction torque" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「軸承摩擦與啟閉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 軸承摩擦與啟閉
knowledge.text: 鉸軸摩擦把支承反力轉成阻力矩，潤滑不足、鏽蝕與偏心會改變摩擦係數。簡化庫侖摩擦式只估給定接觸狀態的量級，不能保證啟動與運轉摩擦相同；驗證應比較鉸反力、啟動力及運轉後溫升趨勢。

steps.instruction: 摩擦上升可能把額外彎矩傳入原本主要受壓支臂。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較啟動與穩定運轉的馬達電流及軸承溫升，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sling angle and tension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重心偏移可讓單側吊索超出對稱分載估計。診斷時應採取以下查核：以吊點荷重讀值核對分載並確認重心與吊索角度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An offset center of mass can overload one sling relative to symmetric sharing. Diagnose it by the following check: Check sharing with pick-point load readings and confirm center of mass and sling angles. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two slings each carry half the weight regardless of angle" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 面板支承間彎曲：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 門葉面板把分布水壓傳到肋材，再經主梁與支臂送至鉸軸，支承距離會強烈影響局部彎曲。簡支條帶模型只示範一維傳力，實際板的雙向作用、焊接拘束與曲率需另分析；驗證須核對肋距及面板厚度。 驗證時應量測肋間距與板厚並比較受水壓後局部撓度，並辨識以下失效情境：肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板支承間彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The skin transfers distributed pressure to stiffeners, girders and arms. Support spacing strongly affects local bending. A simply supported strip illustrates one-dimensional action only; plate action, welded restraint and curvature need separate treatment. Verify actual stiffener spacing and thickness before comparing measured deformation. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure stiffener spacing and thickness and compare local deflection under water pressure. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Skinplate bending between supports” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Unit-width strip: pressure=50 kPa; lineLoad=50 kN/m; span=1.2 m; simpleBeamMoment=50*1.2**2/8=9 kN*m per1m strip。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Unit-width strip: pressure=50 kPa; lineLoad=50 kN/m; span=1.2 m; simpleBeamMoment=50*1.2**2/8=9 kN*m per1m strip.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal total skin area guarantees identical local bending" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「面板支承間彎曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 面板支承間彎曲：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Skinplate bending between supports: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板支承間彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Skinplate bending between supports” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測肋間距與板厚並比較受水壓後局部撓度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure stiffener spacing and thickness and compare local deflection under water pressure. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以量測肋間距與板厚並比較受水壓後局部撓度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Measure stiffener spacing and thickness and compare local deflection under water pressure. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 面板支承間彎曲：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Skinplate bending between supports: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「面板支承間彎曲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Skinplate bending between supports” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 肋材漏焊或接續不良可能延長實際無支承跨度。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測肋間距與板厚並比較受水壓後局部撓度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Missing or defective stiffener welds can increase the effective unsupported span. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure stiffener spacing and thickness and compare local deflection under water pressure. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「面板總面積相同就保證局部彎曲完全相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal total skin area guarantees identical local bending" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「支臂長細與屈曲」與「支座錨定與分載」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Arm slenderness and buckling" and "Support anchorage and load sharing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 支臂長細與屈曲：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Arm slenderness and buckling: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支臂長細與屈曲」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Arm slenderness and buckling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 支臂承受壓力時需檢查整體穩定與局部板件屈曲，端部拘束會影響有效長度。歐拉公式僅適用理想彈性細長柱，不涵蓋初始彎曲、殘餘應力與組合彎矩；安裝偏差應進入模型而非只驗收截面積。 驗證時應核對支臂初始直線度接點拘束與局部板件尺寸，並辨識以下失效情境：鉸軸摩擦或偏心彎矩會降低理想軸壓模型的適用性。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支臂長細與屈曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compressed arms require global and local stability checks. End restraint affects effective length. Euler theory applies to an ideal elastic slender member and omits imperfections, residual stress and combined bending; installed deviations belong in the model rather than being ignored after checking area alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check arm straightness, connection restraint and local plate dimensions. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Trunnion friction or eccentric bending invalidates a purely axial idealization. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Arm slenderness and buckling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ideal pinned elastic column: E=200e9 Pa; I=0.00008 m4; L=6 m; Pcr=pi**2*200e9*0.00008/6**2/1000=4386.49 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal pinned elastic column: E=200e9 Pa; I=0.00008 m4; L=6 m; Pcr=pi**2*200e9*0.00008/6**2/1000=4386.49 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「理想歐拉屈曲力就是現場支臂可直接承受荷載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ideal Euler load is the directly usable field capacity of the arm" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支臂長細與屈曲」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Arm slenderness and buckling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支臂長細與屈曲
knowledge.text: 支臂承受壓力時需檢查整體穩定與局部板件屈曲，端部拘束會影響有效長度。歐拉公式僅適用理想彈性細長柱，不涵蓋初始彎曲、殘餘應力與組合彎矩；安裝偏差應進入模型而非只驗收截面積。
knowledge.textEn: Compressed arms require global and local stability checks. End restraint affects effective length.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：理想歐拉屈曲力就是現場支臂可直接承受荷載 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal pinned elastic column: E=200e9 Pa; I=0.00008 m4; L=6 m; Pcr=pi**2*200e9*0.00008/6**2/1000=4386.49 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對支臂初始直線度接點拘束與局部板件尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check arm straightness, connection restraint and local plate dimensions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 支座錨定與分載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Support anchorage and load sharing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支座錨定與分載」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support anchorage and load sharing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。平均分載只能作帳務起點；灌漿空洞、預緊差異與裂縫會改變接觸及荷載路徑，須配合局部模型與檢測。 驗證時應核對預緊紀錄灌漿完整性與支座變形再比較分載，並辨識以下失效情境：底板局部離縫會把拉力集中到少數錨栓。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支座錨定與分載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. Eccentricity and plate flexibility generally make bolt forces unequal. Equal sharing is only a bookkeeping start; grout voids, preload variation and cracking alter contact and load paths and need local analysis and inspection. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Review preload, grout continuity and support deformation before comparing load sharing. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Local baseplate separation concentrates tension in a few anchors. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support anchorage and load sharing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Ideal centered tension=800 kN; eight equal-stiffness anchors; averageTension=800/8=100 kN per anchor.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total tension divided by anchor count equals every anchor maximum" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支座錨定與分載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Support anchorage and load sharing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 支座錨定與分載
knowledge.text: 鉸支座透過底板、錨定與混凝土把反力傳入壩墩，各螺栓受力通常因偏心與底板彈性而不均。平均分載只能作帳務起點；灌漿空洞、預緊差異與裂縫會改變接觸及荷載路徑，須配合局部模型與檢測。
knowledge.textEn: Trunnion supports transfer load through plates, anchorage and concrete. Eccentricity and plate flexibility generally make bolt forces unequal.

knowledge.text: 誤解：總拉力除錨栓數就是每支錨栓的實際最大力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 側封壓縮與摩擦：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「側封壓縮與摩擦」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Side-seal compression and friction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 側封須在門葉運動範圍維持接觸，過少壓縮會漏水，過多則增加摩擦與磨耗。壓縮百分比是幾何量，不是接觸壓力的通用換算式；橡膠硬度、溫度與支承形狀需按供應商資料及實際接觸試驗確認。 驗證時應沿全行程量測封面接觸與啟閉阻力並定位滲漏，並辨識以下失效情境：偏斜門葉可使一側過壓縮而另一側失去密封。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側封壓縮與摩擦」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Side seals need contact throughout travel. Too little compression leaks, while too much raises friction and wear. Compression percentage is geometry rather than a universal contact-pressure law; elastomer hardness, temperature and support shape require supplier information and representative contact testing. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Measure seal contact and operating resistance throughout travel and locate leakage. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A skewed gate can overcompress one seal while unloading the other. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Side-seal compression and friction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止水壓縮越多就必定越好且沒有代價」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More seal compression is always better and has no adverse effect" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側封壓縮與摩擦」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Side-seal compression and friction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: FreeSealThickness=30 mm; installedThickness=24 mm; compression=(30-24)/30*100=20 percent. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 偏斜門葉可使一側過壓縮而另一側失去密封。診斷時應採取以下查核：沿全行程量測封面接觸與啟閉阻力並定位滲漏，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A skewed gate can overcompress one seal while unloading the other. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure seal contact and operating resistance throughout travel and locate leakage. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More seal compression is always better and has no adverse effect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「同步行程與試運轉」如何影響大型弧形閘門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synchronized travel and commissioning” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large radial-gate installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雙側啟閉機不同步會造成門葉扭轉與封面不均，試運轉需逐工況核對行程、負荷與停留位置。兩側位移差除跨距僅是小角度扭斜指標；最終判定還需軸承、支臂與密封反應，不能只依位置訊號相近。 驗證時應同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持，並辨識以下失效情境：位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「同步行程與試運轉」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unsynchronized drives skew the leaf and seals. Commissioning must compare travel, load and stopping positions across operating states. Differential travel divided by span is only a small-angle skew indicator; acceptance also requires bearing, arm and seal response rather than nearly equal position signals alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Synchronized travel and commissioning” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal side-position readings guarantee equal loads on both sides" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「同步行程與試運轉」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Synchronized travel and commissioning”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

options: 兩側位置讀值相同就保證兩側荷載相同

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同步行程與試運轉」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Synchronized travel and commissioning” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: LeftTravel=1250 mm; rightTravel=1244 mm; spacing=12000 mm; skewIndicator=(1250-1244)/12000=0.0005 rad. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 同步行程與試運轉：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synchronized travel and commissioning: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「同步行程與試運轉」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Synchronized travel and commissioning” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步記錄兩側行程與負荷並核對限位及停機後保持作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Record both travels and loads synchronously and check limits and position holding. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「同步行程與試運轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Synchronized travel and commissioning" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。
理想弧門水壓通過鉸軸就代表全部荷載皆無力矩
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds.
Pressure passing through the trunnion means every gate load has zero moment
quiz.explanation: 位置訊號一致但一側卡阻仍可能出現不均勻受力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Matching position signals can coexist with unequal force when one side binds. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 升降式水閘門吊裝
courses.summary: 本課以以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門為主線，先用矩形門葉靜水力與水壓中心與輪載界定水力與構造條件，再將上提力與水動力、鋼索彈性與行程連結到洩量率定與交接。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks through Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force and Pressure center and wheel reactions, then connects Hoisting force and hydraulic load and Rope elasticity and travel to Discharge rating and handover. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以導軌輪壓啟閉力及幾何查核組立升降門
courses.focusEn: Erecting lift gates through guide geometry wheel reactions and operating-force checks
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查矩形門葉靜水力：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN；再獨立檢查水壓中心與輪載：Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m。敏感度：輪載600kN不變而滾動阻力係數由0.01增為0.03，阻力由6增至18kN；此增量應連結實測輪軸狀態，不能把所有阻力都以同一固定係數涵蓋。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。採準靜態示意且各工況分開，荷載組合、吊裝與通水程序須依核准工程文件。 將定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. Independently examine Pressure center and wheel reactions: Triangular pressure depth=6 m; pressureCenterBelowSurface=2*6/3=4 m. Sensitivity: for a600kN wheel load, increasing the rolling-resistance coefficient from0.01 to0.03 raises resistance from6 to18kN. Relate this change to observed wheel conditions instead of assigning one coefficient to every resistance mechanism. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Quasi-static examples keep load cases separate; combinations lifting and wet commissioning require approved engineering documents. Use the following independent check: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「矩形門葉靜水力」與「水壓中心與輪載」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" and "Pressure center and wheel reactions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「矩形門葉靜水力」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。 驗證時應核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較，並辨識以下失效情境：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「矩形門葉靜水力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case. With water on both sides or partial immersion, integrate each pressure field and obtain the net action instead of using full upstream load. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「矩形門葉靜水力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 矩形門葉靜水力
knowledge.text: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。以自由水面起算的三角分布只能代表指定工況；兩側都有水或門葉不完全浸沒時，應分別積分並取淨作用。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. A triangular distribution from a free surface represents one specific case.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「矩形門葉靜水力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force" is correct?
options: 上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力
平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。
水壓合力一定作用在幾何中心深度
optionsEn: Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf
Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides.
The hydrostatic resultant always acts at geometric middepth
quiz.explanation: 平面升降門承受隨深度增加的水壓，合力位置與平均壓力不同，需將荷載傳到輪組或滑塊再送入門槽。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure on a flat leaf grows with depth and transfers through wheels or slides into guides. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「矩形門葉靜水力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「矩形門葉靜水力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force", which statement holds?
options: 門葉能移動就證明每個輪子正常滾動
雙吊點總載重合格就保證兩側都不超載
原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。
optionsEn: Gate movement proves that every wheel is rolling correctly
An acceptable total load guarantees neither pick point is overloaded
Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: One-sided depth=5 m; width=6 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; force=0.5*9.81*6*5**2=735.75 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 矩形門葉靜水力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「矩形門葉靜水力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rectangular leaf hydrostatic force” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對兩側同時水位並以門葉應變與輪載量測比較。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「漏扣下游水壓會算錯淨力與其作用位置」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Check simultaneous water levels on both sides against leaf strain and wheel-load measurements. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Omitting downstream pressure misstates net force and its line of action. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

steps.title: 門槽平行與淨距：機制與系統路徑
