steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Guide parallelism and clearance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 導軌間距沿高度的變化會影響門葉行走，局部過窄可能卡阻，過寬則改變輪緣與密封接觸。幾何淨距只是裝配檢查，尚需考慮溫度、受水壓撓曲及施工偏差；不能只量上下兩點就宣稱全行程平行。 驗證時應沿全高度分站量測導軌淨距並檢查受荷後變形，並辨識以下失效情境：中段局部收窄可能在端點量測正常時仍造成卡門。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門槽平行與淨距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Guide spacing along the travel path affects movement. A narrow point can bind while excessive clearance changes flange and seal contact. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Survey guide clearance at multiple elevations and inspect deformation under load. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A local midheight narrowing can bind a gate despite correct endpoint readings. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Guide parallelism and clearance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 輪組應以滾動降低啟閉阻力，但軸承損傷、輪緣摩擦與軌道錯位會引入滑動或偏載。用等效滾動係數只描述已知狀態的總阻力，不能把轉不動的輪仍當正常滾動；要比較輪轉速、行程與驅動負荷。 驗證時應同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度，並辨識以下失效情境：輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「輪組滾動與阻力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wheels reduce operating resistance through rolling, but bearing damage, flange rubbing and misalignment introduce sliding and eccentric load. An equivalent coefficient describes a known state only. A seized wheel cannot still be modeled as normal rolling; compare rotation, travel and drive demand. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wheel rolling and resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 輪組滾動與阻力
knowledge.text: 輪組應以滾動降低啟閉阻力，但軸承損傷、輪緣摩擦與軌道錯位會引入滑動或偏載。用等效滾動係數只描述已知狀態的總阻力，不能把轉不動的輪仍當正常滾動；要比較輪轉速、行程與驅動負荷。
knowledge.textEn: Wheels reduce operating resistance through rolling, but bearing damage, flange rubbing and misalignment introduce sliding and eccentric load. An equivalent coefficient describes a known state only.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：門葉能移動就證明每個輪子正常滾動 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gate movement proves that every wheel is rolling correctly Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「輪組滾動與阻力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

輪組應以滾動降低啟閉阻力，但軸承損傷、輪緣摩擦與軌道錯位會引入滑動或偏載。
空載試車通過就保證所有通水開度啟閉力足夠
optionsEn: Gate movement proves that every wheel is rolling correctly
Wheels reduce operating resistance through rolling, but bearing damage, flange rubbing and misalignment introduce sliding and eccentric load.
Passing dry tests guarantees adequate hoisting force at every wet opening

quiz.explanationEn: Wheels reduce operating resistance through rolling, but bearing damage, flange rubbing and misalignment introduce sliding and eccentric load. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 輪組滾動與阻力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wheel rolling and resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「輪組滾動與阻力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wheel rolling and resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：totalNormalWheelLoad=600 kN; equivalentRollingCoefficient=0.015; resistance=600*0.015=9 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: totalNormalWheelLoad=600 kN; equivalentRollingCoefficient=0.015; resistance=600*0.015=9 kN. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 輪組滾動與阻力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wheel rolling and resistance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「輪組滾動與阻力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wheel rolling and resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 輪組滾動與阻力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wheel rolling and resistance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「輪組滾動與阻力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wheel rolling and resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 輪停止轉動而門仍移動會造成滑磨與阻力升高。診斷時應採取以下查核：同步量測門葉行程與輪轉數並核對軸承溫度，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stationary wheel on a moving gate causes sliding wear and higher resistance. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare gate travel with wheel rotation and check bearing temperature. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 上提力與水動力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hoisting force and hydraulic load: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上提力與水動力」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hoisting force and hydraulic load” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上提需求包括自重、浮力、密封摩擦及水流造成的上下吸力，項目方向要在同一自由體圖列明。把已知分量代數相加可示範平衡，但動水吸力隨開度與下游邊界改變；不能以空載試車推定所有通水工況。 驗證時應在不同開度同步記錄吊點力兩側水位及密封接觸，並辨識以下失效情境：空載運轉正常仍可能在部分開度出現大下吸力。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上提力與水動力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hoisting demand includes weight, buoyancy, seal friction and flow-induced vertical force. Show directions in one free-body diagram. Adding prescribed components illustrates equilibrium, while hydrodynamic downpull changes with opening and tailwater. Dry travel tests therefore cannot establish every wet operating condition. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record lifting force, both water levels and seal contact at several openings. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Normal dry operation can coexist with strong downpull at partial opening. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hoisting force and hydraulic load” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：weight=300 kN; buoyancy=40 kN; sealFriction=25 kN; downpull=60 kN; liftDemand=300-40+25+60=345 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: weight=300 kN; buoyancy=40 kN; sealFriction=25 kN; downpull=60 kN; liftDemand=300-40+25+60=345 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空載試車通過就保證所有通水開度啟閉力足夠」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：weight=300 kN; buoyancy=40 kN; sealFriction=25 kN; downpull=60 kN; liftDemand=300-40+25+60=345 kN。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 底封接觸與雜物：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Bottom seal contact and debris: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「底封接觸與雜物」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bottom seal contact and debris” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 底封需在門葉就位時形成連續接觸，沉積物與門檻不平整會造成局部縫隙。滲漏孔口式只估已知缺口的水量量級，軟封變形與顆粒沖移會改變面積；應觀察漏水位置與接觸圖，而非只看總漏量。 驗證時應定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量，並辨識以下失效情境：局部硬物頂住底封會使其餘位置無法均勻就位。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「底封接觸與雜物」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bottom seals require continuous contact on seating. Sediment and sill irregularity create local openings. An orifice estimate applies to a prescribed gap, while elastomer deformation and particle movement change its area. Inspect leakage location and contact patterns instead of judging performance by total flow alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A hard object beneath the seal prevents uniform seating elsewhere. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bottom seal contact and debris” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：Assumed defectArea=0.0005 m2; Cd=0.6; head=4 m; leakQ=0.6*0.0005*sqrt(2*9.81*4)=0.00265767 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: Assumed defectArea=0.0005 m2; Cd=0.6; head=4 m; leakQ=0.6*0.0005*sqrt(2*9.81*4)=0.00265767 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總漏量小就保證整條底封接觸完整」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bottom seal contact and debris” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部硬物頂住底封會使其餘位置無法均勻就位。診斷時應採取以下查核：定位漏點並比較清除雜物前後的接觸與漏量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A hard object beneath the seal prevents uniform seating elsewhere. Diagnose it by the following check: Locate leakage and compare contact and flow before and after debris removal. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low total leakage guarantees complete contact along the bottom seal" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「停止距離與限位」與「洩量率定與交接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Stopping distance and limits" and "Discharge rating and handover": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 停止距離與限位：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance and limits: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「停止距離與限位」如何影響升降式水閘門吊裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stopping distance and limits” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Vertical-lift water-gate erection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 限位開關與控制系統需考慮訊號延遲及機械減速，停止位置不會等於發出命令的瞬間位置。定減速算例僅是理想運動學，實際煞車能力與負荷方向、摩擦及故障狀態相關；需以核准程序做量測，不能靠猜測保留距離。 驗證時應記錄限位觸發時間實際速度與停止位置並核對重複性，並辨識以下失效情境：忽略控制延遲會低估到達硬止擋前所需距離。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停止距離與限位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Limit systems must account for signal latency and mechanical deceleration. A command position is not the final stop position. Constant-deceleration kinematics is an idealization; brake response varies with load direction, friction and faults and must be measured within an approved test procedure. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Record limit-trigger time, actual speed and stop position and check repeatability. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Ignoring control delay understates distance required before a hard stop. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping distance and limits” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：speed=0.08 m/s; delay=0.5 s; constantDeceleration=0.16 m/s2; stopDistance=0.08*0.5+0.08**2/(2*0.16)=0.060 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: speed=0.08 m/s; delay=0.5 s; constantDeceleration=0.16 m/s2; stopDistance=0.08*0.5+0.08**2/(2*0.16)=0.060 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「限位訊號一觸發門葉就會立即停止」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The leaf stops instantaneously when a limit signal activates" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「停止距離與限位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stopping distance and limits”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 停止距離與限位
knowledge.text: 限位開關與控制系統需考慮訊號延遲及機械減速，停止位置不會等於發出命令的瞬間位置。定減速算例僅是理想運動學，實際煞車能力與負荷方向、摩擦及故障狀態相關；需以核准程序做量測，不能靠猜測保留距離。
knowledge.textEn: Limit systems must account for signal latency and mechanical deceleration. A command position is not the final stop position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：限位訊號一觸發門葉就會立即停止 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The leaf stops instantaneously when a limit signal activates Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.title: 停止距離與限位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping distance and limits: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停止距離與限位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping distance and limits” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：speed=0.08 m/s; delay=0.5 s; constantDeceleration=0.16 m/s2; stopDistance=0.08*0.5+0.08**2/(2*0.16)=0.060 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: speed=0.08 m/s; delay=0.5 s; constantDeceleration=0.16 m/s2; stopDistance=0.08*0.5+0.08**2/(2*0.16)=0.060 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄限位觸發時間實際速度與停止位置並核對重複性。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停止距離與限位：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停止距離與限位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping distance and limits” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略控制延遲會低估到達硬止擋前所需距離。診斷時應採取以下查核：記錄限位觸發時間實際速度與停止位置並核對重複性，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring control delay understates distance required before a hard stop. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 閘門開度不是流量本身，兩側水位、收縮係數與淹沒會共同控制洩量。自由孔流算例只示範特定工況，不適用所有開度與尾水；交接應包含實測率定、位置校正及異常訊號的追查方式，使操作資料與實體閘門一致。 驗證時應將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表，並辨識以下失效情境：位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洩量率定與交接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Opening is not discharge: heads, contraction and submergence control the relation. A free-orifice example covers one condition, not every opening or tailwater. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同開度不論上下游水位都具有相同流量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same opening produces the same discharge at every pair of water levels" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。診斷時應採取以下查核：將實測流量與兩側水位開度共同建立率定表，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. Diagnose it by the following check: Build a rating from measured discharge together with opening and both water levels. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洩量率定與交接」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Discharge rating and handover" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。
上游水壓合力永遠就是門葉淨水壓合力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings.
Upstream hydrostatic force always equals the net force on the leaf
quiz.explanation: 位置零點錯誤會使小開度洩量產生較大相對偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A position-zero error causes larger relative discharge errors at small openings. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大壩止水帶施工
courses.summary: 本課以以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水為主線，先用水壓高度與接縫與接縫張開與伸長界定水力與構造條件，再將定位支撐與覆蓋、狹縫層流與敏感度連結到壓力保持與量測誤差。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 每單元以原創算例、量測與失效辨識共同檢查推論。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality through Head pressure and joints and Joint opening and extension, then connects Positioning support and cover and Slot flow and sensitivity to Pressure holding and measurement error. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. Each unit combines original calculation, measurement and failure diagnosis to test the inference.
courses.focus: 以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水
courses.focusEn: Forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合算例輸入全為教學假設，先檢查水壓高度與接縫：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa；再獨立檢查接縫張開與伸長：Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless。敏感度：平行板層流缺口由0.20增至0.30mm且其餘條件不變，理想滲流量按三次方增加至3.375倍；實際粗糙接縫、湍流與曲折流路不一定遵守此比例。 兩個結果須按各自量綱解釋，不能直接相加或當成完整設計。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 將比較實際水質下自由膨脹與受拘束試驗並檢查預膨潤作為獨立驗證，明確列出尚缺的現地輸入及其對結論的影響。
workedExample.textEn: Every input in this integrated example is a teaching assumption. First examine Head pressure and joints: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. Independently examine Joint opening and extension: Ideal straight activeLength=80 mm; jointOpeningIncrease=6 mm; nominalStrain=6/80=0.075 dimensionless. Sensitivity: increasing a parallel-plate laminar gap from0.20 to0.30mm at fixed conditions multiplies ideal flow by3.375. Real rough joints, turbulent flow and tortuous paths need not follow this cubic relation. Interpret each result in its own dimensions rather than adding them or treating them as a complete design. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. Use the following independent check: Compare free and confined swelling in representative water and inspect premature expansion. Identify missing field inputs and state which conclusions depend on them.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水壓高度與接縫」與「接縫張開與伸長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Head pressure and joints" and "Joint opening and extension": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水壓高度與接縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Head pressure and joints: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水壓高度與接縫」如何影響大壩止水帶施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Head pressure and joints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam waterstop installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 止水帶阻斷收縮縫或施工縫中的連通水路，所承受壓差與實際連通水頭相關。水深乘單位重只給靜水壓量級，不代表接縫任何點都處於同樣壓力；排水、局部缺陷與瞬變需另外辨識，才能確認試驗工況。 驗證時應對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差，並辨識以下失效情境：下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水壓高度與接縫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Waterstops interrupt connected paths through joints. Differential pressure depends on the connected head, not merely a nearby water level. Depth times unit weight provides a hydrostatic scale; drainage, defects and transients create different local conditions and must be identified before defining a test case. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Head pressure and joints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水壓高度與接縫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Head pressure and joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水壓高度與接縫
knowledge.text: 止水帶阻斷收縮縫或施工縫中的連通水路，所承受壓差與實際連通水頭相關。水深乘單位重只給靜水壓量級，不代表接縫任何點都處於同樣壓力；排水、局部缺陷與瞬變需另外辨識，才能確認試驗工況。
knowledge.textEn: Waterstops interrupt connected paths through joints. Differential pressure depends on the connected head, not merely a nearby water level.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水壓高度與接縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Head pressure and joints" is correct?
options: 附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差
止水帶阻斷收縮縫或施工縫中的連通水路，所承受壓差與實際連通水頭相關。
止水帶總寬度就是所有型式的有效拉伸長度
optionsEn: Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location
Waterstops interrupt connected paths through joints.
Total waterstop width is the active stretch length for every profile
quiz.explanation: 止水帶阻斷收縮縫或施工縫中的連通水路，所承受壓差與實際連通水頭相關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Waterstops interrupt connected paths through joints. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水壓高度與接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Head pressure and joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水壓高度與接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Head pressure and joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水壓高度與接縫」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Head pressure and joints", which statement holds?
options: 接頭表面平整就證明整個斷面完全熔合
止水帶本體完好就保證接縫一定不漏水
原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。
optionsEn: A smooth splice surface proves complete fusion through the section
An intact waterstop guarantees that the joint cannot leak
Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: waterHead=35 m; gammaWater=9.81 kN/m3; hydrostaticPressure=35*9.81=343.35 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水壓高度與接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Head pressure and joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水壓高度與接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Head pressure and joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以對照接縫位置庫水位與下游排水壓力界定壓差作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Use joint elevation, reservoir level and downstream drainage pressure to define differential head. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Blocked drainage changes the assumed pressure distribution along the joint. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：下游排水堵塞會改變原先假設的接縫壓力分布。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint opening and extension” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總帶寬當有效伸長區會低估局部應變。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測接縫張開與剪切並對照產品完整型式變形試驗，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total strip width as active length understates local strain. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure joint opening and shear and compare with full-profile product deformation tests. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水帶總寬度就是所有型式的有效拉伸長度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total waterstop width is the active stretch length for every profile" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總帶寬當有效伸長區會低估局部應變。診斷時應採取以下查核：量測接縫張開與剪切並對照產品完整型式變形試驗，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Using total strip width as active length understates local strain. Diagnose it by the following check: Measure joint opening and shear and compare with full-profile product deformation tests. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫張開與伸長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint opening and extension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
自由熱縮算值必定等於現場實測接縫張開
把總帶寬當有效伸長區會低估局部應變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Calculated free contraction must equal measured joint opening in the field
Using total strip width as active length understates local strain.
quiz.explanation: 把總帶寬當有效伸長區會低估局部應變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total strip width as active length understates local strain. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「溫度收縮與位移」與「焊接接續與搭接」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal contraction and movement" and "Splice continuity and joining": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and movement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「溫度收縮與位移」如何影響大壩止水帶施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal contraction and movement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam waterstop installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 混凝土降溫會使接縫張開，但相鄰塊體的約束與溫度分布影響實際位移。自由熱縮量只能提供上限或參考尺度，不能直接等同現場縫寬；監測需同時記錄溫度與接縫位移，分辨季節循環與不可逆變形。 驗證時應比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化，並辨識以下失效情境：將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「溫度收縮與位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cooling can open joints, but restraint and temperature distribution govern actual movement. Free thermal contraction supplies a reference scale rather than the installed joint width. Record temperature and displacement together to distinguish seasonal cycling from irreversible change and avoid attributing every movement to temperature alone. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal contraction and movement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「自由熱縮算值必定等於現場實測接縫張開」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculated free contraction must equal measured joint opening in the field" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「溫度收縮與位移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal contraction and movement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 溫度收縮與位移
knowledge.text: 混凝土降溫會使接縫張開，但相鄰塊體的約束與溫度分布影響實際位移。自由熱縮量只能提供上限或參考尺度，不能直接等同現場縫寬；監測需同時記錄溫度與接縫位移，分辨季節循環與不可逆變形。
knowledge.textEn: Cooling can open joints, but restraint and temperature distribution govern actual movement. Free thermal contraction supplies a reference scale rather than the installed joint width.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：自由熱縮算值必定等於現場實測接縫張開 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculated free contraction must equal measured joint opening in the field Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「溫度收縮與位移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal contraction and movement" is correct?
options: 混凝土降溫會使接縫張開，但相鄰塊體的約束與溫度分布影響實際位移。
自由熱縮算值必定等於現場實測接縫張開
接頭表面平整就證明整個斷面完全熔合
optionsEn: Cooling can open joints, but restraint and temperature distribution govern actual movement.
Calculated free contraction must equal measured joint opening in the field
A smooth splice surface proves complete fusion through the section
quiz.explanation: 混凝土降溫會使接縫張開，但相鄰塊體的約束與溫度分布影響實際位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Cooling can open joints, but restraint and temperature distribution govern actual movement. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與位移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and movement: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「溫度收縮與位移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal contraction and movement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「溫度收縮與位移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal contraction and movement", which statement holds?
options: 止水帶本體完好就保證接縫一定不漏水
原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。
自由膨脹百分比可以直接換成密封接觸壓力
optionsEn: An intact waterstop guarantees that the joint cannot leak
Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m.
Free swelling percentage directly converts into sealing contact pressure
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: freeBlockLength=20 m; alpha=10e-6 perK; cooling=15 K; freeContraction=20*10e-6*15=0.003 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 溫度收縮與位移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal contraction and movement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「溫度收縮與位移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal contraction and movement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以比對塊體溫度與接縫計時序並標記約束變化作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對將自由熱縮直接當縫寬會忽略相鄰塊體共同移動，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Compare block temperatures and joint-meter histories and identify restraint changes. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Equating free contraction with gap width ignores common movement of adjacent blocks. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「溫度收縮與位移」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 焊接接續與搭接：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 熱塑止水帶需用適用程序形成連續熔接，金屬或其他材料則需對應接續方式。接合面積乘名義應力只是一項示意，實際接頭的缺口、污染與型式變形會控制失效；應檢查完整剖面而非只看表面接縫漂亮。 驗證時應保留接頭試片破壞位置與斷面影像並核對製程參數，並辨識以下失效情境：外觀平整仍可能存在未熔合或內部氣孔。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「焊接接續與搭接」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 焊接接續與搭接：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Illustrative tensile coupon: bondedArea=120 mm2; failureLoad=1800 N; nominalStress=1800/120=15 MPa。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Illustrative tensile coupon: bondedArea=120 mm2; failureLoad=1800 N; nominalStress=1800/120=15 MPa. steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 止水帶需在澆置期間保持中心位置與足夠埋入深度，偏移會縮短繞流路徑或露出翼緣。幾何覆蓋扣減可示範誤差餘量，但還需考慮轉角和施工接續；支撐方式不可任意穿刺主要止水區造成新滲漏點。 驗證時應澆置前後量測中心線與埋入尺寸並記錄固定點，並辨識以下失效情境：澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「定位支撐與覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The strip must retain its center and embedment during placement. Displacement shortens bypass paths or exposes ribs. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. steps.title: 定位支撐與覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Positioning support and cover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「定位支撐與覆蓋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Positioning support and cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：nominalEmbedment=150 mm; positioningError=25 mm; remainingEmbedment=150-25=125 mm。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: nominalEmbedment=150 mm; positioningError=25 mm; remainingEmbedment=150-25=125 mm. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 定位支撐與覆蓋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Positioning support and cover: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「定位支撐與覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Positioning support and cover” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 澆置前後量測中心線與埋入尺寸並記錄固定點。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey centerline and embedment before and after placement and record supports. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Placement impact can fold the strip and create concealed connected voids. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以澆置前後量測中心線與埋入尺寸並記錄固定點作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Survey centerline and embedment before and after placement and record supports. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Placement impact can fold the strip and create concealed connected voids. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Placement impact can fold the strip and create concealed connected voids. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 定位支撐與覆蓋：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Positioning support and cover: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「定位支撐與覆蓋」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Positioning support and cover” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 澆置沖擊使止水帶翻折會形成隱藏連通空隙。診斷時應採取以下查核：澆置前後量測中心線與埋入尺寸並記錄固定點，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Placement impact can fold the strip and create concealed connected voids. Diagnose it by the following check: Survey centerline and embedment before and after placement and record supports. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct preplacement positioning guarantees no movement during concreting" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.instruction: 止水翼緣周圍混凝土需充分密實，蜂窩會讓水繞過完整材料本體。空洞體積帳只能量化缺陷大小，連通性與位置才決定滲漏路徑；應結合澆置方向、振實可達性與適用檢測，不能以材料出廠合格取代包覆品質。 驗證時應檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測，並辨識以下失效情境：帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「混凝土包覆與空洞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Concrete must encapsulate the ribs without honeycombing that lets water bypass an intact strip. Void volume measures size, while connectivity and location determine leakage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止水帶本體完好就保證接縫一定不漏水 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An intact waterstop guarantees that the joint cannot leak Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「混凝土包覆與空洞」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Concrete encapsulation and voids" is correct?
options: 止水翼緣周圍混凝土需充分密實，蜂窩會讓水繞過完整材料本體。
止水帶本體完好就保證接縫一定不漏水
任何粗糙接縫都完全遵守光滑平行板立方律
optionsEn: Concrete must encapsulate the ribs without honeycombing that lets water bypass an intact strip.
An intact waterstop guarantees that the joint cannot leak
Every rough joint exactly follows the smooth parallel-plate cubic law
quiz.explanation: 止水翼緣周圍混凝土需充分密實，蜂窩會讓水繞過完整材料本體。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Concrete must encapsulate the ribs without honeycombing that lets water bypass an intact strip. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 混凝土包覆與空洞：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Concrete encapsulation and voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「混凝土包覆與空洞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Concrete encapsulation and voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：Rectangular illustrative void: length=0.8 m; height=0.04 m; width=0.03 m; volume=0.8*0.04*0.03=0.00096 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: Rectangular illustrative void: length=0.8 m; height=0.04 m; width=0.03 m; volume=0.8*0.04*0.03=0.00096 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「混凝土包覆與空洞」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Concrete encapsulation and voids", which statement holds?
options: 修補點不滴水就證明整個接縫水路已封閉
原創教學假設：Rectangular illustrative void: length=0.8 m; height=0.04 m; width=0.03 m; volume=0.8*0.04*0.03=0.00096 m3。
附近水深就等於接縫每一位置的實際壓差

Original teaching assumptions: Rectangular illustrative void: length=0.8 m; height=0.04 m; width=0.03 m; volume=0.8*0.04*0.03=0.00096 m3.
Nearby water depth equals actual pressure difference at every joint location
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：Rectangular illustrative void: length=0.8 m; height=0.04 m; width=0.03 m; volume=0.8*0.04*0.03=0.00096 m3。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 混凝土包覆與空洞：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Concrete encapsulation and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「混凝土包覆與空洞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concrete encapsulation and voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「混凝土包覆與空洞」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Concrete encapsulation and voids"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
自由熱縮算值必定等於現場實測接縫張開
檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Calculated free contraction must equal measured joint opening in the field
Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately.
quiz.explanation: 檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 混凝土包覆與空洞：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Concrete encapsulation and voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「混凝土包覆與空洞」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Concrete encapsulation and voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。診斷時應採取以下查核：檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. Diagnose it by the following check: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水帶本體完好就保證接縫一定不漏水」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An intact waterstop guarantees that the joint cannot leak" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。診斷時應採取以下查核：檢查止水帶下方振實可達性並對疑似蜂窩作適用探測，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. Diagnose it by the following check: Check consolidation access below the strip and investigate suspected honeycombing appropriately. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「混凝土包覆與空洞」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Concrete encapsulation and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
任何粗糙接縫都完全遵守光滑平行板立方律
optionsEn: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every rough joint exactly follows the smooth parallel-plate cubic law
quiz.explanation: 帶下連續蜂窩可讓水完全繞過未損壞的止水帶。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Continuous honeycombing beneath the strip lets water bypass an undamaged barrier. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「狹縫層流與敏感度」與「材料膨脹與拘束」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Slot flow and sensitivity" and "Material swelling and restraint": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 狹縫層流與敏感度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Slot flow and sensitivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「狹縫層流與敏感度」如何影響大壩止水帶施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Slot flow and sensitivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam waterstop installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平行板層流模型顯示縫隙開度對流量有立方影響，細小位移也可能明顯改變滲漏。此式限於光滑平行板、牛頓流體及層流，實際粗糙接縫可能有接觸點與曲折流路；應用它辨識敏感度而非預測未查明裂縫的精確漏量。 驗證時應比較同壓差下漏量對開度的變化並確認是否仍為層流，並辨識以下失效情境：將立方律延用至湍流大縫隙會錯估漏量。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「狹縫層流與敏感度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel-plate laminar flow has cubic sensitivity to aperture, so small opening changes can strongly affect leakage. The relation assumes smooth parallel walls, a Newtonian fluid and laminar conditions. Rough contacts and tortuous joints violate these assumptions; use it for sensitivity rather than exact leakage prediction. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare leakage versus opening at fixed pressure difference and check laminar applicability. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Extending the cubic law to a large turbulent gap misstates leakage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slot flow and sensitivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions: width=0.1 m; gap=0.0002 m; deltaP=1000 Pa; mu=0.001 Pa*s; length=1 m; Q=0.1*0.0002**3*1000/(12*0.001*1)=0.0000000666667 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何粗糙接縫都完全遵守光滑平行板立方律」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every rough joint exactly follows the smooth parallel-plate cubic law" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「狹縫層流與敏感度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Slot flow and sensitivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Parallel-plate laminar flow has cubic sensitivity to aperture, so small opening changes can strongly affect leakage. The relation assumes smooth parallel walls, a Newtonian fluid and laminar conditions.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「狹縫層流與敏感度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slot flow and sensitivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將立方律延用至湍流大縫隙會錯估漏量。診斷時應採取以下查核：比較同壓差下漏量對開度的變化並確認是否仍為層流，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extending the cubic law to a large turbulent gap misstates leakage. Diagnose it by the following check: Compare leakage versus opening at fixed pressure difference and check laminar applicability. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任何粗糙接縫都完全遵守光滑平行板立方律」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every rough joint exactly follows the smooth parallel-plate cubic law" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instructionEn: Hydrophilic materials expand in water, but confinement and chemistry control sealing and concrete interaction. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Swelling before concreting can reduce subsequent accommodation reserve. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material swelling and restraint” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Zoned leakage and localization” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dam waterstop installation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫漏水應分區收集並與水位及溫度同步，總漏量下降可能只是流路轉移而非修補成功。量測容積除時間提供直接流量，但集水效率與暫態蓄水仍需核對；染色或其他定位方法也須符合水質與工程程序。 驗證時應以相同水頭比較修補區及相鄰區漏量並核對集水效率，並辨識以下失效情境：只看修補點乾燥可能漏掉滲流轉往相鄰接縫。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分區漏量與定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Collect joint leakage by zone and align it with head and temperature. A lower total may reflect pathway diversion rather than successful repair. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Compare repaired and adjacent zones at matching head and verify collection efficiency. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: A dry repaired point can conceal diversion into an adjacent joint. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Zoned leakage and localization” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 封閉水路壓力試驗需分辨漏水、溫度與系統柔度造成的壓力變化，壓降不直接等於漏量。若以已率定體積柔度換算，只在小變形且溫度穩定時成立；應保留水溫、補水量及壓力校正，避免單一壓力曲線過度推論。 驗證時應核對水溫與系統柔度並以補水體積交叉驗證壓降，並辨識以下失效情境：溫降造成的壓力降低可能被誤判為止水漏失。這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力保持與量測誤差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pressure-hold test must separate leakage from temperature and system compliance. Pressure drop is not directly a leak rate. Conversion through calibrated volumetric compliance assumes small changes and stable temperature; retain temperature, makeup volume and calibration records before interpreting one pressure trace. Test this interpretation with the following evidence: Check water temperature and system compliance and cross-check pressure loss using makeup volume. In particular, distinguish this failure mechanism: Cooling-induced pressure reduction can be mistaken for leakage. That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure holding and measurement error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
