steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resurveyed capacity and net benefit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 復測容積與淨成效
knowledge.text: 疏浚完成後需用同基準復測確認有效容量增加，挖出量不一定全部轉為可用庫容，邊坡回淤與施工外擴都會影響結果。淨增量須扣除同期沉積並列不確定度；長期成效還取決於後續入砂率與維護策略。
knowledge.textEn: Postdredging surveys on the same datum establish useful capacity gain. Excavated volume does not all become usable storage because slope adjustment and redeposition intervene.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外運泥砂體積必定等於新增可用水庫容量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hauled sediment volume must equal newly usable reservoir capacity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「復測容積與淨成效」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resurveyed capacity and net benefit" is correct?
options: 外運泥砂體積必定等於新增可用水庫容量
疏浚完成後需用同基準復測確認有效容量增加，挖出量不一定全部轉為可用庫容，邊坡回淤與施工外擴都會影響結果。
網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差
optionsEn: Hauled sediment volume must equal newly usable reservoir capacity
Postdredging surveys on the same datum establish useful capacity gain.
More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias
quiz.explanation: 疏浚完成後需用同基準復測確認有效容量增加，挖出量不一定全部轉為可用庫容，邊坡回淤與施工外擴都會影響結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Postdredging surveys on the same datum establish useful capacity gain. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 復測容積與淨成效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resurveyed capacity and net benefit: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「復測容積與淨成效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resurveyed capacity and net benefit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設：ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions: ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設：ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3。數值只檢查量綱與機制，不是實測資料、設計設定或允收門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions: ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3. These values check dimensions and mechanism, not measured data, design settings or acceptance thresholds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「復測容積與淨成效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resurveyed capacity and net benefit", which statement holds?
options: 固體質量百分比與體積百分比可以直接互換
只要管內有流動就不可能發生泥砂沉積
原創教學假設：ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3。
optionsEn: Solids mass percentage and volume percentage are directly interchangeable
Any pipe flow makes sediment deposition impossible
Original teaching assumptions: ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設：ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions: ExcavatedInSituVolume=22000 m3; measuredRedeposition=2500 m3; netStorageGain=22000-2500=19500 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 復測容積與淨成效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resurveyed capacity and net benefit: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「復測容積與淨成效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resurveyed capacity and net benefit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：交接時以以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量。應將原始量測與本單元模型的輸入條件對齊，並針對「只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整」取得獨立證據；同時保留儀器校正、測點位置與時間，避免把不同工況的資料直接相減。
knowledge.textEn: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Match raw observations to the input conditions of this unit and obtain independent evidence for this specific scenario: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. Preserve calibration, location and timing so that unlike operating states are not directly subtracted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 交接時以以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量作為可追溯證據，保存對應材料、構形與工況版本。針對只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整，由負責工程師設定需補驗的項目與停留點，不能把教學結果當作現場操作許可。
knowledge.textEn: At handover, use the following traceable evidence: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Record material, geometry and operating-state versions. Address this scenario: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. The responsible engineer defines additional checks and hold points; the teaching result is not field operating authorization.

quiz.question: 要驗證「復測容積與淨成效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resurveyed capacity and net benefit"?
options: 以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
沉澱池面積足夠就保證所有顆粒完全沉降
optionsEn: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate nominal basin area guarantees complete settling of every particle
quiz.explanation: 以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 復測容積與淨成效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resurveyed capacity and net benefit: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「復測容積與淨成效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resurveyed capacity and net benefit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. Diagnose it by the following check: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：這有助於確認模型的水流、受力或量測邊界是否仍成立。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: That distinction determines whether the model boundary or measurement assumption remains valid.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外運泥砂體積必定等於新增可用水庫容量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hauled sediment volume must equal newly usable reservoir capacity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。診斷時應採取以下查核：以同一水位基準復測庫容並獨立估算施工期再淤量，確認異常是否同時出現在相關量測；未釐清原因就調整門檻，會使真正的機制變化被資料處理掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. Diagnose it by the following check: Resurvey capacity on a common datum and independently estimate deposition during the works. Establish whether related measurements corroborate the anomaly; changing thresholds before identifying the cause can conceal a real change in the governing mechanism.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「復測容積與淨成效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resurveyed capacity and net benefit" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。
網格越多就自動消除高程基準偏差
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment.
More survey cells automatically eliminate vertical-datum bias
quiz.explanation: 只用外運量宣稱可用庫容會忽略庫內回淤與邊坡調整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming useful storage from hauled quantity ignores redeposition and slope adjustment. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 水壩地震動力分析
courses.summary: 本課把混凝土水壩的線性模態示意與土石壩孔壓機制分開，從質量、剛度、阻尼及地震輸入逐步走向水庫互制、接縫與數值收斂。十個單元均有原創計算與明確邊界，要求學徒追蹤同時刻、同座標和相同物理定義，不以單一週期或峰值吻合宣告整壩耐震合格。
courses.summaryEn: The course separates linear concrete-dam modal illustrations from embankment pore-pressure mechanisms. It moves through mass, stiffness, damping and forcing to reservoir interaction, joints and numerical convergence. Ten original calculations require consistent time, coordinates and physical definitions; matching one period or peak never establishes complete seismic adequacy.
courses.focus: 從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限
courses.focusEn: Identify dam-dynamics assumptions through modal mass, forcing histories and model boundaries
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度：選定模態質量50000000kg與線性剛度2000000000N/m，週期T=2π√(m/k)=0.9935s。只把剛度增加10%至2200000000N/m、質量不變，週期變成0.9472s，約減少4.65%，不是減少10%。這項計算僅隔離剛度影響，沒有證明實際壩體可用補強達到此值；基礎、水庫、接縫與阻尼也可能同時改變。學徒需先寫出廣義座標和校準方法，再比較週期、模態形狀與應力位置是否一起合理。即使週期縮短，地震需求可能因輸入譜形改變而升高或降低，不能直接推論風險同步下降。
workedExample.textEn: Original sensitivity: selected modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m give T=2π√(m/k)=0.9935s. Increase only stiffness by10% to2200000000N/m at unchanged mass; period becomes0.9472s, about4.65% shorter rather than10%. This isolates stiffness and does not establish that a real retrofit can achieve the assumed change. Foundation, reservoir, joints and damping may also vary. Define the generalized coordinate and calibration evidence before comparing period, mode shape and stress location together. Even a shorter period can increase or decrease seismic demand depending on the forcing spectrum; it cannot directly establish a corresponding reduction in risk.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩模態1與3Hz均ζ=0.05，C=αM+βK得α=0.47124s⁻¹、β=0.0039789s；在2Hz時ζ=0.04375。
factsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume m=50000000kg,k=2000000000N/m and ζ=0.05. c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m, representing linear viscous damping only.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「模態質量與週期」與「慣性力與加速度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Modal mass and period" and "Inertia and acceleration definition": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 模態質量與週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and period: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「模態質量與週期」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Modal mass and period” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。單自由度模型只代表已選定的廣義座標，其質量和剛度必須成對校準；不同模態參與程度不同，第一週期吻合也不能證明全部壩體應力分布正確。 假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模態質量與週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient. A single degree of freedom represents a chosen generalized coordinate whose mass and stiffness must be calibrated together. Matching the first period does not establish the correctness of higher modes or the complete spatial stress distribution. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Modal mass and period” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「模態質量與週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Modal mass and period”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 模態質量與週期
knowledge.text: 水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。單自由度模型只代表已選定的廣義座標，其質量和剛度必須成對校準；不同模態參與程度不同，第一週期吻合也不能證明全部壩體應力分布正確。
knowledge.textEn: Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient. A single degree of freedom represents a chosen generalized coordinate whose mass and stiffness must be calibrated together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「模態質量與週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Modal mass and period" is correct?
options: 第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。
水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。
地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。
optionsEn: Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct.
Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient.
Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam.
quiz.explanation: 水壩地震反應不是把整座重量直接乘一個係數，首先要理解材料剛度、基礎與水庫如何形成振動模態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dam response begins with how stiffness, foundation and reservoir interactions form vibration modes rather than multiplying total weight by one coefficient. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 模態質量與週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and period: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「模態質量與週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Modal mass and period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設線性模態質量m=50000000kg、剛度k=2000000000N/m，ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s，T=2π/ω=0.9935s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「模態質量與週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Modal mass and period", which statement holds?
options: 共振穩態放大係數可直接乘所有地震峰值作為真實反應。
瑞利阻尼只要在兩個頻率匹配就會在所有頻率保持同樣阻尼比。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: The steady resonant magnification can directly multiply every earthquake peak to give the actual response.
Rayleigh damping fitted at two frequencies has the same damping ratio at every frequency.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 模態質量與週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and period: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「模態質量與週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Modal mass and period” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。
knowledge.textEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。將解析週期與有限元素特徵值及環境振動資料比較，保留水位和溫度條件，不只調整一個參數湊合。
knowledge.textEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Compare the analytical period with eigenvalue and ambient-vibration evidence while retaining water-level and temperature conditions rather than tuning one parameter merely to force agreement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「模態質量與週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Modal mass and period"?
options: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。
optionsEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.
quiz.explanation: 在自由體圖上說明廣義座標與質量正規化，核對剛度及質量是否使用同一模態定義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define the generalized coordinate and mass normalization and check consistent stiffness and mass conventions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 模態質量與週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Modal mass and period: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模態質量與週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Modal mass and period” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。第一週期接近量測時，局部接縫、壩肩或高階反應仍可能沒有被描述。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. A matching first period can still leave joints, abutments and higher-mode responses poorly represented. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume linear modal mass50000000kg and stiffness2000000000N/m. ω=√(k/m)=6.325rad/s and T=2π/ω=0.9935s, for this generalized coordinate only.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。第一週期接近量測時，局部接縫、壩肩或高階反應仍可能沒有被描述。
knowledge.textEn: Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. A matching first period can still leave joints, abutments and higher-mode responses poorly represented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「模態質量與週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Modal mass and period" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。
地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness.
Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam.
quiz.explanation: 模態質量誤用總壩重會讓週期和慣性力同時錯位，固定基礎假設也可能高估剛度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total dam mass as modal mass distorts both period and inertia, while an unrealistically fixed foundation may overstate stiffness. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 慣性力與加速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inertia and acceleration definition: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「慣性力與加速度」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inertia and acceleration definition” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 慣性力跟質量及相應的絕對加速度有關，但地表峰值、基岩輸入與結構反應不是同一數據。等效靜力只提供量級，不能代替時變相位與變形計算；三方向輸入還要保持坐標一致，避免把不同時刻峰值任意拼成實際不存在的受力狀態。 假設所選質量50000000kg瞬時絕對加速度0.20g，F=ma=98.10MN；此數值不是由地表PGA自動得到的壩體反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「慣性力與加速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inertia depends on mass and its corresponding absolute acceleration, but surface peak, bedrock input and structural response are different quantities. Equivalent static force gives a scale rather than temporal phase or deformation. Three-component inputs also require consistent coordinates, and unrelated peaks must not be assembled into a force state that never occurred in the actual time history. Assume selected mass50000000kg has instantaneous absolute acceleration0.20g. F=ma=98.10MN, not a dam response automatically inferred from surface PGA. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inertia and acceleration definition” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「慣性力與加速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 慣性力與加速度
knowledge.text: 慣性力跟質量及相應的絕對加速度有關，但地表峰值、基岩輸入與結構反應不是同一數據。等效靜力只提供量級，不能代替時變相位與變形計算；三方向輸入還要保持坐標一致，避免把不同時刻峰值任意拼成實際不存在的受力狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Inertia depends on mass and its corresponding absolute acceleration, but surface peak, bedrock input and structural response are different quantities. Equivalent static force gives a scale rather than temporal phase or deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「慣性力與加速度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inertia and acceleration definition" is correct?
options: 地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 阻尼比是相對臨界阻尼的比例，實體耗能可包含材料、接縫和基礎輻射，不應任意重複加入。線性黏滯模型便於分析但不能代表所有開裂摩擦機制，且校準模態與頻率範圍必須明示；增加阻尼使數值變小不等於取得可靠設計。 假設m=50000000kg、k=2000000000N/m、ζ=0.05，c=2ζ√(km)=31622776.6N·s/m；只代表線性黏滯阻尼。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「阻尼係數與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 共振概念可用持續正弦力說明，但地震是有限時間且頻率不斷改變的訊號，兩者反應不能混用。線性振子的穩態放大取決於頻率比及阻尼，建立穩態需要時間；脈衝、非線性接縫和頻率漂移可能使真正峰值與簡式大不相同。 假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「諧波放大與歷時」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Assume linear steady forced response with frequency ratio r=1 and ζ=0.05. R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee. quiz.question: 要驗證「諧波放大與歷時」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Harmonic magnification versus history"?
options: 畫出多個頻率比的反應曲線，標明以靜態位移為分母的定義。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

quiz.explanationEn: Plot response over several frequency ratios and state that magnification is relative to static displacement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 諧波放大與歷時：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Harmonic magnification versus history: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「諧波放大與歷時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Harmonic magnification versus history” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 地震短脈衝未必有時間建立穩態，直接套十倍可能高估；若忽略結構頻率變化或其他模態，也可能漏掉另一時間段的放大。單一數值無法替代完整歷時檢查。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short pulse may not build steady resonance, making direct tenfold scaling excessive. Ignoring frequency change or additional modes can instead miss amplification later in the record, so one factor cannot replace evaluation of the full time history. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設線性受迫穩態、頻率比r=1、ζ=0.05，R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10；非地震歷時放大保證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: R=1/√[(1−r²)²+(2ζr)²]=10, not an earthquake amplification guarantee.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「共振穩態放大係數可直接乘所有地震峰值作為真實反應。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The steady resonant magnification can directly multiply every earthquake peak to give the actual response." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地震短脈衝未必有時間建立穩態，直接套十倍可能高估；若忽略結構頻率變化或其他模態，也可能漏掉另一時間段的放大。單一數值無法替代完整歷時檢查。
knowledge.textEn: A short pulse may not build steady resonance, making direct tenfold scaling excessive. Ignoring frequency change or additional modes can instead miss amplification later in the record, so one factor cannot replace evaluation of the full time history.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「諧波放大與歷時」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Harmonic magnification versus history" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
地震短脈衝未必有時間建立穩態，直接套十倍可能高估；若忽略結構頻率變化或其他模態，也可能漏掉另一時間段的放大。
任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A short pulse may not build steady resonance, making direct tenfold scaling excessive.
Any acceleration peak divided by frequency squared necessarily gives the correct spectral displacement.
quiz.explanation: 地震短脈衝未必有時間建立穩態，直接套十倍可能高估；若忽略結構頻率變化或其他模態，也可能漏掉另一時間段的放大。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A short pulse may not build steady resonance, making direct tenfold scaling excessive. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反應譜位移換算」與「瑞利阻尼頻帶」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Spectral displacement conversion" and "Rayleigh damping frequency band": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反應譜位移換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Spectral displacement conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反應譜位移換算」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Spectral displacement conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。譜值忽略不同模態峰值發生時間，合成規則需另外選擇；先確認譜的定義與單位，才有資格比較位移和接縫需求。 假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反應譜位移換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping. Pseudo-acceleration is not an arbitrary measured absolute-acceleration peak. Spectra also omit the timing of different modal maxima, requiring separate combination rules. Definitions and units must therefore be checked before comparing converted displacement with joint or deformation demands. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Spectral displacement conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any acceleration peak divided by frequency squared necessarily gives the correct spectral displacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反應譜位移換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Spectral displacement conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反應譜位移換算
knowledge.text: 擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。譜值忽略不同模態峰值發生時間，合成規則需另外選擇；先確認譜的定義與單位，才有資格比較位移和接縫需求。
knowledge.textEn: Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping. Pseudo-acceleration is not an arbitrary measured absolute-acceleration peak.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any acceleration peak divided by frequency squared necessarily gives the correct spectral displacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反應譜位移換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Spectral displacement conversion" is correct?
options: 任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。
瑞利阻尼只要在兩個頻率匹配就會在所有頻率保持同樣阻尼比。
擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。
optionsEn: Any acceleration peak divided by frequency squared necessarily gives the correct spectral displacement.
Rayleigh damping fitted at two frequencies has the same damping ratio at every frequency.
Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping.
quiz.explanation: 擬加速度反應譜與位移譜在同一線性振子和阻尼下可由角頻率換算，但擬加速度不是任意量測絕對加速度峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pseudo-spectral acceleration and spectral displacement convert through angular frequency for the same linear oscillator and damping. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反應譜位移換算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Spectral displacement conversion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反應譜位移換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Spectral displacement conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同一線性振子週期T=1s、擬譜加速度Sa=0.40g，Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m；阻尼定義保持一致。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume the same linear oscillator has T=1s and pseudo-spectral acceleration Sa=0.40g. Sd=Sa/(2π/T)²=0.09940m at consistently defined damping.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反應譜位移換算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Spectral displacement conversion", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。
土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.
Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反應譜位移換算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Spectral displacement conversion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反應譜位移換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Spectral displacement conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。用同一歷時振子直接求位移峰值對照，確認週期及阻尼一致，並保留多模態合成方法的另行說明。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency. Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。用同一歷時振子直接求位移峰值對照，確認週期及阻尼一致，並保留多模態合成方法的另行說明。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Identify pseudo-spectral versus absolute-acceleration input and show conversion from g and period to angular frequency. Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將Hz直接當rad/s會使位移差數十倍，不同阻尼譜混用又會改變需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using hertz as radians per second changes displacement by a large factor, and mixing damping definitions changes demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare with direct oscillator displacement from the same record at matching period and damping, documenting the separate method used for multiple-mode combination.

核對輸入是擬譜加速度或絕對加速度譜，將g與角頻率的轉換逐步寫出。

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「附加水質量與週期」與「同步位移與接縫」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Added water mass and period" and "Synchronized displacement and joints": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 附加水質量與週期：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Added water mass and period: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「附加水質量與週期」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Added water mass and period” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。不能把整個水庫重量直接加到壩上，亦不能忽略可壓縮性、邊界吸收或水位改變；本單元固定剛度，只檢查一個假設附加量如何改變週期。 假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「附加水質量與週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions. The entire reservoir mass cannot be attached to the dam, nor can compressibility, absorption and water-level change always be ignored. This unit holds stiffness fixed to isolate the period effect of one assumed modal addition. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Added water mass and period” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「附加水質量與週期」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Added water mass and period”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 附加水質量與週期
knowledge.text: 水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。不能把整個水庫重量直接加到壩上，亦不能忽略可壓縮性、邊界吸收或水位改變；本單元固定剛度，只檢查一個假設附加量如何改變週期。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions. The entire reservoir mass cannot be attached to the dam, nor can compressibility, absorption and water-level change always be ignored.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「附加水質量與週期」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Added water mass and period" is correct?
options: 水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。
水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。
接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。
optionsEn: Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam.
Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions.
Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.
quiz.explanation: 水庫動壓可能與壩體運動耦合，簡化附加質量僅在已指定形狀與頻率條件下代表某種等效作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir pressure can couple with dam movement, while an added-mass approximation represents an equivalent effect only under stated geometry and frequency conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 附加水質量與週期：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Added water mass and period: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「附加水質量與週期」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Added water mass and period” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原模態m=50000000kg、附加水質量20000000kg、k=2000000000N/m，T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume modal mass50000000kg,added water mass20000000kg and unchanged stiffness2000000000N/m. T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「附加水質量與週期」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Added water mass and period", which statement holds?
options: 土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。
地表峰值加速度就是壩體每一點在同一時刻的絕對加速度。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator.
Surface peak acceleration equals the simultaneous absolute acceleration at every point of the dam.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 附加水質量與週期：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Added water mass and period: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「附加水質量與週期」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Added water mass and period” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。
knowledge.textEn: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。檢查水庫邊界是否過近造成反射，保存原質量和附加量分項，不把週期延長全歸因於材料變軟。
knowledge.textEn: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Check artificial reflection from nearby reservoir boundaries, retaining structural and water contributions separately rather than attributing every period increase to softened dam material.

quiz.question: 要驗證「附加水質量與週期」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Added water mass and period"?
options: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
共振穩態放大係數可直接乘所有地震峰值作為真實反應。
optionsEn: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The steady resonant magnification can directly multiply every earthquake peak to give the actual response.
quiz.explanation: 明列附加質量的推導範圍與所代表模態，與流固耦合模型在多個水位下比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State the added-mass derivation and represented mode and compare coupled calculations at several levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 附加水質量與週期：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Added water mass and period: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「附加水質量與週期」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Added water mass and period” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。僅因空庫與滿庫週期不同就判定結構劣化，會把正常流固互制當成損傷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. Declaring deterioration solely from empty- versus full-reservoir period differences mistakes normal fluid-structure interaction for structural damage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: T=2π√[(m+ma)/k]=1.1755s for this assumed approximation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。僅因空庫與滿庫週期不同就判定結構劣化，會把正常流固互制當成損傷。
knowledge.textEn: Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. Declaring deterioration solely from empty- versus full-reservoir period differences mistakes normal fluid-structure interaction for structural damage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「附加水質量與週期」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Added water mass and period" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。
接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks.
Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.
quiz.explanation: 直接加整個水庫質量會嚴重扭曲週期，人工反射又可能假造動壓峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Attaching the entire reservoir mass grossly distorts period, and artificial reflections create spurious pressure peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 同步位移與接縫：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Synchronized displacement and joints: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「同步位移與接縫」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Synchronized displacement and joints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接縫張開由相鄰部位同一時刻的相對位移決定，而不是兩個獨立最大值相減或平方和。坐標方向和局部法向需先定義，剛體平移應在相減時消除；縫面接觸、止水材料與剪切交互作用則需另建模型，位移量本身不代表水密性。 假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「同步位移與接縫」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joint opening comes from simultaneous relative displacement, not subtraction or quadrature of unrelated extrema. Coordinate direction and local normal must be defined so common rigid translation cancels. Contact, waterstop response and combined shear require additional models; a displacement difference alone does not establish watertightness or allowable joint performance during an earthquake. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Synchronized displacement and joints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「同步位移與接縫」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Synchronized displacement and joints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 同步位移與接縫
knowledge.text: 接縫張開由相鄰部位同一時刻的相對位移決定，而不是兩個獨立最大值相減或平方和。坐標方向和局部法向需先定義，剛體平移應在相減時消除；縫面接觸、止水材料與剪切交互作用則需另建模型，位移量本身不代表水密性。
knowledge.textEn: Joint opening comes from simultaneous relative displacement, not subtraction or quadrature of unrelated extrema. Coordinate direction and local normal must be defined so common rigid translation cancels.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「同步位移與接縫」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Synchronized displacement and joints" is correct?
options: 接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。
動力程式成功跑完且每週期有足夠點數就不必再查收斂。
接縫張開由相鄰部位同一時刻的相對位移決定，而不是兩個獨立最大值相減或平方和。
optionsEn: Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement.
A completed dynamic run with many points per period never needs a convergence assessment.

quiz.explanationEn: Joint opening comes from simultaneous relative displacement, not subtraction or quadrature of unrelated extrema. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 同步位移與接縫：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Synchronized displacement and joints: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「同步位移與接縫」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Synchronized displacement and joints” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume simultaneous normal displacements u1=12mm and u2=−8mm. Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Synchronized displacement and joints", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。
阻尼設得越大就一定越接近真實水壩的地震反應。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct.
A larger damping value always makes the predicted dam earthquake response more realistic.

steps.title: 同步位移與接縫：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Synchronized displacement and joints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「同步位移與接縫」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Synchronized displacement and joints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。另列剪切滑移、接觸壓和止水變形，檢查剛體平移能否抵銷，保留真正控制時刻供受力與漏水判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Transform both records to one local normal and synchronized clock, then difference each time step before locating the peak. Record shear, contact pressure and waterstop deformation separately, checking cancellation of rigid translation and retaining the actual controlling instant for interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。另列剪切滑移、接觸壓和止水變形，檢查剛體平移能否抵銷，保留真正控制時刻供受力與漏水判讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Transform both records to one local normal and synchronized clock, then difference each time step before locating the peak. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

先把兩側位移轉到同一局部法向與時鐘，再逐時刻求差並找峰值。
任何加速度峰值除以頻率平方都一定得到正確的反應譜位移。

Transform both records to one local normal and synchronized clock, then difference each time step before locating the peak.

steps.title: 同步位移與接縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Synchronized displacement and joints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「同步位移與接縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Synchronized displacement and joints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘偏移會把原本同步移動變成假張開，法向反轉又可能讓共同平移加倍。只取單側峰值會錯過兩側反向運動，低估止水和接觸介面的真正需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation. A one-sided peak can miss opposing movements and understate the actual demand on waterstops and contact interfaces between neighboring blocks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設同時刻沿接縫法向位移u1=12mm、u2=−8mm，相對張開u1−u2=20mm；不是各自峰值的非同步組合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relative opening is20mm, rather than a combination of nonconcurrent individual maxima.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「接縫最大張開永遠等於兩側各自最大位移的平方和平方根。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Maximum joint opening always equals the root-sum-square of each side's individual peak displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 時鐘偏移會把原本同步移動變成假張開，法向反轉又可能讓共同平移加倍。只取單側峰值會錯過兩側反向運動，低估止水和接觸介面的真正需求。
knowledge.textEn: Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation. A one-sided peak can miss opposing movements and understate the actual demand on waterstops and contact interfaces between neighboring blocks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「同步位移與接縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Synchronized displacement and joints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
動力程式成功跑完且每週期有足夠點數就不必再查收斂。
時鐘偏移會把原本同步移動變成假張開，法向反轉又可能讓共同平移加倍。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A completed dynamic run with many points per period never needs a convergence assessment.
Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation.
quiz.explanation: 時鐘偏移會把原本同步移動變成假張開，法向反轉又可能讓共同平移加倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Clock offsets make common movement appear as opening, and reversed normals can double rigid translation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「時間步與高頻解析」與「土壩孔壓與有效應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Timestep and high-frequency resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 動力積分步長要解析關心的短週期，但每週期點數只是起點，不是收斂證明。輸入記錄取樣、內插方法、積分演算法和非線性接觸都可能施加更嚴限制；縮小步長後應比較峰值、相位及能量，而不是只確認程式沒有發散或報錯。 假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時間步與高頻解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dynamic timestep must resolve relevant short periods, but points per cycle are only an initial check, not proof of convergence. Input sampling, interpolation, integration algorithm and nonlinear contact may impose stricter limits. Refinement should compare peaks, phase and energy rather than merely confirming that software completes without numerical divergence or reported errors. Assume the shortest relevant period0.20s and timestep0.005s. T/Δt=40points per cycle, without guaranteeing input bandwidth or resolved contact response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Timestep and high-frequency resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A completed dynamic run with many points per period never needs a convergence assessment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時間步與高頻解析」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Halve the timestep with unchanged physics and compare displacement peaks, acceleration and energy residuals while checking original input sampling. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時間步與高頻解析」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Timestep and high-frequency resolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 程式穩定仍可能有顯著相位誤差，粗步長也會漏掉短促接觸力。把稀疏輸入內插成密集資料看似解析度提高，實際卻沒有補回缺失的地震頻率內容。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stable computation can retain serious phase error and miss brief contact forces. Interpolating sparse input into many samples looks more resolved but does not restore earthquake frequencies absent from the original measured record. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設最短關注週期0.20s、積分步長0.005s，點數T/Δt=40；不能由此保證輸入頻寬或接觸反應已解析。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「動力程式成功跑完且每週期有足夠點數就不必再查收斂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A completed dynamic run with many points per period never needs a convergence assessment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
