steps.title: 土壩孔壓與有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「土壩孔壓與有效應力」如何影響水壩地震動力分析的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seismic dynamic analysis of dams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。有效應力下降需以相同應力路徑和時間的資料計算，孔壓比接近某值也不能單獨宣告整座壩已液化；殘餘強度、震後排水與永久變形仍需專門材料和穩定分析。 假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「土壩孔壓與有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Embankments can develop cyclic pore pressure and altered strength, mechanisms distinct from a linear concrete oscillator. Effective-stress reduction needs matching stress paths and times. A pore-pressure ratio alone cannot declare the entire dam liquefied; residual strength, post-earthquake drainage and permanent deformation still require appropriate material testing and stability analysis rather than transfer of concrete-dam assumptions. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「土壩孔壓與有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 土壩孔壓與有效應力
knowledge.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress
knowledge.text: 土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。有效應力下降需以相同應力路徑和時間的資料計算，孔壓比接近某值也不能單獨宣告整座壩已液化；殘餘強度、震後排水與永久變形仍需專門材料和穩定分析。
knowledge.textEn: Embankments can develop cyclic pore pressure and altered strength, mechanisms distinct from a linear concrete oscillator. Effective-stress reduction needs matching stress paths and times.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「土壩孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" is correct?
options: 土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。
土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。
第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。
optionsEn: Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator.
Embankments can develop cyclic pore pressure and altered strength, mechanisms distinct from a linear concrete oscillator.
Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct.
quiz.explanation: 土石壩可能發生循環孔壓增加及強度改變，這與混凝土線彈性振子是不同機制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。比較不同土層的循環試驗與震後強度，記錄局部高孔壓位置和排水路徑，避免把單點比值推廣到所有壩體材料。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference. Compare layer-specific cyclic tests and post-shaking strength, mapping local high pressures and drainage routes without extending one point ratio to every material in the dam.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。比較不同土層的循環試驗與震後強度，記錄局部高孔壓位置和排水路徑，避免把單點比值推廣到所有壩體材料。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference. Compare layer-specific cyclic tests and post-shaking strength, mapping local high pressures and drainage routes without extending one point ratio to every material in the dam.

quiz.question: 要驗證「土壩孔壓與有效應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress"?
options: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
水庫對水壩動力的作用就是把全部庫水重量加到壩體質量。
optionsEn: Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Reservoir interaction simply adds the mass of all stored water to the dam.
quiz.explanation: 將孔壓與總應力歷時同步，核對初始有效應力和超額孔壓的基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize pore-pressure and total-stress histories, checking initial effective stress and the excess-pressure reference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 土壩孔壓與有效應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Embankment pore pressure and effective stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「土壩孔壓與有效應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Embankment pore pressure and effective stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總孔壓誤當超額孔壓會高估累積，忽略總應力變動則可能誤判有效應力。局部弱層即使不控制平均值，也可能形成永久變形路徑，不能只看整壩平均反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total pressure instead of excess pressure overstates accumulation, while omitted total-stress variation misstates effective stress. A local weak layer can govern permanent deformation despite a modest average ratio across the wider dam body. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設初有效垂直應力100kPa、總應力固定而超額孔壓增60kPa，ru=0.60，剩餘有效應力40kPa；非液化整體判定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume initial effective vertical stress100kPa and excess pore-pressure rise60kPa at fixed total stress. ru=0.60 and remaining effective stress40kPa, not a global liquefaction verdict.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「土石壩的孔壓變化可直接用混凝土線彈性振子的阻尼比完全代表。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Embankment pore-pressure change is fully represented by the damping ratio of a linear concrete oscillator." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總孔壓誤當超額孔壓會高估累積，忽略總應力變動則可能誤判有效應力。局部弱層即使不控制平均值，也可能形成永久變形路徑，不能只看整壩平均反應。
knowledge.textEn: Using total pressure instead of excess pressure overstates accumulation, while omitted total-stress variation misstates effective stress. A local weak layer can govern permanent deformation despite a modest average ratio across the wider dam body.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「土壩孔壓與有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Embankment pore pressure and effective stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把總孔壓誤當超額孔壓會高估累積，忽略總應力變動則可能誤判有效應力。
第一振動週期吻合即可證明整座水壩的地震應力全部正確。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using total pressure instead of excess pressure overstates accumulation, while omitted total-stress variation misstates effective stress.
Matching the first natural period proves that every earthquake stress in the dam is correct.
quiz.explanation: 把總孔壓誤當超額孔壓會高估累積，忽略總應力變動則可能誤判有效應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total pressure instead of excess pressure overstates accumulation, while omitted total-stress variation misstates effective stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 水力模型縮尺試驗
courses.summary: 本課以非扭曲自由水面重力模型為主軸，逐步推導幾何、速度、流量、時間、壓力與合力比例，再檢查雷諾數、韋伯數及量測誤差無法自動相似的部分。十個單元要求先說明研究目的與控制尺度，再判斷哪些結果可量化放大，哪些只能定性比較，避免以模型照片漂亮取代實驗驗證。
courses.summaryEn: An undistorted gravity-driven free-surface model provides the main thread. Units derive geometry, velocity, discharge, time, pressure and force scales, then examine Reynolds and Weber mismatches and measurement uncertainty. Apprentices define the question and controlling length before deciding which results support quantitative extrapolation and which allow only qualitative comparison.
courses.focus: 用相似律與量測證據分辨水工縮尺模型可代表哪些現象
courses.focusEn: Use similitude and measurement evidence to define what hydraulic scale models represent
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創縮尺敏感度：原型總流量1000m³/s，長度比例40，依佛祿相似Qm=1000/40^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s。若為節省實驗空間把比例增加10%至44，原型保持不變，所需模型流量降為1000/44^(5/2)=0.07787m³/s，約減少21.20%，並不是只減少10%。此時模型尺度更小，黏滯和表面張力相對影響反而更值得查核。學徒應重算速度、時間、感測器量程與誤差放大，確認試驗台是否能穩定提供較小流量。不能只因用水減少就認為改尺度必然改善研究品質。
workedExample.textEn: Original scale sensitivity: a prototype discharge of1000m³/s with length ratio40 requires Qm=1000/40^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s under Froude similarity. Increasing the ratio by10% to44 to save laboratory space while retaining the same prototype reduces flow to1000/44^(5/2)=0.07787m³/s, about21.20% rather than10%. The smaller model makes relative viscous and capillary effects more important to check. Recalculate velocity, timing, sensor range and uncertainty amplification, then verify that the rig can reliably provide the lower discharge. Reduced water demand alone does not establish that the revised scale improves the quality of the experiment.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型總Q=1000m³/s，模型Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s；不是單位寬度流量比例。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40，原型事件120s，模型時間tm=120/√40=18.974s；只適用所選重力相似過程。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、同密度重力壓力原型60kPa，模型壓力1.50kPa；此為表壓重力尺度，不代表絕對氣壓也縮四十倍。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型重力主導合力2MN，模型Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N；未處理感測器動態或氣泡衝擊。
factsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype total discharge1000m³/s. Model Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s, distinct from unit-width discharge scaling.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype duration120s. Model tm=120/√40=18.974s, applying only to the selected gravity-similar process.

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and matched density. Prototype gravity gauge pressure60kPa scales to1.50kPa, without scaling ambient absolute air pressure fortyfold.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype gravity-dominated force2MN. Model Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N, excluding sensor dynamics and air-impact scaling.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「幾何比例與控制長度」與「重力流速度比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Geometry ratio and reference length" and "Velocity scaling for gravity flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「幾何比例與控制長度」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Geometry ratio and reference length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。非扭曲模型各方向採同一比例，局部粗糙、縫隙與邊界若無法製作應記錄；改用垂直水平不同比例時，速度與輸砂關係必須重新推導。 假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「幾何比例與控制長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. An undistorted model uses one ratio in all directions, documenting roughness, gaps or boundaries that cannot be reproduced. Different vertical and horizontal scales require rederived velocity and sediment relationships, so they cannot be introduced quietly while retaining undistorted-model formulas. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Geometry ratio and reference length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「幾何比例與控制長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Geometry ratio and reference length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 幾何比例與控制長度
knowledge.text: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。非扭曲模型各方向採同一比例，局部粗糙、縫隙與邊界若無法製作應記錄；改用垂直水平不同比例時，速度與輸砂關係必須重新推導。
knowledge.textEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. An undistorted model uses one ratio in all directions, documenting roughness, gaps or boundaries that cannot be reproduced.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「幾何比例與控制長度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Geometry ratio and reference length" is correct?
options: 只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。
縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。
佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
optionsEn: Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales.
A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization.
Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
quiz.explanation: 縮尺試驗先決定要研究的水理現象，再選控制長度及完整幾何範圍，不能只把外觀縮小就認為等價。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A model starts with the physical question, reference length and geometric domain rather than visual miniaturization. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 幾何比例與控制長度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Geometry ratio and reference length: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「幾何比例與控制長度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Geometry ratio and reference length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把原型及模型坐標、邊界和粗糙尺寸列成對照表，實測關鍵斷面而非只看製圖尺寸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate prototype and model coordinates, boundaries and roughness, measuring critical sections rather than relying only on drawings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設原型與模型長度比λL=40，原型水深8m及長80m，模型分別0.20m與2m；所有方向採同一比例。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume prototype-to-model length ratio40. Prototype depth8m and length80m become0.20m and2m, with the same ratio in every direction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「幾何比例與控制長度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Geometry ratio and reference length", which statement holds?
options: 只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
縮尺合力只需要跟長度成正比而不必考慮受壓面積。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自由水面重力主導時以佛祿數相等建立速度比例，必須確認原型與模型使用相同重力場。此時速度不是隨長度線性縮小，且黏滯或表面張力主導的小尺度區仍可能失真；同一速度比例也不能無條件套到加壓水錘或可壓縮氣流。 假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力流速度比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For gravity-dominated free surfaces, equal Froude numbers determine velocity scaling under equal gravity. Velocity does not shrink linearly with length, and small viscous or capillary regions may remain distorted. The same relation cannot automatically describe pressurized water hammer or compressible air, whose controlling physics and required similarity parameters differ from the chosen free-surface experiment. Assume length ratio40 and Froude similarity. Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity. steps.title: 重力流速度比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Velocity scaling for gravity flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重力流速度比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Velocity scaling for gravity flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。局部黏性控制區即使佛祿數正確，壓力和渦流仍未必可直接放大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Locally viscous regions can still have unrepresentative pressures and vortices despite equal Froude numbers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設λL=40且佛祿相似，原型速度8m/s，模型Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s；不保證雷諾相似。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prototype velocity8m/s gives Vm=8/√40=1.2649m/s, without guaranteeing Reynolds similarity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。局部黏性控制區即使佛祿數正確，壓力和渦流仍未必可直接放大。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Locally viscous regions can still have unrepresentative pressures and vortices despite equal Froude numbers.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

將速度也縮小四十倍會使流態和波速錯位，僅調整入流直到外觀看似相同也可能改變水深。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth.

quiz.explanationEn: Reducing velocity fortyfold misrepresents flow regime and wave propagation, while adjusting inflow merely to match appearance may change depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「總流量縮尺次方」與「時間縮尺與記錄」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Total-discharge scale exponent" and "Time scaling and recording": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 總流量縮尺次方：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Total-discharge scale exponent: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「總流量縮尺次方」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Total-discharge scale exponent” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 總流量是斷面面積乘速度，非扭曲重力模型的面積按長度平方、速度按平方根縮放，因此總流量有不同次方。單位寬度流量另有分母，兩者不能混用；量測管路與模型入口也需一致，旁通或溢流未記錄會破壞整體收支。 假設λL=40、原型總Q=1000m³/s，模型Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s；不是單位寬度流量比例。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「總流量縮尺次方」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total discharge combines cross-sectional area with velocity. An undistorted gravity model scales area with length squared and velocity with its square root, producing a distinct exponent. Unit-width discharge has a different denominator and cannot use the same rule. Measurement piping, bypasses and overflow must also match the model boundary to preserve the water balance. Assume length ratio40 and prototype total discharge1000m³/s. Model Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s, distinct from unit-width discharge scaling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Total-discharge scale exponent” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「總流量縮尺次方」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Total-discharge scale exponent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 總流量縮尺次方
knowledge.text: 總流量是斷面面積乘速度，非扭曲重力模型的面積按長度平方、速度按平方根縮放，因此總流量有不同次方。單位寬度流量另有分母，兩者不能混用；量測管路與模型入口也需一致，旁通或溢流未記錄會破壞整體收支。
knowledge.textEn: Total discharge combines cross-sectional area with velocity. An undistorted gravity model scales area with length squared and velocity with its square root, producing a distinct exponent.

knowledge.text: 誤解：總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「總流量縮尺次方」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Total-discharge scale exponent" is correct?
options: 總流量是斷面面積乘速度，非扭曲重力模型的面積按長度平方、速度按平方根縮放，因此總流量有不同次方。
總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
optionsEn: Total discharge combines cross-sectional area with velocity.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test.

steps.title: 總流量縮尺次方：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Total-discharge scale exponent: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「總流量縮尺次方」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Total-discharge scale exponent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型總Q=1000m³/s，模型Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s；不是單位寬度流量比例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype total discharge1000m³/s. Model Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s, distinct from unit-width discharge scaling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從面積與速度比例逐步推導流量次方，確認資料標示總流量或每米寬度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Derive the exponent from area and velocity and label total versus per-width discharge.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、原型總Q=1000m³/s，模型Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s；不是單位寬度流量比例。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype total discharge1000m³/s. Model Qm=Qp/λL^(5/2)=0.09882m³/s, distinct from unit-width discharge scaling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「總流量縮尺次方」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 縮尺合力只需要跟長度成正比而不必考慮受壓面積。

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable.

steps.title: 總流量縮尺次方：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Total-discharge scale exponent: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「總流量縮尺次方」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Total-discharge scale exponent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從面積與速度比例逐步推導流量次方，確認資料標示總流量或每米寬度。以獨立容積時間法查核流量計，記錄旁通與回流，並將校正範圍對照實際模型所需的小流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Derive the exponent from area and velocity and label total versus per-width discharge. Check the flow meter independently by volume and time, recording bypass and recirculation and comparing its calibration range with the small discharge actually required by the model. steps.observation: 現場實務：從面積與速度比例逐步推導流量次方，確認資料標示總流量或每米寬度。以獨立容積時間法查核流量計，記錄旁通與回流，並將校正範圍對照實際模型所需的小流量。

optionsEn: Using the unit-width exponent for total discharge introduces an entire length-scale error, compounded if the meter operates outside calibration.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test.
quiz.explanation: 把每米流量的次方用在總流量會差一個長度比例，低流量儀器超出校正範圍又會加深誤差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the unit-width exponent for total discharge introduces an entire length-scale error, compounded if the meter operates outside calibration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 時間縮尺與記錄：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time scaling and recording: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「時間縮尺與記錄」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time scaling and recording” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力模型的時間比例由長度除速度得到，原型漫長變化會在模型較短時間內發生。儀器取樣率、閥門運動與入流變化需同步配合，不能只縮放最後結果而保留原型的操作時間；資料對齊也應記錄起始事件，避免把時間偏移誤認為物理遲滯。 假設λL=40，原型事件120s，模型時間tm=120/√40=18.974s；只適用所選重力相似過程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「時間縮尺與記錄」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-model time follows length divided by velocity, compressing long prototype changes into shorter experiments. Sampling, actuator movement and inflow variation must be synchronized accordingly, rather than scaling outputs while retaining prototype operating duration. Records also require a defined start event so clock offsets are not mistaken for physical lag in the measured hydraulic response. Assume length ratio40 and prototype duration120s. Model tm=120/√40=18.974s, applying only to the selected gravity-similar process. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time scaling and recording” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「時間縮尺與記錄」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time scaling and recording”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 時間縮尺與記錄
knowledge.text: 重力模型的時間比例由長度除速度得到，原型漫長變化會在模型較短時間內發生。儀器取樣率、閥門運動與入流變化需同步配合，不能只縮放最後結果而保留原型的操作時間；資料對齊也應記錄起始事件，避免把時間偏移誤認為物理遲滯。

knowledge.text: 誤解：只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「時間縮尺與記錄」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time scaling and recording" is correct?
options: 只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
重力模型的時間比例由長度除速度得到，原型漫長變化會在模型較短時間內發生。
重力壓力比例正確就表示空化與封閉氣泡壓縮也完全相似。

steps.title: 時間縮尺與記錄：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time scaling and recording: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「時間縮尺與記錄」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time scaling and recording” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40，原型事件120s，模型時間tm=120/√40=18.974s；只適用所選重力相似過程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype duration120s. Model tm=120/√40=18.974s, applying only to the selected gravity-similar process. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把入流、閥位與量測通道放在共同時間軸，明列原型與模型的換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align inflow, valve position and sensor channels on a common clock and document both time scales.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume length ratio40 and prototype duration120s. Model tm=120/√40=18.974s, applying only to the selected gravity-similar process.

quiz.question: 依「時間縮尺與記錄」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.

steps.title: 時間縮尺與記錄：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time scaling and recording: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「時間縮尺與記錄」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time scaling and recording” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把入流、閥位與量測通道放在共同時間軸，明列原型與模型的換算。以可辨識水波事件校核時鐘和觸發延遲，檢查最快變化是否仍有足夠資料，不讓儀器更新頻率主導試驗結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align inflow, valve position and sensor channels on a common clock and document both time scales. Check triggers against an identifiable wave event and verify resolution of the fastest changes so instrument refresh limits do not govern the apparent experimental response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把入流、閥位與量測通道放在共同時間軸，明列原型與模型的換算。以可辨識水波事件校核時鐘和觸發延遲，檢查最快變化是否仍有足夠資料，不讓儀器更新頻率主導試驗結果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Align inflow, valve position and sensor channels on a common clock and document both time scales. Check triggers against an identifiable wave event and verify resolution of the fastest changes so instrument refresh limits do not govern the apparent experimental response.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：閥門動作沒有縮時會讓模型充水過慢，取樣頻率不足又會漏掉短峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unscaled actuator duration makes filling too slow, and sparse sampling misses short peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「時間縮尺與記錄」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time scaling and recording"?
options: 把入流、閥位與量測通道放在共同時間軸，明列原型與模型的換算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

quiz.explanationEn: Align inflow, valve position and sensor channels on a common clock and document both time scales. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 時間縮尺與記錄：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Time scaling and recording: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「時間縮尺與記錄」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time scaling and recording” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 閥門動作沒有縮時會讓模型充水過慢，取樣頻率不足又會漏掉短峰值。事後把時間軸乘比例，不能補回試驗當時沒有正確重現的邊界變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unscaled actuator duration makes filling too slow, and sparse sampling misses short peaks. Multiplying the time axis afterward cannot restore boundary changes that were not correctly reproduced while the physical experiment was running. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設λL=40，原型事件120s，模型時間tm=120/√40=18.974s；只適用所選重力相似過程。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「時間縮尺與記錄」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 壓力尺度與氣泡：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「壓力尺度與氣泡」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure scale and air effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同液體密度與重力下，重力壓力尺度隨長度比例改變，但絕對氣壓不會自動跟著縮小。模型氣泡、負壓和空化可能因此偏離原型，尤其局部高速與衝擊區；靜水或重力動壓的可放大性不能被解釋成所有瞬態壓力都相似。 假設λL=40、同密度重力壓力原型60kPa，模型壓力1.50kPa；此為表壓重力尺度，不代表絕對氣壓也縮四十倍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力尺度與氣泡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: At matched liquid density and gravity, gravity-pressure scale follows length, but ambient absolute pressure does not automatically scale. Air bubbles, suction and cavitation can therefore differ from the prototype, especially in high-speed or impact regions. Scaling hydrostatic or gravity-dominated pressure does not establish similarity of every transient pressure mechanism within the same apparatus. Assume length ratio40 and matched density. Prototype gravity gauge pressure60kPa scales to1.50kPa, without scaling ambient absolute air pressure fortyfold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure scale and air effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力尺度與氣泡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設λL=40、同密度重力壓力原型60kPa，模型壓力1.50kPa；此為表壓重力尺度，不代表絕對氣壓也縮四十倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Prototype gravity gauge pressure60kPa scales to1.50kPa, without scaling ambient absolute air pressure fortyfold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄壓力是表壓或絕對壓力並核對零點，區分慢變重力壓與短時衝擊。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.instruction: 封閉空氣團的壓縮在模型可能比原型更顯著，直接放大尖峰會誤判結構荷載。把表壓負值當成低於蒸氣壓，亦會在沒有絕對壓力基準時錯判空化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Trapped-air compression can be disproportionately important in the model, making direct scaling of peaks misleading. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 合力尺度與量測：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Force scaling and measurement: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「合力尺度與量測」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Force scaling and measurement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知方向和位置的砝碼校核整套力傳遞路徑，記錄支架自振頻率及零漂。比較壓力積分與總力感測器結果，檢查水流是否繞過或推到未量測的支架，不只校正單顆感測元件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the full load path using known weights and positions, recording support frequency and zero drift. Compare integrated pressure with measured resultant and check whether water loads bypass the sensor or act on unmeasured supports rather than calibrating only the isolated transducer. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以已知方向和位置的砝碼校核整套力傳遞路徑，記錄支架自振頻率及零漂。比較壓力積分與總力感測器結果，檢查水流是否繞過或推到未量測的支架，不只校正單顆感測元件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calibrate the full load path using known weights and positions, recording support frequency and zero drift. Compare integrated pressure with measured resultant and check whether water loads bypass the sensor or act on unmeasured supports rather than calibrating only the isolated transducer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支架摩擦可能承擔部分荷重，使感測器低估；共振則可能放大短峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support friction can carry load away from the sensor, while resonance amplifies short peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「合力尺度與量測」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Force scaling and measurement"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
以已知方向和位置的砝碼校核整套力傳遞路徑，記錄支架自振頻率及零漂。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
Calibrate the full load path using known weights and positions, recording support frequency and zero drift.
quiz.explanation: 以已知方向和位置的砝碼校核整套力傳遞路徑，記錄支架自振頻率及零漂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the full load path using known weights and positions, recording support frequency and zero drift. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 合力尺度與量測：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Force scaling and measurement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「合力尺度與量測」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force scaling and measurement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 支架摩擦可能承擔部分荷重，使感測器低估；共振則可能放大短峰值。兩種偏差都能在靜態校正看似良好時出現，必須查核水中實際動態條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Support friction can carry load away from the sensor, while resonance amplifies short peaks. Both errors can occur despite satisfactory static calibration and require examination under the actual submerged dynamic conditions of the experiment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設λL=40、原型重力主導合力2MN，模型Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N；未處理感測器動態或氣泡衝擊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Model Fm=2000000/40³=31.25N, excluding sensor dynamics and air-impact scaling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「縮尺合力只需要跟長度成正比而不必考慮受壓面積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Model force scales only linearly with length and does not depend on loaded area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支架摩擦可能承擔部分荷重，使感測器低估；共振則可能放大短峰值。兩種偏差都能在靜態校正看似良好時出現，必須查核水中實際動態條件。
knowledge.textEn: Support friction can carry load away from the sensor, while resonance amplifies short peaks. Both errors can occur despite satisfactory static calibration and require examination under the actual submerged dynamic conditions of the experiment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「合力尺度與量測」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force scaling and measurement" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 支架摩擦可能承擔部分荷重，使感測器低估；共振則可能放大短峰值。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。
optionsEn: Support friction can carry load away from the sensor, while resonance amplifies short peaks.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region.
quiz.explanation: 支架摩擦可能承擔部分荷重，使感測器低估；共振則可能放大短峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Support friction can carry load away from the sensor, while resonance amplifies short peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雷諾數與黏滯失真」與「韋伯數與表面張力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Reynolds number and viscous distortion" and "Weber number and surface tension": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雷諾數與黏滯失真：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reynolds number and viscous distortion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雷諾數與黏滯失真」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reynolds number and viscous distortion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 使用同一水體且採佛祿相似時，模型速度和長度都變小，雷諾數不能同時保持。主要流區可能仍是紊流，但薄水層、近壁與小縫可能受黏滯控制；不能用一個全域雷諾數宣稱所有局部現象相似，應檢查尺寸改變後結果是否穩定。 假設ν=10⁻⁶m²/s，以水深為控制長度，模型V=8/√40m/s、h=0.20m，Re≈252982；原型V=8m/s、h=8m，Re=64000000。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雷諾數與黏滯失真」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With the same fluid under Froude similarity, both velocity and length decrease, so Reynolds number is not preserved. Main flow may remain turbulent while thin layers, walls and gaps become viscosity-sensitive. One global Reynolds number cannot qualify every local phenomenon; comparing more than one scale helps determine whether the measured result depends on the altered viscous regime. Assumeν=10⁻⁶m²/s, using depth as the reference length. Model V=8/√40m/s,h=0.20m gives Re≈252982; prototype V=8m/s,h=8m gives Re=64000000. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reynolds number and viscous distortion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reynolds number and viscous distortion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雷諾數與黏滯失真
knowledge.text: 使用同一水體且採佛祿相似時，模型速度和長度都變小，雷諾數不能同時保持。主要流區可能仍是紊流，但薄水層、近壁與小縫可能受黏滯控制；不能用一個全域雷諾數宣稱所有局部現象相似，應檢查尺寸改變後結果是否穩定。
knowledge.textEn: With the same fluid under Froude similarity, both velocity and length decrease, so Reynolds number is not preserved. Main flow may remain turbulent while thin layers, walls and gaps become viscosity-sensitive.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雷諾數與黏滯失真」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Reynolds number and viscous distortion" is correct?
options: 模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。
使用同一水體且採佛祿相似時，模型速度和長度都變小，雷諾數不能同時保持。
重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。
optionsEn: A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region.
With the same fluid under Froude similarity, both velocity and length decrease, so Reynolds number is not preserved.
Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable.
quiz.explanation: 使用同一水體且採佛祿相似時，模型速度和長度都變小，雷諾數不能同時保持。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: With the same fluid under Froude similarity, both velocity and length decrease, so Reynolds number is not preserved. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雷諾數與黏滯失真：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reynolds number and viscous distortion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reynolds number and viscous distortion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ν=10⁻⁶m²/s，以水深為控制長度，模型V=8/√40m/s、h=0.20m，Re≈252982；原型V=8m/s、h=8m，Re=64000000。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeν=10⁻⁶m²/s, using depth as the reference length. Model V=8/√40m/s,h=0.20m gives Re≈252982; prototype V=8m/s,h=8m gives Re=64000000. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ν=10⁻⁶m²/s，以水深為控制長度，模型V=8/√40m/s、h=0.20m，Re≈252982；原型V=8m/s、h=8m，Re=64000000。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeν=10⁻⁶m²/s, using depth as the reference length. Model V=8/√40m/s,h=0.20m gives Re≈252982; prototype V=8m/s,h=8m gives Re=64000000.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Reynolds number and viscous distortion", which statement holds?
options: 重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。
佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias.
Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雷諾數與黏滯失真：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reynolds number and viscous distortion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雷諾數與黏滯失真」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reynolds number and viscous distortion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。比較至少兩尺度的壓損、分離或薄層行為，保留不能可靠外推的區域與觀察量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width. Compare losses, separation or thin layers at multiple scales and retain explicit limits for quantities that cannot be reliably extrapolated. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。比較至少兩尺度的壓損、分離或薄層行為，保留不能可靠外推的區域與觀察量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width. Compare losses, separation or thin layers at multiple scales and retain explicit limits for quantities that cannot be reliably extrapolated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：大水槽的全域雷諾數很高仍可能有層流閘縫，若把局部漏流按紊流比例放大，會算錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high basin-scale Reynolds number can coexist with a laminar gate gap, invalidating turbulent leakage scaling. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。比較至少兩尺度的壓損、分離或薄層行為，保留不能可靠外推的區域與觀察量。
knowledge.textEn: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width. Compare losses, separation or thin layers at multiple scales and retain explicit limits for quantities that cannot be reliably extrapolated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雷諾數與黏滯失真」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Reynolds number and viscous distortion"?
options: 用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
optionsEn: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test.
quiz.explanation: 用真正控制局部現象的長度估雷諾數，記錄水溫對黏度的影響，不能只選最大池寬。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate Reynolds number using lengths controlling the local mechanism and record temperature-dependent viscosity rather than automatically choosing maximum basin width. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雷諾數與黏滯失真：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Reynolds number and viscous distortion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雷諾數與黏滯失真」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reynolds number and viscous distortion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 大水槽的全域雷諾數很高仍可能有層流閘縫，若把局部漏流按紊流比例放大，會算錯。溫度變化又可能在同一模型內改變黏度，使重複試驗不完全可比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high basin-scale Reynolds number can coexist with a laminar gate gap, invalidating turbulent leakage scaling. Water-temperature changes also alter viscosity between repeated tests, so nominally identical geometry and discharge need not give directly comparable local behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設ν=10⁻⁶m²/s，以水深為控制長度，模型V=8/√40m/s、h=0.20m，Re≈252982；原型V=8m/s、h=8m，Re=64000000。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Model V=8/√40m/s,h=0.20m gives Re≈252982; prototype V=8m/s,h=8m gives Re=64000000.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 大水槽的全域雷諾數很高仍可能有層流閘縫，若把局部漏流按紊流比例放大，會算錯。溫度變化又可能在同一模型內改變黏度，使重複試驗不完全可比。
knowledge.textEn: A high basin-scale Reynolds number can coexist with a laminar gate gap, invalidating turbulent leakage scaling. Water-temperature changes also alter viscosity between repeated tests, so nominally identical geometry and discharge need not give directly comparable local behavior.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雷諾數與黏滯失真」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Reynolds number and viscous distortion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
大水槽的全域雷諾數很高仍可能有層流閘縫，若把局部漏流按紊流比例放大，會算錯。
重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A high basin-scale Reynolds number can coexist with a laminar gate gap, invalidating turbulent leakage scaling.
Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable.
quiz.explanation: 大水槽的全域雷諾數很高仍可能有層流閘縫，若把局部漏流按紊流比例放大，會算錯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A high basin-scale Reynolds number can coexist with a laminar gate gap, invalidating turbulent leakage scaling. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 韋伯數與表面張力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weber number and surface tension: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「韋伯數與表面張力」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weber number and surface tension” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 表面張力對小尺度水舌、液滴與薄膜相對重要，重力縮尺通常不會保留慣性與表面張力之比。模型看見的破碎、噴濺或氣泡大小可能因此失真，不能以外觀照片當定量證據；若研究問題正是這些現象，需要另選尺度或承認觀察僅能定性。 假設ρ=1000kg/m³、σ=0.072N/m、模型V²=1.6m²/s²、L=0.20m，We=ρV²L/σ=4444.4；原型值是其1600倍。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「韋伯數與表面張力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface tension matters disproportionately for small jets, drops and films, and gravity scaling generally does not preserve its ratio to inertia. Breakup, spray and bubble size can therefore be distorted, making photographs insufficient quantitative evidence. If these phenomena are the study objective, a different scale or explicit qualitative limitation is needed rather than assuming visual similarity guarantees the physics. Assumeρ=1000kg/m³,σ=0.072N/m,model V²=1.6m²/s² and L=0.20m. We=4444.4; the corresponding prototype value is1600times larger. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weber number and surface tension” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「韋伯數與表面張力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weber number and surface tension”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 韋伯數與表面張力
knowledge.text: 表面張力對小尺度水舌、液滴與薄膜相對重要，重力縮尺通常不會保留慣性與表面張力之比。模型看見的破碎、噴濺或氣泡大小可能因此失真，不能以外觀照片當定量證據；若研究問題正是這些現象，需要另選尺度或承認觀察僅能定性。
knowledge.textEn: Surface tension matters disproportionately for small jets, drops and films, and gravity scaling generally does not preserve its ratio to inertia. Breakup, spray and bubble size can therefore be distorted, making photographs insufficient quantitative evidence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「韋伯數與表面張力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weber number and surface tension" is correct?
options: 重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。
模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。
表面張力對小尺度水舌、液滴與薄膜相對重要，重力縮尺通常不會保留慣性與表面張力之比。
optionsEn: Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable.
A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale.
Surface tension matters disproportionately for small jets, drops and films, and gravity scaling generally does not preserve its ratio to inertia.
quiz.explanation: 表面張力對小尺度水舌、液滴與薄膜相對重要，重力縮尺通常不會保留慣性與表面張力之比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface tension matters disproportionately for small jets, drops and films, and gravity scaling generally does not preserve its ratio to inertia. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 韋伯數與表面張力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weber number and surface tension: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「韋伯數與表面張力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weber number and surface tension” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ρ=1000kg/m³、σ=0.072N/m、模型V²=1.6m²/s²、L=0.20m，We=ρV²L/σ=4444.4；原型值是其1600倍。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeρ=1000kg/m³,σ=0.072N/m,model V²=1.6m²/s² and L=0.20m. We=4444.4; the corresponding prototype value is1600times larger. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先指定表面張力影響的局部長度，記錄水質、溫度及表面污染，查核材料是否改變潤濕。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define the local length relevant to surface tension and record temperature, water condition and contamination, checking altered wetting on model materials.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設ρ=1000kg/m³、σ=0.072N/m、模型V²=1.6m²/s²、L=0.20m，We=ρV²L/σ=4444.4；原型值是其1600倍。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assumeρ=1000kg/m³,σ=0.072N/m,model V²=1.6m²/s² and L=0.20m. We=4444.4; the corresponding prototype value is1600times larger.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「韋伯數與表面張力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weber number and surface tension", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。
總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales.
Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 韋伯數與表面張力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weber number and surface tension: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「韋伯數與表面張力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weber number and surface tension” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先指定表面張力影響的局部長度，記錄水質、溫度及表面污染，查核材料是否改變潤濕。比較不同尺度水舌破裂和噴濺，將可量化水位與只宜定性解讀的液滴外觀分開。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define the local length relevant to surface tension and record temperature, water condition and contamination, checking altered wetting on model materials. Compare jet breakup and spray across scales, separating quantitatively useful levels from droplet appearances that support only qualitative interpretation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先指定表面張力影響的局部長度，記錄水質、溫度及表面污染，查核材料是否改變潤濕。比較不同尺度水舌破裂和噴濺，將可量化水位與只宜定性解讀的液滴外觀分開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define the local length relevant to surface tension and record temperature, water condition and contamination, checking altered wetting on model materials. Compare jet breakup and spray across scales, separating quantitatively useful levels from droplet appearances that support only qualitative interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型小液滴可能被表面張力束縛，原型卻更易破碎，直接按照片估曝氣會偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small model droplets can remain surface-tension-bound where prototype flow breaks up, biasing air-entrainment estimates from imagery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
