steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重力相似已經自動保證液滴尺寸與曝氣程度都能直接放大。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Gravity similarity automatically makes droplet size and air entrainment directly scalable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 模型小液滴可能被表面張力束縛，原型卻更易破碎，直接按照片估曝氣會偏差。加入界面活性物質改變張力時，也可能連帶改變氣泡與量測條件，不能當簡單修補。
knowledge.textEn: Small model droplets can remain surface-tension-bound where prototype flow breaks up, biasing air-entrainment estimates from imagery. Surfactant adjustments also change bubbles and measurement conditions and cannot be treated as an uncomplicated correction to all scale effects.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「韋伯數與表面張力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Weber number and surface tension" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。
模型小液滴可能被表面張力束縛，原型卻更易破碎，直接按照片估曝氣會偏差。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale.
Small model droplets can remain surface-tension-bound where prototype flow breaks up, biasing air-entrainment estimates from imagery.
quiz.explanation: 模型小液滴可能被表面張力束縛，原型卻更易破碎，直接按照片估曝氣會偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Small model droplets can remain surface-tension-bound where prototype flow breaks up, biasing air-entrainment estimates from imagery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「讀值誤差的放大」與「重複試驗與代表性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scaling measurement uncertainty" and "Replicates and representativeness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 讀值誤差的放大：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scaling measurement uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「讀值誤差的放大」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scaling measurement uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 模型的微小讀值誤差放回原型後也按相應比例放大，不能以數字小就忽略。讀值重複性、共同零點及尺度製造誤差屬不同分量，必須說明相關性後再合成；原型結果的小數位應反映證據，而不是把模型儀器的每一位都乘出來展示。 假設模型水位標準不確定度0.0005m、λL=40且比例視為精確，原型相應標準不確定度0.020m；未含尺度本身誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「讀值誤差的放大」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Small model reading errors grow under prototype scaling and cannot be dismissed by their absolute size. Repeatability, coherent zero offset and fabrication-scale error are distinct components requiring stated correlations before combination. Reported prototype precision should follow the evidence, not every digit produced by multiplying an instrument display by the geometric ratio in a spreadsheet. Assume model level standard uncertainty0.0005m and exact length ratio40. Prototype-equivalent uncertainty is0.020m, excluding uncertainty in the scale itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scaling measurement uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「讀值誤差的放大」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scaling measurement uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 讀值誤差的放大
knowledge.text: 模型的微小讀值誤差放回原型後也按相應比例放大，不能以數字小就忽略。讀值重複性、共同零點及尺度製造誤差屬不同分量，必須說明相關性後再合成；原型結果的小數位應反映證據，而不是把模型儀器的每一位都乘出來展示。
knowledge.textEn: Small model reading errors grow under prototype scaling and cannot be dismissed by their absolute size. Repeatability, coherent zero offset and fabrication-scale error are distinct components requiring stated correlations before combination.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「讀值誤差的放大」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scaling measurement uncertainty" is correct?
options: 模型的微小讀值誤差放回原型後也按相應比例放大，不能以數字小就忽略。
模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。
重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。
optionsEn: Small model reading errors grow under prototype scaling and cannot be dismissed by their absolute size.
A small model reading error can be ignored completely after conversion to prototype scale.
Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias.

steps.title: 讀值誤差的放大：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scaling measurement uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「讀值誤差的放大」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scaling measurement uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設模型水位標準不確定度0.0005m、λL=40且比例視為精確，原型相應標準不確定度0.020m；未含尺度本身誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume model level standard uncertainty0.0005m and exact length ratio40. Prototype-equivalent uncertainty is0.020m, excluding uncertainty in the scale itself. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分開估水位零偏、讀值散布及模型尺寸誤差，說明哪些為共同分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate level bias, reading scatter and fabrication error separately, identifying shared components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設模型水位標準不確定度0.0005m、λL=40且比例視為精確，原型相應標準不確定度0.020m；未含尺度本身誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume model level standard uncertainty0.0005m and exact length ratio40. Prototype-equivalent uncertainty is0.020m, excluding uncertainty in the scale itself.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「讀值誤差的放大」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scaling measurement uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 佛祿相似要求速度與模型長度使用完全相同的縮小倍數。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
只要事後修改時間軸就能補救試驗時未縮尺的閥門動作。
optionsEn: Froude similarity requires velocity to use exactly the same reduction factor as length.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Rescaling the recorded time axis repairs any valve motion that was not correctly scaled during the test.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 讀值誤差的放大：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scaling measurement uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「讀值誤差的放大」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scaling measurement uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分開估水位零偏、讀值散布及模型尺寸誤差，說明哪些為共同分量。以獨立控制點檢核高程，將量測及尺度不確定度傳播到原型結果，按有效精度四捨五入，不使用無依據的小數位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate level bias, reading scatter and fabrication error separately, identifying shared components. Check elevations against independent control, propagate measurement and scale uncertainty to prototype results and round to defensible precision rather than retaining unsupported decimal places. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分開估水位零偏、讀值散布及模型尺寸誤差，說明哪些為共同分量。以獨立控制點檢核高程，將量測及尺度不確定度傳播到原型結果，按有效精度四捨五入，不使用無依據的小數位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Estimate level bias, reading scatter and fabrication error separately, identifying shared components. Check elevations against independent control, propagate measurement and scale uncertainty to prototype results and round to defensible precision rather than retaining unsupported decimal places.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水位零偏在所有測點共同存在時不會靠平均消失，尺度錯誤還可能同時影響水深和流量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared level offset survives averaging, and incorrect scale can affect both depth and discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「讀值誤差的放大」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scaling measurement uncertainty"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
縮尺合力只需要跟長度成正比而不必考慮受壓面積。

optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Model force scales only linearly with length and does not depend on loaded area.
Estimate level bias, reading scatter and fabrication error separately, identifying shared components.
quiz.explanation: 分開估水位零偏、讀值散布及模型尺寸誤差，說明哪些為共同分量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Estimate level bias, reading scatter and fabrication error separately, identifying shared components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 讀值誤差的放大：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scaling measurement uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「讀值誤差的放大」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scaling measurement uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水位零偏在所有測點共同存在時不會靠平均消失，尺度錯誤還可能同時影響水深和流量。只放大平均讀值而不放大誤差，會讓原型推估看起來過度精確。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared level offset survives averaging, and incorrect scale can affect both depth and discharge. Scaling the mean reading without its uncertainty makes the inferred prototype result appear more precise than the experiment actually supports. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設模型水位標準不確定度0.0005m、λL=40且比例視為精確，原型相應標準不確定度0.020m；未含尺度本身誤差。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型讀值誤差很小所以換算回原型後可以完全忽略不計。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 水位零偏在所有測點共同存在時不會靠平均消失，尺度錯誤還可能同時影響水深和流量。只放大平均讀值而不放大誤差，會讓原型推估看起來過度精確。
knowledge.textEn: A shared level offset survives averaging, and incorrect scale can affect both depth and discharge. Scaling the mean reading without its uncertainty makes the inferred prototype result appear more precise than the experiment actually supports.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「讀值誤差的放大」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scaling measurement uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 水位零偏在所有測點共同存在時不會靠平均消失，尺度錯誤還可能同時影響水深和流量。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。
optionsEn: A shared level offset survives averaging, and incorrect scale can affect both depth and discharge.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias.
quiz.explanation: 水位零偏在所有測點共同存在時不會靠平均消失，尺度錯誤還可能同時影響水深和流量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A shared level offset survives averaging, and incorrect scale can affect both depth and discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 重複試驗與代表性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Replicates and representativeness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複試驗與代表性」如何影響水力模型縮尺試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Replicates and representativeness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Scale-model testing of hydraulic structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重複試驗能估計同條件下的散布，但三次重複不能涵蓋未測水位、流量或邊界狀態。平均值標準誤與單次觀測標準差用途不同，獨立性也需要重新建立初始條件；若同一零點偏差持續存在，增加次數只會讓錯誤平均顯得更穩定。 假設獨立流量結果0.098、0.100、0.102m³/s，平均0.100、樣本標準差0.002m³/s，變異係數2%；非全部工況不確定度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複試驗與代表性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Replicates estimate scatter under one condition but do not cover untested levels, discharges or boundaries. Standard error of a mean differs from the deviation of individual observations, and independence requires reestablishing initial conditions. A persistent zero bias is not reduced by replication; more runs can merely make the wrong mean appear increasingly stable and convincing. Assume independent discharges0.098,0.100,0.102m³/s. Mean0.100 and sample deviation0.002m³/s give2% coefficient of variation, not uncertainty for all operating conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Replicates and representativeness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複試驗與代表性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Replicates and representativeness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複試驗與代表性
knowledge.text: 重複試驗能估計同條件下的散布，但三次重複不能涵蓋未測水位、流量或邊界狀態。平均值標準誤與單次觀測標準差用途不同，獨立性也需要重新建立初始條件；若同一零點偏差持續存在，增加次數只會讓錯誤平均顯得更穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Replicates estimate scatter under one condition but do not cover untested levels, discharges or boundaries. Standard error of a mean differs from the deviation of individual observations, and independence requires reestablishing initial conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複試驗與代表性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Replicates and representativeness" is correct?
options: 重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。
重複試驗能估計同條件下的散布，但三次重複不能涵蓋未測水位、流量或邊界狀態。
只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。
optionsEn: Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias.
Replicates estimate scatter under one condition but do not cover untested levels, discharges or boundaries.
Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales.
quiz.explanation: 重複試驗能估計同條件下的散布，但三次重複不能涵蓋未測水位、流量或邊界狀態。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Replicates estimate scatter under one condition but do not cover untested levels, discharges or boundaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複試驗與代表性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Replicates and representativeness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複試驗與代表性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Replicates and representativeness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設獨立流量結果0.098、0.100、0.102m³/s，平均0.100、樣本標準差0.002m³/s，變異係數2%；非全部工況不確定度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume independent discharges0.098,0.100,0.102m³/s. Mean0.100 and sample deviation0.002m³/s give2% coefficient of variation, not uncertainty for all operating conditions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設獨立流量結果0.098、0.100、0.102m³/s，平均0.100、樣本標準差0.002m³/s，變異係數2%；非全部工況不確定度。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume independent discharges0.098,0.100,0.102m³/s. Mean0.100 and sample deviation0.002m³/s give2% coefficient of variation, not uncertainty for all operating conditions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複試驗與代表性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Replicates and representativeness", which statement holds?
options: 總流量與每米寬度流量在縮尺模型都使用同一比例次方。
重力壓力比例正確就表示空化與封閉氣泡壓縮也完全相似。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Total discharge and discharge per unit width use the same scaling exponent.
Correct gravity-pressure scaling proves that cavitation and trapped-air compression are also fully similar.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複試驗與代表性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Replicates and representativeness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複試驗與代表性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Replicates and representativeness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。用樣本而非母體分母計標準差，另列未試工況矩陣，避免以少量重複的低散布宣稱整個模型已驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records. Use the sample-deviation denominator and list the untested condition matrix separately, without interpreting low scatter from a few replicates as complete validation of the model domain. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。用樣本而非母體分母計標準差，另列未試工況矩陣，避免以少量重複的低散布宣稱整個模型已驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records. Use the sample-deviation denominator and list the untested condition matrix separately, without interpreting low scatter from a few replicates as complete validation of the model domain.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：三次都受同一流量計偏差時仍可非常一致，卻系統性偏離真值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Three runs sharing one meter bias can agree closely while all miss the true value. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。用樣本而非母體分母計標準差，另列未試工況矩陣，避免以少量重複的低散布宣稱整個模型已驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records. Use the sample-deviation denominator and list the untested condition matrix separately, without interpreting low scatter from a few replicates as complete validation of the model domain.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。用樣本而非母體分母計標準差，另列未試工況矩陣，避免以少量重複的低散布宣稱整個模型已驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records. Use the sample-deviation denominator and list the untested condition matrix separately, without interpreting low scatter from a few replicates as complete validation of the model domain.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複試驗與代表性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Replicates and representativeness"?
options: 事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
模型主流雷諾數高就可以證明每個細縫和近壁區都與原型相似。
optionsEn: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A high main-flow Reynolds number proves similarity in every small gap and near-wall region.
quiz.explanation: 事先定義重複方式和回復初始水位程序，保留每次原始紀錄與共同校正資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define repetition and initial-level restoration beforehand, retaining raw runs and shared calibration records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複試驗與代表性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Replicates and representativeness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複試驗與代表性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Replicates and representativeness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 三次都受同一流量計偏差時仍可非常一致，卻系統性偏離真值。挑掉不喜歡的試驗又會縮小散布，若沒有預定排除規則，所謂重複性可能只反映選擇性報告。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Three runs sharing one meter bias can agree closely while all miss the true value. Selective deletion shrinks scatter further, and without predefined exclusion criteria apparent repeatability may reflect reporting choices rather than reliable experimental behavior. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設獨立流量結果0.098、0.100、0.102m³/s，平均0.100、樣本標準差0.002m³/s，變異係數2%；非全部工況不確定度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean0.100 and sample deviation0.002m³/s give2% coefficient of variation, not uncertainty for all operating conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重複三次結果很接近就代表所有未測工況與系統偏差都已驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Three closely agreeing repeats validate every untested condition and eliminate systematic bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 三次都受同一流量計偏差時仍可非常一致，卻系統性偏離真值。挑掉不喜歡的試驗又會縮小散布，若沒有預定排除規則，所謂重複性可能只反映選擇性報告。
knowledge.textEn: Three runs sharing one meter bias can agree closely while all miss the true value. Selective deletion shrinks scatter further, and without predefined exclusion criteria apparent repeatability may reflect reporting choices rather than reliable experimental behavior.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複試驗與代表性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Replicates and representativeness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
三次都受同一流量計偏差時仍可非常一致，卻系統性偏離真值。
只要模型外觀像原型就可以忽略局部縫隙與尺度方向差異。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Three runs sharing one meter bias can agree closely while all miss the true value.
Visual similarity alone permits ignoring gaps and differences between horizontal and vertical scales.
quiz.explanation: 三次都受同一流量計偏差時仍可非常一致，卻系統性偏離真值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Three runs sharing one meter bias can agree closely while all miss the true value. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 抽蓄水庫水位調度
courses.summary: 本課從上下庫逐時水量守恆開始，將庫容、水位、淨水頭、機組效率與電能連成可追溯帳本。十個單元分別處理抽水與發電方向、往返效率、可用時數、爬坡積分、天氣損失和期末預留，要求學徒在每個時間步查兩庫限制，並把慢速排程與快速水錘模型分開驗證。
courses.summaryEn: Starting with paired-reservoir conservation, this course connects storage, level, net head, machine efficiency and energy in a traceable ledger. Ten units distinguish pumping and generation, cycle efficiency, duration, ramps, weather exchange and terminal reserves. Apprentices check both reservoirs at every step and verify slow scheduling separately from rapid waterway transients.
courses.focus: 以雙庫水量與能量守恆建立可追溯的抽蓄水位排程
courses.focusEn: Build traceable pumped-storage schedules using paired-reservoir water and energy balances
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創水頭敏感度：固定流量100m³/s、總發電效率0.90與密度1000kg/m³，淨水頭385m時功率為339.9165MW。如果其他假設維持不變而淨水頭提高10%至423.5m，功率為373.90815MW，正好提高10%。這不表示真實機組可突破額定容量，也不表示水頭提高後效率必然固定。學徒應把新工況放回效率曲線、流量與電氣容量限制，再沿上下庫水位歷時積分電能。若要求固定功率，流量會反向調整，不能仍用原先水量帳本，且需重新檢查管路瞬態與進水條件。
workedExample.textEn: Original head sensitivity: with discharge100m³/s, overall generating efficiency0.90 and density1000kg/m³ fixed, net head385m gives339.9165MW. Raising net head by10% to423.5m while holding the other assumptions fixed gives373.90815MW, exactly10% higher. This does not permit exceeding nameplate capacity or establish constant real-machine efficiency at the new head. Place the new condition on the efficiency map and check discharge and electrical limits before integrating energy along the reservoir-level histories. If constant power is required instead, discharge changes inversely; the original water ledger no longer applies and transient and intake conditions must be checked again.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫600m、下庫200m、發電水頭損失15m，淨水頭H=600−200−15=385m；未代表其他流量的損失。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。
factsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper elevation600m, lower200m and generation loss15m. Net headH=600−200−15=385m, without prescribing losses at other discharges.

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume density1000kg/m³, discharge100m³/s, net head385m and overall generating efficiency0.90. P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙庫水量帳本」與「水位庫容換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Paired reservoir water balance" and "Level and storage conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙庫水量帳本」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Paired reservoir water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。每個時間步都應同時更新兩庫，明確約定流量正方向；只看上庫水位容易掩蓋下庫已滿或總水量不守恆的排程錯誤。 假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙庫水量帳本」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. Update both reservoirs at every interval with explicit flow signs. Tracking only the upper level can hide a full lower reservoir or a schedule that violates total water conservation. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Paired reservoir water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙庫水量帳本」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Paired reservoir water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙庫水量帳本
knowledge.text: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。每個時間步都應同時更新兩庫，明確約定流量正方向；只看上庫水位容易掩蓋下庫已滿或總水量不守恆的排程錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. Update both reservoirs at every interval with explicit flow signs.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙庫水量帳本」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Paired reservoir water balance" is correct?
options: 只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。
抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。
同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。
optionsEn: A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.
Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms.
The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.
quiz.explanation: 抽蓄把水在上下庫之間搬移，不會因為發電而消耗同等體積的水，但外部入流、蒸發與放流仍要分別列帳。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumped storage transfers water between reservoirs without consuming the transferred volume through generation, although external inflow, evaporation and release remain separate terms. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙庫水量帳本」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Paired reservoir water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume no external exchange and generation flow100m³/s for1800s. Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙庫水量帳本」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Paired reservoir water balance", which statement holds?
options: 額定發電容量足夠就保證任意水位都能連續輸出相同功率。
只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Adequate nameplate capacity guarantees identical continuous output at any reservoir level.
Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙庫水量帳本」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Paired reservoir water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。以兩庫總量閉合差找單位或漏項錯誤，再確認每步結果沒有超過個別可用容積邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Use total-volume closure to locate unit errors or omissions, then confirm each step remains inside both reservoirs’ individual usable-storage bounds.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙庫水量帳本」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Paired reservoir water balance"?
options: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
爬坡期間總水量正確就能證明任何閥門動作都不會產生水錘。
optionsEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A correct total ramp volume proves that every associated valve movement is free of water hammer.
quiz.explanation: 建立上庫與下庫兩欄逐時帳本，逐一核對抽水及發電符號並把外部交換獨立列出。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build separate time-step ledgers, checking pumping and generating signs and listing external exchanges explicitly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙庫水量帳本：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Paired reservoir water balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙庫水量帳本」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Paired reservoir water balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。日終總量碰巧正確也不能證明中途下庫未經溢流或超界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A correct daily total does not prove that intermediate lower-reservoir storage avoided overflow or other boundary violations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設無外部交換，發電流量100m³/s持續1800s，上庫減少180000m³、下庫增加同量，兩庫合計不變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Upper storage falls180000m³ while lower storage rises equally, preserving their combined volume.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。日終總量碰巧正確也不能證明中途下庫未經溢流或超界。
knowledge.textEn: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. A correct daily total does not prove that intermediate lower-reservoir storage avoided overflow or other boundary violations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙庫水量帳本」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Paired reservoir water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。
同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water.
The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.
quiz.explanation: 將同一流量在兩庫都列成流出會製造虛假耗水，反過來都列入流又會創造水量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering a transfer as outflow from both reservoirs invents losses, while dual inflow creates water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水位庫容換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level and storage conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位庫容換算」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level and storage conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位不是可直接加減的能量刻度，必須透過測得的庫容曲線換成水量。局部面積不變只適合小範圍近似，廣大的淺灘或陡岸會改變同一水量對應的水位變化；上下庫曲線也不能混用，即使它們具有相近的最大面積。 假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位庫容換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water level is not an additive energy scale; surveyed storage curves connect level to volume. A constant surface area is a local approximation, and broad shelves or steep banks change the level response to equal transfers. Upper and lower curves are not interchangeable merely because their maximum surface areas appear similar. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level and storage conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位庫容換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level and storage conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位庫容換算
knowledge.text: 水位不是可直接加減的能量刻度，必須透過測得的庫容曲線換成水量。局部面積不變只適合小範圍近似，廣大的淺灘或陡岸會改變同一水量對應的水位變化；上下庫曲線也不能混用，即使它們具有相近的最大面積。
knowledge.textEn: Water level is not an additive energy scale; surveyed storage curves connect level to volume. A constant surface area is a local approximation, and broad shelves or steep banks change the level response to equal transfers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位庫容換算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

水位不是可直接加減的能量刻度，必須透過測得的庫容曲線換成水量。
optionsEn: The same transferred volume must produce identical level changes in both reservoirs.
Gross reservoir head and machine net head are equal at every discharge.
Water level is not an additive energy scale; surveyed storage curves connect level to volume.
quiz.explanation: 水位不是可直接加減的能量刻度，必須透過測得的庫容曲線換成水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water level is not an additive energy scale; surveyed storage curves connect level to volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位庫容換算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位庫容換算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設局部上庫面積600000m²恆定，抽入180000m³，Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m；大範圍水位需積分實際庫容曲線。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume locally constant upper area600000m² and inflow180000m³. Δz=ΔV/A=0.300m; broader changes require the actual integrated storage curve. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 水位庫容換算：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Put level, storage and area on a common datum and check that storage-curve slope equals surface area. steps.instruction: 水力功率由流量與淨水頭共同決定，電輸出還要乘適用工況的總效率。額定容量只是設備界限而不是每一時刻都能供應的功率；水位下降、效率曲線或流道限制會改變結果，排程應保存每步輸入而非只指定固定兆瓦數。 假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「發電功率與輸出」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

knowledge.text: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。以每步流量和淨水頭算功率，積分成電能後對照電表，同時保留啟停、輔機與不可運轉區域的獨立紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses. Compute each step’s power from discharge and net head, integrate to energy and compare with meters while separately retaining starts, auxiliary loads and prohibited operating regions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。以每步流量和淨水頭算功率，積分成電能後對照電表，同時保留啟停、輔機與不可運轉區域的獨立紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses. Compute each step’s power from discharge and net head, integrate to energy and compare with meters while separately retaining starts, auxiliary loads and prohibited operating regions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「發電功率與輸出」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Generating power and output"?
options: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。
optionsEn: Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.
quiz.explanation: 分清機械、發電機與總效率的定義，避免把同一損失計算兩遍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Distinguish mechanical, generator and overall efficiency to avoid duplicated losses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 發電功率與輸出：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Generating power and output: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「發電功率與輸出」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Generating power and output” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將百分之九十直接代成九十會放大百倍，忽略功率與電能的時間轉換則使排程帳本失衡。用額定效率覆蓋全部負載，也可能系統性高估低負載輸出。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entering ninety instead of0.90 inflates output a hundredfold, while omitting the time conversion confuses power and energy. Extending rated efficiency to every load can systematically overstate output away from the reference condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設單一工況ρ=1000kg/m³、Q=100m³/s、淨水頭385m、總效率0.90，P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: P=ρgQHη=339.9165MW at this stated operating point.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「額定發電容量足夠就保證任意水位都能連續輸出相同功率。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate nameplate capacity guarantees identical continuous output at any reservoir level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將百分之九十直接代成九十會放大百倍，忽略功率與電能的時間轉換則使排程帳本失衡。用額定效率覆蓋全部負載，也可能系統性高估低負載輸出。
knowledge.textEn: Entering ninety instead of0.90 inflates output a hundredfold, while omitting the time conversion confuses power and energy. Extending rated efficiency to every load can systematically overstate output away from the reference condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「發電功率與輸出」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Generating power and output" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
將百分之九十直接代成九十會放大百倍，忽略功率與電能的時間轉換則使排程帳本失衡。
抽水效率越低時用電需求反而應該越小。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Entering ninety instead of0.90 inflates output a hundredfold, while omitting the time conversion confuses power and energy.
Lower pumping efficiency should reduce the electrical input required for the same lift and flow.
quiz.explanation: 將百分之九十直接代成九十會放大百倍，忽略功率與電能的時間轉換則使排程帳本失衡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entering ninety instead of0.90 inflates output a hundredfold, while omitting the time conversion confuses power and energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「抽水輸入與損失」與「往返效率的邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pumping input and losses" and "Round-trip efficiency boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 抽水輸入與損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping input and losses: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「抽水輸入與損失」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping input and losses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽水必須提供提升水體與克服損失所需的能量，因此電輸入除以效率而不是乘以效率。泵的穩定運轉範圍、可變速能力及轉換時間會影響流量是否可調；能源帳本可比較方案，但不能把連續公式直接當成每座固定轉速機組的控制命令。 假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「抽水輸入與損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pumping input must cover both elevation gain and hydraulic losses, so electrical demand divides by efficiency rather than multiplying it. Stable pump range, speed flexibility and mode-transition time determine whether discharge can actually be varied. An energy ledger can compare options without turning a continuous formula into an operating command for every fixed-speed unit. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping input and losses” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抽水效率越低時用電需求反而應該越小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower pumping efficiency should reduce the electrical input required for the same lift and flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「抽水輸入與損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pumping input and losses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 抽水輸入與損失
knowledge.text: 抽水必須提供提升水體與克服損失所需的能量，因此電輸入除以效率而不是乘以效率。泵的穩定運轉範圍、可變速能力及轉換時間會影響流量是否可調；能源帳本可比較方案，但不能把連續公式直接當成每座固定轉速機組的控制命令。
knowledge.textEn: Pumping input must cover both elevation gain and hydraulic losses, so electrical demand divides by efficiency rather than multiplying it. Stable pump range, speed flexibility and mode-transition time determine whether discharge can actually be varied.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抽水效率越低時用電需求反而應該越小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower pumping efficiency should reduce the electrical input required for the same lift and flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「抽水輸入與損失」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pumping input and losses" is correct?
options: 抽水效率越低時用電需求反而應該越小。
只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。
抽水必須提供提升水體與克服損失所需的能量，因此電輸入除以效率而不是乘以效率。
optionsEn: Lower pumping efficiency should reduce the electrical input required for the same lift and flow.
Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.
Pumping input must cover both elevation gain and hydraulic losses, so electrical demand divides by efficiency rather than multiplying it.
quiz.explanation: 抽水必須提供提升水體與克服損失所需的能量，因此電輸入除以效率而不是乘以效率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pumping input must cover both elevation gain and hydraulic losses, so electrical demand divides by efficiency rather than multiplying it. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 抽水輸入與損失：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping input and losses: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「抽水輸入與損失」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumping input and losses” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一能量邊界記錄泵輸入與水體得到的能量，標註效率是否已含馬達及變頻設備。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record pump input and water-energy gain across the same boundary, noting whether motor and converter losses are included.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設抽水流量100m³/s、總揚程415m、電至水效率0.88，Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume pumping discharge100m³/s, total lift415m and electricity-to-water efficiency0.88. Pin=1000×9.81×100×415/0.88=462.631MW, excluding any separately modeled auxiliaries.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「抽水輸入與損失」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pumping input and losses", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
爬坡期間總水量正確就能證明任何閥門動作都不會產生水錘。
同一份預留水量可以同時保證任意多個獨立備援服務。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
A correct total ramp volume proves that every associated valve movement is free of water hammer.
The same reserved water can simultaneously guarantee any number of independent backup services.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 抽水輸入與損失：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumping input and losses: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「抽水輸入與損失」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumping input and losses” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一能量邊界記錄泵輸入與水體得到的能量，標註效率是否已含馬達及變頻設備。檢查機組曲線與模式切換時段，將不可行的中間流量排除，再用電表積分核對假設效率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record pump input and water-energy gain across the same boundary, noting whether motor and converter losses are included. Check machine curves and mode transitions, exclude infeasible intermediate flows and compare metered energy with the assumed aggregate efficiency. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一能量邊界記錄泵輸入與水體得到的能量，標註效率是否已含馬達及變頻設備。檢查機組曲線與模式切換時段，將不可行的中間流量排除，再用電表積分核對假設效率。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record pump input and water-energy gain across the same boundary, noting whether motor and converter losses are included. Check machine curves and mode transitions, exclude infeasible intermediate flows and compare metered energy with the assumed aggregate efficiency.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將效率相乘會得到比水力需求還小的電輸入，違反能量守恆。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying by efficiency produces electrical input below the water-energy requirement and violates conservation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將效率相乘會得到比水力需求還小的電輸入，違反能量守恆。若輔機已含在總效率又再扣一次，亦會錯估整個循環的損失與可回收電量。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying by efficiency produces electrical input below the water-energy requirement and violates conservation. Counting auxiliaries both within aggregate efficiency and separately also misstates cycle loss and recoverable electrical output.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「抽水輸入與損失」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pumping input and losses" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。
將效率相乘會得到比水力需求還小的電輸入，違反能量守恆。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.
Multiplying by efficiency produces electrical input below the water-energy requirement and violates conservation.
quiz.explanation: 將效率相乘會得到比水力需求還小的電輸入，違反能量守恆。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying by efficiency produces electrical input below the water-energy requirement and violates conservation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 往返效率的邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「往返效率的邊界」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip efficiency boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 往返效率應以完整且一致的週期比較輸入與輸出，起終庫存不同時不能把借用的水能誤當效率提升。定水頭理想化下兩個方向效率相乘很方便，但水頭損失和輔機仍要說明；不同計量邊界的結果不可直接排名優劣。 假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「往返效率的邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Round-trip efficiency compares input and output over a complete cycle with consistent boundaries. Different terminal storage can make borrowed water energy look like improved efficiency. Multiplying directional efficiencies is convenient under equal constant head, but hydraulic loss and auxiliaries must be stated, and values measured across different boundaries should not be ranked as equivalent. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip efficiency boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「往返效率的邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip efficiency boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 往返效率的邊界
knowledge.text: 往返效率應以完整且一致的週期比較輸入與輸出，起終庫存不同時不能把借用的水能誤當效率提升。定水頭理想化下兩個方向效率相乘很方便，但水頭損失和輔機仍要說明；不同計量邊界的結果不可直接排名優劣。
knowledge.textEn: Round-trip efficiency compares input and output over a complete cycle with consistent boundaries. Different terminal storage can make borrowed water energy look like improved efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返效率的邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip efficiency boundaries" is correct?
options: 往返效率應以完整且一致的週期比較輸入與輸出，起終庫存不同時不能把借用的水能誤當效率提升。
只要輸出電量除以當日抽水電量超過一就證明儲能效率超過百分之百。
只要上庫尚未排空就可以維持額定功率直到最後一滴水。
optionsEn: Round-trip efficiency compares input and output over a complete cycle with consistent boundaries.
Output exceeding the same day’s pumping input proves a storage efficiency above one hundred percent.
Rated power can be maintained until the upper reservoir is completely empty.
quiz.explanation: 往返效率應以完整且一致的週期比較輸入與輸出，起終庫存不同時不能把借用的水能誤當效率提升。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Round-trip efficiency compares input and output over a complete cycle with consistent boundaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 往返效率的邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返效率的邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip efficiency boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出週期起終兩庫水位、輸入電能與輸出電能，校正外來水量造成的能量改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List initial and final levels in both reservoirs and metered input and output, correcting for energy introduced by external water.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設相同定水頭且起終庫存相同，抽水效率0.88、發電效率0.90，往返ηrt=0.88×0.90=0.792即79.2%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume equal constant head and identical initial and final storage. Pumping efficiency0.88 and generating efficiency0.90 give round-tripηrt=0.792, or79.2%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「往返效率的邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Round-trip efficiency boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。
optionsEn: Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.

steps.title: 往返效率的邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返效率的邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip efficiency boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出週期起終兩庫水位、輸入電能與輸出電能，校正外來水量造成的能量改變。註明是否計入待機及變壓器損失，只有邊界相同時才比較往返效率，並保留原始電表時間區間。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List initial and final levels in both reservoirs and metered input and output, correcting for energy introduced by external water. State treatment of standby and transformer losses and compare round-trip figures only across matching boundaries and time intervals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：列出週期起終兩庫水位、輸入電能與輸出電能，校正外來水量造成的能量改變。註明是否計入待機及變壓器損失，只有邊界相同時才比較往返效率，並保留原始電表時間區間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List initial and final levels in both reservoirs and metered input and output, correcting for energy introduced by external water. State treatment of standby and transformer losses and compare round-trip figures only across matching boundaries and time intervals.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若日終上庫比起初低，額外發電可能只是消耗庫存。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ending with a lower upper reservoir can add generation by consuming inventory. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.titleEn: Round-trip efficiency boundaries: failure diagnosis

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「可用水量與時數」與「爬坡流量積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Usable volume and duration" and "Integrating flow ramps": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 可用水量與時數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Usable volume and duration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用水量與時數」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Usable volume and duration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 儲能時數受可移動水量及可接受流量共同限制，不等同於水庫總容積除以任意大流量。死水位、下庫空間、最低淹沒深度和保留需求會縮小可用範圍；長時間輸出還會改變水頭，所以等流量時數只提供第一層水量檢核。 假設已扣保留量的可移水量720000m³、定流量100m³/s，t=720000/100=7200s即2h；不保證定功率兩小時。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用水量與時數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storage duration is limited by transferable water and feasible discharge, not total reservoir volume divided by any desired flow. Dead storage, lower-reservoir room, intake submergence and reserved water reduce the usable range. Head changes during a long release, so constant-discharge duration provides only the first water-balance check rather than constant-power endurance. Assume transferable volume720000m³ after reservations and constant discharge100m³/s. Duration7200s equals2h, without guaranteeing constant electrical power throughout. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Usable volume and duration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 可用水量與時數
knowledge.text: 儲能時數受可移動水量及可接受流量共同限制，不等同於水庫總容積除以任意大流量。死水位、下庫空間、最低淹沒深度和保留需求會縮小可用範圍；長時間輸出還會改變水頭，所以等流量時數只提供第一層水量檢核。
knowledge.textEn: Storage duration is limited by transferable water and feasible discharge, not total reservoir volume divided by any desired flow. Dead storage, lower-reservoir room, intake submergence and reserved water reduce the usable range.

A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.

steps.title: 爬坡流量積分：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「爬坡流量積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Integrating flow ramps” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留流量歷時並檢查爬坡形狀，將梯形積分與較短時間步積分比較。另把閥位、轉速及壓力歷時送到瞬態分析，清楚標註此水量帳本沒有證明閥門速度或壓力變化可被接受。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain the discharge history, check ramp shape and compare trapezoidal integration with smaller time steps. Examine valve, speed and pressure histories in a separate transient analysis, explicitly recording that the volume ledger does not approve actuator rates or pressure excursions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
