steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the final discharge over the full interval doubles this transferred volume and biases the next storage estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 爬坡流量積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integrating flow ramps: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「爬坡流量積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Integrating flow ramps” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以末端一百立方米每秒乘全段會把移水量加倍，造成下一時段庫位預測偏移。即使水量積分正確，短暫快速動作仍可能產生排程模型看不到的壓力波。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the final discharge over the full interval doubles this transferred volume and biases the next storage estimate. Correct integration still cannot reveal short rapid actions that generate pressure waves outside the scheduling model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設流量在300s內由0線性升至100m³/s，V=(0+100)×300/2=15000m³；此為水量積分而非水錘驗算。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「爬坡期間總水量正確就能證明任何閥門動作都不會產生水錘。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct total ramp volume proves that every associated valve movement is free of water hammer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「爬坡流量積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Integrating flow ramps" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。
以末端一百立方米每秒乘全段會把移水量加倍，造成下一時段庫位預測偏移。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage.
Using the final discharge over the full interval doubles this transferred volume and biases the next storage estimate.
quiz.explanation: 以末端一百立方米每秒乘全段會把移水量加倍，造成下一時段庫位預測偏移。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the final discharge over the full interval doubles this transferred volume and biases the next storage estimate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外部水量與封閉循環」與「期末庫存與預留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "External water and closed loops" and "Terminal inventory and reservation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外部水量與封閉循環：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: External water and closed loops: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「外部水量與封閉循環」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “External water and closed loops” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封閉循環表示缺乏持續天然水體連通，並不代表沒有降雨、蒸發、滲漏或補水。這些小流量累積後會改變長期可用庫存，兩庫表面積不同又會造成不對稱損失；調度帳本要分清天氣水量與機組搬移，才能找到真實偏差來源。 假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「外部水量與封閉循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed loop lacks an ongoing natural-water connection, but rainfall, evaporation, seepage and makeup water still matter. Small persistent fluxes alter long-term inventory, and different reservoir areas produce unequal losses. Separating weather exchange from machine transfers allows the scheduling ledger to diagnose the actual source of a storage discrepancy rather than assign every change to pumping. Assume combined surface area1000000m² and daily evaporation0.004m. Loss is4000m³/day, excluding rain and seepage; closed-loop does not mean zero water use. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “External water and closed loops” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「外部水量與封閉循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “External water and closed loops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 外部水量與封閉循環
knowledge.text: 封閉循環表示缺乏持續天然水體連通，並不代表沒有降雨、蒸發、滲漏或補水。這些小流量累積後會改變長期可用庫存，兩庫表面積不同又會造成不對稱損失；調度帳本要分清天氣水量與機組搬移，才能找到真實偏差來源。
knowledge.textEn: A closed loop lacks an ongoing natural-water connection, but rainfall, evaporation, seepage and makeup water still matter. Small persistent fluxes alter long-term inventory, and different reservoir areas produce unequal losses.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「外部水量與封閉循環」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "External water and closed loops" is correct?
options: 封閉循環表示缺乏持續天然水體連通，並不代表沒有降雨、蒸發、滲漏或補水。
封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。
同一份預留水量可以同時保證任意多個獨立備援服務。
optionsEn: A closed loop lacks an ongoing natural-water connection, but rainfall, evaporation, seepage and makeup water still matter.
Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage.
The same reserved water can simultaneously guarantee any number of independent backup services.
quiz.explanation: 封閉循環表示缺乏持續天然水體連通，並不代表沒有降雨、蒸發、滲漏或補水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A closed loop lacks an ongoing natural-water connection, but rainfall, evaporation, seepage and makeup water still matter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外部水量與封閉循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume combined surface area1000000m² and daily evaporation0.004m. Loss is4000m³/day, excluding rain and seepage; closed-loop does not mean zero water use. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將降雨蒸發深度乘當日水面積，核對毫米與米及每日與每秒的換算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Multiply weather depths by contemporaneous surface area and verify millimeter-to-meter and daily-to-second conversions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「外部水量與封閉循環」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "External water and closed loops", which statement holds?
options: 同樣的移水量在上下庫必定造成完全相同的水位變化。

steps.title: 外部水量與封閉循環：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: External water and closed loops: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外部水量與封閉循環」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “External water and closed loops” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將蒸發列成每次抽水循環的固定損失會讓結果隨排程次數虛增，忽略面積變化又會產生季節偏差。漏水與零漂混在一起時，錯誤補水判斷也可能擴大。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating evaporation as a fixed loss per pumping cycle makes it grow artificially with cycling frequency. Ignoring area variation adds seasonal bias, while confusing leakage with sensor drift can lead to inappropriate makeup estimates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設兩庫合計水面1000000m²、日蒸發0.004m，日損失4000m³；未計降雨與滲漏，不可稱封閉循環零耗水。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封閉循環抽蓄完全不會受到降雨、蒸發或滲漏影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Closed-loop pumped storage is completely unaffected by rainfall, evaporation or seepage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.explanationEn: Treating evaporation as a fixed loss per pumping cycle makes it grow artificially with cycling frequency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 期末庫存與預留：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Terminal inventory and reservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「期末庫存與預留」如何影響抽蓄水庫水位調度的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Terminal inventory and reservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Reservoir-level scheduling for pumped storage”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有限時域排程若不約束期末庫存，會把最後一刻耗盡上庫當成最佳結果，卻把下一日需求隱藏起來。預留可用水量與電能不能直接互換，必須考慮當時水頭和可用機組；應明列預留目的以及何時可以釋放，避免重複承諾同一份水。 假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「期末庫存與預留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A finite-horizon schedule without a terminal-storage constraint can favor emptying the upper reservoir at the last instant while hiding the following day’s need. Reserved water is not automatically reserved electrical energy because head and unit availability matter. State the purpose and release condition of each reservation to avoid committing the same inventory to multiple services. Assume upper usable storage800000m³ with200000m³ reserved. At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Terminal inventory and reservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「期末庫存與預留」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

有限時域排程若不約束期末庫存，會把最後一刻耗盡上庫當成最佳結果，卻把下一日需求隱藏起來。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume upper usable storage800000m³ with200000m³ reserved. At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把期末目標、預留用途與可釋放條件寫成獨立約束，逐步檢查同一水量是否被重複計入不同服務。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「期末庫存與預留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Terminal inventory and reservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。若兩個備援服務同時到來，共用一份預留水量的承諾便無法全部履行。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage. If two reserve services arrive together, promises backed by the same water inventory cannot both be fulfilled. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設上庫可用800000m³，其中預留200000m³，其他條件允許時最多移出600000m³；兩項服務不能重複使用同一預留量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: At most600000m³ is transferable if other constraints permit, without double-allocating the reservation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一份預留水量可以同時保證任意多個獨立備援服務。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same reserved water can simultaneously guarantee any number of independent backup services." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。若兩個備援服務同時到來，共用一份預留水量的承諾便無法全部履行。
knowledge.textEn: Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage. If two reserve services arrive together, promises backed by the same water inventory cannot both be fulfilled.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「期末庫存與預留」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Terminal inventory and reservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。
只要日終上庫水位正確就不需要檢查下庫逐時水量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage.
A correct final upper-reservoir level removes any need to check lower-reservoir storage through time.
quiz.explanation: 完美預報假設會讓預留不足的方案看似可行，期末缺水又會被截斷時域隱藏。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Perfect-forecast assumptions can make inadequate reserves seem feasible, while horizon truncation hides terminal shortage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 壓力鋼管錨定與支承
courses.summary: 本課用完整荷載路徑理解壓力鋼管，而不只套一條薄壁應力公式。十個單元依序分辨環向與軸向力、彎管向量、熱伸縮、滿管重量、跨距反力、滑動摩擦、錨塊基底及減薄檢查，要求每個簡化模型先畫自由體與邊界，再說明未包含的局部殼體、基礎與疲勞問題。
courses.summaryEn: This course follows the complete penstock load path rather than relying on one thin-wall formula. Ten units distinguish hoop and axial action, elbow vectors, thermal movement, full-pipe weight, span reactions, friction, anchor bearing and wall loss. Each simplified model begins with a free body and boundaries and identifies excluded shell, foundation and fatigue behavior.
courses.focus: 追蹤壓力、重量與溫度荷載如何經鋼管傳到錨塊支承
courses.focusEn: Trace pressure, gravity and thermal loads through penstocks into anchors and supports
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 壩工監測、溢洪與壓力水路
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Dam monitoring, spillways and pressure waterways

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創壓力敏感度：薄壁圓管內徑2m、均勻厚度0.020m，表壓2MPa時環向膜應力為100MPa。如果保持幾何及線彈性假設而壓力增加10%至2.2MPa，應力增為110MPa，增加10%。此線性關係不能證明材料、焊縫或支座仍有足夠餘量。學徒應再列端部軸力、彎管壓力向量和錨塊需求如何同時增加，並檢查壓力峰值是否出自水錘。若發生減薄、塑性或外壓屈曲，原先模型邊界已改變，不能以這個單一百分比概括所有失效機制。
workedExample.textEn: Original pressure sensitivity: a thin circular pipe with inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m has hoop membrane stress100MPa at gauge pressure2MPa. Holding geometry and linear-elastic assumptions fixed while increasing pressure10% to2.2MPa raises stress to110MPa, also10%. That proportionality does not demonstrate adequate material, weld or support margin. Apprentices should also trace increased end force, elbow pressure vectors and anchor demands and determine whether the peak is a water-hammer transient. Wall loss, plasticity or external-pressure buckling changes the original model boundary, so one percentage cannot summarize every failure mechanism.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等徑2m、兩端表壓2MPa、轉角90°且忽略動量及重量，F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN，方向沿兩壓力向量合成。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設軸向完全固定、均勻升溫30°C、E=200GPa、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C，壓應力幅值EαΔT=72MPa，限線彈性。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設水平滿管內徑2m、外徑2.04m、鋼密度7850及水1000kg/m³，w=g[7850π(2.04²−2²)/4+1000π]=40.593kN/m。
factsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume thin circular pipe gauge pressure2MPa, inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m. Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume closed ends and no external axial restraint, withp=2MPa,D=2m,t=0.020m. Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model.

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume diameter2m, equal gauge pressure2MPa and90° turn, neglecting momentum and weight. F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN along the pressure-vector resultant.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint.

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume full axial restraint, uniform warming30°C,E=200GPa andα=12×10⁻⁶/°C. Compressive stress magnitudeEαΔT=72MPa in the linear-elastic idealization.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a horizontal full pipe with inner diameter2m, outer2.04m, steel density7850 and water1000kg/m³. Combined distributed weight is40.593kN/m.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「環向薄膜應力」與「封閉端軸向作用」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Circumferential membrane stress" and "Closed-end axial action": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 環向薄膜應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Circumferential membrane stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環向薄膜應力」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Circumferential membrane stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 圓管內壓使管壁承受環向拉力，薄壁公式可先估量級，但只描述遠離支承與接頭的膜應力。焊接缺陷、橢圓化和局部加勁會改變應力分布，外壓失穩又是另一機制；必須先辨明幾何與壓力方向，不能把一個平均值當成整根鋼管安全證明。 假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環向薄膜應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Internal pressure creates circumferential tension, and a thin-wall estimate gives membrane stress away from supports and connections. Weld defects, ovality and local stiffening alter the distribution, while external-pressure buckling is a different mechanism. Establish geometry and pressure direction before treating a mean stress as evidence about the entire penstock’s structural behavior. Assume thin circular pipe gauge pressure2MPa, inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m. Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Circumferential membrane stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環向薄膜應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Circumferential membrane stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環向薄膜應力
knowledge.text: 圓管內壓使管壁承受環向拉力，薄壁公式可先估量級，但只描述遠離支承與接頭的膜應力。焊接缺陷、橢圓化和局部加勁會改變應力分布，外壓失穩又是另一機制；必須先辨明幾何與壓力方向，不能把一個平均值當成整根鋼管安全證明。
knowledge.textEn: Internal pressure creates circumferential tension, and a thin-wall estimate gives membrane stress away from supports and connections. Weld defects, ovality and local stiffening alter the distribution, while external-pressure buckling is a different mechanism.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環向薄膜應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Circumferential membrane stress" is correct?
options: 平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。
圓管內壓使管壁承受環向拉力，薄壁公式可先估量級，但只描述遠離支承與接頭的膜應力。
封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。
optionsEn: A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable.
Internal pressure creates circumferential tension, and a thin-wall estimate gives membrane stress away from supports and connections.
The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline.
quiz.explanation: 圓管內壓使管壁承受環向拉力，薄壁公式可先估量級，但只描述遠離支承與接頭的膜應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Internal pressure creates circumferential tension, and a thin-wall estimate gives membrane stress away from supports and connections. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環向薄膜應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Circumferential membrane stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環向薄膜應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Circumferential membrane stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume thin circular pipe gauge pressure2MPa, inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m. Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫半圓自由體平衡，核對內徑、有效厚度及表壓使用方式，並計算厚徑比。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw a half-cylinder equilibrium diagram, checking inner diameter, effective thickness and gauge pressure and calculating thickness ratio.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume thin circular pipe gauge pressure2MPa, inner diameter2m and uniform thickness0.020m. Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環向薄膜應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Circumferential membrane stress", which statement holds?
options: 算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。
管線支座只需要承受鋼材自重而不必考慮管內水重。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks.
Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環向薄膜應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Circumferential membrane stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環向薄膜應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Circumferential membrane stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫半圓自由體平衡，核對內徑、有效厚度及表壓使用方式，並計算厚徑比。將支座、分岔、焊縫與變厚位置另列局部分析範圍，保留材料和厚度量測資料而不只比較單一應力數字。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw a half-cylinder equilibrium diagram, checking inner diameter, effective thickness and gauge pressure and calculating thickness ratio. Flag supports, branches, welds and thickness transitions for local analysis and retain material and measurement evidence rather than comparing only one stress value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫半圓自由體平衡，核對內徑、有效厚度及表壓使用方式，並計算厚徑比。將支座、分岔、焊縫與變厚位置另列局部分析範圍，保留材料和厚度量測資料而不只比較單一應力數字。

Flag supports, branches, welds and thickness transitions for local analysis and retain material and measurement evidence rather than comparing only one stress value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部腐蝕孔與焊縫缺陷可能控制承載，平均厚度會掩蓋最弱位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local pits and weld flaws may govern strength while mean thickness hides the weakest region. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Circumferential membrane stress"?

靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。

steps.title: 環向薄膜應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Circumferential membrane stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環向薄膜應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Circumferential membrane stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部腐蝕孔與焊縫缺陷可能控制承載，平均厚度會掩蓋最弱位置。空管外部地下水形成的壓力方向相反，不能把內壓拉力公式直接用來證明抗屈曲能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local pits and weld flaws may govern strength while mean thickness hides the weakest region. Groundwater acting on a drained pipe reverses pressure direction, so an internal-tension formula does not establish external-buckling resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設薄壁圓管表壓p=2MPa、內徑D=2m、均勻壁厚t=0.020m，σh=pD/(2t)=100MPa；未含局部彎曲。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hoopσh=pD/(2t)=100MPa, excluding local bending.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部腐蝕孔與焊縫缺陷可能控制承載，平均厚度會掩蓋最弱位置。空管外部地下水形成的壓力方向相反，不能把內壓拉力公式直接用來證明抗屈曲能力。
knowledge.textEn: Local pits and weld flaws may govern strength while mean thickness hides the weakest region. Groundwater acting on a drained pipe reverses pressure direction, so an internal-tension formula does not establish external-buckling resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環向薄膜應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Circumferential membrane stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
局部腐蝕孔與焊縫缺陷可能控制承載，平均厚度會掩蓋最弱位置。
封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Local pits and weld flaws may govern strength while mean thickness hides the weakest region.
The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline.
quiz.explanation: 局部腐蝕孔與焊縫缺陷可能控制承載，平均厚度會掩蓋最弱位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local pits and weld flaws may govern strength while mean thickness hides the weakest region. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 封閉端軸向作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Closed-end axial action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「封閉端軸向作用」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Closed-end axial action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 封閉端的壓力合力需要由管壁或其他結構路徑平衡，軸向應力取決於端部約束與伸縮接頭。對可自由伸長的封閉薄壁管可以直接用端面平衡，但固定管線、泊松變形和錨塊分擔會改變答案；不能將教學圓筒公式無條件貼到埋設管。 假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「封閉端軸向作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure on a closed end must be balanced through the wall or another structural path. Axial stress depends on end restraint and expansion joints. End equilibrium applies directly to a freely extending closed thin cylinder, but fixed pipelines, Poisson effects and anchor load sharing change that answer and require a consistent boundary model. Assume closed ends and no external axial restraint, withp=2MPa,D=2m,t=0.020m. Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Closed-end axial action” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「封閉端軸向作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Closed-end axial action”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 封閉端軸向作用
knowledge.text: 封閉端的壓力合力需要由管壁或其他結構路徑平衡，軸向應力取決於端部約束與伸縮接頭。對可自由伸長的封閉薄壁管可以直接用端面平衡，但固定管線、泊松變形和錨塊分擔會改變答案；不能將教學圓筒公式無條件貼到埋設管。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure on a closed end must be balanced through the wall or another structural path. Axial stress depends on end restraint and expansion joints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「封閉端軸向作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Closed-end axial action" is correct?
options: 封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。
彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。
封閉端的壓力合力需要由管壁或其他結構路徑平衡，軸向應力取決於端部約束與伸縮接頭。
optionsEn: The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline.
Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle.
Pressure on a closed end must be balanced through the wall or another structural path.
quiz.explanation: 封閉端的壓力合力需要由管壁或其他結構路徑平衡，軸向應力取決於端部約束與伸縮接頭。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure on a closed end must be balanced through the wall or another structural path. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 封閉端軸向作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Closed-end axial action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「封閉端軸向作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Closed-end axial action” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume closed ends and no external axial restraint, withp=2MPa,D=2m,t=0.020m. Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume closed ends and no external axial restraint, withp=2MPa,D=2m,t=0.020m. Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「封閉端軸向作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Closed-end axial action", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。
梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation.
A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 封閉端軸向作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Closed-end axial action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「封閉端軸向作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Closed-end axial action” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。分開列自由伸長與完全固定的邊界情境，核對管壁軸力與外部反力是否共同滿足整體平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions. Separate free-extension and fixed-boundary cases, checking that wall force and external reactions together satisfy equilibrium of the complete selected pipe segment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。分開列自由伸長與完全固定的邊界情境，核對管壁軸力與外部反力是否共同滿足整體平衡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions. Separate free-extension and fixed-boundary cases, checking that wall force and external reactions together satisfy equilibrium of the complete selected pipe segment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若壓力推力已被錨塊承擔又完整加到管壁，會重複荷載；反之兩邊都忽略則遺失力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning full pressure thrust to both wall and anchor double-counts load, while assigning it to neither loses equilibrium. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。分開列自由伸長與完全固定的邊界情境，核對管壁軸力與外部反力是否共同滿足整體平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions. Separate free-extension and fixed-boundary cases, checking that wall force and external reactions together satisfy equilibrium of the complete selected pipe segment.

knowledge.text: 沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。分開列自由伸長與完全固定的邊界情境，核對管壁軸力與外部反力是否共同滿足整體平衡。
knowledge.textEn: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions. Separate free-extension and fixed-boundary cases, checking that wall force and external reactions together satisfy equilibrium of the complete selected pipe segment.

quiz.question: 要驗證「封閉端軸向作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Closed-end axial action"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿管線標出固定點、滑動點與伸縮接頭，畫端部壓力進入管壁或錨塊的路徑。

Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions.

quiz.explanationEn: Map fixed points, sliding supports and expansion joints and trace end pressure into wall or anchor reactions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 封閉端軸向作用：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Closed-end axial action: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「封閉端軸向作用」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Closed-end axial action” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若壓力推力已被錨塊承擔又完整加到管壁，會重複荷載；反之兩邊都忽略則遺失力。約束不清時即使公式算得精準，軸向設計仍可能根本錯位。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning full pressure thrust to both wall and anchor double-counts load, while assigning it to neither loses equilibrium. Precise arithmetic cannot repair an axial design based on an undefined or inconsistent restraint condition. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設封閉端且軸向無外部約束，p=2MPa、D=2m、t=0.020m，σa=pD/(4t)=50MPa；固定管段需另建約束模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Axialσa=pD/(4t)=50MPa; restrained segments require another model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若壓力推力已被錨塊承擔又完整加到管壁，會重複荷載；反之兩邊都忽略則遺失力。約束不清時即使公式算得精準，軸向設計仍可能根本錯位。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning full pressure thrust to both wall and anchor double-counts load, while assigning it to neither loses equilibrium. Precise arithmetic cannot repair an axial design based on an undefined or inconsistent restraint condition.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「封閉端軸向作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Closed-end axial action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。
若壓力推力已被錨塊承擔又完整加到管壁，會重複荷載；反之兩邊都忽略則遺失力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle.
Assigning full pressure thrust to both wall and anchor double-counts load, while assigning it to neither loses equilibrium.
quiz.explanation: 若壓力推力已被錨塊承擔又完整加到管壁，會重複荷載；反之兩邊都忽略則遺失力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning full pressure thrust to both wall and anchor double-counts load, while assigning it to neither loses equilibrium. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彎管壓力向量」與「自由熱伸長」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elbow pressure vectors" and "Free thermal expansion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彎管壓力向量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elbow pressure vectors: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彎管壓力向量」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elbow pressure vectors” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 管線轉向時兩端壓力力的向量差形成彎管合力，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當成所有方向的錨定荷載。動量變化、水重、管重與支承反力還要在完整自由體另列；等壓靜態示例只幫助確認角度與方向，不代表實際組合荷載。 假設等徑2m、兩端表壓2MPa、轉角90°且忽略動量及重量，F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN，方向沿兩壓力向量合成。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彎管壓力向量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A change in direction produces a resultant from the pressure-force vectors at an elbow’s ends. Pressure times one area alone does not describe every anchorage component. Momentum flux, water and pipe weight and support reactions belong in the full free body; an equal-pressure static example checks orientation rather than replacing the actual load combination. Assume diameter2m, equal gauge pressure2MPa and90° turn, neglecting momentum and weight. F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN along the pressure-vector resultant. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elbow pressure vectors” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彎管壓力向量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elbow pressure vectors”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彎管壓力向量
knowledge.text: 管線轉向時兩端壓力力的向量差形成彎管合力，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當成所有方向的錨定荷載。動量變化、水重、管重與支承反力還要在完整自由體另列；等壓靜態示例只幫助確認角度與方向，不代表實際組合荷載。
knowledge.textEn: A change in direction produces a resultant from the pressure-force vectors at an elbow’s ends. Pressure times one area alone does not describe every anchorage component.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彎管壓力向量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elbow pressure vectors" is correct?
options: 管線轉向時兩端壓力力的向量差形成彎管合力，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當成所有方向的錨定荷載。
彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。
算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。
optionsEn: A change in direction produces a resultant from the pressure-force vectors at an elbow’s ends.
Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle.
Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks.
quiz.explanation: 管線轉向時兩端壓力力的向量差形成彎管合力，不能只把壓力乘單一截面就當成所有方向的錨定荷載。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A change in direction produces a resultant from the pressure-force vectors at an elbow’s ends. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彎管壓力向量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elbow pressure vectors: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎管壓力向量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elbow pressure vectors” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等徑2m、兩端表壓2MPa、轉角90°且忽略動量及重量，F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN，方向沿兩壓力向量合成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume diameter2m, equal gauge pressure2MPa and90° turn, neglecting momentum and weight. F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN along the pressure-vector resultant. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等徑2m、兩端表壓2MPa、轉角90°且忽略動量及重量，F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN，方向沿兩壓力向量合成。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume diameter2m, equal gauge pressure2MPa and90° turn, neglecting momentum and weight. F=2pA sin45°=8.8858MN along the pressure-vector resultant.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彎管壓力向量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elbow pressure vectors", which statement holds?
options: 管線支座只需要承受鋼材自重而不必考慮管內水重。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。
optionsEn: Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 彎管壓力向量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elbow pressure vectors: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彎管壓力向量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elbow pressure vectors” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。再加入流速動量、重力與管壁傳力，標註哪些項已由相鄰固定點吸收，避免重複或漏列。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle. Then add momentum, gravity and wall-force paths, marking loads transferred to adjacent fixed points to prevent omission or double counting. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。再加入流速動量、重力與管壁傳力，標註哪些項已由相鄰固定點吸收，避免重複或漏列。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle. Then add momentum, gravity and wall-force paths, marking loads transferred to adjacent fixed points to prevent omission or double counting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把九十度誤認為兩箭頭之夾角可能改變符號，錯把單端推力當合力則低估需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing pipe turn with arrow orientation can reverse signs, and using one end thrust understates the resultant. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。再加入流速動量、重力與管壁傳力，標註哪些項已由相鄰固定點吸收，避免重複或漏列。
knowledge.textEn: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle. Then add momentum, gravity and wall-force paths, marking loads transferred to adjacent fixed points to prevent omission or double counting.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。再加入流速動量、重力與管壁傳力，標註哪些項已由相鄰固定點吸收，避免重複或漏列。
knowledge.textEn: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle. Then add momentum, gravity and wall-force paths, marking loads transferred to adjacent fixed points to prevent omission or double counting.

quiz.question: 要驗證「彎管壓力向量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elbow pressure vectors"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。
在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects.
Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle.
quiz.explanation: 在平面圖畫兩端法向及壓力箭頭，用分量法和向量模長各算一次，確認轉角定義。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw end normals and pressure arrows, calculating both components and resultant magnitude with a stated turn angle. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

quiz.explanationEn: Confusing pipe turn with arrow orientation can reverse signs, and using one end thrust understates the resultant. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 自由熱伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free thermal expansion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由熱伸長」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free thermal expansion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴露鋼管溫度改變會產生自由伸縮，支座與接頭必須提供與模型一致的運動空間。水溫、日照及安裝時溫度不必相同，沿線不均勻加熱還會造成彎曲；先算無約束伸長有助於辨認需求，但不能把這個位移視為固定管段也會自由發生。 假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由熱伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exposed steel changes length with temperature, so supports and joints must permit the motion assumed by the model. Water temperature, solar heating and erection temperature differ, and nonuniform heating can induce bending. Computing unconstrained extension identifies movement demand without implying that a fixed segment can actually undergo the same free displacement. Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free thermal expansion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由熱伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free thermal expansion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由熱伸長
knowledge.text: 暴露鋼管溫度改變會產生自由伸縮，支座與接頭必須提供與模型一致的運動空間。水溫、日照及安裝時溫度不必相同，沿線不均勻加熱還會造成彎曲；先算無約束伸長有助於辨認需求，但不能把這個位移視為固定管段也會自由發生。
knowledge.textEn: Exposed steel changes length with temperature, so supports and joints must permit the motion assumed by the model. Water temperature, solar heating and erection temperature differ, and nonuniform heating can induce bending.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由熱伸長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Free thermal expansion" is correct?
options: 算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。
暴露鋼管溫度改變會產生自由伸縮，支座與接頭必須提供與模型一致的運動空間。
完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。
optionsEn: Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks.
Exposed steel changes length with temperature, so supports and joints must permit the motion assumed by the model.
The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation.
quiz.explanation: 暴露鋼管溫度改變會產生自由伸縮，支座與接頭必須提供與模型一致的運動空間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Exposed steel changes length with temperature, so supports and joints must permit the motion assumed by the model. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 自由熱伸長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free thermal expansion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由熱伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free thermal expansion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「自由熱伸長」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Free thermal expansion", which statement holds?
options: 梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。
基底平均壓力算得出來就代表錨塊抗滑、傾覆與地基承載均已合格。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle.
Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 自由熱伸長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free thermal expansion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由熱伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free thermal expansion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。將預測位移與接頭行程及滑動支座位置對照，並檢查沿管溫差是否需要分段積分而非使用單一平均溫度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed. Compare predicted displacement with joint travel and sliding-support position, and assess whether varying temperature requires integration along separate pipe segments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。將預測位移與接頭行程及滑動支座位置對照，並檢查沿管溫差是否需要分段積分而非使用單一平均溫度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed. Compare predicted displacement with joint travel and sliding-support position, and assess whether varying temperature requires integration along separate pipe segments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：接頭卡死會把本來的位移需求轉成內力，支座滑到行程端也會改變邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A seized joint converts movement demand into internal force, and a support reaching its travel stop changes the boundary. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。將預測位移與接頭行程及滑動支座位置對照，並檢查沿管溫差是否需要分段積分而非使用單一平均溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed. Compare predicted displacement with joint travel and sliding-support position, and assess whether varying temperature requires integration along separate pipe segments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。將預測位移與接頭行程及滑動支座位置對照，並檢查沿管溫差是否需要分段積分而非使用單一平均溫度。
knowledge.textEn: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed. Compare predicted displacement with joint travel and sliding-support position, and assess whether varying temperature requires integration along separate pipe segments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「自由熱伸長」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Free thermal expansion"?
options: 以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。
optionsEn: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 以安裝溫度為基準記錄季節溫度範圍，核對自由長度兩端是否真能移動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reference the seasonal range to erection temperature and verify both ends of the free length can move as assumed. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 自由熱伸長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free thermal expansion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由熱伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free thermal expansion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 接頭卡死會把本來的位移需求轉成內力，支座滑到行程端也會改變邊界。只用水溫估暴露管線，可能漏掉日照引起的上下壁溫差和彎曲。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A seized joint converts movement demand into internal force, and a support reaching its travel stop changes the boundary. Water temperature alone may miss solar differences between upper and lower pipe walls and associated bending. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設均勻升溫30°C、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C、自由長度100m，ΔL=αLΔT=0.036m；未含溫度梯度與約束。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume uniform warming30°C, expansion coefficient12×10⁻⁶/°C and free length100m. ΔL=0.036m, excluding temperature gradients and restraint.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 接頭卡死會把本來的位移需求轉成內力，支座滑到行程端也會改變邊界。只用水溫估暴露管線，可能漏掉日照引起的上下壁溫差和彎曲。
knowledge.textEn: A seized joint converts movement demand into internal force, and a support reaching its travel stop changes the boundary. Water temperature alone may miss solar differences between upper and lower pipe walls and associated bending.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「自由熱伸長」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Free thermal expansion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
接頭卡死會把本來的位移需求轉成內力，支座滑到行程端也會改變邊界。
完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A seized joint converts movement demand into internal force, and a support reaching its travel stop changes the boundary.
The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation.
quiz.explanation: 接頭卡死會把本來的位移需求轉成內力，支座滑到行程端也會改變邊界。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A seized joint converts movement demand into internal force, and a support reaching its travel stop changes the boundary. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「完全約束熱應力」與「管體與充水重量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fully restrained thermal stress" and "Pipe and contained-water weight": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 完全約束熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全約束熱應力」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fully restrained thermal stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 熱伸縮被阻止時會產生軸向內力，其大小取決於管壁、錨塊與地基共同剛度。完全固定只是一個清楚的極端情境，實際支座滑移或混凝土變形會重新分配力；溫度循環還可能形成疲勞，因此不能僅檢查一次最大升溫的平均應力。 假設軸向完全固定、均勻升溫30°C、E=200GPa、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C，壓應力幅值EαΔT=72MPa，限線彈性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全約束熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Prevented thermal movement creates axial force governed by combined pipe, anchor and foundation stiffness. Full restraint is a defined limiting case; sliding and concrete deformation redistribute force in practice. Temperature cycling can also contribute to fatigue, so a single maximum-warming stress does not characterize the complete history or the response of every connection. Assume full axial restraint, uniform warming30°C,E=200GPa andα=12×10⁻⁶/°C. Compressive stress magnitudeEαΔT=72MPa in the linear-elastic idealization. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fully restrained thermal stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全約束熱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fully restrained thermal stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全約束熱應力
knowledge.text: 熱伸縮被阻止時會產生軸向內力，其大小取決於管壁、錨塊與地基共同剛度。完全固定只是一個清楚的極端情境，實際支座滑移或混凝土變形會重新分配力；溫度循環還可能形成疲勞，因此不能僅檢查一次最大升溫的平均應力。
knowledge.textEn: Prevented thermal movement creates axial force governed by combined pipe, anchor and foundation stiffness. Full restraint is a defined limiting case; sliding and concrete deformation redistribute force in practice.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全約束熱應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fully restrained thermal stress" is correct?
options: 完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。
管線支座只需要承受鋼材自重而不必考慮管內水重。
熱伸縮被阻止時會產生軸向內力，其大小取決於管壁、錨塊與地基共同剛度。
optionsEn: The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation.
Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water.
Prevented thermal movement creates axial force governed by combined pipe, anchor and foundation stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 熱伸縮被阻止時會產生軸向內力，其大小取決於管壁、錨塊與地基共同剛度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Prevented thermal movement creates axial force governed by combined pipe, anchor and foundation stiffness. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完全約束熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完全約束熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fully restrained thermal stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設軸向完全固定、均勻升溫30°C、E=200GPa、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C，壓應力幅值EαΔT=72MPa，限線彈性。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume full axial restraint, uniform warming30°C,E=200GPa andα=12×10⁻⁶/°C. Compressive stress magnitudeEαΔT=72MPa in the linear-elastic idealization. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先說明固定是位移約束還是高剛度彈簧，分開計算完全自由與固定兩端情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether restraint is a prescribed displacement or a stiff spring and compare free and fixed limiting cases.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.
