knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完全約束熱應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Fully restrained thermal stress", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。
壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force.
A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完全約束熱應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全約束熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fully restrained thermal stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先說明固定是位移約束還是高剛度彈簧，分開計算完全自由與固定兩端情境。核對升溫造成壓縮、降溫造成拉伸的符號，再與壓力軸力及支承變形組合，保留各荷載的時間關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether restraint is a prescribed displacement or a stiff spring and compare free and fixed limiting cases. Check warming-compression and cooling-tension signs, then combine pressure force and support deformation while retaining the timing of each load contribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先說明固定是位移約束還是高剛度彈簧，分開計算完全自由與固定兩端情境。核對升溫造成壓縮、降溫造成拉伸的符號，再與壓力軸力及支承變形組合，保留各荷載的時間關係。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether restraint is a prescribed displacement or a stiff spring and compare free and fixed limiting cases. Check warming-compression and cooling-tension signs, then combine pressure force and support deformation while retaining the timing of each load contribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略錨塊位移可能高估平均熱力，但忽略局部卡阻又可能低估局部需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring anchor movement can overstate average thermal force, while missing local seizure understates local demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完全約束熱應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fully restrained thermal stress"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
先說明固定是位移約束還是高剛度彈簧，分開計算完全自由與固定兩端情境。
封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
State whether restraint is a prescribed displacement or a stiff spring and compare free and fixed limiting cases.
The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline.

quiz.explanationEn: State whether restraint is a prescribed displacement or a stiff spring and compare free and fixed limiting cases. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完全約束熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全約束熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fully restrained thermal stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略錨塊位移可能高估平均熱力，但忽略局部卡阻又可能低估局部需求。若進入降伏或接頭滑移，線性完全固定公式便不能描述卸載後的殘餘變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring anchor movement can overstate average thermal force, while missing local seizure understates local demand. Yielding or joint slip invalidates the linear fully restrained model for residual deformation after unloading. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設軸向完全固定、均勻升溫30°C、E=200GPa、α=12×10⁻⁶/°C，壓應力幅值EαΔT=72MPa，限線彈性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compressive stress magnitudeEαΔT=72MPa in the linear-elastic idealization.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略錨塊位移可能高估平均熱力，但忽略局部卡阻又可能低估局部需求。若進入降伏或接頭滑移，線性完全固定公式便不能描述卸載後的殘餘變形。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring anchor movement can overstate average thermal force, while missing local seizure understates local demand. Yielding or joint slip invalidates the linear fully restrained model for residual deformation after unloading.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完全約束熱應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fully restrained thermal stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
管線支座只需要承受鋼材自重而不必考慮管內水重。
忽略錨塊位移可能高估平均熱力，但忽略局部卡阻又可能低估局部需求。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water.
Ignoring anchor movement can overstate average thermal force, while missing local seizure understates local demand.
quiz.explanation: 忽略錨塊位移可能高估平均熱力，但忽略局部卡阻又可能低估局部需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring anchor movement can overstate average thermal force, while missing local seizure understates local demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 管體與充水重量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pipe and contained-water weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「管體與充水重量」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instructionEn: Supports carry both steel and contained water, making empty and full conditions distinct load cases. Inclined weight must be resolved axially and normally, while encasement or external buoyancy requires separate terms. Internal water volume is not steel volume, and the reference unit length must remain explicit before reactions are distributed between supports. Assume a horizontal full pipe with inner diameter2m, outer2.04m, steel density7850 and water1000kg/m³. Combined distributed weight is40.593kN/m. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pipe and contained-water weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「管體與充水重量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「管體與充水重量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.

steps.title: 管體與充水重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pipe and contained-water weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「管體與充水重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pipe and contained-water weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別畫鋼環與水圓截面，以密度乘面積再乘重力計單位長度荷載，核對外徑減內徑的平方順序。比較空管和滿管，再按斜率分解重量，將外部水壓或混凝土支承另列清楚。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw steel annulus and water disk separately, multiplying density by area and gravity for each unit-length load. Check squared diameters, compare empty and full cases, resolve inclined weight and separately identify external pressure and any concrete support contribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別畫鋼環與水圓截面，以密度乘面積再乘重力計單位長度荷載，核對外徑減內徑的平方順序。比較空管和滿管，再按斜率分解重量，將外部水壓或混凝土支承另列清楚。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw steel annulus and water disk separately, multiplying density by area and gravity for each unit-length load. Check squared diameters, compare empty and full cases, resolve inclined weight and separately identify external pressure and any concrete support contribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏算水重會低估反力，將壁厚直接當成截面面積則量綱已錯。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting water understates reactions, while using thickness as area is dimensionally wrong. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「管體與充水重量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。

steps.title: 管體與充水重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pipe and contained-water weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「管體與充水重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pipe and contained-water weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏算水重會低估反力，將壁厚直接當成截面面積則量綱已錯。外部地下水作用於空管時可能有淨上浮，與滿管向下重量情境不能混為同一驗算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting water understates reactions, while using thickness as area is dimensionally wrong. Groundwater can produce net uplift on an empty conduit, which must not be conflated with the downward weight of the full-pipe case. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水平滿管內徑2m、外徑2.04m、鋼密度7850及水1000kg/m³，w=g[7850π(2.04²−2²)/4+1000π]=40.593kN/m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combined distributed weight is40.593kN/m.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管線支座只需要承受鋼材自重而不必考慮管內水重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Penstock supports carry only the steel’s own weight and need not consider contained water." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏算水重會低估反力，將壁厚直接當成截面面積則量綱已錯。外部地下水作用於空管時可能有淨上浮，與滿管向下重量情境不能混為同一驗算。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting water understates reactions, while using thickness as area is dimensionally wrong. Groundwater can produce net uplift on an empty conduit, which must not be conflated with the downward weight of the full-pipe case.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「管體與充水重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pipe and contained-water weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏算水重會低估反力，將壁厚直接當成截面面積則量綱已錯。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。
optionsEn: Omitting water understates reactions, while using thickness as area is dimensionally wrong.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle.
quiz.explanation: 漏算水重會低估反力，將壁厚直接當成截面面積則量綱已錯。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting water understates reactions, while using thickness as area is dimensionally wrong. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「跨距與梁式反力」與「滑動摩擦與固定點」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Span and beam reactions" and "Sliding friction and fixed points": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 跨距與梁式反力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Span and beam reactions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「跨距與梁式反力」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Span and beam reactions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰支座之間的管段可先用梁模型理解整體彎矩與反力，但鞍座附近的環向彎曲和殼體橢圓化不是梁公式能描述。連續支承、不同沉陷與壓力剛化也可能改變分配，因此必須把全跨分析與局部殼體查核分開，同時保持一致荷載路徑。 假設簡支跨距10m、均布荷載40kN/m，Mmax=wL²/8=500kNm，兩端反力各200kN；未評估鞍座局部殼應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「跨距與梁式反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A beam idealization helps interpret span moment and reactions, but it does not resolve circumferential bending and shell ovality near saddles. Continuity, differential settlement and pressure effects can change load distribution. Separate global span response from local shell assessment while keeping a consistent load path between the two analytical representations. Assume a simply supported10m span under uniform40kN/m. Maximum moment500kNm and reactions200kN each exclude local saddle shell stresses. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Span and beam reactions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「跨距與梁式反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Span and beam reactions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 跨距與梁式反力
knowledge.text: 相鄰支座之間的管段可先用梁模型理解整體彎矩與反力，但鞍座附近的環向彎曲和殼體橢圓化不是梁公式能描述。連續支承、不同沉陷與壓力剛化也可能改變分配，因此必須把全跨分析與局部殼體查核分開，同時保持一致荷載路徑。
knowledge.textEn: A beam idealization helps interpret span moment and reactions, but it does not resolve circumferential bending and shell ovality near saddles. Continuity, differential settlement and pressure effects can change load distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「跨距與梁式反力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Span and beam reactions" is correct?
options: 梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。
相鄰支座之間的管段可先用梁模型理解整體彎矩與反力，但鞍座附近的環向彎曲和殼體橢圓化不是梁公式能描述。
靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。
optionsEn: A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle.
A beam idealization helps interpret span moment and reactions, but it does not resolve circumferential bending and shell ovality near saddles.
Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force.

quiz.explanationEn: A beam idealization helps interpret span moment and reactions, but it does not resolve circumferential bending and shell ovality near saddles. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 跨距與梁式反力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Span and beam reactions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「跨距與梁式反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Span and beam reactions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設簡支跨距10m、均布荷載40kN/m，Mmax=wL²/8=500kNm，兩端反力各200kN；未評估鞍座局部殼應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a simply supported10m span under uniform40kN/m. Maximum moment500kNm and reactions200kN each exclude local saddle shell stresses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫清支座轉動及平移自由度，以反力總和檢查荷載平衡，再比較連續梁或支座沉陷情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Define support rotational and translational freedoms and check reaction sum against total load, then compare continuity and settlement cases.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設簡支跨距10m、均布荷載40kN/m，Mmax=wL²/8=500kNm，兩端反力各200kN；未評估鞍座局部殼應力。

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Span and beam reactions", which statement holds?

封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。

steps.instruction: 畫清支座轉動及平移自由度，以反力總和檢查荷載平衡，再比較連續梁或支座沉陷情境。把全跨彎矩傳入管壁應力分析，並另設鞍座接觸角、加勁環及局部變形檢核項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 跨距與梁式反力：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「跨距與梁式反力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Span and beam reactions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 簡支假設若不符合實際固定程度會改變彎矩位置，單看跨中最大值也可能漏掉支座負彎矩。管殼局部壓扁即使總體梁應力不高，仍可能控制支承細節。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect simple-support assumption shifts moment distribution, and focusing on midspan misses support moments. Local flattening of the shell can govern saddle details even when the global beam stress appears modest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設簡支跨距10m、均布荷載40kN/m，Mmax=wL²/8=500kNm，兩端反力各200kN；未評估鞍座局部殼應力。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

steps.title: 滑動摩擦與固定點：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「滑動摩擦與固定點」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sliding friction and fixed points” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滑動支座的目的通常是容許伸縮，但摩擦仍會把部分軸力傳到固定點。靜摩擦上限與實際動摩擦力不同，接觸壓力、鏽蝕及潤滑會改變參數；不能用名義摩擦係數保證永遠能滑動，也不能把所有支座最大摩擦同時同向當成必然情況。 假設接觸法向力400kN、庫侖摩擦係數0.15，摩擦上限μN=60kN；靜止時實際摩擦可小於此值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滑動摩擦與固定點」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sliding supports permit movement while friction still transfers axial force to fixed points. Limiting static friction differs from actual sliding resistance, and contact pressure, corrosion and lubrication change the parameter. A nominal coefficient does not guarantee motion, nor does it establish that every support simultaneously mobilizes its maximum resistance in the same direction. Assume contact normal force400kN and Coulomb coefficient0.15. Limiting frictionμN=60kN; actual static friction may be smaller than this bound. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sliding friction and fixed points” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滑動摩擦與固定點」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sliding friction and fixed points”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滑動摩擦與固定點

knowledge.textEn: Sliding supports permit movement while friction still transfers axial force to fixed points. Limiting static friction differs from actual sliding resistance, and contact pressure, corrosion and lubrication change the parameter.

optionsEn: Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force.
Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity.
Sliding supports permit movement while friction still transfers axial force to fixed points.
quiz.explanation: 滑動支座的目的通常是容許伸縮，但摩擦仍會把部分軸力傳到固定點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 支座鏽死時原先的滑動邊界可能變成固定點，熱力路徑隨之改變。摩擦方向也會在升降溫時反轉，忽略歷時便可能錯算錨塊反力及接頭行程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A corroded seized support may become a fixed point and redirect thermal force. Friction reverses with movement direction, so neglecting the sequence can misstate anchor reaction and expansion-joint travel during temperature cycles. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設接觸法向力400kN、庫侖摩擦係數0.15，摩擦上限μN=60kN；靜止時實際摩擦可小於此值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Limiting frictionμN=60kN; actual static friction may be smaller than this bound.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靜止滑動支座的實際摩擦力在任何時刻都必定等於摩擦係數乘法向力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Actual friction at a stationary sliding support always equals coefficient times normal force." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 支座鏽死時原先的滑動邊界可能變成固定點，熱力路徑隨之改變。摩擦方向也會在升降溫時反轉，忽略歷時便可能錯算錨塊反力及接頭行程。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滑動摩擦與固定點」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
基底平均壓力算得出來就代表錨塊抗滑、傾覆與地基承載均已合格。
支座鏽死時原先的滑動邊界可能變成固定點，熱力路徑隨之改變。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity.
A corroded seized support may become a fixed point and redirect thermal force.
quiz.explanation: 支座鏽死時原先的滑動邊界可能變成固定點，熱力路徑隨之改變。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A corroded seized support may become a fixed point and redirect thermal force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「錨塊基底平均壓力」與「減薄與剩餘厚度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Anchor base average pressure" and "Wall loss and remaining thickness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 錨塊基底平均壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anchor base average pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「錨塊基底平均壓力」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anchor base average pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 錨塊把管線荷載傳到地基，但平均基底壓力只適用於假設的接觸狀態，不能單獨評估抗滑或抗傾覆。偏心、基底張開及地基不均勻會改變壓力分布；應把力、力矩、排水及基礎剛度放在同一自由體中，再決定簡化均壓是否合理。 假設中心向下合力2MN作用於全接觸基底4m²，q=N/A=500kPa；不是地基允許承壓值且未計偏心。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「錨塊基底平均壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An anchor transfers pipeline loads to the foundation, but average base pressure depends on the assumed contact state and does not establish sliding or overturning resistance. Eccentricity, uplifted contact and variable ground stiffness change the distribution. Include force, moment, drainage and foundation stiffness before deciding whether a uniform-pressure idealization is defensible. Assume a centered downward resultant2MN on a fully contacting4m² base. Averageq=500kPa is not allowable bearing pressure and excludes eccentricity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anchor base average pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基底平均壓力算得出來就代表錨塊抗滑、傾覆與地基承載均已合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「錨塊基底平均壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anchor base average pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 錨塊基底平均壓力

knowledge.textEn: An anchor transfers pipeline loads to the foundation, but average base pressure depends on the assumed contact state and does not establish sliding or overturning resistance. Eccentricity, uplifted contact and variable ground stiffness change the distribution.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基底平均壓力算得出來就代表錨塊抗滑、傾覆與地基承載均已合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「錨塊基底平均壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anchor base average pressure" is correct?
options: 錨塊把管線荷載傳到地基，但平均基底壓力只適用於假設的接觸狀態，不能單獨評估抗滑或抗傾覆。
基底平均壓力算得出來就代表錨塊抗滑、傾覆與地基承載均已合格。

optionsEn: An anchor transfers pipeline loads to the foundation, but average base pressure depends on the assumed contact state and does not establish sliding or overturning resistance.
Calculating average base pressure proves acceptable sliding, overturning and foundation capacity.
A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects.

quiz.explanationEn: An anchor transfers pipeline loads to the foundation, but average base pressure depends on the assumed contact state and does not establish sliding or overturning resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 錨塊基底平均壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anchor base average pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「錨塊基底平均壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anchor base average pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設中心向下合力2MN作用於全接觸基底4m²，q=N/A=500kPa；不是地基允許承壓值且未計偏心。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a centered downward resultant2MN on a fully contacting4m² base. Averageq=500kPa is not allowable bearing pressure and excludes eccentricity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對錨塊整體列垂直力與力矩平衡，核對是否有地下水上浮或水平管推力造成偏心。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check vertical-force and moment equilibrium, including groundwater uplift and eccentricity from horizontal pipe thrust.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設中心向下合力2MN作用於全接觸基底4m²，q=N/A=500kPa；不是地基允許承壓值且未計偏心。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume a centered downward resultant2MN on a fully contacting4m² base. Averageq=500kPa is not allowable bearing pressure and excludes eccentricity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「錨塊基底平均壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anchor base average pressure", which statement holds?
options: 封閉端公式可直接代表任何固定、埋設或帶伸縮接頭管線的軸向應力。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
算出自由伸長後就可假定任何固定錨塊之間都會發生同樣位移。
optionsEn: The closed-end formula directly gives axial stress for every fixed, buried or expansion-jointed pipeline.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Calculated free expansion occurs unchanged between any pair of fixed anchor blocks.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 錨塊基底平均壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anchor base average pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「錨塊基底平均壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anchor base average pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對錨塊整體列垂直力與力矩平衡，核對是否有地下水上浮或水平管推力造成偏心。用接觸範圍和地基資料判斷均壓假設，再分別查抗滑、傾覆、沉陷與混凝土局部受力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check vertical-force and moment equilibrium, including groundwater uplift and eccentricity from horizontal pipe thrust. Use contact and ground evidence to assess uniform pressure, then examine sliding, overturning, settlement and local concrete actions as separate mechanisms. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對錨塊整體列垂直力與力矩平衡，核對是否有地下水上浮或水平管推力造成偏心。用接觸範圍和地基資料判斷均壓假設，再分別查抗滑、傾覆、沉陷與混凝土局部受力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check vertical-force and moment equilibrium, including groundwater uplift and eccentricity from horizontal pipe thrust. steps.failure: 注意干擾：將五百千帕誤寫成地基承載能力會倒置需求與抗力，偏心時平均值又會掩蓋最大壓力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects.
quiz.explanation: 將五百千帕誤寫成地基承載能力會倒置需求與抗力，偏心時平均值又會掩蓋最大壓力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calling500kPa a foundation capacity reverses demand and resistance, while average pressure hides peaks under eccentricity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 減薄與剩餘厚度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Wall loss and remaining thickness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「減薄與剩餘厚度」如何影響壓力鋼管錨定與支承的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wall loss and remaining thickness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Penstock anchorage and supports”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 腐蝕造成的壁厚減少會提高相同內壓下的膜應力，但均勻減薄只是一種理想情境，局部坑蝕與裂縫需要不同評估。厚度量測的網格與位置應可追溯，不能用最容易量到的一點代表整段；塗層良好也不等於內外壁都沒有缺陷。 假設壓力及直徑不變、均勻厚度20mm降至18mm，環向應力100×20/18=111.11MPa，增加11.11%；未評局部坑蝕。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「減薄與剩餘厚度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wall loss raises membrane stress at the same internal pressure, but uniform thinning is only one idealization and pits or cracks require different assessment. Measurement grids and locations must be traceable; an easily accessible point cannot represent the whole segment. A sound coating also does not prove the absence of defects on either surface. Assume unchanged pressure and diameter with uniform thickness falling20 to18mm. Hoop stress rises100×20/18=111.11MPa, an11.11% increase, excluding pitting assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wall loss and remaining thickness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「減薄與剩餘厚度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Wall loss and remaining thickness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 減薄與剩餘厚度
knowledge.text: 腐蝕造成的壁厚減少會提高相同內壓下的膜應力，但均勻減薄只是一種理想情境，局部坑蝕與裂縫需要不同評估。厚度量測的網格與位置應可追溯，不能用最容易量到的一點代表整段；塗層良好也不等於內外壁都沒有缺陷。
knowledge.textEn: Wall loss raises membrane stress at the same internal pressure, but uniform thinning is only one idealization and pits or cracks require different assessment. Measurement grids and locations must be traceable; an easily accessible point cannot represent the whole segment.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「減薄與剩餘厚度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Wall loss and remaining thickness" is correct?
options: 壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。
腐蝕造成的壁厚減少會提高相同內壓下的膜應力，但均勻減薄只是一種理想情境，局部坑蝕與裂縫需要不同評估。
平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。
optionsEn: A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects.
Wall loss raises membrane stress at the same internal pressure, but uniform thinning is only one idealization and pits or cracks require different assessment.
A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 腐蝕造成的壁厚減少會提高相同內壓下的膜應力，但均勻減薄只是一種理想情境，局部坑蝕與裂縫需要不同評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wall loss raises membrane stress at the same internal pressure, but uniform thinning is only one idealization and pits or cracks require different assessment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 減薄與剩餘厚度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Wall loss and remaining thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「減薄與剩餘厚度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Wall loss and remaining thickness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設壓力及直徑不變、均勻厚度20mm降至18mm，環向應力100×20/18=111.11MPa，增加11.11%；未評局部坑蝕。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume unchanged pressure and diameter with uniform thickness falling20 to18mm. Hoop stress rises100×20/18=111.11MPa, an11.11% increase, excluding pitting assessment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設壓力及直徑不變、均勻厚度20mm降至18mm，環向應力100×20/18=111.11MPa，增加11.11%；未評局部坑蝕。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume unchanged pressure and diameter with uniform thickness falling20 to18mm. Hoop stress rises100×20/18=111.11MPa, an11.11% increase, excluding pitting assessment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「減薄與剩餘厚度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Wall loss and remaining thickness", which statement holds?
options: 彎管的錨定合力永遠等於一端壓力乘截面積而與轉角無關。
完全固定熱應力公式能直接描述任何降伏、滑移與殘餘變形。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: Elbow anchorage force always equals one end pressure times area, regardless of the turn angle.
The fully restrained elastic formula directly describes yielding, sliding and all residual deformation.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 減薄與剩餘厚度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Wall loss and remaining thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「減薄與剩餘厚度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Wall loss and remaining thickness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。分辨均勻減薄、局部坑蝕和裂紋，再用相應方法評估，不以平均厚度或外觀照片取代最弱區域的證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections. Distinguish uniform loss, pits and cracks and apply appropriate assessment methods rather than substituting average thickness or appearance for evidence at the weakest region. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。分辨均勻減薄、局部坑蝕和裂紋，再用相應方法評估，不以平均厚度或外觀照片取代最弱區域的證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections. Distinguish uniform loss, pits and cracks and apply appropriate assessment methods rather than substituting average thickness or appearance for evidence at the weakest region.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：量測點偏離最薄區會得到假安心，腐蝕速率也未必長期固定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measurements missing the thinnest area give false reassurance, and corrosion rate need not remain constant. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。分辨均勻減薄、局部坑蝕和裂紋，再用相應方法評估，不以平均厚度或外觀照片取代最弱區域的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections. Distinguish uniform loss, pits and cracks and apply appropriate assessment methods rather than substituting average thickness or appearance for evidence at the weakest region.

knowledge.text: 將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。分辨均勻減薄、局部坑蝕和裂紋，再用相應方法評估，不以平均厚度或外觀照片取代最弱區域的證據。
knowledge.textEn: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections. Distinguish uniform loss, pits and cracks and apply appropriate assessment methods rather than substituting average thickness or appearance for evidence at the weakest region.

quiz.question: 要驗證「減薄與剩餘厚度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wall loss and remaining thickness"?
options: 將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
梁式跨中彎矩通過檢查就等於鞍座周圍殼體應力也已驗證。
optionsEn: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A satisfactory beam midspan moment automatically verifies shell stresses around every saddle.
quiz.explanation: 將厚度圖與原始製造、焊縫和歷次量測對位，確認儀器校正與塗層修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Register thickness maps with fabrication, weld and prior inspection records, checking calibration and coating corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 減薄與剩餘厚度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wall loss and remaining thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「減薄與剩餘厚度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wall loss and remaining thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測點偏離最薄區會得到假安心，腐蝕速率也未必長期固定。單靠線性外推厚度可能漏掉局部加速或裂紋擴展，應保留測值不確定度與機制分類。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measurements missing the thinnest area give false reassurance, and corrosion rate need not remain constant. Linear thickness extrapolation can miss local acceleration or crack growth, requiring retained uncertainty and a clear classification of damage mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設壓力及直徑不變、均勻厚度20mm降至18mm，環向應力100×20/18=111.11MPa，增加11.11%；未評局部坑蝕。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hoop stress rises100×20/18=111.11MPa, an11.11% increase, excluding pitting assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壁厚減少百分之十時膜應力一定也只增加百分之十且不需檢查局部缺陷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A ten-percent thickness loss raises stress by exactly ten percent and removes any need to check local defects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量測點偏離最薄區會得到假安心，腐蝕速率也未必長期固定。單靠線性外推厚度可能漏掉局部加速或裂紋擴展，應保留測值不確定度與機制分類。
knowledge.textEn: Measurements missing the thinnest area give false reassurance, and corrosion rate need not remain constant. Linear thickness extrapolation can miss local acceleration or crack growth, requiring retained uncertainty and a clear classification of damage mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「減薄與剩餘厚度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wall loss and remaining thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
量測點偏離最薄區會得到假安心，腐蝕速率也未必長期固定。
平均環向應力低於某個數字就能證明所有支座與焊縫都安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Measurements missing the thinnest area give false reassurance, and corrosion rate need not remain constant.
A low average hoop stress proves every support and weld is structurally acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 量測點偏離最薄區會得到假安心，腐蝕速率也未必長期固定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Measurements missing the thinnest area give false reassurance, and corrosion rate need not remain constant. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 調壓井水錘控制
courses.summary: 本課將快速彈性壓力波與較慢的調壓井自由水面振盪分開建模，再用共同邊界把兩者連起來。十個單元涵蓋波速、往返時間、首波增量、井內連續方程、剛性水柱週期、無損湧升、摩擦節流、汽化及數值收斂，所有算例都明定原創假設，不提供可直接套用的閥門動作規程。
courses.summaryEn: This course models rapid elastic pressure waves separately from slower free-surface surge oscillations, then reconnects them through shared boundaries. Ten units cover celerity, travel time, first-wave increment, continuity, rigid-column period, ideal upsurge, friction, throttling, vapor formation and numerical convergence. All examples state original assumptions rather than prescribing transferable valve-operating procedures.
courses.focus: 分開快速彈性壓力波與慢速調壓井振盪並檢查相互作用
courses.focusEn: Distinguish rapid elastic pressure waves from slower surge-shaft oscillations and check their interaction
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創井面積敏感度：定水位上庫、無損剛性水柱、初始井位與庫位相同，L=1000m、Ap=10m²、V0=2m/s且瞬停下游時，As=100m²得到zmax=6.3855m。將井面積增加10%至110m²而其他假設不變，湧升變為6.3855/√1.1≈6.0883m，降低約4.65%，並非10%。同時理想週期會乘√1.1而變長。學徒應比較較低湧升與較長振盪的不同效果，再加入摩擦、井水慣性、通氣及彈性管路，不把理想幅值減少誤稱所有壓力風險均以相同比例降低。
workedExample.textEn: Original shaft-area sensitivity: assume a fixed reservoir, lossless rigid column, equal initial shaft and reservoir levels,L=1000m,Ap=10m²,V0=2m/s and instantaneous downstream demand stop. Shaft area100m² gives maximum rise6.3855m. Increasing area10% to110m² with all other assumptions fixed gives6.3855/√1.1≈6.0883m, about4.65% lower rather than10%. The ideal period simultaneously increases by√1.1. Apprentices compare lower rise with longer oscillation before adding friction, shaft inertia, ventilation and elastic waterways. A reduced ideal amplitude does not imply that every pressure risk declines by the same percentage across the full connected system.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彈性波速與管壁」與「往返時間與邊界」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall" and "Round-trip time and boundaries": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彈性波速與管壁：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic wave speed and pipe wall: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彈性波速與管壁」如何影響調壓井水錘控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surge-shaft control of water hammer”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水錘傳播速度同時受水可壓縮性與管壁變形影響，不是把水視為完全剛性就能描述。管壁約束、材料模數與含氣量會改變波速，薄壁圓管公式需要明列修正係數；用一個假設波速計算的壓力峰值，必須隨參數不確定度重新檢查。 假設K=2.2GPa、ρ=1000kg/m³、E=200GPa、D=2m、t=0.02m，管壁修正係數取1，a=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彈性波速與管壁」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water-hammer propagation depends on both fluid compressibility and pipe-wall deformation, so a rigid-water assumption cannot describe the wave. Restraint, material modulus and gas content affect celerity, and the thin circular-pipe expression requires an explicit restraint factor. Pressure estimates made with one assumed speed must be reconsidered when that parameter is uncertain. AssumeK=2.2GPa,ρ=1000kg/m³,E=200GPa,D=2m,t=0.02m and wall-restraint factor1. Wave speeda=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s for this idealization. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水錘波速只由水決定而完全不受管壁、約束或夾氣影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water-hammer wave speed depends only on water and never on pipe walls, restraint or entrained gas." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彈性波速與管壁」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彈性波速與管壁
knowledge.titleEn: Elastic wave speed and pipe wall
knowledge.text: 水錘傳播速度同時受水可壓縮性與管壁變形影響，不是把水視為完全剛性就能描述。管壁約束、材料模數與含氣量會改變波速，薄壁圓管公式需要明列修正係數；用一個假設波速計算的壓力峰值，必須隨參數不確定度重新檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Water-hammer propagation depends on both fluid compressibility and pipe-wall deformation, so a rigid-water assumption cannot describe the wave. Restraint, material modulus and gas content affect celerity, and the thin circular-pipe expression requires an explicit restraint factor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水錘波速只由水決定而完全不受管壁、約束或夾氣影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water-hammer wave speed depends only on water and never on pipe walls, restraint or entrained gas. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彈性波速與管壁」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall" is correct?
options: 水錘波速只由水決定而完全不受管壁、約束或夾氣影響。
水錘傳播速度同時受水可壓縮性與管壁變形影響，不是把水視為完全剛性就能描述。
閥門動作時間大於單一往返時間就一定不會出現任何危險壓力。
optionsEn: Water-hammer wave speed depends only on water and never on pipe walls, restraint or entrained gas.
Water-hammer propagation depends on both fluid compressibility and pipe-wall deformation, so a rigid-water assumption cannot describe the wave.
An actuator duration longer than one round-trip time guarantees the absence of dangerous pressure.
quiz.explanation: 水錘傳播速度同時受水可壓縮性與管壁變形影響，不是把水視為完全剛性就能描述。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Water-hammer propagation depends on both fluid compressibility and pipe-wall deformation, so a rigid-water assumption cannot describe the wave. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彈性波速與管壁：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elastic wave speed and pipe wall: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彈性波速與管壁」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設K=2.2GPa、ρ=1000kg/m³、E=200GPa、D=2m、t=0.02m，管壁修正係數取1，a=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. AssumeK=2.2GPa,ρ=1000kg/m³,E=200GPa,D=2m,t=0.02m and wall-restraint factor1. Wave speeda=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s for this idealization. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設K=2.2GPa、ρ=1000kg/m³、E=200GPa、D=2m、t=0.02m，管壁修正係數取1，a=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. AssumeK=2.2GPa,ρ=1000kg/m³,E=200GPa,D=2m,t=0.02m and wall-restraint factor1. Wave speeda=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s for this idealization.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彈性波速與管壁」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall", which statement holds?
options: 瞬時水位上升速度可直接乘任意長時間而不必更新管內流量。
理想無損湧升數值就是任何真實調壓井所需的完整井高。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: An instantaneous shaft rise rate can be multiplied by any duration without updating conduit flow.
The ideal lossless rise directly gives the complete required height for every real surge shaft.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 彈性波速與管壁：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elastic wave speed and pipe wall: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彈性波速與管壁」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。用量測波到達時間比較估計波速，再測試含氣或厚度變動的敏感度，不藉調整波速掩蓋錯誤邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor. Compare predicted speed with measured wave arrival, then test gas-content and wall variations rather than tuning celerity to conceal an incorrect boundary condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。用量測波到達時間比較估計波速，再測試含氣或厚度變動的敏感度，不藉調整波速掩蓋錯誤邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor. Compare predicted speed with measured wave arrival, then test gas-content and wall variations rather than tuning celerity to conceal an incorrect boundary condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少量夾氣可能顯著改變可壓縮性，複合管或厚壁管也不符合簡式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entrained gas changes compressibility, and composite or thick walls fall outside this simple expression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。用量測波到達時間比較估計波速，再測試含氣或厚度變動的敏感度，不藉調整波速掩蓋錯誤邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor. Compare predicted speed with measured wave arrival, then test gas-content and wall variations rather than tuning celerity to conceal an incorrect boundary condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。用量測波到達時間比較估計波速，再測試含氣或厚度變動的敏感度，不藉調整波速掩蓋錯誤邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor. Compare predicted speed with measured wave arrival, then test gas-content and wall variations rather than tuning celerity to conceal an incorrect boundary condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「彈性波速與管壁」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall"?
options: 記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
節流孔越小就必定同時降低所有位置的最大與最小壓力風險。
optionsEn: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A smaller throttle opening necessarily reduces every maximum- and minimum-pressure risk throughout the system.
quiz.explanation: 記錄流體與管材模數、厚度和軸向約束來源，確認管壁修正係數是否適用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Document fluid and wall moduli, thickness and axial-restraint evidence and check the chosen correction factor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 彈性波速與管壁：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elastic wave speed and pipe wall: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「彈性波速與管壁」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elastic wave speed and pipe wall” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 少量夾氣可能顯著改變可壓縮性，複合管或厚壁管也不符合簡式。把鋼材彈性模數當水體積模數，或漏掉帕與吉帕換算，會使壓力與時間尺度同時失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entrained gas changes compressibility, and composite or thick walls fall outside this simple expression. Substituting steel modulus for water bulk modulus or confusing pascals and gigapascals distorts both pressure magnitude and wave timing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設K=2.2GPa、ρ=1000kg/m³、E=200GPa、D=2m、t=0.02m，管壁修正係數取1，a=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Wave speeda=√[K/ρ/(1+KD/Et)]=1023.53m/s for this idealization.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水錘波速只由水決定而完全不受管壁、約束或夾氣影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water-hammer wave speed depends only on water and never on pipe walls, restraint or entrained gas." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少量夾氣可能顯著改變可壓縮性，複合管或厚壁管也不符合簡式。把鋼材彈性模數當水體積模數，或漏掉帕與吉帕換算，會使壓力與時間尺度同時失真。
knowledge.textEn: Entrained gas changes compressibility, and composite or thick walls fall outside this simple expression. Substituting steel modulus for water bulk modulus or confusing pascals and gigapascals distorts both pressure magnitude and wave timing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「彈性波速與管壁」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elastic wave speed and pipe wall" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
少量夾氣可能顯著改變可壓縮性，複合管或厚壁管也不符合簡式。
閥門動作時間大於單一往返時間就一定不會出現任何危險壓力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Entrained gas changes compressibility, and composite or thick walls fall outside this simple expression.
An actuator duration longer than one round-trip time guarantees the absence of dangerous pressure.
quiz.explanation: 少量夾氣可能顯著改變可壓縮性，複合管或厚壁管也不符合簡式。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Entrained gas changes compressibility, and composite or thick walls fall outside this simple expression. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and boundaries: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「往返時間與邊界」如何影響調壓井水錘控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and boundaries” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Surge-shaft control of water hammer”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閥門動作與壓力波往返時間的比較，決定反射是否已在動作期間返回控制點。最簡水庫管閥系統只有一條明確路徑，但分岔、調壓井與不同波速管段會產生多重反射；時間尺度只是辨識模型的入口，不能據此直接宣布某個關閉時間安全。 假設均勻管長L=1000m、波速a=1000m/s，往返時間2L/a=2s；只代表此單一路徑，不是允許關閉時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「往返時間與邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing actuator duration with wave round-trip time shows whether a reflection returns during the action. A reservoir-pipe-valve system has one simple path, whereas branches, shafts and segments with different celerity create multiple reflections. This time scale helps select the analysis and does not by itself approve a particular valve-closing duration. Assume uniform pipe length1000m and celerity1000m/s. Round-trip2L/a=2s describes only this path, not an allowable closing time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip time and boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閥門動作時間大於單一往返時間就一定不會出現任何危險壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An actuator duration longer than one round-trip time guarantees the absence of dangerous pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「往返時間與邊界」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip time and boundaries”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 往返時間與邊界
knowledge.text: 閥門動作與壓力波往返時間的比較，決定反射是否已在動作期間返回控制點。最簡水庫管閥系統只有一條明確路徑，但分岔、調壓井與不同波速管段會產生多重反射；時間尺度只是辨識模型的入口，不能據此直接宣布某個關閉時間安全。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing actuator duration with wave round-trip time shows whether a reflection returns during the action. A reservoir-pipe-valve system has one simple path, whereas branches, shafts and segments with different celerity create multiple reflections.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閥門動作時間大於單一往返時間就一定不會出現任何危險壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An actuator duration longer than one round-trip time guarantees the absence of dangerous pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「往返時間與邊界」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Round-trip time and boundaries" is correct?
options: 閥門動作時間大於單一往返時間就一定不會出現任何危險壓力。
焦科夫斯基首波增量就是所有反射與氣穴情境下的完整最大總壓力。
閥門動作與壓力波往返時間的比較，決定反射是否已在動作期間返回控制點。
optionsEn: An actuator duration longer than one round-trip time guarantees the absence of dangerous pressure.
The Joukowsky first-wave increment is the complete maximum total pressure for every reflection and cavitation scenario.
Comparing actuator duration with wave round-trip time shows whether a reflection returns during the action.
quiz.explanation: 閥門動作與壓力波往返時間的比較，決定反射是否已在動作期間返回控制點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing actuator duration with wave round-trip time shows whether a reflection returns during the action. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and boundaries: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「往返時間與邊界」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip time and boundaries” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻管長L=1000m、波速a=1000m/s，往返時間2L/a=2s；只代表此單一路徑，不是允許關閉時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform pipe length1000m and celerity1000m/s. Round-trip2L/a=2s describes only this path, not an allowable closing time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在系統圖標出反射邊界及每段長度波速，逐段累加單程時間，再與閥門實際流量變化歷時比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark reflecting boundaries and each segment’s length and celerity, sum one-way travel times and compare with actual discharge-change histories.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設均勻管長L=1000m、波速a=1000m/s，往返時間2L/a=2s；只代表此單一路徑，不是允許關閉時間。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume uniform pipe length1000m and celerity1000m/s. Round-trip2L/a=2s describes only this path, not an allowable closing time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「往返時間與邊界」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Round-trip time and boundaries", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。
調壓井剛性水柱週期與管路彈性壓力波往返時間必定完全相同。
管路反向流動時摩擦仍應保持原方向並向水流提供能量。
optionsEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
The rigid-column surge period must equal the conduit’s elastic-wave round-trip time.
During reversed flow friction keeps its original direction and supplies energy to the water.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 往返時間與邊界：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and boundaries: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「往返時間與邊界」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and boundaries” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在系統圖標出反射邊界及每段長度波速，逐段累加單程時間，再與閥門實際流量變化歷時比較。遇到分岔或調壓接點就建立多路徑時間表，不能只取地圖上兩點直線距離。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark reflecting boundaries and each segment’s length and celerity, sum one-way travel times and compare with actual discharge-change histories. For branches and shaft junctions construct a multiple-path timing table instead of using the straight-line distance between map locations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在系統圖標出反射邊界及每段長度波速，逐段累加單程時間，再與閥門實際流量變化歷時比較。遇到分岔或調壓接點就建立多路徑時間表，不能只取地圖上兩點直線距離。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark reflecting boundaries and each segment’s length and celerity, sum one-way travel times and compare with actual discharge-change histories. For branches and shaft junctions construct a multiple-path timing table instead of using the straight-line distance between map locations.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將單程時間當往返時間會改變快速與慢速的分類，忽略分岔反射則可能漏掉疊加峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing one-way with round-trip time changes the rapid-action classification, while omitted branch reflections can hide superposed peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 在系統圖標出反射邊界及每段長度波速，逐段累加單程時間，再與閥門實際流量變化歷時比較。遇到分岔或調壓接點就建立多路徑時間表，不能只取地圖上兩點直線距離。

For branches and shaft junctions construct a multiple-path timing table instead of using the straight-line distance between map locations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「往返時間與邊界」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Round-trip time and boundaries"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在系統圖標出反射邊界及每段長度波速，逐段累加單程時間，再與閥門實際流量變化歷時比較。

Mark reflecting boundaries and each segment’s length and celerity, sum one-way travel times and compare with actual discharge-change histories.
Every negative gauge pressure means vaporization, while positive gauge pressure guarantees no cavitation anywhere.

quiz.explanationEn: Mark reflecting boundaries and each segment’s length and celerity, sum one-way travel times and compare with actual discharge-change histories. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

Slow actuation can still produce long-period level oscillations or unstable control interactions. quiz.questionEn: When "Round-trip time and boundaries" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
焦科夫斯基首波增量就是所有反射與氣穴情境下的完整最大總壓力。
將單程時間當往返時間會改變快速與慢速的分類，忽略分岔反射則可能漏掉疊加峰值。

The Joukowsky first-wave increment is the complete maximum total pressure for every reflection and cavitation scenario.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「快速變速壓力增量」與「井內連續方程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rapid velocity-change pressure" and "Continuity within the shaft": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 快速變速壓力增量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rapid velocity-change pressure: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 單相彈性管中的突然流速變化會形成壓力波，焦科夫斯基關係估第一個波前的壓力增量。它不是整段歷時的通用最大值，反射疊加、氣穴與控制器仍可能改變結果；應先區分增量和原有靜壓，再檢查是否仍滿足單相及快速動作假設。 假設ρ=1000kg/m³、a=1000m/s，0.5s內減速1m/s且小於2s往返，Δp=ρaΔV=1MPa，ΔH=101.94m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「快速變速壓力增量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A rapid velocity change in a single-phase elastic conduit generates a pressure wave, with the Joukowsky relation estimating the first-front increment. knowledge.textEn: A rapid velocity change in a single-phase elastic conduit generates a pressure wave, with the Joukowsky relation estimating the first-front increment. It is not a universal maximum for the entire history: reflections, cavities and control behavior can alter the result.

quiz.question: 關於「快速變速壓力增量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

焦科夫斯基首波增量就是所有反射與氣穴情境下的完整最大總壓力。

The Joukowsky first-wave increment is the complete maximum total pressure for every reflection and cavitation scenario.
An instantaneous shaft rise rate can be multiplied by any duration without updating conduit flow.
