stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」與「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" and "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏口能量與聲源形成」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leak energy and acoustic generation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏口能量與聲源形成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship. Crack geometry, surrounding soil, pipe material and pressure affect hydraulic and acoustic coupling together. A larger opening can produce lower-frequency or weaker sound, so loudness cannot rank every leak by discharge. The orifice expression estimates flow for specified geometry and coefficient, not acoustic level. If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leak energy and acoustic generation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏口能量與聲源形成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leak energy and acoustic generation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。裂縫形狀、土壤包覆、管材及水壓會同時改變水力與聲學耦合；較大的漏口也可能產生較低頻或較弱的聲音，因此不能按音量直接排序所有漏失量。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. Leakage rate and audible strength are not in a one-to-one relationship.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。
相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。
optionsEn: Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound.
A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 漏口內外壓差驅動水流，局部湍流與構件振動可形成聲源，但漏水流量與可聽聲強並非一對一關係。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure difference drives flow through a leak, and local turbulence and vibration can generate sound. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏口能量與聲源形成」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m²、Δp=300 kPa、ρ=1000 kg/m³，Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s，非由音量反算。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, A=1.0×10⁻⁵ m², Δp=300 kPa and ρ=1000 kg/m³. Q=CdA√(2Δp/ρ)=0.1519 L/s, not an inference from loudness.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏口能量與聲源形成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leak energy and acoustic generation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將聲音紀錄與同步壓力及流量背景配對，確認疑似聲源是否隨供水狀態改變。以已知訓練漏點或經核准的修復前後資料驗證，不將未校準的麥克風振幅直接當成漏水量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair acoustic records with synchronized pressure and background flow, checking whether the suspected source changes with supply conditions. Validate against known training leaks or approved before-and-after repair observations rather than converting uncalibrated microphone amplitude directly into leakage volume. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同孔口在兩個假設壓差下的流量，另列聲源與傳播尚需哪些資料。要求調查報告分開漏水存在、位置與流量三種結論，不讓聲音證據超出可支持範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one hypothetical opening at two pressure differences and list additional source and propagation information needed. Keep conclusions about leak presence, location and flow separate so acoustic evidence is not overstated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏口能量與聲源形成」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leak energy and acoustic generation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage. Incorrect discharge ranking then directs investigation and repair resources away from the actual loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：孔口式只估給定幾何與係數下的流量，不預測聲壓級；裂縫面積隨壓力變動時，固定孔口模型也需重新檢核。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: If crack area changes with pressure, the fixed-opening model also requires reassessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「漏口能量與聲源形成機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Leak energy and acoustic generation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?

只追逐最響的聲音可能漏掉安靜的大漏口，也可能把節流閥或泵的正常噪聲當作漏水；錯誤的流量排序會使調查與修復資源偏離真正損失。
相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。

Following only the loudest sound can miss a quiet large opening or mistake normal valve and pump noise for leakage.
A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant.

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙點到時差與定位」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-sensor delay and location” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一漏聲沿管線往兩端傳播，兩支感測器的到時差可把聲源限制在已知管段內。座標方向與延遲符號必須明確，否則同一數值會得到鏡像位置；管長應沿實際管路量測而不是兩測點的地表直線距離，分支與材質變化則可能使單速模型不再適用。定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙點到時差與定位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A leak signal travels toward both ends of a pipe, and its arrival-time difference constrains the source within a known reach. Coordinate direction and delay sign must be explicit or the same number yields a mirrored location. Length follows the actual pipe rather than a straight surface distance, while branches and material transitions can invalidate a single-speed model. Define x from sensor A and Δt=tB−tA, with the source between A and B. The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sensor delay and location” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、a=1000 m/s、Δt=0.040 s，x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m，自A沿管量測；至B為120 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, a=1000 m/s and Δt=0.040 s. x=(L−aΔt)/2=80.0 m along the pipe from A, leaving 120 m to B.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙點到時差與定位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。改變感測器配置再作獨立相關，確認推定位置在共同地圖上重疊，而不是只重複同一組訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings. Repeat correlation with an independent sensor arrangement and check overlapping map locations rather than merely reprocessing the same signals. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出聲源到兩端的傳播路徑，用各自距離除以波速重新求延遲，反查定位結果。再交換感測器名稱，確認物理位置不變而座標與延遲符號一致轉換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw propagation paths to both sensors and recompute delay from each distance divided by speed. Then exchange sensor names, confirming that the physical location stays fixed while coordinates and delay sign transform consistently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings. Repeat correlation with an independent sensor arrangement and check overlapping map locations rather than merely reprocessing the same signals.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。
管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings.
An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
quiz.explanation: 在資料檔中固定A、B編號與延遲正負定義，核對實際管路長度及中途閥件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix sensor A and B identifiers and the delay-sign convention in the data file, verifying pipe length and intervening fittings. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙點到時差與定位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-sensor delay and location” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Substituting straight surface distance for a curved pipe route creates systematic bias even when the correlation peak is sharp. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：定義x自感測器A量起、Δt=tB−tA，且聲源位於A與B之間；兩側共用相同波速時才有此代數關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The algebraic relation requires the same wave speed on both sides.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相關峰很尖銳就可以忽略管線長度與感測器方向。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sharp correlation peak makes pipe length and sensor orientation irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。
knowledge.textEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Substituting straight surface distance for a curved pipe route creates systematic bias even when the correlation peak is sharp.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙點到時差與定位機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-sensor delay and location mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location.
quiz.explanation: 若交換感測器卻沒有交換延遲符號，位置會被鏡射到管段另一側；用地表直線距離取代彎曲管長則會造成系統偏移，即使相關峰很尖銳。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Swapping sensors without reversing the delay sign mirrors the inferred location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」與「速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification" and "Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效傳播速度校準」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective propagation-speed calibration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。若某一已知聲源位置可提供到時差，便能反推單段有效速度；但管長、感測器時間同步與聲源位置都必須獨立可信，否則校準會把其他誤差吸收到速度參數內。當已知聲源靠近兩感測器中點，延遲趨近零，反算速度會對時間誤差極敏感；不能把這種配置當作高品質校準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效傳播速度校準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. A known source position and delay can calibrate one reach. Pipe length, sensor synchronization and source location must independently be trustworthy, however, or calibration merely absorbs their errors into the speed parameter. For a known source near the sensor midpoint, delay approaches zero and inferred speed becomes highly sensitive to timing error. That geometry is unsuitable as strong calibration evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective propagation-speed calibration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效傳播速度校準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective propagation-speed calibration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。若某一已知聲源位置可提供到時差，便能反推單段有效速度；但管長、感測器時間同步與聲源位置都必須獨立可信，否則校準會把其他誤差吸收到速度參數內。
knowledge.textEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. A known source position and delay can calibrate one reach.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。
optionsEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias.
quiz.explanation: 聲學定位所需的速度是特定管材、幾何與頻帶下的有效傳播速度，不必等於自由水聲速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Acoustic location needs an effective propagation speed for the particular material, geometry and frequency band, not necessarily free-water sound speed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效傳播速度校準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective propagation-speed calibration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用可確認位置的訓練聲源建立速度範圍，保留頻帶、壓力、溫度與管材資訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate a speed range using a training source at a confirmed position, retaining frequency band, pressure, temperature and material information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。
平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。
optionsEn: The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only.
Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設L=200 m、已知x=60 m、Δt=0.080 s，a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s，僅代表該假設均勻管段。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume L=200 m, known x=60 m and Δt=0.080 s. a=(L−2x)/Δt=1000 m/s for this hypothetical uniform reach only. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效傳播速度校準機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective propagation-speed calibration mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效傳播速度校準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective propagation-speed calibration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用可確認位置的訓練聲源建立速度範圍，保留頻帶、壓力、溫度與管材資訊。再用另一個位置或另一組感測器驗證，檢查同一速度是否可跨測段使用，避免只報單次最佳值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate a speed range using a training source at a confirmed position, retaining frequency band, pressure, temperature and material information. Validate with another source position or sensor pair to test transfer between reaches instead of reporting only one best-fit value. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較已知聲源位於偏中與正中時的反算條件，說明為何小延遲不利校準。把速度寫成有證據支持的範圍，再觀察位置區間如何隨範圍擴大。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare calibration geometry for an off-center and a centered known source, explaining why small delay is unfavorable. Express speed as an evidence-based range and examine how the inferred location interval expands.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把混合材質管路的校準速度套到全線，可能讓不同測段得到互不相容的位置；若校準聲源位置本身有誤，反算仍可能看似精確卻帶有共同偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying one calibrated speed across mixed materials can produce incompatible locations from different reaches. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 把混合材質管路的校準速度套到全線，可能讓不同測段得到互不相容的位置；若校準聲源位置本身有誤，反算仍可能看似精確卻帶有共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

If the calibration source position is itself wrong, the fitted speed can appear precise while carrying a shared bias. steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 定位公式把管長、速度及延遲誤差一起傳到位置，誤差的來源與相關性必須分開。固定時間偏移會沿同一方向移動全部結果，而隨機雜訊會使重複估計散布；只報演算法相關峰的寬度，不能涵蓋管材速度或儀器時鐘的系統偏差。下式是一階局部敏感度，固定管長與延遲，只改變速度；若多個參數同時變動，需保留交互關係及可能共同偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「速度與同步誤差傳遞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. A fixed timing offset shifts all results in one direction, whereas random noise spreads repeated estimates. Correlation-peak width alone cannot cover systematic bias in material wave speed or instrument clocks. The expression is a first-order local sensitivity, holding length and delay fixed while changing speed. Simultaneous parameter changes require their dependence and possible common bias to be retained. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=0.040 s and speed error δa=+100 m/s. δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重複量測結果很接近就代表沒有任何系統定位偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Closely repeated measurements prove there is no systematic location bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「速度與同步誤差傳遞」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: The location formula propagates length, speed and delay errors into position, requiring their sources and correlations to remain distinct. A fixed timing offset shifts all results in one direction, whereas random noise spreads repeated estimates.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed and synchronization uncertainty mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「速度與同步誤差傳遞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed and synchronization uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=0.040 s、速度誤差δa=+100 m/s，δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m；另有1 ms時差偏移可造成0.50 m位置偏移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=0.040 s and speed error δa=+100 m/s. δx=−Δtδa/2=−2.0 m. A separate 1 ms delay offset at a=1000 m/s produces a 0.50 m shift. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 速度與同步誤差傳遞機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「速度與同步誤差傳遞」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 以共同訊號測試兩通道的相對延遲，再以獨立管長資料約束幾何誤差。將速度、時間與路徑各自列成誤差項，對系統偏差採情境比較，對可證明獨立的隨機量才使用統計合成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Test relative channel delay with a common signal and constrain geometry using independent pipe-length information. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stable relative clock offset can persist through repeated tests and shift all inferred locations. steps.instruction: 兩通道之間固定的相對時鐘偏移可能在重複測試中完全穩定，卻使所有漏點位置一起偏離；把這種偏差當成可平均消除的雜訊，會給出過窄的開挖搜尋區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stable relative clock offset can persist through repeated tests and shift all inferred locations. Treating that bias as noise removable by averaging produces an unjustifiably narrow excavation search interval. stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」與「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification" and "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣間隔與定位解析」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling interval and location resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離散取樣把到時差表示為時間格點，較高取樣率可以縮小格點間隔，但不會自動提高實際定位準確度。抗混疊濾波、訊號頻寬、感測器耦合及雜訊決定可用資訊，次取樣插值也不能憑空創造遺失頻率；應分開理論格點尺度與經驗證的現地誤差。本例假設均勻波速且只考慮一個取樣間隔的延遲變化，不包含頻寬限制與峰值估計誤差，也不是可保證的定位精度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣間隔與定位解析」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete sampling represents delay on a time grid, and higher sample rate reduces grid spacing without automatically improving actual location accuracy. Anti-alias filtering, signal bandwidth, sensor coupling and noise determine usable information. Subsample interpolation cannot recreate missing frequencies, so theoretical grid resolution must be distinguished from validated field error. The example assumes uniform speed and considers one sample interval of delay only. It excludes bandwidth and peak-estimation error and is not a guaranteed positioning accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling interval and location resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣率加倍就必定讓現場定位誤差減少一半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling sample rate necessarily halves the field location error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣間隔與定位解析」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling interval and location resolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣間隔與定位解析」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling interval and location resolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. At a=1000 m/s, one-sample location scale aΔts/2=0.25 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設fs=2000 Hz，Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s；a=1000 m/s時，一格位置尺度aΔts/2=0.25 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume fs=2000 Hz, giving Δts=1/fs=0.0005 s. At a=1000 m/s, one-sample location scale aΔts/2=0.25 m.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
Eighty percent correct alarms means eighty percent of all leaks were found.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣間隔與定位解析」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling interval and location resolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄感測器頻率響應、取樣率與抗混疊設定，使用已知時間差訊號檢查通道處理延遲。比較原始與適當降採樣資料的定位差異，確認較高取樣率是否真的提供額外有效頻帶。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record sensor response, sample rate and anti-alias settings, using a known-delay signal to check channel processing latency. Compare original and appropriately downsampled records to determine whether the higher sampling rate actually adds usable frequency information. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一個取樣間隔換算成位置格點，另列速度與同步誤差作比較。設計可驗證的已知延遲測試，讓報告中的解析度與準確度使用不同欄位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert one sample interval into a position-grid scale and compare it with speed and synchronization errors. Design a known-delay verification so resolution and accuracy appear in separate report fields.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「取樣間隔與定位解析機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sampling interval and location resolution mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location.
quiz.explanation: 高取樣率搭配低頻寬感測器可能只產生更多相似資料，並未改善定位；未經抗混疊處理的高頻干擾還可能折入低頻，形成穩定但錯誤的相關峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A high sample rate with a narrow-band sensor may only create more similar samples without improving location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頻帶選擇與色散」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Band selection and dispersion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。高頻通常提供較短的時間特徵，但不一定能傳到遠端；濾波選擇若只追求最尖的峰，可能選到機械噪聲或與單速假設不相容的頻段。波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻帶選擇與色散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. Higher frequencies may provide shorter temporal features but may not reach a distant sensor. Selecting filters solely for the sharpest peak can favor machinery noise or a band incompatible with the single-speed assumption. Wavelength links a frequency to its corresponding phase speed and is not a location-error measure. With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Band selection and dispersion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻帶選擇與色散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Band selection and dispersion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。高頻通常提供較短的時間特徵，但不一定能傳到遠端；濾波選擇若只追求最尖的峰，可能選到機械噪聲或與單速假設不相容的頻段。
knowledge.textEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. Higher frequencies may provide shorter temporal features but may not reach a distant sensor.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。
某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。
兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。
optionsEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band.
The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location.
Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak.
quiz.explanation: 不同頻率的漏聲可能受到不同程度的衰減與傳播速度變化，管材、壁厚及周圍介質共同決定有效頻帶。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Leak-signal frequencies can experience different attenuation and propagation speeds, with pipe material, wall thickness and surrounding medium determining the useful band. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻帶選擇與色散」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Band selection and dispersion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Wavelength λ=a/f=4.0 m; this is not leak-location resolution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Wavelength λ=a/f=4.0 m; this is not leak-location resolution.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。
漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
optionsEn: An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設指定頻帶相速度a=800 m/s、頻率f=200 Hz，λ=a/f=4.0 m；此數值不是漏點解析度。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume phase speed a=800 m/s at frequency f=200 Hz. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頻帶選擇與色散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Band selection and dispersion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。保留濾波前後資料與相位處理方式，避免後續分析者無法重現延遲估計。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Retain records before and after filtering with the phase-processing method so later analysts can reproduce the delay estimate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一資料的低頻與高頻定位並排，列出速度、衰減與干擾三種可能原因。要求每次濾波選擇都有可重現的依據，避免為得到預期位置反覆挑選頻帶。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place low- and high-band locations side by side and list speed, attenuation and interference as alternative explanations. Require a reproducible reason for each filter choice rather than selecting bands until a desired position appears.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。保留濾波前後資料與相位處理方式，避免後續分析者無法重現延遲估計。
knowledge.textEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Retain records before and after filtering with the phase-processing method so later analysts can reproduce the delay estimate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同一資料的低頻與高頻定位並排，列出速度、衰減與干擾三種可能原因。要求每次濾波選擇都有可重現的依據，避免為得到預期位置反覆挑選頻帶。
knowledge.textEn: Place low- and high-band locations side by side and list speed, attenuation and interference as alternative explanations. Require a reproducible reason for each filter choice rather than selecting bands until a desired position appears.

quiz.question: 要驗證「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation.
quiz.explanation: 比較多個合理頻帶的相關位置、相干性及訊號能量，核對是否存在與泵運轉同步的窄頻峰。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare location, coherence and signal energy across several defensible bands, checking narrow peaks synchronized with pump operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頻帶選擇與色散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Band selection and dispersion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Ignoring dispersion can also create contradictory locations across bands without any obvious instrument malfunction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：波長公式只連結某頻率與其對應相速度，不把波長當定位誤差；存在色散時，不同頻帶須使用相容的傳播模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With dispersion, different bands need compatible propagation models.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「某頻帶訊號最大就表示它必定最適合漏水定位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The band with the strongest signal is necessarily best for leak location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。
knowledge.textEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Ignoring dispersion can also create contradictory locations across bands without any obvious instrument malfunction.

quiz.question: 在「頻帶選擇與色散機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Band selection and dispersion mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只保留機械設備的強烈窄頻訊號可能得到週期性多重峰，位置因此跳到錯誤週期；忽略色散也會使不同頻帶定位互相矛盾卻沒有明顯儀器故障。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。
optionsEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

quiz.explanationEn: Retaining strong narrow-band machinery sound can produce periodic ambiguous peaks and a location on the wrong cycle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」與「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification" and "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attenuation and sensor coupling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 漏聲到達感測器前會經過管壁、接頭與地層，傳播損失和接觸耦合都可能降低振幅。兩測點訊號差異不一定代表一端離漏點更遠，鬆動的感測器或不同閥件可造成額外損失；衰減模型應以相同安裝與頻帶比較，不能把單次振幅比直接解成距離。指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Before reaching a sensor, leak sound passes through pipe walls, joints and surrounding ground, while both propagation loss and contact coupling reduce amplitude. Unequal signals do not necessarily mean one sensor is farther from the leak: loose attachment or different fittings can add loss. Attenuation comparisons require matched installation and band, rather than interpreting one amplitude ratio directly as distance. Exponential decay is a teaching model for one band and uniform path, with α an amplitude attenuation coefficient. Power ratios are squared, so amplitude and power decibel definitions must not be mixed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attenuation and sensor coupling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume α=0.010 m⁻¹ and d=100 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支感測器振幅不同就一定是漏點距離不同造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Different sensor amplitudes must be caused by different distances to the leak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attenuation and sensor coupling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設α=0.010 m⁻¹、d=100 m，A/A0=e^(−αd)=0.3679；振幅變化20log10(A/A0)=−8.686 dB。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Attenuation and sensor coupling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先用已知訊號及重複安裝檢查耦合一致性，再比較不同距離的同頻帶振幅。將接頭、管材改變與閥件位置記入路徑圖，判斷指數模型是否只是局部近似而非全線常數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: First test coupling repeatability with a known signal and repeated mounting, then compare matched-band amplitude at different distances. Map joints, material changes and fittings to determine whether exponential decay is only a local approximation rather than a network-wide constant. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把振幅比與功率比各自換算成分貝，確認得到一致的物理衰減。設計重裝感測器的對照試驗，將接觸損失與管路傳播損失分開。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert amplitude and power ratios separately to decibels and confirm consistent physical attenuation. Design a remounting comparison that separates contact loss from propagation loss along the pipe.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器接觸不良可能被誤解成管線高度衰減，導致過早否定聲學方法；反之把良好耦合的單點優勢當成較近漏源，也會使位置判讀偏向錯誤方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor sensor contact can be mistaken for severe pipe attenuation and lead to premature rejection of acoustics. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「傳播衰減與感測器耦合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Attenuation and sensor coupling” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器接觸不良可能被誤解成管線高度衰減，導致過早否定聲學方法；反之把良好耦合的單點優勢當成較近漏源，也會使位置判讀偏向錯誤方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor sensor contact can be mistaken for severe pipe attenuation and lead to premature rejection of acoustics. Conversely, interpreting one well-coupled sensor’s stronger signal as proximity to the leak biases location in the wrong direction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：指數衰減是單一頻帶、均勻路徑的教學模型，α為振幅衰減係數；功率比需平方，不能混用二十分貝與十分貝定義。

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相干性與共同干擾」如何影響輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Coherence and common interference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Acoustic leak location in water mains”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。平方相干性衡量線性頻域關聯，可協助篩選可信頻帶，但缺乏來源身分資訊；需要改變測點、比對設備時序與獨立水力證據，才能縮小聲源假說。計算的自譜與互譜須使用相同窗函數、尺度與頻率格點；相干值介於零與一，並不是漏水存在的機率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相干性與共同干擾」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels. Magnitude-squared coherence measures linear frequency-domain association and can help select useful bands, but it does not identify the source. Changed sensor geometry, equipment timing and independent hydraulic evidence are needed to constrain competing source hypotheses. Auto- and cross-spectra must use compatible windows, scaling and frequency bins. Coherence lies between zero and one but is not the probability that a leak exists. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Coherence and common interference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相干性與共同干擾」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Coherence and common interference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。平方相干性衡量線性頻域關聯，可協助篩選可信頻帶，但缺乏來源身分資訊；需要改變測點、比對設備時序與獨立水力證據，才能縮小聲源假說。
knowledge.textEn: Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels. Magnitude-squared coherence measures linear frequency-domain association and can help select useful bands, but it does not identify the source.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 平方相干性等於漏水存在的機率且可直接作定位結論。
管內工具一定完全隨水流移動，所以不需要獨立追蹤。
兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。
optionsEn: Magnitude-squared coherence equals leak probability and directly establishes location.
An inline tool always follows water exactly and needs no independent tracking.
Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels.
quiz.explanation: 兩訊號具有共同頻率成分並不證明共同來源就是漏水，泵、交通或電氣干擾也可能同時被兩通道接收。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared frequency content does not prove that the common source is a leak: pumps, traffic and electrical interference can reach both channels. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相干性與共同干擾」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Coherence and common interference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢視相干性與相位是否在多段時間窗保持一致，同時比對泵啟停、道路作業及電源雜訊。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。
漏水聲越大就必定代表漏口越大且流量越高。
一次校準的傳播速度可以不加檢查地用於所有管材。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25.
Louder leakage noise always means a larger opening and greater flow.
A speed calibrated once can be used for every pipe material without checking.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設同一頻率的Gxx=4、Gyy=9及|Gxy|=3，三者採相容譜單位，γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gxx=4, Gyy=9 and |Gxy|=3 at one frequency with compatible spectral units. γ²=|Gxy|²/(GxxGyy)=0.25. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 相干性與共同干擾機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Coherence and common interference mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相干性與共同干擾」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Coherence and common interference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢視相干性與相位是否在多段時間窗保持一致，同時比對泵啟停、道路作業及電源雜訊。使用另一組測點或訓練漏點作盲測，避免只以同一資料選頻又驗證方法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise. Use another sensor pair or blinded training leak for validation instead of selecting and validating the method on the same records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立漏水、泵噪聲與電氣干擾三種假說，為每種指定一項可區分的獨立觀察。用相干性選擇分析頻帶，再用幾何與修復證據驗證來源。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create leak, pump-noise and electrical-interference hypotheses, assigning one independent discriminating observation to each. Use coherence to choose analysis bands, then use geometry and repair evidence to verify the source.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同機械噪聲可產生很高相干性，若把它直接當漏水機率就會累積假警報；短資料窗又可能讓估計波動很大，卻被誤讀成漏口間歇出現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared machinery noise can yield high coherence and generate false alarms if interpreted as leak probability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 檢視相干性與相位是否在多段時間窗保持一致，同時比對泵啟停、道路作業及電源雜訊。使用另一組測點或訓練漏點作盲測，避免只以同一資料選頻又驗證方法。
knowledge.textEn: Inspect coherence and phase across multiple time windows while comparing pump activity, road work and electrical noise. Use another sensor pair or blinded training leak for validation instead of selecting and validating the method on the same records.
