入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
optionsEn: Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved.
Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
quiz.explanation: 水損改善的判斷需要可比的壓力、需求、邊界與表計條件，原始前後差值不能自動歸因於修復。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Assessing loss reduction needs comparable pressure, demand, boundaries and metering, so a raw before-and-after difference cannot automatically be credited to repair. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「改善成效與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Intervention effect and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 總水量帳接近平衡就能證明每一支水表都沒有偏差。
夜間流量最低的那一筆就是整區的真實漏水速率。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。
optionsEn: A nearly balanced total proves that every meter is unbiased.
The single lowest night-flow reading is the district’s true leakage rate.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入口、用水與儲量的標準不確定度為10、8、3 m³/day且獨立，uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent standard uncertainties of 10, 8 and 3 m³/day for inflow, use and storage. uR=√(10²+8²+3²)=13.15 m³/day. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「改善成效與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Intervention effect and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。使用未受施工影響的比較區或多日重複觀察檢查其他變因，並將共同偏差與統計散布分開呈現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Use an unaffected comparison district or repeated days to examine other changes, presenting shared bias separately from statistical scatter. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一個假設改善量與合成不確定度並列，再列出壓力及需求不匹配造成的系統情境。說明哪些結論已受資料支持、哪些仍需延長觀察或增加獨立計量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Place an assumed improvement beside combined uncertainty, then list systematic scenarios from unmatched pressure and demand. Distinguish supported conclusions from those needing longer observation or additional independent metering.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。使用未受施工影響的比較區或多日重複觀察檢查其他變因，並將共同偏差與統計散布分開呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Use an unaffected comparison district or repeated days to examine other changes, presenting shared bias separately from statistical scatter.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一個假設改善量與合成不確定度並列，再列出壓力及需求不匹配造成的系統情境。說明哪些結論已受資料支持、哪些仍需延長觀察或增加獨立計量。
knowledge.textEn: Place an assumed improvement beside combined uncertainty, then list systematic scenarios from unmatched pressure and demand. Distinguish supported conclusions from those needing longer observation or additional independent metering.

quiz.question: 要驗證「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification"?
options: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
水表都經過校準就不需要核對它們的統計時間窗。
optionsEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Calibrated meters do not require checks of their reporting time windows.
quiz.explanation: 將修復前後資料依壓力和需求匹配，逐項記錄表計與儲量的不確定度來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match pre- and post-repair data by pressure and demand, documenting uncertainty sources for meters and storage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「改善成效與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Intervention effect and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Shared calibration bias or changed district boundaries can also create an apparently substantial improvement between the two periods. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以下合成式只適用互相獨立的標準不確定度，沒有把結果當成信賴區間；若來源相關，需加入共變異數或使用適當界限。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Correlated sources require covariance terms or appropriate bounds.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「修復後入口水量下降多少就能直接宣稱節省多少漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any reduction in inlet volume after repair directly equals leakage saved." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Shared calibration bias or changed district boundaries can also create an apparently substantial improvement between the two periods.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「改善成效與不確定度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Intervention effect and uncertainty mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。
入口總量減用戶帳單就一定等於實際地下漏水量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions.
Inlet volume minus customer bills necessarily equals real underground leakage.
quiz.explanation: 若改善量小於可辨識的量測差異，仍宣稱高精度節水績效會誤導維護決策；共同校準偏差或改變分區邊界也可能製造看似顯著的前後改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming precise savings below the measurement system’s resolving capability misleads maintenance decisions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 配水管網壓力管理
courses.summary: 本課從高程與服務壓力出發，分析壓力相依需求、漏失指數及閥門耗能，再進入閥權度、遠端延遲、回授方向和備援供水。最後把快速水錘與低流量水質納入同一管理問題，讓節水效益與服務可靠度各有證據，不把降低平均壓力當成唯一成功指標。
courses.summaryEn: Beginning with elevation and service pressure, this course examines pressure-dependent demand, leakage exponents and valve dissipation, then addresses authority, remote delay, feedback direction and backup supply. Rapid transients and low-flow water quality complete the management problem, giving savings and service reliability separate evidence instead of treating lower average pressure as the only success metric.
courses.focus: 服務水頭、漏失敏感度與調壓動態驗證
courses.focusEn: Service head, leakage sensitivity and pressure-control dynamics
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例設定同一漏口群的初始漏失10 L/s、代表壓力水頭40 m，降至30 m後若採固定孔口指數N=0.5，漏失為8.660 L/s；若改用假設校準指數N=1.2，則為7.081 L/s。兩個模型分別預測13.4%與29.2%的減少，差異來自模型而非新的現場量測。應用獨立資料校準指數，同時檢查高處服務壓力、閥動作水錘及低更新支線水質。不得選擇看起來節水較多的指數來替代驗證，也不能將本例壓力寫成真實控制設定。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example uses the same leak population with initial leakage 10 L/s at representative head 40 m. Reducing head to 30 m gives 8.660 L/s with fixed-orifice exponent N=0.5, or 7.081 L/s with hypothetical calibrated exponent N=1.2. The predicted reductions are 13.4% and 29.2%; the difference comes from the model rather than new field observations. Calibrate the exponent independently while checking elevated-customer pressure, valve-induced transients and quality in low-renewal branches. Choosing the exponent that promises greater savings cannot replace validation, and the assumed heads are not real control settings.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭由40 m降至30 m、漏失指數N=1.2，Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081；假設原漏失10 L/s，則為7.081 L/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭變化率dh/dt=−0.020 m/s、總延遲τ=180 s，未觀測變化Δh≈τdh/dt=−3.60 m。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head falls from 40 m to 30 m and leakage exponent N=1.2. Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081; assumed initial leakage 10 L/s becomes 7.081 L/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s. Dissipated hydraulic power P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW, not generated power.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m. Authority Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40 for the specified operating condition.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head-change rate dh/dt=−0.020 m/s and total delay τ=180 s. Unobserved change Δh≈τdh/dt=−3.60 m.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」與「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" and "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程水頭與服務壓力」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation head and service pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。節點水頭包含高程與壓力，沿途摩阻又隨需求變動，因此低處壓力過高時，高處仍可能接近供水不足；管理分區需同時考慮高程帶、管路阻力與代表性服務點。下式分開能量水頭、高程及流動損失，忽略速度水頭差；所得壓力水頭只適用指定需求工況，不代表全天最小值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程水頭與服務壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. Nodal head includes elevation and pressure, while friction changes with demand. A low-lying area can have excessive pressure while an elevated area approaches insufficient supply, so zoning must consider elevation bands, resistance and representative service points together. The relation separates energy head, elevation and losses while neglecting velocity-head differences. The resulting pressure head applies to one demand condition, not the daily minimum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elevation head and service pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高程水頭與服務壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elevation head and service pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。節點水頭包含高程與壓力，沿途摩阻又隨需求變動，因此低處壓力過高時，高處仍可能接近供水不足；管理分區需同時考慮高程帶、管路阻力與代表性服務點。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. Nodal head includes elevation and pressure, while friction changes with demand.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。
壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。
管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
optionsEn: Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer.
Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet.
A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
quiz.explanation: 壓力管理要控制的是用戶與關鍵設施可取得的壓力，不能只追求減壓閥出口的一個數字。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure management concerns pressure available to customers and critical facilities, not merely one number at a reducing-valve outlet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高程水頭與服務壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elevation head and service pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Pressure head h=H−z−hf=25 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。
通訊連線正常就表示控制器讀到的壓力一定是即時值。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。
optionsEn: All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.
A working communication link guarantees the controller sees current pressure.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設供水水頭H=100 m、節點高程z=60 m、路徑損失hf=15 m，壓力水頭h=H−z−hf=25 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume supply head H=100 m, node elevation z=60 m and path loss hf=15 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高程水頭與服務壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elevation head and service pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。比較尖峰與低需求兩個時段的水頭線，檢查閥後量測是否能代表最不利用戶而非只代表附近低點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Compare hydraulic grades at peak and low demand and test whether the downstream sensor represents the limiting customer rather than a nearby low point. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：繪出高低兩個服務點在相同閥後水頭下的壓力差，加入需求增加造成的摩阻。列出應監測的最不利位置，避免只以平均區壓決定管理策略。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw pressures at high and low service points under one valve-outlet head and add demand-dependent friction. Identify limiting monitoring locations instead of selecting management strategy from average district pressure alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。比較尖峰與低需求兩個時段的水頭線，檢查閥後量測是否能代表最不利用戶而非只代表附近低點。
knowledge.textEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Compare hydraulic grades at peak and low demand and test whether the downstream sensor represents the limiting customer rather than a nearby low point.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 繪出高低兩個服務點在相同閥後水頭下的壓力差，加入需求增加造成的摩阻。列出應監測的最不利位置，避免只以平均區壓決定管理策略。
knowledge.textEn: Draw pressures at high and low service points under one valve-outlet head and add demand-dependent friction. Identify limiting monitoring locations instead of selecting management strategy from average district pressure alone.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification"?
options: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
現場有旁通管就代表任何失效情境都能維持原有供水。
optionsEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Having a bypass guarantees unchanged supply in every failure scenario.
quiz.explanation: 將關鍵服務點的高程、壓力與需求時間對齊，核對感測器讀值是表壓或水頭。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align elevations, pressure and demand times at critical service points, checking whether sensors report gauge pressure or head. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高程水頭與服務壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elevation head and service pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Confusing ground elevation with the pressure-measurement datum can then misclassify a genuine pressure deficit as instrument error. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式分開能量水頭、高程及流動損失，忽略速度水頭差；所得壓力水頭只適用指定需求工況，不代表全天最小值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resulting pressure head applies to one demand condition, not the daily minimum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。
knowledge.textEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Confusing ground elevation with the pressure-measurement datum can then misclassify a genuine pressure deficit as instrument error.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高程水頭與服務壓力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elevation head and service pressure mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。
管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users.
A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
quiz.explanation: 只在減壓閥附近量到足夠壓力，可能漏掉遠端或高處缺壓；若把地面高程錯當管線量測基準，模型又會把壓力不足誤判成儀器偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate pressure near a reducing valve can conceal shortages at remote or elevated users. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力相依需求與缺水量」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。壓力相依需求把可供流量連到可用壓力區間，使缺水成為可量化輸出；但需求曲線仍是模型假設，不能將所有用戶、儲水設備與消防用途視為相同的孔口行為。此例採分段模型：低於最低水頭供量為零，達要求水頭供滿量，中間以平方根插值；參數不是任何地方服務標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力相依需求與缺水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. Pressure-dependent demand relates available flow to a pressure range and makes supply deficit an explicit output. The demand curve remains an assumption, however, and customers, storage installations and fire-service functions cannot all be treated as identical orifices. The example sets zero delivery below minimum head, full delivery at required head and square-root interpolation between them. Its parameters are not jurisdictional service standards. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。壓力相依需求把可供流量連到可用壓力區間，使缺水成為可量化輸出；但需求曲線仍是模型假設，不能將所有用戶、儲水設備與消防用途視為相同的孔口行為。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. Pressure-dependent demand relates available flow to a pressure range and makes supply deficit an explicit output.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。
optionsEn: A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures.
quiz.explanation: 傳統固定需求模型可能在壓力不足時仍要求節點供出全部流量，造成不合理的負壓結果。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A fixed-demand model can require full delivery even when pressure is insufficient, producing unrealistic negative pressures. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Delivered q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。
控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。
比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m.
A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow.
Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設需求qreq=20 L/s、hmin=10 m、hreq=30 m、實際h=20 m，q=20√[(20−10)/(30−10)]=14.14 L/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume required demand qreq=20 L/s, hmin=10 m, hreq=30 m and actual h=20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力相依需求與缺水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。用可取得的壓力及服務資料驗證缺水量，不只要求數值迭代收斂。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Check whether customer categories and storage installations need different representations, and validate deficits using available pressure and service data rather than accepting numerical convergence alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以三個水頭值跨越最低與要求界線，檢查分段需求是否連續且不超過滿額需求。再說明哪些用戶資料可支持參數，而哪些仍應保留敏感度範圍。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Evaluate three heads spanning minimum and required limits, checking continuity and the full-demand cap. Explain which customer observations support the parameters and which uncertainties should remain as sensitivity ranges.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。用可取得的壓力及服務資料驗證缺水量，不只要求數值迭代收斂。
knowledge.textEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Check whether customer categories and storage installations need different representations, and validate deficits using available pressure and service data rather than accepting numerical convergence alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以三個水頭值跨越最低與要求界線，檢查分段需求是否連續且不超過滿額需求。再說明哪些用戶資料可支持參數，而哪些仍應保留敏感度範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Evaluate three heads spanning minimum and required limits, checking continuity and the full-demand cap. Explain which customer observations support the parameters and which uncertainties should remain as sensitivity ranges.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。
平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution.
Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients.
quiz.explanation: 比較固定需求與壓力相依模型在相同邊界下的供量與低壓分布，查核用戶類別與儲水設備是否需不同描述。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare fixed and pressure-dependent demand models under identical boundaries, examining delivery and low-pressure distribution. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力相依需求與缺水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure-dependent demand and deficit” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Both can misdirect improvement priorities. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此例採分段模型：低於最低水頭供量為零，達要求水頭供滿量，中間以平方根插值；參數不是任何地方服務標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its parameters are not jurisdictional service standards.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。
knowledge.textEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Both can misdirect improvement priorities.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓力相依需求與缺水量機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure-dependent demand and deficit mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates.
quiz.explanation: 以固定需求強迫缺壓節點繼續滿額供水會低估服務中斷，反之把假設需求曲線當精確行為也會製造過度確定的缺水預測；兩者都可能錯排優先改善區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Forcing full demand at a pressure-deficient node understates service disruption, while treating an assumed demand curve as exact behavior creates false certainty in deficit estimates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證」與「減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification" and "Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「漏口變形與壓力指數」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leak deformation and pressure exponent” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 降低壓力通常能降低既有漏口流量，但效果取決於漏口是否隨壓力張開、材料拘束及不同漏點的組合。固定孔口平方根關係不一定代表整區漏失，經驗指數也不是材料常數；若合法用水、閥位或漏點數同時改變，觀測到的曲線便不能單獨歸因於壓力。本式比較相同漏口群、代表壓力定義不變的兩個狀態，不預測新破口發生率；指數須在適用範圍內校準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「漏口變形與壓力指數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reducing pressure generally reduces flow through existing leaks, but the effect depends on opening deformation, restraint and the mix of leaks. A fixed-orifice square-root relation need not represent district leakage, and an empirical exponent is not a material constant. Simultaneous changes in authorized use, valve state or leak count prevent attributing an observed curve to pressure alone. The relation compares the same leak population under a consistent representative-pressure definition. It does not predict new-break frequency, and its exponent requires calibration within the applicable range. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leak deformation and pressure exponent” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭由40 m降至30 m、漏失指數N=1.2，Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081；假設原漏失10 L/s，則為7.081 L/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head falls from 40 m to 30 m and leakage exponent N=1.2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「漏口變形與壓力指數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leak deformation and pressure exponent”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 降低壓力通常能降低既有漏口流量，但效果取決於漏口是否隨壓力張開、材料拘束及不同漏點的組合。固定孔口平方根關係不一定代表整區漏失，經驗指數也不是材料常數；若合法用水、閥位或漏點數同時改變，觀測到的曲線便不能單獨歸因於壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Reducing pressure generally reduces flow through existing leaks, but the effect depends on opening deformation, restraint and the mix of leaks. A fixed-orifice square-root relation need not represent district leakage, and an empirical exponent is not a material constant.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 降低壓力通常能降低既有漏口流量，但效果取決於漏口是否隨壓力張開、材料拘束及不同漏點的組合。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。
optionsEn: Reducing pressure generally reduces flow through existing leaks, but the effect depends on opening deformation, restraint and the mix of leaks.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.
quiz.explanation: 降低壓力通常能降低既有漏口流量，但效果取決於漏口是否隨壓力張開、材料拘束及不同漏點的組合。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「漏口變形與壓力指數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Leak deformation and pressure exponent” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設壓力水頭由40 m降至30 m、漏失指數N=1.2，Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081；假設原漏失10 L/s，則為7.081 L/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume head falls from 40 m to 30 m and leakage exponent N=1.2. Q2/Q1=(30/40)^1.2=0.7081; assumed initial leakage 10 L/s becomes 7.081 L/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在需求及邊界可比的觀測時段配對壓力與漏失估計，將修復或新爆管事件另外標記。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair pressure and leakage estimates over comparable demand and boundary conditions, marking repairs and new bursts separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「漏口變形與壓力指數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Leak deformation and pressure exponent” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在需求及邊界可比的觀測時段配對壓力與漏失估計，將修復或新爆管事件另外標記。用多個壓力點檢查代表區壓是否合理，並把指數擬合殘差與預測範圍共同呈現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair pressure and leakage estimates over comparable demand and boundary conditions, marking repairs and new bursts separately. Use several pressure locations to test the representative district pressure and present exponent-fit residuals together with the prediction range. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用固定孔口指數與另一個假設經驗指數比較同一壓力變化，列出結果差異。把減少既有漏流與降低新破管風險分成兩個需不同證據的問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one pressure change using a fixed-orifice exponent and another hypothetical fitted exponent. Separate reduction of existing leakage from prevention of new breaks, identifying the different evidence needed for each.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把修復後漏點減少的效果算進壓力指數，會高估下一次減壓效益；相反，合法夜用水增加也可能掩蓋真實漏失下降，讓管理措施被誤判無效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Including leak removal from repairs in a pressure exponent overstates the benefit of a later pressure reduction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare one pressure change using a fixed-orifice exponent and another hypothetical fitted exponent. Separate reduction of existing leakage from prevention of new breaks, identifying the different evidence needed for each.

quiz.question: 要驗證「漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
在需求及邊界可比的觀測時段配對壓力與漏失估計，將修復或新爆管事件另外標記。

Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality.
Pair pressure and leakage estimates over comparable demand and boundary conditions, marking repairs and new bursts separately.

steps.title: 漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leak deformation and pressure exponent mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「漏口變形與壓力指數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Leak deformation and pressure exponent” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把修復後漏點減少的效果算進壓力指數，會高估下一次減壓效益；相反，合法夜用水增加也可能掩蓋真實漏失下降，讓管理措施被誤判無效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including leak removal from repairs in a pressure exponent overstates the benefit of a later pressure reduction. Conversely, increased legitimate night use can hide real leakage reduction and make the measure appear ineffective. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本式比較相同漏口群、代表壓力定義不變的兩個狀態，不預測新破口發生率；指數須在適用範圍內校準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not predict new-break frequency, and its exponent requires calibration within the applicable range.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把修復後漏點減少的效果算進壓力指數，會高估下一次減壓效益；相反，合法夜用水增加也可能掩蓋真實漏失下降，讓管理措施被誤判無效。
knowledge.textEn: Including leak removal from repairs in a pressure exponent overstates the benefit of a later pressure reduction. Conversely, increased legitimate night use can hide real leakage reduction and make the measure appear ineffective.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「漏口變形與壓力指數機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.

quiz.explanationEn: Including leak removal from repairs in a pressure exponent overstates the benefit of a later pressure reduction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「減壓閥能量耗散」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Energy dissipation in reducing valves” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 減壓閥藉節流將一部分水力能轉成湍流、熱及振動，閥後壓力降低不代表能量被回收。壓差與通量共同決定耗散功率，而局部高速區可能涉及空化與噪音；設計需對照閥型、上下游絕對壓力及運轉範圍，不能只從平均壓差選擇設備。壓差乘流量是流體功率差，未乘任何發電效率；只有另設能量回收裝置並證實效率時，才能估可利用電力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「減壓閥能量耗散」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pressure-reducing valve converts hydraulic energy into turbulence, heat and vibration through throttling; lower downstream pressure does not mean energy recovery. Pressure difference and flow determine dissipated power, while local high-speed zones may involve cavitation and noise. Equipment assessment needs valve type, absolute boundary pressures and operating range rather than average pressure drop alone. Pressure difference times flow is a fluid-power difference with no generation efficiency applied. Useful electric power requires a separate recovery device and substantiated efficiency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Energy dissipation in reducing valves” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「減壓閥能量耗散」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Energy dissipation in reducing valves”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Pressure difference and flow determine dissipated power, while local high-speed zones may involve cavitation and noise.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s. Dissipated hydraulic power P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW, not generated power.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。
optionsEn: Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓差Δp=200 kPa、Q=0.020 m³/s，耗散水力功率P=ΔpQ=4000 W=4.0 kW，不是發電量。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve drop Δp=200 kPa and Q=0.020 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「減壓閥能量耗散」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Energy dissipation in reducing valves” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測閥前後壓力與流量，核對壓力取樣點是否避開不適當的局部擾動。比較設備核定的壓差及流量範圍，並追蹤噪音、振動和內部損傷，避免只以能量帳判定設備適用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure upstream and downstream pressure with flow simultaneously, checking whether pressure taps are affected by unsuitable local disturbances. Compare the approved pressure-drop and flow range and track noise, vibration and internal damage instead of judging suitability from the energy ledger alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將同一壓差下兩個流量的耗散功率比較，另畫出有能量回收裝置時的效率鏈。明確區分功率與一段時間的能量，再列出設備適用性仍需的資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare dissipated power at two flows under one pressure drop and draw a separate efficiency chain for a recovery device. Distinguish power from time-integrated energy and list remaining equipment-suitability data.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把耗散功率寫成可回收發電功率會誇大效益，忽略局部低壓又可能漏掉空化損傷；閥後平均壓力正常並不能保證閥內最低壓力也正常。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reporting dissipated power as recoverable generation exaggerates benefits, while ignoring local low pressure misses possible cavitation damage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測閥前後壓力與流量，核對壓力取樣點是否避開不適當的局部擾動。比較設備核定的壓差及流量範圍，並追蹤噪音、振動和內部損傷，避免只以能量帳判定設備適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Measure upstream and downstream pressure with flow simultaneously, checking whether pressure taps are affected by unsuitable local disturbances. Compare the approved pressure-drop and flow range and track noise, vibration and internal damage instead of judging suitability from the energy ledger alone.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將同一壓差下兩個流量的耗散功率比較，另畫出有能量回收裝置時的效率鏈。明確區分功率與一段時間的能量，再列出設備適用性仍需的資料。
knowledge.textEn: Compare dissipated power at two flows under one pressure drop and draw a separate efficiency chain for a recovery device. Distinguish power from time-integrated energy and list remaining equipment-suitability data.

quiz.question: 要驗證「減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification"?
options: 同步量測閥前後壓力與流量，核對壓力取樣點是否避開不適當的局部擾動。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。
optionsEn: Measure upstream and downstream pressure with flow simultaneously, checking whether pressure taps are affected by unsuitable local disturbances.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測閥前後壓力與流量，核對壓力取樣點是否避開不適當的局部擾動。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure upstream and downstream pressure with flow simultaneously, checking whether pressure taps are affected by unsuitable local disturbances. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「減壓閥能量耗散」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Energy dissipation in reducing valves” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把耗散功率寫成可回收發電功率會誇大效益，忽略局部低壓又可能漏掉空化損傷；閥後平均壓力正常並不能保證閥內最低壓力也正常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reporting dissipated power as recoverable generation exaggerates benefits, while ignoring local low pressure misses possible cavitation damage. Normal downstream mean pressure does not ensure an acceptable internal minimum pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：壓差乘流量是流體功率差，未乘任何發電效率；只有另設能量回收裝置並證實效率時，才能估可利用電力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Useful electric power requires a separate recovery device and substantiated efficiency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把耗散功率寫成可回收發電功率會誇大效益，忽略局部低壓又可能漏掉空化損傷；閥後平均壓力正常並不能保證閥內最低壓力也正常。
knowledge.textEn: Reporting dissipated power as recoverable generation exaggerates benefits, while ignoring local low pressure misses possible cavitation damage. Normal downstream mean pressure does not ensure an acceptable internal minimum pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「減壓閥能量耗散機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Energy dissipation in reducing valves mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把耗散功率寫成可回收發電功率會誇大效益，忽略局部低壓又可能漏掉空化損傷；閥後平均壓力正常並不能保證閥內最低壓力也正常。
控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Reporting dissipated power as recoverable generation exaggerates benefits, while ignoring local low pressure misses possible cavitation damage.
A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow.
quiz.explanation: 把耗散功率寫成可回收發電功率會誇大效益，忽略局部低壓又可能漏掉空化損傷；閥後平均壓力正常並不能保證閥內最低壓力也正常。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reporting dissipated power as recoverable generation exaggerates benefits, while ignoring local low pressure misses possible cavitation damage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證」與「遠端壓力與通訊延遲機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification" and "Remote pressure and communication delay mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閥權度與穩定調節」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Valve authority and stable regulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 控制閥的作用取決於自身壓降相對整個受控支路壓降的比例，閥位改變不一定帶來同樣比例的流量變化。閥過大時可能長期在很小開度工作，機械間隙與摩擦會放大調節困難；閥權度提供一種局部比較，但不能單獨描述導閥、控制器與管網的動態穩定性。此比值在同一工況下分開閥門與其餘支路損失，沒有給出通用合格門檻；實際控制增益還取決於閥特性與邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閥權度與穩定調節」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A control valve’s influence depends on its pressure drop relative to the controlled branch, so a position change does not necessarily produce a proportional flow change. An oversized valve may operate near closure where backlash and friction complicate regulation. Valve authority offers a local comparison but cannot by itself describe pilot, controller and network dynamic stability. The ratio separates valve loss from the rest of the branch at one condition and supplies no universal acceptance threshold. Actual control gain also depends on valve characteristic and boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Valve authority and stable regulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閥權度與穩定調節」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Valve authority and stable regulation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 控制閥的作用取決於自身壓降相對整個受控支路壓降的比例，閥位改變不一定帶來同樣比例的流量變化。閥過大時可能長期在很小開度工作，機械間隙與摩擦會放大調節困難；閥權度提供一種局部比較，但不能單獨描述導閥、控制器與管網的動態穩定性。
knowledge.textEn: A control valve’s influence depends on its pressure drop relative to the controlled branch, so a position change does not necessarily produce a proportional flow change. An oversized valve may operate near closure where backlash and friction complicate regulation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。
通訊連線正常就表示控制器讀到的壓力一定是即時值。
控制閥的作用取決於自身壓降相對整個受控支路壓降的比例，閥位改變不一定帶來同樣比例的流量變化。
optionsEn: A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow.
A working communication link guarantees the controller sees current pressure.
A control valve’s influence depends on its pressure drop relative to the controlled branch, so a position change does not necessarily produce a proportional flow change.
quiz.explanation: 控制閥的作用取決於自身壓降相對整個受控支路壓降的比例，閥位改變不一定帶來同樣比例的流量變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A control valve’s influence depends on its pressure drop relative to the controlled branch, so a position change does not necessarily produce a proportional flow change. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閥權度與穩定調節」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Valve authority and stable regulation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m. Authority Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40 for the specified operating condition. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得閥位、流量係數與實測壓差關係，檢查低流量及高流量時是否仍具可調範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain valve-position, flow-coefficient and measured-drop relationships, checking controllable range at low and high flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m. Authority Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40 for the specified operating condition.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閥權度與穩定調節機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Valve authority and stable regulation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設閥壓降hv=20 m、其餘受控支路損失hr=30 m，權度Av=hv/(hv+hr)=0.40，為指定工況比較。
現場有旁通管就代表任何失效情境都能維持原有供水。
壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume valve loss hv=20 m and remaining controlled-branch loss hr=30 m.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Remote pressure and communication delay” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以遠端服務點回授可改善代表性，但通訊延遲使控制器看到的是過去狀態而非當前壓力。需求快速增加時，延遲期間的壓降可能已消耗原有裕度；資料時間戳、封包重送與感測器濾波都會增加有效滯後，不能只把無線傳輸的名目速度當整體延遲。線性變化率乘延遲只估未觀測的水頭改變，並非實際控制響應；需求突變與非線性管網仍需另外模擬。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「遠端壓力與通訊延遲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Remote service-point feedback can improve representation, but communication delay means the controller sees a past state rather than current pressure. During rising demand, pressure can consume its available margin before the update arrives. Timestamps, retransmission and sensor filtering all add effective lag, so nominal wireless transmission speed does not equal total feedback delay. A linear rate times delay estimates unobserved head change, not actual closed-loop response. Demand steps and nonlinear network behavior still require separate modeling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Remote pressure and communication delay” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 遠端壓力與通訊延遲機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Measure delay from sensor sampling to actual controller use, retaining source and receipt timestamps.
