steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If a controller treats retransmitted old pressure as current, it can counteract a pressure condition that has already recovered and create repeated chasing or oscillation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 從感測器採樣到控制器使用資料的整條路徑量測延遲，保留來源時間與接收時間。對缺值、重送及過期資料建立可辨識標記，在離線情境中檢查失去遠端訊號時的核定備援行為。
knowledge.textEn: Measure delay from sensor sampling to actual controller use, retaining source and receipt timestamps. Flag missing, retransmitted and stale records explicitly and examine the approved fallback behavior during loss of remote signals in offline scenarios.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出採樣、傳送、重送與使用四個時間點，分開資料新鮮度與連線狀態。用假設壓力斜率估延遲影響，再說明核定控制設計應如何驗證過期資料處理。
knowledge.textEn: Draw sampling, transmission, retransmission and use timestamps, separating data freshness from link status. Estimate delay effect with a hypothetical pressure slope and explain how approved control design should verify stale-data handling.

quiz.question: 要驗證「遠端壓力與通訊延遲機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Remote pressure and communication delay mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
從感測器採樣到控制器使用資料的整條路徑量測延遲，保留來源時間與接收時間。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
Measure delay from sensor sampling to actual controller use, retaining source and receipt timestamps.
quiz.explanation: 從感測器採樣到控制器使用資料的整條路徑量測延遲，保留來源時間與接收時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure delay from sensor sampling to actual controller use, retaining source and receipt timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 遠端壓力與通訊延遲機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Remote pressure and communication delay mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遠端壓力與通訊延遲」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Remote pressure and communication delay” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 控制器若將重送的舊壓力當成新資料，可能反向修正已經恢復的壓力，造成反覆追逐與振盪；通訊恢復也不等於所有歷史封包都可立即參與控制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If a controller treats retransmitted old pressure as current, it can counteract a pressure condition that has already recovered and create repeated chasing or oscillation. Restored communication does not make every historical packet suitable for immediate control. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：線性變化率乘延遲只估未觀測的水頭改變，並非實際控制響應；需求突變與非線性管網仍需另外模擬。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Demand steps and nonlinear network behavior still require separate modeling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「通訊連線正常就表示控制器讀到的壓力一定是即時值。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A working communication link guarantees the controller sees current pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 控制器若將重送的舊壓力當成新資料，可能反向修正已經恢復的壓力，造成反覆追逐與振盪；通訊恢復也不等於所有歷史封包都可立即參與控制。
knowledge.textEn: If a controller treats retransmitted old pressure as current, it can counteract a pressure condition that has already recovered and create repeated chasing or oscillation. Restored communication does not make every historical packet suitable for immediate control.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「遠端壓力與通訊延遲機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Remote pressure and communication delay mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 控制器若將重送的舊壓力當成新資料，可能反向修正已經恢復的壓力，造成反覆追逐與振盪；通訊恢復也不等於所有歷史封包都可立即參與控制。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
optionsEn: If a controller treats retransmitted old pressure as current, it can counteract a pressure condition that has already recovered and create repeated chasing or oscillation.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
quiz.explanation: 控制器若將重送的舊壓力當成新資料，可能反向修正已經恢復的壓力，造成反覆追逐與振盪；通訊恢復也不等於所有歷史封包都可立即參與控制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If a controller treats retransmitted old pressure as current, it can counteract a pressure condition that has already recovered and create repeated chasing or oscillation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證」與「備援供水與非常態邊界機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification" and "Backup supply and abnormal boundaries mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回授增益與控制方向」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Feedback gain and control direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力回授必須先確認誤差符號與閥門作用方向，否則負回授可能被接成正回授。比例增益把壓力誤差轉成控制量，但實際壓力還受閥特性、管網儲能及延遲影響；提高增益未必改善速度，積分飽和與機械死區可能讓系統反而反覆超越目標。本式只是指定符號的控制量算術，不是可直接投入現場的增益；正百分點方向必須由設備作用定義，不假設等於開閥。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回授增益與控制方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pressure feedback first needs consistent error sign and valve action, or intended negative feedback becomes positive feedback. Proportional gain converts pressure error into a command, while actual pressure also depends on valve characteristics, network storage and delay. Higher gain need not improve response; integral saturation and mechanical deadband can instead create repeated overshoot. This is command arithmetic under a declared sign convention, not a field-ready gain. The positive percentage-point direction must be defined by equipment action and is not presumed to mean opening. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Feedback gain and control direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設誤差e=目標−量測=5 m、比較增益Kp=0.40百分點/m，比例命令Δu=Kp e=2.0百分點；未計動態。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume error e=target−measured=5 m and comparison gain Kp=0.40 percentage points/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回授增益與控制方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Feedback gain and control direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓力回授必須先確認誤差符號與閥門作用方向，否則負回授可能被接成正回授。比例增益把壓力誤差轉成控制量，但實際壓力還受閥特性、管網儲能及延遲影響；提高增益未必改善速度，積分飽和與機械死區可能讓系統反而反覆超越目標。
knowledge.textEn: Pressure feedback first needs consistent error sign and valve action, or intended negative feedback becomes positive feedback. Proportional gain converts pressure error into a command, while actual pressure also depends on valve characteristics, network storage and delay.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
壓力回授必須先確認誤差符號與閥門作用方向，否則負回授可能被接成正回授。
現場有旁通管就代表任何失效情境都能維持原有供水。
optionsEn: Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
Pressure feedback first needs consistent error sign and valve action, or intended negative feedback becomes positive feedback.
Having a bypass guarantees unchanged supply in every failure scenario.
quiz.explanation: 壓力回授必須先確認誤差符號與閥門作用方向，否則負回授可能被接成正回授。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pressure feedback first needs consistent error sign and valve action, or intended negative feedback becomes positive feedback. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回授增益與控制方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Feedback gain and control direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設誤差e=目標−量測=5 m、比較增益Kp=0.40百分點/m，比例命令Δu=Kp e=2.0百分點；未計動態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume error e=target−measured=5 m and comparison gain Kp=0.40 percentage points/m. Proportional command Δu=Kp e=2.0 percentage points, excluding dynamics. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在離線模型確認誤差與設備方向，再檢查命令限制、死區及回授延遲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm error and device direction in an offline model, then inspect command limits, deadband and feedback delay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設誤差e=目標−量測=5 m、比較增益Kp=0.40百分點/m，比例命令Δu=Kp e=2.0百分點；未計動態。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume error e=target−measured=5 m and comparison gain Kp=0.40 percentage points/m. Proportional command Δu=Kp e=2.0 percentage points, excluding dynamics.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設誤差e=目標−量測=5 m、比較增益Kp=0.40百分點/m，比例命令Δu=Kp e=2.0百分點；未計動態。
optionsEn: Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality.
A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume error e=target−measured=5 m and comparison gain Kp=0.40 percentage points/m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設誤差e=目標−量測=5 m、比較增益Kp=0.40百分點/m，比例命令Δu=Kp e=2.0百分點；未計動態。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume error e=target−measured=5 m and comparison gain Kp=0.40 percentage points/m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回授增益與控制方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Feedback gain and control direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在離線模型確認誤差與設備方向，再檢查命令限制、死區及回授延遲。以核准測試資料比較目標、量測、閥位與控制命令，確認任何飽和或失訊時均使用已設計的行為。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm error and device direction in an offline model, then inspect command limits, deadband and feedback delay. Compare target, measurement, position and command using approved test records, verifying designed behavior during saturation or signal loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩種相反的設備方向畫出回授符號圖，判斷哪一種形成負回授。把簡單命令計算與完整動態驗證分開，列出延遲及飽和需要的額外情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw feedback-sign diagrams for two opposite device actions and identify negative feedback. Separate command arithmetic from dynamic validation, listing additional delay and saturation scenarios needed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：符號設定錯誤會讓低壓時的動作進一步降低壓力，形成正回授；增益過高還可能使閥位頻繁反轉，增加磨耗並把控制波動傳到用戶端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect sign can make the response to low pressure reduce pressure further, creating positive feedback. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在離線模型確認誤差與設備方向，再檢查命令限制、死區及回授延遲。以核准測試資料比較目標、量測、閥位與控制命令，確認任何飽和或失訊時均使用已設計的行為。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm error and device direction in an offline model, then inspect command limits, deadband and feedback delay. Compare target, measurement, position and command using approved test records, verifying designed behavior during saturation or signal loss.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用兩種相反的設備方向畫出回授符號圖，判斷哪一種形成負回授。把簡單命令計算與完整動態驗證分開，列出延遲及飽和需要的額外情境。
knowledge.textEn: Draw feedback-sign diagrams for two opposite device actions and identify negative feedback. Separate command arithmetic from dynamic validation, listing additional delay and saturation scenarios needed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Feedback gain and control direction mechanism and verification"?
options: 在離線模型確認誤差與設備方向，再檢查命令限制、死區及回授延遲。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。
optionsEn: Confirm error and device direction in an offline model, then inspect command limits, deadband and feedback delay.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.

steps.title: 回授增益與控制方向機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Feedback gain and control direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 符號設定錯誤會讓低壓時的動作進一步降低壓力，形成正回授；增益過高還可能使閥位頻繁反轉，增加磨耗並把控制波動傳到用戶端。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect sign can make the response to low pressure reduce pressure further, creating positive feedback. Excessive gain can also reverse valve motion repeatedly, increasing wear and transmitting control oscillations to customers. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 備援供水與非常態邊界機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 壓力管理設備檢修或失效時，替代供水路徑的水頭損失可能不同於正常路徑。備援管路存在不代表備援服務能力足夠，較小管徑、較長距離或不同水源高程都會降低遠端壓力；評估需按實際可用的水源與閥位重建網路，而不是把名目容量直接相加。此例只檢查一個指定備援工況的水頭餘量，不包含水源可用性、消防需求與瞬變；負餘量表示假設條件未滿足比較需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援供水與非常態邊界」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: During maintenance or failure of pressure-management equipment, an alternative supply path can have different head losses from the normal route. A bypass does not guarantee adequate backup service: smaller diameter, longer length or another source elevation can reduce remote pressure. Assessment must reconstruct actual available sources and valve states instead of simply adding nominal capacities. The example checks head margin for one backup condition, excluding source availability, fire demand and transients. A negative margin means the assumed case does not meet the comparison requirement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup supply and abnormal boundaries” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設備援水頭45 m、節點高程20 m、損失18 m，h=7 m；比較需求15 m，餘量h−hreq=−8 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume backup head 45 m, node elevation 20 m and loss 18 m, giving h=7 m.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設備援水頭45 m、節點高程20 m、損失18 m，h=7 m；比較需求15 m，餘量h−hreq=−8 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「備援供水與非常態邊界機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backup supply and abnormal boundaries mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。
只確認旁通閥能開啟而未檢查路徑損失，可能在真正需要備援時才發現供壓不足；借用相鄰區水頭又可能使另一區同時失去服務裕度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients.
Checking only that a bypass valve can open can leave inadequate pressure undiscovered until backup is needed.
quiz.explanation: 只確認旁通閥能開啟而未檢查路徑損失，可能在真正需要備援時才發現供壓不足；借用相鄰區水頭又可能使另一區同時失去服務裕度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only that a bypass valve can open can leave inadequate pressure undiscovered until backup is needed. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證」與「低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification" and "Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調壓動作與快速瞬變」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 降低長期平均壓力不代表每一次調節都降低瞬間峰值，過快閥動作會改變流速並激發壓力波。控制器時間尺度與管線波傳時間可能相差很大，延時管網模型無法解析快速水錘；因此壓力管理方案需把服務水頭、控制動態及瞬變包絡分開而又一致地驗證。焦可夫斯基算例只估單一快速波前的壓力增量，不是閥動作建議，也不包含反射、低壓空穴及其他設備邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調壓動作與快速瞬變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lower long-term mean pressure does not guarantee lower instantaneous peaks during every adjustment. Rapid valve motion changes velocity and launches pressure waves. Controller and wave-travel time scales can differ greatly, and an extended-period network model cannot resolve fast water hammer. Service head, control dynamics and transient envelopes therefore need separate but consistent verification. The Joukowsky example estimates one rapid wavefront’s increment only. It is not a valve-action recommendation and excludes reflections, low-pressure cavities and other equipment boundaries. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=800 m/s、快速速度變化幅度Δv=0.20 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa，須另加初始壓力。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=800 m/s and rapid velocity-change magnitude Δv=0.20 m/s. Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa, separate from initial pressure.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「調壓動作與快速瞬變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 降低長期平均壓力不代表每一次調節都降低瞬間峰值，過快閥動作會改變流速並激發壓力波。控制器時間尺度與管線波傳時間可能相差很大，延時管網模型無法解析快速水錘；因此壓力管理方案需把服務水頭、控制動態及瞬變包絡分開而又一致地驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Lower long-term mean pressure does not guarantee lower instantaneous peaks during every adjustment. Rapid valve motion changes velocity and launches pressure waves.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 降低長期平均壓力不代表每一次調節都降低瞬間峰值，過快閥動作會改變流速並激發壓力波。
平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。
壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
optionsEn: Lower long-term mean pressure does not guarantee lower instantaneous peaks during every adjustment.
Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients.
Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality.
quiz.explanation: 降低長期平均壓力不代表每一次調節都降低瞬間峰值，過快閥動作會改變流速並激發壓力波。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lower long-term mean pressure does not guarantee lower instantaneous peaks during every adjustment. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「調壓動作與快速瞬變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=800 m/s、快速速度變化幅度Δv=0.20 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa，須另加初始壓力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=800 m/s and rapid velocity-change magnitude Δv=0.20 m/s. Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa, separate from initial pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將閥位時間歷程與高速壓力紀錄同步，確認一般遙測是否足以看見短時尖峰。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Synchronize valve-position history with high-rate pressure records and check whether ordinary telemetry can resolve short peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=800 m/s、快速速度變化幅度Δv=0.20 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa，須另加初始壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=800 m/s and rapid velocity-change magnitude Δv=0.20 m/s. Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa, separate from initial pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 管網模型能收斂就表示每一節點都實際得到要求水量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=800 m/s、快速速度變化幅度Δv=0.20 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa，須另加初始壓力。
減壓閥降低的水力功率都已自動轉換成可使用電力。
optionsEn: A converged network model means every node actually receives its required flow.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=800 m/s and rapid velocity-change magnitude Δv=0.20 m/s. Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa, separate from initial pressure.
All hydraulic power removed by a reducing valve automatically becomes usable electricity.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、a=800 m/s、快速速度變化幅度Δv=0.20 m/s，Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa，須另加初始壓力。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, a=800 m/s and rapid velocity-change magnitude Δv=0.20 m/s. Δp=ρaΔv=160 kPa, separate from initial pressure. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「調壓動作與快速瞬變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將閥位時間歷程與高速壓力紀錄同步，確認一般遙測是否足以看見短時尖峰。使用相容的瞬變模型檢查正常調節、停電及失訊情境，再與延時模型的初始水頭及需求保持一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize valve-position history with high-rate pressure records and check whether ordinary telemetry can resolve short peaks. Use a compatible transient model for regulation, power loss and signal loss, keeping initial heads and demands consistent with the extended-period model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一段含短時尖峰的假設壓力歷程做低頻平均，觀察哪些資訊消失。列出應用延時與瞬變模型的不同問題，並指出兩者需要共同保留的邊界資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Average a hypothetical pressure history containing a short peak and identify the information lost. List questions for extended-period and transient models and the boundary data that both must share.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將閥位時間歷程與高速壓力紀錄同步，確認一般遙測是否足以看見短時尖峰。使用相容的瞬變模型檢查正常調節、停電及失訊情境，再與延時模型的初始水頭及需求保持一致。
knowledge.textEn: Synchronize valve-position history with high-rate pressure records and check whether ordinary telemetry can resolve short peaks. Use a compatible transient model for regulation, power loss and signal loss, keeping initial heads and demands consistent with the extended-period model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一段含短時尖峰的假設壓力歷程做低頻平均，觀察哪些資訊消失。列出應用延時與瞬變模型的不同問題，並指出兩者需要共同保留的邊界資料。
knowledge.textEn: Average a hypothetical pressure history containing a short peak and identify the information lost. List questions for extended-period and transient models and the boundary data that both must share.

quiz.question: 要驗證「調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
通訊連線正常就表示控制器讀到的壓力一定是即時值。
將閥位時間歷程與高速壓力紀錄同步，確認一般遙測是否足以看見短時尖峰。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A working communication link guarantees the controller sees current pressure.
Synchronize valve-position history with high-rate pressure records and check whether ordinary telemetry can resolve short peaks.
quiz.explanation: 將閥位時間歷程與高速壓力紀錄同步，確認一般遙測是否足以看見短時尖峰。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize valve-position history with high-rate pressure records and check whether ordinary telemetry can resolve short peaks. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「調壓動作與快速瞬變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure adjustments and rapid transients” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient. Repeated rapid feedback actions can also increase cyclic shell stress. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：焦可夫斯基算例只估單一快速波前的壓力增量，不是閥動作建議，也不包含反射、低壓空穴及其他設備邊界。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not a valve-action recommendation and excludes reflections, low-pressure cavities and other equipment boundaries.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均壓力降低後就不需要再檢查任何快速水錘事件。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower average pressure removes the need to examine rapid transients." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。
knowledge.textEn: Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient. Repeated rapid feedback actions can also increase cyclic shell stress.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「調壓動作與快速瞬變機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pressure adjustments and rapid transients mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
optionsEn: Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality.
quiz.explanation: 只看每十五分鐘平均壓力可能完全漏掉秒級壓峰，讓減壓措施被誤判為同時解決所有水錘；快速回授反覆動作也可能增加管殼循環應力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Fifteen-minute mean pressure can completely miss second-scale peaks and falsely suggest that pressure reduction solved every transient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「低流量水齡與水質介面」如何影響配水管網壓力管理的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pressure management of water-distribution networks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 壓力管理改變漏流與部分壓力相依需求後，某些支線的更新水量可能下降，水齡和消毒劑衰減便需要重新評估。幾何容積除以通量只給理想平均停留尺度，實際管網有混合、短路及死端分布；不能以較少水量損失直接推定所有水質指標都會改善。本例假設固定容積與穩定通量，只計平均尺度；它不是所有水粒子的年齡，也沒有提供任何水質合格判準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「低流量水齡與水質介面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After pressure management changes leakage and some pressure-dependent demand, renewal flow in certain branches can decrease, requiring reassessment of water age and disinfectant decay. Volume divided by flow gives an ideal mean residence scale, while actual networks contain mixing, short circuits and dead ends. Reduced physical loss therefore does not directly establish improvement in every water-quality indicator. The example assumes fixed volume and steady throughput to calculate a mean scale only. It is not the age of every water parcel and supplies no water-quality acceptance criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設支路有效水量V=500 m³、更新通量Q=10 m³/h，平均停留尺度τ=V/Q=50 h；若Q降至8 m³/h，τ=62.5 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective branch volume V=500 m³ and renewal flow Q=10 m³/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「低流量水齡與水質介面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 壓力管理改變漏流與部分壓力相依需求後，某些支線的更新水量可能下降，水齡和消毒劑衰減便需要重新評估。幾何容積除以通量只給理想平均停留尺度，實際管網有混合、短路及死端分布；不能以較少水量損失直接推定所有水質指標都會改善。
knowledge.textEn: After pressure management changes leakage and some pressure-dependent demand, renewal flow in certain branches can decrease, requiring reassessment of water age and disinfectant decay. Volume divided by flow gives an ideal mean residence scale, while actual networks contain mixing, short circuits and dead ends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。
壓力管理改變漏流與部分壓力相依需求後，某些支線的更新水量可能下降，水齡和消毒劑衰減便需要重新評估。
減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。
optionsEn: Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality.
After pressure management changes leakage and some pressure-dependent demand, renewal flow in certain branches can decrease, requiring reassessment of water age and disinfectant decay.
Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer.
quiz.explanation: 壓力管理改變漏流與部分壓力相依需求後，某些支線的更新水量可能下降，水齡和消毒劑衰減便需要重新評估。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After pressure management changes leakage and some pressure-dependent demand, renewal flow in certain branches can decrease, requiring reassessment of water age and disinfectant decay. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「低流量水齡與水質介面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設支路有效水量V=500 m³、更新通量Q=10 m³/h，平均停留尺度τ=V/Q=50 h；若Q降至8 m³/h，τ=62.5 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective branch volume V=500 m³ and renewal flow Q=10 m³/h. Mean residence scale τ=V/Q=50 h; at Q=8 m³/h, τ=62.5 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將壓力管理前後的流量、溫度及水質採樣位置對齊，使用適當管網水質模型檢查死端與水池混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align pre- and post-management flow, temperature and water-quality sampling locations, using an appropriate network-quality model to examine dead ends and tank mixing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設支路有效水量V=500 m³、更新通量Q=10 m³/h，平均停留尺度τ=V/Q=50 h；若Q降至8 m³/h，τ=62.5 h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective branch volume V=500 m³ and renewal flow Q=10 m³/h. Mean residence scale τ=V/Q=50 h; at Q=8 m³/h, τ=62.5 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 漏失壓力指數固定不變且能直接預測未來所有爆管。
控制閥只要能通過最大流量就一定能穩定調節所有流量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設支路有效水量V=500 m³、更新通量Q=10 m³/h，平均停留尺度τ=V/Q=50 h。
optionsEn: The leakage exponent is fixed and directly predicts every future pipe break.
A valve that passes maximum flow can stably regulate every lower flow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective branch volume V=500 m³ and renewal flow Q=10 m³/h.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設支路有效水量V=500 m³、更新通量Q=10 m³/h，平均停留尺度τ=V/Q=50 h；若Q降至8 m³/h，τ=62.5 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective branch volume V=500 m³ and renewal flow Q=10 m³/h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「低流量水齡與水質介面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將壓力管理前後的流量、溫度及水質採樣位置對齊，使用適當管網水質模型檢查死端與水池混合。保留代表性時段及實測殘留資料，避免只用平均停留時間代替水質驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align pre- and post-management flow, temperature and water-quality sampling locations, using an appropriate network-quality model to examine dead ends and tank mixing. Retain representative periods and measured residuals rather than substituting mean residence time for water-quality verification. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以相同支路容積比較兩個更新通量的停留尺度，再說明死端與混合會如何改變年齡分布。把節水、供壓與水質列成三個需要共同驗證的成果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare residence scales at two renewal flows for one branch volume, then explain how dead ends and mixing change the age distribution. Treat water savings, service pressure and quality as three outcomes requiring joint verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏流減少後若忽略低更新支線，可能讓水齡增加而未被平均區壓監測發現；把理想停留尺度當成每個用戶的實際水齡，又會錯估局部水質風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring low-renewal branches after leakage reduction can allow water age to rise without appearing in average-pressure monitoring. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將壓力管理前後的流量、溫度及水質採樣位置對齊，使用適當管網水質模型檢查死端與水池混合。保留代表性時段及實測殘留資料，避免只用平均停留時間代替水質驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Align pre- and post-management flow, temperature and water-quality sampling locations, using an appropriate network-quality model to examine dead ends and tank mixing. Retain representative periods and measured residuals rather than substituting mean residence time for water-quality verification.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以相同支路容積比較兩個更新通量的停留尺度，再說明死端與混合會如何改變年齡分布。把節水、供壓與水質列成三個需要共同驗證的成果。
knowledge.textEn: Compare residence scales at two renewal flows for one branch volume, then explain how dead ends and mixing change the age distribution. Treat water savings, service pressure and quality as three outcomes requiring joint verification.

quiz.question: 要驗證「低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification"?
options: 將壓力管理前後的流量、溫度及水質採樣位置對齊，使用適當管網水質模型檢查死端與水池混合。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
比例增益越大就一定越快達標且不會增加振盪。
optionsEn: Align pre- and post-management flow, temperature and water-quality sampling locations, using an appropriate network-quality model to examine dead ends and tank mixing.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Larger proportional gain always reaches the target faster without increasing oscillation.
quiz.explanation: 將壓力管理前後的流量、溫度及水質採樣位置對齊，使用適當管網水質模型檢查死端與水池混合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align pre- and post-management flow, temperature and water-quality sampling locations, using an appropriate network-quality model to examine dead ends and tank mixing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「低流量水齡與水質介面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Low-flow residence and water-quality interface” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏流減少後若忽略低更新支線，可能讓水齡增加而未被平均區壓監測發現；把理想停留尺度當成每個用戶的實際水齡，又會錯估局部水質風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring low-renewal branches after leakage reduction can allow water age to rise without appearing in average-pressure monitoring. Treating ideal residence scale as every customer’s actual water age also misrepresents localized quality concerns. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設固定容積與穩定通量，只計平均尺度；它不是所有水粒子的年齡，也沒有提供任何水質合格判準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not the age of every water parcel and supplies no water-quality acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「壓力管理只會影響漏水量而完全不會改變水齡或水質。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Pressure management affects leakage only and cannot change water age or quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏流減少後若忽略低更新支線，可能讓水齡增加而未被平均區壓監測發現；把理想停留尺度當成每個用戶的實際水齡，又會錯估局部水質風險。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring low-renewal branches after leakage reduction can allow water age to rise without appearing in average-pressure monitoring. Treating ideal residence scale as every customer’s actual water age also misrepresents localized quality concerns.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「低流量水齡與水質介面機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Low-flow residence and water-quality interface mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
漏流減少後若忽略低更新支線，可能讓水齡增加而未被平均區壓監測發現；把理想停留尺度當成每個用戶的實際水齡，又會錯估局部水質風險。
減壓閥出口壓力足夠就能保證所有用戶壓力都足夠。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring low-renewal branches after leakage reduction can allow water age to rise without appearing in average-pressure monitoring.
Adequate reducing-valve outlet pressure guarantees adequate pressure for every customer.
quiz.explanation: 漏流減少後若忽略低更新支線，可能讓水齡增加而未被平均區壓監測發現；把理想停留尺度當成每個用戶的實際水齡，又會錯估局部水質風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring low-renewal branches after leakage reduction can allow water age to rise without appearing in average-pressure monitoring. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 海水淡化取水工程
courses.summary: 本課由淡化回收率推導取水需求，依序分析篩網法向流速、有效面積、管路損失及潮位吸入裕度，再比較地下取水、堵塞、海管浮力與生物暴露。最後將排放回流接回進水水質，要求每個算例保留控制體、單位及適用邊界，不將平均值直接當成生態或設備允收結論。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from desalination recovery, this course develops intake demand through screen-normal velocity, effective area, losses and tidal suction margin, then examines subsurface collection, clogging, pipe buoyancy and biological exposure. Outfall recirculation closes the feed-quality loop. Every example retains its control volume, units and limits rather than converting an average into ecological or equipment acceptance.
courses.focus: 取水水量、生物介面與海岸水力驗證
courses.focusEn: Intake balances, biological interfaces and coastal hydraulic verification
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 原創敏感度例設定產品水0.50 m³/s，膜段回收率45%時需進水1.111 m³/s；只把回收率降至40%，進水增為1.250 m³/s，增加12.5%。若有效篩面維持10 m²，平均法向速度隨之由0.1111增至0.1250 m/s。這只是膜段與理想均勻篩面的聯動，尚未加入反洗、堵塞與物種條件。接著應以全廠水量帳及局部流場檢查結果，再比較地下取水的水文地質可行性。數值不是兩座西澳案例的操作參數，也不是推薦取水或生態門檻。
workedExample.textEn: An original sensitivity example supplies product water at 0.50 m³/s. Membrane recovery of 45% requires feed 1.111 m³/s; lowering only recovery to 40% increases feed to 1.250 m³/s, a 12.5% rise. With effective screen area fixed at 10 m², mean normal velocity rises from 0.1111 to 0.1250 m/s. This couples only the membrane balance and an ideally uniform screen, omitting backwash, blockage and species conditions. Check the result against the complete plant balance and local flow field, then compare hydrogeological feasibility of subsurface alternatives. These values are neither operating parameters from the Western Australian cases nor recommended intake or ecological limits.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外框A=20 m²、孔隙率φ=0.60、通暢比例β=0.75，Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²；Q=1.20 m³/s時vn=0.1333 m/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設K=2.0、基準速度v=1.5 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，局部損失hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.0 m、靜淹水3.0 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.3 m、吸入損失1.5 m，NPSHa=11.2 m；若NPSHr=8.0 m，差3.2 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s、截面A=300 m²、水力坡降i=0.10，Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s，為理想介質比較。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s. Required effective area Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m².

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross A=20 m², open-area ratio φ=0.60 and unblocked fraction β=0.75. Aeff=Aφβ=9.0 m²; at Q=1.20 m³/s, vn=0.1333 m/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume K=2.0, reference velocity v=1.5 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Local loss hL=Kv²/(2g)=0.2294 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.0 m, static submergence 3.0 m, vapor head 0.3 m and suction loss 1.5 m. NPSHa=11.2 m; compared with NPSHr=8.0 m, the difference is 3.2 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=5×10⁻⁴ m/s, section A=300 m² and hydraulic gradient i=0.10. Q=kAi=0.0150 m³/s for an idealized medium.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」與「接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" and "Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「產水需求與取水總量」如何影響海水淡化取水工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Product demand and intake volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seawater-desalination intake works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。若只用產品容量選擇取水口，可能低估海管、篩網與抽水負荷；不同流程的回收率定義須明確標示是膜段或全廠，避免重複或漏算支流。本例只對膜段作水量守恆，忽略密度差及其他支流；不能把得到的進水流量直接當成全廠海水取水設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「產水需求與取水總量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. Recovery links membrane product and feed, while pretreatment sludge, backwash and other streams can increase total intake. Sizing an intake from product capacity alone can understate pipeline, screen and pumping loads. Recovery definitions must distinguish the membrane stage from the entire plant to avoid omitting or double-counting side streams. The example applies volume balance to the membrane stage only, neglecting density differences and side streams. Its feed flow is not automatically the complete plant intake design flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Product demand and intake volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「產水需求與取水總量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Product demand and intake volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。若只用產品容量選擇取水口，可能低估海管、篩網與抽水負荷；不同流程的回收率定義須明確標示是膜段或全廠，避免重複或漏算支流。
knowledge.textEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. Recovery links membrane product and feed, while pretreatment sludge, backwash and other streams can increase total intake.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。
淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。
篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。
optionsEn: A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow.
A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output.
Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
quiz.explanation: 淡化廠取水量大於產品水量，回收率把膜系統產水與進水連結，預處理排泥、反洗及其他支流還會增加總取水需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A desalination plant takes in more seawater than its product output. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「產水需求與取水總量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Product demand and intake volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Feed Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s and concentrate Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 所有局部損失係數都可直接相加而不必核對速度基準。
地下取水只要量到一處高滲透層就能保證全廠長期供水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。
optionsEn: All local-loss coefficients can be added without checking their velocity basis.
One highly permeable layer guarantees long-term supply for the whole plant.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設產品Qp=0.50 m³/s、膜段回收率R=0.45，Qf=Qp/R=1.111 m³/s，濃水Qb=Qf−Qp=0.611 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume product Qp=0.50 m³/s and membrane recovery R=0.45. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「產水需求與取水總量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Product demand and intake volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。核對回收率的實際控制體，將膜段水量帳與全廠取水帳分開驗證後再合併。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verify the recovery control volume and validate membrane and whole-plant balances separately against synchronized flow-meter records before combining them. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出膜段與全廠兩個控制體，分別填入相同產品需求和假設回收率。逐一指出尚未計量的支流，並說明哪些額外資料會改變海管容量估計。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw membrane and whole-plant control volumes using the same product demand and assumed recovery. Identify unmetered side streams and explain which additional information would alter the intake-pipeline estimate.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。核對回收率的實際控制體，將膜段水量帳與全廠取水帳分開驗證後再合併。
knowledge.textEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verify the recovery control volume and validate membrane and whole-plant balances separately against synchronized flow-meter records before combining them.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出膜段與全廠兩個控制體，分別填入相同產品需求和假設回收率。逐一指出尚未計量的支流，並說明哪些額外資料會改變海管容量估計。
knowledge.textEn: Draw membrane and whole-plant control volumes using the same product demand and assumed recovery. Identify unmetered side streams and explain which additional information would alter the intake-pipeline estimate.

quiz.question: 要驗證「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification"?
options: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
海管永久狀態穩定就代表空管施工或排空維修時也一定穩定。
optionsEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Permanent stability guarantees stability during empty-pipe construction or drained maintenance.
quiz.explanation: 以流程圖列出產品、濃水、反洗與排泥等支流，為每支流標明連續或間歇性及計量時間窗。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map product, concentrate, backwash and sludge streams, identifying continuous or intermittent operation and measurement windows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「產水需求與取水總量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Product demand and intake volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Higher recovery can also increase concentrate salinity, so it is not simply a one-directional intake benefit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只對膜段作水量守恆，忽略密度差及其他支流；不能把得到的進水流量直接當成全廠海水取水設計值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Its feed flow is not automatically the complete plant intake design flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「產水需求與取水總量機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Product demand and intake volume mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。
篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand.
Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected.
quiz.explanation: 把膜回收率當成全廠回收率會漏掉預處理耗水，使取水泵與海管容量估計偏小；高回收率情境也可能增加濃水鹽度，不能只把它視為減少取水的單向好處。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using membrane recovery as whole-plant recovery omits pretreatment water and understates intake pump and pipeline demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接近流速與篩網面積」如何影響海水淡化取水工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Approach velocity and screen area” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seawater-desalination intake works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。增加有效過水面積可降低平均法向流速，但局部堵塞、潮流與幾何不均仍會產生較高速度；生物保護還取決於物種、生命階段與孔隙尺寸，不能只用平均流速保證無影響。以下面積為有效法向過水面積，尚未換算成外框尺寸或考慮局部不均；假設流速只供計算，不代表任何物種或許可標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接近流速與篩網面積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flow near an intake includes approach velocity normal to the screen and sweeping velocity parallel to it, with different implications for biological exposure. More effective area lowers mean normal velocity, but blockage, currents and uneven geometry can produce local peaks. Protection also depends on species, life stage and opening size, so mean velocity alone cannot prove absence of impact. The area is effective normal flow area, not gross frame dimensions, and local nonuniformity is omitted. The assumed velocity is a calculation input, not a species or permit criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Approach velocity and screen area” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設取水Q=1.20 m³/s、平均法向速度vn=0.12 m/s，所需有效面積Aeff=Q/vn=10.0 m²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume intake Q=1.20 m³/s and mean normal velocity vn=0.12 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「篩網平均流速低就能直接證明所有海洋生物都不受影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average screen velocity proves that no marine organisms are affected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接近流速與篩網面積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Approach velocity and screen area”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接近流速與篩網面積機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Approach velocity and screen area mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 取水口附近流場包含垂直篩面的接近分量及沿篩面的掃流分量，兩者對生物暴露的意義不同。增加有效過水面積可降低平均法向流速，但局部堵塞、潮流與幾何不均仍會產生較高速度；生物保護還取決於物種、生命階段與孔隙尺寸，不能只用平均流速保證無影響。
