knowledge.text: 誤解：濃度乘取水量算出的生物數就等於已證明的死亡數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Concentration times intake volume equals proven biological mortality. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「生物暴露與取樣代表性機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Biological exposure and sampling representation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 取水可能使生物撞擊篩面或隨水進入系統，兩種途徑的體型、生命階段與評估方法不同。
濃度乘取水量算出的生物數就等於已證明的死亡數。
只要取水口與排放口有一定水平距離就絕對不會回流。
optionsEn: Organisms may be impinged on screens or entrained into the system, with different sizes, life stages and assessment methods.
Concentration times intake volume equals proven biological mortality.
A horizontal separation between intake and outfall guarantees no recirculation.
quiz.explanation: 取水可能使生物撞擊篩面或隨水進入系統，兩種途徑的體型、生命階段與評估方法不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 生物暴露與取樣代表性機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Biological exposure and sampling representation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按物種與生命階段規劃季節、潮汐及深度取樣，核對網具或感測方法的捕獲效率。將暴露估計、存活資料與背景變動分開報告，對未觀測季節保留不確定性而非補成零。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plan sampling by species and life stage across seasons, tides and depths, checking capture efficiency of nets or sensors. Report exposure, survival evidence and background variability separately, retaining uncertainty for unobserved periods instead of replacing them with zero. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把暴露量、受傷率與存活率畫成不同資料欄位，說明何時可以及不可以相乘。以兩個季節的假設濃度比較結果，指出長期評估需要的代表性樣本。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate exposure, injury and survival into distinct data fields, explaining when multiplication is justified. Compare hypothetical concentrations in two seasons and identify representative sampling needed for long-term assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把潛在通過數直接稱為死亡數會混淆機制，反之以篩網擋住大魚便推定幼生也受保護則會漏掉不同尺度風險；不完整取樣可讓兩種錯誤同時存在。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling potential passage count mortality confuses mechanisms, while protection of large fish does not demonstrate protection of larvae. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 生物暴露與取樣代表性機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Biological exposure and sampling representation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把潛在通過數直接稱為死亡數會混淆機制，反之以篩網擋住大魚便推定幼生也受保護則會漏掉不同尺度風險；不完整取樣可讓兩種錯誤同時存在。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling potential passage count mortality confuses mechanisms, while protection of large fish does not demonstrate protection of larvae. Incomplete sampling can allow both errors to persist simultaneously. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此算例假設濃度及流量在時段內均勻，得到的是潛在通過數量而非死亡數；實際需考慮空間分布與取樣效率。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濃度乘取水量算出的生物數就等於已證明的死亡數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Concentration times intake volume equals proven biological mortality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「生物暴露與取樣代表性機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排放回流與取水水質」如何影響海水淡化取水工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Outfall recirculation and intake quality” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Seawater-desalination intake works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 取水與排放位置不能各自孤立設計，濃鹽水在潮流轉向、弱流或密度流條件下可能重新進入取水區。回流會提高進水鹽度並改變膜系統能耗及濃水條件，形成系統回饋；只看兩管水平距離不足以判定獨立，需把三維水深、分層及季節水動力一起分析。此例以質量分率混合兩股海水，鹽度用g/kg，沒有混用體積分率；它不預測實際回流比例，該比例需由水動力及現場資料決定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排放回流與取水水質」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intake and outfall cannot be designed independently: brine can return toward the intake during current reversal, weak flow or density-driven transport. Recirculation raises feed salinity and changes membrane energy and concentrate conditions, creating feedback. Horizontal separation alone cannot prove independence; three-dimensional bathymetry, stratification and seasonal hydrodynamics must be assessed together. The example mixes two streams by mass fraction with salinity in g/kg, not volume fraction. It does not predict actual recirculation, which requires hydrodynamic and field evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outfall recirculation and intake quality” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設背景鹽度S0=35 g/kg、回流水Sr=45 g/kg、回流質量分率f=0.10，Sint=(1−f)S0+fSr=36.0 g/kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume background S0=35 g/kg, returning water Sr=45 g/kg and returning mass fraction f=0.10.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要取水口與排放口有一定水平距離就絕對不會回流。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A horizontal separation between intake and outfall guarantees no recirculation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排放回流與取水水質」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

A positive NPSH margin proves that intake vortices and entrained air are absent.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume background S0=35 g/kg, returning water Sr=45 g/kg and returning mass fraction f=0.10.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設背景鹽度S0=35 g/kg、回流水Sr=45 g/kg、回流質量分率f=0.10，Sint=(1−f)S0+fSr=36.0 g/kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume background S0=35 g/kg, returning water Sr=45 g/kg and returning mass fraction f=0.10. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排放回流與取水水質」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Outfall recirculation and intake quality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將取排水鹽度、溫度與海流剖面同步量測，涵蓋潮流反轉及低交換時段。比較適用的近場與遠場模型，保留背景鹽度變化，避免把所有進水升鹽都歸因於本廠排放。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Synchronize intake/outfall salinity and temperature with current profiles, covering reversals and weak exchange. Compare suitable near- and far-field models while retaining natural background variation rather than attributing every feed-salinity increase to the plant’s discharge. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩個假設回流質量分率比較進水鹽度，再指出為何需另解潮流與密度輸送。設計上游背景與取水點的同步比較，避免以受影響水體充當未受影響基線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare feed salinity at two assumed returning mass fractions and explain why tidal and density transport still need separate solution. Design synchronized background and intake observations without using affected water as an unaffected baseline.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Synchronize intake/outfall salinity and temperature with current profiles, covering reversals and weak exchange. Compare suitable near- and far-field models while retaining natural background variation rather than attributing every feed-salinity increase to the plant’s discharge.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification"?
options: 將取排水鹽度、溫度與海流剖面同步量測，涵蓋潮流反轉及低交換時段。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要提高抽吸就能無限制補償濾床或地下取水層的堵塞。
optionsEn: Synchronize intake/outfall salinity and temperature with current profiles, covering reversals and weak exchange.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Increasing suction can compensate indefinitely for filter or subsurface-intake clogging.
quiz.explanation: 將取排水鹽度、溫度與海流剖面同步量測，涵蓋潮流反轉及低交換時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Synchronize intake/outfall salinity and temperature with current profiles, covering reversals and weak exchange. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排放回流與取水水質」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Outfall recirculation and intake quality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity. If the elevated intake salinity is then treated as natural background, long-term discharge effects are hidden inside the baseline and appear self-justifying. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此例以質量分率混合兩股海水，鹽度用g/kg，沒有混用體積分率；它不預測實際回流比例，該比例需由水動力及現場資料決定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not predict actual recirculation, which requires hydrodynamic and field evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要取水口與排放口有一定水平距離就絕對不會回流。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A horizontal separation between intake and outfall guarantees no recirculation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity. If the elevated intake salinity is then treated as natural background, long-term discharge effects are hidden inside the baseline and appear self-justifying.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「排放回流與取水水質機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Outfall recirculation and intake quality mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。
淡化廠標示的產品水容量就等於需要的海水取水流量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity.
A plant’s stated product capacity equals the required seawater intake flow.
quiz.explanation: 忽略回流可能低估膜進水負荷與排放濃度，若又以升高後的取水鹽度當自然背景，會把排放造成的長期增加藏進基線，形成自我合理化的比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring recirculation can understate feed loading and discharge salinity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 海水淡化鹵水擴散排放
courses.summary: 本課逐步拆解膜段鹽量、背景稀釋、孔口流速、密度差、噴流動量與海域交換，建立可檢核的鹵水擴散分析鏈。近場、遠場和長期箱體各有控制體與適用邊界，必須分別驗證後才銜接；全部算例為原創假設，並非實廠排放或許可限值。
courses.summaryEn: This course develops a checkable brine-analysis chain through membrane salt balance, background dilution, port velocity, density contrast, jet momentum and receiving-basin exchange. Near-field, far-field and long-term box models have distinct control volumes and validity limits that require separate verification before coupling. All calculations use original assumptions, not plant discharge measurements or permit limits.
courses.focus: 從鹽量守恆到負浮力排放的多尺度驗證
courses.focusEn: Multiscale verification from salt conservation to negatively buoyant discharge
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度算例固定單孔流量q=0.050 m³/s及縮減重力g′=0.15 m/s²，只將孔徑由0.20 m增加至0.22 m。面平均噴速由1.5915降至1.3153 m/s，降低17.36%；密度福祿數由9.1888降至7.2407，降低21.20%，因固定流量時速度隨孔徑平方反比而變，福祿數隨孔徑的二點五次方反比。這只比較初始尺度，沒有把福祿數當成稀釋倍數，也沒有預測海床接觸點。實際比較還需幹管壓力、角度、潮流和多孔交互作用，不能只依孔徑變大就宣稱環境改善。
workedExample.textEn: For sensitivity, hold one-port flow q=0.050 m³/s and reduced gravity g′=0.15 m/s² fixed while increasing diameter from 0.20 to 0.22 m. Mean exit velocity falls from 1.5915 to 1.3153 m/s, a 17.36% reduction. Densimetric Froude number falls from 9.1888 to 7.2407, a 21.20% reduction: velocity varies as diameter to the power −2 and Froude number as diameter to the power −2.5 at fixed flow. These are initial-scale comparisons, not dilution predictions or seabed-contact locations. Header pressure, discharge angle, tidal currents, seabed clearance and multiport interaction remain necessary before judging environmental performance. The calculation does not establish an ecological threshold or discharge approval.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排放Sb=60 g/kg、背景Sa=35 g/kg、質量稀釋D=10，混合Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總Q=0.40 m³/s、孔數n=8、直徑d=0.15 m，單孔q=0.050 m³/s，v=q/(πd²/4)=2.829 m/s。

原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單孔ρ=1040 kg/m³、q=0.050 m³/s、v=3.0 m/s，動量力F=ρqv=156 N；運動學通量qv=0.150 m⁴/s²。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0. Concentrate mb=600 kg/s and Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge Sb=60 g/kg, ambient Sa=35 g/kg and mass dilution D=10. Mixed Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume total Q=0.40 m³/s, n=8 ports and diameter d=0.15 m. Each q=0.050 m³/s and v=q/(πd²/4)=2.829 m/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge ρb=1040 kg/m³, ambient ρa=1025 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Reduced-gravity magnitude g′=g(ρb−ρa)/ρa=0.1436 m/s².

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m. Densimetric Froude number Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one port ρ=1040 kg/m³, q=0.050 m³/s and v=3.0 m/s. Momentum force F=ρqv=156 N; kinematic flux qv=0.150 m⁴/s².

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」與「背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification" and "Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濃縮鹽量守恆」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Concentrate salt conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。若用質量鹽度表示濃度，必須同時使用質量流率，並保留產品水殘餘鹽分；以體積流量近似時則須明說密度差的處理。濃水濃度不只決定排口鹽負荷，也會改變密度、浮力與混合路徑，不能把產水效率與海域影響分開看待。本例固定進水質量流率並假設產品完全不含鹽，只作理想守恆；真實產品鹽分、藥劑與其他支流需要另外計入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濃縮鹽量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear. Mass-based salinity requires mass flow rates and retention of residual product salt. A volume-flow approximation must state how density differences are treated. Concentrate salinity affects salt loading, density, buoyancy and mixing trajectory, linking recovery decisions to the receiving environment. This ideal balance fixes feed mass flow and assumes salt-free product. Actual product salt, chemical additions and side streams require separate accounting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Concentrate salt conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濃縮鹽量守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Concentrate salt conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Concentrate salt conservation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 淡化膜將進流水分配成產品與濃水，鹽分不會因水量減少而消失。若用質量鹽度表示濃度，必須同時使用質量流率，並保留產品水殘餘鹽分；以體積流量近似時則須明說密度差的處理。
knowledge.textEn: A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear. Mass-based salinity requires mass flow rates and retention of residual product salt.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.question: 關於「濃縮鹽量守恆機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

A membrane separates feed into product and concentrate without making dissolved salt disappear.
Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設進水mf=1000 kg/s、產品mp=400 kg/s、進水鹽度Sf=35 g/kg且Sp=0，mb=600 kg/s，Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume feed mf=1000 kg/s, product mp=400 kg/s, feed Sf=35 g/kg and product Sp=0. Concentrate mb=600 kg/s and Sb=mfSf/mb=58.33 g/kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Concentrate salt conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各股流的流率、密度與鹽度同步量測，統一為質量鹽通量後檢查收支。保留儀表校正與預處理支流資料，確認未把不同時間的最大流量與最高鹽度拼成不存在的工況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure stream flow, density and salinity synchronously, convert them to salt mass flux and check closure. Retain calibration and pretreatment-stream records, ensuring that maxima from different times are not combined into a physically nonexistent operating state. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出三股質量流及鹽通量，先用理想零產品鹽度求解，再加入假設殘餘鹽分。說明哪些流量計資料必須搭配密度才能維持相同守恆基準。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw the three mass and salt flows, solve first with salt-free product, then introduce residual product salinity. Explain which flow-meter data require density to maintain a consistent conservation basis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用質量鹽度直接乘不一致的體積流率會引入密度誤差，忽略產品與排泥鹽分則使收支失真；錯誤的濃度輸入還會傳到負浮力羽流模型。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying mass salinity by inconsistent volume flow introduces density error, while omitted product or sludge salt distorts closure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濃縮鹽量守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 用質量鹽度直接乘不一致的體積流率會引入密度誤差，忽略產品與排泥鹽分則使收支失真；錯誤的濃度輸入還會傳到負浮力羽流模型。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying mass salinity by inconsistent volume flow introduces density error, while omitted product or sludge salt distorts closure. Incorrect concentrate inputs then propagate into the negatively buoyant plume model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Background salinity and dilution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海水本身含鹽，因此稀釋應追蹤相對於背景的鹽度增量，而不是把環境當成無鹽水。以質量流率定義的混合倍數等於混合後總質量流率除以原排放質量流率，對應超額濃度的衰減；中心線、截面平均與通量平均值可能不同，報告中必須明確指明所比較的量。本例為完全混合的質量鹽度守恆，不預測達到該混合倍數的位置，也不把它當作許可或生態允收值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背景鹽度與稀釋定義」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seawater already contains salt, so dilution tracks salinity excess above background rather than treating the environment as freshwater. A mass-flow dilution factor divides mixed total mass flow by discharged mass flow and corresponds to excess-concentration reduction. Centerline, section-averaged and flux-averaged values can differ, making the stated comparison quantity essential. The example is a fully mixed mass-salinity balance. It predicts neither where this dilution occurs nor whether it satisfies a permit or ecological criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Background salinity and dilution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排放Sb=60 g/kg、背景Sa=35 g/kg、質量稀釋D=10，混合Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge Sb=60 g/kg, ambient Sa=35 g/kg and mass dilution D=10.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在排口影響範圍外量測背景剖面，將潮位、深度與取樣時刻和羽流資料配對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure ambient profiles beyond the discharge influence and pair tide, depth and sampling time with plume observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排放Sb=60 g/kg、背景Sa=35 g/kg、質量稀釋D=10，混合Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge Sb=60 g/kg, ambient Sa=35 g/kg and mass dilution D=10. Mixed Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排放Sb=60 g/kg、背景Sa=35 g/kg、質量稀釋D=10，混合Sm=Sa+(Sb−Sa)/D=37.5 g/kg。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge Sb=60 g/kg, ambient Sa=35 g/kg and mass dilution D=10.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge Sb=60 g/kg, ambient Sa=35 g/kg and mass dilution D=10. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「背景鹽度與稀釋定義」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Background salinity and dilution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在排口影響範圍外量測背景剖面，將潮位、深度與取樣時刻和羽流資料配對。檢查模型輸出是中心線或平均濃度，再以一致的質量或體積定義換算稀釋倍數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure ambient profiles beyond the discharge influence and pair tide, depth and sampling time with plume observations. Determine whether model outputs are centerline or averaged concentrations, then convert dilution using a consistent mass or volume definition throughout the comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同排放鹽度比較有鹽與無鹽背景，計算兩種混合結果並指出物理差異。為中心線與通量平均輸出各寫一句精確圖說，避免讀者以為兩者相同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare saline and salt-free backgrounds for the same discharge, calculating both mixtures and explaining the physical difference. Write precise captions for centerline and flux-averaged outputs so readers do not mistake them for identical quantities.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用排放鹽度直接除以稀釋倍數會得到低於背景的不合理結果，混用中心線與平均濃度則可能低估局部暴露；背景採樣受排口污染時也會掩蓋真實增量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dividing discharge salinity directly by dilution can produce an impossible value below ambient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure ambient profiles beyond the discharge influence and pair tide, depth and sampling time with plume observations. Determine whether model outputs are centerline or averaged concentrations, then convert dilution using a consistent mass or volume definition throughout the comparison.

knowledge.text: 用相同排放鹽度比較有鹽與無鹽背景，計算兩種混合結果並指出物理差異。為中心線與通量平均輸出各寫一句精確圖說，避免讀者以為兩者相同。
knowledge.textEn: Compare saline and salt-free backgrounds for the same discharge, calculating both mixtures and explaining the physical difference. Write precise captions for centerline and flux-averaged outputs so readers do not mistake them for identical quantities.

quiz.question: 要驗證「背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在排口影響範圍外量測背景剖面，將潮位、深度與取樣時刻和羽流資料配對。
排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure ambient profiles beyond the discharge influence and pair tide, depth and sampling time with plume observations.
Rapid mixing near the outlet makes a long-term salt budget unnecessary in a semi-enclosed bay.
quiz.explanation: 在排口影響範圍外量測背景剖面，將潮位、深度與取樣時刻和羽流資料配對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure ambient profiles beyond the discharge influence and pair tide, depth and sampling time with plume observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背景鹽度與稀釋定義」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Background salinity and dilution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用排放鹽度直接除以稀釋倍數會得到低於背景的不合理結果，混用中心線與平均濃度則可能低估局部暴露；背景採樣受排口污染時也會掩蓋真實增量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing discharge salinity directly by dilution can produce an impossible value below ambient. Mixing centerline and average concentration may understate local exposure, and contaminated background sampling can conceal the actual increment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為完全混合的質量鹽度守恆，不預測達到該混合倍數的位置，也不把它當作許可或生態允收值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It predicts neither where this dilution occurs nor whether it satisfies a permit or ecological criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用排放鹽度直接除以稀釋倍數會得到低於背景的不合理結果，混用中心線與平均濃度則可能低估局部暴露；背景採樣受排口污染時也會掩蓋真實增量。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing discharge salinity directly by dilution can produce an impossible value below ambient. Mixing centerline and average concentration may understate local exposure, and contaminated background sampling can conceal the actual increment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「背景鹽度與稀釋定義機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Background salinity and dilution mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。
用排放鹽度直接除以稀釋倍數會得到低於背景的不合理結果，混用中心線與平均濃度則可能低估局部暴露；背景採樣受排口污染時也會掩蓋真實增量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states.
Dividing discharge salinity directly by dilution can produce an impossible value below ambient.
quiz.explanation: 用排放鹽度直接除以稀釋倍數會得到低於背景的不合理結果，混用中心線與平均濃度則可能低估局部暴露；背景採樣受排口污染時也會掩蓋真實增量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing discharge salinity directly by dilution can produce an impossible value below ambient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「多孔流量分配機理與驗證」與「密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Multiport flow distribution mechanism and verification" and "Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 多孔流量分配機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Multiport flow distribution mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「多孔流量分配」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Multiport flow distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擴散器將總排放分配到多個噴口以改變初始動量與接觸環境水的方式，但各孔未必等量。幹管沿程損失、孔口高程、局部背壓與堵塞會使流量偏向部分噴口；因此總流量除以孔數只是一個起始假設，不能取代幹管壓力與孔口出流的聯立分析。以下圓孔速度使用相同孔徑與等量流分配，未包含收縮係數；實際縮流速度與幾何面平均速度需要區分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多孔流量分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A diffuser divides discharge among ports to modify initial momentum and contact with ambient water, but equal port flow is not guaranteed. Header friction, elevation, local backpressure and blockage redistribute discharge. Dividing total flow by port count is therefore an initial assumption, not a substitute for coupled header-pressure and orifice-flow analysis. The circular-port calculation assumes identical diameters and equal flow, without a contraction coefficient. Actual contracted-jet velocity and geometric-area mean velocity must be distinguished. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Multiport flow distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總Q=0.40 m³/s、孔數n=8、直徑d=0.15 m，單孔q=0.050 m³/s，v=q/(πd²/4)=2.829 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume total Q=0.40 m³/s, n=8 ports and diameter d=0.15 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「多孔流量分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Multiport flow distribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 多孔流量分配機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Multiport flow distribution mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 擴散器將總排放分配到多個噴口以改變初始動量與接觸環境水的方式，但各孔未必等量。幹管沿程損失、孔口高程、局部背壓與堵塞會使流量偏向部分噴口；因此總流量除以孔數只是一個起始假設，不能取代幹管壓力與孔口出流的聯立分析。
knowledge.textEn: A diffuser divides discharge among ports to modify initial momentum and contact with ambient water, but equal port flow is not guaranteed. Header friction, elevation, local backpressure and blockage redistribute discharge.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「多孔流量分配機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Multiport flow distribution mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 擴散器將總排放分配到多個噴口以改變初始動量與接觸環境水的方式，但各孔未必等量。
多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。
只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。
optionsEn: A diffuser divides discharge among ports to modify initial momentum and contact with ambient water, but equal port flow is not guaranteed.
Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states.
Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused.
quiz.explanation: 擴散器將總排放分配到多個噴口以改變初始動量與接觸環境水的方式，但各孔未必等量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A diffuser divides discharge among ports to modify initial momentum and contact with ambient water, but equal port flow is not guaranteed. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 多孔流量分配機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Multiport flow distribution mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「多孔流量分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Multiport flow distribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總Q=0.40 m³/s、孔數n=8、直徑d=0.15 m，單孔q=0.050 m³/s，v=q/(πd²/4)=2.829 m/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Each q=0.050 m³/s and v=q/(πd²/4)=2.829 m/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對每孔幾何、標高與壓力，將可量測的分流量和總流量對帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check each port geometry, elevation and pressure, reconciling measured branch flows with the total.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 多孔流量分配機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Multiport flow distribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對每孔幾何、標高與壓力，將可量測的分流量和總流量對帳。以部分堵塞及低流量情境測試均勻分配假設，並區分孔面速度、縮流速度及後續羽流平均速度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check each port geometry, elevation and pressure, reconciling measured branch flows with the total. Test equal-flow assumptions under partial blockage and low discharge, distinguishing geometric port velocity, contracted-jet velocity and subsequent plume-average velocity in all records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以孔數平均會忽略堵孔造成的局部高速及動量增大，低流量時部分孔也可能受到逆流影響；用錯有效孔徑會透過平方關係放大速度誤差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A port-count average misses local acceleration and momentum increases caused by blockage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 只以孔數平均會忽略堵孔造成的局部高速及動量增大，低流量時部分孔也可能受到逆流影響；用錯有效孔徑會透過平方關係放大速度誤差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度差與縮減重力」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Density contrast and reduced gravity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹵水通常比受納海水密度大，其浮力方向與較淡的污水羽流不同。密度差受鹽度和溫度共同影響，應在相同壓力基準下比較；縮減重力把密度差轉為浮力尺度，但並不單獨決定上升高度、落點或海床濃度，這些仍取決於噴射動量與環境流場。本例採環境密度作分母，計算負浮力的大小；若座標向上為正，對較重排放的有號浮力加速度應另記為負值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度差與縮減重力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Brine is commonly denser than receiving seawater, giving it the opposite buoyancy direction to a fresher wastewater plume. Salinity and temperature jointly affect density and must be compared at a consistent pressure basis. Reduced gravity expresses the density contrast as a buoyancy scale, but jet momentum and ambient flow are still needed to predict rise, return or seabed concentration. Ambient density is the reference denominator and the calculation gives negative-buoyancy magnitude. With upward positive, the signed buoyancy acceleration for denser discharge is negative. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Density contrast and reduced gravity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排放ρb=1040 kg/m³、環境ρa=1025 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，g′=g(ρb−ρa)/ρa=0.1436 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume discharge ρb=1040 kg/m³, ambient ρa=1025 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度差與縮減重力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Density contrast and reduced gravity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為相同鹽度差建立兩種溫度情境，說明密度資料如何改變浮力輸入。畫出向上為正的座標，標記重鹵水的浮力方向及需要額外求解的軌跡。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create two temperature scenarios for the same salinity contrast and explain how density data change buoyancy input. Draw an upward-positive coordinate system, marking dense-brine buoyancy and the trajectory that still requires solution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把負浮力套入只適合上浮羽流的終止或遠場假設，可能漏掉海床接觸與沿底擴散；忽略溫度差也可能誤估密度差大小甚至方向。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Check model sign conventions and reference density, and test the zero-density-difference limit to confirm that the buoyancy term vanishes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification"?

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear.
quiz.explanation: 將排放與環境溫鹽資料轉成一致密度基準，保留垂向分層而非只取表層樣本。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert discharge and ambient temperature-salinity data to consistent density estimates, retaining vertical stratification rather than only surface samples. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度差與縮減重力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Density contrast and reduced gravity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把負浮力套入只適合上浮羽流的終止或遠場假設，可能漏掉海床接觸與沿底擴散；忽略溫度差也可能誤估密度差大小甚至方向。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading. Ignoring temperature differences can also misestimate the magnitude or even direction of the density contrast. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例採環境密度作分母，計算負浮力的大小；若座標向上為正，對較重排放的有號浮力加速度應另記為負值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: With upward positive, the signed buoyancy acceleration for denser discharge is negative.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading. Ignoring temperature differences can also misestimate the magnitude or even direction of the density contrast.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度差與縮減重力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Density contrast and reduced gravity mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把負浮力套入只適合上浮羽流的終止或遠場假設，可能漏掉海床接觸與沿底擴散；忽略溫度差也可能誤估密度差大小甚至方向。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
quiz.explanation: 把負浮力套入只適合上浮羽流的終止或遠場假設，可能漏掉海床接觸與沿底擴散；忽略溫度差也可能誤估密度差大小甚至方向。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying rising-plume termination or far-field assumptions to negative buoyancy can omit seabed contact and bottom spreading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「密度福祿數機理與驗證」與「動量通量與反力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification" and "Momentum flux and reaction mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「密度福祿數」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Densimetric Froude number” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度福祿數比較噴口慣性與密度差浮力，以孔徑、噴射速度及縮減重力構成無量綱比例。較大的比例代表初始動量相對較強，卻不保證所有位置的稀釋更好；出口角度、海床距離、相鄰噴流與環境流向都會改變後續軌跡，必須在相似條件下比較。本例使用單孔圓射流的尺度定義，沒有套入未驗證的經驗稀釋係數；無量綱值不能直接當成稀釋倍數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密度福祿數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The densimetric Froude number compares port inertia with density-driven buoyancy using diameter, velocity and reduced gravity. A larger ratio indicates stronger initial momentum relative to buoyancy but does not guarantee better dilution everywhere. Discharge angle, bed clearance, neighboring jets and ambient-current direction alter the subsequent trajectory, so comparisons require compatible conditions. The example uses the scale definition for one circular jet without an unverified empirical dilution coefficient. This dimensionless value is not itself a dilution factor. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Densimetric Froude number” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「密度福祿數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Densimetric Froude number”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 密度福祿數比較噴口慣性與密度差浮力，以孔徑、噴射速度及縮減重力構成無量綱比例。較大的比例代表初始動量相對較強，卻不保證所有位置的稀釋更好；出口角度、海床距離、相鄰噴流與環境流向都會改變後續軌跡，必須在相似條件下比較。
knowledge.textEn: The densimetric Froude number compares port inertia with density-driven buoyancy using diameter, velocity and reduced gravity. A larger ratio indicates stronger initial momentum relative to buoyancy but does not guarantee better dilution everywhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「密度福祿數機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。
密度福祿數比較噴口慣性與密度差浮力，以孔徑、噴射速度及縮減重力構成無量綱比例。
optionsEn: Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition.
The densimetric Froude number compares port inertia with density-driven buoyancy using diameter, velocity and reduced gravity.
quiz.explanation: 密度福祿數比較噴口慣性與密度差浮力，以孔徑、噴射速度及縮減重力構成無量綱比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The densimetric Froude number compares port inertia with density-driven buoyancy using diameter, velocity and reduced gravity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「密度福祿數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Densimetric Froude number” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m. Densimetric Froude number Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐項核對孔徑、速度截面及密度差的定義，確認比較試驗使用相同角度和邊界條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check diameter, velocity section and density-contrast definitions, ensuring comparison experiments use matching angles and boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m. Densimetric Froude number Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「密度福祿數機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。
海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。
感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m.
Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted.
A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設噴速v=3.0 m/s、g′=0.15 m/s²、孔徑d=0.20 m，Fd=v/√(g′d)=17.32。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume jet speed v=3.0 m/s, g′=0.15 m/s² and diameter d=0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「密度福祿數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Densimetric Froude number” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐項核對孔徑、速度截面及密度差的定義，確認比較試驗使用相同角度和邊界條件。對照實驗或適用模型的參數範圍，並另行驗證海床接觸位置與峰值濃度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check diameter, velocity section and density-contrast definitions, ensuring comparison experiments use matching angles and boundaries. Compare inputs with the validated parameter range of the experiment or model, and independently verify seabed contact location and peak concentration before interpreting performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在固定流量下將孔徑增加一成，分別更新面積、噴速與福祿數。說明為何不能只把孔徑代入分母而保持速度不變，並列出仍未求解的環境結果。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase diameter by ten percent at fixed flow and update area, velocity and Froude number separately. Explain why velocity cannot remain fixed while only the denominator changes, and identify environmental outcomes still unresolved.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把福祿數當稀釋倍數會省略真正的混合過程，增加噴速也可能把高濃度水送到敏感區；超出經驗式試驗範圍時，漂亮的無量綱圖不代表預測可靠。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating Froude number as dilution bypasses the mixing process, and increased velocity can carry concentrated water toward sensitive locations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐項核對孔徑、速度截面及密度差的定義，確認比較試驗使用相同角度和邊界條件。對照實驗或適用模型的參數範圍，並另行驗證海床接觸位置與峰值濃度。
knowledge.textEn: Check diameter, velocity section and density-contrast definitions, ensuring comparison experiments use matching angles and boundaries. Compare inputs with the validated parameter range of the experiment or model, and independently verify seabed contact location and peak concentration before interpreting performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在固定流量下將孔徑增加一成，分別更新面積、噴速與福祿數。說明為何不能只把孔徑代入分母而保持速度不變，並列出仍未求解的環境結果。
knowledge.textEn: Increase diameter by ten percent at fixed flow and update area, velocity and Froude number separately. Explain why velocity cannot remain fixed while only the denominator changes, and identify environmental outcomes still unresolved.

quiz.question: 要驗證「密度福祿數機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
逐項核對孔徑、速度截面及密度差的定義，確認比較試驗使用相同角度和邊界條件。
海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check diameter, velocity section and density-contrast definitions, ensuring comparison experiments use matching angles and boundaries.
Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten.
quiz.explanation: 逐項核對孔徑、速度截面及密度差的定義，確認比較試驗使用相同角度和邊界條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check diameter, velocity section and density-contrast definitions, ensuring comparison experiments use matching angles and boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 密度福祿數機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「密度福祿數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Densimetric Froude number” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把福祿數當稀釋倍數會省略真正的混合過程，增加噴速也可能把高濃度水送到敏感區；超出經驗式試驗範圍時，漂亮的無量綱圖不代表預測可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating Froude number as dilution bypasses the mixing process, and increased velocity can carry concentrated water toward sensitive locations. Outside an empirical correlation’s test range, a neat dimensionless plot does not establish predictive reliability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例使用單孔圓射流的尺度定義，沒有套入未驗證的經驗稀釋係數；無量綱值不能直接當成稀釋倍數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This dimensionless value is not itself a dilution factor.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把福祿數當稀釋倍數會省略真正的混合過程，增加噴速也可能把高濃度水送到敏感區；超出經驗式試驗範圍時，漂亮的無量綱圖不代表預測可靠。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密度福祿數機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Densimetric Froude number mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。
把福祿數當稀釋倍數會省略真正的混合過程，增加噴速也可能把高濃度水送到敏感區；超出經驗式試驗範圍時，漂亮的無量綱圖不代表預測可靠。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition.
Treating Froude number as dilution bypasses the mixing process, and increased velocity can carry concentrated water toward sensitive locations.
quiz.explanation: 把福祿數當稀釋倍數會省略真正的混合過程，增加噴速也可能把高濃度水送到敏感區；超出經驗式試驗範圍時，漂亮的無量綱圖不代表預測可靠。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 動量通量與反力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Momentum flux and reaction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「動量通量與反力」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Momentum flux and reaction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 噴口把壓力能轉為射流動量，單孔的運動學動量通量與真正的力具有不同單位。若需估算構件反力，必須包含密度並考慮方向與控制體上的壓力作用；只加上所有速度大小不會得到合力，對向噴口的水平分量可能抵消而垂直分量仍保留。以下只算均勻自由射流的動量力大小，未含幹管壓力、彎頭及支承作用；不能直接拿此數值設計整支擴散管錨定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「動量通量與反力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A port converts pressure energy into jet momentum, but kinematic momentum flux and force have different units. Estimating structural reaction requires density, direction and pressure forces on the control volume. Adding speed magnitudes does not produce a resultant: opposing horizontal components may cancel while vertical components remain. This calculates momentum-force magnitude for a uniform free jet only, excluding header pressure, bends and supports. It is not a complete anchorage load for the diffuser. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Momentum flux and reaction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單孔ρ=1040 kg/m³、q=0.050 m³/s、v=3.0 m/s，動量力F=ρqv=156 N；運動學通量qv=0.150 m⁴/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one port ρ=1040 kg/m³, q=0.050 m³/s and v=3.0 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「動量通量與反力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Momentum flux and reaction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「動量通量與反力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition.
Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition.

steps.title: 動量通量與反力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Momentum flux and reaction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「動量通量與反力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Momentum flux and reaction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單孔ρ=1040 kg/m³、q=0.050 m³/s、v=3.0 m/s，動量力F=ρqv=156 N；運動學通量qv=0.150 m⁴/s²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume one port ρ=1040 kg/m³, q=0.050 m³/s and v=3.0 m/s. Momentum force F=ρqv=156 N; kinematic flux qv=0.150 m⁴/s². Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在控制體圖上標明每孔流向、流量及壓力邊界，將動量力分解為座標分量後才求和。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark port directions, flows and pressure boundaries on a control-volume diagram, resolving momentum forces into components before summation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單孔ρ=1040 kg/m³、q=0.050 m³/s、v=3.0 m/s，動量力F=ρqv=156 N；運動學通量qv=0.150 m⁴/s²。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「動量通量與反力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「動量通量與反力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Momentum flux and reaction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在控制體圖上標明每孔流向、流量及壓力邊界，將動量力分解為座標分量後才求和。與支承及幹管內力模型核對載荷傳遞，避免把單孔自由射流值當完整結構反力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark port directions, flows and pressure boundaries on a control-volume diagram, resolving momentum forces into components before summation. Check load transfer against support and header-force models, avoiding use of a single free-jet result as the complete structural reaction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩個對稱斜噴口畫出動量向量，分別求水平與垂直分量。將自由射流反力和幹管壓力端力分開列帳，指出支承模型還需要哪些幾何資料。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏乘密度會把運動學通量誤認成力，忽略方向則可能錯估總反力與扭矩；若再漏掉壓力端力，錨定分析即使數字整齊也缺少必要載荷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting density mistakes kinematic flux for force, while ignoring direction misstates resultant force and torque. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
