Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以下只算均勻自由射流的動量力大小，未含幹管壓力、彎頭及支承作用；不能直接拿此數值設計整支擴散管錨定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not a complete anchorage load for the diffuser.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量乘速度已經是牛頓力，而且所有噴口反力只須加大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Flow times velocity is already force in newtons and port reactions require only scalar addition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏乘密度會把運動學通量誤認成力，忽略方向則可能錯估總反力與扭矩；若再漏掉壓力端力，錨定分析即使數字整齊也缺少必要載荷。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting density mistakes kinematic flux for force, while ignoring direction misstates resultant force and torque. Missing pressure end forces then leaves anchorage analysis incomplete even when its arithmetic appears orderly.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「動量通量與反力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Momentum flux and reaction mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏乘密度會把運動學通量誤認成力，忽略方向則可能錯估總反力與扭矩；若再漏掉壓力端力，錨定分析即使數字整齊也缺少必要載荷。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。
optionsEn: Omitting density mistakes kinematic flux for force, while ignoring direction misstates resultant force and torque.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition.
quiz.explanation: 漏乘密度會把運動學通量誤認成力，忽略方向則可能錯估總反力與扭矩；若再漏掉壓力端力，錨定分析即使數字整齊也缺少必要載荷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting density mistakes kinematic flux for force, while ignoring direction misstates resultant force and torque. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」與「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification" and "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔距與噴流合併」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Port spacing and jet merging” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰射流會在擴展過程中互相影響，過早合併可能減少各自可捲吸的環境水，但是否有利不能只由孔距大小判斷。角度、交錯排列、海流與密度差會改變交會位置；單孔模型的稀釋結果也不能直接乘以孔數當成多孔系統的表現。孔距除以孔徑只是幾何比較，不是通用的無干擾門檻；本例沒有預測合併高度或環境可接受性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔距與噴流合併」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Neighboring jets interact as they widen, and early merging can reduce ambient water available to each jet. Whether a layout is beneficial cannot be judged from spacing alone. Angle, staggering, current and density contrast shift the interaction location, and single-port dilution cannot simply be multiplied by port count to represent the whole diffuser. Spacing divided by diameter is a geometric comparison, not a universal noninteraction threshold. The example predicts neither merging height nor environmental acceptability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Port spacing and jet merging” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設中心孔距s=2.0 m、孔徑d=0.20 m，幾何比例s/d=10；若d增至0.22 m且s不變，比例為9.09。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume center spacing s=2.0 m and diameter d=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔距與噴流合併」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Port spacing and jet merging”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 相鄰射流會在擴展過程中互相影響，過早合併可能減少各自可捲吸的環境水，但是否有利不能只由孔距大小判斷。角度、交錯排列、海流與密度差會改變交會位置；單孔模型的稀釋結果也不能直接乘以孔數當成多孔系統的表現。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring jets interact as they widen, and early merging can reduce ambient water available to each jet. Whether a layout is beneficial cannot be judged from spacing alone.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。
相鄰射流會在擴展過程中互相影響，過早合併可能減少各自可捲吸的環境水，但是否有利不能只由孔距大小判斷。
海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。
optionsEn: Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition.
Neighboring jets interact as they widen, and early merging can reduce ambient water available to each jet.
Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰射流會在擴展過程中互相影響，過早合併可能減少各自可捲吸的環境水，但是否有利不能只由孔距大小判斷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Neighboring jets interact as they widen, and early merging can reduce ambient water available to each jet. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔距與噴流合併」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Port spacing and jet merging” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設中心孔距s=2.0 m、孔徑d=0.20 m，幾何比例s/d=10；若d增至0.22 m且s不變，比例為9.09。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume center spacing s=2.0 m and diameter d=0.20 m. Geometric s/d=10; increasing d to 0.22 m at fixed spacing gives 9.09. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以平面及剖面圖核對孔位和方向，使用適合多孔合併的模型或物理試驗觀察交互作用。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify port positions and directions in plan and section, using a model or physical experiment suited to multiport merging.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設中心孔距s=2.0 m、孔徑d=0.20 m，幾何比例s/d=10；若d增至0.22 m且s不變，比例為9.09。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume center spacing s=2.0 m and diameter d=0.20 m. Geometric s/d=10; increasing d to 0.22 m at fixed spacing gives 9.09.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。
海水鹵水稀釋十倍就是把原始總鹽度直接除以十。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設中心孔距s=2.0 m、孔徑d=0.20 m，幾何比例s/d=10。
optionsEn: A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety.
Tenfold seawater-brine dilution means dividing total original salinity by ten.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume center spacing s=2.0 m and diameter d=0.20 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設中心孔距s=2.0 m、孔徑d=0.20 m，幾何比例s/d=10；若d增至0.22 m且s不變，比例為9.09。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume center spacing s=2.0 m and diameter d=0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔距與噴流合併」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Port spacing and jet merging” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以平面及剖面圖核對孔位和方向，使用適合多孔合併的模型或物理試驗觀察交互作用。檢查低潮、弱流及不同流向，並追蹤環境水可進入噴流間隙的路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify port positions and directions in plan and section, using a model or physical experiment suited to multiport merging. Examine low tide, weak currents and changing current direction, tracking pathways through which ambient water can enter between adjacent jets. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出相同總長度的直列與交錯擴散器，指出可能的合併與捲吸區域。列出區分兩種布局所需的試驗觀察，而不是只用孔數或總長度選優。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw aligned and staggered diffusers of equal total length, marking possible merging and entrainment regions. Identify experimental observations that distinguish their behavior instead of selecting a layout solely by port count or overall length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把某個孔距比例當通用保證可能漏掉回流與合併，部分孔停用後有效排列也會改變；沿用正常全開工況的稀釋率會掩蓋維護或低負荷的不利情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating one spacing ratio as a universal guarantee can miss recirculation and merging. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以平面及剖面圖核對孔位和方向，使用適合多孔合併的模型或物理試驗觀察交互作用。檢查低潮、弱流及不同流向，並追蹤環境水可進入噴流間隙的路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Verify port positions and directions in plan and section, using a model or physical experiment suited to multiport merging. Examine low tide, weak currents and changing current direction, tracking pathways through which ambient water can enter between adjacent jets.

knowledge.text: 畫出相同總長度的直列與交錯擴散器，指出可能的合併與捲吸區域。列出區分兩種布局所需的試驗觀察，而不是只用孔數或總長度選優。
knowledge.textEn: Draw aligned and staggered diffusers of equal total length, marking possible merging and entrainment regions. Identify experimental observations that distinguish their behavior instead of selecting a layout solely by port count or overall length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification"?
options: 以平面及剖面圖核對孔位和方向，使用適合多孔合併的模型或物理試驗觀察交互作用。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要鹽度較高，就可忽略溫度並沿用所有上浮羽流公式。
optionsEn: Verify port positions and directions in plan and section, using a model or physical experiment suited to multiport merging.

Higher salinity allows temperature to be ignored and all rising-plume formulas reused.
quiz.explanation: 以平面及剖面圖核對孔位和方向，使用適合多孔合併的模型或物理試驗觀察交互作用。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify port positions and directions in plan and section, using a model or physical experiment suited to multiport merging. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔距與噴流合併」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Port spacing and jet merging” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把某個孔距比例當通用保證可能漏掉回流與合併，部分孔停用後有效排列也會改變；沿用正常全開工況的稀釋率會掩蓋維護或低負荷的不利情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating one spacing ratio as a universal guarantee can miss recirculation and merging. Port shutdown changes the effective arrangement, so normal all-open dilution may conceal unfavorable maintenance or low-load conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

quiz.question: 在「孔距與噴流合併機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Port spacing and jet merging mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把某個孔距比例當通用保證可能漏掉回流與合併，部分孔停用後有效排列也會改變；沿用正常全開工況的稀釋率會掩蓋維護或低負荷的不利情境。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating one spacing ratio as a universal guarantee can miss recirculation and merging.
Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted.
quiz.explanation: 把某個孔距比例當通用保證可能漏掉回流與合併，部分孔停用後有效排列也會改變；沿用正常全開工況的稀釋率會掩蓋維護或低負荷的不利情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating one spacing ratio as a universal guarantee can miss recirculation and merging. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「環境流與停留尺度」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ambient currents and residence scales” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離開初始動量主導區後，羽流會受到海流、潮汐反轉及紊動輸送影響。以流速乘時間只能估計被動水團的平移尺度，不能描述密度流沿底滑動或回流累積；弱流時平均流向也可能不穩定，單一順流斷面可能漏掉往返經過的高鹽水。本例假設速度均勻且方向不變，忽略擴散、剪切及重力流；平移距離不是混合區邊界或鹽度達標距離。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「環境流與停留尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beyond the initial momentum-dominated region, currents, tidal reversal and turbulence influence transport. Velocity times time estimates passive water-parcel translation but does not describe bottom density currents or recirculating accumulation. Under weak flow the mean direction may be unstable, and one downstream transect can miss concentrated water returning with the tide. The example assumes uniform constant-direction velocity, excluding dispersion, shear and gravity currents. Translation distance is neither a mixing-zone boundary nor a distance to a salinity target. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ambient currents and residence scales” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻海流U=0.10 m/s、時間t=1800 s，被動平移尺度x=Ut=180 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform current U=0.10 m/s and time t=1800 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「環境流與停留尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ambient currents and residence scales”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 離開初始動量主導區後，羽流會受到海流、潮汐反轉及紊動輸送影響。以流速乘時間只能估計被動水團的平移尺度，不能描述密度流沿底滑動或回流累積；弱流時平均流向也可能不穩定，單一順流斷面可能漏掉往返經過的高鹽水。
knowledge.textEn: Beyond the initial momentum-dominated region, currents, tidal reversal and turbulence influence transport. Velocity times time estimates passive water-parcel translation but does not describe bottom density currents or recirculating accumulation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。
排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。
離開初始動量主導區後，羽流會受到海流、潮汐反轉及紊動輸送影響。
optionsEn: Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted.
Rapid mixing near the outlet makes a long-term salt budget unnecessary in a semi-enclosed bay.
Beyond the initial momentum-dominated region, currents, tidal reversal and turbulence influence transport.
quiz.explanation: 離開初始動量主導區後，羽流會受到海流、潮汐反轉及紊動輸送影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beyond the initial momentum-dominated region, currents, tidal reversal and turbulence influence transport. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「環境流與停留尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ambient currents and residence scales” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻海流U=0.10 m/s、時間t=1800 s，被動平移尺度x=Ut=180 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform current U=0.10 m/s and time t=1800 s. Passive translation scale x=Ut=180 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻海流U=0.10 m/s、時間t=1800 s，被動平移尺度x=Ut=180 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform current U=0.10 m/s and time t=1800 s. Passive translation scale x=Ut=180 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻海流U=0.10 m/s、時間t=1800 s，被動平移尺度x=Ut=180 m。
提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。
多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform current U=0.10 m/s and time t=1800 s.
Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear.
Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設均勻海流U=0.10 m/s、時間t=1800 s，被動平移尺度x=Ut=180 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume uniform current U=0.10 m/s and time t=1800 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「環境流與停留尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ambient currents and residence scales” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。檢查近場與遠場銜接時的濃度、位置及通量連續性，另確認負浮力接觸海床後的模型適用性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals. Check concentration, position and flux continuity between near and far fields, separately confirming model validity after negatively buoyant flow contacts the seabed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較單向流與半小時後反轉的平移示意，說明相同速率不代表相同淨位移或暴露歷史。列出需要三維水動力與密度耦合分析的情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one-way transport with a current reversing after half an hour, explaining why equal speed does not imply equal displacement or exposure history. Identify cases requiring three-dimensional hydrodynamics coupled to density.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。檢查近場與遠場銜接時的濃度、位置及通量連續性，另確認負浮力接觸海床後的模型適用性。
knowledge.textEn: Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals. Check concentration, position and flux continuity between near and far fields, separately confirming model validity after negatively buoyant flow contacts the seabed.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較單向流與半小時後反轉的平移示意，說明相同速率不代表相同淨位移或暴露歷史。列出需要三維水動力與密度耦合分析的情境。
knowledge.textEn: Compare one-way transport with a current reversing after half an hour, explaining why equal speed does not imply equal displacement or exposure history. Identify cases requiring three-dimensional hydrodynamics coupled to density.

quiz.question: 要驗證「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
quiz.explanation: 使用涵蓋潮週期的流速剖面和溫鹽量測，區分平均流、剪切與短時反轉。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use velocity profiles and temperature-salinity measurements spanning tidal cycles to distinguish mean transport, shear and short reversals. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「環境流與停留尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ambient currents and residence scales” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. Connecting a passive far-field module for rising plumes directly to bottom gravity flow can violate assumptions and systematically understate exposure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設速度均勻且方向不變，忽略擴散、剪切及重力流；平移距離不是混合區邊界或鹽度達標距離。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Translation distance is neither a mixing-zone boundary nor a distance to a salinity target.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海流速度乘一小時得到的距離，就是鹵水必然被稀釋完的位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Current speed times one hour gives the distance at which brine is necessarily fully diluted." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. Connecting a passive far-field module for rising plumes directly to bottom gravity flow can violate assumptions and systematically understate exposure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「環境流與停留尺度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ambient currents and residence scales mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
排口附近混合很快，所以半封閉海灣的長期鹽量帳不必計算。
只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Rapid mixing near the outlet makes a long-term salt budget unnecessary in a semi-enclosed bay.
Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow.
quiz.explanation: 只用最大順流速度會低估弱流期停留與累積，直接把上浮羽流的被動遠場模組接到沿底重流也可能違反模型假設，造成系統性低估暴露。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using only maximum favorable current understates residence and accumulation during weak flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證」與「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification" and "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 海域箱體鹽度收支機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Receiving-basin salinity budget mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「海域箱體鹽度收支」如何影響海水淡化鹵水擴散排放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Receiving-basin salinity budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 近場高稀釋不代表半封閉水域不會長期累積鹽分，外海交換、潮汐回流與排放持續時間共同控制背景變化。簡化箱體可以檢查鹽量與交換流的尺度，卻把空間分層和局部高濃度平均掉；因此它適合守恆檢查，不適合取代底棲暴露或敏感區域的空間預測。本例以質量流率表示交換，箱體均勻且穩態，出流等於環境入流加排放；這不是忽略排放增量的近似交換式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「海域箱體鹽度收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Strong near-field dilution does not prevent long-term salt accumulation in a semi-enclosed basin. Exchange with offshore water, tidal return and discharge duration control background change. A simple box checks salt and exchange scales but averages away stratification and local peaks, making it useful for conservation checks rather than spatial prediction of benthic exposure. The example uses mass flow, a uniform steady box, and outflow equal to ambient inflow plus discharge. It does not omit the additional discharged mass from the outlet balance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Receiving-basin salinity budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設外海入流Ma=9000 kg/s、Sa=35 g/kg，排放Mb=1000 kg/s、Sb=60 g/kg，穩態S=(MaSa+MbSb)/(Ma+Mb)=37.5 g/kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 先核對箱體水量與鹽量收支，確認外海交換不是重複計入同一來回潮水。用多深度長時間觀測測試均勻穩態假設，並對交換減弱及初始鹽度做敏感度比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check both water and salt balances, ensuring that offshore exchange does not count the same returning tidal water twice. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating all back-and-forth tidal flow as fresh offshore exchange overstates flushing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Monitoring uncertainty and exposure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Brine diffuser outfalls for desalination”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽度監測需要同時控制感測器校正、溫度補償、深度定位與時間對齊，否則小幅鹽度增量可能與量測偏差混淆。單點超額鹽度不能直接代表整個生態系的暴露，還必須關注持續時間、空間範圍與背景變化；不確定度的合成也取決於誤差是否獨立。下式只合成兩個獨立標準不確定度，未加涵蓋因子或系統漂移；它不是法定容許誤差，也不是生態效應門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「監測誤差與暴露判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salinity monitoring requires calibration, temperature compensation, depth control and synchronized timing, because a small salinity increment can be confused with measurement bias. One-point excess salinity does not represent exposure of the entire ecosystem; duration, spatial extent and background variation also matter. Combining uncertainty requires attention to whether errors are independent. The expression combines two independent standard uncertainties only, without a coverage factor or systematic drift. It is neither a legal tolerance nor an ecological-effect threshold. knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。
鹽度監測需要同時控制感測器校正、溫度補償、深度定位與時間對齊，否則小幅鹽度增量可能與量測偏差混淆。
提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。
optionsEn: A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety.
Salinity monitoring requires calibration, temperature compensation, depth control and synchronized timing, because a small salinity increment can be confused with measurement bias.
Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear.
quiz.explanation: 鹽度監測需要同時控制感測器校正、溫度補償、深度定位與時間對齊，否則小幅鹽度增量可能與量測偏差混淆。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Salinity monitoring requires calibration, temperature compensation, depth control and synchronized timing, because a small salinity increment can be confused with measurement bias. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「監測誤差與暴露判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Monitoring uncertainty and exposure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排口樣本與背景標準不確定度各u1=u2=0.10 g/kg且獨立，差值uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sample and background standard uncertainties u1=u2=0.10 g/kg. Difference uncertainty uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將校正前後結果、重複樣本與定位資料保留，核對兩儀器是否共享偏差來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain before-and-after calibration, duplicate samples and positioning records, checking whether instruments share bias sources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排口樣本與背景標準不確定度各u1=u2=0.10 g/kg且獨立，差值uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sample and background standard uncertainties u1=u2=0.10 g/kg. Difference uncertainty uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 多孔擴散器的每個孔在所有流量和堵塞狀態下必定等量。
密度福祿數等於最後稀釋倍數，而且越大就一定越環保。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排口樣本與背景標準不確定度各u1=u2=0.10 g/kg且獨立，差值uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg。
optionsEn: Every diffuser port carries equal flow at all discharges and blockage states.
Densimetric Froude number equals final dilution and a larger value always means less impact.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sample and background standard uncertainties u1=u2=0.10 g/kg.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排口樣本與背景標準不確定度各u1=u2=0.10 g/kg且獨立，差值uΔ=√(u1²+u2²)=0.1414 g/kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sample and background standard uncertainties u1=u2=0.10 g/kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「監測誤差與暴露判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Monitoring uncertainty and exposure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將校正前後結果、重複樣本與定位資料保留，核對兩儀器是否共享偏差來源。以相同潮相和深度比較背景及影響區，並把量測不確定度、暴露持續時間與生態證據分開報告。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain before-and-after calibration, duplicate samples and positioning records, checking whether instruments share bias sources. Compare background and affected locations at matched tidal phase and depth, reporting measurement uncertainty, exposure duration and ecological evidence as distinct components of the assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩支感測器列出獨立與共同誤差來源，說明哪些可以平方和合成。設計跨潮位、深度與時間的對照採樣表，將濃度證據和生態解釋清楚分欄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List independent and shared error sources for two sensors and identify which support root-sum-square combination. Design paired sampling across tide, depth and time, keeping concentration evidence separate from ecological interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同校正偏差不一定符合獨立平方和假設，漂移也不會靠增加樣本自動消失；將短時單點差異直接描述成長期生態安全或危害，會超出資料支持範圍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shared calibration bias may violate the independent root-sum-square assumption, and drift does not vanish automatically with more samples. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將校正前後結果、重複樣本與定位資料保留，核對兩儀器是否共享偏差來源。以相同潮相和深度比較背景及影響區，並把量測不確定度、暴露持續時間與生態證據分開報告。
knowledge.textEn: Retain before-and-after calibration, duplicate samples and positioning records, checking whether instruments share bias sources. Compare background and affected locations at matched tidal phase and depth, reporting measurement uncertainty, exposure duration and ecological evidence as distinct components of the assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩支感測器列出獨立與共同誤差來源，說明哪些可以平方和合成。設計跨潮位、深度與時間的對照採樣表，將濃度證據和生態解釋清楚分欄。
knowledge.textEn: List independent and shared error sources for two sensors and identify which support root-sum-square combination. Design paired sampling across tide, depth and time, keeping concentration evidence separate from ecological interpretation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification"?
options: 將校正前後結果、重複樣本與定位資料保留，核對兩儀器是否共享偏差來源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要孔距是孔徑十倍，就能保證任何海況下噴流不互相影響。
optionsEn: Retain before-and-after calibration, duplicate samples and positioning records, checking whether instruments share bias sources.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Spacing of ten diameters guarantees no jet interaction under any marine condition.
quiz.explanation: 將校正前後結果、重複樣本與定位資料保留，核對兩儀器是否共享偏差來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain before-and-after calibration, duplicate samples and positioning records, checking whether instruments share bias sources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「監測誤差與暴露判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Monitoring uncertainty and exposure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共同校正偏差不一定符合獨立平方和假設，漂移也不會靠增加樣本自動消失；將短時單點差異直接描述成長期生態安全或危害，會超出資料支持範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shared calibration bias may violate the independent root-sum-square assumption, and drift does not vanish automatically with more samples. Calling a brief point difference evidence of long-term ecological safety or harm exceeds the observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式只合成兩個獨立標準不確定度，未加涵蓋因子或系統漂移；它不是法定容許誤差，也不是生態效應門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is neither a legal tolerance nor an ecological-effect threshold.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器讀值差很小，就能直接證明長期海域生態完全安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small sensor difference directly proves complete long-term ecological safety." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共同校正偏差不一定符合獨立平方和假設，漂移也不會靠增加樣本自動消失；將短時單點差異直接描述成長期生態安全或危害，會超出資料支持範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Shared calibration bias may violate the independent root-sum-square assumption, and drift does not vanish automatically with more samples. Calling a brief point difference evidence of long-term ecological safety or harm exceeds the observations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「監測誤差與暴露判讀機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Monitoring uncertainty and exposure mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共同校正偏差不一定符合獨立平方和假設，漂移也不會靠增加樣本自動消失；將短時單點差異直接描述成長期生態安全或危害，會超出資料支持範圍。
提高產水回收率會讓剩下濃水中的總鹽量自行消失。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shared calibration bias may violate the independent root-sum-square assumption, and drift does not vanish automatically with more samples.
Higher water recovery makes the remaining concentrate salt disappear.
quiz.explanation: 共同校正偏差不一定符合獨立平方和假設，漂移也不會靠增加樣本自動消失；將短時單點差異直接描述成長期生態安全或危害，會超出資料支持範圍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shared calibration bias may violate the independent root-sum-square assumption, and drift does not vanish automatically with more samples. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 河岸取水口防淤設計
courses.summary: 課程由季節分流和泥砂輸入開始，逐步分析沉降、沉砂面積、起動剪應力、篩網方向與沖砂水量，再以庫容和縮尺試驗建立可驗證的維護策略。紅崖與弗里波特提供真實取水工程背景，所有量值為獨立教學假設，不把水理比較當成魚類保護、許可或現場操作判定。
courses.summaryEn: Starting with seasonal diversion and sediment input, the course develops settling, basin area, incipient-motion stress, screen orientation and flushing-volume analyses, then connects storage and scale experiments to verifiable maintenance planning. Red Bluff and Freeport provide real intake context. Numerical values are independent assumptions, and hydraulic comparisons do not establish fish protection, permission or field operating decisions.
courses.focus: 以泥砂收支與局部水理協調河岸取水防淤
courses.focusEn: Coordinating river-intake sediment budgets with local hydraulics
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度以稀薄、不絮凝球形顆粒的斯托克斯模型為基準，水黏度0.001 Pa·s、顆粒及水密度2650與1000 kg/m³。粒徑由20 μm增至22 μm，只增加10%，沉降速度卻由0.0003597增至0.0004352 m/s，增加21%；顆粒雷諾數由0.00719增至0.00958，仍符合此理想低雷諾數比較。這不能代表絮凝泥或實際沉砂率，因為粒徑分布、短路和再懸浮未納入。若改變粒徑到粗砂，必須重新檢查阻力流態，而不是繼續使用平方比例。
workedExample.textEn: Use the Stokes model for dilute, nonflocculating spheres with viscosity 0.001 Pa·s and particle/water densities 2650 and 1000 kg/m³. Increasing diameter from 20 to 22 μm is only a ten-percent change, but settling speed increases from 0.0003597 to 0.0004352 m/s, or 21%. Particle Reynolds number rises from 0.00719 to 0.00958, remaining small for this ideal comparison. This is not a prediction of flocculating mud or actual basin removal, because size distributions, short-circuiting and resuspension are excluded. Moving to coarse sand requires a fresh drag-regime check rather than continued use of the squared-diameter scaling.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設河流Qr=80 m³/s、取水Qd=8 m³/s，引水比r=Qd/Qr=0.10，忽略其他支流後剩餘72 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=2.0 m³/s、C=0.30 kg/m³、事件t=3600 s，輸入泥砂M=QCt=2160 kg。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρs=2650、ρw=1000 kg/m³、d=20 μm、μ=0.001 Pa·s，ws=(ρs−ρw)gd²/(18μ)=0.0003597 m/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=0.20 m³/s、平面面積A=100 m²，表面負荷vo=Q/A=0.0020 m/s；指定ws=0.003 m/s大於vo。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設θc=0.05、ρs=2650、ρw=1000 kg/m³、d=0.001 m，τc=θc(ρs−ρw)gd=0.8093 Pa。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²、水力半徑R=0.50 m、能坡Sf=0.001，τ=ρgRSf=4.905 Pa。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume river Qr=80 m³/s and diversion Qd=8 m³/s. Fraction r=Qd/Qr=0.10, leaving 72 m³/s when other streams are excluded.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=2.0 m³/s, concentration C=0.30 kg/m³ and duration t=3600 s. Incoming sediment M=QCt=2160 kg.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρs=2650, ρw=1000 kg/m³, d=20 μm and μ=0.001 Pa·s. Stokes ws=(ρs−ρw)gd²/(18μ)=0.0003597 m/s with g=9.81 m/s².

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=0.20 m³/s and plan area A=100 m². Surface loading vo=Q/A=0.0020 m/s; specified ws=0.003 m/s exceeds vo.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume θc=0.05, ρs=2650, ρw=1000 kg/m³ and d=0.001 m. Critical τc=θc(ρs−ρw)gd=0.8093 Pa at g=9.81 m/s².

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, g=9.81 m/s², hydraulic radius R=0.50 m and energy slope Sf=0.001. Mean stress τ=ρgRSf=4.905 Pa.
