steps.instruction: 在測點圖標明篩面切線、法線及感測器方向，依相同離面距離量測速度分量。將面積積分流量與取水計量核對，並在堵塞、低水位與不同機組運轉下重查熱點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark screen tangent, normal and sensor orientation on the survey map, measuring components at consistent offsets. Reconcile area-integrated flow with intake metering and revisit hotspots under blockage, low water and different pump combinations to check spatial representation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為同一來流畫出兩個篩面角度並分解速度，清楚標記角度起算方向。指出幾何比較之外仍需驗證的旁通入口、局部堵塞與物種條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw two screen angles for the same incoming flow and resolve velocities, explicitly marking the angle reference. Identify bypass-entry, local-blockage and species conditions that still need checking beyond the geometric comparison.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把角度從法線量卻套切線公式會交換兩個分量，局部高速區可能因此被低估；只報平均掃流也無法證明魚類可順利到達旁通出口。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Measuring angle from the normal but using tangent-based formulas swaps components and can understate hotspots. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 篩網方向與掃流機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screen orientation and sweeping flow mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「篩網方向與掃流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screen orientation and sweeping flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把角度從法線量卻套切線公式會交換兩個分量，局部高速區可能因此被低估；只報平均掃流也無法證明魚類可順利到達旁通出口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Measuring angle from the normal but using tangent-based formulas swaps components and can understate hotspots. Reporting mean sweeping velocity alone also does not establish successful movement to the bypass outlet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例角度明確定義為流向相對篩面切線的夾角，未把假設速度當魚種標準；接近速度的量測位置須依評估方法指定。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「沿篩速度和穿篩速度只差名稱，因此可以互換使用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sweeping and through-screen velocities differ only in name and can be interchanged." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「篩網方向與掃流機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

把角度從法線量卻套切線公式會交換兩個分量，局部高速區可能因此被低估；只報平均掃流也無法證明魚類可順利到達旁通出口。

Measuring angle from the normal but using tangent-based formulas swaps components and can understate hotspots.
More flushing water is always more effective and downstream redeposition need not be checked.

steps.title: 沖砂水量與事件管理機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flushing volume and event management mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沖砂水量與事件管理」如何影響河岸取水口防淤設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flushing volume and event management” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sediment-resistant river intake design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沖砂不是只要閘門開啟就完成，水量、持續時間和下游輸送能力共同決定效果。短時大流量可能啟動床砂卻在出口形成新沉積，長時低流量則可能不足以維持運移；用水帳還須與供水和河川需求協調，不能把排砂水當作沒有代價的額外資源。本例只求指定穩定排砂流量的總水體積，不預測泥砂去除率，也不建議任何現場開閘順序或時間設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沖砂水量與事件管理」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Opening a gate does not by itself complete sediment flushing. Flow, duration and downstream transport capacity determine performance. A brief large release may mobilize material that redeposits at the outlet, while prolonged low flow may not sustain movement. The water budget must also account for supply and river needs rather than treating flushing water as a free additional resource. The example calculates water volume for a specified constant flushing flow, not sediment removal efficiency. It gives no field gate-opening sequence or operating-time recommendation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flushing volume and event management” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排砂流量Qf=3.0 m³/s、持續t=600 s，使用水量V=Qft=1800 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume flushing flow Qf=3.0 m³/s for t=600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排砂用水越多就必定越有效，而且不用檢查下游再沉積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "More flushing water is always more effective and downstream redeposition need not be checked." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沖砂水量與事件管理」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flushing volume and event management”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Opening a gate does not by itself complete sediment flushing. Flow, duration and downstream transport capacity determine performance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：排砂用水越多就必定越有效，而且不用檢查下游再沉積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「沖砂水量與事件管理機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flushing volume and event management mechanism and verification" is correct?

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設排砂流量Qf=3.0 m³/s、持續t=600 s，使用水量V=Qft=1800 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Water volume V=Qft=1800 m³. steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立一次假設排砂的水量、泥砂輸出與床形變化三本帳。說明三者不一致時可能是取樣、密度換算或泥砂轉移問題，並提出可區分原因的觀察。
knowledge.textEn: Create separate ledgers for flushing water, exported sediment and bed-volume change. Explain how disagreement can reflect sampling, density conversion or relocation, and propose observations that distinguish those possible causes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沖砂水量與事件管理機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Flushing volume and event management mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將排砂前後地形和出流泥砂濃度對時，核對實際水量與輸出質量。
床砂開始動就等於所有泥砂會立即沖走且不會在下游再沉積。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Align before-and-after bathymetry with outgoing sediment concentration, checking actual water volume and exported mass.
Initial bed motion means all sediment immediately flushes away without downstream redeposition.
quiz.explanation: 將排砂前後地形和出流泥砂濃度對時，核對實際水量與輸出質量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align before-and-after bathymetry with outgoing sediment concentration, checking actual water volume and exported mass. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沖砂水量與事件管理機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flushing volume and event management mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沖砂水量與事件管理」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flushing volume and event management” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以耗水量大就推定沖砂有效會忽略低速死區，未檢查下游則可能把取水口的問題搬到河道；沖砂後供水恢復也不能證明所有沉積已清除。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: High water use does not prove effective flushing in low-velocity dead zones. Without downstream checks the intake problem may simply move into the river, and restored supply does not demonstrate complete sediment removal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只求指定穩定排砂流量的總水體積，不預測泥砂去除率，也不建議任何現場開閘順序或時間設定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It gives no field gate-opening sequence or operating-time recommendation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排砂用水越多就必定越有效，而且不用檢查下游再沉積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "More flushing water is always more effective and downstream redeposition need not be checked." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以耗水量大就推定沖砂有效會忽略低速死區，未檢查下游則可能把取水口的問題搬到河道；沖砂後供水恢復也不能證明所有沉積已清除。
knowledge.textEn: High water use does not prove effective flushing in low-velocity dead zones. Without downstream checks the intake problem may simply move into the river, and restored supply does not demonstrate complete sediment removal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沖砂水量與事件管理機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flushing volume and event management mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
清淤間隔只需用總庫容除以全年平均量，不必測局部床形。
以耗水量大就推定沖砂有效會忽略低速死區，未檢查下游則可能把取水口的問題搬到河道；沖砂後供水恢復也不能證明所有沉積已清除。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Maintenance interval needs only total storage divided by annual mean load, without local bed surveys.
High water use does not prove effective flushing in low-velocity dead zones.
quiz.explanation: 以耗水量大就推定沖砂有效會忽略低速死區，未檢查下游則可能把取水口的問題搬到河道；沖砂後供水恢復也不能證明所有沉積已清除。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: High water use does not prove effective flushing in low-velocity dead zones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證」與「實體模型相似限制機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification" and "Physical-model similarity limits mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」如何影響河岸取水口防淤設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Deposit storage and maintenance interval” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Sediment-resistant river intake design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉砂設施需要把固體質量換成含孔隙的沉積體積，才可估計可用庫容與清理需求。顆粒密度不是沉積乾容重，孔隙、含水與固結會改變體積；平均沉積率只提供規劃尺度，洪水脈衝和空間不均可能使局部高程先達限制，不能只等總庫容耗盡。本例採乾固體質量和指定乾容重，忽略固結與事件變動；算得間隔是線性庫容比較，並非實際維護排程。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment storage planning converts solid mass into deposit volume including pores. Grain density is not dry bulk density, and porosity, water content and consolidation alter volume. A mean deposition rate gives a planning scale only: flood pulses and uneven deposits can reach local elevation constraints before total nominal storage is exhausted. The example uses dry solid mass and specified dry bulk density, excluding consolidation and event variability. The interval is a linear storage comparison, not an actual maintenance schedule. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Deposit storage and maintenance interval” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設日沉積乾質量Md=1200 kg/day、乾容重ρd=1500 kg/m³，日體積0.80 m³/day；可用容積40 m³對應50 day。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume deposited dry mass Md=1200 kg/day and dry bulk density ρd=1500 kg/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「清淤間隔只需用總庫容除以全年平均量，不必測局部床形。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maintenance interval needs only total storage divided by annual mean load, without local bed surveys." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Deposit storage and maintenance interval”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 沉砂設施需要把固體質量換成含孔隙的沉積體積，才可估計可用庫容與清理需求。顆粒密度不是沉積乾容重，孔隙、含水與固結會改變體積；平均沉積率只提供規劃尺度，洪水脈衝和空間不均可能使局部高程先達限制，不能只等總庫容耗盡。
knowledge.textEn: Sediment storage planning converts solid mass into deposit volume including pores. Grain density is not dry bulk density, and porosity, water content and consolidation alter volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：清淤間隔只需用總庫容除以全年平均量，不必測局部床形。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maintenance interval needs only total storage divided by annual mean load, without local bed surveys. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 沉砂設施需要把固體質量換成含孔隙的沉積體積，才可估計可用庫容與清理需求。
清淤間隔只需用總庫容除以全年平均量，不必測局部床形。
水工模型保持福祿數後，泥砂起動和所有魚類行為就自然相似。
optionsEn: Sediment storage planning converts solid mass into deposit volume including pores.
Maintenance interval needs only total storage divided by annual mean load, without local bed surveys.
Preserving Froude number automatically preserves sediment motion and all fish behavior.
quiz.explanation: 沉砂設施需要把固體質量換成含孔隙的沉積體積，才可估計可用庫容與清理需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sediment storage planning converts solid mass into deposit volume including pores. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Deposit storage and maintenance interval” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設日沉積乾質量Md=1200 kg/day、乾容重ρd=1500 kg/m³，日體積0.80 m³/day；可用容積40 m³對應50 day。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume deposited dry mass Md=1200 kg/day and dry bulk density ρd=1500 kg/m³. Volume is 0.80 m³/day; 40 m³ usable storage corresponds to 50 days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以代表樣本量測乾容重並以測深確認沉積分布，將清理量、事件負荷與剩餘庫容交叉比對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure representative dry bulk density and map deposit distribution, comparing removed volume, event loads and remaining storage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設日沉積乾質量Md=1200 kg/day、乾容重ρd=1500 kg/m³，日體積0.80 m³/day；可用容積40 m³對應50 day。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume deposited dry mass Md=1200 kg/day and dry bulk density ρd=1500 kg/m³. Volume is 0.80 m³/day; 40 m³ usable storage corresponds to 50 days.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 取水流量固定時，只量一次濁度就能確定整場泥砂輸入。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設日沉積乾質量Md=1200 kg/day、乾容重ρd=1500 kg/m³，日體積0.80 m³/day。
沉砂池只要越深，所有粒徑的理想去除效率就一定越高。
optionsEn: With constant diversion, one turbidity measurement determines the entire event sediment input.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume deposited dry mass Md=1200 kg/day and dry bulk density ρd=1500 kg/m³.
A deeper settling basin necessarily improves ideal removal for every grain size.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設日沉積乾質量Md=1200 kg/day、乾容重ρd=1500 kg/m³，日體積0.80 m³/day；可用容積40 m³對應50 day。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume deposited dry mass Md=1200 kg/day and dry bulk density ρd=1500 kg/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Deposit storage and maintenance interval” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以代表樣本量測乾容重並以測深確認沉積分布，將清理量、事件負荷與剩餘庫容交叉比對。對門檻與取水附近設局部高程檢查，避免用總體積掩蓋關鍵區域先被填滿。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure representative dry bulk density and map deposit distribution, comparing removed volume, event loads and remaining storage. Check local elevations near sills and intake openings so that a total-volume ledger does not conceal critical areas filling before the nominal capacity is reached. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同固體質量在兩種乾容重下的體積，再加入一次假設洪水脈衝。指出庫容帳和局部床形檢查各回答什麼問題，設計可更新間隔的資料表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare deposit volumes at two dry bulk densities, then add a hypothetical flood pulse. Explain the distinct questions answered by storage accounting and local bathymetry, and create a record that supports updating the interval.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用礦物密度代替乾容重會低估堆積體積，以平均日量推算固定清淤日可能漏掉一次大洪水；局部堆積抬高即使總庫容仍足夠也能妨礙取水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using grain density instead of dry bulk density understates deposit volume, and a fixed date based on mean daily load can miss a major flood pulse. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以代表樣本量測乾容重並以測深確認沉積分布，將清理量、事件負荷與剩餘庫容交叉比對。對門檻與取水附近設局部高程檢查，避免用總體積掩蓋關鍵區域先被填滿。
knowledge.textEn: Measure representative dry bulk density and map deposit distribution, comparing removed volume, event loads and remaining storage. Check local elevations near sills and intake openings so that a total-volume ledger does not conceal critical areas filling before the nominal capacity is reached.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較相同固體質量在兩種乾容重下的體積，再加入一次假設洪水脈衝。指出庫容帳和局部床形檢查各回答什麼問題，設計可更新間隔的資料表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare deposit volumes at two dry bulk densities, then add a hypothetical flood pulse. Explain the distinct questions answered by storage accounting and local bathymetry, and create a record that supports updating the interval.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
均勻流平均剪應力就是每個角落與閘門下方的真實床面應力。
以代表樣本量測乾容重並以測深確認沉積分布，將清理量、事件負荷與剩餘庫容交叉比對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Uniform-flow mean shear equals actual bed stress in every corner and beneath every gate.
Measure representative dry bulk density and map deposit distribution, comparing removed volume, event loads and remaining storage.
quiz.explanation: 以代表樣本量測乾容重並以測深確認沉積分布，將清理量、事件負荷與剩餘庫容交叉比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure representative dry bulk density and map deposit distribution, comparing removed volume, event loads and remaining storage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沉積庫容與清淤頻率機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Deposit storage and maintenance interval mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉積庫容與清淤頻率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Deposit storage and maintenance interval” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.

Geometric reduction does not guarantee proportionally scaled grains reproduce settling and motion. A clear-water experiment can verify hydraulic behavior without automatically validating sediment exclusion or ecological performance. Length ratio is model divided by prototype. Froude similarity supplies velocity and discharge ratios without claiming simultaneous Reynolds or mobile-bed similarity. quiz.question: 在「實體模型相似限制機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Physical-model similarity limits mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只按幾何比縮砂會讓黏性與黏聚效應變得相對重要，過小模型也可能落入不同流態；忽略這些失真會把清水試驗的漂亮流線誤當成可靠排砂證據。
只要取水量低於年平均河川流量，就不必分析枯水分流。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Scaling grains geometrically can make viscosity and cohesion disproportionately important, and a small model may enter a different flow regime.
Diversion below annual mean river flow makes low-flow allocation analysis unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 只按幾何比縮砂會讓黏性與黏聚效應變得相對重要，過小模型也可能落入不同流態；忽略這些失真會把清水試驗的漂亮流線誤當成可靠排砂證據。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling grains geometrically can make viscosity and cohesion disproportionately important, and a small model may enter a different flow regime. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 河川水位自動遙測
courses.summary: 本課將自動水位站拆為基準、感測、取樣、傳輸、率定與電源備援，逐一區分準確度、資料時效及可用性。以李斯渡口和維克斯堡真實站點為背景，所有算例是合成資料；觀測水位、推估流量和警戒決策屬不同層次，必須保留各自假設及品質旗標。
courses.summaryEn: This course separates automated gaging into datum, sensing, sampling, transmission, rating and power redundancy, distinguishing accuracy, data age and availability. Lees Ferry and Vicksburg provide real station context, while every calculation uses synthetic observations. Measured stage, estimated discharge and warning decisions occupy different layers and require their own assumptions and quality flags.
courses.focus: 把水位感測、時間與發布品質連成可追溯資料鏈
courses.focusEn: Connecting stage sensing, timing and publication quality into a traceable chain
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定率定係數a=20 m^1.4/s與指數b=1.6，原水位h=2.0 m、零流量參數h0=0.5 m，流量為38.26 m³/s。若水位有正偏差0.10 m而其他參數不變，有效水頭由1.5增至1.6 m，推估流量變成42.43 m³/s，增加約10.88%。這不是把水位增加5%就讓流量增加5%，因率定依有效水頭的非線性冪次變化。實際站點還可能有回水、控制改變及率定參數不確定度；本例只隔離水位偏差，不能據此宣稱流量總誤差或設置警戒值。
workedExample.textEn: Hold rating coefficient a=20 m^1.4/s and exponent b=1.6 fixed, with h=2.0 m and zero-flow parameter h0=0.5 m. The baseline estimate is 38.26 m³/s. A positive stage bias of 0.10 m raises effective head from 1.5 to 1.6 m and gives 42.43 m³/s, approximately 10.88% higher. A five-percent increase in the displayed stage therefore does not produce a five-percent discharge change, because the relation is nonlinear in effective head. Real stations additionally face backwater, control changes and uncertain rating parameters. This isolates stage bias only and establishes neither total discharge error nor a warning setting. Datum checks and independent discharge measurements remain separate evidence needed to evaluate the resulting record.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」與「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" and "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測站基準與水面高程」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gage datum and water elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。基準點沉陷、支架位移與換儀器可能使整段資料產生偏移，即使曲線仍然平滑；跨站或與堤頂比較前必須連接相同垂直基準，並保存基準更動日期，避免把儀器零點變化誤認為河川水位突變。本例基準與讀值已用同一垂直系統及公尺表示；沒有處理不同國家高程系統、橢球高或潮位基準間的轉換。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測站基準與水面高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. Benchmark settlement, support movement and instrument replacement can shift an entire record while leaving a smooth curve. Comparing stations or levee crests requires a common vertical datum and documented changes so that instrument offsets are not mistaken for river-level changes. The example uses meters and one vertical system for datum and reading. It does not convert national height systems, ellipsoidal heights or tidal datums. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gage datum and water elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測站基準與水面高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gage datum and water elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。基準點沉陷、支架位移與換儀器可能使整段資料產生偏移，即使曲線仍然平滑；跨站或與堤頂比較前必須連接相同垂直基準，並保存基準更動日期，避免把儀器零點變化誤認為河川水位突變。
knowledge.textEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. Benchmark settlement, support movement and instrument replacement can shift an entire record while leaving a smooth curve.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。
水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。
任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
optionsEn: Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation.
Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
quiz.explanation: 水位計讀值通常相對測站自訂零點，不等於海拔或工程共用高程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A gage reading is generally relative to a station datum rather than sea level or a shared project elevation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測站基準與水面高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gage datum and water elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Water-surface elevation Z=z0+h=102.35 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Water-surface elevation Z=z0+h=102.35 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要圖表每秒重畫，就代表河川每秒都有一筆新量測。
裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。
optionsEn: A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second.
Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設測站零點高程z0=100.00 m、水尺讀值h=2.35 m，水面高程Z=z0+h=102.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gage-datum elevation z0=100.00 m and reading h=2.35 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「測站基準與水面高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gage datum and water elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。對任何零點改正加上生效日期和版本，並用同時人工讀值確認自動資料沒有未標記跳變。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Date and version every datum correction, and compare simultaneous manual observations to ensure that automated data contain no unmarked discontinuity after installation or adjustment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩站建立零點、讀值和水面高程表，讓一站零點改變但實際水面不變。說明資料庫應如何保留原值、改正值及版本，以免形成假洪峰。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build datum, reading and elevation tables for two stations, changing one datum without changing the physical surface. Explain how original values, corrections and versions should be retained to prevent an artificial flood peak.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。對任何零點改正加上生效日期和版本，並用同時人工讀值確認自動資料沒有未標記跳變。
knowledge.textEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Date and version every datum correction, and compare simultaneous manual observations to ensure that automated data contain no unmarked discontinuity after installation or adjustment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為兩站建立零點、讀值和水面高程表，讓一站零點改變但實際水面不變。說明資料庫應如何保留原值、改正值及版本，以免形成假洪峰。
knowledge.textEn: Build datum, reading and elevation tables for two stations, changing one datum without changing the physical surface. Explain how original values, corrections and versions should be retained to prevent an artificial flood peak.

quiz.question: 要驗證「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification"?
options: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。
optionsEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter.
quiz.explanation: 由獨立穩定基準點檢查水尺及感測器標高，保留水準閉合與前後儀器高度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check staff-gage and sensor elevations from independent stable marks, retaining leveling closure and instrument-height records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測站基準與水面高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gage datum and water elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Overwriting originals with corrections prevents reconstruction of the warning information displayed at the time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例基準與讀值已用同一垂直系統及公尺表示；沒有處理不同國家高程系統、橢球高或潮位基準間的轉換。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not convert national height systems, ellipsoidal heights or tidal datums.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。
knowledge.textEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Overwriting originals with corrections prevents reconstruction of the warning information displayed at the time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測站基準與水面高程機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gage datum and water elevation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。
任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data.
Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
quiz.explanation: 把局部水尺數字直接和海拔堤頂比較會產生錯誤餘高，支架沉陷又可能讓整季記錄偏移；若改正覆蓋原資料，事後便無法追溯當時顯示的警戒情境。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Comparing a local gage number directly with a levee elevation gives false freeboard, and support settlement can bias a season of data. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。水密度受溫鹽影響，感測器位置也可能被淤埋或漂移；因此壓力變化不一定全是水位變化，氣壓補償和安裝高程必須與原始壓力一起保存。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓並假設靜水、淡水定密度；在高速流或堵塞導壓管附近，動壓與延遲需要另行評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. Absolute sensors require synchronized atmospheric subtraction, while vented sensors rely on a reference vent. Density varies with temperature and salinity, and the sensor can be buried or displaced. Pressure changes therefore need not all represent stage changes; barometric compensation and installation elevation must accompany the raw pressure record. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric subtraction and assumes hydrostatic freshwater of fixed density. Dynamic pressure and lag require separate assessment near fast flow or blocked pressure tubing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。水密度受溫鹽影響，感測器位置也可能被淤埋或漂移；因此壓力變化不一定全是水位變化，氣壓補償和安裝高程必須與原始壓力一起保存。
knowledge.textEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. Absolute sensors require synchronized atmospheric subtraction, while vented sensors rely on a reference vent.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。
雷達不接觸水，所以不需要高程測量或現地水尺交叉驗證。
浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。
optionsEn: Any pressure output divided by water unit weight gives true river depth.
Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth.
quiz.explanation: 浸水式壓力計依水柱壓力換算深度，絕對壓力感測器需扣除同步大氣壓，通氣式則依通氣管維持參考。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A submerged pressure sensor converts water-column pressure to depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Water-column height h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。
封包剛收到就一定代表此刻水位，無需再看量測時間。
取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s².
A newly received packet necessarily represents current stage without checking observation time.
Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設表壓p=19620 Pa、ρ=1000 kg/m³、g=9.81 m/s²，水柱h=p/(ρg)=2.00 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gauge pressure p=19620 Pa, density ρ=1000 kg/m³ and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。檢查通氣管結露、導壓管堵塞與漂移，避免用軟體校正常數掩蓋實際安裝故障。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Inspect vent condensation, pressure-line blockage and displacement so that software correction constants do not conceal physical installation faults or delayed response. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同水位下兩種大氣壓的絕對壓力讀值，完成扣除後確認水深不變。再加入氣壓資料延遲情境，說明時間同步和精確感測同樣必要。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare absolute readings at two atmospheric pressures with unchanged water level and confirm invariant depth after subtraction. Then introduce delayed barometric data and explain why synchronization matters alongside sensor precision.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Converting absolute pressure directly includes atmospheric pressure as water depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。檢查通氣管結露、導壓管堵塞與漂移，避免用軟體校正常數掩蓋實際安裝故障。
knowledge.textEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Inspect vent condensation, pressure-line blockage and displacement so that software correction constants do not conceal physical installation faults or delayed response.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較相同水位下兩種大氣壓的絕對壓力讀值，完成扣除後確認水深不變。再加入氣壓資料延遲情境，說明時間同步和精確感測同樣必要。
knowledge.textEn: Compare absolute readings at two atmospheric pressures with unchanged water level and confirm invariant depth after subtraction. Then introduce delayed barometric data and explain why synchronization matters alongside sensor precision.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。
電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage.
Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information.
quiz.explanation: 同步記錄水壓與氣壓，核對壓力種類、單位與感測器標高，並以人工水尺交叉比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record water and atmospheric pressure synchronously, checking pressure type, units and sensor elevation against a manual staff gage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓力式量測與氣壓補償機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pressure sensing and barometric compensation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓力式量測與氣壓補償」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pressure sensing and barometric compensation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將絕對壓力直接換成水深會把大氣壓算入水柱，通氣管受潮則可能形成緩慢偏差；淤埋造成的遲滯也可能讓洪峰看起來較低且較晚。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 雷達距離與安裝幾何機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Radar range and installation geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 非接觸雷達由天線到水面的傳播訊號求距離，再與天線高程組合成水面高程。量到的是距離而不是直接水位，斜裝、波浪、橋構件與漂浮物可能改變有效回波；儀器內部常使用調頻等處理，但基礎往返傳播關係仍可用來核對量綱與幾何方向。本例為理想垂直往返飛行時間示意，近似空氣中光速；不是描述特定雷達的電子取樣解析度或實際量測準確度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雷達距離與安裝幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Noncontact radar derives antenna-to-surface range from the propagation signal and combines it with antenna elevation. It measures distance rather than stage directly; tilt, waves, bridge members and floating debris can change the effective return. Practical instruments often use frequency-modulated processing, but the basic round-trip relation remains useful for checking dimensions and geometric direction. The example illustrates ideal vertical round-trip travel time using approximate light speed in air. It does not describe a particular radar’s sampling resolution or field accuracy. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Radar range and installation geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設c=3.0×10⁸ m/s、往返t=40 ns，距離d=ct/2=6.00 m；天線Zs=110 m時水面Z=104 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume c=3.0×10⁸ m/s and round-trip t=40 ns.

steps.title: 雷達距離與安裝幾何機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Radar range and installation geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設c=3.0×10⁸ m/s、往返t=40 ns，距離d=ct/2=6.00 m；天線Zs=110 m時水面Z=104 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume c=3.0×10⁸ m/s and round-trip t=40 ns. Range d=ct/2=6.00 m; antenna elevation Zs=110 m gives water elevation Z=104 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測天線標高與傾角並檢查波束覆蓋，將回波品質和水尺讀值同步保存。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey antenna elevation and tilt, inspect beam coverage and retain echo-quality indicators with simultaneous staff-gage readings.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 量測天線標高與傾角並檢查波束覆蓋，將回波品質和水尺讀值同步保存。針對橋面反射、漂浮物及暴雨測試異常旗標，確認失去有效水面回波時不會輸出看似正常的舊值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey antenna elevation and tilt, inspect beam coverage and retain echo-quality indicators with simultaneous staff-gage readings. Test anomaly flags for bridge reflections, floating objects and intense rain, ensuring that lost water-surface returns do not silently appear as normal stale measurements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting the round-trip factor doubles range, and support movement shifts all elevations. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雷達距離與安裝幾何機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Radar range and installation geometry mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏除往返因子二會把距離加倍，天線支架位移則使所有高程產生偏移；挑錯回波可能讀到橋梁或漂流物，曲線平滑也不能保證目標正確。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
只要圖表每秒重畫，就代表河川每秒都有一筆新量測。
optionsEn: Omitting the round-trip factor doubles range, and support movement shifts all elevations.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second.
quiz.explanation: 漏除往返因子二會把距離加倍，天線支架位移則使所有高程產生偏移；挑錯回波可能讀到橋梁或漂流物，曲線平滑也不能保證目標正確。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting the round-trip factor doubles range, and support movement shifts all elevations. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and missed crests mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling interval and missed crests” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 離散水位資料只能觀察取樣時刻，洪峰若發生在兩筆之間就可能被低估。提高取樣頻率可縮小這類誤差，但儲存、傳輸頻率與畫面更新不一定相同；平均濾波又可能壓低短時尖峰，因此應保存原始取樣時間，並區分缺測與真正平穩水位。下式假設內部洪峰附近水位變化速率有已知上限且兩側取樣完整；只界定時間離散誤差，未含儀器誤差或資料中斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discrete records observe stage only at sample times, so a crest between samples can be underestimated. Faster sampling reduces this error, but storage, transmission and display frequencies need not match. Averaging can additionally suppress short peaks, making original timestamps and a clear distinction between missing data and genuinely stable stage essential. The bound assumes a known maximum rate around an interior crest and complete samples on both sides. It concerns temporal discretization only, excluding sensor error and missing records. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling interval and missed crests” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設|dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s、等距取樣Δt=60 s，洪峰到最近取樣最多30 s，漏峰界限rΔt/2=0.12 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume |dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s and sample interval Δt=60 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要圖表每秒重畫，就代表河川每秒都有一筆新量測。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Sampling interval and missed crests mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 離散水位資料只能觀察取樣時刻，洪峰若發生在兩筆之間就可能被低估。提高取樣頻率可縮小這類誤差，但儲存、傳輸頻率與畫面更新不一定相同；平均濾波又可能壓低短時尖峰，因此應保存原始取樣時間，並區分缺測與真正平穩水位。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A graph refreshed every second means the river has a new measurement every second. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

離散水位資料只能觀察取樣時刻，洪峰若發生在兩筆之間就可能被低估。

Discrete records observe stage only at sample times, so a crest between samples can be underestimated.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and missed crests mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling interval and missed crests” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設|dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s、等距取樣Δt=60 s，洪峰到最近取樣最多30 s，漏峰界限rΔt/2=0.12 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume |dh/dt|≤r=0.004 m/s and sample interval Δt=60 s. The nearest sample is at most 30 s away, giving missed-crest bound rΔt/2=0.12 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從原始時間戳檢查實際取樣間距及遺漏，將平均後曲線與高頻原資料比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual intervals and omissions from original timestamps, comparing averaged curves with high-frequency records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 取樣間隔與漏失洪峰機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling interval and missed crests mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣間隔與漏失洪峰」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling interval and missed crests” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從原始時間戳檢查實際取樣間距及遺漏，將平均後曲線與高頻原資料比較。以獨立事件驗證速率上限的合理性；若有缺筆或未觀測尖峰，需撤回此完整取樣誤差界限。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual intervals and omissions from original timestamps, comparing averaged curves with high-frequency records. Assess the assumed rate bound against independent events; if samples are missing or sharper behavior is unobserved, withdraw this complete-sampling error bound instead of treating it as guaranteed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立一個落在兩取樣點中間的三角洪峰，分別以六十秒和三十秒取樣比較峰值。將顯示更新頻率保持相同，說明它為何不會補回漏掉的觀測。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：把傳輸每小時一次誤當成現地每分鐘取樣會低估資訊延遲，平均值也可能掩蓋警戒尖峰；無資料時延用最後值會產生看似平穩的假象。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing hourly transmission with minute-by-minute local sampling understates information delay, and averaging can conceal a warning crest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 自動遙測鏈包含感測、記錄、通訊、接收與發布，各段延遲相加才形成使用者看到的資料年齡。接收時間不等於量測時間，補傳舊封包更可能讓新到資料看似最新水位；洪水快速上升時，即使數值本身準確，過時資料仍可能造成錯誤情境判讀。本例在固定上升速率下比較量測時與現在的差異，不是預報模型；真實加速度、回落及通訊中斷會破壞線性外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「傳輸延遲與資料時效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An automated chain includes sensing, logging, communication, reception and publication; their delays determine the age of displayed information. Receipt time is not observation time, and retransmitted old packets can look deceptively current. During a rapid rise, an accurate but stale reading can still produce a misleading picture of the river. The example compares observation time with the present under a constant rise rate. It is not a forecast model; acceleration, recession and communication outages invalidate simple linear extrapolation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transmission latency and data age” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證

steps.title: 傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transmission latency and data age mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「傳輸延遲與資料時效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transmission latency and data age” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位上升率r=0.003 m/s、總資料延遲L=120 s，線性時效差Δh=rL=0.36 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume rise rate r=0.003 m/s and total data latency L=120 s. Linear age-related difference Δh=rL=0.36 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存量測、封包發送、接收與發布四種時間，使用一致時區和校時紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain observation, transmission, receipt and publication times with consistent timezone and clock records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transmission latency and data age mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「傳輸延遲與資料時效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transmission latency and data age” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存量測、封包發送、接收與發布四種時間，使用一致時區和校時紀錄。透過測試封包量測端到端延遲分布，對補傳和過期資料加註旗標，避免只報平均延遲而漏掉長尾。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain observation, transmission, receipt and publication times with consistent timezone and clock records. Measure end-to-end latency distributions using test packets, flag backfilled and stale data, and inspect long delays rather than reporting only an average that hides the tail. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出含一次補傳的時間線，分開標記觀測與發布順序。計算每筆資料年齡並制定畫面標示規則，說明哪些值只能補歷史而不能覆蓋最新狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a timeline containing a retransmission, separating observation order from publication order. Calculate each record’s age and define display labels, explaining which records may fill history but must not replace the latest state.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用收到封包的時間覆蓋量測時間會把歷史水位當現況，時區錯置也可能產生假負延遲；只用平均通訊速度無法描述暴雨時的最長資料空窗。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Replacing observation time with receipt time presents historical stage as current, while timezone mistakes can create impossible negative latency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。

steps.title: 傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transmission latency and data age mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「傳輸延遲與資料時效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transmission latency and data age” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用收到封包的時間覆蓋量測時間會把歷史水位當現況，時區錯置也可能產生假負延遲；只用平均通訊速度無法描述暴雨時的最長資料空窗。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Replacing observation time with receipt time presents historical stage as current, while timezone mistakes can create impossible negative latency. Average communication speed does not describe the longest information gaps during a storm. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例在固定上升速率下比較量測時與現在的差異，不是預報模型；真實加速度、回落及通訊中斷會破壞線性外推。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「封包剛收到就一定代表此刻水位，無需再看量測時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「傳輸延遲與資料時效機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

用收到封包的時間覆蓋量測時間會把歷史水位當現況，時區錯置也可能產生假負延遲；只用平均通訊速度無法描述暴雨時的最長資料空窗。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
Replacing observation time with receipt time presents historical stage as current, while timezone mistakes can create impossible negative latency.
quiz.explanation: 用收到封包的時間覆蓋量測時間會把歷史水位當現況，時區錯置也可能產生假負延遲；只用平均通訊速度無法描述暴雨時的最長資料空窗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
