steps.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位流量關係與外推」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河川水位轉成流量通常依現地率定關係，控制斷面、糙率及回水變化會讓同一水位對應不同流量。漲退水遲滯與下游潮位可能使單值曲線失效；因此水位遙測完成不代表流量已直接量到，率定版本、有效範圍與量測支撐必須隨資料一起提供。本例採指定單值冪次曲線並明列係數單位，限定有效水頭為正；不是實站率定，也不應外推到回水或河床劇變情境。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位流量關係與外推」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Converting stage to discharge normally uses a site-calibrated relation whose behavior depends on channel control, roughness and backwater. Rising/falling hysteresis and downstream tide can give different flows at the same stage. Automated stage measurement therefore does not mean discharge was directly measured; rating version, valid range and supporting observations must accompany derived flow. The example specifies a single-valued power rating with coefficient units and positive effective head. It is not a real station rating and should not be extrapolated into backwater or major bed change. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位流量關係與外推」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 河川水位轉成流量通常依現地率定關係，控制斷面、糙率及回水變化會讓同一水位對應不同流量。漲退水遲滯與下游潮位可能使單值曲線失效；因此水位遙測完成不代表流量已直接量到，率定版本、有效範圍與量測支撐必須隨資料一起提供。
knowledge.textEn: Converting stage to discharge normally uses a site-calibrated relation whose behavior depends on channel control, roughness and backwater. Rising/falling hysteresis and downstream tide can give different flows at the same stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 河川水位轉成流量通常依現地率定關係，控制斷面、糙率及回水變化會讓同一水位對應不同流量。
裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。
取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
optionsEn: Converting stage to discharge normally uses a site-calibrated relation whose behavior depends on channel control, roughness and backwater.
Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
quiz.explanation: 河川水位轉成流量通常依現地率定關係，控制斷面、糙率及回水變化會讓同一水位對應不同流量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Converting stage to discharge normally uses a site-calibrated relation whose behavior depends on channel control, roughness and backwater. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位流量關係與外推」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m. Discharge Q=38.26 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m. Discharge Q=38.26 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。
所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。
optionsEn: Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m.
Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=a(h−h0)^b，a=20 m^1.4/s、b=1.6、h=2.0 m、h0=0.5 m，Q=38.26 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=a(h−h0)^b, a=20 m^1.4/s, b=1.6, h=2.0 m and h0=0.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位流量關係與外推」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。保存率定版本和外推旗標，洪水後重新查控制斷面，而不是只調係數追求漂亮擬合。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time. Retain rating versions and extrapolation flags, and resurvey channel control after floods instead of merely adjusting coefficients for an attractive fit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用指定曲線計算兩個水位，標出有效水頭與係數單位。再畫出相同水位有兩個流量的遲滯示意，說明需要增加哪種觀測才能區分兩支曲線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate two discharges from the specified rating, labeling effective head and coefficient units. Draw a hysteresis example with two flows at one stage and explain what additional observation could distinguish the two branches.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。保存率定版本和外推旗標，洪水後重新查控制斷面，而不是只調係數追求漂亮擬合。
knowledge.textEn: Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time. Retain rating versions and extrapolation flags, and resurvey channel control after floods instead of merely adjusting coefficients for an attractive fit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用指定曲線計算兩個水位，標出有效水頭與係數單位。再畫出相同水位有兩個流量的遲滯示意，說明需要增加哪種觀測才能區分兩支曲線。
knowledge.textEn: Calculate two discharges from the specified rating, labeling effective head and coefficient units. Draw a hysteresis example with two flows at one stage and explain what additional observation could distinguish the two branches.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
雷達不接觸水，所以不需要高程測量或現地水尺交叉驗證。
以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立流量量測覆蓋漲退水及不同水位，檢查殘差是否與下游水位或時間有系統關係。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use independent discharge measurements across stages and both hydrograph limbs, checking whether residuals depend systematically on downstream level or time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位流量關係與外推」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias. One stage observation cannot uniquely resolve discharge under strong backwater. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例採指定單值冪次曲線並明列係數單位，限定有效水頭為正；不是實站率定，也不應外推到回水或河床劇變情境。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not a real station rating and should not be extrapolated into backwater or major bed change.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。
knowledge.textEn: Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias. One stage observation cannot uniquely resolve discharge under strong backwater.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水位流量關係與外推機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Stage-discharge relation and extrapolation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
optionsEn: Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
quiz.explanation: 把超出量測範圍的曲線延伸當實測會低估高水位不確定度，河床沖淤後沿用舊率定也可能產生系統偏差；單點水位無法唯一解決強回水流量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calling an extrapolated curve measured flow understates high-stage uncertainty, and using an old rating after bed change introduces bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」與「高程不確定度合成機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification" and "Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「上升速率與雜訊」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Rise-rate estimation and noise” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水位上升速率能補充絕對水位資訊，但差分運算會放大量測雜訊和時間誤差。取樣間隔越短，並不保證速率越準確；過度平滑雖降低雜訊卻延遲急升訊號，因此應將原始資料、濾波方式和速率計算窗分開保存，避免用單一尖峰差分觸發無法解釋的判斷。本例計算兩筆有效讀值間的平均變化率，不代表區間內瞬時最大值；警戒規則與多源確認需另按實際防洪系統制定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「上升速率與雜訊」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Rise rate supplements absolute stage, but differencing amplifies measurement noise and timing errors. A shorter interval does not guarantee a more accurate derivative. Heavy smoothing reduces noise while delaying rapid-rise signals, so raw data, filtering method and derivative window should remain separately documented rather than relying on an unexplained single-sample spike. The example is the mean rate between two valid readings, not the maximum instantaneous rate within the interval. Warning rules and multisource confirmation require a separate operational framework. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Rise-rate estimation and noise” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位由2.10升至2.22 m、間隔Δt=600 s，平均r=0.12/600=0.00020 m/s=0.72 m/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume stage rises from 2.10 to 2.22 m over Δt=600 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「上升速率與雜訊」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Rise-rate estimation and noise”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水位上升速率能補充絕對水位資訊，但差分運算會放大量測雜訊和時間誤差。取樣間隔越短，並不保證速率越準確；過度平滑雖降低雜訊卻延遲急升訊號，因此應將原始資料、濾波方式和速率計算窗分開保存，避免用單一尖峰差分觸發無法解釋的判斷。
knowledge.textEn: Rise rate supplements absolute stage, but differencing amplifies measurement noise and timing errors. A shorter interval does not guarantee a more accurate derivative.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
水位上升速率能補充絕對水位資訊，但差分運算會放大量測雜訊和時間誤差。
感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。
optionsEn: Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
Rise rate supplements absolute stage, but differencing amplifies measurement noise and timing errors.
Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter.
quiz.explanation: 水位上升速率能補充絕對水位資訊，但差分運算會放大量測雜訊和時間誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Rise rate supplements absolute stage, but differencing amplifies measurement noise and timing errors. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「上升速率與雜訊」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rise-rate estimation and noise” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水位由2.10升至2.22 m、間隔Δt=600 s，平均r=0.12/600=0.00020 m/s=0.72 m/h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume stage rises from 2.10 to 2.22 m over Δt=600 s. Mean r=0.12/600=0.00020 m/s=0.72 m/h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：檢查兩筆資料的品質旗標、實際時間差及是否跨越零點改正，再比較不同窗長的速率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check quality flags, actual time separation and any intervening datum correction, then compare rates from different windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「上升速率與雜訊」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rise-rate estimation and noise” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 檢查兩筆資料的品質旗標、實際時間差及是否跨越零點改正，再比較不同窗長的速率。用已知事件或合成訊號量測濾波延遲，將可接受雜訊與漏失急升的取捨明確記錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check quality flags, actual time separation and any intervening datum correction, then compare rates from different windows. Measure filter delay with known events or synthetic signals, explicitly recording the tradeoff between tolerated noise and missed or delayed rapid rises. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：給兩筆水位加入正負一公分誤差，比較短窗和長窗的速率偏差。另以快速上升訊號測試移動平均，說明減噪與延遲不能只用同一個指標評分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add opposite one-centimeter errors to two readings and compare rate bias over short and long windows. Test a moving average on a rapid rise and explain why noise reduction and delay need separate evaluation metrics.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification"?
options: 檢查兩筆資料的品質旗標、實際時間差及是否跨越零點改正，再比較不同窗長的速率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Check quality flags, actual time separation and any intervening datum correction, then compare rates from different windows.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Check quality flags, actual time separation and any intervening datum correction, then compare rates from different windows. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「上升速率與雜訊」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rise-rate estimation and noise” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge. Excessive filtering can instead display a genuine rapid rise too late. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例計算兩筆有效讀值間的平均變化率，不代表區間內瞬時最大值；警戒規則與多源確認需另按實際防洪系統制定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Warning rules and multisource confirmation require a separate operational framework.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。
knowledge.textEn: Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge. Excessive filtering can instead display a genuine rapid rise too late.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「上升速率與雜訊機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Rise-rate estimation and noise mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。
感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge.
Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter.
quiz.explanation: 兩個相鄰讀值的小誤差經短時間差相除可變成巨大速率，跨越零點調整也會形成假急升；過度濾波則可能把真實快速上漲延後呈現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Small adjacent-reading errors divided by a short interval can create a large apparent rate, and a datum adjustment can mimic a surge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高程不確定度合成機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程不確定度合成」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation uncertainty combination” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 自動水位高程包含感測、基準連接和安裝幾何等不確定度，顯示小數位數不代表同樣程度的可信度。獨立隨機項可用平方和合成，但共同基準偏差、漂移及未修正系統誤差不能隨意當成獨立量；報告需區分標準不確定度、擴展區間與誤差來源，而不是只給一個精度標籤。下式只合成兩個指定獨立標準不確定度，沒有乘涵蓋因子；不能把結果直接稱為百分之九十五信賴區間或量測閉合差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程不確定度合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Automated elevation combines sensor, datum-transfer and installation-geometry uncertainty, and display decimals do not imply equal confidence. Independent random contributions can be combined by root-sum-square, but shared datum bias, drift and uncorrected systematic error cannot simply be treated as independent. Reports should distinguish standard uncertainty, expanded intervals and contributing sources rather than provide one vague accuracy label. The expression combines two specified independent standard uncertainties without a coverage factor. It is neither automatically a 95-percent interval nor a measured leveling closure error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elevation uncertainty combination” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測標準不確定度us=0.010 m、基準連接ud=0.020 m且獨立，uc=√(us²+ud²)=0.02236 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sensor uncertainty us=0.010 m and datum-transfer uncertainty ud=0.020 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高程不確定度合成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 依「高程不確定度合成機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
Noncontact radar needs neither elevation surveying nor field staff-gage checks.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測標準不確定度us=0.010 m、基準連接ud=0.020 m且獨立，uc=√(us²+ud²)=0.02236 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent sensor uncertainty us=0.010 m and datum-transfer uncertainty ud=0.020 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 高程不確定度合成機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「高程不確定度合成」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Elevation uncertainty combination” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立誤差來源表，列明每項來自校正、重複量測或幾何估計，以及是否共享參考。檢查偏差是否已改正，將標準不確定度和實際水準閉合值分開，必要時保留相關係數再合成。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a source table identifying calibration, repeat measurement or geometric estimation and shared references. Check whether bias has been corrected, keep standard uncertainty distinct from actual leveling closure, and retain covariance terms where dependence prevents a simple independent combination. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一份誤差表分成獨立與共用來源，先合成可獨立的項，再討論共用基準如何影響兩站高差。寫出包含單位和涵蓋說明的完整結果句。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate independent and shared sources, combine only eligible terms, then discuss how a shared datum affects a two-station elevation difference. Write a complete result sentence with units and an explicit statement about coverage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Build a source table identifying calibration, repeat measurement or geometric estimation and shared references. Check whether bias has been corrected, keep standard uncertainty distinct from actual leveling closure, and retain covariance terms where dependence prevents a simple independent combination.

knowledge.text: 將一份誤差表分成獨立與共用來源，先合成可獨立的項，再討論共用基準如何影響兩站高差。寫出包含單位和涵蓋說明的完整結果句。
knowledge.textEn: Separate independent and shared sources, combine only eligible terms, then discuss how a shared datum affects a two-station elevation difference. Write a complete result sentence with units and an explicit statement about coverage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程不確定度合成機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
建立誤差來源表，列明每項來自校正、重複量測或幾何估計，以及是否共享參考。
封包剛收到就一定代表此刻水位，無需再看量測時間。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Build a source table identifying calibration, repeat measurement or geometric estimation and shared references.
A newly received packet necessarily represents current stage without checking observation time.

quiz.explanationEn: Build a source table identifying calibration, repeat measurement or geometric estimation and shared references. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 高程不確定度合成機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高程不確定度合成」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elevation uncertainty combination” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias. Labeling a root-sum-square result as maximum error further confuses a probabilistic scale with a guaranteed bound. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式只合成兩個指定獨立標準不確定度，沒有乘涵蓋因子；不能把結果直接稱為百分之九十五信賴區間或量測閉合差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is neither automatically a 95-percent interval nor a measured leveling closure error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「感測器顯示到毫米，就代表水面絕對高程也準確到毫米。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Millimeter display resolution means absolute water elevation is accurate to a millimeter." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。
knowledge.textEn: Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias. Labeling a root-sum-square result as maximum error further confuses a probabilistic scale with a guaranteed bound.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高程不確定度合成機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elevation uncertainty combination mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。
把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information.
Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias.
quiz.explanation: 把共同基準誤差當兩個獨立項可能錯估比較結果，增加取樣也無法消除固定偏差；將平方和結果直接標為最大誤差則又混淆機率尺度與保證界限。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating shared datum error as independent can misstate a comparison, and more samples do not remove fixed bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證」與「獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification" and "Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「備援電源與能量帳」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup power and energy budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 偏遠測站的可用時間取決於平均負載、通訊脈衝、電池可用容量及環境條件，不能只看安培小時數。電壓換算、允許放電深度和電源轉換損失都影響可用能量，低溫與老化又可能降低容量；太陽能日均供電也無法單獨保證連續陰雨期間仍有資料。本例以固定平均負載與指定可用係數作能量比較，忽略自放電、老化和低溫；計算時數不是實站續航保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援電源與能量帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Remote-station endurance depends on average load, transmission pulses, usable battery capacity and environment rather than ampere-hours alone. Voltage, allowed depth of discharge and conversion losses determine useful energy, while cold and aging may reduce capacity. Mean solar input likewise cannot guarantee observations throughout an extended cloudy period. The example uses fixed mean load and specified usable factors, excluding self-discharge, aging and cold. Calculated hours are an energy comparison, not a station-endurance guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup power and energy budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設電池12 V、40 Ah、可用放電比例0.50、轉換效率0.85、平均負載2 W，續航t=12×40×0.50×0.85/2=102 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume battery 12 V, 40 Ah, usable discharge fraction 0.50, conversion efficiency 0.85 and mean load 2 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「備援電源與能量帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backup power and energy budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 偏遠測站的可用時間取決於平均負載、通訊脈衝、電池可用容量及環境條件，不能只看安培小時數。電壓換算、允許放電深度和電源轉換損失都影響可用能量，低溫與老化又可能降低容量；太陽能日均供電也無法單獨保證連續陰雨期間仍有資料。
knowledge.textEn: Remote-station endurance depends on average load, transmission pulses, usable battery capacity and environment rather than ampere-hours alone. Voltage, allowed depth of discharge and conversion losses determine useful energy, while cold and aging may reduce capacity.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 偏遠測站的可用時間取決於平均負載、通訊脈衝、電池可用容量及環境條件，不能只看安培小時數。

只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。
optionsEn: Remote-station endurance depends on average load, transmission pulses, usable battery capacity and environment rather than ampere-hours alone.

Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 偏遠測站的可用時間取決於平均負載、通訊脈衝、電池可用容量及環境條件，不能只看安培小時數。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備援電源與能量帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup power and energy budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設電池12 V、40 Ah、可用放電比例0.50、轉換效率0.85、平均負載2 W，續航t=12×40×0.50×0.85/2=102 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume battery 12 V, 40 Ah, usable discharge fraction 0.50, conversion efficiency 0.85 and mean load 2 W. Endurance t=12×40×0.50×0.85/2=102 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量測感測、待機和傳輸各狀態功率及占空比，將短時峰值和平均能量分開核對。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 任何壓力感測器輸出除以水重度就一定得到真實河川水深。

steps.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「備援電源與能量帳」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup power and energy budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測感測、待機和傳輸各狀態功率及占空比，將短時峰值和平均能量分開核對。以老化與低溫容量資料更新可用量，並用中斷充電的測試確認低電量標示及資料保存行為。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy. Update usable capacity with aging and temperature evidence, and test interrupted charging to confirm low-battery indication and preservation of observations before power is exhausted. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將通訊占空比增加一倍後重算平均負載，再比較低溫容量下降情境。為能量耗盡前後設計資料旗標，區分感測中斷、通訊中斷和仍可本地記錄的狀態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double communication duty cycle and recalculate mean load, then compare reduced cold-weather capacity. Define data flags around energy exhaustion that distinguish sensing failure, communication loss and continued local recording.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring transmission peaks can cause reset from voltage sag despite remaining energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy. Update usable capacity with aging and temperature evidence, and test interrupted charging to confirm low-battery indication and preservation of observations before power is exhausted.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將通訊占空比增加一倍後重算平均負載，再比較低溫容量下降情境。為能量耗盡前後設計資料旗標，區分感測中斷、通訊中斷和仍可本地記錄的狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Double communication duty cycle and recalculate mean load, then compare reduced cold-weather capacity. Define data flags around energy exhaustion that distinguish sensing failure, communication loss and continued local recording.

quiz.question: 要驗證「備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
裝好水位計後，任何洪水流量都能無誤差地自動換算。
量測感測、待機和傳輸各狀態功率及占空比，將短時峰值和平均能量分開核對。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Once a stage sensor is installed, every flood discharge converts automatically without error.
Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy.
quiz.explanation: 量測感測、待機和傳輸各狀態功率及占空比，將短時峰值和平均能量分開核對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure sensing, standby and transmission power with duty cycles, checking peak demand separately from average energy. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備援電源與能量帳」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup power and energy budget” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring transmission peaks can cause reset from voltage sag despite remaining energy. Using new-battery capacity for an aged station overstates endurance, and missing outage flags can make power failure look like unchanging river stage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例以固定平均負載與指定可用係數作能量比較，忽略自放電、老化和低溫；計算時數不是實站續航保證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calculated hours are an energy comparison, not a station-endurance guarantee.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「電池安培小時越大就可直接比較續航，不需要知道電壓或負載。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Battery ampere-hours alone compare endurance without voltage or load information." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring transmission peaks can cause reset from voltage sag despite remaining energy. Using new-battery capacity for an aged station overstates endurance, and missing outage flags can make power failure look like unchanging river stage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「備援電源與能量帳機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backup power and energy budget mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities.
quiz.explanation: 忽略傳輸峰值可能使電池尚有能量卻因瞬時壓降重啟，使用新電池容量估計老站又會高估續航；斷電後無明確旗標可能被誤解為河水停止變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring transmission peaks can cause reset from voltage sag despite remaining energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「獨立備援與共因失效」如何影響河川水位自動遙測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent redundancy and common causes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Automatic river-level telemetry”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩套感測或通訊可提高資料可用性，但只有真正獨立的失效才可直接相乘。若共用電源、支架、基準點或被同一洪水淹沒，備援仍可能同時失效；不同技術也可能共享資料伺服器，應沿整條量測到發布路徑辨認共因，而不是只數現場儀器數量。本例定義相同觀察期間兩通道失效機率且假設獨立，只示範理想備援；未加入修復、共因及不同失效模式。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立備援與共因失效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two sensors or links can improve availability, but failure probabilities multiply only for independent events. Shared power, support, datum or flood exposure can disable both. Different sensing technologies may still share a publication server, so common causes must be traced through the complete observation-to-display chain rather than inferred from device count. The example defines channel-failure probabilities over the same observation period and assumes independence. It illustrates ideal redundancy without repair, common causes or multiple failure modes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Independent redundancy and common causes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩通道期間失效機率p1=p2=0.02且獨立，同時失效p=p1p2=0.0004，即0.04%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent channel-failure probabilities p1=p2=0.02 over the same period.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「獨立備援與共因失效」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Independent redundancy and common causes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 兩套感測或通訊可提高資料可用性，但只有真正獨立的失效才可直接相乘。若共用電源、支架、基準點或被同一洪水淹沒，備援仍可能同時失效；不同技術也可能共享資料伺服器，應沿整條量測到發布路徑辨認共因，而不是只數現場儀器數量。
knowledge.textEn: Two sensors or links can improve availability, but failure probabilities multiply only for independent events. Shared power, support, datum or flood exposure can disable both.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。
兩套感測或通訊可提高資料可用性，但只有真正獨立的失效才可直接相乘。
所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。
optionsEn: Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities.
Two sensors or links can improve availability, but failure probabilities multiply only for independent events.
Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
quiz.explanation: 兩套感測或通訊可提高資料可用性，但只有真正獨立的失效才可直接相乘。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two sensors or links can improve availability, but failure probabilities multiply only for independent events. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「獨立備援與共因失效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Independent redundancy and common causes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩通道期間失效機率p1=p2=0.02且獨立，同時失效p=p1p2=0.0004，即0.04%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent channel-failure probabilities p1=p2=0.02 over the same period. Joint failure p=p1p2=0.0004, or 0.04%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩通道期間失效機率p1=p2=0.02且獨立，同時失效p=p1p2=0.0004，即0.04%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent channel-failure probabilities p1=p2=0.02 over the same period. Joint failure p=p1p2=0.0004, or 0.04%.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

A newly received packet necessarily represents current stage without checking observation time.

steps.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「獨立備援與共因失效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Independent redundancy and common causes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。以受控故障測試確認切換、補傳與資料旗標，並用實際事件記錄評估獨立假設是否成立。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure. Use controlled failure tests to check switching, backfill and quality flags, then examine event records to assess whether the assumed independence is supported rather than merely convenient. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為雙感測器畫出共用與獨立電源兩個架構，指出哪些故障可由另一通道保留觀測。加入共同淹水事件後重新描述模型限制，避免把理想數字當保證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw shared- and independent-power versions of a dual-sensor system, identifying failures that leave observations available. Add a common inundation event and restate the model limits rather than presenting the ideal probability as a guarantee.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。以受控故障測試確認切換、補傳與資料旗標，並用實際事件記錄評估獨立假設是否成立。
knowledge.textEn: Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure. Use controlled failure tests to check switching, backfill and quality flags, then examine event records to assess whether the assumed independence is supported rather than merely convenient.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 為雙感測器畫出共用與獨立電源兩個架構，指出哪些故障可由另一通道保留觀測。加入共同淹水事件後重新描述模型限制，避免把理想數字當保證。
knowledge.textEn: Draw shared- and independent-power versions of a dual-sensor system, identifying failures that leave observations available. Add a common inundation event and restate the model limits rather than presenting the ideal probability as a guarantee.

quiz.question: 要驗證「獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification"?
options: 畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
取樣越密，任何相鄰兩點差分得到的水位速率就一定越可靠。
optionsEn: Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Denser sampling always makes a two-point stage derivative more reliable.
quiz.explanation: 畫出感測、電源、通訊與發布的依賴圖，逐項尋找共用構件和洪水暴露。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map dependencies among sensing, power, communication and publication, identifying shared components and flood exposure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「獨立備援與共因失效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Independent redundancy and common causes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server. Multiplying probabilities then gives optimistic availability without genuine isolation of the failure mechanisms. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例定義相同觀察期間兩通道失效機率且假設獨立，只示範理想備援；未加入修復、共因及不同失效模式。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It illustrates ideal redundancy without repair, common causes or multiple failure modes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要現場裝兩支感測器，就一定可以把全部失效機率相乘。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Installing two field sensors always permits multiplication of all failure probabilities." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。
knowledge.textEn: Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server. Multiplying probabilities then gives optimistic availability without genuine isolation of the failure mechanisms.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「獨立備援與共因失效機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Independent redundancy and common causes mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。
所有水位計顯示的公尺數都已是同一海拔基準下的高程。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server.
Every water-level reading in meters already uses the same sea-level datum.
quiz.explanation: 共用電源的雙感測器可能一次斷電全部停擺，雙通訊也可能同時依賴同一伺服器；直接乘機率會給出過度樂觀的可用性，卻沒有增加真正的失效隔離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two sensors on one supply can fail in a single outage, and two links may depend on the same server. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 防洪抽水站機組整合
courses.summary: 本課由內水收支與系統揚程進入並聯泵、效率、變速、啟停及吸入條件，再串接電源、閘門與備援能力。上環與西部封閉綜合工程提供不同尺度的實例，所有算例為原創簡化條件；課程要求可追溯驗證與失效界面分析，不將教學數字當現場操作設定。
courses.summaryEn: The course moves from interior-water balance and system head to parallel units, efficiency, speed, cycling and suction conditions, then integrates power, gates and retained capacity. Sheung Wan and the West Closure Complex provide examples at different scales. Every calculation is an original simplification, requiring traceable verification and interface analysis rather than treating lesson values as field operating settings.
courses.focus: 連結水理、電源、儲水與故障情境的抽水站整合
courses.focusEn: Integrating pump hydraulics power storage and failure scenarios
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度沿用兩台相同泵的Hp=10−0.25q²與系統H=Hs+0.20Q²，流量以m³/s、揚程以m表示且Q=2q。靜揚程Hs由3.0增至3.3 m，增加10%，兩台總流量由5.164降至5.052 m³/s，約減少2.17%。此例不是說所有外水位上升都只減少少量排水，而是展示實際變化由泵與系統曲線共同決定；若新交點超出允許工況，簡化曲線就不能繼續外推。效率、電功率、汽蝕及儲水演算需在新工作點重新檢查。
workedExample.textEn: Use two identical pumps with Hp=10−0.25q² and system H=Hs+0.20Q², flows in m³/s, heads in meters and Q=2q. Increasing static head Hs from 3.0 to 3.3 m, or ten percent, reduces combined flow from 5.164 to 5.052 m³/s, approximately 2.17%. This does not imply that rising receiving water always causes only a small drainage loss. It demonstrates that the response follows both pump and system curves. A new intersection outside allowable operation invalidates extrapolation of the simplified curve. Efficiency, electrical power, cavitation and storage routing all need reassessment at the new operating point.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. System head Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證」與「系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification" and "System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「內水蓄積與抽排收支」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Interior storage and pumping balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。外河高水位關閉重力出口時，集水池與上游管網共同儲存未排出的水，水位上升速度取決於淨入流和有效面積；抽水能力需要與降雨逕流、儲水曲線和外水位成組分析，不能只比較泵銘牌與最大入流。本例在短時間內固定面積和進出流量，假設沒有其他溢流或滲流；不是整場洪水演算，也未描述管網局部積水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「內水蓄積與抽排收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge. When high receiving water closes a gravity outlet, the sump and upstream network store unremoved water; rise rate depends on net inflow and effective surface area. Pumping must be evaluated with runoff, storage curves and receiving stage rather than merely comparing nameplate capacity with peak inflow. The short-step example fixes area and flows and excludes other overflow or seepage. It is neither full-event routing nor a description of local network flooding. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Interior storage and pumping balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「內水蓄積與抽排收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Interior storage and pumping balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。外河高水位關閉重力出口時，集水池與上游管網共同儲存未排出的水，水位上升速度取決於淨入流和有效面積；抽水能力需要與降雨逕流、儲水曲線和外水位成組分析，不能只比較泵銘牌與最大入流。
knowledge.textEn: A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge. When high receiving water closes a gravity outlet, the sump and upstream network store unremoved water; rise rate depends on net inflow and effective surface area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。
防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。
optionsEn: Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge.
A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
quiz.explanation: 防洪抽水站處理的是隨時間進入低窪區的水量，而不是單一固定流量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A flood station handles a time-varying inflow rather than one fixed discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「內水蓄積與抽排收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Interior storage and pumping balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設入流Qi=6、抽排Qp=4 m³/s、時間Δt=300 s、有效面積A=600 m²，水位升幅Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume inflow Qi=6, pumping Qp=4 m³/s, Δt=300 s and effective area A=600 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)Δt/A=1.00 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同步雨量、入流、泵流量和池水位核對每個時間步的體積收支，確認有效面積是否隨水位改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile stepwise volumes with synchronized rainfall, inflow, pumping and sump level, checking whether effective area changes with stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「內水蓄積與抽排收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Interior storage and pumping balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同步雨量、入流、泵流量和池水位核對每個時間步的體積收支，確認有效面積是否隨水位改變。將溢流、重力排水與閘門狀態分開記錄，避免把未知出口造成的差額歸因感測誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile stepwise volumes with synchronized rainfall, inflow, pumping and sump level, checking whether effective area changes with stage. Record overflow, gravity discharge and gate state separately so that an unrecognized outlet is not incorrectly absorbed into a sensor-error correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立五分鐘體積帳並逐步更新池水位，讓其中一段抽排量降低。指出峰值入流比較與全事件體積演算各會發現什麼問題，並標記需要水位面積曲線的區段。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a five-minute volume ledger with sequential stage updates and reduce pumping during one interval. Explain the different problems revealed by peak-flow comparison and full-event volume routing, marking where a stage-area curve becomes necessary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Record overflow, gravity discharge and gate state separately so that an unrecognized outlet is not incorrectly absorbed into a sensor-error correction.

knowledge.text: 建立五分鐘體積帳並逐步更新池水位，讓其中一段抽排量降低。指出峰值入流比較與全事件體積演算各會發現什麼問題，並標記需要水位面積曲線的區段。
knowledge.textEn: Build a five-minute volume ledger with sequential stage updates and reduce pumping during one interval. Explain the different problems revealed by peak-flow comparison and full-event volume routing, marking where a stage-area curve becomes necessary.

quiz.question: 要驗證「內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification"?
options: 以同步雨量、入流、泵流量和池水位核對每個時間步的體積收支，確認有效面積是否隨水位改變。

備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
optionsEn: Reconcile stepwise volumes with synchronized rainfall, inflow, pumping and sump level, checking whether effective area changes with stage.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
