quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile stepwise volumes with synchronized rainfall, inflow, pumping and sump level, checking whether effective area changes with stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「內水蓄積與抽排收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Interior storage and pumping balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. Omitting upstream network storage distorts sump response, and persistently positive net inflow eventually exhausts finite available storage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例在短時間內固定面積和進出流量，假設沒有其他溢流或滲流；不是整場洪水演算，也未描述管網局部積水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is neither full-event routing nor a description of local network flooding.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。
knowledge.textEn: Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. Omitting upstream network storage distorts sump response, and persistently positive net inflow eventually exhausts finite available storage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「內水蓄積與抽排收支機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Interior storage and pumping balance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。
防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage.
A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
quiz.explanation: 只用最大泵量而忽略高外水位的實際工況會高估抽排，漏掉上游管網蓄水則可能錯估池水位變化；淨入流長時間為正時，有限儲量終究會耗盡。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using maximum pump flow without the high-tailwater operating point overstates drainage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「系統揚程與外水位」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “System head and receiving stage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。靜揚程可隨內水位上升而降低，但摩阻通常隨流量增加，兩者不能混成固定總揚程；不同閘門與出口狀態也會改變損失，需為代表工況建立一致的能量帳。本例用二次損失近似固定配置的系統曲線，係數帶有單位；不涵蓋氣塞、虹吸建立或瞬變逆流。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「系統揚程與外水位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses. Rising river or tide shifts the system curve and operating point. Static head can decrease as the sump rises, while friction generally increases with flow; they cannot be collapsed into one fixed total head. Gate and outlet states also require separate, consistent energy balances. The example uses a quadratic loss approximation for a fixed configuration, with a dimensional coefficient. It excludes trapped air, siphon establishment and transient reverse flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “System head and receiving stage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「系統揚程與外水位」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “System head and receiving stage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。靜揚程可隨內水位上升而降低，但摩阻通常隨流量增加，兩者不能混成固定總揚程；不同閘門與出口狀態也會改變損失，需為代表工況建立一致的能量帳。
knowledge.textEn: A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses. Rising river or tide shifts the system curve and operating point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。
兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。
泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。
optionsEn: A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses.
quiz.explanation: 泵需要克服內外水面差與管路損失，外河或海潮升高會改變系統曲線並移動工作點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A pump overcomes the difference between interior and receiving surfaces plus hydraulic losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「系統揚程與外水位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “System head and receiving stage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. System head Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。
泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。

Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設靜揚程Hs=3.0 m、損失係數K=0.20 s²/m⁵、流量Q=4.0 m³/s，Hsys=Hs+KQ²=6.20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume static head Hs=3.0 m, loss coefficient K=0.20 s²/m⁵ and flow Q=4.0 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「系統揚程與外水位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “System head and receiving stage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量測內外水位並核對同一高程基準，將流量、閥位及壓差配對以辨認系統損失。分別檢查高外水位、低內水位及部分堵塞工況，不把單次測試曲線直接套用全部事件。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses. Examine high tailwater, low sump level and partial blockage separately rather than applying one test curve unchanged to every storm condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩種外水位的系統曲線，保持管路損失係數不變。說明曲線移動如何影響與泵曲線的交點，再列出哪些構件改變會使係數也必須更新。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw system curves for two receiving stages while holding the loss coefficient fixed. Explain their changed intersections with the pump curve, then identify component changes that would also require updating the coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量測內外水位並核對同一高程基準，將流量、閥位及壓差配對以辨認系統損失。分別檢查高外水位、低內水位及部分堵塞工況，不把單次測試曲線直接套用全部事件。
knowledge.textEn: Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses. Examine high tailwater, low sump level and partial blockage separately rather than applying one test curve unchanged to every storm condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩種外水位的系統曲線，保持管路損失係數不變。說明曲線移動如何影響與泵曲線的交點，再列出哪些構件改變會使係數也必須更新。
knowledge.textEn: Draw system curves for two receiving stages while holding the loss coefficient fixed. Explain their changed intersections with the pump curve, then identify component changes that would also require updating the coefficient.

quiz.question: 要驗證「系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
量測內外水位並核對同一高程基準，將流量、閥位及壓差配對以辨認系統損失。
閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses.
Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
quiz.explanation: 量測內外水位並核對同一高程基準，將流量、閥位及壓差配對以辨認系統損失。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure interior and receiving stages on one datum, pairing flow, valve position and pressure difference to identify system losses. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「系統揚程與外水位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “System head and receiving stage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction. Outlet blockage or changed valve position can invalidate the originally predicted operating point. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例用二次損失近似固定配置的系統曲線，係數帶有單位；不涵蓋氣塞、虹吸建立或瞬變逆流。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It excludes trapped air, siphon establishment and transient reverse flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。
knowledge.textEn: Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction. Outlet blockage or changed valve position can invalidate the originally predicted operating point.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「系統揚程與外水位機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "System head and receiving stage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。
把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction.
quiz.explanation: 把外水位忽略會在最需要抽排時高估流量，將靜揚程當成全部揚程又會低估摩阻；出口堵塞或閥位改變可使原有工作點預測失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting tailwater overstates flow when drainage is most needed, while treating static head as total head understates friction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證」與「電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification" and "Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯機組與共同管路」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel pumps and common pipework” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。不同機組曲線、止回閥及局部損失還可能造成不均分流，甚至讓一台落在不利區域；整合時須同時解機組與系統曲線，而不是把型錄數字相加。以下兩台完全相同且均分流量，泵曲線與系統曲線均為教學二次式；沒有替代實機穩定區、效率及汽蝕檢查。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯機組與共同管路」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge. Different unit curves, check valves and local losses can create uneven sharing or an unfavorable operating region. Integration therefore solves pump and system curves together rather than adding catalog values. The two units are identical and share flow equally, with hypothetical quadratic pump and system curves. This does not replace real-machine stability, efficiency or cavitation checks. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel pumps and common pipework” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並聯機組與共同管路」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel pumps and common pipework”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。不同機組曲線、止回閥及局部損失還可能造成不均分流，甚至讓一台落在不利區域；整合時須同時解機組與系統曲線，而不是把型錄數字相加。
knowledge.textEn: Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge. Different unit curves, check valves and local losses can create uneven sharing or an unfavorable operating region.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。
兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。
水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。
optionsEn: Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge.
Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses.
quiz.explanation: 並聯泵在相同揚程下疊加流量，但共同管路的摩阻會隨總流量增加，因此加開第二台通常不會使站流量正好加倍。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Parallel pumps add flow at a common head, but shared-pipe friction grows with total flow, so a second pump generally does not double station discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並聯機組與共同管路」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel pumps and common pipework” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以每台支路流量、共同揚程及轉速驗證分流，核對曲線使用的流量單位與機組組合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify sharing from individual branch flows, common head and speed, checking curve units and pump combinations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Two pumps give Q=2q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計。
備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
optionsEn: The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s.
Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單泵Hp=10−0.25q² m、系統Hs=3+0.20Q² m，q、Q以m³/s計；兩泵Q=2q得Q=2√(7/1.05)=5.164 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume pump Hp=10−0.25q² m and system Hs=3+0.20Q² m, with q,Q in m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯機組與共同管路」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel pumps and common pipework” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以每台支路流量、共同揚程及轉速驗證分流，核對曲線使用的流量單位與機組組合。比較單台及多台實測交點，檢查止回閥開啟與低流量穩定性，再評估剩餘備援能力。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify sharing from individual branch flows, common head and speed, checking curve units and pump combinations. Compare measured single- and multiple-unit intersections, inspect check-valve opening and low-flow stability, and only then assess the drainage capability retained under backup arrangements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先解單台交點，再解兩台交點並比較增加比例。將一台泵曲線稍微下移，說明均分流量假設為何不再成立，以及需要補量測哪個支路。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Solve single- and two-pump intersections and compare the increase. Shift one pump curve downward slightly, explaining why equal sharing then fails and which branch measurements would be needed to determine the new distribution.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Compare measured single- and multiple-unit intersections, inspect check-valve opening and low-flow stability, and only then assess the drainage capability retained under backup arrangements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。

One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.

steps.title: 並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並聯機組與共同管路」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel pumps and common pipework” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly. Even with adequate nominal total capacity, an individual unit can leave its acceptable range and experience vibration or overheating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以下兩台完全相同且均分流量，泵曲線與系統曲線均為教學二次式；沒有替代實機穩定區、效率及汽蝕檢查。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This does not replace real-machine stability, efficiency or cavitation checks.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「並聯機組與共同管路機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel pumps and common pipework mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。
optionsEn: Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses.
quiz.explanation: 直接把單台工況流量乘台數會忽略共同摩阻，異型泵也可能出現分流失衡；名義總容量足夠時，某台仍可能偏離允許運轉區而增加振動或過熱。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying a single-unit operating flow by unit count ignores shared friction, and dissimilar pumps may share unevenly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電功率與效率鏈」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Electrical power and efficiency chain” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。不同效率應對應各自能量邊界，不能重複扣同一損失；峰值功率、啟動需求與整場耗電又是不同問題，平均節能指標不足以代表防洪事件中的供電能力。本例泵與馬達效率分開且忽略其他輔機，計算穩態實功率；不包含啟動電流、功率因數或發電機瞬態容量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電功率與效率鏈」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies. Each efficiency must correspond to a distinct energy boundary so losses are not counted twice. Peak power, starting demand and event energy are separate questions; a mean energy metric does not establish electrical adequacy during a flood. Pump and motor efficiencies are separate and auxiliary loads are excluded. The result is steady real power, not starting current, power factor or generator transient capacity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Electrical power and efficiency chain” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電功率與效率鏈」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Electrical power and efficiency chain”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。不同效率應對應各自能量邊界，不能重複扣同一損失；峰值功率、啟動需求與整場耗電又是不同問題，平均節能指標不足以代表防洪事件中的供電能力。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies. Each efficiency must correspond to a distinct energy boundary so losses are not counted twice.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。
抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。
泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
optionsEn: Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses.
Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies.
Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
quiz.explanation: 抽水的水力功率由流量和總揚程決定，馬達輸入還須考慮泵、傳動與電機效率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Hydraulic power follows flow and total head, while motor input includes pump, transmission and electrical efficiencies. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電功率與效率鏈」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Electrical power and efficiency chain” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Input P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。
閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設ρ=1000 kg/m³、Q=4 m³/s、H=6 m、ηp=0.75、ηm=0.95，P=ρgQH/(ηpηm)=330.44 kW，g=9.81 m/s²。
optionsEn: Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s².

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume ρ=1000 kg/m³, Q=4 m³/s, H=6 m, ηp=0.75, ηm=0.95 and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電功率與效率鏈」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Electrical power and efficiency chain” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。將輔機與馬達邊界分開，另記錄啟動電壓和電流，避免以穩態功率測試代替啟動能力驗證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load. Separate auxiliaries from motor boundaries and record starting voltage and current independently so that a steady-power test is not mistaken for validation of starting capability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出電表、馬達軸與水流三個能量邊界，將效率放在正確位置。比較泵效率下降而其他條件固定時的輸入功率，再指出啟動分析尚缺的電氣資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw meter, motor-shaft and water-flow energy boundaries with efficiencies at the correct interfaces. Compare input power after reduced pump efficiency at fixed conditions, then identify electrical information still missing for a starting analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。將輔機與馬達邊界分開，另記錄啟動電壓和電流，避免以穩態功率測試代替啟動能力驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load. Separate auxiliaries from motor boundaries and record starting voltage and current independently so that a steady-power test is not mistaken for validation of starting capability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出電表、馬達軸與水流三個能量邊界，將效率放在正確位置。比較泵效率下降而其他條件固定時的輸入功率，再指出啟動分析尚缺的電氣資料。
knowledge.textEn: Draw meter, motor-shaft and water-flow energy boundaries with efficiencies at the correct interfaces. Compare input power after reduced pump efficiency at fixed conditions, then identify electrical information still missing for a starting analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification"?
options: 同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
optionsEn: Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
quiz.explanation: 同步量測流量、揚程與電表實功率，核對效率曲線是否對應當時轉速和負載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure flow, head and real electrical power synchronously, checking efficiency curves against actual speed and load. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電功率與效率鏈」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Electrical power and efficiency chain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation. Average kilowatts can also conceal a starting voltage dip that disconnects other operating units. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例泵與馬達效率分開且忽略其他輔機，計算穩態實功率；不包含啟動電流、功率因數或發電機瞬態容量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The result is steady real power, not starting current, power factor or generator transient capacity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。
knowledge.textEn: Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation. Average kilowatts can also conceal a starting voltage dip that disconnects other operating units.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電功率與效率鏈機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electrical power and efficiency chain mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。
泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation.
Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
quiz.explanation: 把泵效率當成整體效率會低估供電需求，使用額定高效率代替偏離工況的效率也會造成偏差；只看平均千瓦可能忽略啟動壓降使其他機組掉電。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using pump efficiency as overall efficiency understates electrical demand, and rated efficiency can misrepresent off-design operation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證」與「啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification" and "Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「變速相似與實際工況」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Speed affinity and operating conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。實際站的靜揚程不隨轉速縮放，因此新工作點未必位於相似點；效率、汽蝕與低速穩定區也可能改變，不能把轉速平方或立方律直接當成整站保證。本例假設同一葉輪與近似相同效率，僅比較相似點；實際抽排量必須再與未同比縮放的系統曲線求交。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「變速相似與實際工況」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check. Station static head does not scale with speed, so the new operating point need not be homologous. Efficiency, cavitation and low-speed stability may change, preventing direct use of square or cube laws as station-wide guarantees. The example assumes one impeller and approximately unchanged efficiency and compares homologous points only. Actual discharge requires intersecting the shifted pump curve with the system curve. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Speed affinity and operating conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「變速相似與實際工況」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Speed affinity and operating conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。實際站的靜揚程不隨轉速縮放，因此新工作點未必位於相似點；效率、汽蝕與低速穩定區也可能改變，不能把轉速平方或立方律直接當成整站保證。
knowledge.textEn: For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check. Station static head does not scale with speed, so the new operating point need not be homologous.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。
幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。
optionsEn: Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow.
For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check.
quiz.explanation: 幾何相同的泵在相似工況下，流量、揚程和軸功率可依轉速比例建立近似關係，適合檢查性能曲線變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a geometrically unchanged pump at homologous conditions, flow, head and shaft power approximately scale with speed, supporting a curve-shift check. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「變速相似與實際工況」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Speed affinity and operating conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. At homologous points Q2/Q1=0.90, H2/H1=0.81 and P2/P1=0.729.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。
備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90.
Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設轉速比N2/N1=0.90，相似點Q2/Q1=0.90、H2/H1=0.81、P2/P1=0.729。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume speed ratio N2/N1=0.90. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「變速相似與實際工況」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Speed affinity and operating conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。用現地量測驗證結果，尤其檢查靜揚程占比高時是否仍能維持有效出流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data. Validate with field observations, especially whether useful discharge remains when static head forms a large share of total head. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出含靜揚程與不含靜揚程兩條系統曲線，比較同一降速泵曲線的交點。指出相似點與實際工作點的差別，避免把兩種比例放在同一張效益表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw system curves with and without static head and compare intersections with one reduced-speed pump curve. Distinguish homologous points from operating points so their ratios are not mixed in a performance table.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。用現地量測驗證結果，尤其檢查靜揚程占比高時是否仍能維持有效出流。
knowledge.textEn: Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data. Validate with field observations, especially whether useful discharge remains when static head forms a large share of total head.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出含靜揚程與不含靜揚程兩條系統曲線，比較同一降速泵曲線的交點。指出相似點與實際工作點的差別，避免把兩種比例放在同一張效益表。
knowledge.textEn: Draw system curves with and without static head and compare intersections with one reduced-speed pump curve. Distinguish homologous points from operating points so their ratios are not mixed in a performance table.

quiz.question: 要驗證「變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。
防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data.
A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
quiz.explanation: 將原泵曲線按相似律移動後與實際系統曲線重求交點，核對效率、允許轉速和汽蝕資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Shift the pump curve using affinity laws and solve its intersection with the actual system curve, checking efficiency, allowed speed and cavitation data. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「變速相似與實際工況」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Speed affinity and operating conditions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. With substantial static head, a slower pump may barely overcome receiving water and provide little drainage. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例假設同一葉輪與近似相同效率，僅比較相似點；實際抽排量必須再與未同比縮放的系統曲線求交。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Actual discharge requires intersecting the shifted pump curve with the system curve.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。
knowledge.textEn: Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. With substantial static head, a slower pump may barely overcome receiving water and provide little drainage.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「變速相似與實際工況機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Speed affinity and operating conditions mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。
直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow.
Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 直接宣稱降速一成必節電百分之二十七點一，會忽略新工作點和效率改變；靜揚程較大時，低速泵可能無法克服外水位而幾乎沒有抽排。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Claiming a guaranteed 27.1-percent saving from a ten-percent speed reduction ignores the changed operating point and efficiency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「啟停水位差與循環」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level hysteresis and cycling” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。填充與抽降時間分別受入流及淨抽出量控制，不可只用池容積除以泵流量；多台輪替、變入流與感測遲延會讓實際循環更複雜。本例為一台泵、固定池面積與固定入流，且抽排大於入流；算得啟動頻率只是比較，不是設備允許值或現場設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「啟停水位差與循環」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin. Filling and drawdown depend on inflow and net pumping respectively, not simply volume divided by pump flow. Multiple-unit rotation, variable inflow and sensing delay further complicate actual cycling. The example uses one pump, constant area and inflow, with pumping exceeding inflow. Its start frequency is a comparison, not an equipment limit or field setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level hysteresis and cycling” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「啟停水位差與循環」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level hysteresis and cycling”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。填充與抽降時間分別受入流及淨抽出量控制，不可只用池容積除以泵流量；多台輪替、變入流與感測遲延會讓實際循環更複雜。
knowledge.textEn: The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin. Filling and drawdown depend on inflow and net pumping respectively, not simply volume divided by pump flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。
啟停週期等於調節容積除以泵流量，入流大小完全無關。
池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。
optionsEn: The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin.
The start-stop cycle equals regulating volume divided by pump flow and is independent of inflow.
Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
quiz.explanation: 單台泵的啟停水位差形成可用調節容積，能減少頻繁啟動，但過大水位帶可能占用防洪儲量或降低淹沒裕度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The start-stop level band creates regulating volume that can reduce repeated starts, but an excessive band may consume flood storage or reduce submergence margin. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「啟停水位差與循環」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level hysteresis and cycling” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用事件紀錄核對啟動、停止、入流及池水位，檢查每次實際抽降時間與計算差異。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check starts, stops, inflow and sump level against event logs, comparing actual and calculated drawdown time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Cycle T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s, or 22.5 starts/h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s。
泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
optionsEn: Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s.
Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A=100 m²、啟停差Δh=0.60 m、Qi=0.50、Qp=2.0 m³/s；循環T=60/0.50+60/(2−0.50)=160 s，即22.5次/h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A=100 m², level band Δh=0.60 m, Qi=0.50 and Qp=2.0 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「啟停水位差與循環」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level hysteresis and cycling” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用事件紀錄核對啟動、停止、入流及池水位，檢查每次實際抽降時間與計算差異。將設備可允許啟動次數、最小運轉時間及池體淹沒條件一起核對，避免只靠一條水位帶決策。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check starts, stops, inflow and sump level against event logs, comparing actual and calculated drawdown time. Review permitted starts, minimum run time and submergence together rather than deciding from the level band alone, and record any delayed switching behavior. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分開計算填充與抽降時間，再把入流改成原值兩倍觀察循環變化。將水位帶、可用防洪儲量和最低淹沒畫在同一剖面，說明三者的限制關係。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate fill and drawdown times separately, then double inflow and examine the cycle change. Show the level band, available flood storage and minimum submergence on one section, explaining how their constraints interact.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉持續入流會低估抽降時間，水位噪訊可能使接點反覆切換；為減少啟動而任意擴大水位帶，則可能犧牲暴雨時原本可用的儲水空間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring continuing inflow understates drawdown time, and level noise can chatter the switching signal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Calculate fill and drawdown times separately, then double inflow and examine the cycle change. Show the level band, available flood storage and minimum submergence on one section, explaining how their constraints interact.

quiz.question: 要驗證「啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification"?

quiz.explanationEn: Check starts, stops, inflow and sump level against event logs, comparing actual and calculated drawdown time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.
