knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 漏掉持續入流會低估抽降時間，水位噪訊可能使接點反覆切換；為減少啟動而任意擴大水位帶，則可能犧牲暴雨時原本可用的儲水空間。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring continuing inflow understates drawdown time, and level noise can chatter the switching signal. Enlarging the band solely to reduce starts may consume storage that would otherwise be available during heavy rainfall.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「啟停水位差與循環機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level hysteresis and cycling mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏掉持續入流會低估抽降時間，水位噪訊可能使接點反覆切換；為減少啟動而任意擴大水位帶，則可能犧牲暴雨時原本可用的儲水空間。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。
optionsEn: Ignoring continuing inflow understates drawdown time, and level noise can chatter the switching signal.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉持續入流會低估抽降時間，水位噪訊可能使接點反覆切換；為減少啟動而任意擴大水位帶，則可能犧牲暴雨時原本可用的儲水空間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring continuing inflow understates drawdown time, and level noise can chatter the switching signal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」與「實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification" and "Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吸入工況與流場品質」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Suction conditions and flow quality” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。淨正吸入水頭取決於大氣壓、吸入水位、蒸氣壓及損失，設備需求又隨流量和轉速變動；整合多台機組時應檢查不同組合造成的流場，不能只驗證全開狀態。下式各項均以同一淡水密度的水頭表示，水面高於泵參考取正；正差值不保證沒有渦流、捲氣或其他吸入問題。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吸入工況與流場品質」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow. Available NPSH depends on atmospheric pressure, sump level, vapor pressure and losses, while required NPSH varies with flow and speed. Integrating several units requires checking different combinations rather than testing only all-units-on operation. All terms are freshwater heads on one density basis, with surface above the pump reference positive. A positive margin does not guarantee absence of vortices, air entrainment or other inlet problems. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Suction conditions and flow quality” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吸入工況與流場品質」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Suction conditions and flow quality”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。淨正吸入水頭取決於大氣壓、吸入水位、蒸氣壓及損失，設備需求又隨流量和轉速變動；整合多台機組時應檢查不同組合造成的流場，不能只驗證全開狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow. Available NPSH depends on atmospheric pressure, sump level, vapor pressure and losses, while required NPSH varies with flow and speed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。
抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。
備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
optionsEn: Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow.
Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 抽水站入口須同時滿足壓力裕度與均勻流場，池水位足夠也可能因不對稱入流而產生渦流與捲氣。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pump inlets need both pressure margin and acceptable flow quality; adequate depth can still coexist with vortices from asymmetric inflow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「吸入工況與流場品質」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Suction conditions and flow quality” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m. Available NPSH is 10.35 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m. Available NPSH is 10.35 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。
防洪泵在所有外河水位下都會維持同一銘牌流量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。
optionsEn: One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.
A flood pump maintains the same nameplate flow at every receiving-river level.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設大氣水頭10.3 m、靜淹水1.5 m、蒸氣壓水頭0.25 m、吸入損失1.2 m，NPSHa=10.35 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume atmospheric head 10.3 m, static submergence 1.5 m, vapor head 0.25 m and suction loss 1.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吸入工況與流場品質」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Suction conditions and flow quality” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。另用速度分布、渦流觀察或適用模型驗證入口品質，將汽蝕壓力與捲氣問題分開判讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves. Independently examine velocity distribution and vortices through observations or suitable models, keeping cavitation-pressure and air-entrainment assessments distinct in the evidence. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：列出全開、單台與相鄰一台停用三種流場檢查，分別指出壓力與速度證據。計算一個增加入口損失的情境，說明同樣水位也會改變吸入裕度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: List all-on, single-unit and adjacent-unit-out checks, distinguishing pressure from velocity evidence. Calculate a case with greater entrance loss and explain why identical sump level can still produce a different suction margin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。另用速度分布、渦流觀察或適用模型驗證入口品質，將汽蝕壓力與捲氣問題分開判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves. Independently examine velocity distribution and vortices through observations or suitable models, keeping cavitation-pressure and air-entrainment assessments distinct in the evidence.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 列出全開、單台與相鄰一台停用三種流場檢查，分別指出壓力與速度證據。計算一個增加入口損失的情境，說明同樣水位也會改變吸入裕度。
knowledge.textEn: List all-on, single-unit and adjacent-unit-out checks, distinguishing pressure from velocity evidence. Calculate a case with greater entrance loss and explain why identical sump level can still produce a different suction margin.

quiz.question: 要驗證「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification"?
options: 以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
水力功率就是抽水站電表功率，不必計入馬達和泵的損失。
optionsEn: Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Hydraulic power equals metered station power without pump or motor losses.
quiz.explanation: 以低池水位、高水溫及代表機組組合檢查吸入壓力，核對泵參考高程與需求曲線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check suction pressure at low sump level, high water temperature and representative unit combinations, verifying pump datum and required curves. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吸入工況與流場品質」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Suction conditions and flow quality” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. Idle units can change approach symmetry, and an intake modification improving one combination may not improve all other operating combinations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：下式各項均以同一淡水密度的水頭表示，水面高於泵參考取正；正差值不保證沒有渦流、捲氣或其他吸入問題。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A positive margin does not guarantee absence of vortices, air entrainment or other inlet problems.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。
knowledge.textEn: Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. Idle units can change approach symmetry, and an intake modification improving one combination may not improve all other operating combinations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吸入工況與流場品質機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Suction conditions and flow quality mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。
備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature.
Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
quiz.explanation: 只以池水深推定無汽蝕會忽略入口損失與溫度，某些機組停用後也可能產生偏流；入口整流改善一種組合時，未必同時改善其他組合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Inferring cavitation freedom from depth alone ignores entrance losses and temperature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「實功率視在功率與備援」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Real apparent and backup power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。機組啟動時的電流與電壓暫降可能決定可行組合，即使連續千瓦需求足夠也不代表能順利啟動；燃料、冷卻及淹水隔離另影響可維持的事件時間。本例只換算平衡穩態負載的視在功率，不提供發電機選型容量；啟動、諧波及備援輔機需求尚未加入。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「實功率視在功率與備援」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries. Real and apparent power impose different constraints, and power factor is not efficiency. Starting current and voltage dip can determine feasible combinations even when continuous kilowatts appear adequate. Fuel, cooling and flood isolation separately influence how long the station can continue through an event. The example converts a balanced steady load to apparent power only, not generator selection capacity. Starting, harmonics and backup auxiliary demand remain excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Real apparent and backup power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「實功率視在功率與備援」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Real apparent and backup power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。機組啟動時的電流與電壓暫降可能決定可行組合，即使連續千瓦需求足夠也不代表能順利啟動；燃料、冷卻及淹水隔離另影響可維持的事件時間。
knowledge.textEn: Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries. Real and apparent power impose different constraints, and power factor is not efficiency.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。
閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。
備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。
optionsEn: Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously.
Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries.
quiz.explanation: 備援電源須供應泵、控制和輔機，實功率與視在功率是不同容量約束，功率因數不能被效率取代。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backup supply serves pumps, controls and auxiliaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「實功率視在功率與備援」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Real apparent and backup power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80. Apparent power S=P/pf=625 kVA. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80. Apparent power S=P/pf=625 kVA.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。
泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80.
Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設穩態實功率P=500 kW、功率因數pf=0.80，視在功率S=P/pf=625 kVA。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume steady real power P=500 kW and power factor pf=0.80. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「實功率視在功率與備援」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Real apparent and backup power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。以受控測試記錄電壓、頻率和恢復時間，另檢查燃料及冷卻不會受同一洪水中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination. Record voltage, frequency and recovery in controlled tests, and independently verify that fuel and cooling are not interrupted by the same flood exposure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把三個假設負載分成持續與啟動兩張表，再計算同一實功率在不同功率因數下的視在功率。指出仍需電源動態資料才能判斷的啟動問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate three hypothetical loads into continuous and starting tables, then compare apparent power at different power factors for the same real load. Identify starting questions that still require dynamic supply information rather than steady arithmetic.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。以受控測試記錄電壓、頻率和恢復時間，另檢查燃料及冷卻不會受同一洪水中斷。
knowledge.textEn: Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination. Record voltage, frequency and recovery in controlled tests, and independently verify that fuel and cooling are not interrupted by the same flood exposure.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把三個假設負載分成持續與啟動兩張表，再計算同一實功率在不同功率因數下的視在功率。指出仍需電源動態資料才能判斷的啟動問題。
knowledge.textEn: Separate three hypothetical loads into continuous and starting tables, then compare apparent power at different power factors for the same real load. Identify starting questions that still require dynamic supply information rather than steady arithmetic.

quiz.question: 要驗證「實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。
泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination.
Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
quiz.explanation: 建立機組與輔機負載表，分開持續千瓦、千伏安及啟動事件，核對供電邊界和保護配合。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build a pump-and-auxiliary load list separating continuous kilowatts, kilovolt-amperes and starts, checking supply boundaries and protection coordination. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「實功率視在功率與備援」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Real apparent and backup power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips. A backup generator sharing a flood-prone location with main distribution can fail at the same time it is needed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只換算平衡穩態負載的視在功率，不提供發電機選型容量；啟動、諧波及備援輔機需求尚未加入。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Starting, harmonics and backup auxiliary demand remain excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「備援電源連續千瓦足夠，就代表所有泵可以同時順利啟動。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate continuous backup kilowatts guarantee that all pumps can start simultaneously." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。
knowledge.textEn: Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips. A backup generator sharing a flood-prone location with main distribution can fail at the same time it is needed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「實功率視在功率與備援機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Real apparent and backup power mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。
把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths.
Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips.
quiz.explanation: 把千瓦直接當千伏安會低估電氣容量，忽略啟動可能造成連鎖跳脫；備援發電機若與主配電共處易淹位置，也可能在需要時一起失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equating kilowatts with kilovolt-amperes understates electrical capacity, and omitted starting demand can trigger cascading trips. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證」與「單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Backflow and gate interfaces mechanism and verification" and "Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backflow and gate interfaces mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「外水倒灌與閘門界面」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backflow and gate interfaces” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 外水高於內水時，重力出口可能成為倒灌通道，閘門和止回構件的作用必須與抽排路徑協調。兩側水壓的差額決定部分靜水載荷，但實際關閉還涉及摩擦、浮物、動水與機構力；把閘門關閉訊號當成水密保證，會掩蓋漏水或位置感測錯誤。本例為同底高程直立矩形門兩側靜水合力差，不含動水與摩擦，也不直接給出致動器推力或關閉時機。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「外水倒灌與閘門界面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When receiving water exceeds interior stage, a gravity outlet can become a backflow path, requiring coordination of gates and check devices with pumping routes. Differential hydrostatic pressure supplies part of the static load, but closure also involves friction, debris, moving water and actuator forces. A closed indication is not proof of watertightness or correct position sensing. The example is the difference in hydrostatic resultants on a vertical rectangular gate with a common bottom datum. It excludes flow and friction and does not specify actuator force or closure timing. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backflow and gate interfaces” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Backflow and gate interfaces mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 外水高於內水時，重力出口可能成為倒灌通道，閘門和止回構件的作用必須與抽排路徑協調。兩側水壓的差額決定部分靜水載荷，但實際關閉還涉及摩擦、浮物、動水與機構力；把閘門關閉訊號當成水密保證，會掩蓋漏水或位置感測錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: When receiving water exceeds interior stage, a gravity outlet can become a backflow path, requiring coordination of gates and check devices with pumping routes. Differential hydrostatic pressure supplies part of the static load, but closure also involves friction, debris, moving water and actuator forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Net gate pressure depends only on squared level difference, not the individual water depths. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

閘門兩側淨水壓只需把水位差平方，與各側實際水深無關。

optionsEn: When receiving water exceeds interior stage, a gravity outlet can become a backflow path, requiring coordination of gates and check devices with pumping routes.

One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.

steps.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「外水倒灌與閘門界面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backflow and gate interfaces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設水重度γ=9.81 kN/m³、門寬b=2 m、外水深ho=3 m、內水深hi=1 m，淨力F=γb(ho²−hi²)/2=78.48 kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γ=9.81 kN/m³, gate width b=2 m, outside depth ho=3 m and inside hi=1 m. Net force F=γb(ho²−hi²)/2=78.48 kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「外水倒灌與閘門界面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backflow and gate interfaces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對門底和兩側水位基準，將位置回饋、實際行程及漏流量交叉檢查。測試狀態介面時保留閘門與泵的時間紀錄，並依核准操作文件確認不會形成封閉抽排或倒灌路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check gate-bottom and water-level datums, comparing position feedback with physical travel and leakage. Retain gate and pump timestamps during interface tests, and use approved operating documentation to verify that transitions do not create a blocked discharge or backflow path. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩側三角壓力圖並相減，和只用水位差平方的錯誤結果比較。另列位置訊號與實際漏水兩種驗證，說明它們為何不能互相代替。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw and subtract the two triangular pressure diagrams, comparing the result with the incorrect squared-level-difference method. Separately list position-signal and leakage checks, explaining why neither substitutes for the other.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只算外側三角水壓會漏掉內側抵銷，誤用水位差平方則不能代替兩水深平方差；關閉回饋失真或漂流物夾住時，抽水站仍可能持續承受倒灌。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using only outside pressure omits interior opposition, while squaring the level difference cannot replace the difference of squared depths. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 外水倒灌與閘門界面機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backflow and gate interfaces mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「外水倒灌與閘門界面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backflow and gate interfaces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只算外側三角水壓會漏掉內側抵銷，誤用水位差平方則不能代替兩水深平方差；關閉回饋失真或漂流物夾住時，抽水站仍可能持續承受倒灌。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using only outside pressure omits interior opposition, while squaring the level difference cannot replace the difference of squared depths. False closed feedback or trapped debris can leave a backflow path despite the station’s indicated state. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「單機停用與整站能力」如何影響防洪抽水站機組整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit outage and station capability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood-pumping-station integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。多台可能共用變壓器、閘門、攔污設備或控制，因此機械可用性不等於整站可用性；故障情境應把剩餘排量與儲水時間一起評估，並辨認共因失效。本例每台排量已指定為相同實際揚程下的可用量，假設停機不改變其他台工作點；真實並聯工況須重新求解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單機停用與整站能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Spare-unit counts matter only at actual head, electrical and pipe conditions. One spare does not preserve full drainage for every fault. Units can share a transformer, gate, screen or controller, so mechanical availability is not station availability. Failure scenarios should compare retained flow with storage time and identify common causes across the complete system. Each unit’s stated flow is available at the same actual head, and an outage is assumed not to shift other operating points. Real parallel-system performance must be solved again. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit outage and station capability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unit outage and station capability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。多台可能共用變壓器、閘門、攔污設備或控制，因此機械可用性不等於整站可用性；故障情境應把剩餘排量與儲水時間一起評估，並辨認共因失效。

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。
備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。
泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
optionsEn: One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure.
Spare-unit counts matter only at actual head, electrical and pipe conditions.
Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
quiz.explanation: 備援台數只有在實際揚程、電源和管路條件下才有意義，保留一台泵不代表任何故障都能維持完整排水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Spare-unit counts matter only at actual head, electrical and pipe conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「單機停用與整站能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unit outage and station capability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s. One outage leaves 4.0 m³/s, an instantaneous shortfall of 1.0 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s. One outage leaves 4.0 m³/s, an instantaneous shortfall of 1.0 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 兩台並聯泵的實際排水量必定是單台接原管路時的兩倍。
泵降速一成，整站一定同時少抽一成水且省下固定立方比例電力。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。
optionsEn: Two parallel pumps always deliver twice the single-pump flow through the original system.
Reducing speed ten percent guarantees ten percent less station flow and fixed cube-law energy savings.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三台各可排2.0 m³/s、需求5.0 m³/s；一台停用後可用4.0 m³/s，瞬時缺口為1.0 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume three units each available at 2.0 m³/s and demand 5.0 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「單機停用與整站能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unit outage and station capability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。以可用儲量演算缺口持續時間，並測試故障旗標和人工接管介面，保存實際限制而非只報備援台數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation. Route shortfalls through available storage, test fault indication and manual takeover interfaces, and document real limitations rather than reporting only the number of spare units. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立至少三種故障的剩餘能力表，將共同電源故障與單泵故障分開。把一個排量缺口轉成池水位變化，說明儲水只能提供有限緩衝而非永久替代抽排。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build retained-capacity cases for at least three failures, separating shared-power loss from a single-pump outage. Convert one flow shortfall into sump rise and explain why storage provides a finite buffer rather than a permanent substitute for pumping.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。以可用儲量演算缺口持續時間，並測試故障旗標和人工接管介面，保存實際限制而非只報備援台數。
knowledge.textEn: List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation. Route shortfalls through available storage, test fault indication and manual takeover interfaces, and document real limitations rather than reporting only the number of spare units.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立至少三種故障的剩餘能力表，將共同電源故障與單泵故障分開。把一個排量缺口轉成池水位變化，說明儲水只能提供有限緩衝而非永久替代抽排。
knowledge.textEn: Build retained-capacity cases for at least three failures, separating shared-power loss from a single-pump outage. Convert one flow shortfall into sump rise and explain why storage provides a finite buffer rather than a permanent substitute for pumping.

quiz.question: 要驗證「單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification"?
options: 逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
池水位只要夠高，任何機組組合都不可能出現渦流或汽蝕。
optionsEn: List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Sufficient sump level makes vortices or cavitation impossible for every pump combination.
quiz.explanation: 逐一列出單泵、電源、攔污與共同管路故障，確認剩餘流量不是直接沿用正常工況。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: List pump, supply, screen and common-pipe failures, checking that retained flow is not simply copied from normal operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「單機停用與整站能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unit outage and station capability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow. Multiplying normal unit capacity by remaining count may also miss changed head and overstate the duration for which storage can bridge the flood. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例每台排量已指定為相同實際揚程下的可用量，假設停機不改變其他台工作點；真實並聯工況須重新求解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Real parallel-system performance must be solved again.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設有一台備用泵就能保證抽水站任何單一故障都不減排水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "One spare pump guarantees unchanged station discharge under every single failure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。
knowledge.textEn: If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow. Multiplying normal unit capacity by remaining count may also miss changed head and overstate the duration for which storage can bridge the flood.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單機停用與整站能力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit outage and station capability mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。
泵的標示總流量大於平均雨水流量，就能保證任何洪水不積水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow.
Total labeled pump flow above mean runoff guarantees no flooding in any event.
quiz.explanation: 三台泵共用一個失效配電盤時，名義備援無法保留排量；以正常單台能力乘剩餘台數也可能忽略新揚程，導致可支撐的洪水時間被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: If three pumps share one failed switchboard, nominal redundancy preserves no flow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 都市滯洪池配置
courses.summary: 課程從連通集水區和事件體積進入儲量演算，逐項建立池容、孔口、溢流、滲透與排空模型，最後檢查下游峰時、沉積和數值閉合。大坑東與跑馬地提供地下蓄洪實例，全部數值為合成假設；規劃的核心是保存水量與確認去向，不把單一削峰百分比當完整防洪成效。
courses.summaryEn: The course moves from connected catchment and event volume into storage routing, geometry, orifices, overflow, infiltration and drawdown, then checks downstream timing, sediment and numerical closure. Tai Hang Tung and Happy Valley provide underground-storage examples. All numbers are synthetic assumptions; planning centers on conservation and destination rather than treating one peak-reduction percentage as complete flood performance.
courses.focus: 以事件體積、出流時間與下游條件配置都市滯洪
courses.focusEn: Planning urban detention through event volume release timing and downstream conditions
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定孔口係數Cd=0.62與兩側水頭差1.0 m，只把圓孔直徑增加10%。面積和瞬時流量都增加21%，若原開口0.10 m²的流量為0.2746 m³/s，新面積0.121 m²對應0.3323 m³/s。這可能較快恢復池容，但也可能增加下游負荷；在同一固定池面積及自由排水積分模型下，排空時間因面積增加而降為原值的82.64%。實際事件的水位會隨出流改變，尾水和部分淹沒也可能變動，因此不能直接用固定水頭比例取代全歷線重算。
workedExample.textEn: For sensitivity, hold Cd=0.62 and differential head at 1.0 m while increasing circular-orifice diameter by ten percent. Area and instantaneous discharge both rise by 21%. An original 0.10 m² opening releases 0.2746 m³/s; the new 0.121 m² opening releases 0.3323 m³/s. This can restore storage sooner but also increases downstream loading. Under the same constant-area, free-drawdown integral model, time falls to 82.64% of its original value. Real event stage responds to release, while tailwater and submergence may change. The fixed-head ratio therefore cannot replace rerouting the complete hydrograph.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設事件雨量P=0.050 m、連通面積A=200000 m²、體積逕流係數C=0.70，V=CPA=7000 m³。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δt=300 s、入流I1=4、I2=6及出流O1=2、O2=3 m³/s，ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設A(h)=1000+200h m²，其中h以m計；到h=2 m的庫容S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume event rainfall P=0.050 m, connected area A=200000 m² and volume runoff coefficient C=0.70. Runoff V=CPA=7000 m³.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δt=300 s, inflows I1=4, I2=6 and outflows O1=2, O2=3 m³/s. Storage change ΔS=[(I1+I2)−(O1+O2)]Δt/2=750 m³.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume A(h)=1000+200h m² with h in meters. Storage at h=2 m is S=1000h+100h²=2400 m³.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s². Flow Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m. Overflow Q=0.5587 m³/s.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Infiltrated volume Vi=Aft=10.0 m³.
