knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s². Flow Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。
只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。
optionsEn: Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release.
A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Cd=0.62、開口A=0.10 m²、兩側水頭差ΔH=1.0 m、g=9.81 m/s²，Q=CdA√(2gΔH)=0.2746 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Cd=0.62, opening A=0.10 m², differential head ΔH=1.0 m and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔口出流與尾水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Orifice release and tailwater” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量測池內與下游水位，核對孔心高程、開口和係數來源。比較清潔、部分堵塞與尾水上升的出流資料，確認模型在自由與淹沒狀態切換時不會突然創造或消失流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure basin and downstream stages together, checking orifice elevation, opening and coefficient source. Compare clean, partially blocked and rising-tailwater observations, ensuring that switching between free and submerged representations does not abruptly create or remove flow in the model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持池水位不變而提高尾水，計算兩個水頭差的出流量。再將有效面積減半，區分堵塞和尾水兩種原因如何在量測上辨認。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold basin stage fixed while raising tailwater and calculate releases at two differential heads. Then halve effective area, distinguishing the observations needed to separate blockage from a tailwater-driven reduction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同時量測池內與下游水位，核對孔心高程、開口和係數來源。比較清潔、部分堵塞與尾水上升的出流資料，確認模型在自由與淹沒狀態切換時不會突然創造或消失流量。
knowledge.textEn: Measure basin and downstream stages together, checking orifice elevation, opening and coefficient source. Compare clean, partially blocked and rising-tailwater observations, ensuring that switching between free and submerged representations does not abruptly create or remove flow in the model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持池水位不變而提高尾水，計算兩個水頭差的出流量。再將有效面積減半，區分堵塞和尾水兩種原因如何在量測上辨認。
knowledge.textEn: Hold basin stage fixed while raising tailwater and calculate releases at two differential heads. Then halve effective area, distinguishing the observations needed to separate blockage from a tailwater-driven reduction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification"?
options: 同時量測池內與下游水位，核對孔心高程、開口和係數來源。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
知道總雨量與總面積後，就能唯一決定所需滯洪池容量。
optionsEn: Measure basin and downstream stages together, checking orifice elevation, opening and coefficient source.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total rainfall and total area uniquely determine the required detention capacity.
quiz.explanation: 同時量測池內與下游水位，核對孔心高程、開口和係數來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure basin and downstream stages together, checking orifice elevation, opening and coefficient source. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔口出流與尾水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orifice release and tailwater” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage. Ignored blockage conceals maintenance loss, and reversed differential head can admit water through an opening without backflow protection. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例是淹沒薄孔的簡化定常流，指定係數與兩側水頭差，忽略接管沿程損失；不推定任何產品或許可排量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The example is simplified steady flow through a submerged thin orifice with specified coefficient and differential head, excluding downstream pipe friction and any product or permit rating.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口流量只和池內水深有關，下游水位升高不會影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Orifice discharge depends only on basin depth and is unaffected by downstream water level." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。
knowledge.textEn: Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage. Ignored blockage conceals maintenance loss, and reversed differential head can admit water through an opening without backflow protection.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔口出流與尾水機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Orifice release and tailwater mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。
只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage.
An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis.
quiz.explanation: 尾水升高仍用池深當水頭會高估出流而低估池水位，忽略堵塞則讓維護不足被掩蓋；水頭差反向時，未設防倒流的開口可能反而進水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using basin depth despite high tailwater overstates release and understates basin stage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證」與「滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification" and "Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「超量溢流與越頂路徑」如何影響都市滯洪池配置的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exceedance overflow and routes” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滯洪池遇到超過控制出口能力的事件時，需要辨認水會流向何處，正常出流設計不能代表超量情境。溢流堰流量與堰頂以上水頭呈非線性，來流速度、淹沒與側向幾何會改變係數；更重要的是溢出後的路徑和受影響空間，不能只證明池內水位降低而忽略下游風險。本例用指定係數的自由矩形堰比較，係數已包含單位；未模擬側堰、淹沒或街道二維流動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「超量溢流與越頂路徑」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When an event exceeds the controlled outlet, the overflow destination matters; normal-release design does not represent exceedance behavior. Weir flow is nonlinear in head above crest, and approach velocity, submergence and lateral geometry alter the coefficient. The route and exposed spaces downstream must be assessed rather than claiming success merely because basin level is reduced. The example uses a free rectangular weir with a specified dimensional coefficient, excluding side-weir behavior, submergence and two-dimensional street flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exceedance overflow and routes” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「超量溢流與越頂路徑」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exceedance overflow and routes”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 滯洪池遇到超過控制出口能力的事件時，需要辨認水會流向何處，正常出流設計不能代表超量情境。溢流堰流量與堰頂以上水頭呈非線性，來流速度、淹沒與側向幾何會改變係數；更重要的是溢出後的路徑和受影響空間，不能只證明池內水位降低而忽略下游風險。
knowledge.textEn: When an event exceeds the controlled outlet, the overflow destination matters; normal-release design does not represent exceedance behavior. Weir flow is nonlinear in head above crest, and approach velocity, submergence and lateral geometry alter the coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。
透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。
滯洪池遇到超過控制出口能力的事件時，需要辨認水會流向何處，正常出流設計不能代表超量情境。
optionsEn: An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis.
A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage.
When an event exceeds the controlled outlet, the overflow destination matters; normal-release design does not represent exceedance behavior.
quiz.explanation: 滯洪池遇到超過控制出口能力的事件時，需要辨認水會流向何處，正常出流設計不能代表超量情境。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: When an event exceeds the controlled outlet, the overflow destination matters; normal-release design does not represent exceedance behavior. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「超量溢流與越頂路徑」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exceedance overflow and routes” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m. Overflow Q=0.5587 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m. Overflow Q=0.5587 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。
每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。
模型水量誤差很小，就等於峰值水位和所有設計判斷都正確。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m.
Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus.
A small model water-balance error proves correct peak stage and every design decision.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Q=Cw bH^1.5，Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s、堰寬b=2.0 m、水頭H=0.30 m，Q=0.5587 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Q=Cw bH^1.5, Cw=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=2.0 m and head H=0.30 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「超量溢流與越頂路徑」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exceedance overflow and routes” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。以超量事件追蹤地面流向和深度，確認出口不導向脆弱空間，並保留正常出口堵塞時的獨立情境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence. Track surface direction and depth during exceedance, verifying that overflow does not lead toward vulnerable spaces, and retain a separate scenario for blockage of the normal outlet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在地形圖標出設計溢流口和其他低點，為同一水位比較可能先出流的位置。用簡化堰式計算後，列出仍需地表流模型回答的深度與速度問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark the designed overflow and other low points on a terrain map and compare which can spill first at one stage. After a weir calculation, identify depth and velocity questions still requiring surface-flow analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。以超量事件追蹤地面流向和深度，確認出口不導向脆弱空間，並保留正常出口堵塞時的獨立情境。
knowledge.textEn: Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence. Track surface direction and depth during exceedance, verifying that overflow does not lead toward vulnerable spaces, and retain a separate scenario for blockage of the normal outlet.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在地形圖標出設計溢流口和其他低點，為同一水位比較可能先出流的位置。用簡化堰式計算後，列出仍需地表流模型回答的深度與速度問題。
knowledge.textEn: Mark the designed overflow and other low points on a terrain map and compare which can spill first at one stage. After a weir calculation, identify depth and velocity questions still requiring surface-flow analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。
所需滯洪容積就是最大入流減去最大出流，不需要積分時間。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence.
Required detention volume is maximum inflow minus maximum outflow without time integration.
quiz.explanation: 測量堰頂、相鄰低點和下游路徑，核對流量係數及淹沒範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey crest, adjacent low points and downstream routes, checking coefficient basis and submergence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「超量溢流與越頂路徑」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exceedance overflow and routes” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure. A nearby lower gap may bypass the intended weir, and downstream backwater can further reduce the available overflow capacity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例用指定係數的自由矩形堰比較，係數已包含單位；未模擬側堰、淹沒或街道二維流動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The example uses a free rectangular weir with a specified dimensional coefficient, excluding side-weir behavior, submergence and two-dimensional street flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。
knowledge.textEn: Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure. A nearby lower gap may bypass the intended weir, and downstream backwater can further reduce the available overflow capacity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「超量溢流與越頂路徑機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exceedance overflow and routes mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。
把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage.
Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure.
quiz.explanation: 把溢流量視為無害排出會漏掉街道或地下室的暴露，忽略鄰近較低缺口則可能使實際溢流繞過設計堰；下游回水還能降低溢流能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating overflow as harmless removal overlooks street or basement exposure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滲透折減與前期飽和」如何影響都市滯洪池配置的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 透水滯洪池可讓部分水進入地層，但滲透能力會受到前期含水、地下水位、細粒堵塞與土層連續性控制。短時間現地試驗不能直接代表長期暴雨條件，尤其地下水接近池底時，向下水力梯度可能減小；將滲透當作永遠固定的額外出口，可能低估連續降雨所需庫容。本例使用指定均勻入滲速率作體積尺度，沒有採用實測保證值；飽和、污染控制或襯底條件可能使可計入滲透為零。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滲透折減與前期飽和」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A permeable basin can infiltrate some water, but antecedent wetness, groundwater, fine-particle clogging and stratigraphy control that capacity. A short field test does not necessarily represent prolonged rainfall, particularly when groundwater approaches the floor and downward gradient weakens. Treating infiltration as a permanently fixed extra outlet can understate storage needed during successive storms. The example uses a specified uniform infiltration rate as a volume scale, not a guaranteed field value. Saturation, contamination controls or lining may reduce creditable infiltration to zero. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滲透折減與前期飽和」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 透水滯洪池可讓部分水進入地層，但滲透能力會受到前期含水、地下水位、細粒堵塞與土層連續性控制。短時間現地試驗不能直接代表長期暴雨條件，尤其地下水接近池底時，向下水力梯度可能減小；將滲透當作永遠固定的額外出口，可能低估連續降雨所需庫容。
knowledge.textEn: A permeable basin can infiltrate some water, but antecedent wetness, groundwater, fine-particle clogging and stratigraphy control that capacity. A short field test does not necessarily represent prolonged rainfall, particularly when groundwater approaches the floor and downward gradient weakens.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 透水滯洪池可讓部分水進入地層，但滲透能力會受到前期含水、地下水位、細粒堵塞與土層連續性控制。
透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。
孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。
optionsEn: A permeable basin can infiltrate some water, but antecedent wetness, groundwater, fine-particle clogging and stratigraphy control that capacity.
A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage.
Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release.
quiz.explanation: 透水滯洪池可讓部分水進入地層，但滲透能力會受到前期含水、地下水位、細粒堵塞與土層連續性控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A permeable basin can infiltrate some water, but antecedent wetness, groundwater, fine-particle clogging and stratigraphy control that capacity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「滲透折減與前期飽和」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Infiltrated volume Vi=Aft=10.0 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Infiltrated volume Vi=Aft=10.0 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。
知道總雨量與總面積後，就能唯一決定所需滯洪池容量。
optionsEn: A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h.
Total rainfall and total area uniquely determine the required detention capacity.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設有效池底A=1000 m²、入滲率f=5 mm/h、時間t=2 h，滲透體積Vi=Aft=10.0 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective floor A=1000 m², infiltration f=5 mm/h and duration t=2 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滲透折減與前期飽和」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。比較可計入與零滲透兩個情境，並確認水質或襯底需求不與假設滲透功能衝突。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state. Compare credited-infiltration and zero-infiltration cases, checking that water-quality or lining requirements do not contradict the infiltration function assumed by the storage model. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把指定滲透體積與事件逕流體積比較，判斷它在此假設下的相對影響。將入滲設為零重新演算，說明哪些場地證據才能支持恢復部分折減。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare the specified infiltration volume with event runoff to assess its relative influence under these assumptions. Rerun with zero infiltration and identify site evidence needed before restoring any infiltration credit.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。比較可計入與零滲透兩個情境，並確認水質或襯底需求不與假設滲透功能衝突。
knowledge.textEn: Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state. Compare credited-infiltration and zero-infiltration cases, checking that water-quality or lining requirements do not contradict the infiltration function assumed by the storage model.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把指定滲透體積與事件逕流體積比較，判斷它在此假設下的相對影響。將入滲設為零重新演算，說明哪些場地證據才能支持恢復部分折減。
knowledge.textEn: Compare the specified infiltration volume with event runoff to assess its relative influence under these assumptions. Rerun with zero infiltration and identify site evidence needed before restoring any infiltration credit.

quiz.question: 要驗證「滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
池頂平面面積乘總深度永遠等於可用滯洪容量。
在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Top plan area times total depth always equals usable detention storage.
Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state.
quiz.explanation: 在代表土層與季節進行入滲和地下水觀測，將試驗持續時間、前期含水與堵塞狀態記錄完整。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Observe infiltration and groundwater in representative strata and seasons, documenting test duration, antecedent wetness and clogging state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲透折減與前期飽和」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years. Counting infiltration benefits without groundwater and water-quality checks produces an incomplete engineering comparison. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例使用指定均勻入滲速率作體積尺度，沒有採用實測保證值；飽和、污染控制或襯底條件可能使可計入滲透為零。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Saturation, contamination controls or lining may reduce creditable infiltration to zero.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。
knowledge.textEn: Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years. Counting infiltration benefits without groundwater and water-quality checks produces an incomplete engineering comparison.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「滲透折減與前期飽和機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Infiltration credit and antecedent saturation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。
optionsEn: Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release.
quiz.explanation: 以乾季初始入滲率外推連續暴雨會高估損失，孔隙堵塞又可能逐年降低能力；只計入滲優點而未檢查地下水與水質，會形成不完整的工程比較。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extrapolating dry-season initial infiltration through prolonged storms overstates losses, while clogging can reduce performance over years. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」與「下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification" and "Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「變水頭排空時間」如何影響都市滯洪池配置的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drawdown under changing head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔口排水會隨水位下降而減慢，因此以初始最大出流除池容會低估排空時間。若後續降雨在池尚未恢復容量時到達，前一場殘留水會改變下一場峰值；排空策略需同時考慮下游容許出流和連續事件，而非只追求單場暴雨結束後最快放空。本例池面積固定、無入流與滲透、自由孔口小到可用孔心水頭近似，積分到仍為正的水頭；不外推到孔口部分露出階段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「變水頭排空時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Orifice release slows as stage falls, so dividing storage by the initial maximum discharge understates drawdown time. A second storm arriving before recovery encounters less available storage. Drawdown planning must therefore consider downstream release constraints and successive events rather than simply emptying as quickly as possible after one storm. The example assumes constant basin area, no inflow or infiltration and a small free orifice described by center head, integrating only to a positive head before partial uncovering. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drawdown under changing head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「變水頭排空時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drawdown under changing head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 孔口排水會隨水位下降而減慢，因此以初始最大出流除池容會低估排空時間。若後續降雨在池尚未恢復容量時到達，前一場殘留水會改變下一場峰值；排空策略需同時考慮下游容許出流和連續事件，而非只追求單場暴雨結束後最快放空。
knowledge.textEn: Orifice release slows as stage falls, so dividing storage by the initial maximum discharge understates drawdown time. A second storm arriving before recovery encounters less available storage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。
孔口排水會隨水位下降而減慢，因此以初始最大出流除池容會低估排空時間。
每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。
optionsEn: Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release.
Orifice release slows as stage falls, so dividing storage by the initial maximum discharge understates drawdown time.
Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus.
quiz.explanation: 孔口排水會隨水位下降而減慢，因此以初始最大出流除池容會低估排空時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Orifice release slows as stage falls, so dividing storage by the initial maximum discharge understates drawdown time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「變水頭排空時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drawdown under changing head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s². Drawdown t=7042 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s². Drawdown t=7042 s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 模型水量誤差很小，就等於峰值水位和所有設計判斷都正確。
所需滯洪容積就是最大入流減去最大出流，不需要積分時間。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。
optionsEn: A small model water-balance error proves correct peak stage and every design decision.
Required detention volume is maximum inflow minus maximum outflow without time integration.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池面積Ab=1000 m²、Cd=0.62、孔面a=0.10 m²、h1=2.0、h2=0.20 m，t=2Ab(√h1−√h2)/(Cd a√(2g))=7042 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume basin Ab=1000 m², Cd=0.62, orifice a=0.10 m², h1=2.0, h2=0.20 m and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「變水頭排空時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drawdown under changing head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。比較積分解與逐步演算，並確認終止水頭仍符合孔口完整淹沒的幾何假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown. Compare the integrated solution with stepwise routing, verifying that the final head still satisfies the assumed geometry of a fully covered opening. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較固定初始流量估計與變水頭積分結果，畫出排水逐漸減慢的曲線。讓第二場雨在恢復前到達，指出演算必須保留的初始儲量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare a fixed-initial-flow estimate with changing-head integration and plot the slowing release. Introduce a second storm before recovery and identify the initial storage that must carry into the new routing calculation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。比較積分解與逐步演算，並確認終止水頭仍符合孔口完整淹沒的幾何假設。
knowledge.textEn: Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown. Compare the integrated solution with stepwise routing, verifying that the final head still satisfies the assumed geometry of a fully covered opening.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較固定初始流量估計與變水頭積分結果，畫出排水逐漸減慢的曲線。讓第二場雨在恢復前到達，指出演算必須保留的初始儲量。
knowledge.textEn: Compare a fixed-initial-flow estimate with changing-head integration and plot the slowing release. Introduce a second storm before recovery and identify the initial storage that must carry into the new routing calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification"?
options: 用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
孔口流量只和池內水深有關，下游水位升高不會影響。
optionsEn: Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Orifice discharge depends only on basin depth and is unaffected by downstream water level.
quiz.explanation: 用不同水位下實測出流檢查孔口關係，核對排空期間是否仍有管網入流或尾水抬升。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check the outlet relation using measured releases at several stages and identify continuing network inflow or rising tailwater during drawdown. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 變水頭排空時間機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「變水頭排空時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drawdown under changing head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic. Continuing the same equation after the opening becomes exposed extends it beyond the assumed flow regime. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例池面積固定、無入流與滲透、自由孔口小到可用孔心水頭近似，積分到仍為正的水頭；不外推到孔口部分露出階段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The example assumes constant basin area, no inflow or infiltration and a small free orifice described by center head, integrating only to a positive head before partial uncovering.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔口排空時間可永遠用總水量除以一開始的最大出流量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Orifice drawdown time always equals total water volume divided by the initial maximum release." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。
knowledge.textEn: Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic. Continuing the same equation after the opening becomes exposed extends it beyond the assumed flow regime.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「變水頭排空時間機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Drawdown under changing head mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。
每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic.
Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus.
quiz.explanation: 以初始流量當全程固定會低估恢復容量所需時間，忽略尾水或再降雨更會過度樂觀；積分到孔口露出後仍沿用同式，則超出原有流況。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Holding the initial discharge constant understates recovery time, and omitted tailwater or renewed rainfall makes it more optimistic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下游匯流與峰值錯時」如何影響都市滯洪池配置的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Downstream combination and peak timing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單一池出口削峰不一定降低流域最下游峰值，因延後的出流可能剛好與另一支流洪峰重疊。配置池址和出流歷線時應在共同時間軸上做河網演算，不能把各支流最大值不加區分地相加；也不能只比較工程前後同一個時刻而忽略新峰值出現時間。本例在匯流點忽略傳播延遲與局部儲水，只示範同時流量相加；完整流域需先把各歷線演算至同一位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游匯流與峰值錯時」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Attenuation at one basin outlet does not necessarily reduce the furthest downstream peak: delayed release may coincide with another tributary crest. Basin siting and release hydrographs require routing on a shared time axis. Adding separate maxima ignores timing, while comparing only one preselected instant can miss a new peak occurring later. The example neglects travel time and local storage at a junction and demonstrates only simultaneous addition. Full-basin work must route each hydrograph to the same location first. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Downstream combination and peak timing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s；各自峰值相加15 m³/s並非同時峰值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游匯流與峰值錯時」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Downstream combination and peak timing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 單一池出口削峰不一定降低流域最下游峰值，因延後的出流可能剛好與另一支流洪峰重疊。配置池址和出流歷線時應在共同時間軸上做河網演算，不能把各支流最大值不加區分地相加；也不能只比較工程前後同一個時刻而忽略新峰值出現時間。
knowledge.textEn: Attenuation at one basin outlet does not necessarily reduce the furthest downstream peak: delayed release may coincide with another tributary crest. Basin siting and release hydrographs require routing on a shared time axis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。
只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。
單一池出口削峰不一定降低流域最下游峰值，因延後的出流可能剛好與另一支流洪峰重疊。
optionsEn: Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus.
A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
Attenuation at one basin outlet does not necessarily reduce the furthest downstream peak: delayed release may coincide with another tributary crest.
quiz.explanation: 單一池出口削峰不一定降低流域最下游峰值，因延後的出流可能剛好與另一支流洪峰重疊。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Attenuation at one basin outlet does not necessarily reduce the furthest downstream peak: delayed release may coincide with another tributary crest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下游匯流與峰值錯時」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Downstream combination and peak timing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s；各自峰值相加15 m³/s並非同時峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2. Both totals are 10 m³/s; adding separate peaks gives 15 m³/s without concurrence. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將各支流與池出口時間戳統一並校核傳播時間，在匯流點比較完整工程前後歷線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s；各自峰值相加15 m³/s並非同時峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2. Both totals are 10 m³/s; adding separate peaks gives 15 m³/s without concurrence.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s。
知道總雨量與總面積後，就能唯一決定所需滯洪池容量。
池頂平面面積乘總深度永遠等於可用滯洪容量。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2.
Total rainfall and total area uniquely determine the required detention capacity.
Top plan area times total depth always equals usable detention storage.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩支流在時刻t1為8與2 m³/s、t2為3與7 m³/s，兩時刻合流皆10 m³/s；各自峰值相加15 m³/s並非同時峰值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume tributaries are 8 and 2 m³/s at t1, then 3 and 7 m³/s at t2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下游匯流與峰值錯時」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Downstream combination and peak timing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將各支流與池出口時間戳統一並校核傳播時間，在匯流點比較完整工程前後歷線。檢查峰值時刻、持續時間及受納水位，而不是只記錄池出口的單一削峰百分比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction. Examine crest timing, duration and receiving stage instead of reporting only one attenuation percentage measured at the basin outlet. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一支出流歷線平移一個時間步，重新計算匯流而不改總體積。比較局部峰值和下游峰值，說明時間配置為何是池址規劃的一部分。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shift one release hydrograph by one step without changing volume and recompute junction flow. Compare local and downstream peaks, explaining why temporal alignment is part of basin planning rather than a secondary plotting detail.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
