knowledge.textEn: Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction. Examine crest timing, duration and receiving stage instead of reporting only one attenuation percentage measured at the basin outlet.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把一支出流歷線平移一個時間步，重新計算匯流而不改總體積。比較局部峰值和下游峰值，說明時間配置為何是池址規劃的一部分。
knowledge.textEn: Shift one release hydrograph by one step without changing volume and recompute junction flow. Compare local and downstream peaks, explaining why temporal alignment is part of basin planning rather than a secondary plotting detail.

quiz.question: 要驗證「下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將各支流與池出口時間戳統一並校核傳播時間，在匯流點比較完整工程前後歷線。
只要設置溢流堰，超量洪水就已經有安全去處而不必追蹤。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction.
An overflow weir automatically gives excess floodwater a safe destination without route analysis.
quiz.explanation: 將各支流與池出口時間戳統一並校核傳播時間，在匯流點比較完整工程前後歷線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align tributary and basin-outlet timestamps and verify travel times before comparing complete pre- and post-project hydrographs at the junction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下游匯流與峰值錯時」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Downstream combination and peak timing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream. Adding separate maxima overstates some scenarios, but ignoring changing timing can also miss the truly unfavorable combination. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例在匯流點忽略傳播延遲與局部儲水，只示範同時流量相加；完整流域需先把各歷線演算至同一位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Full-basin work must route each hydrograph to the same location first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每座滯洪池都降低自己的出口峰值，就能保證最下游峰值同比降低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reducing each basin outlet peak guarantees the same proportional reduction at the downstream terminus." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。
knowledge.textEn: Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream. Adding separate maxima overstates some scenarios, but ignoring changing timing can also miss the truly unfavorable combination.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「下游匯流與峰值錯時機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Downstream combination and peak timing mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。
延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream.
quiz.explanation: 延遲出流若與另一支流同時達峰，可能把局部改善轉成下游負擔；直接加各峰值會高估某些情境，但忽略時間變化也可能漏掉真正最不利組合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Delayed release can coincide with another tributary crest and transfer a local improvement downstream. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證」與「數值水量閉合與收斂機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification" and "Numerical closure and convergence mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沉積與可用容量維持」如何影響都市滯洪池配置的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment and retained capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 滯洪池會接收顆粒與垃圾，沉積不僅占去容積，也可能堵塞出口或改變入流分配。總容量衰減與局部水力失效是不同路徑，平均薄層估算不能代表出口附近的堆積；維護應以測量、出流能力和可清理性共同評估，而不是等到池完全填滿才處理。本例沉積層厚度均勻且直接扣除有效容積，未模擬固結或出流堵塞；真實局部影響可能比體積比例更早主導。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉積與可用容量維持」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Detention basins receive particles and debris that occupy volume, obstruct outlets and redistribute incoming flow. Bulk storage loss and localized hydraulic failure are different mechanisms, and a mean thin-layer estimate does not represent deposits near an outlet. Maintenance should combine survey, outlet performance and cleaning access rather than wait until the entire basin fills. The example subtracts a uniform deposit layer from usable storage without consolidation or outlet blockage. Local hydraulic effects may govern before the bulk volume fraction becomes large. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment and retained capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³；原可用2400 m³剩2250 m³。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沉積與可用容量維持」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sediment and retained capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 滯洪池會接收顆粒與垃圾，沉積不僅占去容積，也可能堵塞出口或改變入流分配。總容量衰減與局部水力失效是不同路徑，平均薄層估算不能代表出口附近的堆積；維護應以測量、出流能力和可清理性共同評估，而不是等到池完全填滿才處理。
knowledge.textEn: Detention basins receive particles and debris that occupy volume, obstruct outlets and redistribute incoming flow. Bulk storage loss and localized hydraulic failure are different mechanisms, and a mean thin-layer estimate does not represent deposits near an outlet.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 滯洪池會接收顆粒與垃圾，沉積不僅占去容積，也可能堵塞出口或改變入流分配。
只要沉積占總池容比例很小，出口與滯洪效能就不可能受影響。
模型水量誤差很小，就等於峰值水位和所有設計判斷都正確。
optionsEn: Detention basins receive particles and debris that occupy volume, obstruct outlets and redistribute incoming flow.
A small deposited fraction of total storage cannot affect the outlet or detention performance.
A small model water-balance error proves correct peak stage and every design decision.
quiz.explanation: 滯洪池會接收顆粒與垃圾，沉積不僅占去容積，也可能堵塞出口或改變入流分配。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Detention basins receive particles and debris that occupy volume, obstruct outlets and redistribute incoming flow. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沉積與可用容量維持」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment and retained capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³；原可用2400 m³剩2250 m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m. Lost Vd=Ad=150 m³; initial usable 2400 m³ becomes 2250 m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定基準測深並標出出口附近的局部堆積，將清淤量與容積曲線更新對帳。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey deposits on a fixed datum and map local buildup near the outlet, reconciling removed volume with the updated storage curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³；原可用2400 m³剩2250 m³。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m. Lost Vd=Ad=150 m³; initial usable 2400 m³ becomes 2250 m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 所需滯洪容積就是最大入流減去最大出流，不需要積分時間。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³。
孔口流量只和池內水深有關，下游水位升高不會影響。
optionsEn: Required detention volume is maximum inflow minus maximum outflow without time integration.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m.
Orifice discharge depends only on basin depth and is unaffected by downstream water level.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設池底A=1000 m²、平均沉積厚度d=0.15 m，損失Vd=Ad=150 m³；原可用2400 m³剩2250 m³。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume floor A=1000 m² and mean deposit thickness d=0.15 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉積與可用容量維持」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment and retained capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以固定基準測深並標出出口附近的局部堆積，將清淤量與容積曲線更新對帳。另測正常出口能力及垃圾攔截狀態，確認容量恢復和水力通暢都已驗證而非只完成清理作業。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey deposits on a fixed datum and map local buildup near the outlet, reconciling removed volume with the updated storage curve. Independently check normal-release capacity and debris control so that both recovered storage and hydraulic openness are verified, not merely the completion of cleaning work. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較均勻沉積和集中堵住孔口兩種同體積情境，分別更新池容與出流關係。說明為何維護績效需要容量和水力兩個指標，而不是只報清出重量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare uniform deposition with the same volume concentrated at the orifice, updating storage and release relations separately. Explain why maintenance performance needs both capacity and hydraulic indicators rather than only removed mass.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只扣平均沉積容積會漏掉孔口先被堵塞的情況，未更新模型則持續高估可用池容；清淤若只移動泥砂到另一區，也不代表總有效容量已恢復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Subtracting mean deposit volume misses an outlet blocked first, while an unchanged model continues to overstate storage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以固定基準測深並標出出口附近的局部堆積，將清淤量與容積曲線更新對帳。另測正常出口能力及垃圾攔截狀態，確認容量恢復和水力通暢都已驗證而非只完成清理作業。

Independently check normal-release capacity and debris control so that both recovered storage and hydraulic openness are verified, not merely the completion of cleaning work.

knowledge.textEn: Compare uniform deposition with the same volume concentrated at the orifice, updating storage and release relations separately. Explain why maintenance performance needs both capacity and hydraulic indicators rather than only removed mass.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沉積與可用容量維持機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sediment and retained capacity mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
透水池底的入滲率永遠固定，因此可以無條件扣減所需池容。
以固定基準測深並標出出口附近的局部堆積，將清淤量與容積曲線更新對帳。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A permeable floor has constant infiltration that can always be deducted from required storage.
Survey deposits on a fixed datum and map local buildup near the outlet, reconciling removed volume with the updated storage curve.

quiz.explanationEn: Survey deposits on a fixed datum and map local buildup near the outlet, reconciling removed volume with the updated storage curve. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 數值水量閉合與收斂機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Numerical closure and convergence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Urban detention-basin planning”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 雨洪模型的水量閉合檢查能發現漏列出流、時間積分或邊界處理問題，但閉合良好不代表洪峰位置或水位一定正確。粗網格和粗時間步可能保住總體積卻錯過短時高水位，錯誤糙率也能得到漂亮收支；因此守恆、時間收斂與獨立事件驗證應分開進行。本例殘差定義為入流減出流再減儲量增加，百分比以總入流作分母；正殘差只表示未解釋水量，並不直接指出物理漏水位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「數值水量閉合與收斂」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A water-balance check can reveal missing outlets, integration problems or boundary errors, but good closure does not prove correct peak timing or stage. Coarse grids and time steps can preserve volume while missing brief high water, and wrong roughness may still yield a neat balance. Conservation, temporal convergence and independent-event validation therefore require separate checks. Residual is inflow minus outflow minus storage increase, normalized by total inflow. A positive residual is unexplained water and does not locate a physical leak. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Numerical closure and convergence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設事件入流Vi=10000 m³、出流Vo=7600 m³、儲量增ΔS=2350 m³，殘差R=50 m³，即入流的0.50%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume event inflow Vi=10000 m³, outflow Vo=7600 m³ and storage increase ΔS=2350 m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型水量誤差很小，就等於峰值水位和所有設計判斷都正確。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small model water-balance error proves correct peak stage and every design decision." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「數值水量閉合與收斂」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 數值水量閉合與收斂機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Numerical closure and convergence mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「數值水量閉合與收斂」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Numerical closure and convergence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設事件入流Vi=10000 m³、出流Vo=7600 m³、儲量增ΔS=2350 m³，殘差R=50 m³，即入流的0.50%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume event inflow Vi=10000 m³, outflow Vo=7600 m³ and storage increase ΔS=2350 m³. Residual R=50 m³, or 0.50% of inflow. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出所有水量項與正負號，核對初始儲量、溢流、滲透和反向流是否都有計入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: List all terms with signs, checking initial storage, overflow, infiltration and reversed flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 數值水量閉合與收斂機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Numerical closure and convergence mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「數值水量閉合與收斂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Numerical closure and convergence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出所有水量項與正負號，核對初始儲量、溢流、滲透和反向流是否都有計入。逐次縮小時間步比較最大水位和峰時，再以獨立事件檢查參數，避免只以殘差達標宣告模型有效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: List all terms with signs, checking initial storage, overflow, infiltration and reversed flow. Progressively reduce time steps to compare maximum stage and peak time, then assess parameters against an independent event rather than declaring validity solely from a small residual. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作三種時間步的水量殘差與最大水位比較表，讓其中一種總量相近但漏掉尖峰。說明要保留哪幾項證據，才能同時支持守恆和峰值解析度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare water residual and maximum stage at three time steps, including one that preserves volume but misses a sharp peak. Identify the evidence needed to support both conservation and adequate resolution of the maximum.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將未列溢流當數值誤差會掩蓋真實外排，反之把數值殘差當漏水又會誤導維護；只校正總體積而不查水位歷線，可能得到錯誤的池容配置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling omitted overflow numerical error hides actual discharge, while interpreting numerical residual as leakage misdirects maintenance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

courses.title: 河道分洪工程
courses.summary: 課程把分洪入口、渠段、收縮、尾水及重匯流視為同一系統，逐步計算流量、比能、臨界水深、波速與泥砂收支，再檢查高程餘量及數值解析度。紅河與元朗是已核對的實際工程背景，所有算例均為原創假設，並非這兩處的操作門檻或斷面設計。
courses.summaryEn: The course treats inlet, channel, contraction, tailwater and rejoining reach as one system, calculating discharge, specific energy, critical depth, wave speed and sediment budgets before checking elevation margins and numerical resolution. Red River and Yuen Long are verified project contexts. All numerical examples are original assumptions rather than their operating thresholds or section designs.
courses.focus: 從分流連續到回水與下游影響的分洪道分析
courses.focusEn: Floodway analysis from flow division to backwater and downstream effects
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定矩形渠寬20 m、水深2 m及能坡0.0004，只把曼寧糙率由0.030增至0.036 s/m^(1/3)。在這個固定幾何與能坡比較下，流量由37.49降至31.24 m³/s，減少16.67%。這不是說洪水流量固定時水位會同樣減少；若入流必須通過，水深與回水曲線會重新調整。植被、沉積與橋孔還可能同時改變有效幾何，所以實務敏感度應逐項隔離再合併情境，並檢查下游邊界是否仍適用。
workedExample.textEn: Hold rectangular width at 20 m, depth at 2 m and energy slope at 0.0004 while increasing Manning roughness from 0.030 to 0.036 s/m^(1/3). Under this fixed-geometry and fixed-slope comparison, flow falls from 37.49 to 31.24 m³/s, a 16.67% reduction. This does not mean stage falls proportionally when a fixed flood inflow must pass; depth and backwater must then adjust. Vegetation, deposits and bridge openings may also change effective geometry. Practical sensitivity work should isolate those effects before combining scenarios and recheck the receiving boundary throughout. Field observations should distinguish vegetation resistance from an actual reduction of channel area.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Manning Q=37.49 m³/s.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Kinetic-head increase Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Local depth gradient dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」與「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" and "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分流控制體與受益範圍」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion control volume and effects” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分流控制體與受益範圍」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries. Diversion fraction emerges from levels, structures and branch resistance rather than remaining a fixed design percentage. The example applies instantaneous continuity without junction storage or other branches. It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion control volume and effects” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分流控制體與受益範圍」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion control volume and effects”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。局部水位降低可能伴隨上游回水或出口負荷增加，跨區影響不能藏在模型邊界外；分流比例是水位、構造物和支路阻力共同求得的結果，而不是永遠固定的設計百分比。
knowledge.textEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. Local stage reduction may accompany upstream backwater or greater outlet loading, and transferred effects must not be hidden outside model boundaries.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。
所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。
optionsEn: Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach.
Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 分洪道把部分洪水移至另一條路徑，並沒有消除水量，因此必須同時描述主河道、分洪道和重新匯流的受益與負擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A floodway transfers water to another route rather than eliminating it, requiring assessment of the main channel, bypass and rejoining reach. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分流控制體與受益範圍」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion control volume and effects” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Main-channel Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s, with a 30% diversion fraction.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。
optionsEn: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游Qin=400 m³/s、分洪Qb=120 m³/s，主河道Qm=Qin−Qb=280 m³/s，分流比30%。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream Qin=400 m³/s and bypass Qb=120 m³/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分流控制體與受益範圍」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion control volume and effects” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。把主河、繞道與重匯流區列在同一評估邊界，分別比較水位、流量及受影響土地。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Include the main river, bypass and rejoining area in one assessment boundary, comparing stage, discharge and affected land separately rather than reporting one local benefit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。把主河、繞道與重匯流區列在同一評估邊界，分別比較水位、流量及受影響土地。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Include the main river, bypass and rejoining area in one assessment boundary, comparing stage, discharge and affected land separately rather than reporting one local benefit.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出含重新匯流點的完整控制體，標記每股流量和可能儲水區。說明缺少哪個邊界會讓局部效益被誤認為全流域效益，再檢查合成水量帳。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a complete control volume including the rejoining point, labeling flows and possible storage. Identify a missing boundary that could turn a local benefit into a misleading basin-wide claim, then reconcile the synthetic ledger.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification"?
options: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。
optionsEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 將上下游與分洪入口流量同步對帳，確認量測區間內是否有河段蓄水或支流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile upstream, downstream and bypass flows synchronously, identifying reach storage and tributaries within the measurement interval. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分流控制體與受益範圍」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion control volume and effects” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只作瞬時水量連續，假設分流節點沒有蓄水或其他支路；不由此推定任何河段水位或可接受的影響分配。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It determines neither reach stages nor an acceptable distribution of impacts.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。
knowledge.textEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. An unclosed ledger may treat transferred water as flood volume that has disappeared.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分流控制體與受益範圍機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Diversion control volume and effects mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。
所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control.
Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 只展示城市段降水位會漏掉其他地區的負擔，將分流比例固定則可能忽略尾水和入口控制；水量帳不閉合時，模型可能把外排錯當成消失的洪水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Showing only reduced city stage omits burdens elsewhere, while a fixed split can ignore tailwater and inlet control. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口門檻與自由溢流」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inlet threshold and free overflow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。堰頂以上水頭的非線性關係，使小幅高程誤差可能明顯改變開始分流的時間與比例；實際側向入口、閘門和回水會偏離簡單正面堰，因此計算式應與入口構型一致。本例為理想正面自由矩形堰並指定係數，不描述紅河或元朗實際入口；不將此算式用作現場閘門操作規則。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口門檻與自由溢流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. Nonlinear dependence on head above crest means small elevation errors can alter diversion timing and share. Real lateral entrances, gates and backwater differ from a simple frontal weir, so the chosen relation must match the actual inlet configuration. The example is an ideal frontal free rectangular weir with a specified coefficient, not the actual Red River or Yuen Long inlet and not a field gate rule. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inlet threshold and free overflow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口門檻與自由溢流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inlet threshold and free overflow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。堰頂以上水頭的非線性關係，使小幅高程誤差可能明顯改變開始分流的時間與比例；實際側向入口、閘門和回水會偏離簡單正面堰，因此計算式應與入口構型一致。
knowledge.textEn: An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. Nonlinear dependence on head above crest means small elevation errors can alter diversion timing and share.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。
分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。
分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。
optionsEn: Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises.
quiz.explanation: 分洪入口門檻使低水位時流量留在主河，水位超過門檻後才逐漸啟動支路。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An inlet sill retains low flows in the main river and progressively activates the bypass as stage rises. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口門檻與自由溢流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inlet threshold and free overflow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Diversion Q=17.0 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堰式Q=C bH^1.5，C=1.70 m^0.5/s、寬b=10 m、堰上水頭H=1.0 m，分流Q=17.0 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume weir Q=C bH^1.5, C=1.70 m^0.5/s, width b=10 m and crest head H=1.0 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口門檻與自由溢流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inlet threshold and free overflow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。將模型入口類型、係數及有效長度記錄完整，必要時以實體或三維流場試驗驗證側向進流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence. Document inlet type, coefficient and effective length, using physical or three-dimensional flow testing where lateral approach invalidates a simple frontal-weir representation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出正面與側向入口的差異，為同一指定水頭先做理想計算。再列出側向流、淹沒與閘門會新增的資料需求，避免把手算結果當實際分流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw frontal and lateral inlet differences and perform the ideal calculation at one specified head. List additional information for lateral approach, submergence and gates so that the hand result is not mistaken for actual diversion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把側堰直接當正面堰會忽略沿程水頭變化，門檻高程錯誤也可能造成過早或過晚分流；下游淹沒時沿用自由堰式則通常高估能力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating a side weir as frontal ignores head variation along its length. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。將模型入口類型、係數及有效長度記錄完整，必要時以實體或三維流場試驗驗證側向進流。
knowledge.textEn: Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence. Document inlet type, coefficient and effective length, using physical or three-dimensional flow testing where lateral approach invalidates a simple frontal-weir representation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出正面與側向入口的差異，為同一指定水頭先做理想計算。再列出側向流、淹沒與閘門會新增的資料需求，避免把手算結果當實際分流量。
knowledge.textEn: Draw frontal and lateral inlet differences and perform the ideal calculation at one specified head. List additional information for lateral approach, submergence and gates so that the hand result is not mistaken for actual diversion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。
分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence.
Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
quiz.explanation: 核對堰頂和上游量測的共同基準，觀察分流開始與尾水淹沒的時刻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check crest and upstream-stage datums and observe the onset of diversion and tailwater submergence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.
