knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入口門檻與自由溢流機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inlet threshold and free overflow mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。
把側堰直接當正面堰會忽略沿程水頭變化，門檻高程錯誤也可能造成過早或過晚分流；下游淹沒時沿用自由堰式則通常高估能力。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
Treating a side weir as frontal ignores head variation along its length.
quiz.explanation: 把側堰直接當正面堰會忽略沿程水頭變化，門檻高程錯誤也可能造成過早或過晚分流；下游淹沒時沿用自由堰式則通常高估能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating a side weir as frontal ignores head variation along its length. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證」與「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification" and "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分洪渠輸水能力」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Floodway conveyance capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。曼寧式適合穩定均勻流的初步尺度，但入口、橋梁、出口與潮汐回水通常需要非均勻流分析；將地形坡度不加檢查地當成能坡，可能高估平緩河段可提供的驅動水頭。本例為矩形固定斷面且採國際單位的曼寧式，所得不是整條分洪道的保證容量；最窄控制段與回水仍須另算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分洪渠輸水能力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width. Manning’s equation gives a steady-uniform preliminary scale, while entrances, bridges, outlets and tidal backwater generally need nonuniform analysis. Substituting bed slope for energy slope without checking can overstate the driving head available in a flat reach. The example uses a fixed rectangular section and SI Manning form. It is not guaranteed capacity of the whole floodway; constrictions and backwater require separate analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Floodway conveyance capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分洪渠輸水能力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Floodway conveyance capacity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。曼寧式適合穩定均勻流的初步尺度，但入口、橋梁、出口與潮汐回水通常需要非均勻流分析；將地形坡度不加檢查地當成能坡，可能高估平緩河段可提供的驅動水頭。
knowledge.textEn: Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width. Manning’s equation gives a steady-uniform preliminary scale, while entrances, bridges, outlets and tidal backwater generally need nonuniform analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。
分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。
算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
optionsEn: Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width.
Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
quiz.explanation: 分洪道的能力不只取決於寬度，水深、濕周、糙率和能量坡降都會改變輸水量。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Floodway capacity depends on depth, wetted perimeter, roughness and energy slope as well as width. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分洪渠輸水能力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Floodway conveyance capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Manning Q=37.49 m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Manning Q=37.49 m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004。
只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。
optionsEn: A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m.
If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設b=20 m、y=2 m、n=0.030 s/m^(1/3)、Sf=0.0004；A=40 m²、R=40/24 m，Q=AR^(2/3)√Sf/n=37.49 m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume b=20 m, y=2 m, n=0.030 s/m^(1/3), Sf=0.0004, A=40 m² and R=40/24 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分洪渠輸水能力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Floodway conveyance capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。用多個流況校驗糙率，並把橋孔及出口控制接入整體模型，避免單段均勻流計算掩蓋系統瓶頸。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope. Calibrate roughness across several flows and connect bridge and outlet controls to the full model so that one uniform reach does not conceal a system bottleneck. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定水深和坡降，把糙率提高兩成重算流量，再指出這不是定流量時的水位變化。將入口、橋梁和出口畫成控制鏈，辨認可能先限制能力的位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: At fixed depth and slope increase roughness by twenty percent and recompute flow, noting that this is not the stage response at fixed discharge. Map inlet, bridge and outlet controls to identify possible governing restrictions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。用多個流況校驗糙率，並把橋孔及出口控制接入整體模型，避免單段均勻流計算掩蓋系統瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope. Calibrate roughness across several flows and connect bridge and outlet controls to the full model so that one uniform reach does not conceal a system bottleneck.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 固定水深和坡降，把糙率提高兩成重算流量，再指出這不是定流量時的水位變化。將入口、橋梁和出口畫成控制鏈，辨認可能先限制能力的位置。
knowledge.textEn: At fixed depth and slope increase roughness by twenty percent and recompute flow, noting that this is not the stage response at fixed discharge. Map inlet, bridge and outlet controls to identify possible governing restrictions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。
測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions.
Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope.
quiz.explanation: 測量實際斷面、植被與障礙物，核對能坡來自哪個水位區間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey actual sections, vegetation and obstructions, identifying the stage interval used to estimate energy slope. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分洪渠輸水能力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Floodway conveyance capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. Seasonal vegetation changes effective roughness, and continued use of a clean new-channel value can overstate long-term conveyance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為矩形固定斷面且採國際單位的曼寧式，所得不是整條分洪道的保證容量；最窄控制段與回水仍須另算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not guaranteed capacity of the whole floodway; constrictions and backwater require separate analysis.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。
knowledge.textEn: Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. Seasonal vegetation changes effective roughness, and continued use of a clean new-channel value can overstate long-term conveyance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分洪渠輸水能力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Floodway conveyance capacity mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
optionsEn: Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
quiz.explanation: 只加寬一段而不處理下游控制可能幾乎不增加整體能力，季節植被也會改變有效糙率；若模型仍用清潔新渠值，長期排洪能力會被高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Widening one reach without addressing downstream control may barely improve overall capacity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「臨界水深與控制斷面」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Critical depth and control sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。臨界條件不等於正常水深，也不直接指出上游水面高程；判斷入口或橋孔是否壅水時，還須比較可用能量、局部損失與兩側邊界，不能只靠水深大小分類。本例為寬度固定的矩形渠、靜水壓分布且動能修正係數取一；複合斷面或強三維入口需其他求解。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「臨界水深與控制斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. Contraction or bed raising can drive a section toward control. Critical depth differs from normal depth and does not directly give upstream elevation; assessing choking also requires available energy, local losses and both boundaries rather than classifying flow from depth alone. The example assumes a fixed-width rectangular channel, hydrostatic pressure and unit energy coefficient. Compound sections or strongly three-dimensional entrances require another solution. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Critical depth and control sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「臨界水深與控制斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Critical depth and control sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。臨界條件不等於正常水深，也不直接指出上游水面高程；判斷入口或橋孔是否壅水時，還須比較可用能量、局部損失與兩側邊界，不能只靠水深大小分類。
knowledge.textEn: For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. Contraction or bed raising can drive a section toward control.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
optionsEn: Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
quiz.explanation: 明渠比能在指定單寬流量下存在最小值，對應臨界水深，縮窄或抬高底床可能把流況推向控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: For a specified unit discharge, open-channel specific energy has a minimum at critical depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「臨界水深與控制斷面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Critical depth and control sections” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Critical depth yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。
分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。
optionsEn: A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設單寬流量q=5.0 m²/s、g=9.81 m/s²，臨界水深yc=(q²/g)^(1/3)=1.366 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume unit discharge q=5.0 m²/s and g=9.81 m/s². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「臨界水深與控制斷面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Critical depth and control sections” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。以量測流況、下游控制和局部損失檢查可能的水面分支，避免直接把臨界水深填成全河段水位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum. Check possible water-surface branches against observed regime, downstream control and local losses instead of assigning critical depth as the water level throughout the floodway. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出指定單寬流量的比能曲線，標示可能的兩個水深分支。加入一個底床抬升情境，說明還需要哪些能量資料才能判斷是否發生控制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot specific energy for the given unit discharge and mark the two possible depth branches. Introduce a bed rise and identify the energy information still needed to decide whether choking occurs.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。以量測流況、下游控制和局部損失檢查可能的水面分支，避免直接把臨界水深填成全河段水位。
knowledge.textEn: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum. Check possible water-surface branches against observed regime, downstream control and local losses instead of assigning critical depth as the water level throughout the floodway.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出指定單寬流量的比能曲線，標示可能的兩個水深分支。加入一個底床抬升情境，說明還需要哪些能量資料才能判斷是否發生控制。
knowledge.textEn: Plot specific energy for the given unit discharge and mark the two possible depth branches. Introduce a bed rise and identify the energy information still needed to decide whether choking occurs.

quiz.question: 要驗證「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
optionsEn: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
quiz.explanation: 核對單寬流量使用的有效寬度，計算比能曲線並標出最小值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the effective width used for unit discharge and plot the specific-energy minimum. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「臨界水深與控制斷面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Critical depth and control sections” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Depth above critical at one section does not prove that the entire system remains subcritical. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為寬度固定的矩形渠、靜水壓分布且動能修正係數取一；複合斷面或強三維入口需其他求解。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compound sections or strongly three-dimensional entrances require another solution.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Depth above critical at one section does not prove that the entire system remains subcritical.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「臨界水深與控制斷面機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Critical depth and control sections mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
quiz.explanation: 把正常水深與臨界水深混同會選錯水面分支，忽略縮窄損失則可能漏掉入口壅水；只看到渠深大於臨界值，也不能證明整個系統都不會出現急流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing normal and critical depth selects the wrong branch, and omitted contraction losses can miss inlet backwater. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證」與「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification" and "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「收縮速度與能量轉換」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Contraction velocity and energy change” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。速度水頭增加本身不是摩阻損失，把兩者重複扣除會錯算水面；反之若完全忽略損失，則可能高估可通流量，需要用一致能量線分開表達可逆轉換與耗散。本例只比較動能水頭、兩截面動能修正係數均取一；沒有假定相同底床或已求得水面差，也未包含局部損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「收縮速度與能量轉換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. Increased velocity head is not itself friction loss, and deducting it twice miscalculates the surface. Ignoring actual loss has the opposite problem, so one energy line must distinguish reversible conversion from dissipation. The example compares kinetic heads with unit energy coefficients only. It does not assume equal bed elevations or determine surface difference, and it excludes local loss. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Contraction velocity and energy change” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「收縮速度與能量轉換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Contraction velocity and energy change”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。速度水頭增加本身不是摩阻損失，把兩者重複扣除會錯算水面；反之若完全忽略損失，則可能高估可通流量，需要用一致能量線分開表達可逆轉換與耗散。
knowledge.textEn: A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. Increased velocity head is not itself friction loss, and deducting it twice miscalculates the surface.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。
optionsEn: An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.
A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses.
quiz.explanation: 分洪入口或橋孔縮窄會提高速度，部分水面位能轉為動能，另外還有不可回復的局部損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A contracted inlet or bridge opening accelerates flow, converting some surface potential into kinetic energy while also causing irreversible local losses. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「收縮速度與能量轉換」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Contraction velocity and energy change” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設上游v1=1.0 m/s、縮口v2=3.0 m/s、g=9.81 m/s²，動能水頭增量Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume upstream v1=1.0 m/s, contracted v2=3.0 m/s and g=9.81 m/s². Kinetic-head increase Δhv=(v2²−v1²)/(2g)=0.4077 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把底床、水面和能量線畫在同一剖面，核對速度截面與修正係數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot bed, water surface and energy line on one section, checking velocity sections and correction factors.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「收縮速度與能量轉換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Contraction velocity and energy change” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把底床、水面和能量線畫在同一剖面，核對速度截面與修正係數。以量測總能量差辨認真正損失，再檢查是否把速度水頭變化同時放入損失項和能量項造成重複扣除。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot bed, water surface and energy line on one section, checking velocity sections and correction factors. Identify genuine losses from measured total-energy change, then inspect whether velocity-head conversion has been counted both as an energy term and as a separate loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立含底高、水深、速度水頭與損失的能量帳，將已知和未知項分開。用兩種假設損失係數比較可用能量，說明速度變化無法單獨決定水面差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build an energy ledger with bed elevation, depth, kinetic head and loss, separating knowns from unknowns. Compare available energy under two assumed loss coefficients and explain why velocity change alone cannot determine surface difference.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling every surface drop dissipation confuses acceleration with loss and can lead calibration to the wrong coefficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
把底床、水面和能量線畫在同一剖面，核對速度截面與修正係數。
所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。

Plot bed, water surface and energy line on one section, checking velocity sections and correction factors.
Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.

steps.title: 收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contraction velocity and energy change mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「收縮速度與能量轉換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contraction velocity and energy change” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling every surface drop dissipation confuses acceleration with loss and can lead calibration to the wrong coefficient. Omitting local losses makes contraction control optimistic; both errors affect predicted upstream backwater. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只比較動能水頭、兩截面動能修正係數均取一；沒有假定相同底床或已求得水面差，也未包含局部損失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It does not assume equal bed elevations or determine surface difference, and it excludes local loss.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。

quiz.question: 在「收縮速度與能量轉換機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。
把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater.

quiz.explanation: 把所有水面下降當成能量耗散會混淆加速與損失，模型校正可能因此選錯係數；漏掉局部損失又會使收縮控制過於樂觀，兩者都會影響上游壅水預測。 需以量測區分可能原因。

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回水曲線與下游控制」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backwater profiles and downstream control” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 緩流分洪道的下游水位可向上游影響水深，因此出口河川漲水可能降低分洪效益。漸變流方程把底坡、摩阻坡與福祿數連到局部水深梯度，但接近臨界時分母變小，局部線性外推會不可靠；閘門、跌水和水躍還需另處理，不能跨越不連續流況套同一坡度。本例為稜柱渠的局部漸變流導數，正座標沿下游，水深變化不等於絕對水面高程變化；不作長距離定坡外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回水曲線與下游控制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Downstream stage influences upstream depth in subcritical flow, so rising receiving water can reduce diversion benefit. The gradually varied equation relates bed slope, friction slope and Froude number to local depth gradient. Near critical conditions its denominator becomes small and linear extrapolation becomes unreliable; gates, drops and jumps also need separate treatment rather than one continuous slope. The example is a local gradually varied derivative in a prismatic channel with downstream-positive coordinate. Depth change is not absolute water-surface elevation change, and the slope is not extrapolated over a long reach. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backwater profiles and downstream control” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回水曲線與下游控制」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backwater profiles and downstream control” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Local depth gradient dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Local depth gradient dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。
分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
optionsEn: Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60.
Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設S0=0.001、Sf=0.0005、Fr=0.60，dy/dx=(S0−Sf)/(1−Fr²)=0.00078125 m/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume S0=0.001, Sf=0.0005 and Fr=0.60. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回水曲線與下游控制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backwater profiles and downstream control” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。用沿程水位資料檢查曲線，接近臨界或存在水躍時改用可處理轉換的分析而非延長局部直線。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth. Compare the profile with longitudinal observations and use transition-capable analysis near critical flow or jumps instead of extending a local straight line. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將局部水深坡度與底坡合成絕對水面坡度，再比較不同福祿數下的分母。說明為何需要逐段更新而不能將一點導數乘整條河長。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Combine local depth gradient with bed slope to obtain the absolute surface slope, then compare denominators at different Froude numbers. Explain why reachwise updating is needed instead of multiplying one derivative by the entire channel length.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth. Compare the profile with longitudinal observations and use transition-capable analysis near critical flow or jumps instead of extending a local straight line.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將局部水深坡度與底坡合成絕對水面坡度，再比較不同福祿數下的分母。說明為何需要逐段更新而不能將一點導數乘整條河長。
knowledge.textEn: Combine local depth gradient with bed slope to obtain the absolute surface slope, then compare denominators at different Froude numbers. Explain why reachwise updating is needed instead of multiplying one derivative by the entire channel length.

quiz.question: 要驗證「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。
確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth.
quiz.explanation: 確認座標、底坡與水深定義，從適當邊界逐段求解並隨水深更新摩阻和福祿數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm coordinates, bed slope and depth definitions, solve reachwise from an appropriate boundary and update friction and Froude number with depth. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「回水曲線與下游控制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backwater profiles and downstream control” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. Coarse steps near critical flow can further magnify numerical instability. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為稜柱渠的局部漸變流導數，正座標沿下游，水深變化不等於絕對水面高程變化；不作長距離定坡外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Depth change is not absolute water-surface elevation change, and the slope is not extrapolated over a long reach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分洪道只要向下游傾斜，下游漲水就不可能影響上游水位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A floodway sloping downstream cannot experience upstream effects from rising tailwater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. Coarse steps near critical flow can further magnify numerical instability.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回水曲線與下游控制機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Backwater profiles and downstream control mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。
optionsEn: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
quiz.explanation: 把水深坡度當成水面坡度會漏掉底床高程，從錯誤端指定緩流邊界也可能得到錯誤曲線；接近臨界仍用粗步長則會放大數值不穩定。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking depth slope for surface slope omits bed elevation, and imposing subcritical control from the wrong end can give the wrong profile. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」與「堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" and "Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪波傳遞與水團速度」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。對寬矩形均勻曼寧流的運動波近似，可得到流速的特定倍數，但回水、擴散與洪泛區儲存會破壞這個簡化；以距離除平均流速直接估警戒時間可能混淆兩種傳遞。本例採寬矩形、固定坡降與糙率的運動波關係c=5V/3，不用於強回水、閘控或急變洪水；不是實際預警提前量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪波傳遞與水團速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. A wide rectangular uniform Manning channel yields a particular velocity multiple under a kinematic approximation, but backwater, diffusion and floodplain storage break that simplification. Distance divided by mean velocity can therefore confuse parcel and warning travel times. The example uses c=5V/3 for a wide rectangular kinematic Manning channel with fixed slope and roughness, excluding strong backwater, gate control and abrupt flood transitions. It is not an operational warning lead time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設平均流速V=1.5 m/s、長度L=5000 m，運動波c=2.5 m/s，傳遞尺度t=L/c=2000 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume mean velocity V=1.5 m/s and length L=5000 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪波傳遞與水團速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。對寬矩形均勻曼寧流的運動波近似，可得到流速的特定倍數，但回水、擴散與洪泛區儲存會破壞這個簡化；以距離除平均流速直接估警戒時間可能混淆兩種傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. A wide rectangular uniform Manning channel yields a particular velocity multiple under a kinematic approximation, but backwater, diffusion and floodplain storage break that simplification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。
洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。
只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。
optionsEn: A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth.
If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 洪峰訊號的傳遞速度不等於某一水團的移動速度，波速取決於流量隨儲水或水深的變化。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A flood signal does not travel at the same speed as a water parcel; wave celerity depends on how discharge changes with storage or depth. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洪波傳遞與水團速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設平均流速V=1.5 m/s、長度L=5000 m，運動波c=2.5 m/s，傳遞尺度t=L/c=2000 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume mean velocity V=1.5 m/s and length L=5000 m. Kinematic celerity c=2.5 m/s gives travel scale t=L/c=2000 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以多次洪水的上下游歷線估計傳遞與展寬，檢查是否受到尾水或漫地儲存控制。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Estimate travel and broadening from upstream/downstream hydrographs across several floods, checking tailwater and overbank storage influence.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「洪波傳遞與水團速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以多次洪水的上下游歷線估計傳遞與展寬，檢查是否受到尾水或漫地儲存控制。分別標示流速、波速及資料延遲，並比較簡化尺度與完整非恆定演算的適用差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Estimate travel and broadening from upstream/downstream hydrographs across several floods, checking tailwater and overbank storage influence. Label flow velocity, wave celerity and data latency separately, and compare the simplified scale with the conditions represented by full unsteady routing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一河長分別算水團和運動波行程，清楚標出兩者差異。加入假設通訊延遲後，將物理傳遞與資訊到達分開列帳，避免混成一個校正係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate parcel and kinematic-wave travel for one reach and label their difference. Add a hypothetical communication delay, keeping physical travel and information arrival in separate ledgers instead of combining them into one calibration factor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「洪波傳遞與水團速度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Flood-wave travel and parcel speed” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. Folding telemetry delay into physical celerity additionally gives model parameters an ambiguous and misleading meaning. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例採寬矩形、固定坡降與糙率的運動波關係c=5V/3，不用於強回水、閘控或急變洪水；不是實際預警提前量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not an operational warning lead time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. Folding telemetry delay into physical celerity additionally gives model parameters an ambiguous and misleading meaning.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪波傳遞與水團速度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Flood-wave travel and parcel speed mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。
只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening.
If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail.
quiz.explanation: 把水團行程當洪峰行程可能錯估訊號到達時間，忽略洪泛區儲存則可能漏掉展寬；若再把遙測延遲算進物理波速，模型參數會失去明確意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using parcel travel for crest travel misstates arrival, while omitting floodplain storage misses broadening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堤頂餘高與高程預留」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crest margin and elevation allowances” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪道兩側堤頂到水面的幾何差只是起點，沉陷、波浪、模型不確定度與局部水位抬升都會消耗可用餘量。各項預留需要一致定義，不能重複扣已包含在設計水位中的因素；同一標準餘高也不能代替滲流、邊坡和出口安全分析，因為未越頂仍可能發生其他失效。本例只扣指定沉陷量，未加入波浪或其他必要項，也不是任何規範的所需餘高；輸入皆採相同高程基準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堤頂餘高與高程預留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The geometric difference between crest and water surface is only a starting point. Settlement, waves, model uncertainty and local setup consume available margin. Allowances need consistent definitions to avoid deducting factors already included in design stage. A crest margin also does not replace seepage, slope or outlet analysis, because failure can occur without overtopping. The example deducts specified settlement only, omitting waves and other necessary terms. It is not a code-required freeboard, and all elevations use one datum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crest margin and elevation allowances” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堤頂Zc=102.5 m、計算水面Zw=101.7 m、預留沉陷s=0.20 m，剩餘幾何餘量F=Zc−Zw−s=0.60 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume crest Zc=102.5 m, computed surface Zw=101.7 m and settlement allowance s=0.20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
