options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堤頂Zc=102.5 m、計算水面Zw=101.7 m、預留沉陷s=0.20 m，剩餘幾何餘量F=Zc−Zw−s=0.60 m。
分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
分洪道某一斷面用曼寧式算得的流量，就是全系統任何洪水下的容量。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume crest Zc=102.5 m, computed surface Zw=101.7 m and settlement allowance s=0.20 m.
Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
Manning flow at one section is the entire system capacity under every flood condition.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設堤頂Zc=102.5 m、計算水面Zw=101.7 m、預留沉陷s=0.20 m，剩餘幾何餘量F=Zc−Zw−s=0.60 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume crest Zc=102.5 m, computed surface Zw=101.7 m and settlement allowance s=0.20 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「堤頂餘高與高程預留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crest margin and elevation allowances” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿線測量最低堤頂與接合點，確認水位和沉陷使用同一基準及時間。把波浪、模型誤差與沉陷來源逐項列出，檢查哪些已含在設計水位，並另外評估未越頂的失效模式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey minimum crest and transitions along the route, aligning water level and settlement by datum and time. List wave, model-error and settlement sources, check which are already included in stage, and independently assess failure mechanisms that do not require overtopping. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用三個沿線堤頂與水面資料找最小餘量，加入局部沉陷後重新排序。將越頂和非越頂失效列成平行檢查，說明高程表無法回答的土工問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Find the minimum margin from three crest/surface pairs and reorder them after local settlement. List overtopping and non-overtopping checks in parallel, explaining geotechnical questions that an elevation table cannot answer.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿線測量最低堤頂與接合點，確認水位和沉陷使用同一基準及時間。把波浪、模型誤差與沉陷來源逐項列出，檢查哪些已含在設計水位，並另外評估未越頂的失效模式。
knowledge.textEn: Survey minimum crest and transitions along the route, aligning water level and settlement by datum and time. List wave, model-error and settlement sources, check which are already included in stage, and independently assess failure mechanisms that do not require overtopping.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用三個沿線堤頂與水面資料找最小餘量，加入局部沉陷後重新排序。將越頂和非越頂失效列成平行檢查，說明高程表無法回答的土工問題。
knowledge.textEn: Find the minimum margin from three crest/surface pairs and reorder them after local settlement. List overtopping and non-overtopping checks in parallel, explaining geotechnical questions that an elevation table cannot answer.

quiz.question: 要驗證「堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿線測量最低堤頂與接合點，確認水位和沉陷使用同一基準及時間。
速度水頭增加就是全部局部損失，兩者可以視為同一個項目。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Survey minimum crest and transitions along the route, aligning water level and settlement by datum and time.
An increase in velocity head is the entire local loss and the two terms are identical.
quiz.explanation: 沿線測量最低堤頂與接合點，確認水位和沉陷使用同一基準及時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey minimum crest and transitions along the route, aligning water level and settlement by datum and time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「堤頂餘高與高程預留」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Crest margin and elevation allowances” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. Declaring complete safety from positive geometric margin overlooks internal erosion, slope instability and foundation problems below overtopping conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只扣指定沉陷量，未加入波浪或其他必要項，也不是任何規範的所需餘高；輸入皆採相同高程基準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is not a code-required freeboard, and all elevations use one datum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要水面沒有碰到堤頂，分洪道及兩側堤防就不存在失效可能。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If water remains below the crest, the floodway and its embankments cannot fail." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。
knowledge.textEn: An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. Declaring complete safety from positive geometric margin overlooks internal erosion, slope instability and foundation problems below overtopping conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堤頂餘高與高程預留機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Crest margin and elevation allowances mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。
只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons.
quiz.explanation: 只用平均堤頂會漏掉低點，將預留沉陷重複扣除又可能扭曲比較；宣稱仍有幾何餘量就完全安全，則忽略內部侵蝕、邊坡或基礎問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An average crest hides low points, while double-counted settlement distorts comparisons. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」與「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification" and "Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分洪泥砂與河床演變」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。長期淤積可能抬高入口或減少渠容，沖刷則可能威脅基礎；泥砂體積帳需要區分固體體積與含孔隙床體積，不能把水量分流比例直接當成泥砂分流比例。本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分洪泥砂與河床演變」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. Aggradation can raise the inlet or reduce channel space, while scour threatens foundations. A sediment-volume ledger distinguishes solids from porous bed volume and must not equate water diversion fraction with sediment diversion fraction. The example assumes uniform bed change, fixed porosity and solid-volume transport rates. It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分洪泥砂與河床演變」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Diversion sediment and bed evolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。長期淤積可能抬高入口或減少渠容，沖刷則可能威脅基礎；泥砂體積帳需要區分固體體積與含孔隙床體積，不能把水量分流比例直接當成泥砂分流比例。
knowledge.textEn: Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. Aggradation can raise the inlet or reduce channel space, while scour threatens foundations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。
分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。
模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。
optionsEn: Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average.
Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed.
A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions.
quiz.explanation: 分洪改變水量分配也會改變輸砂，進入支路的粒徑與濃度不一定和主河平均相同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Diverting water also redistributes sediment, whose size and concentration entering a branch may differ from the main-river average. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分洪泥砂與河床演變」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m. Mean Δz=(Qsin−Qsout)t/[(1−p)BL]=0.0015 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m. Mean Δz=(Qsin−Qsout)t/[(1−p)BL]=0.0015 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 所有分洪入口只需一個自由堰公式，不受入口方向與尾水影響。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。
算出臨界水深後，就已經得到分洪道所有位置的正常水深。
optionsEn: Every floodway inlet needs only one free-weir formula regardless of orientation or tailwater.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m.
Calculating critical depth gives normal depth at every location in the floodway.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設固體輸入Qs,in=0.020、輸出Qs,out=0.015 m³/s，t=3600 s、孔隙率p=0.40、寬B=20 m、長L=1000 m，Δz=0.0015 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume solid inflow 0.020 and outflow 0.015 m³/s, t=3600 s, porosity p=0.40, B=20 m and L=1000 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Diversion sediment and bed evolution mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分洪泥砂與河床演變」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將上下游分粒徑輸砂量與重複地形測量比較，統一固體與床體積定義。檢查入口附近和彎道的局部變化，並讓更新後河床回饋到水理模型，而不是永久固定初始斷面。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare size-resolved upstream/downstream transport with repeat surveys using consistent solid and bulk-volume definitions. Inspect localized changes near the inlet and bends, and feed the updated bed back into hydraulics instead of retaining the initial channel geometry indefinitely despite sediment evolution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用相同固體量比較兩種孔隙率的床面升幅，再把沉積集中於入口短段。說明平均高程與局部高程對水理模型有何不同影響，規劃重複測量位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare bed rise at two porosities for the same solid volume, then concentrate deposition in a short inlet reach. Explain how mean and local elevations affect hydraulics differently and choose repeat-survey locations accordingly.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分洪泥砂與河床演變」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Diversion sediment and bed evolution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 漏掉孔隙率會低估沉積床體積，區段平均很小也可能掩蓋入口沙洲；固定河床模型若用於多年規劃，可能高估未來分洪能力或漏掉局部基礎沖刷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting porosity understates deposited bed volume, and a small reach average can conceal an inlet bar. A fixed-bed model used for long-term planning may overstate future diversion or miss local foundation scour. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例採均勻床面變化、固定孔隙率與固體體積輸砂率，只表示區段平均沉積；未預測局部沖刷或粒徑分選。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It gives reach-average deposition only, excluding local scour and size sorting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「分走三成水就必定分走三成泥砂，而且河床可以永遠固定。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Diverting thirty percent of water necessarily diverts thirty percent of sediment with an unchanged bed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「分洪泥砂與河床演變機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「非恆定時間步與驗證」如何影響河道分洪工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unsteady time step and verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River flood-diversion works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。庫朗數可作顯式淺水波離散的尺度檢查，但不同求解器的穩定與準確條件不同，不能把一個數值當所有軟體保證；網格、時間步和邊界敏感度應與量測驗證一同檢查。本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「非恆定時間步與驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. Courant number offers a scale check for explicit shallow-water discretization, but stability and accuracy differ among solvers. One number is not a universal software guarantee; grid, time-step and boundary sensitivity require checking alongside observations. The example adds rectangular-channel gravity-wave speed to downstream velocity for an illustrative target Courant number. Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unsteady time step and verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δx=50 m、V=2 m/s、h=2 m、g=9.81 m/s²、C=0.80，Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δx=50 m, V=2 m/s, h=2 m, g=9.81 m/s² and C=0.80.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「非恆定時間步與驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Unsteady time step and verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。庫朗數可作顯式淺水波離散的尺度檢查，但不同求解器的穩定與準確條件不同，不能把一個數值當所有軟體保證；網格、時間步和邊界敏感度應與量測驗證一同檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Flood routing must resolve propagation between cells; a large time step can cause oscillation, numerical diffusion or missed brief control. Courant number offers a scale check for explicit shallow-water discretization, but stability and accuracy differ among solvers.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

洪水演算需解析波在網格間的傳遞，時間步過大可能造成振盪、數值擴散或漏失短時控制。

optionsEn: A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions.

Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δx=50 m、V=2 m/s、h=2 m、g=9.81 m/s²、C=0.80，Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δx=50 m, V=2 m/s, h=2 m, g=9.81 m/s² and C=0.80. Time step Δt=CΔx/(V+√gh)=6.221 s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「非恆定時間步與驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unsteady time step and verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。保留水量殘差及局部振盪位置，再用未參與校正的事件驗證，不能只以計算成功結束當作通過。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time. Retain balance residuals and locations of oscillation, then validate against an event excluded from calibration rather than treating successful program completion as proof. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：製作粗細兩組網格與時間步的比較表，分開列穩定性、守恆與峰值差異。指出哪種差異需要改善數值解析度，哪種可能需要重新調查實際邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare coarse and fine grids and steps, listing stability, conservation and peak differences separately. Identify differences requiring numerical refinement versus those suggesting renewed investigation of the physical boundary conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。保留水量殘差及局部振盪位置，再用未參與校正的事件驗證，不能只以計算成功結束當作通過。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time. Retain balance residuals and locations of oscillation, then validate against an event excluded from calibration rather than treating successful program completion as proof.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 製作粗細兩組網格與時間步的比較表，分開列穩定性、守恆與峰值差異。指出哪種差異需要改善數值解析度，哪種可能需要重新調查實際邊界。
knowledge.textEn: Compare coarse and fine grids and steps, listing stability, conservation and peak differences separately. Identify differences requiring numerical refinement versus those suggesting renewed investigation of the physical boundary conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification"?
options: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
洪峰永遠和平均水流等速，所以距離除流速就是精確到達時間。
optionsEn: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A flood crest always moves at mean flow velocity, giving exact arrival from distance divided by velocity.
quiz.explanation: 確認求解器格式和庫朗數定義，縮小網格與時間步比較水位、分流比例和峰時。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm solver formulation and Courant definition, refine grid and time step and compare stage, diversion share and peak time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「非恆定時間步與驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unsteady time step and verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. Changing physical roughness merely to achieve numerical stability gives that parameter a false physical interpretation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例使用矩形水深的重力波速與順流速度相加，指定目標庫朗數只為示範；隱式求解器或其他格式需依自身文件判斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Implicit solvers and other schemes require their own documented criteria.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型沒有發散且水量閉合，就足以證明分洪水位預測完全可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A nondiverging model with volume closure proves fully reliable floodway stage predictions." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。
knowledge.textEn: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. Changing physical roughness merely to achieve numerical stability gives that parameter a false physical interpretation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「非恆定時間步與驗證機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unsteady time step and verification mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。
分洪道把洪水帶離城市後，這部分水就不需要再納入下游分析。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point.
Once a floodway removes water from a city, that water no longer needs downstream analysis.
quiz.explanation: 穩定但過度擴散的解仍可能壓低洪峰，粗網格也會抹平入口或堤頂低點；只為通過數值穩定而修改物理糙率，會讓參數失去真實意義。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A stable but diffusive solution can suppress the crest, and coarse cells can smooth an inlet or low crest point. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 土堤壓密與防滲
courses.summary: 由土料三相、調濕與乾密度出發，課程連結地基壓密時間、達西流徑、防滲牆阻抗、濾層及孔壓監測。每一步區分材料試驗與整體構造行為，特別避免把抗隆起比值當所有管湧的安全證明。西沙加緬度及紅河提供已核對背景，數學量值全部是獨立教學假設。
courses.summaryEn: Starting from soil phases, conditioning and dry density, the course connects consolidation timing, Darcy paths, cutoff resistance, filters and pore-pressure monitoring. Each step distinguishes material tests from whole-structure behavior, especially avoiding claims that a heave ratio proves safety against all piping. West Sacramento and Red River provide verified context; every numerical value is an independent teaching assumption.
courses.focus: 區分夯實、地基壓密與防滲失效的土堤推導
courses.focusEn: Levee reasoning that separates compaction, consolidation and seepage failure
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定一維均質層的排水長2 m及百分之九十時間因子0.848，只把壓密係數由1.0×10⁻⁷提高到1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s。時間由392.59降至356.90日，減少9.09%，並非減少百分之十；壓密係數在分母，所以必須用倒數比例。此比較假設排水邊界、荷載與土性模型均不變，不能代表打設排水板或改變填築速度後的現場工期。這些變更還會影響排水路徑、塗抹區、井阻與荷載歷程，應另建立模型並以多深度孔壓及沉陷歷線檢核。
workedExample.textEn: Hold drainage length at 2 m and the ninety-percent time factor at 0.848 for a uniform one-dimensional layer, increasing consolidation coefficient from 1.0×10⁻⁷ to 1.1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time decreases from 392.59 to 356.90 days, a 9.09% reduction rather than ten percent because the coefficient enters the denominator. This comparison holds drainage boundaries, loading and the material model fixed. It does not predict construction time after adding vertical drains or changing fill rate. Such changes can alter drainage distance, smear, well resistance and loading history, requiring a different model checked against multi-depth pore-pressure and settlement histories. The uncertainty in the coefficient should therefore remain visible alongside the computed time.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、厚5 m、寬100 m、Δh=3 m、L=30 m，Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Required retained water ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15. Void ratio e=0.50 and saturation Sr=0.81.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Primary settlement S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59 days.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m. Darcy discharge Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」與「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" and "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「含水量與乾密度」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture and dry density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。相對夯實度還需對應相同土料及試驗能量的室內最大乾密度；不同級配、超粒徑修正或取樣位置會改變可比性，不能只追求單一百分比而忽略土層接合與滲透性。本例含水量以水重除乾土重定義，密度均為質量密度。數值只做換算，不把假設室內峰值或百分比當任何現場驗收標準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「含水量與乾密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. Field wet density includes solids and water and must be converted using moisture content. Relative compaction additionally requires a laboratory maximum for compatible material and test energy. Gradation changes, oversize corrections and sampling location affect comparability, so one percentage cannot replace attention to lift bonding and permeability. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass, and densities are mass densities. This conversion does not make the assumed laboratory peak or resulting percentage a field acceptance criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture and dry density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「含水量與乾密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture and dry density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。相對夯實度還需對應相同土料及試驗能量的室內最大乾密度；不同級配、超粒徑修正或取樣位置會改變可比性，不能只追求單一百分比而忽略土層接合與滲透性。
knowledge.textEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. Field wet density includes solids and water and must be converted using moisture content.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
optionsEn: Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
quiz.explanation: 夯實以機械能改變土粒排列並排出部分空氣，現場濕密度同時含固體與水，必須配合含水量換算乾密度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compaction rearranges particles mechanically and removes some air. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「含水量與乾密度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moisture and dry density” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濕密度ρ=2.00 Mg/m³、w=0.15，乾密度ρd=ρ/(1+w)=1.739 Mg/m³；室內峰值1.85 Mg/m³，相對夯實度94.01%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume wet density 2.00 Mg/m³ and moisture w=0.15. Dry density is 1.739 Mg/m³; relative to a laboratory maximum of 1.85 Mg/m³, compaction is 94.01%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。

optionsEn: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「含水量與乾密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moisture and dry density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。沿每層厚度與接合帶安排檢查，異常時先追查土料和儀器校核，不能用另一處含水量替代。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Inspect lift thickness and transitions as well as point density; investigate material changes and instrument calibration before substituting moisture measurements from another location. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以兩組相同濕密度但不同含水量重算乾密度，再列出室內與現場必須一致的條件。說明為何密度比較仍不能代替滲透試驗和層間連續性檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate dry density for equal wet densities at two moisture contents, then list laboratory and field comparability conditions. Explain why density comparison still cannot replace permeability testing and inspection of continuity between lifts.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。沿每層厚度與接合帶安排檢查，異常時先追查土料和儀器校核，不能用另一處含水量替代。
knowledge.textEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Inspect lift thickness and transitions as well as point density; investigate material changes and instrument calibration before substituting moisture measurements from another location.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以兩組相同濕密度但不同含水量重算乾密度，再列出室內與現場必須一致的條件。說明為何密度比較仍不能代替滲透試驗和層間連續性檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate dry density for equal wet densities at two moisture contents, then list laboratory and field comparability conditions. Explain why density comparison still cannot replace permeability testing and inspection of continuity between lifts.

quiz.question: 要驗證「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification"?
options: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
optionsEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 將密度與含水量取自可對應的土樣和位置，核對室內試驗能量、級配及超粒徑處理。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair density and moisture from corresponding material and locations, checking laboratory energy, gradation and oversize treatment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 含水量與乾密度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「含水量與乾密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture and dry density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A laboratory peak from different material misclassifies acceptance, while a dense surface can conceal an inadequately compacted lower part of a thick lift. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：數值只做換算，不把假設室內峰值或百分比當任何現場驗收標準。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This conversion does not make the assumed laboratory peak or resulting percentage a field acceptance criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。
knowledge.textEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. A laboratory peak from different material misclassifies acceptance, while a dense surface can conceal an inadequately compacted lower part of a thick lift.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「含水量與乾密度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture and dry density mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
quiz.explanation: 濕土可能有較高濕密度卻較低乾密度，誤用不同材料的室內峰值會造成錯誤合格判斷；局部表面測得密實也可能掩蓋厚層底部未壓實。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Wet soil may show high bulk density but low dry density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「土料調濕與拌合」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Moisture conditioning and blending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。加水計畫需以乾土質量建立水量帳，再考慮拌合均勻度、蒸發與雨水；平均含水量符合目標不代表每一團塊都符合，過濕或乾硬團塊仍可能留下不同變形與滲流通道。本例封閉水量帳假設乾土質量不變、加入的水全部保留，目標只是指定教學值，不宣稱位於最佳含水量或可立即施工。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「土料調濕與拌合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. Added water is calculated from dry-solid mass before accounting for mixing, evaporation and rainfall. Meeting an average moisture target does not mean every clod meets it; wet pockets and hard dry clods can produce contrasting deformation and seepage paths. The closed water balance holds dry mass fixed and retains all added water. The target is an assigned teaching value, not a demonstrated optimum or authorization to place the soil. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture conditioning and blending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「土料調濕與拌合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Moisture conditioning and blending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。加水計畫需以乾土質量建立水量帳，再考慮拌合均勻度、蒸發與雨水；平均含水量符合目標不代表每一團塊都符合，過濕或乾硬團塊仍可能留下不同變形與滲流通道。
knowledge.textEn: Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. Added water is calculated from dry-solid mass before accounting for mixing, evaporation and rainfall.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。
optionsEn: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy.
quiz.explanation: 土料調濕改變施工時的可壓實性，但最佳含水量隨土性與夯實能量而異。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Moisture conditioning changes compactability, but optimum moisture depends on material and compaction energy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「土料調濕與拌合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Moisture conditioning and blending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Required retained water ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。

Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設乾土Md=1000 kg，初始w1=0.12、目標w2=0.15，需加水ΔMw=Md(w2−w1)=30 kg。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume dry soil Md=1000 kg, initial moisture w1=0.12 and target w2=0.15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「土料調濕與拌合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Moisture conditioning and blending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。利用試驗填築確認鬆鋪厚度、機具與遍數，並比較表層和內部含水量以辨識混合不均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending. Use trial placement to establish loose-lift thickness, equipment and passes, comparing surface and interior moisture to detect uneven mixing rather than relying solely on a delivered water total. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把乾土質量、水量與可能蒸發分開列帳，另設幾個混合後取樣點。比較平均合格但離散很大的情況，提出能辨識土團內外差異的驗證方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate dry mass, water dose and possible evaporation in a ledger, with several post-mixing sample locations. Compare a compliant mean with high scatter and propose verification that distinguishes clod interiors from their surfaces.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。利用試驗填築確認鬆鋪厚度、機具與遍數，並比較表層和內部含水量以辨識混合不均。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending. Use trial placement to establish loose-lift thickness, equipment and passes, comparing surface and interior moisture to detect uneven mixing rather than relying solely on a delivered water total.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把乾土質量、水量與可能蒸發分開列帳，另設幾個混合後取樣點。比較平均合格但離散很大的情況，提出能辨識土團內外差異的驗證方式。
knowledge.textEn: Separate dry mass, water dose and possible evaporation in a ledger, with several post-mixing sample locations. Compare a compliant mean with high scatter and propose verification that distinguishes clod interiors from their surfaces.

quiz.question: 要驗證「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
quiz.explanation: 先核對含水量分母為乾土質量，追蹤加水計量、天候及拌合後各點試樣。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm the dry-mass moisture denominator and track metered water, weather and samples after blending. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「土料調濕與拌合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Moisture conditioning and blending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. Brief surface spraying can wet only the exterior, and additional passes may not correct unsuitable interior moisture or clods that remain intact. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例封閉水量帳假設乾土質量不變、加入的水全部保留，目標只是指定教學值，不宣稱位於最佳含水量或可立即施工。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The target is an assigned teaching value, not a demonstrated optimum or authorization to place the soil.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。
knowledge.textEn: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. Brief surface spraying can wet only the exterior, and additional passes may not correct unsuitable interior moisture or clods that remain intact.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「土料調濕與拌合機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Moisture conditioning and blending mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose.
quiz.explanation: 以濕土總重乘含水量差會算錯加水量，短時間表面灑水也可能只弄濕外皮；直接增加機具遍數未必能補救內部含水量不適或團塊未打散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Multiplying moisture change by wet total mass gives the wrong dose. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證」與「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification" and "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔隙比與飽和度」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void ratio and saturation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 乾密度只描述單位總體積中的固體質量，配合土粒比重才能求孔隙比，再由含水量判斷孔隙中水與空氣的比例。相同乾密度可能對應不同飽和度與吸力，浸水後的濕陷或膨脹也不能由密度一項排除；三相圖是檢查量測一致性的工具，不是直接推定滲透係數的公式。本例土粒比重與水密度已指定，忽略溶解鹽及體積量測誤差。飽和度應介於零與一，超界值要追查輸入而非截斷後繼續計算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙比與飽和度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Dry density describes solid mass per bulk volume. Particle specific gravity enables void ratio, and moisture then divides void space into water and air. Equal dry density can coexist with different saturation and suction; density alone does not exclude collapse or swelling on wetting. A phase diagram checks measurement consistency rather than directly predicting hydraulic conductivity. Specific gravity and water density are specified, with dissolved salts and volume error neglected. Saturation must lie between zero and one; an impossible value triggers input investigation rather than silent clipping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void ratio and saturation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔隙比與飽和度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Void ratio and saturation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 乾密度只描述單位總體積中的固體質量，配合土粒比重才能求孔隙比，再由含水量判斷孔隙中水與空氣的比例。相同乾密度可能對應不同飽和度與吸力，浸水後的濕陷或膨脹也不能由密度一項排除；三相圖是檢查量測一致性的工具，不是直接推定滲透係數的公式。
knowledge.textEn: Dry density describes solid mass per bulk volume. Particle specific gravity enables void ratio, and moisture then divides void space into water and air.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 乾密度只描述單位總體積中的固體質量，配合土粒比重才能求孔隙比，再由含水量判斷孔隙中水與空氣的比例。
相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
optionsEn: Dry density describes solid mass per bulk volume.
Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
quiz.explanation: 乾密度只描述單位總體積中的固體質量，配合土粒比重才能求孔隙比，再由含水量判斷孔隙中水與空氣的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry density describes solid mass per bulk volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔隙比與飽和度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Void ratio and saturation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15. Void ratio e=0.50 and saturation Sr=0.81. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15. Void ratio e=0.50 and saturation Sr=0.81.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
optionsEn: Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.70、ρw=1.00、ρd=1.80 Mg/m³、w=0.15，e=Gsρw/ρd−1=0.50，Sr=wGs/e=0.81。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.70, water density 1.00 and dry density 1.80 Mg/m³, with moisture w=0.15. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙比與飽和度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Void ratio and saturation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。若需要預估浸水行為，另做代表性應力下的濕陷、膨脹和滲透試驗，不能由單次相圖外推。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density. When wetting behavior matters, conduct collapse, swelling and permeability tests under representative stresses instead of extrapolating those responses from one phase-diagram calculation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：固定乾密度並改變含水量，繪出孔隙中水與空氣的比例，再試算一組不可能的超飽和輸入。說明應回查哪些量測，而不是直接把結果改成百分之百。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Hold dry density fixed while varying moisture and draw the water/air shares of voids. Try an impossible supersaturated input and explain which measurements should be checked instead of forcing the result to one hundred percent.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯把含水量當水體積比例會造成飽和度誤差，不同土粒比重也使同密度材料具有不同孔隙比；推定密實土必定不透水則可能忽略裂縫和連通大孔隙。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。若需要預估浸水行為，另做代表性應力下的濕陷、膨脹和滲透試驗，不能由單次相圖外推。
knowledge.textEn: Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density. When wetting behavior matters, conduct collapse, swelling and permeability tests under representative stresses instead of extrapolating those responses from one phase-diagram calculation.

knowledge.textEn: Hold dry density fixed while varying moisture and draw the water/air shares of voids. Try an impossible supersaturated input and explain which measurements should be checked instead of forcing the result to one hundred percent.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density.
quiz.explanation: 用三相圖核對質量與體積守恆，將飽和度與含水量、密度的不確定度一同呈現。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check phase mass and volume closure and report saturation alongside uncertainty in moisture and density. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔隙比與飽和度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void ratio and saturation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯把含水量當水體積比例會造成飽和度誤差，不同土粒比重也使同密度材料具有不同孔隙比；推定密實土必定不透水則可能忽略裂縫和連通大孔隙。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density. Declaring dense soil impermeable additionally ignores cracks and connected macropores through the fill. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：飽和度應介於零與一，超界值要追查輸入而非截斷後繼續計算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Saturation must lie between zero and one; an impossible value triggers input investigation rather than silent clipping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
