knowledge.textEn: Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density. Declaring dense soil impermeable additionally ignores cracks and connected macropores through the fill.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔隙比與飽和度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void ratio and saturation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 錯把含水量當水體積比例會造成飽和度誤差，不同土粒比重也使同密度材料具有不同孔隙比；推定密實土必定不透水則可能忽略裂縫和連通大孔隙。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
optionsEn: Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
quiz.explanation: 錯把含水量當水體積比例會造成飽和度誤差，不同土粒比重也使同密度材料具有不同孔隙比；推定密實土必定不透水則可能忽略裂縫和連通大孔隙。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing gravimetric moisture with a water-volume fraction distorts saturation, while different particle gravity changes void ratio at equal density. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地基一次壓密沉陷」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Primary consolidation settlement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。正常固結土在指定應力範圍可用壓縮指數估算一次壓密量，但超固結、分層、次壓縮或側向變形需要另處理，不能把現場夯實百分比當作地基沉陷保證。本例為均質正常固結層的一維平均應力近似，使用常用十進對數。忽略側移與次壓縮，並不代表實際堤頂最終總沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地基一次壓密沉陷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. New loading initially creates pore pressure; drainage then increases effective stress and reduces void space. A compression index estimates primary settlement for normally consolidated soil within its tested stress range. Overconsolidation, layering, secondary compression and lateral deformation require additional treatment beyond fill-density acceptance. This is a one-dimensional mean-stress estimate for a uniform normally consolidated layer using base-ten logarithms. Lateral movement and secondary compression are omitted, so the result is not total final crest settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Primary consolidation settlement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地基一次壓密沉陷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Primary consolidation settlement”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。正常固結土在指定應力範圍可用壓縮指數估算一次壓密量，但超固結、分層、次壓縮或側向變形需要另處理，不能把現場夯實百分比當作地基沉陷保證。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. New loading initially creates pore pressure; drainage then increases effective stress and reduces void space.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
optionsEn: Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
quiz.explanation: 堤身機械夯實與軟弱地基的壓密是不同過程：新增填土荷載可先引起孔壓，之後排水使有效應力增加與孔隙減少。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mechanical compaction of fill differs from consolidation of soft foundation soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地基一次壓密沉陷」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Primary consolidation settlement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Primary settlement S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Primary settlement S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設H=4 m、Cc=0.25、e0=0.80、初始σ′0=100 kPa、增量Δσ′=50 kPa，S=CcH log10(150/100)/(1+e0)=0.09783 m。
optionsEn: A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa.

quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume H=4 m, Cc=0.25, e0=0.80, initial effective stress 100 kPa and increase 50 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地基一次壓密沉陷」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Primary consolidation settlement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。利用沉陷板與孔壓同步觀測區別排水壓密與側移，並保留填築階段及水位變動紀錄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation. Observe settlement plates and pore pressures together to distinguish drainage-driven consolidation from lateral movement, retaining fill-stage and groundwater records when interpreting displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將一層地基分成兩個應力不同的子層並比較總沉陷，列出先期固結壓力不足時的資料缺口。規劃沉陷與孔壓配對觀測，避免只從單一沉陷值推斷原因。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Divide the foundation into two layers with different stress changes and compare total settlement. List missing preconsolidation information and plan paired settlement/pore-pressure observations instead of inferring the mechanism from one displacement value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。利用沉陷板與孔壓同步觀測區別排水壓密與側移，並保留填築階段及水位變動紀錄。

Observe settlement plates and pore pressures together to distinguish drainage-driven consolidation from lateral movement, retaining fill-stage and groundwater records when interpreting displacement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將一層地基分成兩個應力不同的子層並比較總沉陷，列出先期固結壓力不足時的資料缺口。規劃沉陷與孔壓配對觀測，避免只從單一沉陷值推斷原因。
knowledge.textEn: Divide the foundation into two layers with different stress changes and compare total settlement. List missing preconsolidation information and plan paired settlement/pore-pressure observations instead of inferring the mechanism from one displacement value.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
optionsEn: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
quiz.explanation: 核對原狀取樣品質、先期固結壓力與實際新增應力分布，將地層細分後比較結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check sample quality, preconsolidation stress and the distribution of added stress, comparing a layered calculation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地基一次壓密沉陷」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Primary consolidation settlement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. Crest observations alone cannot separate foundation and fill contributions or identify the mechanism of continuing movement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：忽略側移與次壓縮，並不代表實際堤頂最終總沉陷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Lateral movement and secondary compression are omitted, so the result is not total final crest settlement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。
knowledge.textEn: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. Crest observations alone cannot separate foundation and fill contributions or identify the mechanism of continuing movement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地基一次壓密沉陷機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Primary consolidation settlement mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
quiz.explanation: 把超固結層全用正常固結斜率可能失真，用總應力代替有效應力也會錯估壓縮；只測堤頂而不分地基和填土，則難以辨識沉陷機制與後續變形。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a virgin-compression slope throughout overconsolidated soil distorts settlement, as does substituting total for effective stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」與「滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification" and "Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「排水路徑與壓密時間」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drainage path and consolidation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。壓密係數會隨應力與土層而變，排水邊界也可能因低透水覆層或堵塞而改變，因此施工階段的孔壓消散不能只由一個實驗值和日曆時間決定，需與沉陷歷線一起判讀。本例使用均質一維壓密的平均百分之九十時間因子，瞬時均布荷載且排水邊界固定。係數明列為平方公尺每秒，換算日數另除秒數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「排水路徑與壓密時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. Double drainage changes the longest path relative to full layer thickness. Stress-dependent properties, low-permeability covers and clogged drains can alter the response, so elapsed time and one laboratory coefficient cannot alone establish field pore-pressure dissipation. The example uses the average ninety-percent time factor for uniform one-dimensional consolidation under instantaneous uniform loading and fixed drainage boundaries. The coefficient is in square metres per second, with a separate seconds-to-days conversion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drainage path and consolidation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「排水路徑與壓密時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Drainage path and consolidation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。壓密係數會隨應力與土層而變，排水邊界也可能因低透水覆層或堵塞而改變，因此施工階段的孔壓消散不能只由一個實驗值和日曆時間決定，需與沉陷歷線一起判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. Double drainage changes the longest path relative to full layer thickness.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。
一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。
optionsEn: Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation.
quiz.explanation: 一次壓密時間由排水距離平方和壓密係數控制；雙向排水時的最長路徑不同於整層厚度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Primary consolidation time scales with the square of drainage distance and inversely with the coefficient of consolidation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「排水路徑與壓密時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drainage path and consolidation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59 days. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Time t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59 days.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Tv,90=0.848、排水長Hdr=2 m、cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s，t90=TvHdr²/cv=33,920,000 s=392.59日。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Tv,90=0.848, drainage length Hdr=2 m and cv=1×10⁻⁷ m²/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「排水路徑與壓密時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drainage path and consolidation time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。以多深度孔壓和沉陷反算時間尺度，再檢查相同係數能否描述不同階段而不是只擬合單一點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading. Compare multi-depth pore pressure and settlement against the time scale, testing whether one coefficient explains several stages rather than fitting a single observation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較同一層單向與雙向排水的路徑平方，再將秒與日逐項換算。提出可辨識排水邊界失效的孔壓觀測配置，並說明分段填築為何改變時間起點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare squared drainage distances for single and double drainage and convert seconds to days explicitly. Design pore-pressure observations to identify a failed drainage boundary and explain why staged filling changes the loading time origin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把全層厚度誤當雙向排水路徑會放大時間估算，反向錯用則可能提早判定壓密完成；若忽略低透水夾層，名義上雙向排水也未必等於真實邊界。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using full thickness for double drainage overstates time, while the opposite mistake can suggest premature completion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。以多深度孔壓和沉陷反算時間尺度，再檢查相同係數能否描述不同階段而不是只擬合單一點。
knowledge.textEn: Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading. Compare multi-depth pore pressure and settlement against the time scale, testing whether one coefficient explains several stages rather than fitting a single observation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較同一層單向與雙向排水的路徑平方，再將秒與日逐項換算。提出可辨識排水邊界失效的孔壓觀測配置，並說明分段填築為何改變時間起點。
knowledge.textEn: Compare squared drainage distances for single and double drainage and convert seconds to days explicitly. Design pore-pressure observations to identify a failed drainage boundary and explain why staged filling changes the loading time origin.

quiz.question: 要驗證「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
quiz.explanation: 在地質剖面標出可排水與不透水邊界，辨識實際最長路徑及分階段荷載。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark draining and impermeable boundaries on the ground profile and identify the longest path and staged loading. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drainage path and consolidation time mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「排水路徑與壓密時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drainage path and consolidation time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把全層厚度誤當雙向排水路徑會放大時間估算，反向錯用則可能提早判定壓密完成；若忽略低透水夾層，名義上雙向排水也未必等於真實邊界。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using full thickness for double drainage overstates time, while the opposite mistake can suggest premature completion. Low-permeability interlayers can also prevent nominal double drainage from representing the actual hydraulic boundary conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：係數明列為平方公尺每秒，換算日數另除秒數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The coefficient is in square metres per second, with a separate seconds-to-days conversion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「排水路徑與壓密時間機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
Using full thickness for double drainage overstates time, while the opposite mistake can suggest premature completion.

steps.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「滲流量與流徑長度」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seepage discharge and path length” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 達西流量由滲透係數、過水面積及水力坡降共同決定，坡降是總水頭差除流徑長度，並非只有水位差。堤身和地基通常具有分層與異向性，簡化一維流線只能建立尺度；總漏水量偏小也可能伴隨局部集中的危險出口，故流量與局部梯度需要分開檢查。本例採飽和、均質、固定截面的恆定一維流，面積垂直於流向。未模擬自由水面、接縫或繞過防滲構造的流線。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滲流量與流徑長度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Darcy discharge combines hydraulic conductivity, flow area and hydraulic gradient, which is total-head difference divided by path length rather than head difference alone. Embankments and foundations are commonly layered and anisotropic, so a one-dimensional path supplies only a scale. A small total discharge may still accompany a concentrated adverse exit gradient. The example assumes steady saturated one-dimensional flow through a uniform constant section, with area normal to flow. It omits the phreatic surface, joints and paths around seepage-control structures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seepage discharge and path length” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、厚5 m、寬100 m、Δh=3 m、L=30 m，Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「滲流量與流徑長度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Seepage discharge and path length”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Embankments and foundations are commonly layered and anisotropic, so a one-dimensional path supplies only a scale.

quiz.question: 關於「滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。
抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
optionsEn: Darcy discharge combines hydraulic conductivity, flow area and hydraulic gradient, which is total-head difference divided by path length rather than head difference alone.
Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.

steps.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Seepage discharge and path length” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、厚5 m、寬100 m、Δh=3 m、L=30 m，Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m. Darcy discharge Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：標出總水頭測點、流向、面積和路徑長度，核對滲透試驗方向與現場分層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Label total-head points, flow direction, area and path length, checking test orientation against layering.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s、厚5 m、寬100 m、Δh=3 m、L=30 m，Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m. Darcy discharge Q=kAΔh/L=5×10⁻⁵ m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。

現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=1×10⁻⁶ m/s, thickness 5 m, width 100 m, head difference 3 m and length 30 m.

steps.title: 滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 標出總水頭測點、流向、面積和路徑長度，核對滲透試驗方向與現場分層。用實測孔壓和排水流量一起校核；如有異向性、裂縫或明顯自由面，改採能表示該幾何的模型。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label total-head points, flow direction, area and path length, checking test orientation against layering. Calibrate with both pore pressures and drain discharge; where anisotropy, cracks or a moving free surface matter, use a model that represents that geometry explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把水頭差和流長各改一倍，分別比較坡降與流量，再畫出測點高程。說明總水頭含壓力水頭與位置水頭，避免把不同高度的壓力表直接相減。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double head difference and path length separately and compare gradient and discharge. Draw measurement elevations and explain total head as pressure plus elevation head, avoiding direct subtraction of pressure readings at different heights.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
