quiz.question: 在「滲流量與流徑長度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seepage discharge and path length mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
optionsEn: Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 漏掉流徑長度會造成量綱錯誤，誤用沿流向面積也會使流量失真；只以總流量穩定判定安全，則可能看不到局部裂縫流逐漸集中與顆粒流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitting path length creates a dimensional error, and using area parallel to flow distorts discharge. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」與「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" and "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exit heave versus internal erosion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。這種垂直臨界梯度分析不等於水平逆向侵蝕或裂縫集中沖蝕的門檻；內部侵蝕還受級配、濾層、幾何與缺陷控制，不能把抗隆起比值命名為涵蓋一切管湧的安全係數。本例無覆載、均質非黏性土且出口垂直向上，僅比較理想臨界梯度與指定局部梯度；不能據此核准堤防或濾層配置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave. This vertical critical-gradient calculation is not the onset criterion for horizontal backward erosion or concentrated crack erosion. Internal erosion also depends on gradation, filters, geometry and defects, so a heave ratio cannot represent every piping mechanism. The example has no surcharge and uses uniform cohesionless soil with vertical upward exit flow. It compares ideal critical and assigned local gradients only, not approval of an embankment or filter arrangement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exit heave versus internal erosion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exit heave versus internal erosion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。這種垂直臨界梯度分析不等於水平逆向侵蝕或裂縫集中沖蝕的門檻；內部侵蝕還受級配、濾層、幾何與缺陷控制，不能把抗隆起比值命名為涵蓋一切管湧的安全係數。
knowledge.textEn: Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave. This vertical critical-gradient calculation is not the onset criterion for horizontal backward erosion or concentrated crack erosion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
optionsEn: A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 向上滲流的滲透力可抵消顆粒的浮重，在理想非黏性土柱中有效應力趨近零時可能隆起。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Upward seepage force can counter submerged particle weight, approaching zero effective stress in an ideal cohesionless column and allowing heave. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exit heave versus internal erosion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40. Ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00; heave ratio icr/ie=2.50. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40. Ideal critical gradient icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00; heave ratio icr/ie=2.50.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。
optionsEn: The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Gs=2.65、e=0.65、垂直出口梯度ie=0.40，icr=(Gs−1)/(1+e)=1.00，理想抗隆起比icr/ie=2.50。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Gs=2.65, e=0.65 and vertical exit gradient ie=0.40. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exit heave versus internal erosion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。另行建立逆向侵蝕、集中漏水與濾層失效情境，配對觀測排水量、濁度及地表隆起，不能只看單一梯度比。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts. Separately assess backward erosion, concentrated leaks and filter failure, observing discharge, turbidity and heave together instead of treating a single gradient ratio as the entire seepage assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將垂直隆起與沿弱層逆向侵蝕各畫一張機理圖，列出它們需要的不同資料。比較縮短梯度取樣距離的影響，說明為何必須同時觀測帶砂出水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw separate mechanisms for vertical heave and backward erosion along a weak layer, listing their different data needs. Compare shorter gradient measurement distances and explain why sediment-bearing seepage must also be observed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。另行建立逆向侵蝕、集中漏水與濾層失效情境，配對觀測排水量、濁度及地表隆起，不能只看單一梯度比。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts. Separately assess backward erosion, concentrated leaks and filter failure, observing discharge, turbidity and heave together instead of treating a single gradient ratio as the entire seepage assessment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將垂直隆起與沿弱層逆向侵蝕各畫一張機理圖，列出它們需要的不同資料。比較縮短梯度取樣距離的影響，說明為何必須同時觀測帶砂出水。
knowledge.textEn: Draw separate mechanisms for vertical heave and backward erosion along a weak layer, listing their different data needs. Compare shorter gradient measurement distances and explain why sediment-bearing seepage must also be observed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification"?
options: 確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
optionsEn: Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
quiz.explanation: 確認出口梯度的方向與取樣距離，檢查覆載、土性和排水層接觸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm gradient direction and sampling distance and check surcharge, material and drain contacts. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exit heave versus internal erosion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption. A ratio above unity does not exclude erosion paths developing under distinctly different conditions elsewhere in the foundation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例無覆載、均質非黏性土且出口垂直向上，僅比較理想臨界梯度與指定局部梯度；不能據此核准堤防或濾層配置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It compares ideal critical and assigned local gradients only, not approval of an embankment or filter arrangement.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。
knowledge.textEn: A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption. A ratio above unity does not exclude erosion paths developing under distinctly different conditions elsewhere in the foundation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「出口隆起與內部侵蝕區別機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exit heave versus internal erosion mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。
牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption.
Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
quiz.explanation: 粗網格平均梯度可能掩蓋局部出口峰值，黏性土裂縫也不符合無黏土柱假設；把大於一的比值當全面安全會漏掉可在不同條件下發展的侵蝕通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A coarse averaged gradient can hide an exit peak, and cracks in cohesive soil violate the ideal granular-column assumption. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutoff walls and series resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。串聯阻抗把每段長度除滲透係數與面積後相加，適合展示低透水薄層的重要性；真實水流會繞過牆尖、側緣或施工缺陷，所以一維小流量不代表牆後壓力和局部出口都已降低。本例所有水量必須依序通過兩段相同截面，牆無缺陷且不存在繞流；僅為阻抗比較，不能當二維防滲牆設計成果。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata. Series resistance sums each length divided by conductivity and area, illustrating a thin low-permeability layer. Actual flow may bypass tips, edges or defects, so a small one-dimensional discharge does not prove favorable downstream pressures and exit gradients. All flow in this example crosses two equal-area sections in series through a defect-free wall without bypass. It is a resistance comparison rather than a two-dimensional cutoff-wall design result. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutoff walls and series resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutoff walls and series resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。串聯阻抗把每段長度除滲透係數與面積後相加，適合展示低透水薄層的重要性；真實水流會繞過牆尖、側緣或施工缺陷，所以一維小流量不代表牆後壓力和局部出口都已降低。
knowledge.textEn: A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata. Series resistance sums each length divided by conductivity and area, illustrating a thin low-permeability layer.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。
optionsEn: Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata.
quiz.explanation: 低透水防滲牆可以增加理想流路的水力阻抗，但效果取決於接頭、嵌入深度和周邊地層連續性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-conductivity cutoff increases resistance along an ideal path, but effectiveness depends on joints, penetration and surrounding strata. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutoff walls and series resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s. Series discharge is 4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s. Series discharge is 4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。
現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s.
Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設Δh=3 m、A=10 m²，牆厚0.6 m、kw=10⁻⁹ m/s，土長29.4 m、ks=10⁻⁵ m/s，Q=Δh/[Lw/(kwA)+Ls/(ksA)]=4.976×10⁻⁸ m³/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume Δh=3 m and A=10 m²: wall Lw=0.6 m, kw=10⁻⁹ m/s; soil Ls=29.4 m, ks=10⁻⁵ m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutoff walls and series resistance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。用牆前後孔壓及排水量辨識壓降位置，必要時檢查不連續缺陷，避免只比較材料試體的滲透係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately. Use upstream/downstream pressures and discharge to locate head loss, investigating discontinuities where necessary instead of comparing laboratory wall-material conductivity alone as evidence of overall performance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在串聯模型旁增設一條假設平行缺陷，分別列各路的壓差和阻抗。比較總流量及壓降分配，指出現場哪些量測能區分材料不良與繞流問題。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a hypothetical parallel defect beside the series path and list head differences and resistances separately. Compare total discharge and head-loss distribution, identifying measurements that distinguish poor wall material from hydraulic bypass.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。用牆前後孔壓及排水量辨識壓降位置，必要時檢查不連續缺陷，避免只比較材料試體的滲透係數。
knowledge.textEn: Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately. Use upstream/downstream pressures and discharge to locate head loss, investigating discontinuities where necessary instead of comparing laboratory wall-material conductivity alone as evidence of overall performance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在串聯模型旁增設一條假設平行缺陷，分別列各路的壓差和阻抗。比較總流量及壓降分配，指出現場哪些量測能區分材料不良與繞流問題。
knowledge.textEn: Add a hypothetical parallel defect beside the series path and list head differences and resistances separately. Compare total discharge and head-loss distribution, identifying measurements that distinguish poor wall material from hydraulic bypass.

quiz.question: 要驗證「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
quiz.explanation: 核對牆體連續性、施工接頭和嵌入地層，將穿牆與繞牆路徑分開建模。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify wall continuity, joints and the penetrated stratum, modeling through-wall and bypass paths separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutoff walls and series resistance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. One permeable defect creates a parallel path that invalidates the series model, while deeper penetration without checking exits may concentrate head loss in an unfavorable location. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例所有水量必須依序通過兩段相同截面，牆無缺陷且不存在繞流；僅為阻抗比較，不能當二維防滲牆設計成果。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It is a resistance comparison rather than a two-dimensional cutoff-wall design result.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「牆材滲透係數很低，就能忽略所有牆尖繞流與施工接頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Very low wall-material conductivity makes all tip bypass and construction joints irrelevant." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。
knowledge.textEn: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. One permeable defect creates a parallel path that invalidates the series model, while deeper penetration without checking exits may concentrate head loss in an unfavorable location.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「防滲牆與串聯水力阻抗機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutoff walls and series resistance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity.
quiz.explanation: 低透水試體不能保證接縫同樣密實，一條高透水缺陷可成平行流路而破壞串聯假設；僅延長牆深而不檢查出口，也可能把壓降集中到不利位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low-conductivity specimen does not prove joint continuity. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」與「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification" and "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾層保土與通水」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter retention and drainage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。粒徑比是篩選工具，適用界線取決於基土類別、細料比例、分散性和採用的設計程序；施工離析、污染或濾層中斷會使合格室內級配失去意義，因此保土、通水與連續性都需驗證。本例只算兩個粒徑比，未指定土類或完整設計準則，因此不能標示濾層合格。粒徑均取各自累積通過曲線對應百分位。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾層保土與通水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup. Particle-size ratios are screening tools whose limits depend on base-soil category, fines, dispersivity and the selected procedure. Segregation, contamination or interrupted placement can defeat a compliant laboratory gradation, so retention, drainage and continuity all require verification in the completed work. The example computes two grain-size ratios without specifying soil class or a complete design procedure, so it cannot declare acceptance. Diameters refer to the appropriate percent-finer points on their respective curves. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter retention and drainage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾層保土與通水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter retention and drainage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。粒徑比是篩選工具，適用界線取決於基土類別、細料比例、分散性和採用的設計程序；施工離析、污染或濾層中斷會使合格室內級配失去意義，因此保土、通水與連續性都需驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup. Particle-size ratios are screening tools whose limits depend on base-soil category, fines, dispersivity and the selected procedure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。
兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。
兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
optionsEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup.
Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type.
The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
quiz.explanation: 濾層需在土料流失前形成可靠的顆粒截留，同時讓水排出而不累積不利孔壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must retain migrating base particles while passing water without adverse pressure buildup. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾層保土與通水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter retention and drainage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Screening ratios are D15/d85=3 and D15/d15=12, without an acceptance claim. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Screening ratios are D15/d85=3 and D15/d15=12, without an acceptance claim.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要加水總量正確，每個土團就會立即具有相同含水量。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。
填土達到指定夯實度，就能證明下方軟弱地基不再壓密。
optionsEn: A correct total water dose immediately gives every soil clod identical moisture.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm.
Specified fill compaction proves that the underlying soft foundation will no longer consolidate.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設濾料D15=0.60 mm，基土d85=0.20 mm、d15=0.05 mm，保土指標比D15/d85=3，通水指標比D15/d15=12。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume filter D15=0.60 mm, base d85=0.20 mm and base d15=0.05 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾層保土與通水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter retention and drainage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。施工時追蹤離析、厚度、污染和接縫，必要時用相容性試驗驗證，而不是只留兩個比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits. Inspect segregation, thickness, contamination and transitions during placement, using compatibility testing when needed instead of retaining only two screening ratios in the acceptance record. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用同一濾料對兩種基土重算比值，列出尚缺的土類和分散性資料。畫出轉角與穿堤構造旁的濾層接續，說明級配計算無法替代施工連續性檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Apply one filter to two base soils and recalculate ratios, listing missing classification and dispersivity data. Draw filter continuity at corners and conduits, explaining why grading arithmetic cannot replace inspection of physical continuity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。施工時追蹤離析、厚度、污染和接縫，必要時用相容性試驗驗證，而不是只留兩個比值。
knowledge.textEn: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits. Inspect segregation, thickness, contamination and transitions during placement, using compatibility testing when needed instead of retaining only two screening ratios in the acceptance record.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用同一濾料對兩種基土重算比值，列出尚缺的土類和分散性資料。畫出轉角與穿堤構造旁的濾層接續，說明級配計算無法替代施工連續性檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Apply one filter to two base soils and recalculate ratios, listing missing classification and dispersivity data. Draw filter continuity at corners and conduits, explaining why grading arithmetic cannot replace inspection of physical continuity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
達西公式中的水位差本身就是水力坡降，不需要流徑長度。
核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Head difference alone is the Darcy hydraulic gradient and needs no flow-path length.
Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits.
quiz.explanation: 核對代表性基土完整級配與分散性，按選定手冊土類步驟設計並檢查濾料生產範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check representative full base gradations and dispersivity, follow the chosen manual’s soil-category procedure and review production limits. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濾層保土與通水機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾層保土與通水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter retention and drainage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows. Even plausible particle ratios cannot protect base soil where an interrupted filter exposes it directly to concentrated seepage flow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：粒徑均取各自累積通過曲線對應百分位。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Diameters refer to the appropriate percent-finer points on their respective curves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個粒徑比看起來合理，就能證明任何土類的濾層完整合格。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Plausible values of two particle ratios prove complete filter acceptance for every soil type." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。
knowledge.textEn: An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows. Even plausible particle ratios cannot protect base soil where an interrupted filter exposes it directly to concentrated seepage flow.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濾層保土與通水機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filter retention and drainage mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
optionsEn: An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
quiz.explanation: 用平均基土掩蓋最不利細粒層會漏掉保土需求，運輸離析又可能形成局部粗料窗；即使顆粒比合理，濾層中斷仍讓集中滲流直接侵蝕未保護基土。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An averaged base soil can hide a critical finer layer, and transport segregation can create coarse windows. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「孔壓監測與總水頭」如何影響土堤壓密與防滲的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Levee compaction and seepage control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。若不分感測器高度而直接比較壓力數值，可能誤判流向；水頭變化還應結合排水流量、濁度和填築歷史，才能區別洪水邊界變動、儀器漂移與局部異常。本例使用已扣氣壓的表壓與同一高程基準，忽略速度水頭。總水頭是該點水力勢，不自動等於另一處自由地下水面位置。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔壓監測與總水頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor; seepage interpretation adds pressure head to sensor elevation and aligns atmospheric compensation and timestamps. Comparing pressure alone at different heights can reverse an inferred flow direction. Head changes should also be assessed with discharge, turbidity and construction history to distinguish changing flood boundaries, instrument drift and local anomalies. The example uses gauge pressure after atmospheric correction and one elevation datum, neglecting velocity head. Point total head represents hydraulic potential, not automatically the free groundwater surface at another location. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「孔壓監測與總水頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。若不分感測器高度而直接比較壓力數值，可能誤判流向；水頭變化還應結合排水流量、濁度和填築歷史，才能區別洪水邊界變動、儀器漂移與局部異常。
knowledge.textEn: A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor; seepage interpretation adds pressure head to sensor elevation and aligns atmospheric compensation and timestamps. Comparing pressure alone at different heights can reverse an inferred flow direction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。
孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。
現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
optionsEn: The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation.
A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor.
Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計量到的是感測點附近壓力，解讀滲流需要把壓力水頭加到感測器高程，並統一氣壓補償與時間基準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A piezometer measures pressure near its sensor; seepage interpretation adds pressure head to sensor elevation and aligns atmospheric compensation and timestamps. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「孔壓監測與總水頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Total head h=z+u/γw=15 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Total head h=z+u/γw=15 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 相同乾密度的兩份土一定具有相同飽和度與滲透係數。
土層厚度減半時，所有情況的壓密時間都只會減半。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。
optionsEn: Two soils with equal dry density necessarily have equal saturation and hydraulic conductivity.
Halving soil thickness always halves consolidation time under every drainage condition.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設感測器高程z=12 m、表孔壓u=29.43 kPa、水單位重γw=9.81 kN/m³，總水頭h=z+u/γw=15 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume sensor elevation z=12 m, gauge pore pressure u=29.43 kPa and water unit weight γw=9.81 kN/m³. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔壓監測與總水頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。比較多測點總水頭和出水量濁度，異常先交叉檢核儀器及邊界，不用單支感測器代表整段堤防。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Compare total head across instruments with discharge and turbidity, cross-checking equipment and boundaries before allowing one sensor to represent an entire embankment reach. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：給兩支不同高度感測器相同表壓，計算總水頭並判斷可能流向。再加入儀器零點偏移，列出需要哪些獨立量測才能區分真實滲流改變與感測錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Give two sensors at different elevations equal gauge pressures, compute total heads and infer possible flow direction. Add a zero offset and list independent observations needed to distinguish an actual seepage change from measurement error.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。比較多測點總水頭和出水量濁度，異常先交叉檢核儀器及邊界，不用單支感測器代表整段堤防。
knowledge.textEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Compare total head across instruments with discharge and turbidity, cross-checking equipment and boundaries before allowing one sensor to represent an entire embankment reach.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 給兩支不同高度感測器相同表壓，計算總水頭並判斷可能流向。再加入儀器零點偏移，列出需要哪些獨立量測才能區分真實滲流改變與感測錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: Give two sensors at different elevations equal gauge pressures, compute total heads and infer possible flow direction. Add a zero offset and list independent observations needed to distinguish an actual seepage change from measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification"?
options: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
抗隆起比值大於一，就能排除所有逆向侵蝕與管湧機制。
optionsEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A heave ratio above one eliminates every backward-erosion and piping mechanism.
quiz.explanation: 保留安裝高程、零點、氣壓與校正紀錄，確認量程及觀測頻率適合洪水變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain installation elevation, zero, atmospheric and calibration records and match range and frequency to flood changes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔壓監測與總水頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore-pressure monitoring and total head” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A stage-only alarm without sediment observations can miss erosion developing even when measured pore-pressure changes remain modest. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：總水頭是該點水力勢，不自動等於另一處自由地下水面位置。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Point total head represents hydraulic potential, not automatically the free groundwater surface at another location.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩支孔壓計讀值較大的那支，無論安裝高度如何都位於上游。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The higher pressure reading always identifies the upstream sensor regardless of installation elevation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。
knowledge.textEn: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. A stage-only alarm without sediment observations can miss erosion developing even when measured pore-pressure changes remain modest.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔壓監測與總水頭機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore-pressure monitoring and total head mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。
現場濕密度較高就必定表示乾密度與防滲能力都較好。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability.
Higher field wet density necessarily means better dry density and seepage resistance.
quiz.explanation: 基準高程錯誤會使所有水頭判讀系統性偏移，堵塞或失聯也可能假裝平穩；如果只設水位警戒而不追蹤出砂，即使孔壓變化不大仍可能漏掉侵蝕發展。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An elevation-datum error systematically shifts inferred heads, while blockage or lost communication may mimic stability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 防洪牆基礎設計
courses.summary: 課程串聯靜水合力、揚壓、抗滑、偏心接觸、承載與沉陷，再檢查被動土阻、防滲、接頭及退水反向作用。每個模型明示假設與量綱，區分荷載計算、強度和使用性。比尤德利與波士頓提供工程背景，但本課不把假設尺寸、強度或安全比值當成實際設計或地方核准。
courses.summaryEn: The course connects hydrostatic force, uplift, sliding, eccentric contact, bearing and settlement before examining passive resistance, cutoffs, joints and recession loads. Each model identifies assumptions and dimensions while distinguishing loading, strength and serviceability. Bewdley and Boston provide engineering context, but assumed dimensions, strengths and resistance ratios are not project designs or local approvals.
courses.focus: 從靜水力到接觸與變形的防洪牆基礎推導
courses.focusEn: Floodwall foundation reasoning from hydrostatic action to contact and movement
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定單側靜水、每公尺牆長和水單位重9.81 kN/m³，只把水深從3.0增至3.3 m。合力由44.145增至53.41545 kN/m，增加21%；底部力矩由44.145增至58.7570 kN·m/m，增加33.1%。兩者分別按水深平方和立方變化，不能使用相同百分比。這並不直接給出基礎偏心的新值，因為底版揚壓、垂直水重及其他荷載可能也變動；完整比較必須重新組合相同時刻的各項作用，確認接觸模型仍適用，並獨立檢查承載、滑動與變形。
workedExample.textEn: Hold one-sided still water, unit wall length and water unit weight at 9.81 kN/m³ while raising depth from 3.0 to 3.3 m. Force rises from 44.145 to 53.41545 kN/m, an increase of 21%; base moment rises from 44.145 to 58.7570 kN·m/m, an increase of 33.1%. Force and moment scale with depth squared and cubed respectively. This does not directly give a new foundation eccentricity, because uplift, vertical water weight and other loads may also change. A complete comparison recombines all actions at compatible times, confirms the contact model remains applicable and independently checks bearing, sliding and deformation. No acceptance criterion is inferred from the scaling exercise alone.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=3 m，合力F=γwh²/2=44.145 kN/m，作用點高h/3=1 m，底矩M=44.145 kN·m/m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設底寬B=4 m，高低端揚壓p1=30、p2=10 kPa，U=(p1+p2)B/2=80 kN/m，合力距高壓端1.667 m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總向下力W=200 kN/m、揚壓U=80 kN/m、μ=0.50、水平H=40 kN/m，R=μ(W−U)=60 kN/m，R/H=1.50。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設B=4 m、N=120 kN/m、M=60 kN·m/m，e=M/N=0.50 m；qmax,min=N/B(1±6e/B)=52.5、7.5 kPa。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設不排水強度su=40 kPa、Nc=5.14，淨極限承載力qnet,ult=Ncsu=205.6 kPa；未施安全係數或折減。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設q=50 kPa、B=4 m、ν=0.30、E=20,000 kPa、影響係數I=1.0，s=qB(1−ν²)I/E=0.00910 m。

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross W=200 kN/m, uplift U=80 kN/m, friction μ=0.50 and horizontal H=40 kN/m. Resistance R=60 kN/m and ratio R/H=1.50.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume B=4 m, N=120 kN/m and M=60 kN·m/m. Eccentricity e=0.50 m; full-contact edge pressures are qmax=52.5 and qmin=7.5 kPa.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume undrained strength su=40 kPa and Nc=5.14. Ideal net ultimate bearing qnet,ult=Ncsu=205.6 kPa, before any safety factor or reduction.
