quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective friction angle φ′=30°. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「被動土壓與可動員變形」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Passive pressure and mobilization” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對土面幾何、界面與地下水，列出需要動員被動阻力的方向及位移。檢查前方土是否可能沖走、開挖或受管線擾動，再使用適合邊界的模型並與結構可接受變形比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check ground geometry, interface and groundwater, identifying the movement needed to mobilize passive resistance. Assess whether front soil can be scoured, excavated or disturbed by utilities, then choose a boundary-compatible model and compare its required deformation with structural serviceability limits. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別畫出未變形、局部動員與被動極限三種狀態，列出同一係數不能回答的問題。移除一層前方土後重新界定埋深，說明調查與維護介面的重要性。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw undeformed, partially mobilized and limiting passive states and list questions that one coefficient cannot answer. Remove a front-soil layer, redefine embedment and explain the investigation and maintenance implications of that changed geometry.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Check ground geometry, interface and groundwater, identifying the movement needed to mobilize passive resistance. Assess whether front soil can be scoured, excavated or disturbed by utilities, then choose a boundary-compatible model and compare its required deformation with structural serviceability limits.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別畫出未變形、局部動員與被動極限三種狀態，列出同一係數不能回答的問題。移除一層前方土後重新界定埋深，說明調查與維護介面的重要性。
knowledge.textEn: Draw undeformed, partially mobilized and limiting passive states and list questions that one coefficient cannot answer. Remove a front-soil layer, redefine embedment and explain the investigation and maintenance implications of that changed geometry.

quiz.question: 要驗證「被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification"?
options: 核對土面幾何、界面與地下水，列出需要動員被動阻力的方向及位移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
底面最小壓力大於零，就足以證明承載、沉陷與牆身強度全都合格。
optionsEn: Check ground geometry, interface and groundwater, identifying the movement needed to mobilize passive resistance.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Positive minimum footing pressure proves bearing, settlement and wall strength all acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 核對土面幾何、界面與地下水，列出需要動員被動阻力的方向及位移。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check ground geometry, interface and groundwater, identifying the movement needed to mobilize passive resistance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「被動土壓與可動員變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Passive pressure and mobilization” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements. Omitting future excavation or scour allows a sliding calculation to depend on material that may no longer be present. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只算無黏乾砂、水平面、光滑直牆的理想係數，未算總抗力，也未宣稱已達被動狀態；飽和土需一致有效應力處理。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It neither gives total resistance nor establishes mobilization; saturated soil needs consistent effective-stress treatment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「朗肯被動係數算出後，任何微小位移都能立即動員全部被動抗力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once the Rankine coefficient is calculated, any tiny displacement immediately mobilizes full passive resistance." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。
knowledge.textEn: Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements. Omitting future excavation or scour allows a sliding calculation to depend on material that may no longer be present.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「被動土壓與可動員變形機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Passive pressure and mobilization mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。
防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements.
A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location.
quiz.explanation: 只要看到土在牆前就全額計入被動阻力，可能在小變形下高估抗力；漏掉未來開挖或沖刷情境，則讓原本依賴該土體的抗滑結果失去實體基礎。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crediting full passive resistance merely because soil exists ahead of the wall can overstate resistance at small movements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「截水深度與滲透方向」如何影響防洪牆基礎設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cutoff depth and seepage direction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floodwall foundation design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牆基防滲構造不只減漏，也會改變底版揚壓和出口位置，深度增加可能使流路轉移至較深透水層。以均質流徑延長估算只表示水力阻抗尺度，實際需考慮二維或三維流線、層間異向性及牆尖梯度；總漏水下降不一定表示所有局部孔壓同步下降。本例使用指定長度的固定截面飽和一維路徑，水頭差與滲透係數不變。延長流路不是把實際牆深直接代入，也不提供出口侵蝕判定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「截水深度與滲透方向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Foundation cutoffs reduce leakage but also redistribute uplift and exit locations; greater depth can redirect flow into deeper permeable strata. A lengthened uniform path gives only a resistance scale. Actual analysis needs two- or three-dimensional flow, anisotropic layers and tip gradients, because lower total discharge does not necessarily lower every local pore pressure. This example uses an assigned saturated one-dimensional path of constant area, head difference and conductivity. Path extension is not actual wall depth substituted directly, and it gives no exit-erosion acceptance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cutoff depth and seepage direction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=10 m²、Δh=4 m、L=20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s；路徑40 m時為2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s, A=10 m², Δh=4 m and L=20 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「截水深度與滲透方向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cutoff depth and seepage direction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 牆基防滲構造不只減漏，也會改變底版揚壓和出口位置，深度增加可能使流路轉移至較深透水層。以均質流徑延長估算只表示水力阻抗尺度，實際需考慮二維或三維流線、層間異向性及牆尖梯度；總漏水下降不一定表示所有局部孔壓同步下降。
knowledge.textEn: Foundation cutoffs reduce leakage but also redistribute uplift and exit locations; greater depth can redirect flow into deeper permeable strata. A lengthened uniform path gives only a resistance scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。
兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。
牆基防滲構造不只減漏，也會改變底版揚壓和出口位置，深度增加可能使流路轉移至較深透水層。
optionsEn: A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location.
Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness.
Foundation cutoffs reduce leakage but also redistribute uplift and exit locations; greater depth can redirect flow into deeper permeable strata.
quiz.explanation: 牆基防滲構造不只減漏，也會改變底版揚壓和出口位置，深度增加可能使流路轉移至較深透水層。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Foundation cutoffs reduce leakage but also redistribute uplift and exit locations; greater depth can redirect flow into deeper permeable strata. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「截水深度與滲透方向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cutoff depth and seepage direction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=10 m²、Δh=4 m、L=20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s；路徑40 m時為2×10⁻⁶ m³/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s, A=10 m², Δh=4 m and L=20 m. Q=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s; increasing the ideal path to 40 m halves it. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s, A=10 m², Δh=4 m and L=20 m. Q=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s; increasing the ideal path to 40 m halves it.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設k=2×10⁻⁶ m/s、A=10 m²、Δh=4 m、L=20 m，Q=kAΔh/L=4×10⁻⁶ m³/s。
水深增加一成時，防洪牆的底部水壓力矩也只增加一成。
底版摩擦永遠由全部自重決定，地下水揚壓不會改變抗滑力。

A ten-percent increase in depth increases hydrostatic base moment by only ten percent.
Base friction always uses full self-weight and is unaffected by groundwater uplift.

steps.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「截水深度與滲透方向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cutoff depth and seepage direction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。比較有無防滲構造時的揚壓分布及局部出口梯度，用實測孔壓和流量共同驗證而非只看漏水總數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers. Compare uplift distributions and local exit gradients with and without the cutoff, validating against both measured pressure and discharge rather than total leakage alone as the performance metric. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對一維模型改變流長，另外畫一條繞牆尖的替代路徑。列出需要二維分析才能比較的孔壓位置，說明流量減半不等於每一處梯度減半。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change path length in the one-dimensional model and draw a separate route around the cutoff tip. Identify pressure locations needing two-dimensional analysis and explain why halved discharge does not imply halved gradient everywhere.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。比較有無防滲構造時的揚壓分布及局部出口梯度，用實測孔壓和流量共同驗證而非只看漏水總數。
knowledge.textEn: Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers. Compare uplift distributions and local exit gradients with and without the cutoff, validating against both measured pressure and discharge rather than total leakage alone as the performance metric.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對一維模型改變流長，另外畫一條繞牆尖的替代路徑。列出需要二維分析才能比較的孔壓位置，說明流量減半不等於每一處梯度減半。
knowledge.textEn: Change path length in the one-dimensional model and draw a separate route around the cutoff tip. Identify pressure locations needing two-dimensional analysis and explain why halved discharge does not imply halved gradient everywhere.

quiz.question: 要驗證「截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。
極限承載力就是工程可長期使用的容許壓力，不需檢查沉陷。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers.
Ultimate bearing capacity is the permissible long-term service pressure without settlement checks.
quiz.explanation: 在剖面標出地層、牆尖、排水與總水頭邊界，檢查是否存在繞流或高透水夾層。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map layers, cutoff tip, drains and total-head boundaries and inspect bypass and permeable interlayers. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「截水深度與滲透方向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cutoff depth and seepage direction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass. Claiming improved stability solely from reduced leakage can miss adverse gradients concentrated near a cutoff tip or exit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：延長流路不是把實際牆深直接代入，也不提供出口侵蝕判定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Path extension is not actual wall depth substituted directly, and it gives no exit-erosion acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「防滲牆越深時，所有位置的孔壓與出口梯度必定同時降低。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A deeper cutoff necessarily lowers pore pressure and exit gradient at every location." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。
knowledge.textEn: Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass. Claiming improved stability solely from reduced leakage can miss adverse gradients concentrated near a cutoff tip or exit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「截水深度與滲透方向機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cutoff depth and seepage direction mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。
把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness.
Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass.
quiz.explanation: 把牆深誤當全部流徑會扭曲流量，忽略透水夾層可能低估繞流；如果只根據總漏水變小宣稱穩定改善，就可能漏掉牆尖或出口附近集中的不利梯度。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating cutoff depth as the entire flow path distorts discharge, and an omitted permeable layer understates bypass. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證」與「退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification" and "Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「差異沉陷與止水接頭」如何影響防洪牆基礎設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Differential movement and waterstops” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floodwall foundation design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰牆段的位移差會改變止水材料與接頭幾何，整段平均沉陷很小仍可能在轉折或地層變化處集中變形。以兩測點高差除距離只能得到平均沉陷斜率，未扣剛體轉動時不能直接叫構件角變形；接頭還可能受到開口、剪移和轉角的組合作用，需要與可驗證的材料容許值比較。本例僅為兩點高差的幾何平均斜率，未分解牆段剛體傾斜或局部曲率；不能單憑這個比值計算止水接觸壓力或證明水密。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「差異沉陷與止水接頭」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative movement between wall segments changes waterstop and joint geometry, and a small average settlement can conceal concentration at bends or layer transitions. Elevation difference divided by spacing gives a mean settlement slope, not automatically component angular distortion before removing rigid-body rotation. Joints also experience combined opening, shear and rotation that require validated material capacities. This is only the geometric mean slope between two points, without separation of rigid-body tilt or local curvature. It cannot calculate waterstop contact pressure or establish watertightness. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Differential movement and waterstops” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「差異沉陷與止水接頭」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Differential movement and waterstops”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 相鄰牆段的位移差會改變止水材料與接頭幾何，整段平均沉陷很小仍可能在轉折或地層變化處集中變形。以兩測點高差除距離只能得到平均沉陷斜率，未扣剛體轉動時不能直接叫構件角變形；接頭還可能受到開口、剪移和轉角的組合作用，需要與可驗證的材料容許值比較。
knowledge.textEn: Relative movement between wall segments changes waterstop and joint geometry, and a small average settlement can conceal concentration at bends or layer transitions. Elevation difference divided by spacing gives a mean settlement slope, not automatically component angular distortion before removing rigid-body rotation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 相鄰牆段的位移差會改變止水材料與接頭幾何，整段平均沉陷很小仍可能在轉折或地層變化處集中變形。
兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。
外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。
optionsEn: Relative movement between wall segments changes waterstop and joint geometry, and a small average settlement can conceal concentration at bends or layer transitions.
Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness.
Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰牆段的位移差會改變止水材料與接頭幾何，整段平均沉陷很小仍可能在轉折或地層變化處集中變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Relative movement between wall segments changes waterstop and joint geometry, and a small average settlement can conceal concentration at bends or layer transitions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「差異沉陷與止水接頭」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Differential movement and waterstops” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m. Mean settlement slope Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m, without a waterstop-capacity claim. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m. Mean settlement slope Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m, without a waterstop-capacity claim.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 只要揚壓總力算對，它作用在底版何處就完全不影響穩定。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。
底面最小壓力大於零，就足以證明承載、沉陷與牆身強度全都合格。
optionsEn: Correct total uplift makes its position beneath the footing irrelevant to stability.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m.
Positive minimum footing pressure proves bearing, settlement and wall strength all acceptable.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設兩測點沉陷s1=8 mm、s2=20 mm、間距L=6 m，平均沉陷斜率Δs/L=0.012/6=0.002 m/m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume settlements s1=8 mm and s2=20 mm separated by L=6 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「差異沉陷與止水接頭」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential movement and waterstops” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。量測接頭開口和剪移，取得止水材料在相應溫度、老化與壓差下的性能資料，並以適當漏水測試核對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature. Measure opening and shear and obtain waterstop performance at relevant temperature, aging and pressure difference, checking with appropriate leakage tests rather than inferring sealing behavior from two elevations. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用三個以上測點分解一個假設的剛體傾斜與局部相對變形，另列開口與剪移。說明仍須哪些材料曲線與漏水試驗，才能連結幾何量測和止水性能。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use at least three points to separate a hypothetical rigid tilt from local relative movement, listing opening and shear independently. Explain which material curves and leakage tests are still required to connect geometry with sealing performance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。量測接頭開口和剪移，取得止水材料在相應溫度、老化與壓差下的性能資料，並以適當漏水測試核對。
knowledge.textEn: Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature. Measure opening and shear and obtain waterstop performance at relevant temperature, aging and pressure difference, checking with appropriate leakage tests rather than inferring sealing behavior from two elevations.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用三個以上測點分解一個假設的剛體傾斜與局部相對變形，另列開口與剪移。說明仍須哪些材料曲線與漏水試驗，才能連結幾何量測和止水性能。
knowledge.textEn: Use at least three points to separate a hypothetical rigid tilt from local relative movement, listing opening and shear independently. Explain which material curves and leakage tests are still required to connect geometry with sealing performance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
計算得到小的瞬時彈性沉陷，就能排除所有長期接頭變形。
統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Small calculated instantaneous elastic settlement excludes every long-term joint movement problem.
Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature.
quiz.explanation: 統一測點高程基準與時間，增加牆段內測點以區分整體傾斜與彎曲。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Align survey datum and time and add points within segments to distinguish tilt from curvature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「差異沉陷與止水接頭」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential movement and waterstops” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure. No visible crack does not confirm the integrity of hidden waterstops, connections or their response under pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例僅為兩點高差的幾何平均斜率，未分解牆段剛體傾斜或局部曲率；不能單憑這個比值計算止水接觸壓力或證明水密。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: It cannot calculate waterstop contact pressure or establish watertightness.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個高程點的沉陷斜率可直接換算止水接頭接觸壓力與水密保證。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Settlement slope from two elevations directly gives waterstop contact pressure and guaranteed watertightness." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。
knowledge.textEn: Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure. No visible crack does not confirm the integrity of hidden waterstops, connections or their response under pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「差異沉陷與止水接頭機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential movement and waterstops mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。
optionsEn: Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together.
quiz.explanation: 將平均斜率當全部接頭轉角可能錯配性能試驗，忽略剪移和開口組合也會漏掉止水失效；只用目視無裂縫判斷水密，則無法確認隱藏止水材料或接續完整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating mean slope as the entire joint rotation misapplies performance tests, while ignoring combined shear and opening misses seal failure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「退水與反向荷載情境」如何影響防洪牆基礎設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Recession and reversed loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floodwall foundation design”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水退去後，背側積水或地基孔壓可能尚未消散，原本抵抗外河水的牆會遇到不同方向或分布的作用。水位變化、抽排和排水堵塞應以時間一致的荷載組合處理，不能把各自最大值任意拼湊也不能只檢查最高河水位；反向荷載還可能動員不同界面及接觸區域。本例兩側直牆水深由同一底面量起，取外河向背側為正，僅相減兩個靜水合力；未包含基底揚壓或土壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「退水與反向荷載情境」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After river recession, retained water or foundation pressure may persist, changing the direction and distribution of wall loads. Stage change, pumping and blocked drainage need time-consistent combinations, neither arbitrary combinations of unrelated maxima nor only peak river stage. Reversed loading may also mobilize different interfaces, contacts and structural reinforcement than the original forward case. Depths on both vertical faces share the same base, with river-to-landward force positive. The example subtracts two hydrostatic resultants only, excluding base uplift and earth pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Recession and reversed loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「退水與反向荷載情境」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Recession and reversed loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 洪水退去後，背側積水或地基孔壓可能尚未消散，原本抵抗外河水的牆會遇到不同方向或分布的作用。水位變化、抽排和排水堵塞應以時間一致的荷載組合處理，不能把各自最大值任意拼湊也不能只檢查最高河水位；反向荷載還可能動員不同界面及接觸區域。
knowledge.textEn: After river recession, retained water or foundation pressure may persist, changing the direction and distribution of wall loads. Stage change, pumping and blocked drainage need time-consistent combinations, neither arbitrary combinations of unrelated maxima nor only peak river stage.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。
洪水退去後，背側積水或地基孔壓可能尚未消散，原本抵抗外河水的牆會遇到不同方向或分布的作用。
水深增加一成時，防洪牆的底部水壓力矩也只增加一成。
optionsEn: Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together.
After river recession, retained water or foundation pressure may persist, changing the direction and distribution of wall loads.
A ten-percent increase in depth increases hydrostatic base moment by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 洪水退去後，背側積水或地基孔壓可能尚未消散，原本抵抗外河水的牆會遇到不同方向或分布的作用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After river recession, retained water or foundation pressure may persist, changing the direction and distribution of wall loads. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「退水與反向荷載情境」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Recession and reversed loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m. Net F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m, directed riverward. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m. Net F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m, directed riverward.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 底版摩擦永遠由全部自重決定，地下水揚壓不會改變抗滑力。
極限承載力就是工程可長期使用的容許壓力，不需檢查沉陷。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。
optionsEn: Base friction always uses full self-weight and is unaffected by groundwater uplift.
Ultimate bearing capacity is the permissible long-term service pressure without settlement checks.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³，外河水深ho=0.5 m、背側hi=1.5 m，淨力F=γw(ho²−hi²)/2=−9.81 kN/m，方向朝河。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, river depth ho=0.5 m and rear depth hi=1.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「退水與反向荷載情境」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Recession and reversed loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。明列正負方向和不同作用點，追蹤反向彎矩與接觸區變化，再檢查止水和排水是否可在兩向壓差下運作。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure. State signs and lever arms, trace reversed moments and changing contact regions and check whether seals and drainage can function under pressure differences in both directions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立河水先降而背水暫留的三個時點，逐一計算淨力方向。另畫可能延遲的底版孔壓，說明需要時間相容荷載而不能只挑最高河水位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Create three times with falling river water and temporarily retained rear water, calculating force direction at each. Sketch delayed footing pressures and explain why time-consistent loads are needed instead of choosing only the maximum river stage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。明列正負方向和不同作用點，追蹤反向彎矩與接觸區變化，再檢查止水和排水是否可在兩向壓差下運作。
knowledge.textEn: Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure. State signs and lever arms, trace reversed moments and changing contact regions and check whether seals and drainage can function under pressure differences in both directions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立河水先降而背水暫留的三個時點，逐一計算淨力方向。另畫可能延遲的底版孔壓，說明需要時間相容荷載而不能只挑最高河水位。
knowledge.textEn: Create three times with falling river water and temporarily retained rear water, calculating force direction at each. Sketch delayed footing pressures and explain why time-consistent loads are needed instead of choosing only the maximum river stage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification"?
options: 將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
朗肯被動係數算出後，任何微小位移都能立即動員全部被動抗力。
optionsEn: Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Once the Rankine coefficient is calculated, any tiny displacement immediately mobilizes full passive resistance.
quiz.explanation: 將兩側水位、孔壓與泵站狀態畫在同一時間軸，檢查洪峰、退水及抽排失效。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot both stages, pore pressure and pump state on one time axis and examine peak, recession and pumping failure. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「退水與反向荷載情境」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Recession and reversed loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession. Squaring the depth difference loses the shared-base geometry, and ignoring slower pore-pressure dissipation produces an inconsistent time history of effective foundation loading and resistance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例兩側直牆水深由同一底面量起，取外河向背側為正，僅相減兩個靜水合力；未包含基底揚壓或土壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The example subtracts two hydrostatic resultants only, excluding base uplift and earth pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「外河水位一旦下降，防洪牆受到的所有荷載與風險就必定同步減少。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once river stage falls, every floodwall load and failure risk necessarily decreases together." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。
knowledge.textEn: Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession. Squaring the depth difference loses the shared-base geometry, and ignoring slower pore-pressure dissipation produces an inconsistent time history of effective foundation loading and resistance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「退水與反向荷載情境機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Recession and reversed loading mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。
水深增加一成時，防洪牆的底部水壓力矩也只增加一成。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession.
A ten-percent increase in depth increases hydrostatic base moment by only ten percent.
quiz.explanation: 只以外河最高水位驗算會漏掉退水後背側水壓，直接用水深差平方又抹掉兩側共同底面幾何；忽略孔壓消散較慢也會使基礎有效載重的時程不合理。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Checking only peak river stage misses rear water during recession. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 移動式防洪擋板部署
courses.summary: 課程把可拆構件視為包含預警、儲存、運輸、組裝、基礎、密封及抽排的完整系統，逐步估算時程、載重與水量，再以共同原因及演練統計檢查可靠度。比尤德利與科隆提供官方工程背景，全部算例為假設，不作實際啟動水位、錨定配置或產品合格證明。
courses.summaryEn: The course treats removable elements as a system of warning, storage, transport, assembly, foundations, sealing and pumping. It calculates timing, loading and water balance before examining common causes and exercise statistics. Bewdley and Cologne provide official project context. Every example is hypothetical, without prescribing operating triggers, anchorage layouts or product certification.
courses.focus: 從預警物流到水密與可靠度的移動防洪部署
courses.focusEn: Deployable flood protection from warning logistics to sealing and reliability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 敏感度固定四個必要且互相獨立的操作階段，將每階段成功率由0.98提高到0.99，完整成功率由0.98⁴=0.92236816變成0.99⁴=0.96059601，增加3.822785個百分點。這不是失敗率只減少一個百分點，也不代表現場一定達到相同改善；改善若來自共用同一道路的備援車輛，獨立假設可能根本不成立。應先辨識預報、通知、調度與閉合的共同原因，再用可追溯演練估計條件機率，另外保留洪水超標、密封及結構性能的失效範圍，避免把操作成功當成全面防洪保證。
workedExample.textEn: Keep four necessary independent operational stages and improve each success probability from 0.98 to 0.99. Complete success increases from 0.98⁴=0.92236816 to 0.99⁴=0.96059601, a gain of 3.822785 percentage points. This is not a reduction of only one percentage point in system failure, nor a promise of the same field improvement. Backup vehicles sharing one road may invalidate independence entirely. First identify common causes across forecasting, alerting, mobilization and closure, then estimate conditional probabilities from traceable exercises. Retain separate failure scopes for flood exceedance, sealing and structural performance so that operational success is never presented as comprehensive protection. Changes in crew composition and available routes also require renewed evidence rather than automatic transfer of old probabilities.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=1.2 m、柱距s=2 m，單柱分攤F=γwh²s/2=14.1264 kN，底矩Fh/3=5.65056 kN·m。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設自由厚度t0=12 mm、安裝間隙g=9 mm，壓縮量c=t0−g=3 mm，壓縮率c/t0=25%。
factsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection. Total T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Required whole trips N=ceil(M/C)=4, not 3.43 trips.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, depth h=1.2 m and post spacing s=2 m. Tributary force F=14.1264 kN gives base moment 5.65056 kN·m.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN. R=μ(W−U)=10 kN; R/H=1.25.

Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume free seal thickness t0=12 mm and installed gap g=9 mm. Geometric compression c=3 mm and compression fraction c/t0=25%.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」與「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" and "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Warning lead time and float” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預警提前量與時間餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together. Positive average float is a planning starting point that still requires forecast and duration uncertainty. The example has sequential nonoverlapping phases and hypothetical timing, not any city’s mobilization trigger. The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Warning lead time and float” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Warning lead time and float”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。通知、調度、運輸、組裝與檢查皆消耗時間，且降雨可能同時影響道路和人員；正的平均餘裕只能作規劃起點，仍需處理預報誤差與作業時間分布。
knowledge.textEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. Alerting, mobilization, transport, assembly and checking all consume time, while weather may affect roads and staff together.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。
可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment.
A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 可拆擋板在洪水前必須完成整條防線的閉合，預警提前量應以安全施工的最晚時間為終點，而不是只看洪峰到達。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A demountable system must close the entire defence before flooding, with lead time ending at the latest safe installation time rather than merely the crest arrival. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Warning lead time and float” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume available lead time 8 h: alert 0.5 h, mobilization 1 h, transport 1.5 h, assembly 3 h and inspection 0.5 h. Required time is 6.5 h; float is 1.5 h.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設可用提前量TL=8 h，通知0.5 h、動員1 h、運輸1.5 h、組裝3 h、查驗0.5 h，所需6.5 h，餘裕1.5 h。
optionsEn: A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Warning lead time and float” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。以安全截止時間而非單一洪峰預報比較所需時間，清楚保留不確定度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Include interrupted routes and faster-rising floods in scenarios, comparing required duration against the safe closure deadline rather than one crest forecast while retaining uncertainty in both quantities.

knowledge.text: 把一場假設部署畫成時間線，列出安全截止與預報誤差，再加入交通延遲。比較是否仍有完整查驗時間，並說明不能為了表面準時而省略閉合檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a deployment timeline with a safe deadline and forecast uncertainty, then introduce traffic delay. Check whether full inspection time remains and explain why omitting closure verification cannot be used to create apparent on-time completion.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification"?
options: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 依真實演練記錄各階段開始與結束，檢查是否有重疊或共享資源，並將路線中斷與較快上升洪水列入情境。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record actual start and finish times during exercises, checking overlap and shared resources. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預警提前量與時間餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Warning lead time and float” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Using crest time as the deadline may falsely show positive float even though access or safe working conditions are lost earlier. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例各階段依序不重疊，提前量與工時均是假設值，不是任何城市的動員觸發門檻；未將人員安全截止時間等同於水到板頂。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The safe working deadline is not assumed to occur when water reaches the barrier top.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。
knowledge.textEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Using crest time as the deadline may falsely show positive float even though access or safe working conditions are lost earlier.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預警提前量與時間餘裕機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Warning lead time and float mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 只看組裝速度會漏掉通知和運輸，重複加總平行工作又可能高估時間；若以洪峰當截止而場地更早進水，即使名義餘裕為正也無法安全完成閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Considering assembly alone misses alert and transport time, while adding parallel tasks twice can overstate duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平行班組與資源瓶頸」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 增加班組只會加速可真正平行的工作，卸貨機具、單一道路或依序接續的構件仍可能控制總工期。網路排程需要先列工作相依與共同資源，再找最長路徑；平均每人每小時的產量不能直接乘所有人數，因為相互干擾、交接和查驗會限制現場有效產能。本例兩個區段同時開始且人力完全獨立，完成後才能共同進行最終查驗；不含共用吊具、交通或未列前置作業。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平行班組與資源瓶頸」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel; unloading equipment, a single access road or sequentially connected components may still govern duration. Network scheduling first identifies dependencies and shared resources, then the longest path. Individual output cannot simply be multiplied by headcount because interference, handover and inspection constrain effective production. Two sections start together with fully independent crews, followed by one final inspection only after both finish. Shared lifting equipment, traffic and unlisted preliminary work are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平行班組與資源瓶頸」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel crews and bottlenecks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。

optionsEn: Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
More crews accelerate only work that can genuinely run in parallel.
