增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。
擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection.
Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier.
Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設區段A需2.0 h、B需3.5 h且可平行，最後共同查驗0.5 h，總時間T=max(2.0,3.5)+0.5=4.0 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume independent parallel sections A=2.0 h and B=3.5 h, followed by 0.5 h joint inspection. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平行班組與資源瓶頸」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。檢查短路徑加人是否能改變最長路徑，再用不同班表或設備故障情境重算總時程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Test whether adding staff to a shorter branch changes the critical path, then recalculate total duration for altered shifts or equipment outages rather than assuming proportional acceleration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在兩條平行路徑上加入一台共用吊車，重新安排不能重疊的時段。比較增加班組與增加瓶頸設備的效果，說明需要記錄的現場交接資訊。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Introduce one shared crane into two parallel paths and reschedule nonoverlapping tasks. Compare adding crews with adding bottleneck equipment and identify the field handover information needed to validate the resulting schedule.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。檢查短路徑加人是否能改變最長路徑，再用不同班表或設備故障情境重算總時程。
knowledge.textEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Test whether adding staff to a shorter branch changes the critical path, then recalculate total duration for altered shifts or equipment outages rather than assuming proportional acceleration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在兩條平行路徑上加入一台共用吊車，重新安排不能重疊的時段。比較增加班組與增加瓶頸設備的效果，說明需要記錄的現場交接資訊。
knowledge.textEn: Introduce one shared crane into two parallel paths and reschedule nonoverlapping tasks. Compare adding crews with adding bottleneck equipment and identify the field handover information needed to validate the resulting schedule.

quiz.question: 要驗證「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。
四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time.
Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable.
quiz.explanation: 以演練逐項核對可平行的真實條件，追蹤吊具、車輛、鑰匙和檢查人員的共享時段。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify actual parallelism in exercises and track shared lifting equipment, vehicles, keys and inspectors over time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「平行班組與資源瓶頸」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel crews and bottlenecks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Adding people to a noncritical activity may not advance closure, and omitted final inspection lets local completion be incorrectly reported as a fully functioning defence line. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例兩個區段同時開始且人力完全獨立，完成後才能共同進行最終查驗；不含共用吊具、交通或未列前置作業。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Shared lifting equipment, traffic and unlisted preliminary work are excluded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。
knowledge.textEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Adding people to a noncritical activity may not advance closure, and omitted final inspection lets local completion be incorrectly reported as a fully functioning defence line.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平行班組與資源瓶頸機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel crews and bottlenecks mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration.
quiz.explanation: 把兩段都假設獨立但共用唯一吊車會低估工期，將人員加到非關鍵工作也不一定提早閉合；忽略最後整線查驗，可能讓局部完成被誤報為全線可用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assuming independent sections that share one crane understates duration. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」與「板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification" and "Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「構件清點與運輸趟次」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Component inventory and transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。清點不只確認總件數，還需匹配區段、方向與介面；一個關鍵專用件缺少就可能中斷閉合，而備品不能任意替換未經驗證的規格。本例只依載重計算整數趟次，假設各件可分配且體積及裝卸已確認不控制；未計司機班時、路程或多車平行調度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「構件清點與運輸趟次」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. Transport is constrained by mass, volume and securing arrangements. Inventory must match sections, orientation and interfaces rather than merely total counts. One missing specialist component can prevent closure, and a spare is not interchangeable without verified compatibility with the intended system. The example counts whole trips by payload only, assuming items can be distributed and volume and handling do not govern. Driver hours, travel time and parallel vehicle scheduling are excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Component inventory and transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「構件清點與運輸趟次」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Component inventory and transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。清點不只確認總件數，還需匹配區段、方向與介面；一個關鍵專用件缺少就可能中斷閉合，而備品不能任意替換未經驗證的規格。
knowledge.textEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. Transport is constrained by mass, volume and securing arrangements.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
optionsEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
quiz.explanation: 擋板、立柱、螺栓與密封件形成可追溯的組裝系統，運輸容量既受質量也受體積和固定方式限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Panels, posts, fasteners and seals form a traceable assembly system. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「構件清點與運輸趟次」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Component inventory and transport” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Required whole trips N=ceil(M/C)=4, not 3.43 trips. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Required whole trips N=ceil(M/C)=4, not 3.43 trips.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總構件質量M=12,000 kg、每趟有效載重C=3500 kg，趟次N=ceil(M/C)=4；不是3.43趟。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume component mass M=12,000 kg and effective payload C=3500 kg. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Component inventory and transport mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「構件清點與運輸趟次」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Component inventory and transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把構件清單連到區段標識與裝車順序，核對尺寸、載重、固定和現場卸貨空間。用實際庫存及備品相容紀錄驗證，演練中記錄最後關鍵件到達時間而非僅平均車趟。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Link inventory to section identifiers and loading order, checking dimensions, payload, securing and unloading space. Verify actual stock and spare compatibility and record arrival of the last critical component during exercises rather than relying only on average truck-trip duration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 構件清點與運輸趟次機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「構件清點與運輸趟次」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Component inventory and transport” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小數趟次向下取整會遺漏構件，僅按總重量裝車可能讓先用構件最後才到；混用外觀相似但介面不合的零件，則可能在現場造成無法壓緊或閉合的接頭。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Rounding trips downward leaves components behind. Loading only by total weight may deliver early-use items last, while visually similar but incompatible parts can create joints that cannot close or achieve their specified compression during installation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只依載重計算整數趟次，假設各件可分配且體積及裝卸已確認不控制；未計司機班時、路程或多車平行調度。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「板面水壓與立柱傳力」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Panel pressure and post load path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水壓由板面傳到立柱，再經底座與預設基礎承擔，簡單合力分配只能說明某一傳力假設。每根立柱的分攤寬度取決於跨距和邊界，端柱與轉角不一定相同；水深增加還使作用點和彎矩改變，不能只比較板材厚度或額定高度就跳過錨座與地基。本例為垂直單側靜水、均勻跨距的內柱，分攤寬度等於柱距；合力只是外荷載，並非螺栓拉力或任何現場安裝設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「板面水壓與立柱傳力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water pressure passes from panels through posts and bases into prepared foundations. A simple tributary calculation explains only one load-path assumption. Post width depends on span and boundary conditions, with end and corner posts differing from interior posts. Greater depth also changes lever arm and moment, so panel thickness or rated height cannot replace anchorage and foundation assessment. The example uses one-sided still water and an interior post in equally spaced bays, with tributary width equal to spacing. The resultant is external loading, not bolt tension or a field installation design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Panel pressure and post load path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=1.2 m、柱距s=2 m，單柱分攤F=γwh²s/2=14.1264 kN，底矩Fh/3=5.65056 kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, depth h=1.2 m and post spacing s=2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「板面水壓與立柱傳力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Panel pressure and post load path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證

quiz.question: 關於「板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「板面水壓與立柱傳力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Panel pressure and post load path” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設γw=9.81 kN/m³、水深h=1.2 m、柱距s=2 m，單柱分攤F=γwh²s/2=14.1264 kN，底矩Fh/3=5.65056 kN·m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume γw=9.81 kN/m³, depth h=1.2 m and post spacing s=2 m. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 畫出板到柱、底座及地基的完整傳力路徑，逐一核對邊跨、轉角和接頭邊界。確認製造商證明資料對應實際底座及水深，另評估撞擊、波浪和反向作用，不由合力直接推定錨栓合格。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw the full path from panels to posts, bases and soil, checking end bays, corners and joint boundaries. Confirm documented system evidence matches the actual base and head, assessing impact, waves and reversed action separately rather than inferring anchor adequacy directly from total force. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Vary spacing at one depth and compare forces, drawing tributary areas for end and corner posts separately. List base and material evidence still needed beyond total load, avoiding conversion of the teaching calculation into an installation layout.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying interior-post tributary width everywhere can misallocate force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對同一水深改變柱距並比較合力，另外畫出端柱與轉角的分攤區。列出合力之外仍需的底座與材料資料，避免把教學載重直接當施工配置。
knowledge.textEn: Vary spacing at one depth and compare forces, drawing tributary areas for end and corner posts separately. List base and material evidence still needed beyond total load, avoiding conversion of the teaching calculation into an installation layout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification"?
options: 畫出板到柱、底座及地基的完整傳力路徑，逐一核對邊跨、轉角和接頭邊界。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。
optionsEn: Draw the full path from panels to posts, bases and soil, checking end bays, corners and joint boundaries.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment.
quiz.explanation: 畫出板到柱、底座及地基的完整傳力路徑，逐一核對邊跨、轉角和接頭邊界。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw the full path from panels to posts, bases and soil, checking end bays, corners and joint boundaries. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「板面水壓與立柱傳力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Panel pressure and post load path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把內柱分攤寬度套到所有邊界可能錯分荷載，忽略底座力矩又會漏掉錨定需求；單獨測試板材不能證明柱、基礎與止水組合在同一荷載下可靠。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying interior-post tributary width everywhere can misallocate force. Ignoring base moment misses anchorage demand, and a panel-only test cannot establish reliability of posts, foundations and seals acting together under the same loading conditions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例為垂直單側靜水、均勻跨距的內柱，分攤寬度等於柱距；合力只是外荷載，並非螺栓拉力或任何現場安裝設計。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The resultant is external loading, not bolt tension or a field installation design.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把內柱分攤寬度套到所有邊界可能錯分荷載，忽略底座力矩又會漏掉錨定需求；單獨測試板材不能證明柱、基礎與止水組合在同一荷載下可靠。
knowledge.textEn: Applying interior-post tributary width everywhere can misallocate force. Ignoring base moment misses anchorage demand, and a panel-only test cannot establish reliability of posts, foundations and seals acting together under the same loading conditions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「板面水壓與立柱傳力機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Panel pressure and post load path mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把內柱分攤寬度套到所有邊界可能錯分荷載，忽略底座力矩又會漏掉錨定需求；單獨測試板材不能證明柱、基礎與止水組合在同一荷載下可靠。
增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Applying interior-post tributary width everywhere can misallocate force.
Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier.
quiz.explanation: 把內柱分攤寬度套到所有邊界可能錯分荷載，忽略底座力矩又會漏掉錨定需求；單獨測試板材不能證明柱、基礎與止水組合在同一荷載下可靠。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying interior-post tributary width everywhere can misallocate force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證」與「密封壓縮與幾何公差機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification" and "Seal compression and geometric tolerance mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重力式底座與滑動尺度」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gravity-base sliding scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。地表材質、坡度、泥砂及鋪面接縫也會影響接觸，不能把乾燥平整試驗地面的摩擦係數直接帶到雨中現場；滑動計算需和傾覆、承載及滲流並列。本例是單一假設底座的庫侖摩擦尺度，向下重量尚未扣揚壓，無錨定與被動土抗力；比值不是任何產品額定值或安裝許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重力式底座與滑動尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction. Surface material, slope, silt and paving joints affect contact, so a coefficient from a dry level test surface cannot automatically represent a wet site. Sliding belongs alongside overturning, bearing and seepage assessment. This is a Coulomb-friction scale for one hypothetical base. Gross weight excludes uplift deduction and no anchors or passive soil resistance are credited; the ratio is neither a product rating nor installation approval. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gravity-base sliding scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重力式底座與滑動尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Gravity-base sliding scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。地表材質、坡度、泥砂及鋪面接縫也會影響接觸，不能把乾燥平整試驗地面的摩擦係數直接帶到雨中現場；滑動計算需和傾覆、承載及滲流並列。
knowledge.textEn: Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction. Surface material, slope, silt and paving joints affect contact, so a coefficient from a dry level test surface cannot automatically represent a wet site.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。
密封條只要算出正的壓縮量，就已證明接觸壓力足夠且完全不漏水。
臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。
optionsEn: Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier.
Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.
Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction.
quiz.explanation: 臨時重力式防洪系統可能依自重、蓄水重量或支撐形成抗力，但底面滲水會降低有效法向力並改變摩擦。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temporary gravity systems may resist through self-weight, contained water or bracing, but under-base seepage reduces effective normal force and friction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重力式底座與滑動尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gravity-base sliding scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN. R=μ(W−U)=10 kN; R/H=1.25. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN. R=μ(W−U)=10 kN; R/H=1.25.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
三十次演練都成功，就能用統計方法證明未來失敗機率恰好為零。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
Thirty successful exercises statistically prove that future failure probability is exactly zero.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設向下W=30 kN、揚壓U=5 kN、μ=0.40、水平力H=8 kN，摩擦R=μ(W−U)=10 kN，R/H=1.25。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume gross downward W=30 kN, uplift U=5 kN, friction μ=0.40 and horizontal H=8 kN. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重力式底座與滑動尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gravity-base sliding scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。對排水堵塞、表面沖刷及不平整重新評估，並核對整個經測試系統而不是僅一個底座比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight. Reassess blocked drainage, surface erosion and unevenness, checking the tested complete system rather than relying on one isolated base resistance ratio. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用兩種假設揚壓比較有效法向力和滑動比，再列出未檢查的失效模式。說明為何改變底座重量或表面配置，需要重新核對完整系統的證明資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare effective normal load and sliding ratio at two hypothetical uplifts, listing unchecked failure modes. Explain why changing base weight or surface preparation requires renewed review of evidence for the complete system configuration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略泥砂潤滑可能高估摩擦，將乾地試驗係數當成固定材料常數也會失真；只為增加自重而疊放未經核對的重物，還可能改變基礎承載和構件受力方式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting lubricating silt can overstate friction, and treating a dry-test coefficient as a universal material constant is misleading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。對排水堵塞、表面沖刷及不平整重新評估，並核對整個經測試系統而不是僅一個底座比值。
knowledge.textEn: Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight. Reassess blocked drainage, surface erosion and unevenness, checking the tested complete system rather than relying on one isolated base resistance ratio.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用兩種假設揚壓比較有效法向力和滑動比，再列出未檢查的失效模式。說明為何改變底座重量或表面配置，需要重新核對完整系統的證明資料。
knowledge.textEn: Compare effective normal load and sliding ratio at two hypothetical uplifts, listing unchecked failure modes. Explain why changing base weight or surface preparation requires renewed review of evidence for the complete system configuration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gravity-base sliding scale mechanism and verification"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check friction evidence against actual wetness, contamination and surface condition and track whether uplift has already been deducted in weight.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
quiz.explanation: 確認摩擦資料與實際濕潤、污染和表面條件相容，追蹤揚壓是否已在重量定義中扣除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。

steps.title: 重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gravity-base sliding scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略泥砂潤滑可能高估摩擦，將乾地試驗係數當成固定材料常數也會失真；只為增加自重而疊放未經核對的重物，還可能改變基礎承載和構件受力方式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting lubricating silt can overstate friction, and treating a dry-test coefficient as a universal material constant is misleading. Adding unverified ballast solely for weight can also change bearing demands and the intended loading of individual components. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例是單一假設底座的庫侖摩擦尺度，向下重量尚未扣揚壓，無錨定與被動土抗力；比值不是任何產品額定值或安裝許可。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Gross weight excludes uplift deduction and no anchors or passive soil resistance are credited; the ratio is neither a product rating nor installation approval.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加自重一定能解決所有臨時防洪系統的滑動、滲水與承載問題。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「重力式底座與滑動尺度機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage.
Omitting lubricating silt can overstate friction, and treating a dry-test coefficient as a universal material constant is misleading.

steps.title: 密封壓縮與幾何公差機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Seal compression and geometric tolerance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 接頭密封需要適當壓縮和連續接觸，板面變形、地面不平與裝配誤差會消耗幾何餘量。壓縮量可以從厚度和間隙求得，但接觸壓力取決於材料曲線、溫度、老化與壓縮歷程；只看到正壓縮不能保證水密，也不能任意增加鎖緊量而忽略構件和密封件的限制。本例僅計算均勻密封條的幾何壓縮率，未指定材料本構或可用範圍；不得由此推定接觸壓力、鎖緊力或水密等級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「密封壓縮與幾何公差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Seals require suitable compression and continuous contact. Panel movement, uneven ground and assembly errors consume geometric allowance. Thickness and gap give compression, but contact pressure depends on material curves, temperature, aging and loading history. Positive compression does not prove watertightness, and additional tightening cannot ignore component or seal limits and verified installation procedures. The example computes geometric compression of a uniform seal only, without constitutive behavior or an acceptable range. It cannot establish contact pressure, tightening force or a watertightness rating. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Seal compression and geometric tolerance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設自由厚度t0=12 mm、安裝間隙g=9 mm，壓縮量c=t0−g=3 mm，壓縮率c/t0=25%。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設自由厚度t0=12 mm、安裝間隙g=9 mm，壓縮量c=t0−g=3 mm，壓縮率c/t0=25%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume free seal thickness t0=12 mm and installed gap g=9 mm. Geometric compression c=3 mm and compression fraction c/t0=25%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any positive calculated seal compression proves adequate contact pressure and zero leakage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 地面顆粒可能形成局部未接觸通道，過度壓縮也可能損傷密封或讓板柱受力異常；把名義厚度當每處實際厚度，則會漏掉老化、永久變形和接頭轉角的影響。
knowledge.textEn: Particles under a seal can create local noncontact paths, while excessive compression may damage it or alter panel/post loading. Assuming nominal thickness everywhere misses aging, permanent set and joint rotation that affect the actual contact geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「密封壓縮與幾何公差機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seal compression and geometric tolerance mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 地面顆粒可能形成局部未接觸通道，過度壓縮也可能損傷密封或讓板柱受力異常；把名義厚度當每處實際厚度，則會漏掉老化、永久變形和接頭轉角的影響。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。
optionsEn: Particles under a seal can create local noncontact paths, while excessive compression may damage it or alter panel/post loading.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise.
quiz.explanation: 地面顆粒可能形成局部未接觸通道，過度壓縮也可能損傷密封或讓板柱受力異常；把名義厚度當每處實際厚度，則會漏掉老化、永久變形和接頭轉角的影響。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Particles under a seal can create local noncontact paths, while excessive compression may damage it or alter panel/post loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」與「端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification" and "End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual leakage and pumping buffer” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 已閉合的擋板仍可能由密封、地層或地下管線滲水，防線後方降雨也會增加積水，因此抽排與暫存是系統的一部分。水量平衡要納入所有進出路徑及泵的實際揚程工作點，不能以名牌流量保證內側不積水；停電或排出口被外河淹沒時還可能改變有效能力。本例入流和抽排量均為固定的假設實際流率，暫存池面積固定，未含背側降雨或外河變化；只算短時水位變化尺度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A closed barrier may leak through seals, soil or buried services, and rainfall behind it adds water. Pumping and storage therefore belong to the system. Balance all paths using the pump’s actual head-dependent operating point rather than nameplate flow; power loss or a submerged outfall can further alter effective removal during a flood event. Inflows and pumping are hypothetical constant actual rates with fixed storage area, excluding rainfall and changing river stage. This is a short-duration water-level scale only. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual leakage and pumping buffer” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總滲入Qi=0.012 m³/s、抽排Qp=0.008 m³/s、t=1800 s、池面積A=40 m²，Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qi=0.012 m³/s, pumping Qp=0.008 m³/s, time t=1800 s and storage area A=40 m².
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual leakage and pumping buffer”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 已閉合的擋板仍可能由密封、地層或地下管線滲水，防線後方降雨也會增加積水，因此抽排與暫存是系統的一部分。水量平衡要納入所有進出路徑及泵的實際揚程工作點，不能以名牌流量保證內側不積水；停電或排出口被外河淹沒時還可能改變有效能力。
knowledge.textEn: A closed barrier may leak through seals, soil or buried services, and rainfall behind it adds water. Pumping and storage therefore belong to the system.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。
已閉合的擋板仍可能由密封、地層或地下管線滲水，防線後方降雨也會增加積水，因此抽排與暫存是系統的一部分。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise.
A closed barrier may leak through seals, soil or buried services, and rainfall behind it adds water.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 已閉合的擋板仍可能由密封、地層或地下管線滲水，防線後方降雨也會增加積水，因此抽排與暫存是系統的一部分。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A closed barrier may leak through seals, soil or buried services, and rainfall behind it adds water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual leakage and pumping buffer” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總滲入Qi=0.012 m³/s、抽排Qp=0.008 m³/s、t=1800 s、池面積A=40 m²，Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qi=0.012 m³/s, pumping Qp=0.008 m³/s, time t=1800 s and storage area A=40 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：盤點密封、地下管線和地表降雨的入流路徑，量測實際泵流量及內外水位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inventory inflow through seals, services and rainfall and measure actual pumping and both water levels.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總滲入Qi=0.012 m³/s、抽排Qp=0.008 m³/s、t=1800 s、池面積A=40 m²，Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qi=0.012 m³/s, pumping Qp=0.008 m³/s, time t=1800 s and storage area A=40 m². Rise Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 三十次演練都成功，就能用統計方法證明未來失敗機率恰好為零。
任意增加一倍人力，所有部署流程的總時間就必定減半。
原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總滲入Qi=0.012 m³/s、抽排Qp=0.008 m³/s、t=1800 s、池面積A=40 m²，Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m。
optionsEn: Thirty successful exercises statistically prove that future failure probability is exactly zero.
Doubling staff anywhere necessarily halves the total duration of every deployment process.
Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qi=0.012 m³/s, pumping Qp=0.008 m³/s, time t=1800 s and storage area A=40 m².
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設總滲入Qi=0.012 m³/s、抽排Qp=0.008 m³/s、t=1800 s、池面積A=40 m²，Δh=(Qi−Qp)t/A=0.18 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume leakage Qi=0.012 m³/s, pumping Qp=0.008 m³/s, time t=1800 s and storage area A=40 m². Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual leakage and pumping buffer” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 盤點密封、地下管線和地表降雨的入流路徑，量測實際泵流量及內外水位。檢查電源、出水管和逆止配置，再以停泵或外水抬升情境比較可用儲水時間，而不是只記錄泵已啟動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inventory inflow through seals, services and rainfall and measure actual pumping and both water levels. Check power, discharge piping and backflow control, comparing storage time under pump failure or raised tailwater instead of recording only whether the pump motor is running. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將滲水、降雨和抽排分列水量帳，計算固定面積池的短時水位變化。再設定一台泵失效，指出何時需要重新計算實際揚程和可用通行時間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate leakage, rainfall and pumping in a water ledger and calculate short-term rise in fixed-area storage. Add a pump outage and identify when actual head and remaining access time must be recalculated.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略地下排水管回流會低估入流，泵啟動但不在預期工作點也可能抽不出名牌流量；如果儲水區還承擔通行，水量雖小仍可能先破壞人員和設備的可用路線。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitted drain backflow understates inflow, and an operating pump may deliver less than its rated flow at the actual head. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 盤點密封、地下管線和地表降雨的入流路徑，量測實際泵流量及內外水位。檢查電源、出水管和逆止配置，再以停泵或外水抬升情境比較可用儲水時間，而不是只記錄泵已啟動。
knowledge.textEn: Inventory inflow through seals, services and rainfall and measure actual pumping and both water levels. Check power, discharge piping and backflow control, comparing storage time under pump failure or raised tailwater instead of recording only whether the pump motor is running.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將滲水、降雨和抽排分列水量帳，計算固定面積池的短時水位變化。再設定一台泵失效，指出何時需要重新計算實際揚程和可用通行時間。
knowledge.textEn: Separate leakage, rainfall and pumping in a water ledger and calculate short-term rise in fixed-area storage. Add a pump outage and identify when actual head and remaining access time must be recalculated.

quiz.question: 要驗證「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification"?
options: 盤點密封、地下管線和地表降雨的入流路徑，量測實際泵流量及內外水位。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
板材能承受水壓，就能自動證明立柱底座與地基也完全足夠。
optionsEn: Inventory inflow through seals, services and rainfall and measure actual pumping and both water levels.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A panel resisting water pressure automatically proves its post base and foundation adequate.
quiz.explanation: 盤點密封、地下管線和地表降雨的入流路徑，量測實際泵流量及內外水位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inventory inflow through seals, services and rainfall and measure actual pumping and both water levels. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual leakage and pumping buffer” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略地下排水管回流會低估入流，泵啟動但不在預期工作點也可能抽不出名牌流量；如果儲水區還承擔通行，水量雖小仍可能先破壞人員和設備的可用路線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitted drain backflow understates inflow, and an operating pump may deliver less than its rated flow at the actual head. Storage occupying an access route can also disrupt personnel and equipment before the accumulated volume appears large. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例入流和抽排量均為固定的假設實際流率，暫存池面積固定，未含背側降雨或外河變化；只算短時水位變化尺度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This is a short-duration water-level scale only.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「擋板閉合後只要任何一台泵在運轉，內側水位就一定不會上升。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Once barriers close, any running pump guarantees that interior water level cannot rise." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Omitted drain backflow understates inflow, and an operating pump may deliver less than its rated flow at the actual head. Storage occupying an access route can also disrupt personnel and equipment before the accumulated volume appears large.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「殘餘滲漏與抽排緩衝機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Residual leakage and pumping buffer mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
忽略地下排水管回流會低估入流，泵啟動但不在預期工作點也可能抽不出名牌流量；如果儲水區還承擔通行，水量雖小仍可能先破壞人員和設備的可用路線。
每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Omitted drain backflow understates inflow, and an operating pump may deliver less than its rated flow at the actual head.
Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
quiz.explanation: 忽略地下排水管回流會低估入流，泵啟動但不在預期工作點也可能抽不出名牌流量；如果儲水區還承擔通行，水量雖小仍可能先破壞人員和設備的可用路線。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Omitted drain backflow understates inflow, and an operating pump may deliver less than its rated flow at the actual head. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「端部接續與最低高程」如何影響移動式防洪擋板部署的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Deployable flood-barrier systems”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水可以繞過防線端部或從低點進入，即使每塊板本身都達到高度與強度要求，整體仍可能未形成封閉邊界。測量應追蹤連續路線、建築介面、路口和地下開口，將共同高程基準上的最低有效防護點與水位比較；平均高度或最高構件不能代表系統的限制位置。本例只比較三個已確認連續接合點的幾何高程，不含波浪、沉陷或模型誤差預留；正餘量不代表結構、滲流和營運全部通過。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「端部接續與最低高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Water can outflank the ends or enter at a low point even when every panel meets its individual height and strength requirements. Survey the continuous route, building interfaces, road openings and buried penetrations. Compare stage with the lowest effective defence point on one datum; average elevation or the tallest component does not define the system’s limiting location. The example compares three assumed continuous tie-in elevations only, without wave, settlement or uncertainty allowances. Positive margin does not establish structural, seepage and operational acceptance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三處有效頂高102.0、101.7、101.9 m，水面101.5 m，最小幾何餘量F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective crest elevations 102.0, 101.7 and 101.9 m with water level 101.5 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「端部接續與最低高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “End tie-ins and minimum elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證
knowledge.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification
knowledge.text: 水可以繞過防線端部或從低點進入，即使每塊板本身都達到高度與強度要求，整體仍可能未形成封閉邊界。測量應追蹤連續路線、建築介面、路口和地下開口，將共同高程基準上的最低有效防護點與水位比較；平均高度或最高構件不能代表系統的限制位置。
knowledge.textEn: Water can outflank the ends or enter at a low point even when every panel meets its individual height and strength requirements. Survey the continuous route, building interfaces, road openings and buried penetrations.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification" is correct?
options: 每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。
四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。
水可以繞過防線端部或從低點進入，即使每塊板本身都達到高度與強度要求，整體仍可能未形成封閉邊界。
optionsEn: Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings.
Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable.
Water can outflank the ends or enter at a low point even when every panel meets its individual height and strength requirements.
quiz.explanation: 水可以繞過防線端部或從低點進入，即使每塊板本身都達到高度與強度要求，整體仍可能未形成封閉邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「端部接續與最低高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三處有效頂高102.0、101.7、101.9 m，水面101.5 m，最小幾何餘量F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective crest elevations 102.0, 101.7 and 101.9 m with water level 101.5 m. Minimum geometric margin F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三處有效頂高102.0、101.7、101.9 m，水面101.5 m，最小幾何餘量F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective crest elevations 102.0, 101.7 and 101.9 m with water level 101.5 m. Minimum geometric margin F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification", which statement holds?
options: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三處有效頂高102.0、101.7、101.9 m，水面101.5 m，最小幾何餘量F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m。
只要擋板組裝時間短於洪峰到達時間，就一定來得及安全部署。
只要總件數和總重量足夠，就能保證每個區段的構件都相容。
optionsEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective crest elevations 102.0, 101.7 and 101.9 m with water level 101.5 m.
Assembly shorter than time to the flood crest guarantees timely and safe deployment.
Sufficient total count and mass guarantee compatible components for every barrier section.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設算例，以下量值用於簡化機理比較：假設三處有效頂高102.0、101.7、101.9 m，水面101.5 m，最小幾何餘量F=min(Z)−Zw=0.20 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching example using hypothetical inputs to compare a simplified physical mechanism: Assume effective crest elevations 102.0, 101.7 and 101.9 m with water level 101.5 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「端部接續與最低高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。逐段查驗接續和地下穿越，將幾何餘量、波浪預留及其他失效模式分列，不以一張平均高度表代替現場閉合確認。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage. Verify transitions and buried crossings segment by segment, separating geometric margin, wave allowance and other failure modes instead of substituting an average-height table for physical closure confirmation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出一條包含路口、建築和端部高地的防線，找最低有效高程並加上未封閉管線。分別說明越頂、繞流和地下回流，為每一種安排不同的閉合證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw a line crossing roads, buildings and high ground, identify the lowest effective elevation and add an open service pipe. Distinguish overtopping, outflanking and underground backflow and assign different closure evidence to each pathway.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Checking the tallest panel misses low ground at an end. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。逐段查驗接續和地下穿越，將幾何餘量、波浪預留及其他失效模式分列，不以一張平均高度表代替現場閉合確認。
knowledge.textEn: Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage. Verify transitions and buried crossings segment by segment, separating geometric margin, wave allowance and other failure modes instead of substituting an average-height table for physical closure confirmation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出一條包含路口、建築和端部高地的防線，找最低有效高程並加上未封閉管線。分別說明越頂、繞流和地下回流，為每一種安排不同的閉合證據。
knowledge.textEn: Draw a line crossing roads, buildings and high ground, identify the lowest effective elevation and add an open service pipe. Distinguish overtopping, outflanking and underground backflow and assign different closure evidence to each pathway.

quiz.question: 要驗證「端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。

optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage.
Added weight necessarily solves every sliding, seepage and bearing problem of a temporary barrier.
quiz.explanation: 沿整條防線實測端點、門洞與局部低點，確認與水位使用同一基準。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey ends, openings and local lows along the complete line using the same datum as water stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「端部接續與最低高程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “End tie-ins and minimum elevation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Checking the tallest panel misses low ground at an end. Unsealed road or building transitions create bypass paths, and mixed elevation datums can erase an apparently positive margin regardless of the structural strength of the panels themselves. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：本例只比較三個已確認連續接合點的幾何高程，不含波浪、沉陷或模型誤差預留；正餘量不代表結構、滲流和營運全部通過。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Positive margin does not establish structural, seepage and operational acceptance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每塊擋板的額定高度足夠，就不需要檢查兩端與地下開口的連續性。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adequate rated height of every panel removes the need to check ends and buried openings." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。

quiz.question: 在「端部接續與最低高程機理與驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "End tie-ins and minimum elevation mechanism and verification" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
四個必要環節各有百分之九十八成功率，整個流程就必定也是百分之九十八。
只看最高擋板會漏掉端部低地，跨越道路或建築接點未密合也可能形成繞流；基準混用則讓表面上正的餘量消失，與板材本身的強度高低無關。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Four necessary stages each succeeding ninety-eight percent make the entire process ninety-eight percent reliable.
Checking the tallest panel misses low ground at an end.
