steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N。適用邊界：完全浸沒且密度均勻，僅計靜水淨上浮力，不是錨具額定需求。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged uniform density; calculates net hydrostatic uplift only, not an anchorage rating.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「木構護岸的浮力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Buoyancy of wood revetments", which statement holds?
options: 採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積
下游濃度下降就足以證明護岸永久移除了同等比例泥砂
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N。
optionsEn: Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
Lower downstream concentration alone proves permanent removal of the same sediment fraction
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhow=1000 kg/m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhow=1000 kg/m3; rhol=600 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; V=0.8 m3; Fu=(rhow-rhol)*g*V=3139.2 N. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 木構護岸的浮力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Buoyancy of wood revetments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「木構護岸的浮力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Buoyancy of wood revetments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先量木構尺寸與濕重，再以部分浸水試驗檢查排水量。洪水後記錄轉角、接頭滑移與岸土流失，將浮力計算和現場受力方向比對，若受力不共線則增加力矩分析與接頭試驗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure geometry and wet mass, then check displacement during partial immersion. After floods, record rotation, connection movement and soil loss. Compare the buoyancy direction with observed loading and add moment analysis when forces are not aligned. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較木材密度增加到八百公斤每立方公尺後的淨浮力，另畫一個岸趾淘空的偏心支承圖，指出還缺哪些尺寸才能計算錨點受力。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate uplift for timber density of eight hundred kilograms per cubic metre. Draw an eccentric support after toe erosion and identify the additional dimensions needed to resolve anchor forces and moments.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先量木構尺寸與濕重，再以部分浸水試驗檢查排水量。洪水後記錄轉角、接頭滑移與岸土流失，將浮力計算和現場受力方向比對，若受力不共線則增加力矩分析與接頭試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Measure geometry and wet mass, then check displacement during partial immersion. After floods, record rotation, connection movement and soil loss. Compare the buoyancy direction with observed loading and add moment analysis when forces are not aligned.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較木材密度增加到八百公斤每立方公尺後的淨浮力，另畫一個岸趾淘空的偏心支承圖，指出還缺哪些尺寸才能計算錨點受力。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate uplift for timber density of eight hundred kilograms per cubic metre. Draw an eccentric support after toe erosion and identify the additional dimensions needed to resolve anchor forces and moments.

quiz.question: 要驗證「木構護岸的浮力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Buoyancy of wood revetments"?
options: 先量木構尺寸與濕重，再以部分浸水試驗檢查排水量。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力
optionsEn: Measure geometry and wet mass, then check displacement during partial immersion.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
quiz.explanation: 先量木構尺寸與濕重，再以部分浸水試驗檢查排水量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure geometry and wet mass, then check displacement during partial immersion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 木構護岸的浮力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Buoyancy of wood revetments: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「木構護岸的浮力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Buoyancy of wood revetments” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。只用淨浮力除以錨點數，會掩蓋負荷分配不均及漸進破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension. Dividing uplift equally among anchors hides unequal distribution and progressive connection failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：木構隨浸泡吸水與腐朽改變密度，因此檢查不能只依新材出廠重量，還需辨認失去土體包覆後的受力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Inspection therefore needs the evolving load path after surrounding soil erodes, rather than relying solely on the weight of freshly supplied timber.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「木構的淨浮力除以錨點數就是每支錨具唯一荷載」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Net buoyancy divided by anchor count is the only load on each anchor" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。只用淨浮力除以錨點數，會掩蓋負荷分配不均及漸進破壞。
knowledge.textEn: Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension. Dividing uplift equally among anchors hides unequal distribution and progressive connection failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「木構護岸的浮力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Buoyancy of wood revetments" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。
剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension.
Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
quiz.explanation: 岸土被淘空後木構可能繞剩餘錨點旋轉，接頭受撬力而非單純拉力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Erosion can leave timber rotating about one anchor, prying connections instead of loading them in simple tension. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」與「建立期植株存活率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Toe embedment and erosion allowance" and "Plant survival during establishment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment and erosion allowance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Toe embedment and erosion allowance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。扣除一次量測沖刷深度能得到幾何餘量，但尚未考慮洪水規模、長期下切與橫向深槽遷移。埋得更深也可能增加施工擾動與地下水交換阻力。合理比較需要把施工基準、自然河床高程與預期變化分開記錄，再以重複測線判斷餘量如何消耗。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes. Embedment must therefore reference a changing bed rather than one construction survey point. Subtracting observed scour gives geometric reserve but omits larger floods, long term incision and lateral thalweg migration. Greater embedment can also increase disturbance or obstruct groundwater exchange. Separate construction datum, natural bed elevation and expected change, then use repeated cross sections to track how the reserve is consumed over time. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toe embedment and erosion allowance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Toe embedment and erosion allowance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量
knowledge.text: 植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。扣除一次量測沖刷深度能得到幾何餘量，但尚未考慮洪水規模、長期下切與橫向深槽遷移。
knowledge.textEn: Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes. Embedment must therefore reference a changing bed rather than one construction survey point.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Toe embedment and erosion allowance" is correct?
options: 剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定
原始植株存活百分比就是護岸抗剪強度保留百分比
植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。
optionsEn: Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
The surviving percentage of original plants equals the retained percentage of bank shear strength
Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes.
quiz.explanation: 植生護岸常由岸趾流失開始失去支承，因此埋深應相對於可變河床而非單一施工測點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vegetated protection often loses support when its toe erodes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.titleEn: Toe embedment and erosion allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Toe embedment and erosion allowance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m。適用邊界：同一垂直基準的幾何差值，沒有將剩餘埋深換算成穩定安全係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Applicable boundary: A geometric difference on one vertical datum, without converting remaining embedment into a stability factor. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Establish fixed transects and preserve survey benchmarks.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Toe embedment and erosion allowance", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：e=1.2 m; ds=0.5 m; er=e-ds=0.7 m。
岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散

steps.titleEn: Toe embedment and erosion allowance: testing and verification

steps.title: 岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Toe embedment and erosion allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岸趾埋深與沖刷餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Toe embedment and erosion allowance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若深槽移到護岸外緣，先前測線可能漏掉局部淘空。表面仍貼合的護岸不代表底部有支承，需用水下測量確認邊界是否改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A migrating thalweg may create local undermining between previous transects. An apparently flush surface does not prove support underneath; underwater surveys must check whether the erosion boundary has shifted. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：合理比較需要把施工基準、自然河床高程與預期變化分開記錄，再以重複測線判斷餘量如何消耗。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate construction datum, natural bed elevation and expected change, then use repeated cross sections to track how the reserve is consumed over time.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 建立期植株存活率：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「建立期植株存活率」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Plant survival during establishment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 生態護岸的功能會隨植物建立而演變，栽植後存活率只是其中一個可重複觀察的指標。萌芽、根系延伸與土壤覆蓋不同步，存活的插穗也可能尚未穿過潛在沖蝕面。調查應追蹤固定植株群並記錄洪水、乾旱與補植，避免把後來新增的植株混入原始分母。比較坡位與物種可找出適生限制，但不能由存活百分比直接推算抗剪強度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「建立期植株存活率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bioengineered protection evolves as plants establish, and survival is one repeatable indicator among several. Budding, root extension and soil cover develop at different rates; a living cutting may not yet cross an erosion plane. Track a fixed cohort and record floods, drought and replacements so newly planted individuals do not contaminate the original denominator. Compare species and bank elevations to investigate suitability, without converting survival percentage directly into shear resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Plant survival during establishment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「原始植株存活百分比就是護岸抗剪強度保留百分比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The surviving percentage of original plants equals the retained percentage of bank shear strength" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「建立期植株存活率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Plant survival during establishment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 建立期植株存活率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Plant survival during establishment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「建立期植株存活率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Plant survival during establishment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless。適用邊界：固定原始植株群的觀察比例，不含補植且不是抗剪能力比例。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N0=240 plants; Ns=180 plants; ps=Ns/N0=0.75 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Observed proportion of the fixed original cohort, excluding replacements and not representing a shear strength ratio. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：為原始植株編號，在相同季節重訪並明確定義存活，例如有活體芽或組織。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.explanation: 為原始植株編號，在相同季節重訪並明確定義存活，例如有活體芽或組織。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tag the original cohort and revisit in the same season with an explicit definition of survival. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 建立期植株存活率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Plant survival during establishment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「建立期植株存活率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Plant survival during establishment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 補植後若把新株計入存活數而沿用原始分母，會高估建立成功。另一方面，短期綠葉也可能掩蓋根部腐爛，需結合根區與土壤觀察。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting replacement plants against the original denominator exaggerates establishment success. Short lived foliage can also conceal root decay, so survival counts need observations of root conditions and surrounding soil. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較坡位與物種可找出適生限制，但不能由存活百分比直接推算抗剪強度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare species and bank elevations to investigate suitability, without converting survival percentage directly into shear resistance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「原始植株存活百分比就是護岸抗剪強度保留百分比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The surviving percentage of original plants equals the retained percentage of bank shear strength" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 補植後若把新株計入存活數而沿用原始分母，會高估建立成功。另一方面，短期綠葉也可能掩蓋根部腐爛，需結合根區與土壤觀察。
knowledge.textEn: Counting replacement plants against the original denominator exaggerates establishment success. Short lived foliage can also conceal root decay, so survival counts need observations of root conditions and surrounding soil.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「建立期植株存活率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Plant survival during establishment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補植後若把新株計入存活數而沿用原始分母，會高估建立成功。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積
optionsEn: Counting replacement plants against the original denominator exaggerates establishment success.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
quiz.explanation: 補植後若把新株計入存活數而沿用原始分母，會高估建立成功。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting replacement plants against the original denominator exaggerates establishment success. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」與「退水期孔隙水壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mat overlap and effective coverage" and "Pore pressure during drawdown": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mat overlap and effective coverage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mat overlap and effective coverage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。搭接方向要配合水流，避免迎流邊緣掀起後使水在毯下集中。相鄰條帶需保持連續接觸土面，懸空會讓幼根難以穿入，也會形成沖蝕通道。數量估算可以先用平面幾何，但施工驗收還要檢查坡面展長、固定點與排水，不能用足量材料替代安裝品質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material. Orient overlaps with flow so exposed edges do not lift and channel water underneath. Adjacent strips need continuous soil contact; bridging can obstruct root establishment and create erosion pathways. Begin quantities with planar geometry, then inspect slope length, fixings and drainage. Delivering enough material does not demonstrate that the installation transfers loads or supports vegetation as intended. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mat overlap and effective coverage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mat overlap and effective coverage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。搭接方向要配合水流，避免迎流邊緣掀起後使水在毯下集中。
knowledge.textEn: Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material. Orient overlaps with flow so exposed edges do not lift and channel water underneath.

knowledge.text: 誤解：採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mat overlap and effective coverage" is correct?
options: 採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積
椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。
岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散
optionsEn: Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material.
A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated
quiz.explanation: 椰纖維毯的採購面積不等於實際覆蓋面積，搭接、端部固定與曲面貼合都會消耗材料。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Purchased coir mat area differs from effective cover because seams, end anchorage and surface conformity consume material. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mat overlap and effective coverage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mat overlap and effective coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。適用邊界：平面平行條帶僅計五道縱向搭接，未扣端部與曲面裁切。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2. Applicable boundary: Parallel planar strips with five longitudinal overlaps only; excludes end anchorage and curved trimming. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在展開圖上逐條標出淨寬與搭接，不把每條兩側都重複扣除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark net width and seams strip by strip without subtracting every edge twice.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。適用邊界：平面平行條帶僅計五道縱向搭接，未扣端部與曲面裁切。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2. Applicable boundary: Parallel planar strips with five longitudinal overlaps only; excludes end anchorage and curved trimming.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mat overlap and effective coverage", which statement holds?
options: 處理區植被增加的全部百分點都必然由護岸工程造成
種植面積可以直接代替所有莖葉的迎流投影面積
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。
optionsEn: Every percentage point of vegetation gain in the treated reach must be caused by the works
Planted ground area directly equals the frontal area of all stems
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: N=6 strips; w=2 m; o=0.2 m; L=20 m; Ac=(N*w-(N-1)*o)*L=220 m2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mat overlap and effective coverage: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mat overlap and effective coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在展開圖上逐條標出淨寬與搭接，不把每條兩側都重複扣除。現場用卷尺抽驗搭接和坡面貼合，灑少量清水觀察是否沿毯下集中，再另列端部埋設與修剪損耗。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark net width and seams strip by strip without subtracting every edge twice. Check overlap and soil contact in the field. A small controlled water application can reveal underflow; record end anchorage and trimming losses separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把搭接改為三十公分重新計算淨覆蓋，並畫出彎曲岸坡需要裁切的位置。將幾何損耗與安裝缺失分成兩項，提出各自的驗收證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase overlap to thirty centimetres and recalculate effective coverage. Draw where a curved bank requires trimming, distinguish geometric waste from installation defects, and specify separate acceptance evidence for those two issues.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：材料總面積足夠但接縫逆流或鬆弛時，水會掀毯並從下方沖走細土。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adequate total material can still fail when loose or upstream-facing seams lift. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 在「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mat overlap and effective coverage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
材料總面積足夠但接縫逆流或鬆弛時，水會掀毯並從下方沖走細土。
岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adequate total material can still fail when loose or upstream-facing seams lift.
A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated
quiz.explanation: 材料總面積足夠但接縫逆流或鬆弛時，水會掀毯並從下方沖走細土。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adequate total material can still fail when loose or upstream-facing seams lift. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 退水期孔隙水壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure during drawdown: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「退水期孔隙水壓」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pore pressure during drawdown” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。植物蒸散不能在短時間內保證消除這種壓差，根系補強也不取代排水條件分析。以水頭差估算孔壓只能描述指定位置與假定連通狀態，真實退水過程還受滲透係數、層理與儲水性控制。監測應把河水位與岸內孔壓時間序列同步對齊。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「退水期孔隙水壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress. Plant transpiration cannot guarantee rapid relief, and roots do not replace drainage analysis. A head difference estimates pressure at a specified point under assumed connectivity, while actual drawdown depends on permeability, layering and storage. Synchronize river stage and internal piezometer records to distinguish transient pressure lag from static groundwater conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pore pressure during drawdown” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「退水期孔隙水壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pore pressure during drawdown”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 退水期孔隙水壓
knowledge.text: 洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。植物蒸散不能在短時間內保證消除這種壓差，根系補強也不取代排水條件分析。
knowledge.textEn: After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress. Plant transpiration cannot guarantee rapid relief, and roots do not replace drainage analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「退水期孔隙水壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pore pressure during drawdown" is correct?
options: 岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散
下游濃度下降就足以證明護岸永久移除了同等比例泥砂
洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。
optionsEn: A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated
Lower downstream concentration alone proves permanent removal of the same sediment fraction
After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress.
quiz.explanation: 洪水退去後，河道側支承水壓可能先降低，而岸土內水位仍高，產生朝河道的滲流與較低有效應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: After a flood, river support pressure may fall before pore pressures inside the bank dissipate, promoting outward seepage and reducing effective stress. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 退水期孔隙水壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure during drawdown: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「退水期孔隙水壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pore pressure during drawdown” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。適用邊界：同一高程兩點之靜水壓差示例，不求解非定常滲流或整體穩定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa. Applicable boundary: Illustrates hydrostatic pressure difference at one elevation, without solving transient seepage or overall stability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。適用邊界：同一高程兩點之靜水壓差示例，不求解非定常滲流或整體穩定。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa. Applicable boundary: Illustrates hydrostatic pressure difference at one elevation, without solving transient seepage or overall stability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「退水期孔隙水壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pore pressure during drawdown", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。
河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力
表層根系密度可直接代表任何深度滑動面的補強能力
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa.
Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
Surface root density directly represents reinforcement on a failure plane at any depth
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: gammaw=9.81 kN/m3; dh=2 m; du=gammaw*dh=19.62 kPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 退水期孔隙水壓：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure during drawdown: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「退水期孔隙水壓」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pore pressure during drawdown” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。退水時比較峰值與延遲，並查看排水出口是否阻塞；若土層反應差異大，應分層建模而非平均所有孔壓。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage. Compare pressure peaks and delays during drawdown, inspect drainage outlets, and model distinct layers separately when their measured pressure responses differ substantially. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設河水再降五十公分而岸內水頭未變，重算壓差。畫出兩條可能的消散曲線，指出需要多長的觀測紀錄才能分辨快速與緩慢排水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Lower river stage another fifty centimetres while holding internal head fixed and recalculate the pressure difference. Sketch fast and slow dissipation curves and specify monitoring duration needed to distinguish the two responses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。退水時比較峰值與延遲，並查看排水出口是否阻塞；若土層反應差異大，應分層建模而非平均所有孔壓。
knowledge.textEn: Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage. Compare pressure peaks and delays during drawdown, inspect drainage outlets, and model distinct layers separately when their measured pressure responses differ substantially.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 假設河水再降五十公分而岸內水頭未變，重算壓差。畫出兩條可能的消散曲線，指出需要多長的觀測紀錄才能分辨快速與緩慢排水。
knowledge.textEn: Lower river stage another fifty centimetres while holding internal head fixed and recalculate the pressure difference. Sketch fast and slow dissipation curves and specify monitoring duration needed to distinguish the two responses.

quiz.question: 要驗證「退水期孔隙水壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pore pressure during drawdown"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。
剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage.
Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
quiz.explanation: 在岸內不同深度設孔壓量測點，與河水位使用同一高程及時鐘。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Place piezometers at different depths and use a common datum and clock with river stage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 退水期孔隙水壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pore pressure during drawdown: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「退水期孔隙水壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pore pressure during drawdown” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。若只量地表含水率，會誤判退水後已恢復承載能力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface. Surface moisture alone can therefore suggest recovered resistance while deeper parts of the bank remain vulnerable to sliding. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測應把河水位與岸內孔壓時間序列同步對齊。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Synchronize river stage and internal piezometer records to distinguish transient pressure lag from static groundwater conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岸面已經乾燥就代表深處孔隙水壓已完全消散」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dry bank surface proves that deeper pore water pressure has completely dissipated" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。若只量地表含水率，會誤判退水後已恢復承載能力。
knowledge.textEn: A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface. Surface moisture alone can therefore suggest recovered resistance while deeper parts of the bank remain vulnerable to sliding.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「退水期孔隙水壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pore pressure during drawdown" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
下游濃度下降就足以證明護岸永久移除了同等比例泥砂
不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Lower downstream concentration alone proves permanent removal of the same sediment fraction
A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface.
quiz.explanation: 不透水夾層可能保留高孔壓，岸面看似乾燥卻仍有深層滑動風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low permeability layer may retain pressure beneath a dry-looking surface. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泥砂通量的護岸檢核」與「對照監測的生態成效」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sediment flux around bank treatments" and "Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sediment flux around bank treatments: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泥砂通量的護岸檢核」如何影響河岸生態護岸的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sediment flux around bank treatments” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Bioengineered riverbank protection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 生態護岸可能攔截細砂，也可能在施工或洪水初期釋出土粒，因此應比較質量通量而非只比較濁度讀數。流量與濃度必須在相同控制體邊界及時段取得，清水側向流入會稀釋濃度卻不代表沉積。輸入減輸出得到的是控制體內暫存與未量側向交換的合計，需要另查床面變化才能歸因。濁度轉濃度關係還會隨粒徑與有機質改變，必須用水樣校準。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泥砂通量的護岸檢核」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A treatment may trap fines or release soil during construction and early floods. Compare mass flux rather than turbidity alone, matching discharge and concentration at the same boundaries and times. Clear lateral inflow can dilute concentration without depositing sediment. Inflow minus outflow represents storage plus unmeasured exchanges, requiring bed observations before attribution. The turbidity to concentration relation also changes with grain size and organic material, so physical samples are needed for calibration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sediment flux around bank treatments” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg.

steps.title: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sediment flux around bank treatments” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg。適用邊界：一小時定常且無側向泥砂通量，所得為控制體暫存，不能直接宣稱永久去除。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qin=0.08 m3/s; Cin=0.12 kg/m3; Qout=0.075 m3/s; Cout=0.07 kg/m3; dt=3600 s; dM=(Qin*Cin-Qout*Cout)*dt=15.66 kg. Applicable boundary: Steady one-hour interval without lateral sediment flux; result is control-volume storage, not demonstrated permanent removal. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步採集上下游流量與水樣，以實驗室懸浮固體建立濁度校正，再確認是否有排水溝或岸崩加入泥砂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Collect synchronized upstream and downstream discharge and samples, calibrate turbidity against suspended solids, and identify drains or bank failures adding sediment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 泥砂通量的護岸檢核：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sediment flux around bank treatments: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥砂通量的護岸檢核」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sediment flux around bank treatments” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步採集上下游流量與水樣，以實驗室懸浮固體建立濁度校正，再確認是否有排水溝或岸崩加入泥砂。用床面標記或沉積盤驗證暫存方向，並在下一次洪水後查是否重新被帶走。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Collect synchronized upstream and downstream discharge and samples, calibrate turbidity against suspended solids, and identify drains or bank failures adding sediment. Check storage direction with bed markers or traps, then inspect whether the next monitored flood event remobilizes that stored material. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：新增一股已知流量與濃度的側向排水後重寫質量平衡，列出新增量測。比較暫存與永久去除需要的追蹤時間，說明下一場洪水可能如何改變結論。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add a lateral drain with specified flow and concentration, rewrite the mass balance and list new measurements. Compare the monitoring needed for temporary storage and permanent removal, including how another flood could reverse the interpretation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若下游被清水稀釋，濃度下降可能被誤報成攔砂成功。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dilution can make lower concentration appear to prove trapping. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 若下游被清水稀釋，濃度下降可能被誤報成攔砂成功。漏算側向流量或採樣時間錯開，也會製造假質量差，應先閉合水量帳。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.instruction: 工程後植被增加可能來自較濕的年份、放牧減少或上游治理，而不完全由護岸措施造成。前後加對照的設計，用未處理區的同期間變化扣除共同背景，能提供比單純前後比較更清楚的證據。對照區仍須有相近坡位、土壤與管理，並避免受工程水流改變影響。覆蓋率是面積比例，差中之差應以百分點表示；它不能單獨代表物種多樣性、棲地品質或結構安全。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對照監測的生態成效」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

The comparison reach still needs similar soils, elevation and management, without receiving the treatment's hydraulic effects. Cover is an area proportion, so the difference in differences uses percentage points and does not independently measure biodiversity, habitat quality or structural safety. Vegetation can increase because a year is wetter, grazing declines or upstream management changes.
Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
quiz.explanation: 工程後植被增加可能來自較濕的年份、放牧減少或上游治理，而不完全由護岸措施造成。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Vegetation can increase because a year is wetter, grazing declines or upstream management changes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 對照監測的生態成效：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對照監測的生態成效」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points。適用邊界：示範差中之差，因果解釋仍需平行趨勢與不受干擾的對照。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points. Applicable boundary: Illustrates difference in differences; causal interpretation still requires parallel trends and an unaffected comparison. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points。適用邊界：示範差中之差，因果解釋仍需平行趨勢與不受干擾的對照。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points. Applicable boundary: Illustrates difference in differences; causal interpretation still requires parallel trends and an unaffected comparison.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「對照監測的生態成效」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring", which statement holds?
options: 表層根系密度可直接代表任何深度滑動面的補強能力
剩餘埋深為正就代表護岸在所有洪水下都穩定
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points。
optionsEn: Surface root density directly represents reinforcement on a failure plane at any depth
Any positive remaining embedment proves stability under every flood
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: T0=35 percent.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: T0=35 percent; T1=70 percent; C0=40 percent; C1=55 percent; effect=(T1-T0)-(C1-C0)=20 percentage-points. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 對照監測的生態成效：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對照監測的生態成效」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。另記洪水、放牧與補植，若對照區也受到改流影響，應重新界定對照或限制因果結論。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules. Record floods, grazing and replanting. If altered flow affects the comparison reach, redefine it or limit the causal claim. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將對照區的後期覆蓋率改成百分之六十五，重算效果並解釋差異。設計一項獨立棲地指標，使覆蓋率改善不會被誤用為所有生態功能均改善的結論。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change later comparison cover to sixty five percent, recompute the effect and explain the difference. Add an independent habitat indicator so increased cover cannot be mistaken for improvement in every ecological function.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。另記洪水、放牧與補植，若對照區也受到改流影響，應重新界定對照或限制因果結論。
knowledge.textEn: Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules. Record floods, grazing and replanting. If altered flow affects the comparison reach, redefine it or limit the causal claim.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將對照區的後期覆蓋率改成百分之六十五，重算效果並解釋差異。設計一項獨立棲地指標，使覆蓋率改善不會被誤用為所有生態功能均改善的結論。
knowledge.textEn: Change later comparison cover to sixty five percent, recompute the effect and explain the difference. Add an independent habitat indicator so increased cover cannot be mistaken for improvement in every ecological function.

quiz.question: 要驗證「對照監測的生態成效」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring"?
options: 在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
採購總面積等於完工後不重疊的有效覆蓋面積
optionsEn: Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Purchased material area equals the effective nonoverlapping area after installation
quiz.explanation: 在工程前至少重複調查不同季節，確認兩區變化方向是否相近，之後用相同樣方與判讀規則追蹤。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Repeat surveys across seasons before treatment to compare trajectories, then retain the same quadrats and interpretation rules. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 對照監測的生態成效：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對照監測的生態成效」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。若只選長得好的護岸段，平均覆蓋也會偏高，需事先固定抽樣設計。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects. Selecting only thriving sections further inflates average cover; fix the sampling design before observing which areas appear successful in the field. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：覆蓋率是面積比例，差中之差應以百分點表示；它不能單獨代表物種多樣性、棲地品質或結構安全。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Cover is an area proportion, so the difference in differences uses percentage points and does not independently measure biodiversity, habitat quality or structural safety.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「處理區植被增加的全部百分點都必然由護岸工程造成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every percentage point of vegetation gain in the treated reach must be caused by the works" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。若只選長得好的護岸段，平均覆蓋也會偏高，需事先固定抽樣設計。
knowledge.textEn: Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects. Selecting only thriving sections further inflates average cover; fix the sampling design before observing which areas appear successful in the field.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「對照監測的生態成效」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ecological outcomes with comparison monitoring" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。
河段平均剪力就是每一處岸坡承受的最大剪力
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects.
Reach average shear is the maximum stress at every bank location
quiz.explanation: 不同年份用不同樣方位置會把空間差異當成工程效果。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving quadrats between years confuses spatial differences with treatment effects. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 河床固床工設計
courses.summary: 固床工會改變水面、河床及泥砂通量，並非把河床固定後便完成任務。十個單元連結落差配置、臨界水深、水躍、揚壓、顆粒起動、濾層與上下游地形反應，讓學員分辨幾何可行、結構穩定與河道長期平衡三種不同檢核。
courses.summaryEn: Grade control changes water levels, bed elevations and sediment fluxes. Ten units connect drop spacing, critical depth, hydraulic jumps, uplift, grain motion, filters and channel response. Learners distinguish geometric feasibility, structural resistance and long term channel adjustment, and examine how protecting one location may transfer erosion or sedimentation to another reach.
courses.focus: 由河床縱坡、能量耗散與泥砂連續性設計固床工
courses.focusEn: Designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 輸配水、河川與都市防洪
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Water conveyance, rivers and urban flood protection

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課先用「落差配置與縱坡」建立原創假想基準，再以「斷面比能的兩種流態」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m；第二組為 y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定兩個無因次坡度 S0=0.012 與 Se=0.004，將單一落差 dz 從 0.6 m 增至 0.66 m，L=82.5 m，相較 75 m 增加一成。此為幾何敏感度，沒有驗證較大落差的消能、通行或結構需求。
workedExample.textEn: Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Drop spacing and longitudinal slope and examine another controlling mechanism through Specific energy and alternate depths. The first inputs and result are dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m; the second are y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Hold dimensionless slopes S0=0.012 and Se=0.004 fixed and raise drop dz from 0.6 m to 0.66 m. Spacing becomes 82.5 m, ten percent above 75 m. This is geometric sensitivity and does not validate energy dissipation, passage or structural requirements at the larger drop.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「落差配置與縱坡」與「斷面比能的兩種流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Drop spacing and longitudinal slope" and "Specific energy and alternate depths": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「落差配置與縱坡」如何影響河床固床工設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riverbed grade-control structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固床工把河段總落差分配到構造物與其間河床，先用幾何關係可以檢查配置是否自洽。原坡與目標坡的差值乘以間距，才是單一落差需要承擔的高程差，並非河段全部天然落差。目標坡還受輸砂、河寬與下游控制影響，不能僅為縮短施工量而任意選定。配置圖須同時標出支流匯入、橋梁與魚類通行位置，因為相同總落差的不同分配會產生不同局部影響。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「落差配置與縱坡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Grade control distributes total reach fall between structures and intervening bed. A geometric balance checks consistency: the difference between existing and target slope, multiplied by spacing, gives the drop assigned to one structure. Target slope also depends on sediment supply, width and downstream control, so it cannot be chosen solely to reduce construction. Map tributaries, bridges and passage routes because different distributions of identical total fall create different local consequences. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「落差配置與縱坡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m。適用邊界：均一坡度的幾何初估，不是最適間距或平衡坡保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=0.6 m; S0=0.012 dimensionless; Se=0.004 dimensionless; L=dz/(S0-Se)=75 m. Applicable boundary: Geometric screening with uniform slopes, not an optimal spacing or guarantee of equilibrium. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「落差配置與縱坡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。將支流出口與洪水水面另畫，若存在回水控制，應進行水面與泥砂分析後再修正幾何配置。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey the bed profile on one datum, distinguishing bar crests from the thalweg, and check total fall between structures. Plot tributary outlets and flood levels separately; backwater control requires hydraulic and sediment analysis before adopting geometric spacing. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將目標坡改成千分之六重算間距，說明為何落差較少分配給河床時構造密度會改變。畫出末端下切時的可能傳遞路徑，列出必要調查點。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Set target slope to six per thousand and recompute spacing. Explain the changed distribution of fall, then sketch how terminal incision could propagate and identify the survey points needed to test that sequence.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。將支流出口與洪水水面另畫，若存在回水控制，應進行水面與泥砂分析後再修正幾何配置。

options: 以同一高程基準重測河床縱斷面，分辨局部沙洲頂與深槽底，核對相鄰構造物之間的總落差。

steps.title: 落差配置與縱坡：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Drop spacing and longitudinal slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「落差配置與縱坡」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 間距雖符合幾何式，若下游河床持續下降，末端構造仍可能被淘空並引發逐級失效。診斷應從下游控制與供砂變化回查，而非只補高上游堰頂。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Geometrically consistent spacing can still fail when downstream incision undermines the terminal structure and progresses upstream. Investigate downstream control and sediment supply before simply raising upstream crests to restore the profile. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：配置圖須同時標出支流匯入、橋梁與魚類通行位置，因為相同總落差的不同分配會產生不同局部影響。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specific energy and alternate depths” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riverbed grade-control structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 比能以局部河床為基準，把水深與速度水頭合在一起，適合辨認落差上游是否接近控制斷面。矩形河道的單寬流量固定時，同一比能可能對應深慢與淺快兩種水深解；臨界點則是比能最低位置。這裡所稱兩種解不是可任意互換的現場狀態，還要符合上下游邊界和能量損失。河床高程若改變，總水頭必須另加高程，不能直接比較不同斷面的比能數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷面比能的兩種流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Specific energy combines depth and velocity head relative to the local bed. At fixed unit discharge in a rectangular channel, one energy level can correspond to a deep slow or shallow fast depth, while the minimum defines critical flow. These alternate depths are not freely interchangeable field states; boundary conditions and losses select the actual solution. When bed elevation changes, include elevation in total head rather than comparing specific energy values from different sections directly. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specific energy and alternate depths” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: y=0.8 m; q=2.4 m2/s; g=9.81 m/s2; E=y+q^2/(2*g*y^2)=1.258716 m.
