knowledge.title: 塊石浸水重量
knowledge.text: 塊石抗移動的一部分來自浸水重量，水下浮力會減少可提供的法向力，但拖曳、升力與支點位置才共同決定滑動或翻滾。球形假設便於建立體積尺度，真實塊石的角狀、扁平與互鎖不能由同一粒徑完全描述。
knowledge.textEn: Submerged weight contributes to rock resistance, but drag, lift and pivot geometry jointly govern sliding or rolling. A sphere provides a transparent volume scale; angularity, flatness and interlocking of real stones are not captured by one diameter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要乾燥重量相同不同形狀石塊就具有相同抗移動能力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Stones with equal dry weight have identical movement resistance regardless of shape Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

只要乾燥重量相同不同形狀石塊就具有相同抗移動能力
兩次測量算出的平均速率就是未來每日固定的陡坎速度

Stones with equal dry weight have identical movement resistance regardless of shape

steps.title: 塊石浸水重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight of loose rock: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「塊石浸水重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Submerged weight of loose rock” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.6 m; Ws=(rhos-rhow)*g*pi*d^3/6=1830.650022 N。適用邊界：完全浸沒理想球體的重量尺度，未計升力、拖曳或互鎖。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rhos=2650 kg/m3; rhow=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; d=0.6 m; Ws=(rhos-rhow)*g*pi*d^3/6=1830.650022 N. Applicable boundary: Submerged ideal-sphere weight scale, excluding lift, drag and interlocking. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量實際石塊三軸尺寸、乾重與排水體積，檢查等效球假設的偏差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure three axes, dry weight and displaced volume to evaluate the equivalent-sphere approximation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 塊石浸水重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight of loose rock: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「塊石浸水重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged weight of loose rock” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量實際石塊三軸尺寸、乾重與排水體積，檢查等效球假設的偏差。於代表鋪排方式下觀察最先移動的石塊與支點，並記錄它是滑動或翻滾，避免只以平均重量判定整層材料表現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure three axes, dry weight and displaced volume to evaluate the equivalent-sphere approximation. Test representative arrangements and identify the first moving stone and pivot. Record sliding versus rolling rather than judging the entire layer from average weight alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將等效直徑增加百分之十，計算浸水重量增加比例，再比較迎流面積的增加比例。畫出一塊石的可能支點，指出仍缺哪些荷載才能判斷翻滾。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase equivalent diameter by ten percent and compare the weight increase with frontal-area growth. Draw a possible pivot for one stone and identify the additional loads required before assessing rolling resistance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：扁平石片迎流後可能受升力而翻起，與同重緻密石塊的行為不同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A flat stone may lift and overturn differently from a compact stone of equal mass. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「塊石浸水重量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submerged weight of loose rock"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

One critical Shields value applies to every grain mixture and cohesive riverbed
Measure three axes, dry weight and displaced volume to evaluate the equivalent-sphere approximation.

quiz.explanationEn: Measure three axes, dry weight and displaced volume to evaluate the equivalent-sphere approximation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 塊石浸水重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submerged weight of loose rock: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「塊石浸水重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submerged weight of loose rock” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 扁平石片迎流後可能受升力而翻起，與同重緻密石塊的行為不同。若局部石塊先失去互鎖，後續移動會增加，應檢查鋪排而不只換更重材料。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A flat stone may lift and overturn differently from a compact stone of equal mass. Local loss of interlock can trigger further movement, calling for arrangement checks before simply specifying heavier material. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析應先畫自由體圖，再決定需要摩擦、力矩或群體排列試驗，而不是只比較乾重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Draw the free-body diagram before selecting friction, moment or arrangement tests, and distinguish a weight calculation from a complete stability assessment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要乾燥重量相同不同形狀石塊就具有相同抗移動能力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Stones with equal dry weight have identical movement resistance regardless of shape" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「塊石浸水重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tracking migrating bed steps” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riverbed grade-control structures”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河床陡坎可能沿河道向上游遷移，把下游擾動傳到支流或基礎附近。重複測量其位置可求期間平均移動速率，但侵蝕通常集中在少數洪水，不能把多年平均當成每日固定速度。里程方向必須先定義，否則正負號容易被解讀相反。調查也需區分同一陡坎移動與新陡坎形成，並配合床質、落差和事件流量辨認過程，避免只把兩個影像點連線外推。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「遷移陡坎的追蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tracking migrating bed steps” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「遷移陡坎的追蹤」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tracking migrating bed steps” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream。適用邊界：相同陡坎之期間平均向上游速率，不是未來事件預測。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream. Applicable boundary: Interval-average upstream rate for the same bed step, not a forecast of future events. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream。適用邊界：相同陡坎之期間平均向上游速率，不是未來事件預測。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream. Applicable boundary: Interval-average upstream rate for the same bed step, not a forecast of future events.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「遷移陡坎的追蹤」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Tracking migrating bed steps", which statement holds?
options: 臨界水深只由單寬流量決定所以尾水永遠不影響構造出流
護坦下方有排水孔就可以在所有工況忽略揚壓
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream。
optionsEn: Because critical depth depends on unit discharge, tailwater never affects structure discharge
Drain holes beneath an apron allow uplift to be ignored in every condition
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: x0=350 m downstream-chainage.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: x0=350 m downstream-chainage; x1=295 m downstream-chainage; dt=5 year; vu=(x0-x1)/dt=11 m/year upstream. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 遷移陡坎的追蹤：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Tracking migrating bed steps: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「遷移陡坎的追蹤」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tracking migrating bed steps” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。將每次洪水後的位置加到時間軸，保留位置誤差；如果只有兩期資料，應明確報告平均值而不畫成已知連續速度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature. Add post-flood positions to a timeline with uncertainty. With only two surveys, report an interval mean rather than a known continuous velocity. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：若兩次位置各有兩公尺可能誤差，估算速率的最保守範圍。提出洪水後加測的時間安排，說明新增資料如何區分事件跳躍與穩定緩慢遷移。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Allow two metres of possible error at each position and estimate conservative rate bounds. Plan post-flood surveys and explain how additional observations would distinguish event-driven jumps from steady slow migration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。將每次洪水後的位置加到時間軸，保留位置誤差；如果只有兩期資料，應明確報告平均值而不畫成已知連續速度。
knowledge.textEn: Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature. Add post-flood positions to a timeline with uncertainty. With only two surveys, report an interval mean rather than a known continuous velocity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 若兩次位置各有兩公尺可能誤差，估算速率的最保守範圍。提出洪水後加測的時間安排，說明新增資料如何區分事件跳躍與穩定緩慢遷移。
knowledge.textEn: Allow two metres of possible error at each position and estimate conservative rate bounds. Plan post-flood surveys and explain how additional observations would distinguish event-driven jumps from steady slow migration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「遷移陡坎的追蹤」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tracking migrating bed steps"?
options: 以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
任一濾料與基土的粒徑比等於四就保證濾層安全
optionsEn: Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Any filter to base-soil grading ratio of four guarantees filter safety
quiz.explanation: 以固定基準重測陡坎頂與底，並用照片及床料辨認是否為同一特徵。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Resurvey crest and toe from fixed benchmarks and use photographs and bed material to identify the same feature. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 遷移陡坎的追蹤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tracking migrating bed steps: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「遷移陡坎的追蹤」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tracking migrating bed steps” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。先核對特徵身分與基準，再討論是否需要額外防護，避免依假速率加碼工程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement. Verify feature identity and survey datum before using the apparent rate to justify additional protective works upstream. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：調查也需區分同一陡坎移動與新陡坎形成，並配合床質、落差和事件流量辨認過程，避免只把兩個影像點連線外推。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish movement of the same step from creation of a new one, and combine positions with bed material, drop height and event flows instead of extrapolating a line between two images.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩次測量算出的平均速率就是未來每日固定的陡坎速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The average from two surveys is the fixed daily speed of future step migration" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。先核對特徵身分與基準，再討論是否需要額外防護，避免依假速率加碼工程。
knowledge.textEn: Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement. Verify feature identity and survey datum before using the apparent rate to justify additional protective works upstream.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「遷移陡坎的追蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tracking migrating bed steps" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。
由坡差算出的間距就是所有流量下的最適構造物間距
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement.
Spacing derived from slope difference is optimal at every discharge
quiz.explanation: 不同陡坎被誤配會造成虛假的快速遷移，定位誤差也可能大於真實移動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Matching different steps creates false rapid migration, while positional error can exceed actual movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 魚道水理設計
courses.summary: 從水池落差、孔口流量與能量密度開始，接續游泳能力、入口誘導、休息區與篩網比較。課程不提供通用魚類流速標準，而要求把魚種、體長、季節和水溫寫入設計條件，並透過偵測率及多段通過率分析，區分水理可行性與真正的遷移成果。
courses.summaryEn: Start with pool drops, opening discharge and energy density, then examine swimming ability, attraction, resting areas and screening. No universal fish velocity limit is supplied. Species, body size, season and temperature belong in the design conditions. Detection efficiency and passage through multiple reaches distinguish a hydraulically plausible facility from demonstrated migration outcomes.
courses.focus: 依魚種生命期解析通道水理、入口誘導與通過證據
courses.focusEn: Relating passage hydraulics and attraction to species, life stage and passage evidence
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課先用「池間落差與射流」建立原創假想基準，再以「開口流量與係數」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s；第二組為 Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定 g=9.81 m/s2 與理想無損失假設，將 dh 從 0.15 m 增至 0.18 m，速度由 1.715517 m/s 增至 1.879255 m/s，約增加百分之九點五四。落差增加兩成而速度非增加兩成，且仍未判定魚種可通過性。
workedExample.textEn: Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Pool drops and jet velocity and examine another controlling mechanism through Opening discharge and coefficient. The first inputs and result are g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s; the second are Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep g=9.81 m/s2 and the ideal loss-free assumption fixed while increasing dh from 0.15 m to 0.18 m. Velocity rises from 1.715517 m/s to 1.879255 m/s, approximately 9.54 percent. A twenty percent drop increase does not produce a twenty percent speed increase and still does not determine species passage suitability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「池間落差與射流」與「開口流量與係數」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pool drops and jet velocity" and "Opening discharge and coefficient": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「池間落差與射流」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pool drops and jet velocity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。理想能量式只提供速度尺度，真實射流會收縮、耗散並與池內回流互動，不能用它代替魚所選路徑的速度。魚種、體長、水溫與游泳時間共同決定能力，短時爆發速度也不同於可持續速度。設計應先描述目標族群與季節，再把局部水理和可供停留的空間連成一條可走通的路徑。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「池間落差與射流」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. An ideal energy equation gives a velocity scale, while real jets contract, dissipate and interact with recirculation. It does not describe every route selected by a fish. Species, length, temperature and duration affect swimming ability, and burst speed differs from sustained speed. Define the target population and season before linking hydraulic conditions with connected resting opportunities. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pool drops and jet velocity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「池間落差與射流」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pool drops and jet velocity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 池間落差與射流
knowledge.text: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。理想能量式只提供速度尺度，真實射流會收縮、耗散並與池內回流互動，不能用它代替魚所選路徑的速度。
knowledge.textEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. An ideal energy equation gives a velocity scale, while real jets contract, dissipate and interact with recirculation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「池間落差與射流」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pool drops and jet velocity" is correct?
options: 池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
optionsEn: Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage.
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
quiz.explanation: 魚道各池之間的水頭差會轉成局部射流動能，分散總落差可以改變每一段的通行負擔。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Head difference between pools creates local jet energy, so dividing total fall changes the challenge at each passage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「池間落差與射流」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pool drops and jet velocity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。適用邊界：忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Applicable boundary: Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。適用邊界：忽略損失的局部速度尺度，不是魚種可通過限值或池內平均流速。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Applicable boundary: Local ideal velocity scale without losses, not a species passage limit or pool average.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「池間落差與射流」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pool drops and jet velocity", which statement holds?
options: 魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度
名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。
optionsEn: A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank
Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; v=sqrt(2*g*dh)=1.715517 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「池間落差與射流」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pool drops and jet velocity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。將瞬時峰值與時間平均分列，並記錄目標魚體長與水溫，避免把一支流速計的平均值當成完整通行環境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Separate instantaneous peaks from time averages, recording fish length and water temperature so one meter average is not mistaken for the whole passage environment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將落差增加一倍重算理想速度，與速度也加倍的假設比較。畫出一條包含休息區的通行路徑，標示仍需取得的魚種能力及局部流速資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double the drop and compare ideal velocity with a doubled-speed assumption. Draw a connected route including refuges and identify the species-performance and local velocity observations still needed to assess passage.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。將瞬時峰值與時間平均分列，並記錄目標魚體長與水溫，避免把一支流速計的平均值當成完整通行環境。
knowledge.textEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Separate instantaneous peaks from time averages, recording fish length and water temperature so one meter average is not mistaken for the whole passage environment.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將落差增加一倍重算理想速度，與速度也加倍的假設比較。畫出一條包含休息區的通行路徑，標示仍需取得的魚種能力及局部流速資料。
knowledge.textEn: Double the drop and compare ideal velocity with a doubled-speed assumption. Draw a connected route including refuges and identify the species-performance and local velocity observations still needed to assess passage.

quiz.question: 要驗證「池間落差與射流」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pool drops and jet velocity"?
options: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
optionsEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
quiz.explanation: 同步量相鄰池水位，沿開口與魚可能游經區量測速度分布及水深。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure adjoining levels simultaneously and map velocity and depth across the opening and potential routes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 池間落差與射流：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pool drops and jet velocity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「池間落差與射流」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pool drops and jet velocity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。即使每池落差相同，也需檢查射流方向及避流區是否彼此連通。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Equal pool drops therefore still require checking jet orientation and connectivity between lower-velocity refuge areas. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計應先描述目標族群與季節，再把局部水理和可供停留的空間連成一條可走通的路徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Define the target population and season before linking hydraulic conditions with connected resting opportunities.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。即使每池落差相同，也需檢查射流方向及避流區是否彼此連通。
knowledge.textEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Equal pool drops therefore still require checking jet orientation and connectivity between lower-velocity refuge areas.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「池間落差與射流」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pool drops and jet velocity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest.
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
quiz.explanation: 射流正面衝向下一開口可能形成連續高速走廊，讓魚無法休息。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A jet aimed directly at the next opening can create a continuous fast corridor without rest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「開口流量與係數」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Opening discharge and coefficient” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。用水深乘寬度建立面積之前，要確認開口是否完全被水淹沒，否則出流型態可能不同。相同流量可以經不同面積形成不同速度與剪切分布，因此滿足供水量並不等於滿足通行條件。控制計算應與入口誘導、下游尾水及池內水位一起閉合。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「開口流量與係數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses but changes with geometry, edges and submergence. Before using width times height, verify that the opening is fully wetted; otherwise a different flow relation may apply. The same discharge through different areas produces different velocities and shear distributions, so supplying enough water does not establish passage suitability. Close the calculation with attraction flow, tailwater and pool levels instead of treating one opening independently. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Opening discharge and coefficient” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「開口流量與係數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Opening discharge and coefficient”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 開口流量與係數
knowledge.text: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。用水深乘寬度建立面積之前，要確認開口是否完全被水淹沒，否則出流型態可能不同。
knowledge.textEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. Its coefficient represents contraction and losses but changes with geometry, edges and submergence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「開口流量與係數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Opening discharge and coefficient" is correct?
options: 流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。
optionsEn: A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
An opening converts level difference into discharge.
quiz.explanation: 魚道開口把水位差轉為流量，流量係數濃縮了收縮與損失，但它會隨開口形狀、邊緣與淹沒狀態改變。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An opening converts level difference into discharge. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「開口流量與係數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Opening discharge and coefficient” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。適用邊界：完全淹沒開口與給定有效係數，未把係數當通用常數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

Applicable boundary: Fully submerged opening with an assumed effective coefficient, not a universal coefficient.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「開口流量與係數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Opening discharge and coefficient", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。
誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Cd=0.7 dimensionless.
Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Cd=0.7 dimensionless; b=0.2 m; h=0.8 m; g=9.81 m/s2; dh=0.15 m; Q=Cd*b*h*sqrt(2*g*dh)=0.192138 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「開口流量與係數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Opening discharge and coefficient” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。量開口實際尺寸及邊緣損傷，將堵塞與未堵塞資料分開；若係數不穩定，應辨認流態轉換而非只取全部平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Survey actual dimensions and edge damage. Separate blocked and clear conditions; unstable coefficients call for identifying regime changes rather than averaging every observation together. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：使有效開口寬度縮小四分之一重算流量，再討論水位差可能隨之改變的情況。列出應同步觀測的池水位，說明為何單一開口不能獨立調整。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce effective width by one quarter and recalculate discharge, then discuss possible changes in head difference. Identify pool levels that require simultaneous observation and explain why one opening cannot always be adjusted independently.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Survey actual dimensions and edge damage. Separate blocked and clear conditions; unstable coefficients call for identifying regime changes rather than averaging every observation together.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 使有效開口寬度縮小四分之一重算流量，再討論水位差可能隨之改變的情況。列出應同步觀測的池水位，說明為何單一開口不能獨立調整。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce effective width by one quarter and recalculate discharge, then discuss possible changes in head difference. Identify pool levels that require simultaneous observation and explain why one opening cannot always be adjusted independently.

quiz.question: 要驗證「開口流量與係數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Opening discharge and coefficient"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。
上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence.
Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
quiz.explanation: 在多組水位差下量測流量，反算有效係數並檢查是否隨尾水改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure discharge over several head differences and infer the effective coefficient, checking tailwater dependence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 開口流量與係數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Opening discharge and coefficient: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「開口流量與係數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Opening discharge and coefficient” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。只按閘門開度推流量會漏掉堵塞造成的網路連鎖反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Inferring discharge solely from gate position misses these blockage effects and their propagation through the connected passage system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：控制計算應與入口誘導、下游尾水及池內水位一起閉合。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Close the calculation with attraction flow, tailwater and pool levels instead of treating one opening independently.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。只按閘門開度推流量會漏掉堵塞造成的網路連鎖反應。
knowledge.textEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Inferring discharge solely from gate position misses these blockage effects and their propagation through the connected passage system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「開口流量與係數」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Opening discharge and coefficient" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools.
quiz.explanation: 枝葉堵住部分開口會改變流量與局部高速區，可能使其他池水位也偏離預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Debris can reduce opening area while changing local jets and levels in adjoining pools. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「池體積與平均能量密度」與「游泳速度與地面進度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pool volume and mean energy density" and "Swimming speed and ground progress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 池體積與平均能量密度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pool volume and mean energy density: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「池體積與平均能量密度」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pool volume and mean energy density” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流量跨越水頭差釋出的功率除以池體積，可形成平均體積能量耗散尺度，方便比較不同配置。這個平均數不表示能量在空間均勻分布，入口射流、渦流中心與底部角落可能差異很大。有效參與混合的水體也可能小於幾何池容，死水區增加體積卻未改善通行。魚類反應還受紊流尺度與方向影響，因此平均功率密度須搭配流場和行為觀察，不應單獨作成效判決。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「池體積與平均能量密度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Discharge falling through a head difference releases power; dividing by pool volume gives a mean volumetric dissipation scale for comparing layouts. Dissipation is not spatially uniform: jets, vortex cores and corners differ. The actively mixed volume may be smaller than geometric volume, so dead zones can enlarge a pool without improving passage. Fish also respond to turbulence scale and direction. Pair the average power density with flow mapping and behaviour instead of making it the sole performance criterion. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pool volume and mean energy density” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; dh=0.15 m; V=3.5 m3; Pv=rho*g*Q*dh/V=105.107143 W/m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: rho=1000 kg/m3; g=9.81 m/s2; Q=0.25 m3/s; dh=0.15 m; V=3.5 m3; Pv=rho*g*Q*dh/V=105.107143 W/m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「池體積與平均能量密度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pool volume and mean energy density”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.titleEn: Pool volume and mean energy density

knowledge.text: 誤解：平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 池體積與平均能量密度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pool volume and mean energy density: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「池體積與平均能量密度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pool volume and mean energy density” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量實際池容並排除淤積占據空間，將水位及流量同步記錄。以流場測量辨認射流核心與死水區，再觀察魚是否使用預期休息區；平均值降低但局部仍猛烈時，需改配置而非只加池深。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure usable volume after sediment accumulation and synchronize levels with discharge. Map jet cores and dead zones, then observe refuge use. If average power decreases while local turbulence remains intense, revise layout rather than simply deepening the pool. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設淤積占去半立方公尺重算功率密度，另畫一個總體積更大但死水區更多的池。提出能區分兩種改善是否有效的流場與魚行為量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Remove half a cubic metre of usable volume and recalculate power density. Sketch a larger pool with more inactive space and propose hydraulic and behavioural measurements that distinguish genuine improvement from a misleading volume increase.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：池底淤積會減少有效體積，使原計算低估平均耗散；另一方面，大死水區也會掩蓋集中紊流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sediment reduces usable volume and can invalidate the original average dissipation estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Measure usable volume after sediment accumulation and synchronize levels with discharge. Map jet cores and dead zones, then observe refuge use. If average power decreases while local turbulence remains intense, revise layout rather than simply deepening the pool.

knowledge.textEn: Remove half a cubic metre of usable volume and recalculate power density. Sketch a larger pool with more inactive space and propose hydraulic and behavioural measurements that distinguish genuine improvement from a misleading volume increase.

quiz.question: 要驗證「池體積與平均能量密度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

quiz.explanationEn: Measure usable volume after sediment accumulation and synchronize levels with discharge. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 池體積與平均能量密度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pool volume and mean energy density: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「池體積與平均能量密度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pool volume and mean energy density” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 池底淤積會減少有效體積，使原計算低估平均耗散；另一方面，大死水區也會掩蓋集中紊流。檢查時需同時看淤積地形與主流混合範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Sediment reduces usable volume and can invalidate the original average dissipation estimate. Large inactive zones can also conceal concentrated turbulence, requiring inspection of both deposited material and the region actively mixed by the jet. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：魚類反應還受紊流尺度與方向影響，因此平均功率密度須搭配流場和行為觀察，不應單獨作成效判決。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pair the average power density with flow mapping and behaviour instead of making it the sole performance criterion.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「池體積與平均能量密度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度
optionsEn: Sediment reduces usable volume and can invalidate the original average dissipation estimate.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank

steps.title: 游泳速度與地面進度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Swimming speed and ground progress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「游泳速度與地面進度」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Swimming speed and ground progress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚相對水的游泳速度與水流相對地面的速度是不同參考系，逆流時兩者相減才是向上游的地面進度。若水流接近可維持游速，通過時間會急遽增加；水流更快時，簡化模型便無正向進度。魚可能利用邊界層或間歇爆發，真實軌跡不能由單一平均速度完整描述。計算應把可維持時間與距離一起列出，並明示水溫及體長條件，避免以最高速度替代耐力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「游泳速度與地面進度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Swimming speed relative to water differs from progress relative to the bank. Against a uniform current, subtract flow speed to obtain upstream ground speed. As current approaches sustainable swimming speed, travel time rises sharply; a faster current gives no positive progress in this simplified model. Fish may use boundary layers or bursts, so an average cannot represent every trajectory. State duration, distance, temperature and body size rather than substituting maximum speed for endurance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Swimming speed and ground progress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Us=1.2 m/s upstream-relative-water; U=0.8 m/s downstream; L=6 m; t=L/(Us-U)=15 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Us=1.2 m/s upstream-relative-water; U=0.8 m/s downstream; L=6 m; t=L/(Us-U)=15 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「游泳速度與地面進度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

quiz.question: 關於「游泳速度與地面進度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance

steps.titleEn: Swimming speed and ground progress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「游泳速度與地面進度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Swimming speed and ground progress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先確認游泳能力資料的魚種、體長、水溫及試驗持續時間，再於候選路徑量流速。以追蹤影像取得地面位移與停留時間，若魚利用邊界低速帶，應沿實際路徑比較而非套斷面平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check species, size, temperature and test duration behind the swimming input, then measure current along candidate routes. Use tracking to obtain ground displacement and pauses. Fish using low-velocity boundaries should be assessed along their actual trajectories. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將水流提高到每秒一公尺重算時間，再試每秒一點二公尺並解釋分母為零的物理意義。列出可用來驗證固定游速假設的追蹤資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise current to one metre per second and recalculate travel time, then examine current equal to swimming speed. Explain the zero denominator physically and identify tracking data that test the fixed-speed assumption.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 先確認游泳能力資料的魚種、體長、水溫及試驗持續時間，再於候選路徑量流速。以追蹤影像取得地面位移與停留時間，若魚利用邊界低速帶，應沿實際路徑比較而非套斷面平均。
knowledge.textEn: Check species, size, temperature and test duration behind the swimming input, then measure current along candidate routes. Use tracking to obtain ground displacement and pauses. Fish using low-velocity boundaries should be assessed along their actual trajectories.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將水流提高到每秒一公尺重算時間，再試每秒一點二公尺並解釋分母為零的物理意義。列出可用來驗證固定游速假設的追蹤資料。
knowledge.textEn: Raise current to one metre per second and recalculate travel time, then examine current equal to swimming speed. Explain the zero denominator physically and identify tracking data that test the fixed-speed assumption.

quiz.question: 要驗證「游泳速度與地面進度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Swimming speed and ground progress"?
options: 先確認游泳能力資料的魚種、體長、水溫及試驗持續時間，再於候選路徑量流速。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
optionsEn: Check species, size, temperature and test duration behind the swimming input, then measure current along candidate routes.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
quiz.explanation: 先確認游泳能力資料的魚種、體長、水溫及試驗持續時間，再於候選路徑量流速。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check species, size, temperature and test duration behind the swimming input, then measure current along candidate routes. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 游泳速度與地面進度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Swimming speed and ground progress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「游泳速度與地面進度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Swimming speed and ground progress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。觀察到魚反覆嘗試後下退時，需檢查持續時間而不只檢查最大流速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat. Repeated attempts followed by downstream movement call for examining endurance and resting opportunities, not merely the maximum local current. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：計算應把可維持時間與距離一起列出，並明示水溫及體長條件，避免以最高速度替代耐力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: State duration, distance, temperature and body size rather than substituting maximum speed for endurance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。觀察到魚反覆嘗試後下退時，需檢查持續時間而不只檢查最大流速。
knowledge.textEn: Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat. Repeated attempts followed by downstream movement call for examining endurance and resting opportunities, not merely the maximum local current.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「游泳速度與地面進度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Swimming speed and ground progress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。
誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat.
Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
quiz.explanation: 以短時爆發游速估整段長距離通過，會低估疲勞與退回的機會。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using burst speed for a long reach underestimates fatigue and retreat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「入口誘導流量比例」與「水池換水與魚類停留」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Attraction flow proportion" and "Water turnover and fish residence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 入口誘導流量比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attraction flow proportion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入口誘導流量比例」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attraction flow proportion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 魚道入口需讓目標魚在多股水流中辨認可接近的路徑，誘導流量只是其中一個因素。入口位置、尾水深度、射流方向與附近洩流都會改變魚是否找到入口。流量占河川總流量的比例能描述供水分配，卻不直接量化入口可見度或魚的選擇。相同占比在不同洪水與機組運轉條件下可能產生不同流場，因此應把入口尋找與進入後通過分成兩個評估階段。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入口誘導流量比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Attraction flow helps fish locate an accessible entrance among competing currents, but location, tailwater depth, jet direction and nearby releases also matter. Its fraction of river discharge describes water allocation, not entrance detectability or fish choice. Identical fractions can create different flow patterns during floods or generating-unit changes. Evaluate finding the entrance separately from passing through the facility, and examine the operating conditions that alter approach routes rather than assuming a fixed ratio guarantees attraction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attraction flow proportion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入口誘導流量比例」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attraction flow proportion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 入口誘導流量比例
knowledge.text: 魚道入口需讓目標魚在多股水流中辨認可接近的路徑，誘導流量只是其中一個因素。入口位置、尾水深度、射流方向與附近洩流都會改變魚是否找到入口。
knowledge.textEn: Attraction flow helps fish locate an accessible entrance among competing currents, but location, tailwater depth, jet direction and nearby releases also matter. Its fraction of river discharge describes water allocation, not entrance detectability or fish choice.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「入口誘導流量比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Attraction flow proportion" is correct?
options: 誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間
魚道入口需讓目標魚在多股水流中辨認可接近的路徑，誘導流量只是其中一個因素。
optionsEn: Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
Attraction flow helps fish locate an accessible entrance among competing currents, but location, tailwater depth, jet direction and nearby releases also matter.
quiz.explanation: 魚道入口需讓目標魚在多股水流中辨認可接近的路徑，誘導流量只是其中一個因素。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Attraction flow helps fish locate an accessible entrance among competing currents, but location, tailwater depth, jet direction and nearby releases also matter. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 入口誘導流量比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Attraction flow proportion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「入口誘導流量比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attraction flow proportion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。適用邊界：僅為指定時刻水量比例，不是普遍建議值或吸引成功率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: A discharge fraction at one specified time, not a universal recommendation or attraction success rate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map approach velocities and record river flow and nearby outlet operation while tracking arrival, search and entry times.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。適用邊界：僅為指定時刻水量比例，不是普遍建議值或吸引成功率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: A discharge fraction at one specified time, not a universal recommendation or attraction success rate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「入口誘導流量比例」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Attraction flow proportion", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。
相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
每一段通過率都是九成所以五段全部通過率仍是九成
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless.
Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
If each stage passes ninety percent, passage through all five is still ninety percent
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qa=0.6 m3/s; Qr=40 m3/s; fa=Qa/Qr=0.015 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Attraction flow proportion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入口誘導流量比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。將未找到入口與進入後退出分開統計，並比較不同尾水條件，避免把兩種失敗混成一個通過率。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

Separate failure to find the entrance from retreat after entry, comparing tailwater conditions rather than combining both into one passage statistic. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。將未找到入口與進入後退出分開統計，並比較不同尾水條件，避免把兩種失敗混成一個通過率。
knowledge.textEn: Map approach velocities and record river flow and nearby outlet operation while tracking arrival, search and entry times. Separate failure to find the entrance from retreat after entry, comparing tailwater conditions rather than combining both into one passage statistic.
