knowledge.text: 將河川流量加倍但誘導流量不變，重算比例並說明它不能直接預測成效減半。設計一個同時量水流及搜尋時間的比較試驗，控制魚種與季節。
knowledge.textEn: Double river discharge at unchanged attraction flow and recalculate the fraction without assuming success halves. Design a comparison measuring both currents and search time while controlling species and season across observations.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入口誘導流量比例」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Attraction flow proportion"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Map approach velocities and record river flow and nearby outlet operation while tracking arrival, search and entry times.
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
quiz.explanation: 於入口外布設流速測線，記錄河川流量及附近出口操作，同時追蹤魚到達、搜尋與進入時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map approach velocities and record river flow and nearby outlet operation while tracking arrival, search and entry times. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 入口誘導流量比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Attraction flow proportion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入口誘導流量比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Attraction flow proportion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 誘導射流可能被主流偏轉，讓魚聚集在無法進入的位置。此時增加同方向流量未必改善，需查入口位置與可達水深，而不是只提高占比。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location. Increasing discharge in the same direction may not help; investigate entrance placement and accessible depth instead of only increasing the fraction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：相同占比在不同洪水與機組運轉條件下可能產生不同流場，因此應把入口尋找與進入後通過分成兩個評估階段。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Evaluate finding the entrance separately from passing through the facility, and examine the operating conditions that alter approach routes rather than assuming a fixed ratio guarantees attraction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 誘導射流可能被主流偏轉，讓魚聚集在無法進入的位置。此時增加同方向流量未必改善，需查入口位置與可達水深，而不是只提高占比。
knowledge.textEn: The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location. Increasing discharge in the same direction may not help; investigate entrance placement and accessible depth instead of only increasing the fraction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入口誘導流量比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Attraction flow proportion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間
誘導射流可能被主流偏轉，讓魚聚集在無法進入的位置。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location.
quiz.explanation: 誘導射流可能被主流偏轉，讓魚聚集在無法進入的位置。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: The main current can deflect an attraction jet toward an inaccessible location. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 水池換水與魚類停留：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water turnover and fish residence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水池換水與魚類停留」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water turnover and fish residence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 池容除以流量得到名義換水時間，可作水體更新的尺度，但真實水粒子停留時間會因短路與回流形成分布。魚不是被動示蹤物，可能主動停留、避流或反覆進出，所以水的平均換水時間不能代替魚類恢復體力的時間。溶氧與水溫也受外界交換影響，不能只靠較大體積假定適合休息。課程應把幾何池容、有效混合體積與觀測到的行為時間分開記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水池換水與魚類停留」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pool volume divided by discharge gives nominal water turnover time, while short-circuiting and recirculation produce a distribution of particle residence times. Fish are active organisms that can rest, avoid currents or repeatedly enter and leave; hydraulic turnover therefore does not equal recovery time. Oxygen and temperature depend on additional exchanges, so larger volume alone does not establish refuge quality. Keep geometric volume, actively mixed volume and observed behavioural residence as distinct quantities in the assessment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water turnover and fish residence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水池換水與魚類停留」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water turnover and fish residence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水池換水與魚類停留
knowledge.text: 池容除以流量得到名義換水時間，可作水體更新的尺度，但真實水粒子停留時間會因短路與回流形成分布。魚不是被動示蹤物，可能主動停留、避流或反覆進出，所以水的平均換水時間不能代替魚類恢復體力的時間。
knowledge.textEn: Pool volume divided by discharge gives nominal water turnover time, while short-circuiting and recirculation produce a distribution of particle residence times. Fish are active organisms that can rest, avoid currents or repeatedly enter and leave; hydraulic turnover therefore does not equal recovery time.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水池換水與魚類停留」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water turnover and fish residence" is correct?
options: 池容除以流量得到名義換水時間，可作水體更新的尺度，但真實水粒子停留時間會因短路與回流形成分布。
名義換水時間就是所有魚必須在池中停留的時間
孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同
optionsEn: Pool volume divided by discharge gives nominal water turnover time, while short-circuiting and recirculation produce a distribution of particle residence times.
Nominal water turnover time is the time every fish must remain in the pool
Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
quiz.explanation: 池容除以流量得到名義換水時間，可作水體更新的尺度，但真實水粒子停留時間會因短路與回流形成分布。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pool volume divided by discharge gives nominal water turnover time, while short-circuiting and recirculation produce a distribution of particle residence times. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水池換水與魚類停留：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water turnover and fish residence: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水池換水與魚類停留」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water turnover and fish residence” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。適用邊界：名義水體換水尺度，未假設每隻魚或每個水粒子停留二十秒。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s. Applicable boundary: Nominal water turnover scale, without assuming every fish or water particle remains twenty seconds. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用適合現場且獲准的示蹤方式量入口與出口濃度曲線，檢查早到峰與長尾。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use an appropriate authorized tracer method to measure inlet and outlet concentration histories, looking for early peaks and long tails.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。適用邊界：名義水體換水尺度，未假設每隻魚或每個水粒子停留二十秒。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s. Applicable boundary: Nominal water turnover scale, without assuming every fish or water particle remains twenty seconds.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水池換水與魚類停留」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water turnover and fish residence", which statement holds?
options: 上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。
池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
optionsEn: Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s.
Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: V=8 m3; Q=0.4 m3/s; tn=V/Q=20 s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水池換水與魚類停留：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water turnover and fish residence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水池換水與魚類停留」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water turnover and fish residence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用適合現場且獲准的示蹤方式量入口與出口濃度曲線，檢查早到峰與長尾。同步追蹤魚停留分布並量水溫、溶氧，將水力短路與魚主動休息區分，不能只用一個平均時間判斷池體功能。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use an appropriate authorized tracer method to measure inlet and outlet concentration histories, looking for early peaks and long tails. Track fish residence alongside temperature and oxygen, distinguishing hydraulic short-circuiting from active resting rather than relying on one mean. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持流量不變將池容增加四分之一重算名義時間，畫兩條平均相近但形狀不同的示蹤曲線。說明哪種附加量測可辨認真正可用的休息空間。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase volume by one quarter at fixed flow and recalculate nominal time. Sketch two tracer curves with similar means but different shapes, then identify additional observations that reveal usable resting space for fish.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：主流直接穿池可能使大部分水快速離開，而角落長時間不更新。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flow can short-circuit across a pool while corner water renews slowly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

optionsEn: Flow can short-circuit across a pool while corner water renews slowly.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
quiz.explanation: 主流直接穿池可能使大部分水快速離開，而角落長時間不更新。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flow can short-circuit across a pool while corner water renews slowly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「篩網接近速度比較」與「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Screen approach velocity comparison" and "Eddy scales and fish size": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 篩網接近速度比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Screen approach velocity comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「篩網接近速度比較」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Screen approach velocity comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 取水篩網與上溯魚道目的不同，前者常需避免魚被吸附或帶入取水口，不能把魚道開口流速直接當成篩網標準。接近速度應相對篩網法向定義，而掃流沿網面方向，兩者對魚的作用不同。以總流量除有效開孔面積得到孔隙平均速度，與按整體網面積計算的表觀速度也不同。教材必須明確標示所用面積和速度定義，才能與指定魚種及生命期的評估方法比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「篩網接近速度比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Intake screens and upstream fish passages serve different purposes; a passage-opening velocity cannot simply become a screen criterion. Approach velocity is normal to the screen, while sweeping velocity runs along it. Dividing discharge by effective open area gives a mean opening velocity, distinct from superficial velocity based on gross screen area. State both area and velocity definitions explicitly before comparing with an evaluation method for a particular species and life stage or interpreting blockage effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Screen approach velocity comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「篩網接近速度比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Screen approach velocity comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 篩網接近速度比較
knowledge.text: 取水篩網與上溯魚道目的不同，前者常需避免魚被吸附或帶入取水口，不能把魚道開口流速直接當成篩網標準。接近速度應相對篩網法向定義，而掃流沿網面方向，兩者對魚的作用不同。
knowledge.textEn: Intake screens and upstream fish passages serve different purposes; a passage-opening velocity cannot simply become a screen criterion. Approach velocity is normal to the screen, while sweeping velocity runs along it.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「篩網接近速度比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Screen approach velocity comparison" is correct?
options: 孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同
取水篩網與上溯魚道目的不同，前者常需避免魚被吸附或帶入取水口，不能把魚道開口流速直接當成篩網標準。
相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
optionsEn: Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
Intake screens and upstream fish passages serve different purposes; a passage-opening velocity cannot simply become a screen criterion.
Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
quiz.explanation: 取水篩網與上溯魚道目的不同，前者常需避免魚被吸附或帶入取水口，不能把魚道開口流速直接當成篩網標準。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Intake screens and upstream fish passages serve different purposes; a passage-opening velocity cannot simply become a screen criterion. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 篩網接近速度比較：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Screen approach velocity comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「篩網接近速度比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Screen approach velocity comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻法向通流的孔隙平均速度，不與總網面表觀接近速度混稱。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s. Applicable boundary: Mean opening velocity for uniform normal flow, distinct from gross-area superficial approach velocity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。適用邊界：均勻法向通流的孔隙平均速度，不與總網面表觀接近速度混稱。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s. Applicable boundary: Mean opening velocity for uniform normal flow, distinct from gross-area superficial approach velocity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「篩網接近速度比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Screen approach velocity comparison", which statement holds?
options: 每一段通過率都是九成所以五段全部通過率仍是九成
流量係數一旦量到就不會隨開口堵塞或尾水改變
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。
optionsEn: If each stage passes ninety percent, passage through all five is still ninety percent
A measured discharge coefficient never changes with blockage or tailwater
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.9 m3/s; Ag=3 m2; phi=0.6 dimensionless; vp=Q/(Ag*phi)=0.5 m/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 篩網接近速度比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Screen approach velocity comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「篩網接近速度比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Screen approach velocity comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。比較孔隙平均與表觀速度時標出定義，避免把兩種不同面積基準的數字當成儀器不一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method. Label opening and superficial velocities explicitly so different area bases are not mistaken for inconsistent instruments. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將開孔比例降低到零點四重算孔隙速度，另算總網面表觀速度並比較。畫出局部堵塞可能形成的高流速區，說明應如何加密量測而非只取平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce open fraction to zero point four and recalculate opening velocity, then compare with gross-area superficial velocity. Sketch a blockage-induced fast region and propose denser measurements instead of relying only on the average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。比較孔隙平均與表觀速度時標出定義，避免把兩種不同面積基準的數字當成儀器不一致。
knowledge.textEn: Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method. Label opening and superficial velocities explicitly so different area bases are not mistaken for inconsistent instruments.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將開孔比例降低到零點四重算孔隙速度，另算總網面表觀速度並比較。畫出局部堵塞可能形成的高流速區，說明應如何加密量測而非只取平均。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce open fraction to zero point four and recalculate opening velocity, then compare with gross-area superficial velocity. Sketch a blockage-induced fast region and propose denser measurements instead of relying only on the average.

quiz.question: 要驗證「篩網接近速度比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Screen approach velocity comparison"?
options: 先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
魚相對水的游速就是它相對岸邊的上游移動速度
optionsEn: Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A fish's swimming speed relative to water is its upstream speed relative to the bank
quiz.explanation: 先記錄網面總面積、開孔比例及堵塞分布，再依評估方法在網前規定位置量法向與切向速度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record gross area, open fraction and blockage pattern, then measure normal and tangential velocities at locations specified by the evaluation method. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 篩網接近速度比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screen approach velocity comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「篩網接近速度比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screen approach velocity comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。診斷應看空間分布及清污狀態，不能只查總取水量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest. Investigate spatial velocity patterns and cleaning condition rather than relying solely on total intake discharge or nominal screen area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教材必須明確標示所用面積和速度定義，才能與指定魚種及生命期的評估方法比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: State both area and velocity definitions explicitly before comparing with an evaluation method for a particular species and life stage or interpreting blockage effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。診斷應看空間分布及清污狀態，不能只查總取水量。
knowledge.textEn: Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest. Investigate spatial velocity patterns and cleaning condition rather than relying solely on total intake discharge or nominal screen area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「篩網接近速度比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Screen approach velocity comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。
相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest.
Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
quiz.explanation: 局部堵塞會把流量集中到剩餘開孔，平均全網速度可能仍低卻出現高吸附區。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local blockage concentrates flow through remaining openings even when the gross-area average appears modest. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eddy scales and fish size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」如何影響魚道水理設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eddy scales and fish size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 紊流不只由速度大小決定，渦流的空間尺度、持續時間及方向都可能影響魚維持姿態的能力。以特徵長度除以速度擾動可建立周轉時間尺度，但這不是魚的疲勞時間，也不是特定物種的允許週期。渦流尺寸相對魚體長度可能改變作用方式，因此測量應保留空間與時間解析度。過度平均會消除瞬時結構，反之短紀錄又可能把偶發渦流當成代表狀態，需要兼顧兩者。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turbulence affects posture through spatial scale, duration and direction as well as velocity magnitude. Dividing a characteristic length by velocity fluctuation gives an eddy turnover scale, not fish fatigue time or a species acceptance period. Eddy size relative to body length can change the interaction, so measurements need suitable spatial and temporal resolution. Excessive averaging removes transient structures, whereas very short records may mistake a rare event for typical conditions; both sampling limits require attention. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eddy scales and fish size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eddy scales and fish size”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度
knowledge.text: 紊流不只由速度大小決定，渦流的空間尺度、持續時間及方向都可能影響魚維持姿態的能力。以特徵長度除以速度擾動可建立周轉時間尺度，但這不是魚的疲勞時間，也不是特定物種的允許週期。
knowledge.textEn: Turbulence affects posture through spatial scale, duration and direction as well as velocity magnitude. Dividing a characteristic length by velocity fluctuation gives an eddy turnover scale, not fish fatigue time or a species acceptance period.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eddy scales and fish size" is correct?
options: 相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流
上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率
紊流不只由速度大小決定，渦流的空間尺度、持續時間及方向都可能影響魚維持姿態的能力。
optionsEn: Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction
Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
Turbulence affects posture through spatial scale, duration and direction as well as velocity magnitude.
quiz.explanation: 紊流不只由速度大小決定，渦流的空間尺度、持續時間及方向都可能影響魚維持姿態的能力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Turbulence affects posture through spatial scale, duration and direction as well as velocity magnitude. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eddy scales and fish size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eddy scales and fish size” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s。適用邊界：量綱尺度估算，非完整紊流頻譜或魚類生理反應模型。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s. Applicable boundary: Dimensional scale estimate, not a complete turbulence spectrum or physiological response model. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在魚可能利用的路徑採集足夠長的高速流速序列，說明取樣頻率與探頭空間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s。適用邊界：量綱尺度估算，非完整紊流頻譜或魚類生理反應模型。

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eddy scales and fish size", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s。
池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ell=0.4 m; uprime=0.2 m/s; te=ell/uprime=2 s.
Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool

steps.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eddy scales and fish size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eddy scales and fish size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在魚可能利用的路徑採集足夠長的高速流速序列，說明取樣頻率與探頭空間。比較不同位置的變動與相干性，再將影像中的魚體轉向和時間序列對齊，避免只憑均速推論紊流影響。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing. Compare fluctuations and coherence across locations, then align fish turning observations with the records rather than inferring turbulence effects from mean velocity alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將擾動速度增加一倍重算周轉尺度，並比較兩種魚體長度與渦流尺寸的相對大小。提出能檢驗姿態變化與水流擾動時間關係的同步觀測方案。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Double fluctuation velocity and recompute turnover scale. Compare eddy size with two fish lengths and propose synchronized observations that test the timing between hydraulic fluctuations and changes in fish posture along the route.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing. Compare fluctuations and coherence across locations, then align fish turning observations with the records rather than inferring turbulence effects from mean velocity alone.

knowledge.textEn: Double fluctuation velocity and recompute turnover scale. Compare eddy size with two fish lengths and propose synchronized observations that test the timing between hydraulic fluctuations and changes in fish posture along the route.

quiz.question: 要驗證「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Eddy scales and fish size"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在魚可能利用的路徑採集足夠長的高速流速序列，說明取樣頻率與探頭空間。
誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing.
Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
quiz.explanation: 在魚可能利用的路徑採集足夠長的高速流速序列，說明取樣頻率與探頭空間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Collect sufficiently long high-rate velocity records along likely routes, documenting sampling frequency and probe spacing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 渦流尺度與魚體尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Eddy scales and fish size: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Eddy scales and fish size” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。若魚明顯失衡而紀錄平穩，應先查解析度及位置，而非否定行為觀察。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies. If fish lose posture while records appear smooth, examine resolution and location before dismissing the behavioural evidence as unreliable. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：過度平均會消除瞬時結構，反之短紀錄又可能把偶發渦流當成代表狀態，需要兼顧兩者。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excessive averaging removes transient structures, whereas very short records may mistake a rare event for typical conditions; both sampling limits require attention.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同平均流速就代表魚會遭遇相同尺度與方向的紊流」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal mean velocity means fish encounter turbulence of identical scale and direction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。若魚明顯失衡而紀錄平穩，應先查解析度及位置，而非否定行為觀察。
knowledge.textEn: Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies. If fish lose posture while records appear smooth, examine resolution and location before dismissing the behavioural evidence as unreliable.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「渦流尺度與魚體尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eddy scales and fish size" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
上下游原始計數相除必然等於真實通過機率
探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Dividing raw upstream by downstream counts necessarily gives the true passage probability
Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies.
quiz.explanation: 探頭取樣過慢會漏掉快速擾動，過大的空間平均又會抹平渦流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slow sampling can miss rapid fluctuations, and broad spatial averaging can erase eddies. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Detection efficiency and passage proportion" and "Cumulative passage across reaches": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Detection efficiency and passage proportion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Hydraulic design of fish passages”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上下游感測站看到的魚數同時受到真實通過及偵測效率影響，直接相除可能把儀器差異誤認為生物損失。用已估偵測機率修正計數，是在同一受追蹤族群、單次計數及相容觀測期間下的簡化估計。重複通過、標記脫落與不同魚種的可偵測性會破壞這些假設。分析需保存個體識別及時間順序，並把尋找入口、進入和完成通過分別定義，才能解釋比例代表什麼。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「偵測效率與通過比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Counts at upstream and downstream detectors combine actual passage with detection efficiency, so a raw ratio can mistake instrumentation differences for biological loss. Correcting counts by estimated detection probabilities is a simplified estimator for one tracked cohort, unique counts and compatible observation windows. Repeated passages, tag loss and species-dependent detectability violate those assumptions. Preserve individual identities and event order, and distinguish attraction, entry and completed passage so the estimated proportion has a clear denominator and interpretation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Detection efficiency and passage proportion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nu=80 fish; pu=0.8 dimensionless; Nd=100 fish; pd=0.9 dimensionless; phat=(Nu/pu)/(Nd/pd)=0.9 dimensionless.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：下游偵測效率較低時，分母被低估會誇大通過率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Poor downstream detection reduces the denominator and inflates apparent passage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Detection efficiency and passage proportion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 下游偵測效率較低時，分母被低估會誇大通過率。若把反覆往返同一魚當不同個體，還可能得到表面大於全部進入數的錯誤成果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Poor downstream detection reduces the denominator and inflates apparent passage. Counting repeated movements of one fish as separate individuals can further produce an implausible number of successes relative to the original cohort. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析需保存個體識別及時間順序，並把尋找入口、進入和完成通過分別定義，才能解釋比例代表什麼。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 流域中的多個障礙會把單處看似很高的通過率累積成較低的整體成功率，但乘法必須使用相容的條件機率。若每段數值是已到達該段魚群的通過機率，連乘可表示依序完成的比例；若只是不同調查族群的平均值，就未必可直接相乘。等待與繞行也會延長遷移時間，即使最後通過仍可能錯過繁殖窗口。改善排序應同時考慮瓶頸、時序與族群差異，而非只追求單處漂亮數字。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「多段通行的累積效果」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Multiple barriers can turn high local passage into modest basin-wide success, but multiplication requires compatible conditional probabilities. If each value describes fish that actually reach that stage, their product represents sequential completion; averages from unrelated populations need not be compatible. Delays and detours also matter because eventual passage can miss a breeding window. Prioritize improvements using bottlenecks, timing and population differences rather than optimizing one attractive local percentage without considering the connected migration route. options: 平均功率密度相同就代表池內每個位置紊流程度相同
誘導流量占比就是到達魚道入口的魚類成功百分比
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless。
optionsEn: Equal average power density means identical turbulence at every point in a pool
Attraction discharge fraction equals the percentage of fish that successfully find the entrance
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: p=0.9 dimensionless conditional-stage-probability; N=5 stages; Pall=p^N=0.59049 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 多段通行的累積效果：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cumulative passage across reaches: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「多段通行的累積效果」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cumulative passage across reaches” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對同一標記族群建立各段到達及通過的時間表，分母使用真正到達該段的個體。檢查魚體狀態與季節是否逐段改變，將累積成功與總延遲分開報告，並追查失聯是否只是偵測不足。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build arrival and completion histories for the same tagged cohort, using actual arrivals as each denominator. Check changing condition and season across stages. Report cumulative completion separately from total delay and investigate whether disappearance reflects inadequate detection rather than loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將其中一段條件通過率提高到零點九八重算全程比例，再比較減少等待時間但不改通過率的方案。說明兩種效益需要哪些不同觀測才能評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise one conditional stage probability to zero point nine eight and recompute completion. Compare this with reducing delay at unchanged passage probability, identifying the different observations required to evaluate these two benefits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對同一標記族群建立各段到達及通過的時間表，分母使用真正到達該段的個體。檢查魚體狀態與季節是否逐段改變，將累積成功與總延遲分開報告，並追查失聯是否只是偵測不足。
knowledge.textEn: Build arrival and completion histories for the same tagged cohort, using actual arrivals as each denominator. Check changing condition and season across stages. Report cumulative completion separately from total delay and investigate whether disappearance reflects inadequate detection rather than loss.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將其中一段條件通過率提高到零點九八重算全程比例，再比較減少等待時間但不改通過率的方案。說明兩種效益需要哪些不同觀測才能評估。
knowledge.textEn: Raise one conditional stage probability to zero point nine eight and recompute completion. Compare this with reducing delay at unchanged passage probability, identifying the different observations required to evaluate these two benefits.

quiz.question: 要驗證「多段通行的累積效果」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cumulative passage across reaches"?
options: 對同一標記族群建立各段到達及通過的時間表，分母使用真正到達該段的個體。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
孔隙平均速度與按總網面積計算的表觀速度永遠相同
optionsEn: Build arrival and completion histories for the same tagged cohort, using actual arrivals as each denominator.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Opening velocity and superficial velocity based on gross screen area are always identical
quiz.explanation: 對同一標記族群建立各段到達及通過的時間表，分母使用真正到達該段的個體。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build arrival and completion histories for the same tagged cohort, using actual arrivals as each denominator. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 多段通行的累積效果：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cumulative passage across reaches: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「多段通行的累積效果」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cumulative passage across reaches” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。只連乘公布百分比會忽略這種跨段與跨時影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year. Multiplying published percentages without cohort and timing checks can therefore misrepresent cumulative migration outcomes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：改善排序應同時考慮瓶頸、時序與族群差異，而非只追求單處漂亮數字。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Prioritize improvements using bottlenecks, timing and population differences rather than optimizing one attractive local percentage without considering the connected migration route.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每一段通過率都是九成所以五段全部通過率仍是九成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If each stage passes ninety percent, passage through all five is still ninety percent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。只連乘公布百分比會忽略這種跨段與跨時影響。
knowledge.textEn: Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year. Multiplying published percentages without cohort and timing checks can therefore misrepresent cumulative migration outcomes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「多段通行的累積效果」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cumulative passage across reaches" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。
池間落差相同就代表所有魚種都具有相同通過機會
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year.
Equal pool drops give every fish species the same passage opportunity
quiz.explanation: 某段延遲可能改變下一段面對的流量或季節，讓從其他年份搬來的局部通過率不適用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Delay at one barrier can change the flow or season encountered next, invalidating local rates borrowed from another year. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 河川再蜿蜒工程
courses.summary: 再蜿蜒不只是把直線河道畫成曲線，而是重新安排河道長度、洪氾空間、地下水交換與泥砂的移動途徑。十個單元由地形量測走向流況及監測設計，並要求比較工程前後及參照區，避免把自然年際變化誤認為復育工程的單一成果。
courses.summaryEn: Remeandering reorganizes channel length, floodplain space, groundwater exchange and sediment pathways. Ten units move from geometric measurement to flow processes and monitoring design. Comparisons across time and reference reaches help separate restoration signals from natural variation. Learners examine both the intended ecological gains and the hydraulic consequences of reconnecting a river with surrounding land.
courses.focus: 以地形、水文與泥砂連通性檢驗河川再蜿蜒
courses.focusEn: Testing river remeandering through geometry, hydrology and sediment connectivity
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課先用「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」建立原創假想基準，再以「展長後的平均坡度」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless；第二組為 dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：固定谷地參考長 Lv=1200 m，將中心線 Lc 從 1800 m 增至 1980 m，蜿蜒度由 1.5 增至 1.65。河長與指標同增一成，但這個比值不能單獨證明棲地、洪峰或泥砂平衡改善。
workedExample.textEn: Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Sinuosity and measurement scale and examine another controlling mechanism through Mean slope after lengthening. The first inputs and result are Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless; the second are dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep valley reference length Lv=1200 m fixed and increase centreline Lc from 1800 m to 1980 m. Sinuosity rises from 1.5 to 1.65. Length and index both increase ten percent, but the ratio alone does not establish improvement in habitat, flood peaks or sediment balance.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」與「展長後的平均坡度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sinuosity and measurement scale" and "Mean slope after lengthening": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sinuosity and measurement scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 蜿蜒度比較沿河道中心線與谷地參考路徑的長度，能描述平面幾何，卻不直接代表棲地品質或洪水安全。中心線取自低水槽、滿岸線或影像水面時可能得到不同結果，谷地長度也必須固定相同起訖點。影像解析度太細會把小幅岸線起伏計入長度，太粗則削去彎道。因此工程前後比較應維持相同定義與解析度，先確認幾何變化是真實河道重組而非測圖方式改變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. A centreline based on low flow, bankfull edges or visible water can differ, and valley length must use matching endpoints. Fine imagery may count minor irregularities while coarse mapping removes bends. Keep definitions and resolution consistent before and after works so an apparent change represents channel reorganization rather than a different surveying method or mapping scale. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sinuosity and measurement scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sinuosity and measurement scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度
knowledge.text: 蜿蜒度比較沿河道中心線與谷地參考路徑的長度，能描述平面幾何，卻不直接代表棲地品質或洪水安全。中心線取自低水槽、滿岸線或影像水面時可能得到不同結果，谷地長度也必須固定相同起訖點。
knowledge.textEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. A centreline based on low flow, bankfull edges or visible water can differ, and valley length must use matching endpoints.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sinuosity and measurement scale" is correct?
options: 蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
蜿蜒度比較沿河道中心線與谷地參考路徑的長度，能描述平面幾何，卻不直接代表棲地品質或洪水安全。
河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度
optionsEn: Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety.
Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge
quiz.explanation: 蜿蜒度比較沿河道中心線與谷地參考路徑的長度，能描述平面幾何，卻不直接代表棲地品質或洪水安全。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sinuosity compares channel-centreline length with a valley reference route, describing plan geometry rather than habitat quality or flood safety. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sinuosity and measurement scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。適用邊界：相同起訖點與固定中心線定義，只描述平面長度比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Matching endpoints and a fixed centreline definition; describes plan-length ratio only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。適用邊界：相同起訖點與固定中心線定義，只描述平面長度比。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Matching endpoints and a fixed centreline definition; describes plan-length ratio only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sinuosity and measurement scale", which statement holds?
options: 幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。
optionsEn: Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Lc=1800 m; Lv=1200 m; P=Lc/Lv=1.5 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sinuosity and measurement scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。以第二位判讀者重畫部分彎道估計主觀差異，再將長度改變與實際開挖或自然遷移位置核對，避免把繪圖密度當成果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Have another interpreter redraw selected bends to estimate subjective variation, then compare length changes with actual excavation or migration rather than treating denser digitizing as improvement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在谷地長度固定下將河長增加一成重算蜿蜒度，另畫一個增加長度但缺少洪氾空間的方案。說明還需哪些水理及生態證據才能比較兩者。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase channel length by ten percent at fixed valley length and recalculate sinuosity. Sketch a longer channel without additional floodplain space, then identify hydraulic and ecological evidence needed to compare the alternatives.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。以第二位判讀者重畫部分彎道估計主觀差異，再將長度改變與實際開挖或自然遷移位置核對，避免把繪圖密度當成果。
knowledge.textEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Have another interpreter redraw selected bends to estimate subjective variation, then compare length changes with actual excavation or migration rather than treating denser digitizing as improvement.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在谷地長度固定下將河長增加一成重算蜿蜒度，另畫一個增加長度但缺少洪氾空間的方案。說明還需哪些水理及生態證據才能比較兩者。
knowledge.textEn: Increase channel length by ten percent at fixed valley length and recalculate sinuosity. Sketch a longer channel without additional floodplain space, then identify hydraulic and ecological evidence needed to compare the alternatives.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sinuosity and measurement scale"?
options: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
optionsEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
quiz.explanation: 使用同一底圖投影及解析度數化工程前後中心線，保留起訖點和谷地基準路徑。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Digitize both centrelines using the same projection and resolution, preserving endpoints and valley reference. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 蜿蜒度與量測尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sinuosity and measurement scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sinuosity and measurement scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。診斷應先檢查中心線定義及流量條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. Check centreline definitions and flow conditions before interpreting apparent geometric improvement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：因此工程前後比較應維持相同定義與解析度，先確認幾何變化是真實河道重組而非測圖方式改變。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keep definitions and resolution consistent before and after works so an apparent change represents channel reorganization rather than a different surveying method or mapping scale.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。診斷應先檢查中心線定義及流量條件。
knowledge.textEn: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. Check centreline definitions and flow conditions before interpreting apparent geometric improvement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蜿蜒度與量測尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Sinuosity and measurement scale" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。
河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel.
Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge
quiz.explanation: 不同年份使用不同解析度影像可能製造虛假蜿蜒度增加，洪水影像還可能把漫流支線誤認主槽。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different image resolutions can create false sinuosity gains, while flood imagery may confuse overbank branches with the main channel. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「展長後的平均坡度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean slope after lengthening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在上游與下游控制高程不變時，河道展長會降低沿程平均坡度，但各彎段的床坡不必均勻。局部深潭、淺瀨與回水可能分配大部分水頭損失，因此不能把平均坡度直接視為每一點能坡。坡度降低也會改變輸砂能力，若上游供砂維持不變，河床可能淤積再調整。設計應把高程控制、幾何長度與預期泥砂交換連在一起，而非只透過平面曲線追求更大的蜿蜒度。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「展長後的平均坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: With fixed upstream and downstream control elevations, channel lengthening reduces mean longitudinal slope, but individual bends need not share that slope. Pools, riffles and backwater distribute losses unevenly, so mean bed slope is not the energy slope everywhere. Lower slope can alter transport capacity and trigger deposition when upstream sediment supply persists. Connect elevation controls, channel geometry and sediment exchange rather than pursuing a larger sinuosity value through planform geometry alone without checking adjustment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean slope after lengthening” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「展長後的平均坡度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean slope after lengthening”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 展長後的平均坡度

knowledge.textEn: With fixed upstream and downstream control elevations, channel lengthening reduces mean longitudinal slope, but individual bends need not share that slope. Pools, riffles and backwater distribute losses unevenly, so mean bed slope is not the energy slope everywhere.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「展長後的平均坡度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean slope after lengthening" is correct?
options: 河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度
曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
在上游與下游控制高程不變時，河道展長會降低沿程平均坡度，但各彎段的床坡不必均勻。
optionsEn: Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge
Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
With fixed upstream and downstream control elevations, channel lengthening reduces mean longitudinal slope, but individual bends need not share that slope.
quiz.explanation: 在上游與下游控制高程不變時，河道展長會降低沿程平均坡度，但各彎段的床坡不必均勻。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: With fixed upstream and downstream control elevations, channel lengthening reduces mean longitudinal slope, but individual bends need not share that slope. The other options are common misconceptions.
