quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: dz=3 m; L=1800 m; S=dz/L=0.001666667 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「展長後的平均坡度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean slope after lengthening” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。另量代表流量下水面坡度，對照床坡差異；若出現大範圍回水，應調查下游控制而非把所有差異歸因於新彎道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures. Measure water-surface slope at representative discharge and compare with bed slope. Extensive backwater requires investigating downstream control instead of attributing every difference to the new bends. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將河長縮短三百公尺重算平均坡度，保持兩端高程不變。畫出兩個具有相同平均坡但局部深潭配置不同的縱斷面，說明其水理仍可能不同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Shorten the channel by three hundred metres with endpoint levels fixed and recalculate slope. Draw two profiles with identical mean slope but different pool distributions, explaining why their hydraulic behaviour may still differ.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。另量代表流量下水面坡度，對照床坡差異；若出現大範圍回水，應調查下游控制而非把所有差異歸因於新彎道。
knowledge.textEn: Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures. Measure water-surface slope at representative discharge and compare with bed slope. Extensive backwater requires investigating downstream control instead of attributing every difference to the new bends.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將河長縮短三百公尺重算平均坡度，保持兩端高程不變。畫出兩個具有相同平均坡但局部深潭配置不同的縱斷面，說明其水理仍可能不同。
knowledge.textEn: Shorten the channel by three hundred metres with endpoint levels fixed and recalculate slope. Draw two profiles with identical mean slope but different pool distributions, explaining why their hydraulic behaviour may still differ.

quiz.question: 要驗證「展長後的平均坡度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Mean slope after lengthening"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。
水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures.
Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream
quiz.explanation: 重測兩端控制高程與沿程縱斷面，將深潭、淺瀨及構造物逐一標示。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Survey endpoint controls and the full profile, identifying pools, riffles and structures. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 展長後的平均坡度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Mean slope after lengthening: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「展長後的平均坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean slope after lengthening” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。床面局部淤積也可能重新縮短有效流路，需追蹤水面與地形的共同演變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. Local deposition may also shorten the effective flow path, requiring joint monitoring of water levels and evolving channel geometry. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計應把高程控制、幾何長度與預期泥砂交換連在一起，而非只透過平面曲線追求更大的蜿蜒度。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Connect elevation controls, channel geometry and sediment exchange rather than pursuing a larger sinuosity value through planform geometry alone without checking adjustment.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。床面局部淤積也可能重新縮短有效流路，需追蹤水面與地形的共同演變。
knowledge.textEn: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. Local deposition may also shorten the effective flow path, requiring joint monitoring of water levels and evolving channel geometry.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「展長後的平均坡度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Mean slope after lengthening" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater.
quiz.explanation: 若只增加河長卻忽略下游固定水位，上游可能產生預期外壅水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Lengthening while ignoring a fixed downstream level can create unexpected upstream backwater. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「粗糙度與通水尺度」與「洪氾地的可用蓄水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Roughness and conveyance scale" and "Available floodplain storage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Roughness and conveyance scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「粗糙度與通水尺度」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Roughness and conveyance scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 復育後植生、木構與河床形態會改變阻力，用曼寧式可初步比較斷面通水尺度，但必須確認近似均勻流及適用的單位系統。粗糙係數不是純粹材料常數，會隨淹水深度、植生彎伏和季節改變。複式斷面中主槽與洪氾地的交換也難由單一係數描述。計算應保留面積、水力半徑與能坡各自來源，不可用調整係數掩蓋幾何或邊界條件的錯誤。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粗糙度與通水尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restored vegetation, wood and bed forms change resistance. Manning's relation offers a preliminary conveyance comparison under approximately uniform flow and a stated unit system. Roughness is not merely a material constant; depth, plant reconfiguration and season affect it. Exchange between the main channel and floodplain also exceeds a single-coefficient description. Keep the origins of area, hydraulic radius and energy slope explicit instead of tuning roughness to conceal errors in geometry or boundary conditions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Roughness and conveyance scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「粗糙度與通水尺度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Roughness and conveyance scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度
knowledge.text: 復育後植生、木構與河床形態會改變阻力，用曼寧式可初步比較斷面通水尺度，但必須確認近似均勻流及適用的單位系統。粗糙係數不是純粹材料常數，會隨淹水深度、植生彎伏和季節改變。
knowledge.textEn: Restored vegetation, wood and bed forms change resistance. Manning's relation offers a preliminary conveyance comparison under approximately uniform flow and a stated unit system.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「粗糙度與通水尺度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Roughness and conveyance scale" is correct?
options: 復育後植生、木構與河床形態會改變阻力，用曼寧式可初步比較斷面通水尺度，但必須確認近似均勻流及適用的單位系統。
曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
optionsEn: Restored vegetation, wood and bed forms change resistance.
Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
quiz.explanation: 復育後植生、木構與河床形態會改變阻力，用曼寧式可初步比較斷面通水尺度，但必須確認近似均勻流及適用的單位系統。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Restored vegetation, wood and bed forms change resistance. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Roughness and conveyance scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「粗糙度與通水尺度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Roughness and conveyance scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。適用邊界：SI 曼寧形式的近均勻流示例，能坡為獨立假設且非前單元床坡。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s. Applicable boundary: SI Manning approximation for near-uniform flow; energy slope is independently assumed, not the preceding unit's bed slope. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對數個流量實測水位與速度，先驗證斷面幾何，再比較推算係數是否隨水深系統性改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure levels and velocities at several discharges, verify geometry first, and check systematic depth dependence in inferred roughness.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。適用邊界：SI 曼寧形式的近均勻流示例，能坡為獨立假設且非前單元床坡。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s. Applicable boundary: SI Manning approximation for near-uniform flow; energy slope is independently assumed, not the preceding unit's bed slope.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「粗糙度與通水尺度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Roughness and conveyance scale", which statement holds?
options: 岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
optionsEn: All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3).
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: n=0.04 s/m^(1/3); A=24 m2; R=1.2 m; S=0.0015 dimensionless; Q=A*R^(2/3)*sqrt(S)/n=26.241241 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Roughness and conveyance scale: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「粗糙度與通水尺度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Roughness and conveyance scale” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對數個流量實測水位與速度，先驗證斷面幾何，再比較推算係數是否隨水深系統性改變。分別調查有葉與落葉狀態，若主槽和洪氾地速度差很大，應分區估算並考慮側向交換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure levels and velocities at several discharges, verify geometry first, and check systematic depth dependence in inferred roughness. Survey leafy and leafless conditions separately. Strong main-channel and floodplain velocity contrasts call for divided treatment and attention to lateral exchange. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將粗糙係數增加四分之一並保持幾何與能坡不變，重算通水量。說明真實河道為何可能改以水位上升回應，並列出判斷所需的邊界條件。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase roughness by one quarter at fixed geometry and energy slope and recompute discharge. Explain why a real river may instead respond through rising stage, identifying boundary conditions needed to distinguish these responses.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用低水位校準的粗糙係數外推洪水，可能誤估植生淹沒後阻力或洪氾通道。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Roughness calibrated at low flow can misrepresent submerged vegetation and floodplain pathways during floods. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對數個流量實測水位與速度，先驗證斷面幾何，再比較推算係數是否隨水深系統性改變。分別調查有葉與落葉狀態，若主槽和洪氾地速度差很大，應分區估算並考慮側向交換。
knowledge.textEn: Measure levels and velocities at several discharges, verify geometry first, and check systematic depth dependence in inferred roughness. Survey leafy and leafless conditions separately. Strong main-channel and floodplain velocity contrasts call for divided treatment and attention to lateral exchange.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將粗糙係數增加四分之一並保持幾何與能坡不變，重算通水量。說明真實河道為何可能改以水位上升回應，並列出判斷所需的邊界條件。
knowledge.textEn: Increase roughness by one quarter at fixed geometry and energy slope and recompute discharge. Explain why a real river may instead respond through rising stage, identifying boundary conditions needed to distinguish these responses.

quiz.question: 要驗證「粗糙度與通水尺度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Roughness and conveyance scale"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
對數個流量實測水位與速度，先驗證斷面幾何，再比較推算係數是否隨水深系統性改變。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
Measure levels and velocities at several discharges, verify geometry first, and check systematic depth dependence in inferred roughness.
quiz.explanation: 對數個流量實測水位與速度，先驗證斷面幾何，再比較推算係數是否隨水深系統性改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure levels and velocities at several discharges, verify geometry first, and check systematic depth dependence in inferred roughness. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 粗糙度與通水尺度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Roughness and conveyance scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粗糙度與通水尺度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Roughness and conveyance scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用低水位校準的粗糙係數外推洪水，可能誤估植生淹沒後阻力或洪氾通道。若模擬僅在某一水深吻合，應查機制而非宣稱全流量範圍已驗證。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Roughness calibrated at low flow can misrepresent submerged vegetation and floodplain pathways during floods. Agreement at one depth does not validate the full discharge range; investigate the changing resistance mechanism before extrapolation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：計算應保留面積、水力半徑與能坡各自來源，不可用調整係數掩蓋幾何或邊界條件的錯誤。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Keep the origins of area, hydraulic radius and energy slope explicit instead of tuning roughness to conceal errors in geometry or boundary conditions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「粗糙度與通水尺度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
optionsEn: Roughness calibrated at low flow can misrepresent submerged vegetation and floodplain pathways during floods.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
quiz.explanation: 用低水位校準的粗糙係數外推洪水，可能誤估植生淹沒後阻力或洪氾通道。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Roughness calibrated at low flow can misrepresent submerged vegetation and floodplain pathways during floods. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 洪氾地的可用蓄水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Available floodplain storage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「洪氾地的可用蓄水」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Available floodplain storage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重新連接洪氾地可增加水體暫存空間，但蓄水量取決於地形、水位與進出水時間，而非整片土地面積。以平均淹水深乘面積只是給定水位下的幾何容量，若入口太窄或洪峰太短，空間可能來不及填滿。原本已積水的窪地還需扣除既有水量。削峰效果則取決於容量何時使用與何時退水，必須把容量和流量歷線一起分析，不能把立方公尺直接說成洪峰降低值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「洪氾地的可用蓄水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconnecting a floodplain creates potential temporary storage, but usable volume depends on topography, stage and exchange timing rather than land area alone. Area times mean depth gives geometric capacity at a specified stage; a narrow entrance or brief peak may prevent filling. Existing ponded water reduces available capacity. Peak attenuation also depends on filling and drainage timing, so evaluate storage alongside hydrographs instead of treating a volume as if it were a discharge reduction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Available floodplain storage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「洪氾地的可用蓄水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Available floodplain storage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「洪氾地的可用蓄水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Available floodplain storage" is correct?
options: 幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
重新連接洪氾地可增加水體暫存空間，但蓄水量取決於地形、水位與進出水時間，而非整片土地面積。
橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷
optionsEn: Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
Reconnecting a floodplain creates potential temporary storage, but usable volume depends on topography, stage and exchange timing rather than land area alone.
A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode
quiz.explanation: 重新連接洪氾地可增加水體暫存空間，但蓄水量取決於地形、水位與進出水時間，而非整片土地面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconnecting a floodplain creates potential temporary storage, but usable volume depends on topography, stage and exchange timing rather than land area alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 洪氾地的可用蓄水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Available floodplain storage: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「洪氾地的可用蓄水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Available floodplain storage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3。適用邊界：指定水位下新增平均水深且無既存積水，不推算洪峰削減。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3. Applicable boundary: Added mean depth at a specified stage with no pre-existing water; peak reduction is not inferred. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以地形模型建立水位容量關係，現場核對低窪與阻水土堤。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Develop a stage-storage relation from terrain and verify depressions and embankments.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3。適用邊界：指定水位下新增平均水深且無既存積水，不推算洪峰削減。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3. Applicable boundary: Added mean depth at a specified stage with no pre-existing water; peak reduction is not inferred.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「洪氾地的可用蓄水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Available floodplain storage", which statement holds?
options: 側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積
水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3。
optionsEn: Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume
Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: A=60000 m2; d=0.35 m; V=A*d=21000 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instructionEn: Develop a stage-storage relation from terrain and verify depressions and embankments. During events, synchronize inlet and outlet flows with floodplain levels to determine actual use and drainage timing, rather than inferring flood protection solely from the highest water mark. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 洪氾入口堵塞可能使圖上容量無法使用，出口過快又可能把水送回洪峰。應檢查連通與時間，而非只增加名義土地面積。
knowledge.textEn: A blocked entrance can make mapped storage inaccessible, while rapid drainage can return water during the peak. Investigate connectivity and timing rather than assuming more nominal floodplain area will necessarily improve attenuation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「洪氾地的可用蓄水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Available floodplain storage" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
洪氾入口堵塞可能使圖上容量無法使用，出口過快又可能把水送回洪峰。
橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A blocked entrance can make mapped storage inaccessible, while rapid drainage can return water during the peak.
A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「彎道橫向水面差」與「岸線遷移與土方體積」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transverse water level in bends" and "Bank migration and eroded volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 彎道橫向水面差：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transverse water level in bends: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「彎道橫向水面差」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transverse water level in bends” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水流轉彎需要向心加速度，橫向水面坡度可提供相應壓力差，因此外彎水面可能較高。簡化關係以平均速度、河寬和曲率半徑建立尺度，但真實彎道還有二次流、深槽及垂直速度分布。外彎侵蝕並不只由水面高差決定，近床流向與土體條件同樣重要。再蜿蜒設計應把曲率、岸趾及洪氾邊界一起檢查，避免把平面美觀的急彎當成自然穩定形狀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「彎道橫向水面差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turning flow requires centripetal acceleration, which a transverse water-surface gradient can help supply, producing higher levels near the outer bend. A simplified relation uses mean velocity, width and curvature radius, while real bends include secondary circulation, thalweg variation and vertical velocity structure. Outer-bank erosion is not determined by surface difference alone; near-bed currents and soil matter. Examine curvature, toe conditions and floodplain boundaries together rather than assuming an attractive planform is naturally stable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transverse water level in bends” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「彎道橫向水面差」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transverse water level in bends”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 彎道橫向水面差
knowledge.text: 水流轉彎需要向心加速度，橫向水面坡度可提供相應壓力差，因此外彎水面可能較高。簡化關係以平均速度、河寬和曲率半徑建立尺度，但真實彎道還有二次流、深槽及垂直速度分布。
knowledge.textEn: Turning flow requires centripetal acceleration, which a transverse water-surface gradient can help supply, producing higher levels near the outer bend. A simplified relation uses mean velocity, width and curvature radius, while real bends include secondary circulation, thalweg variation and vertical velocity structure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「彎道橫向水面差」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transverse water level in bends" is correct?
options: 橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷
岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
水流轉彎需要向心加速度，橫向水面坡度可提供相應壓力差，因此外彎水面可能較高。
optionsEn: A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode
All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Turning flow requires centripetal acceleration, which a transverse water-surface gradient can help supply, producing higher levels near the outer bend.
quiz.explanation: 水流轉彎需要向心加速度，橫向水面坡度可提供相應壓力差，因此外彎水面可能較高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Turning flow requires centripetal acceleration, which a transverse water-surface gradient can help supply, producing higher levels near the outer bend. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 彎道橫向水面差：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transverse water level in bends: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「彎道橫向水面差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transverse water level in bends” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m。適用邊界：小寬徑比與代表平均速度的尺度估算，未解析二次流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m. Applicable boundary: Scale estimate using modest width-to-radius ratio and representative mean velocity, without resolving secondary circulation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一斷面同步量內外彎水位，並取得垂向與橫向流速資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inner and outer levels simultaneously and obtain vertical and transverse velocity data.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m。適用邊界：小寬徑比與代表平均速度的尺度估算，未解析二次流。

Applicable boundary: Scale estimate using modest width-to-radius ratio and representative mean velocity, without resolving secondary circulation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「彎道橫向水面差」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transverse water level in bends", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m.
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: v=1.5 m/s; B=12 m; g=9.81 m/s2; R=60 m; dh=v^2*B/(g*R)=0.045872 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 彎道橫向水面差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transverse water level in bends: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「彎道橫向水面差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transverse water level in bends” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一斷面同步量內外彎水位，並取得垂向與橫向流速資料。量測曲率時保持中心線定義一致，若水面差與簡式偏離，先查回水、非均勻速度及幾何急變，不把偏差全歸為測量誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inner and outer levels simultaneously and obtain vertical and transverse velocity data. Use a consistent centreline for curvature. Differences from the simple estimate require checking backwater, nonuniform velocity and abrupt geometry before attributing everything to survey error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將曲率半徑縮小一半而速度與河寬固定，重算水面差。畫出可能的二次流方向並說明簡式沒有提供哪些近床資訊，安排相應測速位置。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve curvature radius at fixed speed and width and recalculate level difference. Sketch possible secondary circulation, identify near-bed information missing from the formula, and place velocity measurements to investigate those processes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：急彎可能把主流壓向尚未穩定的外岸，造成局部淘空和岸塊崩落。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A tight bend can direct the main current toward an unestablished outer bank, causing undermining and block failure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.objective: 說明「岸線遷移與土方體積」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Bank migration and eroded volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 允許河道在限定走廊內遷移，可以提供沉積物和新生棲地，但也需要清楚界定土地、設施與管理邊界。岸線後退距離乘長度與平均高度，可初估流失土體的原位體積，並非全部會立即成為下游懸浮泥砂。崩落土塊可能暫存岸趾、再被洪水分次帶走，細粗料行為也不同。監測應區分平面遷移、體積侵蝕與輸出通量，避免把三個量互相代替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「岸線遷移與土方體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Allowing migration within a defined corridor can create habitat and supply sediment, but land, infrastructure and management boundaries must be explicit. Retreat distance times bank length and mean height estimates in-place eroded volume, not sediment immediately exported downstream. Failed blocks may remain at the toe and be removed during later floods, with fines and coarse material behaving differently. Monitor planform movement, volumetric erosion and exported flux separately rather than substituting one quantity for another. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Bank migration and eroded volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「岸線遷移與土方體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Bank migration and eroded volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 岸線遷移與土方體積
knowledge.text: 允許河道在限定走廊內遷移，可以提供沉積物和新生棲地，但也需要清楚界定土地、設施與管理邊界。岸線後退距離乘長度與平均高度，可初估流失土體的原位體積，並非全部會立即成為下游懸浮泥砂。
knowledge.textEn: Allowing migration within a defined corridor can create habitat and supply sediment, but land, infrastructure and management boundaries must be explicit. Retreat distance times bank length and mean height estimates in-place eroded volume, not sediment immediately exported downstream.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「岸線遷移與土方體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Bank migration and eroded volume" is correct?
options: 允許河道在限定走廊內遷移，可以提供沉積物和新生棲地，但也需要清楚界定土地、設施與管理邊界。
岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積
optionsEn: Allowing migration within a defined corridor can create habitat and supply sediment, but land, infrastructure and management boundaries must be explicit.
All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume
quiz.explanation: 允許河道在限定走廊內遷移，可以提供沉積物和新生棲地，但也需要清楚界定土地、設施與管理邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Allowing migration within a defined corridor can create habitat and supply sediment, but land, infrastructure and management boundaries must be explicit. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 岸線遷移與土方體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Bank migration and eroded volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「岸線遷移與土方體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bank migration and eroded volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place。適用邊界：均勻矩形岸塊幾何估算，未轉成固體質量或下游輸砂量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place. Applicable boundary: Uniform rectangular bank-block estimate, not converted to solid mass or downstream sediment export. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用相同高程與平面基準比較岸頂、岸趾及水下地形，量崩落塊體是否仍留在控制體內。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare bank crest, toe and submerged terrain on common datums and measure failed blocks remaining inside the control volume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place。適用邊界：均勻矩形岸塊幾何估算，未轉成固體質量或下游輸砂量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place. Applicable boundary: Uniform rectangular bank-block estimate, not converted to solid mass or downstream sediment export.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「岸線遷移與土方體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Bank migration and eroded volume", which statement holds?
options: 水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place。
蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
optionsEn: Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=240 m; r=2.5 m; H=1.8 m; Ve=L*r*H=1080 m3 in-place. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 岸線遷移與土方體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Bank migration and eroded volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「岸線遷移與土方體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bank migration and eroded volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用相同高程與平面基準比較岸頂、岸趾及水下地形，量崩落塊體是否仍留在控制體內。若需換算質量，另採原位密度與含水資料；再用下游採樣判斷何時輸出，避免把體積直接當通量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare bank crest, toe and submerged terrain on common datums and measure failed blocks remaining inside the control volume. Mass conversion needs density and moisture data; downstream sampling identifies export timing instead of treating volume as a transport rate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將平均岸高增加三分之一重算體積，再假設一半崩塊暫留岸趾，列出剩餘輸出上限與所需證據。說明為何這仍不是完整輸砂歷線。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase mean bank height by one third and recalculate volume. Assume half remains at the toe, describe the remaining export bound and required evidence, and explain why this still does not provide a transport hydrograph.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅用岸頂退縮會漏掉水下掏空，也可能把斜坡整形當成天然侵蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Crest retreat alone can miss underwater undercutting or confuse grading with natural erosion. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用相同高程與平面基準比較岸頂、岸趾及水下地形，量崩落塊體是否仍留在控制體內。若需換算質量，另採原位密度與含水資料；再用下游採樣判斷何時輸出，避免把體積直接當通量。
knowledge.textEn: Compare bank crest, toe and submerged terrain on common datums and measure failed blocks remaining inside the control volume. Mass conversion needs density and moisture data; downstream sampling identifies export timing instead of treating volume as a transport rate.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將平均岸高增加三分之一重算體積，再假設一半崩塊暫留岸趾，列出剩餘輸出上限與所需證據。說明為何這仍不是完整輸砂歷線。
knowledge.textEn: Increase mean bank height by one third and recalculate volume. Assume half remains at the toe, describe the remaining export bound and required evidence, and explain why this still does not provide a transport hydrograph.

quiz.question: 要驗證「岸線遷移與土方體積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Bank migration and eroded volume"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
用相同高程與平面基準比較岸頂、岸趾及水下地形，量崩落塊體是否仍留在控制體內。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
Compare bank crest, toe and submerged terrain on common datums and measure failed blocks remaining inside the control volume.
quiz.explanation: 用相同高程與平面基準比較岸頂、岸趾及水下地形，量崩落塊體是否仍留在控制體內。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare bank crest, toe and submerged terrain on common datums and measure failed blocks remaining inside the control volume. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 岸線遷移與土方體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bank migration and eroded volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「岸線遷移與土方體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bank migration and eroded volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅用岸頂退縮會漏掉水下掏空，也可能把斜坡整形當成天然侵蝕。若忽略暫存崩塊，下游輸砂模型會過早加入全部土方而誇大峰值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Crest retreat alone can miss underwater undercutting or confuse grading with natural erosion. Ignoring stored blocks also injects all eroded material into a transport model too early and exaggerates downstream sediment peaks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：監測應區分平面遷移、體積侵蝕與輸出通量，避免把三個量互相代替。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitor planform movement, volumetric erosion and exported flux separately rather than substituting one quantity for another.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅用岸頂退縮會漏掉水下掏空，也可能把斜坡整形當成天然侵蝕。若忽略暫存崩塊，下游輸砂模型會過早加入全部土方而誇大峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Crest retreat alone can miss underwater undercutting or confuse grading with natural erosion. Ignoring stored blocks also injects all eroded material into a transport model too early and exaggerates downstream sediment peaks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「岸線遷移與土方體積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Bank migration and eroded volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 僅用岸頂退縮會漏掉水下掏空，也可能把斜坡整形當成天然侵蝕。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積
optionsEn: Crest retreat alone can miss underwater undercutting or confuse grading with natural erosion.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume
quiz.explanation: 僅用岸頂退縮會漏掉水下掏空，也可能把斜坡整形當成天然侵蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Crest retreat alone can miss underwater undercutting or confuse grading with natural erosion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「側汊連通的交換水量」與「河岸地下水交換」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Exchange volume through a side channel" and "Groundwater exchange across banks": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 側汊連通的交換水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Exchange volume through a side channel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「側汊連通的交換水量」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exchange volume through a side channel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 再連接側汊可改變主槽與洪氾地的水量、泥砂和生物交換，但流向可能隨主河水位升降而反轉。流量乘時間只適用於已知定常流段，變動事件需要逐時積分並保留正負號。流入量不等同淨蓄水，若另一出口同時排出，水體只是通過。設計應把入口、出口與內部水位畫成控制體，並關注過低水位時是否形成孤立水塘或阻斷生物退路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「側汊連通的交換水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reconnecting a side channel changes water, sediment and biological exchange with the main river, but direction can reverse as river stage rises and falls. Discharge times duration applies to a known steady interval; variable events require signed integration. Inflow is not net storage when another outlet simultaneously drains the area. Draw inlet, outlet and internal water levels as a control volume and examine whether low stages isolate pools or interrupt return routes for organisms. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exchange volume through a side channel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「側汊連通的交換水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Exchange volume through a side channel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 側汊連通的交換水量
knowledge.titleEn: Exchange volume through a side channel
knowledge.text: 再連接側汊可改變主槽與洪氾地的水量、泥砂和生物交換，但流向可能隨主河水位升降而反轉。流量乘時間只適用於已知定常流段，變動事件需要逐時積分並保留正負號。
knowledge.textEn: Reconnecting a side channel changes water, sediment and biological exchange with the main river, but direction can reverse as river stage rises and falls. Discharge times duration applies to a known steady interval; variable events require signed integration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「側汊連通的交換水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Exchange volume through a side channel" is correct?
options: 側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積
再連接側汊可改變主槽與洪氾地的水量、泥砂和生物交換，但流向可能隨主河水位升降而反轉。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
optionsEn: Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume
Reconnecting a side channel changes water, sediment and biological exchange with the main river, but direction can reverse as river stage rises and falls.
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
quiz.explanation: 再連接側汊可改變主槽與洪氾地的水量、泥砂和生物交換，但流向可能隨主河水位升降而反轉。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconnecting a side channel changes water, sediment and biological exchange with the main river, but direction can reverse as river stage rises and falls. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側汊連通的交換水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Exchange volume through a side channel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側汊連通的交換水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Exchange volume through a side channel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。適用邊界：定常向內流量之總流入體積，不等於淨蓄水或削峰量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3. Applicable boundary: Gross inflow volume during steady inward flow, not net storage or peak attenuation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量側汊入口及出口的水位與流量，採可辨方向的儀器並統一正號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure inlet and outlet levels and signed flows simultaneously.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。適用邊界：定常向內流量之總流入體積，不等於淨蓄水或削峰量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3. Applicable boundary: Gross inflow volume during steady inward flow, not net storage or peak attenuation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「側汊連通的交換水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Exchange volume through a side channel", which statement holds?
options: 兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。
optionsEn: Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
Mean bed slope equals the energy slope at every section and discharge
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Q=0.8 m3/s into-side-channel; dt=7200 s; Vin=Q*dt=5760 m3. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 側汊連通的交換水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Exchange volume through a side channel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側汊連通的交換水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Exchange volume through a side channel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量側汊入口及出口的水位與流量，採可辨方向的儀器並統一正號。將流量積分與水位容量變化比較，檢查地下滲漏或未量支路；退水期另追蹤斷流位置，確認連通性不是只有洪峰時存在。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure inlet and outlet levels and signed flows simultaneously. Compare integrated exchange with stage-storage change and investigate seepage or unmeasured branches. During recession, track where flow disconnects so connectivity is not assessed solely at the flood peak. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：加入每秒零點三立方公尺的同時出流，重算兩小時淨蓄水。再畫流向反轉的退水階段，指出積分正負號與生物退路各需如何檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add simultaneous outflow of zero point three cubic metres per second and compute net storage over two hours. Sketch reversal during recession and explain checks for both integration signs and organism return routes.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口未量而只記入口流量，會高估側汊蓄水效益；退水時若形成孤立池，還可能把先前進入的生物困住。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Recording only inlet flow exaggerates storage when an unmeasured outlet is active. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 同步量側汊入口及出口的水位與流量，採可辨方向的儀器並統一正號。將流量積分與水位容量變化比較，檢查地下滲漏或未量支路；退水期另追蹤斷流位置，確認連通性不是只有洪峰時存在。
knowledge.textEn: Measure inlet and outlet levels and signed flows simultaneously. Compare integrated exchange with stage-storage change and investigate seepage or unmeasured branches. During recession, track where flow disconnects so connectivity is not assessed solely at the flood peak.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 加入每秒零點三立方公尺的同時出流，重算兩小時淨蓄水。再畫流向反轉的退水階段，指出積分正負號與生物退路各需如何檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Add simultaneous outflow of zero point three cubic metres per second and compute net storage over two hours. Sketch reversal during recession and explain checks for both integration signs and organism return routes.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側汊連通的交換水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Exchange volume through a side channel"?
options: 同步量側汊入口及出口的水位與流量，採可辨方向的儀器並統一正號。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
幾何蓄水容量直接等於河川洪峰流量減少量
optionsEn: Measure inlet and outlet levels and signed flows simultaneously.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Geometric storage volume directly equals the reduction in river peak discharge
quiz.explanation: 同步量側汊入口及出口的水位與流量，採可辨方向的儀器並統一正號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure inlet and outlet levels and signed flows simultaneously. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 側汊連通的交換水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Exchange volume through a side channel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側汊連通的交換水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Exchange volume through a side channel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口未量而只記入口流量，會高估側汊蓄水效益；退水時若形成孤立池，還可能把先前進入的生物困住。需連續追蹤整個水位循環。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Recording only inlet flow exaggerates storage when an unmeasured outlet is active. Disconnected recession pools can also trap organisms that entered earlier, requiring observation across the complete stage cycle rather than only rising water. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：設計應把入口、出口與內部水位畫成控制體，並關注過低水位時是否形成孤立水塘或阻斷生物退路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Draw inlet, outlet and internal water levels as a control volume and examine whether low stages isolate pools or interrupt return routes for organisms.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出口未量而只記入口流量，會高估側汊蓄水效益；退水時若形成孤立池，還可能把先前進入的生物困住。需連續追蹤整個水位循環。
knowledge.textEn: Recording only inlet flow exaggerates storage when an unmeasured outlet is active. Disconnected recession pools can also trap organisms that entered earlier, requiring observation across the complete stage cycle rather than only rising water.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側汊連通的交換水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exchange volume through a side channel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
出口未量而只記入口流量，會高估側汊蓄水效益；退水時若形成孤立池，還可能把先前進入的生物困住。
達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Recording only inlet flow exaggerates storage when an unmeasured outlet is active.
Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores
quiz.explanation: 出口未量而只記入口流量，會高估側汊蓄水效益；退水時若形成孤立池，還可能把先前進入的生物困住。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Recording only inlet flow exaggerates storage when an unmeasured outlet is active. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 河岸地下水交換：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Groundwater exchange across banks: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「河岸地下水交換」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Groundwater exchange across banks” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河道復育改變水位與流路後，地下水可能向河道補注，也可能由河道暫時滲入岸土。達西式用水頭梯度與滲透係數估算體積通量，適用於已定義的飽和多孔介質控制面。孔隙中的平均實際流速還需要除有效孔隙率，不能把達西通量直接當成示蹤旅行速度。層狀沉積物可能有方向性，河床堵塞也會改變交換，所以監測須同時掌握水頭、介質與水質。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「河岸地下水交換」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Restoration can shift groundwater discharge to the river or drive temporary bank infiltration. Darcy's relation estimates volume flux from conductivity and head gradient across a defined saturated porous section. Average pore-water velocity additionally depends on effective porosity; Darcy flux is not directly tracer travel speed. Layering can create directional conductivity, and bed clogging can alter exchange. Monitor heads, sediment properties and water quality together to distinguish changes in hydraulic connection from changes in the source water. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Groundwater exchange across banks” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「河岸地下水交換」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Groundwater exchange across banks”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s。適用邊界：飽和均質一維定常達西流，水頭差方向已指定。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Saturated homogeneous one-dimensional steady Darcy flow with a specified head-gradient direction.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「河岸地下水交換」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Groundwater exchange across banks", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s。
蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
