quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: K=0.00002 m/s; A=300 m2; dh=0.4 m; L=20 m; Q=K*A*dh/L=0.00012 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 河岸地下水交換：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Groundwater exchange across banks: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「河岸地下水交換」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Groundwater exchange across banks” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在河道與岸內井使用同一高程基準量水頭，透過適合土層的試驗估滲透係數。以溫度或保守示蹤資料比對交換方向，若水頭響應有明顯延遲，應加入儲水與非定常效應而非維持定常假設。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure river and well heads on the same datum and estimate conductivity with tests appropriate to the strata. Compare exchange direction using temperature or conservative tracers. Delayed head responses require storage and transient effects instead of retaining a steady-flow assumption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將水頭差反向而大小不變，計算帶符號流量並畫交換方向。另指定有效孔隙率，說明由通量換算孔隙速度還需要哪個面積定義與流路假設。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reverse the head difference without changing magnitude and calculate signed discharge. Specify an effective porosity and explain the area definition and pathway assumptions needed to convert Darcy flux into average pore velocity.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以表層砂樣代表深部黏土夾層會高估交換量，堵塞層形成後原係數也可能失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using surface sand to represent a deeper clay layer exaggerates exchange, and new clogging can invalidate earlier conductivity estimates. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在河道與岸內井使用同一高程基準量水頭，透過適合土層的試驗估滲透係數。以溫度或保守示蹤資料比對交換方向，若水頭響應有明顯延遲，應加入儲水與非定常效應而非維持定常假設。
knowledge.textEn: Measure river and well heads on the same datum and estimate conductivity with tests appropriate to the strata. Compare exchange direction using temperature or conservative tracers. Delayed head responses require storage and transient effects instead of retaining a steady-flow assumption.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將水頭差反向而大小不變，計算帶符號流量並畫交換方向。另指定有效孔隙率，說明由通量換算孔隙速度還需要哪個面積定義與流路假設。
knowledge.textEn: Reverse the head difference without changing magnitude and calculate signed discharge. Specify an effective porosity and explain the area definition and pathway assumptions needed to convert Darcy flux into average pore velocity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「河岸地下水交換」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Groundwater exchange across banks"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在河道與岸內井使用同一高程基準量水頭，透過適合土層的試驗估滲透係數。
橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure river and well heads on the same datum and estimate conductivity with tests appropriate to the strata.
A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode
quiz.explanation: 在河道與岸內井使用同一高程基準量水頭，透過適合土層的試驗估滲透係數。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure river and well heads on the same datum and estimate conductivity with tests appropriate to the strata. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 河岸地下水交換：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Groundwater exchange across banks: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「河岸地下水交換」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Groundwater exchange across banks” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以表層砂樣代表深部黏土夾層會高估交換量，堵塞層形成後原係數也可能失效。若模型流量大但示蹤反應弱，應查層理與有效連通面積。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using surface sand to represent a deeper clay layer exaggerates exchange, and new clogging can invalidate earlier conductivity estimates. Large modeled flux with weak tracer response warrants checking layering and the effectively connected area. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：層狀沉積物可能有方向性，河床堵塞也會改變交換，所以監測須同時掌握水頭、介質與水質。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Monitor heads, sediment properties and water quality together to distinguish changes in hydraulic connection from changes in the source water.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「達西通量就是孔隙中每個水粒子的實際移動速度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Darcy flux is the actual speed of every water particle inside the pores" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以表層砂樣代表深部黏土夾層會高估交換量，堵塞層形成後原係數也可能失效。若模型流量大但示蹤反應弱，應查層理與有效連通面積。
knowledge.textEn: Using surface sand to represent a deeper clay layer exaggerates exchange, and new clogging can invalidate earlier conductivity estimates. Large modeled flux with weak tracer response warrants checking layering and the effectively connected area.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「河岸地下水交換」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Groundwater exchange across banks" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間
以表層砂樣代表深部黏土夾層會高估交換量，堵塞層形成後原係數也可能失效。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream
Using surface sand to represent a deeper clay layer exaggerates exchange, and new clogging can invalidate earlier conductivity estimates.
quiz.explanation: 以表層砂樣代表深部黏土夾層會高估交換量，堵塞層形成後原係數也可能失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using surface sand to represent a deeper clay layer exaggerates exchange, and new clogging can invalidate earlier conductivity estimates. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水體平移與洪波傳播」與「地形差分的量測不確定性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Water advection and flood-wave travel" and "Uncertainty in terrain differences": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Water advection and flood-wave travel: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水體平移與洪波傳播」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Water advection and flood-wave travel” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 河道延長可能增加水體沿流路的平移時間，但洪波傳播速度並不等於水粒子平均流速。以長度除速度得到的是固定速度的平流尺度，未計彌散、死水交換或水位波形變化。示蹤物可能早到也可能留下長尾，洪峰則受蓄水及邊界影響。評估復育的時間效益時，應分別量測示蹤突破、洪水歷線與局部流速，避免用水的旅行時間直接宣稱下游洪峰必然延後同樣秒數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水體平移與洪波傳播」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Lengthening can increase water-parcel advection time, but flood-wave celerity differs from mean parcel velocity. Length divided by velocity gives a constant-speed advection scale without dispersion, inactive-zone exchange or changing wave shape. Tracers can arrive early and leave long tails, while flood peaks depend on storage and boundaries. Evaluate tracer breakthrough, hydrographs and local velocity separately rather than claiming downstream peak delay directly from the calculated travel time of water parcels through the restored reach. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Water advection and flood-wave travel” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水體平移與洪波傳播」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Water advection and flood-wave travel”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播
knowledge.text: 河道延長可能增加水體沿流路的平移時間，但洪波傳播速度並不等於水粒子平均流速。以長度除速度得到的是固定速度的平流尺度，未計彌散、死水交換或水位波形變化。
knowledge.textEn: Lengthening can increase water-parcel advection time, but flood-wave celerity differs from mean parcel velocity. Length divided by velocity gives a constant-speed advection scale without dispersion, inactive-zone exchange or changing wave shape.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水體平移與洪波傳播」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Water advection and flood-wave travel" is correct?
options: 河道延長可能增加水體沿流路的平移時間，但洪波傳播速度並不等於水粒子平均流速。
水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間
兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
optionsEn: Lengthening can increase water-parcel advection time, but flood-wave celerity differs from mean parcel velocity.
Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream
Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
quiz.explanation: 河道延長可能增加水體沿流路的平移時間，但洪波傳播速度並不等於水粒子平均流速。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Lengthening can increase water-parcel advection time, but flood-wave celerity differs from mean parcel velocity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Water advection and flood-wave travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水體平移與洪波傳播」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Water advection and flood-wave travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s。適用邊界：定常均速平流時間尺度，不是洪峰傳播或完整示蹤停留分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s. Applicable boundary: Steady uniform advection scale, not flood-peak travel or a full tracer residence distribution. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L=1800 m; u=0.6 m/s; ta=L/u=3000 s。適用邊界：定常均速平流時間尺度，不是洪峰傳播或完整示蹤停留分布。

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水體平移與洪波傳播」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Water advection and flood-wave travel", which statement holds?
options: 河道平均床坡就是所有流量下每一斷面的能量坡度

steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Water advection and flood-wave travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水體平移與洪波傳播」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Water advection and flood-wave travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。比較首達、質心與峰值時間，並說明各自物理意義；若差異大，檢查死水交換及沿程支流，不能任選最有利數字。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves. Compare first arrival, centroid and peak times with their distinct meanings. Large differences warrant checking inactive-zone exchange and tributaries rather than selecting a favourable statistic. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將平均流速降低兩成重算平流時間，再畫一條有長尾的示蹤曲線及一條洪水歷線。標出不能直接互換的時間，列出檢驗削峰所需額外資料。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce mean velocity by twenty percent and recalculate advection time. Draw a long-tailed tracer curve and a flood hydrograph, label noninterchangeable times, and identify additional evidence needed to evaluate peak attenuation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。比較首達、質心與峰值時間，並說明各自物理意義；若差異大，檢查死水交換及沿程支流，不能任選最有利數字。
knowledge.textEn: Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves. Compare first arrival, centroid and peak times with their distinct meanings. Large differences warrant checking inactive-zone exchange and tributaries rather than selecting a favourable statistic.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將平均流速降低兩成重算平流時間，再畫一條有長尾的示蹤曲線及一條洪水歷線。標出不能直接互換的時間，列出檢驗削峰所需額外資料。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce mean velocity by twenty percent and recalculate advection time. Draw a long-tailed tracer curve and a flood hydrograph, label noninterchangeable times, and identify additional evidence needed to evaluate peak attenuation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水體平移與洪波傳播」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Water advection and flood-wave travel"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
岸坡流失的原位體積必然在同一時刻全部通過下游斷面
在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
All in-place bank erosion volume necessarily passes the downstream section at the same moment
Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves.
quiz.explanation: 在合法且適合的示蹤試驗中量測上下游濃度曲線，另用同步水位流量觀測洪波。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use an appropriate authorized tracer test for concentration histories and synchronized level-discharge observations for flood waves. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水體平移與洪波傳播：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Water advection and flood-wave travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水體平移與洪波傳播」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Water advection and flood-wave travel” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。應根據問題選指標，避免混用不同時間尺度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence. Choose the time metric for the actual question instead of mixing different transport and wave processes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：評估復育的時間效益時，應分別量測示蹤突破、洪水歷線與局部流速，避免用水的旅行時間直接宣稱下游洪峰必然延後同樣秒數。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Evaluate tracer breakthrough, hydrographs and local velocity separately rather than claiming downstream peak delay directly from the calculated travel time of water parcels through the restored reach.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「水粒子旅行時間一定等於洪水峰值傳到下游的時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water-parcel travel time always equals the time for a flood peak to reach downstream" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。應根據問題選指標，避免混用不同時間尺度。
knowledge.textEn: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence. Choose the time metric for the actual question instead of mixing different transport and wave processes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水體平移與洪波傳播」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Water advection and flood-wave travel" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
optionsEn: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
quiz.explanation: 把示蹤質心時間當洪峰延遲，可能誇大防洪效果；相反地，忽略長尾也會低估污染物停留。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using tracer-centroid travel as flood-peak delay can exaggerate protection, while ignoring long tails understates contaminant persistence. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「地形差分的量測不確定性」如何影響河川再蜿蜒工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Uncertainty in terrain differences” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “River remeandering works”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。兩期獨立隨機高程誤差的標準差可用平方和開根號合成，若兩期共享基準偏差或植生遮蔽，獨立假設便不成立。單點標準差也不等於整個土方體積的誤差，空間相關會改變總量不確定性。分析應先分離系統偏差與隨機分散，再清楚報告檢出尺度，而不把所有不同顏色像元當成真實侵蝕或沉積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「地形差分的量測不確定性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. Independent random elevation standard deviations combine by root sum of squares; shared datum errors or vegetation bias violate independence. Point uncertainty also differs from volume uncertainty because spatial correlation affects aggregation. Separate systematic bias from random scatter and state the detection scale clearly, rather than interpreting every coloured difference pixel as real morphological change or assigning confidence without an explicit error model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Uncertainty in terrain differences” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「地形差分的量測不確定性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Uncertainty in terrain differences”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性
knowledge.text: 工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。兩期獨立隨機高程誤差的標準差可用平方和開根號合成，若兩期共享基準偏差或植生遮蔽，獨立假設便不成立。
knowledge.textEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. Independent random elevation standard deviations combine by root sum of squares; shared datum errors or vegetation bias violate independence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「地形差分的量測不確定性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Uncertainty in terrain differences" is correct?
options: 兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化
工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。
蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
optionsEn: Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change
Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
quiz.explanation: 工程前後地形差分可找出沖淤，但小變化可能只是測量誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Terrain differencing reveals erosion and deposition, but small changes may be survey noise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「地形差分的量測不確定性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Uncertainty in terrain differences” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。適用邊界：兩期獨立零均值隨機誤差的差分標準差，非自動的可信界限。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m. Applicable boundary: Difference standard deviation for independent zero-mean random errors, not an automatic confidence bound. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。適用邊界：兩期獨立零均值隨機誤差的差分標準差，非自動的可信界限。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m. Applicable boundary: Difference standard deviation for independent zero-mean random errors, not an automatic confidence bound.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「地形差分的量測不確定性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Uncertainty in terrain differences", which statement holds?
options: 曼寧粗糙係數只由材料決定且永遠不隨水深改變
橫向水面差很小就能證明外彎岸坡不會沖刷
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。
optionsEn: Manning roughness depends only on material and never changes with water depth
A small transverse water-level difference proves that the outer bank will not erode
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: s1=0.03 m; s2=0.04 m; sd=sqrt(s1^2+s2^2)=0.05 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「地形差分的量測不確定性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Uncertainty in terrain differences” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。用獨立控制點驗證，並分別報裸地與植生區精度；設定檢出門檻時需交代誤差分布及採用的信心水準。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Validate with independent control points and separate bare-ground from vegetated accuracy. Any detection threshold needs a stated error distribution and confidence level. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：假設第二期標準差降到兩公分，重算差分精度並比較改善幅度。再提出兩期誤差相關的情況，說明為何不能繼續使用獨立平方和公式宣稱同樣精度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the second survey standard deviation to two centimetres and recompute difference uncertainty. Describe a source of correlated errors and explain why the independent root-sum-square formula would then require modification before claiming equivalent accuracy.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。用獨立控制點驗證，並分別報裸地與植生區精度；設定檢出門檻時需交代誤差分布及採用的信心水準。
knowledge.textEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Validate with independent control points and separate bare-ground from vegetated accuracy. Any detection threshold needs a stated error distribution and confidence level.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 假設第二期標準差降到兩公分，重算差分精度並比較改善幅度。再提出兩期誤差相關的情況，說明為何不能繼續使用獨立平方和公式宣稱同樣精度。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce the second survey standard deviation to two centimetres and recompute difference uncertainty. Describe a source of correlated errors and explain why the independent root-sum-square formula would then require modification before claiming equivalent accuracy.

quiz.question: 要驗證「地形差分的量測不確定性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Uncertainty in terrain differences"?
options: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
側汊總流入體積就是側汊最後增加的淨蓄水體積
optionsEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Total side-channel inflow equals its final increase in net stored volume
quiz.explanation: 在穩定未變區檢查兩期高程偏差，先校正可識別系統差，再分析殘差分布與空間相關。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check differences on stable ground, correct identifiable systematic shifts, and examine residual distributions and spatial correlation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 地形差分的量測不確定性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Uncertainty in terrain differences: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地形差分的量測不確定性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Uncertainty in terrain differences” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。若差分呈現整區同號，應先查基準及分類再解釋地形過程。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. Region-wide differences of one sign call for checking datum and classification before interpreting geomorphic processes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：分析應先分離系統偏差與隨機分散，再清楚報告檢出尺度，而不把所有不同顏色像元當成真實侵蝕或沉積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Separate systematic bias from random scatter and state the detection scale clearly, rather than interpreting every coloured difference pixel as real morphological change or assigning confidence without an explicit error model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩期地形圖任何非零差值都代表真實河床變化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every nonzero difference between two terrain surveys represents real bed change" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。若差分呈現整區同號，應先查基準及分類再解釋地形過程。
knowledge.textEn: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. Region-wide differences of one sign call for checking datum and classification before interpreting geomorphic processes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地形差分的量測不確定性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Uncertainty in terrain differences" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。
蜿蜒度較大必然代表所有生態功能與防洪能力較好
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground.
Greater sinuosity necessarily means better ecological function and flood protection in every respect
quiz.explanation: 未校正的共同高程偏移會讓整段河道看似淤積或侵蝕，植生高度也可能被當成地面。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An uncorrected datum shift can make the whole reach appear to deposit or erode, and vegetation may be mistaken for ground. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 洪水預報與水庫聯合操作
courses.titleEn: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation
courses.summary: 將預報誤差、河道傳播時間、庫容與下游通洪能力放在同一個運算框架，練習集合機率、校準、預洩與衝突限制辨識。教材以兩座假想水庫展示聯合操作所需的狀態和責任邊界，計算結果只作方法教學，實際操作仍需正式規程與有權機關決策。
courses.summaryEn: Place forecast uncertainty, routing time, storage and downstream capacity in one calculation framework. Exercises cover ensemble probabilities, calibration, prerelease and conflicting constraints. Two hypothetical reservoirs illustrate the states and responsibilities required for coordinated operation. Results teach methods rather than authorize releases; real decisions require approved operating rules, current observations and the responsible institutions.
courses.focus: 以集合預報、守恆與限制條件協調多水庫防洪
courses.focusEn: Coordinating reservoir flood operations using ensembles, conservation and constraints
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 本課先用「集合超越機率」建立原創假想基準，再以「分位數與有限成員」檢查另一個控制機制。第一組輸入及結果為 Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless；第二組為 ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。學員需在同一張工作表分列量綱、時間、位置與適用範圍，先核對守恆，再解釋為何兩個得數不能互相代替。最後以第三單元提出的量測設計驗證假設，並將超出模型能力的水理、生態或治理問題列為待研究項目；這些示例並非所列案例的現場實測。敏感度重算：保持 N=20 個等權成員及同一流量門檻，把超越成員 Ne 從 8 增至 10，經驗比例由 0.4 增至 0.5，也就是增加十個百分點。這不是證明真實風險上升同樣幅度，仍須用獨立事件檢驗機率校準。
workedExample.textEn: Begin with an original hypothetical baseline for Ensemble exceedance probability and examine another controlling mechanism through Quantiles with finite ensembles. The first inputs and result are Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless; the second are ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Keep dimensions, time, location and validity conditions in separate columns of the same working sheet. Check conservation before explaining why the two numerical results cannot substitute for one another. Use the third unit measurement design to test assumptions and identify hydraulic, ecological or governance questions that exceed the model. These examples are not field observations from the named reference cases. Sensitivity recalculation: Keep N=20 equally weighted members and the same flow threshold, increasing exceedances Ne from 8 to 10. The empirical fraction rises from 0.4 to 0.5, an increase of ten percentage points. This does not prove an equal change in true risk; probability calibration still requires independent events.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集合超越機率」與「分位數與有限成員」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ensemble exceedance probability" and "Quantiles with finite ensembles": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集合超越機率」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ensemble exceedance probability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。這些成員不一定相互獨立，也可能共享降雨偏差，因此比例不是自然界真實機率的保證。門檻必須對應同一地點、時段與流量定義，瞬時峰值不能與日平均混用。操作比較應同時看後果與機率，並透過過往未參與校準的事件檢查可靠度，而不是只選最樂觀的成員作決策依據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集合超越機率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. Members may be dependent or share rainfall bias, so the fraction is not a guarantee of nature's true probability. Match location, lead period and discharge definition; instantaneous peaks differ from daily means. Compare consequences as well as probabilities, and evaluate reliability on events excluded from calibration instead of basing decisions on the most optimistic member. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ensemble exceedance probability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集合超越機率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ensemble exceedance probability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集合超越機率
knowledge.text: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。這些成員不一定相互獨立，也可能共享降雨偏差，因此比例不是自然界真實機率的保證。
knowledge.textEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. Members may be dependent or share rainfall bias, so the fraction is not a guarantee of nature's true probability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集合超越機率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ensemble exceedance probability" is correct?
options: 集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
optionsEn: Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability.
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
quiz.explanation: 集合預報用多個可能情境表達不確定性，超過指定流量門檻的成員比例可作經驗超越機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: An ensemble expresses uncertainty through alternative scenarios, and the fraction exceeding a threshold gives an empirical exceedance probability. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集合超越機率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ensemble exceedance probability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境的經驗比例，非已驗證校準之真實洪水機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Empirical fraction of equally weighted scenarios, not a demonstrated calibrated probability of flooding. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境的經驗比例，非已驗證校準之真實洪水機率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Empirical fraction of equally weighted scenarios, not a demonstrated calibrated probability of flooding.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集合超越機率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ensemble exceedance probability", which statement holds?
options: 水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。
optionsEn: A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Ne=8 members above-threshold; N=20 equally-weighted-members; p=Ne/N=0.4 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集合超越機率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ensemble exceedance probability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。用獨立歷史預報回放分組比較預報機率和實際發生頻率，保留漏報與誤報紀錄，並確認沒有事後雨量被偷偷加入當時預報。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Use independent forecast replays to compare probability groups with observed frequencies, retaining misses and false alarms and ensuring later rainfall observations were not inserted into earlier forecasts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持二十個等權成員，將超越數增加到十個重算比例。說明需要哪些歷史樣本才能檢查這個機率是否可靠，並列出成員相關可能造成的限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep twenty equally weighted members and increase exceedances to ten. Recalculate the fraction, identify historical samples needed to test reliability, and describe limitations caused by dependence between ensemble members across the forecast set.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。用獨立歷史預報回放分組比較預報機率和實際發生頻率，保留漏報與誤報紀錄，並確認沒有事後雨量被偷偷加入當時預報。
knowledge.textEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Use independent forecast replays to compare probability groups with observed frequencies, retaining misses and false alarms and ensuring later rainfall observations were not inserted into earlier forecasts.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持二十個等權成員，將超越數增加到十個重算比例。說明需要哪些歷史樣本才能檢查這個機率是否可靠，並列出成員相關可能造成的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Keep twenty equally weighted members and increase exceedances to ten. Recalculate the fraction, identify historical samples needed to test reliability, and describe limitations caused by dependence between ensemble members across the forecast set.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集合超越機率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Ensemble exceedance probability"?
options: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
optionsEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied
quiz.explanation: 固定預報發布時刻、有效時段與斷面門檻，逐一檢查成員是否超越。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Fix issue time, valid period and section threshold before counting exceedances. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集合超越機率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ensemble exceedance probability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集合超越機率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ensemble exceedance probability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。若只用集合範圍當絕對上下界，會掩蓋共同模式誤差，需以獨立事件檢查可靠度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Treating its range as an absolute physical bound conceals shared model error, requiring reliability checks against independent observed events. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：操作比較應同時看後果與機率，並透過過往未參與校準的事件檢查可靠度，而不是只選最樂觀的成員作決策依據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare consequences as well as probabilities, and evaluate reliability on events excluded from calibration instead of basing decisions on the most optimistic member.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。若只用集合範圍當絕對上下界，會掩蓋共同模式誤差，需以獨立事件檢查可靠度。
knowledge.textEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Treating its range as an absolute physical bound conceals shared model error, requiring reliability checks against independent observed events.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集合超越機率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Ensemble exceedance probability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement.
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
quiz.explanation: 集合全部偏低時，即使成員看似一致也可能漏掉洪水。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A consistently low ensemble can miss flooding despite strong member agreement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「分位數與有限成員」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quantiles with finite ensembles” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。分位數描述預報分布的位置，不是平均值的信賴區間，也不是所有可能洪水的上限。比較不同系統時應保留相同分位數定義、權重與有效時段，並報告成員數。操作評估還需檢視完整歷線，因為單一峰值分位數可能無法代表水量和峰值到達時間之間的關係。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「分位數與有限成員」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. A quantile locates a forecast distribution; it is neither a confidence interval for the mean nor a bound on every possible flood. Preserve definitions, weights and valid periods when comparing systems, and report member count. Examine complete hydrographs because a peak quantile alone may miss relationships between flood volume and arrival time that matter for storage decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Quantiles with finite ensembles” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「分位數與有限成員」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Quantiles with finite ensembles”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 分位數與有限成員
knowledge.text: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。分位數描述預報分布的位置，不是平均值的信賴區間，也不是所有可能洪水的上限。
knowledge.textEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. A quantile locates a forecast distribution; it is neither a confidence interval for the mean nor a bound on every possible flood.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「分位數與有限成員」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Quantiles with finite ensembles" is correct?
options: 九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。
optionsEn: The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes.
quiz.explanation: 集合分位數把排序後的情境濃縮為可讀摘要，但小集合的高分位數會對插值規則及個別極端成員敏感。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Ensemble quantiles summarize ordered scenarios, but high quantiles in a small set are sensitive to interpolation and individual extremes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「分位數與有限成員」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Quantiles with finite ensembles” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。適用邊界：指定線性插值經驗分位數，五個成員不能證明尾部分布校準。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Specified linearly interpolated empirical quantile; five members do not establish tail calibration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。適用邊界：指定線性插值經驗分位數，五個成員不能證明尾部分布校準。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Specified linearly interpolated empirical quantile; five members do not establish tail calibration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「分位數與有限成員」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Quantiles with finite ensembles", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。
同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行

Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: ordered-flows=[80,100,120,140,160] m3/s; q=0.9 dimensionless; h=(5-1)*q=3.6 zero-based-rank; Qq=140+0.6*(160-140)=152 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「分位數與有限成員」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Quantiles with finite ensembles” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。用另一種常見分位數定義做差異檢查，若高分位變動大，應報成員有限造成的不穩定，而不是隱藏選法。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Compare an alternative quantile convention. Large high-quantile differences should be reported as finite-ensemble instability rather than concealed by an undocumented choice of method. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把最高成員改成每秒二百立方公尺重算同一分位數，其他值與定義不變。說明單一成員敏感度如何影響解讀，並保留原始情境供水量分析。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only the largest member to two hundred cubic metres per second and recompute the same quantile. Explain sensitivity to one member and retain complete scenarios for subsequent flood-volume analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。用另一種常見分位數定義做差異檢查，若高分位變動大，應報成員有限造成的不穩定，而不是隱藏選法。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Compare an alternative quantile convention. Large high-quantile differences should be reported as finite-ensemble instability rather than concealed by an undocumented choice of method.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把最高成員改成每秒二百立方公尺重算同一分位數，其他值與定義不變。說明單一成員敏感度如何影響解讀，並保留原始情境供水量分析。
knowledge.textEn: Change only the largest member to two hundred cubic metres per second and recompute the same quantile. Explain sensitivity to one member and retain complete scenarios for subsequent flood-volume analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「分位數與有限成員」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Quantiles with finite ensembles"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。
情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output.
Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
quiz.explanation: 保存原始排序值與使用的插值規則，手算相鄰兩成員及權重，再與軟體結果比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserve sorted values and interpolation rules, manually checking neighbouring members and weights against software output. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 分位數與有限成員：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Quantiles with finite ensembles: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「分位數與有限成員」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Quantiles with finite ensembles” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。應標示此為摘要包絡，不能當成一個一致情境。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Label such a curve as a summary envelope rather than treating it as one dynamically consistent forecast scenario. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：操作評估還需檢視完整歷線，因為單一峰值分位數可能無法代表水量和峰值到達時間之間的關係。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Examine complete hydrographs because a peak quantile alone may miss relationships between flood volume and arrival time that matter for storage decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。應標示此為摘要包絡，不能當成一個一致情境。
knowledge.textEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Label such a curve as a summary envelope rather than treating it as one dynamically consistent forecast scenario.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「分位數與有限成員」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Quantiles with finite ensembles" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member.
quiz.explanation: 若把不同時刻的各自高分位拼成一條歷線，可能產生不存在於任何成員的水量與峰型組合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Joining pointwise high quantiles can create a volume and peak shape found in no individual member. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「機率預報的布里爾分數」與「水庫時段水量守恆」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Brier score for probability forecasts" and "Reservoir interval water balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 機率預報的布里爾分數：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Brier score for probability forecasts: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「機率預報的布里爾分數」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Brier score for probability forecasts” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 布里爾分數以預報機率與二元觀測的平方差衡量機率誤差，數值較小通常表示較好的整體配對，但不直接說明每一次決策的損失。評估事件必須使用相同門檻與預報提前時間，並包含未發生洪水的情況，否則會扭曲分數。不同地區的基準發生率會影響比較，因此還需與適當參考預報對照。可靠度、辨識度及資料不足的問題應分開診斷，避免把一個平均分數當作完整風險認證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「機率預報的布里爾分數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The Brier score averages squared differences between probabilities and binary outcomes. Lower values generally indicate better matching but do not directly measure the loss from each decision. Use consistent thresholds and lead times and include non-events; selecting only floods distorts the score. Different base rates also affect comparisons, requiring an appropriate reference forecast. Diagnose reliability, discrimination and sample limitations separately rather than treating one average score as complete certification of operational risk or forecast quality. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Brier score for probability forecasts” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「機率預報的布里爾分數」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Brier score for probability forecasts”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 機率預報的布里爾分數
knowledge.text: 布里爾分數以預報機率與二元觀測的平方差衡量機率誤差，數值較小通常表示較好的整體配對，但不直接說明每一次決策的損失。評估事件必須使用相同門檻與預報提前時間，並包含未發生洪水的情況，否則會扭曲分數。
knowledge.textEn: The Brier score averages squared differences between probabilities and binary outcomes. Lower values generally indicate better matching but do not directly measure the loss from each decision.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「機率預報的布里爾分數」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Brier score for probability forecasts" is correct?
options: 布里爾分數以預報機率與二元觀測的平方差衡量機率誤差，數值較小通常表示較好的整體配對，但不直接說明每一次決策的損失。
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加
optionsEn: The Brier score averages squared differences between probabilities and binary outcomes.
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase
quiz.explanation: 布里爾分數以預報機率與二元觀測的平方差衡量機率誤差，數值較小通常表示較好的整體配對，但不直接說明每一次決策的損失。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The Brier score averages squared differences between probabilities and binary outcomes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 機率預報的布里爾分數：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Brier score for probability forecasts: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「機率預報的布里爾分數」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Brier score for probability forecasts” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless。適用邊界：四筆獨立保留樣本的示範平均，不代表已完成長期服務驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Illustrative average for four held-out cases, not validation of a long-term forecasting service. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將預報檔案凍結在發布時刻，核對每一筆門檻與後來觀測，再逐項列平方誤差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Freeze forecasts at issue time and match thresholds to subsequent observations before listing each squared error.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless。適用邊界：四筆獨立保留樣本的示範平均，不代表已完成長期服務驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Illustrative average for four held-out cases, not validation of a long-term forecasting service.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「機率預報的布里爾分數」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Brier score for probability forecasts", which statement holds?
options: 下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless。

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: probabilities=[0.2,0.7,0.6,0.1] dimensionless; outcomes=[0,1,1,0] binary; BS=(0.2^2+(0.7-1)^2+(0.6-1)^2+0.1^2)/4=0.075 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 機率預報的布里爾分數：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Brier score for probability forecasts: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「機率預報的布里爾分數」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Brier score for probability forecasts” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將預報檔案凍結在發布時刻，核對每一筆門檻與後來觀測，再逐項列平方誤差。另報事件數、非事件數及基準分數，分提前時間比較，避免把較容易的短期預報混入後宣稱長期能力改善。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Freeze forecasts at issue time and match thresholds to subsequent observations before listing each squared error. Report event and non-event counts with reference scores, separating lead times so easier short-range cases do not create a misleading claim of long-range improvement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第三筆機率從零點六改成零點八，其餘不變重算分數。說明這次改善為何不能保證所有未來事件都較好，並提出需增加的樣本分層方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change the third probability from zero point six to zero point eight and recalculate. Explain why improvement on this case does not guarantee future performance, then propose additional strata for evaluating a larger sample.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑曾經發生大洪水的日期會破壞原本機率樣本，使過度警報的系統看似合理。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Selecting only major-flood dates distorts the probability sample and can make frequent over-warning look reasonable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將預報檔案凍結在發布時刻，核對每一筆門檻與後來觀測，再逐項列平方誤差。另報事件數、非事件數及基準分數，分提前時間比較，避免把較容易的短期預報混入後宣稱長期能力改善。
knowledge.textEn: Freeze forecasts at issue time and match thresholds to subsequent observations before listing each squared error. Report event and non-event counts with reference scores, separating lead times so easier short-range cases do not create a misleading claim of long-range improvement.
