knowledge.textEn: Change the third probability from zero point six to zero point eight and recalculate. Explain why improvement on this case does not guarantee future performance, then propose additional strata for evaluating a larger sample.

quiz.question: 要驗證「機率預報的布里爾分數」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Brier score for probability forecasts"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
將預報檔案凍結在發布時刻，核對每一筆門檻與後來觀測，再逐項列平方誤差。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
Freeze forecasts at issue time and match thresholds to subsequent observations before listing each squared error.

quiz.explanationEn: Freeze forecasts at issue time and match thresholds to subsequent observations before listing each squared error. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 機率預報的布里爾分數：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Brier score for probability forecasts: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「機率預報的布里爾分數」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Brier score for probability forecasts” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只挑曾經發生大洪水的日期會破壞原本機率樣本，使過度警報的系統看似合理。若評估資料由結果篩選，應重新建立完整發布紀錄。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Selecting only major-flood dates distorts the probability sample and can make frequent over-warning look reasonable. An outcome-selected evaluation needs rebuilding from the complete issue archive, including dates on which the event did not occur. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：可靠度、辨識度及資料不足的問題應分開診斷，避免把一個平均分數當作完整風險認證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Diagnose reliability, discrimination and sample limitations separately rather than treating one average score as complete certification of operational risk or forecast quality.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只挑曾經發生大洪水的日期會破壞原本機率樣本，使過度警報的系統看似合理。若評估資料由結果篩選，應重新建立完整發布紀錄。
knowledge.textEn: Selecting only major-flood dates distorts the probability sample and can make frequent over-warning look reasonable. An outcome-selected evaluation needs rebuilding from the complete issue archive, including dates on which the event did not occur.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 水庫時段水量守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Reservoir interval water balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水庫時段水量守恆」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Reservoir interval water balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯合操作必須先確保每座水庫的入流、出流與庫容變化閉合，否則優化可能在不存在的水量上作決策。時段兩端流量線性變化時可用梯形積分，若洪峰在中間突起，端點平均便可能漏算重要水量。蒸發、取水與溢流應依時間尺度決定是否列入，省略時需明示。庫容還必須透過現行水位容量曲線與觀測對照，不能把高程差直接當成體積差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水庫時段水量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Coordinated operation first requires each reservoir's inflow, outflow and storage to balance; otherwise optimization acts on nonexistent water. Trapezoidal integration is appropriate for linearly changing endpoint flows, but can miss an interior peak. Include or explicitly neglect evaporation, withdrawals and spill according to the time scale. Compare storage with observations through a current stage-storage relation, because elevation change is not itself a volume change and sediment accumulation can alter that relation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Reservoir interval water balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：I0=100 m3/s; I1=180 m3/s; O0=80 m3/s; O1=120 m3/s; dt=3600 s; dS=((I0+I1)-(O0+O1))*dt/2=144000 m3。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: I0=100 m3/s; I1=180 m3/s; O0=80 m3/s; O1=120 m3/s; dt=3600 s; dS=((I0+I1)-(O0+O1))*dt/2=144000 m3.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水庫時段水量守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Reservoir interval water balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水庫時段水量守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加

steps.title: 水庫時段水量守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Reservoir interval water balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水庫時段水量守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reservoir interval water balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：I0=100 m3/s; I1=180 m3/s; O0=80 m3/s; O1=120 m3/s; dt=3600 s; dS=((I0+I1)-(O0+O1))*dt/2=144000 m3。適用邊界：時段流量線性變化且無其他水量項，僅求庫容增量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: I0=100 m3/s; I1=180 m3/s; O0=80 m3/s; O1=120 m3/s; dt=3600 s; dS=((I0+I1)-(O0+O1))*dt/2=144000 m3. Applicable boundary: Linearly changing flows without other water terms; calculates storage increment only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先統一流量時戳及單位，以較細時間資料檢查梯形近似，再用水位容量曲線估觀測增量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Align timestamps and units, test the trapezoidal approximation with finer records, and compare storage change inferred from the stage-storage curve.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Applicable boundary: Linearly changing flows without other water terms; calculates storage increment only.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 水庫時段水量守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Reservoir interval water balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水庫時段水量守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reservoir interval water balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先統一流量時戳及單位，以較細時間資料檢查梯形近似，再用水位容量曲線估觀測增量。分列取水、洩漏及溢流，若殘差集中在洪峰時，應查取樣頻率與測站延遲，不先任意修改入流。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Align timestamps and units, test the trapezoidal approximation with finer records, and compare storage change inferred from the stage-storage curve. List withdrawals, leakage and spill. Peak-centred residuals require checking sampling and station delays before arbitrarily adjusting inflow. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將時段縮短一半而保留相同端點流量假設，重算庫容增量並說明線性假設改變了什麼。再加入一個時段中間峰值，提出更適合的積分方式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Halve the interval while retaining the endpoint-flow assumptions and recompute storage change, explaining the altered linear trajectory. Add an interior peak and propose an integration approach that can capture its volume.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：流量資料以小時標記卻被當成秒積分，會造成巨大水量誤差；測站傳輸延遲也可能讓入出流錯配。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating hourly labels as seconds creates major volume errors, while telemetry delays can pair mismatched inflow and outflow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: When "Reservoir interval water balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
流量資料以小時標記卻被當成秒積分，會造成巨大水量誤差；測站傳輸延遲也可能讓入出流錯配。
同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Treating hourly labels as seconds creates major volume errors, while telemetry delays can pair mismatched inflow and outflow.
Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
quiz.explanation: 流量資料以小時標記卻被當成秒積分，會造成巨大水量誤差；測站傳輸延遲也可能讓入出流錯配。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating hourly labels as seconds creates major volume errors, while telemetry delays can pair mismatched inflow and outflow. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「匯流點的同步疊加」與「下游剩餘通洪額度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Aligned flows at a junction" and "Residual downstream flow allowance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 匯流點的同步疊加：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Aligned flows at a junction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「匯流點的同步疊加」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Aligned flows at a junction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多水庫出流在下游匯流點相遇時，必須先經河道演算對齊到達時間，不能把不同水庫同一發布時刻的流量直接相加。支流洪峰可能與水庫洩流錯峰或疊峰，傳播過程也有蓄水與波形變化。本單元只在已演算到同一斷面同一時刻的流量上做守恆相加，明確把路由工作放在前置條件。操作比較應保存每股貢獻歷線，才能追溯下游超限來自哪個時段和來源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「匯流點的同步疊加」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reservoir releases must be routed and aligned at the downstream junction before addition; flows issued at the same clock time upstream need not arrive together. Tributary peaks can coincide or separate, while channel storage changes timing and shape. This unit adds contributions already routed to one section and instant, explicitly treating routing as a prerequisite. Preserve each contribution hydrograph so a downstream exceedance can be traced to its source and release period rather than to a misleading simultaneous upstream sum. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Aligned flows at a junction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「匯流點的同步疊加」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Aligned flows at a junction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 匯流點的同步疊加
knowledge.text: 多水庫出流在下游匯流點相遇時，必須先經河道演算對齊到達時間，不能把不同水庫同一發布時刻的流量直接相加。支流洪峰可能與水庫洩流錯峰或疊峰，傳播過程也有蓄水與波形變化。
knowledge.textEn: Reservoir releases must be routed and aligned at the downstream junction before addition; flows issued at the same clock time upstream need not arrive together. Tributary peaks can coincide or separate, while channel storage changes timing and shape.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「匯流點的同步疊加」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Aligned flows at a junction" is correct?
options: 同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
多水庫出流在下游匯流點相遇時，必須先經河道演算對齊到達時間，不能把不同水庫同一發布時刻的流量直接相加。
optionsEn: Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Reservoir releases must be routed and aligned at the downstream junction before addition; flows issued at the same clock time upstream need not arrive together.
quiz.explanation: 多水庫出流在下游匯流點相遇時，必須先經河道演算對齊到達時間，不能把不同水庫同一發布時刻的流量直接相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reservoir releases must be routed and aligned at the downstream junction before addition; flows issued at the same clock time upstream need not arrive together. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 匯流點的同步疊加：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Aligned flows at a junction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「匯流點的同步疊加」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Aligned flows at a junction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s。適用邊界：三股流量已演算至同一匯流斷面同一時刻，未在此假設原始洩流同步。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s. Applicable boundary: All contributions are routed to the same junction and instant; upstream releases are not assumed simultaneous here. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以示蹤、事件歷線或校準路由模型檢查傳播時間，將各來源到達歷線放在共同時間軸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check travel timing with tracers, event hydrographs or calibrated routing, and align arriving contributions on one timeline.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s。適用邊界：三股流量已演算至同一匯流斷面同一時刻，未在此假設原始洩流同步。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s. Applicable boundary: All contributions are routed to the same junction and instant; upstream releases are not assumed simultaneous here.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「匯流點的同步疊加」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Aligned flows at a junction", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s。
求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: QAarr=120 m3/s.
Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied
The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: QAarr=120 m3/s; QBarr=80 m3/s; Qtarr=60 m3/s; Qj=QAarr+QBarr+Qtarr=260 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 匯流點的同步疊加：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Aligned flows at a junction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「匯流點的同步疊加」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Aligned flows at a junction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以示蹤、事件歷線或校準路由模型檢查傳播時間，將各來源到達歷線放在共同時間軸。用匯流點實測流量核對合計，並保留河段儲水及側向流入項，避免把差額全歸成某座水庫計量誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check travel timing with tracers, event hydrographs or calibrated routing, and align arriving contributions on one timeline. Compare their sum with junction observations, retaining reach storage and lateral inputs instead of assigning every residual to one reservoir's meter error. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將支流到達流量增加二十立方公尺每秒重算合計，再把其峰值提前一小時畫出歷線。說明沒有河道路由資料時，哪些聯合操作結論仍無法成立。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase arriving tributary flow by twenty cubic metres per second and recalculate the sum, then shift its peak one hour earlier on a hydrograph. Identify coordination conclusions that remain unsupported without routing information.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若忽略支流較早到達，可能在預計空窗內增加洩流卻與真正洪峰重疊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring earlier tributary arrival can place increased release inside an apparent window that actually overlaps the flood peak. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以示蹤、事件歷線或校準路由模型檢查傳播時間，將各來源到達歷線放在共同時間軸。用匯流點實測流量核對合計，並保留河段儲水及側向流入項，避免把差額全歸成某座水庫計量誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Check travel timing with tracers, event hydrographs or calibrated routing, and align arriving contributions on one timeline. Compare their sum with junction observations, retaining reach storage and lateral inputs instead of assigning every residual to one reservoir's meter error.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將支流到達流量增加二十立方公尺每秒重算合計，再把其峰值提前一小時畫出歷線。說明沒有河道路由資料時，哪些聯合操作結論仍無法成立。
knowledge.textEn: Increase arriving tributary flow by twenty cubic metres per second and recalculate the sum, then shift its peak one hour earlier on a hydrograph. Identify coordination conclusions that remain unsupported without routing information.

quiz.question: 要驗證「匯流點的同步疊加」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Aligned flows at a junction"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
以示蹤、事件歷線或校準路由模型檢查傳播時間，將各來源到達歷線放在共同時間軸。
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Check travel timing with tracers, event hydrographs or calibrated routing, and align arriving contributions on one timeline.
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
quiz.explanation: 以示蹤、事件歷線或校準路由模型檢查傳播時間，將各來源到達歷線放在共同時間軸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check travel timing with tracers, event hydrographs or calibrated routing, and align arriving contributions on one timeline. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 匯流點的同步疊加：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Aligned flows at a junction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「匯流點的同步疊加」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Aligned flows at a junction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若忽略支流較早到達，可能在預計空窗內增加洩流卻與真正洪峰重疊。需查到達時間分布與預報誤差，而非只比較各水庫的最大出流值。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring earlier tributary arrival can place increased release inside an apparent window that actually overlaps the flood peak. Examine arrival-time uncertainty rather than comparing only the maximum outflow from each reservoir separately. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：操作比較應保存每股貢獻歷線，才能追溯下游超限來自哪個時段和來源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Preserve each contribution hydrograph so a downstream exceedance can be traced to its source and release period rather than to a misleading simultaneous upstream sum.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若忽略支流較早到達，可能在預計空窗內增加洩流卻與真正洪峰重疊。需查到達時間分布與預報誤差，而非只比較各水庫的最大出流值。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring earlier tributary arrival can place increased release inside an apparent window that actually overlaps the flood peak. Examine arrival-time uncertainty rather than comparing only the maximum outflow from each reservoir separately.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「匯流點的同步疊加」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Aligned flows at a junction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
若忽略支流較早到達，可能在預計空窗內增加洩流卻與真正洪峰重疊。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Ignoring earlier tributary arrival can place increased release inside an apparent window that actually overlaps the flood peak.
quiz.explanation: 若忽略支流較早到達，可能在預計空窗內增加洩流卻與真正洪峰重疊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring earlier tributary arrival can place increased release inside an apparent window that actually overlaps the flood peak. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 下游剩餘通洪額度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Residual downstream flow allowance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「下游剩餘通洪額度」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Residual downstream flow allowance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 下游斷面流量限制扣除已到達的支流與其他來源，可得到某一控制貢獻的剩餘額度，但這仍是斷面到達流量而非立即閘門設定。把它轉成水庫出流需要路由、設備能力與爬升限制，也要面對預報誤差。若其他來源已超過限制，負餘額代表該假設組合無法靠非負洩流解決，不能隨意截成零後宣稱安全。規則來源與權責必須清楚，教材僅比較假想限制的數學含義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「下游剩餘通洪額度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Subtracting arriving tributary and other flows from a downstream limit gives a residual allowance for one contribution, not an immediate gate setting. Routing, outlet capacity, ramp limits and forecast uncertainty intervene before converting it to release. If other sources already exceed the limit, a negative allowance signals infeasibility under the assumptions; clipping it to zero does not restore safety. Identify rule authority and provenance while treating the numerical limit here only as a hypothetical teaching condition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Residual downstream flow allowance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「下游剩餘通洪額度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Residual downstream flow allowance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 下游剩餘通洪額度
knowledge.text: 下游斷面流量限制扣除已到達的支流與其他來源，可得到某一控制貢獻的剩餘額度，但這仍是斷面到達流量而非立即閘門設定。把它轉成水庫出流需要路由、設備能力與爬升限制，也要面對預報誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Subtracting arriving tributary and other flows from a downstream limit gives a residual allowance for one contribution, not an immediate gate setting. Routing, outlet capacity, ramp limits and forecast uncertainty intervene before converting it to release.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「下游剩餘通洪額度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Residual downstream flow allowance" is correct?
options: 下游斷面流量限制扣除已到達的支流與其他來源，可得到某一控制貢獻的剩餘額度，但這仍是斷面到達流量而非立即閘門設定。
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行
optionsEn: Subtracting arriving tributary and other flows from a downstream limit gives a residual allowance for one contribution, not an immediate gate setting.
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
quiz.explanation: 下游斷面流量限制扣除已到達的支流與其他來源，可得到某一控制貢獻的剩餘額度，但這仍是斷面到達流量而非立即閘門設定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Subtracting arriving tributary and other flows from a downstream limit gives a residual allowance for one contribution, not an immediate gate setting. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 下游剩餘通洪額度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Residual downstream flow allowance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「下游剩餘通洪額度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Residual downstream flow allowance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s。適用邊界：給定假想斷面限制與同步到達流量，不是實際核准洩流量。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Hypothetical section limit with aligned arriving flows, not an authorized reservoir release. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：查核限制對應的斷面、時段及流量定義，再把其他來源以共同時間軸列入。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the limit's section, period and flow definition, align other contributions, and test tributary uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s。適用邊界：給定假想斷面限制與同步到達流量，不是實際核准洩流量。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s. Applicable boundary: Hypothetical section limit with aligned arriving flows, not an authorized reservoir release.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「下游剩餘通洪額度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Residual downstream flow allowance", which statement holds?
options: 情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s。
集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
optionsEn: Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qlim=300 m3/s.
Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Qlim=300 m3/s; Qtrib=90 m3/s; Qother=70 m3/s; Qallow=Qlim-Qtrib-Qother=140 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 下游剩餘通洪額度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Residual downstream flow allowance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「下游剩餘通洪額度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Residual downstream flow allowance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 查核限制對應的斷面、時段及流量定義，再把其他來源以共同時間軸列入。對預報支流做敏感度範圍，使用路由模型檢查水庫能否形成目標到達流量，並確認設備及正式操作規程是否允許。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the limit's section, period and flow definition, align other contributions, and test tributary uncertainty. Use routing to examine whether a reservoir can produce the target arriving flow, then check equipment constraints and formally approved operating rules. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將支流到達流量提高到每秒二百五十立方公尺，重算餘額並說明負值意義。列出應回報的限制衝突，而不是自行創造一個看似可行的非負數字。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Raise tributary arrival to two hundred fifty cubic metres per second and recompute the allowance. Explain a negative result and list the conflicting conditions to report rather than inventing an apparently feasible nonnegative value.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把到達額度直接作成上游即時洩流，可能因傳播延遲在錯誤時段超限。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Applying an arrival allowance directly as an upstream release can exceed the limit at the wrong time because of routing delay. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 查核限制對應的斷面、時段及流量定義，再把其他來源以共同時間軸列入。對預報支流做敏感度範圍，使用路由模型檢查水庫能否形成目標到達流量，並確認設備及正式操作規程是否允許。
knowledge.textEn: Verify the limit's section, period and flow definition, align other contributions, and test tributary uncertainty. Use routing to examine whether a reservoir can produce the target arriving flow, then check equipment constraints and formally approved operating rules.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將支流到達流量提高到每秒二百五十立方公尺，重算餘額並說明負值意義。列出應回報的限制衝突，而不是自行創造一個看似可行的非負數字。
knowledge.textEn: Raise tributary arrival to two hundred fifty cubic metres per second and recompute the allowance. Explain a negative result and list the conflicting conditions to report rather than inventing an apparently feasible nonnegative value.

quiz.question: 要驗證「下游剩餘通洪額度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Residual downstream flow allowance"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
查核限制對應的斷面、時段及流量定義，再把其他來源以共同時間軸列入。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Verify the limit's section, period and flow definition, align other contributions, and test tributary uncertainty.
quiz.explanation: 查核限制對應的斷面、時段及流量定義，再把其他來源以共同時間軸列入。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the limit's section, period and flow definition, align other contributions, and test tributary uncertainty. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 下游剩餘通洪額度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Residual downstream flow allowance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「下游剩餘通洪額度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Residual downstream flow allowance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把到達額度直接作成上游即時洩流，可能因傳播延遲在錯誤時段超限。限制也可能隨堤防或下游施工改變，必須確認版本與有效範圍。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Applying an arrival allowance directly as an upstream release can exceed the limit at the wrong time because of routing delay. Limits may also depend on current downstream conditions, requiring version and validity checks. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：規則來源與權責必須清楚，教材僅比較假想限制的數學含義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify rule authority and provenance while treating the numerical limit here only as a hypothetical teaching condition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把到達額度直接作成上游即時洩流，可能因傳播延遲在錯誤時段超限。限制也可能隨堤防或下游施工改變，必須確認版本與有效範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Applying an arrival allowance directly as an upstream release can exceed the limit at the wrong time because of routing delay. Limits may also depend on current downstream conditions, requiring version and validity checks.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「下游剩餘通洪額度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Residual downstream flow allowance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若把到達額度直接作成上游即時洩流，可能因傳播延遲在錯誤時段超限。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行
optionsEn: Applying an arrival allowance directly as an upstream release can exceed the limit at the wrong time because of routing delay.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
quiz.explanation: 若把到達額度直接作成上游即時洩流，可能因傳播延遲在錯誤時段超限。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Applying an arrival allowance directly as an upstream release can exceed the limit at the wrong time because of routing delay. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「預洩所需時間窗」與「不相容操作限制」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Time window for prerelease" and "Incompatible operating constraints": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 預洩所需時間窗：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Time window for prerelease: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預洩所需時間窗」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Time window for prerelease” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 預洩試算需區分原本既定出流與額外釋放所創造的庫容，否則會把同一股水重複計算。可用時間窗還受下游容量、設備爬升、環境要求與預報可靠度影響，不能只用目標體積除最大閘流量。若入流在窗口內增加，淨庫容形成速度會降低；若將來降雨落空，保留供水也有代價。教材以固定額外淨釋放量建立時間尺度，實際方案必須透過完整情境與授權規則比較。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預洩所需時間窗」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Prerelease analysis distinguishes baseline outflow from additional net release that creates storage; otherwise the same water is counted twice. The available window depends on downstream capacity, ramping, environmental requirements and forecast reliability, not just maximum gate flow. Increasing inflow reduces net storage creation, while a missed storm creates water-supply tradeoffs. This example uses a fixed additional net release to establish a time scale; real alternatives require full scenarios and authorized rules, not direct execution of the arithmetic. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Time window for prerelease” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預洩所需時間窗」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Time window for prerelease”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預洩所需時間窗
knowledge.text: 預洩試算需區分原本既定出流與額外釋放所創造的庫容，否則會把同一股水重複計算。可用時間窗還受下游容量、設備爬升、環境要求與預報可靠度影響，不能只用目標體積除最大閘流量。
knowledge.textEn: Prerelease analysis distinguishes baseline outflow from additional net release that creates storage; otherwise the same water is counted twice. The available window depends on downstream capacity, ramping, environmental requirements and forecast reliability, not just maximum gate flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預洩所需時間窗」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Time window for prerelease" is correct?
options: 目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行
預洩試算需區分原本既定出流與額外釋放所創造的庫容，否則會把同一股水重複計算。
求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
optionsEn: Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
Prerelease analysis distinguishes baseline outflow from additional net release that creates storage; otherwise the same water is counted twice.
Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied

quiz.explanationEn: Prerelease analysis distinguishes baseline outflow from additional net release that creates storage; otherwise the same water is counted twice. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預洩所需時間窗：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Time window for prerelease: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預洩所需時間窗」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Time window for prerelease” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h。適用邊界：額外淨釋放已扣相對基準入流變化，假設可持續且無爬升時間。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h. Applicable boundary: Additional net release already accounts for inflow change relative to baseline, assuming sustained feasibility and no ramp time. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立基準及預洩兩套水量帳，逐時比較新增庫容，而非只加總全部出流。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build baseline and prerelease water ledgers and compare incremental storage hour by hour rather than summing all outflow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h。適用邊界：額外淨釋放已扣相對基準入流變化，假設可持續且無爬升時間。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h. Applicable boundary: Additional net release already accounts for inflow change relative to baseline, assuming sustained feasibility and no ramp time.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預洩所需時間窗」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Time window for prerelease", which statement holds?
options: 預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h。
optionsEn: The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Vtarget=1800000 m3; Qnetextra=50 m3/s; t=Vtarget/Qnetextra/3600=10 h. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預洩所需時間窗：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Time window for prerelease: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預洩所需時間窗」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Time window for prerelease” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立基準及預洩兩套水量帳，逐時比較新增庫容，而非只加總全部出流。核對窗口內下游條件與爬升限制，對降雨提前、延後或未發生情境分別演算，並保存決策使用的預報版本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build baseline and prerelease water ledgers and compare incremental storage hour by hour rather than summing all outflow. Check downstream conditions and ramps, replay early, late and absent rainfall scenarios, and preserve the forecast version used for comparison. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將額外淨釋放降到每秒四十立方公尺重算時間，再加入兩小時逐步爬升。說明為何須積分實際增量歷線，並列出方案比較需要的正式限制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce additional net release to forty cubic metres per second and recalculate time, then introduce a two-hour ramp. Explain why the actual incremental hydrograph needs integration and list formal constraints required for comparing alternatives.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：如果把最大出口能力當成可全程使用的額外淨釋放，會低估所需時間並漏掉下游限制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating maximum outlet capacity as sustained additional net release understates required time and ignores downstream constraints. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立基準及預洩兩套水量帳，逐時比較新增庫容，而非只加總全部出流。核對窗口內下游條件與爬升限制，對降雨提前、延後或未發生情境分別演算，並保存決策使用的預報版本。
knowledge.textEn: Build baseline and prerelease water ledgers and compare incremental storage hour by hour rather than summing all outflow. Check downstream conditions and ramps, replay early, late and absent rainfall scenarios, and preserve the forecast version used for comparison.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將額外淨釋放降到每秒四十立方公尺重算時間，再加入兩小時逐步爬升。說明為何須積分實際增量歷線，並列出方案比較需要的正式限制。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce additional net release to forty cubic metres per second and recalculate time, then introduce a two-hour ramp. Explain why the actual incremental hydrograph needs integration and list formal constraints required for comparing alternatives.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預洩所需時間窗」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Time window for prerelease"?
options: 建立基準及預洩兩套水量帳，逐時比較新增庫容，而非只加總全部出流。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加
optionsEn: Build baseline and prerelease water ledgers and compare incremental storage hour by hour rather than summing all outflow.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase
quiz.explanation: 建立基準及預洩兩套水量帳，逐時比較新增庫容，而非只加總全部出流。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Build baseline and prerelease water ledgers and compare incremental storage hour by hour rather than summing all outflow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預洩所需時間窗：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Time window for prerelease: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預洩所需時間窗」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Time window for prerelease” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 如果把最大出口能力當成可全程使用的額外淨釋放，會低估所需時間並漏掉下游限制。預報延後發布時，原先看似足夠的窗口也可能消失。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating maximum outlet capacity as sustained additional net release understates required time and ignores downstream constraints. A later forecast issue can also remove a previously available window, invalidating the earlier feasibility calculation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：教材以固定額外淨釋放量建立時間尺度，實際方案必須透過完整情境與授權規則比較。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: This example uses a fixed additional net release to establish a time scale; real alternatives require full scenarios and authorized rules, not direct execution of the arithmetic.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 如果把最大出口能力當成可全程使用的額外淨釋放，會低估所需時間並漏掉下游限制。預報延後發布時，原先看似足夠的窗口也可能消失。
knowledge.textEn: Treating maximum outlet capacity as sustained additional net release understates required time and ignores downstream constraints. A later forecast issue can also remove a previously available window, invalidating the earlier feasibility calculation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預洩所需時間窗」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Time window for prerelease" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
如果把最大出口能力當成可全程使用的額外淨釋放，會低估所需時間並漏掉下游限制。
求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Treating maximum outlet capacity as sustained additional net release understates required time and ignores downstream constraints.
Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied
quiz.explanation: 如果把最大出口能力當成可全程使用的額外淨釋放，會低估所需時間並漏掉下游限制。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating maximum outlet capacity as sustained additional net release understates required time and ignores downstream constraints. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 不相容操作限制：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Incompatible operating constraints: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「不相容操作限制」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Incompatible operating constraints” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多項規則可以轉成同一時段的出流上下界，最大下界若高於最小上界，數學上便沒有共同可行值。這個結果應揭露限制衝突，不能由程式默默刪除較難滿足的條件。某些規則可能有正式優先序或應變程序，但作者不能自行發明權限。模型需保留各限制的來源、有效時間與物理意義，分辨設備能力不足、下游容量衝突及資料錯誤，讓有權人員能檢查並作成可追溯決策。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不相容操作限制」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Several rules can become release bounds for one interval. If the largest lower bound exceeds the smallest upper bound, no common feasible value exists. Report that conflict rather than silently discarding a difficult condition. Formal priorities or emergency procedures may apply, but a model author cannot invent authority. Retain each bound's source, valid period and physical meaning to distinguish equipment limits, downstream conflicts and data errors, enabling responsible personnel to make a traceable decision. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Incompatible operating constraints” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L1=90 m3/s; L2=120 m3/s; U1=140 m3/s; U2=100 m3/s; gap=max(L1,L2)-min(U1,U2)=20 m3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L1=90 m3/s; L2=120 m3/s; U1=140 m3/s; U2=100 m3/s; gap=max(L1,L2)-min(U1,U2)=20 m3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不相容操作限制」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Incompatible operating constraints”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不相容操作限制
knowledge.text: 多項規則可以轉成同一時段的出流上下界，最大下界若高於最小上界，數學上便沒有共同可行值。這個結果應揭露限制衝突，不能由程式默默刪除較難滿足的條件。
knowledge.textEn: Several rules can become release bounds for one interval. If the largest lower bound exceeds the smallest upper bound, no common feasible value exists.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不相容操作限制」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Incompatible operating constraints" is correct?
options: 求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足
情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
多項規則可以轉成同一時段的出流上下界，最大下界若高於最小上界，數學上便沒有共同可行值。
optionsEn: Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied
Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
Several rules can become release bounds for one interval.
quiz.explanation: 多項規則可以轉成同一時段的出流上下界，最大下界若高於最小上界，數學上便沒有共同可行值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Several rules can become release bounds for one interval. The other options are common misconceptions.

集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
