optionsEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L1=90 m3/s.
Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：L1=90 m3/s; L2=120 m3/s; U1=140 m3/s; U2=100 m3/s; gap=max(L1,L2)-min(U1,U2)=20 m3/s。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: L1=90 m3/s; L2=120 m3/s; U1=140 m3/s; U2=100 m3/s; gap=max(L1,L2)-min(U1,U2)=20 m3/s. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不相容操作限制：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Incompatible operating constraints: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不相容操作限制」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Incompatible operating constraints” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每條限制附上來源、時段與適用水庫，先統一單位及符號，再計交集。若無解，檢查是否誤把不同時段或不同斷面限制混合，確認後輸出衝突清單及責任窗口，不以數值平滑掩蓋問題。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Attach source, interval and reservoir to every constraint, harmonize units and signs, then compute the intersection. For infeasibility, check mixed periods or sections before producing a conflict list and responsible review route rather than smoothing the numbers to hide it. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把第二下界改成每秒九十五立方公尺，重新求交集並說明可行範圍。再列一個資料時段不一致造成假衝突的例子，設計能攔下它的前置檢查。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change the second lower bound to ninety five cubic metres per second and find the feasible interval. Construct a false conflict caused by mismatched time periods and design a preprocessing check that would catch it.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：優化器若自行移除下游上限，可能回傳漂亮目標值卻已違反原問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An optimizer that drops a downstream upper bound can return an attractive objective while violating the original problem. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每條限制附上來源、時段與適用水庫，先統一單位及符號，再計交集。若無解，檢查是否誤把不同時段或不同斷面限制混合，確認後輸出衝突清單及責任窗口，不以數值平滑掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Attach source, interval and reservoir to every constraint, harmonize units and signs, then compute the intersection. For infeasibility, check mixed periods or sections before producing a conflict list and responsible review route rather than smoothing the numbers to hide it.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 把第二下界改成每秒九十五立方公尺，重新求交集並說明可行範圍。再列一個資料時段不一致造成假衝突的例子，設計能攔下它的前置檢查。
knowledge.textEn: Change the second lower bound to ninety five cubic metres per second and find the feasible interval. Construct a false conflict caused by mismatched time periods and design a preprocessing check that would catch it.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不相容操作限制」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Incompatible operating constraints"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將每條限制附上來源、時段與適用水庫，先統一單位及符號，再計交集。
同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Attach source, interval and reservoir to every constraint, harmonize units and signs, then compute the intersection.
Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
quiz.explanation: 將每條限制附上來源、時段與適用水庫，先統一單位及符號，再計交集。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Attach source, interval and reservoir to every constraint, harmonize units and signs, then compute the intersection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不相容操作限制：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Incompatible operating constraints: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不相容操作限制」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Incompatible operating constraints” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 優化器若自行移除下游上限，可能回傳漂亮目標值卻已違反原問題。必須檢查求解狀態及每條限制殘差，不能只看目標函數有改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An optimizer that drops a downstream upper bound can return an attractive objective while violating the original problem. Inspect solver status and every constraint residual rather than judging success solely by an improved objective value. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：模型需保留各限制的來源、有效時間與物理意義，分辨設備能力不足、下游容量衝突及資料錯誤，讓有權人員能檢查並作成可追溯決策。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Retain each bound's source, valid period and physical meaning to distinguish equipment limits, downstream conflicts and data errors, enabling responsible personnel to make a traceable decision.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「求解器有回傳數字就代表原本所有操作限制都已滿足」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any number returned by a solver proves that all original operating constraints are satisfied" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 優化器若自行移除下游上限，可能回傳漂亮目標值卻已違反原問題。必須檢查求解狀態及每條限制殘差，不能只看目標函數有改善。
knowledge.textEn: An optimizer that drops a downstream upper bound can return an attractive objective while violating the original problem. Inspect solver status and every constraint residual rather than judging success solely by an improved objective value.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不相容操作限制」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Incompatible operating constraints" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
優化器若自行移除下游上限，可能回傳漂亮目標值卻已違反原問題。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
An optimizer that drops a downstream upper bound can return an attractive objective while violating the original problem.
quiz.explanation: 優化器若自行移除下游上限，可能回傳漂亮目標值卻已違反原問題。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An optimizer that drops a downstream upper bound can return an attractive objective while violating the original problem. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「情境違反率與風險」與「預報改善與獨立驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scenario violation rate and risk" and "Forecast improvement and independent validation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 情境違反率與風險：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scenario violation rate and risk: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「情境違反率與風險」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scenario violation rate and risk” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯合操作方案可對每個預報情境計算是否超過下游或庫容限制，再統計違反比例。此比例取決於情境權重、代表性與相關性，不等於已知真實風險，也未描述超限幅度。少數很嚴重的失敗可能比多次輕微超限更重要，因此應同時報告頻率、最大值、持續時間及涉及對象。增加集合成員只改善抽樣解析度的一部分，若共同模型偏差未修正，風險估計仍會系統性失真。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「情境違反率與風險」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A coordinated plan can be simulated under each forecast scenario to count downstream or storage violations. The fraction depends on weights, representativeness and dependence; it is not a known true risk and says nothing about severity. A few severe failures may matter more than many slight exceedances, so report frequency, magnitude, duration and affected receptors together. More members refine only part of sampling resolution and cannot by themselves remove shared model bias or an omitted failure mechanism. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scenario violation rate and risk” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「情境違反率與風險」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scenario violation rate and risk”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 情境違反率與風險
knowledge.text: 聯合操作方案可對每個預報情境計算是否超過下游或庫容限制，再統計違反比例。此比例取決於情境權重、代表性與相關性，不等於已知真實風險，也未描述超限幅度。
knowledge.textEn: A coordinated plan can be simulated under each forecast scenario to count downstream or storage violations. The fraction depends on weights, representativeness and dependence; it is not a known true risk and says nothing about severity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「情境違反率與風險」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scenario violation rate and risk" is correct?
options: 聯合操作方案可對每個預報情境計算是否超過下游或庫容限制，再統計違反比例。
情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果
預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
optionsEn: A coordinated plan can be simulated under each forecast scenario to count downstream or storage violations.
Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences
The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
quiz.explanation: 聯合操作方案可對每個預報情境計算是否超過下游或庫容限制，再統計違反比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A coordinated plan can be simulated under each forecast scenario to count downstream or storage violations. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 情境違反率與風險：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scenario violation rate and risk: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「情境違反率與風險」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scenario violation rate and risk” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境違反比例，沒有將百分之六宣稱成核准風險或真實機率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Equally weighted scenario violation fraction, not an approved risk level or established true probability. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每個情境保存相同限制定義與完整結果，逐一核對超限時間和幅度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Store identical constraint definitions and full results for every scenario, checking violation timing and magnitude individually.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless。適用邊界：等權情境違反比例，沒有將百分之六宣稱成核准風險或真實機率。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Equally weighted scenario violation fraction, not an approved risk level or established true probability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「情境違反率與風險」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scenario violation rate and risk", which statement holds?
options: 九成分位數就是所有可能洪水永遠不會超越的上限
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless。
水庫水位增加一公尺就代表固定不變的一立方公尺庫容增加
optionsEn: The ninetieth percentile is an upper bound that every possible flood must obey
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nv=3 violating-scenarios.
A one-metre reservoir level rise always means a fixed one-cubic-metre storage increase
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: Nv=3 violating-scenarios; N=50 equally-weighted-scenarios; pv=Nv/N=0.06 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 情境違反率與風險：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scenario violation rate and risk: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「情境違反率與風險」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scenario violation rate and risk” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對每個情境保存相同限制定義與完整結果，逐一核對超限時間和幅度。另檢查高後果但低頻情境是否被抽樣遺漏，以保留事件回放測試共同偏差，並明示若成員有權重時應改用加權比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Store identical constraint definitions and full results for every scenario, checking violation timing and magnitude individually. Examine omitted rare but consequential cases and replay held-out events for common bias. If members carry weights, explicitly replace the simple count with weighted probability. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持三個違反情境但將集合增加到六十個重算比例，說明為何不能據此自動宣稱更安全。為三個情境補上不同超限幅度和時間，提出更完整比較表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep three violating scenarios but enlarge the ensemble to sixty and recalculate the fraction without automatically claiming greater safety. Assign different magnitudes and durations to the three cases and construct a more informative comparison table.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把輕微超限與長時間嚴重超限都記成一，可能讓不同方案看似同風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Coding slight and prolonged severe exceedances identically can make very different plans appear equally risky. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每個情境保存相同限制定義與完整結果，逐一核對超限時間和幅度。另檢查高後果但低頻情境是否被抽樣遺漏，以保留事件回放測試共同偏差，並明示若成員有權重時應改用加權比例。
knowledge.textEn: Store identical constraint definitions and full results for every scenario, checking violation timing and magnitude individually. Examine omitted rare but consequential cases and replay held-out events for common bias. If members carry weights, explicitly replace the simple count with weighted probability.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保持三個違反情境但將集合增加到六十個重算比例，說明為何不能據此自動宣稱更安全。為三個情境補上不同超限幅度和時間，提出更完整比較表。
knowledge.textEn: Keep three violating scenarios but enlarge the ensemble to sixty and recalculate the fraction without automatically claiming greater safety. Assign different magnitudes and durations to the three cases and construct a more informative comparison table.

quiz.question: 要驗證「情境違反率與風險」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenario violation rate and risk"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
下游剩餘流量額度可不經路由直接當成上游即時閘門指令
對每個情境保存相同限制定義與完整結果，逐一核對超限時間和幅度。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Residual downstream flow allowance can directly become an immediate upstream gate command without routing
Store identical constraint definitions and full results for every scenario, checking violation timing and magnitude individually.
quiz.explanation: 對每個情境保存相同限制定義與完整結果，逐一核對超限時間和幅度。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Store identical constraint definitions and full results for every scenario, checking violation timing and magnitude individually. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 情境違反率與風險：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenario violation rate and risk: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「情境違反率與風險」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenario violation rate and risk” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把輕微超限與長時間嚴重超限都記成一，可能讓不同方案看似同風險。若只報比例而刪除歷線，決策者便無法辨認真正需要應變的後果。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Coding slight and prolonged severe exceedances identically can make very different plans appear equally risky. Reporting only the fraction while discarding hydrographs prevents reviewers from identifying consequences that require a distinct response. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：增加集合成員只改善抽樣解析度的一部分，若共同模型偏差未修正，風險估計仍會系統性失真。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: More members refine only part of sampling resolution and cannot by themselves remove shared model bias or an omitted failure mechanism.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「情境違反比例相同就代表兩個方案具有完全相同後果」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal scenario violation fractions mean that two plans have identical consequences" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把輕微超限與長時間嚴重超限都記成一，可能讓不同方案看似同風險。若只報比例而刪除歷線，決策者便無法辨認真正需要應變的後果。
knowledge.textEn: Coding slight and prolonged severe exceedances identically can make very different plans appear equally risky. Reporting only the fraction while discarding hydrographs prevents reviewers from identifying consequences that require a distinct response.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「情境違反率與風險」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenario violation rate and risk" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把輕微超限與長時間嚴重超限都記成一，可能讓不同方案看似同風險。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
optionsEn: Coding slight and prolonged severe exceedances identically can make very different plans appear equally risky.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
quiz.explanation: 把輕微超限與長時間嚴重超限都記成一，可能讓不同方案看似同風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Coding slight and prolonged severe exceedances identically can make very different plans appear equally risky. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 預報改善與獨立驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Forecast improvement and independent validation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「預報改善與獨立驗證」如何影響洪水預報與水庫聯合操作的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Forecast improvement and independent validation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均絕對誤差描述流量預報偏離觀測的平均幅度，與參考預報比較可形成相對改善尺度。不同事件、提前時間及流量大小必須公平配對，否則看似改善可能只是測試樣本更容易。校準與驗證要按時間或事件分開，避免同一場洪水的相鄰資料同時進入訓練與測試。平均指標還可能掩蓋洪峰時間或極端事件表現，因此應搭配事件分層與操作後果回放，才能判斷改善是否對聯合調度有用。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「預報改善與獨立驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean absolute error describes average discharge discrepancy, and comparison with a reference forecast gives a relative improvement scale. Match events, lead times and flow regimes fairly; an easier test sample can mimic improvement. Separate calibration and validation by time or event so neighbouring records from one flood do not leak across sets. Average scores may hide peak-timing or extreme-event errors, requiring stratified evaluation and operational replays before claiming that better forecasting improves coordinated reservoir decisions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Forecast improvement and independent validation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction" It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「預報改善與獨立驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Forecast improvement and independent validation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 預報改善與獨立驗證
knowledge.text: 平均絕對誤差描述流量預報偏離觀測的平均幅度，與參考預報比較可形成相對改善尺度。不同事件、提前時間及流量大小必須公平配對，否則看似改善可能只是測試樣本更容易。
knowledge.textEn: Mean absolute error describes average discharge discrepancy, and comparison with a reference forecast gives a relative improvement scale. Match events, lead times and flow regimes fairly; an easier test sample can mimic improvement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「預報改善與獨立驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Forecast improvement and independent validation" is correct?
options: 預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比
平均絕對誤差描述流量預報偏離觀測的平均幅度，與參考預報比較可形成相對改善尺度。
集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
optionsEn: The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction
Mean absolute error describes average discharge discrepancy, and comparison with a reference forecast gives a relative improvement scale.
Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
quiz.explanation: 平均絕對誤差描述流量預報偏離觀測的平均幅度，與參考預報比較可形成相對改善尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean absolute error describes average discharge discrepancy, and comparison with a reference forecast gives a relative improvement scale. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 預報改善與獨立驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Forecast improvement and independent validation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「預報改善與獨立驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Forecast improvement and independent validation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless。適用邊界：同四筆保留樣本與正參考誤差，改善尺度不等於風險降低百分比。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Same four held-out cases with positive reference error; skill is not a percentage reduction in operational risk. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保存訓練截止日與所有預報發布版本，確認參考和新模型使用相同可取得資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Preserve training cutoffs and issued forecast versions, ensuring reference and new models use equally available information.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless。適用邊界：同四筆保留樣本與正參考誤差，改善尺度不等於風險降低百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless. Applicable boundary: Same four held-out cases with positive reference error; skill is not a percentage reduction in operational risk.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「預報改善與獨立驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Forecast improvement and independent validation", which statement holds?
options: 只用發生洪水的日期評分就能公平驗證所有機率預報
同一時刻兩座水庫的出流必然在下游同時到達
原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless。
optionsEn: Scoring only flood dates fairly validates every probabilistic forecast system
Releases from two reservoirs at the same time necessarily arrive downstream together
Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教材輸入，不是現地設計值或操作指令：model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs, not field design values or operating instructions: model-errors=[12,8,20,4] m3/s; reference-errors=[20,15,25,12] m3/s; MAE=44/4=11 m3/s; MAEref=72/4=18 m3/s; skill=1-MAE/MAEref=0.388889 dimensionless. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 預報改善與獨立驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Forecast improvement and independent validation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「預報改善與獨立驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Forecast improvement and independent validation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保存訓練截止日與所有預報發布版本，確認參考和新模型使用相同可取得資料。逐筆列絕對誤差，再按洪峰、低流與提前時間分層；最後用相同規則回放操作，檢查誤差改善是否真正改變庫容或下游結果。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Preserve training cutoffs and issued forecast versions, ensuring reference and new models use equally available information. List absolute errors and stratify by peaks, low flows and lead time. Replay identical operating rules to test whether better scores actually change storage or downstream outcomes. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將模型第三筆誤差降到十二立方公尺每秒重算改善尺度，其他資料不變。說明仍需哪些峰值時序及操作回放結果，才能判定對防洪決策有實際幫助。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Reduce the third model error to twelve cubic metres per second and recompute skill with other values fixed. Identify peak-timing and operating-replay evidence still needed before judging whether the improvement benefits flood decisions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用事後修正雨量驗證即時預報會造成資訊洩漏，誤差看似降低卻無法在發布時重現。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Verifying a real-time forecast with later-corrected rainfall leaks future information and produces gains unavailable at issue time. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保存訓練截止日與所有預報發布版本，確認參考和新模型使用相同可取得資料。逐筆列絕對誤差，再按洪峰、低流與提前時間分層；最後用相同規則回放操作，檢查誤差改善是否真正改變庫容或下游結果。
knowledge.textEn: Preserve training cutoffs and issued forecast versions, ensuring reference and new models use equally available information. List absolute errors and stratify by peaks, low flows and lead time. Replay identical operating rules to test whether better scores actually change storage or downstream outcomes.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將模型第三筆誤差降到十二立方公尺每秒重算改善尺度，其他資料不變。說明仍需哪些峰值時序及操作回放結果，才能判定對防洪決策有實際幫助。
knowledge.textEn: Reduce the third model error to twelve cubic metres per second and recompute skill with other values fixed. Identify peak-timing and operating-replay evidence still needed before judging whether the improvement benefits flood decisions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「預報改善與獨立驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Forecast improvement and independent validation"?
options: 保存訓練截止日與所有預報發布版本，確認參考和新模型使用相同可取得資料。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
目標庫容除以最大閘流量就能保證預洩方案可執行
optionsEn: Preserve training cutoffs and issued forecast versions, ensuring reference and new models use equally available information.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Target storage divided by maximum gate discharge guarantees an executable prerelease plan
quiz.explanation: 保存訓練截止日與所有預報發布版本，確認參考和新模型使用相同可取得資料。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Preserve training cutoffs and issued forecast versions, ensuring reference and new models use equally available information. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 預報改善與獨立驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Forecast improvement and independent validation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「預報改善與獨立驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Forecast improvement and independent validation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用事後修正雨量驗證即時預報會造成資訊洩漏，誤差看似降低卻無法在發布時重現。若模型只改善低流量，也可能未改善最關鍵洪峰操作。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Verifying a real-time forecast with later-corrected rainfall leaks future information and produces gains unavailable at issue time. Improvements concentrated in low flow may also leave the most consequential flood-peak decisions unchanged. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：平均指標還可能掩蓋洪峰時間或極端事件表現，因此應搭配事件分層與操作後果回放，才能判斷改善是否對聯合調度有用。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Average scores may hide peak-timing or extreme-event errors, requiring stratified evaluation and operational replays before claiming that better forecasting improves coordinated reservoir decisions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「預報平均誤差改善百分比必然等於下游洪災風險降低百分比」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The percentage improvement in mean forecast error necessarily equals downstream flood-risk reduction" leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用事後修正雨量驗證即時預報會造成資訊洩漏，誤差看似降低卻無法在發布時重現。若模型只改善低流量，也可能未改善最關鍵洪峰操作。
knowledge.textEn: Verifying a real-time forecast with later-corrected rainfall leaks future information and produces gains unavailable at issue time. Improvements concentrated in low flow may also leave the most consequential flood-peak decisions unchanged.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「預報改善與獨立驗證」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Forecast improvement and independent validation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
用事後修正雨量驗證即時預報會造成資訊洩漏，誤差看似降低卻無法在發布時重現。
集合中四成成員超越就保證真實洪水機率恰為四成
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Verifying a real-time forecast with later-corrected rainfall leaks future information and produces gains unavailable at issue time.
Forty percent ensemble exceedance guarantees the true flood probability is exactly forty percent
quiz.explanation: 用事後修正雨量驗證即時預報會造成資訊洩漏，誤差看似降低卻無法在發布時重現。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Verifying a real-time forecast with later-corrected rainfall leaks future information and produces gains unavailable at issue time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
courses.summary: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 以尺度相似、波列統計與量測鏈判讀海堤越波模型
courses.focusEn: Interpret seawall overtopping tests through scale similarity, wave statistics and measurement chains
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。假設長度比由25增10%為27.5，固定原型週期10s時模型週期由2降為1.9069s，下降約4.65%；不能把時間也直接縮小10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Increasing length ratio from25 to27.5 by10% at fixed prototype period10s changes model period from2 to1.9069s, about4.65% lower; time does not change by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「弗勞德縮尺條件」與「單寬流量換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Froude scaling conditions" and "Unit-discharge conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「弗勞德縮尺條件」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Froude scaling conditions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。 假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 空氣可壓縮性與液滴破裂對縮尺的反應不同，須分開選擇可外推的觀察量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「弗勞德縮尺條件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Air compressibility and droplet breakup respond differently to scaling, requiring separate decisions about which observations can be extrapolated. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Froude scaling conditions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「弗勞德縮尺條件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Froude scaling conditions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件
knowledge.text: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。黏滯、表面張力和含氣衝擊卻不能同時自動相似，縮小到細小水舌時必須重新檢查主導機制，避免只憑幾何比例接受模型。
knowledge.textEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. Viscosity, surface tension and aerated impacts do not automatically remain similar; a thin model water tongue may therefore change the dominant physics despite geometrically accurate construction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「弗勞德縮尺條件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Froude scaling conditions" is correct?
options: 長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。
單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
optionsEn: Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length.
Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
quiz.explanation: 重力主導的自由液面試驗可保持弗勞德相似，使速度與時間按長度平方根縮放。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Gravity-dominated free-surface tests can preserve Froude similarity, scaling velocity and time with the square root of length. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「弗勞德縮尺條件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Froude scaling conditions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原型對模型長度比25，原型波高5m、週期10s，模型為0.20m與10/√25=2s；只採重力相似。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume prototype:model length ratio25, prototype height5m and period10s. Model height is0.20m and period10/√25=2s under gravity similarity only.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「弗勞德縮尺條件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Froude scaling conditions", which statement holds?
options: 最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 弗勞德縮尺條件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Froude scaling conditions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「弗勞德縮尺條件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Froude scaling conditions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 製作長度、時間與速度換算表，另以模型水深及速度估算雷諾數和韋伯數的量級。比較不同縮尺的關鍵輸出，記錄哪種現象不能由單一重力相似支持外推。另列模型最小水深與最大流速。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Prepare length, time and velocity conversions, then estimate Reynolds and Weber scales from model depth and speed. Compare critical outputs at different scales and record phenomena for which gravity similarity alone cannot justify extrapolation. Also tabulate minimum model depth and maximum flow speed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unit-discharge conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單寬越波流量的量綱是面積除時間，與整條海堤的總流量不同。重力相似下它按長度比的二分之三次方縮放，先辨清是否已除試驗寬度，才能避免額外乘一次長度比例造成嚴重誤差。 假設長度比25、模型q=0.0004m²/s，原型q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m；不代表人員容許值。 若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「單寬流量換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unit-width overtopping discharge has dimensions of area per time and differs from total flow across a seawall. Under gravity similarity it scales with length to the three-halves power. Determine whether the measured quantity has already been divided by width before applying a second width conversion. Assume length ratio25 and model q=0.0004m²/s. Prototype q=25^1.5×0.0004=0.050m²/s=50L/s/m, not a pedestrian tolerance. Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unit-discharge conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Plausible-looking plots may carry the unit error directly into drainage estimates unless the original dimensions remain visible. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：若沿堤方向越波不均，單一收集段也不能代表整條堤線的流量分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Spatially uneven overtopping means one collector segment cannot represent the discharge distribution along the entire seawall.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。圖表數值看似合理時，單位錯誤仍可一路傳入排水需求。

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「單寬流量換算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Unit-discharge conversion" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading.
quiz.explanation: 若把單寬量再按全流量的尺度放大，結果會系統性偏高；反向混用則可能低估外水負荷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Scaling a unit-width quantity as total flow creates systematic overestimation; the reverse can understate loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「集水控制體積」與「不規則波能量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Collection control volume" and "Irregular-wave energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水控制體積」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Collection control volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。側漏、濺出、槽內滯留與試驗結束後延遲排水都會破壞收支；控制體積及起訖時刻應先定義，再討論平均越波量。 假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 計量解析度在低越波情境尤其重要，小讀值可能與容器零點漂移相當。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水控制體積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance. Define the control volume and start/end times before interpreting the measurement as mean overtopping discharge. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Meter resolution becomes especially important at low overtopping, where the collected increment may resemble tank zero drift. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Collection control volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「集水控制體積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Collection control volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 集水控制體積
knowledge.text: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。側漏、濺出、槽內滯留與試驗結束後延遲排水都會破壞收支；控制體積及起訖時刻應先定義，再討論平均越波量。
knowledge.textEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. Side leakage, splash loss, storage and delayed drainage disrupt the balance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「集水控制體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Collection control volume" is correct?
options: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。
收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
optionsEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
quiz.explanation: 集水裝置量到的是進入特定容器的水，不一定等於全部跨越堤頂的水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A collection device measures water entering a particular container, not necessarily everything crossing the crest. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水控制體積」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Collection control volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設收集V=0.030m³、有效寬B=0.50m、時間120s，q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s；僅在收支閉合時成立。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume collected V=0.030m³, effective B=0.50m and duration120s. q=V/(Bt)=0.0005m²/s applies only to a closed collection balance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「集水控制體積」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Collection control volume", which statement holds?
options: 反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
optionsEn: Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 集水控制體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Collection control volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水控制體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Collection control volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。用空白試驗量化容器零點漂移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits. Quantify collector zero drift through a blank test. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用已知水量做集水校準，記錄容器讀值、側漏與殘留，並分開波列有效段和後續排空時間。以另一種流量或重量量測交叉檢查，保留零越波與低於檢出限的區別。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calibrate with known water input, recording tank reading, leakage and retention while separating the valid wave sequence from later drainage. Cross-check by weight or independent flow measurement and distinguish zero overtopping from values below detection limits.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：狹窄收集槽可能漏掉斜向越波，餘水又可能被算到下一組試驗；這兩種偏差可互相抵銷，使平均值看似穩定，卻無法支持不同斷面的可靠比較。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A narrow collector can miss oblique discharge while retained water enters the next test. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 不規則波能量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Irregular-wave energy: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「不規則波能量」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Irregular-wave energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。頻帶截取、漂移去除和量測位置會改變零階譜矩，需記清處理方法，才能把造波設定與入射波條件對上。 假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 譜矩是波面變異的積分描述，頻率單位與積分間距必須在程式中一致。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「不規則波能量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. One maximum wave cannot replace a representative height for the sequence. Frequency limits, detrending and measurement location alter the zero-order spectral moment, so processing must remain traceable when comparing generator settings with incident conditions. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1. The moment integrates surface-elevation variance, requiring consistent frequency units and integration spacing throughout the processing code. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Irregular-wave energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「不規則波能量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Irregular-wave energy”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 不規則波能量
knowledge.text: 不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。頻帶截取、漂移去除和量測位置會改變零階譜矩，需記清處理方法，才能把造波設定與入射波條件對上。
knowledge.textEn: Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. One maximum wave cannot replace a representative height for the sequence.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「不規則波能量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Irregular-wave energy" is correct?
options: 最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。
相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
optionsEn: Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description.
Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
quiz.explanation: 不規則波需由波面紀錄建立能譜及統計量，單一最大波不能取代整段波列的代表波高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Irregular waves require a surface-elevation record, spectrum and statistical description. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 不規則波能量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Irregular-wave energy: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「不規則波能量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Irregular-wave energy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設零階譜矩m0=0.0025m²，Hm0=4√m0=0.20m；m0增10%時波高乘√1.1而非1.1。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume zero-order moment m0=0.0025m². Hm0=4√m0=0.20m; increasing m0 by10% multiplies height by√1.1, not1.1.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「不規則波能量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Irregular-wave energy", which statement holds?
options: 每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 不規則波能量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Irregular-wave energy: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「不規則波能量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Irregular-wave energy” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。獨立檢查頻率積分與波面變異數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement. Independently compare spectral integration with surface-elevation variance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。獨立檢查頻率積分與波面變異數。
knowledge.textEn: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement. Independently compare spectral integration with surface-elevation variance.
