knowledge.text: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。用時域波高分布交叉比較譜波高，並列出兩者定義差異而非強迫相等。
knowledge.textEn: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Compare spectral height with the time-domain wave-height distribution, documenting their differing definitions instead of forcing numerical agreement.

quiz.question: 要驗證「不規則波能量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Irregular-wave energy"?
options: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
optionsEn: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
quiz.explanation: 保留原始波面時間序列及處理參數，檢查取樣頻率、有效頻帶與漂移移除是否一致。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Retain raw elevation and processing parameters, checking sample rate, retained frequencies and detrending consistently. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 不規則波能量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Irregular-wave energy: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「不規則波能量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Irregular-wave energy” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。相同造波設定不能保證處理後的有效波況相同。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy. Identical generator settings therefore do not guarantee equivalent effective wave conditions after processing. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：譜矩是波面變異的積分描述，頻率單位與積分間距必須在程式中一致。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The moment integrates surface-elevation variance, requiring consistent frequency units and integration spacing throughout the processing code.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。相同造波設定不能保證處理後的有效波況相同。
knowledge.textEn: Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy. Identical generator settings therefore do not guarantee equivalent effective wave conditions after processing.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「不規則波能量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Irregular-wave energy" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。
相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy.
Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
quiz.explanation: 感測器慢漂移若被當成低頻波能，譜矩會被抬高；另一方面過度濾波可能刪掉真實長週期能量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Slow sensor drift mistaken for wave energy inflates the spectral moment, while aggressive filtering removes genuine long-period energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「相對出水高度」與「入射反射分離」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Relative crest freeboard" and "Incident-reflected wave separation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 相對出水高度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「相對出水高度」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative crest freeboard” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。比較試驗時必須區分堤頂變化和靜水面變化，兩者在幾何上可能等效，但對前灘水深與破波位置的影響不同。 假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「相對出水高度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water. Tide, surge and datum bias alter effective freeboard. Crest adjustment and water-level change can produce the same nominal freeboard while changing foreshore depth and breaking location differently, so the complete geometry must be retained. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Relative crest freeboard” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「相對出水高度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Relative crest freeboard”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。比較試驗時必須區分堤頂變化和靜水面變化，兩者在幾何上可能等效，但對前灘水深與破波位置的影響不同。
knowledge.textEn: Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water. Tide, surge and datum bias alter effective freeboard.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「相對出水高度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Relative crest freeboard" is correct?
options: 相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。
optionsEn: Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Overtopping responds strongly to crest level relative to still water.
quiz.explanation: 越波對堤頂相對水面的高度十分敏感，潮位、增水及基準偏差都會改變有效出水高。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 相對出水高度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「相對出水高度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative crest freeboard” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Rc=0.10m、Hm0=0.20m，比值Rc/Hm0=0.50；水位上升0.02m且堤頂不變時比值為0.40。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Rc=0.10m and Hm0=0.20m, giving Rc/Hm0=0.50. Raising water0.02m at fixed crest changes the ratio to0.40. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。

A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.

steps.title: 相對出水高度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「相對出水高度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative crest freeboard” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。列出水位修正前後的前灘水深。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime. List foreshore depths before and after each level correction. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。重做水位改變時需重新校準結構前的入射波，檢查是否同時改變破波型態。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix. Recalibrate incident waves before the structure after changing water level, checking for a simultaneous change in breaking regime.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「相對出水高度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

從同一高程基準量取堤頂和靜水面，將量測不確定度與波況一同列入試驗矩陣。

optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Measure crest and still water from one datum and include level uncertainty alongside wave conditions in the test matrix.

steps.title: 相對出水高度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Relative crest freeboard: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「相對出水高度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Relative crest freeboard” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. The resulting discharge change may be mistaken for an improved wall geometry, and checking crest dimensions alone will not reveal the cause. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：有效出水高的分母應使用結構前指定位置的入射波，而非任意遠端設定值。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Relative freeboard should use incident waves at the specified structure location rather than an arbitrary distant generator setting.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「相對出水高度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard.
quiz.explanation: 模型底板沉陷或水位零點偏移會讓標稱出水高失真，越波量變化可能因此被誤認為新堤型較好；只校核堤頂尺寸而忽略水面基準無法辨識原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Settlement of the model base or water-level zero drift corrupts nominal freeboard. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 入射反射分離：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Incident-reflected wave separation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「入射反射分離」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Incident-reflected wave separation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 結構反射與入射波疊加形成空間起伏，單點量測可能剛好位在節點或腹點。要把試驗與設計入射波連結，需用適當測點配置和分離方法；反射振幅比也不能直接當成反射能量比。 假設分離得到入射振幅0.50m、反射0.20m，Kr=0.40；同介質同頻率下反射能量比約Kr²=0.16。 能量比例的平方關係還假設入射和反射有相同的傳播介質與群速。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「入射反射分離」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reflected and incident waves create spatial interference, so a single gauge may sit near a node or antinode. Appropriate gauge geometry and separation are needed to recover incident conditions. An amplitude reflection coefficient also differs from the associated energy fraction under matched propagation conditions. Assume separated incident and reflected amplitudes0.50m and0.20m. Kr=0.40; for matched medium and frequency the reflected energy fraction is approximately0.16. Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Incident-reflected wave separation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「入射反射分離」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 入射反射分離：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Incident-reflected wave separation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「入射反射分離」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Incident-reflected wave separation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。對分離後波列重建原始量測訊號。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient. Reconstruct measured signals from the separated wave components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。用多組距離重算結果並記錄無法可靠分離的頻帶，避免只報一個漂亮係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Recompute using alternative gauge combinations and identify frequency bands with unreliable separation rather than reporting only one attractive overall coefficient. Reconstruct measured signals from the separated wave components.

quiz.question: 要驗證「入射反射分離」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Incident-reflected wave separation"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 先在無結構或已知反射條件下驗證分離方法，檢查測點距離相對波長是否合適。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify separation against absent or known reflection, checking gauge spacing against wavelength. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 入射反射分離：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Incident-reflected wave separation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「入射反射分離」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Incident-reflected wave separation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Normalizing discharge with the resulting wrong incident height compounds the error across two analysis stages, even when both outputs appear smoothly varying. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：能量比例的平方關係還假設入射和反射有相同的傳播介質與群速。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Squaring amplitudes for energy additionally assumes matched propagation medium and group velocity for incident and reflected components.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。
knowledge.textEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Normalizing discharge with the resulting wrong incident height compounds the error across two analysis stages, even when both outputs appear smoothly varying.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「入射反射分離」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Incident-reflected wave separation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
optionsEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
quiz.explanation: 測點間距落在病態幾何時，微小讀值誤差會被放大成不合理反射；若再用錯誤入射波高歸一化越波量，兩個分析步驟會共同偏離真實條件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ill-conditioned gauge spacing magnifies small reading errors into unrealistic reflection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「取樣頻帶配置」與「堤頂水舌流態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sampling bandwidth selection" and "Crest-flow regime": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「取樣頻帶配置」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sampling bandwidth selection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。 假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 感測器的固有頻率和裝置共振同樣限制有效頻帶，不能僅查擷取器規格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「取樣頻帶配置」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks. Analog filtering and sensor response matter before digitization; interpolating afterward increases sample count without recovering aliased or absent information. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Sensor natural frequency and rig resonance also limit useful bandwidth, so acquisition specifications alone are insufficient evidence. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sampling bandwidth selection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「取樣頻帶配置」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sampling bandwidth selection”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 取樣頻帶配置
knowledge.text: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。取樣前的類比濾波與感測器自身頻率響應同樣重要，事後加密插值只能增加點數，無法回復已混疊或漏掉的訊號。
knowledge.textEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. Sampling sufficient for the main wave period may miss brief pressure peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「取樣頻帶配置」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sampling bandwidth selection" is correct?
options: 每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。
弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
optionsEn: Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 波面和衝擊壓力的時間尺度不同，能記錄主波週期的頻率不一定能捕捉短暫壓峰。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface elevation and impact pressure occupy different timescales. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「取樣頻帶配置」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sampling bandwidth selection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設取樣20Hz，理想奈奎斯特頻率10Hz；週期2s波有40點，但不能據此保證毫秒衝擊峰值準確。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sampling20Hz: ideal Nyquist frequency is10Hz and a2s wave has40 points. This does not establish accuracy for millisecond impact peaks.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「取樣頻帶配置」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Sampling bandwidth selection", which statement holds?
options: 平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「取樣頻帶配置」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sampling bandwidth selection” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。比較不同取樣率所得峰值收斂性。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction. Compare peak convergence at several justified sampling rates. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。比較不同取樣率所得峰值收斂性。
knowledge.textEn: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction. Compare peak convergence at several justified sampling rates.

knowledge.text: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。以已知快變訊號檢查峰值與相位，保留抗混疊設定及原始時間戳供重算。
knowledge.textEn: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Use a known rapidly changing signal to assess peak and phase response, retaining anti-alias settings and raw timestamps for reconstruction.

quiz.question: 要驗證「取樣頻帶配置」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Sampling bandwidth selection"?
options: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
optionsEn: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
quiz.explanation: 分別為波面、集水量與衝擊設定需求頻帶，確認感測器與擷取器整條量測鏈。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Specify bandwidth separately for elevation, collection and impacts, checking the complete sensor-acquisition chain. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 取樣頻帶配置：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sampling bandwidth selection: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「取樣頻帶配置」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sampling bandwidth selection” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。平滑後的波形不等於可信波形，將其當結構設計荷載前仍須確認頻率響應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones. A smooth trace is not automatically credible, and structural load interpretation still requires demonstrated frequency response of the measurement chain. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：感測器的固有頻率和裝置共振同樣限制有效頻帶，不能僅查擷取器規格。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sensor natural frequency and rig resonance also limit useful bandwidth, so acquisition specifications alone are insufficient evidence.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。
弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones.
A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
quiz.explanation: 過低頻率會漏掉短峰，過高頻率若未控制電噪音又可能產生假峰。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Low sampling misses short peaks, while uncontrolled electrical noise at high rates creates false ones. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 堤頂水舌流態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crest-flow regime: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堤頂水舌流態」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crest-flow regime” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 跨堤水舌具有局部水深與速度，平均單寬流量無法唯一決定兩者。弗勞德數可比較慣性與重力尺度，但不含人員失衡、漂浮物及脈動衝擊；同一平均越波量仍可能對應很不同的瞬間流況。 假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。 水舌前緣可能近似乾濕交界，局部水深接近零時此比值會很敏感。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堤頂水舌流態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A crest water tongue has local depth and velocity that mean unit discharge cannot uniquely determine. The Froude number compares inertia with gravity but excludes pedestrian instability, debris and impulsive loading. Equal mean overtopping can therefore conceal very different instantaneous flow regimes at the crest. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. The tongue front approaches a wet-dry boundary, making the ratio highly sensitive when local depth approaches zero. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crest-flow regime” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「弗勞德數小於某一數字就能直接開放海堤通行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堤頂水舌流態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crest-flow regime”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

quiz.question: 關於「堤頂水舌流態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。

optionsEn: A Froude value below one chosen number directly permits seawall access.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
A crest water tongue has local depth and velocity that mean unit discharge cannot uniquely determine.

steps.title: 堤頂水舌流態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crest-flow regime: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「堤頂水舌流態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crest-flow regime” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量測水深與速度而非分別取各自最大值，檢查儀器在含氣薄層中的有效性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure depth and velocity simultaneously instead of combining unrelated maxima, checking sensor validity in shallow aerated flow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設局部v=2m/s、h=0.30m，Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17；這是局部流態指標，不是通行安全判定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume local v=2m/s and h=0.30m. Fr=v/√(gh)=1.17 is a local flow-regime indicator, not an access-safety decision.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「堤頂水舌流態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.

steps.title: 堤頂水舌流態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Crest-flow regime: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「堤頂水舌流態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Crest-flow regime” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量測水深與速度而非分別取各自最大值，檢查儀器在含氣薄層中的有效性。用影像核對水舌範圍及持續時間，並把局部資料和整段平均流量分開呈現。記錄深度感測器失效與含氣片段。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure depth and velocity simultaneously instead of combining unrelated maxima, checking sensor validity in shallow aerated flow. Use video to confirm tongue extent and duration, presenting local measurements separately from whole-sequence mean discharge. Flag depth-sensor dropout and strongly aerated intervals explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同步量測水深與速度而非分別取各自最大值，檢查儀器在含氣薄層中的有效性。用影像核對水舌範圍及持續時間，並把局部資料和整段平均流量分開呈現。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure depth and velocity simultaneously instead of combining unrelated maxima, checking sensor validity in shallow aerated flow. Use video to confirm tongue extent and duration, presenting local measurements separately from whole-sequence mean discharge.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水深與速度不同步會產生根本未發生的極端組合，含氣又可能讓讀值失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unsynchronized depth and velocity create extreme combinations that never occurred, while air distorts measurements. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized depth and velocity create extreme combinations that never occurred, while air distorts measurements. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「重複試驗變異」與「局部荷載與平均量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Repeated-test variability" and "Local load versus mean flow": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複試驗變異」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeated-test variability” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。 假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複試驗變異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data. Uncertainty of the mean differs from the spread of individual events or test outcomes. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeated-test variability” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複試驗變異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Repeated-test variability”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 重複試驗變異
knowledge.text: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。重複試驗應涵蓋波列變異，而不只是重讀同一段資料；平均值的不確定度也不等於單次事件分散程度。
knowledge.textEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. Repeats should sample sequence variability rather than reread identical data.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「重複試驗變異」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Repeated-test variability" is correct?
options: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。
重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。
平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
optionsEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima.
Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples.
Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
quiz.explanation: 相同能譜可以由不同隨機相位波列實現，少數大波會影響集水平均與最大事件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The same spectrum can be realized through different random-phase sequences, and a few large waves influence collected means and maxima. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複試驗變異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeated-test variability” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三次q為0.4、0.5、0.6L/s/m，平均0.5、樣本標準差0.1，獨立時平均標準誤0.1/√3=0.0577；樣本僅3。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume q=0.4,0.5,0.6L/s/m: mean0.5, sample deviation0.1 and independent-mean standard error0.0577. Only3 realizations are represented.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「重複試驗變異」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Repeated-test variability", which statement holds?
options: 單寬越波量與全堤總流量可以使用同一縮尺指數。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
最大單波高度就是能譜有效波高的另一種寫法。
optionsEn: Unit-width overtopping and total seawall flow use the same scale exponent.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Maximum individual wave height is another name for spectral significant height.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「重複試驗變異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Repeated-test variability” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。分開列出隨機變異與共同校準誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty. Separate random variability from shared calibration uncertainty explicitly. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。分開列出隨機變異與共同校準誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty. Separate random variability from shared calibration uncertainty explicitly.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。檢查樣本是否真正獨立，並在報告列出原始三次結果，避免只留下不確定度最小的組合。
knowledge.textEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Check genuine independence and report the original realizations instead of retaining only the combination with the smallest apparent uncertainty.

quiz.question: 要驗證「重複試驗變異」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Repeated-test variability"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
反射振幅百分之四十就表示反射了百分之四十能量。
記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Forty percent reflected amplitude means forty percent reflected energy.
Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately.
quiz.explanation: 記錄每次隨機種子、有效波數與試驗長度，分別比較平均越波與個別大事件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record random seed, valid wave count and duration for every run, comparing mean discharge and large events separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 重複試驗變異：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated-test variability: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重複試驗變異」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated-test variability” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：獨立性涉及實際波列而非檔案數量，系統校準偏差也不會隨重複次數消失。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Independence concerns the physical realization rather than file count, and shared calibration bias does not vanish through repetition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「重播同一段波列三次等於取得三組獨立海況樣本。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Replaying one wave sequence three times gives three independent sea-state samples." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Removing a high-discharge realization further distorts the tail behavior that matters for the engineering interpretation of unusually severe events.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「重複試驗變異」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Repeated-test variability" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
optionsEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
quiz.explanation: 重用同一波列再把它當獨立樣本會虛增有效樣本數，標準誤因此過小；刪除一次較大越波結果更會直接扭曲工程所關心的尾部行為與風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing one wave sequence as independent observations inflates sample size and understates standard error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部荷載與平均量」如何影響海堤越波模型試驗的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local load versus mean flow” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Overtopping model tests for seawalls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。 假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部荷載與平均量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks. Passing a discharge criterion does not qualify every secondary component. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local load versus mean flow” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部荷載與平均量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local load versus mean flow”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部荷載與平均量
knowledge.text: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。力、壓力和受力面積必須區分，壓力感測器的空間平均也會抹去小範圍峰值；不能由流量合格推論所有附屬構件合格。
knowledge.textEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. Distinguish force, pressure and loaded area; spatial averaging by a pressure sensor also smooths small peaks.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「局部荷載與平均量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Local load versus mean flow" is correct?
options: 平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。
越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。
長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
optionsEn: Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels.
Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
quiz.explanation: 越波平均量適合描述一段時間的水量，但堤後構件可能由短時局部衝擊控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mean overtopping describes water quantity over time, whereas a rear-side element may be governed by a brief localized impact. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部荷載與平均量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Local load versus mean flow” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻瞬時合力100N作用於0.020m²平板，p=F/A=5kPa；不代表其他面積或非均勻衝擊峰值。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a uniform instantaneous100N resultant on a0.020m² plate. p=F/A=5kPa does not represent another area or a nonuniform impact peak.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「局部荷載與平均量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Local load versus mean flow", which statement holds?
options: 收集槽有讀值就代表所有越波水量都已被量到。
相同出水高比值必然代表相同前灘破波與越波結果。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A collector reading proves that all overtopping water was measured.
Equal relative freeboard guarantees identical foreshore breaking and overtopping.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部荷載與平均量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Local load versus mean flow” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。另外積分時間歷程取得荷載衝量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions. Integrate the force history separately to obtain impulse. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。另外積分時間歷程取得荷載衝量。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions. Integrate the force history separately to obtain impulse.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。保存感測面積、取樣頻率及載重方向，並檢查附屬構件的實際邊界是否與模型平板相同。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Retain sensor area, sampling rate and load direction, checking whether the actual secondary element shares the model plate's support conditions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「局部荷載與平均量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Local load versus mean flow"?
options: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
每個主波週期有很多點就能保證任何壓力峰值可靠。
optionsEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Many samples per main wave guarantee reliable measurement of every pressure peak.
quiz.explanation: 以已知荷載校準整個受力裝置，核對壓力積分與獨立力計結果。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrate the full force assembly with known loading and compare integrated pressure with an independent force sensor. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 局部荷載與平均量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Local load versus mean flow: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「局部荷載與平均量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Local load versus mean flow” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。若只存最大數字而不存時間歷程，便無法分辨水力作用與儀器反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Retaining only a maximum value prevents separation of the hydraulic event from the instrument response that followed it. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：峰值持續時間決定荷載衝量，結構反應也受自身頻率與阻尼控制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Peak duration controls load impulse, while the structural response additionally depends on its natural frequencies and damping.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「平均越波量通過後堤後欄杆與面板的衝擊荷載也已通過。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acceptable mean overtopping also qualifies impact loads on rear railings and panels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。若只存最大數字而不存時間歷程，便無法分辨水力作用與儀器反應。
knowledge.textEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Retaining only a maximum value prevents separation of the hydraulic event from the instrument response that followed it.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「局部荷載與平均量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Local load versus mean flow" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。
長度縮尺正確就代表所有越波及衝擊現象同時相似。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks.
Correct length scaling makes every overtopping and impact process similar.
quiz.explanation: 小面積衝擊被平均到大面積後可能低估局部破壞，裝置自振又可能製造額外峰值。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Averaging a small impact over a large area understates local damage, while rig vibration adds artificial peaks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 拋石防波堤施工
courses.summary: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 連結塊石質量、層次幾何、基床與施工量測以理解拋石防波堤
courses.focusEn: Understand rubble-mound breakwaters through stone mass, layered geometry, foundations and construction measurements
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。假設排水體積由2增10%至2.2m³、兩種密度固定，水下有效重量由31.8825增至35.07075kN；此線性增加不代表波浪穩定能力必定增加10%，因形狀與接觸可能改變。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Increasing displaced volume from2 to2.2m³ by10% at fixed densities changes effective weight from31.8825 to35.07075kN. Wave stability does not necessarily improve by10%, because shape and contact can change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume100m³ bulk volume contains60m³ solids. Porosity n=0.40 and void ratio e=40/60=0.667 are different quantities.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. Horizontal run is20m and slope length√(10²+20²)=22.36m, not20m.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension.
