stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水下有效重量」與「無因次穩定指標」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Submerged effective weight" and "Dimensionless stability indicator": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水下有效重量」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Submerged effective weight” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。 假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水下有效重量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Submerged effective weight” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水下有效重量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Submerged effective weight”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水下有效重量
knowledge.text: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。含孔隙岩石的吸水狀態和外包體積定義需一致，乾石秤重不能不經轉換就代表水下作用。
knowledge.textEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. Absorption state and external volume definition must be consistent; a dry weighing result is not directly the submerged action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水下有效重量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Submerged effective weight" is correct?
options: 同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
quiz.explanation: 塊石在水下抵抗移動的重量應扣除浮力，材料密度與海水密度共同決定有效重度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stone resistance underwater depends on weight minus buoyancy, with both rock and water density controlling effective unit weight. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水下有效重量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Submerged effective weight” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設岩石密度2650kg/m³、海水1025kg/m³、排水體積2m³，W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rock density2650kg/m³, seawater1025kg/m³ and displaced volume2m³. W′=(2650−1025)×9.81×2=31.8825kN.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水下有效重量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Submerged effective weight", which statement holds?
options: 只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水下有效重量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submerged effective weight” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。分別核對實體、外包與堆積體積定義。
knowledge.textEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average. Check solid, envelope and stockpile volume definitions separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。以獨立浮力或密度試驗驗證，並保留個別塊石資料而非只報整批平均。
knowledge.textEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verify through independent buoyancy or density testing and retain individual records instead of only a batch average.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水下有效重量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submerged effective weight"?
options: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
optionsEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
quiz.explanation: 將石料質量、吸水狀態與體積量測配對，另核對海水密度的取樣條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Pair stone mass with absorption state and measured volume, checking seawater sampling conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 水下有效重量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submerged effective weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水下有效重量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submerged effective weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積量測應明確說明是否包含可進水開口孔隙，否則排水體積與材料密度不相容。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Volume measurement must state whether water-accessible pores are included; otherwise displaced volume and the selected material density are inconsistent.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。
knowledge.textEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. A plausible average can conceal weak porous pieces and systematically overestimate underwater resistance throughout the placed layer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「水下有效重量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Submerged effective weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
quiz.explanation: 若把鬆方堆積體積當成單塊排水體積，孔隙水會被錯算為石料；平均密度看似合理卻可掩蓋弱石和多孔石，造成水下抗力估計系統性偏高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using bulk stockpile volume as individual displaced volume counts void water as stone. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「無因次穩定指標」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dimensionless stability indicator” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。穩定指標只能在相應實驗關係的適用範圍內解釋，不能自訂一個數字就決定石料規格。 假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。 堤頭的三維流況也不同於直線堤身，不能未經驗證共用同一穩定判據。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「無因次穩定指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. Interpret this indicator within the relevant empirical relation; choosing a convenient number alone cannot establish an armour specification. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned. Three-dimensional flow around a breakwater head differs from a straight trunk, so their stability criteria are not automatically interchangeable. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dimensionless stability indicator” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「無因次穩定指標」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dimensionless stability indicator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 無因次穩定指標
knowledge.text: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。穩定指標只能在相應實驗關係的適用範圍內解釋，不能自訂一個數字就決定石料規格。
knowledge.textEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. Interpret this indicator within the relevant empirical relation; choosing a convenient number alone cannot establish an armour specification.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「無因次穩定指標」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dimensionless stability indicator" is correct?
options: 相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。
optionsEn: The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.
Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition.
quiz.explanation: 波高與有效密度及標稱石徑的比值可組織不同試驗的量級，但本身不包含坡度、波週期、透水性與容許損傷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wave height relative to effective density and nominal diameter organizes test scales but omits slope, period, permeability and damage definition. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「無因次穩定指標」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dimensionless stability indicator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854、H=3m、Dn=1m，Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892；此處沒有指定合格門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Δ=2650/1025−1=1.5854, H=3m and Dn=1m. Ns=H/(ΔDn)=1.892; no acceptance threshold is assigned.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「無因次穩定指標」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dimensionless stability indicator", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「無因次穩定指標」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dimensionless stability indicator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。將堤身與堤頭測試資料分開比較。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ. Compare trunk and head test evidence as separate cases. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。再以現地材料形狀和模型層次檢查哪些條件並不相同。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Compare actual rock shapes and model layering to identify conditions that differ.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「無因次穩定指標」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dimensionless stability indicator"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
quiz.explanation: 把波高定義、週期、坡度、層數與損傷指標列成試驗對照表，查明採用關係的校準範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Tabulate wave-height definition, period, slope, layers and damage metric against the calibration range of the chosen relation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 無因次穩定指標：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless stability indicator: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「無因次穩定指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dimensionless stability indicator” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Similar-looking slopes can still develop different movement patterns because their permeability and wave periods are different. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：堤頭的三維流況也不同於直線堤身，不能未經驗證共用同一穩定判據。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Three-dimensional flow around a breakwater head differs from a straight trunk, so their stability criteria are not automatically interchangeable.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Similar-looking slopes can still develop different movement patterns because their permeability and wave periods are different.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「無因次穩定指標」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Dimensionless stability indicator" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks.
quiz.explanation: 把不同波高定義或不同損傷標準的資料混用，會讓同一穩定數代表不同風險；外觀相似的石坡仍可能因透水性和波週期差異而有不同移動模式。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing wave-height definitions or damage criteria makes one stability number represent different risks. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型

steps.title: 堆積孔隙與耗能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Packing porosity and dissipation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堆積孔隙與耗能」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Packing porosity and dissipation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 護面與堤心孔隙影響水流穿透、壓力釋放與能量耗散，孔隙率卻不是越大越好。級配、形狀和安放方式決定連通性；相同總孔隙體積可能形成截然不同的通道與局部流速。 假設堆體100m³內石料實體60m³，孔隙率n=(100−60)/100=0.40；孔隙比e=40/60=0.667，兩者不同。 層間細料遷移可改變連通孔隙而不顯著改變總孔隙率，需看內部壓力反應。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堆積孔隙與耗能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Armour and core voids influence penetration, pressure relief and energy loss, but more porosity is not automatically better. Grading, shape and placement govern connectivity; equal total void volume can produce very different flow paths and local velocities. Assume100m³ bulk volume contains60m³ solids. Porosity n=0.40 and void ratio e=40/60=0.667 are different quantities. Migration between layers can change connected voids without much change in total porosity, requiring attention to internal pressure response. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Packing porosity and dissipation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堆積孔隙與耗能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 水下坡面放樣要區分垂直高度、水平投影與斜面長度，測深資料還需回到共同高程基準。邊坡外形控制材料量和護面連續性，名義坡比正確不表示坡腳與轉折位置都已符合實際斷面。 假設坡比1垂直比2水平、高10m，水平投影20m、斜面長√(10²+20²)=22.36m；不是20m斜長。 斜面護面面積與水平投影面積不同，材料覆蓋密度的分母需跟著定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「坡面幾何放樣」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater setting-out distinguishes vertical height, horizontal run and slope length while referencing soundings to one datum. Profile geometry controls material quantity and armour continuity; the nominal slope ratio alone does not confirm toe or transition locations. Assume a1V:2H slope with10m rise. steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。另在坡腳與堤頂增加測線，避免只用中間一條斜線判定整段層厚。獨立計算水平投影與實際坡面面積。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Add survey lines at toe and crest rather than using one central slope line to infer layer thickness everywhere. Compute projected and actual slope areas independently.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。另在坡腳與堤頂增加測線，避免只用中間一條斜線判定整段層厚。
knowledge.textEn: Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Add survey lines at toe and crest rather than using one central slope line to infer layer thickness everywhere.

quiz.question: 要驗證「坡面幾何放樣」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Slope geometry setting-out"?
options: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
optionsEn: Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
quiz.explanation: 用剖面點重建垂直與水平坐標，檢查潮位、船體姿態和探頭偏置的修正。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconstruct profile coordinates and check tide, vessel attitude and transducer-offset corrections. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 坡面幾何放樣：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slope geometry setting-out: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「坡面幾何放樣」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slope geometry setting-out” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Excess material higher up can hide a deficient toe, so equal average cross-sectional area does not prove continuous local support. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：斜面護面面積與水平投影面積不同，材料覆蓋密度的分母需跟著定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Armoured slope area differs from its horizontal projection, and the denominator used for coverage density must follow that definition.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要平均坡比正確就不必另外檢查坡腳位置。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A correct average slope makes separate toe-position checks unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。
knowledge.textEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Excess material higher up can hide a deficient toe, so equal average cross-sectional area does not prove continuous local support.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「坡面幾何放樣」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Slope geometry setting-out" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
quiz.explanation: 把斜長當水平距離會使石料數量和安放位置同時偏差，坡腳缺料又可能被高處多料掩蓋；平均斷面面積相同仍無法保證局部支承連續。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Confusing slope length with horizontal run shifts both quantities and placement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「反濾相容判讀」與「標稱石徑與形狀」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filter compatibility interpretation" and "Nominal diameter and shape": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「反濾相容判讀」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter compatibility interpretation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。粒徑比只是選用準則中的一部分，基土是否分散、級配是否間斷以及波浪反向流都會影響可用性。 假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。 土工織物還涉及接縫與穿刺，不能套用顆粒反濾的尺寸比便宣告等效。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「反濾相容判讀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. Grain-size ratios are only part of a selected criterion; dispersive soil, gap grading and reversing wave flow can change applicability substantially. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion. Geotextiles introduce seam and puncture behavior and cannot be declared equivalent merely by applying a granular-filter size ratio. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter compatibility interpretation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「反濾相容判讀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter compatibility interpretation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 反濾相容判讀
knowledge.text: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。粒徑比只是選用準則中的一部分，基土是否分散、級配是否間斷以及波浪反向流都會影響可用性。
knowledge.textEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. Grain-size ratios are only part of a selected criterion; dispersive soil, gap grading and reversing wave flow can change applicability substantially.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「反濾相容判讀」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Filter compatibility interpretation" is correct?
options: 任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。
反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。
optionsEn: A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning.
Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives.
quiz.explanation: 反濾層要限制細料流失並允許排水，保土與透水兩個目標必須一起考慮。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Filters must retain finer material while allowing drainage, so retention and permeability are joint objectives. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「反濾相容判讀」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter compatibility interpretation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設濾料D15=4mm、基料d85=1mm，比值D15/d85=4；只示範粒徑比，不宣稱符合所有反濾準則。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume filter D15=4mm and base d85=1mm, giving ratio4. This illustrates the ratio without claiming compliance with every filter criterion.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「反濾相容判讀」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Filter compatibility interpretation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。
無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists.
A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「反濾相容判讀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter compatibility interpretation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。分別標示顆粒層與織物介面缺陷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition. Map granular-layer and geotextile-interface defects separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只挑一個粒徑比合格會漏掉基土被沖走或排水受阻的另一端風險；施工分離造成局部級配改變時，料場檢驗合格也不能證明現地整層有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Passing one grain-size ratio can miss either base-material loss or blocked drainage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition. Map granular-layer and geotextile-interface defects separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。採用具適用性的保土與透水判據，再以實際流向和材料狀態檢查需要的相容性試驗。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Apply appropriate retention and permeability criteria, then assess compatibility testing against actual flow reversals and material condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「反濾相容判讀」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter compatibility interpretation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
分別取得基料與濾料完整級配曲線，核對粒徑符號和試驗方法。
相同穩定數就能不看坡度與週期直接採用相同石重。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods.
The same stability number permits identical stone mass regardless of slope and period.

quiz.explanationEn: Obtain complete grading curves for base and filter and verify percentile definitions and test methods. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 反濾相容判讀：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter compatibility interpretation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「反濾相容判讀」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter compatibility interpretation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只挑一個粒徑比合格會漏掉基土被沖走或排水受阻的另一端風險；施工分離造成局部級配改變時，料場檢驗合格也不能證明現地整層有效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Segregation during placement changes local grading, so quarry compliance does not establish that the full installed filter remains effective. steps.title: 標稱石徑與形狀：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal diameter and shape” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 標稱石徑是由石塊體積換算的立方體尺度，不是最長邊或篩孔尺寸。扁長石可能有相同質量卻較容易受力翻轉，故尺寸換算需和形狀、裂隙及安放接觸一起判讀。 假設石重M=5000kg、密度ρ=2650kg/m³，Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m；不是石塊最大邊長。 以立方體代表尺寸保留體積而不保留所有投影面，受力仍需實際幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「標稱石徑與形狀」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nominal diameter is the cube-root volume scale, not the longest axis or sieve opening. Slender stones of equal mass may rotate differently under loading, so conversion must be interpreted with shape, fractures and contact arrangement rather than as a complete stability description. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension. The equivalent cube preserves volume without preserving every projected face, so load assessment still requires the actual exposed geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal diameter and shape” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「標稱石徑一樣表示塊石形狀與翻轉阻力也相同。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal nominal diameter implies equal shape and resistance to overturning." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「標稱石徑與形狀」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

Slender stones of equal mass may rotate differently under loading, so conversion must be interpreted with shape, fractures and contact arrangement rather than as a complete stability description.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass M=5000kg and densityρ=2650kg/m³. Dn=(M/ρ)^(1/3)=1.2357m is not the stone's maximum dimension. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「標稱石徑與形狀」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 對代表性石塊同時量質量、三主軸與裂隙，從密度換算標稱徑後保留原始形狀資料。比較合格級配內的扁長比例，並檢查安放後接觸是否符合設計假設。核對最長與最短主軸的比值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeρ=1025kg/m³, Cd=1, projected A=2m² and steady v=2m/s. steps.instruction: 拋石堤的基床變形會改變坡腳與堤頂高程，也會重新分配護面接觸。平均壓縮應變可估量沉陷，但不能代表差異沉陷或循環孔壓引起的軟化，施工分期與海床土性必須一起記錄。 假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。 沉陷還可能改變有效堤頂出水高，進而影響原先估計的越波和堤後排水需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基床沉陷與層厚」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基床沉陷與層厚」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Foundation settlement and thickness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設厚H=3m的單層均勻垂直應變0.02，s=εH=0.060m；未包含其他土層或差異沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a3m layer with uniform vertical strain0.02. Settlement s=εH=0.060m excludes other layers and differential movement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基床沉陷與層厚」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Foundation settlement and thickness", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
孔隙率與孔隙比只是同一比例的兩種名稱。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
Porosity and void ratio are simply two names for the same fraction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基床沉陷與層厚」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Foundation settlement and thickness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。核對壓縮層厚度及地下水條件，避免把石堆重排和地基壓縮混成同一機制。把沉陷量換算成有效出水高變化。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation. Translate settlement into the corresponding effective-freeboard change. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。核對壓縮層厚度及地下水條件，避免把石堆重排和地基壓縮混成同一機制。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verify compressible-layer thickness and groundwater conditions, distinguishing stone rearrangement from deformation of the underlying foundation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「基床沉陷與層厚」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Foundation settlement and thickness"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。
任意基土只要粒徑比等於四就必然滿足反濾要求。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement.
A grain-size ratio of four automatically satisfies filter requirements for every base soil.
quiz.explanation: 在相同基準下追蹤多個剖面的高程與施工荷載，將即時變形和後續變形分開。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Track elevations across several profiles against construction loading using one datum, separating immediate and delayed movement. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 基床沉陷與層厚：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation settlement and thickness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「基床沉陷與層厚」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation settlement and thickness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. Fine material may escape beneath an intact-looking surface, and average crest movement can miss the area most in need of intervention. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：沉陷還可能改變有效堤頂出水高，進而影響原先估計的越波和堤後排水需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Settlement can also reduce effective crest freeboard, altering the overtopping and rear-drainage demand originally estimated for the completed structure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堤頂平均沉陷很小就代表基床與反濾層沒有局部損傷。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average crest settlement proves no local foundation or filter damage exists." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。
knowledge.textEn: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. Fine material may escape beneath an intact-looking surface, and average crest movement can miss the area most in need of intervention.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「基床沉陷與層厚」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Foundation settlement and thickness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible.
quiz.explanation: 基床局部下陷可能先讓濾層拉開而不是整堤明顯下沉，外觀仍完整時內部已可流失細料；只用堤頂平均沉陷容易漏掉最需要維修的區域。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Localized foundation movement can open the filter before large crest settlement becomes visible. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「吊索角度與受力」與「損傷斷面與追蹤」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sling angle and force" and "Damage profiles and tracking": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「吊索角度與受力」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sling angle and force” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。索向與垂直方向的角度會改變張力，重心偏移、動態加速度及吊點強度仍需由核准吊裝方案處理。 假設靜態重量100kN由兩索對稱承擔，各與垂直夾30°，T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN；不含動載。 此處張力是索的軸向力，不能把垂直分量誤當成吊索本身所承受的力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「吊索角度與受力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. Angle from the vertical changes tension, while center-of-gravity offset, dynamic acceleration and attachment capacity still require an approved lifting analysis. Assume static100kN shared symmetrically by two slings each30° from vertical. T=100/(2cos30°)=57.74kN, excluding dynamic loading. Sling tension is axial force; its vertical component must not be mistaken for the force carried by the sling itself. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sling angle and force” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「吊索角度與受力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sling angle and force”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 吊索角度與受力
knowledge.text: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。索向與垂直方向的角度會改變張力，重心偏移、動態加速度及吊點強度仍需由核准吊裝方案處理。
knowledge.textEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. Angle from the vertical changes tension, while center-of-gravity offset, dynamic acceleration and attachment capacity still require an approved lifting analysis.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「吊索角度與受力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sling angle and force" is correct?
options: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。
兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。
無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
optionsEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count.
Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle.
A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred.
quiz.explanation: 拋石安放常涉及吊具或抓斗，但載重分配不是把總重平均除以吊索數就結束。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Stone placement can involve slings or grabs, but force sharing is not simply weight divided by sling count. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「吊索角度與受力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。以兩索分力總和重新核對平衡。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting. Recheck equilibrium using the sum of both sling components. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在示意圖標明角度相對垂直或水平的定義，驗算垂直分力和水平分力平衡。另列吊具能力、重心與動載條件，讓教學靜力值不被誤用為現場吊裝設定。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label whether angles reference vertical or horizontal and verify both force components. Separately document rig capacity, center of gravity and dynamic conditions so the teaching equilibrium result cannot become a field lifting setting.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 吊索角度與受力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sling angle and force: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「吊索角度與受力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sling angle and force” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 角度定義弄反會使張力估算大幅錯誤，海上吊運的加速度又可能超出靜態值；若只查總重量而忽略索力與吊點，系統最弱介面可能先行破壞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Checking total weight without sling and attachment forces can leave the weakest interface unrecognized until it governs failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：此處張力是索的軸向力，不能把垂直分量誤當成吊索本身所承受的力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Sling tension is axial force; its vertical component must not be mistaken for the force carried by the sling itself.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩條索永遠各承受總重量的一半而不受角度影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two slings always carry half the weight regardless of their angle." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.explanationEn: Reversing the angle convention greatly changes predicted tension, while offshore acceleration exceeds static loading. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「損傷斷面與追蹤」如何影響拋石防波堤施工的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damage profiles and tracking” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Rubble-mound breakwater construction”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。損傷面積可以組織觀測，但需要搭配位置和時序，避免把移位後仍在斷面內的石塊誤算成完全流失。 假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。 同一損傷數的風險仍受位置控制，堤頭或過渡區不能以堤身平均表現代替。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「損傷斷面與追蹤」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-storm armour movement needs fixed survey areas and datums. Surface depressions, toe accumulation and actual material loss differ. A damage-area measure organizes observations only when location and chronology remain available, preventing displaced stones still within the section from being counted as entirely lost. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage. The significance of a damage number still depends on location; head or transition damage cannot be replaced by average trunk performance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Damage profiles and tracking” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「損傷斷面與追蹤」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Damage profiles and tracking”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「損傷斷面與追蹤」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Damage profiles and tracking" is correct?
options: 無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。
暴風後護面位移要用固定測區和基準比較，表面凹陷、坡腳隆起與真正石料流失不相同。

Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「損傷斷面與追蹤」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damage profiles and tracking” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一斷面受損面積Ae=8m²、Dn=1m，無因次S=Ae/Dn²=8；這不是百分之八損傷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume damage area Ae=8m² in one section and Dn=1m. Dimensionless S=Ae/Dn²=8 is not eight-percent damage. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「損傷斷面與追蹤」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Damage profiles and tracking"?
options: 明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
流速增加百分之十時阻力也只會增加百分之十。
optionsEn: Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A ten-percent increase in speed produces only ten-percent more drag.
quiz.explanation: 明確定義受損面積的基準線與積分範圍，重測坡腳和堤頂並保留暴風前後影像。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Define the baseline and integration limits for damage area, resurvey toe and crest and retain before/after imagery. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 損傷斷面與追蹤：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Damage profiles and tracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「損傷斷面與追蹤」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damage profiles and tracking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Local filter exposure may also disappear in section-wide averaging, delaying recognition of the starting point for further material loss. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：同一損傷數的風險仍受位置控制，堤頭或過渡區不能以堤身平均表現代替。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The significance of a damage number still depends on location; head or transition damage cannot be replaced by average trunk performance.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「無因次損傷數等於百分比，可以直接乘一百解讀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A dimensionless damage number is a percentage that can be multiplied by one hundred." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。
knowledge.textEn: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Local filter exposure may also disappear in section-wide averaging, delaying recognition of the starting point for further material loss.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「損傷斷面與追蹤」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Damage profiles and tracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。
同樣乾重量的石塊在任何水體中都有相同水下重量。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands.
Equal dry stone weights imply equal submerged weights in every water body.
quiz.explanation: 若每次測量都換基準或範圍，損傷指標可能下降但實際弱點擴大；局部反濾裸露也可能在整段平均面積中被稀釋，延誤辨識進一步流失的起點。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Changing datum or survey extent can make the index decrease while a weak area expands. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 沉箱式防波堤施工
courses.summary: 沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 沿製造浮運到基床受力追蹤沉箱防波堤的狀態變化
courses.focusEn: Track caisson-breakwater state changes from fabrication and flotation to foundation loading
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。假設混凝土材料體積由1000增10%至1100m³、密度固定2400kg/m³，重量由23544增至25898.4kN；浮體的排水體積和重心必須另行更新，不能宣稱浮穩同步改善10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy. Increasing concrete volume from1000 to1100m³ by10% at fixed2400kg/m³ changes weight from23544 to25898.4kN. Displacement and gravity center require separate updates; stability does not automatically improve by10%. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設混凝土密度2400kg/m³、材料體積1000m³，質量2400000kg，重量mg=23544kN；這不是浮力所用外包體積。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設總質量2460000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，吃水T=m/(ρA)=6m；側高10m時靜態乾舷4m。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設20m×20m矩形水線、吃水6m、排水V=2400m³、KB=3m、KG=7m，GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同密度艙水的自由液面10m×10m、排水2400m³，修正ΔGM=If/V=(10×10³/12)/2400=0.3472m；只適用小角近似。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設增重205000kg、海水1025kg/m³、水線面400m²，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m；水線面與密閉狀態保持不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米堤長、底寬20m，底壓由80線性降至20kPa，U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m；未計時變壓力。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume concrete density2400kg/m³ and material volume1000m³. Mass is2400000kg and weight23544kN; this is not the envelope volume used for buoyancy.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume mass2460000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². Draft T=m/(ρA)=6m; a10m side gives static freeboard4m.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume20m×20m waterplane,6m draft, displacement2400m³, KB=3m and KG=7m. GM=3+(20×20³/12)/2400−7=1.556m.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume same-density tank water, a10m×10m free surface and2400m³ displacement. ΔGM=If/V=0.3472m under the small-angle approximation.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume added205000kg, seawater1025kg/m³ and waterplane400m². ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.50m at unchanged geometry and sealed condition.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unit breakwater length,20m base width and linear pressure from80 to20kPa. U=(80+20)×20/2=1000kN/m, excluding time variation.
