quiz.explanationEn: Record temperature, age and mould or base restraint and match modulus to the relevant time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 約束冷卻與裂縫：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Restrained cooling and cracking: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「約束冷卻與裂縫」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Restrained cooling and cracking” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Arbitrarily removing restraint merely because the theoretical stress seems high instead understates genuine cracking potential. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：抗拉能力也隨齡期改變，應力和抗力需在相同時間比較才有物理意義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Tensile resistance changes with age too; comparing stress and resistance at the same time is necessary for a physically meaningful interpretation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。
knowledge.textEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Arbitrarily removing restraint merely because the theoretical stress seems high instead understates genuine cracking potential.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「約束冷卻與裂縫」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Restrained cooling and cracking" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。
抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
quiz.explanation: 以成熟混凝土模數套用早齡期可能高估或錯排應力時序，忽略徐變又改變鬆弛預測；反之僅因理論值過高而任意刪除約束，也會低估真實裂縫風險。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using mature modulus at early age can misstate stress magnitude and timing, while omitted creep changes relaxation. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「試體強度與構件」與「吊運力向分解」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Specimen strength versus unit behavior" and "Resolving handling forces": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「試體強度與構件」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。 假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 試體平均值與特徵值的統計意義不同，樣本數及離散程度需另外明列。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「試體強度與構件」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. A specimen mean and a characteristic value have different statistical meanings, requiring separate statements of sample size and observed variability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「試體強度與構件」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Specimen strength versus unit behavior”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 試體強度與構件
knowledge.text: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。試體與構件的溫度歷程、密實度和尺度不同，因此名義抗壓值不能代表全部構造能力。
knowledge.textEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. Their temperature histories, consolidation and size differ, so nominal compressive strength cannot describe every structural capacity of the full unit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「試體強度與構件」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Specimen strength versus unit behavior" is correct?
options: 抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
對稱吊索的理想靜力數值已包含海上起伏造成的動載。
抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。
optionsEn: Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
Ideal symmetric sling forces already include dynamic loading from offshore motion.
Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension.
quiz.explanation: 抗壓試體提供特定製作養護和載入條件下的材料證據，異形消波構件卻可能受彎曲、局部接觸和吊運拉力控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Compression specimens provide evidence under specified preparation, curing and loading, while armour units can be governed by bending, local contacts and lifting tension. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「試體強度與構件」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設立方試體邊長0.15m、破壞荷重900kN，f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa；不是直接設計強度。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a0.15m cube and failure load900kN. f=P/A=900000/0.15²=40MPa is specimen strength, not directly a design strength.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「試體強度與構件」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Specimen strength versus unit behavior", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 試體強度與構件：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Specimen strength versus unit behavior: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「試體強度與構件」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Specimen strength versus unit behavior” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。再檢查試體與構件的養護溫度差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification. Check curing-temperature differences between specimens and full units. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試體養護較好時可能高估構件內部品質，局部蜂窩又未必出現在取樣中；平均抗壓值達標仍可能伴隨吊運破裂或安放後接觸臂損傷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Better specimen curing can overstate actual unit quality, and sampling may miss local honeycombing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對試體尺寸、端面、載入方法與養護紀錄，將取樣批次連回實際構件。另檢查細臂、轉角與吊點的受力模式，避免讓抗壓試驗代替必要的材料或構造驗證。再檢查試體與構件的養護溫度差異。
knowledge.textEn: Check specimen dimensions, ends, loading method and curing, linking each sample to its production batch. Separately review slender arms, corners and lifting points so compression testing does not replace other necessary material or structural verification. Check curing-temperature differences between specimens and full units.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「吊運力向分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolving handling forces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。
optionsEn: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
quiz.explanation: 一索先張緊時對稱分配不成立，構件姿態轉動又會改變吊點力向；早期細臂裂縫可能在後續安放才顯現，僅查總吊重不能追出受損原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Symmetric sharing fails when one sling engages first, while rotation changes attachment force directions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「安放密度與孔隙」與「三維位置與姿態」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Placement density and voids" and "Three-dimensional placement geometry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「安放密度與孔隙」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Placement density and voids” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。 假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「安放密度與孔隙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Placement density and voids” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「安放密度與孔隙」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Placement density and voids”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 安放密度與孔隙
knowledge.text: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。每平方米的件數不能直接換成孔隙率，也不能只增加件數就期待水工功能改善，過密可能改變透流與局部架空。
knowledge.textEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. Units per square metre cannot be directly converted into porosity, and adding more units need not improve performance because overly dense placement can alter flow and create unsupported contacts.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「安放密度與孔隙」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Placement density and voids" is correct?
options: 總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。
安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
optionsEn: Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
quiz.explanation: 安放密度連結構件數量與覆蓋面積，但互鎖還取決於姿態、層數和接觸位置。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Placement density relates unit count to area, but interlocking also depends on orientation, layers and contacts. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「安放密度與孔隙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Placement density and voids” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一層200件覆蓋1000m²，安放密度N/A=0.20件/m²；未提供體積與層厚，不能推出孔隙率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume200 units cover1000m² in one layer. Placement density is0.20units/m²; without volume and thickness it does not determine porosity.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「安放密度與孔隙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Placement density and voids", which statement holds?
options: 一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。
每批水表加入相同水量就代表有效水膠比保持不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage.
Identical metered water addition guarantees an unchanged effective water-to-binder ratio.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「安放密度與孔隙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Placement density and voids” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。分別檢查坡腳和坡頂的局部覆蓋。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean. Check local coverage at toe and crest separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。分別檢查坡腳和坡頂的局部覆蓋。
knowledge.textEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean. Check local coverage at toe and crest separately.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。與該構件型式核准的安放規則對照，保留局部空缺而不是用全堤平均密度掩蓋。
knowledge.textEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Compare the approved rules for that unit type, preserving local gaps rather than hiding them in a whole-structure mean.

quiz.question: 要驗證「安放密度與孔隙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Placement density and voids"?
options: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
完全約束彈性熱應力就是實際混凝土最後一定保留的應力。
optionsEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Fully restrained elastic thermal stress is the stress the concrete must retain permanently.
quiz.explanation: 明示面積採用水平投影或實際斜面，逐區記錄件數、姿態和接觸照片。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State whether area is horizontal projection or actual slope and record count, orientation and contacts by zone. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 安放密度與孔隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Placement density and voids: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「安放密度與孔隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Placement density and voids” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：實際斜面和水平面積的選擇會改變名義件數密度，跨專案比較要先統一定義。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Choosing actual slope area versus horizontal projection changes nominal placement density, so comparisons across projects require a consistent denominator first.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。只驗收總數量，不能確認荷載和互鎖已沿斷面連續傳遞。
knowledge.textEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Total quantity alone does not establish continuous contact, load transfer or interlocking along the section.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「安放密度與孔隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Placement density and voids" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。
構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves.
Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts.
quiz.explanation: 高處多放構件可以使平均件數達標，坡腳空缺卻仍存在；架空構件在波浪下可能重新轉動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extra units higher up can satisfy average count while toe gaps remain, and bridged units may rotate under waves. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「三維位置與姿態」如何影響消波塊製作與安放的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Three-dimensional placement geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Wave-dissipating concrete-unit casting and placement”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下安放需把位置誤差與姿態誤差分開，三維坐標偏差小不代表接觸臂方向正確。測量基準、船體姿態和吊具桿臂都會影響重建位置，圖上的點位必須能追溯到構件的特定參考點。 假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。 位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「三維位置與姿態」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. Survey datum, vessel attitude and rig lever arms affect reconstruction, so each plotted position must refer to a defined point on the actual unit. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error. Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Three-dimensional placement geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「三維位置與姿態」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Three-dimensional placement geometry”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 三維位置與姿態
knowledge.text: 水下安放需把位置誤差與姿態誤差分開，三維坐標偏差小不代表接觸臂方向正確。測量基準、船體姿態和吊具桿臂都會影響重建位置，圖上的點位必須能追溯到構件的特定參考點。
knowledge.textEn: Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. Survey datum, vessel attitude and rig lever arms affect reconstruction, so each plotted position must refer to a defined point on the actual unit.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「三維位置與姿態」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Three-dimensional placement geometry" is correct?
options: 構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。
外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。

Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.

quiz.explanationEn: Underwater placement separates position error from orientation error; small coordinate deviation does not establish correct contact-arm direction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「三維位置與姿態」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Three-dimensional placement geometry” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設參考點偏差Δx=0.10m、Δy=0.20m、Δz=0.05m，距離e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m；不是姿態誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reference-point offsets0.10m,0.20m and0.05m. Distance e=√(Δx²+Δy²+Δz²)=0.2291m does not describe orientation error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「三維位置與姿態」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Three-dimensional placement geometry", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。
整體長度變化很小就表示混凝土內部沒有熱應力。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.
Small overall length change proves there is no internal thermal stress.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「三維位置與姿態」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Three-dimensional placement geometry” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。同時保存三個方向的原始偏差值。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones. Preserve the original offsets in all three directions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。比較安放前後的水下影像或測量資料，保留量測不確定度與盲區。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Compare underwater observations before and after placement, retaining uncertainty and blind zones.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「三維位置與姿態」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Three-dimensional placement geometry"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。
抗壓試體合格即可證明消波構件吊點和細臂承載都合格。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately.
Passing compression specimens also proves adequate lifting points and slender arms.
quiz.explanation: 用獨立控制點檢查坐標轉換，將吊具參考點換算到構件指定點，另記姿態與接觸。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check coordinate transformations against independent control, transfer the rig reference to the specified unit point and record orientation and contact separately. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 三維位置與姿態：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Three-dimensional placement geometry: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「三維位置與姿態」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Three-dimensional placement geometry” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。點位殘差小仍可能對應水工模型從未驗證過的安放方式，影響後續穩定判讀。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Small position residuals can therefore coexist with an arrangement never validated in the hydraulic model used for stability assessment. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：位置距離是三維向量的長度，不會保留偏移方向，方向仍需另行記錄。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Position distance is the magnitude of a three-dimensional vector and does not preserve direction, which must therefore remain separately recorded.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「構件參考點位置正確就能證明其朝向與接觸也正確。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Correct reference-point coordinates prove correct orientation and contacts." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。點位殘差小仍可能對應水工模型從未驗證過的安放方式，影響後續穩定判讀。
knowledge.textEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Small position residuals can therefore coexist with an arrangement never validated in the hydraulic model used for stability assessment.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「三維位置與姿態」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Three-dimensional placement geometry" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
外形縮小二十倍時質量也只要縮小二十倍即可。
參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Scaling the shape down by twenty requires mass to decrease only twentyfold.
An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms.
quiz.explanation: 參考點選錯可能讓所有坐標一致偏移，姿態未記錄則無法辨識接觸臂翻轉。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An incorrect reference point shifts every coordinate consistently, while missing orientation hides reversed contact arms. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.instruction: 幾何縮尺構件的體積按長度三次方變化，相同材料密度才可直接使用相同質量比。實體試驗還需維持相對密度、表面粗糙和接觸方式，不能只做外形相似卻讓有效重量與摩擦特性失去對應。 假設原型質量3000kg、長度比20且材料密度相同，模型質量3000/20³=0.375kg；同時需檢查水下相對密度。 模型接觸面若相對粗糙過大，摩擦行為可能與原型不同，即使質量縮尺正確。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「模型質量縮尺」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geometrically scaled units change volume with the cube of length, and equal material density permits the same mass ratio. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response. Confirm identical drying reference conditions for both weighings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。將不同批次依同方法比較，另以現地追蹤建立環境與材料反應的關聯。確認兩次秤重使用相同乾燥基準。
knowledge.textEn: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Compare batches under the same method, using field follow-up separately to relate environment and material response. Confirm identical drying reference conditions for both weighings.

quiz.question: 要驗證「磨耗試驗與壽命」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Abrasion testing and service life"?
options: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
總安放件數達標就能證明每一個區域都有足夠互鎖。
optionsEn: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Meeting the total unit count proves adequate interlocking in every local area.
quiz.explanation: 核對試驗程序、含水條件與秤重時間，記錄失重之外的裂縫和缺角形態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify test procedure, moisture condition and weighing time and record cracking or corner loss beyond mass change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 磨耗試驗與壽命：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Abrasion testing and service life: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「磨耗試驗與壽命」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Abrasion testing and service life” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Direct lifetime extrapolation then misses how localized damage to a contact arm disproportionately affects the function of the complete unit. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：耐久判讀還需要考慮鹽害與濕乾循環，機械磨耗不是唯一材料退化途徑。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Durability interpretation must also consider salt exposure and wet-dry cycling, because mechanical abrasion is not the sole material deterioration mechanism.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「一次磨耗試驗失重百分比就是構件每年的耗損百分比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Mass-loss percentage in one abrasion test equals the unit's annual loss percentage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。
knowledge.textEn: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Direct lifetime extrapolation then misses how localized damage to a contact arm disproportionately affects the function of the complete unit.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「磨耗試驗與壽命」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Abrasion testing and service life" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。
任何形狀的消波塊只要質量相同就有相同水工穩定性。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes.
Concrete armour units of any shape have identical hydraulic stability when mass matches.
quiz.explanation: 試樣表面殘水會掩蓋實際失重，破碎與均勻磨耗又可能有相同總質量差；若據此直接預測剩餘年限，會忽略局部接觸臂受損對結構功能的放大作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Residual water hides actual mass loss, while fragmentation and uniform wear can produce equal changes. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 海岸養灘工程
courses.summary: 以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 以泥沙守恆與監測辨識養灘的短期重塑和長期功能
courses.focusEn: Distinguish nourishment reshaping and long-term function through sediment accounting and monitoring
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。假設增寬由20改為22m而長度、厚度不變，方量30000增至33000m³，增加10%；並不代表養灘維持時間增加10%。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Increasing added width from20 to22m at fixed length and thickness raises volume from30000 to33000m³ by10%, without implying10% longer retention. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume bulk volume10000m³, porosity0.40 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n).

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「養灘幾何與方量」與「固體量與孔隙」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nourishment geometry and volume" and "Solid quantity and porosity": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「養灘幾何與方量」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nourishment geometry and volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。矩形示意適合練習尺寸核對，真實海灘有斜坡與沿岸變化，需要逐剖面積分；初始灘寬也不保證風浪重塑後仍維持相同位置。 假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「養灘幾何與方量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. Delivered loose volume need not equal completed profile volume. A rectangular illustration helps check dimensions, but a real beach varies alongshore and across its slopes and requires section integration; initial width does not guarantee the same shoreline after wave-driven redistribution. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nourishment geometry and volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「養灘幾何與方量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nourishment geometry and volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 養灘幾何與方量
knowledge.text: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。矩形示意適合練習尺寸核對，真實海灘有斜坡與沿岸變化，需要逐剖面積分；初始灘寬也不保證風浪重塑後仍維持相同位置。
knowledge.textEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. Delivered loose volume need not equal completed profile volume.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「養灘幾何與方量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nourishment geometry and volume" is correct?
options: 施工完成灘寬可以直接當成未來每個季節都固定的岸線。
養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。
孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
optionsEn: The completed beach width guarantees an unchanged shoreline in every future season.
Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum.
Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
quiz.explanation: 養灘計量先界定施工面、斷面及高程基準，填入的鬆方與完成後剖面方量不必相等。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Nourishment accounting begins with placement limits, sections and a vertical datum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 養灘幾何與方量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nourishment geometry and volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「養灘幾何與方量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nourishment geometry and volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設長1000m、增寬20m、等厚1.5m，V=Lbt=30000m³；只作矩形填方示意，不是平衡剖面設計。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length1000m, added width20m and uniform thickness1.5m. V=Lbt=30000m³ is rectangular accounting, not equilibrium-profile design. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一基準上畫施工前後剖面，標出超出量測範圍的部分並逐區積分。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw before-and-after sections on one datum, identify unmeasured portions and integrate by area.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Solid quantity and porosity"?

取具代表性的乾濕樣本，分別量含水、顆粒密度及堆積體積，保留採樣位置與重複試驗。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。

steps.title: 固體量與孔隙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Solid quantity and porosity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「固體量與孔隙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Solid quantity and porosity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。不同批次含貝殼與細料時，沿用同一密度也可能製造不存在的收支缺口。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Variable shell and fine content also makes a single borrowed density create an artificial deficit in the sediment budget. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設鬆方10000m³、孔隙率0.40、顆粒密度2650kg/m³，乾砂質量V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg；不含孔隙水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Dry mass V(1−n)ρs=15900000kg, excluding pore water.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。不同批次含貝殼與細料時，沿用同一密度也可能製造不存在的收支缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Variable shell and fine content also makes a single borrowed density create an artificial deficit in the sediment budget.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「固體量與孔隙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Solid quantity and porosity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。
若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss.
quiz.explanation: 若濕砂質量被當成乾砂，輸入固體會被高估，排水後看似大量砂消失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating wet mass as dry mass overstates solid input and makes drainage resemble major sand loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「粒徑相容性」與「活動剖面平移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Grain-size compatibility" and "Active-profile translation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 粒徑相容性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Grain-size compatibility: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「粒徑相容性」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Grain-size compatibility” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 借砂與原灘的中值粒徑可作第一層比較，但單一比值會隱藏級配、細料與顆粒形狀。不同粒群在波流中有不同沉降及搬運行為，較粗不必然在所有位置都更好；材料選擇還牽涉生態、灘坡和使用功能，需把各種證據並列。 假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「粒徑相容性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Median size offers an initial comparison between borrow material and native sand, but one ratio hides grading, fines and particle shape. Different fractions settle and move differently under waves and currents. Coarser is not universally better, and selection also involves ecology, beach slope and intended use, requiring several complementary observations. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Grain-size compatibility” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「粒徑相容性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Grain-size compatibility”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 粒徑相容性
knowledge.text: 借砂與原灘的中值粒徑可作第一層比較，但單一比值會隱藏級配、細料與顆粒形狀。不同粒群在波流中有不同沉降及搬運行為，較粗不必然在所有位置都更好；材料選擇還牽涉生態、灘坡和使用功能，需把各種證據並列。
knowledge.textEn: Median size offers an initial comparison between borrow material and native sand, but one ratio hides grading, fines and particle shape. Different fractions settle and move differently under waves and currents.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「粒徑相容性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Grain-size compatibility" is correct?
options: 借砂與原灘的中值粒徑可作第一層比較，但單一比值會隱藏級配、細料與顆粒形狀。
借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。
新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。
optionsEn: Median size offers an initial comparison between borrow material and native sand, but one ratio hides grading, fines and particle shape.
A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.
quiz.explanation: 借砂與原灘的中值粒徑可作第一層比較，但單一比值會隱藏級配、細料與顆粒形狀。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Median size offers an initial comparison between borrow material and native sand, but one ratio hides grading, fines and particle shape. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 粒徑相容性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Grain-size compatibility: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「粒徑相容性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Grain-size compatibility” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將完整累積粒徑曲線並排，核對細料比例及取樣深度，避免只比中值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare complete cumulative size curves, checking fines and sampling depth rather than only medians.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume borrow D50=0.45mm and native D50=0.30mm. Their ratio is1.50; this alone establishes neither grading compatibility nor retention.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「粒徑相容性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Grain-size compatibility", which statement holds?
options: 乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。
optionsEn: Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 粒徑相容性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Grain-size compatibility: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「粒徑相容性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 將完整累積粒徑曲線並排，核對細料比例及取樣深度，避免只比中值。另記顆粒形狀、污染篩查與原灘季節變化，說明哪些物理或環境條件仍沒有代表性樣本。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare complete cumulative size curves, checking fines and sampling depth rather than only medians. Record particle shape, contaminant screening and seasonal native variability, identifying physical or environmental conditions for which representative field samples remain unavailable. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將完整累積粒徑曲線並排，核對細料比例及取樣深度，避免只比中值。另記顆粒形狀、污染篩查與原灘季節變化，說明哪些物理或環境條件仍沒有代表性樣本。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare complete cumulative size curves, checking fines and sampling depth rather than only medians. Record particle shape, contaminant screening and seasonal native variability, identifying physical or environmental conditions for which representative field samples remain unavailable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中值相同的兩批材料可能有完全不同的細料尾端，入水後一批產生長距離濁羽、另一批迅速沉降。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two materials with identical medians may have very different fine tails; one generates a long plume while another settles quickly. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「粒徑相容性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Grain-size compatibility” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中值相同的兩批材料可能有完全不同的細料尾端，入水後一批產生長距離濁羽、另一批迅速沉降。只使用中值配比會錯估輸運與環境影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two materials with identical medians may have very different fine tails; one generates a long plume while another settles quickly. Median-only matching therefore misrepresents both transport behavior and environmental consequences of placement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設借砂D50=0.45mm、原灘D50=0.30mm，比值1.50；不能據此單獨判定全級配相容或保留率。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.

steps.title: 活動剖面平移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Active-profile translation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「活動剖面平移」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active-profile translation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 把新增體積分配到假想活動剖面，可估計岸線平移的量級，但須先指定陸側高度與閉合水深。實際剖面會調整坡度並沿岸交換泥沙，閉合深度也受觀測期影響；平行平移只是一項幾何假設，不能將計算結果直接當成施工後岸線預測。 假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「活動剖面平移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Distributing added volume across an assumed active profile gives a shoreline-displacement scale after specifying berm elevation and closure depth. Real profiles change slope and exchange sand alongshore, and closure depth depends on the observation period. Parallel translation is a geometric assumption, not a direct forecast of the actual post-construction beach shoreline. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Active-profile translation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「活動剖面平移」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Active-profile translation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 誤解：新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「活動剖面平移」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。
把新增體積分配到假想活動剖面，可估計岸線平移的量級，但須先指定陸側高度與閉合水深。
年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。
optionsEn: Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.
Distributing added volume across an assumed active profile gives a shoreline-displacement scale after specifying berm elevation and closure depth.
An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month.

steps.title: 活動剖面平移：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active-profile translation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「活動剖面平移」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active-profile translation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：清楚標出剖面上下界和零高程，測試閉合深度不同時結果如何改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark profile limits and the vertical origin and test alternative closure depths.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設V=30000m³、沿岸長1000m、閉合深5m、陸側高2m，Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m；只限平行平移。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume V=30000m³, length1000m, closure depth5m and berm elevation2m. Parallel translation Δy=V/[L(hc+B)]=4.286m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「活動剖面平移」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active-profile translation", which statement holds?
options: 暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast.
An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 活動剖面平移：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active-profile translation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「活動剖面平移」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Active-profile translation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 清楚標出剖面上下界和零高程，測試閉合深度不同時結果如何改變。用多季節水陸聯測剖面比較實際重塑，將沿岸漏失、坡形變化及測量誤差另列，不強迫資料吻合平移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark profile limits and the vertical origin and test alternative closure depths. Compare multiple seasonal land-and-water surveys with the translation estimate, listing alongshore exchange, slope adjustment and measurement error rather than forcing the measured observations to fit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark profile limits and the vertical origin and test alternative closure depths. steps.failure: 注意干擾：把短期觀測不到變化的位置當成永久閉合深度，會高估岸線移動量；若近岸形成砂壩，材料仍在剖面內卻未出現在乾灘，使僅看岸線的判讀失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
