stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沿岸泥沙收支」與「壓密與體積變化」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Alongshore sediment budget" and "Compaction and apparent volume loss": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沿岸泥沙收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Alongshore sediment budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沿岸泥沙收支」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Alongshore sediment budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 養灘區不是封閉容器，上下游輸砂差和跨岸交換共同改變儲砂。年度平均通量只適合所定義邊界與時段，暴風、港口阻砂及補砂事件可能打破平穩假設；應先確認輸入輸出各自的符號與單位，再討論需要維持的功能。 假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沿岸泥沙收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A nourishment reach is not a sealed container: alongshore flux differences and cross-shore exchange alter storage. Annual mean transport applies only to its specified boundaries and period. Storms, harbor interception and new placements can break stationarity, so signs and units must be established before discussing the intended coastal function to maintain. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Alongshore sediment budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沿岸泥沙收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Alongshore sediment budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 沿岸泥沙收支
knowledge.text: 養灘區不是封閉容器，上下游輸砂差和跨岸交換共同改變儲砂。年度平均通量只適合所定義邊界與時段，暴風、港口阻砂及補砂事件可能打破平穩假設；應先確認輸入輸出各自的符號與單位，再討論需要維持的功能。
knowledge.textEn: A nourishment reach is not a sealed container: alongshore flux differences and cross-shore exchange alter storage. Annual mean transport applies only to its specified boundaries and period.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「沿岸泥沙收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Alongshore sediment budget" is correct?
options: 年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。
乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。
養灘區不是封閉容器，上下游輸砂差和跨岸交換共同改變儲砂。
optionsEn: An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month.
Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
A nourishment reach is not a sealed container: alongshore flux differences and cross-shore exchange alter storage.
quiz.explanation: 養灘區不是封閉容器，上下游輸砂差和跨岸交換共同改變儲砂。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A nourishment reach is not a sealed container: alongshore flux differences and cross-shore exchange alter storage. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 沿岸泥沙收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Alongshore sediment budget: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「沿岸泥沙收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Alongshore sediment budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「沿岸泥沙收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Alongshore sediment budget", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。
粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
Once a particle first reaches the bed, it can never be transported again.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 沿岸泥沙收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Alongshore sediment budget: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沿岸泥沙收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Alongshore sediment budget” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。
knowledge.textEn: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。用獨立地形差量測試收支殘差，並把不同年份的風暴條件分開而不是只看長期平均。
knowledge.textEn: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Test budget residuals against independent elevation change and distinguish storm conditions between years rather than relying exclusively on a single long-term average.

quiz.question: 要驗證「沿岸泥沙收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Alongshore sediment budget"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。
孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways.
Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
quiz.explanation: 在地圖上標示每個通量邊界、正方向及可觀測證據，檢查是否漏掉近岸或風成砂。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map each flux boundary, sign and observational evidence, checking nearshore and windblown pathways. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 沿岸泥沙收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Alongshore sediment budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沿岸泥沙收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Alongshore sediment budget” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。平穩外推也可能低估一次大事件的主導作用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss. Stationary extrapolation can also miss the dominant influence of one large event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設僅沿岸輸入30000、輸出45000m³/year，dV/dt=−15000m³/year；若通量固定5year，儲量減75000m³。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume only alongshore input30000 and output45000m³/year. dV/dt=−15000m³/year; fixed fluxes over5years reduce storage75000m³.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「年平均泥沙赤字能保證每個月份都按同一速度退縮。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An annual sediment deficit guarantees an identical retreat rate every month." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。平穩外推也可能低估一次大事件的主導作用。
knowledge.textEn: Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss. Stationary extrapolation can also miss the dominant influence of one large event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沿岸泥沙收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Alongshore sediment budget" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。
同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss.
quiz.explanation: 同一砂量在兩個相鄰邊界重複計入會製造假盈餘，忽略跨岸砂壩交換則容易將季節儲存誤認永久流失。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Double-counting sediment at adjacent boundaries creates an artificial surplus, while omitted cross-shore bar exchange makes seasonal storage resemble permanent loss. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 壓密與體積變化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Compaction and apparent volume loss: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓密與體積變化」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Compaction and apparent volume loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同一乾固體量隨孔隙改變而呈現不同鬆方，養灘完工後地形下降不一定全是輸砂。需要把粒子輸出和孔隙水排除分開，同時注意級配分選會改變密實狀態；幾何測量提供外形，而固體收支才幫助辨認真正材料流失。 假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓密與體積變化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An unchanged quantity of solids occupies different bulk volumes as porosity changes, so post-placement lowering need not be entirely sediment transport. Separate particle export from drainage while recognizing that sorting changes packing. Geometry describes the exterior, whereas solid accounting helps identify actual offshore material loss. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n). Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Compaction and apparent volume loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓密與體積變化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Compaction and apparent volume loss”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓密與體積變化
knowledge.text: 同一乾固體量隨孔隙改變而呈現不同鬆方，養灘完工後地形下降不一定全是輸砂。需要把粒子輸出和孔隙水排除分開，同時注意級配分選會改變密實狀態；幾何測量提供外形，而固體收支才幫助辨認真正材料流失。
knowledge.textEn: An unchanged quantity of solids occupies different bulk volumes as porosity changes, so post-placement lowering need not be entirely sediment transport. Separate particle export from drainage while recognizing that sorting changes packing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓密與體積變化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Compaction and apparent volume loss" is correct?
options: 同一乾固體量隨孔隙改變而呈現不同鬆方，養灘完工後地形下降不一定全是輸砂。
乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。

optionsEn: An unchanged quantity of solids occupies different bulk volumes as porosity changes, so post-placement lowering need not be entirely sediment transport.
Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume.
All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast.

steps.title: 壓密與體積變化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Compaction and apparent volume loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓密與體積變化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Compaction and apparent volume loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume unchanged solid volume18000m³. Bulk volume is30000m³ at porosity0.40 and27692.3m³ at porosity0.35, using V=Vs/(1−n). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在相同範圍重測剖面並取密度樣本，將沉降量與孔隙改變能解釋的部分比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「壓密與體積變化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Compaction and apparent volume loss", which statement holds?

steps.title: 壓密與體積變化：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Compaction and apparent volume loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓密與體積變化」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Compaction and apparent volume loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.

steps.instructionEn: Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space. Maintain a consistent dry-solid definition and inspect transport evidence separately rather than automatically absorbing every discrepancy into an arbitrary compaction factor. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在相同範圍重測剖面並取密度樣本，將沉降量與孔隙改變能解釋的部分比較。保持乾固體定義一致，另查波流輸出證據，避免以任意壓密係數吸收所有量測差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space. Maintain a consistent dry-solid definition and inspect transport evidence separately rather than automatically absorbing every discrepancy into an arbitrary compaction factor.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calling all surface lowering erosion overstates maintenance needs, while labeling real export as compaction conceals inadequate supply. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓密與體積變化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

借砂中值粒徑較大即可證明材料全面相容且永不流失。
在相同範圍重測剖面並取密度樣本，將沉降量與孔隙改變能解釋的部分比較。

A larger borrow-sand median proves complete compatibility and permanent retention.
Resurvey identical limits and sample density, comparing lowering with the portion explained by changing void space.

steps.title: 壓密與體積變化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Compaction and apparent volume loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓密與體積變化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Compaction and apparent volume loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。缺少密度與地形的共同證據無法區分兩種機制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calling all surface lowering erosion overstates maintenance needs, while labeling real export as compaction conceals inadequate supply. Without paired density and terrain evidence, the two mechanisms cannot reliably be distinguished in the completed beach. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設固體體積18000m³保持不變，孔隙率0.40時鬆方30000m³，降到0.35後V=18000/0.65=27692.3m³。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「乾固體總量不變時養灘外觀體積必定保持不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Unchanged dry-solid quantity requires an unchanged visible bulk volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。缺少密度與地形的共同證據無法區分兩種機制。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓密與體積變化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Compaction and apparent volume loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。
optionsEn: Calling all surface lowering erosion overstates maintenance needs, while labeling real export as compaction conceals inadequate supply.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast.
quiz.explanation: 濕砂表面下降若全部記成侵蝕，會高估維護需求；反過來把真正沖失都稱為壓密，則隱藏砂源不足。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calling all surface lowering erosion overstates maintenance needs, while labeling real export as compaction conceals inadequate supply. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「暴風後剖面恢復」與「高程偏差與方量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 暴風後剖面恢復：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-storm profile recovery: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「暴風後剖面恢復」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-storm profile recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 暴風可把上灘砂移到水下，後續較緩波況再將部分材料送回，因此恢復率需明示控制範圍與基準。相同乾灘體積恢復不代表粒群或灘形完全恢復，觀測期間亦會左右比例；應同時追蹤總量、位置與功能而非只追一個百分比。 假設固定調查範圍暴風減少20000m³，之後回增8000m³，仍缺12000m³、恢復率40%；未證明其餘砂永久外移。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「暴風後剖面恢復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Storms can move upper-beach sand offshore and calmer waves return part of it. A recovery fraction therefore requires explicit survey limits and a reference state. Restored dry-beach volume does not imply identical grading or shape, and the observation interval affects the fraction; track quantity, geographical position and function together. Assume a fixed survey area loses20000m³ in a storm and later gains8000m³. Deficit remains12000m³ and recovery is40%, without proving permanent export. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-storm profile recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「暴風後剖面恢復」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a fixed survey area loses20000m³ in a storm and later gains8000m³. Deficit remains12000m³ and recovery is40%, without proving permanent export.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「暴風後剖面恢復」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-storm profile recovery", which statement holds?
options: 粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。
孔隙水排出造成的重量下降全部代表養灘砂粒流失。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Once a particle first reaches the bed, it can never be transported again.
Every decrease in weight caused by drainage represents loss of nourishment grains.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 暴風後剖面恢復：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-storm profile recovery: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「暴風後剖面恢復」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-storm profile recovery” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留暴風前、後及恢復期的同範圍剖面，分別記上灘與近岸砂壩的量。核對水位和季節條件，將未觀測水深列為未知，而不把那部分材料自動列為損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage. Check water level and season, marking unobserved depths as unknown rather than automatically treating their material as lost from the system. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留暴風前、後及恢復期的同範圍剖面，分別記上灘與近岸砂壩的量。核對水位和季節條件，將未觀測水深列為未知，而不把那部分材料自動列為損失。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage. Check water level and season, marking unobserved depths as unknown rather than automatically treating their material as lost from the system.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「暴風後剖面恢復」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-storm profile recovery"?
options: 保留暴風前、後及恢復期的同範圍剖面，分別記上灘與近岸砂壩的量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
新增砂量除以灘長就能得到岸線前進的長度。
optionsEn: Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Dividing added sand volume by beach length alone gives shoreline advancement.

quiz.explanationEn: Retain matching pre-storm, post-storm and recovery surveys, separating upper-beach and nearshore-bar storage. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 暴風後剖面恢復：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-storm profile recovery: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「暴風後剖面恢復」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-storm profile recovery” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。若依單一百分比決定補砂，可能反覆搬入材料而沒有處理真正輸砂路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery. Basing replenishment on one percentage can repeatedly add material without addressing the actual sediment pathways responsible for observed change. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設固定調查範圍暴風減少20000m³，之後回增8000m³，仍缺12000m³、恢復率40%；未證明其餘砂永久外移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Deficit remains12000m³ and recovery is40%, without proving permanent export.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「暴風後尚未回到乾灘的砂都已永久離開海岸系統。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All sand not yet returned to the dry beach has permanently left the coast." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。若依單一百分比決定補砂，可能反覆搬入材料而沒有處理真正輸砂路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery. Basing replenishment on one percentage can repeatedly add material without addressing the actual sediment pathways responsible for observed change.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「暴風後剖面恢復」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-storm profile recovery" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。
增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery.
Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
quiz.explanation: 恢復期只量乾灘會忽略仍在近岸的庫存，調查邊界移動又可能創造假恢復。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dry-beach-only monitoring misses nearshore storage, and moving survey boundaries can create artificial recovery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 高程偏差與方量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elevation bias and volume uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「高程偏差與方量」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elevation bias and volume uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大面積相減對共同高程偏差非常敏感，許多測點並不能消除同一基準造成的系統誤差。兩期獨立的整面偏差可用不確定度傳播估計量級，但不能與逐格獨立噪音混為一談；這項區別決定應改善控制點還是加密量測。 假設面積100000m²，兩期各有獨立整面高程標準不確定度0.03m，σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³；不是逐格獨立誤差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「高程偏差與方量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Large-area differencing is sensitive to coherent vertical bias, and many points do not remove an error shared by one datum. Independent whole-survey offsets can be propagated to estimate uncertainty, but they must not be confused with independent cell noise; that distinction determines whether better control or denser sampling is needed. Assume area100000m² and independent coherent survey offsets with standard uncertainty0.03m each. σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³, not independent cell error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Elevation bias and volume uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「高程偏差與方量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Elevation bias and volume uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 高程偏差與方量
knowledge.text: 大面積相減對共同高程偏差非常敏感，許多測點並不能消除同一基準造成的系統誤差。兩期獨立的整面偏差可用不確定度傳播估計量級，但不能與逐格獨立噪音混為一談；這項區別決定應改善控制點還是加密量測。
knowledge.textEn: Large-area differencing is sensitive to coherent vertical bias, and many points do not remove an error shared by one datum. Independent whole-survey offsets can be propagated to estimate uncertainty, but they must not be confused with independent cell noise; that distinction determines whether better control or denser sampling is needed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「高程偏差與方量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Elevation bias and volume uncertainty" is correct?
options: 增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。
大面積相減對共同高程偏差非常敏感，許多測點並不能消除同一基準造成的系統誤差。
optionsEn: Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero.
An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
Large-area differencing is sensitive to coherent vertical bias, and many points do not remove an error shared by one datum.
quiz.explanation: 大面積相減對共同高程偏差非常敏感，許多測點並不能消除同一基準造成的系統誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Large-area differencing is sensitive to coherent vertical bias, and many points do not remove an error shared by one datum. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 高程偏差與方量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Elevation bias and volume uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「高程偏差與方量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elevation bias and volume uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設面積100000m²，兩期各有獨立整面高程標準不確定度0.03m，σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³；不是逐格獨立誤差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume area100000m² and independent coherent survey offsets with standard uncertainty0.03m each. σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³, not independent cell error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用穩定地物及外部控制檢查每期共同偏差，分開報告隨機散布與高程系統分量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use stable features and external control to check common offsets, reporting random scatter separately from systematic elevation components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Use stable features and external control to check common offsets, reporting random scatter separately from systematic elevation components. State correlations when propagating volume uncertainty; shared bias across both epochs does not permit the same independent sum-of-squares calculation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「高程偏差與方量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.title: 高程偏差與方量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Elevation bias and volume uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「高程偏差與方量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Elevation bias and volume uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整面偏差除以測點數平方根會虛構極高精度，使很小的地形差被誤判為侵蝕。共同控制點移動也可能讓兩次調查一起偏移而難以自行察覺。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing coherent bias by the square root of point count invents precision and makes small elevation differences appear significant. Moving common control may also shift both surveys together, escaping detection within the survey network itself. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設面積100000m²，兩期各有獨立整面高程標準不確定度0.03m，σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³；不是逐格獨立誤差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume area100000m² and independent coherent survey offsets with standard uncertainty0.03m each. σV=A√2σz=4242.6m³, not independent cell error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「增加測點數一定能把共同高程基準偏差平均到零。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Adding more survey points always averages a common datum bias to zero." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整面偏差除以測點數平方根會虛構極高精度，使很小的地形差被誤判為侵蝕。共同控制點移動也可能讓兩次調查一起偏移而難以自行察覺。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing coherent bias by the square root of point count invents precision and makes small elevation differences appear significant. Moving common control may also shift both surveys together, escaping detection within the survey network itself.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「高程偏差與方量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Elevation bias and volume uncertainty" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。
把整面偏差除以測點數平方根會虛構極高精度，使很小的地形差被誤判為侵蝕。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
Dividing coherent bias by the square root of point count invents precision and makes small elevation differences appear significant.
quiz.explanation: 把整面偏差除以測點數平方根會虛構極高精度，使很小的地形差被誤判為侵蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing coherent bias by the square root of point count invents precision and makes small elevation differences appear significant. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「背景扣除與濁羽通量」與「沉降與水平輸運」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Background correction and plume flux" and "Settling and horizontal advection": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 背景扣除與濁羽通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Background correction and plume flux: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「背景扣除與濁羽通量」如何影響海岸養灘工程的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Background correction and plume flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濁度光學訊號不直接等於懸浮泥沙質量，需要採樣校正且區分自然背景。橫斷面通量取決於濃度與速度的共同分布，均勻完全混合只是示意；估算增量輸送量不能替代環境許可，粒徑、沉降與暴露時間仍須分別解釋。 假設均勻濃度150mg/L、背景20mg/L，增量130mg/L=0.13kg/m³，流量2m³/s，增量質量通量0.26kg/s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「背景扣除與濁羽通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An optical turbidity signal is not directly suspended-sediment mass; sampling calibration and background separation are required. Section flux depends jointly on concentration and velocity, with complete uniform mixing only an illustration. Estimated incremental transport does not establish environmental compliance; grading, settling and exposure duration remain separate questions. Assume uniform concentration150mg/L and background20mg/L. Increment130mg/L=0.13kg/m³; at2m³/s, incremental mass flux is0.26kg/s. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Background correction and plume flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「背景扣除與濁羽通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Background correction and plume flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 背景扣除與濁羽通量
knowledge.text: 濁度光學訊號不直接等於懸浮泥沙質量，需要採樣校正且區分自然背景。橫斷面通量取決於濃度與速度的共同分布，均勻完全混合只是示意；估算增量輸送量不能替代環境許可，粒徑、沉降與暴露時間仍須分別解釋。
knowledge.textEn: An optical turbidity signal is not directly suspended-sediment mass; sampling calibration and background separation are required. Section flux depends jointly on concentration and velocity, with complete uniform mixing only an illustration.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「背景扣除與濁羽通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Background correction and plume flux" is correct?
options: 濁度光學訊號不直接等於懸浮泥沙質量，需要採樣校正且區分自然背景。
濁度儀的光學讀值不經校正就等於泥沙質量濃度。
粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。
optionsEn: An optical turbidity signal is not directly suspended-sediment mass; sampling calibration and background separation are required.
An uncalibrated optical turbidity reading directly equals sediment mass concentration.
Once a particle first reaches the bed, it can never be transported again.
quiz.explanation: 濁度光學訊號不直接等於懸浮泥沙質量，需要採樣校正且區分自然背景。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 背景扣除與濁羽通量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Background correction and plume flux: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「背景扣除與濁羽通量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Background correction and plume flux” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻濃度150mg/L、背景20mg/L，增量130mg/L=0.13kg/m³，流量2m³/s，增量質量通量0.26kg/s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform concentration150mg/L and background20mg/L. Increment130mg/L=0.13kg/m³; at2m³/s, incremental mass flux is0.26kg/s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步取得背景、作業區濃度和流速，檢查背景點是否真的位於影響區外。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Sample background, working-area concentration and velocity together, verifying that the background station lies outside the affected plume.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻濃度150mg/L、背景20mg/L，增量130mg/L=0.13kg/m³，流量2m³/s，增量質量通量0.26kg/s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform concentration150mg/L and background20mg/L. Increment130mg/L=0.13kg/m³; at2m³/s, incremental mass flux is0.26kg/s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

quiz.question: 依「背景扣除與濁羽通量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Background correction and plume flux", which statement holds?

steps.instructionEn: Sample background, working-area concentration and velocity together, verifying that the background station lies outside the affected plume. steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「背景扣除與濁羽通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 選到已受影響的背景站會低估作業增量，速度和濃度不同時取樣也可能錯配通量。儀器讀值下降可能只是粒徑改變，不一定代表輸送質量減少。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 沉降與水平輸運：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Settling and horizontal advection” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beach nourishment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 粒子沉降與水流搬運的競爭影響落砂區，但真實濁羽還有紊流、絮凝和再懸浮。固定沉速及水平流速模型能建立時間與距離量級，不能將單一結果當成影響邊界；初始釋放深度和海床起伏也需與模型坐標一致。 假設距床3m、沉速0.02m/s、水平流0.30m/s，t=h/ws=150s，x=Ut=45m；忽略紊流與再懸浮。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沉降與水平輸運」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Competition between settling and advection influences deposition, but real plumes also experience turbulence, flocculation and resuspension. Constant settling and current velocities provide time and distance scales, not a definitive impact boundary. Release depth and bed relief must also be consistent with the coordinates used by the simplified model. Assume height above bed3m, settling speed0.02m/s and horizontal current0.30m/s. t=150s and x=45m, excluding turbulence and resuspension. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Settling and horizontal advection” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「粒子第一次碰到海床後就永遠不會再進入水體輸運。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.textEn: Competition between settling and advection influences deposition, but real plumes also experience turbulence, flocculation and resuspension. Constant settling and current velocities provide time and distance scales, not a definitive impact boundary.

粒子沉降與水流搬運的競爭影響落砂區，但真實濁羽還有紊流、絮凝和再懸浮。

steps.title: 沉降與水平輸運：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Settling and horizontal advection: quantitative estimate

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Settling and horizontal advection” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設距床3m、沉速0.02m/s、水平流0.30m/s，t=h/ws=150s，x=Ut=45m；忽略紊流與再懸浮。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume height above bed3m, settling speed0.02m/s and horizontal current0.30m/s. t=150s and x=45m, excluding turbulence and resuspension. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以沉降柱試驗辨識不同粒群的速度範圍，核對現地潮流轉向及釋放深度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use settling-column tests to identify velocity ranges for different fractions and check current reversals and release depth.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 沉降與水平輸運：試驗與驗證

courses.title: 離岸潛堤地形整合
courses.summary: 連結潛堤越頂透射缺口流與海岸地形的相互作用。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Connect submerged-breakwater transmission, gap currents and evolving coastal morphology. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 連結潛堤越頂透射缺口流與海岸地形的相互作用
courses.focusEn: Connect submerged-breakwater transmission, gap currents and evolving coastal morphology
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水位2.0m、堤頂1.2m，淹水深0.8m；入射波高1.6m時相對淹水深0.50，非透射係數。假設水位由2.0升至2.2m、堤頂仍1.2m，覆水0.8增至1.0m，增加25%；相同1.6m入射波的相對覆水由0.50變0.625，仍不能推出新的透射量。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume water level2.0m and crest1.2m. Cover is0.8m; relative to incident height1.6m the ratio is0.50, not transmission. Raising level from2.0 to2.2m at fixed crest1.2m increases cover from0.8 to1.0m by25%. Relative cover at unchanged1.6m incident height changes from0.50 to0.625, without determining a new transmission coefficient. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「淹水深與共同基準」與「波高與能量透射」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Submergence and shared datum" and "Wave-height and energy transmission": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淹水深與共同基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submergence and shared datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「淹水深與共同基準」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Submergence and shared datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潛堤是否淹水取決於堤頂與水位共同高程，不是海圖水深單獨決定。潮汐、增水與沉陷會改變相對淹水深，使同一結構在不同時段呈現不同透流狀態；越頂自由面和波浪運動仍須另行解析，不能把水下高度直接視為減波量。 假設水位2.0m、堤頂1.2m，淹水深0.8m；入射波高1.6m時相對淹水深0.50，非透射係數。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淹水深與共同基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Submergence depends on crest and water elevations on one datum, not chart depth alone. Tide, surge and settlement change relative cover, so the same structure experiences different transmission states. The overtopping free surface and wave motion still need separate analysis; water cover cannot directly represent the amount of wave reduction or the resulting shoreline response. Assume water level2.0m and crest1.2m. Cover is0.8m; relative to incident height1.6m the ratio is0.50, not transmission. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Submergence and shared datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「淹水深與共同基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Submergence and shared datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 淹水深與共同基準
knowledge.text: 潛堤是否淹水取決於堤頂與水位共同高程，不是海圖水深單獨決定。潮汐、增水與沉陷會改變相對淹水深，使同一結構在不同時段呈現不同透流狀態；越頂自由面和波浪運動仍須另行解析，不能把水下高度直接視為減波量。
knowledge.textEn: Submergence depends on crest and water elevations on one datum, not chart depth alone. Tide, surge and settlement change relative cover, so the same structure experiences different transmission states.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淹水深與共同基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Submergence and shared datum" is correct?
options: 相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。
潛堤是否淹水取決於堤頂與水位共同高程，不是海圖水深單獨決定。
波高減少六成就必然表示能量通量也只減少六成。
optionsEn: Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width.
Submergence depends on crest and water elevations on one datum, not chart depth alone.
A sixty-percent reduction in wave height always means exactly sixty-percent less energy flux.
quiz.explanation: 潛堤是否淹水取決於堤頂與水位共同高程，不是海圖水深單獨決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Submergence depends on crest and water elevations on one datum, not chart depth alone. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 淹水深與共同基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Submergence and shared datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淹水深與共同基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Submergence and shared datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水位2.0m、堤頂1.2m，淹水深0.8m；入射波高1.6m時相對淹水深0.50，非透射係數。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume water level2.0m and crest1.2m. Cover is0.8m; relative to incident height1.6m the ratio is0.50, not transmission. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水位2.0m、堤頂1.2m，淹水深0.8m；入射波高1.6m時相對淹水深0.50，非透射係數。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume water level2.0m and crest1.2m. Cover is0.8m; relative to incident height1.6m the ratio is0.50, not transmission.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「淹水深與共同基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Submergence and shared datum", which statement holds?
options: 缺口平均流速可以直接當成每一個位置的瞬時最大流速。
希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: The gap-average velocity directly gives the instantaneous maximum at every point.
The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 淹水深與共同基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Submergence and shared datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「淹水深與共同基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Submergence and shared datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。分別列出高低水位時的覆水範圍，並檢查堤頂起伏，避免以平均值掩蓋局部深缺口。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps. List cover at different levels and inspect crest irregularities, ensuring an average elevation does not conceal a locally deep notch or missing section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。分別列出高低水位時的覆水範圍，並檢查堤頂起伏，避免以平均值掩蓋局部深缺口。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps. List cover at different levels and inspect crest irregularities, ensuring an average elevation does not conceal a locally deep notch or missing section.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同高程基準相混可能把實際淹沒堤頂算成出水，直接改變選用的水理機制。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixed elevation datums can turn a submerged crest into an apparently emerged one and select the wrong hydraulic mechanism. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps. List cover at different levels and inspect crest irregularities, ensuring an average elevation does not conceal a locally deep notch or missing section.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。分別列出高低水位時的覆水範圍，並檢查堤頂起伏，避免以平均值掩蓋局部深缺口。
knowledge.textEn: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps. List cover at different levels and inspect crest irregularities, ensuring an average elevation does not conceal a locally deep notch or missing section.

quiz.question: 要驗證「淹水深與共同基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Submergence and shared datum"?
options: 將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。
optionsEn: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape.
quiz.explanation: 將潮位、堤頂測量及海床資料轉到同一高程基準，保留每筆測量時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Convert tide, crest and seabed observations to one vertical datum and retain timestamps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 淹水深與共同基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Submergence and shared datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「淹水深與共同基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Submergence and shared datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不同高程基準相混可能把實際淹沒堤頂算成出水，直接改變選用的水理機制。局部低點若未量到，也可能集中越頂流而造成後側沖刷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixed elevation datums can turn a submerged crest into an apparently emerged one and select the wrong hydraulic mechanism. An unmeasured low point may also concentrate overtopping flow and cause localized scour behind the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水位2.0m、堤頂1.2m，淹水深0.8m；入射波高1.6m時相對淹水深0.50，非透射係數。

steps.instruction: 透射波高比描述振幅變化，能量通量還涉及群速度與水深，不能直接以相同百分比換算。量測必須分離入射反射及透射成分，兩側頻譜也可能因破波而改變；只有明定波型與能量定義後，才可比較堤前與堤後的水理量。 假設Hi=2m、Ht=0.8m，Kt=0.40；相同密度且群速比Cgt/Cgi=0.80時，能量通量比Kt²×0.80=0.128。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波高與能量透射」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave-height transmission describes amplitude, whereas energy flux also depends on group velocity and depth. Measurements must separate incident, reflected and transmitted components, and breaking can change the spectrum. Only after defining wave type and energy consistently can measurements on either side be compared; an amplitude percentage is not automatically an energy percentage. Assume Hi=2m and Ht=0.8m, giving Kt=0.40. Equal density and group-speed ratio0.80 give energy-flux ratio Kt²×0.80=0.128. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave-height and energy transmission” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「波高與能量透射」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 破波水深尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Depth-limited breaking scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「破波水深尺度」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 淺水破波受波陡、坡度與水深限制，常見破波指標只是特定資料範圍下的近似。潛堤頂部流速和波形會改變，短堤頂也未必達到平衡破波；教學比例應用於辨識量級，不能被當成任何不規則波條件下的固定上限。 假設選用破波指標γb=0.78、水深h=2m，Hb=γbh=1.56m；此係數非所有潛堤的通用設計值。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「破波水深尺度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設選用破波指標γb=0.78、水深h=2m，Hb=γbh=1.56m；此係數非所有潛堤的通用設計值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a selected breaker indexγb=0.78 at depth2m. Hb=γbh=1.56m; the index is not a universal submerged-breakwater design value. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

Retain both broken and unbroken observations, state the evidence range for the chosen index, and avoid extrapolating it directly to untested seas. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設穩定缺口流量30m³/s、有效過水面積20m²，平均v=Q/A=1.50m/s；不等於局部最大流速。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume steady gap discharge30m³/s through effective area20m². Mean v=Q/A=1.50m/s, not the local maximum velocity. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：沿缺口橫斷面量測速度與水深，積分流量並核對堤後水位變化。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure velocity and depth across the gap, integrating discharge and comparing it with lee-side level change.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「缺口連續流量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Gap-flow continuity", which statement holds?
options: 所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。
覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Every ocean wave travels at a speed determined only by depth, regardless of wavelength.
The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。

steps.title: 缺口連續流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gap-flow continuity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「缺口連續流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gap-flow continuity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 沿缺口橫斷面量測速度與水深，積分流量並核對堤後水位變化。分別報告平均、近床和瞬時峰值，保存潮向與波況，避免把單點尖峰直接當成整斷面流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity and depth across the gap, integrating discharge and comparing it with lee-side level change. Report means, near-bed values and peaks separately with tide and waves; one-point spikes cannot represent discharge over the entire section. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：沿缺口橫斷面量測速度與水深，積分流量並核對堤後水位變化。分別報告平均、近床和瞬時峰值，保存潮向與波況，避免把單點尖峰直接當成整斷面流量。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure velocity and depth across the gap, integrating discharge and comparing it with lee-side level change. Report means, near-bed values and peaks separately with tide and waves; one-point spikes cannot represent discharge over the entire section.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：斷面局部被砂堆堵塞時平均面積假設失效，剩餘通道流速可能增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Partial blockage by sediment invalidates the assumed area and can accelerate flow through the remaining opening. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
