quiz.question: 要驗證「缺口連續流量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Gap-flow continuity"?
options: 沿缺口橫斷面量測速度與水深，積分流量並核對堤後水位變化。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。
optionsEn: Measure velocity and depth across the gap, integrating discharge and comparing it with lee-side level change.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width.
quiz.explanation: 沿缺口橫斷面量測速度與水深，積分流量並核對堤後水位變化。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure velocity and depth across the gap, integrating discharge and comparing it with lee-side level change. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 缺口連續流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Gap-flow continuity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「缺口連續流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Gap-flow continuity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 斷面局部被砂堆堵塞時平均面積假設失效，剩餘通道流速可能增加。若儀器只放在緩流區，收支殘差會掩蓋真正的集中流和沖刷熱點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Partial blockage by sediment invalidates the assumed area and can accelerate flow through the remaining opening. Instruments placed only in slow water conceal concentrated currents and scour hotspots behind apparently modest mean-flow observations. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設穩定缺口流量30m³/s、有效過水面積20m²，平均v=Q/A=1.50m/s；不等於局部最大流速。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean v=Q/A=1.50m/s, not the local maximum velocity.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「缺口平均流速可以直接當成每一個位置的瞬時最大流速。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The gap-average velocity directly gives the instantaneous maximum at every point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 斷面局部被砂堆堵塞時平均面積假設失效，剩餘通道流速可能增加。若儀器只放在緩流區，收支殘差會掩蓋真正的集中流和沖刷熱點。
knowledge.textEn: Partial blockage by sediment invalidates the assumed area and can accelerate flow through the remaining opening. Instruments placed only in slow water conceal concentrated currents and scour hotspots behind apparently modest mean-flow observations.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「缺口連續流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Gap-flow continuity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
斷面局部被砂堆堵塞時平均面積假設失效，剩餘通道流速可能增加。
規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Partial blockage by sediment invalidates the assumed area and can accelerate flow through the remaining opening.
Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change.
quiz.explanation: 斷面局部被砂堆堵塞時平均面積假設失效，剩餘通道流速可能增加。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Partial blockage by sediment invalidates the assumed area and can accelerate flow through the remaining opening. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「規則波能通量」與「床面剪力無因次化」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Regular-wave energy flux" and "Dimensionless bed shear": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 規則波能通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Regular-wave energy flux: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「規則波能通量」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Regular-wave energy flux” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波能公式必須說明波高代表規則波還是頻譜顯著波高，兩者係數不同。群速度傳遞能量而相速度描述波峰移動，混用會改變功率；入射角、反射和耗散也影響垂直結構方向的能流，單位寬度結果不能直接當成整座結構承受的總負荷。 假設規則線性波ρ=1025kg/m³、H=2m、Cg=5m/s，E=ρgH²/8=5027.6J/m²，P=ECg=25.138kW/m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「規則波能通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wave-energy formulas must identify whether height is regular-wave height or spectral significant height because their coefficients differ. Group velocity transports energy while phase velocity follows crests. Incidence, reflection and dissipation also affect the normal energy flux, so a result per unit crest width does not directly describe total structural loading or impact pressure. Assume a regular linear wave:ρ=1025kg/m³, H=2m, Cg=5m/s. E=ρgH²/8=5027.6J/m² and P=25.138kW/m. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Regular-wave energy flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「規則波能通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Regular-wave energy flux”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 規則波能通量

knowledge.textEn: Wave-energy formulas must identify whether height is regular-wave height or spectral significant height because their coefficients differ. Group velocity transports energy while phase velocity follows crests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「規則波能通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Regular-wave energy flux" is correct?
options: 規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。
希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。
波能公式必須說明波高代表規則波還是頻譜顯著波高，兩者係數不同。
optionsEn: Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change.
The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth.
Wave-energy formulas must identify whether height is regular-wave height or spectral significant height because their coefficients differ.
quiz.explanation: 波能公式必須說明波高代表規則波還是頻譜顯著波高，兩者係數不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Wave-energy formulas must identify whether height is regular-wave height or spectral significant height because their coefficients differ. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 規則波能通量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Regular-wave energy flux: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「規則波能通量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Regular-wave energy flux” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在計算表明列波高統計定義、密度及群速來源，確認每米寬度的方向。用能量收支比較反射透射與耗散；若改用顯著波高，重新選頻譜能量公式而不是保留原係數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record height convention, density and group-velocity derivation and define the direction of unit width. Compare reflected, transmitted and dissipated fluxes; when switching to significant height, select the corresponding spectral-energy formula instead of retaining the regular-wave coefficient. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在計算表明列波高統計定義、密度及群速來源，確認每米寬度的方向。用能量收支比較反射透射與耗散；若改用顯著波高，重新選頻譜能量公式而不是保留原係數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record height convention, density and group-velocity derivation and define the direction of unit width. Compare reflected, transmitted and dissipated fluxes; when switching to significant height, select the corresponding spectral-energy formula instead of retaining the regular-wave coefficient.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：使用顯著波高卻套規則波係數會使能量差一倍，拿相速度代群速度又增加另一偏差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using significant height in the regular-wave formula doubles the energy estimate, and substituting phase velocity adds another bias. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「規則波能通量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Regular-wave energy flux"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
在計算表明列波高統計定義、密度及群速來源，確認每米寬度的方向。

steps.title: 規則波能通量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Regular-wave energy flux: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「規則波能通量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Regular-wave energy flux” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用顯著波高卻套規則波係數會使能量差一倍，拿相速度代群速度又增加另一偏差。數值即使量綱正確，仍可能因統計定義不同而不可比較。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using significant height in the regular-wave formula doubles the energy estimate, and substituting phase velocity adds another bias. Dimensionally correct numbers may still be incomparable because the underlying statistical definition is different. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設規則線性波ρ=1025kg/m³、H=2m、Cg=5m/s，E=ρgH²/8=5027.6J/m²，P=ECg=25.138kW/m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: E=ρgH²/8=5027.6J/m² and P=25.138kW/m.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用顯著波高卻套規則波係數會使能量差一倍，拿相速度代群速度又增加另一偏差。數值即使量綱正確，仍可能因統計定義不同而不可比較。
knowledge.textEn: Using significant height in the regular-wave formula doubles the energy estimate, and substituting phase velocity adds another bias. Dimensionally correct numbers may still be incomparable because the underlying statistical definition is different.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「規則波能通量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Regular-wave energy flux" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。
使用顯著波高卻套規則波係數會使能量差一倍，拿相速度代群速度又增加另一偏差。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth.
Using significant height in the regular-wave formula doubles the energy estimate, and substituting phase velocity adds another bias.
quiz.explanation: 使用顯著波高卻套規則波係數會使能量差一倍，拿相速度代群速度又增加另一偏差。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using significant height in the regular-wave formula doubles the energy estimate, and substituting phase velocity adds another bias. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 床面剪力無因次化：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless bed shear: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「床面剪力無因次化」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dimensionless bed shear” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潛堤改變波流剪力後可能引發近床輸砂，粒徑與相對密度決定顆粒重量尺度。希爾茲參數只把作用力無因次化，起動條件還受級配、床面形態與振盪流影響；不能由單一參數宣告侵蝕深度，亦不能跳過黏性細料與非黏性砂的不同機制。 假設τ=2Pa、ρs=2650、ρ=1025kg/m³、D=0.0005m，θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509；未指定起動門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「床面剪力無因次化」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Modified wave-current shear can mobilize sediment, with grain size and relative density setting the gravitational scale. The Shields parameter nondimensionalizes forcing; onset also depends on grading, bed form and oscillatory motion. One parameter does not give scour depth, and cohesive fines require a different treatment from the noncohesive grains assumed here. Assumeτ=2Pa,ρs=2650,ρ=1025kg/m³ and D=0.0005m. θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509, without prescribing a motion threshold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dimensionless bed shear” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「床面剪力無因次化」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dimensionless bed shear”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 床面剪力無因次化
knowledge.text: 潛堤改變波流剪力後可能引發近床輸砂，粒徑與相對密度決定顆粒重量尺度。希爾茲參數只把作用力無因次化，起動條件還受級配、床面形態與振盪流影響；不能由單一參數宣告侵蝕深度，亦不能跳過黏性細料與非黏性砂的不同機制。
knowledge.textEn: Modified wave-current shear can mobilize sediment, with grain size and relative density setting the gravitational scale. The Shields parameter nondimensionalizes forcing; onset also depends on grading, bed form and oscillatory motion.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「床面剪力無因次化」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Dimensionless bed shear" is correct?
options: 潛堤改變波流剪力後可能引發近床輸砂，粒徑與相對密度決定顆粒重量尺度。
希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。
所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。
optionsEn: Modified wave-current shear can mobilize sediment, with grain size and relative density setting the gravitational scale.
The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth.
Every ocean wave travels at a speed determined only by depth, regardless of wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 潛堤改變波流剪力後可能引發近床輸砂，粒徑與相對密度決定顆粒重量尺度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Modified wave-current shear can mobilize sediment, with grain size and relative density setting the gravitational scale. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 床面剪力無因次化：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless bed shear: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「床面剪力無因次化」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Dimensionless bed shear” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設τ=2Pa、ρs=2650、ρ=1025kg/m³、D=0.0005m，θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509；未指定起動門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeτ=2Pa,ρs=2650,ρ=1025kg/m³ and D=0.0005m. θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509, without prescribing a motion threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對剪力是瞬時或週期平均以及粒徑代表值，對照原床級配與黏性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check whether shear is instantaneous or cycle-averaged and identify representative size, grading and cohesion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設τ=2Pa、ρs=2650、ρ=1025kg/m³、D=0.0005m，θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509；未指定起動門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assumeτ=2Pa,ρs=2650,ρ=1025kg/m³ and D=0.0005m. θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509, without prescribing a motion threshold.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「床面剪力無因次化」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Dimensionless bed shear", which statement holds?
options: 覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。
optionsEn: The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「床面剪力無因次化」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Dimensionless bed shear"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
只要堤頂水深固定所有週期和波形都在同一高度破波。

At fixed crest depth every period and waveform breaks at exactly the same height.

steps.title: 床面剪力無因次化：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dimensionless bed shear: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「床面剪力無因次化」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dimensionless bed shear” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將黏土當成同粒徑砂會忽略顆粒間作用，僅取平均剪力又漏掉波峰短暫起動。錯誤起動判斷可能使原本穩定的基床保護假設突然失效。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating clay as sand of equal size omits interparticle forces, while mean shear can miss brief wave-driven motion. Incorrect onset interpretation may invalidate the assumed stability of the bed supporting or protecting the structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設τ=2Pa、ρs=2650、ρ=1025kg/m³、D=0.0005m，θ=τ/[(ρs−ρ)gD]=0.2509；未指定起動門檻。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「床面剪力無因次化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。
optionsEn: Treating clay as sand of equal size omits interparticle forces, while mean shear can miss brief wave-driven motion.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Every ocean wave travels at a speed determined only by depth, regardless of wavelength.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「淺水傳播時間」與「離岸幾何與岸線」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Shallow-water propagation time" and "Offshore geometry and shoreline response": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 淺水傳播時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Shallow-water propagation time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長波相對水深很淺時，重力與水深控制傳播速度，可用來估計堤後區域的響應時間。這個近似不適用任意短波，亦未計底摩擦或水流影響；地形改變既影響速度也可能造成反射，因此傳播時間只是辨識訊號因果的一項線索。 假設線性淺水長波h=2m，c=√(gh)=4.429m/s；傳播100m約22.58s，需滿足水深遠小於波長。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「淺水傳播時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: For sufficiently long waves relative to depth, gravity and depth control propagation speed and give a response-time scale behind the structure. The approximation does not apply to arbitrary short waves and excludes friction and currents. Bathymetric changes affect speed and reflections, so travel time is only one clue for interpreting cause and effect in observations. Assume a linear shallow-water long wave at depth2m. c=√(gh)=4.429m/s;100m takes22.58s, requiring depth much smaller than wavelength. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Shallow-water propagation time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「淺水傳播時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Shallow-water propagation time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: For sufficiently long waves relative to depth, gravity and depth control propagation speed and give a response-time scale behind the structure. The approximation does not apply to arbitrary short waves and excludes friction and currents.

knowledge.text: 誤解：所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every ocean wave travels at a speed determined only by depth, regardless of wavelength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「淺水傳播時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。

steps.title: 淺水傳播時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Shallow-water propagation time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「淺水傳播時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Shallow-water propagation time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設線性淺水長波h=2m，c=√(gh)=4.429m/s；傳播100m約22.58s，需滿足水深遠小於波長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a linear shallow-water long wave at depth2m. c=√(gh)=4.429m/s;100m takes22.58s, requiring depth much smaller than wavelength. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用觀測週期檢查淺水條件，再比較兩站訊號延遲與估算傳播時間。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設線性淺水長波h=2m，c=√(gh)=4.429m/s；傳播100m約22.58s，需滿足水深遠小於波長。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a linear shallow-water long wave at depth2m. c=√(gh)=4.429m/s;100m takes22.58s, requiring depth much smaller than wavelength.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

A sixty-percent reduction in wave height always means exactly sixty-percent less energy flux.

堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Unsynchronized instruments create false travel speeds, and short waves modeled as long waves produce incorrect delays.
The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape.
quiz.explanation: 儀器時間不同步會製造假的傳播速度，短波套長波公式則錯估延遲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Unsynchronized instruments create false travel speeds, and short waves modeled as long waves produce incorrect delays. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 離岸幾何與岸線：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Offshore geometry and shoreline response: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「離岸幾何與岸線」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Offshore geometry and shoreline response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 堤長與離岸距離影響遮蔽區形狀，但岸線反應同時受波向、輸砂供應及缺口控制。幾何比例可以整理案例，不能直接預報連島砂洲或突出灘形成；功能比較還需確認結構淹水狀態及尺度，避免將出水防波堤經驗直接移植到潛堤。 假設堤長L=100m、離岸距X=200m，L/X=0.50；僅為幾何描述，不是連島砂洲必然形成的門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「離岸幾何與岸線」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Length and offshore distance influence the sheltered footprint, but wave direction, sediment supply and gaps also govern shoreline response. A geometric ratio organizes comparisons; it does not directly predict a salient or tombolo. Comparisons must account for submergence and scale rather than transferring emerged-breakwater experience directly to a submerged structure in a different sediment regime. Assume length100m and offshore distance200m. L/X=0.50 describes geometry only and is not a threshold guaranteeing tombolo formation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Offshore geometry and shoreline response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「離岸幾何與岸線」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Offshore geometry and shoreline response”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 離岸幾何與岸線
knowledge.text: 堤長與離岸距離影響遮蔽區形狀，但岸線反應同時受波向、輸砂供應及缺口控制。幾何比例可以整理案例，不能直接預報連島砂洲或突出灘形成；功能比較還需確認結構淹水狀態及尺度，避免將出水防波堤經驗直接移植到潛堤。
knowledge.textEn: Length and offshore distance influence the sheltered footprint, but wave direction, sediment supply and gaps also govern shoreline response. A geometric ratio organizes comparisons; it does not directly predict a salient or tombolo.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「離岸幾何與岸線」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Offshore geometry and shoreline response" is correct?
options: 堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。
覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。
堤長與離岸距離影響遮蔽區形狀，但岸線反應同時受波向、輸砂供應及缺口控制。
optionsEn: The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape.
The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height.
Length and offshore distance influence the sheltered footprint, but wave direction, sediment supply and gaps also govern shoreline response.
quiz.explanation: 堤長與離岸距離影響遮蔽區形狀，但岸線反應同時受波向、輸砂供應及缺口控制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Length and offshore distance influence the sheltered footprint, but wave direction, sediment supply and gaps also govern shoreline response. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 離岸幾何與岸線：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Offshore geometry and shoreline response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「離岸幾何與岸線」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Offshore geometry and shoreline response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設堤長L=100m、離岸距X=200m，L/X=0.50；僅為幾何描述，不是連島砂洲必然形成的門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length100m and offshore distance200m. L/X=0.50 describes geometry only and is not a threshold guaranteeing tombolo formation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設堤長L=100m、離岸距X=200m，L/X=0.50；僅為幾何描述，不是連島砂洲必然形成的門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume length100m and offshore distance200m. L/X=0.50 describes geometry only and is not a threshold guaranteeing tombolo formation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「離岸幾何與岸線」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Offshore geometry and shoreline response", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。
只要堤頂水深固定所有週期和波形都在同一高度破波。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width.
At fixed crest depth every period and waveform breaks at exactly the same height.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 離岸幾何與岸線：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Offshore geometry and shoreline response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「離岸幾何與岸線」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Offshore geometry and shoreline response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。比較不同季節地形及鄰岸變化，將相似幾何但不同淹水條件的案例分開解讀。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps. Compare seasonal and neighboring terrain, distinguishing geometrically similar cases whose submergence and transport conditions differ substantially from the site under study. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。比較不同季節地形及鄰岸變化，將相似幾何但不同淹水條件的案例分開解讀。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps. Compare seasonal and neighboring terrain, distinguishing geometrically similar cases whose submergence and transport conditions differ substantially from the site under study.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一波向下的堆砂可能在季風轉向後消失，上游攔砂也可能讓遮蔽區缺乏材料。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Accumulation under one wave direction may disappear after seasonal reversal, while updrift interception leaves little sand for the shelter. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。比較不同季節地形及鄰岸變化，將相似幾何但不同淹水條件的案例分開解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps. Compare seasonal and neighboring terrain, distinguishing geometrically similar cases whose submergence and transport conditions differ substantially from the site under study.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。比較不同季節地形及鄰岸變化，將相似幾何但不同淹水條件的案例分開解讀。
knowledge.textEn: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps. Compare seasonal and neighboring terrain, distinguishing geometrically similar cases whose submergence and transport conditions differ substantially from the site under study.

quiz.question: 要驗證「離岸幾何與岸線」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Offshore geometry and shoreline response"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。
規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps.
Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change.
quiz.explanation: 在同一岸線基準下量堤長與距離，記錄波向分布、沿岸砂源和缺口位置。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure length and distance against a consistent shoreline reference and record directional waves, sediment supply and gaps. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 離岸幾何與岸線：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Offshore geometry and shoreline response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「離岸幾何與岸線」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Offshore geometry and shoreline response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一波向下的堆砂可能在季風轉向後消失，上游攔砂也可能讓遮蔽區缺乏材料。只憑幾何比例許諾岸線效果，會忽略整段海岸的收支限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Accumulation under one wave direction may disappear after seasonal reversal, while updrift interception leaves little sand for the shelter. Geometry-only promises therefore ignore sediment-budget limitations across the wider coast and its changing wave climate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設堤長L=100m、離岸距X=200m，L/X=0.50；僅為幾何描述，不是連島砂洲必然形成的門檻。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: L/X=0.50 describes geometry only and is not a threshold guaranteeing tombolo formation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「堤長與離岸距的比值足以唯一決定未來岸線形狀。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The length-to-offshore-distance ratio uniquely determines the future shoreline shape." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一波向下的堆砂可能在季風轉向後消失，上游攔砂也可能讓遮蔽區缺乏材料。只憑幾何比例許諾岸線效果，會忽略整段海岸的收支限制。
knowledge.textEn: Accumulation under one wave direction may disappear after seasonal reversal, while updrift interception leaves little sand for the shelter. Geometry-only promises therefore ignore sediment-budget limitations across the wider coast and its changing wave climate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「離岸幾何與岸線」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Offshore geometry and shoreline response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。
某一波向下的堆砂可能在季風轉向後消失，上游攔砂也可能讓遮蔽區缺乏材料。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height.
Accumulation under one wave direction may disappear after seasonal reversal, while updrift interception leaves little sand for the shelter.
quiz.explanation: 某一波向下的堆砂可能在季風轉向後消失，上游攔砂也可能讓遮蔽區缺乏材料。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Accumulation under one wave direction may disappear after seasonal reversal, while updrift interception leaves little sand for the shelter. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「堤頂沉陷與覆水」與「數值步長與收斂」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Crest settlement and water cover" and "Numerical timestep and convergence": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 堤頂沉陷與覆水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Crest settlement and water cover: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「堤頂沉陷與覆水」如何影響離岸潛堤地形整合的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Crest settlement and water cover” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Submerged-breakwater coastal integration”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潛堤長期沉陷會增加覆水並改變波浪互動，不能只把沉陷看成材料方量問題。局部差異沉陷還形成優先過流通道，而透射對幾何的反應通常非線性；需要把結構監測、水位歷程與水理測試放在同一狀態描述中追蹤。 假設水位固定、原覆水0.8m，堤頂沉陷0.2m後覆水1.0m，增加25%；不能推論透射波高也增25%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「堤頂沉陷與覆水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Settlement increases water cover and changes wave interaction rather than merely reducing material volume. Differential movement also creates preferred flow paths, while transmission often responds nonlinearly to geometry. Structural surveys, water-level history and hydraulic observations therefore need to describe the same evolving state; a percentage change in cover cannot determine an equal change in transmission. Assume fixed water level and original cover0.8m. Crest settlement0.2m raises cover to1.0m, a25% increase, not necessarily25% higher transmission. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Crest settlement and water cover” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「堤頂沉陷與覆水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Crest settlement and water cover”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 堤頂沉陷與覆水
knowledge.text: 潛堤長期沉陷會增加覆水並改變波浪互動，不能只把沉陷看成材料方量問題。局部差異沉陷還形成優先過流通道，而透射對幾何的反應通常非線性；需要把結構監測、水位歷程與水理測試放在同一狀態描述中追蹤。
knowledge.textEn: Settlement increases water cover and changes wave interaction rather than merely reducing material volume. Differential movement also creates preferred flow paths, while transmission often responds nonlinearly to geometry.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「堤頂沉陷與覆水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Crest settlement and water cover" is correct?
options: 潛堤長期沉陷會增加覆水並改變波浪互動，不能只把沉陷看成材料方量問題。
覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。
模型圖形平滑且沒有報錯就代表網格與時間步長已收斂。
optionsEn: Settlement increases water cover and changes wave interaction rather than merely reducing material volume.
The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height.
Smooth output without error messages proves that grid and timestep convergence is complete.

quiz.explanationEn: Settlement increases water cover and changes wave interaction rather than merely reducing material volume. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 堤頂沉陷與覆水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Crest settlement and water cover: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「堤頂沉陷與覆水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Crest settlement and water cover” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水位固定、原覆水0.8m，堤頂沉陷0.2m後覆水1.0m，增加25%；不能推論透射波高也增25%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed water level and original cover0.8m. Crest settlement0.2m raises cover to1.0m, a25% increase, not necessarily25% higher transmission. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：重測堤頂縱剖面並連結共同水位，分離均勻沉陷與局部凹槽。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

缺口平均流速可以直接當成每一個位置的瞬時最大流速。
optionsEn: A sixty-percent reduction in wave height always means exactly sixty-percent less energy flux.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
The gap-average velocity directly gives the instantaneous maximum at every point.

Compare transmission under similar waves and retain foundation and unit-movement records, checking whether the observed change results from settlement rather than different tidal levels. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重測堤頂縱剖面並連結共同水位，分離均勻沉陷與局部凹槽。以相近波況比較前後透射，保留地基與構件位移紀錄，確認變化是否來自沉陷而非潮位差。

steps.failure: 注意干擾：量測只追最高點會漏掉主要低槽，平均沉陷很小仍可能有集中水流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Tracking only crest high points misses controlling troughs, allowing concentrated flow despite small mean settlement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

quiz.question: 要驗證「堤頂沉陷與覆水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Crest settlement and water cover"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
希爾茲參數的數值本身就是預期海床沖刷深度。
重測堤頂縱剖面並連結共同水位，分離均勻沉陷與局部凹槽。

The numerical Shields parameter directly equals the expected seabed scour depth.
Resurvey the crest against a shared water datum, separating uniform settlement from local troughs.

quiz.explanationEn: Resurvey the crest against a shared water datum, separating uniform settlement from local troughs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「堤頂沉陷與覆水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: Tracking only crest high points misses controlling troughs, allowing concentrated flow despite small mean settlement. Comparing transmission at different tides can instead mistake a water-level effect for deterioration of the physical structure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水位固定、原覆水0.8m，堤頂沉陷0.2m後覆水1.0m，增加25%；不能推論透射波高也增25%。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「覆水深度增加百分比必定等於透射波高增加百分比。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The percentage increase in water cover must equal the percentage increase in transmitted height." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「堤頂沉陷與覆水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
模型圖形平滑且沒有報錯就代表網格與時間步長已收斂。
optionsEn: Tracking only crest high points misses controlling troughs, allowing concentrated flow despite small mean settlement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Smooth output without error messages proves that grid and timestep convergence is complete.
quiz.explanation: 量測只追最高點會漏掉主要低槽，平均沉陷很小仍可能有集中水流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Tracking only crest high points misses controlling troughs, allowing concentrated flow despite small mean settlement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設一維顯式淺水示意U=2m/s、h=2m、Δt=0.5s、Δx=5m，C=(U+√gh)Δt/Δx=0.6429；非穩定保證。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a one-dimensional explicit shallow-water illustration: U=2m/s,h=2m,Δt=0.5s,Δx=5m. C=(U+√gh)Δt/Δx=0.6429, not guaranteed stability.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「數值步長與收斂」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Numerical timestep and convergence", which statement holds?
options: 只要堤頂水深固定所有週期和波形都在同一高度破波。
規則波高和顯著波高可直接代入同一能量係數而無差別。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: At fixed crest depth every period and waveform breaks at exactly the same height.
Regular height and significant height can use the same energy coefficient without change.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 數值步長與收斂：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Numerical timestep and convergence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「數值步長與收斂」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Numerical timestep and convergence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。另做網格和步長細化，核對水量與泥沙守恆殘差，保存未收斂區域而不只展示平滑的彩色圖。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme. Refine grid and time separately, audit water and sediment residuals, and retain unconverged regions rather than displaying only smooth and visually persuasive contour maps. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。另做網格和步長細化，核對水量與泥沙守恆殘差，保存未收斂區域而不只展示平滑的彩色圖。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme. Refine grid and time separately, audit water and sediment residuals, and retain unconverged regions rather than displaying only smooth and visually persuasive contour maps.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均網格符合條件仍可能在小網格區失穩，過度數值擴散則可能掩蓋缺口流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A satisfactory average grid hides instability in smaller cells, while excessive diffusion conceals gap currents. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。另做網格和步長細化，核對水量與泥沙守恆殘差，保存未收斂區域而不只展示平滑的彩色圖。
knowledge.textEn: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme. Refine grid and time separately, audit water and sediment residuals, and retain unconverged regions rather than displaying only smooth and visually persuasive contour maps.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。另做網格和步長細化，核對水量與泥沙守恆殘差，保存未收斂區域而不只展示平滑的彩色圖。
knowledge.textEn: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme. Refine grid and time separately, audit water and sediment residuals, and retain unconverged regions rather than displaying only smooth and visually persuasive contour maps.

quiz.question: 要驗證「數值步長與收斂」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Numerical timestep and convergence"?
options: 逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
所有海浪的傳播速度都只由水深決定而與波長無關。
optionsEn: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Every ocean wave travels at a speed determined only by depth, regardless of wavelength.
quiz.explanation: 逐區檢查最小網格、最大特徵速度與時間步長，確認採用格式的條件。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check local minimum spacing, maximum characteristic speed and timestep against the actual scheme. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 數值步長與收斂：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Numerical timestep and convergence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「數值步長與收斂」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Numerical timestep and convergence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均網格符合條件仍可能在小網格區失穩，過度數值擴散則可能掩蓋缺口流。圖像平滑不代表守恆正確，錯誤地形趨勢甚至可能看起來很合理。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A satisfactory average grid hides instability in smaller cells, while excessive diffusion conceals gap currents. Smooth graphics do not establish conservation, and an incorrect morphological trend can still appear visually plausible to an uncritical observer. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設一維顯式淺水示意U=2m/s、h=2m、Δt=0.5s、Δx=5m，C=(U+√gh)Δt/Δx=0.6429；非穩定保證。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: C=(U+√gh)Δt/Δx=0.6429, not guaranteed stability.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「模型圖形平滑且沒有報錯就代表網格與時間步長已收斂。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Smooth output without error messages proves that grid and timestep convergence is complete." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均網格符合條件仍可能在小網格區失穩，過度數值擴散則可能掩蓋缺口流。圖像平滑不代表守恆正確，錯誤地形趨勢甚至可能看起來很合理。
knowledge.textEn: A satisfactory average grid hides instability in smaller cells, while excessive diffusion conceals gap currents. Smooth graphics do not establish conservation, and an incorrect morphological trend can still appear visually plausible to an uncritical observer.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「數值步長與收斂」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Numerical timestep and convergence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
平均網格符合條件仍可能在小網格區失穩，過度數值擴散則可能掩蓋缺口流。
相對淹水深等於波高透射係數且不受堤寬影響。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A satisfactory average grid hides instability in smaller cells, while excessive diffusion conceals gap currents.
Relative submergence equals the wave-height transmission coefficient regardless of crest width.
quiz.explanation: 平均網格符合條件仍可能在小網格區失穩，過度數值擴散則可能掩蓋缺口流。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A satisfactory average grid hides instability in smaller cells, while excessive diffusion conceals gap currents. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 港池航道疏浚
courses.summary: 以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 以測深方量泥漿輸送與環境收支管理港池航道疏浚
courses.focusEn: Manage harbor dredging through sounding, volume, slurry transport and environmental accounting
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。假設第二斷面面積由180增10%至198m²，其餘不變，方量由7500增至7950m³，只增加6%；不是任何航道加深都按同一百分比變化。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation. Increasing the second section area from180 to198m² by10% with everything else fixed raises volume from7500 to7950m³, only6%; this is not a universal channel-deepening response. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「疏浚稜體與斷面」與「泥漿密度與濃度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Dredging prism and sections" and "Slurry density and concentration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 疏浚稜體與斷面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dredging prism and sections: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「疏浚稜體與斷面」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dredging prism and sections” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 航道挖方由既有海床和目標稜體之差形成，邊坡與局部淺點不能用單一平均深度取代。相鄰斷面梯形積分只在面積沿程近似線性時合理，曲率大時應加密；計量還須區分設計挖方、允許超挖及實際移除量，避免讓合約分類混入物理收支。 假設相鄰斷面挖方面積120與180m²、間距50m，V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³；限線性面積變化。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「疏浚稜體與斷面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Excavation is the difference between surveyed bed and a defined dredging prism; side slopes and local shoals cannot be replaced by one mean depth. Trapezoidal integration assumes approximately linear area variation between sections and needs refinement where curvature is large. Design volume, permitted overdepth and actual removal remain distinct quantities in the physical balance. Assume excavation areas120 and180m² separated by50m. V=(120+180)×50/2=7500m³, assuming linear area variation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dredging prism and sections” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「疏浚稜體與斷面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Dredging prism and sections”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 疏浚稜體與斷面
knowledge.text: 航道挖方由既有海床和目標稜體之差形成，邊坡與局部淺點不能用單一平均深度取代。相鄰斷面梯形積分只在面積沿程近似線性時合理，曲率大時應加密；計量還須區分設計挖方、允許超挖及實際移除量，避免讓合約分類混入物理收支。
knowledge.textEn: Excavation is the difference between surveyed bed and a defined dredging prism; side slopes and local shoals cannot be replaced by one mean depth. Trapezoidal integration assumes approximately linear area variation between sections and needs refinement where curvature is large.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泥漿密度與濃度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 比較線上密度計與乾固體採樣，核對水體鹽度和代表粒子密度。標明每份報表用質量或體積濃度，追蹤氣泡與分層造成的偏差，不用單點讀值代表整段輸送狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare inline density with dry-solid samples, checking salinity and representative grain density. Label each report by mass or volume concentration and track air or stratification biases instead of treating a single reading as the state of the full pipeline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Entrained air lowers density without necessarily reducing solid feed, and stratified samples miss concentrated bed material. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slurry density and concentration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 吸入空氣會降低密度卻不等於固體供應下降，分層採樣則可能錯失底部高濃度。將兩種濃度百分比互換會使固體產量與負荷計算同時偏離實際。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Entrained air lowers density without necessarily reducing solid feed, and stratified samples miss concentrated bed material. Interchanging mass and volume percentages simultaneously corrupts estimates of solid production and the hydraulic burden on the system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow.
Entrained air lowers density without necessarily reducing solid feed, and stratified samples miss concentrated bed material.

quiz.explanationEn: Entrained air lowers density without necessarily reducing solid feed, and stratified samples miss concentrated bed material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 乾固體生產率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Dry-solid production rate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「乾固體生產率」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Dry-solid production rate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 吸泥泵的總體積流量包含大量水，疏浚產量必須說明是泥漿、固體或原狀土量。沿管路濃度和流速需同步量測，平均值相乘在兩者相關變動時未必等於平均固體通量；生產紀錄也要分出停機與工作時間，不能把瞬時峰值當日產量。 假設泥漿Q=2m³/s、均勻Cv=0.15、顆粒2650kg/m³，乾固體通量ρsCvQ=795kg/s，1h為2862000kg。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「乾固體生產率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pump volume includes carrier water, so production must distinguish slurry, solids and in-situ sediment. Concentration and velocity require synchronized observations; multiplying separate means need not equal mean solid flux when they covary. Records must also separate downtime from pumping duration, since an instantaneous peak cannot be interpreted as achieved daily production or retained placement volume. Assume slurry Q=2m³/s,Cv=0.15 and grain density2650kg/m³. Dry-solid flux is795kg/s, giving2862000kg over1h of unchanged operation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Dry-solid production rate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泥漿流量全部等於真正挖出的乾固體體積流量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「乾固體生產率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instructionEn: Bed deposition reduces effective area and increases resistance; interpreting rising pressure solely as increased flow can delay blockage detection. Aging geometry and wear also make the original hydraulic curve unrepresentative of the operating pipeline. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設清水基準f=0.02、L=500m、D=0.50m、v=3m/s，hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m；不含彎頭與漿體修正。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume a clear-water baseline f=0.02,L=500m,D=0.50m,v=3m/s. hf=f(L/D)v²/(2g)=9.174m, excluding fittings and slurry corrections.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「清水管損公式無需任何修正就能保證高濃度泥漿可輸送。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "An uncorrected clear-water friction formula guarantees transport of concentrated dredging slurry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

quiz.question: 在「管路摩擦水頭」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pipeline friction head" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
管底沉積會縮小有效截面並增大阻力，壓力升高若只被當成流量增加可能延誤堵塞辨識。
泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Bed deposition reduces effective area and increases resistance; interpreting rising pressure solely as increased flow can delay blockage detection.
Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production.
quiz.explanation: 管底沉積會縮小有效截面並增大阻力，壓力升高若只被當成流量增加可能延誤堵塞辨識。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bed deposition reduces effective area and increases resistance; interpreting rising pressure solely as increased flow can delay blockage detection. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「泵送能量收支」與「聲波測深與基準」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pumping energy balance" and "Acoustic depth and datum": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 泵送能量收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「泵送能量收支」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pumping energy balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水力功率代表流體得到的機械能，電功率還需除以泵與驅動效率，不能拿銘牌最大值代替工況。漿體密度、總水頭和流量必須來自同一時段，效率又隨運轉點改變；這項收支可診斷異常，但無法獨立決定設備選型或允許負載。 假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「泵送能量收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic power is mechanical energy delivered to the fluid, while input power additionally reflects pump and drive efficiency. Nameplate maximum is not an operating measurement. Density, total head and flow must describe the same period, and efficiency varies with operating point. This balance helps diagnose discrepancies but does not independently select machinery or establish its permissible load. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pumping energy balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「泵送能量收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pumping energy balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 水力功率代表流體得到的機械能，電功率還需除以泵與驅動效率，不能拿銘牌最大值代替工況。漿體密度、總水頭和流量必須來自同一時段，效率又隨運轉點改變；這項收支可診斷異常，但無法獨立決定設備選型或允許負載。
knowledge.textEn: Hydraulic power is mechanical energy delivered to the fluid, while input power additionally reflects pump and drive efficiency. Nameplate maximum is not an operating measurement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「泵送能量收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pumping energy balance" is correct?
options: 泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。
測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。
水力功率代表流體得到的機械能，電功率還需除以泵與驅動效率，不能拿銘牌最大值代替工況。
optionsEn: Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production.
Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction.
Hydraulic power is mechanical energy delivered to the fluid, while input power additionally reflects pump and drive efficiency.
quiz.explanation: 水力功率代表流體得到的機械能，電功率還需除以泵與驅動效率，不能拿銘牌最大值代替工況。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
