steps.title: 泵送能量收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「泵送能量收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pumping energy balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記電力、流量、進出口總水頭和密度，區分瞬時與平均資料。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record power, flow, inlet-outlet total head and density synchronously, distinguishing instantaneous and average records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設泥漿ρ=1300kg/m³、Q=2m³/s、總水頭20m、總效率0.70，Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW；效率固定示意。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume slurry1300kg/m³,Q=2m³/s,total head20m and total efficiency0.70. Pin=ρgQH/η=728.7kW with fixed illustrative efficiency.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「泵送能量收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pumping energy balance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
靜態水深大於吃水就代表任何航速與波況都可以通航。
九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Water depth exceeding draft permits navigation at every speed and wave condition.
Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 泵送能量收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pumping energy balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「泵送能量收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pumping energy balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記電力、流量、進出口總水頭和密度，區分瞬時與平均資料。用實測工況核對效率範圍，查找水頭漏項與機械損失，不能因公式吻合就忽略振動或材料輸送異常。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record power, flow, inlet-outlet total head and density synchronously, distinguishing instantaneous and average records. Check efficiency at the measured operating point and investigate missing head terms or mechanical losses without overlooking vibration or transport abnormalities merely because arithmetic agrees. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同步記電力、流量、進出口總水頭和密度，區分瞬時與平均資料。用實測工況核對效率範圍，查找水頭漏項與機械損失，不能因公式吻合就忽略振動或材料輸送異常。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record power, flow, inlet-outlet total head and density synchronously, distinguishing instantaneous and average records. Check efficiency at the measured operating point and investigate missing head terms or mechanical losses without overlooking vibration or transport abnormalities merely because arithmetic agrees.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using clear-water density for concentrated slurry understates power, while omitted suction velocity and elevation miss head terms. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 聲波測深與基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Acoustic depth and datum: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲波測深與基準」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Acoustic depth and datum” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 測深由聲波往返時間轉成距離，探頭吃水、船體升沉和潮位又把距離轉成海床高程。聲速剖面隨溫鹽改變，斜波束更容易出現折射偏差；只校正一個表面聲速不足以代表整個水柱，且各項修正必須保持相同符號約定。 假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲波測深與基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sounding converts two-way travel time into range, then transducer draft, vessel motion and tide convert range into bed elevation. Temperature and salinity alter the sound-speed profile, particularly affecting oblique beams through refraction. A surface-only correction does not describe the whole water column, and every correction requires a consistent sign convention and reference frame. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Acoustic depth and datum” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聲波測深與基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Acoustic depth and datum”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 聲波測深與基準
knowledge.text: 測深由聲波往返時間轉成距離，探頭吃水、船體升沉和潮位又把距離轉成海床高程。聲速剖面隨溫鹽改變，斜波束更容易出現折射偏差；只校正一個表面聲速不足以代表整個水柱，且各項修正必須保持相同符號約定。
knowledge.textEn: Sounding converts two-way travel time into range, then transducer draft, vessel motion and tide convert range into bed elevation. Temperature and salinity alter the sound-speed profile, particularly affecting oblique beams through refraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「聲波測深與基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Acoustic depth and datum" is correct?
options: 測深由聲波往返時間轉成距離，探頭吃水、船體升沉和潮位又把距離轉成海床高程。
測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。
測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。
optionsEn: Sounding converts two-way travel time into range, then transducer draft, vessel motion and tide convert range into bed elevation.
Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction.
Small sounding uncertainty proves that every channel obstruction has been detected.
quiz.explanation: 測深由聲波往返時間轉成距離，探頭吃水、船體升沉和潮位又把距離轉成海床高程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Sounding converts two-way travel time into range, then transducer draft, vessel motion and tide convert range into bed elevation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 聲波測深與基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Acoustic depth and datum: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「聲波測深與基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Acoustic depth and datum” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a vertical beam, uniform sound speed1500m/s and two-way time0.020s. Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「聲波測深與基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Acoustic depth and datum", which statement holds?
options: 每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。
optionsEn: Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 聲波測深與基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Acoustic depth and datum: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲波測深與基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Acoustic depth and datum” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。
knowledge.textEn: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。用獨立檢核線和聲速剖面測試折射，保留時鐘及姿態校準紀錄，避免只看點雲外觀平順。
knowledge.textEn: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Test refraction with independent check lines and sound-speed profiles, retaining timing and attitude calibration instead of relying solely on smooth point-cloud appearance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「聲波測深與基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Acoustic depth and datum"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
泥漿流量全部等於真正挖出的乾固體體積流量。
畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow.
Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs.
quiz.explanation: 畫水面、探頭和海床的高程關係，逐項核對吃水、升沉與潮位符號。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw elevations of water surface, transducer and bed and verify draft, heave and tide signs. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 聲波測深與基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Acoustic depth and datum: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聲波測深與基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Acoustic depth and datum” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。不同方向測線看似吻合時，仍可能共同受錯誤高程基準影響而一起偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error. Agreement between opposite survey directions can still conceal a shared incorrect vertical datum that shifts both sets of depths together. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設垂直聲束、均勻聲速1500m/s、往返0.020s，探頭至床距15m；探頭在瞬時水面下1m時水深16m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Transducer-bed range is15m;1m transducer draft gives water depth16m.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。不同方向測線看似吻合時，仍可能共同受錯誤高程基準影響而一起偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error. Agreement between opposite survey directions can still conceal a shared incorrect vertical datum that shifts both sets of depths together.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「聲波測深與基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Acoustic depth and datum" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。
optionsEn: Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Small sounding uncertainty proves that every channel obstruction has been detected.
quiz.explanation: 聲速設錯會造成整條測線深度偏差，吃水符號反轉又能讓誤差加倍。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Incorrect sound speed biases the entire line, while reversed draft signs can amplify the error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「測深不確定度預算」與「船底淨空分項」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Sounding uncertainty budget" and "Under-keel clearance components": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 測深不確定度預算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sounding uncertainty budget: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「測深不確定度預算」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sounding uncertainty budget” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 深度不確定度來自儀器、聲速、姿態和基準等分量，獨立隨機分量才能直接平方和。覆蓋率和小物體偵測又屬不同品質維度，精度高並不表示沒有漏測；合成預算用來理解誤差傳播，不是在未指定測量等級時自行宣告符合國際標準。 假設三個獨立零均值標準不確定度0.05、0.08、0.04m，合成σ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「測深不確定度預算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Depth uncertainty combines instrument, sound-speed, attitude and reference contributions, with direct quadrature applying only to independent random components. Coverage and feature detection are separate quality dimensions: accurate points can still leave unseen obstructions. A synthetic budget illustrates propagation rather than claiming compliance with an international survey order that has not been specified and verified. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties0.05,0.08 and0.04m. Combinedσ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m, excluding systematic bias. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sounding uncertainty budget” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small sounding uncertainty proves that every channel obstruction has been detected." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「測深不確定度預算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Sounding uncertainty budget”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 測深不確定度預算
knowledge.text: 深度不確定度來自儀器、聲速、姿態和基準等分量，獨立隨機分量才能直接平方和。覆蓋率和小物體偵測又屬不同品質維度，精度高並不表示沒有漏測；合成預算用來理解誤差傳播，不是在未指定測量等級時自行宣告符合國際標準。
knowledge.textEn: Depth uncertainty combines instrument, sound-speed, attitude and reference contributions, with direct quadrature applying only to independent random components. Coverage and feature detection are separate quality dimensions: accurate points can still leave unseen obstructions.

quiz.question: 關於「測深不確定度預算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Sounding uncertainty budget" is correct?
options: 測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。
深度不確定度來自儀器、聲速、姿態和基準等分量，獨立隨機分量才能直接平方和。

steps.title: 測深不確定度預算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「測深不確定度預算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Sounding uncertainty budget” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設三個獨立零均值標準不確定度0.05、0.08、0.04m，合成σ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume independent zero-mean standard uncertainties0.05,0.08 and0.04m. Combinedσ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m, excluding systematic bias. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將標準不確定度、偏差及信賴界限分欄，說明每個分量是否相關。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Separate standard uncertainty, bias and confidence limits and identify correlations between components.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

Solid mass percentage and solid volume percentage are interchangeable without conversion.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 測深不確定度預算：試驗與驗證

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Separate standard uncertainty, bias and confidence limits and identify correlations between components. steps.failure: 注意干擾：相關的潮位和基準誤差被假設獨立會低估不確定度，未測間隙中的石塊更不在預算內。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assuming independence between correlated tide and datum errors understates uncertainty, while a rock in an unsurveyed gap is absent from the budget entirely. quiz.explanationEn: Separate standard uncertainty, bias and confidence limits and identify correlations between components. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 測深不確定度預算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sounding uncertainty budget: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「測深不確定度預算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sounding uncertainty budget” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 相關的潮位和基準誤差被假設獨立會低估不確定度，未測間隙中的石塊更不在預算內。漂亮的精度數字無法補救航道關鍵區沒有資料的問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assuming independence between correlated tide and datum errors understates uncertainty, while a rock in an unsurveyed gap is absent from the budget entirely. Impressive precision cannot compensate for missing observations in controlling navigation areas. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Combinedσ=√(0.05²+0.08²+0.04²)=0.1025m, excluding systematic bias.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「測深標準不確定度很小就表示所有航道障礙物都被找到。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small sounding uncertainty proves that every channel obstruction has been detected." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「測深不確定度預算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

靜態水深大於吃水就代表任何航速與波況都可以通航。

Assuming independence between correlated tide and datum errors understates uncertainty, while a rock in an unsurveyed gap is absent from the budget entirely.
Water depth exceeding draft permits navigation at every speed and wave condition.

quiz.explanationEn: Assuming independence between correlated tide and datum errors understates uncertainty, while a rock in an unsurveyed gap is absent from the budget entirely. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Under-keel clearance components” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Under-keel clearance components", which statement holds?

航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。
泥漿流量全部等於真正挖出的乾固體體積流量。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed.
The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow.

steps.title: 船底淨空分項：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Under-keel clearance components: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「船底淨空分項」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Under-keel clearance components” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明列水位時刻、吃水來源與各需求的定義，檢查是否有重複或漏計。將示意預算與權責單位的場址方法分開保存，核對船型、航速及波向適用性，不以平均水深代替最淺點。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission. Keep this illustration separate from the authority’s site method, verify vessel, speed and wave-direction applicability, and use controlling shallows rather than average depth. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission. Keep this illustration separate from the authority’s site method, verify vessel, speed and wave-direction applicability, and use controlling shallows rather than average depth.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「船底淨空分項」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Under-keel clearance components"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
明列水位時刻、吃水來源與各需求的定義，檢查是否有重複或漏計。
泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission.
Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production.

quiz.explanationEn: Record water-level time, draft source and each demand definition, checking duplication and omission. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 船底淨空分項：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Under-keel clearance components: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「船底淨空分項」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Under-keel clearance components” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。多個保守餘量重複扣除則可能讓分析失去可追溯性。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth. Duplicating conservative allowances creates the opposite error and makes the resulting assessment difficult to audit or interpret. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設可用水深15m、吃水13m、動態下沉0.5m、波動需求0.4m、量測餘量0.2m，剩餘示意淨空0.9m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Illustrative residual clearance is0.9m, not permission to transit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「靜態水深大於吃水就代表任何航速與波況都可以通航。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Water depth exceeding draft permits navigation at every speed and wave condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。多個保守餘量重複扣除則可能讓分析失去可追溯性。
knowledge.textEn: Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth. Duplicating conservative allowances creates the opposite error and makes the resulting assessment difficult to audit or interpret.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「船底淨空分項」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Under-keel clearance components" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。
忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation.
Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth.
quiz.explanation: 忽略動態下沉會在靜態淨空看似充裕時低估碰底可能，混用潮位時刻也會錯估可用水深。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring squat can understate bottom-contact exposure despite apparently adequate static clearance, and mismatched tide times misstate depth. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「循環時間與產量」與「回流水固體平衡」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cycle time and production" and "Return-water solids balance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 循環時間與產量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cycle time and production: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「循環時間與產量」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cycle time and production” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 耙吸船或抓斗作業有挖取、移動、卸料及等待階段，只有完整循環才能換算持續產量。有效利用率需明確說明是否已包含等待，避免重複扣除；料艙容量亦非原狀土方，材料膨鬆與含水會使不同產量報表無法直接比較。 假設每循環合格完成方600m³、循環時間40min且另計可用率0.75，平均600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環時間與產量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A dredging cycle includes excavation, travel, unloading and waiting, so sustainable production requires the complete cycle. Utilization must state whether waiting is already included to avoid double deductions. Hopper capacity is also not in-situ soil volume; bulking and water content make reports with different volume definitions unsuitable for direct comparison across equipment or shifts. Assume completed acceptable volume600m³ per40min cycle and separately defined availability0.75. Mean production=600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cycle time and production” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「循環時間與產量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cycle time and production”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 循環時間與產量
knowledge.text: 耙吸船或抓斗作業有挖取、移動、卸料及等待階段，只有完整循環才能換算持續產量。有效利用率需明確說明是否已包含等待，避免重複扣除；料艙容量亦非原狀土方，材料膨鬆與含水會使不同產量報表無法直接比較。
knowledge.textEn: A dredging cycle includes excavation, travel, unloading and waiting, so sustainable production requires the complete cycle. Utilization must state whether waiting is already included to avoid double deductions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「循環時間與產量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cycle time and production" is correct?
options: 耙吸船或抓斗作業有挖取、移動、卸料及等待階段，只有完整循環才能換算持續產量。
每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。
九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。
optionsEn: A dredging cycle includes excavation, travel, unloading and waiting, so sustainable production requires the complete cycle.
Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation.
Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement.

steps.title: 循環時間與產量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cycle time and production: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環時間與產量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cycle time and production” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每循環合格完成方600m³、循環時間40min且另計可用率0.75，平均600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume completed acceptable volume600m³ per40min cycle and separately defined availability0.75. Mean production=600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。核對完成方是否已由測量確認，並比較多個班次的分布，不以最快一趟或料艙名義容量代表長期績效。
knowledge.textEn: Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability. Check whether completed volume is survey-confirmed and compare distributions across shifts rather than representing long-term performance by the fastest trip or nominal hopper capacity.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。核對完成方是否已由測量確認，並比較多個班次的分布，不以最快一趟或料艙名義容量代表長期績效。
knowledge.textEn: Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability. Check whether completed volume is survey-confirmed and compare distributions across shifts rather than representing long-term performance by the fastest trip or nominal hopper capacity.

quiz.question: 要驗證「循環時間與產量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cycle time and production"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
測得聲波往返距離後不必考慮探頭吃水與潮位修正。
用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Acoustic range alone gives charted bed elevation without draft or tide correction.
Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability.
quiz.explanation: 用原始時戳分解循環階段，標明可用率排除或納入的停機原因。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use raw timestamps to separate cycle phases and define included downtime in availability. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 循環時間與產量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cycle time and production: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環時間與產量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cycle time and production” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 將等待時間納入循環又乘含等待的可用率會重複扣減，反之漏記卸料與移航則過度樂觀。容量達標而底部仍留淺點，也不能視為合格完成方。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting waiting in both cycle time and availability double-reduces output, while omitting travel and unloading inflates it. A full hopper does not represent acceptable completed excavation if controlling shallow patches remain on the bed. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設每循環合格完成方600m³、循環時間40min且另計可用率0.75，平均600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean production=600×60/40×0.75=675m³/h.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每次滿艙容量乘理論班次就是已驗收的航道完成方量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Full hopper capacity times theoretical cycles equals accepted completed channel excavation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 將等待時間納入循環又乘含等待的可用率會重複扣減，反之漏記卸料與移航則過度樂觀。容量達標而底部仍留淺點，也不能視為合格完成方。
knowledge.textEn: Counting waiting in both cycle time and availability double-reduces output, while omitting travel and unloading inflates it. A full hopper does not represent acceptable completed excavation if controlling shallow patches remain on the bed.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「循環時間與產量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cycle time and production" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 將等待時間納入循環又乘含等待的可用率會重複扣減，反之漏記卸料與移航則過度樂觀。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。
optionsEn: Counting waiting in both cycle time and availability double-reduces output, while omitting travel and unloading inflates it.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement.
quiz.explanation: 將等待時間納入循環又乘含等待的可用率會重複扣減，反之漏記卸料與移航則過度樂觀。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting waiting in both cycle time and availability double-reduces output, while omitting travel and unloading inflates it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 回流水固體平衡：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Return-water solids balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「回流水固體平衡」如何影響港池航道疏浚的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Return-water solids balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Harbor-basin and navigation-channel dredging”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 放置區回流水可能攜帶細料，輸入和排出通量需以同一時段及乾固體定義比較。截留比例只說明材料收支，不能替代水質與生態評估；沉積暫存和再懸浮也會改變短期結果，因此要避免把短時間高截留率解釋為長期永久固定。 假設乾固體輸入100kg/s、回流水2m³/s且固體0.5kg/m³，輸出1kg/s，當期截留率99%；不代表水質合格。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「回流水固體平衡」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Return water can carry fines out of a placement area, so input and output fluxes require matching periods and dry-solid definitions. Retention describes material accounting rather than water-quality or ecological acceptability. Temporary storage and resuspension alter short-term results, meaning a high measured fraction cannot demonstrate permanent confinement or the absence of downstream effects. Assume dry-solid input100kg/s and return water2m³/s at0.5kg/m³. Export is1kg/s and period retention99%, not water-quality compliance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Return-water solids balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「回流水固體平衡」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Return-water solids balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 回流水固體平衡
knowledge.text: 放置區回流水可能攜帶細料，輸入和排出通量需以同一時段及乾固體定義比較。截留比例只說明材料收支，不能替代水質與生態評估；沉積暫存和再懸浮也會改變短期結果，因此要避免把短時間高截留率解釋為長期永久固定。
knowledge.textEn: Return water can carry fines out of a placement area, so input and output fluxes require matching periods and dry-solid definitions. Retention describes material accounting rather than water-quality or ecological acceptability.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「回流水固體平衡」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Return-water solids balance" is correct?
options: 九成九固體截留率可以自動證明回流水符合所有環境要求。
放置區回流水可能攜帶細料，輸入和排出通量需以同一時段及乾固體定義比較。
航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。
optionsEn: Ninety-nine-percent solid retention automatically proves that return water meets every environmental requirement.
Return water can carry fines out of a placement area, so input and output fluxes require matching periods and dry-solid definitions.
Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 放置區回流水可能攜帶細料，輸入和排出通量需以同一時段及乾固體定義比較。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Return water can carry fines out of a placement area, so input and output fluxes require matching periods and dry-solid definitions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 回流水固體平衡：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Return-water solids balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「回流水固體平衡」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Return-water solids balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體輸入100kg/s、回流水2m³/s且固體0.5kg/m³，輸出1kg/s，當期截留率99%；不代表水質合格。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry-solid input100kg/s and return water2m³/s at0.5kg/m³. Export is1kg/s and period retention99%, not water-quality compliance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步量入料與回流水濃度流量，確認排水口是否全部納入，並扣除可辨識的原床再懸浮。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure input and all return outlets synchronously and account for identifiable native-bed resuspension.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體輸入100kg/s、回流水2m³/s且固體0.5kg/m³，輸出1kg/s，當期截留率99%；不代表水質合格。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry-solid input100kg/s and return water2m³/s at0.5kg/m³. Export is1kg/s and period retention99%, not water-quality compliance.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「回流水固體平衡」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Return-water solids balance", which statement holds?
options: 泥漿流量全部等於真正挖出的乾固體體積流量。
泵的電力消耗增加就一定代表乾固體疏浚產量增加。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: The entire slurry discharge equals the actual excavated dry-solid volume flow.
Increased pump electricity consumption always means increased dry-solid dredging production.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 回流水固體平衡：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Return-water solids balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「回流水固體平衡」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Return-water solids balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步量入料與回流水濃度流量，確認排水口是否全部納入，並扣除可辨識的原床再懸浮。用分期地形和乾固體存量核對積分收支，將環境暴露與截留率分開呈現。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure input and all return outlets synchronously and account for identifiable native-bed resuspension. Check integrated fluxes against repeated terrain and dry-solid storage observations, presenting environmental exposure separately from the numerical fraction retained during the selected period. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同步量入料與回流水濃度流量，確認排水口是否全部納入，並扣除可辨識的原床再懸浮。用分期地形和乾固體存量核對積分收支，將環境暴露與截留率分開呈現。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure input and all return outlets synchronously and account for identifiable native-bed resuspension. Check integrated fluxes against repeated terrain and dry-solid storage observations, presenting environmental exposure separately from the numerical fraction retained during the selected period.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：少量流失若集中在敏感時段仍可能重要，漏掉旁通排水會使截留率虛高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A small exported fraction can matter during sensitive periods, and omitted bypass outlets inflate retention. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 少量流失若集中在敏感時段仍可能重要，漏掉旁通排水會使截留率虛高。存量變化不符時只改濃度平均值，會掩蓋未量到的出口或暫存延遲。
knowledge.textEn: A small exported fraction can matter during sensitive periods, and omitted bypass outlets inflate retention. Adjusting mean concentration to close a storage discrepancy conceals unmeasured paths or delays instead of explaining the actual material balance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「回流水固體平衡」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Return-water solids balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
少量流失若集中在敏感時段仍可能重要，漏掉旁通排水會使截留率虛高。
航道平均深度達標就代表每個局部淺點都已移除。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A small exported fraction can matter during sensitive periods, and omitted bypass outlets inflate retention.
Meeting average channel depth proves that every local controlling shoal has been removed.
quiz.explanation: 少量流失若集中在敏感時段仍可能重要，漏掉旁通排水會使截留率虛高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A small exported fraction can matter during sensitive periods, and omitted bypass outlets inflate retention. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 疏浚泥沙有益利用
courses.summary: 用材料分流地形高程和生態追蹤判斷疏浚土的有益利用。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Evaluate dredged-sediment reuse through material routing, elevation and ecological follow-up. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 用材料分流地形高程和生態追蹤判斷疏浚土的有益利用
courses.focusEn: Evaluate dredged-sediment reuse through material routing, elevation and ecological follow-up
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。假設其他類別保持不變，已驗證砂量6500增10%至7150t，總料由10000增至10650t，確認利用率為67.14%，並非原65%加10百分點。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%. If verified sand increases10% from6500 to7150t while other classes remain fixed, total feed becomes10650t and confirmed reuse is67.14%, not65% plus ten percentage points. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設潮位η=A sinωt、A=1m、地面z=0.5m且無滯水，淹水比例arccos(z/A)/π=1/3，非存活率。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設原料乾砂600t，產品含砂540t且產品總乾質量600t；砂回收率540/600=90%，產品純度也90%，分母巧合相同。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾料1000t、某示蹤物20mg/kg，總量20kg；加入1000t不含該物材料後均濃度10mg/kg，但總量仍20kg。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume tideη=A sinωt,A=1m and ground z=0.5m without ponding. Inundation fraction arccos(z/A)/π=1/3, not survival probability.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume feed contains600t dry sand; product contains540t sand in600t total dry mass. Recovery and purity are both90%, with coincidentally equal denominators.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume1000t dry sediment at tracer concentration20mg/kg: total20kg. Adding1000t tracer-free material gives10mg/kg while total remains20kg; no compliance claim.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「材料分流與去向」與「薄層放置與高程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Material routing and destinations" and "Thin-layer placement and elevation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 材料分流與去向：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material routing and destinations: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料分流與去向」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material routing and destinations” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有益利用先確認可用材料類別與接收目的，不能將全部挖出量直接算成成功利用。篩分、脫水和不合用材料各有去向，所有分類需用一致乾質量基準並避免重複計數；接收場適合性還有污染、鹽分與地工條件，帳面分流不能取代證據。 假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料分流與去向」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Beneficial reuse starts with material classification and receiving purpose rather than counting all excavation as successful use. Screening, dewatering and unsuitable fractions have distinct destinations that require one dry-mass basis and no duplicate counting. Suitability additionally depends on contaminants, salinity and geotechnical behavior, so an accounting split cannot substitute for evidence of fitness at the receiving site. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material routing and destinations” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料分流與去向」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Material routing and destinations”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料分流與去向
knowledge.text: 有益利用先確認可用材料類別與接收目的，不能將全部挖出量直接算成成功利用。篩分、脫水和不合用材料各有去向，所有分類需用一致乾質量基準並避免重複計數；接收場適合性還有污染、鹽分與地工條件，帳面分流不能取代證據。
knowledge.textEn: Beneficial reuse starts with material classification and receiving purpose rather than counting all excavation as successful use. Screening, dewatering and unsuitable fractions have distinct destinations that require one dry-mass basis and no duplicate counting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料分流與去向」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material routing and destinations" is correct?
options: 疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。
有益利用先確認可用材料類別與接收目的，不能將全部挖出量直接算成成功利用。
平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。
optionsEn: Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse.
Beneficial reuse starts with material classification and receiving purpose rather than counting all excavation as successful use.
A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
quiz.explanation: 有益利用先確認可用材料類別與接收目的，不能將全部挖出量直接算成成功利用。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Beneficial reuse starts with material classification and receiving purpose rather than counting all excavation as successful use. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 材料分流與去向：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Material routing and destinations: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「材料分流與去向」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Material routing and destinations” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume dry solids10000t comprise sand6500t,fines3000t and debris500t. Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「材料分流與去向」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Material routing and destinations", which statement holds?
options: 潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。
混合後平均濃度降低代表同百分比的污染物已被消除。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
A lower average concentration after mixing means the same fraction of contaminant was destroyed.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 材料分流與去向：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Material routing and destinations: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「材料分流與去向」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Material routing and destinations” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。
knowledge.textEn: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。將待判定材料獨立保留，不以計畫去向當成已完成利用，並查證接收端實際數量和用途。
knowledge.textEn: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Keep unresolved material separate, distinguish planned destinations from completed reuse, and verify actual received quantity and purpose rather than relying only on dispatch records.

quiz.question: 要驗證「材料分流與去向」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Material routing and destinations"?
options: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。
optionsEn: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
quiz.explanation: 對每一批建立來源、檢測、處理與接收紀錄，核對三類材料是否同用乾質量。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Trace each batch through source, testing, treatment and receipt, checking a common dry-mass basis. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 材料分流與去向：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Material routing and destinations: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「材料分流與去向」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Material routing and destinations” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。不同接收場需要的性質不同，不能以一處通過代表全用途適用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions. Different receiving sites need different properties; acceptance for one purpose does not qualify every other use. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設乾固體10000t中砂6500t、細料3000t、雜物500t，質量守恆10000t；若僅砂獲適用驗證，確認再利用率65%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Balance closes; if only sand is verified suitable, confirmed reuse is65%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。不同接收場需要的性質不同，不能以一處通過代表全用途適用。
knowledge.textEn: Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions. Different receiving sites need different properties; acceptance for one purpose does not qualify every other use.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「材料分流與去向」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Material routing and destinations" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。
平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions.
A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
quiz.explanation: 把含水泥漿與乾砂噸數相加會造出虛假利用量，待檢材料提前算成功也會掩蓋不合用比例。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding wet slurry tonnes to dry sand invents reuse quantities, and counting untested material as accepted hides unsuitable fractions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 薄層放置與高程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thin-layer placement and elevation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「薄層放置與高程」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thin-layer placement and elevation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 濕地放置厚度決定表面相對潮位位置，但卸入泥漿體積尚含會排出的水。完成厚度需明確指排水後或長期壓密後的狀態，地面高程和植被耐受也有空間差異；一個平均厚度不能保證所有區域得到相同淹水時間或恢復條件。 假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「薄層放置與高程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Placement thickness sets surface position relative to tides, but delivered slurry includes water that later drains. Completed thickness must identify whether it is after drainage or longer-term consolidation. Terrain and vegetation tolerance vary spatially, so a mean layer cannot establish equal inundation or recovery conditions throughout the entire restored area without additional elevation and ecological observations. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thin-layer placement and elevation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「薄層放置與高程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thin-layer placement and elevation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 薄層放置與高程
