knowledge.textEn: Placement thickness sets surface position relative to tides, but delivered slurry includes water that later drains. Completed thickness must identify whether it is after drainage or longer-term consolidation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「薄層放置與高程」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thin-layer placement and elevation" is correct?
options: 平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。
放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。
濕地放置厚度決定表面相對潮位位置，但卸入泥漿體積尚含會排出的水。
optionsEn: A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
Placement thickness sets surface position relative to tides, but delivered slurry includes water that later drains.
quiz.explanation: 濕地放置厚度決定表面相對潮位位置，但卸入泥漿體積尚含會排出的水。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Placement thickness sets surface position relative to tides, but delivered slurry includes water that later drains. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 薄層放置與高程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thin-layer placement and elevation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「薄層放置與高程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thin-layer placement and elevation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：比較放置前後同基準高程面，標明體積對應的排水時點及施工邊界。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre- and post-placement surfaces on one datum, specifying drainage time and boundaries.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設排水後保留體積12000m³、面積60000m²且均勻，平均厚度t=V/A=0.20m；不含後續壓密沉陷。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume retained post-drainage volume12000m³ over60000m² uniformly. Mean thickness t=V/A=0.20m, excluding subsequent consolidation settlement.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「薄層放置與高程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thin-layer placement and elevation", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
產品純度與原料回收率永遠具有相同分母而且相等。
覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Product purity and feed recovery always share the same denominator and value.
Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 薄層放置與高程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thin-layer placement and elevation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「薄層放置與高程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thin-layer placement and elevation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 比較放置前後同基準高程面，標明體積對應的排水時點及施工邊界。按高低地分區檢查厚度與植被狀態，保留低窪及局部堆厚資料，而不讓全區平均取代空間分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre- and post-placement surfaces on one datum, specifying drainage time and boundaries. Inspect thickness and vegetation by elevation zone, retaining depressions and local mounds rather than substituting a whole-site average for the distribution that controls actual inundation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較放置前後同基準高程面，標明體積對應的排水時點及施工邊界。按高低地分區檢查厚度與植被狀態，保留低窪及局部堆厚資料，而不讓全區平均取代空間分布。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare pre- and post-placement surfaces on one datum, specifying drainage time and boundaries. Inspect thickness and vegetation by elevation zone, retaining depressions and local mounds rather than substituting a whole-site average for the distribution that controls actual inundation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均厚度符合計畫時局部深堆仍可能掩埋植株，低區又可能沒有足夠增高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local mounds can bury vegetation despite a matching mean thickness, while low areas remain insufficiently raised. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「薄層放置與高程」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thin-layer placement and elevation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。
平均厚度符合計畫時局部深堆仍可能掩埋植株，低區又可能沒有足夠增高。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
Local mounds can bury vegetation despite a matching mean thickness, while low areas remain insufficiently raised.
quiz.explanation: 平均厚度符合計畫時局部深堆仍可能掩埋植株，低區又可能沒有足夠增高。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Local mounds can bury vegetation despite a matching mean thickness, while low areas remain insufficiently raised. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「壓密後高程餘量」與「潮汐淹水比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Post-consolidation elevation reserve" and "Tidal inundation fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 壓密後高程餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Post-consolidation elevation reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「壓密後高程餘量」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Post-consolidation elevation reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細泥排水壓密會使放置面逐漸降低，固體體積保持時孔隙比變化可換算一維厚度縮減。真實地基也會沉陷、側向流動及有機質分解，因此這個模型只涵蓋單層材料本身；應將施工時點高程和長期目標分開，而非一次測量完成即結案。 假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「壓密後高程餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fine sediment lowers as it drains and consolidates. At fixed solid volume, void-ratio change gives a one-dimensional thickness reduction. Foundation settlement, lateral spreading and organic decomposition add other mechanisms, so this model covers only the placed layer itself. Construction elevation and long-term target must remain distinct, and one completion survey cannot close the performance assessment. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Post-consolidation elevation reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「壓密後高程餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Post-consolidation elevation reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 壓密後高程餘量
knowledge.text: 細泥排水壓密會使放置面逐漸降低，固體體積保持時孔隙比變化可換算一維厚度縮減。真實地基也會沉陷、側向流動及有機質分解，因此這個模型只涵蓋單層材料本身；應將施工時點高程和長期目標分開，而非一次測量完成即結案。
knowledge.textEn: Fine sediment lowers as it drains and consolidates. At fixed solid volume, void-ratio change gives a one-dimensional thickness reduction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「壓密後高程餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Post-consolidation elevation reserve" is correct?
options: 細泥排水壓密會使放置面逐漸降低，固體體積保持時孔隙比變化可換算一維厚度縮減。
放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。
潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。
optionsEn: Fine sediment lowers as it drains and consolidates.
If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
quiz.explanation: 細泥排水壓密會使放置面逐漸降低，固體體積保持時孔隙比變化可換算一維厚度縮減。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fine sediment lowers as it drains and consolidates. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 壓密後高程餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Post-consolidation elevation reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「壓密後高程餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Post-consolidation elevation reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial thickness1m,e0=2 and final e1=1. H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「壓密後高程餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Post-consolidation elevation reserve", which statement holds?
options: 混合後平均濃度降低代表同百分比的污染物已被消除。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。
optionsEn: A lower average concentration after mixing means the same fraction of contaminant was destroyed.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 壓密後高程餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Post-consolidation elevation reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「壓密後高程餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Post-consolidation elevation reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。
knowledge.textEn: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。比較不同時間的高程及乾固體存量，將側向外移和有機質損失另列，不強迫所有變化符合一維式。
knowledge.textEn: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Compare elevation and dry-solid storage through time, listing lateral export and organic loss separately instead of forcing all change into one-dimensional compression.

quiz.question: 要驗證「壓密後高程餘量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Post-consolidation elevation reserve"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。
用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling.
quiz.explanation: 用沉陷板和孔壓觀測區分材料壓密與原地基移動，核對孔隙比樣本的代表性。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use settlement and pore-pressure observations to distinguish placed-layer consolidation from foundation movement, checking void-ratio sampling. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 壓密後高程餘量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Post-consolidation elevation reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「壓密後高程餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Post-consolidation elevation reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。高程達標後持續下降會改變植被帶與潮溝連通，影響復育功能。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas. Continued lowering after nominal completion alters vegetation zones and creek connectivity, changing the intended restoration function. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設初厚1m、初孔隙比e0=2、末孔隙比e1=1，末厚H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m，沉陷0.333m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: H1=H0(1+e1)/(1+e0)=0.667m and settlement0.333m, with fixed solid volume.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。高程達標後持續下降會改變植被帶與潮溝連通，影響復育功能。
knowledge.textEn: Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas. Continued lowering after nominal completion alters vegetation zones and creek connectivity, changing the intended restoration function.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「壓密後高程餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Post-consolidation elevation reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。
optionsEn: Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
quiz.explanation: 把原地基沉陷也算成填料壓密會誤估所需材料，未考慮側向流動又可能低估低處擴散。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Assigning foundation settlement entirely to fill consolidation misstates material demand, while omitted spreading understates movement into low areas. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 潮汐淹水比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tidal inundation fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「潮汐淹水比例」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal inundation fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 潮位與地面高程的相對關係決定浸水時間，對植被及水質交換都重要。單一正弦潮忽略不對稱、風增水與排水滯後，但能說明高程小變動如何改變淹水比例；時間比例不同於水深，也不能直接換成某物種存活率或生態成功機率。 假設潮位η=A sinωt、A=1m、地面z=0.5m且無滯水，淹水比例arccos(z/A)/π=1/3，非存活率。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮汐淹水比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative tide and ground elevation determine inundation duration, affecting vegetation and exchange. One sinusoid omits asymmetry, wind setup and drainage lag but illustrates how elevation changes alter the wet fraction. Duration fraction differs from water depth and cannot directly become a species-survival probability or a general measure of ecological success at the restoration site. Assume tideη=A sinωt,A=1m and ground z=0.5m without ponding. Inundation fraction arccos(z/A)/π=1/3, not survival probability. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal inundation fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 潮汐淹水比例
knowledge.text: 潮位與地面高程的相對關係決定浸水時間，對植被及水質交換都重要。單一正弦潮忽略不對稱、風增水與排水滯後，但能說明高程小變動如何改變淹水比例；時間比例不同於水深，也不能直接換成某物種存活率或生態成功機率。
knowledge.textEn: Relative tide and ground elevation determine inundation duration, affecting vegetation and exchange. One sinusoid omits asymmetry, wind setup and drainage lag but illustrates how elevation changes alter the wet fraction.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「潮汐淹水比例」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

產品純度與原料回收率永遠具有相同分母而且相等。
optionsEn: The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
Relative tide and ground elevation determine inundation duration, affecting vegetation and exchange.

quiz.question: 在「篩分回收與產率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 污染質量與濃度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Contaminant mass versus concentration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「污染質量與濃度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Contaminant mass versus concentration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 熱點被大量低濃度樣本平均後可能消失在報表中，總負荷和局部接觸仍存在。以稀釋比例代替處理成效會漏掉溶出條件改變和生物累積的可能途徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A hotspot can disappear statistically among low-concentration samples while burden and local exposure persist. Replacing treatment evidence with a dilution ratio overlooks changes in leaching conditions and possible pathways for biological accumulation after placement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設乾料1000t、某示蹤物20mg/kg，總量20kg；加入1000t不含該物材料後均濃度10mg/kg，但總量仍20kg。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Adding1000t tracer-free material gives10mg/kg while total remains20kg; no compliance claim.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「混合後平均濃度降低代表同百分比的污染物已被消除。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A lower average concentration after mixing means the same fraction of contaminant was destroyed." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 熱點被大量低濃度樣本平均後可能消失在報表中，總負荷和局部接觸仍存在。以稀釋比例代替處理成效會漏掉溶出條件改變和生物累積的可能途徑。
knowledge.textEn: A hotspot can disappear statistically among low-concentration samples while burden and local exposure persist. Replacing treatment evidence with a dilution ratio overlooks changes in leaching conditions and possible pathways for biological accumulation after placement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「污染質量與濃度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Contaminant mass versus concentration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 熱點被大量低濃度樣本平均後可能消失在報表中，總負荷和局部接觸仍存在。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。
optionsEn: A hotspot can disappear statistically among low-concentration samples while burden and local exposure persist.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 熱點被大量低濃度樣本平均後可能消失在報表中，總負荷和局部接觸仍存在。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A hotspot can disappear statistically among low-concentration samples while burden and local exposure persist. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」與「填料有效應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cover thickness and erosion reserve" and "Effective stress in placed sediment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cover thickness and erosion reserve: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cover thickness and erosion reserve” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 隔離覆蓋層需維持連續厚度，平均放置量不能代表局部最薄處。侵蝕、壓密和底泥混入會消耗幾何餘量，而化學隔離還涉及擴散與生物擾動；本課只計厚度收支，不提供任何污染場址的建議覆蓋規格或長期隔離保證。 假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A cover layer needs continuous thickness, and average placed quantity does not describe its thinnest location. Erosion, consolidation and mixing consume geometric reserve, while chemical isolation also involves diffusion and biological disturbance. This lesson only accounts for thickness; it supplies no recommended contaminated-site cap specification and cannot establish durable isolation from the remaining number alone. Assume initial cover0.50m,erosion0.08m and compression0.04m uniformly. Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cover thickness and erosion reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Cover thickness and erosion reserve”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量
knowledge.text: 隔離覆蓋層需維持連續厚度，平均放置量不能代表局部最薄處。侵蝕、壓密和底泥混入會消耗幾何餘量，而化學隔離還涉及擴散與生物擾動；本課只計厚度收支，不提供任何污染場址的建議覆蓋規格或長期隔離保證。
knowledge.textEn: A cover layer needs continuous thickness, and average placed quantity does not describe its thinnest location. Erosion, consolidation and mixing consume geometric reserve, while chemical isolation also involves diffusion and biological disturbance.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Cover thickness and erosion reserve" is correct?
options: 覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。
隔離覆蓋層需維持連續厚度，平均放置量不能代表局部最薄處。
表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。
optionsEn: Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere.
A cover layer needs continuous thickness, and average placed quantity does not describe its thinnest location.
A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
quiz.explanation: 隔離覆蓋層需維持連續厚度，平均放置量不能代表局部最薄處。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A cover layer needs continuous thickness, and average placed quantity does not describe its thinnest location. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Cover thickness and erosion reserve: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cover thickness and erosion reserve” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial cover0.50m,erosion0.08m and compression0.04m uniformly. Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume initial cover0.50m,erosion0.08m and compression0.04m uniformly. Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Cover thickness and erosion reserve", which statement holds?
options: 處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。
平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Cover thickness and erosion reserve: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cover thickness and erosion reserve” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。
knowledge.textEn: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。另查材料相容、滲流和生物作用，不讓幾何驗證取代完整隔離績效評估。
knowledge.textEn: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Assess compatibility, seepage and biological processes separately so geometric verification does not replace a complete isolation-performance evaluation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Cover thickness and erosion reserve"?
options: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。
optionsEn: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
quiz.explanation: 用可辨識界面量測覆蓋層頂底，分區記錄最薄值和不確定度，核對侵蝕與壓密是否重複扣除。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure identifiable upper and lower interfaces, recording minimum thickness and uncertainty by zone and checking double-counted erosion or compression. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Cover thickness and erosion reserve: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cover thickness and erosion reserve” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。只依材料總方量驗收，無法找到控制暴露的薄弱路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover. Total material quantity cannot identify the thin pathways controlling actual exposure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設初始覆蓋0.50m、侵蝕0.08m、壓密0.04m且均勻，剩餘0.38m；未考慮混層、擴散與生物擾動。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Remaining thickness is0.38m, excluding mixing, diffusion and bioturbation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。只依材料總方量驗收，無法找到控制暴露的薄弱路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover. Total material quantity cannot identify the thin pathways controlling actual exposure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「覆蓋厚度與侵蝕餘量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Cover thickness and erosion reserve" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。
表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover.
A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
quiz.explanation: 覆蓋料與原泥混合會使外觀厚度足夠但隔離距離不足，局部沖槽也可能穿透平均合格的區域。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing with native sediment can leave adequate apparent thickness but inadequate separation, while a local scour channel breaches an otherwise satisfactory average cover. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 填料有效應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in placed sediment: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「填料有效應力」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective stress in placed sediment” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 新放置細泥的自重部分由孔隙水承受，有效應力才與土骨架壓縮及強度形成相關。總應力增加不等於立即取得同樣骨架荷載，排水時間和地層連通性需要量測；一個有效應力數值也不能直接代替剪力強度或允許設備通行荷重。 假設某點總垂直應力50kPa、孔隙壓35kPa，有效應力σ′=σ−u=15kPa；若總應力不變而u降10kPa，σ′升至25kPa。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「填料有效應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pore water supports part of freshly placed sediment weight; effective stress governs skeleton loading, compression and strength development. Increased total stress does not immediately become equal skeleton load, and drainage timing and connectivity need observation. One effective-stress result cannot replace a shear-strength evaluation or establish allowable equipment loading on a soft placement surface in the field. Assume total vertical stress50kPa and pore pressure35kPa:σ′=15kPa. At fixed total stress, a10kPa pressure fall raisesσ′ to25kPa. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective stress in placed sediment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「填料有效應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective stress in placed sediment”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 填料有效應力
knowledge.text: 新放置細泥的自重部分由孔隙水承受，有效應力才與土骨架壓縮及強度形成相關。總應力增加不等於立即取得同樣骨架荷載，排水時間和地層連通性需要量測；一個有效應力數值也不能直接代替剪力強度或允許設備通行荷重。
knowledge.textEn: Pore water supports part of freshly placed sediment weight; effective stress governs skeleton loading, compression and strength development. Increased total stress does not immediately become equal skeleton load, and drainage timing and connectivity need observation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「填料有效應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective stress in placed sediment" is correct?
options: 表面變乾就代表全部填料已完全排水並取得最終強度。
運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。
新放置細泥的自重部分由孔隙水承受，有效應力才與土骨架壓縮及強度形成相關。
optionsEn: A dry surface proves that the entire fill has drained and reached final strength.
The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit.
Pore water supports part of freshly placed sediment weight; effective stress governs skeleton loading, compression and strength development.
quiz.explanation: 新放置細泥的自重部分由孔隙水承受，有效應力才與土骨架壓縮及強度形成相關。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pore water supports part of freshly placed sediment weight; effective stress governs skeleton loading, compression and strength development. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 填料有效應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in placed sediment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「填料有效應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective stress in placed sediment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設某點總垂直應力50kPa、孔隙壓35kPa，有效應力σ′=σ−u=15kPa；若總應力不變而u降10kPa，σ′升至25kPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total vertical stress50kPa and pore pressure35kPa:σ′=15kPa. At fixed total stress, a10kPa pressure fall raisesσ′ to25kPa. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在同一高程與時刻比較孔壓和總荷載，檢查加載、潮位與排水的共同影響。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pore pressure and total loading at matching elevations and times, checking loading, tide and drainage together.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設某點總垂直應力50kPa、孔隙壓35kPa，有效應力σ′=σ−u=15kPa；若總應力不變而u降10kPa，σ′升至25kPa。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume total vertical stress50kPa and pore pressure35kPa:σ′=15kPa. At fixed total stress, a10kPa pressure fall raisesσ′ to25kPa.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「填料有效應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective stress in placed sediment", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。
放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse.
If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 填料有效應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective stress in placed sediment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「填料有效應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective stress in placed sediment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在同一高程與時刻比較孔壓和總荷載，檢查加載、潮位與排水的共同影響。以獨立土樣或現地試驗追蹤強度演進，明列有效應力與承載判斷之間仍缺的材料關係。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pore pressure and total loading at matching elevations and times, checking loading, tide and drainage together. Track strength with independent samples or field tests and state the constitutive relationships still needed between effective stress and a bearing assessment. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在同一高程與時刻比較孔壓和總荷載，檢查加載、潮位與排水的共同影響。以獨立土樣或現地試驗追蹤強度演進，明列有效應力與承載判斷之間仍缺的材料關係。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare pore pressure and total loading at matching elevations and times, checking loading, tide and drainage together. Track strength with independent samples or field tests and state the constitutive relationships still needed between effective stress and a bearing assessment.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：孔壓計零點漂移可能假造排水進展，忽略新增填土則錯判有效應力變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Piezometer drift can mimic drainage, while omitted new fill misstates effective-stress change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective stress in placed sediment"?
