quiz.question: 在「填料有效應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective stress in placed sediment" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。
孔壓計零點漂移可能假造排水進展，忽略新增填土則錯判有效應力變化。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit.
Piezometer drift can mimic drainage, while omitted new fill misstates effective-stress change.
quiz.explanation: 孔壓計零點漂移可能假造排水進展，忽略新增填土則錯判有效應力變化。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Piezometer drift can mimic drainage, while omitted new fill misstates effective-stress change. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「運輸碳量比較」與「對照監測與歸因」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transport emissions comparison" and "Control monitoring and attribution": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 運輸碳量比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transport emissions comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「運輸碳量比較」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transport emissions comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 有益利用可改變材料運距與新料需求，但環境比較必須採相同功能和系統邊界。運輸噸公里只是部分排放，處理、泵送、空車回程及未避免的新料也可能重要；合成係數只練習計量，不能把局部節省包裝成完整生命週期淨收益。 假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「運輸碳量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Reuse changes transport distance and demand for virgin material, but environmental comparisons require equivalent function and system boundaries. Tonne-kilometres describe only part of emissions; treatment, pumping, empty return trips and any unavoided supply also matter. A synthetic factor illustrates accounting rather than establishing complete life-cycle savings from a limited change in transport distance alone. Assume10000t moves20km instead of50km at0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km). Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transport emissions comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「運輸碳量比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transport emissions comparison”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 運輸碳量比較
knowledge.text: 有益利用可改變材料運距與新料需求，但環境比較必須採相同功能和系統邊界。運輸噸公里只是部分排放，處理、泵送、空車回程及未避免的新料也可能重要；合成係數只練習計量，不能把局部節省包裝成完整生命週期淨收益。
knowledge.textEn: Reuse changes transport distance and demand for virgin material, but environmental comparisons require equivalent function and system boundaries. Tonne-kilometres describe only part of emissions; treatment, pumping, empty return trips and any unavoided supply also matter.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「運輸碳量比較」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transport emissions comparison" is correct?
options: 有益利用可改變材料運距與新料需求，但環境比較必須採相同功能和系統邊界。
運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。
處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。
optionsEn: Reuse changes transport distance and demand for virgin material, but environmental comparisons require equivalent function and system boundaries.
The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit.
Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
quiz.explanation: 有益利用可改變材料運距與新料需求，但環境比較必須採相同功能和系統邊界。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Reuse changes transport distance and demand for virgin material, but environmental comparisons require equivalent function and system boundaries. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 運輸碳量比較：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transport emissions comparison: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「運輸碳量比較」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transport emissions comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume10000t moves20km instead of50km at0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km). Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume10000t moves20km instead of50km at0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km). Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「運輸碳量比較」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Transport emissions comparison", which statement holds?
options: 平均放置厚度達標就能證明每個位置的淹水條件都合適。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
潮位超過地面的時間比例直接等於植被的存活機率。
optionsEn: A satisfactory mean placement thickness proves suitable inundation at every location.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
The fraction of time tide exceeds ground directly equals plant survival probability.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 運輸碳量比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transport emissions comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「運輸碳量比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transport emissions comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。
knowledge.textEn: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。將處理、能耗和回程另列，對主要係數作敏感度比較，保留沒有證據可抵扣的項目。
knowledge.textEn: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. List treatment, energy and return trips separately, test important factors for sensitivity, and retain items without evidence for any claimed avoided burden.

quiz.question: 要驗證「運輸碳量比較」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transport emissions comparison"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
混合後平均濃度降低代表同百分比的污染物已被消除。
明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A lower average concentration after mixing means the same fraction of contaminant was destroyed.
State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance.
quiz.explanation: 明列兩方案是否提供同樣材料功能與時間需求，記錄噸位、路程和排放係數來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: State whether alternatives deliver equivalent function and timing and document mass, distance and emission-factor provenance. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 運輸碳量比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transport emissions comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「運輸碳量比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transport emissions comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。把並未真正減少的新料生產扣除，或忽略空船回程，都會放大報表上的環境好處。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy. Crediting virgin production that was not actually avoided, or ignoring an empty return voyage, further inflates the environmental benefit claimed for the reuse alternative. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設10000t材料運距由50降至20km、係數0.08kgCO₂e/(t·km)，運輸差額10000×30×0.08=24000kgCO₂e。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Transport difference is24000kgCO₂e, excluding treatment and return-trip changes.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「運距縮短的排放差額就是再利用方案完整的生命週期淨減碳。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The emissions saved by shorter transport equal the reuse project's complete life-cycle benefit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。把並未真正減少的新料生產扣除，或忽略空船回程，都會放大報表上的環境好處。
knowledge.textEn: Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy. Crediting virgin production that was not actually avoided, or ignoring an empty return voyage, further inflates the environmental benefit claimed for the reuse alternative.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「運輸碳量比較」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transport emissions comparison" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。
optionsEn: Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
quiz.explanation: 若再利用料需要額外長時間脫水，運輸減碳可能被處理能耗抵銷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Extended dewatering may offset transport savings through treatment energy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 對照監測與歸因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Control monitoring and attribution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「對照監測與歸因」如何影響疏浚泥沙有益利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Control monitoring and attribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Beneficial reuse of dredged sediment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 放置後植被或生物數量改變可能同時受季節、氣候與其他工程影響，單一前後差不能直接歸因。處理區與參照區的變化差提供較好的辨識起點，但仍依賴可比性和共同趨勢；多期及重複樣區可檢查這些假設，而不是以漂亮百分比宣布復育成功。 假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「對照監測與歸因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Post-placement ecological change can reflect season, climate or other works, so a simple before-after difference does not establish causation. Comparing changes in treatment and reference areas provides a stronger starting point but still requires comparability and parallel trends. Repeated periods and plots test those assumptions rather than allowing an attractive percentage to establish restoration success by itself. Assume treatment cover rises30%to50% and reference40%to50%. Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Control monitoring and attribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「對照監測與歸因」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Control monitoring and attribution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 對照監測與歸因
knowledge.text: 放置後植被或生物數量改變可能同時受季節、氣候與其他工程影響，單一前後差不能直接歸因。處理區與參照區的變化差提供較好的辨識起點，但仍依賴可比性和共同趨勢；多期及重複樣區可檢查這些假設，而不是以漂亮百分比宣布復育成功。
knowledge.textEn: Post-placement ecological change can reflect season, climate or other works, so a simple before-after difference does not establish causation. Comparing changes in treatment and reference areas provides a stronger starting point but still requires comparability and parallel trends.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「對照監測與歸因」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Control monitoring and attribution" is correct?
options: 處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。
放置後植被或生物數量改變可能同時受季節、氣候與其他工程影響，單一前後差不能直接歸因。
疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。
optionsEn: Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase.
Post-placement ecological change can reflect season, climate or other works, so a simple before-after difference does not establish causation.
Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse.
quiz.explanation: 放置後植被或生物數量改變可能同時受季節、氣候與其他工程影響，單一前後差不能直接歸因。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Post-placement ecological change can reflect season, climate or other works, so a simple before-after difference does not establish causation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 對照監測與歸因：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Control monitoring and attribution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「對照監測與歸因」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Control monitoring and attribution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume treatment cover rises30%to50% and reference40%to50%. Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume treatment cover rises30%to50% and reference40%to50%. Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「對照監測與歸因」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Control monitoring and attribution", which statement holds?
options: 放置材料乾固體沒有流失就代表地表高程不會再下降。
產品純度與原料回收率永遠具有相同分母而且相等。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: If placed dry solids are retained, surface elevation cannot subsequently decrease.
Product purity and feed recovery always share the same denominator and value.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 對照監測與歸因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Control monitoring and attribution: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「對照監測與歸因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Control monitoring and attribution” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。
knowledge.textEn: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。分開報告百分點、相對增幅及不確定度，追蹤物種組成與高程，避免只選有利單一指標。
knowledge.textEn: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Report percentage points, relative changes and uncertainty separately, tracking composition and elevation rather than selecting only a favorable single indicator.

quiz.question: 要驗證「對照監測與歸因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Control monitoring and attribution"?
options: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
覆蓋材料總方量足夠就能證明各處隔離厚度與化學功能足夠。
optionsEn: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Enough total cover volume proves adequate thickness and chemical isolation everywhere.
quiz.explanation: 保留相同季節與方法的重複樣區，檢查施工前處理與參照區是否有近似趨勢。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintain repeated plots surveyed with the same seasonal method and examine pre-treatment trends in both areas. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 對照監測與歸因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Control monitoring and attribution: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「對照監測與歸因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Control monitoring and attribution” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。總覆蓋增加可能來自非目標物種，不能自動解釋為恢復預期棲地。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement. Greater total cover may arise from nontarget species rather than recovery of the intended habitat function. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設處理區植被覆蓋30%升50%、參照區40%升50%，差中差=(50−30)−(50−40)=10百分點；不是因果已證實。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Difference-in-differences is10percentage points, not established causation without supporting assumptions.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「處理區施工後植被增加就足以證明增長完全由工程造成。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any vegetation increase after treatment proves that the project caused the entire increase." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。總覆蓋增加可能來自非目標物種，不能自動解釋為恢復預期棲地。
knowledge.textEn: A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement. Greater total cover may arise from nontarget species rather than recovery of the intended habitat function.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「對照監測與歸因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Control monitoring and attribution" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。
疏浚材料只要有預定去向就全部算成已驗證成功再利用。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement.
Every dredged batch with a planned destination already counts as verified successful reuse.
quiz.explanation: 參照區若同時受到放置濁羽影響便不是獨立比較，前後季節不同也會造成假改善。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A reference affected by the placement plume is not an independent comparison, and different survey seasons create apparent improvement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
courses.summary: 將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 將回填土水壓船舶作用與地基變形連成沉箱碼頭受力路徑
courses.focusEn: Trace caisson-quay load paths through backfill, water, vessels and foundation deformation
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。假設摩擦角由30增10%至33°，其他朗肯條件不變，Ka由0.3333降為0.2948，約減11.56%；不能推論整座碼頭風險同比下降。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure. Increasing friction angle10% from30°to33° under unchanged Rankine assumptions reduces Ka from0.3333 to0.2948, approximately11.56%, without an equivalent reduction in whole-quay risk. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設無限均布q=30kPa、Ka=1/3、牆高15m，增量側壓Ka q=10kPa、合力150kN/m；不代表局部輪載。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同底面兩側靜水深5與3m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，淨水平力γ(5²−3²)/2=80.442kN/m；不含滲流動態。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=3000kN、B=15m、e=1.5m，q=N/B(1±6e/B)，qmax=320kPa、qmin=80kPa，且e<B/6。

factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume infinite uniform surcharge30kPa,Ka=1/3 and wall height15m. Incremental pressure is10kPa and resultant150kN/m, not a local wheel-load model.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume hydrostatic depths5 and3m above one base and seawaterγ=10.05525kN/m³. Net horizontal force=80.442kN/m, excluding transient seepage.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「主動土壓假設」與「有效土壓積分」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Active earth-pressure assumptions" and "Effective earth-pressure integration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「主動土壓假設」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Active earth-pressure assumptions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。簡單朗肯係數假設水平無黏性回填與光滑直立牆，與靜止土壓不同；港區受限位移、分層或密實施工時，不能僅憑摩擦角選一個較小係數。 假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「主動土壓假設」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The simple Rankine coefficient assumes level cohesionless backfill and a smooth vertical wall, distinct from at-rest pressure. Restricted deformation, layering or compaction means friction angle alone cannot justify selecting the smaller coefficient for every quay-wall condition. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Active earth-pressure assumptions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「主動土壓假設」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Active earth-pressure assumptions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 主動土壓假設
knowledge.text: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。簡單朗肯係數假設水平無黏性回填與光滑直立牆，與靜止土壓不同；港區受限位移、分層或密實施工時，不能僅憑摩擦角選一個較小係數。
knowledge.textEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The simple Rankine coefficient assumes level cohesionless backfill and a smooth vertical wall, distinct from at-rest pressure.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「主動土壓假設」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Active earth-pressure assumptions" is correct?
options: 所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。
碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。
使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
optionsEn: Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement.
Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions.
Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 碼頭背填土會把側向作用傳入沉箱，但是否達到主動狀態取決於牆體位移及土體條件。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Backfill transfers lateral action into a caisson, but mobilizing an active state requires compatible wall movement and soil conditions. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「主動土壓假設」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume level cohesionless fill, a smooth vertical wall and mobilized active conditions. Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「主動土壓假設」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Active earth-pressure assumptions", which statement holds?
options: 回填內水位總是與外海潮位同步所以不必量測孔壓。
靠泊能量增加一倍就表示護舷峰值反力一定增加一倍。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Backfill water always follows the harbor tide exactly, making pore-pressure measurements unnecessary.
Doubling berthing energy necessarily doubles the fender's peak reaction force.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「主動土壓假設」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Active earth-pressure assumptions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。分開檢查施工壓密與服務期約束，用土樣與位移紀錄確認參數，不以單一公式取代狀態辨識。
knowledge.textEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Review compaction and service constraints separately and use soil and displacement records to justify parameters rather than substituting one formula for identification of the stress state.

quiz.question: 要驗證「主動土壓假設」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Active earth-pressure assumptions"?
options: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
optionsEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
quiz.explanation: 畫出背填坡面、牆背摩擦與可能位移方向，核對使用主動狀態是否有足夠變形依據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw backfill geometry, wall interface and possible movement, checking evidence for mobilizing the active state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 主動土壓假設：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Active earth-pressure assumptions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「主動土壓假設」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Active earth-pressure assumptions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。施工時壓密設備可能留下高於單純自重理論的壓力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Compaction equipment may also leave pressures greater than predicted by a simple self-weight active model. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水平無黏性回填、光滑直立牆且已達主動狀態，φ=30°，Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333；不適用靜止狀態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Atφ=30°,Ka=tan²(45°−φ/2)=0.3333, not at-rest pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。施工時壓密設備可能留下高於單純自重理論的壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Compaction equipment may also leave pressures greater than predicted by a simple self-weight active model.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「主動土壓假設」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Active earth-pressure assumptions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。
使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions.
Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
quiz.explanation: 剛性受限牆體未達主動位移卻採主動係數會低估側壓，黏性回填或坡面改變也使假設失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using active pressure for a restrained wall understates lateral action, and cohesive fill or altered slopes violate the assumptions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效土壓積分」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective earth-pressure integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。深度線性分布只涵蓋均質填料自重，分層和地面堆載另列；將孔壓漏掉或重複計入都會破壞沉箱整體平衡與作用點判讀。 假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效土壓積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. Integration with submerged unit weight gives effective soil action, not total lateral action. A linear distribution covers homogeneous self-weight only; layers and surcharges require separate terms. Omitting or double-counting water pressure corrupts both caisson equilibrium and interpretation of the resultant location along the wall. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective earth-pressure integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效土壓積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective earth-pressure integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效土壓積分
knowledge.text: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。深度線性分布只涵蓋均質填料自重，分層和地面堆載另列；將孔壓漏掉或重複計入都會破壞沉箱整體平衡與作用點判讀。
knowledge.textEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. Integration with submerged unit weight gives effective soil action, not total lateral action.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效土壓積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective earth-pressure integration" is correct?
options: 使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。
水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。
optionsEn: Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge.
Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure.
quiz.explanation: 水下回填的土骨架壓力與孔隙水壓必須分開，使用浮重度積分的是有效土壓而不是總側壓。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Effective skeleton pressure in submerged fill must be separated from pore pressure. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效土壓積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective earth-pressure integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume Ka=1/3,submerged unit weight10kN/m³ and H=15m. Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效土壓積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective earth-pressure integration", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。
護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory.
All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「有效土壓積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective earth-pressure integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。核對浮重度來源，將船舶、堆載及地震作用分開，避免相同水壓被不同表格重複加入。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verify submerged unit weight and keep vessel, surcharge and seismic terms separate so the same water action is not added twice in different tables.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective earth-pressure integration"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
逐層畫有效土壓和水壓圖，標明水位及每個三角形的作用點，積分後重建合力與力矩。
全碼頭平均沉陷不大即可保證起重機軌道不會扭曲。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment.
Small average quay settlement guarantees that crane rails cannot distort.

quiz.explanationEn: Plot effective-soil and water-pressure diagrams with levels and resultant locations, then reconstruct total force and moment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 有效土壓積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective earth-pressure integration: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效土壓積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective earth-pressure integration” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。合力數值碰巧相近時，錯誤作用點仍可能使傾覆力矩嚴重偏離。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Even coincidentally similar total forces can have incorrect resultant locations and materially wrong overturning moments. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設Ka=1/3、浮重度10kN/m³、高H=15m，Pa=Kaγ′H²/2=375kN/m，作用在底上5m；水壓另算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pa=375kN/m acts5m above base; pore-water pressure is separate.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。合力數值碰巧相近時，錯誤作用點仍可能使傾覆力矩嚴重偏離。
knowledge.textEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Even coincidentally similar total forces can have incorrect resultant locations and materially wrong overturning moments.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有效土壓積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective earth-pressure integration" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。
以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge.
Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water.
quiz.explanation: 以飽和重度積分後又加完整水壓可能高估作用，僅用浮重度卻不加水壓則低估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using saturated unit weight and then adding full water pressure can overcount action, while submerged weight alone omits water. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「碼頭堆載側壓」與「潮差與殘留水壓」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.title: 碼頭堆載側壓：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「碼頭堆載側壓」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Quay surcharge lateral action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 港區堆載的位置與範圍影響牆背側壓，無限均布面載只是簡化情境。貨櫃堆、起重機輪壓及條形基礎不能直接視為同一面載，局部作用可能沿牆長擴散；需要將工況、荷載路徑及土體假設相連，不能把一項平均值永久套用所有作業。 假設無限均布q=30kPa、Ka=1/3、牆高15m，增量側壓Ka q=10kPa、合力150kN/m；不代表局部輪載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「碼頭堆載側壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Position and extent of terminal loading govern lateral response, with an infinite uniform surcharge only one idealization. Container stacks, crane wheels and strip foundations are different actions and can spread differently along the wall. Load cases, transfer paths and soil assumptions must be connected rather than assigning one average surcharge permanently to every possible terminal operation. Assume infinite uniform surcharge30kPa,Ka=1/3 and wall height15m. Incremental pressure is10kPa and resultant150kN/m, not a local wheel-load model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Quay surcharge lateral action” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮差與殘留水壓」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal difference and retained water"?

Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.

steps.title: 潮差與殘留水壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal difference and retained water: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮差與殘留水壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal difference and retained water” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 排水堵塞會在外海退潮後保留較高側壓，僅取兩側各自最高水位又可能拼出不存在的工況。忽略時間相位，會錯估最不利水平作用及其持續時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked drains retain lateral pressure after the sea falls, while combining separate maximum levels can create a nonexistent load case. Ignoring phase misstates both the adverse horizontal action and how long it persists. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設同底面兩側靜水深5與3m、海水γ=10.05525kN/m³，淨水平力γ(5²−3²)/2=80.442kN/m；不含滲流動態。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Net horizontal force=80.442kN/m, excluding transient seepage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回填內水位總是與外海潮位同步所以不必量測孔壓。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Backfill water always follows the harbor tide exactly, making pore-pressure measurements unnecessary." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Blocked drains retain lateral pressure after the sea falls, while combining separate maximum levels can create a nonexistent load case. Ignoring phase misstates both the adverse horizontal action and how long it persists.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮差與殘留水壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal difference and retained water" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
排水堵塞會在外海退潮後保留較高側壓，僅取兩側各自最高水位又可能拼出不存在的工況。
基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Blocked drains retain lateral pressure after the sea falls, while combining separate maximum levels can create a nonexistent load case.
A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory.
quiz.explanation: 排水堵塞會在外海退潮後保留較高側壓，僅取兩側各自最高水位又可能拼出不存在的工況。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked drains retain lateral pressure after the sea falls, while combining separate maximum levels can create a nonexistent load case. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「基底偏心壓力」與「船舶靠泊動能」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Eccentric base pressure" and "Vessel berthing energy": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 基底偏心壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Eccentric base pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「基底偏心壓力」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric base pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉箱基底反力同時由法向力與力矩決定，平均壓力不足以描述邊緣需求。矩形線彈性全接觸公式還要求地基不出現拉力，若有缺口或基床不平需改變接觸模型；幾何壓力分布也只是作用需求，不能單獨證明現地地基的極限承載力足夠。 假設每米N=3000kN、B=15m、e=1.5m，q=N/B(1±6e/B)，qmax=320kPa、qmin=80kPa，且e<B/6。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「基底偏心壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Normal force and moment jointly determine base reaction, so average pressure misses edge demand. The rectangular linear full-contact formula requires nonnegative contact; gaps or uneven bedding change the model. This geometric pressure distribution describes demand only, not adequate foundation capacity, and must be paired with independent information about ground behavior and actual contact conditions. Assume per-metre N=3000kN,B=15m and e=1.5m. q=N/B(1±6e/B) gives320 and80kPa, with e<B/6. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric base pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「基底偏心壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Eccentric base pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 基底偏心壓力
knowledge.text: 沉箱基底反力同時由法向力與力矩決定，平均壓力不足以描述邊緣需求。矩形線彈性全接觸公式還要求地基不出現拉力，若有缺口或基床不平需改變接觸模型；幾何壓力分布也只是作用需求，不能單獨證明現地地基的極限承載力足夠。
knowledge.textEn: Normal force and moment jointly determine base reaction, so average pressure misses edge demand. The rectangular linear full-contact formula requires nonnegative contact; gaps or uneven bedding change the model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「基底偏心壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Eccentric base pressure" is correct?
options: 基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。
靠泊能量增加一倍就表示護舷峰值反力一定增加一倍。
沉箱基底反力同時由法向力與力矩決定，平均壓力不足以描述邊緣需求。
optionsEn: A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory.
Doubling berthing energy necessarily doubles the fender's peak reaction force.
Normal force and moment jointly determine base reaction, so average pressure misses edge demand.
quiz.explanation: 沉箱基底反力同時由法向力與力矩決定，平均壓力不足以描述邊緣需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Normal force and moment jointly determine base reaction, so average pressure misses edge demand. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 基底偏心壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Eccentric base pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「基底偏心壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Eccentric base pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=3000kN、B=15m、e=1.5m，q=N/B(1±6e/B)，qmax=320kPa、qmin=80kPa，且e<B/6。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=3000kN,B=15m and e=1.5m. q=N/B(1±6e/B) gives320 and80kPa, with e<B/6. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：標明法向力是否已扣除揚壓，核對力矩參考點與偏心正負號。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether normal force already excludes uplift and check moment reference and eccentricity signs.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米N=3000kN、B=15m、e=1.5m，q=N/B(1±6e/B)，qmax=320kPa、qmin=80kPa，且e<B/6。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume per-metre N=3000kN,B=15m and e=1.5m. q=N/B(1±6e/B) gives320 and80kPa, with e<B/6.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「基底偏心壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Eccentric base pressure", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 基底偏心壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Eccentric base pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「基底偏心壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Eccentric base pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 標明法向力是否已扣除揚壓，核對力矩參考點與偏心正負號。積分壓力圖回算原合力，再以基床平整、接觸與土體資料檢查全接觸假設，保留局部不適用區域。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether normal force already excludes uplift and check moment reference and eccentricity signs. Integrate the diagram back to the original resultant, then test full contact against bedding, interface and soil evidence, retaining locations where the assumption is unsupported. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Integrate the diagram back to the original resultant, then test full contact against bedding, interface and soil evidence, retaining locations where the assumption is unsupported.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基床局部空洞會集中實際壓力，公式仍畫出平順分布卻不代表真接觸。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A bedding void concentrates real pressure despite a smooth calculated diagram. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 船舶靠泊動能：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vessel berthing energy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 靠泊作用從船舶法向運動能量傳至護舷與碼頭，速度對能量有平方影響。有效質量和偏心等係數需明確定義，不能將排水量直接當任意工況的質量；能量需求也不同於峰值力，必須透過護舷特性及接觸路徑連接兩者。 假設已含附加質量的有效質量20000000kg、法向速0.10m/s、選定合成係數0.80，E=0.5Mv²C=80kJ。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「船舶靠泊動能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Normal vessel motion transfers energy to fenders and the quay, with velocity entering quadratically. Effective mass and correction factors need explicit definitions rather than treating displacement as the mass for every condition. Energy demand differs from peak force; the fender response and contact path connect them, so one kinetic-energy number cannot alone determine the resulting structural action. Assume effective mass20000000kg already includes added mass, normal speed0.10m/s and selected combined factor0.80. E=0.5Mv²C=80kJ, not an operating limit. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vessel berthing energy” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.check: 系統圖標明「船舶靠泊動能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.textEn: Normal vessel motion transfers energy to fenders and the quay, with velocity entering quadratically. Effective mass and correction factors need explicit definitions rather than treating displacement as the mass for every condition.

optionsEn: Normal vessel motion transfers energy to fenders and the quay, with velocity entering quadratically.
Doubling berthing energy necessarily doubles the fender's peak reaction force.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective mass20000000kg already includes added mass, normal speed0.10m/s and selected combined factor0.80. E=0.5Mv²C=80kJ, not an operating limit. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
