steps.title: 護舷曲線積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Integrating fender response: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「護舷曲線積分」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Integrating fender response” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 護舷吸能是力與變形曲線下面積，不是峰值力直接當能量，材料又可能受溫度、速度及老化影響。線性示意有三角形面積，但實際橡膠護舷曲線常非線性；卸載回彈與耗散也不同，不能把可恢復儲能全部稱為永久吸收。 假設護舷載入反力從0線性增至1000kN、壓縮0.30m，載入功W=Fmaxδ/2=150kJ；卸載耗散未給定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「護舷曲線積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fender work is the area under force versus displacement, not the numerical peak force. Temperature, loading rate and aging affect material response. A linear illustration gives triangular area, but real rubber curves are often nonlinear. Recoverable energy and dissipated energy also differ, so the complete loading work cannot automatically be labeled permanently absorbed impact energy. Assume reaction rises linearly from0 to1000kN over0.30m compression. Loading work is150kJ; unloading dissipation is not specified. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Integrating fender response” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「護舷曲線積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Integrating fender response”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 護舷曲線積分
knowledge.text: 護舷吸能是力與變形曲線下面積，不是峰值力直接當能量，材料又可能受溫度、速度及老化影響。線性示意有三角形面積，但實際橡膠護舷曲線常非線性；卸載回彈與耗散也不同，不能把可恢復儲能全部稱為永久吸收。
knowledge.textEn: Fender work is the area under force versus displacement, not the numerical peak force. Temperature, loading rate and aging affect material response.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「護舷曲線積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Integrating fender response" is correct?
options: 護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。
護舷吸能是力與變形曲線下面積，不是峰值力直接當能量，材料又可能受溫度、速度及老化影響。
加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
optionsEn: All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy.
Fender work is the area under force versus displacement, not the numerical peak force.
Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
quiz.explanation: 護舷吸能是力與變形曲線下面積，不是峰值力直接當能量，材料又可能受溫度、速度及老化影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Fender work is the area under force versus displacement, not the numerical peak force. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 護舷曲線積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Integrating fender response: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「護舷曲線積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Integrating fender response” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設護舷載入反力從0線性增至1000kN、壓縮0.30m，載入功W=Fmaxδ/2=150kJ；卸載耗散未給定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction rises linearly from0 to1000kN over0.30m compression. Loading work is150kJ; unloading dissipation is not specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設護舷載入反力從0線性增至1000kN、壓縮0.30m，載入功W=Fmaxδ/2=150kJ；卸載耗散未給定。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume reaction rises linearly from0 to1000kN over0.30m compression. Loading work is150kJ; unloading dissipation is not specified.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「護舷曲線積分」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Integrating fender response", which statement holds?
options: 止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。
使用浮重度算出的有效土壓已經包含全部靜水壓力。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head.
Effective earth pressure calculated with submerged unit weight already includes all hydrostatic pressure.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 護舷曲線積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Integrating fender response: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「護舷曲線積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Integrating fender response” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。將峰值反力另傳到錨栓和沉箱模型，核對接觸面積與多護舷分擔，避免用吸能值取代力路徑。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units. Transfer peak reaction separately to anchors and caisson, checking contact area and sharing among fenders rather than replacing the force path with an energy rating. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。將峰值反力另傳到錨栓和沉箱模型，核對接觸面積與多護舷分擔，避免用吸能值取代力路徑。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units. Transfer peak reaction separately to anchors and caisson, checking contact area and sharing among fenders rather than replacing the force path with an energy rating.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：護舷變硬可能在相同位移產生較大峰力，老化裂損也可能改變回彈。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A stiffer fender produces higher reaction at the same displacement, while aging cracks alter recovery. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。將峰值反力另傳到錨栓和沉箱模型，核對接觸面積與多護舷分擔，避免用吸能值取代力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units. Transfer peak reaction separately to anchors and caisson, checking contact area and sharing among fenders rather than replacing the force path with an energy rating.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。將峰值反力另傳到錨栓和沉箱模型，核對接觸面積與多護舷分擔，避免用吸能值取代力路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units. Transfer peak reaction separately to anchors and caisson, checking contact area and sharing among fenders rather than replacing the force path with an energy rating.

quiz.question: 要驗證「護舷曲線積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Integrating fender response"?
options: 取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
回填內水位總是與外海潮位同步所以不必量測孔壓。
optionsEn: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Backfill water always follows the harbor tide exactly, making pore-pressure measurements unnecessary.
quiz.explanation: 取得適用溫度與速度下的力變形曲線，積分載入和卸載並檢查量測單位。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Obtain response curves for applicable temperature and rate, integrating loading and unloading with consistent units. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 護舷曲線積分：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Integrating fender response: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「護舷曲線積分」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Integrating fender response” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 護舷變硬可能在相同位移產生較大峰力，老化裂損也可能改變回彈。若只核對標稱吸能而忽略反力曲線，碼頭局部構件可能承受未被納入的需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A stiffer fender produces higher reaction at the same displacement, while aging cracks alter recovery. Checking nominal energy alone and ignoring the reaction curve can leave local quay components exposed to unexamined structural demands. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設護舷載入反力從0線性增至1000kN、壓縮0.30m，載入功W=Fmaxδ/2=150kJ；卸載耗散未給定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loading work is150kJ; unloading dissipation is not specified.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 護舷變硬可能在相同位移產生較大峰力，老化裂損也可能改變回彈。若只核對標稱吸能而忽略反力曲線，碼頭局部構件可能承受未被納入的需求。
knowledge.textEn: A stiffer fender produces higher reaction at the same displacement, while aging cracks alter recovery. Checking nominal energy alone and ignoring the reaction curve can leave local quay components exposed to unexamined structural demands.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「護舷曲線積分」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Integrating fender response" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
護舷變硬可能在相同位移產生較大峰力，老化裂損也可能改變回彈。
加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
A stiffer fender produces higher reaction at the same displacement, while aging cracks alter recovery.
Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
quiz.explanation: 護舷變硬可能在相同位移產生較大峰力，老化裂損也可能改變回彈。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A stiffer fender produces higher reaction at the same displacement, while aging cracks alter recovery. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 簡化地震慣性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Simplified seismic inertia: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「簡化地震慣性」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Simplified seismic inertia” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沉箱質量在地震中產生慣性作用，但實際反應還包括土水互制、接觸非線性及背填地震土壓。等效靜力示意只能追蹤一個質量的慣性量級，不可被當成完整地震設計；加速度係數必須說明用途，不能直接拿地表峰值代替所有構件反應。 假設每米參與質量300000kg、指定水平加速度0.20g，F=ma=588.6kN/m；僅此質量慣性，不含動水與土壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「簡化地震慣性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Caisson mass produces seismic inertia, but actual response includes soil-water interaction, nonlinear contact and dynamic backfill action. An equivalent-static illustration tracks one mass contribution only, not complete seismic design. The acceleration coefficient needs an explicit purpose rather than substituting peak ground acceleration directly for the response of every structural component and interacting material domain. Assume participating mass300000kg per metre and selected horizontal acceleration0.20g. F=ma=588.6kN/m includes only this mass inertia, not dynamic soil or water action. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Simplified seismic inertia” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「簡化地震慣性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Simplified seismic inertia”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 簡化地震慣性
knowledge.text: 沉箱質量在地震中產生慣性作用，但實際反應還包括土水互制、接觸非線性及背填地震土壓。等效靜力示意只能追蹤一個質量的慣性量級，不可被當成完整地震設計；加速度係數必須說明用途，不能直接拿地表峰值代替所有構件反應。
knowledge.textEn: Caisson mass produces seismic inertia, but actual response includes soil-water interaction, nonlinear contact and dynamic backfill action. An equivalent-static illustration tracks one mass contribution only, not complete seismic design.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「簡化地震慣性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Simplified seismic inertia" is correct?
options: 加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。
全碼頭平均沉陷不大即可保證起重機軌道不會扭曲。
沉箱質量在地震中產生慣性作用，但實際反應還包括土水互制、接觸非線性及背填地震土壓。
optionsEn: Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand.
Small average quay settlement guarantees that crane rails cannot distort.
Caisson mass produces seismic inertia, but actual response includes soil-water interaction, nonlinear contact and dynamic backfill action.

quiz.explanationEn: Caisson mass produces seismic inertia, but actual response includes soil-water interaction, nonlinear contact and dynamic backfill action. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 簡化地震慣性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Simplified seismic inertia: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「簡化地震慣性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Simplified seismic inertia” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設每米參與質量300000kg、指定水平加速度0.20g，F=ma=588.6kN/m；僅此質量慣性，不含動水與土壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume participating mass300000kg per metre and selected horizontal acceleration0.20g. F=ma=588.6kN/m includes only this mass inertia, not dynamic soil or water action. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在自由體圖標出參與質量與施力位置，說明加速度是合成分析輸入而非現地建議值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark participating mass and force location on the free-body diagram and identify acceleration as a synthetic input.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「簡化地震慣性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。
全場平均堆載可以直接代表貼近岸壁的所有局部輪壓。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement.
The terminal-average surcharge directly represents every concentrated wheel load near the quay edge.

steps.title: 簡化地震慣性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Simplified seismic inertia: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「簡化地震慣性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instructionEn: Mark participating mass and force location on the free-body diagram and identify acceleration as a synthetic input. List water, foundation and backfill dynamics separately, checking phases and combination assumptions instead of arbitrarily adding unrelated peak values into one load case. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在自由體圖標出參與質量與施力位置，說明加速度是合成分析輸入而非現地建議值。另列動水、地基與背填作用，核對相位與組合方式，不將各自峰值任意相加。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark participating mass and force location on the free-body diagram and identify acceleration as a synthetic input. List water, foundation and backfill dynamics separately, checking phases and combination assumptions instead of arbitrarily adding unrelated peak values into one load case.

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「簡化地震慣性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Simplified seismic inertia"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
在自由體圖標出參與質量與施力位置，說明加速度是合成分析輸入而非現地建議值。
基底平均壓力不大就足以證明邊緣接觸與承載都沒有問題。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Mark participating mass and force location on the free-body diagram and identify acceleration as a synthetic input.
A modest mean base pressure proves that edge contact and foundation capacity are satisfactory.
quiz.explanation: 在自由體圖標出參與質量與施力位置，說明加速度是合成分析輸入而非現地建議值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Mark participating mass and force location on the free-body diagram and identify acceleration as a synthetic input. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 簡化地震慣性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Simplified seismic inertia: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「簡化地震慣性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Simplified seismic inertia” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只增加沉箱重量可能同時增加慣性需求，不能只看到抗滑增益。把土水作用漏掉或重複放入參與質量，都可能令整體地震反應和接觸壓力判讀失真。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Adding caisson weight can increase inertia as well as sliding resistance. Omitting soil-water action or counting it twice within participating mass can distort the interpreted overall seismic response and the associated distribution of contact pressure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設每米參與質量300000kg、指定水平加速度0.20g，F=ma=588.6kN/m；僅此質量慣性，不含動水與土壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: F=ma=588.6kN/m includes only this mass inertia, not dynamic soil or water action.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「加重沉箱只增加抵抗力而不會增加任何地震慣性需求。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Increasing caisson mass raises resistance without increasing any seismic inertia demand." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只增加沉箱重量可能同時增加慣性需求，不能只看到抗滑增益。把土水作用漏掉或重複放入參與質量，都可能令整體地震反應和接觸壓力判讀失真。
knowledge.textEn: Adding caisson weight can increase inertia as well as sliding resistance. Omitting soil-water action or counting it twice within participating mass can distort the interpreted overall seismic response and the associated distribution of contact pressure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「簡化地震慣性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Simplified seismic inertia" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
全碼頭平均沉陷不大即可保證起重機軌道不會扭曲。
只增加沉箱重量可能同時增加慣性需求，不能只看到抗滑增益。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small average quay settlement guarantees that crane rails cannot distort.
Adding caisson weight can increase inertia as well as sliding resistance.
quiz.explanation: 只增加沉箱重量可能同時增加慣性需求，不能只看到抗滑增益。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Adding caisson weight can increase inertia as well as sliding resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「地基壓縮與軌道」與「接縫位移與止水」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。

steps.instructionEn: Foundation settlement changes quay and crane-rail elevations, while uniform layer compression gives only one contribution. Effective stress increment, thickness and constrained modulus must refer to compatible drainage conditions; layering and delayed consolidation add other effects. Serviceability is often controlled by differential movement, so an average settlement alone cannot establish the geometry required by the operational equipment. Assume uniform layer5m,effective stress increment100kPa and constrained modulus10000kPa. One-dimensional s=Δσ′H/M=0.050m, not a complete site prediction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Foundation compression and rails” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「地基壓縮與軌道」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 在剖面標出受壓層與排水邊界，用試驗說明模數對應應力範圍，核對是否適用線性近似。沿岸壁和軌道佈設共同基準觀測，分解整體沉陷與差異變形並記錄時間歷程。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Identify compressible layers and drainage boundaries, justifying modulus over the relevant stress range and checking linearity. Observe wall and rails against a common datum, separating overall settlement from differential deformation and retaining their evolution through time rather than only final readings. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：同一平均沉陷可能對應完全不同的軌道扭曲，地層厚度沿岸改變會放大局部差異。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Identical mean settlement can accompany very different rail distortion, and varying layer thickness amplifies local differences. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 地基壓縮與軌道：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Foundation compression and rails: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「地基壓縮與軌道」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Foundation compression and rails” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同一平均沉陷可能對應完全不同的軌道扭曲，地層厚度沿岸改變會放大局部差異。把短期量測當最終值，又可能漏掉仍在發展的排水固結。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Identical mean settlement can accompany very different rail distortion, and varying layer thickness amplifies local differences. Treating short-term observations as final movement can also miss consolidation still progressing as excess pore pressure dissipates. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設均勻層H=5m、有效應力增量100kPa、拘束模數M=10000kPa，一維s=Δσ′H/M=0.050m；非完整場址預測。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One-dimensional s=Δσ′H/M=0.050m, not a complete site prediction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「全碼頭平均沉陷不大即可保證起重機軌道不會扭曲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small average quay settlement guarantees that crane rails cannot distort." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「地基壓縮與軌道」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head.

quiz.explanationEn: Identical mean settlement can accompany very different rail distortion, and varying layer thickness amplifies local differences. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 接縫位移與止水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint movement and sealing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接縫位移與止水」如何影響大型港口沉箱碼頭的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint movement and sealing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Large-port caisson quay walls”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相鄰沉箱接縫需要容納溫度、沉陷及水平變位，名義縫寬並不直接代表止水材料可用變形。軸向伸長應變只是幾何量，材料壓縮、剪切和黏結還要靠適用試驗；水密功能亦受水頭和缺陷控制，不能將應變計算當成漏水性能預測。 假設止水材料有效標距500mm、單軸伸長15mm，工程應變ε=15/500=0.030即3%；不含剪切或水密評估。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接縫位移與止水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joints between caissons accommodate temperature, settlement and horizontal movement, but nominal gap width is not the permissible movement of a seal. Axial strain is geometric; compression, shear and adhesion require relevant material tests. Watertightness also depends on head and defects, so a strain calculation cannot predict leakage performance or qualify a joint for all displacement combinations. Assume effective seal gauge length500mm and uniaxial extension15mm. Engineering strainε=0.030=3%, excluding shear and watertightness evaluation. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint movement and sealing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接縫位移與止水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint movement and sealing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Joints between caissons accommodate temperature, settlement and horizontal movement, but nominal gap width is not the permissible movement of a seal. Axial strain is geometric; compression, shear and adhesion require relevant material tests.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接縫位移與止水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint movement and sealing" is correct?
options: 止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。
相鄰沉箱接縫需要容納溫度、沉陷及水平變位，名義縫寬並不直接代表止水材料可用變形。
所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。
optionsEn: Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head.
Joints between caissons accommodate temperature, settlement and horizontal movement, but nominal gap width is not the permissible movement of a seal.
Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement.
quiz.explanation: 相鄰沉箱接縫需要容納溫度、沉陷及水平變位，名義縫寬並不直接代表止水材料可用變形。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Joints between caissons accommodate temperature, settlement and horizontal movement, but nominal gap width is not the permissible movement of a seal. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接縫位移與止水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint movement and sealing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接縫位移與止水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint movement and sealing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設止水材料有效標距500mm、單軸伸長15mm，工程應變ε=15/500=0.030即3%；不含剪切或水密評估。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective seal gauge length500mm and uniaxial extension15mm. Engineering strainε=0.030=3%, excluding shear and watertightness evaluation. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：標定止水有效變形段而非任意表面長度，同步量接縫開口、剪切及相對轉角。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Identify the actual deforming gauge length and measure opening, shear and relative rotation together. Compare the observed movement path with material test envelopes, recording head and leakage location and retaining combinations that the uniaxial illustration does not represent.

quiz.question: 要驗證「接縫位移與止水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Joint movement and sealing"?
options: 標定止水有效變形段而非任意表面長度，同步量接縫開口、剪切及相對轉角。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
護舷載入曲線下面積全部等於不可恢復的永久耗散能量。
optionsEn: Identify the actual deforming gauge length and measure opening, shear and relative rotation together.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
All work under the fender loading curve is irreversibly dissipated energy.
quiz.explanation: 標定止水有效變形段而非任意表面長度，同步量接縫開口、剪切及相對轉角。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Identify the actual deforming gauge length and measure opening, shear and relative rotation together. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 接縫位移與止水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint movement and sealing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接縫位移與止水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint movement and sealing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把整條埋入長度當成有效標距會低估局部應變，界面脫黏又可能在材料仍完整時形成水路。只有外觀縫寬資料，無法辨識隱藏的剪切和背面滲漏。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the entire embedded length as deforming gauge length understates local strain, while debonding creates a water path even with intact material. Visible gap width alone cannot identify hidden shear or leakage behind the joint. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設止水材料有效標距500mm、單軸伸長15mm，工程應變ε=15/500=0.030即3%；不含剪切或水密評估。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Engineering strainε=0.030=3%, excluding shear and watertightness evaluation.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「止水材料幾何應變不大就能證明所有水頭下都完全不漏水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small geometric seal strain proves complete watertightness under every water head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把整條埋入長度當成有效標距會低估局部應變，界面脫黏又可能在材料仍完整時形成水路。只有外觀縫寬資料，無法辨識隱藏的剪切和背面滲漏。
knowledge.textEn: Using the entire embedded length as deforming gauge length understates local strain, while debonding creates a water path even with intact material. Visible gap width alone cannot identify hidden shear or leakage behind the joint.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「接縫位移與止水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Joint movement and sealing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把整條埋入長度當成有效標距會低估局部應變，界面脫黏又可能在材料仍完整時形成水路。
所有碼頭背填土都不需牆體變形就會自動達到主動土壓。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Using the entire embedded length as deforming gauge length understates local strain, while debonding creates a water path even with intact material.
Every quay backfill automatically reaches active pressure without any wall movement.
quiz.explanation: 把整條埋入長度當成有效標距會低估局部應變，界面脫黏又可能在材料仍完整時形成水路。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using the entire embedded length as deforming gauge length understates local strain, while debonding creates a water path even with intact material. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基
courses.summary: 由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 由海床調查到樁群變形與耐久追蹤棧橋碼頭荷載
courses.focusEn: Trace pile-supported pier loads from seabed investigation to group deformation and durability
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。假設外徑1m增10%至1.1m、壁厚固定20mm且軸力固定，面積由0.061575增至0.067858m²，平均應力由32.48降至29.47MPa；未代表地工承載同步增加。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling. Increasing outer diameter10% from1to1.1m at fixed20mm thickness and load raises area from0.061575 to0.067858m² and lowers mean stress from32.48 to29.47MPa, without an equivalent geotechnical capacity claim. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設4支等剛度樁、兩支x=+3m兩支−3m，P=12000kN、M=12000kN·m，Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx²，得4000與2000kN。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume four equal-stiffness piles, two each at x=±3m,P=12000kN,M=12000kN·m. Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx² gives4000 and2000kN.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform P=2MN,L=30m,E=200GPa,A=0.060m². Elastic shorteningδ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm, excluding ground settlement.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「鋼管截面與軸應力」與「樁端面積與土阻」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Steel-pipe section and axial stress" and "Toe area and soil resistance": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Steel-pipe section and axial stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「鋼管截面與軸應力」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海上鋼管樁的空心截面不能用外包圓面積計材料應力，內外徑與腐蝕減薄都會改變承載面。平均軸應力只是彈性需求，局部屈曲、焊接細節和彎矩需另行處理；打設與服務狀態的作用也不同，不能以一個低平均值證明所有階段可靠。 假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鋼管截面與軸應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A hollow steel pile requires annular material area rather than its outer circular footprint. Diameters and corrosion loss change that area. Mean axial stress is an elastic demand only; local buckling, weld details and bending remain separate. Installation and service actions also differ, so one low average stress cannot demonstrate reliability throughout every stage of the pile's use. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「鋼管截面與軸應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Steel-pipe section and axial stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力
knowledge.text: 海上鋼管樁的空心截面不能用外包圓面積計材料應力，內外徑與腐蝕減薄都會改變承載面。平均軸應力只是彈性需求，局部屈曲、焊接細節和彎矩需另行處理；打設與服務狀態的作用也不同，不能以一個低平均值證明所有階段可靠。
knowledge.textEn: A hollow steel pile requires annular material area rather than its outer circular footprint. Diameters and corrosion loss change that area.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「鋼管截面與軸應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Steel-pipe section and axial stress" is correct?
options: 空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。
海上鋼管樁的空心截面不能用外包圓面積計材料應力，內外徑與腐蝕減薄都會改變承載面。
開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。
optionsEn: The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint.
A hollow steel pile requires annular material area rather than its outer circular footprint.
Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging.
quiz.explanation: 海上鋼管樁的空心截面不能用外包圓面積計材料應力，內外徑與腐蝕減薄都會改變承載面。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A hollow steel pile requires annular material area rather than its outer circular footprint. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Steel-pipe section and axial stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「鋼管截面與軸應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check actual thickness and diameters in several directions for ovality and local loss, retaining weld locations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume outer diameter1m and inner0.96m. Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「鋼管截面與軸應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Steel-pipe section and axial stress", which statement holds?

optionsEn: Equal pile count means every pile carries identical axial force under any eccentric loading.
The seabed mudline can always be treated as a perfectly fixed pile support.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Steel-pipe section and axial stress: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「鋼管截面與軸應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。將軸力、彎矩與施工動載分開列示，確認材料截面和土端阻用的承壓面積沒有混用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check actual thickness and diameters in several directions for ovality and local loss, retaining weld locations. List axial, bending and installation actions separately and confirm that steel material area is not confused with the area used for geotechnical toe resistance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。將軸力、彎矩與施工動載分開列示，確認材料截面和土端阻用的承壓面積沒有混用。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check actual thickness and diameters in several directions for ovality and local loss, retaining weld locations. List axial, bending and installation actions separately and confirm that steel material area is not confused with the area used for geotechnical toe resistance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「鋼管截面與軸應力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Steel-pipe section and axial stress"?
options: 核對實際壁厚與內外徑，量測多方向以辨識橢圓度和局部減薄，保留焊縫位置。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

steps.title: 鋼管截面與軸應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Steel-pipe section and axial stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「鋼管截面與軸應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Steel-pipe section and axial stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。材料仍未屈服時，細薄區已可能因局部穩定問題控制反應。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting. A thin damaged region can govern local stability even when the average material stress remains below a nominal yield level. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設外徑1m、內徑0.96m，A=π(Do²−Di²)/4=0.061575m²；軸力2000kN時平均σ=32.48MPa。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Annular A=0.061575m²; axial load2000kN gives mean stress32.48MPa, excluding bending and buckling.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。材料仍未屈服時，細薄區已可能因局部穩定問題控制反應。
knowledge.textEn: Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting. A thin damaged region can govern local stability even when the average material stress remains below a nominal yield level.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「鋼管截面與軸應力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Steel-pipe section and axial stress" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。
開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting.
Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging.
quiz.explanation: 用外包面積除軸力會大幅低估空心鋼管應力，平均壁厚又可能掩蓋局部凹蝕。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Dividing by outer footprint grossly understates hollow-pile stress, while average thickness hides local pitting. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 樁端面積與土阻：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Toe area and soil resistance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樁端面積與土阻」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Toe area and soil resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樁端土阻與材料截面不同，封閉端和開口管樁是否形成土塞會影響有效承壓面積。端阻單位值必須來自場址證據和相應變位，不是可任意套用的材料強度；計算名義端阻仍須考慮打設擾動、持力層厚度與下伏弱層。 假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁端面積與土阻」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Geotechnical toe area differs from steel area, and open-ended plugging determines whether an outer footprint is mobilized. Unit resistance requires site evidence at compatible displacement rather than a freely selected material strength. Even nominal toe resistance needs review of installation disturbance, bearing-layer thickness and weaker layers below, none of which is resolved by area multiplication alone. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Toe area and soil resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁端面積與土阻」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Toe area and soil resistance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樁端面積與土阻
knowledge.text: 樁端土阻與材料截面不同，封閉端和開口管樁是否形成土塞會影響有效承壓面積。端阻單位值必須來自場址證據和相應變位，不是可任意套用的材料強度；計算名義端阻仍須考慮打設擾動、持力層厚度與下伏弱層。
knowledge.textEn: Geotechnical toe area differs from steel area, and open-ended plugging determines whether an outer footprint is mobilized. Unit resistance requires site evidence at compatible displacement rather than a freely selected material strength.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樁端面積與土阻」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Toe area and soil resistance" is correct?
options: 開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。
樁側所有摩擦力都必定向上提供抵抗而不會增加軸力。
樁端土阻與材料截面不同，封閉端和開口管樁是否形成土塞會影響有效承壓面積。
optionsEn: Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging.
Every shaft-friction force necessarily acts upward and can never increase pile compression.
Geotechnical toe area differs from steel area, and open-ended plugging determines whether an outer footprint is mobilized.
quiz.explanation: 樁端土阻與材料截面不同，封閉端和開口管樁是否形成土塞會影響有效承壓面積。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Geotechnical toe area differs from steel area, and open-ended plugging determines whether an outer footprint is mobilized. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樁端面積與土阻：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Toe area and soil resistance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樁端面積與土阻」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Toe area and soil resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在地質剖面標出樁端與持力層厚度，說明端部封閉或土塞證據，核對單位端阻對應的位移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark toe depth and bearing-layer thickness, documenting closure or plugging and the displacement associated with unit resistance.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume a closed circular toe1m in diameter with uniform qb=5MPa. Qb=3927.0kN; this footprint is not assumed for an unverified open-pile plug.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樁端面積與土阻」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Toe area and soil resistance", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
樁頂沉陷完全來自土壤所以樁身彈性縮短永遠可以忽略。
沖刷只影響外觀而不會改變樁基水平剛度和彎矩需求。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Pile-head settlement comes entirely from soil, so elastic pile shortening can always be ignored.
Scour affects appearance only and cannot change lateral pile stiffness or bending demand.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.instruction: 未形成土塞卻採完整圓面積會高估端阻，薄硬層下有軟層也可能發生穿透。施工紀錄只達到預定深度，不能單獨證明樁端已取得假設的力學行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using full footprint without a developed plug overstates resistance, and a thin hard layer over soft ground may punch through. Reaching a specified depth during installation alone does not establish the assumed toe behavior or load-transfer mechanism. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設封閉圓端D=1m且均勻端阻qb=5MPa，Qb=qbπD²/4=3927.0kN；不直接用於未證實土塞的開口樁。

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 樁側阻力積分：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「樁側阻力積分」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Integrating shaft resistance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樁側剪力沿土層分布，平均值乘周長和長度只適合所定義區段。土體位移相對樁體的方向決定正側阻或負摩擦，不能把所有剪力都列為抵抗；側阻與端阻動員位移也不同，直接加總極值未必符合相同變形狀態。 假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁側阻力積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Shaft shear varies by soil layer, and mean resistance times perimeter and length applies only to a defined segment. Relative soil-pile movement determines positive resistance or downdrag, so not all shear is beneficial. Shaft and toe resistance mobilize at different displacements, meaning their individual maxima may not coexist in a compatible overall load-transfer state for the pile. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Integrating shaft resistance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「樁側所有摩擦力都必定向上提供抵抗而不會增加軸力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every shaft-friction force necessarily acts upward and can never increase pile compression." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樁側阻力積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

optionsEn: Shaft shear varies by soil layer, and mean resistance times perimeter and length applies only to a defined segment.
Every shaft-friction force necessarily acts upward and can never increase pile compression.
Equal pile count means every pile carries identical axial force under any eccentric loading.

steps.title: 樁側阻力積分：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Integrating shaft resistance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設D=1m、有效段長20m、均勻正側阻τ=50kPa，Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN；不含負摩擦或端阻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume diameter1m,effective length20m and uniform positive shaft shear50kPa. Qs=πτDL=3141.6kN, excluding downdrag and toe resistance. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按地層分段列出周長、長度與剪力方向，核對地下水及回填沉陷對相對位移的影響。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Eccentric pile-group distribution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 剛性承台在等軸向剛度假設下可用線性分配追蹤軸力與力矩，但土層差異、斜樁及承台柔性會改變分擔。各樁反力需要同時滿足總力及總矩，並檢查是否有拉拔；群樁效率和地盤整體破壞不能由單樁算式直接保證。 假設4支等剛度樁、兩支x=+3m兩支−3m，P=12000kN、M=12000kN·m，Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx²，得4000與2000kN。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁群偏心分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A rigid cap over equal axial stiffnesses permits linear sharing of force and moment. Different soils, battered piles and cap flexibility alter that distribution. Reactions must satisfy both total force and moment and be checked for uplift. Neither group efficiency nor overall ground failure is established by a single-pile resistance equation or a convenient equal-load assumption alone. Assume four equal-stiffness piles, two each at x=±3m,P=12000kN,M=12000kN·m. Ni=P/4+Mxi/Σx² gives4000 and2000kN. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric pile-group distribution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 樁身彈性縮短：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Elastic pile shortening: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樁身彈性縮短」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Elastic pile shortening” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 長樁在受壓時材料本身會縮短，樁頂沉陷因此不全來自地基。均勻軸力模型只適用一段不沿程卸載的杆件，實際樁因側阻傳力而軸力隨深度改變，應分段積分；混凝土齡期、徐變與鋼材截面損失也可能影響有效軸向剛度。 假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樁身彈性縮短」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.title: 樁身彈性縮短：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樁身彈性縮短」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Elastic pile shortening” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設均勻P=2MN、L=30m、E=200GPa、A=0.060m²，δ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm；未含土體沉陷。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume uniform P=2MN,L=30m,E=200GPa,A=0.060m². Elastic shorteningδ=PL/(EA)=0.005m=5mm, excluding ground settlement. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：從傳力量測建立沿深度軸力分布，用分段EA計算材料縮短，核對儀器標距和溫度。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build the depthwise force profile from load-transfer evidence and integrate shortening with segmented EA, checking gauge length and temperature.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 樁身彈性縮短：試驗與驗證

steps.instruction: 從傳力量測建立沿深度軸力分布，用分段EA計算材料縮短，核對儀器標距和溫度。再把樁頂與樁端位移比較，分開材料壓縮和地盤反應，避免用單一頂部位移反推全部端阻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build the depthwise force profile from load-transfer evidence and integrate shortening with segmented EA, checking gauge length and temperature. Compare head and toe movements to separate material compression from ground response rather than inferring all toe behavior from one head displacement. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：從傳力量測建立沿深度軸力分布，用分段EA計算材料縮短，核對儀器標距和溫度。再把樁頂與樁端位移比較，分開材料壓縮和地盤反應，避免用單一頂部位移反推全部端阻。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build the depthwise force profile from load-transfer evidence and integrate shortening with segmented EA, checking gauge length and temperature. Compare head and toe movements to separate material compression from ground response rather than inferring all toe behavior from one head displacement.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：將樁頂全部位移當成土體沉陷會低估地基剛度，反之忽略土體位移則高估樁身壓縮。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Assigning all head movement to soil understates ground stiffness, while omitting ground movement overstates material compression. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.instruction: 將樁頂全部位移當成土體沉陷會低估地基剛度，反之忽略土體位移則高估樁身壓縮。側阻傳遞很強時，以頂部最大軸力套全長會過度預測縮短。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

quiz.explanationEn: Lateral pile response combines the exposed segment with support from embedded soil. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 側向彎曲基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Lateral bending baseline: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「側向彎曲基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral bending baseline” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「側向彎曲基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Lateral bending baseline", which statement holds?
options: 剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
空心鋼管樁的材料受壓面積就是整個外徑圓面積。
optionsEn: The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
The steel material area of a hollow pile equals its entire outer circular footprint.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 側向彎曲基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Lateral bending baseline: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「側向彎曲基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral bending baseline” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。比較含土彈簧與懸臂基準的差異，另檢查循環荷載和群樁效應，不將示意固定端當成現地邊界。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations. Compare soil-supported and cantilever responses, reviewing cyclic and group effects separately rather than treating the illustrative clamp as an established site boundary. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。比較含土彈簧與懸臂基準的差異，另檢查循環荷載和群樁效應，不將示意固定端當成現地邊界。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations. Compare soil-supported and cantilever responses, reviewing cyclic and group effects separately rather than treating the illustrative clamp as an established site boundary.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「側向彎曲基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Lateral bending baseline"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
樁側所有摩擦力都必定向上提供抵抗而不會增加軸力。
標出固定端是假設位置並核對露出長度，用位移及應變量測檢查彎曲形狀。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
Every shaft-friction force necessarily acts upward and can never increase pile compression.
Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations.
