quiz.explanationEn: Mark the assumed fixed point and exposed length and check bending shape against displacement and strain observations. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 側向彎曲基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Lateral bending baseline: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「側向彎曲基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Lateral bending baseline” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。樁頭接合轉動也會改變彎矩分布，不能只核對一個頂端位移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error. Pile-head connection rotation also changes moment distribution, so checking one head displacement is insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設理想懸臂P=100kN、L=10m、E=200GPa、I=0.0074m⁴，δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm，根部矩1000kN·m。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume ideal cantilever P=100kN,L=10m,E=200GPa,I=0.0074m⁴. δ=PL³/(3EI)=22.52mm and root moment1000kN·m, excluding soil flexibility.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「海床泥面在所有情況下都可直接視為樁身完全固定端。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The seabed mudline can always be treated as a perfectly fixed pile support." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。樁頭接合轉動也會改變彎矩分布，不能只核對一個頂端位移。
knowledge.textEn: Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error. Pile-head connection rotation also changes moment distribution, so checking one head displacement is insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「側向彎曲基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Lateral bending baseline" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
沖刷只影響外觀而不會改變樁基水平剛度和彎矩需求。
optionsEn: Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Scour affects appearance only and cannot change lateral pile stiffness or bending demand.
quiz.explanation: 把泥面誤當完全固定可能低估水平位移，沖刷加深後若仍用舊長度則再次低估需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Treating the mudline as perfectly fixed can understate lateral movement, and retaining old length after scour adds further error. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「沖刷與側向剛度」與「波流拖曳分量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scour and lateral stiffness" and "Wave-current drag component": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 沖刷與側向剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scour and lateral stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「沖刷與側向剛度」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scour and lateral stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 沖刷移除上部土支承，可能增加有效自由長度並改變樁的水平剛度，作用不只是少了一層保護石。以固定彎曲剛度懸臂比較可看三次方敏感度，但真實固定點會隨土體反應移動，海床回填也不必然立即恢復原支承，需持續觀測。 假設同EI懸臂有效長度由10增至12m，k=3EI/L³，剛度比(10/12)³=0.5787，減少42.13%；非完整樁土預測。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「沖刷與側向剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scour removes near-surface support and can increase effective free length, changing lateral stiffness rather than merely removing armor. A constant-EI cantilever illustrates cubic sensitivity, but the effective fixity also shifts with soil response. Sediment refill does not necessarily restore original support immediately, requiring continued observation instead of assuming that a visually recovered bed reinstates the previous behavior. Assume fixed-EI cantilever length increases10to12m. k=3EI/L³ gives stiffness ratio0.5787, a42.13% reduction, not a complete pile-soil prediction. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scour and lateral stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「沖刷只影響外觀而不會改變樁基水平剛度和彎矩需求。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Scour affects appearance only and cannot change lateral pile stiffness or bending demand." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「沖刷與側向剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scour and lateral stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Wave-current drag component” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 細長樁的水動力可分速度拖曳和加速度慣性，兩者在波浪中未必同時達峰。穩定流拖曳基準需要投影直徑與流速，海生物附著會改變粗糙與尺度；不能拿單一拖曳值代表完整波浪荷載，也不能忽略成群樁的遮蔽與局部加速。 假設海水1025kg/m³、Cd=1.2、D=1m、穩定流2m/s，每米拖曳f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m；不含慣性力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「波流拖曳分量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hydrodynamic action on a slender pile includes velocity-dependent drag and acceleration-dependent inertia, whose peaks need not coincide. One drag value cannot represent complete wave loading, and pile-group shielding or local acceleration may modify the action around individual members. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,Cd=1.2,D=1m and steady speed2m/s. Drag per length f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m, excluding inertia. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Wave-current drag component” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range. For waves, retain velocity and acceleration histories and calculate phase-resolved components rather than summing peaks occurring at unrelated times in the cycle.

knowledge.title: 現場實務

knowledge.textEn: Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range. For waves, retain velocity and acceleration histories and calculate phase-resolved components rather than summing peaks occurring at unrelated times in the cycle.

quiz.question: 要驗證「波流拖曳分量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Wave-current drag component"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
核對流速方向和量測高度，記錄海生物附著、樁群間距與所用拖曳係數的範圍。
樁頂沉陷完全來自土壤所以樁身彈性縮短永遠可以忽略。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.
Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range.
Pile-head settlement comes entirely from soil, so elastic pile shortening can always be ignored.
quiz.explanation: 核對流速方向和量測高度，記錄海生物附著、樁群間距與所用拖曳係數的範圍。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check velocity direction and elevation, recording marine growth, group spacing and the drag coefficient's evidence range. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 波流拖曳分量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Wave-current drag component: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「波流拖曳分量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Wave-current drag component” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 使用未附著的直徑可能低估長期拖曳，忽略慣性則漏掉短週期作用。將遮蔽係數套用所有流向也可能低估前排或局部通道中的高流速需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using a clean diameter can understate long-term drag, while omitted inertia misses short-period action. Applying one shielding factor to every direction may also understate loads on leading piles or in accelerated local flow passages. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設海水1025kg/m³、Cd=1.2、D=1m、穩定流2m/s，每米拖曳f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m；不含慣性力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Drag per length f=ρCdDU²/2=2.460kN/m, excluding inertia.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「穩定流拖曳算式已經自動包含波浪造成的全部慣性作用。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The steady-current drag formula automatically includes all wave-induced inertia effects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 使用未附著的直徑可能低估長期拖曳，忽略慣性則漏掉短週期作用。將遮蔽係數套用所有流向也可能低估前排或局部通道中的高流速需求。
knowledge.textEn: Using a clean diameter can understate long-term drag, while omitted inertia misses short-period action. Applying one shielding factor to every direction may also understate loads on leading piles or in accelerated local flow passages.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「波流拖曳分量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Wave-current drag component" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。
使用未附著的直徑可能低估長期拖曳，忽略慣性則漏掉短週期作用。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining.
Using a clean diameter can understate long-term drag, while omitted inertia misses short-period action.
quiz.explanation: 使用未附著的直徑可能低估長期拖曳，忽略慣性則漏掉短週期作用。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using a clean diameter can understate long-term drag, while omitted inertia misses short-period action. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」與「循環需求與疲勞」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Corrosion loss and remaining section" and "Cyclic demand and fatigue": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and remaining section: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」如何影響棧橋式碼頭樁基的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Corrosion loss and remaining section” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 海水區鋼樁腐蝕常隨高程和環境變化，平均減薄無法代表局部凹蝕或焊縫。假設外徑不變且內壁損失只是一種幾何情境，真實腐蝕可能雙面發生；剩餘面積比例也不是剩餘壽命或承載比例，還需檢查彎曲、局部穩定及疲勞。 假設外徑固定1m，壁厚由20降至17mm，內徑0.960變0.966m，剩餘面積比[1−0.966²]/[1−0.960²]=0.8526。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Marine corrosion varies with elevation and environment, and average loss does not describe pitting or weld zones. Fixed outer diameter with internal loss is only one geometry; actual attack may occur on both faces. Remaining area fraction is neither remaining life nor overall capacity, since bending, local stability and fatigue depend on additional features of the damaged member. Assume fixed outer diameter1m and wall thickness20to17mm, so inner diameter0.960to0.966m. Remaining annular-area ratio is0.8526, not remaining life. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Corrosion loss and remaining section” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Corrosion loss and remaining section”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面
knowledge.text: 海水區鋼樁腐蝕常隨高程和環境變化，平均減薄無法代表局部凹蝕或焊縫。假設外徑不變且內壁損失只是一種幾何情境，真實腐蝕可能雙面發生；剩餘面積比例也不是剩餘壽命或承載比例，還需檢查彎曲、局部穩定及疲勞。
knowledge.textEn: Marine corrosion varies with elevation and environment, and average loss does not describe pitting or weld zones. Fixed outer diameter with internal loss is only one geometry; actual attack may occur on both faces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Corrosion loss and remaining section" is correct?
options: 海水區鋼樁腐蝕常隨高程和環境變化，平均減薄無法代表局部凹蝕或焊縫。
剩餘截面百分比必定等於鋼樁剩餘使用年限的百分比。
Miner損傷比等於一半就保證還能再使用同樣長的時間。
optionsEn: Marine corrosion varies with elevation and environment, and average loss does not describe pitting or weld zones.
The remaining cross-sectional percentage necessarily equals the percentage of service life remaining.
A Miner damage fraction of one half guarantees an equally long remaining service period.
quiz.explanation: 海水區鋼樁腐蝕常隨高程和環境變化，平均減薄無法代表局部凹蝕或焊縫。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Marine corrosion varies with elevation and environment, and average loss does not describe pitting or weld zones. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and remaining section: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Corrosion loss and remaining section” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑固定1m，壁厚由20降至17mm，內徑0.960變0.966m，剩餘面積比[1−0.966²]/[1−0.960²]=0.8526。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed outer diameter1m and wall thickness20to17mm, so inner diameter0.960to0.966m. Remaining annular-area ratio is0.8526, not remaining life. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設外徑固定1m，壁厚由20降至17mm，內徑0.960變0.966m，剩餘面積比[1−0.966²]/[1−0.960²]=0.8526。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed outer diameter1m and wall thickness20to17mm, so inner diameter0.960to0.966m. Remaining annular-area ratio is0.8526, not remaining life.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Corrosion loss and remaining section", which statement holds?
options: 開口管樁無論土塞狀態都具有與封閉端相同的有效端面積。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
只要樁數相同每支樁在任何偏心荷載下都承擔相同軸力。
optionsEn: Every open-ended pipe pile has the same effective toe area as a closed pile regardless of plugging.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Equal pile count means every pile carries identical axial force under any eccentric loading.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and remaining section: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Corrosion loss and remaining section” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。將更新截面帶回軸力彎矩與穩定分析，另檢查塗層和陰極防蝕狀態而非只報平均減薄。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。將更新截面帶回軸力彎矩與穩定分析，另檢查塗層和陰極防蝕狀態而非只報平均減薄。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：水線附近局部深蝕可在平均截面尚大時控制失效，內外面誤判又會改變慣性矩。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Deep localized attack near the waterline can govern despite a large average remaining area, and misidentified corrosion faces alter inertia. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss.

Recompute axial, bending and stability demands using updated geometry, reviewing coating and cathodic-protection condition separately rather than reporting only mean thickness loss.

quiz.question: 要驗證「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Corrosion loss and remaining section"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
海床泥面在所有情況下都可直接視為樁身完全固定端。
按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
The seabed mudline can always be treated as a perfectly fixed pile support.
Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face.
quiz.explanation: 按高程和周向建立厚度地圖，保留最薄區與量測不確定度，說明損失是在內外哪一面。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map thickness by elevation and circumference, retaining thin spots and uncertainty and identifying the affected face. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Corrosion loss and remaining section: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「腐蝕減薄與剩餘截面」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Corrosion loss and remaining section” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 水線附近局部深蝕可在平均截面尚大時控制失效，內外面誤判又會改變慣性矩。用平均腐蝕速率外推壽命，可能漏掉環境變化和保護系統失效後的加速。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Deep localized attack near the waterline can govern despite a large average remaining area, and misidentified corrosion faces alter inertia. Extrapolating mean corrosion rate misses environmental changes or acceleration following loss of protective-system performance. steps.title: 循環需求與疲勞：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cyclic demand and fatigue” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Pile-supported pier foundations”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 波流與靠泊反覆作用在焊縫及接頭形成疲勞需求，應力範圍和循環次數需共同描述。線性損傷累積假設忽略載入順序、腐蝕交互及裂縫成長細節，只適合有相應曲線的初步比較；損傷比未到某值也不能取代檢查或保證剩餘壽命。 假設兩級循環n1=100000、N1=1000000，n2=200000、N2=500000，Miner D=Σn/N=0.50；非剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環需求與疲勞」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repeated waves and berthing create fatigue demand at welds and connections, requiring stress ranges together with cycle counts. Linear cumulative damage ignores sequence, corrosion interaction and detailed crack growth, supporting only a preliminary comparison with appropriate fatigue curves. A calculated fraction does not replace inspection or guarantee remaining life, especially when local details differ from those represented by the selected curve. Assume cycle pairs n1=100000,N1=1000000 and n2=200000,N2=500000. Miner D=Σn/N=0.50, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cyclic demand and fatigue” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.textEn: Repeated waves and berthing create fatigue demand at welds and connections, requiring stress ranges together with cycle counts. Linear cumulative damage ignores sequence, corrosion interaction and detailed crack growth, supporting only a preliminary comparison with appropriate fatigue curves.

steps.title: 循環需求與疲勞：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「循環需求與疲勞」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cyclic demand and fatigue” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩級循環n1=100000、N1=1000000，n2=200000、N2=500000，Miner D=Σn/N=0.50；非剩餘壽命保證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume cycle pairs n1=100000,N1=1000000 and n2=200000,N2=500000. Miner D=Σn/N=0.50, not a remaining-life guarantee. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：追蹤應力範圍來源與循環計數方法，核對疲勞曲線是否適合實際焊縫和環境。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Trace stress-range derivation and cycle counting, verifying curve applicability to the actual weld and environment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

courses.title: 浮動碼頭繫泊系統
courses.summary: 辨識浮碼頭浮力纜繩幾何與岸上通道的耦合反應。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Identify coupled buoyancy, mooring geometry and shore-access response of floating docks. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 辨識浮碼頭浮力纜繩幾何與岸上通道的耦合反應
courses.focusEn: Identify coupled buoyancy, mooring geometry and shore-access response of floating docks
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設海水1025kg/m³、水線面100m²、均勻增重10250kg，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.10m；不含傾斜與波浪。假設增重由10250加10%至11275kg、水線面與密度不變，平均吃水增量由0.10變0.11m；並不保證各角點只增加同樣深度。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,constant waterplane100m² and uniformly added10250kg. Mean draft increaseΔT=0.10m, excluding heel and waves. Increasing added mass10% from10250 to11275kg at fixed waterplane and density changes mean draft increment from0.10 to0.11m, without guaranteeing equal immersion changes at every corner. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「浮台載重與吃水」與「迎風面與風作用」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pontoon loading and draft" and "Windage and wind action": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 浮台載重與吃水：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pontoon loading and draft: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「浮台載重與吃水」如何影響浮動碼頭繫泊系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Pontoon loading and draft” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮碼頭用排水體積平衡總重量，增加人員或設備會改變平均吃水與乾舷。矩形常水線面只是靜水近似，重量位置還影響傾斜，進水或浮筒形狀變化會改變面積；因此承載評估需把平均下沉、偏載與損壞狀態分開，不能只算總浮力。 假設海水1025kg/m³、水線面100m²、均勻增重10250kg，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.10m；不含傾斜與波浪。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮台載重與吃水」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A floating dock balances total weight through displaced water. Added people or equipment change mean draft and freeboard. A constant rectangular waterplane is only a calm-water approximation; weight location causes heel, while flooding or changing hull shape alters area. Assessment must separate mean immersion, eccentric loading and damage rather than relying on one total-buoyancy figure for every condition. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,constant waterplane100m² and uniformly added10250kg. Mean draft increaseΔT=0.10m, excluding heel and waves. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Pontoon loading and draft” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「浮台載重與吃水」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Pontoon loading and draft”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 浮台載重與吃水
knowledge.text: 浮碼頭用排水體積平衡總重量，增加人員或設備會改變平均吃水與乾舷。矩形常水線面只是靜水近似，重量位置還影響傾斜，進水或浮筒形狀變化會改變面積；因此承載評估需把平均下沉、偏載與損壞狀態分開，不能只算總浮力。
knowledge.textEn: A floating dock balances total weight through displaced water. Added people or equipment change mean draft and freeboard.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「浮台載重與吃水」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Pontoon loading and draft" is correct?
options: 只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。
浮碼頭用排水體積平衡總重量，增加人員或設備會改變平均吃水與乾舷。
浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。
optionsEn: Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves.
A floating dock balances total weight through displaced water.
Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels.
quiz.explanation: 浮碼頭用排水體積平衡總重量，增加人員或設備會改變平均吃水與乾舷。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A floating dock balances total weight through displaced water. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮台載重與吃水：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Pontoon loading and draft: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮台載重與吃水」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Pontoon loading and draft” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設海水1025kg/m³、水線面100m²、均勻增重10250kg，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.10m；不含傾斜與波浪。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,constant waterplane100m² and uniformly added10250kg. Mean draft increaseΔT=0.10m, excluding heel and waves. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設海水1025kg/m³、水線面100m²、均勻增重10250kg，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.10m；不含傾斜與波浪。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume seawater1025kg/m³,constant waterplane100m² and uniformly added10250kg. Mean draft increaseΔT=0.10m, excluding heel and waves.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮台載重與吃水」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Pontoon loading and draft", which statement holds?
options: 纜繩總數增加一倍就保證每條纜在任何姿態都只受一半張力。
浮台隨潮升降但平面位置不變時纜繩幾何與張力也一定不變。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Doubling line count guarantees half the tension in every line under any geometry.
If pontoon plan position is unchanged, tidal rise cannot alter line geometry or tension.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮台載重與吃水：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Pontoon loading and draft: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮台載重與吃水」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Pontoon loading and draft” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。另記密閉艙狀態及最低乾舷，把靜水預算與實際使用限制分開保存。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion. Record compartment condition and minimum freeboard, keeping this static budget distinct from the actual restrictions governing use of the facility. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。另記密閉艙狀態及最低乾舷，把靜水預算與實際使用限制分開保存。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion. Record compartment condition and minimum freeboard, keeping this static budget distinct from the actual restrictions governing use of the facility.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：偏載時平均吃水正常仍可能有一角進水，未察覺艙漏又使有效浮力持續減少。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Eccentric loading can flood a corner despite normal mean draft, and unnoticed leakage progressively reduces buoyant reserve. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。另記密閉艙狀態及最低乾舷，把靜水預算與實際使用限制分開保存。
knowledge.textEn: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion. Record compartment condition and minimum freeboard, keeping this static budget distinct from the actual restrictions governing use of the facility.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。另記密閉艙狀態及最低乾舷，把靜水預算與實際使用限制分開保存。
knowledge.textEn: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion. Record compartment condition and minimum freeboard, keeping this static budget distinct from the actual restrictions governing use of the facility.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮台載重與吃水」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Pontoon loading and draft"?
options: 用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
自然週期算對就可以不需阻尼資料直接預測最大纜繩張力。
optionsEn: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A correct natural period predicts maximum mooring tension without any damping information.
quiz.explanation: 用多角點吃水與重量清單交叉核對，標出人員和設備可能集中區，檢查水線面是否隨吃水改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare corner drafts with the weight schedule, marking potential concentrated occupancy and checking whether waterplane changes with immersion. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮台載重與吃水：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Pontoon loading and draft: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮台載重與吃水」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Pontoon loading and draft” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏載時平均吃水正常仍可能有一角進水，未察覺艙漏又使有效浮力持續減少。只核對設計總重量，無法辨識局部低乾舷與失去密閉性的共同影響。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Eccentric loading can flood a corner despite normal mean draft, and unnoticed leakage progressively reduces buoyant reserve. Checking design total weight alone cannot reveal the combined effect of local low freeboard and compromised compartment integrity. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設海水1025kg/m³、水線面100m²、均勻增重10250kg，ΔT=Δm/(ρA)=0.10m；不含傾斜與波浪。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Mean draft increaseΔT=0.10m, excluding heel and waves.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 偏載時平均吃水正常仍可能有一角進水，未察覺艙漏又使有效浮力持續減少。只核對設計總重量，無法辨識局部低乾舷與失去密閉性的共同影響。
knowledge.textEn: Eccentric loading can flood a corner despite normal mean draft, and unnoticed leakage progressively reduces buoyant reserve. Checking design total weight alone cannot reveal the combined effect of local low freeboard and compromised compartment integrity.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮台載重與吃水」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Pontoon loading and draft" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
偏載時平均吃水正常仍可能有一角進水，未察覺艙漏又使有效浮力持續減少。
浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Eccentric loading can flood a corner despite normal mean draft, and unnoticed leakage progressively reduces buoyant reserve.
Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels.
quiz.explanation: 偏載時平均吃水正常仍可能有一角進水，未察覺艙漏又使有效浮力持續減少。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Eccentric loading can flood a corner despite normal mean draft, and unnoticed leakage progressively reduces buoyant reserve. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 迎風面與風作用：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Windage and wind action: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「迎風面與風作用」如何影響浮動碼頭繫泊系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Windage and wind action” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮碼頭與繫泊船舶的迎風面共同傳力，風向改變會讓受力位置與扭矩不同。平方風速式使用指定平均時間與高度，不能把瞬間陣風和長期平均混在同一係數下；遮蔽、上層設施及船舶配置也會改變受風面，需追蹤實際組合。 假設空氣ρ=1.225kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積100m²、指定風速20m/s，F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN；非操作門檻。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「迎風面與風作用」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The dock and attached vessels contribute windage and transfer load together; direction changes force location and torque. A quadratic wind relation requires a specified averaging period and elevation, rather than mixing gusts and long-term means under one coefficient. Shelter, superstructures and vessel arrangements also change projected area, making the actual combined configuration part of the load case. Assume air1.225kg/m³,Cd=1.2,projected area100m² and selected speed20m/s. F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN, not an operating threshold. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Windage and wind action” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「迎風面與風作用」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Windage and wind action”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 迎風面與風作用
knowledge.text: 浮碼頭與繫泊船舶的迎風面共同傳力，風向改變會讓受力位置與扭矩不同。平方風速式使用指定平均時間與高度，不能把瞬間陣風和長期平均混在同一係數下；遮蔽、上層設施及船舶配置也會改變受風面，需追蹤實際組合。
knowledge.textEn: The dock and attached vessels contribute windage and transfer load together; direction changes force location and torque. A quadratic wind relation requires a specified averaging period and elevation, rather than mixing gusts and long-term means under one coefficient.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「迎風面與風作用」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Windage and wind action" is correct?
options: 浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。
遠處測到的平均潮流速度必定等於所有浮體表面的局部速度。
浮碼頭與繫泊船舶的迎風面共同傳力，風向改變會讓受力位置與扭矩不同。
optionsEn: Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels.
A distant mean tidal-current measurement necessarily equals local velocity at every pontoon surface.
The dock and attached vessels contribute windage and transfer load together; direction changes force location and torque.
quiz.explanation: 浮碼頭與繫泊船舶的迎風面共同傳力，風向改變會讓受力位置與扭矩不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The dock and attached vessels contribute windage and transfer load together; direction changes force location and torque. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 迎風面與風作用：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Windage and wind action: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「迎風面與風作用」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Windage and wind action” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空氣ρ=1.225kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積100m²、指定風速20m/s，F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN；非操作門檻。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume air1.225kg/m³,Cd=1.2,projected area100m² and selected speed20m/s. F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN, not an operating threshold. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在平面與立面標出迎風投影、合力高度及係纜點，核對風速定義與量測位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map projected area, force height and mooring points and check wind-speed definition and measurement location.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空氣ρ=1.225kg/m³、Cd=1.2、投影面積100m²、指定風速20m/s，F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN；非操作門檻。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume air1.225kg/m³,Cd=1.2,projected area100m² and selected speed20m/s. F=ρCdAU²/2=29.40kN, not an operating threshold.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「迎風面與風作用」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Windage and wind action", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。
所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling.
Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 迎風面與風作用：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Windage and wind action: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「迎風面與風作用」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Windage and wind action” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在平面與立面標出迎風投影、合力高度及係纜點，核對風速定義與量測位置。比較不同船舶和風向配置，將遮蔽證據與未遮蔽情境分開，保留由偏心造成的扭矩需求。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map projected area, force height and mooring points and check wind-speed definition and measurement location. Compare vessel and directional configurations, separating evidenced shelter from exposed conditions and retaining torque demand created by an eccentric line of action. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在平面與立面標出迎風投影、合力高度及係纜點，核對風速定義與量測位置。比較不同船舶和風向配置，將遮蔽證據與未遮蔽情境分開，保留由偏心造成的扭矩需求。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map projected area, force height and mooring points and check wind-speed definition and measurement location. Compare vessel and directional configurations, separating evidenced shelter from exposed conditions and retaining torque demand created by an eccentric line of action.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：新增遮棚或高船舶可增加迎風面及力矩，沿用空碼頭參數會低估系統需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A canopy or taller vessel increases windage and torque, so empty-dock parameters understate demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 在平面與立面標出迎風投影、合力高度及係纜點，核對風速定義與量測位置。比較不同船舶和風向配置，將遮蔽證據與未遮蔽情境分開，保留由偏心造成的扭矩需求。
knowledge.textEn: Map projected area, force height and mooring points and check wind-speed definition and measurement location. Compare vessel and directional configurations, separating evidenced shelter from exposed conditions and retaining torque demand created by an eccentric line of action.

quiz.question: 要驗證「迎風面與風作用」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Windage and wind action"?

在平面與立面標出迎風投影、合力高度及係纜點，核對風速定義與量測位置。
引橋坡度符合任意幾何計算值就自動代表完全符合無障礙要求。
optionsEn: Reusing results from another hydraulic structure or catchment counts as verifying this structure.

quiz.explanationEn: Map projected area, force height and mooring points and check wind-speed definition and measurement location. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 迎風面與風作用：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Windage and wind action” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 新增遮棚或高船舶可增加迎風面及力矩，沿用空碼頭參數會低估系統需求。平均風速與陣風混用則可能把不同時間尺度的作用錯誤相加或相互抵銷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.textEn: A canopy or taller vessel increases windage and torque, so empty-dock parameters understate demand. Mixing mean wind and gust definitions can also incorrectly combine or cancel actions occurring on different response timescales in the system.

quiz.question: 在「迎風面與風作用」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Windage and wind action" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
遠處測到的平均潮流速度必定等於所有浮體表面的局部速度。
新增遮棚或高船舶可增加迎風面及力矩，沿用空碼頭參數會低估系統需求。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A distant mean tidal-current measurement necessarily equals local velocity at every pontoon surface.
A canopy or taller vessel increases windage and torque, so empty-dock parameters understate demand.

quiz.explanationEn: A canopy or taller vessel increases windage and torque, so empty-dock parameters understate demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 水力機制、材料與定量模型
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水下流阻尺度」與「纜繩力向分解」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Submerged-current drag scale" and "Resolving mooring-line forces": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水下流阻尺度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Submerged-current drag scale: mechanism and system paths

steps.instruction: 係纜的軸向張力只有投影分量抵抗指定水平力，平面角與垂直角均會影響傳力。理想兩索對稱必須同時張緊才可平均分擔，預張力、鬆弛與彈性差異會破壞此條件；不能將幾何張力直接當成纜具額定能力或現場張緊設定。 假設水平力40kN由兩條水平對稱張緊纜承受，各與力向30°，T=40/(2cos30°)=23.094kN；未含預張與動載。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「纜繩力向分解」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

quiz.explanation: 係纜的軸向張力只有投影分量抵抗指定水平力，平面角與垂直角均會影響傳力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Only a line's projected tension resists the selected horizontal action, with both plan and vertical angles affecting transfer. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 纜繩力向分解：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resolving mooring-line forces: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「纜繩力向分解」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resolving mooring-line forces” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平力40kN由兩條水平對稱張緊纜承受，各與力向30°，T=40/(2cos30°)=23.094kN；未含預張與動載。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume horizontal40kN resisted by two taut horizontal symmetric lines30°from the force direction. T=23.094kN each, excluding pretension and dynamics. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫每條纜的三維方向和自由體圖，確認角度參考軸及同時受力條件，分開預張與荷載增量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw each line in three dimensions and define angle reference and simultaneous engagement, separating pretension from load increment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設水平力40kN由兩條水平對稱張緊纜承受，各與力向30°，T=40/(2cos30°)=23.094kN；未含預張與動載。

quiz.question: 依「纜繩力向分解」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resolving mooring-line forces", which statement holds?
options: 所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。
引橋坡度符合任意幾何計算值就自動代表完全符合無障礙要求。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction.
Any calculated gangway slope automatically establishes full compliance with accessibility requirements.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 纜繩力向分解：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resolving mooring-line forces: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「纜繩力向分解」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resolving mooring-line forces” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫每條纜的三維方向和自由體圖，確認角度參考軸及同時受力條件，分開預張與荷載增量。沿纜具、連接和岸上錨點追蹤力路徑，核對不均分時的替代情境。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw each line in three dimensions and define angle reference and simultaneous engagement, separating pretension from load increment. Trace force through rope, fittings and shore anchorage and evaluate alternative sharing when the symmetric assumption is not supported. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫每條纜的三維方向和自由體圖，確認角度參考軸及同時受力條件，分開預張與荷載增量。沿纜具、連接和岸上錨點追蹤力路徑，核對不均分時的替代情境。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw each line in three dimensions and define angle reference and simultaneous engagement, separating pretension from load increment. Trace force through rope, fittings and shore anchorage and evaluate alternative sharing when the symmetric assumption is not supported.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一條纜鬆弛時另一條可能承擔大部分需求，垂直角增加又減少水平分量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One slack line shifts much of the demand to another, and vertical inclination reduces horizontal resistance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「纜繩力向分解」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Resolving mooring-line forces"?
options: 畫每條纜的三維方向和自由體圖，確認角度參考軸及同時受力條件，分開預張與荷載增量。

Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves.

steps.title: 纜繩力向分解：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Resolving mooring-line forces: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「纜繩力向分解」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Resolving mooring-line forces” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一條纜鬆弛時另一條可能承擔大部分需求，垂直角增加又減少水平分量。僅靠纜數平均分配，會漏掉不對稱姿態及突然繃緊造成的衝擊。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One slack line shifts much of the demand to another, and vertical inclination reduces horizontal resistance. Dividing load only by line count misses asymmetric geometry and impact when a previously slack line suddenly becomes taut. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水平力40kN由兩條水平對稱張緊纜承受，各與力向30°，T=40/(2cos30°)=23.094kN；未含預張與動載。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: T=23.094kN each, excluding pretension and dynamics.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「纜繩總數增加一倍就保證每條纜在任何姿態都只受一半張力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling line count guarantees half the tension in every line under any geometry." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 一條纜鬆弛時另一條可能承擔大部分需求，垂直角增加又減少水平分量。僅靠纜數平均分配，會漏掉不對稱姿態及突然繃緊造成的衝擊。
knowledge.textEn: One slack line shifts much of the demand to another, and vertical inclination reduces horizontal resistance. Dividing load only by line count misses asymmetric geometry and impact when a previously slack line suddenly becomes taut.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「纜繩力向分解」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Resolving mooring-line forces" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
一條纜鬆弛時另一條可能承擔大部分需求，垂直角增加又減少水平分量。
所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
One slack line shifts much of the demand to another, and vertical inclination reduces horizontal resistance.
Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling.
quiz.explanation: 一條纜鬆弛時另一條可能承擔大部分需求，垂直角增加又減少水平分量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One slack line shifts much of the demand to another, and vertical inclination reduces horizontal resistance. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「材料伸長與有效剛度」與「潮位幾何與鬆弛」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Material extension and effective stiffness" and "Tidal geometry and slack": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 材料伸長與有效剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Material extension and effective stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「材料伸長與有效剛度」如何影響浮動碼頭繫泊系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Material extension and effective stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 纜繩伸長包含材料應變與編織重排，許多材料在循環中有遲滯、徐變和不同切線剛度。直桿彈性式只是一個局部基準，不適合把所有纜索都當鋼杆；量測時還需分開初始鬆弛與幾何拉直，否則剛度估計會隨量測區間改變。 假設直線彈性纜有效EA=5000kN、長20m、張力增量25kN，伸長ΔL=ΔTL/(EA)=0.10m；不含鬆弛與徐變。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「材料伸長與有效剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Line extension combines material strain with constructional rearrangement, and many ropes show hysteresis, creep and changing tangent stiffness. A straight elastic rod is a local baseline rather than a universal steel-like representation. Initial slack and geometric straightening must be separated from material extension, otherwise the inferred stiffness depends on which portion of the load-displacement path was measured. Assume a straight elastic line with effective EA=5000kN,length20m and tension increment25kN. Extension is0.10m, excluding slack and creep. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Material extension and effective stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「材料伸長與有效剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Material extension and effective stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 材料伸長與有效剛度
knowledge.text: 纜繩伸長包含材料應變與編織重排，許多材料在循環中有遲滯、徐變和不同切線剛度。直桿彈性式只是一個局部基準，不適合把所有纜索都當鋼杆；量測時還需分開初始鬆弛與幾何拉直，否則剛度估計會隨量測區間改變。
knowledge.textEn: Line extension combines material strain with constructional rearrangement, and many ropes show hysteresis, creep and changing tangent stiffness. A straight elastic rod is a local baseline rather than a universal steel-like representation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「材料伸長與有效剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Material extension and effective stiffness" is correct?
options: 所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。
浮台隨潮升降但平面位置不變時纜繩幾何與張力也一定不變。
纜繩伸長包含材料應變與編織重排，許多材料在循環中有遲滯、徐變和不同切線剛度。
optionsEn: Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling.
If pontoon plan position is unchanged, tidal rise cannot alter line geometry or tension.
Line extension combines material strain with constructional rearrangement, and many ropes show hysteresis, creep and changing tangent stiffness.
quiz.explanation: 纜繩伸長包含材料應變與編織重排，許多材料在循環中有遲滯、徐變和不同切線剛度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 將編織收緊當材料彈性會低估後續切線剛度，長時間徐變又可能增加鬆弛和位移。相同最終伸長下，張力歷史與儲能可以不同，不能只讀總長度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.title: 潮位幾何與鬆弛：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「潮位幾何與鬆弛」如何影響浮動碼頭繫泊系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tidal geometry and slack” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 岸上固定點與浮台的高差隨潮位變化，連線長度及入射角因此改變，即使平面位置未動也可能拉緊纜繩。直線距離只是幾何下限，鏈條垂度和海床接觸另影響反力；不能把一段預留長度視為在所有水位都具有相同的鬆弛餘量。 假設水平距10m，高差由1變3m，直線距由√101=10.0499增至√109=10.4403m，增0.3904m；非鏈條張力模型。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「潮位幾何與鬆弛」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The height difference between a shore point and a pontoon varies with tide, changing chord length and angle even without horizontal motion. Straight-line distance is a geometric lower bound; chain sag and bed contact separately affect reaction. A reserved length therefore does not provide the same slack margin at every water level or imply unchanged horizontal restoring behavior. Assume horizontal distance10m and height difference1to3m. Chord length rises10.0499to10.4403m, an increase0.3904m; this is not a catenary-tension model. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tidal geometry and slack” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「浮台隨潮升降但平面位置不變時纜繩幾何與張力也一定不變。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "If pontoon plan position is unchanged, tidal rise cannot alter line geometry or tension." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「潮位幾何與鬆弛」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 潮位幾何與鬆弛

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：浮台隨潮升降但平面位置不變時纜繩幾何與張力也一定不變。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

knowledge.text: 以同一基準畫高低水位的纜端位置，量測可用纜長、垂度和海床接觸，核對可能卡阻。把幾何變化連回經驗證的力位移曲線，另查高水位時岸上構件的垂直反力。
knowledge.textEn: Plot line-end positions at different levels on one datum, measuring available length, sag and seabed contact and checking obstructions. Relate geometric changes to a verified force-displacement curve and separately examine vertical reactions on shore attachments during higher water.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 以同一基準畫高低水位的纜端位置，量測可用纜長、垂度和海床接觸，核對可能卡阻。把幾何變化連回經驗證的力位移曲線，另查高水位時岸上構件的垂直反力。
