Relate geometric changes to a verified force-displacement curve and separately examine vertical reactions on shore attachments during higher water.

quiz.question: 要驗證「潮位幾何與鬆弛」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Tidal geometry and slack"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
遠處測到的平均潮流速度必定等於所有浮體表面的局部速度。
以同一基準畫高低水位的纜端位置，量測可用纜長、垂度和海床接觸，核對可能卡阻。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
A distant mean tidal-current measurement necessarily equals local velocity at every pontoon surface.
Plot line-end positions at different levels on one datum, measuring available length, sag and seabed contact and checking obstructions.
quiz.explanation: 以同一基準畫高低水位的纜端位置，量測可用纜長、垂度和海床接觸，核對可能卡阻。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Plot line-end positions at different levels on one datum, measuring available length, sag and seabed contact and checking obstructions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 潮位幾何與鬆弛：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tidal geometry and slack: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「潮位幾何與鬆弛」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tidal geometry and slack” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高水位使纜線接近拉直時，剩餘伸長可能轉為很大的張力增量；低水位則可能增加海床磨耗。只檢查中潮幾何，無法涵蓋兩端的不同行為。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: As a line straightens at high water, further extension can produce a large tension increment, while low water increases seabed abrasion. Mid-tide geometry alone cannot cover these different behaviors at the ends of the tidal range. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設水平距10m，高差由1變3m，直線距由√101=10.0499增至√109=10.4403m，增0.3904m；非鏈條張力模型。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Chord length rises10.0499to10.4403m, an increase0.3904m; this is not a catenary-tension model.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「浮台隨潮升降但平面位置不變時纜繩幾何與張力也一定不變。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "If pontoon plan position is unchanged, tidal rise cannot alter line geometry or tension." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 高水位使纜線接近拉直時，剩餘伸長可能轉為很大的張力增量；低水位則可能增加海床磨耗。只檢查中潮幾何，無法涵蓋兩端的不同行為。
knowledge.textEn: As a line straightens at high water, further extension can produce a large tension increment, while low water increases seabed abrasion. Mid-tide geometry alone cannot cover these different behaviors at the ends of the tidal range.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「潮位幾何與鬆弛」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Tidal geometry and slack" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 高水位使纜線接近拉直時，剩餘伸長可能轉為很大的張力增量；低水位則可能增加海床磨耗。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。
optionsEn: As a line straightens at high water, further extension can produce a large tension increment, while low water increases seabed abrasion.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 高水位使纜線接近拉直時，剩餘伸長可能轉為很大的張力增量；低水位則可能增加海床磨耗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: As a line straightens at high water, further extension can produce a large tension increment, while low water increases seabed abrasion. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「並聯恢復剛度」與「水平振盪時間尺度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Parallel restoring stiffness" and "Horizontal oscillation timescale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 並聯恢復剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel restoring stiffness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯恢復剛度」如何影響浮動碼頭繫泊系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel restoring stiffness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 多條纜的水平恢復力可以在特定平衡點線性化，但只有同方向、同時受力的小位移增量才直接相加。幾何旋轉與單向受拉特性會改變參與線數，整個系統還有浮台轉動自由度；單一總剛度不代表所有位移方向和幅度都相同。 假設兩個同向並聯線性恢復分量k1=20、k2=30kN/m，受增量力10kN時x=10/(20+30)=0.20m；兩者均持續受力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯恢復剛度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal restoring force can be linearized about one equilibrium, with direct addition applying only to simultaneously engaged, collinear small-displacement increments. Geometry and tension-only behavior change the active lines, and the dock also rotates. One total stiffness cannot describe every direction and amplitude, so its use must remain tied to the specified equilibrium state and local motion coordinate. Assume two collinear parallel restoring components20and30kN/m remain engaged. An incremental10kN gives x=10/50=0.20m near that equilibrium. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel restoring stiffness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「並聯恢復剛度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Parallel restoring stiffness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 並聯恢復剛度
knowledge.text: 多條纜的水平恢復力可以在特定平衡點線性化，但只有同方向、同時受力的小位移增量才直接相加。幾何旋轉與單向受拉特性會改變參與線數，整個系統還有浮台轉動自由度；單一總剛度不代表所有位移方向和幅度都相同。
knowledge.textEn: Horizontal restoring force can be linearized about one equilibrium, with direct addition applying only to simultaneously engaged, collinear small-displacement increments. Geometry and tension-only behavior change the active lines, and the dock also rotates.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「並聯恢復剛度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Parallel restoring stiffness" is correct?
options: 所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。
多條纜的水平恢復力可以在特定平衡點線性化，但只有同方向、同時受力的小位移增量才直接相加。
自然週期算對就可以不需阻尼資料直接預測最大纜繩張力。
optionsEn: Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction.
Horizontal restoring force can be linearized about one equilibrium, with direct addition applying only to simultaneously engaged, collinear small-displacement increments.
A correct natural period predicts maximum mooring tension without any damping information.
quiz.explanation: 多條纜的水平恢復力可以在特定平衡點線性化，但只有同方向、同時受力的小位移增量才直接相加。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Horizontal restoring force can be linearized about one equilibrium, with direct addition applying only to simultaneously engaged, collinear small-displacement increments. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 並聯恢復剛度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Parallel restoring stiffness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「並聯恢復剛度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Parallel restoring stiffness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩個同向並聯線性恢復分量k1=20、k2=30kN/m，受增量力10kN時x=10/(20+30)=0.20m；兩者均持續受力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two collinear parallel restoring components20and30kN/m remain engaged. An incremental10kN gives x=10/50=0.20m near that equilibrium. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Project each force-displacement response onto the same horizontal coordinate and check slack or sliding during small-motion tests.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設兩個同向並聯線性恢復分量k1=20、k2=30kN/m，受增量力10kN時x=10/(20+30)=0.20m；兩者均持續受力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume two collinear parallel restoring components20and30kN/m remain engaged. An incremental10kN gives x=10/50=0.20m near that equilibrium.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「並聯恢復剛度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Parallel restoring stiffness", which statement holds?
options: 理論全浸沒前的浮力餘量可以全部當成額外允許載重。
浮碼頭繫泊需求只由碼頭自身迎風面決定而不受靠船影響。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: All buoyant reserve up to full immersion can be used as permissible additional loading.
Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 並聯恢復剛度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel restoring stiffness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯恢復剛度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel restoring stiffness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。比較正反向剛度與轉動耦合，記錄適用平衡點，不能將局部斜率延伸到極端偏移。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Project each force-displacement response onto the same horizontal coordinate and check slack or sliding during small-motion tests. Compare opposite directions and rotational coupling, recording the equilibrium point instead of extending one local slope to extreme offsets of the dock. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。比較正反向剛度與轉動耦合，記錄適用平衡點，不能將局部斜率延伸到極端偏移。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Project each force-displacement response onto the same horizontal coordinate and check slack or sliding during small-motion tests. Compare opposite directions and rotational coupling, recording the equilibrium point instead of extending one local slope to extreme offsets of the dock.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一條纜失去預張會讓原先並聯分擔消失，總位移可能突然增加。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Loss of pretension removes a previously active parallel contribution and can sharply increase displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。比較正反向剛度與轉動耦合，記錄適用平衡點，不能將局部斜率延伸到極端偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Project each force-displacement response onto the same horizontal coordinate and check slack or sliding during small-motion tests. Compare opposite directions and rotational coupling, recording the equilibrium point instead of extending one local slope to extreme offsets of the dock.

knowledge.text: 將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。比較正反向剛度與轉動耦合，記錄適用平衡點，不能將局部斜率延伸到極端偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Project each force-displacement response onto the same horizontal coordinate and check slack or sliding during small-motion tests. Compare opposite directions and rotational coupling, recording the equilibrium point instead of extending one local slope to extreme offsets of the dock.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並聯恢復剛度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel restoring stiffness"?
options: 將每條纜的力位移投影到相同水平座標，檢查小位移試驗期間是否有鬆弛或滑移。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
纜繩總數增加一倍就保證每條纜在任何姿態都只受一半張力。

Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Doubling line count guarantees half the tension in every line under any geometry.

steps.title: 並聯恢復剛度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel restoring stiffness: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並聯恢復剛度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel restoring stiffness” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 一條纜失去預張會讓原先並聯分擔消失，總位移可能突然增加。若只用所有材料EA相加而未投影幾何，會高估真正提供的水平恢復剛度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Loss of pretension removes a previously active parallel contribution and can sharply increase displacement. Adding material EA values without geometric projection also overstates the horizontal restoring stiffness actually available to the floating structure. knowledge.title: 引橋坡度與行程
knowledge.text: 岸上平台固定而浮台升降，引橋坡度及端部滑移隨水位變化，與纜繩容許位移需要共同檢查。幾何斜率不是無障礙或使用合格證明，轉折、扶手、表面及動態運動亦有要求；在水平長度和實際橋長之間混用會導致角度與行程錯誤。
knowledge.textEn: A fixed shore platform and moving pontoon change gangway slope and end travel, which must be compatible with mooring offsets. Geometric grade is not proof of accessibility or acceptable use; transitions, rails, surfaces and dynamic movement matter too.

steps.title: 引橋坡度與行程：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Gangway slope and travel: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「引橋坡度與行程」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Gangway slope and travel” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設高差1.2m、水平投影12m，坡度10%、角度atan(1.2/12)=5.711°，斜長12.0599m；不是通行允收值。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume rise1.2m and horizontal run12m. Grade is10%,angle5.711° and sloping length12.0599m, not an access acceptance criterion. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：分別標示水平投影、實際橋長及端部可滑行範圍，在高低潮與浮台偏移組合下重畫幾何。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Distinguish horizontal run, span length and available end travel, redrawing geometry for combined tide and dock offsets.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

quiz.question: 依「引橋坡度與行程」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？

纜繩總數增加一倍就保證每條纜在任何姿態都只受一半張力。
optionsEn: Floating-dock mooring demand depends only on dock windage and is unaffected by attached vessels.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.

steps.title: 引橋坡度與行程：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Gangway slope and travel: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「引橋坡度與行程」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Gangway slope and travel” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分別標示水平投影、實際橋長及端部可滑行範圍，在高低潮與浮台偏移組合下重畫幾何。依適用無障礙及設施設計要求檢查全路徑，另記防滑、夾點與動態運動的驗證證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Distinguish horizontal run, span length and available end travel, redrawing geometry for combined tide and dock offsets. Check the entire route against applicable accessibility and facility requirements, retaining evidence for slip resistance, pinch interfaces and dynamic movement separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分別標示水平投影、實際橋長及端部可滑行範圍，在高低潮與浮台偏移組合下重畫幾何。依適用無障礙及設施設計要求檢查全路徑，另記防滑、夾點與動態運動的驗證證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Distinguish horizontal run, span length and available end travel, redrawing geometry for combined tide and dock offsets. Check the entire route against applicable accessibility and facility requirements, retaining evidence for slip resistance, pinch interfaces and dynamic movement separately.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看平均坡度會漏掉端部短折角，浮台水平偏移也可能耗盡滑座行程。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Average grade can hide a short end transition, and horizontal pontoon movement can exhaust sliding travel. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.titleEn: Gangway slope and travel: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「引橋坡度與行程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Buoyant reserve and compartment loss” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Mooring systems for floating docks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 浮筒損壞會改變可用排水體積及重量分布，分艙的目的之一是限制局部進水影響。完整密閉體的總容積不是損壞後可用浮力，且浸沒到頂的理論餘量不含動態乾舷需求；應分開完整和損艙狀態，追蹤何處先失去通達或穩定功能。 假設密閉可排水體積120m³、海水1025kg/m³、總質量100000kg，至全浸沒理論質量餘量23000kg；不是允許載重。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「浮力儲備與損艙」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Damage changes available buoyant volume and weight distribution, while compartments limit the extent of flooding. Total enclosed volume in the intact state is not available buoyancy after damage, and a theoretical reserve to deck immersion excludes dynamic freeboard needs. Intact and damaged states need separate treatment, identifying where access or stability is lost before relying on a total reserve number. Assume sealed displacement capacity120m³,seawater1025kg/m³ and mass100000kg. Theoretical reserve to full immersion is23000kg, not an allowable additional load. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Buoyant reserve and compartment loss” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Buoyant reserve and compartment loss" is correct?
options: 理論全浸沒前的浮力餘量可以全部當成額外允許載重。
浮筒損壞會改變可用排水體積及重量分布，分艙的目的之一是限制局部進水影響。
只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。
optionsEn: All buoyant reserve up to full immersion can be used as permissible additional loading.
Damage changes available buoyant volume and weight distribution, while compartments limit the extent of flooding.
Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves.
quiz.explanation: 浮筒損壞會改變可用排水體積及重量分布，分艙的目的之一是限制局部進水影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Damage changes available buoyant volume and weight distribution, while compartments limit the extent of flooding. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 浮力儲備與損艙：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Buoyant reserve and compartment loss: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「浮力儲備與損艙」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Buoyant reserve and compartment loss” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設密閉可排水體積120m³、海水1025kg/m³、總質量100000kg，至全浸沒理論質量餘量23000kg；不是允許載重。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sealed displacement capacity120m³,seawater1025kg/m³ and mass100000kg. Theoretical reserve to full immersion is23000kg, not an allowable additional load. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設密閉可排水體積120m³、海水1025kg/m³、總質量100000kg，至全浸沒理論質量餘量23000kg；不是允許載重。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume sealed displacement capacity120m³,seawater1025kg/m³ and mass100000kg. Theoretical reserve to full immersion is23000kg, not an allowable additional load.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「浮力儲備與損艙」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Buoyant reserve and compartment loss", which statement holds?
options: 遠處測到的平均潮流速度必定等於所有浮體表面的局部速度。
所有纜繩都具固定線性剛度且循環後不會有永久伸長。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A distant mean tidal-current measurement necessarily equals local velocity at every pontoon surface.
Every mooring line has constant linear stiffness and no permanent extension after cycling.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 浮力儲備與損艙：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Buoyant reserve and compartment loss: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「浮力儲備與損艙」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Buoyant reserve and compartment loss” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。將理論浮力餘量與最低乾舷、穩性及使用條件分開，不讓總容積掩蓋局部進水。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection. Draw intact and specified damaged attitudes separately and distinguish theoretical buoyant reserve from freeboard, stability and use requirements so total volume does not hide localized flooding. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。將理論浮力餘量與最低乾舷、穩性及使用條件分開，不讓總容積掩蓋局部進水。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection. Draw intact and specified damaged attitudes separately and distinguish theoretical buoyant reserve from freeboard, stability and use requirements so total volume does not hide localized flooding.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：某一端進水可能先造成傾斜和引橋不對位，總剩餘浮力尚大也不表示功能完整。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flooding at one end can first cause heel and gangway misalignment even with substantial remaining total buoyancy. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。將理論浮力餘量與最低乾舷、穩性及使用條件分開，不讓總容積掩蓋局部進水。
knowledge.textEn: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection. Draw intact and specified damaged attitudes separately and distinguish theoretical buoyant reserve from freeboard, stability and use requirements so total volume does not hide localized flooding.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。將理論浮力餘量與最低乾舷、穩性及使用條件分開，不讓總容積掩蓋局部進水。
knowledge.textEn: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection. Draw intact and specified damaged attitudes separately and distinguish theoretical buoyant reserve from freeboard, stability and use requirements so total volume does not hide localized flooding.

quiz.question: 要驗證「浮力儲備與損艙」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Buoyant reserve and compartment loss"?
options: 建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
所有纜的軸向剛度相加就是任何方向的浮台水平剛度。
optionsEn: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Adding all axial line stiffnesses gives the pontoon's horizontal stiffness in every direction.
quiz.explanation: 建立分艙體積和重量位置清單，核對水密檢查及進水警示，分別畫完整與指定損艙吃水姿態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Inventory compartment volumes and weight locations, checking watertightness and flooding detection. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 浮力儲備與損艙：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Buoyant reserve and compartment loss: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮力儲備與損艙」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Buoyant reserve and compartment loss” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 某一端進水可能先造成傾斜和引橋不對位，總剩餘浮力尚大也不表示功能完整。把全浸沒餘量當可加載量，會忽略波浪、進水和人員偏載所需的空間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flooding at one end can first cause heel and gangway misalignment even with substantial remaining total buoyancy. Treating reserve to full immersion as permissible loading ignores the space needed for waves, flooding and eccentric occupancy. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設密閉可排水體積120m³、海水1025kg/m³、總質量100000kg，至全浸沒理論質量餘量23000kg；不是允許載重。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Theoretical reserve to full immersion is23000kg, not an allowable additional load.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「理論全浸沒前的浮力餘量可以全部當成額外允許載重。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "All buoyant reserve up to full immersion can be used as permissible additional loading." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 某一端進水可能先造成傾斜和引橋不對位，總剩餘浮力尚大也不表示功能完整。把全浸沒餘量當可加載量，會忽略波浪、進水和人員偏載所需的空間。
knowledge.textEn: Flooding at one end can first cause heel and gangway misalignment even with substantial remaining total buoyancy. Treating reserve to full immersion as permissible loading ignores the space needed for waves, flooding and eccentric occupancy.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮力儲備與損艙」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Buoyant reserve and compartment loss" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
某一端進水可能先造成傾斜和引橋不對位，總剩餘浮力尚大也不表示功能完整。
只要總浮力大於總重量就代表偏載和波浪下所有角點都安全。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Flooding at one end can first cause heel and gangway misalignment even with substantial remaining total buoyancy.
Total buoyancy exceeding weight guarantees every corner remains safe under eccentric loading and waves.
quiz.explanation: 某一端進水可能先造成傾斜和引橋不對位，總剩餘浮力尚大也不表示功能完整。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flooding at one end can first cause heel and gangway misalignment even with substantial remaining total buoyancy. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
courses.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
courses.summary: 從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統
courses.focusEn: Understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。假設升水高度由10加10%至11m、空閘平面固定，水量由90000增至99000m³；若另假設平均流量仍150m³/s，時間600增至660s，但實際流量時程需重算。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry. Increasing lift10% from10to11m at fixed empty-chamber plan increases volume90000to99000m³. If mean discharge is separately held at150m³/s, time rises600to660s; the actual hydrograph must be recalculated. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

facts: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設所需補水量90000m³、整段平均流量150m³/s，t=V/Qavg=600s=10min；不表示瞬時流量恆定。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設有效面積9000m²、淨入流150m³/s，dη/dt=Q/A=0.01667m/s=1m/min；僅是空間平均。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設固定孔口Cd=0.70、面積8m²、瞬時水頭差5m，Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s；準定常示意。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ac=9000m²、Cd=0.70、孔口8m²、固定上游，水頭由10降0.1m，t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設同一參考流速v=4m/s、局部總係數K=3，hL=Kv²/(2g)=2.446m；只合併同速度基準的損失。
factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume required volume90000m³ and interval-mean discharge150m³/s. t=V/Qavg=600s=10min, without implying constant instantaneous flow.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume effective area9000m² and net inflow150m³/s. Mean rise Q/A=0.01667m/s=1m/min, not every local surface velocity.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume fixed opening Cd=0.70,area8m² and instantaneous head difference5m. Quasi-steady Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s, excluding acceleration effects.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume chamber area9000m²,Cd=0.70,opening8m² and fixed upper level. Reducing head10to0.1m gives t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume common reference velocity4m/s and total local coefficient K=3. hL=Kv²/(2g)=2.446m, combining only coefficients on that velocity basis.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「閘室有效水量」與「平均流量與灌水時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Effective chamber water volume" and "Mean discharge and filling time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 閘室有效水量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective chamber water volume: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「閘室有效水量」如何影響大型船閘灌排水系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective chamber water volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘室水位變化所需水量由有效水平面積積分，船舶排水、局部台階與側室會影響實際幾何。矩形空閘示意只是基本量級，水量還要連到上游庫與下游河段收支；不能把一次升降量直接當成每日取水量，因為節水池與交通次序不同。 假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「閘室有效水量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Required water volume follows integration of effective horizontal area with level; vessel displacement, steps and side spaces modify geometry. An empty rectangular chamber supplies a basic scale only, which must connect to upstream and downstream balances. One level-change volume is not daily freshwater demand because water-saving basins, traffic direction and operating sequences alter the complete system accounting. Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective chamber water volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閘室全部容積就是每次通航必須重新消耗的淡水量。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire chamber volume is fresh water that must be consumed anew on every transit." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「閘室有效水量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective chamber water volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 閘室水位變化所需水量由有效水平面積積分，船舶排水、局部台階與側室會影響實際幾何。矩形空閘示意只是基本量級，水量還要連到上游庫與下游河段收支；不能把一次升降量直接當成每日取水量，因為節水池與交通次序不同。
knowledge.textEn: Required water volume follows integration of effective horizontal area with level; vessel displacement, steps and side spaces modify geometry. An empty rectangular chamber supplies a basic scale only, which must connect to upstream and downstream balances.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閘室全部容積就是每次通航必須重新消耗的淡水量。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire chamber volume is fresh water that must be consumed anew on every transit. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「閘室有效水量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective chamber water volume" is correct?
options: 閘室全部容積就是每次通航必須重新消耗的淡水量。
閘室水位變化所需水量由有效水平面積積分，船舶排水、局部台階與側室會影響實際幾何。
峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。
optionsEn: The entire chamber volume is fresh water that must be consumed anew on every transit.
Required water volume follows integration of effective horizontal area with level; vessel displacement, steps and side spaces modify geometry.
Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume.
quiz.explanation: 閘室水位變化所需水量由有效水平面積積分，船舶排水、局部台階與側室會影響實際幾何。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Required water volume follows integration of effective horizontal area with level; vessel displacement, steps and side spaces modify geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 閘室有效水量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective chamber water volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「閘室有效水量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective chamber water volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「閘室有效水量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective chamber water volume", which statement holds?
options: 閥門開度固定時流量就不受兩側水頭差變化影響。
廊道總水頭損失較小就保證船閘內水流一定更均勻。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: A fixed valve opening makes flow independent of the changing head difference.
Lower total culvert head loss guarantees a more uniform flow field inside the lock.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 閘室有效水量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Effective chamber water volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「閘室有效水量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective chamber water volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。將每次灌排的來源去向畫成收支圖，核對節水交換是否重複計入，並保留不同交通方向的水量差異。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment. Map source and destination for each filling step, checking duplicated saving-basin exchange and retaining water-budget differences between traffic directions instead of assuming all lockages are identical. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。將每次灌排的來源去向畫成收支圖，核對節水交換是否重複計入，並保留不同交通方向的水量差異。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment. Map source and destination for each filling step, checking duplicated saving-basin exchange and retaining water-budget differences between traffic directions instead of assuming all lockages are identical.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把總閘室容積當升降用水會高估單次需求，忽略船舶與連通空間又可能漏掉水位相關面積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using total chamber volume as lift water overstates demand, while ignored vessels or connected spaces misstate level-dependent area. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。將每次灌排的來源去向畫成收支圖，核對節水交換是否重複計入，並保留不同交通方向的水量差異。
knowledge.textEn: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment. Map source and destination for each filling step, checking duplicated saving-basin exchange and retaining water-budget differences between traffic directions instead of assuming all lockages are identical.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。將每次灌排的來源去向畫成收支圖，核對節水交換是否重複計入，並保留不同交通方向的水量差異。
knowledge.textEn: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment. Map source and destination for each filling step, checking duplicated saving-basin exchange and retaining water-budget differences between traffic directions instead of assuming all lockages are identical.

quiz.question: 要驗證「閘室有效水量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Effective chamber water volume"?
options: 用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
任何速度變化無論多慢都會產生相同的焦可夫斯基峰值水錘。
optionsEn: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Every velocity change produces the same Joukowsky peak regardless of how slowly it occurs.
quiz.explanation: 用閘室各高程平面面積核對容積曲線，標明是否含船舶及側廊道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Verify the volume-elevation curve from sectional areas, identifying vessel and side-space treatment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 閘室有效水量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective chamber water volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「閘室有效水量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective chamber water volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把總閘室容積當升降用水會高估單次需求，忽略船舶與連通空間又可能漏掉水位相關面積。若把回收水當新取水，則會錯判整個水源系統的壓力。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using total chamber volume as lift water overstates demand, while ignored vessels or connected spaces misstate level-dependent area. Counting recovered water as fresh withdrawal then distorts the load placed on the wider source-water system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設空閘長300m、寬30m且垂直壁，水位升10m，ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³；不含節水池或船舶幾何。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume an empty vertical-sided chamber300m long and30m wide with a10m rise. ΔV=LBΔh=90000m³, excluding basins and vessel geometry.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閘室全部容積就是每次通航必須重新消耗的淡水量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The entire chamber volume is fresh water that must be consumed anew on every transit." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把總閘室容積當升降用水會高估單次需求，忽略船舶與連通空間又可能漏掉水位相關面積。若把回收水當新取水，則會錯判整個水源系統的壓力。
knowledge.textEn: Using total chamber volume as lift water overstates demand, while ignored vessels or connected spaces misstate level-dependent area. Counting recovered water as fresh withdrawal then distorts the load placed on the wider source-water system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「閘室有效水量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Effective chamber water volume" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
把總閘室容積當升降用水會高估單次需求，忽略船舶與連通空間又可能漏掉水位相關面積。
峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using total chamber volume as lift water overstates demand, while ignored vessels or connected spaces misstate level-dependent area.
Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume.
quiz.explanation: 把總閘室容積當升降用水會高估單次需求，忽略船舶與連通空間又可能漏掉水位相關面積。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using total chamber volume as lift water overstates demand, while ignored vessels or connected spaces misstate level-dependent area. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.objective: 說明「平均流量與灌水時間」如何影響大型船閘灌排水系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean discharge and filling time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 灌水時間由流量時程積分決定，平均流量只是一項事後或假設摘要。水頭隨閘室上升而降低，閥門與廊道慣性又使流量不會立即達峰；因此恆流除法適合收支檢查，不能生成現場操作時程，更不能只以最短時間評估系統功能。 假設所需補水量90000m³、整段平均流量150m³/s，t=V/Qavg=600s=10min；不表示瞬時流量恆定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平均流量與灌水時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Filling duration follows integration of the discharge history, with mean discharge merely a summary or assumption. Head decreases as the chamber rises, and valves plus culvert inertia prevent instantaneous peak flow. Constant-flow division checks accounting but cannot generate an operational schedule or establish performance merely by minimizing elapsed time without considering water-surface disturbance and vessel response. Assume required volume90000m³ and interval-mean discharge150m³/s. t=V/Qavg=600s=10min, without implying constant instantaneous flow. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean discharge and filling time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平均流量與灌水時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean discharge and filling time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Filling duration follows integration of the discharge history, with mean discharge merely a summary or assumption. Head decreases as the chamber rises, and valves plus culvert inertia prevent instantaneous peak flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平均流量與灌水時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean discharge and filling time" is correct?
options: 峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。
平均水位上升率穩定就證明閘室所有位置都沒有水面振盪。
灌水時間由流量時程積分決定，平均流量只是一項事後或假設摘要。
optionsEn: Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume.
A steady mean rise proves that no surface oscillation exists anywhere in the chamber.

Assume required volume90000m³ and interval-mean discharge150m³/s. t=V/Qavg=600s=10min, without implying constant instantaneous flow. steps.title: 平均流量與灌水時間：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Mean discharge and filling time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 以峰值流量計算全程會低估灌水時間，未量到的漏流則讓容積核對不閉合。更快的平均灌水也可能伴隨更大水面坡度，不能直接解讀為整體品質提升。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using peak flow throughout understates filling time, while unmeasured leakage prevents volume closure. Faster average filling may accompany larger surface gradients, so speed alone cannot be interpreted as an improvement in complete system performance. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設所需補水量90000m³、整段平均流量150m³/s，t=V/Qavg=600s=10min；不表示瞬時流量恆定。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Assume required volume90000m³ and interval-mean discharge150m³/s. t=V/Qavg=600s=10min, without implying constant instantaneous flow.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「峰值流量除以總水量即可準確代表整個灌排所需時間。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Peak discharge alone provides an accurate filling duration for the complete chamber volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式

knowledge.textEn: Using peak flow throughout understates filling time, while unmeasured leakage prevents volume closure. Faster average filling may accompany larger surface gradients, so speed alone cannot be interpreted as an improvement in complete system performance.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「平均流量與灌水時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

平均水位上升率穩定就證明閘室所有位置都沒有水面振盪。

A steady mean rise proves that no surface oscillation exists anywhere in the chamber.
Using peak flow throughout understates filling time, while unmeasured leakage prevents volume closure.

steps.instructionEn: Continuity converts net inflow into mean level rise, but a long chamber can simultaneously contain waves and local jets. Assume effective area9000m² and net inflow150m³/s. Mean rise Q/A=0.01667m/s=1m/min, not every local surface velocity. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level rise and spatial uniformity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Orifice head-discharge relation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閥口和孔口將水頭轉成流速，縮流及損失由流量係數近似。固定開口準定常公式忽略廊道加速度與水頭快速變化，局部係數又受開度和雷諾數影響；實際灌排需追蹤上游水位、閘內水位及開度歷程，不能只以初始最大水頭推全程。 假設固定孔口Cd=0.70、面積8m²、瞬時水頭差5m，Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s；準定常示意。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔口水頭流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An opening converts head into flow, with a discharge coefficient approximating contraction and losses. A fixed-opening quasi-steady relation omits culvert acceleration and rapid head variation, while coefficient depends on opening and flow regime. Actual filling must track upper level, chamber level and valve position through time rather than extending the maximum initial head over the whole cycle. Assume fixed opening Cd=0.70,area8m² and instantaneous head difference5m. Quasi-steady Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s, excluding acceleration effects. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Orifice head-discharge relation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。

An opening converts head into flow, with a discharge coefficient approximating contraction and losses.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

optionsEn: Check that opening area matches actual position and compare simultaneous heads and discharge, identifying coefficient changes through the cycle.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The entire chamber volume is fresh water that must be consumed anew on every transit.
quiz.explanation: 核對孔口面積是否對應實際開度，同步比較兩側總水頭與流量，辨識係數在不同階段是否改變。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Check that opening area matches actual position and compare simultaneous heads and discharge, identifying coefficient changes through the cycle. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 孔口水頭流量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Orifice head-discharge relation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔口水頭流量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Orifice head-discharge relation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 開度相同而上游水頭不同會產生不同流量，廊道慣性又可能讓流量落後於水頭。沿用固定係數湊合資料，可能掩蓋閥口損傷或旁通流路改變。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal opening with different upstream head gives different discharge, and culvert inertia can delay the response. Tuning one fixed coefficient to fit observations may conceal damaged openings or changes in bypass paths through the system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設固定孔口Cd=0.70、面積8m²、瞬時水頭差5m，Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s；準定常示意。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Quasi-steady Q=CdA√(2gH)=55.465m³/s, excluding acceleration effects.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閥門開度固定時流量就不受兩側水頭差變化影響。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A fixed valve opening makes flow independent of the changing head difference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 開度相同而上游水頭不同會產生不同流量，廊道慣性又可能讓流量落後於水頭。沿用固定係數湊合資料，可能掩蓋閥口損傷或旁通流路改變。
knowledge.textEn: Equal opening with different upstream head gives different discharge, and culvert inertia can delay the response. Tuning one fixed coefficient to fit observations may conceal damaged openings or changes in bypass paths through the system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔口水頭流量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Orifice head-discharge relation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
開度相同而上游水頭不同會產生不同流量，廊道慣性又可能讓流量落後於水頭。
只要某一瞬間兩側水位相等就代表後續不會再有壓差。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Equal opening with different upstream head gives different discharge, and culvert inertia can delay the response.
One instant of equal levels proves that no pressure difference can develop afterward.
quiz.explanation: 開度相同而上游水頭不同會產生不同流量，廊道慣性又可能讓流量落後於水頭。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal opening with different upstream head gives different discharge, and culvert inertia can delay the response. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平水末段時間」與「廊道局部水頭損失」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Late-stage equalization time" and "Local culvert head losses": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平水末段時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Late-stage equalization time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平水末段時間」如何影響大型船閘灌排水系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Late-stage equalization time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 閘內水位接近上游時水頭衰減，最後一段升水通常比簡單線性外推慢。固定上游庫、固定孔口且無慣性的積分模型可以顯示平方根關係，真實末段還有振盪、漏水及控制判定；剩餘水頭門檻只是數學終點，不是開門或通航條件。 假設Ac=9000m²、Cd=0.70、孔口8m²、固定上游，水頭由10降0.1m，t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平水末段時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: As the chamber approaches the upper level, declining head slows the final rise compared with a linear extrapolation. Integration for a fixed reservoir and opening without inertia reveals the square-root relation. Actual late-stage behavior includes oscillation, leakage and control decisions; a residual-head endpoint in this model is mathematical only, not a gate-opening or transit criterion. Assume chamber area9000m²,Cd=0.70,opening8m² and fixed upper level. Reducing head10to0.1m gives t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Late-stage equalization time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要某一瞬間兩側水位相等就代表後續不會再有壓差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "One instant of equal levels proves that no pressure difference can develop afterward." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平水末段時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Late-stage equalization time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平水末段時間
knowledge.text: 閘內水位接近上游時水頭衰減，最後一段升水通常比簡單線性外推慢。固定上游庫、固定孔口且無慣性的積分模型可以顯示平方根關係，真實末段還有振盪、漏水及控制判定；剩餘水頭門檻只是數學終點，不是開門或通航條件。
knowledge.textEn: As the chamber approaches the upper level, declining head slows the final rise compared with a linear extrapolation. Integration for a fixed reservoir and opening without inertia reveals the square-root relation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要某一瞬間兩側水位相等就代表後續不會再有壓差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: One instant of equal levels proves that no pressure difference can develop afterward. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「平水末段時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Late-stage equalization time" is correct?
options: 只要某一瞬間兩側水位相等就代表後續不會再有壓差。
廊道總水頭損失較小就保證船閘內水流一定更均勻。
閘內水位接近上游時水頭衰減，最後一段升水通常比簡單線性外推慢。
optionsEn: One instant of equal levels proves that no pressure difference can develop afterward.
Lower total culvert head loss guarantees a more uniform flow field inside the lock.
As the chamber approaches the upper level, declining head slows the final rise compared with a linear extrapolation.
quiz.explanation: 閘內水位接近上游時水頭衰減，最後一段升水通常比簡單線性外推慢。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: As the chamber approaches the upper level, declining head slows the final rise compared with a linear extrapolation. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 平水末段時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Late-stage equalization time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「平水末段時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Late-stage equalization time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ac=9000m²、Cd=0.70、孔口8m²、固定上游，水頭由10降0.1m，t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume chamber area9000m²,Cd=0.70,opening8m² and fixed upper level. Reducing head10to0.1m gives t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：明列上游是否可當固定水位及孔口是否全程不變，將水頭平方根對時間作圖檢查近似。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: State whether upper level and opening remain fixed and plot square-root head against time to test the approximation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設Ac=9000m²、Cd=0.70、孔口8m²、固定上游，水頭由10降0.1m，t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume chamber area9000m²,Cd=0.70,opening8m² and fixed upper level. Reducing head10to0.1m gives t=2Ac(√10−√0.1)/(CdA√2g)=2065.3s.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「平水末段時間」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Late-stage equalization time", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
任何速度變化無論多慢都會產生相同的焦可夫斯基峰值水錘。
船舶所有繫纜力都可由兩端水位差單獨精確決定。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
Every velocity change produces the same Joukowsky peak regardless of how slowly it occurs.
The complete vessel mooring force is exactly determined by end-to-end level difference alone.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 平水末段時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Late-stage equalization time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「平水末段時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Late-stage equalization time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 明列上游是否可當固定水位及孔口是否全程不變，將水頭平方根對時間作圖檢查近似。保存末段振盪和測量解析度，另由正式系統要求判定平水條件，不以本算例終點操作閘門。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: State whether upper level and opening remain fixed and plot square-root head against time to test the approximation. Retain late oscillation and measurement resolution, leaving equalization criteria to the approved system rather than using this illustrative endpoint to operate a gate. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
廊道總水頭損失較小就保證船閘內水流一定更均勻。
上游庫面積有限時兩側都會變位，套固定庫模型會算錯時間；末段壓力振盪則可能使瞬間水位相等後再次分離。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Lower total culvert head loss guarantees a more uniform flow field inside the lock.
With finite upper storage, both levels move and the fixed-reservoir estimate becomes inaccurate.
quiz.explanation: 上游庫面積有限時兩側都會變位，套固定庫模型會算錯時間；末段壓力振盪則可能使瞬間水位相等後再次分離。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: With finite upper storage, both levels move and the fixed-reservoir estimate becomes inaccurate. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 廊道局部水頭損失：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local culvert head losses: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「廊道局部水頭損失」如何影響大型船閘灌排水系統的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local culvert head losses” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 彎道、分岔和閥件將能量耗散成紊流，局部損失係數需指定參考速度。把不同截面速度下的係數直接相加會失去一致性，且閥門位置隨時間改變；低損失不一定代表閘內流場較均勻，流量分配和射流方向仍要另行檢驗。 假設同一參考流速v=4m/s、局部總係數K=3，hL=Kv²/(2g)=2.446m；只合併同速度基準的損失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「廊道局部水頭損失」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Bends, junctions and valves dissipate energy through turbulence, with each coefficient tied to a reference velocity. Adding coefficients based on different areas is inconsistent, and valve position changes through time. Low total loss does not necessarily produce more uniform chamber flow; distribution and jet direction require separate assessment rather than being inferred from an apparently efficient hydraulic path. Assume common reference velocity4m/s and total local coefficient K=3. hL=Kv²/(2g)=2.446m, combining only coefficients on that velocity basis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local culvert head losses” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「廊道總水頭損失較小就保證船閘內水流一定更均勻。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower total culvert head loss guarantees a more uniform flow field inside the lock." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「廊道局部水頭損失」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local culvert head losses”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.
