steps.titleEn: Evaporation and basin footprint: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「蒸發與面積代價」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Evaporation and basin footprint” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 取得相同日期的氣象、池位及降雨資料，檢查蒸發量是否為水面而非陸地估值。把每日水面積分與循環用水分欄，並比較不同季節，不把一次高溫日當成全年代表。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Match weather, level and rainfall dates and verify that evaporation represents open water rather than land. Separate daily area integration from cycle demand and compare seasons without making one hot day representative of the full operational year. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：取得相同日期的氣象、池位及降雨資料，檢查蒸發量是否為水面而非陸地估值。把每日水面積分與循環用水分欄，並比較不同季節，不把一次高溫日當成全年代表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Match weather, level and rainfall dates and verify that evaporation represents open water rather than land. Separate daily area integration from cycle demand and compare seasons without making one hot day representative of the full operational year.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用池底面積代替斜坡池的水面可能低估蒸發，重複在每次通航扣日損失則嚴重高估。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using bottom area for a sloped basin understates exposed water, while deducting daily loss at each lockage grossly overstates it. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「蒸發與面積代價」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Evaporation and basin footprint"?
options: 只要結構分析模型看起來合理，就可以省略現場量測與試驗。
節水池回收了多少比例的水就必然回收同樣比例的能量。
取得相同日期的氣象、池位及降雨資料，檢查蒸發量是否為水面而非陸地估值。
optionsEn: If the structural model looks reasonable, site measurement and testing can be skipped.
The fraction of water reused by a basin must equal the fraction of energy recovered.
Match weather, level and rainfall dates and verify that evaporation represents open water rather than land.
quiz.explanation: 取得相同日期的氣象、池位及降雨資料，檢查蒸發量是否為水面而非陸地估值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Match weather, level and rainfall dates and verify that evaporation represents open water rather than land. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 蒸發與面積代價：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Evaporation and basin footprint: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「蒸發與面積代價」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Evaporation and basin footprint” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用池底面積代替斜坡池的水面可能低估蒸發，重複在每次通航扣日損失則嚴重高估。把降雨直接抵銷平均蒸發，還可能漏掉溢流時未能保存的雨水。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using bottom area for a sloped basin understates exposed water, while deducting daily loss at each lockage grossly overstates it. Offsetting mean rainfall can also overlook water that overflowed and was never retained. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設總水面12000m²、當日蒸發深0.005m，損失AE=60m³/day；不是每次通航都損失60m³。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Loss AE=60m³/day, not60m³ for every lockage.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「每日蒸發方量應隨當天通航次數再乘一次作為總損失。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Daily evaporation volume must be multiplied again by the day's number of lockages." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 用池底面積代替斜坡池的水面可能低估蒸發，重複在每次通航扣日損失則嚴重高估。把降雨直接抵銷平均蒸發，還可能漏掉溢流時未能保存的雨水。
knowledge.textEn: Using bottom area for a sloped basin understates exposed water, while deducting daily loss at each lockage grossly overstates it. Offsetting mean rainfall can also overlook water that overflowed and was never retained.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「蒸發與面積代價」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Evaporation and basin footprint" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 用池底面積代替斜坡池的水面可能低估蒸發，重複在每次通航扣日損失則嚴重高估。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。
optionsEn: Using bottom area for a sloped basin understates exposed water, while deducting daily loss at each lockage grossly overstates it.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels.
quiz.explanation: 用池底面積代替斜坡池的水面可能低估蒸發，重複在每次通航扣日損失則嚴重高估。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using bottom area for a sloped basin understates exposed water, while deducting daily loss at each lockage grossly overstates it. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「連通廊道瞬時流量」與「有限水頭的交換時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge" and "Exchange time at finite residual head": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 連通廊道瞬時流量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「連通廊道瞬時流量」如何影響閘室節水池設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-saving basins for lock chambers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 連通初期水頭差較大，流量會隨兩池水位接近而降低，固定孔口式只代表某個瞬間。閥門開度、進出口和廊道損失都會影響等效係數，慣性與水面振盪則超出準穩態模型；單一初始流量不可直接乘整段時間宣稱填池完成。 假設等效Cd=0.70、開口4m²、水頭差2m，Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s；僅作瞬時準穩態示意。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「連通廊道瞬時流量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Initial head difference drives a larger flow that falls as levels converge, so a fixed-orifice relation describes one instant. Valve position, entrances and culvert losses determine the effective coefficient, while inertia and surface oscillation lie outside the quasi-steady model. Initial discharge cannot simply be multiplied by the entire exchange duration to establish completion. Assume effective Cd=0.70,opening4m² and head difference2m. Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s is an instantaneous quasi-steady illustration. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「連通廊道瞬時流量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 連通廊道瞬時流量
knowledge.text: 連通初期水頭差較大，流量會隨兩池水位接近而降低，固定孔口式只代表某個瞬間。閥門開度、進出口和廊道損失都會影響等效係數，慣性與水面振盪則超出準穩態模型；單一初始流量不可直接乘整段時間宣稱填池完成。
knowledge.textEn: Initial head difference drives a larger flow that falls as levels converge, so a fixed-orifice relation describes one instant. Valve position, entrances and culvert losses determine the effective coefficient, while inertia and surface oscillation lie outside the quasi-steady model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「連通廊道瞬時流量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge" is correct?
options: 初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。
連通初期水頭差較大，流量會隨兩池水位接近而降低，固定孔口式只代表某個瞬間。
節水池面積再小也可以在時間計算中一直當作固定水位。
optionsEn: The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels.
Initial head difference drives a larger flow that falls as levels converge, so a fixed-orifice relation describes one instant.
A water-saving basin of any size may be treated as a fixed-level reservoir throughout the timing calculation.
quiz.explanation: 連通初期水頭差較大，流量會隨兩池水位接近而降低，固定孔口式只代表某個瞬間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial head difference drives a larger flow that falls as levels converge, so a fixed-orifice relation describes one instant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 連通廊道瞬時流量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「連通廊道瞬時流量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等效Cd=0.70、開口4m²、水頭差2m，Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s；僅作瞬時準穩態示意。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume effective Cd=0.70,opening4m² and head difference2m. Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s is an instantaneous quasi-steady illustration. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record both levels, valve position and discharge together, plotting coefficient applicability against the head history.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設等效Cd=0.70、開口4m²、水頭差2m，Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s；僅作瞬時準穩態示意。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume effective Cd=0.70,opening4m² and head difference2m. Q=Cd a√(2gΔh)=17.54m³/s is an instantaneous quasi-steady illustration.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「連通廊道瞬時流量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge", which statement holds?
options: 回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。
面積不同的兩個池連通後最終水位仍是原水位的算術平均。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent.
Connected basins of unequal area always finish at the arithmetic mean of their starting levels.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 連通廊道瞬時流量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「連通廊道瞬時流量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。檢查流量是否有相位延遲或反轉，保留瞬態偏差，不用調高係數掩蓋尚未建立的流動。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record both levels, valve position and discharge together, plotting coefficient applicability against the head history. Check lag and reversals and retain transient departures rather than increasing the coefficient to conceal flow that has not yet developed. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。檢查流量是否有相位延遲或反轉，保留瞬態偏差，不用調高係數掩蓋尚未建立的流動。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record both levels, valve position and discharge together, plotting coefficient applicability against the head history. Check lag and reversals and retain transient departures rather than increasing the coefficient to conceal flow that has not yet developed.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：初始流量外推會低估等水位時間，誤把閥位百分比當有效面積也會錯估水量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Extrapolating initial discharge understates equalization time, and valve-position percentage need not equal open-area fraction. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.text: 同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。檢查流量是否有相位延遲或反轉，保留瞬態偏差，不用調高係數掩蓋尚未建立的流動。
knowledge.textEn: Record both levels, valve position and discharge together, plotting coefficient applicability against the head history. Check lag and reversals and retain transient departures rather than increasing the coefficient to conceal flow that has not yet developed.

knowledge.text: 同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。檢查流量是否有相位延遲或反轉，保留瞬態偏差，不用調高係數掩蓋尚未建立的流動。
knowledge.textEn: Record both levels, valve position and discharge together, plotting coefficient applicability against the head history. Check lag and reversals and retain transient departures rather than increasing the coefficient to conceal flow that has not yet developed.

quiz.question: 要驗證「連通廊道瞬時流量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge"?
options: 同步記兩端水位、閥位和流量，將等效係數適用範圍與水頭歷程畫在一起。

steps.title: 連通廊道瞬時流量：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 初始流量外推會低估等水位時間，誤把閥位百分比當有效面積也會錯估水量。快速變動時壓力和流速不再同步，甚至可能出現準穩態式無法描述的反向流。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extrapolating initial discharge understates equalization time, and valve-position percentage need not equal open-area fraction. During rapid change pressure and velocity lose synchronization and may reverse in ways the quasi-steady expression cannot represent. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Exchange time at finite residual head” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-saving basins for lock chambers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 計算交換時間需同時更新兩個池水位，面積較小的一側變化較快，因而水頭衰減不是固定斜率。準穩態積分可到指定殘餘水頭，但接近等水位時慣性和閥門控制會更重要；模型只能提供辨識尺度，不能替實際控制系統設定關閥時刻。 假設固定池面積A1=3000、A2=6000m²、a=4m²、Cd=0.7，k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2)；水頭差Δh由6降0.1m，準穩態時間t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有限水頭的交換時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Exchange-time calculation updates both levels, with the smaller area moving faster so head does not decay linearly. A quasi-steady integral can reach a specified residual head, but inertia and valve control become important near equality. The result provides a diagnostic timescale rather than a command for closing a real valve or authorizing an operating sequence. Assume areas3000,6000m²,opening4m²,Cd=0.7. With k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2), reducing head6to0.1m takes t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Exchange time at finite residual head” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設固定池面積A1=3000、A2=6000m²、a=4m²、Cd=0.7，k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2)；水頭差Δh由6降0.1m，準穩態時間t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume areas3000,6000m²,opening4m²,Cd=0.7. With k=Cd a√(2g)(1/A1+1/A2), reducing head6to0.1m takes t=2(√6−√0.1)/k=688.0s. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「有限水頭的交換時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Exchange time at finite residual head" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
兩支水位儀讀值一致就能排除共同高程基準偏差。
只更新閘室而固定池位會低估水頭衰減，導致過短交換時間。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Agreement between two level sensors rules out any shared vertical-datum bias.
Updating only the chamber while holding the basin fixed understates head decay and shortens exchange time.
quiz.explanation: 只更新閘室而固定池位會低估水頭衰減，導致過短交換時間。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Updating only the chamber while holding the basin fixed understates head decay and shortens exchange time. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水位偏差與庫容」與「池體停用與供水韌性」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Level bias and storage error" and "Basin outage and supply resilience": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水位偏差與庫容：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Level bias and storage error: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水位偏差與庫容」如何影響閘室節水池設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Level bias and storage error” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-saving basins for lock chambers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大面積節水池的水位微小偏差會轉成顯著方量，更多讀值不能自動消除共同零點誤差。位準轉換、儀器漂移及水面擺動應分別處理，庫容曲線亦需適用目前幾何；這項誤差可能使回用績效看似改善，卻沒有真正降低外部補水。 假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水位偏差與庫容」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A small level bias over a large basin produces substantial storage error, and more readings do not remove a shared zero offset. Datum conversion, instrument drift and surface oscillation require separate treatment, as does the validity of the current storage curve. Such error can create apparent improvement in reuse while external makeup demand remains unchanged. Assume fixed area6000m² and coherent level bias0.010m. Storage bias Aδz=60m³; additional readings do not automatically eliminate this systematic error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Level bias and storage error” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩支水位儀讀值一致就能排除共同高程基準偏差。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two level sensors rules out any shared vertical-datum bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水位偏差與庫容」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Level bias and storage error”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 水位偏差與庫容
knowledge.text: 大面積節水池的水位微小偏差會轉成顯著方量，更多讀值不能自動消除共同零點誤差。位準轉換、儀器漂移及水面擺動應分別處理，庫容曲線亦需適用目前幾何；這項誤差可能使回用績效看似改善，卻沒有真正降低外部補水。
knowledge.textEn: A small level bias over a large basin produces substantial storage error, and more readings do not remove a shared zero offset. Datum conversion, instrument drift and surface oscillation require separate treatment, as does the validity of the current storage curve.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩支水位儀讀值一致就能排除共同高程基準偏差。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement between two level sensors rules out any shared vertical-datum bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「水位偏差與庫容」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Level bias and storage error" is correct?
options: 大面積節水池的水位微小偏差會轉成顯著方量，更多讀值不能自動消除共同零點誤差。
兩支水位儀讀值一致就能排除共同高程基準偏差。
回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。
optionsEn: A small level bias over a large basin produces substantial storage error, and more readings do not remove a shared zero offset.
Agreement between two level sensors rules out any shared vertical-datum bias.
A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent.
quiz.explanation: 大面積節水池的水位微小偏差會轉成顯著方量，更多讀值不能自動消除共同零點誤差。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A small level bias over a large basin produces substantial storage error, and more readings do not remove a shared zero offset. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 水位偏差與庫容：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Level bias and storage error: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「水位偏差與庫容」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Level bias and storage error” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume fixed area6000m² and coherent level bias0.010m. Storage bias Aδz=60m³; additional readings do not automatically eliminate this systematic error. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立穩定基準檢查水位零點，將兩儀器共用基準與獨立誤差分開。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check level zero against independent stable control, separating shared datum error from independent sensor uncertainty.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume fixed area6000m² and coherent level bias0.010m. Storage bias Aδz=60m³; additional readings do not automatically eliminate this systematic error.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「水位偏差與庫容」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Level bias and storage error", which statement holds?
options: 面積不同的兩個池連通後最終水位仍是原水位的算術平均。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
本船閘回用六成就表示它一定比任何舊船閘少取水六成。
optionsEn: Connected basins of unequal area always finish at the arithmetic mean of their starting levels.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
Reusing sixty percent means a lock necessarily withdraws sixty percent less water than any older lock.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 水位偏差與庫容：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Level bias and storage error: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「水位偏差與庫容」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Level bias and storage error” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立穩定基準檢查水位零點，將兩儀器共用基準與獨立誤差分開。核對池位與外部流量表的完整循環差量，保留水面波動區間，不把平均後的小散布當成零偏差證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check level zero against independent stable control, separating shared datum error from independent sensor uncertainty. Reconcile full-cycle storage changes with external meters and retain surface-oscillation ranges rather than treating a small averaged scatter as evidence of no bias. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以獨立穩定基準檢查水位零點，將兩儀器共用基準與獨立誤差分開。核對池位與外部流量表的完整循環差量，保留水面波動區間，不把平均後的小散布當成零偏差證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check level zero against independent stable control, separating shared datum error from independent sensor uncertainty. Reconcile full-cycle storage changes with external meters and retain surface-oscillation ranges rather than treating a small averaged scatter as evidence of no bias.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩支儀器接同一錯誤基準時讀值一致仍可能一起錯，重新校零前後的跳變也可能被誤認為節水。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two sensors sharing an incorrect datum can agree while both are wrong, and a recalibration jump may resemble improved saving. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「水位偏差與庫容」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Level bias and storage error"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
每日蒸發方量應隨當天通航次數再乘一次作為總損失。
以獨立穩定基準檢查水位零點，將兩儀器共用基準與獨立誤差分開。

Check level zero against independent stable control, separating shared datum error from independent sensor uncertainty.

steps.titleEn: Level bias and storage error: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水位偏差與庫容」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Level bias and storage error” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩支儀器接同一錯誤基準時讀值一致仍可能一起錯，重新校零前後的跳變也可能被誤認為節水。將誤差除以樣本數會虛構不合理的庫容精度。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two sensors sharing an incorrect datum can agree while both are wrong, and a recalibration jump may resemble improved saving. Dividing systematic error by sample count invents unwarranted precision in the calculated storage volume. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設固定水面6000m²、共同水位偏差0.010m，庫容偏差Aδz=60m³；此系統偏差不隨讀值數增加自動消失。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「水位偏差與庫容」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Level bias and storage error" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 兩支儀器接同一錯誤基準時讀值一致仍可能一起錯，重新校零前後的跳變也可能被誤認為節水。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。

steps.title: 池體停用與供水韌性：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Basin outage and supply resilience: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「池體停用與供水韌性」如何影響閘室節水池設計的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Basin outage and supply resilience” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Water-saving basins for lock chambers”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 池體檢修或連通失效會改變可達回用率，外部補水增加幅度並不等於回用率減少的百分點。水源調度還受每日通航、庫存和其他用途限制，不能假設取水可無限補足；比較情境時應固定總交換需求，再清楚列出缺少哪些路徑。 假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「池體停用與供水韌性」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Maintenance or a failed connection changes achievable reuse, and the percentage increase in makeup is not the percentage-point drop in reuse. Supply also depends on traffic, stored water and other demands, so unlimited replacement withdrawal cannot be assumed. Scenario comparison must hold gross exchange fixed while identifying missing pathways and any additional operational constraints. Assume gross exchange30000m³ per cycle. Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Basin outage and supply resilience” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創教學假設，非操作設定。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「池體停用與供水韌性」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Basin outage and supply resilience”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 池體停用與供水韌性
knowledge.text: 池體檢修或連通失效會改變可達回用率，外部補水增加幅度並不等於回用率減少的百分點。水源調度還受每日通航、庫存和其他用途限制，不能假設取水可無限補足；比較情境時應固定總交換需求，再清楚列出缺少哪些路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Maintenance or a failed connection changes achievable reuse, and the percentage increase in makeup is not the percentage-point drop in reuse. Supply also depends on traffic, stored water and other demands, so unlimited replacement withdrawal cannot be assumed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「池體停用與供水韌性」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Basin outage and supply resilience" is correct?
options: 回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。
池體檢修或連通失效會改變可達回用率，外部補水增加幅度並不等於回用率減少的百分點。
浮船排水量應在每次閘室升降方量中再完整扣除一次。
optionsEn: A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent.
Maintenance or a failed connection changes achievable reuse, and the percentage increase in makeup is not the percentage-point drop in reuse.
The full floating-vessel displacement must be subtracted again from every chamber lift volume.
quiz.explanation: 池體檢修或連通失效會改變可達回用率，外部補水增加幅度並不等於回用率減少的百分點。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Maintenance or a failed connection changes achievable reuse, and the percentage increase in makeup is not the percentage-point drop in reuse. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 池體停用與供水韌性：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Basin outage and supply resilience: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「池體停用與供水韌性」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Basin outage and supply resilience” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume gross exchange30000m³ per cycle. Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。
knowledge.textEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Assume gross exchange30000m³ per cycle. Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「池體停用與供水韌性」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Basin outage and supply resilience", which statement holds?
options: 節水池回收了多少比例的水就必然回收同樣比例的能量。
沒有船舶通過時節水池就不可能產生任何水量損失。
原創教學假設，非操作設定。
optionsEn: The fraction of water reused by a basin must equal the fraction of energy recovered.
A water-saving basin cannot lose water whenever no vessel is passing through the lock.
Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings.
quiz.explanation: 原創教學假設，非操作設定。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not operating settings. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 池體停用與供水韌性：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Basin outage and supply resilience: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「池體停用與供水韌性」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Basin outage and supply resilience” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。核對水源、日庫存及額外漏損，不把模型餘額自動視為可供給量，並保存恢復連通前後的驗證證據。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand. Check source supply, daily storage and additional loss, without treating a calculated deficit as available water, and retain evidence before and after connection restoration. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。核對水源、日庫存及額外漏損，不把模型餘額自動視為可供給量，並保存恢復連通前後的驗證證據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand. Check source supply, daily storage and additional loss, without treating a calculated deficit as available water, and retain evidence before and after connection restoration.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把回用率降低二十百分點誤當補水只增兩成，會低估檢修期水源需求。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Mistaking a twenty-point reuse reduction for twenty-percent more makeup understates maintenance demand. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。核對水源、日庫存及額外漏損，不把模型餘額自動視為可供給量，並保存恢復連通前後的驗證證據。
knowledge.textEn: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand. Check source supply, daily storage and additional loss, without treating a calculated deficit as available water, and retain evidence before and after connection restoration.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。核對水源、日庫存及額外漏損，不把模型餘額自動視為可供給量，並保存恢復連通前後的驗證證據。
knowledge.textEn: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand. Check source supply, daily storage and additional loss, without treating a calculated deficit as available water, and retain evidence before and after connection restoration.

quiz.question: 要驗證「池體停用與供水韌性」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Basin outage and supply resilience"?
options: 列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
初始最大流量可以保持不變直到兩個池完全等水位。
optionsEn: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
The initial maximum discharge remains unchanged until both basins have exactly equal levels.
quiz.explanation: 列出停用池及仍可連通的路徑，用同一通航需求比較各狀態取水。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map the unavailable basin and surviving connections, comparing withdrawals under identical traffic demand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 池體停用與供水韌性：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Basin outage and supply resilience: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「池體停用與供水韌性」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Basin outage and supply resilience” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把回用率降低二十百分點誤當補水只增兩成，會低估檢修期水源需求。若同時出現乾旱或鹽分沖洗需求，單一池停用可能放大整個通航系統的限制。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking a twenty-point reuse reduction for twenty-percent more makeup understates maintenance demand. Concurrent drought or salinity-flushing requirements can magnify the consequences of one unavailable basin for the wider navigation system. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設每循環30000m³，回用率由0.60降0.40，外部補水由12000升18000m³，增加50%；非只增加20%。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Reuse falls0.60to0.40; makeup rises12000to18000m³, a50% increase rather than20%.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「回用率下降二十個百分點必然只讓外部補水增加百分之二十。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A twenty-percentage-point fall in reuse always increases external makeup by only twenty percent." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把回用率降低二十百分點誤當補水只增兩成，會低估檢修期水源需求。若同時出現乾旱或鹽分沖洗需求，單一池停用可能放大整個通航系統的限制。
knowledge.textEn: Mistaking a twenty-point reuse reduction for twenty-percent more makeup understates maintenance demand. Concurrent drought or salinity-flushing requirements can magnify the consequences of one unavailable basin for the wider navigation system.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「池體停用與供水韌性」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Basin outage and supply resilience" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把回用率降低二十百分點誤當補水只增兩成，會低估檢修期水源需求。
浮船排水量應在每次閘室升降方量中再完整扣除一次。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Mistaking a twenty-point reuse reduction for twenty-percent more makeup understates maintenance demand.
The full floating-vessel displacement must be subtracted again from every chamber lift volume.
quiz.explanation: 把回用率降低二十百分點誤當補水只增兩成，會低估檢修期水源需求。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Mistaking a twenty-point reuse reduction for twenty-percent more makeup understates maintenance demand. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 船閘人字門安裝
courses.summary: 以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 以水壓傳力支承對位和機電幾何理解人字門安裝驗證
courses.focusEn: Understand miter-gate installation through pressure paths, bearing alignment and actuator geometry
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。假設上游水深8m增加10%至8.8m、下游仍6m，同底面每米淨水力由137.34變203.2632kN/m，增加48%；水頭與力不是線性同比關係。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust. Increasing upper depth10% from8to8.8m while lower depth remains6m raises net force per metre from137.34 to203.2632kN/m, a48% increase; force does not change proportionally with depth. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「雙側靜水荷載」與「門葉斜角與跨度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" and "Leaf angle and projected span": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「雙側靜水荷載」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。每米寬的垂直平面條帶可以先建立荷載量級，但門葉斜角、水平主梁與接觸不連續會改變實際傳力；不能把條帶合力直接當成啟閉機的推力需求。 假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「雙側靜水荷載」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. A vertical plane strip per unit width provides an initial load scale. Leaf angle, horizontal girders and discontinuous contact alter real transfer, so the strip resultant cannot directly become the force required of the operating machinery during gate movement. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「雙側靜水荷載」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Two-sided hydrostatic loading”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 雙側靜水荷載
knowledge.text: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。每米寬的垂直平面條帶可以先建立荷載量級，但門葉斜角、水平主梁與接觸不連續會改變實際傳力；不能把條帶合力直接當成啟閉機的推力需求。
knowledge.textEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. A vertical plane strip per unit width provides an initial load scale.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「雙側靜水荷載」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" is correct?
options: 閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。
人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
optionsEn: The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis.
Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
quiz.explanation: 人字門關閉後由門葉及接觸支承傳遞水壓，水壓分布需分別從兩側水深計算。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Closed miter gates transfer water pressure through leaves and contact supports, with pressure integrated separately for both water depths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「雙側靜水荷載」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume freshwater and depths8and6m above the same base. Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「雙側靜水荷載」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Two-sided hydrostatic loading", which statement holds?
options: 排水後門葉支承仍只承受與完全浸水時相同的有效重量。
上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: After dewatering, supports carry only the same effective weight as during full submergence.
Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「雙側靜水荷載」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。另查啟閉時水頭條件和機械阻力，不能將閉門受力直接當操作工況。
knowledge.textEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Review head and resistance during movement separately rather than substituting the closed-gate load case for an operating condition.

quiz.question: 要驗證「雙側靜水荷載」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Two-sided hydrostatic loading"?
options: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。
optionsEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
quiz.explanation: 畫出兩側水壓圖與共同底面，將合力及力矩沿門葉傳到斜接及側枕接觸，確認單位寬度方向。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Draw both pressure diagrams on one base and trace resultant and moment through leaf, miter and quoin contacts, defining unit-width direction. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 雙側靜水荷載：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Two-sided hydrostatic loading: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「雙側靜水荷載」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Two-sided hydrostatic loading” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。支承接觸失效時荷載路徑改變，原本有效的簡化靜力模型也可能不再成立。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Lost support contact changes the load path and can invalidate a previously appropriate simplified static representation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設淡水、同底面兩側深8與6m，垂直平面每米寬淨力F=ρg(8²−6²)/2=137.34kN/m；非致動器推力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Net force per metre of vertical plane is137.34kN/m, not actuator thrust.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。支承接觸失效時荷載路徑改變，原本有效的簡化靜力模型也可能不再成立。
knowledge.textEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Lost support contact changes the load path and can invalidate a previously appropriate simplified static representation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「雙側靜水荷載」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Two-sided hydrostatic loading" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
quiz.explanation: 只用水位差乘總面積會錯估三角形分布，漏掉下游水壓又會高估淨力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Using head difference times total area misses the triangular distribution, while omitted downstream pressure overstates net force. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「門葉斜角與跨度」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Leaf angle and projected span” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。斜角影響斜接位置、接觸及受力，但幾何一致不代表支承壓力已均勻；測量應分開閉合位置與轉動包絡，避免用設計投影尺寸直接安排吊運或調整作業。 假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「門葉斜角與跨度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. Angle affects miter position, contacts and force transfer, but geometric agreement does not establish uniform bearing. Surveys must distinguish closure position from the swept motion envelope rather than using projected design dimensions alone to plan lifting or field adjustment of the gate assembly. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Leaf angle and projected span” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「門葉斜角與跨度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Leaf angle and projected span”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 門葉斜角與跨度
knowledge.text: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。斜角影響斜接位置、接觸及受力，但幾何一致不代表支承壓力已均勻；測量應分開閉合位置與轉動包絡，避免用設計投影尺寸直接安排吊運或調整作業。
knowledge.textEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. Angle affects miter position, contacts and force transfer, but geometric agreement does not establish uniform bearing.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「門葉斜角與跨度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Leaf angle and projected span" is correct?
options: 門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
整扇門位移很小即可證明所有面板局部彎曲應力都很小。
人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。
optionsEn: Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
Small whole-gate displacement proves that every skin panel has low local bending stress.
Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening.
quiz.explanation: 人字門兩葉形成上游指向的平面幾何，門葉實長與航道橫向半寬不同。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Two leaves form an upstream-pointing plan geometry, with leaf length different from half the transverse opening. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: quantitative estimate

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設開口寬20m、各葉與橫向成20°，葉長l=10/cos20°=10.6418m，上游突出10tan20°=3.6397m；忽略接縫細節。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume opening20m and each leaf20°from transverse. Leaf length=10.6418m and upstream projection=3.6397m, excluding joint and hinge details. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。

Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：試驗與驗證

steps.instructionEn: Locate hinges, miter and wall contacts in one coordinate system, checking projected and actual lengths separately. Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Independently survey the closed outline and swept clearances, tracing discrepancies to specific components rather than forcing the assembly into place based only on nominal dimensions.

steps.title: 門葉斜角與跨度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Leaf angle and projected span: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「門葉斜角與跨度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instructionEn: An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment. Forced closure can convert a geometric mismatch into concentrated loading at bearings or contact surfaces within the assembly. steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

quiz.question: 在「門葉斜角與跨度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Small whole-gate displacement proves that every skin panel has low local bending stress.
An incorrect angular reference misstates both length and upstream projection, while inconsistent hinge coordinates prevent miter alignment.

steps.instruction: 面板將局部水壓傳給加勁材，支承距離與邊界條件決定彎曲而非只看整扇門重量。一米寬簡支條帶忽略雙向板作用和焊接約束，只能建立比較基準；腐蝕減薄、初始變形與接觸細節會改變局部反應，需要與實際板格配置對照。 假設一米寬簡支條帶p=100kPa、跨0.50m、厚0.020m，M=pL²/8=3.125kN·m/m，σ=6M/t²=46.875MPa。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「面板跨距與彎曲」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「面板跨距與彎曲」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Longer spans increase strip moment quadratically, and localized thinning rapidly raises stress. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

quiz.question: 要驗證「面板跨距與彎曲」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

steps.instruction: 跨距增加會按平方放大條帶彎矩，局部厚度減少又快速增加應力。忽略焊接約束或初始波浪形可能改變應力位置，整體門葉位移小也不排除局部板格問題。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Longer spans increase strip moment quadratically, and localized thinning rapidly raises stress. Weld restraint or initial waviness can relocate stress concentrations; small overall leaf movement does not exclude a problem in an individual skin panel. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Small whole-gate displacement proves that every skin panel has low local bending stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「面板跨距與彎曲」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Longer spans increase strip moment quadratically, and localized thinning rapidly raises stress.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
After dewatering, supports carry only the same effective weight as during full submergence.

quiz.explanationEn: Longer spans increase strip moment quadratically, and localized thinning rapidly raises stress. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.instructionEn: Effective supported weight differs between submerged operation and dewatered maintenance. Buoyancy of sealed spaces must not be confused with material volume, while support sharing depends on gravity center, buoyancy center and upper restraint. steps.instructionEn: Verify compartment sealing, ventilation and flooding, recording gravity and buoyancy centers on a complete free-body diagram. Check dry and submerged states separately and compare support response with the model instead of dividing total net weight equally among all attachment points. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：逐艙核對密閉、通氣與進水狀態，記錄重心和浮心位置，畫完整垂直受力圖。分開乾態與水中檢查，將實際支承反力或變形與模型比較，不把總淨重平均分到所有接點。

Check dry and submerged states separately and compare support response with the model instead of dividing total net weight equally among all attachment points.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Flooding reduces buoyancy and increases supported load, while dewatering can restore full dry weight. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
