steps.title: 浮力與支承自重：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Buoyancy and supported weight: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「浮力與支承自重」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Buoyancy and supported weight” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 艙室進水會降低浮力並增加支承需求，排水檢修則可能恢復全部乾重量。若仍用水中淨重評估乾態臨時支承，會漏掉安裝或維護轉換中的關鍵負荷。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Flooding reduces buoyancy and increases supported load, while dewatering can restore full dry weight. Assessing temporary dry-state supports using submerged effective weight misses a critical load change during installation or maintenance transitions. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設門葉質量200000kg、密閉排水體積50m³、淡水1000kg/m³，淨向下力(m−ρV)g=1471.5kN；未分配各支承。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Net downward force=(m−ρV)g=1471.5kN, before distribution among supports.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水後門葉支承仍只承受與完全浸水時相同的有效重量。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "After dewatering, supports carry only the same effective weight as during full submergence." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 艙室進水會降低浮力並增加支承需求，排水檢修則可能恢復全部乾重量。若仍用水中淨重評估乾態臨時支承，會漏掉安裝或維護轉換中的關鍵負荷。
knowledge.textEn: Flooding reduces buoyancy and increases supported load, while dewatering can restore full dry weight. Assessing temporary dry-state supports using submerged effective weight misses a critical load change during installation or maintenance transitions.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「浮力與支承自重」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Buoyancy and supported weight" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
艙室進水會降低浮力並增加支承需求，排水檢修則可能恢復全部乾重量。
名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Flooding reduces buoyancy and increases supported load, while dewatering can restore full dry weight.
Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point.
quiz.explanation: 艙室進水會降低浮力並增加支承需求，排水檢修則可能恢復全部乾重量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Flooding reduces buoyancy and increases supported load, while dewatering can restore full dry weight. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工方法與施工階段控制
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「樞軸名義承壓」與「轉軸對位與垂直度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Nominal pintle bearing pressure" and "Hinge alignment and plumbness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 樞軸名義承壓：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Nominal pintle bearing pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「樞軸名義承壓」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Nominal pintle bearing pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 樞軸將門葉作用傳入底部埋件，名義承壓可以用投影面積估量，但不是實際接觸峰值。軸承曲面、間隙、潤滑和偏心會集中壓力，局部磨耗又反過來改變對位；應把承壓需求與材料、接觸及固定系統的驗證分開，不靠一個平均值判定可用。 假設徑向合力1.5MN、投影直徑0.30m、有效承壓長0.40m，pnom=R/(DL)=12.50MPa；非赫茲接觸峰壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「樞軸名義承壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The pintle transfers gate action into embedded support. Projected-area pressure is a nominal scale, not the actual contact maximum. Curvature, clearance, lubrication and eccentricity concentrate pressure, while wear feeds back into alignment. Demand must therefore be evaluated with material, contact and anchorage evidence rather than using a single average number to declare the complete bearing assembly suitable for service. Assume radial resultant1.5MN,projected diameter0.30m and bearing length0.40m. Nominal pressure R/(DL)=12.50MPa, not Hertzian peak contact pressure. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Nominal pintle bearing pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「樞軸名義承壓」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Nominal pintle bearing pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 樞軸名義承壓
knowledge.text: 樞軸將門葉作用傳入底部埋件，名義承壓可以用投影面積估量，但不是實際接觸峰值。軸承曲面、間隙、潤滑和偏心會集中壓力，局部磨耗又反過來改變對位；應把承壓需求與材料、接觸及固定系統的驗證分開，不靠一個平均值判定可用。
knowledge.textEn: The pintle transfers gate action into embedded support. Projected-area pressure is a nominal scale, not the actual contact maximum.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「樞軸名義承壓」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Nominal pintle bearing pressure" is correct?
options: 名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。
上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。
樞軸將門葉作用傳入底部埋件，名義承壓可以用投影面積估量，但不是實際接觸峰值。
optionsEn: Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point.
Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment.
The pintle transfers gate action into embedded support.
quiz.explanation: 樞軸將門葉作用傳入底部埋件，名義承壓可以用投影面積估量，但不是實際接觸峰值。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: The pintle transfers gate action into embedded support. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 樞軸名義承壓：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Nominal pintle bearing pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「樞軸名義承壓」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Nominal pintle bearing pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設徑向合力1.5MN、投影直徑0.30m、有效承壓長0.40m，pnom=R/(DL)=12.50MPa；非赫茲接觸峰壓。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume radial resultant1.5MN,projected diameter0.30m and bearing length0.40m. Nominal pressure R/(DL)=12.50MPa, not Hertzian peak contact pressure. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：確認合力方向與實際接觸型式，核對有效長度、間隙和表面狀態，保留潤滑紀錄。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Confirm resultant direction and actual contact type, checking effective length, clearance and surface condition with lubrication records.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設徑向合力1.5MN、投影直徑0.30m、有效承壓長0.40m，pnom=R/(DL)=12.50MPa；非赫茲接觸峰壓。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume radial resultant1.5MN,projected diameter0.30m and bearing length0.40m. Nominal pressure R/(DL)=12.50MPa, not Hertzian peak contact pressure.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「樞軸名義承壓」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Nominal pintle bearing pressure", which statement holds?
options: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。
修復後總漏水變少就必然代表止水改善而不必核對水頭。
optionsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
Less total leakage after repair necessarily proves a better seal without checking the water head.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.titleEn: Nominal pintle bearing pressure: testing and verification

確認合力方向與實際接觸型式，核對有效長度、間隙和表面狀態，保留潤滑紀錄。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Confirm resultant direction and actual contact type, checking effective length, clearance and surface condition with lubrication records.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
quiz.explanation: 確認合力方向與實際接觸型式，核對有效長度、間隙和表面狀態，保留潤滑紀錄。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Confirm resultant direction and actual contact type, checking effective length, clearance and surface condition with lubrication records. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 樞軸名義承壓：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Nominal pintle bearing pressure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「樞軸名義承壓」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Nominal pintle bearing pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 軸承邊緣接觸可能在平均面壓正常時產生高峰值，潤滑不足又加速磨耗。磨耗後轉軸移動會連帶改變門葉斜接，局部問題可能擴大成整門閉合異常。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Edge contact produces high local pressure despite a normal average, and poor lubrication accelerates wear. Subsequent hinge movement changes miter alignment, allowing a local bearing issue to develop into abnormal closure of the full gate. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設徑向合力1.5MN、投影直徑0.30m、有效承壓長0.40m，pnom=R/(DL)=12.50MPa；非赫茲接觸峰壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Nominal pressure R/(DL)=12.50MPa, not Hertzian peak contact pressure.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「名義平均承壓就是軸承每個接觸點的實際最大壓力。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Nominal average bearing pressure equals the actual maximum pressure at every contact point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 軸承邊緣接觸可能在平均面壓正常時產生高峰值，潤滑不足又加速磨耗。磨耗後轉軸移動會連帶改變門葉斜接，局部問題可能擴大成整門閉合異常。
knowledge.textEn: Edge contact produces high local pressure despite a normal average, and poor lubrication accelerates wear. Subsequent hinge movement changes miter alignment, allowing a local bearing issue to develop into abnormal closure of the full gate.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「樞軸名義承壓」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Nominal pintle bearing pressure" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。
軸承邊緣接觸可能在平均面壓正常時產生高峰值，潤滑不足又加速磨耗。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment.
Edge contact produces high local pressure despite a normal average, and poor lubrication accelerates wear.
quiz.explanation: 軸承邊緣接觸可能在平均面壓正常時產生高峰值，潤滑不足又加速磨耗。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Edge contact produces high local pressure despite a normal average, and poor lubrication accelerates wear. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉軸對位與垂直度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Hinge alignment and plumbness: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉軸對位與垂直度」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Hinge alignment and plumbness” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 上下轉軸相對偏移會改變轉動阻力及門葉接觸，角度很小仍可能在長門葉上放大位移。兩點幾何只能描述整體傾斜，不能辨識軸彎曲或埋件局部變形；量測需要共同穩定基準並補中間點，避免把溫度或儀器漂移誤認為永久錯位。 假設上下測點高差15m、水平偏移3mm，θ≈0.003/15=0.0002rad=0.01146°；只描述兩點整體傾斜。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉軸對位與垂直度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Relative offset between upper and lower pivots changes rotation and leaf contact, and a small angle can create appreciable movement along a large leaf. Two points describe overall tilt but not shaft curvature or local embedment deformation. Stable common control and intermediate observations are needed to distinguish true misalignment from temperature effects or instrument drift during installation verification. Assume pivot points15m vertically apart with horizontal offset3mm. Tilt≈0.0002rad=0.01146°, describing only the overall two-point alignment. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Hinge alignment and plumbness” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉軸對位與垂直度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Hinge alignment and plumbness”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉軸對位與垂直度
knowledge.text: 上下轉軸相對偏移會改變轉動阻力及門葉接觸，角度很小仍可能在長門葉上放大位移。兩點幾何只能描述整體傾斜，不能辨識軸彎曲或埋件局部變形；量測需要共同穩定基準並補中間點，避免把溫度或儀器漂移誤認為永久錯位。
knowledge.textEn: Relative offset between upper and lower pivots changes rotation and leaf contact, and a small angle can create appreciable movement along a large leaf. Two points describe overall tilt but not shaft curvature or local embedment deformation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉軸對位與垂直度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Hinge alignment and plumbness" is correct?
options: 上下轉軸相對偏移會改變轉動阻力及門葉接觸，角度很小仍可能在長門葉上放大位移。
上下兩點量測吻合就可以排除軸線所有彎曲和局部錯位。
氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。
optionsEn: Relative offset between upper and lower pivots changes rotation and leaf contact, and a small angle can create appreciable movement along a large leaf.
Matching two pivot endpoints excludes all shaft curvature and local misalignment.
Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate.
quiz.explanation: 上下轉軸相對偏移會改變轉動阻力及門葉接觸，角度很小仍可能在長門葉上放大位移。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Relative offset between upper and lower pivots changes rotation and leaf contact, and a small angle can create appreciable movement along a large leaf. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉軸對位與垂直度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Hinge alignment and plumbness: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉軸對位與垂直度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Hinge alignment and plumbness” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設上下測點高差15m、水平偏移3mm，θ≈0.003/15=0.0002rad=0.01146°；只描述兩點整體傾斜。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume pivot points15m vertically apart with horizontal offset3mm. Tilt≈0.0002rad=0.01146°, describing only the overall two-point alignment. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立控制點重測上下與中間位置，保存溫度和受力狀態，分開整體傾斜與局部殘差。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Resurvey upper, intermediate and lower points from independent control with temperature and loading recorded.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設上下測點高差15m、水平偏移3mm，θ≈0.003/15=0.0002rad=0.01146°；只描述兩點整體傾斜。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume pivot points15m vertically apart with horizontal offset3mm. Tilt≈0.0002rad=0.01146°, describing only the overall two-point alignment.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「轉軸對位與垂直度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Hinge alignment and plumbness", which statement holds?
options: 油壓達到設定值就能單獨證明門葉已完全到位和止水。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。
optionsEn: Reaching hydraulic pressure alone proves that the gate is fully seated and watertight.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 轉軸對位與垂直度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Hinge alignment and plumbness: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉軸對位與垂直度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Hinge alignment and plumbness” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立控制點重測上下與中間位置，保存溫度和受力狀態，分開整體傾斜與局部殘差。將對位結果連回接觸痕跡及低速受控測試紀錄，由正式程序評估，不以本例角度當允差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Resurvey upper, intermediate and lower points from independent control with temperature and loading recorded. Separate global tilt from local residuals and relate alignment to contact evidence and approved controlled-test records, without using the illustrative angle as a field tolerance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以獨立控制點重測上下與中間位置，保存溫度和受力狀態，分開整體傾斜與局部殘差。將對位結果連回接觸痕跡及低速受控測試紀錄，由正式程序評估，不以本例角度當允差。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Resurvey upper, intermediate and lower points from independent control with temperature and loading recorded. Separate global tilt from local residuals and relate alignment to contact evidence and approved controlled-test records, without using the illustrative angle as a field tolerance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共同基準移動會使所有測點看似對齊，兩點吻合也可能漏掉中間彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Moving common control can make all points appear aligned, and matching endpoints may conceal intermediate curvature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Separate global tilt from local residuals and relate alignment to contact evidence and approved controlled-test records, without using the illustrative angle as a field tolerance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉軸對位與垂直度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Hinge alignment and plumbness"?

整扇門位移很小即可證明所有面板局部彎曲應力都很小。

quiz.question: 在「轉軸對位與垂直度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Hinge alignment and plumbness" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 共同基準移動會使所有測點看似對齊，兩點吻合也可能漏掉中間彎曲。
只要結構還沒倒，就代表安全餘裕仍然足夠。
氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。
optionsEn: Moving common control can make all points appear aligned, and matching endpoints may conceal intermediate curvature.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate.
quiz.explanation: 共同基準移動會使所有測點看似對齊，兩點吻合也可能漏掉中間彎曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Moving common control can make all points appear aligned, and matching endpoints may conceal intermediate curvature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 試驗、量測與監測驗證
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱伸縮與安裝基準」與「致動器力臂幾何」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal movement and installation reference" and "Actuator lever-arm geometry": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱伸縮與安裝基準：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and installation reference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱伸縮與安裝基準」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal movement and installation reference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 大型鋼門的溫度變化會改變尺寸，陽照造成的梯度還可能使面板翹曲。均勻自由膨脹只提供基本量級，約束與不同材料埋件會產生額外內力；安裝測量若不記溫度，跨日對比可能把可逆伸縮當作製造或定位誤差。 假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長15m、均勻升溫20K，自由伸長αLΔT=3.60mm；不含溫度梯度或約束應力。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱伸縮與安裝基準」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Temperature changes alter large steel-gate dimensions, while solar gradients can warp panels. Uniform free expansion supplies only a baseline; restraint and dissimilar embedded materials generate additional forces. Without temperature records, surveys on different days may mistake reversible thermal movement for fabrication or positioning error, leading to inappropriate adjustment of dimensions that are correct at the intended reference condition. Assume steelα=12×10⁻⁶/K,length15m and uniform warming20K. Free expansion is3.60mm, excluding gradients and restraint stresses. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal movement and installation reference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱伸縮與安裝基準」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal movement and installation reference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱伸縮與安裝基準
knowledge.text: 大型鋼門的溫度變化會改變尺寸，陽照造成的梯度還可能使面板翹曲。均勻自由膨脹只提供基本量級，約束與不同材料埋件會產生額外內力；安裝測量若不記溫度，跨日對比可能把可逆伸縮當作製造或定位誤差。
knowledge.textEn: Temperature changes alter large steel-gate dimensions, while solar gradients can warp panels. Uniform free expansion supplies only a baseline; restraint and dissimilar embedded materials generate additional forces.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱伸縮與安裝基準」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Thermal movement and installation reference" is correct?
options: 氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。
大型鋼門的溫度變化會改變尺寸，陽照造成的梯度還可能使面板翹曲。
致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。
optionsEn: Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate.
Temperature changes alter large steel-gate dimensions, while solar gradients can warp panels.
The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
quiz.explanation: 大型鋼門的溫度變化會改變尺寸，陽照造成的梯度還可能使面板翹曲。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Temperature changes alter large steel-gate dimensions, while solar gradients can warp panels. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 熱伸縮與安裝基準：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and installation reference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱伸縮與安裝基準」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Thermal movement and installation reference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長15m、均勻升溫20K，自由伸長αLΔT=3.60mm；不含溫度梯度或約束應力。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume steelα=12×10⁻⁶/K,length15m and uniform warming20K. Free expansion is3.60mm, excluding gradients and restraint stresses. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長15m、均勻升溫20K，自由伸長αLΔT=3.60mm；不含溫度梯度或約束應力。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume steelα=12×10⁻⁶/K,length15m and uniform warming20K. Free expansion is3.60mm, excluding gradients and restraint stresses.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「熱伸縮與安裝基準」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Thermal movement and installation reference", which statement holds?
options: 修復後總漏水變少就必然代表止水改善而不必核對水頭。
門葉實長永遠等於船閘淨寬的一半而不受斜角影響。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: Less total leakage after repair necessarily proves a better seal without checking the water head.
Each miter leaf length always equals half the clear lock width regardless of its angle.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 熱伸縮與安裝基準：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and installation reference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱伸縮與安裝基準」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Thermal movement and installation reference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。將接觸約束和實際位移一起檢查，避免為消除可逆熱變形而永久改動安裝對位。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions. Check restraint and actual movement together, avoiding permanent alignment changes intended merely to remove a reversible thermal deformation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。將接觸約束和實際位移一起檢查，避免為消除可逆熱變形而永久改動安裝對位。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions. Check restraint and actual movement together, avoiding permanent alignment changes intended merely to remove a reversible thermal deformation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。將接觸約束和實際位移一起檢查，避免為消除可逆熱變形而永久改動安裝對位。
knowledge.textEn: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions. Check restraint and actual movement together, avoiding permanent alignment changes intended merely to remove a reversible thermal deformation.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。將接觸約束和實際位移一起檢查，避免為消除可逆熱變形而永久改動安裝對位。
knowledge.textEn: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions. Check restraint and actual movement together, avoiding permanent alignment changes intended merely to remove a reversible thermal deformation.

quiz.question: 要驗證「熱伸縮與安裝基準」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Thermal movement and installation reference"?
options: 記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排水後門葉支承仍只承受與完全浸水時相同的有效重量。
optionsEn: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
After dewatering, supports carry only the same effective weight as during full submergence.
quiz.explanation: 記錄量測時鋼材各位置溫度與參考溫度，先分辨均勻變化和日照梯度再作尺寸比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record steel temperatures at several positions and the reference temperature, separating uniform change from solar gradients before comparing dimensions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 熱伸縮與安裝基準：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Thermal movement and installation reference: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「熱伸縮與安裝基準」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Thermal movement and installation reference” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。若忽略這些條件，晨間可閉合而午後卡阻的問題可能被錯誤歸因為機械故障。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature. Ignoring these conditions may misdiagnose a gate that closes in the morning but binds later as a machinery failure. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設鋼α=12×10⁻⁶/K、長15m、均勻升溫20K，自由伸長αLΔT=3.60mm；不含溫度梯度或約束應力。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Free expansion is3.60mm, excluding gradients and restraint stresses.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。若忽略這些條件，晨間可閉合而午後卡阻的問題可能被錯誤歸因為機械故障。
knowledge.textEn: Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature. Ignoring these conditions may misdiagnose a gate that closes in the morning but binds later as a machinery failure.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「熱伸縮與安裝基準」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Thermal movement and installation reference" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。
致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature.
The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
quiz.explanation: 單點氣溫不一定代表鋼板溫度，迎陽與背陰面差異又可能造成彎曲。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Air temperature at one point may not represent steel temperature, and sun-shade differences can cause curvature. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 致動器力臂幾何：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Actuator lever-arm geometry: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「致動器力臂幾何」如何影響船閘人字門安裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Actuator lever-arm geometry” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Miter-gate installation for navigation locks”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 啟閉機推力透過連桿和轉軸形成力矩，垂直力臂才是有效距離，幾何接近共線時需求可能迅速上升。假定阻力矩固定只用於辨識幾何敏感度，實際摩擦、水力及慣性隨位置變化；不能由單點力矩平衡自行推定完整操作或保護設定。 假設指定阻力矩200kN·m、連接半徑2m、力向與半徑30°，F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN；非實際啟閉設定。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「致動器力臂幾何」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Actuator force produces torque through the perpendicular lever arm, with demand rising as linkage geometry approaches alignment. A fixed resisting torque isolates geometry sensitivity only; actual friction, hydraulic action and inertia vary with position. One equilibrium point therefore cannot define the complete operating sequence, permissible thrust or protective settings for the machinery connected to the gate. Assume selected resisting torque200kN·m,radius2m and force-radius angle30°. F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN, not an operating setting. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Actuator lever-arm geometry” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「致動器力臂幾何」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.title: 致動器力臂幾何
knowledge.text: 啟閉機推力透過連桿和轉軸形成力矩，垂直力臂才是有效距離，幾何接近共線時需求可能迅速上升。假定阻力矩固定只用於辨識幾何敏感度，實際摩擦、水力及慣性隨位置變化；不能由單點力矩平衡自行推定完整操作或保護設定。
knowledge.textEn: Actuator force produces torque through the perpendicular lever arm, with demand rising as linkage geometry approaches alignment. A fixed resisting torque isolates geometry sensitivity only; actual friction, hydraulic action and inertia vary with position.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：致動器力臂永遠等於連接半徑而不受門角和力向影響。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「致動器力臂幾何」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

optionsEn: The effective actuator lever arm always equals its radius regardless of gate angle and force direction.
Reaching hydraulic pressure alone proves that the gate is fully seated and watertight.
Actuator force produces torque through the perpendicular lever arm, with demand rising as linkage geometry approaches alignment.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設指定阻力矩200kN·m、連接半徑2m、力向與半徑30°，F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN；非實際啟閉設定。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume selected resisting torque200kN·m,radius2m and force-radius angle30°. F=M/(r sinθ)=200kN, not an operating setting. steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instructionEn: Plot lever arms at several gate angles using actual pivot coordinates and verify the force-radius angle, checking near-toggle regions. Compare measured torque with friction and hydraulic contributions and validate the full stroke against approved data rather than checking only a convenient intermediate position. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 致動器力臂幾何：失效診斷

steps.instruction: 把連桿長直接當垂直力臂會低估斜向位置的推力，銷軸磨耗又可能改變幾何和摩擦。中間行程符合計算，仍不能排除端部接近共線時的高需求。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

steps.titleEn: Ideal hydraulic-cylinder thrust: testing and verification

steps.instructionEn: Read both chamber pressures and piston position together, checking bore, rod size and units for each direction. Use load and motion records to identify leakage or binding under equipment documentation, without treating ideal thrust as justification for arbitrarily raising pressure. steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring return backpressure overstates net force, while binding produces high pressure without gate movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.instruction: 回油背壓存在時只用缸底壓會高估淨力，卡阻又可造成壓力高但門不動。若控制系統只看壓力完成訊號，便可能把機械未到位誤判成已閉合。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring return backpressure overstates net force, while binding produces high pressure without gate movement. A controller relying only on a pressure-completion signal may therefore misidentify an unseated gate as properly closed in the required position. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設缸徑0.16m、無背壓與摩擦、缸底壓10MPa，F=pπD²/4=201.062kN；回縮需扣活塞桿面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ideal F=pπD²/4=201.062kN; retraction requires rod-area deduction.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「油壓達到設定值就能單獨證明門葉已完全到位和止水。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Reaching hydraulic pressure alone proves that the gate is fully seated and watertight." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「油壓缸理想推力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
修復後總漏水變少就必然代表止水改善而不必核對水頭。
optionsEn: Ignoring return backpressure overstates net force, while binding produces high pressure without gate movement.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
Less total leakage after repair necessarily proves a better seal without checking the water head.
quiz.explanation: 回油背壓存在時只用缸底壓會高估淨力，卡阻又可造成壓力高但門不動。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Ignoring return backpressure overstates net force, while binding produces high pressure without gate movement. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

Leakage versus head, contact evidence and alignment must be interpreted together, because one total-flow measurement cannot uniquely locate a defect or determine its physical cause. Assume equivalent opening0.002m²,Cd=0.60 and head2m. Q=0.007517m³/s=7.517L/s, not an allowable leakage limit. steps.titleEn: Seal leakage and evidence: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「止水漏流與證據」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Seal leakage and evidence” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 分區記錄漏水位置和壓差，核對計量是否包含其他排水路徑，並同步保存門位與接觸證據。比較不同水頭下曲線形狀，先判斷孔口近似是否成立，再依正式要求評估修復成效。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record leak location and pressure difference by zone, checking whether measurements include other drains and retaining gate position and contact evidence. Compare curve shape across heads, test the orifice approximation first and assess repair performance against the actual approved requirements. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：分區記錄漏水位置和壓差，核對計量是否包含其他排水路徑，並同步保存門位與接觸證據。比較不同水頭下曲線形狀，先判斷孔口近似是否成立，再依正式要求評估修復成效。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Record leak location and pressure difference by zone, checking whether measurements include other drains and retaining gate position and contact evidence. Compare curve shape across heads, test the orifice approximation first and assess repair performance against the actual approved requirements.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：另一排水支路混入會高估止水漏量，局部長縫又可能不符合孔口係數。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An unrelated drain inflates measured seal leakage, while a long narrow slot may not fit the orifice coefficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「止水漏流與證據」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Seal leakage and evidence"?
options: 分區記錄漏水位置和壓差，核對計量是否包含其他排水路徑，並同步保存門位與接觸證據。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
氣溫相同就代表整扇鋼門溫度均勻而不會發生熱彎曲。
optionsEn: Record leak location and pressure difference by zone, checking whether measurements include other drains and retaining gate position and contact evidence.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Equal air temperature proves uniform steel temperature and rules out thermal bending of the gate.
quiz.explanation: 分區記錄漏水位置和壓差，核對計量是否包含其他排水路徑，並同步保存門位與接觸證據。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record leak location and pressure difference by zone, checking whether measurements include other drains and retaining gate position and contact evidence. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 止水漏流與證據：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Seal leakage and evidence: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「止水漏流與證據」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Seal leakage and evidence” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 另一排水支路混入會高估止水漏量，局部長縫又可能不符合孔口係數。修復後總流量下降若源自水頭下降，不能被誤當成止水接觸已真正改善。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An unrelated drain inflates measured seal leakage, while a long narrow slot may not fit the orifice coefficient. Lower total flow after repair can simply reflect lower head rather than genuinely improved contact along the seal. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設等效孔口A=0.002m²、Cd=0.60、水頭2m，Q=CdA√(2gH)=0.007517m³/s=7.517L/s；非允許漏量。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Q=0.007517m³/s=7.517L/s, not an allowable leakage limit.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「修復後總漏水變少就必然代表止水改善而不必核對水頭。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Less total leakage after repair necessarily proves a better seal without checking the water head." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 另一排水支路混入會高估止水漏量，局部長縫又可能不符合孔口係數。修復後總流量下降若源自水頭下降，不能被誤當成止水接觸已真正改善。
knowledge.textEn: An unrelated drain inflates measured seal leakage, while a long narrow slot may not fit the orifice coefficient. Lower total flow after repair can simply reflect lower head rather than genuinely improved contact along the seal.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「止水漏流與證據」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Seal leakage and evidence" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
另一排水支路混入會高估止水漏量，局部長縫又可能不符合孔口係數。
閉門靜水合力可以不經力路徑分析直接當成啟閉機推力。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
An unrelated drain inflates measured seal leakage, while a long narrow slot may not fit the orifice coefficient.
The closed-gate hydrostatic resultant directly equals actuator thrust without load-path analysis.
quiz.explanation: 另一排水支路混入會高估止水漏量，局部長縫又可能不符合孔口係數。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: An unrelated drain inflates measured seal leakage, while a long narrow slot may not fit the orifice coefficient. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

courses.title: 河口鹽水入侵控制
courses.summary: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略。課程從邊界辨識與資料整理走到水理量化、構造介面及驗證紀錄；每一步把計算結果連回可量測的證據。十個不同單元分別處理關鍵機制，不以名義尺寸或單一通過率代替整體工程判斷，並明列合成算例與現地資料的差別。
courses.summaryEn: Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints. The course moves from boundary identification and evidence to hydraulic quantification, structural interfaces and verification records. Ten distinct units connect each calculated quantity to measurable evidence. Nominal geometry or a single pass rate does not establish whole-system performance, and synthetic teaching examples remain separate from field observations.
courses.focus: 用鹽質量分層動力與排水限制評估河口阻鹽策略
courses.focusEn: Evaluate estuary salt control with mass balance, stratification and drainage constraints
courses.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
courses.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.
courses.subcategoryTitle: 海岸、港灣與水資源韌性
courses.subcategoryTitleEn: Coasts, ports and water-resource resilience

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為原創合成算例，不是地標工程的實測或推薦操作值。教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。假設淡水流100增加10%至110m³/s，鹹流仍10m³/s且35kg/m³，混合濃度由3.1818降至350/120=2.9167kg/m³，下降8.333%；不直接表示鹽楔縮短同樣比例。重新計算前先列固定條件、單位、適用尺度及可能失效的邊界。把模型敏感度與測量誤差分開，不能將單一參數變化直接當成工程風險或壽命比例。比較兩次結果後，記錄還需要哪些獨立證據，並由負責專業人員判斷適用性。
workedExample.textEn: This original synthetic example is neither a landmark measurement nor a recommended operating value. Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Increasing freshwater10% from100to110m³/s while saline input remains10m³/s at35kg/m³ lowers mixed concentration3.1818to2.9167kg/m³, a8.333% reduction, without an equivalent salt-wedge length change. Before recalculating, list fixed conditions, units, applicable scale and boundaries that could fail. Separate model sensitivity from measurement uncertainty: a parameter change does not directly give a proportional change in engineering risk or service life. Compare the results, record independent evidence still needed, and have the responsible specialist determine applicability.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 水文條件、邊界與工程系統
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「完全混合與鹽收支」與「斷面鹽通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Complete mixing and salt balance" and "Section salt transport": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「完全混合與鹽收支」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Complete mixing and salt balance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。 假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「完全混合與鹽收支」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides. Mean concentration therefore cannot describe short-term exposure at a particular intake depth or establish a spatial intrusion boundary by itself. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Complete mixing and salt balance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「完全混合與鹽收支」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Complete mixing and salt balance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 完全混合與鹽收支
knowledge.text: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。穩態完全混合模型以入流鹽質量守恆求出口濃度，但真實河口常有底層鹽楔及潮汐逆流；平均濃度不能描述取水口所在深度的短時暴露。
knowledge.textEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. A steady completely mixed balance equates incoming and outgoing salt mass, whereas real estuaries may contain a bottom wedge and reversing tides.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「完全混合與鹽收支」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Complete mixing and salt balance" is correct?
options: 河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。
淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。
一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
optionsEn: Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake.
Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers.
Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
quiz.explanation: 淡鹹水混合首先要統一鹽的表示方式，質量濃度與實用鹽度或電導不是可任意互換的數字。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Mixing calculations require a consistent salt measure: mass concentration, practical salinity and conductance are not interchangeable numbers. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「完全混合與鹽收支」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Complete mixing and salt balance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume additive volumes,fresh inflow100m³/s at0 and saline inflow10m³/s at35kg/m³. Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「完全混合與鹽收支」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Complete mixing and salt balance", which statement holds?
options: 一個容積除流量的時間後所有原有鹽水都必定完全排出。
體積理查森數大於某個固定數字就證明整個河口完全沒有紊流。
教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
optionsEn: After one volume-divided-by-flow interval, every original parcel of saltwater has certainly left.
A bulk Richardson number above one fixed value proves that the entire estuary is turbulence-free.
Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「完全混合與鹽收支」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Complete mixing and salt balance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。用多深度剖面檢查分層，將平均收支和取水口暴露分開，不把結果直接改寫為鹽楔長度。
knowledge.textEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Test stratification with profiles and separate the average balance from intake exposure rather than converting the calculated concentration directly into a salt-wedge intrusion distance.

quiz.question: 要驗證「完全混合與鹽收支」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Complete mixing and salt balance"?
options: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。
量測時不必記錄溫度、水頭、水位歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
排口鹽濃度提高就能證明整個河口工程在所有功能上都更好。
optionsEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly.
Temperature, water head, water-level history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Higher outlet salinity proves that the entire estuary project improves every function.
quiz.explanation: 在圖上標每個入口流量與濃度單位，查核是否使用同時同深度資料，明列完全混合假設。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Label every inflow and concentration unit, checking matched times and depths and stating complete mixing explicitly. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 完全混合與鹽收支：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Complete mixing and salt balance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「完全混合與鹽收支」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Complete mixing and salt balance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：假設體積可加、淡流100m³/s且C=0，鹹流10m³/s且C=35kg/m³，完全混合Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Completely mixed Cout=350/110=3.1818kg/m³.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「河口平均鹽濃度下降就證明所有深度與取水位置都同樣改善。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower mean estuary concentration proves an equal improvement at every depth and intake." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。即使整體平均降低，局部取水點仍可能遇到短暫高濃度水團。
knowledge.textEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Even a falling system mean can coexist with a brief high-concentration water mass reaching a particular intake.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「完全混合與鹽收支」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Complete mixing and salt balance" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。
一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions.
Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
quiz.explanation: 僅量表層可能漏掉底部高鹽入侵，將電導數字當質量濃度又使守恆量綱失真。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Surface-only sampling misses saline bottom intrusion, while substituting conductance for mass concentration breaks the balance dimensions. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 斷面鹽通量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Section salt transport: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斷面鹽通量」如何影響河口鹽水入侵控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Section salt transport” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Saltwater-intrusion control in estuaries”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。平均濃度乘淨流量只適用均勻或明定近似，零淨水量也可能有非零淨鹽輸送；因此要同時觀測水流與鹽分，不能只靠一支鹽度儀解讀入侵。 假設截面均勻且向陸流量20m³/s、鹽質量濃度15kg/m³，向陸鹽通量QC=300kg/s；實際分層需積分uC。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斷面鹽通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. Tidal direction and stratification correlate these variables, so mean concentration times net discharge is valid only under a stated approximation. Zero net water exchange can still produce net salt transport. Simultaneous flow and concentration observations are therefore essential; one salinity sensor cannot independently reveal the full direction or magnitude of intrusion. Assume uniform landward flow20m³/s and salt concentration15kg/m³. Landward flux QC=300kg/s; stratified flow requires section integration of uC. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Section salt transport” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設，非操作設定或設計允收值。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斷面鹽通量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Section salt transport”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.text: 鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。平均濃度乘淨流量只適用均勻或明定近似，零淨水量也可能有非零淨鹽輸送；因此要同時觀測水流與鹽分，不能只靠一支鹽度儀解讀入侵。
knowledge.textEn: Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. Tidal direction and stratification correlate these variables, so mean concentration times net discharge is valid only under a stated approximation.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「斷面鹽通量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Section salt transport" is correct?
options: 一個潮週期淨水量為零就代表淨鹽輸送量必定為零。
初始濃度變化率可以無限制線性外推而不需更新出口鹽濃度。
鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。
optionsEn: Zero net water volume over a tide necessarily means zero net salt transport.
The initial concentration-change rate can be extrapolated indefinitely without updating outlet concentration.
Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section.
quiz.explanation: 鹽通量是流速與濃度在斷面的共同積分，漲退潮方向和分層會讓兩者呈現相關性。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Salt flux integrates velocity times concentration across a section. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Section salt transport” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。比較平均乘積與乘積平均的差異，標示未量區和外推方式，不以淨流量代替雙向交換。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Measure velocity and concentration by section cell with direction and tidal phase, integrating before cycle averaging. Compare product-of-means with mean-product results, documenting unmeasured areas and extrapolation instead of replacing two-way exchange by net water flow alone.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：底層入侵與表層出流可在水量上相抵，若只看淨流量會誤以為沒有鹽輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bottom inflow and surface outflow can cancel volumetrically, making net-discharge records falsely suggest no salt input. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「斷面鹽通量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Section salt transport"?
options: 沿用另一處水工設施或流域的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
將斷面分層量測流速和濃度，保留流向符號與潮相，逐格積分後再做週期平均。
