steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。若更新後水位超出物理幾何範圍，簡單截斷也會改變統計分布，必須明確記錄約束處理方式。
knowledge.textEn: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. Clipping updated levels to physical bounds also changes their statistical distribution and must be documented as a constraint treatment, not presented as an unchanged unconstrained update.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「狀態估計與資料同化」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "State estimation and data assimilation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly.
quiz.explanation: 同一觀測若在一次更新後又當作新資料重複加入，會讓變異數不合理地縮小。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Reusing the same observation as new evidence shrinks variance incorrectly. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 耐久、維護與工程交接
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「異常警報與基準發生率」與「情境比較與可追溯決策」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Anomaly alerts and base rates" and "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「異常警報與基準發生率」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Anomaly alerts and base rates” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。當實際異常很少，正常情況的少量誤報也可能超過真正事件。評估時必須定義事件的時間窗口、持續條件與標記來源，避免把連續一百筆同一事故當成一百次獨立成功。警報應附帶可檢查的殘差、感測品質與相似事件證據，並在資料分布變動時重新評估，不能因為模型輸出一個高分就省略人工判讀。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「異常警報與基準發生率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. When anomalies are rare, false alerts from normal conditions can outnumber real events. Define event windows, persistence and labeling evidence, avoiding treatment of repeated samples from one incident as independent successes. Alerts should expose inspectable residuals and data quality, and performance should be reevaluated after distribution changes rather than replacing review with a high model score. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Anomaly alerts and base rates” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「異常警報與基準發生率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Anomaly alerts and base rates”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 異常警報與基準發生率
knowledge.text: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。當實際異常很少，正常情況的少量誤報也可能超過真正事件。
knowledge.textEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. When anomalies are rare, false alerts from normal conditions can outnumber real events.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「異常警報與基準發生率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Anomaly alerts and base rates" is correct?
options: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。
偵測器的真陽性率是百分之九十五，就表示每次警報都有百分之九十五機率是真的。
只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
optionsEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine.
A ninety-five-percent true-positive rate means every alert has a ninety-five-percent chance of being genuine.
Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
quiz.explanation: 異常偵測器的真陽性率與偽陽性率描述不同條件下的分類表現，不能直接解讀成一次警報為真的機率。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: True-positive and false-positive rates condition on different underlying states and do not directly give the probability that an alert is genuine. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「異常警報與基準發生率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Anomaly alerts and base rates” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Alert precision is 0.00095/(0.00095+0.00999)=8.68%, provided all rates apply to the same population. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.textEn: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Alert precision is 0.00095/(0.00095+0.00999)=8.68%, provided all rates apply to the same population.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「異常警報與基準發生率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Anomaly alerts and base rates", which statement holds?
options: 只要兩條曲線的相關係數最高，就證明兩個感測器已正確同步。
教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01。
把同一支感測器的資料複製十份再平均，就能得到十支獨立儀器的準確度。
optionsEn: Maximum correlation between two curves proves that their sensors are correctly synchronized.
Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01.
Copying one sensor record ten times provides the accuracy of ten independent instruments.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設事件基準率0.001、真陽性率0.95、偽陽性率0.01；警報為真機率=0.95×0.001/(0.95×0.001+0.01×0.999)=8.68%，假設這些比例適用於同一母體。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume event prevalence 0.001, true-positive rate 0.95 and false-positive rate 0.01. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 異常警報與基準發生率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「異常警報與基準發生率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Anomaly alerts and base rates” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 使用包含正常時段的獨立事件集建立混淆矩陣，列出每種工況的事件基準率。將警報合併規則與人工複核結果保留，分開計算事件層級與樣本層級指標，並追蹤漏報及誤報的後續處置，不能只蒐集成功警報作成績單。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Preserve alert-grouping rules and reviewed outcomes, separating event-level from sample-level metrics and tracking missed incidents as well as false alarms instead of collecting only successful alerts. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：以十萬個獨立教學事件建表，計算預期真警報與假警報數量。再把基準率提高十倍而保持兩種分類率不變，重算警報可信度，說明相同分類器為何會在不同母體呈現不同的使用價值。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Tabulate expected true and false alerts across one hundred thousand independent teaching events. Increase prevalence tenfold while holding classification rates fixed, then recompute precision and explain why the same classifier has different practical value in another population.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: High hit rates on preselected abnormal records say nothing about false alerts during normal operation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

knowledge.textEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Preserve alert-grouping rules and reviewed outcomes, separating event-level from sample-level metrics and tracking missed incidents as well as false alarms instead of collecting only successful alerts.

knowledge.text: 以十萬個獨立教學事件建表，計算預期真警報與假警報數量。再把基準率提高十倍而保持兩種分類率不變，重算警報可信度，說明相同分類器為何會在不同母體呈現不同的使用價值。
knowledge.textEn: Tabulate expected true and false alerts across one hundred thousand independent teaching events. Increase prevalence tenfold while holding classification rates fixed, then recompute precision and explain why the same classifier has different practical value in another population.

quiz.question: 要驗證「異常警報與基準發生率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Anomaly alerts and base rates"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

quiz.explanationEn: Build confusion matrices from independent event sets including normal operation, with prevalence by operating state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.titleEn: Anomaly alerts and base rates: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「異常警報與基準發生率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 若只在預先挑選的異常樣本上展示高命中率，就無法知道正常運轉會產生多少誤報。模型上線後需求型態或儀器更換也可能改變基準率與誤差分布，使過去的警報可信度不再適用。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。

Changing demand patterns or instruments can alter prevalence and error distributions, invalidating a previously measured alert precision. quiz.question: 在「異常警報與基準發生率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「情境比較與可追溯決策」如何影響水利設施數位孿生的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Digital twins for water infrastructure”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。每次分析應保存模型版本、資料時間範圍、參數、假設和人工審查結果，使未來能重播同一情境。生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「情境比較與可追溯決策」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement. Preserve model version, data period, parameters, assumptions and reviewed conclusions for reproducible replay. A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「情境比較與可追溯決策」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策
knowledge.text: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。單位供水能耗只是其中一項指標，仍需同時滿足水位、水壓、水質與設備限制；較低能耗若伴隨供水不足，不能視為等效服務下的改善。
knowledge.textEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. Specific energy is only one metric alongside level, pressure, quality and equipment constraints; lower energy with unmet demand is not equivalent service improvement.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" is correct?
options: 只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。
數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints.
Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 數位孿生的情境比較應固定需求、邊界及評估期間，才能把節能差異歸因於所比較的策略。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Scenario comparison holds demand, boundaries and assessment duration fixed so that energy differences can be attributed to the proposed strategy. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「情境比較與可追溯決策」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、水頭、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, water head, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（例如增加 10%），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example by +10%), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。
knowledge.textEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Specific energy is 0.20 and 0.18 kWh/m³, a 10% reduction excluding tariff differences and equipment wear.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real structure, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「情境比較與可追溯決策」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions", which statement holds?
options: 兩支壓力計讀值相同，就表示它們所在位置的總水頭必定相同。
最佳化程式只回傳一組參數，就證明這組參數已被資料唯一辨識。
教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh。
optionsEn: Equal pressure readings always imply equal total hydraulic head at both locations.
A single parameter vector returned by an optimizer proves unique identification by the data.
Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh.
quiz.explanation: 教學假設兩方案均供水1000 m³且均滿足相同限制，耗能分別200與180 kWh；單位能耗0.20與0.18 kWh/m³，節能率(200−180)/200=10%，未含價格差與設備磨耗。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Assume both strategies supply 1000 m³ and satisfy identical constraints, using 200 and 180 kWh. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、水頭與施工荷重，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, water head and construction loads make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。用資料與模型雜湊記錄可重播版本，另列需求及參數敏感度，最後把待現場驗證的假設與已被量測支持的結論分開，避免把模擬排名直接當成操作命令。
knowledge.textEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Record replayable data and model hashes, evaluate demand sensitivity, and separate assumptions needing field confirmation from supported conclusions before converting a scenario ranking into an operational decision.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 建立兩方案比較表，包含供水量、能耗、單位能耗及限制是否滿足，再把其中一方案供水量減少一成。重算指標並說明為何原先節能結論需要重新判讀，最後列出第三人重播分析所需的最小檔案清單。
knowledge.textEn: Compare volume, energy, specific energy and constraint compliance, then reduce the delivery of one strategy by ten percent. Recalculate and reconsider the claimed improvement, listing the minimum files another reviewer needs to reproduce the analysis.

quiz.question: 要驗證「情境比較與可追溯決策」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions"?
options: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
驗證殘差的平均值是零，就表示模型的每一個預測值都完全準確。
optionsEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
A zero mean validation residual means every individual model prediction is exact.
quiz.explanation: 先對照兩方案的供水量、服務品質與邊界條件，再檢查能耗計算是否包含同一組設備。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare supplied volume, service quality and boundaries before checking that energy includes the same equipment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 情境比較與可追溯決策：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scenario comparison and traceable decisions: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「情境比較與可追溯決策」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scenario comparison and traceable decisions” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體結構的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-structure safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：生成式助教可協助整理證據與解釋差異，但其文字結論不能代替可執行模型輸出或現場授權程序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A generative tutor can organize evidence and explain differences, but its prose does not replace executable model results or authorized operating procedures.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要數位孿生預測某方案耗能較低，就可以忽略供水限制直接執行。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Any strategy predicted to use less energy can be implemented without checking water-service constraints." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。缺少版本與輸入紀錄的漂亮圖表也無法重現，因此不能在條件已改變後沿用舊排名而不重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Attractive plots without versioned inputs cannot be reproduced, and old rankings should not be reused after conditions change without recalculation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「情境比較與可追溯決策」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Scenario comparison and traceable decisions" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。
節點出現正水量殘差，就一定代表同等流量的管線漏水。
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency.
A positive node balance residual always equals the physical leakage flow.
quiz.explanation: 若兩方案使用不同需求總量或電價期間，較低帳單不必然表示較高能源效率。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Different demands or tariff periods make lower cost an unreliable indicator of greater energy efficiency. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 長江三峽大壩工程
history.text: 業主介紹將三峽列為混凝土重力壩與航運、發電、防洪結合的工程，記錄一九九四年開始施工，二〇一二年主要機組全部投產。這些是工程背景而非本課假想洪水的校準資料。本新增單元延續原有課程，將焦點放在跨系統守恆及不確定性；一九八七年的監測手冊只是方法文獻年代，二〇二六年則標示教材覆核。蓄水高程與壩體高度分別定義，不能因數字近似便互換使用。
history.textEn: The owner describes a concrete gravity dam combining navigation, generation and flood management, with construction beginning in 1994 and the main generating units all operating in 2012. These milestones establish context rather than calibrate the hypothetical flood in this course. The added units extend earlier lessons through conservation across subsystems and uncertainty. The 1987 instrumentation reference dates literature, while 2026 dates curriculum review. Reservoir elevation and structural dam height retain different reference datums and cannot be interchanged.

history.title: 胡佛壩
history.text: 墾務局以基岩至壩頂道路量得的七百二十六點四英尺描述胡佛壩高度，並明確說明它兼具拱與重力作用。官方紀錄載混凝土於一九三三年六月開始澆置、一九三五年五月完成最後澆置；課程不把最後一盤混凝土等同所有附屬工程竣工。新增內容著重既有大壩的相互作用與證據判讀，原創算例與歷史冷卻系統的實際尺寸保持分離，文獻出版日期也另作方法研究節點。
history.textEn: Reclamation defines Hoover height from foundation rock to the crest roadway and describes both arch and gravity action. Its record places the first concrete in June 1933 and the last placement in May 1935; this is not treated as completion of every associated facility. The additional material concerns interactions and evidence in an existing major dam. Original examples remain separate from historical cooling system dimensions, and publication dates identify methodological references rather than construction events.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大古力水壩
history.text: 墾務局施工史記載大古力工程於一九三三年開始，第一批混凝土在一九三五年澆置，灌溉抽水設施於一九五一年完成。這些分期事件提醒學員：攔河壩、發電與灌溉系統不是同一天形成的單一設備。本課以此分期背景研究接口責任與守恆，並不聲稱假想流量等於現場抽水量。監測手冊出版年代另列為知識背景，二〇二六年的來源核對也與歷史建設明確區分。
history.textEn: Reclamation construction history places the start of Grand Coulee in 1933, the first concrete in 1935 and completion of the irrigation pumping plant in 1951. These stages show that the dam, generation and irrigation systems did not arrive as one device on one date. The course uses that sequence to examine interfaces and conservation, without identifying assumed flows as field pumping records. Instrumentation publication dates describe reference history, and the 2026 source check is distinguished from construction.

history.title: 伊泰普水壩
history.text: 業主歷史記載伊泰普首部機組於一九八四年五月五日開始發電，最後兩部機組於二〇〇七年五月投入運轉。官方頻率說明指出二十部機組分成五十與六十赫茲兩組；此資料用於說明跨電網介面，不暗示兩種交流母線可以直接並聯。本課不沿用網頁中的歷史世界排名，也不把電力容量與年發電量混寫；假想的換流效率與尾水參數都另外標明，文獻年代則屬方法背景。
history.textEn: The owner history records first generation on 5 May 1984 and entry of the last two units in May 2007. Its frequency explanation divides twenty units between fifty and sixty hertz groups, establishing a grid-interface context rather than permission to parallel unlike AC buses. Historical world rankings are not repeated, nor is installed power confused with annual energy. Assumed converter efficiencies and tailwater parameters are identified separately, while reference publication dates describe methods rather than construction.

history.text: 供應商紀錄描述古里第二發電廠五部機組更新，並記載二〇一二年安裝大型法蘭西斯轉輪。文中的七百七十兆瓦是轉輪相關最大功率尺度，不能當作全廠裝機容量，也不能與名目功率混用。本課據此研究設備更新如何驗證，不推定未讀得的壩體施工年代或當前所有設備狀態。歷史監測手冊只是比較文獻，原創測試輸入及二〇二六年覆核日期另列，避免把教材算式寫成供應商保證。

The course uses this evidence to examine verification of renewal without inferring unread dam-construction dates or present condition of every unit. Instrumentation literature supplies bibliographic context; original test inputs and the 2026 review date are separate from any supplier performance guarantee.

history.text: 華能公開介紹記錄小灣六部機組合計四千二百兆瓦，於二〇一〇年八月全部建成投產，並將高邊坡、卸荷與溫控列為工程難題。課程保留這些可核對的背景，但不把三百米級描述當成精確壩高。教學中的彈簧、岩楔及水量模型只分離一項機制，沒有重建業主三維分析或地震輸入。監測文獻出版與教材覆核各自標示，避免把網站文章更新日期誤認為水電站投產日。
history.textEn: Huaneng records six Xiaowan units totaling 4200 MW, all operating in August 2010, and identifies slopes, excavation unloading and temperature control as engineering challenges. The course retains those documented facts without interpreting a three-hundred-metre class description as an exact height. Spring, rock-wedge and water-balance examples isolate mechanisms rather than reproduce the owner three-dimensional model or earthquake inputs. Reference publication and curriculum review are dated separately from commissioning and from website article updates.

Reservoir elevation, dam height and pressure depth retain distinct datums when moving between models.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 白鶴灘水壩
history.text: 三峽集團官方報導記錄白鶴灘十六部百萬千瓦機組於二〇二二年十二月全部投產。本課以此機組尺度為背景，但不把單機功率直接換成結構載重，也不沿用報導的世界排名作永久結論。教材中的岩體方向剛度、混凝土熱性質及機電效率都是原創假設，需要另行試驗才能使用於工程。歷史監測手冊僅作資料方法索引，二〇二六年的來源核對不表示工程在該年新增完工。
history.textEn: The official Three Gorges report records all sixteen million-kilowatt Baihetan units operating in December 2022. That scale motivates the course, but unit power is not converted directly into structural load, and contemporary world rankings are not presented as permanent facts. Directional rock stiffness, concrete thermal properties and electromechanical efficiencies are original assumptions requiring testing before engineering use. Historical instrumentation manuals provide methodological indexing, while the 2026 source check is not a new completion event.

history.title: 溪洛渡水壩
history.text: 供應商技術介紹記錄溪洛渡於二〇一四年六月全廠併網，並列十八部機組及十三點八六吉瓦名目裝機。文中單部發電機的八百五十五點六兆伏安是視在功率，不能當成相同數字的兆瓦。課程保留此單位辨識重點，不重複未獨立核對的減碳估算或世界排名。新增算例的功率因數與水力參數均為假設，歷史文獻年代及教材覆核日期亦與工程投產事件分開。
history.textEn: The supplier technical account records full Xiluodu grid connection in June 2014, eighteen units and 13.86 GW nominal installed capacity. Its 855.6 MVA generator figure is apparent power and cannot be relabeled as the same number of megawatts. The course retains that unit distinction without repeating unverified emissions estimates or world rankings. Power factors and hydraulic values in the new examples are assumptions, and literature dates and curriculum review remain separate from commissioning events.

history.title: 阿斯旺高壩
history.text: 阿斯旺高壩位於埃及尼羅河，水利部官方資料將其列為堆石壩，並記載1971年1月15日正式揭幕。此課以長期蓄水、灌溉輸配及水力發電之間的工程界面為主線，而非只以壩體尺寸衡量成就。不同官方頁面的壩長表述並不一致，因此本課不引用長度；河床以上高度也不當成運轉淨水頭。公開事實用於建立案例背景，全部單元數值、材料參數與水文序列另列為原創假設，不能當作阿斯旺現場紀錄或操作方案。
history.textEn: Aswan High Dam stands on the Nile in Egypt. The water ministry identifies it as a rockfill dam and records formal inauguration on15January1971. This course examines interfaces between long-term storage, irrigation delivery and generation. Conflicting official length descriptions are excluded, and structural height is not treated as operating head. Public facts establish context; every lesson quantity, material parameter and hydrological sequence is separately hypothetical and does not represent field records or an operating plan.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 塔貝拉水壩
history.text: 塔貝拉壩位於巴基斯坦印度河，業主資料將其列為土石壩，世界銀行原始計畫資料記載壩工程於1976年完成。後續擴建利用既有水路增加發電功能，使地基防滲、泥砂淤積與改接水路成為同一系統的長期課題。本課區分原壩完工與2012年第四擴建批准，不把批准日期當成機組投入運轉日期，也不採內文不一致的早期機組加總。1986年原始評估用作工程脈絡，全部算例仍是獨立假想模型，並不重現壩基剖面或現行調度。
history.textEn: Tarbela stands on the Indus in Pakistan. Owner information identifies an embankment dam, and World Bank project records give1976 completion. Later generation extensions make foundation seepage, sedimentation and waterway conversion linked long-term issues. The course distinguishes original completion from approval of the fourth extension in2012; approval is not commissioning. Inconsistent early unit arithmetic is excluded. The1986 project audit supplies context, while all calculations remain hypothetical rather than reconstructions of foundation sections or present operations.

history.title: 卡里巴水壩
history.text: 卡里巴壩橫跨尚比西河，管理局2015年公告記載原壩於1956至1959年間建造。業主說明自1958年蓄水起持續監測，後續修復議題包括水墊沖蝕與溢洪閘門運轉。這些資料讓本課把長期監測、岩體沖坑及閘槽變形連成完整的維護問題，而不將修復簡化成一次混凝土補強。官方舊頁仍含預定工期，本課不據此宣稱目前完工狀態。教學載重、沖坑尺寸與設備能力全部另行假設，不是卡里巴的設計或監測數值。
history.textEn: Kariba crosses the Zambezi. The authority records construction during1956–1959 and monitoring since1958 impoundment. Subsequent rehabilitation addresses plunge-pool erosion and spillway-gate operation, linking rock scour, gate-clearance change and long-term observation. Old owner pages retain forecast schedules, which are not used to claim present completion. All lesson loads, scour dimensions and equipment capacities are independently assumed and are not Kariba design values or monitoring records.

history.title: 阿科松博水壩
history.text: 阿科松博壩位於迦納伏爾塔河，業主確認其為堆石壩，原工程建設期為1961至1965年，電廠頁面列示裝置容量1020MW。本課將堆石與過渡層變形、廣域湖泊蓄水及發電放流時序連結，讓容量數字回到水量與設備限制的脈絡。業主同頁對壩高及壩頂長度存在互相不一致的敘述，因此不採用那些尺寸，也不以單一容量推定年度發電。所有單元幾何、流量與效率為教學假設，不能當成阿科松博實際工況或核准操作程序。
history.textEn: Akosombo stands on Ghana’s Volta River. The owner confirms rockfill construction during1961–1965 and lists1020MW for the plant. This course connects embankment transitions, broad-lake storage and generation-release timing. Conflicting height and crest-length statements on the owner page are excluded, and installed capacity does not determine annual energy. Every lesson geometry, flow and efficiency is hypothetical rather than an Akosombo operating condition or approved procedure.

history.title: 大迪克桑斯壩
history.text: 大迪克桑斯壩位於瑞士高山，業主資料確認其為285m高的重力壩，建設期為1951至1961年，並自1961年起啟用。業主另列原Dixence、Cleuson及後續擴建的不同階段，本課保持各壩與系統年代的區別，不將整體水電系統的高程差混同壩高。課程以自重、水壓、揚力、熱變形與廊道監測建立力學路徑，再連到高山集水與發電能量。全部計算採合成斷面及參數，未使用真實壩體剖面推定安全係數或現場狀態。
history.textEn: The owner identifies Grande Dixence as a285m gravity dam, built during1951–1961 and commissioned from1961. Its history distinguishes the original Dixence, Cleuson and later scheme phases, which are kept separate here. Scheme elevation difference is not dam height. Lessons connect weight, water pressure, uplift, thermal movement and gallery monitoring to alpine collection and generation. Synthetic sections and parameters do not assess the actual dam’s safety or present condition.

history.title: 黑部水壩
history.text: 關西電力歷史頁記載黑四工程於一九六三年竣工，黑部水壩高一百八十六公尺，並記述施工隧道遭遇大量地下水的困難。這些是案例背景，不代表本課能重建原設計。教材以拱的推力與岩盤變形為主線，再延伸至水能、瞬變與監測；參考的美國工兵團一九九四年拱壩手冊僅核對官方目錄與封面年代。與翡翠的並列是教學比較，不表示兩壩的施工、材料或法規相同。
history.textEn: KEPCO records Kuroyon completion in 1963, a dam height of 186 m and difficult groundwater encountered during tunnel construction. These facts establish context and do not reconstruct the original design. The curriculum follows arch thrust and rock deformation before extending to energy, transients and monitoring. The USACE 1994 arch reference was checked at catalogue and cover scope. Comparison with Feitsui is educational and implies no equivalence of construction, materials or governing requirements.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 翡翠水庫大壩
history.text: 翡翠管理機關列出雙曲率變厚度拱壩形式，壩高一百二十二點五公尺。水利署回顧記載一九八七年六月完工，並描述基礎岩盤處理的工程背景。教材不使用舊有總庫容冒充今日有效庫容，也不把示範材料強度宣稱為工程檢測結果。美國拱壩方法目錄與墾務局附屬構造索引提供研究方向，沒有取代本地正式規範。與石門土石壩的比較用於說明傳力及滲流機制的差異，而非優劣排行。
history.textEn: The reservoir authority identifies a variable-thickness double-curvature arch dam with height 122.5 m. A WRA retrospective records completion in June 1987 and discusses foundation treatment. The course does not substitute historical gross storage for current usable capacity or present assumed strengths as project test results. American arch and appurtenant-structure reference indexes provide research directions rather than applicable local approval criteria. Comparison with Shihmen illustrates differences in load transfer and seepage mechanisms and is not a ranking of the two projects.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 石門水庫大壩
history.text: 北區水資源分署資料列出石門水庫一九六四年六月完成，壩高一百三十三點一公尺。官方設施介紹提供中央直立心層及後續取水排砂設施的背景，說明水庫功能會隨使用需求與泥砂問題演變。本課不以早期容量當作當前可用蓄量，也沒有把教學濾層比值寫成現地驗收規定。二〇一四年的墾務局滲流章日期屬方法文獻；與德基拱壩的比較用來辨識土石材料與混凝土傳力的不同。
history.textEn: The northern water authority records completion in June 1964 and height 133.1 m. Its facilities account describes the central vertical core and later withdrawal and sediment arrangements, showing how reservoir functions evolve with demand and sediment problems. Early capacity is not treated as current available storage, and illustrative filter ratios are not field acceptance requirements. The 2014 seepage chapter date belongs to a methodological reference. Comparison with Deji helps distinguish embankment behavior from concrete arch load transfer.

history.title: 德基水庫大壩
history.text: 台電歷史檔案記載一九七三年封堵蓄水，而水利署工程介紹列出一九七四年完成；兩個日期代表不同施工里程碑，不能互相取代。公開壩高為一百八十公尺，形式為雙曲率薄拱壩。教材沿大甲溪梯級背景討論能量守恆，沒有宣稱各級實際水頭與效率等於算例。美國一九九四年拱壩資料只作歷史方法索引，與曾文土石壩的並列用於比較承載方式及調蓄時間尺度。
history.textEn: Taipower records closure and initial impoundment in 1973, while the WRA profile gives completion in 1974. These are distinct milestones and should not replace one another. The public height is 180 m and the form is a thin double-curvature arch. Teaching follows the Dajia cascade context without asserting that actual stage heads or efficiencies equal the examples. The 1994 American arch reference is a historical method index; comparison with Tsengwen concerns load paths and storage time scales.

history.text: 南區水資源分署現行工程資料列出曾文土石壩高度一百三十四公尺、壩頂長四百公尺；歷史頁記載一九七三年十月三十一日完工。教材採此一百三十四公尺值，沒有混用部分舊資料的一百三十三公尺。與烏山頭的串聯功能提供水量分區背景，假想放流與渠道條件不代表運用規則。墾務局滲流章索引日期是文獻年代。南化的比較案例則說明灌溉多目標與公共原水供應問題各有不同限制。

Comparison with Nanhua highlights distinct constraints in multipurpose irrigation storage and public raw-water supply.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 南化水庫大壩
history.text: 水利署歷史文章區分一九九三年七月開始蓄水、一九九四年三月主要工程完成與同年七月正式供水，並列出壩高八十七點五公尺的分區土石壩。甲仙越域引水是供水背景，不表示本課使用現行取水權限或時刻表。文章內當時預測的後續工程日期沒有當成已實現事件引用。課程使用墾務局公開索引作容量計算、滲流及量測研究入口；與黑部的比較只針對水量與能量的不同用途。
history.textEn: The WRA history separates initial impoundment in July 1993, completion of main works in March 1994 and formal supply in July 1994, and lists an 87.5 m zoned embankment. Jiaxian diversion establishes supply context without providing current abstraction permissions or schedules. Later predicted dates in that historical article are not represented as completed events. Public Reclamation indexes offer entry points for capacity, seepage and measurement study. Comparison with Kurobe concerns different uses of water and energy rather than equivalent operating conditions.

history.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
history.text: 東斯海爾德防潮閘位於荷蘭澤蘭，以平常保持開口、風暴時形成屏障的方式，兼顧潮汐環境與防洪需求。北海大洪水促成荷蘭強化防洪的三角洲工程計畫。 東斯海爾德防潮閘工程開始建設，後續保留開放潮汐設計。 東斯海爾德防潮閘完成，形成長期海口防護設施。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Eastern Scheldt Barrier in Zeeland combines normally open tidal exchange with storm protection, making ecological exchange and structural loading inseparable engineering questions. The North Sea flood prompts the Netherlands to strengthen protection through the Delta Works. Construction begins on the Eastern Scheldt Barrier with an open tidal configuration. The Eastern Scheldt Barrier is completed as a long-term estuary protection structure. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統
history.text: 威尼斯MOSE在潟湖海口配置多組浮動翻板，讓防潮、通航和潟湖環境成為彼此牽動的系統問題。七月十日全部七十八座閘門試升，不等同全部工程竣工。 十月三日市政府記錄首次實際防潮事件。 美國工兵團出版機電設計手冊作本課技術比較，並非威尼斯事件。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: Venice MOSE places groups of buoyant flap gates at lagoon inlets, coupling flood exclusion, navigation and the lagoon environment. All seventy-eight gates rise in the July ten test, distinct from full project completion. The municipality records the first actual flood-protection event on October three. USACE publishes mechanical-electrical guidance used for comparison, not a Venice project event. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.text: 濱海堤壩在新加坡市中心把淡水蓄存、防洪排水與公共空間結合，低潮重力排水與高潮抽水對應不同邊界條件。十月三十一日濱海堤壩正式開放，形成新加坡第十五座水庫。 水工鋼結構設計指引出版，作活動閘門的技術比較資料。 機電設計指引更新，作抽水與備援觀念的教育參照。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: Marina Barrage combines freshwater storage, urban drainage and public space in Singapore, with different boundary conditions for low-tide gravity flow and high-tide pumping. Marina Barrage officially opens on October thirty-one, forming Singapores fifteenth reservoir. Hydraulic steel-structure guidance is published as a technical comparison for movable gates. Mechanical-electrical guidance is updated as educational context for pumping and redundancy. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.title: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘
history.text: 巴拿馬運河擴建新船閘把大型滾動門與節水池整合，本課承接既有概念課並深化有限水池均衡、密度交換與非恆定荷載。二月首座阿瓜克拉拉節水池充水，進入系統測試階段。 六月二十六日擴建運河正式啟用，開始新船閘服務。 機電設計指引提供比較框架，此節點為手冊出版而非運河改建。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。

This course extends earlier conceptual lessons with finite-pool equalization, density exchange and transient loading. The first Agua Clara saving basin is filled in February for system testing. The expanded canal officially opens on June twenty-six, beginning new-lock service. Mechanical-electrical guidance provides comparison context; this is a publication milestone, not a canal reconstruction. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. history.text: 三峽升船機採用齒輪齒條提升和配重系統，公開資料可用來辨認長行程船廂的多點同步與高程銜接問題。十月升船機續建工程恢復施工，後續進行設備安裝與整合。 九月十八日開始試通航，與後續正式竣工驗收區分。 十二月二十七日竣工驗收，形成工程階段的另一里程碑。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。

Completion acceptance occurs on December twenty-seven as a separate project milestone. history.title: 荷蘭三角洲工程
history.text: 三角洲工程是多個防潮閘、水壩和堤防組成的區域系統，不是一座能代表所有功能的單體工程；後續三角洲計畫加入持續調適觀念。北海洪災促使荷蘭推動區域尺度的三角洲防洪工程。 十月二十二日荷蘭艾瑟爾防潮閘啟用，成為首項完成工程。 官方記錄多座防潮閘首次同時關閉，顯示系統共同面對海象。本課從公開構造辨認荷載、能量與功能之間的關係，另以自訂尺寸做守恆與極限算例。啟用、首次運轉和後續維護是不同里程碑；課程不將新聞日期當成施工日期，也不以比較用的地標暗示相同設備或相同操作規則。
history.textEn: The Delta Works form a regional system of barriers, dams and dykes rather than one structure representing every function. The later Delta Programme adds continuing adaptation. The North Sea flood prompts a regional Dutch Delta Works protection programme. The Hollandsche IJssel Barrier opens on October twenty-two as the first completed work. The owner records barriers closing simultaneously for the first time, illustrating shared storm exposure. The course uses published configurations to distinguish loads, energy and system function, with separately assumed dimensions for conservation and limit calculations. Opening, first operation and later maintenance are different milestones. Publication dates are not substituted for construction events, and comparison landmarks do not imply identical equipment or operating rules.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 混凝土重力壩分塊澆築
history.text: 重力壩分塊澆築把供料、溫控和接縫安排結合，讓施工階段留下的初始條件成為長期結構行為的一部分。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Block-by-block gravity-dam construction connects supply, temperature control and joints, making construction initial conditions part of the long-term structural response. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.text: 碾壓混凝土把土工式鋪層碾壓和水泥水化材料結合，品質核心由單一強度轉為材料、壓實與層面連續性的共同證據。美國墾務局出版重力壩設計專書，提供施工與結構整合背景。 美國工兵團重力壩設計手冊出版，整理荷載與穩定分析。 碾壓混凝土手冊出版，提供不同大體積澆築方法的比較。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: RCC combines earthwork-style lift compaction with cement hydration, shifting quality evidence from strength alone toward materials, compaction and interlift continuity. Reclamation publishes Design of Gravity Dams, providing integrated construction and structural context. USACE publishes Gravity Dam Design guidance for loading and stability analysis. The RCC manual is published, enabling comparison with other mass-concrete placement methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 雙曲拱壩拱座分析
history.titleEn: Abutment analysis for double-curvature arch dams
history.text: 雙曲拱壩把壩體與兩岸岩體當作共同承載系統，拱座調查和三維變形相容比單看混凝土壓應力更能揭露控制條件。墾務局修訂拱壩與重力壩設計準則，提供兩種傳力方式比較。 工兵團拱壩設計手冊出版，整理設計、分析與施工背景。 重力壩手冊出版，作岩基及穩定概念的對照。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: A double-curvature arch dam and its abutment rock act as one load-bearing system. Abutment investigation and three-dimensional compatibility reveal controls beyond concrete compression alone. Reclamation revises arch and gravity design criteria, comparing distinct load-transfer systems. USACE publishes Arch Dam Design, covering design, analysis and construction context. Gravity Dam Design is published as a comparison for foundation and stability concepts. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.text: 混凝土面板堆石壩把防滲和承載功能交給不同材料，面板、墊層、堆石與趾板必須在變形後仍保持相容與連續。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。

Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.titleEn: Zoned placement in earth-core rockfill dams
history.text: 心牆土石壩依靠分區材料共同工作，防滲不等於各區都阻水；反濾保持、排水連通和心牆應力狀態共同決定缺陷是否會擴大。反濾層標準章節更新，聚焦顆粒保持與區域界面。 土石壩設計與施工章節更新，連結材料、填築與品質控制。 滲流與監測章節更新，提供服役水壓及行為判讀背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。

Filter retention, connected drainage and core stress together determine whether defects can progress. The protective-filter standard is updated, emphasizing particle retention and zone interfaces. Seepage and monitoring chapters are updated, supporting interpretation of service pressures and behavior. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.text: 瀝青心牆以低滲透且可變形的材料連接堆石承載體，材料比例、黏彈反應與施工接觸必須共同驗證，不能只以單一密度指標判斷。墾務局土石壩施工與設計章節更新，提供分區填築的一般背景。 瀝青心牆簡化材料模型研究出版，探討分析所需的材料描述。 曲學與照壁山心牆研究出版，分別報告設計表現及施工速率個案。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: An asphalt core combines low permeability with deformation capacity inside a rockfill support body. Mixture proportions, viscoelastic response and construction contacts require joint assessment rather than one density criterion. Reclamation updates embankment design and construction chapters, providing general zoned-placement context. A simplified asphalt-core material-model study is published, addressing descriptions needed for analysis. Quxue and Zhaobishan core studies are published, reporting design performance and a construction-rate case. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.title: 壩基帷幕灌漿
history.text: 基礎帷幕灌漿把裂隙地質、漿液流變和水力驗證連在一起，耗漿量只是過程資料，真正的工程判斷還要追蹤空間連續與剩餘通水路徑。墾務局重力壩設計專書提供岩基處理與結構整合背景。 土石壩設計標準的基礎灌漿章節更新，官方目錄列明版本。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，整理材料、處理與驗證背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Foundation curtain grouting connects fracture geology, grout rheology and hydraulic verification. Consumption is process evidence; engineering interpretation must also track spatial continuity and remaining conductive paths. Reclamation gravity-dam guidance provides context for foundation treatment and structural integration. The foundation-grouting chapter of embankment standards is updated, as documented by the official index. USACE publishes Grouting Technology, organizing material, treatment and verification context. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.title: 壩基排水廊道
history.text: 排水廊道把深部水壓轉為可觀測流量，同時容納監測與集排水系統；判讀必須把孔壓、流量、出口水位與構造變形一起放進水力收支。墾務局重力壩設計專書提供揚壓和排水監測背景。 混凝土壩監測手冊出版，官方目錄列明此技術文獻。 接縫止水研究報告完成，說明滲漏與廊道維護的關聯。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Drainage galleries connect deep pressures to observable discharge while housing monitoring and collection systems. Interpretation must combine pore pressure, flow, outlet level and structural deformation within a hydraulic balance. Reclamation gravity-dam guidance provides context for uplift and drainage monitoring. The Concrete Dam Instrumentation Manual is published, documented in the official technical catalog. A joint-waterstop research report is completed, explaining links between leakage and gallery maintenance. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.text: 壩體接縫灌漿把分開澆築的混凝土塊連成預定傳力系統，結構封拱與既有止水修復是不同目的，課程將兩者證據分開並比較水力與力學性能。重力壩設計專書出版，提供混凝土分塊與接縫背景。 工兵團拱壩設計手冊出版，提供封拱與三維傳力背景。 工兵團灌漿技術手冊出版，作材料與驗證方法參照。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Dam-joint grouting connects separately placed blocks into an intended load-transfer system. Structural closure and repair of existing waterstops have different purposes; this course separates their evidence while comparing hydraulic and mechanical performance. Gravity-dam design guidance is published, providing context for concrete blocks and joints. USACE arch-dam guidance is published, supporting closure and three-dimensional load-transfer context. USACE Grouting Technology is published as a reference for materials and verification methods. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.title: 大壩施工導流
history.text: 施工導流把暫時水工構造、洪水風險與永久工程施工階段連結，核心不是單一設計流量，而是每個轉換階段的水力能力、暴露時間與可驗證完成條件。重力壩設計專書提供水工建設與施工整合背景。 臨時圍堰與支撐開挖規劃規定發布，涵蓋風險與永久構造完整性。 土石壩施工標準章節更新，提供導流和基坑施工的一般背景。這些年份是技術出版節點，不代表某座壩的施工年表。課程從公開工法建立原創算例，地標僅用於對照不同壩型與環境；每項材料參數、荷載和允許條件仍需依工程調查與專案設計重新確定。
history.textEn: Construction diversion connects temporary hydraulic works, flood risk and permanent construction stages. Its core is not one discharge value but the capacity, exposure duration and verifiable completion conditions of each transition. Gravity-dam design guidance provides context for integrating hydraulic works and construction. Temporary-cofferdam and braced-excavation planning requirements are issued, covering risk and permanent-structure integrity. The embankment-construction standards chapter is updated, providing general diversion and excavation context. These years mark technical publications rather than construction events at a particular dam. The course develops original calculations from public engineering principles. Landmarks compare dam types and settings; material parameters, loads and admissible conditions still require project investigations and specific design. The examples do not assert that an unverified technique was used at a named structure.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 壩體滲流監測
history.text: 本課所研究的以水頭流量與含砂證據辨識壩體滲流演變，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。採飽和等溫一維或集中參數示意，實際壩體可能非均質且具暫態儲水。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on diagnosing dam seepage through head discharge and sediment evidence reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Saturated isothermal one-dimensional or lumped examples do not represent heterogeneous transient dam foundations. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.textEn: The focus on connecting retention permeability placement and continuity in filter design reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Gradation and hydraulic examples are screening tools; filter criteria depend on base-soil classification dispersivity and test procedures. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.text: 本課所研究的辨識豎井溢洪道的堰流孔流通氣與控制轉換，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。各算例分屬不同控制工況，不可把自由堰流與滿管流公式同時套在同一斷面。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on distinguishing shaft-spillway weir orifice ventilation and control transitions reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Examples represent different control regimes; free-weir and full-pipe relations must not be applied simultaneously at one section. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大壩止水帶施工
history.text: 本課所研究的以接縫變形材料接續與澆置品質形成連續止水，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。數值均為材料幾何與水量盤點，不能替代止水帶產品試驗、接縫設計與壓力驗證。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on forming continuous water barriers through joint movement splicing and placement quality reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Numbers describe geometry and water accounting, not substitutes for product testing joint design and pressure verification. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.textEn: The focus on verifying sediment bypass through diversion transport abrasion and downstream connection reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. The focus is sediment bypass rather than arbitrary foundation flushing; simplified transport and abrasion examples need field gradation validation. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水庫異重流排砂
history.text: 本課所研究的以密度差潛入沉降與底孔捕捉解析異重流，反映水工設計由單一尺寸選取走向水流、材料、施工與長期監測共同驗證的發展。均勻兩層與稀懸浮算例只呈現尺度，實際異重流受分層地形紊混與粒徑演變控制。 美國墾務局官方目錄列有1978年消能工專論、1980年水力試驗技術及1987年小壩設計，這些是技術文件出版年份，不是本課假想工程的啟用日期。所列具名工程只供公開原理與邊界比較，不主張取得其設計圖、現場紀錄或專有參數。
history.textEn: The focus on analyzing density currents through plunging settling and low-outlet capture reflects development from isolated sizing toward joint verification of flow, materials, construction and long-term observations. Uniform two-layer dilute-suspension examples illustrate scales; real currents depend on stratification topography mixing and grain-size evolution. The Reclamation catalog lists the 1978 energy-dissipator monograph, 1980 hydraulic laboratory techniques and 1987 small-dam manual. These are publication dates, not commissioning dates for a hypothetical project. Named works support comparisons of public principles and boundaries; this course claims no access to proprietary drawings, field records or project parameters.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水壩地震動力分析
history.text: 水壩耐震方法隨結構型式及材料機制而分化，不能以一套線性振子概括所有壩。胡佛壩官方歷史記錄一九三五年主壩混凝土澆置完成，西斯克壩則在一九六三至一九六七年建成分區土石結構，兩者在此只作材料與幾何比較。工兵團二〇〇三年手冊整理混凝土水工結構線彈性歷時分析，墾務局二〇一五年土石壩耐震章節另處理相關土壤行為。課程以可追溯出版紀錄說明方法範圍，不宣稱原創質量、剛度或孔壓值曾在這些工程量得，也不把古老工程完成年份視為現行耐震驗證。
history.textEn: Seismic methods differ with structural form and material mechanism; one linear oscillator cannot describe every dam. Hoover’s official history records completion of main-dam concrete in1935, while Sisk was built as a zoned embankment during1963–1967. They are used only for material and geometry comparison. The2003 USACE manual addresses linear-elastic time histories for concrete hydraulic structures, while Reclamation’s2015 embankment chapter addresses relevant soil behavior. Publication history defines scope, without presenting synthetic masses, stiffnesses or pore pressures as measurements at these landmarks or treating historical completion as current seismic verification.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 水力模型縮尺試驗
history.text: 水工模型的價值來自可控制邊界並檢查機制，而不是宣稱微縮模型包含全部原型物理。墾務局一九八〇年水工實驗室技術手冊整理相似律、製作與量測方法，後續量水手冊解釋佛祿數在自由水面模型的角色。官方研究目錄列二〇一五年克利埃勒姆魚道模型及二〇一八年福爾松附加溢洪道閘門研究，顯示不同問題需要不同觀察量。Deltares另以伊默伊登分層流模型比較物理與數值結果。本課所有尺寸與流量獨立假設，不將案例曾用模型解釋成任意縮尺都可信。
history.textEn: Physical models offer controlled boundaries and mechanism checks rather than containing every prototype process in miniature. Reclamation’s1980 laboratory manual organizes similitude, fabrication and measurement, and its water-measurement guidance explains Froude similarity for free surfaces. The official catalogue lists2015 Cle Elum fish-passage studies and2018 Folsom auxiliary-spillway gate work, illustrating different questions and observations. Deltares separately compares physical and numerical stratified-flow models at IJmuiden. All dimensions and flows here are independently assumed; the existence of a landmark model study does not imply that any chosen reduction scale is reliable.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 抽蓄水庫水位調度
history.text: 抽蓄的核心是先用電把水提升，再於需要時讓水回流發電，並非生產額外能量。巴斯郡業主記錄電站於一九八五年十二月商轉，墾務局埃爾伯特資料提供另一組真實抽蓄配置。本課不把兩站的營運參數混成通用模板。美國陸軍工兵團二〇〇八年更新水力電廠結構手冊；能源部二〇二二年的介紹則記錄國家實驗室指南及二〇二一年工具發布，提醒分析服務、時間邊界和權衡。下列數值全為獨立教學假設，不是任一電站的調度表。
history.textEn: Pumped storage first uses electricity to lift water and later recovers part of that energy; it does not create additional energy. The Bath County owner records commercial operation in December1985, while Reclamation’s Mt. Elbert data supplies another genuine configuration. Their operating parameters are not blended into a universal template. USACE updated hydroelectric structural guidance in2008, and DOE’s2022 article describes laboratory valuation guidance and the tool released in2021, emphasizing services, boundaries and tradeoffs. Every numerical example below is an independent teaching assumption rather than a plant schedule.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 壓力鋼管錨定與支承
history.text: 大型水力工程的鋼管需要把水壓與重量可靠地送到支承和地基，設計與後續檢查因此相互依賴。胡佛壩官方歷史描述壓力鋼管和錨定工程；埃克盧特納資料則記錄包覆鋼管、混凝土錨塊與地基鋼樁，提供不同配置的比較。墾務局鋼壓力管專論於一九四九年出版並在一九六六年修訂，二〇二二年八月的檢查手冊另強調維護證據。本課不把歷史案例的存在當成合成尺寸可直接施工的理由，亦不把舊專論替代場址適用的設計要求。
history.textEn: Large hydropower penstocks must transfer pressure and weight into supports and foundations, making design and inspection interdependent. Hoover’s official history describes penstocks and anchorage, while Eklutna documents encased steel, concrete anchor blocks and foundation piles as a contrasting configuration. Reclamation’s steel-penstock monograph was published in1949 and revised in1966; the August2022 inspection manual supplies a separate maintenance reference. These historical examples do not authorize construction from synthetic dimensions, and an older monograph is not substituted for applicable site design requirements.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 調壓井水錘控制
history.text: 調壓設施的作用是改變長引水路的動量交換與壓力邊界，並非讓水錘從此消失。埃克盧特納官方歷史記錄調壓井於一九五三年開挖、一九五四年襯砌，提供真實井式設施的背景。科切拉配水管網則出現在墾務局一九五四年的湧浪控制專論，其灌溉配水邊界不應直接等同水力機組。工兵團二〇〇八年更新的水力電廠結構手冊提供另一方法入口。本課把各文件年代保留為出版或施工事實，所有管長、流速、井面積和壓力則另設為教學算例。
history.textEn: Surge facilities change momentum exchange and pressure boundaries in long waterways rather than eliminating every transient. Eklutna’s official history records shaft excavation in1953 and lining in1954 as a genuine shaft context. The Coachella distribution network appears in Reclamation’s1954 surge-control monograph, but irrigation boundaries are not equated with turbine behavior. USACE’s2008 hydroelectric structural update provides another methodological entry point. Dates remain publication or construction facts; conduit length, velocity, shaft area and pressure are separately specified as synthetic teaching inputs throughout the lesson.

history.titleEn: Water-hammer analysis for long water mains
history.text: 大型輸水工程的知識由管殼設計逐漸延伸到供水韌性與量測校核。美國墾務局壓力管專論的初版於1949年發行，現存修訂版提供歷史機理參照；2020年EPANET手冊則說明配水管網延時分析。紐約於2025年公告德拉瓦繞道須重新採購接通工程，因此本課不將其寫成已完工案例。莫卡辛系統另呈現老舊鋼管與支座更新議題。所有課內算例為獨立假設，未移植上述工程的操作參數。
history.textEn: Knowledge of large water conduits has expanded from shell design to supply resilience and measurement validation. Reclamation first issued its penstock monograph in 1949; its available revision is a historical mechanics reference. The 2020 EPANET manual addresses extended-period distribution modeling. New York announced a new procurement process for Delaware bypass connection in 2025, so this course does not describe it as completed. Moccasin supplies a separate aging-pipe and support-renewal comparison. Every lesson calculation uses independent assumptions rather than operating parameters from those projects.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 輸水管線洩漏聲學定位
history.titleEn: Acoustic leak location in water mains
history.text: 聲學測漏的發展從聽音經驗延伸到雙點相關、數位訊號與可追溯驗證。美國環保署2010年水損指南整理計量及測漏方法，香港水務署2017年屋苑指引則說明調查與修復後驗證。青衣Q-Leak訓練中心於2021年七月啟用，以不同管材及模擬漏點提供可控制的訓練環境；香港智管網另提供分區水量和壓力背景。兩者是互補的調查尺度，本課不把訓練命中率當成全城市管網準確率，也不宣稱每一種感測方式已用於所有區域。
history.textEn: Acoustic leak work has expanded from listening experience into correlation, digital signals and traceable validation. EPA’s 2010 water-loss guide surveys metering and detection, while Hong Kong’s 2017 estate guideline addresses investigation and verification after repair. The Tsing Yi Q-Leak centre opened in July 2021, using varied materials and simulated leaks for controlled training. Hong Kong’s Water Intelligent Network supplies separate district-flow and pressure context. These are complementary investigation scales; the course does not equate training hit rates with city-wide accuracy or claim every sensing method is installed in every district.

history.text: 分區計量把大型配水網切成可追蹤的水量控制體，但數位化並未取消水量守恆與儀表校核。美國環保署2010年指南整理水損帳與計量方法，2020年EPANET手冊提供管網需求及水質模型。香港智管網以分區流量和壓力支持調查排序；新加坡PUB於2021年公告首期三十萬智慧水表，用戶尺度資料可補充分區需求背景。這些計畫的量測層級不同，本課只作方法比較，不宣稱兩者使用相同演算法或全部水量殘差都來自漏水。
history.textEn: District metering divides a large network into traceable water-balance control volumes, but digitalization does not remove conservation or instrument checks. EPA’s 2010 guide documents water-loss accounting and metering, while its 2020 EPANET manual supports network demand and quality models. Hong Kong’s Water Intelligent Network uses district flow and pressure to prioritize investigation. PUB announced Singapore’s first 300,000 smart meters in 2021, providing customer-scale demand context. These programmes operate at different measurement levels; the course compares methods without claiming identical algorithms or attributing every residual to leakage.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 配水管網壓力管理
history.text: 壓力管理由單一閥門調節擴展成分區觀測與服務可靠度問題。美國環保署2010年水損指南討論多種控制措施，2020年EPANET手冊加入壓力相依需求能力，讓模型可區分要求流量與可供流量。香港智管網把壓力管理區與分區計量連結，新加坡2021年智慧水表公告則提供需求數位化的比較背景。這些公開資料支持方法脈絡，並不提供本課假設閥門增益、壓力需求或水質門檻；列名計畫也不被宣稱採用每一個教學算式。
history.textEn: Pressure management has expanded from individual valve regulation into district observation and service reliability. EPA’s 2010 water-loss guide discusses multiple control measures, while the 2020 EPANET manual adds pressure-dependent demand capability, distinguishing requested from available delivery. Hong Kong’s Water Intelligent Network links pressure-management areas with district metering, and Singapore’s 2021 smart-meter announcement offers a demand-digitalization comparison. These sources establish method context rather than the lesson’s hypothetical gains, required pressures or water-quality limits, and named programmes are not presumed to use every teaching equation.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海水淡化取水工程
history.text: 海淡取水將供水能力、海洋環境與海岸地質連在一起，公開案例可用來比較調查方法而非移植尺寸。西澳伯斯奎那那廠於2006年開始產水，賓寧納普南部廠於2011年開始產水。加州於2015年將海淡取排水議題納入海洋計畫，後續地下取水專家報告須連同2025年主管機關回應閱讀，回應明示它不能作唯一合規指南。本課因此將公開歷史、研究限制與原創算例分開，不從單一海岸案例推定其他地點的取水可行性。
history.textEn: Desalination intakes connect supply capacity, marine ecology and coastal geology. Public cases support comparison of investigation methods rather than transfer of dimensions. Kwinana’s Perth plant began production in 2006 and the Southern plant at Binningup in 2011. California incorporated desalination intake and discharge issues into its Ocean Plan in 2015. A later subsurface-intake panel report must be read with the 2025 agency response, which states that it is not a sole compliance guide. This course separates public history, study limitations and original examples rather than transferring feasibility from one coastline to another.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海水淡化鹵水擴散排放
history.text: 伯斯奎那那海水淡化廠於2006年開始產水，南部賓寧納普廠於2011年開始產水，業主資料提供取排水與海域監測的實際背景。加州於2015年修訂海洋計畫海淡相關條文，這是特定司法區的歷史事件而不是全球共用限值。美國環保署於2024年發布PLUMES第二點〇理論手冊，說明近場與遠場模型；其子模型邊界仍須核對，不能把一般羽流功能當成任意沿底鹵水的有效證明。本課各模型為獨立教學假設。
history.textEn: Perth’s Kwinana desalination plant began production in 2006 and Southern’s Binningup plant in 2011, providing owner-documented marine-system context. California amended its desalination-related Ocean Plan provisions in 2015, a jurisdiction-specific historical event rather than a universal limit. EPA issued the PLUMES 2.0 theory manual in 2024, documenting near- and far-field methods. Submodel limits still require checking; general plume capability does not validate arbitrary bottom-spreading brine. All numerical models here use independent teaching assumptions.

history.title: 河岸取水口防淤設計
history.text: 墾務局於2006年發布取水魚類保護手冊，2009年補充現地水力評估方法，強調設施幾何、魚種及季節條件不能以單一規則取代。弗里波特區域設施於2011年完成，提供河岸取水與區域供水的案例；紅崖新抽水站及篩網於2012年九月實質完成並移交營運。本課不將早期紅崖研究抽水站與新工程混同，也不宣稱這些工程使用本課指定的沉砂池或沖砂流量。算例專供比較守恆與尺度。
history.textEn: Reclamation issued its fish-protection manual in 2006 and added field hydraulic-evaluation guidance in 2009, emphasizing site geometry, species and season rather than one universal rule. Freeport regional facilities were completed in 2011, illustrating river intake and regional supply. Red Bluff’s new pumping plant and screen reached substantial completion and operational transfer in September 2012. The earlier Red Bluff research pumping plant is not conflated with that new project, nor are lesson settling basins or flushing flows attributed to either project. Calculations compare conservation and scale only.

history.title: 河川水位自動遙測
history.text: 維克斯堡站歷史資料記載1977年起的橋下游觀測位置，並說明不同位置即使共用基準仍受水面坡度影響。美國地質調查局於2010年發布水位量測和測站水準測量方法，強調感測與基準維護需並行。李斯渡口官方站頁提供站號、連續資料及明確水位高程換算背景。NOAA的資料收集系統則展示現地平台、衛星與發布鏈的架構。本課於2026年核對這些公開資料，不推定列名測站使用任何特定電池或假設備援配置。
history.textEn: Vicksburg’s historical record documents the downstream-bridge observation location from 1977 and notes that water-surface slope affects readings even under a shared datum. USGS published stage-measurement and gaging-station leveling methods in 2010, linking sensing with datum maintenance. The official Lees Ferry page supplies its identifier, continuous-data context and explicit elevation conversion. NOAA’s Data Collection System illustrates platform, satellite and distribution architecture. These public materials were checked in 2026; no particular battery or hypothetical redundancy arrangement is attributed to either station.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 防洪抽水站機組整合
history.text: 上環雨水抽水站於2009年啟用，業主說明其地下儲水、閘門和抽水共同處理低窪區與潮水問題。西部封閉綜合工程於2012年八月首次為風暴事件關閉閘門並操作抽水，提供大型外水阻隔與內水排除的比較。香港2018年雨水手冊涵蓋防洪抽水設施，工兵團官方目錄則確認2020年機電設計手冊版本。本課核對的是這些歷史與技術範圍，沒有將舊版同名PDF誤稱新版全文，也沒有推定任何列名工程使用假設泵曲線。
history.textEn: Sheung Wan was commissioned in 2009; its owner describes underground storage, gates and pumps addressing low ground and tidal backflow. The West Closure Complex first closed gates and pumped for a storm event in August 2012, providing a larger-scale comparison of exterior protection and interior drainage. Hong Kong’s 2018 drainage manual covers flood pumping, and the USACE official catalogue confirms its 2020 mechanical/electrical manual edition. These historical facts and scopes were checked without mislabeling an older same-named PDF as the new full text or attributing hypothetical pump curves to either project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 都市滯洪池配置
history.text: 大坑東蓄洪計畫於2004年九月啟用，利用離線蓄水和雨後抽排減輕下游負荷；業主特別說明截流太早或太晚都會改變效益。跑馬地於2017年三月全面啟用，結合地下空間、可動堰與監測。美國環保署同年發布雨洪模型水理參考手冊，提供儲水幾何及流量控制的技術背景。這些公開工程和方法形成比較脈絡，但本課池面積、孔口尺寸與排空時間皆為獨立教學假設，未推定實際工程的控制規則。
history.textEn: Tai Hang Tung was commissioned in September 2004, using offline storage and post-storm pumping to relieve downstream demand; its owner notes that interception too early or too late changes effectiveness. Happy Valley entered full service in March 2017 with underground space, movable weir and monitoring. EPA published its hydraulic SWMM reference in the same year, documenting storage geometry and flow controls. These projects and methods provide context, but lesson areas, openings and drawdown times are independent assumptions rather than actual operating rules.

history.title: 河道分洪工程
history.text: 紅河原分洪道於1962至1968年興建，曼尼托巴官方資料說明低水位時入口門檻和洪水時主河與繞道互動；擴建投資於2005年開始。元朗排洪繞道於2003年開工、2006年完成，把部分逕流帶到錦田河下游，並結合濕地與低流量管理。環保署2017年水理手冊提供管渠、控制構造和演算方法背景。本課僅借用已核對的歷史與功能，未宣稱兩處工程採用所列理想堰或假設糙率。
history.textEn: The original Red River Floodway was constructed from 1962 to 1968; Manitoba describes the low-stage inlet threshold and interaction of river and bypass during floods, with expansion investment beginning in 2005. Yuen Long began construction in 2003 and was completed in 2006, diverting part of runoff toward lower Kam Tin while integrating wetland and low-flow management. EPA’s 2017 hydraulic manual supplies routing and control-method context. Only verified history and function are used; neither project is claimed to employ the lesson’s ideal weir or assumed roughness.
