history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 土堤壓密與防滲
history.text: 墾務局於2011年發布土石壩濾層章、2012年發布填築施工章，2014年滲流章進一步區分出口隆起與其他侵蝕機制。這些文件提供可轉用的土工機理，不是所有地區堤防的驗收規範。工兵團2013年公告西沙加緬度南河路退縮堤防防滲牆完成，並指出堤體已於前一年完成；不與南港其他分期工程混淆。曼尼托巴官方另列紅河分洪系統西堤。本課不把教學密度、滲透係數或施工時程歸屬上述工程。
history.textEn: Reclamation published its embankment-dam filter chapter in 2011, construction chapter in 2012 and seepage chapter in 2014, distinguishing exit heave from other erosion mechanisms. These provide transferable geotechnical principles, not universal levee acceptance criteria. A 2013 Corps announcement reports completion of the South River Road setback-levee cutoff in West Sacramento and identifies the embankment as completed the previous year; it is not conflated with other Southport phases. Manitoba separately identifies the Floodway West Dike. Lesson densities, conductivities and timing are not attributed to these projects.

history.text: 環境署資料記錄比尤德利塞文河北區於2004年、南區於2006年完成，結合混凝土牆、可拆擋板及抽水站；2020年維護公告特別涉及地面滲漏和接縫重封。波士頓主要防洪閘及相連工程於2020年十二月完成，但不等於所有後續港口工程都在該年竣工。工兵團官方目錄核對2022年防洪牆手冊的版本與範圍，本課未把取得受限的全文條文當已逐條核實。數值均為獨立假設，用來說明力學與資料需求。
history.textEn: Environment Agency records identify Severnside North completion in 2004 and South in 2006, combining concrete walls, removable barriers and pumps. Its 2020 maintenance release specifically addresses ground seepage and resealing. Boston’s primary gate and associated works completed in December 2020, not every later port-related component. The Corps official catalogue verifies the 2022 floodwall manual edition and scope; restricted full text is not represented as clause-by-clause verification. Numerical examples are independent assumptions explaining mechanics and evidence needs.

history.text: 環境署技術報告版權日期為2011年八月，雖資料頁標題保留2010字樣，本課依全文區分出版日期與計畫名稱。比尤德利塞文河南區於2006年完成，2020年維護公告說明接縫與地面滲漏仍需持續管理；比爾斯角於2025年九月達營運完工，細部景觀工作當時仍續作。科隆官方營運資料另說明固定與活動防線按河水位分段配合。本課不複製這些城市的實際啟動門檻，歷史產品清單也不當作現行供應或認證。
history.textEn: The Environment Agency technical report carries an August 2011 copyright date, although its landing-page title retains 2010; this course distinguishes the document date from that label. Severnside South completed in 2006, and a 2020 maintenance release shows continuing management of joints and ground seepage. Beales Corner reached operational completion in September 2025 while minor landscaping continued. Cologne’s operator separately describes staged interaction of fixed and mobile defences with river level. The course copies no city operating trigger and treats historical product listings as neither current availability nor certification.

history.text: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年河岸土壤生物工程補編，將河趾、岸坡與洪氾平原的處理方式分開討論，並收錄佛蒙特州威努斯基河背景。二〇二〇年國家層級護岸標準目錄另提醒實作須依地方文件。雷赫河一九九八年啟動的復育計畫則提供河川動態與棲地共存的尺度參照。本課不聲稱這些案例採用相同工法，所有荷載及材料數字均為獨立教材假設。
history.textEn: The 2007 NRCS soil bioengineering supplement distinguishes treatments at the toe, bank and floodplain and includes Winooski River context in Vermont. These references do not imply identical construction methods. All loads and material quantities in the exercises are independently chosen teaching assumptions.

history.title: 河床固床工設計
history.text: 美國自然資源保育署二〇〇七年固床技術補編同時討論水理、沖刷與河道反應，案例包括伊利諾州藍溪的一九九七與二〇〇二年縱斷面，以及曼尼托巴省明克溪的塊石構造。這些圖說年份是調查資料年代，不等同施工或完工年代。另以工程兵團泥砂手冊釐清希爾茲參數的定義，避免把任一輸砂公式的臨界值套用到所有河床。
history.textEn: The 2007 NRCS grade stabilization supplement considers hydraulics, scour and channel response. Its examples include Blue Creek profiles dated 1997 and 2002 and a loose rock structure at Mink Creek in Manitoba. Profile dates identify survey evidence rather than construction or completion. The Corps sediment reference provides the Shields definition and explains why critical parameters must correspond to the chosen transport formulation. The lesson uses original numerical examples rather than reproducing case design values.

Named cases and public dates do not turn the independently chosen exercise inputs into field measurements.

history.title: 河川再蜿蜒工程
history.text: 歐洲環境署對斯凱恩河的資料指出，一九六八年河道整治後，於一九九九至二〇〇三年間進行復育；其一九九二與二〇一八年正射影像是比較資料，而不是施工起訖。雷赫河則於一九九八年啟動流域復育計畫。兩地提供不同治理尺度的參照，本課不把舊資料中的預定完成日期改寫成已完成事實，也不以歐洲案例替代其他氣候地區的場址調查。
history.textEn: The EEA account of the Skjern records channelization in 1968 and restoration during 1999 to 2003. Its 1992 and 2018 orthophotos are comparison evidence, not construction dates. The Regge programme began in 1998 and provides another scale of restoration governance. An old anticipated completion date is not restated as an achieved milestone. Neither European example replaces site investigations in other climates; the calculations explore independently specified channel and floodplain scenarios.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 洪水預報與水庫聯合操作
history.titleEn: Flood forecasting and coordinated reservoir operation
history.text: 俄羅斯河預報知情操作研究自二〇一四年起發展，公開案例包括門多西諾湖與索諾瑪湖。另一地區的美國氣象局中大西洋河川預報中心於二〇一七年底開始試行集合水文產品，不能把兩者寫成同一計畫。HEC 水庫網路手冊提供水庫、河段、節點與出口的概念分類。本課引用這些不同來源建立方法脈絡，並以原創集合與庫容數字檢查預報如何進入可追溯的操作比較。
history.textEn: Russian River forecast informed operations research has developed since 2014, with Lake Mendocino and Lake Sonoma as named cases. In another region, the Mid Atlantic River Forecast Center began experimental ensemble products in late 2017. These are distinct programmes. The HEC reservoir network manual distinguishes reservoirs, reaches, junctions and outlets. Together the references establish methodological context, while original ensemble and storage numbers demonstrate how forecasts enter traceable comparisons of operating alternatives.

history.title: 海堤越波模型試驗
history.text: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。
history.textEn: The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 拋石防波堤施工
history.text: 本課的知識脈絡採用可核對的工程文獻，而不替工法編造單一發明年份。美國工兵團官方目錄列出二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊分冊；越波研究團隊於二〇〇七年發布首版手冊，二〇一八年第二版擴展結構型式、試驗與結果解釋。香港海港手冊持續列出勘誤，提醒設計引用必須指定版本。紐比金灣與博斯是海岸防護和監測的比較案例，不表示兩地採用了本課每項構件或假設尺寸。歷史資料用於理解方法演進，合成數據則另作學徒推理練習。
history.textEn: The knowledge history follows verifiable publications rather than inventing a single date when the technique was created. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual parts in2002. The overtopping authors issued the first manual in2007 and expanded structural types, testing and interpretation in the2018 edition. Hong Kong continues to list corrigenda, demonstrating why an applied design must identify its reference version. Newbiggin Bay and Borth are comparisons of coastal protection and monitoring, not claims that both used every component or assumed dimension in this course. Publication history explains methodological development; synthetic values separately support the apprentice exercises.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 沉箱式防波堤施工
history.text: 沉箱方法的教學重點是狀態轉換，不用單一建成年份代替全部知識歷史。日本港灣空港研究所於二〇一二年公布釜石防波堤研究，針對二〇一一年海嘯事件指出越流與背面負壓等機制。新加坡主管機關記錄二〇一六年大士港首座沉箱，以及二〇一九年第一期最後沉箱的安裝；這是碼頭建造比較，並非同一海嘯受力案例。香港及美國官方指南提供一般工程框架，仍須配合實際地盤、波況和施工階段。課程數值全為原創假設，不冒充兩地原設計圖或現場性能。
history.textEn: The teaching emphasis is the transition between caisson states rather than one construction year standing for the entire history. PARI published its Kamaishi investigation in2012 after the2011 tsunami, addressing overflow and rear-side pressure mechanisms. Singapore records the first Tuas caisson installation in2016 and the final Phase1 installation in2019. That quay project provides a construction comparison, not an identical tsunami load case. Hong Kong and US official guidance supply a general engineering framework requiring actual ground, waves and staging. Every numerical example is original and synthetic, not an original design drawing or measured performance from either location.

history.title: 消波塊製作與安放
history.text: 本課以不同用途的混凝土海事構件對照材料與形狀的重要性，不把所有消波塊視為同一產品。美國官方目錄列二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊；新加坡在二〇一六年記錄大士港首座沉箱，提供大型混凝土製造的比較背景。荷蘭主管機關二〇二五年介紹阿夫魯戴克專用護面構件的粗糙外形與空隙，說明形狀、水理和安放接觸需要一起處理。碼頭沉箱不是消波塊，兩者只在材料生產與追溯觀念上比較。課程所有配比、質量及試驗值都是合成假設，並非專利構件的製造規格或專案驗收標準。
history.textEn: The course compares concrete maritime components to show why material and shape both matter, rather than treating every armour unit as one product. USACE lists its Coastal Engineering Manual in2002. Singapore records the first Tuas caisson in2016, providing a large-concrete fabrication comparison. In2025 the Dutch owner described roughness and voids in dedicated Afsluitdijk armour elements, linking shape, hydraulics and contacts. A quay caisson is not an armour block; the comparison concerns production and traceability only. Every mixture, mass and test value in the lessons is synthetic, not a proprietary manufacturing specification or project acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海岸養灘工程
history.text: 養灘的發展不只在搬進更多砂，也在於追蹤砂如何沿岸與跨岸再分布。英國官方記錄海灘管理手冊更新計畫於二〇〇七年開始、二〇一一年完成，重視維護及績效；網頁後來發布的年份不等於手冊完成年份。荷蘭主管機關確認沙引擎於二〇一一年施工，利用自然作用逐步搬運材料。二〇一三年錫爾迪金調查則展示博斯等海岸的連續剖面監測，提醒單一季節不足以代表長期趨勢。本課以這些文件建立觀測觀念，所有砂量、粒徑與速度算例均為原創假設，不聲稱重現專案績效。
history.textEn: Nourishment development concerns tracking cross-shore and alongshore redistribution as well as delivering sand. The UK authority records a manual-update project beginning in2007 and completing in2011, with maintenance and performance emphasized; the later webpage publication date is not the manual-completion date. The Dutch owner confirms construction of the Sand Motor in2011 using natural redistribution. The2013 Ceredigion survey illustrates repeated profiles at Borth and other beaches, warning against equating one season with a long-term trend. These sources establish observational context; every volume, size and velocity calculation here is synthetic rather than a reproduction of project performance.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 離岸潛堤地形整合
history.text: 潛堤教學需要同時閱讀結構水理與地形監測，而不能以單一工程照片代表因果。美國官方目錄列二〇〇二年海岸工程手冊，香港手冊另整理海事結構方法並持續公布勘誤。荷蘭二〇一一年沙引擎是自然砂移動的比較案例，不是假稱有本課潛堤。錫爾迪金二〇一三年報告記錄博斯工程後的剖面與鄰岸變化，可用來討論岩礁、補灘和觀測期之間的關聯。紐比金離岸防波堤只比較遮蔽功能，沒有宣稱與博斯具有相同淹水幾何。所有透射、流量與剪力值均為合成教學情境。
history.textEn: Submerged-breakwater teaching requires structural hydraulics together with morphology monitoring; one project photograph cannot establish causation. The official US catalogue lists its2002 coastal manual, while Hong Kong maintains maritime guidance and corrigenda. The2011 Sand Motor compares natural sediment movement and is not claimed to contain the submerged structure modeled here. Ceredigion’s2013 report records profiles and neighboring changes after Borth works, supporting discussion of reefs, nourishment and observation periods. Newbiggin provides a sheltering-function comparison, without claiming identical submergence geometry. Every transmission, discharge and shear value in these lessons is a synthetic teaching assumption.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 港池航道疏浚
history.text: 港灣疏浚同時包含航行幾何、材料移動與環境介面，不能只用挖泥船大小描述技術演進。二〇一五年工兵團手冊整理新挖、維護和疏浚物管理；二〇二二年薩凡納港官方紀錄明確指加深疏浚部分完成，而非所有配套同日完工。國際水道組織二〇二四年第六點二版標準提供品質與用途框架，不等於設備操作說明。本課另以巴爾的摩航道材料進入波普勒島復育的歷程說明來源與去向必須連結。所有設備、方量和淨空數字都是合成練習，不是上述專案的實際作業資料。
history.textEn: Harbor dredging combines navigation geometry, material movement and environmental interfaces rather than simply the size of dredging machinery. The2015 USACE manual addresses new work, maintenance and material management. The2022 Savannah release specifically records completion of deepening dredging, not all associated works on the same date. IHO’s2024 edition6.2.0 provides survey-quality and intended-use context rather than equipment instructions. Baltimore-channel material used at Poplar Island separately illustrates the link between source and destination. Equipment, volume and clearance values throughout the course are synthetic exercises, not operating records from these projects.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 疏浚泥沙有益利用
history.text: 將疏浚物視為資源並不表示省略品質與場址評估。官方資料記錄波普勒島於一九九八年開始圍堤施工，二〇〇七年取得擴建授權，展現航道材料與島嶼棲地目標相互結合的長期工作。美國環保署與工兵團一九九八年試驗手冊提供物理、化學及生物評估背景；二〇一五年疏浚管理手冊則整合材料去向觀念。末底改島二〇一五年放置後仍持續觀測地形與生物，提醒完成施工不等於效果永久不變。本課所有比例、厚度和排放係數是原創情境，不將特定案例結果複製為普遍承諾。
history.textEn: Treating dredged material as a resource does not remove quality or site evaluation. Official accounts record Poplar Island containment construction beginning in1998 and expansion authorization in2007, linking navigation material with long-term habitat objectives. The1998 EPA-USACE testing manual supplies physical, chemical and biological evaluation context, while the2015 dredging manual integrates material destinations. Following2015 placement at Mordecai Island, morphology and ecological monitoring continued, demonstrating why construction completion is not permanent performance. Every fraction, thickness and emissions factor here is an original synthetic scenario, not a universal promise drawn from a single project.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型港口沉箱碼頭
history.text: 沉箱碼頭與沉箱防波堤共享大型製造及基床接觸問題，但背填、船舶和岸上設備形成不同受力路徑。新加坡主管機關列大士港第一期首座沉箱在二〇一六年安裝，二〇一九年完成最後一座，二〇二一年宣布第一期填海完成；這些里程碑不等於全港所有期別同時營運。香港手冊提供一般海事與岸壁背景，仍須核對適用勘誤。釜石只作海事沉箱功能比較，不能將防波堤海嘯受力移作碼頭背填模型。課程刻意分開土壓、水壓、護舷及地基作用，全部數值都是原創合成假設。
history.textEn: Caisson quays and breakwaters share fabrication and bedding questions but have different load paths from backfill, vessels and terminal equipment. Singapore records the first Phase1 Tuas caisson in2016, the last in2019 and completion of Phase1 reclamation in2021; these milestones do not imply simultaneous operation of every port phase. Hong Kong guidance supplies maritime and waterfront context subject to applicable corrigenda. Kamaishi serves only as a functional comparison of marine caissons, not a source for replacing quay backfill with tsunami loading. The course separates earth, water, fender and foundation actions using entirely synthetic numerical assumptions.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 棧橋式碼頭樁基
history.text: 棧橋碼頭把平台荷載經樁傳入海床，與重力沉箱的連續底面接觸有不同分析需求。一九九一年工兵團樁基手冊涵蓋調查、試樁與設計；香港碼頭與繫船墩分冊另提供海事使用背景，實際應用仍須核對現行修訂。洛杉磯港官方紀錄一七七至一八二號碼頭重建在二〇二三年開始、二〇二五年完成，工程議程包含混凝土樁與新碼頭。本課鋼管幾何只是另一材料情境，不把它說成該專案規格。北角碼頭則比較公共通達功能。十個算例以原創數據串起截面、土阻、變形、沖刷及耐久。
history.textEn: A pile-supported pier transfers deck loads into the seabed through discrete members, unlike continuous base contact beneath a gravity caisson. The1991 USACE manual addresses exploration, testing and pile design, while Hong Kong pier-and-dolphin guidance adds maritime context subject to current revisions. Los Angeles records Berths177–182 restoration beginning in2023 and completing in2025, with official agenda material identifying concrete piles and a new wharf. Steel-pipe geometry here is a separate material scenario, not that project’s specification. Pak Kok provides a public-access comparison. Ten original numerical exercises connect sections, soil resistance, deformation, scour and durability.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 浮動碼頭繫泊系統
history.text: 浮碼頭讓登船面隨潮升降，但也把浮體、繫泊和岸上引橋連成同一系統。香港主管機關記錄二〇二一年海岸風險研究，並以馬料水與三門仔浮台作水位調適背景；二〇二五年九月新馬料水碼頭啟用公告明列浮台與引橋。現行美國官方書目在二〇二六年九月列小型船舶靠泊設施新版，舊站仍有較早版本，因此引用必須標明版本及已閱讀範圍。本課不聲稱取得這些碼頭的纜具配置，所有重量、角度及剛度均為合成示意，用來辨識浮力與力路徑如何耦合。
history.textEn: Floating docks follow tide but couple the pontoon, mooring and shore gangway into one system. Hong Kong records its2021 coastal-hazards study and identifies Ma Liu Shui and Sam Mun Tsai pontoons in an adaptation context; the September2025 opening announcement explicitly describes the new Ma Liu Shui platform and gangway. The current US catalogue lists a September2026 small-craft guide while a legacy site retains older issues, requiring clear version and reading-scope identification. This course does not claim access to those piers’ mooring configurations. All weights, angles and stiffnesses are synthetic illustrations of buoyancy and coupled load paths.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
history.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
history.text: 大型船閘的改進不只在增加閘室尺寸，也包含灌排分布、瞬變與船舶控制的共同驗證。工兵團二〇〇六年船閘水理手冊提供研究與操作經驗的方法背景，二〇一八年廊道閥手冊再聚焦控制構件。巴拿馬官方紀錄二〇一六年六月九日進行新閘試航訓練，同月二十六日完成阿瓜克拉拉與科科利首航，顯示整合試驗在啟用前的重要位置。本課沒有重建真實閥門時程，也未把新閘滾動門稱作人字門；各式只解釋水量、能量、壓力和船舶受力的不同機制，全部數值皆合成。
history.textEn: Improving large locks involves filling distribution, transients and vessel control as well as chamber size. USACE’s2006 manual supplies research and operational-method context, while the2018 culvert-valve manual focuses on control components. Panama records training transits on9June2016 and inaugural passage through Agua Clara and Cocoli on26June, placing integrated trials before opening. This course does not reconstruct actual valve schedules or mislabel new-lock rolling gates as miter gates. Its equations distinguish volume, energy, pressure and vessel-force mechanisms using entirely synthetic values rather than measured operating settings.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 閘室節水池設計
history.text: 船閘節水的發展需要把通航能力與水資源管理一起考量。美國工兵團二〇〇六年水理手冊整理充排水研究與操作經驗，二〇一八年另有廊道閥門水理手冊。巴拿馬主管機關在二〇一六年二月公布阿瓜克拉拉首個節水池蓄水試驗，同年六月擴建運河啟用；阿瓜克拉拉與科科利提供兩個同一計畫內的真實案例。官方所述回用比例是新船閘內的分配，與舊船閘比較另有分母。本課不複製實際控制程序，所有面積和時間皆為原創教學情境。
history.textEn: Lock water saving develops alongside navigation capacity and water-resource management. The2006 USACE hydraulic manual compiles research and operating experience, with separate culvert-valve guidance in2018. Panama announced the first Agua Clara basin filling test in February2016, followed by expanded-canal inauguration that June. Agua Clara and Cocoli provide two real examples within the same program. The owner’s reuse fraction describes allocation within the new locks and has a different denominator from comparison with old locks. No real control sequence is reproduced; all areas and timings are original teaching scenarios.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 船閘人字門安裝
history.text: 人字門靠兩葉斜接與側部支承傳力，其安裝重點包含幾何、接觸與機械系統整合。巴拿馬主管機關記錄加通於一九一三年九月二十六日首次試通航，並說明原有船閘的人字門型式；擴建新閘使用滾動門，不能混用支承與施工假設。工兵團二〇二二年鋼構設計與二〇二五年機電手冊提供不同專業範圍，威爾遜二〇二五年修復紀錄則展示軸承板對位的實務背景。本課不提供吊裝或啟閉操作方案，各計算只是合成的力學與量測練習，需與真實設備及核准程序分開。
history.textEn: Miter gates transmit load through leaf contact and side support, making geometry, bearing and machinery integration central to installation. Panama records Gatun’s first trial lockage on26September1913 and identifies the original miter-gate form; new expansion locks use rolling gates, requiring different support and construction assumptions. USACE’s2022 steel-design and2025 equipment manuals cover distinct professional scopes, while Wilson’s2025 repair record illustrates bearing-plate alignment. This course supplies no lifting or operating plan. Its calculations are synthetic mechanics and measurement exercises, separated from actual equipment requirements and approved procedures.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 河口鹽水入侵控制
history.text: 河口阻鹽不是單一擋牆問題，淡水流量、潮汐交換、分層與排水功能都會互相影響。一九九一年潮汐水理手冊提供方法背景，二〇一九年美國地質調查局電導章節則強調量測品質。二〇二三年密西西比河低水期間的水下門檻是延緩鹽楔的場址措施，不能改寫成永久消除入侵。艾默伊登主管機關於二〇二五年四月回報，前一年末進入測試的鹽壩對排水影響大於預期，正說明功能互制必須經實測查核。本課合成數據分別練習守恆、分層和損失，不把局部排鹽效率當成整體成效保證。
history.textEn: Estuary salt control is not simply a barrier problem: freshwater flow, tidal exchange, stratification and drainage interact. The1991 tidal manual supplies methodology, while USGS’s2019 conductance chapter emphasizes measurement quality. The2023 Mississippi sill is a site intervention to delay a salt wedge, not permanent elimination of intrusion. In April2025 the IJmuiden authority reported greater-than-expected drainage effects during testing that began late the previous year, demonstrating why coupled functions require observations. Synthetic examples separately examine conservation, stratification and losses; local salt-export efficiency is not presented as a guarantee of successful whole-system performance.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 海岸濕地復育水理
history.text: Nisqually河口在2009年移除舊Brown Farm堤防後恢復潮汐影響，官方紀錄強調合作與後續監測。南灣鹽田復育計畫於2003年啟動，2007年完成長期規劃，2009年開始第一期施工，顯示復育是分階段學習與調整的過程。這些案例的地形、潮汐與生態條件不同，不能套用相同開口或植生設定。本課以獨立教學算例練習水量、鹽量和泥砂守恆，再比較地表高程與海面變化，讓工程完成與生態成效驗證成為可分別檢查的問題。
history.textEn: Nisqually restored tidal influence after removal of the old Brown Farm Dike in 2009, with official records emphasizing partnership and subsequent monitoring. South Bay restoration launched in 2003, completed long-term planning in 2007 and began Phase 1 construction in 2009, illustrating staged learning and adjustment. Different terrain, tides and ecological conditions prevent direct transfer of openings or vegetation assumptions. Independent teaching examples examine water, salt and sediment conservation and compare surface elevation with sea level, separating construction completion from evidence of ecological response.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下水人工補注設施
history.text: 人工補注不是單純把水倒入地下，而是水源處理、地表設施、包氣帶與含水層共同作用的系統。橘郡GWRS官方問答記錄2008年啟用，並在2015與2023年擴建，提供水回用與地下水管理的背景。USGS於2013年發表Sand Hollow補注研究，利用水力及水化學資料探討氣體相關效應。兩者不是相同地質或相同處理系統，本課以比較方式學習證據如何支持判斷，所有簡式參數均為獨立假設，不將案例成果直接移植到未調查的場址。
history.textEn: Managed recharge links source treatment, surface facilities, the vadose zone and aquifers. OCWD records GWRS commissioning in 2008 and expansions in 2015 and 2023 as context for reuse and groundwater management. A USGS Sand Hollow study published in 2013 examines gas-related effects using hydraulic and hydrochemical observations. These examples have different geology and treatment arrangements. The course compares how evidence supports interpretation while keeping all simplified-model parameters hypothetical rather than transferring case outcomes to an uninvestigated site.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 地下水屏障防止海水入侵
history.text: 南加州海水屏障把人工補注用於改善沿海地下水壓力，並需要持續監測鹽度。WRD人員撰寫的ITRC案例列出西海岸盆地屏障1953年、Alamitos屏障1964年及Dominguez屏障1971年的建設里程碑。橘郡水區另記錄1965年在Alamitos首次注入進口水，這是不同事件而不是日期矛盾。這些案例說明屏障是水力管理系統，需要水源、含水層與監測機關協作；本課不沿用現場注入設定，而以原創理想算例學習何時簡化有效、何時必須改用密度耦合分析。
history.textEn: Southern California barriers use managed recharge to influence coastal groundwater pressure while monitoring salinity. A WRD-authored ITRC case records construction milestones in 1953 for West Coast Basin, 1964 for Alamitos and 1971 for Dominguez. OCWD separately records its first imported-water injection at Alamitos in 1965, a different milestone rather than a contradictory date. The cases illustrate coordination of water supply, aquifer management and monitoring. Original idealized calculations explain useful simplifications and their limits without transferring field operating settings.

history.title: 雨水貯留與非飲用供水
history.text: 舊金山公用事業委員會的2022年案例集記錄了2012年總部建築及其雨水系統，提供建築尺度水回用的歷史例子。美國能源部另列Fort Buchanan以雨水沖廁的非飲用案例，並提供雨水收集技術指南。本課使用這些背景說明集水、貯留與用途邊界的差別，不推定設施至今沒有改裝，也不把其他飲用雨水專案的規格直接移用。課程中的所有容積、流量與效率均為獨立教學假設，重點是能重現的水量帳和證據。
history.textEn: The SFPUC 2022 case collection documents its headquarters completed in 2012 and a rainwater system as a historical building-scale example. DOE separately lists nonpotable rainwater flushing at Fort Buchanan and provides harvesting guidance. These contexts distinguish collection, storage and use boundaries without assuming unchanged present configurations or transferring specifications from potable projects. All course volumes, flows and efficiencies are independent teaching assumptions, emphasizing reproducible accounting and evidence rather than a site installation prescription.

history.title: 水利設施數位孿生
history.text: 樟宜水再生廠的數位孿生合作在官方紀錄中始於2019年，並在2022年獲得國際水協會創新獎。配水系統的EPANET與製造領域的數位孿生可信度研究，提供不同模型範圍的比較入口。本課不把一套管網工具當作整座處理廠的完整替代，也不宣稱另一座獲獎海淡廠採用相同平台。學習重點是明確定義模型用途、資料交換與驗證證據，將真實工程背景和獨立的教學假設區分。
history.textEn: PUB records the Changi digital-twin collaboration from 2019 and an international innovation award in 2022. Distribution-network modeling and manufacturing credibility research provide comparisons across different model scopes. This course does not equate a pipe-network tool with a complete treatment-plant simulator or claim that another award-winning desalination plant uses the same platform. The learning goal is to define purpose, information exchange and validation evidence while separating documented history from independently assumed teaching models.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘
related.transfer: 可遷移「浮運吃水與壓載」與「止水縫漏流診斷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Floating draft and ballast" and "Seal leakage diagnosis" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦浮運沉降、球鉸傳力與風暴期間可靠度的共同分析；荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘則以潮汐交換、基礎保護與巨型閘門荷載的共同約束為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on joint analysis of flotation, sinking, spherical-joint loading and storm reliability; Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier centres on coupled constraints on tidal exchange, foundation protection and large gate loads, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「浮運吃水與壓載」與「開口流速與收縮」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到荷蘭東斯海爾德防潮閘，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「潮位滯後與上浮」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Floating draft and ballast” and “Opening velocity and contraction”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Oosterschelde storm-surge barrier, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Tidal lag and uplift", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「集水區逕流峰值」與「鹽水入侵質量平衡」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Catchment runoff peak" and "Salt intrusion mass balance" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Venice MOSE flood barriers must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦都市逕流、潮位排水、抽水能源與水庫水質；威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統則以浮動翻板、壓縮空氣與潟湖環境的耦合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on urban runoff, tidal drainage, pumping energy and reservoir water quality; Venice MOSE flood barriers centres on coupling buoyant flap gates, compressed air and lagoon environmental response, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「集水區逕流峰值」與「浮力翻轉與重心」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到威尼斯 MOSE 防潮系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「關閉潟湖降雨收支」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Catchment runoff peak” and “Buoyant rotation and centroids”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Venice MOSE flood barriers, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Rainfall balance in an isolated lagoon", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的水利與海岸設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
related.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring water and coastal works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 三峽升船機
related.transfer: 可遷移「船廂水位與額外質量」與「配重行程與幾何邊界」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；三峽升船機的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Caisson level and extra mass" and "Counterweight travel and geometric limits" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Three Gorges ship lift must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦纜索承載、雙船廂獨立性與高架航道銜接；三峽升船機則以高提升船廂的配重、齒條同步與對接邊界為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on cable load sharing, independent caissons and elevated-reach interfaces; Three Gorges ship lift centres on counterweights, rack synchronization and docking boundaries of a high-lift caisson, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「船廂水位與額外質量」與「船舶排水與船廂質量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到三峽升船機，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「對接水位差作用」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Caisson level and extra mass” and “Vessel displacement and caisson mass”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Three Gorges ship lift, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Docking head-difference force", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 水壩地震動力分析
related.transfer: 可遷移「測深網格與挖方」與「沉澱面積與表面負荷」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；水壩地震動力分析的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Bathymetric grid and excavation volume" and "Settling area and surface loading" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Seismic dynamic analysis of dams must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦串連測深乾砂質量泥漿輸送與回流水的疏浚工程；水壩地震動力分析則以從模態質量與輸入歷時辨識水壩動力分析的假設界限為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「測深網格與挖方」與「模態質量與週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到水壩地震動力分析，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「附加水質量與週期」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” and “Modal mass and period”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic dynamic analysis of dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Added water mass and period", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Bathymetric grid and excavation volume” and “Geometry ratio and reference length”.

related.title: 水壩地震動力分析

practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「幾何比例與控制長度」與「模態質量與週期」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。

Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Seismic dynamic analysis of dams, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Added water mass and period", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

references.title: 水工實驗室技術手冊

references.scopeEn: Official chapter explains equal Froude numbers in free-surface models; this does not also match viscosity, surface tension or air effects.

references.title: 水工模型研究官方目錄
references.scope: 官方目錄列二〇一五年克利埃勒姆魚道研究及二〇一八年福爾松附加溢洪道閘門模型；本課為方法比較。
references.scopeEn: Official catalogue lists2015 Cle Elum fish-passage studies and2018 Folsom auxiliary-spillway gate modeling; lessons compare methods rather than site results.

related.title: 壓力鋼管錨定與支承

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Paired reservoir water balance” and “Circumferential membrane stress”.

Using "Span and beam reactions", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 調壓井水錘控制

related.transfer: 可遷移「縱斷面與局部壓力機理與驗證」與「差異沉陷與接頭轉角機理與驗證」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；輸水管線洩漏聲學定位的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。

related.differenceEn: This course focuses on alignment, bedding, joints and staged load transfer in large mains; Acoustic leak location in water mains centres on leak-noise propagation, time-delay location and uncertainty validation, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「縱斷面與局部壓力」與「漏口能量與聲源形成」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到輸水管線洩漏聲學定位，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「傳播衰減與感測器耦合機理與驗證」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Alignment and local pressure” and “Leak energy and acoustic generation”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Acoustic leak location in water mains, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Attenuation and sensor coupling mechanism and verification", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 河床固床工設計
related.transfer: 可遷移「河岸剪力的尺度」與「纖維毯搭接與淨覆蓋」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；河床固床工設計的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Scales of bank shear" and "Mat overlap and effective coverage" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Riverbed grade-control structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦以水流荷載、活體建立與河岸監測共同設計護岸；河床固床工設計則以由河床縱坡、能量耗散與泥砂連續性設計固床工為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on designing bank protection through hydraulic loads, plant establishment and monitoring; Riverbed grade-control structures centres on designing grade control through bed slope, energy dissipation and sediment continuity, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「河岸剪力的尺度」與「落差配置與縱坡」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到河床固床工設計，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「濾層粒徑的相容比較」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Scales of bank shear” and “Drop spacing and longitudinal slope”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Riverbed grade-control structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Filter grading compatibility", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 大型船閘灌排水系統
related.titleEn: Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks
related.transfer: 可遷移「閘室升降水量」與「連通廊道瞬時流量」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；大型船閘灌排水系統的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Chamber lift volume" and "Instantaneous connecting-culvert discharge" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦沿閘室節水池水量能量與誤差收支檢查回用機制；大型船閘灌排水系統則以從水量平衡到瞬變與船舶受力理解大型船閘灌排系統為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on examine lock-basin reuse through chamber water, energy and uncertainty balances; Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks centres on understand large-lock filling through water balance, transients and vessel forces, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「閘室升降水量」與「閘室有效水量」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到大型船閘灌排水系統，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「射流動量與導流」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Chamber lift volume” and “Effective chamber water volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Filling and emptying systems for navigation locks, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Jet momentum and redirection", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 雨水貯留與非飲用供水
related.transfer: 可遷移「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「保留驗證資料與殘差指標」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；雨水貯留與非飲用供水的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Network topology and balance residuals" and "Held-out validation and residual metrics" transfer, while hydraulic boundaries, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦守恆、時間同步、狀態估計與可重現決策；雨水貯留與非飲用供水則以集水水量、儲槽時序、可靠度與用途隔離為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on conservation, time alignment, state estimation and reproducible decisions; Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply centres on catchment yield, storage timing, reliability and separated uses, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「網路拓樸與守恆殘差」與「屋頂集水與逕流體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到雨水貯留與非飲用供水，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Network topology and balance residuals” and “Roof catchment and runoff volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Rainwater storage and nonpotable supply, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
